def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def json_bytes(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n').encode()


def full_fenced_document(title, explanation, items):
    output = bytearray((f'# {title}\n\n# Responsibility: supply every listed current file body in full with exact paths and code fences; never substitute a summary or an elision.\n\n{explanation}\n\n').encode())
    records = []
    for item in items:
        data = item['data']
        text = data.decode('utf-8')
        longest = max([len(match.group(0)) for match in re.finditer(r'`+', text)] + [2])
        fence = '`' * max(3, longest + 1)
        language = {'.ts': 'typescript', '.js': 'javascript', '.mjs': 'javascript', '.cjs': 'javascript', '.json': 'json', '.md': 'markdown', '.csv': 'csv', '.py': 'python', '.txt': 'text', '.log': 'text', '.tsv': 'text'}.get(Path(item['path']).suffix, 'text')

        offset = len(output)
        output.extend(data)
        if not data.endswith(b'\n'):
            output.extend(b'\n')
        output.extend((f'{fence}\n\n').encode())
        records.append({'number': item.get('number'), 'absolutePath': str(item['path']), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': digest(data), 'bodyByteOffset': offset})
    result = bytes(output)
    for item, record in zip(items, records):
        assert result[record['bodyByteOffset']:record['bodyByteOffset'] + record['bytes']] == item['data']
    return result, records

Responsibility: ensures failed reads cannot become permissive empty values and audits exceptions.\n/**\n * Fail-soft reads (round 8).\n *\n * A database read that fails is an error, not \"no rows\". Before this change\n * about 300 data-access methods caught every storage error and answered an\n * empty list, null, 0 or false, so an outage looked like \"nothing there\" -\n * and four of those answers failed OPEN: a restriction check said \"not\n * restricted\", a closed-period check said \"open\", a session-revocation check\n * said \"not revoked\" and an SSO-enforcement check said \"not enforced\".\n *\n * The methods now let the error propagate (the global PrismaExceptionFilter\n * maps it to a status without leaking the driver message); update/delete\n * methods keep `null`/`false` only for Prisma P2025 (record not found).\n *\n * The last block is a guard: it scans every non-spec module file for the\n * catch-everything-and-answer-empty shape and compares the result with an\n * explicit allowlist, so a new fail-soft read cannot be added silently.\n */\n\nconst STORAGE_DOWN = new Error('connection terminated unexpectedly');\n\nfunction asyncMock(): jest.Mock<(...args: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>> {\n  return jest.fn<(...args: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>>();\n}\n\ndescribe('isRecordNotFound', () => {\n  it('recognises Prisma P2025 as \"not found\"', () => {\n    const known = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Record to update not found.', {\n      code: 'P2025',\n      clientVersion: 'test',\n    });\n    expect(isRecordNotFound(known)).toBe(true);\n    expect(isRecordNotFound({ code: 'P2025' })).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('treats every other failure as an error', () => {\n    const unique = new Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError('Unique constraint failed', {\n      code: 'P2002',\n      clientVersion: 'test',\n    });\n    expect(isRecordNotFound(unique)).toBe(false);\n    expect(isRecordNotFound(STORAGE_DOWN)).toBe(false);\n    expect(isRecordNotFound({ code: '57014' })).toBe(false);\n    expect(isRecordNotFound(null)).toBe(false);\n    expect(isRecordNotFound(undefined)).toBe(false);\n    expect(isRecordNotFound('P2025')).toBe(false);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('fail-open checks now fail closed (the error propagates)', () => {\n  it('AccountRestrictionService.hasRestriction: a failed read is not \"no restriction\"', async () => {\n    const prisma = { accountRestriction: { findFirst: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN) } };\n    const service = new AccountRestrictionService(prisma as any, {} as any);\n    await expect(\n      service.hasRestriction({ tenantId: 't1', accountId: 'a1', restrictionType: 'TRADING_BLOCK' as any }),\n    ).rejects.toBe(STORAGE_DOWN);\n  });\n\n  it('AccountRestrictionService.hasRestriction still answers true/false from a successful read', async () => {\n    const findFirst = asyncMock().mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'r1' }).mockResolvedValueOnce(null);\n    const service = new AccountRestrictionService({ accountRestriction: { findFirst } } as any, {} as any);\n    const params = { tenantId: 't1', accountId: 'a1', restrictionType: 'TRADING_BLOCK' as any };\n    await expect(service.hasRestriction(params)).resolves.toBe(true);\n    await expect(service.hasRestriction(params)).resolves.toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('AccountingPeriodService.isPeriodClosed: a failed read is not \"period open\"', async () => {\n    const prisma = { portfolioAccountingPeriod: { findFirst: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN) } };\n    const service = new AccountingPeriodService(prisma as any, {} as any);\n    await expect(service.isPeriodClosed({ tenantId: 't1', profileId: 'p1', at: new Date() })).rejects.toBe(STORAGE_DOWN);\n  });\n\n  it('SessionSecurityService.isSessionRevoked: a failed read is not \"not revoked\"', async () => {\n    const prisma = { userSession: { findUnique: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN) } };\n    const cache = { get: asyncMock().mockResolvedValue(null) };\n    const service = new SessionSecurityService(prisma as any, {} as any, {} as any, {} as any, cache as any);\n    await expect(service.isSessionRevoked('s1')).rejects.toBe(STORAGE_DOWN);\n  });\n\n  it('SessionSecurityService.isSessionRevoked still honours the cache and the stored revokedAt', async () => {\n    const findUnique = asyncMock().mockResolvedValue({ revokedAt: new Date() });\n    const cache = { get: asyncMock().mockResolvedValueOnce({ reason: 'x' }).mockResolvedValueOnce(null) };\n    const service = new SessionSecurityService({ userSession: { findUnique } } as any, {} as any, {} as any, {} as any, cache as any);\n    await expect(service.isSessionRevoked('s1')).resolves.toBe(true);\n    await expect(service.isSessionRevoked('s1')).resolves.toBe(true);\n    expect(findUnique).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n  });\n\n  it('SessionSecurityService.revokeAllSessions: a failed read is not \"0 sessions revoked\"', async () => {\n    const prisma = { userSession: { findMany: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN) } };\n    const service = new SessionSecurityService(prisma as any, {} as any, {} as any, {} as any, { set: jest.fn() } as any);\n    await expect(service.revokeAllSessions({ userId: 'u1', tenantId: 't1', reason: 'password_changed' })).rejects.toBe(\n      STORAGE_DOWN,\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('SsoProviderFactory.isSsoEnforced / listTenantProviders: a failed read is not \"SSO not enforced\"', async () => {\n    const prisma = {\n      ssoConfiguration: {\n        findFirst: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN),\n        findMany: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN),\n      },\n    };\n    const factory = new SsoProviderFactory(prisma as any, {} as any, {} as any);\n    await expect(factory.isSsoEnforced('t1')).rejects.toBe(STORAGE_DOWN);\n    await expect(factory.listTenantProviders('t1')).rejects.toBe(STORAGE_DOWN);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('fail-soft reads now propagate', () => {\n  it('PaymentRepository lookups used by webhooks and idempotent retries do not report \"no such payment\" on failure', async () => {\n    const prisma = { payment: { findFirst: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN), findMany: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN) } };\n    const repository = new PaymentRepository(prisma as any);\n    await expect(repository.findByIdempotencyKey('idem-1', 't1')).rejects.toBe(STORAGE_DOWN);\n    await expect(repository.findByProviderPaymentId('pi_1', 'STRIPE' as any)).rejects.toBe(STORAGE_DOWN);\n    await expect(repository.list({ tenantId: 't1' } as any)).rejects.toBe(STORAGE_DOWN);\n  });\n\n  it('PaymentRepository still answers null for a payment that is really absent', async () => {\n    const prisma = { payment: { findFirst: asyncMock().mockResolvedValue(null) } };\n    await expect(new PaymentRepository(prisma as any).findByIdempotencyKey('idem-1', 't1')).resolves.toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('CostBasisService does not compute FIFO cost basis against an unread lot list', async () => {\n    const prisma = { portfolioPositionLot: { findMany: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN) } };\n    const policy = { resolvePolicy: asyncMock().mockResolvedValue({}) };\n    const service = new CostBasisService(prisma as any, {} as any, policy as any);\n    await expect(\n      service.calculateCostBasisForFill({\n        tenantId: 't1',\n        profileId: 'p1',\n        fill: {},\n        symbol: 'BTCUSDT',\n        quantity: '1',\n        price: '100',\n        side: 'SELL',\n        occurredAt: new Date(),\n        accountingEventId: 'e1',\n      }),\n    ).rejects.toBe(STORAGE_DOWN);\n  });\n\n  it('OperationalMetricsService does not publish zeros as measured observations', async () => {\n    const prisma = { operationalIncident: { findMany: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN) } };\n    const service = new OperationalMetricsService(prisma as any);\n    await expect(service.calculateMetrics({ tenantId: 't1', from: new Date(Date.now() - 3600_000), to: new Date() })).rejects.toBe(\n      STORAGE_DOWN,\n    );\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('CopySubscriptionRepository.updateState is tenant-scoped and distinguishes a missing row from storage failure', () => {\n  it('answers null when no row matches the tenant and expected state', async () => {\n    const prisma = { copySubscription: { updateMany: asyncMock().mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 }) } };\n    await expect(new CopySubscriptionRepository(prisma as any).updateState('s1', 't1', 'PAUSED' as any)).resolves.toBeNull();\n    expect(prisma.copySubscription.updateMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({ where: { id: 's1', tenantId: 't1' } }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('propagates any storage failure instead of claiming that the row is missing', async () => {\n    const prisma = { copySubscription: { updateMany: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN) } };\n    await expect(new CopySubscriptionRepository(prisma as any).updateState('s1', 't1', 'PAUSED' as any)).rejects.toBe(\n      STORAGE_DOWN,\n    );\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('health and reconciliation report a failed read as a failure, not as clean', () => {\n  it('DependencyHealthService.checkRisk is UNKNOWN (not HEALTHY with 0 policies) when the read fails', async () => {\n    const prisma = { institutionalRiskPolicy: { count: asyncMock().mockRejectedValue(STORAGE_DOWN) } };\n    const service = new DependencyHealthService(prisma as any, {} A replay by the\n *     same tenant still returns that tenant's original row.\n *  2. guard - every Prisma lookup in apps/api/src whose `where` uses an\n *     idempotency key carries `tenantId` as a TOP-LEVEL condition (inside an\n *     `OR` branch it would not scope the other branches), except the\n *     documented platform-level lookups;\n *  3. guard - schema.prisma has no field-level `idempotencyKey @unique` on a\n *     model whose tenantId is non-null; those models carry\n *     `@@unique([tenantId, idempotencyKey])`.\n */\n\nconst TENANT_A = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';\nconst TENANT_B = '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';\nconst PER_TENANT = ['tenantId', 'idempotencyKey'];\n\nfunction complianceOutbox(): OutboxService {\n  const outbox = new OutboxService();\n  jest.spyOn(outbox, 'append').mockImplementation(async (_transaction, event) => {\n    const reviewId = event.payload.reviewId;\n    const reasonCode = event.payload.reasonCode;\n    if (typeof reviewId !== 'string' || typeof reasonCode !== 'string') {\n      throw new Error('compliance review event must retain its validated payload');\n    }\n    return {\n      id: `outbox:${event.idempotencyKey}`,\n      tenantId: event.tenantId,\n      aggregateType: event.aggregateType,\n      aggregateId: event.aggregateId,\n      aggregateSequence: 1,\n      eventType: event.eventType,\n      payload: { reviewId, reasonCode },\n      idempotencyKey: event.idempotencyKey,\n      correlationId: event.correlationId ?? null,\n      createdAt: event.occurredAt ?? new Date(),\n    };\n  });\n  return outbox;\n}\n\ninterface ScopeCase {\n  name: string;\n  delegate: string;\n  create: (prisma: any, tenantId: string, idempotencyKey: string, variant: string) => Promise<unknown>;\n}\n\nconst CASES: ScopeCase[] = [\n  {\n    name: 'billing PayoutRepository.create',\n    delegate: 'payout',\n    create: (prisma, tenantId, idempotencyKey, variant) =>\n      new PayoutRepository(prisma, { append: jest.fn() } as never).create({\n        settlementId: `settlement-${variant}`,\n        beneficiaryId: `beneficiary-${variant}`,\n        beneficiaryType: 'TRADER' as any,\n        tenantId,\n        amount: '10.00',\n        currency: 'USD',\n        destination: { type: 'BANK', reference: `dest-${variant}` } as any,\n        provider: 'MANUAL' as any,\n        status: 'PENDING' as any,\n        idempotencyKey,\n      }),\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'billing BillingLedgerRepository.createEntry',\n    delegate: 'billingLedgerEntry',\n    create: (prisma, tenantId, idempotencyKey, variant) =>\n      new BillingLedgerRepository(prisma).createEntry({\n        tenantId,\n        accountCategory: 'REVENUE' as any,\n        entryType: 'CREDIT' as any,\n        amount: { amount: '5.00', currency: 'USD' } as any,\n        sourceType: 'INVOICE' as any,\n        sourceId: `source-${variant}`,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        description: `entry ${variant}`,\n      }),\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'billing NotificationJobRepository.create',\n    delegate: 'billingNotificationJob',\n    create: (prisma, tenantId, idempotencyKey, channel: 'EMAIL' as any,\n        templateKey: 'invoice-issued',\n        locale: 'en',\n        priority: 'NORMAL' as any,\n        category: 'BILLING' as any,\n        deliveryStatus: 'PENDING' as any,\n        maxAttempts: 3,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        safePayload: {},\n      }),\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'billing UsageEventRepository.create',\n    delegate: 'usageEvent',\n    create: (prisma, tenantId, idempotencyKey, variant) =>\n      new UsageEventRepository(prisma).create({\n        tenantId,\n        meterKey: 'api_calls' as any,\n        scope: 'TENANT' as any,\n        quantity: 1,\n        unit: 'COUNT' as any,\n        sourceType: 'test',\n        sourceId: `source-${variant}`,\n        sourceEventId: `event-${variant}`,\n        periodId: '2026-10',\n        periodType: 'MONTHLY' as any,\n        periodStart: new Date('2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'),\n        periodEnd: new Date('2026-11-01T00:00:00Z'),\n        timestamp: new Date('2026-10-02T00:00:00Z'),\n        idempotencyKey,\n        processingState: 'PENDING' as any,\n        dimensions: {},\n      }),\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'compliance ComplianceCaseRepository.createCase',\n    delegate: 'complianceCase',\n    create: (prisma, tenantId, idempotencyKey, variant) =>\n      new ComplianceCaseRepository(prisma, complianceOutbox()).createCase({\n        tenantId,\n        userId: `user-${variant}`,\n        caseType: 'AML_REVIEW' as any,\n        safeSummary: `case ${variant}`,\n        idempotencyKey,\n      }),\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'client-lifecycle displayName: `client ${variant}`, idempotencyKey }),\n  },\n  {\n    name: 'copy-trading CopySubscriptionRepository.create',\n    delegate: 'copySubscription',\n    create: (prisma, tenantId, '@jest/globals';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\nimport { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';\nimport { FeeAccrualRepository } from '../../modules/billing/fees/fee-accrual.repository';\nimport { FeeSettlementRepository } from '../../modules/billing/fees/fee-settlement.repository';\nimport { PayoutRepository } from '../../modules/billing/fees/payout.repository';\nimport { UsageEventRepository } from '../../modules/billing/usage/usage-event.repository';\nimport { PaymentRepository } from '../../modules/billing/payments/payment.repository';\nimport { InvoiceRepository } from '../../modules/billing/finance/invoice.repository';\nimport { OutboxService } from '../outbox/outbox.service';\nimport { AccountingAdjustmentService } from '../../modules/portfolio-accounting/accounting-adjustment.service';\nimport { AccountingReconciliationService } from '../../modules/portfolio-accounting/accounting-reconciliation.service';\nimport { AttributionService } from '../../modules/portfolio-accounting/attribution.service';\nimport { AccountingPeriodService } from '../../modules/portfolio-accounting/accounting-period.service';\nimport { PortfolioSnapshotService } from '../../modules/portfolio-accounting/portfolio-snapshot.service';\nimport { PeriodCloseService } from '../../modules/portfolio-accounting/period-close.service';\nimport { CustodyReconciliationService } from '../../modules/custody/custody-reconciliation.service';\nimport { CopyReconciliationService } from '../../modules/copy-trading/copy-reconciliation.service';\nimport { TransactionMonitoringService } from '../../modules/compliance/transaction-monitoring.service';\nimport { LifecycleNotificationService } from '../../modules/client-lifecycle/lifecycle-notification.service';\n\n/**\n * # Responsibility: validates service persistence writes against the generated Prisma DMMF.\n * Persistence contract: the services below call Prisma through `(prisma as any)`,\n * so the compiler cannot check their writes. This fake Prisma client validates\n * every create/update against the generated DMMF the way the real client does\n * (unknown argument, missing required argument, wrong scalar type, invalid enum\n * value, plain null for a Json column) and keeps rows in memory so the services'\n * read paths run against what was actually written.\n */\n\ntype Row = Record<string, any>;\ntype DmmfField = (typeof Prisma.dmmf.datamodel.models)[number]['fields'][number];\n\nconst MODELS = new Map(\n  Prisma.dmmf.datamodel.models.map((model) => [\n    model.name.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + model.name.slice(1),\n    { name: model.name, fields: new Map(model.fields.map((f) => [f.name, f])) },\n  ]),\n);\nconst ENUMS = new Map(\n  Prisma.dmmf.datamodel.enums.map((e) => [e.name, new Set(e.values.map((v) => v.name))]),\n);\nconst UPDATE_OPERATORS = new Set([\n  'set',\n  'increment',\n  'decrement',\n  'multiply',\n  'divide',\n  'push',\n  'unset',\n]);\n\nclass PrismaValidationError extends Error {}\n\nfunction isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, any> {\n  return (\n    typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value) && !(value instanceof Date)\n  );\n}\n\nfunction checkScalar(model: string, field: DmmfField, value: unknown): void {\n  const where = `${model}.${field.name}`;\n  if (field.isList) {\n    if (!Array.isArray(value))\n      throw These tests pin the policy:\n *  - an active, enforced, ENFORCED configuration refuses password login with\n *    SSO_REQUIRED (403) and issues no session or 2FA challenge;\n *  - allowedDomains limit enforcement to accounts in those domains;\n *  - platform staff are the break-glass path and are exempt;\n *  - the refusal is only given after the password was verified (a wrong\n *    password still gets INVALID_CREDENTIALS and counts towards lockout);\n *  - a failing policy lookup fails the login instead of allowing it.\n */\n\nconst TENANT = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';\nconst USER = 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa';\nconst tenant: TenantContext = {\n  tenantId: TENANT,\n  slug: 'acme',\n  status: 'ACTIVE',\n  source: 'subdomain',\n  defaultLocale: 'en',\n  defaultCurrency: 'USD',\n} as TenantContext;\nconst context = { ipHash: 'iphash', userAgent: 'jest', requestId: 'req-1', locale: 'en' };\nconst CORRECT_PASSWORD = 'Correct#Horse-Battery-2026';\n\ninterface SsoRow {\n  tenantId: string;\n  providerType: string;\n  state: string;\n  enforced: boolean;\n  isActive: boolean;\n  allowedDomains: string[];\n}\n\nfunction build(options: {\n  email?: string;\n  isPlatformUser?: boolean;\n  twoFactorEnabled?: boolean;\n  sso?: SsoRow[];\n  ssoLookupFails?: boolean;\n} = {}) {\n  const email = options.email ?? 'alice@acme.test';\n  const userRow = {\n    id: USER,\n    tenantId: TENANT,\n    email,\n    emailIndex: `bi:${email}`,\n    passwordHash: '$argon2id$stored',\n    status: 'ACTIVE',\n    twoFactorEnabled: options.twoFactorEnabled ?? false,\n    isPlatformUser: options.isPlatformUser ?? false,\n    sessionVersion: 1,\n    deletedAt: null,\n  };\n  const loginAttempts: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];\n  const ssoFindMany = jest.fn(async ({ where }: any) => {\n    if (options.ssoLookupFails) throw new Error('database unavailable');\n    return (options.sso ?? []).filter(\n      (row) =>\n        row.tenantId === where.tenantId &&\n        row.isActive === where.isActive &&\n        row.enforced === where.enforced &&\n        row.state === where.state,\n    );\n  });\n  const prisma: any = {\n    user: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(async ({ where }: any) =>\n        where.tenantId === userRow.tenantId && where.emailIndex === userRow.emailIndex ? userRow : null,\n      ),\n      findUniqueOrThrow: jest.fn(async () => userRow),\n      update: jest.fn(async () => userRow),\n    },\n    ssoConfiguration: { findMany: ssoFindMany },\n    loginAttempt: { create: jest.fn(async ({ data }: any) => loginAttempts.push(data)) },\n  };\n  const config: any = {};\n  const crypto: any = { blindIndex: (value: string) => `bi:${value}` };\n  const passwords: any hash: jest.fn(),\n  };\n  const tokens: any = {\n    issueTokenPair: jest.fn(async () => ({\n      accessToken: 'access',\n      refreshToken: 'refresh',\n      expiresIn: 900,\n      refreshExpiresIn: 2_592_000,\n    })),\n    issueTwoFactorChallenge: jest.fn(async () => ({ token: 'challenge', expiresIn: 300 })),\n  };\n  const sessions: any = { createOrReuse: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'session-1', isNewDevice: false })) };\n  const lockout: any = {\n    assertNotLocked: jest.fn(async () => undefined),\n    registerFailure: jest.fn(async () => undefined),\n    clear: jest.fn(async () => undefined),\n  };\n  const users: any = { findByIdForSession: jest.fn(async (id: string) => ({ id, email, tenantId: TENANT })) };\n  const permissions: any = {\n    getEffectiveAccess: jest.fn(async () => ({ roleKeys: ['FOLLOWER'], permissionKeys: ['strategy:read'] })),\n  };\n  const audit: any = { record: jest.fn(async () => undefined) };\n  const riskDetector: any = {\n    assess: jest.fn(async () => ({ requiresNotification: false, isNewDevice: false, riskScore: 0 })),\n    recordFailure: jest.fn(async () => undefined),\n  };\n  const notifications: any = { enqueueTransactional: jest.fn() };\n  const logger: any = { warn: jest.fn(), info: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn() };\n  const unused: any = {};\n  const auth = new AuthService(\n    prisma,\n    config,\n    crypto,\n    passwords,\n    tokens,\n    sessions,\n    unused,\n    lockout,\n    users,\n    permissions,\n    unused,\n    audit,\n    riskDetector,\n    notifications,\n    logger,\n  );\n  const login = (password: string = CORRECT_PASSWORD) =>\n    auth.login(tenant, { email, password, deviceId: 'web-device-0001' } as any, context);\n  return { auth, login, prisma, sessions, tokens, lockout, audit, loginAttempts, ssoFindMany };\n}\n\nconst enforced = (overrides: Partial<SsoRow> = {}): SsoRow => ({\n  tenantId: TENANT,\n  providerType: 'OIDC',\n  state: 'ENFORCED',\n  enforced: true,\n  isActive: true,\n  allowedDomains: [],\n  ...overrides,\n});\n\nasync function refusal(promise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<AppException> {\n  const error = await promise.then(\n    () => {\n      throw new Error('login unexpectedly succeeded');\n    },\n    (e: unknown) => e,\n  );\n  expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(AppException);\n  return error as AppException;\n}\n\ndescribe('AuthService password login under ENFORCED SSO (round 7)', () => {\n  it('refuses password login with SSO_REQUIRED and issues no session or challenge', async () => {\n    const h = build({ sso: [enforced()] });\n    const error = await refusal(h.login());\n    expect(error.code).toBe(ErrorCode.SSO_REQUIRED);\n    expect(error.getStatus()).toBe(403);\n    expect(h.sessions.createOrReuse).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(h.tokens.issueTokenPair).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(h.tokens.issueTwoFactorChallenge).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(h.loginAttempts).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ successful: false, reason: 'sso_required' })]);\n    expect(h.audit.record).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'DENIED', metadata: { reason: 'sso_required', providers: ['OIDC'] } }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('also refuses a 2FA-enabled account before any challenge is issued', async () => {\n    const h = build({ expect(h.tokens.issueTwoFactorChallenge).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('a wrong password still answers INVALID_CREDENTIALS and counts towards lockout (no policy leak)', async () => {\n    const h = build({ sso: [enforced()] });\n    const error = await refusal(h.login('wrong-password'));\n    expect(error.code).toBe(ErrorCode.INVALID_CREDENTIALS);\n    expect(h.lockout.registerFailure).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    expect(h.ssoFindMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('allowedDomains limit enforcement to accounts in those domains', async () 'session-1', tokens: expect.objectContaining({ accessToken: 'access' }) }));\n  });\n\n  it('domain matching is case-insensitive', async () => {\n    const h = build({ email: 'ops@acme.test', sso: [enforced({ allowedDomains: ['ACME.TEST'] })] });\n    expect((await refusal(h.login())).code).toBe(ErrorCode.SSO_REQUIRED);\n  });\n\n  it('ENABLED (not enforced), disabled or inactive configurations leave password login alone', async () => {\n    for (const row of [\n      enforced({ state: 'ENABLED', enforced: false }),\n      enforced({ enforced: false }),\n      enforced({ state: 'DISABLED', isActive: false }),\n      enforced({ isActive: false }),\n      enforced({ tenantId: '99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999' }),\n    ]) {\n      const h = build({ sso: [row] });\n      await break-glass path and are exempt', async () => {\n    const h = build({ isPlatformUser: true, sso: [enforced()] });\n    await expect(h.login()).resolves.toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ sessionId: The session is server-side and revocable; revocation kills both the\n * refresh tokens and every live access token of the session.\n */\n\nconst TENANT = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';\nconst OTHER = '99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999';\nconst USER = 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa';\nconst tenant: TenantContext = {\n  tenantId: TENANT,\n  slug: 'acme',\n  status: 'ACTIVE',\n  source: 'subdomain',\n  defaultLocale: 'en',\n  defaultCurrency: 'USD',\n} as TenantContext;\nconst device = {\n  deviceId: 'web-device-0001',\n  deviceName: 'Chrome',\n  platform: 'web',\n  appVersion: null,\n};\nconst context = { ipHash: 'iphash', userAgent: 'jest', requestId: 'req-1', locale: 'en' };\n\ninterface Store {\n  users: Array<Record<string, any>>;\n  sessions: Array<Record<string, any>>;\n  refreshTokens: Array<Record<string, any>>;\n  loginAttempts: Array<Record<string, any>>;\n  /** Round 8: SSO login transactions (the session origin is read from them). */\n  transactions: Array<Record<string, any>>;\n}\n\nfunction build(store: Store) {\n  const matches = (row: Record<string, any>, where: Record<string, any>) =>\n    Object.entries(where).every(([k, v]) =>\n      v === null ? row[k] === null || row[k] === undefined : row[k] === v,\n    );\n  const prisma: any = {\n    user: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(\n        async ({ where }: any) => store.users.find((u) => matches(u, where)) ?? null,\n      ),\n      findUniqueOrThrow: jest.fn(async ({ where }: any) => {\n        const u = store.users.find((x) => x.id === where.id);\n        if (!u) throw new Error('not found');\n        return u;\n      }),\n      update: jest.fn(async ({ where, data }: any) =>\n        Object.assign(\n          store.users.find((x) => x.id === where.id)!,\n          data,\n        ),\n      ),\n    },\n    userSession: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(\n        async ({ where }: any) => store.sessions.find((s) => matches(s, where)) ?? null,\n      ),\n      update: jest.fn(async ({ where, data }: any) =>\n        Object.assign(\n          store.sessions.find((s) => s.id === where.id)!,\n          data,\n        ),\n      ),\n    },\n    refreshToken: {\n      updateMany: jest.fn(async ({ where, data }: any) => {\n        const rows = store.refreshTokens.filter((t) => matches(t, where));\n        rows.forEach((t) => Object.assign(t, data));\n        return { count: rows.length };\n      }),\n    },\n    loginAttempt: { create: jest.fn(async ({ data }: any) => store.loginAttempts.push(data)) },\n    ssoAuthTransaction: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(\n        async ({ where }: any) => store.transactions.find((t) => matches(t, where)) ?? null,\n      ),\n    },\n    $transaction: jest.fn(async (ops: Promise<unknown>[]) => Promise.all(ops)),\n  };\n  const config: any = {\n    jwtAccessVerificationKey: 'test-access-key',\n    jwtAlgorithm: 'HS256',\n    jwtIssuer: 'wlct',\n    jwtAudience: 'wlct-api',\n  };\n  const logger: any = { warn: jest.fn(), info: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn() };\n  const realSessions = new SessionService(prisma, config, logger);\n  const sessions = {\n    createOrReuse: jest.fn(async (input: any) => {\n      const s = {\n        id: `session-${store.sessions.length + 1}`,\n        userId: input.userId,\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        deviceId: input.deviceId,\n        revokedAt: null,\n        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 86_400_000),\n      };\n      store.sessions.push(s);\n      return { id: s.id, isNewDevice: false };\n    }),\n    revoke: jest.fn((userId: string, sessionId: string, reason: string) =>\n      realSessions.revoke(userId, sessionId, reason),\n    ),\n  };\n  const tokens = {\n    issueTokenPair: jest.fn(async (input: any) => {\n      store.refreshTokens.push({\n        sessionId: input.sessionId,\n        userId: input.userId,\n        status: 'ACTIVE',\n        tokenHash: 'sha512-of-refresh',\n      });\n      return {\n        accessToken: `access.${input.sessionId}`,\n        refreshToken: `refresh.${input.sessionId}`,\n        expiresIn: 900,\n        refreshExpiresIn: 2_592_000,\n      };\n    }),\n    issueTwoFactorChallenge: jest.fn(async () => ({ token: 'challenge-token', expiresIn: 300 })),\n    verifyTwoFactorChallenge: jest.fn(async () => ({\n      sub: USER,\n      tid: TENANT,\n      did: device.deviceId,\n      jti: 'challenge-jti',\n    })),\n    consumeTwoFactorChallenge: jest.fn(async () => undefined),\n    revokeSessionTokens: jest.fn(async (sessionId: string, reason: string) => {\n      const rows = store.refreshTokens.filter(\n        (t) => t.sessionId === sessionId && t.status === 'ACTIVE',\n      );\n      rows.forEach((t) => Object.assign(t, { status: 'REVOKED', revokeReason: reason }));\n      return rows.length;\n    }),\n  };\n  const crypto: any = { blindIndex: (v: string) => `bi:${v}` };\n  const permissions: any = {\n    getEffectiveAccess: jest.fn(async () => ({\n      roleKeys: ['FOLLOWER'],\n      permissionKeys: ['strategy:read'],\n    })),\n  };\n  const users: any = {\n    findByIdForSession: jest.fn(async (id: string) => ({\n      id,\n      email: 'alice@acme.test',\n      tenantId: TENANT,\n    })),\n  };\n  const audit: any = { record: jest.fn(async () => undefined) };\n  const riskDetector: any = {\n    assess: jest.fn(async () => ({\n      requiresNotification: false,\n      isNewDevice: false,\n      riskScore: 0,\n    })),\n  };\n  const notifications: any = { enqueueTransactional: jest.fn() };\n  const twoFactor = {\n    verify: jest.fn(async () => ({ usedRecoveryCode: false, remainingRecoveryCodes: 8 })),\n  };\n  const unused: any = {};\n  const auth = new AuthService(\n    prisma,\n    config,\n    crypto,\n    unused,\n    tokens as any,\n    sessions as any,\n    twoFactor as any,\n    unused,\n    users,\n    permissions,\n    unused,\n    audit,\n    riskDetector,\n    notifications,\n    logger,\n  );\n  const jwt = new JwtStrategy(config, prisma);\n  return { auth, prisma, sessions, tokens, audit, jwt, twoFactor };\n}\n\nfunction freshStore(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Store {\n  return {\n    users: [\n      {\n        id: USER,\n        tenantId: TENANT,\n        email: 'alice@acme.test',\n        status: 'ACTIVE',\n        twoFactorEnabled: false,\n        deletedAt: null,\n        isPlatformUser: false,\n        sessionVersion: 3,\n        passwordHash: '$argon2id$secret',\n        ...overrides,\n      },\n    ],\n    sessions: [],\n    refreshTokens: [],\n    loginAttempts: [],\n    transactions: [],\n  };\n}\n\nasync function errorCode(promise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<string> {\n  try {\n    await promise;\n  } catch (error) {\n    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(AppException);\n    return (error as AppException).code;\n  }\n  throw new Error('expected a refusal');\n}\n\ndescribe('AuthService SSO completion (Part 11)', () => {\n  it('[28] issues a session through the existing session + token services, bound to the request tenant and device', async () => {\n    const store = freshStore();\n    const { auth, sessions, tokens, audit, prisma } = build(store);\n    const result = await auth.completeSsoLogin(USER, tenant, device, context);\n    expect(sessions.createOrReuse).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({\n        userId: USER,\n        tenantId: TENANT,\n        deviceId: device.deviceId,\n        ipHash: 'iphash',\n        trusted: false,\n      }),\n    );\n    expect(tokens.issueTokenPair).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({\n        userId: USER,\n        tenantId: TENANT,\n        sessionId: 'session-1',\n        sessionVersion: 3,\n      }),\n    );\n    expect(result).toMatchObject({\n      sessionId: 'session-1',\n      tokens: { accessToken: 'access.session-1' },\n      user: { id: USER },\n    });\n    expect(store.loginAttempts).toEqual([\n      expect.objectContaining({\n        tenantId: TENANT,\n        userId: USER,\n        successful: true,\n        reason: 'sso',\n        deviceId: device.deviceId,\n      }),\n    ]);\n    expect(audit.record).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({\n        tenantId: TENANT,\n        actorId: USER,\n        resourceType: 'UserSession',\n        resourceId: 'session-1',\n      }),\n    );\n    // The user lookup is tenant-scoped and never reads the password hash.\n    expect(prisma.user.findFirst).toHaveBeenCalledWith({\n      where: { id: USER, tenantId: TENANT, deletedAt: null },\n      select: { id: true, email: true, status: true, twoFactorEnabled: true },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('round 7: the session records the SSO method and issuing configuration (for RP-initiated logout)', async () => {\n    const oidcStore = freshStore();\n    const oidc = build(oidcStore);\n    await oidc.auth.completeSsoLogin(USER, tenant, device, context, {\n      providerType: 'OIDC',\n      configurationId: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222',\n    });\n    expect(oidc.sessions.createOrReuse).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({ authMethod: 'SSO_OIDC', ssoConfigurationId: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222' }),\n    );\n\n    const samlStore = freshStore();\n    const saml = build(samlStore);\n    await saml.auth.completeSsoLogin(USER, tenant, device, context, {\n      providerType: 'SAML',\n      configurationId: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222',\n    });\n    expect(saml.sessions.createOrReuse).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ authMethod: 'SSO_SAML' }));\n\n    // Without the provider binding the session is not marked as SSO.\n    const plainStore = freshStore();\n    const plain = build(plainStore);\n    await plain.auth.completeSsoLogin(USER, tenant, device, context);\n    expect(plain.sessions.createOrReuse).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({ authMethod: 'PASSWORD', ssoConfigurationId: null }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('[30] the login result carries no password hash or provider material', async () => {\n    const store = freshStore();\n    const { auth } = build(store);\n    const json = JSON.stringify(await auth.completeSsoLogin(USER, tenant, device, context));\n    expect(json).not.toMatch(/passwordHash|argon2|id_token|client_secret/i);\n  });\n\n  it('refuses users of another tenant, deleted users and unusable accounts without creating a session', async () => {\n    for (const [overrides, expected] of [\n      [{ tenantId: OTHER }, ErrorCode.INVALID_CREDENTIALS],\n      [{ deletedAt: new Date() }, ErrorCode.INVALID_CREDENTIALS],\n      [{ status: 'SUSPENDED' }, ErrorCode.ACCOUNT_DISABLED],\n      [{ status: 'DEACTIVATED' }, ErrorCode.ACCOUNT_DISABLED],\n      [{ status: 'LOCKED' }, ErrorCode.ACCOUNT_LOCKED],\n    ] as const) {\n      const store = freshStore(overrides as Record<string, unknown>);\n      const { auth, sessions, tokens } = build(store);\n      expect(await errorCode(auth.completeSsoLogin(USER, tenant, device, expect(tokens.issueTwoFactorChallenge).toHaveBeenCalledWith(USER, TENANT, device.deviceId);\n    expect(sessions.createOrReuse).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(store.loginAttempts).toEqual([\n as {\n      sessionId: string;\n    };\n    const payload: any = {\n      typ: 'access',\n      sub: USER,\n      tid: TENANT,\n      sid: result.sessionId,\n      sv: 3,\n      roles: ['FOLLOWER'],\n });\n\n    await auth.revokeSsoSession(USER, result.sessionId);\n    expect(store.sessions[0].revokedAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date);\n    expect(store.sessions[0].revokeReason).toBe('sso_audit_failed');\n sessionId: string;\n    };\n    await expect(auth.revokeSsoSession('someone-else', result.sessionId)).rejects.toBeDefined();\n    expect(store.sessions[0].revokedAt).toBeNull();\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('AuthService SSO session origin (round 8: SAML Single Logout, SSO + 2FA)', () => {\n  const CONFIG = '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';\n  const TX = Nothing is committed.\n */\n\nconst TENANT = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';\nconst OTHER_TENANT = '99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999';\nconst CONFIG = '55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555';\nconst OTHER_CONFIG = '66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666';\nconst ALICE = 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa';\nconst BOB = 'bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb';\nconst IDP_ENTITY = 'https://idp.acme.test/saml';\nconst IDP_SSO = 'https://idp.acme.test/saml/sso';\nconst IDP_SLO = 'https://idp.acme.test/saml/slo';\nconst SP_ENTITY = 'https://acme.app.test/saml/sp';\nconst ACS = 'https://acme.app.test/v1/auth/sso/saml/acs';\nconst SP_SLO = 'https://acme.app.test/v1/auth/sso/saml/slo';\nconst WEB_CALLBACK = 'https://acme.app.test/api/auth/sso/callback';\nconst WEB_LOGIN = 'https://acme.app.test/login';\nconst EMAIL_FORMAT = 'urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress';\nconst ALICE_NAME_ID = 'alice@acme.test';\nconst BOB_NAME_ID = 'bob@acme.test';\n\nconst KEYS = loadSamlTestKeys();\nconst SP_SIGNING_KEY = KEYS.spEncKey;\nconst SP_SIGNING_CERT = KEYS.spEncCert;\n\nconst tenantCtx = (tenantId: string): TenantContext => ({\n  tenantId,\n  slug: tenantId === TENANT ? 'acme' : 'other',\n  status: 'ACTIVE',\n  source: 'subdomain',\n  defaultLocale: 'en',\n  defaultCurrency: 'USD',\n});\nconst requestCtx = { ipHash: 'iphash-0001', userAgent: 'jest', requestId: 'req-1', locale: 'en' };\n\nconst queryOf = (url: string): string => url.slice(url.indexOf('?') + 1);\nconst paramsOf = (url: string): Record<string, string> => Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(queryOf(url)));\nconst inflateParam = (url: string, key: 'SAMLRequest' | 'SAMLResponse'): string =>\n  inflateRawSync(Buffer.from(new URLSearchParams(queryOf(url)).get(key) ?? '', 'base64')).toString('utf8');\n\n/** An independent IdP: signs with its own key, trusts only the SP signing certificate. */\nfunction idp(options: {\n  key?: string;\n  signatureAlgorithm?: 'sha1' | 'sha256' | 'sha512';\n  issuer?: string;\n  destination?: string;\n  trustedSpCert?: string;\n} = {}): SAML {\n  return new SAML({\n    entryPoint: IDP_SSO,\n    callbackUrl: 'https://idp.acme.test/unused-acs',\n    issuer: options.issuer ?? IDP_ENTITY,\n    idpCert: options.trustedSpCert ?? SP_SIGNING_CERT,\n    idpIssuer: SP_ENTITY,\n    privateKey: options.key ?? KEYS.idpKey,\n    signatureAlgorithm: options.signatureAlgorithm ?? 'sha256',\n    logoutUrl: options.destination ?? SP_SLO,\n    validateInResponseTo: ValidateInResponseTo.never,\n    generateUniqueId: () => `_idp${randomBytes(12).toString('hex')}`,\n    wantAssertionsSigned: false,\n  });\n}\n\ninterface Harness {\n  prisma: InMemorySsoPrisma;\n  crypto: ReturnType<typeof fakeCryptoService>;\n  saml: SamlProviderService;\n  transactions: SsoTransactionService;\n  sessions: SessionService;\n  login: SsoLoginService;\n  revokeSpy: jest.SpyInstance;\n}\n\nfunction samlConfig(crypto: ReturnType<typeof fakeCryptoService>, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {\n  return {\n    id: CONFIG,\n    tenantId: TENANT,\n    providerType: 'SAML',\n    state: 'ENABLED',\n    isActive: true,\n    enforced: false,\n    issuer: IDP_ENTITY,\n    entityId: SP_ENTITY,\n    audience: null,\n    ssoUrl: IDP_SSO,\n    acsUrl: ACS,\n    certificate: KEYS.idpCert,\n    clockSkewSec: 60,\n    wantResponseSigned: false,\n    wantAssertionsEncrypted: false,\n    spDecryptionKeyCiphertext: null,\n    spEncryptionCertificate: null,\n    redirectUri: WEB_CALLBACK,\n    sloUrl: IDP_SLO,\n    logoutCallbackUrl: SP_SLO,\n    spSigningKeyCiphertext: crypto.encrypt(SP_SIGNING_KEY, samlSpSigningKeyAad(TENANT)),\n    spSigningCertificate: SP_SIGNING_CERT,\n    ...overrides,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction harness(): Harness {\n  const prisma = createInMemorySsoPrisma();\n  const crypto = fakeCryptoService();\n  const saml = new SamlProviderService(prisma as never, crypto as never);\n  const transactions = new SsoTransactionService(prisma as never, crypto as never);\n  const pino = { warn: jest.fn(), info: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn() };\n  const sessions = new SessionService(\n    prisma as never,\n    { refreshTokenTtlSeconds: 3600, maxActiveSessionsPerUser: 10 } as never,\n    pino as never,\n  );\n  const securityAudit = { record: jest.fn(async () => undefined) };\n  const audit = new SsoAuditService(prisma as never, securityAudit as never, string; subjectHash: string; sessionIndexHashes: string[] }) {\n      return AuthService.prototype.revokeSamlIdpSessions.call(this as never, input);\n    },\n  };\n  const revokeSpy = jest.spyOn(auth, 'revokeSamlIdpSessions');\n  const unused = {} as never;\n  const login = new SsoLoginService(prisma as never, auth as never, unused, saml, transactions, unused, audit);\n  prisma.ssoConfiguration.rows.push(samlConfig(crypto));\n  return { prisma, crypto, saml, transactions, sessions, login, revokeSpy };\n}\n\n/** A SAML session exactly as a verified login stores it (sealed context + lookup hashes) and one refresh token. */\nasync function samlSession(\n  h: Harness,\n  input: { userId: string; deviceId: string; nameID: string; sessionIndex: string | null; CONFIG;\n  const tenantId = input.tenantId ?? TENANT;\n  const samlLogout = h.transactions.sealSamlLogout(tenantId, configurationId, {\n    nameID: input.nameID,\n    nameIDFormat: EMAIL_FORMAT,\n    nameQualifier: null,\n    spNameQualifier: null,\n    sessionIndex: input.sessionIndex,\n  });\n  const created = await h.sessions.createOrReuse({\n    userId: input.userId,\n    tenantId,\n    deviceId: input.deviceId,\n    ipHash: 'iphash-0001',\n    authMethod: 'SSO_SAML',\n    ssoConfigurationId: configurationId,\n    samlLogout,\n  });\n  await h.prisma.refreshToken.create({ data: { sessionId: created.id, userId: input.userId, tenantId } });\n  return created.id;\n}\n\nconst sessionRow = (h: Harness, id: string) => h.prisma.userSession.rows.find((row) => row.id === id) as Record<string, any>;\nconst tokenOf = (h: Harness, sessionId: string) => h.prisma.refreshToken.rows.find((row) => row.sessionId === sessionId) as Record<string, any>;\nconst auditCodes = (h: Harness) => h.prisma.ssoAuditEvent.rows.map((row) => row.eventCode);\nconst lastAudit = (h: Harness) => h.prisma.ssoAuditEvent.rows[h.prisma.ssoAuditEvent.rows.length - 1] as Record<string, any>;\n\n/** SP-initiated logout for Alice's session; returns the IdP URL and what the IdP verified. */\nasync function startLogout(h: Harness) {\n  const sessionId = await samlSession(h, { userId: ALICE, deviceId: 'web-alice-1', nameID: ALICE_NAME_ID, sessionIndex: 'idx-alice-1' });\n  const result = await h.login.logoutUrl(TENANT, ALICE, sessionId, 'iphash-0001');\n  expect(result.reason).toBeNull();\n  const url = String(result.logoutUrl);\n  const verified = await idp().validateRedirectAsync(paramsOf(url) as never, queryOf(url));\n  return { sessionId, url, request: verified.profile as Profile, relayState: paramsOf(url).RelayState };\n}\n\nconst logoutTx = (h: Harness) => h.prisma.ssoAuthTransaction.rows.find((row) => row.status === 'LOGOUT_PENDING' || row.samlRequestId) as Record<string, any>;\n\nbeforeAll(() => {\n  process.env.SSO_SAML_ENABLED = 'true';\n});\nafterAll(() => {\n  delete process.env.SSO_SAML_ENABLED;\n});\n\ndescribe('SP-initiated SAML logout (POST /v1/auth/sso/logout-url)', () => {\n  it('builds a signed LogoutRequest that an independent IdP verifies with the SP signing certificate', async () => {\n    const h = harness();\n expect(params.SigAlg).toBe('http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmldsig-more#rsa-sha256');\n    expect(params.Signature).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(params.RelayState).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/);\n\n    // expect(auditCodes(h)).toEqual([SsoAuditEventCode.SAML_LOGOUT_REQUESTED]);\n  });\n\n  it('the signature is real: an IdP that trusts a different certificate refuses the LogoutRequest', async () => {\n expect(lastAudit(h)).toMatchObject({ eventCode: SsoAuditEventCode.SAML_LOGOUT_REJECTED, outcome: 'FAILURE', reasonCode: reason });\n      expect(h.revokeSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    }\n\n '@nestjs/common';\nimport { CacheService } from '../../../infrastructure/redis/cache.service';\nimport { ReportingPeriod } from './revenue-analytics.types';\n\n/**\n * Safe cache/read-through layer for expensive analytics queries using existing Redis/cache infrastructure\n * without becoming a source of truth.\n * Cache key includes tenant/admin scope, metric, period, currency, relevant filters.\n * TTL configurable, invalidate/refresh, fallback to source on failure.\n * Cache is never a source of truth.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class AnalyticsCacheService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AnalyticsCacheService.name);\n  private readonly defaultTtlSeconds: number;\n\n  constructor(private readonly cacheService: CacheService) {\n    this.defaultTtlSeconds = parseInt(process.env.ANALYTICS_CACHE_TTL || '300', 10); // 5 min default\n  }\n\n  private buildKey(params: {\n    scope: string; // tenantId or platform\n    metric: string;\n    period?: ReportingPeriod;\n    currency?: string;\n    filters?: Record<string, any>;\n  }): string {\n    const parts = [\n      'analytics',\n      params.scope,\n      params.metric,\n      params.currency || 'ALL',\n      params.period ? `${params.period.startDate}_${params.period.endDate}_${params.period.type}` : 'NO_PERIOD',\n    ];\n\n    if (params.filters) {\n      const filterStr = Object.entries(params.filters)\n        .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))\n        .map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${JSON.stringify(v)}`)\n        .join('&');\n      parts.push(filterStr);\n    }\n\n    // Hash long keys to avoid Redis key length issues, but keep readable prefix\n    const rawKey = parts.join(':');\n    if (rawKey.length > 200) {\n      // Simple hash for long keys\n      let hash = 0;\n      for (let i = 0; i < rawKey.length; i++) {\n        const char = rawKey.charCodeAt(i);\n        hash = (hash << 5) - hash + char;\n        hash = hash & hash;\n      }\n      return `${parts.slice(0, 4).join(':')}:hash_${Math.abs(hash)}`;\n    }\n\n    return rawKey;\n  }\n\n  async get<T>(params: {\n    scope: string;\n    metric: string;\n    period?: ReportingPeriod;\n    currency?: string;\n    filters?: Record<string, any>;\n  }): Promise<T | null> {\n    const key = this.buildKey(params);\n    try {\n      const cached = await this.cacheService.get<T>(key);\n      if (cached) {\n        this.logger.debug(`Cache hit for analytics key=${key}`);\n      }\n      return cached;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Cache get failed for key=${key}: ${e.message}, falling back to source`);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async set<T>(params: {\n    scope: string;\n    metric: string;\n    period?: ReportingPeriod;\n    currency?: string;\n    filters?: Record<string, any>;\n    ttlSeconds?: number;\n  }, value: T): Promise<void> {\n    const key = this.buildKey(params);\n    const ttl = params.ttlSeconds || this.defaultTtlSeconds;\n    try {\n      await this.cacheService.set(key, value, ttl);\n      this.logger.debug(`Cache set for analytics key=${key} ttl=${ttl}s`);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Cache set failed for key=${key}: ${e.message}, continuing without cache`);\n      // Never throw - cache failure must not break source computation\n    }\n  }\n\n  async remember<T>(params: {\n    scope: string;\n    metric: string;\n    period?: ReportingPeriod;\n    currency?: string;\n    filters?: Record<string, any>;\n    ttlSeconds?: number;\n  }, factory: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {\n    const key = this.buildKey(params);\n    const ttl = params.ttlSeconds || this.defaultTtlSeconds;\n\n    try {\n      // Try cache first\n      const cached = await this.cacheService.get<T>(key);\n      if (cached !== null) {\n        return cached;\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Cache read failed for key=${key}: ${e.message}, computing from source`);\n      // Fall through to factory\n      return factory();\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const value = await factory();\n      // Try to cache, but don't fail if cache unavailable\n      try {\n        await this.cacheService.set(key, value, ttl);\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Cache write failed for key=${key}: ${e.message}`);\n      }\n      return value;\n    } catch (e) {\n      // Factory failed - rethrow, don't cache failure\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async invalidateScope(scope: string): Promise<number> {\n    try {\n      const pattern = `analytics:${scope}:*`;\n      const deleted = await this.cacheService.deleteByPattern(pattern);\n      this.logger.log(`Invalidated ${deleted} analytics cache keys for scope=${scope}`);\n      return deleted;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Cache invalidation failed for scope=${scope}: ${e.message}`);\n      return 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async invalidateMetric(metric: string): Promise<number> {\n    try {\n      const pattern = `analytics:*:${metric}:*`;\n      const deleted = await this.cacheService.deleteByPattern(pattern);\n      this.logger.log(`Invalidated ${deleted} analytics cache keys for metric=${metric}`);\n      return deleted;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Cache invalidation failed for metric=${metric}: ${e.message}`);\n      return 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async invalidateAll(): Promise<number> {\n    try {\n      const deleted = await this.cacheService.deleteByPattern('analytics:*');\n      this.logger.log(`Invalidated ${deleted} analytics cache keys (all)`);\n      return deleted;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Cache invalidation failed for all analytics: ${e.message}`);\n      return 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async deleteKey(params: {\n    scope: string;\n    metric: string;\n    period?: ReportingPeriod;\n    currency?: string;\n    filters?: Record<string, any>;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const key = this.buildKey(params);\n    try {\n      await this.cacheService.delete(key);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Cache delete failed for key=${key}: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/analytics/analytics-reconciliation.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/analytics/analytics.controller.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/analytics/analytics.module.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/analytics/arr-calculation.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected and normalized annual value.\n * MONTHLY × 12, QUARTERLY × 4, YEARLY × 1, LIFETIME excluded unless explicitly configured.\n * Uses canonical subscription state and price, Decimal-safe.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ArrCalculationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ArrCalculationService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async calculateArr(params: {\n    tenantId?: string;\n    currency?: string;\n    asOfDate?: Date;\n    includeTrials?: boolean;\n    includeLifetimeAsRecurring?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<ArrBreakdown | ArrBreakdown[]> {\n    const asOfDate = params.asOfDate || new Date();\n    const currencyFilter = params.currency?.toUpperCase();\n    const includeTrials = params.includeTrials ?? false;\n    const includeLifetime = params.includeLifetimeAsRecurring ?? false;\n\n    const subscriptions = await this.fetchActiveSubscriptions({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      asOfDate,\n      includeTrials,\n    });\n\n    if (subscriptions.length === 0) {\n      const currency = currencyFilter || 'USD';\n      return {\n        totalArr: zeroMoney(currency),\n        currency,\n        activeSubscriptions: 0,\n        calculationDate: asOfDate.toISOString(),\n        methodology: 'Active recurring subscriptions normalized to annual: MONTHLY×12, QUARTERLY×4, YEARLY×1, LIFETIME excluded unless policy says recurring',\n        byPlan: [],\n        byInterval: [],\n      };\n    }\n\n    const byCurrency = new Map<string, typeof subscriptions>();\n    for (const sub of subscriptions) {\n      const curr = (sub.plan?.currency || 'USD').toUpperCase();\n      if (currencyFilter && curr !== currencyFilter) continue;\n      if (!byCurrency.has(curr)) byCurrency.set(curr, []);\n      byCurrency.get(curr)!.push(sub);\n    }\n\n    const results: ArrBreakdown[] = [];\n\n    for (const [currency, subs] of byCurrency.entries()) {\n      let totalMinor = 0;\n      const byPlanMap = new Map<string, { planId: string; planCode: string; planName: string; arrMinor: number; count: number }>();\n      const byIntervalMap = new Map<BillingInterval, { arrMinor: number; count: number }>();\n\n      for (const sub of subs) {\n        const plan = sub.plan;\n        if (!plan) continue;\n\n        const interval = (plan.interval as BillingInterval) || BillingInterval.MONTHLY;\n        const priceStr = plan.price?.toString() || '0';\n        const priceMinor = parseToMinorUnits(priceStr, currency);\n\n        let arrMinor: number;\n        switch (interval) {\n          case BillingInterval.MONTHLY:\n            arrMinor = priceMinor * 12;\n            break;\n          case BillingInterval.QUARTERLY:\n            arrMinor = priceMinor * 4;\n            break;\n          case BillingInterval.YEARLY:\n            arrMinor = priceMinor;\n            break;\n          case BillingInterval.LIFETIME:\n            arrMinor = includeLifetime ? priceMinor : 0;\n            break;\n          default:\n            arrMinor = priceMinor * 12;\n        }\n\n        const seats = sub.seatsPurchased || 1;\n        if (seats > 1) arrMinor = arrMinor * seats;\n\n        if (arrMinor === 0) continue;\n\n        totalMinor += arrMinor;\n\n        const planKey = plan.id;\n        if (!byPlanMap.has(planKey)) {\n          byPlanMap.set(planKey, { planId: plan.id, planCode: plan.code, planName: plan.name, arrMinor: 0, count: 0 });\n        }\n        const planAgg = byPlanMap.get(planKey)!;\n        planAgg.arrMinor += arrMinor;\n        planAgg.count += 1;\n\n        if (!byIntervalMap.has(interval)) {\n          byIntervalMap.set(interval, { arrMinor: 0, count: 0 });\n        }\n        const intervalAgg = byIntervalMap.get(interval)!;\n        intervalAgg.arrMinor += arrMinor;\n        intervalAgg.count += 1;\n      }\n\n      const totalArr = { amount: formatFromMinorUnits(totalMinor, currency), currency, minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) } as MoneyAmount;\n\n      results.push({\n        totalArr,\n        currency,\n        activeSubscriptions: subs.length,\n        calculationDate: asOfDate.toISOString(),\n        methodology: 'Active recurring subscriptions normalized to annual: MONTHLY×12, QUARTERLY×4, YEARLY×1, LIFETIME excluded unless policy says recurring. Decimal-safe minor-unit arithmetic.',\n        byPlan: Array.from(byPlanMap.values()).map((v) => ({\n          planId: v.planId,\n          planCode: v.planCode,\n          planName: v.planName,\n          arr: { amount: formatFromMinorUnits(v.arrMinor, currency), currency, minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) },\n          count: v.count,\n        })),\n        byInterval: Array.from(byIntervalMap.entries()).map(([interval, v]) => ({\n          interval,\n          arr: { amount: formatFromMinorUnits(v.arrMinor, currency), currency, minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) },\n          count: v.count,\n        })),\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (currencyFilter) {\n      return results[0] || {\n        totalArr: zeroMoney(currencyFilter),\n        currency: currencyFilter,\n        activeSubscriptions: 0,\n        calculationDate: asOfDate.toISOString(),\n        methodology: 'No active subscriptions for currency',\n        byPlan: [],\n        byInterval: [],\n      };\n    }\n\n    return results;\n  }\n\n  async calculateArrForTenant(tenantId: string, currency?: string, asOfDate?: Date): Promise<ArrBreakdown> {\n    const result = await this.calculateArr({ tenantId, currency, asOfDate });\n    if (Array.isArray(result)) {\n      return result[0] || {\n        totalArr: zeroMoney(currency || 'USD'),\n        currency: currency || 'USD',\n        activeSubscriptions: 0,\n        calculationDate: (asOfDate || new Date()).toISOString(),\n        methodology: 'Tenant ARR',\n        byPlan: [],\n        byInterval: [],\n      };\n    }\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  async calculatePlatformArr(currency?: string): Promise<ArrBreakdown[]> {\n    const result = await this.calculateArr({ currency });\n    return Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];\n  }\n\n  private async fetchActiveSubscriptions(params: { tenantId?: string; asOfDate: Date; includeTrials: boolean }): Promise<any[]> {\n    const { tenantId, asOfDate, includeTrials } = params;\n    const statuses = includeTrials\n      ? [SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE, SubscriptionStatus.TRIALING, SubscriptionStatus.PAST_DUE]\n      : [SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE, SubscriptionStatus.PAST_DUE];\n\n    try {\n      const where: any = {\n        status: { in: statuses },\n        currentPeriodEnd: { gte: asOfDate },\n      };\n      if (tenantId) where.tenantId = tenantId;\n\n      const subs = await (this.prisma as any).tenantSubscription.findMany({\n        where,\n        include: { plan: true },\n      });\n      return subs || [];\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to fetch active subscriptions for ARR: ${e.message}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  normalizeToArr(price: string, interval: BillingInterval, currency: string, includeLifetime = false): MoneyAmount {\n    const minor = parseToMinorUnits(price, currency);\n    let arrMinor: number;\n    switch (interval) {\n      case BillingInterval.MONTHLY:\n        arrMinor = minor * 12;\n        break;\n      case BillingInterval.QUARTERLY:\n        arrMinor = minor * 4;\n        break;\n      case BillingInterval.YEARLY:\n        arrMinor = minor;\n        break;\n      case BillingInterval.LIFETIME:\n        arrMinor = includeLifetime ? minor : 0;\n        break;\n      default:\n        arrMinor = minor * 12;\n    }\n    return { amount: formatFromMinorUnits(arrMinor, currency), currency, minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/analytics/billing-health.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/analytics/cashflow-analytics.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'successfulCount' is assigned a value but never used.","line":62,"column":9,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":62,"endColumn":24},{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'failedCount' is assigned a value but never used.","line":65,"column":9,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":65,"endColumn":20},{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'pendingCount' is assigned a value but never used.","line":68,"column":9,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":68,"endColumn":21},{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. parseToMinorUnits,\n  formatFromMinorUnits,\n  getMinorUnitForCurrency,\n} from './revenue-analytics.types';\n\n/**\n * Cash collected, refunds, net cash, outstanding amounts, payment-failure impact, period cashflow\n * derived from canonical payment/invoice/ledger data.\n * Does NOT treat invoice as cash unless payment evidence supports it.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class CashflowAnalyticsService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(CashflowAnalyticsService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async calculateCashflow(params: {\n    tenantId?: string;\n    currency?: string;\n    period: ReportingPeriod;\n  }): Promise<CashflowSnapshot> {\n    const currency = (params.currency || 'USD').toUpperCase();\n    const { start, end } = this.parsePeriod(params.period);\n\n    const payments = await this.fetchPayments({ tenantId: params.tenantId, currency, start, end });\n    const invoices = await this.fetchInvoices({ tenantId: params.tenantId, currency, start, end });\n    const refunds = await this.fetchRefunds({ tenantId: params.tenantId, currency, start, end });\n    const dunningCases = await this.fetchDunningCases({ tenantId: params.tenantId, start, end });\n    const feeSettlements = await this.fetchFeeSettlements({ tenantId: params.tenantId, currency, start, end });\n\n    let collectedMinor = 0;\n    let successfulMinor = 0;\n    let failedMinor = 0;\n    let pendingMinor = 0;\n    let refundMinor = 0;\n    let outstandingMinor = 0;\n    let dunningExposureMinor = 0;\n    let feePayoutMinor = 0;\n    let taxCollectedMinor = 0;\n    let grossCashInMinor = 0;\n    let grossCashOutMinor = 0;\n\n    let successfulCount = 0;\n    let failedCount = 0;\n    let pendingCount = 0;\n\n    for (const p of payments) {\n      const amountMinor = parseToMinorUnits(p.amount || '0', currency);\n      const status = (p.status || '').toUpperCase();\n\n      if (['SUCCEEDED', 'PAID', 'COMPLETED', 'CONFIRMED'].includes(status)) {\n        collectedMinor += amountMinor;\n        successfulMinor += amountMinor;\n        grossCashInMinor += amountMinor;\n        successfulCount++;\n      } else if (['FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED'].includes(status)) {\n        failedMinor += amountMinor;\n        failedCount++;\n      } else if (['PENDING', 'CREATED', 'PROCESSING', 'REQUIRES_ACTION'].includes(status)) {\n        pendingMinor += amountMinor;\n        pendingCount++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    for (const r of refunds) {\n      if (['SUCCEEDED', 'COMPLETED', 'PROCESSED'].includes((r.status || '').toUpperCase())) {\n        const amountMinor = parseToMinorUnits(r.amount || '0', currency);\n        refundMinor += amountMinor;\n        grossCashOutMinor += amountMinor;\n      }\n    }\n\n    for (const inv of invoices) {\n      if (['OPEN', 'OVERDUE', 'PARTIALLY_PAID'].includes((inv.status || '').toUpperCase())) {\n        const dueMinor = parseToMinorUnits(inv.amountDue || inv.total || '0', currency);\n        outstandingMinor += dueMinor;\n      }\n      const taxMinor = parseToMinorUnits(inv.taxTotal || '0', currency);\n      taxCollectedMinor += taxMinor;\n    }\n\n    for (const d of dunningCases) {\n      // Dunning exposure: payment amount that is at risk\n      try {\n        const payment = await (this.prisma as any).payment?.findFirst({ where: { id: d.paymentId } });\n        if (payment && payment.currency?.toUpperCase() === currency) {\n          dunningExposureMinor += parseToMinorUnits(payment.amount || breakdown: {\n      invoiceRecognized: MoneyAmount;\n      subscriptionRecognized: MoneyAmount;\n      ledgerRecognized: MoneyAmount;\n    };\n    methodology: string;\n    calculatedAt: string;\n  }> {\n    const currency = (params.currency || 'USD').toUpperCase();\n    const { start, end } = this.parsePeriod(params.period);\n\n    // Fetch invoices in period\n    const invoices = await const due = parseToMinorUnits(inv.amountDue || '0', currency);\n        unpaidMinor += due;\n      } else if (['DRAFT', 'OPEN'].includes(inv.status)) {\n        const totalMinor = || '0', currency);\n      if (entry.entryType === 'CREDIT' || entry.accountCategory?.includes('REVENUE')) {\n        ledgerMinor += amountMinor;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return {\n      period: params.period,\n      currency,\n      recognizedRevenue: { amount: formatFromMinorUnits(recognizedMinor, currency), currency, minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) },\n      deferredRevenue: { minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) },\n      paidRevenue: { amount: formatFromMinorUnits(paidMinor, currency), currency, minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) },\n      unpaidRecognized: { amount: formatFromMinorUnits(unpaidMinor, currency), currency, minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) },\n      breakdown: {\n        invoiceRecognized: { amount: formatFromMinorUnits(invoiceMinor, currency), currency, minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) },\n        subscriptionRecognized: { amount: formatFromMinorUnits(subscriptionMinor, currency), currency, minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) },\n        ledgerRecognized: { amount: formatFromMinorUnits(ledgerMinor, currency), currency, minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) },\n      },\n      methodology: 'Recognized revenue = finalized/paid invoices in period. Deferred = draft/open invoices. Paid = amountPaid. Unpaid = amountDue. Ledger used for cross-check, not as primary. No invented accounting policy.',\n      calculatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getDeferredRevenue(params: { tenantId?: string; currency?: string; asOfDate?: Date }): Promise<{\n    currency: string;\n    deferredAmount: MoneyAmount;\n    invoiceCount: number;\n    asOfDate: string;\n  }> {\n    const currency = (params.currency || 'USD').toUpperCase();\n    const asOfDate = params.asOfDate || new Date();\n\n    try {\n      const where: any = {\n        status: { in: ['DRAFT', 'OPEN'] },\n        currency,\n        createdAt: { lte: asOfDate },\n      };\n      if (params.tenantId) where.tenantId = params.tenantId;\n\n      const invoices = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findMany({ where }) || [];\n      let totalMinor = 0;\n      for (const inv of invoices) {\n        totalMinor += parseToMinorUnits(inv.total || '0', currency);\n      }\n\n      return {\n        currency,\n        deferredAmount: { amount: formatFromMinorUnits(totalMinor, currency), currency, minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency) },\n        invoiceCount: invoices.length,\n        asOfDate: asOfDate.toISOString(),\n      };\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to fetch deferred revenue: ${e.message}`);\n      return {\n        currency,\n        deferredAmount: zeroMoney(currency),\n        invoiceCount: 0,\n        asOfDate: asOfDate.toISOString(),\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  private parsePeriod(period: ReportingPeriod): { start: Date; end: Date } {\n    return { start: new Date(period.startDate), end: new Date(period.endDate) };\n  }\n\n  private async fetchInvoices(params: { tenantId?: string; currency: string; start: Date; end: Date }): Promise<any[]> {\n    const where: any = {\n      currency: params.currency,\n      createdAt: { gte: params.start, lte: params.end },\n    };\n    if (params.tenantId) where.tenantId = params.tenantId;\n    const invoices = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findMany({ where }) || [];\n    return invoices;\n  }\n\n  private async fetchPayments(params: { tenantId?: string; currency: string; start: Date; end: Date }): Promise<any[]> {\n    const where: any = {\n      currency: params.currency,\n      createdAt: { gte: params.start, lte: params.end },\n    };\n    if (params.tenantId) where.tenantId = params.tenantId;\n    const payments = await (this.prisma as any).payment?.findMany({ where }) || [];\n    return payments;\n  }\n\n  private async fetchLedgerEntries(params: { tenantId?: string; currency: string; start: Date; end: Date }): Promise<any[]> {\n    const where: any = {\n      currency: params.currency,\n      effectiveAt: { gte: params.start, lte: params.end },\n      status: 'POSTED',\n    };\n    if (params.tenantId) where.tenantId = params.tenantId;\n    const entries = await (this.prisma as any).billingLedgerEntry?.findMany({ where }) || [];\n    return entries;\n  }\n\n  private async fetchSubscriptionsInPeriod(params: { tenantId?: string; start: Date; end: Date }): Promise<any[]> {\n    const where: any = {\n      currentPeriodStart: { lte: params.end },\n      currentPeriodEnd: { gte: params.start },\n      status: { in: ['ACTIVE', 'TRIALING', 'PAST_DUE'] },\n    };\n    if (params.tenantId) where.tenantId = params.tenantId;\n    const subs = await (this.prisma as any).tenantSubscription?.findMany({ where, include: { plan: true } }) || [];\n    return subs;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/analytics/subscription-analytics.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'active' is assigned a value but never used.","line":51,"column":49,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":51,"endColumn":55},{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any.
