of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":11,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport {\n  ReportingPeriod,\n  SubscriptionKpis,\n  BillingInterval,\n  SubscriptionStatus,\n  calculateRate,\n} from './revenue-analytics.types';\n\n/**\n * Subscription lifecycle analytics: active/trial/cancelled/expired, upgrades, downgrades, renewals, plan distribution, interval distribution, retention.\n * Derive state from canonical subscription records/history, do not invent state transitions.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class SubscriptionAnalyticsService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(SubscriptionAnalyticsService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async calculateSubscriptionKpis(params: {\n    tenantId?: string;\n    period: ReportingPeriod;\n  }): Promise<SubscriptionKpis> {\n    const { start, end } = this.parsePeriod(params.period);\n\n    const subscriptions = await this.fetchSubscriptionsInPeriod({ tenantId: params.tenantId, start, end });\n    const allActive = await this.fetchCurrentActive({ tenantId: params.tenantId });\n\n    let active = 0;\n    let trial = 0;\n    let cancelled = 0;\n    let expired = 0;\n    let scheduled = 0;\n    let newSubs = 0;\n    let renewed = 0;\n    let churned = 0;\n    let upgraded = 0;\n    let downgraded = 0;\n    let totalTenureDays = 0;\n    let totalSeats = 0;\n\n    const planDistributionMap = new Map<string, { planId: string; planCode: string; planName: string; count: number }>();\n    const intervalDistributionMap = new Map<BillingInterval, number>();\n    const statusDistributionMap = new Map<SubscriptionStatus, number>();\n\n    for (const sub of subscriptions) {\n      const status = sub.status as SubscriptionStatus;\n      statusDistributionMap.set(status, (statusDistributionMap.get(status) || 0) + 1);\n\n      if (status === SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE) active++;\n      if (status === SubscriptionStatus.TRIALING) trial++;\n      if (status === SubscriptionStatus.CANCELED) cancelled++;\n      if (status === SubscriptionStatus.EXPIRED) expired++;\n      if (sub.cancelAtPeriodEnd) scheduled++;\n\n      // New subscriptions created in period\n      if (new Date(sub.createdAt) >= start && new Date(sub.createdAt) <= end) {\n        newSubs++;\n      }\n\n      // Renewals: subscriptions whose currentPeriodStart is in period and not first creation\n      if (new Date(sub.currentPeriodStart) >= start && new Date(sub.currentPeriodStart) <= end) {\n        const created = new Date(sub.createdAt).getTime();\n        const periodStart = new Date(sub.currentPeriodStart).getTime();\n        if (Math.abs(periodStart - created) > 60 * 1000) {\n          renewed++;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Churned: cancelled or expired in period\n      if (sub.canceledAt && new Date(sub.canceledAt) >= start && new Date(sub.canceledAt) <= end) {\n        churned++;\n      }\n\n      // Tenure\n      const tenureMs = new Date(sub.currentPeriodEnd).getTime() - new Date(sub.currentPeriodStart).getTime();\n      totalTenureDays += tenureMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);\n      totalSeats += sub.seatsPurchased || 1;\n\n      // Plan distribution\n      const plan = sub.plan;\n      if (plan) {\n        const key = plan.id;\n        if (!planDistributionMap.has(key)) {\n          planDistributionMap.set(key, { planId: plan.id, planCode: plan.code, planName: plan.name, count: 0 });\n        }\n        planDistributionMap.get(key)!.count++;\n\n        const interval = (plan.interval as BillingInterval) || BillingInterval.MONTHLY;\n        intervalDistributionMap.set(interval, (intervalDistributionMap.get(interval) || 0) + 1);\n      }\n\n      // Upgrade/downgrade detection from metadata\n      const metadata = sub.metadata as any;\n      if (metadata?.changeType === 'UPGRADE' || metadata?.pendingPlanCode) {\n        // Simple heuristic: if metadata indicates upgrade, count\n        // More accurate would require plan change history\n        if (metadata.changeType === 'UPGRADE') upgraded++;\n        if (metadata.changeType === 'DOWNGRADE') downgraded++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // For upgrades/downgrades, also check plan change audit if available\n    try {\n      const auditLogs = await (this.prisma as any).auditLog?.findMany({\n        where: {\n          action: { in: ['SUBSCRIPTION_UPDATED', 'PLAN_CHANGED'] },\n          createdAt: { gte: start, lte: end },\n          ...(params.tenantId ? { tenantId: params.tenantId } : {}),\n        },\n      }) || [];\n\n      for (const log of auditLogs) {\n        const meta = log.metadata as any;\n        if (meta?.changeType === 'UPGRADE') upgraded++;\n        if (meta?.changeType === 'DOWNGRADE') downgraded++;\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const total = subscriptions.length || 1;\n\n    const planDistribution = Array.from(planDistributionMap.values()).map((v) => ({\n      ...v,\n      percentage: calculateRate(v.count, total),\n    }));\n\n    const intervalDistribution = Array.from(intervalDistributionMap.entries()).map(([interval, count]) => ({\n      interval,\n      count,\n      percentage: calculateRate(count, total),\n    }));\n\n    const statusDistribution = Array.from(statusDistributionMap.entries()).map(([status, count]) => ({\n      status,\n      count,\n      percentage: calculateRate(count, total),\n    }));\n\n    const avgTenure = subscriptions.length > 0 ? totalTenureDays / subscriptions.length : 0;\n    const avgSeats = subscriptions.length > 0 ? (totalSeats / subscriptions.length).toFixed(2) : '0.00';\n\n    return {\n      period: params.period,\n      activeSubscriptions: allActive.length,\n      trialSubscriptions: trial,\n      cancelledSubscriptions: cancelled,\n      expiredSubscriptions: expired,\n      scheduledCancellations: scheduled,\n      newSubscriptions: newSubs,\n      renewedSubscriptions: renewed,\n      churnedSubscriptions: churned,\n      upgradedSubscriptions: upgraded,\n      downgradedSubscriptions: downgraded,\n      averageTenureDays: Math.round(avgTenure * 100) / 100,\n      averageSeats: avgSeats,\n      planDistribution,\n      intervalDistribution,\n      statusDistribution,\n      calculatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getPlanDistribution(params: { tenantId?: string; asOfDate?: Date }): Promise<\n    { planId: string; planCode: string; planName: string; count: number; percentage: string }[]\n  > {\n    const asOfDate = params.asOfDate || new Date();\n    const active = await this.fetchCurrentActive({ tenantId: params.tenantId, asOfDate });\n    const total = active.length || 1;\n    const map = new Map<string, { planId: string; planCode: string; planName: string; count: number }>();\n\n    for (const sub of active) {\n      const plan = sub.plan;\n      if (!plan) continue;\n      const key = plan.id;\n      if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, { planId: plan.id, planCode: plan.code, planName: plan.name, count: 0 });\n      map.get(key)!.count++;\n    }\n\n    return Array.from(map.values()).map((v) => ({ ...v, percentage: calculateRate(v.count, total) }));\n  }\n\n  async getIntervalDistribution(params: { tenantId?: string; asOfDate?: Date }): Promise<\n    { interval: BillingInterval; count: number; percentage: string }[]\n  > {\n    const asOfDate = params.asOfDate || new Date();\n    const active = await this.fetchCurrentActive({ tenantId: params.tenantId, asOfDate });\n    const total = active.length || 1;\n    const map = new Map<BillingInterval, number>();\n\n    for (const sub of active) {\n      const plan = sub.plan;\n      if (!plan) continue;\n      const interval = (plan.interval as BillingInterval) || BillingInterval.MONTHLY;\n      map.set(interval, (map.get(interval) || 0) + 1);\n    }\n\n    return Array.from(map.entries()).map(([interval, count]) => ({\n      interval,\n      count,\n      percentage: calculateRate(count, total),\n    }));\n  }\n\n  private parsePeriod(period: ReportingPeriod): { start: Date; end: Date } {\n    return { start: new Date(period.startDate), end: new Date(period.endDate) };\n  }\n\n  private async fetchSubscriptionsInPeriod(params: { tenantId?: string; start: Date; end: Date }): Promise<any[]> {\n    try {\n      const where: any = {\n        createdAt: { lte: params.end },\n        currentPeriodEnd: { gte: params.start },\n      };\n      if (params.tenantId) where.tenantId = params.tenantId;\n      return await (this.prisma as any).tenantSubscription?.findMany({ where, include: { plan: true } }) || [];\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to fetch subscriptions in period: ${e.message}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async fetchCurrentActive(params: { tenantId?: string; asOfDate?: Date }): Promise<any[]> {\n    const asOfDate = params.asOfDate || new Date();\n    const where: any = {\n      status: { in: [SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE, SubscriptionStatus.TRIALING, SubscriptionStatus.PAST_DUE] },\n      currentPeriodEnd: { gte: asOfDate },\n    };\n    if (params.tenantId) where.tenantId = params.tenantId;\n    return await (this.prisma as any).tenantSubscription?.findMany({ where, include: { plan: true } }) || [];\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/billing-no-fake-success.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Each case pins the honest behaviour.\n */\nimport { NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PushNotificationService } from './notifications/push-notification.service';\nimport { './usage/usage-export.service';\nimport { ChurnAnalyticsService } from './analytics/churn-analytics.service';\nimport { PlanRepository } from './plans/plan.repository';\nimport { InAppNotificationService } from './notifications/in-app-notification.service';\n\nconst ENV_KEYS = [\n  'PUSH_ENABLED',\n  'FCM_SERVER_KEY',\n  'FIREBASE_CONFIG',\n  'FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID',\n  'FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL',\n  'FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64',\n  'SMS_PROVIDER',\n  'TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID',\n  'TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN',\n  'TWILIO_API_KEY_SID',\n  'TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET',\n {};\nbeforeEach(() => {\n  for (const k of ENV_KEYS) {\n    saved[k] = process.env[k];\n    delete process.env[k];\n  }\n});\nafterEach(() => {\n  for (const k of ENV_KEYS) {\n    if (saved[k] === undefined) delete process.env[k];\n    else process.env[k] = saved[k];\n  }\n});\n\nconst pushInput = (payload: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>\n  ({\n    tenantId: 't1',\n    recipientUserId: 'u1',\n    subject: 'Invoice ready',\n    body: 'Your invoice is ready',\n    safePayload: payload,\n  }) as any;\n\ndescribe('push notifications never report an unsent push as delivered', () => {\n  it('not configured -> PUSH_NOT_CONFIGURED', async () => {\n    const r = await new PushNotificationService().send(pushInput({ deviceToken: 'a'.repeat(40) }));\n    expect(r.accepted).toBe(false);\n    expect(r.errorCode).toBe('PUSH_NOT_CONFIGURED');\n  });\n\n  it('enabled without a device token -> NO_DEVICE_TOKEN', async () => {\n    process.env.PUSH_ENABLED = 'true';\n    const r = await new PushNotificationService().send(pushInput());\n    expect(r.accepted).toBe(false);\n    expect(r.errorCode).toBe('NO_DEVICE_TOKEN');\n  });\n\n  it('enabled but no FCM client -> PUSH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE (was accepted: push_dev_*)', async () => {\n    process.env.PUSH_ENABLED = 'true';\n    const svc = new PushNotificationService();\n    jest.spyOn(svc as any, 'resolveMessaging').mockResolvedValue(null);\n    const r = await svc.send(pushInput({ deviceToken: 'a'.repeat(40) }));\n    expect(r.accepted).toBe(false);\n    expect(r.errorCode).toBe('PUSH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE');\n    expect(r.providerReference).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('accepted only with the id FCM returned', async () => {\n    process.env.PUSH_ENABLED = 'true';\n    const svc = new PushNotificationService();\n    const send = jest.fn(async () => 'projects/p/messages/123');\n    jest.spyOn(svc as any, 'resolveMessaging').mockResolvedValue({ send });\n    const r = await svc.send(pushInput({ deviceToken: 'a'.repeat(40) }));\n    expect(send).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ token: 'a'.repeat(40) }));\n    expect(r.accepted).toBe(true);\n    expect(r.providerReference).toBe('projects/p/messages/123');\n  });\n\n  it('FCM unregistered token -> permanent failure; other errors retryable', async () => {\n    process.env.PUSH_ENABLED = 'true';\n    const svc = new PushNotificationService();\n    const err = Object.assign(new Error('Requested entity was not found.'), {\n      code: 'messaging/registration-token-not-registered',\n    });\n    jest.spyOn(svc as any, 'resolveMessaging').mockResolvedValue({\n      send: jest.fn(async () => {\n        throw err;\n      }),\n    });\n    const bad = await svc.send(pushInput({ deviceToken: 'a'.repeat(40) }));\n    expect(bad).toMatchObject({\n      accepted: false,\n      retryable: false,\n      errorCode: 'INVALID_DEVICE_TOKEN',\n    });\n\n    jest.spyOn(svc as any, 'resolveMessaging').mockResolvedValue({\n      send: jest.fn(async () => {\n        throw new Error('socket hang up');\n      }),\n    });\n    const temp = await svc.send(pushInput({ deviceToken: 'a'.repeat(40) }));\n    expect(temp).toMatchObject({\n      accepted: false,\n      retryable: true,\n      errorCode: 'PUSH_TEMPORARY_FAILURE',\n    });\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('notification provider factory', () => {\n  const email = { isAvailable: () => false } as any;\n\n  it('routes PUSH to the real push adapter when configured', () => {\n    process.env.PUSH_ENABLED = 'true';\n    const push = new PushNotificationService();\n    const factory = new NotificationProviderFactory(email, push);\n    expect(factory.getProvider(NotificationChannel.PUSH)).toBe(push);\n  });\n\n  it('SMS (twilio selected but unconfigured) and WEBHOOK get an unavailable provider, never an always-accepting stub', async () => {\n    process.env.SMS_PROVIDER = 'twilio';\n    const factory = new NotificationProviderFactory(email, new PushNotificationService());\n    for (const channel of [NotificationChannel.SMS, NotificationChannel.WEBHOOK]) {\n      const p = factory.getProvider(channel);\n      expect(p.isAvailable()).toBe(false);\n      await expect(p.send({} as any)).rejects.toThrow(/not configured/);\n    }\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('notification provider factory: SMS', () => {\n  const email = { isAvailable: () => false } as any;\n\n  it('SMS_PROVIDER=twilio with full configuration routes SMS to the process.env.TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER = '+15005550006';\n    const factory = new NotificationProviderFactory(email, new PushNotificationService());\n    const p = factory.getProvider(NotificationChannel.SMS);\n    expect(p.providerName).toBe('twilio');\n    expect(p.isAvailable()).toBe(true);\n NotificationProviderFactory(email, new PushNotificationService());\n    expect(factory.getProvider(NotificationChannel.SMS).isAvailable()).toBe(false);\n expect(PushNotificationService.serviceAccountFromEnv()).toBeNull();\n    process.env.FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64 = Buffer.from('not a key').toString('base64');\n    expect(PushNotificationService.serviceAccountFromEnv()).toBeNull();\n    process.env.FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64 = Buffer.from('-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\\nabc\\n-----END PRIVATE expect(p.providerName).toBe(PayoutProvider.STRIPE);\n    expect(p.isAvailable()).toBe(true);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('payment repository', () => {\n  it('fails closed when the Payment table is missing });\n});\n\ndescribe('usage export status', () => {\n  it('does not invent COMPLETED for an untracked export id', async () => {\n    const svc = new UsageExportService({} as any, {} as any, {} as any, function service(opts: { mrrAtStartMinor: number; churned: any[] }) {\n    const svc = new ChurnAnalyticsService({} as any);\n    const active = [{ tenantId: 'a' }, { tenantId: 'b' }, { tenantId: 'c' .spyOn(svc as any, 'calculateMrrAtDate')\n      .mockResolvedValue({ totalMinor: opts.mrrAtStartMinor });\n    return svc;\n  }\n  const period = {\n    type: 'MONTHLY',\n    startDate: '100.00', interval: 'MONTHLY' },\n      },\n    ];\n    const m = await service({ mrrAtStartMinor: 100_000, churned }).calculateChurn({\n      period,\n      currency: 'USD',\n    });\n    expect(m.subscriptionChurnRate).toBe('25.00');\n    expect(m.revenueChurnRate).toBe('10.00');\n    expect(m.grossRevenueRetention).toBe('90.00');\n    expect(m.netRevenueRetention).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('no MRR at start -> both retention figures null, not 100%', async () => {\n    const m = await service({ mrrAtStartMinor: 0, churned: [] }).calculateChurn({\n      period,\n      currency: No credentials or tokens are ever included.\n */\nexport class PlanLimitExceededError extends EnforcementError {\n  constructor(params: {\n    limitKey: string;\n    currentUsage: number;\n    configuredMaximum: number;\n    remaining: number;\n    scope: EnforcementScope;\n    scopeId?: string;\n  }) {\n    super(\n      ErrorCode.SUBSCRIPTION_LIMIT_REACHED,\n      EnforcementDecisionCode.PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,\n      'Your current plan limit for this resource has been reached.',\n      {\n        limitKey: params.limitKey,\n        currentUsage: params.currentUsage,\n        configuredMaximum: params.configuredMaximum,\n        remaining: params.remaining,\n        scope: params.scope,\n        scopeId: params.scopeId,\n      },\n    );\n    this.name = 'PlanLimitExceededError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The platform could not read the tenant's usage counters.\n *\n * This is a transient infrastructure failure, not a business rejection.\n */\nexport class UsageUnavailableError extends EnforcementError {\n  constructor(limitKey: string, cause?: unknown) {\n    super(\n      ErrorCode.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,\n      EnforcementDecisionCode.USAGE_UNAVAILABLE,\n      'Usage information is temporarily unavailable. Please retry shortly.',\n      { limitKey },\n    );\n    this.name = 'UsageUnavailableError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The tenant's subscription is in a state that blocks the requested action.\n *\n * Valid states that pass: TRIALING, ACTIVE, and LIFETIME.\n */\nexport class SubscriptionInactiveError extends EnforcementError {\n  constructor(subscriptionStatus: string | null, planCode?: string | null) {\n    super(\n      ErrorCode.SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED,\n      EnforcementDecisionCode.SUBSCRIPTION_INACTIVE,\n      'An active subscription is required to perform this action.',\n      { subscriptionStatus: subscriptionStatus ?? 'NONE', planCode: planCode ?? undefined },\n    );\n    this.name = 'SubscriptionInactiveError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The platform could not resolve the tenant's billing state at all.\n *\n * This can happen when the tenant record itself is missing or when the\n * subscription resolution service is unreachable.\n */\nexport class TenantBillingContextError extends EnforcementError {\n  constructor(tenantId: string, reason?: string) {\n    super(\n      ErrorCode.TENANT_NOT_FOUND,\n      EnforcementDecisionCode.BILLING_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE,\n      'Your billing information could not be resolved.',\n      { tenantId, reason },\n    );\n    this.name = 'TenantBillingContextError';\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * The tenant's plan allows the action but the per-window rate limit has been\n * exceeded.\n *\n * Metadata includes retry-after information when available.\n */\nexport class RateLimitExceededError extends EnforcementError {\n  constructor(params: {\n    limitKey: string;\n    currentUsage: number;\n    configuredMaximum: number;\n    windowStart?: Date;\n    windowEnd?: Date;\n    retryAfterSeconds?: number;\n  }) {\n    super(\n      ErrorCode.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,\n      EnforcementDecisionCode.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,\n      'Too many requests. retryAfterSeconds: params.retryAfterSeconds,\n        windowStart: params.windowStart?.toISOString(),\n        windowEnd: params.windowEnd?.toISOString(),\n      },\n    );\n    this.name = 'RateLimitExceededError';\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/enforcement/enforcement.feature-guard.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/enforcement/enforcement.limit-guard.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/enforcement/enforcement.module.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/enforcement/enforcement.resolver.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/enforcement/enforcement.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/enforcement/enforcement.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/mod 0`, so\n * maxTraders and maxExchangeAccounts always saw 0 usage, the per-X limits\n * compared a tenant-wide total, and TraderProfileService created traders\n * without ever asking the maxTraders guard.\n */\nimport { TraderProfileService } from '../../copy-trading/trader-profile.service';\nimport { TenantFeatureAccessService } from '../saas-admin/tenant-feature-access.service';\nimport { BillingUsageSummaryService } from '../portal/billing-usage-summary.service';\nimport { UsageRepository } from './usage.repository';\n\nconst TENANT = '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111';\n\ndescribe('TraderProfileService.createProfile enforces maxTraders', () => {\n  function build(overrides: { reserve?: jest.Mock; create?: jest.Mock } = {}) {\n    const order: string[] = [];\n    const guard = {\n      reserve: overrides.reserve ?? jest.fn(async () => order.push('reserve')),\n      release: jest.fn(async () => order.push('release')),\n    };\n    const create =\n      overrides.create ??\n      jest.fn(async ({ data }: any) => {\n        order.push('create');\n        return data;\n      });\n    const prisma = {\n      user: { findFirst: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'u1', tenantId: TENANT })) },\n      traderProfile: { findFirst: jest.fn(async () => null), create },\n    };\n    // The two stats dependencies are not exercised by these cases - they are only reached by the\n    // public-metrics read. They are still passed, because the service takes them by constructor and a\n    // placeholder here would hide it if that stopped being true.\n    const service = new TraderProfileService(\n      prisma as any,\n      guard as any,\n      {} as any,\n      {} as any,\n      { append: jest.fn() } as never,\n    );\n    return { service, guard, create, order };\n  }\n\n  const input = { tenantId: TENANT, userId: 'u1', displayName: 'Alpha' };\n\n  it('reserves a slot before inserting the profile', async () => {\n    const { service, guard, order } = build();\n    await service.createProfile(input);\n    expect(order).toEqual(['reserve', 'create']);\n    expect(guard.reserve).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({ tenantId: TENANT, userId: 'u1' }),\n    );\n    expect(guard.release).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('creates nothing when the plan is full', async () => {\n    const reserve = jest.fn(async () => {\n      throw new Error('PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED');\n    });\n    const { service, create } = build({ reserve });\n    await expect(service.createProfile(input)).rejects.toThrow('PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED');\n    expect(create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('gives the slot back when the insert fails', async () => {\n    const create = jest.fn(async () => {\n      throw new Error('unique violation');\n    });\n    const { service, guard } = build({ create });\n    await expect(service.createProfile(input)).rejects.toThrow('unique violation');\n    expect(guard.release).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n  });\n\n  it('does not reserve for a duplicate profile', async () => {\n    const { service, guard } = build();\n    const prisma = (service as any).prisma;\n disconnect\n *   - connection failure\n *   - server-side termination\n *\n * Concurrency: the reserve operation uses an atomic Lua script in Redis so\n * two simultaneous connection attempts cannot both succeed when only one slot\n * remains.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class WebsocketLimitGuard {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly usageService: UsageService,\n    private readonly contextBuilder: EnforcementContextBuilder,\n    private readonly audit: EnforcementAuditService,\n    @InjectPinoLogger(WebsocketLimitGuard.name) private readonly logger: PinoLogger,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * Attempt to reserve a websocket connection slot for the tenant.\n   *\n   * Returns a `QuotaCheckResult` indicating whether the reservation succeeded.\n   * When `allowed` is false, the caller must reject the connection.\n   */\n  async reserveConnection(actor: EnforcementActor): Promise<QuotaCheckResult> {\n    const billingCtx = await this.contextBuilder.resolveBillingContext(actor.tenantId);\n    const maximum = billingCtx.planLimits.websocketConnections;\n\n    // Unlimited plan\n    if (maximum === null) {\n      return {\n        allowed: true,\n        decision: EnforcementDecisionCode.ALLOWED,\n        limitKey: 'websocketConnections',\n        currentUsage: 0,\n        configuredMaximum: null,\n        remaining: null,\n        scope: 'TENANT' as any,\n        scopeId: actor.tenantId,\n      };\n    }\n\n    const reserveResult = await this.usageService.reserveWebsocketConnection(\n      actor.tenantId,\n      maximum,\n    );\n\n    const result: QuotaCheckResult = {\n      allowed: reserveResult.reserved,\n      decision: reserveResult.reserved\n        ? EnforcementDecisionCode.ALLOWED\n        : EnforcementDecisionCode.PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,\n      limitKey: 'websocketConnections',\n      currentUsage: reserveResult.currentAfter,\n      configuredMaximum: maximum,\n      remaining: reserveResult.remaining,\n      scope: 'TENANT' as any,\n      scopeId: actor.tenantId,\n      reason: reserveResult.reserved\n        ? undefined\n        : `WebSocket connection limit reached: ${reserveResult.currentAfter}/${maximum}.`,\n    };\n\n    const enforcementCtx = { tenant: billingCtx, actor };\n    await this.audit.logLimitCheck(enforcementCtx, result, actor.userId);\n\n    if (!reserveResult.reserved) {\n      throw new PlanLimitExceededError({\n        limitKey: 'websocketConnections',\n        currentUsage: reserveResult.currentAfter,\n        configuredMaximum: maximum,\n        remaining: 0,\n        scope: 'TENANT' as any,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Release a previously reserved websocket connection slot.\n   *\n   * Must be called on disconnect, connection failure, or server-side\n   * termination so the counter does not permanently leak.\n   */\n  async releaseConnection(tenantId: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.usageService.releaseWebsocketConnection(tenantId);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check whether the tenant can open another websocket connection without\n   * reserving a slot.  Non-destructive: does not increment the counter.\n   */\n  async canConnect(actor: EnforcementActor): Promise<QuotaCheckResult> {\n    const billingCtx = await this.contextBuilder.resolveBillingContext(actor.tenantId);\n    const maximum = billingCtx.planLimits.websocketConnections;\n\n    if (maximum === null) {\n      return {\n        allowed: true,\n        decision: EnforcementDecisionCode.ALLOWED,\n        limitKey: 'websocketConnections',\n        currentUsage: 0,\n        configuredMaximum: null,\n        remaining: null,\n        scope: 'TENANT' as any,\n        scopeId: actor.tenantId,\n      };\n    }\n\n    const usage = await this.usageService.getWebsocketUsage(actor.tenantId, maximum);\n    const allowed = usage.current < maximum;\n\n    return {\n      allowed,\n      decision: allowed\n        ? EnforcementDecisionCode.ALLOWED\n        : EnforcementDecisionCode.PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED,\n      limitKey: 'websocketConnections',\n      currentUsage: usage.current,\n      configuredMaximum: maximum,\n      remaining: usage.remaining,\n      scope: 'TENANT' as any,\n      scopeId: actor.tenantId,\n      reason: allowed\n        ? undefined\n        : `WebSocket connection limit reached: ${usage.current}/${maximum}.`,\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/entitlements/entitlement.errors.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/entitlements/entitlement.guard.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/entitlements/entitlement.keys.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/entitlements/entitlement.policy.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/entitlements/entitlement.resolver.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'context' is defined but never used. { ...(existing as Record<string, unknown>) } : {};\n  const storedRaw = current[FEE_ACCRUAL_METADATA_KEY];\n  const stored: Record<string, unknown> = storedRaw && typeof storedRaw === 'object' ? { ...(storedRaw as Record<string, unknown>) } : {};\n  const user: Record<string, unknown> = userMetadata ? { ...userMetadata } : current;\n  delete user[FEE_ACCRUAL_METADATA_KEY];\n  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(extras)) {\n    if (value !== undefined) stored[key] = value;\n  }\n  return { ...user, [FEE_ACCRUAL_METADATA_KEY]: stored };\n}\n\n/**\n * Persistent storage abstraction for immutable fee accruals.\n * Idempotency via unique idempotencyKey and source reference.\n * Tenant-scoped queries, auditable history.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class FeeAccrualRepository {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(FeeAccrualRepository.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async create(data: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    sourceType: FeeSourceType;\n    sourceId: string;\n    feeType: FeeType;\n    feeRateBps: number;\n    rateBasis: RateBasis;\n    grossAmount: string;\n    feeAmount: string;\n    netAmount: string;\n    currency: string;\n    status: FeeAccrualStatus;\n    settlementState: SettlementState;\n    payoutState?: PayoutState | null;\n    settlementId?: string | null;\n    payoutId?: string | null;\n    ledgerTransactionId?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n    policySnapshot: any;\n    calculationTimestamp: string;\n    metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n    safeMetadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n  }, tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<FeeAccrual> {\n    const client = (tx ?? this.prisma) as any;\n    // Idempotency checks use the same transaction as the insert when supplied.\n    const existingByIdempotencyRow = await client.feeAccrual?.findFirst({\n      where: { idempotencyKey: data.idempotencyKey, tenantId: data.tenantId },\n    });\n    const existingByIdempotency = existingByIdempotencyRow ? this.mapToDomain(existingByIdempotencyRow) : null;\n    if (existingByIdempotency) {\n      this.logger.log(`Idempotent accrual return by idempotencyKey: ${data.idempotencyKey}`);\n      return existingByIdempotency;\n    }\n\n    const existingBySourceRow = await client.feeAccrual?.findFirst({\n      where: {\n        tenantId: data.tenantId,\n        feeSourceType: data.sourceType,\n        sourceId: data.sourceId,\n        feeType: data.feeType,\n      },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    const existingBySource = existingBySourceRow ? this.mapToDomain(existingBySourceRow) : null;\n    if (existingBySource) {\n      this.logger.log(`Idempotent accrual return by source: ${data.sourceType}:${data.sourceId} feeType=${data.feeType}`);\n      return existingBySource;\n    }\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    const accrual: FeeAccrual = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: data.tenantId,\n      sourceType: data.sourceType,\n      sourceId: data.sourceId,\n      feeType: data.feeType,\n      feeRateBps: data.feeRateBps,\n      rateBasis: data.rateBasis,\n      grossAmount: data.grossAmount,\n      feeAmount: data.feeAmount,\n      netAmount: data.netAmount,\n      currency: data.currency.toUpperCase(),\n      status: data.status,\n      settlementState: data.settlementState,\n      payoutState: data.payoutState || null,\n      settlementId: data.settlementId || null,\n      payoutId: data.payoutId || null,\n      ledgerTransactionId: data.ledgerTransactionId || null,\n      idempotencyKey: data.idempotencyKey,\n      policySnapshot: data.policySnapshot,\n      calculationTimestamp: data.calculationTimestamp,\n      settlementTimestamp: null,\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n      metadata: data.metadata || null,\n      safeMetadata: data.safeMetadata || null,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      // FeeAccrual columns only (feeSourceType, sourceAmount, rateBps,\n      // rateReference); the rest of the accrual lives in metadata._fee. The\n      // previous column names made Prisma reject every accrual.\n      const created = await client.feeAccrual?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: accrual.id,\n          tenantId: accrual.tenantId,\n          feeType: accrual.feeType,\n          feeSourceType: accrual.sourceType,\n          sourceId: accrual.sourceId,\n          sourceAmount: accrual.grossAmount,\n          feeAmount: accrual.feeAmount,\n          currency: accrual.currency,\n          rateBps: accrual.feeRateBps ?? null,\n          rateReference: accrual.rateBasis ?? null,\n          status: accrual.status,\n          settlementState: accrual.settlementState,\n          settlementId: accrual.settlementId,\n          settlementTimestamp: null,\n          idempotencyKey: accrual.idempotencyKey,\n          metadata: buildFeeAccrualMetadata(null, (accrual.metadata as any) ?? {}, {\n            netAmount: accrual.netAmount,\n            payoutState: accrual.payoutState,\n            payoutId: accrual.payoutId,\n            ledgerTransactionId: accrual.ledgerTransactionId,\n            policySnapshot: accrual.policySnapshot,\n            calculationTimestamp: new Date(accrual.calculationTimestamp).toISOString(),\n          }) as any,\n          safeMetadata: (accrual.safeMetadata ?? {}) as any,\n          createdAt: new Date(accrual.createdAt),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (created) {\n        return this.mapToDomain(created);\n      }\n      if (tx) {\n        throw new Error('fee accrual was not persisted; refusing to append its outbox event');\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // A PostgreSQL transaction is aborted after a unique-constraint error;\n      // let the caller retry instead of querying through a broken transaction.\n      if ((error.code === 'P2002' || error.message?.includes('Unique constraint')) && tx) {\n        throw error;\n      }\n      // Handle duplicate key (idempotency) for non-transactional callers.\n      if (error.code === 'P2002' || error.message?.includes('Unique constraint')) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Duplicate accrual detected, returning existing: ${data.idempotencyKey}`);\n        const existing = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(data.idempotencyKey, data.tenantId);\n        if (existing) return existing;\n        const bySource = await this.findBySource(data.tenantId, data.sourceType, data.sourceId, data.feeType);\n        if (bySource) return bySource;\n      }\n\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        if (tx) throw new Error('fee accrual table is unavailable inside the caller transaction');\n        // Table doesn't exist - fallback to audit log storage but return domain object\n        this.logger.warn(`feeAccrual table not found, using fallback storage: ${error.message}`);\n        // Try to store in audit log as fallback for auditability\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).auditLog?.create({\n            data: {\n              id: randomUUID(),\n              tenantId: data.tenantId,\n              action: 'FEE_ACCRUED',\n              resourceType: 'FeeAccrual',\n              resourceId: id,\n              metadata: {\n                ...accrual,\n                fallback: true,\n              },\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n        } catch {}\n        return accrual;\n      }\n\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to create fee accrual: ${error.message}`, error.stack);\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    // Fallback if prisma model not available\n    return accrual;\n  }\n\n  async findById(id: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<FeeAccrual | null> {\n    try {\n      const result = await (this.prisma as any).feeAccrual?.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          id,\n          ...(tenantId ? { tenantId } : {}),\n        },\n      });\n      if (!result) return null;\n      return this.mapToDomain(result);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        return null;\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async findByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey: string, tenantId: string): Promise<FeeAccrual | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).feeAccrual?.findFirst({\n      where: { idempotencyKey, tenantId },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async findBySource(tenantId: string, does NOT create another ledger implementation.\n * Every operation idempotent.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class FeeLedgerService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(FeeLedgerService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly ledgerService: BillingLedgerService,\n    private readonly ledgerRepository: BillingLedgerRepository,\n    private readonly auditService: FeeAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async postAccrualToLedger(accrual: FeeAccrual): Promise<any[]> {\n    const idempotencyKey = `fee_ledger_${accrual.id}_${accrual.feeType}`;\n\n    // Idempotency check\n    try {\n      const existing = await this.ledgerRepository.findBySource(LedgerSourceType.FEE, accrual.id);\n      if (existing && existing.length > 0) {\n        this.logger.log(`Idempotent ledger return for accrual ${accrual.id}`);\n        return existing;\n      }\n      const byIdempotency = await this.ledgerRepository.findByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey, accrual.tenantId);\n      if (byIdempotency) {\n        this.logger.log(`Idempotent ledger return by idempotencyKey ${idempotencyKey}`);\n        const bySource = await this.ledgerRepository.findBySource(LedgerSourceType.FEE, accrual.id);\n        return bySource.length > 0 ? bySource : [byIdempotency];\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Ledger idempotency check failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    const feeMoney = createMoney(accrual.feeAmount, accrual.currency);\n    const grossMoney = createMoney(accrual.grossAmount, accrual.currency);\n\n    // Determine ledger account category based on fee type\n    const feeAccountCategory =\n      accrual.feeType === FeeType.PLATFORM_FEE ? LedgerAccountCategory.PLATFORM_FEE_REVENUE : LedgerAccountCategory.PERFORMANCE_FEE_REVENUE;\n\n    // Balanced transaction:\n    // Debit CUSTOMER_RECEIVABLE for fee amount\n    // Credit FEE_REVENUE (PLATFORM or PERFORMANCE) for fee amount\n    // This mirrors existing fee recording pattern in BillingLedgerService.recordFee\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.ledgerService.recordFee({\n        tenantId: accrual.tenantId,\n        sourceId: accrual.id,\n        sourceType: LedgerSourceType.FEE,\n        amount: feeMoney,\n        currency: accrual.currency,\n        feeType: feeAccountCategory,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        metadata: {\n          feeAccrualId: accrual.id,\n          sourceType: accrual.sourceType,\n          sourceId: accrual.sourceId,\n          feeType: accrual.feeType,\n          feeRateBps: accrual.feeRateBps,\n          grossAmount: accrual.grossAmount,\n          currency: accrual.currency,\n          policySnapshot: accrual.policySnapshot,\n          safeMetadata: accrual.safeMetadata,\n        },\n      });\n\n      await this.auditService.logLedgerPosted(accrual.tenantId, accrual.id, accrual.feeType, accrual.feeAmount, accrual.currency, idempotencyKey);\n\n      this.logger.log(`Fee ledger posted accrual=${accrual.id} feeType=${accrual.feeType} amount=${accrual.feeAmount} ${accrual.currency} tx=${idempotencyKey}`);\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to post fee accrual ${accrual.id} to ledger: ${error.message}`, error.stack);\n      await this.auditService.logLedgerPostingFailed(accrual.tenantId, accrual.id, error.message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async postAccrualsBatch(accruals: FeeAccrual[]): Promise<{ success: number; failed: number; results: any[] }> {\n    let success = 0;\n    let failed = 0;\n    const results: any[] = [];\n\n    for (const accrual of accruals) {\n      try {\n        const res = await this.postAccrualToLedger(accrual);\n        success++;\n        results.push({ accrualId: accrual.id, success: true, result: res });\n      } catch (e) {\n        failed++;\n        results.push({ accrualId: accrual.id, success: false, error: (e as Error).message });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { success, failed, results };\n  }\n\n  async reverseAccrualInLedger(accrual: FeeAccrual, reason: string): Promise<any[]> {\n    const idempotencyKey = `fee_reverse_${accrual.id}_${Date.now()}`;\n\n    const feeMoney = createMoney(accrual.feeAmount, accrual.currency);\n    const feeAccountCategory =\n      accrual.feeType === FeeType.PLATFORM_FEE ? LedgerAccountCategory.PLATFORM_FEE_REVENUE : LedgerAccountCategory.PERFORMANCE_FEE_REVENUE;\n\n    // Reversal: Debit fee revenue, Credit receivable (opposite of original)\n    try {\n      // Use recordCredit or custom transaction for reversal\n      // For simplicity, we create a transaction with reversed entries\n      const entries = [\n        {\n          tenantId: accrual.tenantId,\n          accountCategory: feeAccountCategory,\n          entryType: LedgerEntryType.DEBIT,\n          amount: feeMoney,\n          sourceType: LedgerSourceType.FEE,\n          sourceId: accrual.id,\n          idempotencyKey: `${idempotencyKey}_debit`,\n          description: `Fee reversal: ${accrual.feeType} accrual ${accrual.id} reason: ${reason}`,\n          metadata: {\n            reversal: true,\n            originalAccrualId: accrual.id,\n            reason,\n            feeType: accrual.feeType,\n          },\n        },\n        {\n          tenantId: accrual.tenantId,\n          accountCategory: LedgerAccountCategory.CUSTOMER_RECEIVABLE,\n          entryType: LedgerEntryType.CREDIT,\n          amount: feeMoney,\n          sourceType: LedgerSourceType.FEE,\n          sourceId: accrual.id,\n          idempotencyKey: `${idempotencyKey}_credit`,\n          description: `Fee reversal receivable: ${accrual.id}`,\n          metadata: {\n            reversal: true,\n            originalAccrualId: accrual.id,\n            reason,\n          },\n        },\n      ];\n\n      const result = await this.ledgerRepository.createTransaction({\n        tenantId: accrual.tenantId,\n        description: `Fee reversal: ${accrual.id} reason: ${reason}`,\n        entries,\n        sourceType: LedgerSourceType.FEE,\n        sourceId: accrual.id,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        metadata: { reversal: true, reason, originalAccrualId: accrual.id },\n      });\n\n      this.logger.log(`Fee reversal posted accrual=${accrual.id} reason=${reason}`);\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to reverse accrual ${accrual.id}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getLedgerEntriesForAccrual(accrualId: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<any[]> {\n    const entries = await this.ledgerRepository.findBySource(LedgerSourceType.FEE, accrualId);\n    if (tenantId) {\n      return entries.filter((e: any) => Get tenant's current subscription and plan\n    const subscription = await this.subscriptionsService.getCurrent(tenantId);\n    let plan: any = null;\n    let platformFeeBps = 0;\n    let performanceFeeBps = 0;\n    let planId: string | null = null;\n    let planCode: string | null = null;\n    let source: 'plan' | 'tenant_override' | 'global_policy' = 'global_policy';\n\n    if (subscription) {\n      try {\n        plan = subscription.plan || null;\n        if (!plan && subscription.planId) {\n          // Try to fetch via plans service if not included\n          try {\n            const dto = await this.plansService.findById(subscription.planId, {\n              tenantId: null,\n              isPlatformUser: true,\n            });\n            plan = dto;\n          } catch {\n            // ignore, fallback to subscription plan fields if present\n          }\n        }\n\n        if (plan) {\n          platformFeeBps = plan.platformFeeBps ?? plan.limits?.platformFeeBps ?? 0;\n          performanceFeeBps = plan.performanceFeeBps ?? plan.limits?.performanceFeeBps ?? 0;\n          planId = plan.id || subscription.planId;\n          planCode = plan.code || null;\n          source = 'plan';\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to resolve plan for tenant ${tenantId}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Check for tenant-specific override if architecture explicitly supports it\n    // Look into tenant.metadata.commercial or tenant.metadata.feePolicy\n    let tenantOverrideApplied = false;\n    try {\n      const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({\n        where: { id: tenantId },\n        select: { metadata: true },\n      });\n      const metadata = tenant?.metadata as any;\n      if (metadata) {\n        // Explicitly supported override paths\n        const commercialOverride = metadata.commercial || metadata.feePolicy || metadata.billingPolicy;\n        if (commercialOverride && typeof commercialOverride === 'object') {\n          // Only allow override if tenant has explicit flag allowFeeOverride\n          const allowOverride = metadata.allowFeeOverride === true || commercialOverride.allowOverride === true;\n          if (allowOverride) {\n            if (feeType === FeeType.PLATFORM_FEE && typeof commercialOverride.platformFeeBps === 'number') {\n              const overrideBps = this.validateBps(commercialOverride.platformFeeBps);\n              if (overrideBps !== null) {\n                platformFeeBps = overrideBps;\n                tenantOverrideApplied = true;\n                source = 'tenant_override';\n                this.logger.log(`Tenant override applied for ${tenantId} platformFeeBps=${overrideBps}`);\n              }\n            }\n            if (feeType === FeeType.PERFORMANCE_FEE && typeof commercialOverride.performanceFeeBps === 'number') {\n              const overrideBps = this.validateBps(commercialOverride.performanceFeeBps);\n              if (overrideBps !== null) {\n                performanceFeeBps = overrideBps;\n                tenantOverrideApplied = true;\n                source = 'tenant_override';\n                this.logger.log(`Tenant override applied for ${tenantId} performanceFeeBps=${overrideBps}`);\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to check tenant override for ${tenantId}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // 3. Global platform policy fallback (if no plan)\n    if (!plan && !tenantOverrideApplied) {\n      // Try to get default platform policy from env or config\n      // GLOBAL_PLATFORM_FEE_BPS / GLOBAL_PERFORMANCE_FEE_BPS, both defaulting to\n      // 0: with no plan, no tenant override and no global setting, no fee is\n      // charged. Commercial rates come from the plan catalog.\n      const globalPlatformFee = parseInt(process.env.GLOBAL_PLATFORM_FEE_BPS || '0', 10);\n      const globalPerformanceFee = parseInt(process.env.GLOBAL_PERFORMANCE_FEE_BPS || '0', 10);\n      if (source === 'global_policy') {\n        if (platformFeeBps === 0 && !isNaN(globalPlatformFee)) {\n          platformFeeBps = globalPlatformFee;\n        }\n        if (performanceFeeBps === 0 && !isNaN(globalPerformanceFee)) {\n          performanceFeeBps = globalPerformanceFee;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Validate final BPS\n    platformFeeBps = this.validateBps(platformFeeBps) ?? 0;\n    performanceFeeBps = this.validateBps(performanceFeeBps) ?? 0;\n\n    const effectiveBps = feeType === FeeType.PLATFORM_FEE ? platformFeeBps : performanceFeeBps;\n\n    const snapshot: FeePolicySnapshot = {\n      tenantId,\n      planId,\n      planCode,\n      platformFeeBps,\n      performanceFeeBps,\n      currency: currency || 'USD',\n      effectiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      source,\n      minimumFee: null,\n      maximumCap: null,\n      metadata: {\n        resolvedFeeType: feeType,\n        effectiveBps,\n        subscriptionId: subscription?.id || null,\n      },\n    };\n\n    this.logger.log(\n      `Fee policy resolved tenant=${tenantId} feeType=${feeType} plan=${planCode || 'none'} platformBps=${platformFeeBps} performanceBps=${performanceFeeBps} source=${source}`,\n    );\n\n    return snapshot;\n  }\n\n  async resolvePlatformFeePolicy(tenantId: string, currency?: string): Promise<FeePolicySnapshot> {\n    return this.resolvePolicy(tenantId, FeeType.PLATFORM_FEE, currency);\n  }\n\n  async resolvePerformanceFeePolicy(tenantId: string, currency?: string): Promise<FeePolicySnapshot> {\n    return this.resolvePolicy(tenantId, FeeType.PERFORMANCE_FEE, currency);\n  }\n\n  async getEffectiveRateBps(tenantId: string, feeType: FeeType): Promise<number> {\n    const policy = await this.resolvePolicy(tenantId, feeType);\n    return feeType === FeeType.PLATFORM_FEE ? policy.platformFeeBps : policy.performanceFeeBps;\n  }\n\n  private validateBps(bps: any): number | null {\n    if (typeof bps !== 'number') return null;\n    if (isNaN(bps)) return null;\n    if (bps < 0 || bps > 10000) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Invalid BPS ${bps}, must be 0-10000`);\n      return null;\n    }\n    return Math.floor(bps);\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/fees/fee-reconciliation.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/fees/fee-settlement.repository.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { SettlementBatch, SettlementItem, SettlementState, FeeType } from './fee.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Persistence abstraction for settlement batches, items, locks, status transitions.\n * Idempotent via idempotencyKey, prevents double settlement.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class FeeSettlementRepository {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(FeeSettlementRepository.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async createSettlement(data: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    currency: string;\n    grossFeeAmount: string;\n    adjustments?: string;\n    finalSettlementAmount: string;\n    numberOfAccruals: number;\n    feeType: FeeType | 'MIXED';\n    status: SettlementState;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n    accrualIds: string[];\n    metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n  }): Promise<SettlementBatch> {\n    // Idempotency check\n    const existingByKey = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(data.idempotencyKey, data.tenantId);\n    if (existingByKey) {\n      this.logger.log(`Idempotent settlement return by idempotencyKey: ${data.idempotencyKey}`);\n      return existingByKey;\n    }\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    const settlement: SettlementBatch = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: data.tenantId,\n      currency: data.currency.toUpperCase(),\n      grossFeeAmount: data.grossFeeAmount,\n      adjustments: data.adjustments || '0',\n      finalSettlementAmount: data.finalSettlementAmount,\n      numberOfAccruals: data.numberOfAccruals,\n      feeType: data.feeType,\n      status: data.status,\n      idempotencyKey: data.idempotencyKey,\n      accrualIds: data.accrualIds,\n      createdAt: now,\n      calculatedAt: data.status === SettlementState.CALCULATED || data.status === SettlementState.FINALIZED ? now : null,\n      approvedAt: null,\n      finalizedAt: data.status === SettlementState.FINALIZED ? now : null,\n      paidAt: null,\n      metadata: data.metadata || null,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).feeSettlement?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: settlement.id,\n          tenantId: settlement.tenantId,\n          currency: settlement.currency,\n          grossFeeAmount: settlement.grossFeeAmount,\n          adjustments: settlement.adjustments,\n          finalSettlementAmount: settlement.finalSettlementAmount,\n          numberOfAccruals: settlement.numberOfAccruals,\n          feeType: settlement.feeType,\n          status: settlement.status,\n          idempotencyKey: settlement.idempotencyKey,\n          accrualIds: settlement.accrualIds,\n          createdAt: new Date(settlement.createdAt),\n          approvedAt: null,\n          finalizedAt: settlement.finalizedAt ? new Date(settlement.finalizedAt) : null,\n          paidAt: null,\n          // FeeSettlement has no calculatedAt column; it is kept in metadata.\n          metadata: { ...(settlement.metadata ?? {}), calculatedAt: settlement.calculatedAt ?? null } as any,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (created) {\n        // Create settlement items\n        await this.createSettlementItems(id, data.accrualIds, data.tenantId, data.currency, data.feeType);\n\n        return this.mapBatchToDomain(created);\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2002') {\n        this.logger.warn(`Duplicate settlement idempotency: ${data.idempotencyKey}`);\n        const existing = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(data.idempotencyKey, data.tenantId);\n        if (existing) return existing;\n      }\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        this.logger.warn(`feeSettlement table not found, fallback: ${error.message}`);\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).auditLog?.create({\n            data: {\n              id: randomUUID(),\n              tenantId: data.tenantId,\n              action: 'SETTLEMENT_CREATED',\n              resourceType: 'FeeSettlement',\n              resourceId: id,\n              metadata: { ...settlement, fallback: true },\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n        } catch {}\n        return settlement;\n      }\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to create settlement: ${error.message}`, error.stack);\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    return settlement;\n  }\n\n  private async createSettlementItems(settlementId: string, accrualIds: string[], tenantId: string, currency: string, feeType: FeeType | 'MIXED'): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      // Fetch accruals to get fee amounts\n      const accruals = await (this.prisma as any).feeAccrual?.findMany({\n        where: { id: { in: accrualIds } },\n      });\n\n      if (!accruals || accruals.length === 0) {\n        // Fallback: create items without amounts\n        for (const accrualId of accrualIds) {\n          try {\n            await (this.prisma as any).feeSettlementItem?.create({\n              data: {\n                id: randomUUID(),\n                settlementId,\n                accrualId,\n                tenantId,\n                feeType: feeType === 'MIXED' ? 'PLATFORM_FEE' : feeType,\n                feeAmount: '0',\n                currency,\n                status: SettlementState.DRAFT,\n                createdAt: new Date(),\n                updatedAt: new Date(),\n              },\n            });\n          } catch {}\n        }\n        return;\n      }\n\n      for (const accrual of accruals) {\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).feeSettlementItem?.create({\n            data: {\n              id: randomUUID(),\n              settlementId,\n              accrualId: accrual.id,\n              tenantId,\n              feeType: accrual.feeType,\n              feeAmount: accrual.feeAmount?.toString() || '0',\n              currency: accrual.currency,\n              status: SettlementState.DRAFT,\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n              updatedAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n        } catch (e: any) {\n          if (e.code !== 'P2002') {\n            this.logger.warn(`Failed to create settlement item for accrual ${accrual.id}: ${e.message}`);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to create settlement items: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async findById(id: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<SettlementBatch | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).feeSettlement?.findFirst({\n      where: { id, ...(tenantId ? { tenantId } : {}) },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapBatchToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async findByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey: string, tenantId: string): Promise<SettlementBatch | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).feeSettlement?.findFirst({\n      where: { idempotencyKey, tenantId },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapBatchToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async listByTenant(\n    tenantId: string,\n    filter?: {\n      status?: SettlementState;\n      currency?: string;\n      feeType?: FeeType | 'MIXED';\n      fromDate?: Date;\n      toDate?: Date;\n      limit?: number;\n      offset?: number;\n    },\n  ): Promise<SettlementBatch[]> {\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (filter?.status) where.status = filter.status;\n    if (filter?.currency) where.currency = filter.currency;\n    if (filter?.feeType) where.feeType = filter.feeType;\n    if (filter?.fromDate || filter?.toDate) {\n      where.createdAt = {};\n      if (filter.fromDate) where.createdAt.gte = filter.fromDate;\n      if (filter.toDate) where.createdAt.lte = filter.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).feeSettlement?.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      take: filter?.limit || 100,\n      skip: filter?.offset || 0,\n    });\n\n    if (!results) return [];\n    return results.map((r: any) => this.mapBatchToDomain(r));\n  }\n\n  async getSettlementItems(settlementId: string): Promise<SettlementItem[]> {\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).feeSettlementItem?.findMany({\n      where: { settlementId },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },\n    });\n    if (!results) return [];\n    return results.map((r: any) => this.mapItemToDomain(r));\n  }\n\n  async updateStatus(\n    id: string,\n    status: SettlementState,\n    extra?: { approvedAt?: string | null; finalizedAt?: string | null; paidAt?: string | null },\n  ): Promise<SettlementBatch | null> {\n    try {\n      const data: any = { status, updatedAt: new Date() };\n      if (extra?.approvedAt !== undefined) data.approvedAt = extra.approvedAt ? new Date(extra.approvedAt) : null;\n      if (extra?.finalizedAt !== undefined) data.finalizedAt = extra.finalizedAt ? new Date(extra.finalizedAt) : null;\n      if (extra?.paidAt !== undefined) data.paidAt = extra.paidAt ? new Date(extra.paidAt) : null;\n      if (status === SettlementState.CALCULATED) {\n        const existing = await (this.prisma as any).feeSettlement?.findUnique({ where: { id } });\n        const current = existing?.metadata && typeof existing.metadata === 'object' ? existing.metadata : {};\n        data.metadata = { ...current, calculatedAt: current.calculatedAt ?? new Date().toISOString() };\n      }\n      if (status === SettlementState.APPROVED && !data.approvedAt) data.approvedAt = new Date();\n      if (status === SettlementState.FINALIZED && !data.finalizedAt) data.finalizedAt = new Date();\n      if (status === SettlementState.PAID && !data.paidAt) data.paidAt = new Date();\n\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).feeSettlement?.update({\n        where: { id },\n        data,\n      });\n\n      if (!updated) return null;\n      return this.mapBatchToDomain(updated);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private mapBatchToDomain(raw: any): SettlementBatch {\n    return {\n      id: raw.id,\n      tenantId: raw.tenantId,\n      currency: raw.currency,\n      grossFeeAmount: raw.grossFeeAmount?.toString() || '0',\n      adjustments: raw.adjustments?.toString() || '0',\n      finalSettlementAmount: raw.finalSettlementAmount?.toString() || '0',\n      numberOfAccruals: raw.numberOfAccruals,\n      feeType: raw.feeType as FeeType | 'MIXED',\n      status: raw.status as SettlementState,\n      idempotencyKey: raw.idempotencyKey,\n      accrualIds: raw.accrualIds || [],\n      createdAt: raw.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n      calculatedAt: raw.metadata?.calculatedAt ? new Date(raw.metadata.calculatedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      approvedAt: raw.approvedAt ? new Date(raw.approvedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      finalizedAt: raw.finalizedAt ? new Date(raw.finalizedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      paidAt: raw.paidAt ? new Date(raw.paidAt).toISOString() : null,\n      metadata: raw.metadata || null,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private mapItemToDomain(raw: any): SettlementItem {\n    return {\n      id: raw.id,\n      settlementId: raw.settlementId,\n      accrualId: raw.accrualId,\n      tenantId: raw.tenantId,\n      feeType: raw.feeType as FeeType,\n      feeAmount: raw.feeAmount?.toString() || '0',\n      currency: raw.currency,\n      status: raw.status as SettlementState,\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/fees/fee-settlement.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/fees/fee.types.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/fees/fees-phase3.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/fees/fees.module.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/fees/payout-provider.factory.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected Set PAYOUT_PROVIDER env variable to enable payouts. No fake success allowed.');\n  }\n\n  async getPayoutStatus(): Promise<any> {\n    throw new Error('Payout provider not configured');\n  }\n\n  normalizeStatus(): any {\n    return 'FAILED' as any;\n  }\n}\n\nclass ManualPayoutProvider implements IPayoutProvider {\n  readonly providerName = PayoutProvider.MANUAL;\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ManualPayoutProvider.name);\n\n  isAvailable(): boolean {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  async createPayout(input: any): Promise<any> {\n    // Manual provider does not auto-execute, creates pending record for manual approval\n    this.logger.log(`Manual payout created for settlement ${input.settlementId} amount ${input.amount} ${input.currency} beneficiary ${input.beneficiaryId}`);\n    return {\n      providerPayoutId: `manual_${input.settlementId}_${Date.now()}`,\n      providerReference: `MANUAL-${input.tenantId.substring(0, 8)}`,\n      status: 'PENDING' as any,\n      rawResponse: { manual: true, requiresApproval: true },\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getPayoutStatus(providerPayoutId: string): Promise<any> {\n    // Manual provider always returns pending until manually marked succeeded\n    return {\n      providerPayoutId,\n      status: 'PENDING' as any,\n      rawResponse: { manual: true },\n    };\n  }\n\n  normalizeStatus(providerStatus: string): any {\n    const map: Record<string, string> = {\n      pending: 'PENDING',\n      processing: 'PROCESSING',\n      succeeded: 'SUCCEEDED',\n      failed: 'FAILED',\n      cancelled: 'CANCELLED',\n    };\n    return (map[providerStatus.toLowerCase()] || 'PENDING') as any;\n  }\n}\n\nclass InternalPayoutProvider implements IPayoutProvider {\n  readonly providerName = PayoutProvider.INTERNAL;\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(InternalPayoutProvider.name);\n\n  isAvailable(): boolean {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  async createPayout(input: any): Promise<any> {\n    // Internal ledger transfer - no external provider, but still requires confirmation via internal state\n    this.logger.log(`Internal payout ledger transfer settlement=${input.settlementId} amount=${input.amount}`);\n    return {\n      providerPayoutId: `internal_${input.settlementId}_${Date.now()}`,\n      providerReference: `INTERNAL-${input.settlementId.substring(0, 8)}`,\n      status: 'PROCESSING' as any,\n      rawResponse: { internal: true },\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getPayoutStatus(providerPayoutId: string): Promise<any> {\n    // Internal transfers succeed after processing\n    return {\n      providerPayoutId,\n      status: 'SUCCEEDED' as any,\n      processedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      rawResponse: { internal: true, confirmed: true },\n    };\n  }\n\n  normalizeStatus(providerStatus: string): any {\n    return providerStatus === 'SUCCEEDED' ? 'SUCCEEDED' : 'PROCESSING';\n  }\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PayoutProviderFactory {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PayoutProviderFactory.name);\n  private readonly configuredProvider: PayoutProvider;\n\n  constructor() {\n    const providerRaw = (process.env.PAYOUT_PROVIDER || process.env.BILLING_PAYOUT_PROVIDER || 'none').toLowerCase();\n    this.configuredProvider = this.parseProvider(providerRaw);\n    this.logger.log(`Configured payout provider: ${this.configuredProvider}`);\n  }\n\n  getProvider(provider?: PayoutProvider): IPayoutProvider {\n    const target = provider || this.configuredProvider;\n\n    if (target === PayoutProvider.NONE) {\n      this.logger.warn('Payout provider NONE configured - payouts will fail with config error, no fake success');\n      return new NoOpPayoutProvider();\n    }\n\n    switch (target) {\n      case PayoutProvider.MANUAL:\n        return new ManualPayoutProvider();\n      case PayoutProvider.INTERNAL:\n        return new InternalPayoutProvider();\n      case PayoutProvider.STRIPE: {\n        // Stripe Connect Transfers to the beneficiary's connected account.\n        // Without a usable secret key it fails closed (NoOp) instead of\n        // falling back to a provider that could report the payout as paid.\n        const stripe = new StripeConnectPayoutProvider();\n        if (!stripe.isAvailable()) {\n          this.logger.error('STRIPE payout requested but STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (sk_/rk_) is not configured');\n          return new NoOpPayoutProvider();\n        }\n        return stripe;\n      }\n      case PayoutProvider.BANK_TRANSFER:\n      case PayoutProvider.CRYPTO:\n        // No bank or crypto payout adapter ships in this build: fail closed.\n        this.logger.warn(`Payout provider ${target} not fully configured, returning NoOp`);\n        return new NoOpPayoutProvider();\n      default:\n        this.logger.error(`Unsupported payout provider: ${target}`);\n        return new NoOpPayoutProvider();\n    }\n  }\n\n  getDefaultProvider(): IPayoutProvider {\n    return this.getProvider();\n  }\n\n  isProviderAvailable(provider: PayoutProvider): boolean {\n    try {\n      const p = this.getProvider(provider);\n      return p.isAvailable();\n    } catch {\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  validateProviderConfiguration(): { configured: boolean; provider: PayoutProvider; message: string } {\n    const provider = this.getProvider();\n    const available = provider.isAvailable();\n    return {\n      configured: available,\n      provider: this.configuredProvider,\n      message: available\n        ? `Payout provider ${this.configuredProvider} is configured`\n        : `Payout provider not configured (current: ${this.configuredProvider}). Set PAYOUT_PROVIDER to manual|internal|stripe. No fake success allowed.`,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private parseProvider(raw: string): PayoutProvider {\n    switch (raw) {\n      case 'stripe':\n        return PayoutProvider.STRIPE;\n      case 'manual':\n        return PayoutProvider.MANUAL;\n      case 'bank_transfer':\n      case 'bank':\n        return PayoutProvider.BANK_TRANSFER;\n      case 'crypto':\n        return PayoutProvider.CRYPTO;\n      case 'internal':\n        return PayoutProvider.INTERNAL;\n      case 'none':\n      case '':\n      default:\n        return PayoutProvider.NONE;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/fees/payout-provider.interface.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/fees/payout.repository.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. mapping,\n * idempotency, status transitions, tenant-scoped payout history.\n * Protects finalized records from illegal mutation.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class PayoutRepository {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PayoutRepository.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly outbox: OutboxService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async create(data: {\n    settlementId: string;\n    beneficiaryId: string;\n    beneficiaryType: BeneficiaryType;\n    tenantId: string;\n    amount: string;\n    currency: string;\n    destination: PayoutDestination;\n    provider: PayoutProvider;\n    providerPayoutId?: string | null;\n    providerReference?: string | null;\n    status: PayoutStatus;\n    failureReason?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n    metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n    safeMetadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n  }): Promise<Payout> {\n    // Idempotency check\n    const existingByKey = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(data.idempotencyKey, data.tenantId);\n    if (existingByKey) {\n      this.logger.log(`Idempotent payout return by idempotencyKey: ${data.idempotencyKey}`);\n      return existingByKey;\n    }\n\n    const existingBySettlement = await this.findBySettlement(data.settlementId);\n    if (existingBySettlement && existingBySettlement.length > 0) {\n      // Check if same beneficiary and amount already exists for this settlement\n      const duplicate = existingBySettlement.find((p) => p.beneficiaryId === data.beneficiaryId && p.amount === data.amount && p.currency === data.currency);\n      if (duplicate) {\n        this.logger.log(`Idempotent payout return by settlement+beneficiary: settlement=${data.settlementId} beneficiary=${data.beneficiaryId}`);\n        return duplicate;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    const payout: Payout = {\n      id,\n      settlementId: data.settlementId,\n      beneficiaryId: data.beneficiaryId,\n      beneficiaryType: data.beneficiaryType,\n      tenantId: data.tenantId,\n      amount: data.amount,\n      currency: data.currency.toUpperCase(),\n      destination: data.destination,\n      provider: data.provider,\n      providerPayoutId: data.providerPayoutId || null,\n      providerReference: data.providerReference || null,\n      status: data.status,\n      failureReason: data.failureReason || null,\n      idempotencyKey: data.idempotencyKey,\n      requestedAt: now,\n      processedAt: null,\n      succeededAt: null,\n      failedAt: null,\n      cancelledAt: null,\n      metadata: data.metadata || null,\n      safeMetadata: data.safeMetadata || null,\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).payout?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: payout.id,\n          settlementId: payout.settlementId,\n          beneficiaryId: payout.beneficiaryId,\n          beneficiaryType: payout.beneficiaryType,\n          tenantId: payout.tenantId,\n          amount: payout.amount,\n          currency: payout.currency,\n          destination: payout.destination as any,\n          provider: payout.provider,\n          providerPayoutId: payout.providerPayoutId,\n          providerReference: payout.providerReference,\n          status: payout.status,\n          failureReason: payout.failureReason,\n          idempotencyKey: payout.idempotencyKey,\n          processedAt: null,\n          succeededAt: null,\n          failedAt: null,\n          cancelledAt: null,\n          metadata: (payout.metadata ?? {}) as any,\n          safeMetadata: (payout.safeMetadata ?? {}) as any,\n          // Payout has no requestedAt column: the request time is the row's createdAt.\n          createdAt: new Date(payout.requestedAt ?? payout.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(payout.updatedAt),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (created) {\n        return this.mapToDomain(created);\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2002') {\n        this.logger.warn(`Duplicate payout idempotency: ${data.idempotencyKey}`);\n        const existing = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(data.idempotencyKey, data.tenantId);\n        if (existing) return existing;\n      }\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        this.logger.warn(`payout table not found, fallback: ${error.message}`);\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).auditLog?.create({\n            data: {\n              id: randomUUID(),\n              tenantId: data.tenantId,\n              action: 'PAYOUT_CREATED',\n              resourceType: 'Payout',\n              resourceId: id,\n              metadata: { ...payout, fallback: true },\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n        } catch {}\n        return payout;\n      }\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to create payout: ${error.message}`, error.stack);\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    return payout;\n  }\n\n  async findById(id: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<Payout | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).payout?.findFirst({\n      where: { id, ...(tenantId ? { tenantId } : {}) },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async findByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey: string, tenantId: string): Promise<Payout | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).payout?.findFirst({\n      where: { idempotencyKey, tenantId },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async findBySettlement(settlementId: string): Promise<Payout[]> {\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).payout?.findMany({\n      where: { settlementId },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (!results) return [];\n    return results.map((r: any) => this.mapToDomain(r));\n  }\n\n  async findByProviderReference(providerPayoutId: string): Promise<Payout | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).payout?.findFirst({\n      where: { providerPayoutId },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async listByTenant(\n    tenantId: string,\n    filter?: {\n      status?: PayoutStatus;\n      provider?: PayoutProvider;\n      beneficiaryId?: string;\n      currency?: string;\n      fromDate?: Date;\n      toDate?: Date;\n      limit?: number;\n      offset?: number;\n    },\n  ): Promise<Payout[]> {\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (filter?.status) where.status = filter.status;\n    if (filter?.provider) where.provider = filter.provider;\n    if (filter?.beneficiaryId) where.beneficiaryId = filter.beneficiaryId;\n    if (filter?.currency) where.currency = filter.currency;\n    if (filter?.fromDate || filter?.toDate) {\n      where.createdAt = {};\n      if (filter.fromDate) where.createdAt.gte = filter.fromDate;\n      if (filter.toDate) where.createdAt.lte = filter.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).payout?.findMany({\n      where,\n
