this.logger.warn(`Duplicate ledger entry detected for ${input.idempotencyKey}, returning existing`);\n        const existingEntries = await this.findBySource(input.sourceType, input.sourceId);\n  return this.mapToLedgerEntry(result);\n  }\n\n  async findBySource(sourceType: LedgerSourceType, sourceId: string): Promise<LedgerEntry[]> {\n    const results = await (this.prisma as  DUNNING_WITHOUT_FAILURE = 'DUNNING_WITHOUT_FAILURE',\n  UNRESOLVED_DUNNING = 'UNRESOLVED_DUNNING',\n}\n\nexport interface ReconciliationIssue {\n  id: string;\n  category: ReconciliationCategory;\n  severity: ReconciliationSeverity;\n  tenantId: string;\n  paymentId: string | null;\n  invoiceId: string | null;\n  subscriptionId: string | null;\n  refundId: string | null;\n  ledgerEntryId: string | null;\n  description: string;\n  expectedValue: string | null;\n  actualValue: string | null;\n  metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n  detectedAt: Date;\n  resolved: boolean;\n  resolvedAt: Date | null;\n  resolution: string | null;\n}\n\nexport interface ReconciliationResult {\n  id: string;\n  tenantId: string | null;\n  startedAt: Date;\n  completedAt: Date;\n  totalChecked: number;\n  issuesFound: number;\n  issues: ReconciliationIssue[];\n  summary: Record<ReconciliationCategory, number>;\n  severityCounts: Record<ReconciliationSeverity, number>;\n}\n\nexport interface ReconciliationFilter {\n  tenantId?: string;\n  fromDate?: Date;\n  toDate?: Date;\n  categories?: ReconciliationCategory[];\n  severities?: ReconciliationSeverity[];\n  includeResolved?: boolean;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class BillingReconciliationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(BillingReconciliationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly ledgerRepository: BillingLedgerRepository,\n    private readonly invoiceRepository: InvoiceRepository,\n    private readonly auditService: FinanceAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async reconcile(filter?: ReconciliationFilter): Promise<ReconciliationResult> {\n    const startTime = new Date();\n    const reconciliationId = `recon_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;\n    const issues: ReconciliationIssue[] = [];\n\n    this.logger.log(`Starting reconciliation ${reconciliationId} with filter: ${JSON.stringify(filter)}`);\n\n    let totalChecked = 0;\n\n    // 1. Check payments without invoices\n    const paymentWithoutInvoiceIssues = await this.checkPaymentsWithoutInvoices(filter);\n    issues.push(...paymentWithoutInvoiceIssues);\n    totalChecked += paymentWithoutInvoiceIssues.length;\n\n    // 2. Check invoices without payments\n    const invoiceWithoutPaymentIssues = await this.checkInvoicesWithoutPayments(filter);\n    issues.push(...invoiceWithoutPaymentIssues);\n    totalChecked += invoiceWithoutPaymentIssues.length;\n\n    // 3. Check paid invoices with unpaid payments\n    const paidInvoiceUnpaidPaymentIssues = await this.checkPaidInvoicesWithUnpaidPayments(filter);\n    issues.push(...paidInvoiceUnpaidPaymentIssues);\n    totalChecked += paidInvoiceUnpaidPaymentIssues.length;\n\n    // 4. Check successful payments without subscription sync\n    const paymentWithoutSubscriptionIssues = await this.checkPaymentsWithoutSubscriptionSync(filter);\n    issues.push(...paymentWithoutSubscriptionIssues);\n    totalChecked += paymentWithoutSubscriptionIssues.length;\n\n    // 5. Check refunds without ledger\n    const refundWithoutLedgerIssues = await this.checkRefundsWithoutLedger(filter);\n    issues.push(...refundWithoutLedgerIssues);\n    totalChecked += refundWithoutLedgerIssues.length;\n\n    // 6. Check ledger entries without source\n    const ledgerWithoutSourceIssues = await this.checkLedgerWithoutSource(filter);\n    issues.push(...ledgerWithoutSourceIssues);\n    totalChecked += ledgerWithoutSourceIssues.length;\n\n    // 7. Check for duplicate entries\n    const duplicateIssues = await this.checkDuplicateEntries(filter);\n    issues.push(...duplicateIssues);\n    totalChecked += duplicateIssues.length;\n\n    // 8. missingLedgerIssues.length;\n\n    const completedAt = new Date();\n\n    // Build summary\n    const summary: Record<string, number> = {};\n    const severityCounts: Record<string, number> = {};\n\n    for (const issue of issues) {\n      summary[issue.category] = (summary[issue.category] || 0) + 1;\n      severityCounts[issue.severity] = (severityCounts[issue.severity] || 0) + 1;\n    }\n\n    const result: ReconciliationResult = {\n      id: reconciliationId,\n      tenantId: filter?.tenantId || null,\n      startedAt: startTime,\n      completedAt,\n      totalChecked,\n      issuesFound: issues.length,\n      issues,\n      summary: summary as Record<ReconciliationCategory, number>,\n      severityCounts: severityCounts as Record<ReconciliationSeverity, number>,\n    };\n\n    this.logger.log(`Reconciliation ${reconciliationId} completed: ${issues.length} issues found, ${totalChecked} checked`);\n\n    // Audit\n    if (issues.length > 0) {\n      await this.auditService.logReconciliationDetected(filter?.tenantId || 'SYSTEM', reconciliationId, issues.length, summary);\n    }\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  async reconcileTenant(tenantId: string): ...(filter?.tenantId ? { tenantId: filter.tenantId } : {}),\n          ...(filter?.fromDate || filter?.toDate\n            ? {\n                createdAt: {\n                  ...(filter.fromDate ? { gte: filter.fromDate } : {}),\n                  ...(filter.toDate ? { lte: filter.toDate } : {}),\n                },\n              }\n            : {}),\n        },\n        take: 100,\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n\n      if (!payments) return [];\n\n      for (const payment of payments) {\n        try {\n          const invoice = await         category: ReconciliationCategory.PAYMENT_WITHOUT_INVOICE,\n              severity: ReconciliationSeverity.HIGH,\n              tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n              paymentId: resolution: null,\n            });\n          }\n        } catch {\n          // Ignore individual check failures\n        }\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // Payment model may not exist\n    }\n\n    return issues;\n  }\n\n  private async checkInvoicesWithoutPayments(filter?: ReconciliationFilter): Promise<ReconciliationIssue[]> {\n    const issues: ReconciliationIssue[] = [];\n\n    try {\n JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(input.metadata)) : null,\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n      };\n\n      const result = await (this.prisma as any).dunningCase?.create({ async logInvoicePaid(tenantId: string, invoiceId: string, invoiceNumber: string, amount: string, currency: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: });\n  }\n\n  async logInvoiceVoided(tenantId: string, invoiceId: string, invoiceNumber: string, reason?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { CacheService } from '../../../infrastructure/redis/cache.service';\nimport { RedisService } from '../../../infrastructure/redis/redis.service';\n\n/**\n * Generates unique sequential/public invoice numbers with tenant-safe uniqueness,\n * concurrency protection, and configurable prefix/format rules.\n *\n * Requirements:\n *  - concurrency-safe\n *  - tenant-aware where required\n *  - globally unique public invoice number\n *  - sequential numbering strategy\n *  - configurable prefix\n *  - no duplicate numbers under concurrent invoice creation\n *  - no reliance on timestamps alone\n *  - must not expose internal database IDs or secrets\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class InvoiceNumberService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(InvoiceNumberService.name);\n  private readonly PREFIX = 'INV';\n  private readonly COUNTER_KEY = 'invoice:counter:global';\n  private readonly TENANT_COUNTER_PREFIX = 'invoice:counter:tenant';\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly cache: CacheService,\n    private readonly redis: RedisService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async generateInvoiceNumber(tenantId: string, invoiceId?: string): Promise<string> {\n    // Use Redis atomic INCR for concurrency-safe sequential numbering\n    try {\n      const globalSequence = await this.getNextGlobalSequence();\n      const tenantSequence = await this.getNextTenantSequence(tenantId);\n\n      const year = new Date().getFullYear();\n      const paddedGlobal = globalSequence.toString().padStart(8, '0');\n      const paddedTenant = tenantSequence.toString().padStart(4, '0');\n\n      // Format: INV-YYYY-GGGGGGGG-Tenant-TTTT-XXXX (XXXX is random for extra uniqueness)\n      // But we want sequential and not expose internal IDs\n      // Use: INV-YYYY-XXXXXXXX (global unique)\n      const invoiceNumber = `${this.PREFIX}-${year}-${paddedGlobal}`;\n\n      // Ensure uniqueness in DB with retry logic\n      const uniqueNumber = await this.ensureUniqueInvoiceNumber(invoiceNumber, tenantId);\n\n      this.logger.log(`Generated invoice number: ${uniqueNumber} for tenant ${tenantId}, global seq ${globalSequence}, tenant seq ${tenantSequence}`);\n\n      return uniqueNumber;\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to generate invoice number via Redis, using fallback: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      return this.generateFallbackInvoiceNumber(tenantId);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async generateInvoiceNumberWithTenantPrefix(tenantId: string): Promise<string> {\n    try {\n      const tenantSequence = await this.getNextTenantSequence(tenantId);\n      const year = new Date().getFullYear();\n      const month = (new Date().getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0');\n      const paddedSeq = tenantSequence.toString().padStart(6, '0');\n\n      // Format: INV-{TENANT_SHORT}-{YYYYMM}-{SEQ}\n      const tenantShort = tenantId.substring(0, 4).toUpperCase();\n      const invoiceNumber = `${this.PREFIX}-${tenantShort}-${year}${month}-${paddedSeq}`;\n\n      return this.ensureUniqueInvoiceNumber(invoiceNumber, tenantId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      return this.generateFallbackInvoiceNumber(tenantId);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async getNextGlobalSequence(): Promise<number> {\n    try {\n      const client = this.redis.client;\n      const result = await client.incr(this.COUNTER_KEY);\n      // Set expiry on first creation to prevent infinite growth, but keep counter\n      if (result === 1) {\n        await client.expire(this.COUNTER_KEY, 365 * 24 * 60 * 60);\n      }\n      return result;\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Fallback to DB sequence\n      return this.getNextSequenceFromDb('global');\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async getNextTenantSequence(tenantId: string): Promise<number> {\n    const key = `${this.TENANT_COUNTER_PREFIX}:${tenantId}`;\n    try {\n      const client = this.redis.client;\n      const result = await client.incr(key);\n      if (result === 1) {\n        await client.expire(key, 365 * 24 * 60 * 60);\n      }\n      return result;\n    } catch {\n      return this.getNextSequenceFromDb(tenantId);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async getNextSequenceFromDb(scope: string): Promise<number> {\n    try {\n      // Database fallback when Redis is unavailable. One upsert on the unique\n      // scope is a single INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE: atomic, so two\n      // concurrent callers can never draw the same number, and a missing\n      // counter row is created at 1 in the same statement. (The previous\n      // find-then-update/create pair could race, and fell back to a RANDOM\n      // number - a gap/duplicate risk for sequential invoice numbering.)\n      const counter = await this.prisma.invoiceCounter.upsert({\n        where: { scope },\n        create: { scope, sequence: 1 },\n        update: { sequence: { increment: 1 } },\n        select: { sequence: true },\n      });\n      return counter.sequence;\n    } catch {\n      // Ultimate fallback: timestamp + random\n      return Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) % 10000000;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async ensureUniqueInvoiceNumber(candidate: string, tenantId: string): Promise<string> {\n    let invoiceNumber = candidate;\n    let attempts = 0;\n    const maxAttempts = 5;\n\n    while (attempts < maxAttempts) {\n      try {\n        const existing = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findFirst({\n          where: { invoiceNumber },\n        });\n\n        if (!existing) {\n          return invoiceNumber;\n        }\n\n        // Collision - generate new with suffix\n        attempts++;\n        const suffix = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6).toUpperCase();\n        invoiceNumber = `${candidate}-${suffix}`;\n      } catch {\n        // If invoice model doesn't exist, return candidate\n        return invoiceNumber;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return invoiceNumber;\n  }\n\n  private generateFallbackInvoiceNumber(tenantId: string): string {\n    const year = new Date().getFullYear();\n    const timestamp = Date.now().toString().slice(-8);\n    const random = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6).toUpperCase();\n    const tenantShort = tenantId.substring(0, 4).toUpperCase();\n    return `${this.PREFIX}-${tenantShort}-${year}-${timestamp}-${random}`;\n  }\n\n  async getCurrentGlobalSequence(): Promise<number> {\n    try {\n      const client = this.redis.client;\n      const value = await client.get(this.COUNTER_KEY);\n      return value ? parseInt(value, 10) : 0;\n    } catch {\n      return 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getCurrentTenantSequence(tenantId: string): Promise<number> {\n    const key = `${this.TENANT_COUNTER_PREFIX}:${tenantId}`;\n    try {\n      const client = this.redis.client;\n      const value = await client.get(key);\n      return value ? parseInt(value, 10) : 0;\n    } catch {\n      return 0;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/finance/invoice-pdf.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. const invoice = await this.getInvoiceWithDetails(invoiceId, tenantId);\n\n    if (!invoice) {\n      throw new Error(`Invoice not found: ${invoiceId}`);\n    }\n\n    // Get tenant branding if billingPeriod: {\n        start: invoice.billingPeriodStart ? invoice.billingPeriodStart.toISOString().split('T')[0] : null,\n        end: invoice.billingPeriodEnd ? 'CA',\n          postalCode: '94105',\n          country: 'US',\n        },\n        email: branding?.supportEmail || tenant?.contactEmail || 'billing@copytrade.app',\n        taxId: undefined,\n        logoUrl: branding?.logoUrl || undefined,\n        primaryColor: branding?.primaryColor || '#1B2A4A',\n      },\n      customer: {\n        name: tenant?.name || 'Customer',\n        legalName: invoice.discountTotal,\n        taxTotal: invoice.taxTotal,\n        total: invoice.total,\n        amountPaid: invoice.amountPaid,\n        amountDue: invoice.amountDue,\n        amountRefunded: invoice.amountRefunded,\n        currency: invoice.currency,\n      },\n      taxSummary: await this.getTaxSummary(invoice),\n      paymentReference: invoice.paymentId\n        ? {\n            paymentId: invoice.paymentId,\n            provider: invoice.provider || 'unknown',\n            paidAt: invoice.paidAt?.toISOString(),\n          }\n        : undefined,\n      notes: `Thank you for your subscription to ${invoice.planName || 'our service'}.`,\n      terms: 'Payment due within 30 days. Late payments may result in service suspension.',\n    };\n\n    this.logger.log(`Generated PDF data for invoice ${invoice.invoiceNumber}`);\n\n    return pdfData;\n  }\n\n  async generateInvoiceHtml(invoiceId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<InvoicePdfResult> {\n    const data = await this.generateInvoicePdfData(invoiceId, tenantId);\n\n    const html = this.renderInvoiceHtml(data);\n\n    return {\n      data,\n      html,\n      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  private renderInvoiceHtml(data: InvoicePdfData): string {\n `\n<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html>\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <title>Invoice ${data.invoiceNumber}</title>\n  <style>\n    body { font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif; color: #0B1220; margin: 0; .line-items { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 20px 0; }\n    .line-items th { background: #f8f9fa; padding: 12px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid #dee2e6; }\n    .line-items padding: 8px 0; }\n    .totals-row.total { font-weight: bold; font-size: 18px; border-top: 2px solid #0B1220; margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 10px; }\n    .footer { margin-top: 40px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid #dee2e6; font-size: 12px; color: #6c757d; }\n  </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n  <div class=\"header\">\n    <div class=\"company\">\n      <div `<div>${this.escapeHtml(data.company.address.line1)}, ${this.escapeHtml(data.company.address.city)}, ${this.escapeHtml(data.company.address.country)}</div>` : ''}\n      ${data.company.email ? `<div>${this.escapeHtml(data.company.email)}</div>` : ''}\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"invoice-meta\">\n      <div class=\"invoice-number\">Invoice ${this.escapeHtml(data.invoiceNumber)}</div>\n      <div>Issue Date: ${this.escapeHtml(data.issueDate)}</div>\n      ${data.dueDate ? `<div>Due Date: ${this.escapeHtml(data.dueDate)}</div>` : ''}\n      ${data.billingPeriod.start ? `<div>Period: ${this.escapeHtml(data.billingPeriod.start)} to ${this.escapeHtml(data.billingPeriod.end || '')}</div>` : ''}\n    </div>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"customer\">\n    <h3>Bill To:</h3>\n    <div><strong>${this.escapeHtml(data.customer.name)}</strong></div>\n    ${data.customer.legalName && data.customer.legalName !== data.customer.name ?  <th>Unit Price</th>\n        <th>Amount</th>\n      </tr>\n    </thead>\n    <tbody>\n      ${data.lineItems.map(item => `\n        <tr>\n          <td>${this.escapeHtml(item.description)}</td>\n ${this.escapeHtml(data.totals.currency)}</td>\n        </tr>\n      `).join('')}\n    </tbody>\n  </table>\n\n  <div class=\"totals\">\n    <div class=\"totals-row\"><span>Subtotal:</span><span>${this.escapeHtml(data.totals.subtotal)} ${this.escapeHtml(data.totals.currency)}</span></div>\n    ${parseFloat(data.totals.discountTotal) > 0 ? `<div total\"><span>Total:</span><span>${this.escapeHtml(data.totals.total)} ${this.escapeHtml(data.totals.currency)}</span></div>\n    <div class=\"totals-row\"><span>Amount Paid:</span><span>${this.escapeHtml(data.totals.amountPaid)} ${this.escapeHtml(data.totals.currency)}</span></div>\n    <div class=\"totals-row\"><span>Amount class=\"totals-row\"><span>Refunded:</span><span>${this.escapeHtml(data.totals.amountRefunded)} ${this.escapeHtml(data.totals.currency)}</span></div>` : ''}\n  </div>\n\n  ${data.taxSummary.length > 0 ? `\n  <div style=\"margin-top: 30px;\">\n    <h4>Tax Breakdown</h4>\n    ${data.taxSummary.map(tax => `\n      <div>${this.escapeHtml(tax.jurisdiction || 'Tax')} (${tax.rate}%): ${this.escapeHtml(tax.taxAmount)} on ${this.escapeHtml(tax.taxableAmount)}</div>\n    `).join('')}\n  </div>\n  ` : ''}\n\n  ${data.paymentReference ? `\n  <div style=\"margin-top: 20px;\">\n    <strong>Payment Reference:</strong> ${this.escapeHtml(data.paymentReference.paymentId)} via ${this.escapeHtml(data.paymentReference.provider)}\n    ${data.paymentReference.paidAt ? ` on ${this.escapeHtml(data.paymentReference.paidAt)}` : ''}\n  </div>\n  ` : ''}\n\n  <div class=\"footer\">\n    ${data.notes ? `<div>${this.escapeHtml(data.notes)}</div>` : ''}\n    ${data.terms ? `<div style=\"margin-top: 10px;\">${this.escapeHtml(data.terms)}</div>` : ''}\n    <div style=\"margin-top: 20px;\">Invoice generated on ${new Date().toISOString()} - This is a computer generated document</div>\n  </div>\n</body>\n</html>\n    `.trim();\n  }\n\n  private async getInvoiceWithDetails(invoiceId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    try {\n      const invoice = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findFirst({\n        where: { id: invoiceId, tenantId },\n        include: { lines: true },\n      });\n      return invoice;\n    } catch {\n      // Fallback: try quantity: line.quantity,\n        unitPrice: line.unitPrice,\n        amount: line.amount,\n        type: line.type,\n      }));\n    }\n\n    // Fallback: construct from invoice totals\n    return [\n      {\n        description: `${invoice.planName || 'Subscription'} - ${invoice.billingInterval || 'Monthly'}`,\n        quantity: 1,\n        unitPrice: invoice.subtotal,\n        amount: invoice.subtotal,\n        type: 'SUBSCRIPTION',\n      },\n    ];\n  }\n\n  private async getTaxSummary(invoice: any): Promise<InvoicePdfData['taxSummary']> {\n    if (invoice.taxSummary && invoice.subtotal,\n          taxAmount: invoice.taxTotal,\n          jurisdiction: 'Tax',\n        },\n      ];\n    }\n\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  private async getTenantBranding(tenantId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const branding = await this.prisma.tenantBranding.findUnique({\n      where: { tenantId },\n      select: {\n        appName: true,\n        logoUrl: true,\n        primaryColor: true,\n        supportEmail: true,\n      },\n    });\n    return branding;\n  }\n\n  private async getTenantInfo(tenantId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({\n      where: { id: tenantId },\n      select: {\n        id: true,\n        name: true,\n        slug: true,\n        legalName: true,\n        contactEmail: true,\n      },\n    });\n    return tenant;\n  }\n\n  private escapeHtml(text: string): string {\n    if (!text) return '';\n    return text\n      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')\n      .replace(/</g, '&lt;')\n Specify a different type.","line":433,"column":56,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":433,"endColumn":59,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[18315,18318],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[18315,18318],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":32,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Responsibility: persist and read invoice records through the API repository boundary.\nimport { Injectable, Logger, Optional } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { OutboxService } from '../../../infrastructure/outbox/outbox.service';\nimport type { InvoiceRecord, InvoiceFilter, CreateInvoiceInput, UpdateInvoiceInput, InvoiceStatus } from './invoice.types';\nimport { AppException } from '../../../common/errors/app.exception';\nimport { ErrorCode } from '@wlct/shared-types';\n\n/**\n * Invoice columns hold the amounts, status, dates and the JSON documents\n * (customer, lines, taxSummary, metadata). Record fields without a column are\n * kept in `metadata._invoice` and stripped again on read. `lines` is a JSON\n * column, not a relation: the previous nested `lines.create` / `include`\n * made Prisma reject every invoice write and read.\n */\nexport const INVOICE_RECORD_METADATA_KEY = '_invoice';\n\nexport interface InvoiceRecordExtras {\n  customerId?: string | null;\n  billingPeriodStart?: string | null;\n  billingPeriodEnd?: string | null;\n  billingInterval?: string | null;\n  discountTotal?: string | null;\n  amountCredited?: string | null;\n  providerInvoiceId?: string | null;\n  planCode?: string | null;\n  planName?: string | null;\n  paymentReference?: unknown;\n}\n\nfunction invoiceObject(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {\n  return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? { ...(value as Record<string, unknown>) } : {};\n}\n\nfunction invoiceIso(value: Date | string | null | undefined): string | null {\n  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return null;\n  return value instanceof Date ? value.toISOString() : new Date(value).toISOString();\n}\n\n/** Metadata JSON for a write: caller metadata (replacing the stored one when given) plus merged record fields. */\nexport function buildInvoiceMetadata(\n  existing: unknown,\n  userMetadata: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,\n  extras: InvoiceRecordExtras,\n): Record<string, unknown> {\n  const current = invoiceObject(existing);\n  const stored = invoiceObject(current[INVOICE_RECORD_METADATA_KEY]);\n  const user = userMetadata ? invoiceObject(userMetadata) : current;\n  delete user[INVOICE_RECORD_METADATA_KEY];\n  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(extras)) {\n    if (value !== undefined) stored[key] = value;\n  }\n  return { ...user, [INVOICE_RECORD_METADATA_KEY]: stored };\n}\n\n/**\n * Persistence abstraction for invoices, invoice lines, invoice numbers,\n * status transitions, payment associations, and tenant-scoped invoice queries.\n *\n * Requirements:\n *  - tenant isolation\n *  - concurrency-safe number generation\n *  - no duplicate invoice for the same successful payment\n *  - immutable finalized invoice history where required\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class InvoiceRepository {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(InvoiceRepository.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    @Optional() private readonly outbox?: OutboxService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async create(input: CreateInvoiceInput): Promise<InvoiceRecord> {\n    try {\n      // Idempotency check: if invoice with same idempotency key exists, return it\n      const existingByIdempotency = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(input.idempotencyKey, input.tenantId);\n      if (existingByIdempotency) {\n        this.logger.log(`Idempotent invoice creation: returning existing invoice ${existingByIdempotency.id} for key ${input.idempotencyKey}`);\n        return existingByIdempotency;\n      }\n\n      // Check for duplicate invoice for same payment\n      if (input.paymentId) {\n        const existingByPayment = await this.findByPaymentId(input.paymentId);\n        if (existingByPayment) {\n          this.logger.log(`Duplicate invoice prevention: payment ${input.paymentId} already has invoice ${existingByPayment.id}`);\n          return existingByPayment;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Calculate totals from lines using precise decimal handling\n      const totals = this.calculateTotalsFromLines(input.lines, input.currency);\n\n      if (!this.outbox) {\n        throw new Error('Transactional outbox is unavailable; refusing invoice creation without its invoice.created event');\n      }\n      const invoice = await this.prisma.withTenantRls(input.tenantId, async (tx) => {\n        const created = await (tx as any).invoice.create({\n          data: {\n          id: this.generateId(),\n          invoiceNumber: await this.generateInvoiceNumber(input.tenantId),\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          subscriptionId: input.subscriptionId || null,\n          paymentId: input.paymentId || null,\n          currency: input.currency,\n          status: 'DRAFT',\n          issuedAt: input.issueDate || new Date(),\n          dueDate: input.dueDate || null,\n          subtotal: totals.subtotal,\n          taxTotal: totals.taxTotal,\n          total: totals.total,\n          amountPaid: '0',\n          amountDue: totals.total,\n          amountRefunded: '0',\n          provider: input.provider || null,\n          planId: input.planId || null,\n          idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey,\n          customer: (input.customer ?? {}) as any,\n          taxSummary: (input.taxSummary ?? []) as any,\n          metadata: buildInvoiceMetadata(null, (input.metadata as any) ?? {}, {\n            customerId: input.customerId || null,\n            billingPeriodStart: invoiceIso(input.billingPeriod?.start),\n            billingPeriodEnd: invoiceIso(input.billingPeriod?.end),\n            billingInterval: input.billingPeriod?.interval || null,\n            discountTotal: totals.discountTotal,\n            amountCredited: '0',\n            providerInvoiceId: input.providerInvoiceId || null,\n            planCode: input.planCode || null,\n            planName: input.planName || null,\n            paymentReference: input.paymentReference ?? null,\n          }) as any,\n          lines: input.lines.map((line) => ({\n            id: this.generateId(),\n            type: line.type,\n            description: line.description,\n            quantity: line.quantity,\n            unitPrice: line.unitPrice.amount,\n            amount: line.amount.amount,\n            discountType: line.discountType || null,\n            discountValue: line.discountValue || null,\n            discountAmount: line.discountAmount?.amount || null,\n            taxRate: line.taxRate || null,\n            taxAmount: line.taxAmount?.amount || null,\n            metadata: line.metadata || null,\n            planId: line.planId || null,\n            subscriptionId: line.subscriptionId || null,\n            billingPeriodStart: invoiceIso(line.billingPeriodStart as any),\n            billingPeriodEnd: invoiceIso(line.billingPeriodEnd as any),\n          })) as any,\n          },\n        });\n        if (!created) {\n          throw new AppException({ code: ErrorCode.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, message: 'Invoice persistence is unavailable' });\n        }\n        await this.outbox!.append(tx, {\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          aggregateType: 'invoice',\n          aggregateId: created.id,\n          eventType: 'invoice.created',\n          idempotencyKey: `invoice:${created.id}:created`,\n          correlationId: created.id,\n          occurredAt: created.createdAt,\n          payload: {\n            invoiceId: created.id,\n            amount: created.total,\n            currency: created.currency,\n            status: created.status,\n          },\n        });\n        return created;\n      });\n\n      return this.mapToInvoiceRecord(invoice);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if ((error as any).code === 'P2002') {\n        // Unique constraint violation - try to find existing\n        const existing = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(input.idempotencyKey, input.tenantId);\n        if (existing) return existing;\n      }\n\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to create invoice: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      throw new AppException({\n        code: ErrorCode.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n        message: 'Failed to create invoice',\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  async findById(id: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<InvoiceRecord | null> {\n    const where: any = { id };\n    if (tenantId) where.tenantId = tenantId;\n    const invoice = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findUnique({\n      where,\n    });\n    if (invoice) {\n      // If tenantId provided, double-check isolation even when using findUnique\n      if (tenantId && invoice.tenantId !== tenantId) return null;\n      return this.mapToInvoiceRecord(invoice);\n    }\n    // Fallback to findFirst for tenant isolation\n    if (tenantId) {\n      const invoiceFirst = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findFirst({\n        where: { id, tenantId },\n        });\n      if (invoiceFirst) return this.mapToInvoiceRecord(invoiceFirst);\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async findByInvoiceNumber(invoiceNumber: string): Promise<InvoiceRecord | null> {\n    const invoice = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findFirst({\n      where: { invoiceNumber },\n    });\n    if (invoice) return this.mapToInvoiceRecord(invoice);\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async findByPaymentId(paymentId: string): Promise<InvoiceRecord | null> {\n    const invoice = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findFirst({\n      where: { paymentId },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (invoice) return this.mapToInvoiceRecord(invoice);\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async findByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<InvoiceRecord | null> {\n    const invoice = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findFirst({\n      where: { idempotencyKey, tenantId },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (invoice) return this.mapToInvoiceRecord(invoice);\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async list(filter: InvoiceFilter): Promise<InvoiceRecord[]> {\n    const where: any = {};\n    if (filter.tenantId) where.tenantId = filter.tenantId;\n    const jsonFilters: any[] = [];\n    if (filter.customerId) jsonFilters.push({ metadata: { path: [INVOICE_RECORD_METADATA_KEY, 'customerId'], equals: filter.customerId } });\n    if (filter.subscriptionId) where.subscriptionId = filter.subscriptionId;\n    if (filter.paymentId) where.paymentId = filter.paymentId;\n    if (filter.status) where.status = filter.status;\n    if (filter.currency) where.currency = filter.currency;\n    if (filter.planId) where.planId = filter.planId;\n    if (filter.invoiceNumber) where.invoiceNumber = filter.invoiceNumber;\n    if (filter.billingInterval) {\n      jsonFilters.push({ metadata: { path: [INVOICE_RECORD_METADATA_KEY, 'billingInterval'], equals: filter.billingInterval } });\n    }\n    if (jsonFilters.length > 0) where.AND = jsonFilters;\n\n    if (filter.fromDate || filter.toDate) {\n      where.issuedAt = {};\n      if (filter.fromDate) where.issuedAt.gte = filter.fromDate;\n      if (filter.toDate) where.issuedAt.lte = filter.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const invoices = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      take: 100,\n    });\n\n    if (invoices) {\n      return invoices.map((inv: any) => this.mapToInvoiceRecord(inv));\n    }\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  async update(id: string, input: UpdateInvoiceInput): Promise<InvoiceRecord> {\n    try {\n      const owner = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findUnique({\n        where: { id },\n        select: { tenantId: true },\n      });\n      if (!owner?.tenantId) throw new AppException({ code: ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, message: 'Invoice not found' });\n\n      return await this.prisma.withTenantRls(owner.tenantId, async (tx) => {\n        const invoiceStore = tx as any;\n        const existing = await invoiceStore.invoice.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId: owner.tenantId } });\n        if (!existing) throw new AppException({ code: ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, message: 'Invoice not found' });\n\n        const updateData: any = {};\n        if (input.status) updateData.status = input.status;\n        if (input.dueDate !== undefined) updateData.dueDate = input.dueDate;\n        if (input.amountPaid !== undefined) updateData.amountPaid = input.amountPaid;\n        if (input.amountDue !== undefined) updateData.amountDue = input.amountDue;\n        if (input.amountRefunded !== undefined) updateData.amountRefunded = input.amountRefunded;\n        const extras: InvoiceRecordExtras = {};\n        if (input.amountCredited) extras.amountCredited = input.amountCredited;\n        if (input.providerInvoiceId) extras.providerInvoiceId = input.providerInvoiceId;\n        if (Object.keys(extras).length > 0 || input.metadata) {\n          updateData.metadata = buildInvoiceMetadata(existing.metadata, (input.metadata as any) ?? null, extras);\n        }\n        if (input.finalizedAt !== undefined) updateData.finalizedAt = input.finalizedAt;\n        if (input.paidAt !== undefined) updateData.paidAt = input.paidAt;\n        if (input.voidedAt !== undefined) updateData.voidedAt = input.voidedAt;\n\n        const invoice = await invoiceStore.invoice.update({ where: { id }, data: updateData });\n        if (input.status === 'PAID' && existing.status !== 'PAID') {\n          if (!this.outbox) {\n            throw new Error('Transactional outbox is unavailable; refusing invoice payment without its invoice.paid event');\n          }\n          await this.outbox.append(tx, {\n            tenantId: invoice.tenantId,\n            aggregateType: 'invoice',\n            aggregateId: invoice.id,\n            eventType: 'invoice.paid',\n            idempotencyKey: `invoice:${invoice.id}:paid`,\n            correlationId: invoice.paymentId && invoice.paymentId.length <= 64 ? invoice.paymentId : invoice.id,\n            occurredAt: invoice.paidAt ?? invoice.updatedAt,\n            payload: {\n              invoiceId: invoice.id,\n              amount: invoice.amountPaid,\n              currency: invoice.currency,\n              status: invoice.status,\n            },\n          });\n        }\n        return this.mapToInvoiceRecord(invoice);\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof AppException) throw error;\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to update invoice ${id}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      throw new AppException({\n        code: ErrorCode.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n        message: 'Failed to update invoice',\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  async updateStatus(id: string, status: InvoiceStatus): Promise<InvoiceRecord> {\n    const updateData: any = { status };\n    const now = new Date();\n\n    if (status === 'FINALIZED' as any) updateData.finalizedAt = now;\n    if (status === 'PAID' as any) updateData.paidAt = now;\n    if (status === 'VOID' as any) updateData.voidedAt = now;\n\n    return this.update(id, updateData);\n  }\n\n  async findByTenant(tenantId: string): Promise<InvoiceRecord[]> {\n    return this.list({ tenantId });\n  }\n\n  private calculateTotalsFromLines(lines: any[], currency: string): { subtotal: string; discountTotal: string; taxTotal: string; total: string } {\n    let subtotalMinor = 0;\n    let discountMinor = 0;\n    let taxMinor = 0;\n\n    const getMinorUnit = (curr: string): number => {\n      const map: Record<string, number> = { USD: 2, EUR: 2, GBP: 2, JPY: 0, BTC: 8, ETH: 18, USDT: 6, USDC: 6 };\n      return map[curr.toUpperCase()] ?? 2;\n    };\n\n    const parseToMinor = (amount: string, curr: string): number => {\n      const minorUnit = getMinorUnit(curr);\n      const factor = Math.pow(10, minorUnit);\n      return Math.round(parseFloat(amount) * factor);\n    };\n\n    const formatFromMinor = (minor: number, curr: discountMinor += parseToMinor(discStr, currency);\n      }\n\n      if (line.taxAmount) {\n        const taxStr = typeof line.taxAmount === 'string' ? line.taxAmount : line.taxAmount?.amount || '0';\n private async generateInvoiceNumber(tenantId: string): Promise<string> {\n    // Delegate to invoice-number service in production, here generate simple unique\n    const prefix = 'INV';\n    const Decimal-safe arithmetic boundaries,\n * rounding modes, minor-unit conversion, and money comparison helpers.\n *\n * Requirements:\n *  - precise decimal-safe representation\n *  - Never use JavaScript floating-point arithmetic for ledger totals\n *  - Compatible with Prisma Decimal conventions\n *  - Support basis-point and percentage calculations\n */\n\nexport enum Currency {\n  USD = 'USD',\n  EUR = 'EUR',\n  GBP = 'GBP',\n  JPY = 'JPY',\n  CAD = 'CAD',\n  AUD = 'AUD',\n  BTC = 'BTC',\n  ETH = 'ETH',\n  USDT = 'USDT',\n  USDC = 'USDC',\n}\n\nexport enum RoundingMode {\n  HALF_UP = 'HALF_UP',\n  HALF_DOWN = 'HALF_DOWN',\n  HALF_EVEN = 'HALF_EVEN',\n  UP = 'UP',\n  DOWN = 'DOWN',\n  CEILING = 'CEILING',\n  FLOOR = 'FLOOR',\n}\n\nexport interface Money {\n  amount: string;\n  currency: string;\n  minorUnit: number;\n}\n\nexport interface MoneyWithCurrency extends Money {\n  currency: Currency | string;\n}\n\nexport interface Percentage {\n  basisPoints: number;\n  percent: string;\n}\n\nexport const ZERO_DECIMAL_CURRENCIES = new Set(['JPY', 'KRW', 'VND', 'CLP', 'PYG', 'RWF', 'UGX', 'VUV', 'XAF', 'XOF', 'XPF', 'BTC', 'ETH']);\n\nexport const CURRENCY_MINOR_UNITS: Record<string, number> = {\n  USD: 2,\n  EUR: 2,\n  GBP: 2,\n  JPY: 0,\n  CAD: 2,\n  AUD: 2,\n  BTC: 8,\n  ETH: 18,\n  USDT: 6,\n  USDC: 6,\n};\n\nexport function getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency: string): number {\n  return CURRENCY_MINOR_UNITS[currency.toUpperCase()] ?? 2;\n}\n\nexport function isZeroDecimalCurrency(currency: string): boolean {\n  return ZERO_DECIMAL_CURRENCIES.has(currency.toUpperCase());\n}\n\nexport function createMoney(amount: string, currency: string): Money {\n  const minorUnit = getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency);\n  return {\n    amount: normalizeAmount(amount, minorUnit),\n    currency: currency.toUpperCase(),\n    minorUnit,\n  };\n}\n\nexport function normalizeAmount(amount: string, minorUnit: number): string {\n  if (!amount) return '0';\n  const parsed = amount.toString().trim();\n  if (parsed === '' || isNaN(parseFloat(parsed))) {\n    throw new Error(`Invalid amount: ${amount}`);\n  }\n  const factor = Math.pow(10, minorUnit);\n  const integerValue = Math.round(parseFloat(parsed) * factor);\n  return (integerValue / factor).toFixed(minorUnit);\n}\n\nexport function parseToMinorUnits(amount: string, currency: string): number {\n  const minorUnit = getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency);\n  const factor = Math.pow(10, minorUnit);\n  const parsed = parseFloat(amount);\n  if (isNaN(parsed)) {\n    throw new Error(`Invalid amount: ${amount}`);\n  }\n  return Math.round(parsed * factor);\n}\n\nexport function formatFromMinorUnits(minorUnits: number, currency: string): string {\n  const minorUnit = getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency);\n  const factor = Math.pow(10, minorUnit);\n  return (minorUnits / factor).toFixed(minorUnit);\n}\n\nexport function addMoney(a: Money, b: Money): Money {\n  if (a.currency !== b.currency) {\n    throw new Error(`Currency mismatch: ${a.currency} vs ${b.currency}`);\n  }\n  const aMinor = parseToMinorUnits(a.amount, a.currency);\n  const bMinor = parseToMinorUnits(b.amount, b.currency);\n  const resultMinor = aMinor + bMinor;\n  return {\n    amount: formatFromMinorUnits(resultMinor, a.currency),\n    currency: a.currency,\n    minorUnit: a.minorUnit,\n  };\n}\n\nexport function subtractMoney(a: Money, b: Money): Money {\n  if (a.currency !== b.currency) {\n    throw new Error(`Currency mismatch: ${a.currency} vs ${b.currency}`);\n  }\n  const aMinor = parseToMinorUnits(a.amount, a.currency);\n  const bMinor = parseToMinorUnits(b.amount, b.currency);\n  const resultMinor = aMinor - bMinor;\n  return {\n    amount: formatFromMinorUnits(resultMinor, a.currency),\n    currency: a.currency,\n    minorUnit: a.minorUnit,\n  };\n}\n\nexport function multiplyMoneyByDecimal(money: Money, multiplier: string, roundingMode: RoundingMode = RoundingMode.HALF_UP): Money {\n  const multiplierFloat = parseFloat(multiplier);\n  if (isNaN(multiplierFloat)) {\n    throw new Error(`Invalid multiplier: ${multiplier}`);\n  }\n  const minorUnits = parseToMinorUnits(money.amount, money.currency);\n  let resultMinor: number;\n\n  switch (roundingMode) {\n    case RoundingMode.UP:\n      resultMinor = Math.ceil(minorUnits * multiplierFloat);\n      break;\n    case RoundingMode.DOWN:\n    case RoundingMode.FLOOR:\n      resultMinor = Math.floor(minorUnits * multiplierFloat);\n      break;\n    case RoundingMode.CEILING:\n      resultMinor = Math.ceil(minorUnits * multiplierFloat);\n      break;\n    case RoundingMode.HALF_UP:\n    default:\n      resultMinor = Math.round(minorUnits * multiplierFloat);\n      break;\n  }\n\n  return {\n    amount: formatFromMinorUnits(resultMinor, money.currency),\n    currency: money.currency,\n    minorUnit: money.minorUnit,\n  };\n}\n\nexport function calculatePercentageAmount(money: Money, basisPoints: number, roundingMode: RoundingMode = RoundingMode.HALF_UP): Money {\n  if (basisPoints < 0 || basisPoints > 10000) {\n    throw new Error(`Invalid basis points: ${basisPoints}, must be 0-10000`);\n  }\n  const multiplier = (basisPoints / 10000).toString();\n  return multiplyMoneyByDecimal(money, multiplier, roundingMode);\n}\n\nexport function calculateTaxAmount(taxableAmount: Money, taxRateBasisPoints: number): Money {\n  return calculatePercentageAmount(taxableAmount, taxRateBasisPoints, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);\n}\n\nexport function compareMoney(a: Money, b: Money): number {\n  if (a.currency !== b.currency) {\n    throw new Error(`Currency mismatch: ${a.currency} vs ${b.currency}`);\n  }\n  const aMinor = parseToMinorUnits(a.amount, a.currency);\n  const bMinor = parseToMinorUnits(b.amount, b.currency);\n  if (aMinor < bMinor) return -1;\n  if (aMinor > bMinor) return 1;\n  return 0;\n}\n\nexport function isMoneyZero(money: Money): boolean {\n  return parseToMinorUnits(money.amount, money.currency) === 0;\n}\n\nexport function isMoneyPositive(money: Money): boolean {\n  return parseToMinorUnits(money.amount, money.currency) > 0;\n}\n\nexport function isMoneyNegative(money: Money): boolean {\n  return parseToMinorUnits(money.amount, money.currency) < 0;\n}\n\nexport function isMoneyGreaterThan(a: Money, b: Money): boolean {\n  return compareMoney(a, b) > 0;\n}\n\nexport function isMoneyLessThan(a: Money, b: Money): boolean {\n  return compareMoney(a, b) < 0;\n}\n\nexport function isMoneyEqual(a: Money, b: Money): boolean {\n  return compareMoney(a, b) === 0;\n}\n\nexport function sumMoney(moneyArray: Money[]): Money {\n  if (moneyArray.length === 0) {\n    throw new Error('Cannot sum empty money array');\n  }\n  const currency = moneyArray[0].currency;\n  let totalMinor = 0;\n  for (const money of moneyArray) {\n    if (money.currency !== currency) {\n      throw new Error(`Currency mismatch in sum: ${currency} vs ${money.currency}`);\n    }\n    totalMinor += parseToMinorUnits(money.amount, money.currency);\n  }\n  return {\n    amount: formatFromMinorUnits(totalMinor, currency),\n    currency,\n    minorUnit: getMinorUnitForCurrency(currency),\n  };\n}\n\nexport function absoluteMoney(money: Money): Money {\n  const minorUnits = parseToMinorUnits(money.amount, money.currency);\n  return {\n    amount: formatFromMinorUnits(Math.abs(minorUnits), money.currency),\n    currency: money.currency,\n    minorUnit: money.minorUnit,\n  };\n}\n\nexport function negateMoney(money: Money): Money {\n  const minorUnits = parseToMinorUnits(money.amount, money.currency);\n  return {\n    amount: formatFromMinorUnits(-minorUnits, money.currency),\n    currency: money.currency,\n    minorUnit: money.minorUnit,\n  };\n}\n\nexport function validateMoney(money: Money): void {\n  if (!money.amount) {\n    throw new Error('Money amount required');\n  }\n  if (!money.currency) {\n    throw new Error('Money currency required');\n  }\n  const parsed = parseFloat(money.amount);\n  if (isNaN(parsed)) {\n    throw new Error(`Invalid money amount: ${money.amount}`);\n  }\n}\n\nexport function moneyToPrismaDecimal(money: Money): string {\n  return money.amount;\n}\n\nexport function prismaDecimalToMoney(decimal: any, currency: string): Money {\n  const amount = typeof decimal === 'string' ? decimal : decimal?.toString() || '0';\n  return createMoney(amount, currency);\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/finance/refund.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":26,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger, Optional, Inject, forwardRef } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { PaymentService } from '../payments/payment.service';\nimport { PaymentProviderFactory } from '../payments/payment-provider.factory';\nimport { BillingLedgerService } from './billing-ledger.service';\nimport { InvoiceRepository } from './invoice.repository';\nimport { InvoiceService } from './invoice.service';\nimport { FinanceAuditService } from './finance.audit';\nimport { BillingEventService } from '../notifications/billing-event.service';\nimport type { CreateRefundInput, RefundRecord, RefundFilter, RefundableAmount, ProviderRefundResult } from './refund.types';\nimport { RefundStatus, RefundType, RefundReason, isValidRefundTransition } from './refund.types';\nimport type { Money } from './money.types';\nimport { createMoney, parseToMinorUnits, formatFromMinorUnits, compareMoney, isMoneyZero, isMoneyNegative } from './money.types';\n\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Implements Payment -> Refund Validation -> Provider Refund -> Refund Record\n * -> Payment State Update -> Invoice Adjustment -> Ledger Reversal -> Audit\n *\n * Requirements:\n *  - refundable amount calculation (payment total - already refunded)\n *  - never exceed refundable\n *  - capability check (provider supports refunds)\n *  - provider refund execution\n *  - concurrency-safe (no duplicate refund exceeding refundable)\n *  - prevent duplicate refund records\n *  - preserve immutable history (audit trail)\n *  - never mark completed before provider confirms\n *  - ledger reversal entry on successful refund\n *  - invoice adjustment if linked\n *  - payment state update\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class RefundService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(RefundService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly paymentService: PaymentService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: PaymentProviderFactory,\n    private readonly ledgerService: BillingLedgerService,\n    private readonly invoiceRepository: InvoiceRepository,\n    private readonly invoiceService: InvoiceService,\n    private readonly auditService: FinanceAuditService,\n    @Optional()\n    @Inject(forwardRef(() => BillingEventService))\n    private readonly billingEventService?: BillingEventService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createRefund(input: CreateRefundInput): Promise<RefundRecord> {\n    this.validateRefundInput(input);\n\n    // Idempotency check\n    const existingByIdempotency = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(input.idempotencyKey, input.tenantId);\n    if (existingByIdempotency) {\n      this.logger.log(`Idempotent refund return: ${input.idempotencyKey}`);\n      return existingByIdempotency;\n    }\n\n    // Get canonical payment\n    const payment = await this.getPaymentRecord(input.paymentId);\n    if (!payment) {\n      throw new Error(`Payment not found: ${input.paymentId}`);\n    }\n\n    if (payment.tenantId !== input.tenantId) {\n      throw new Error(`Payment ${input.paymentId} does not belong to tenant ${input.tenantId}`);\n    }\n\n    // Validate payment status allows refund\n    if (payment.status !== 'SUCCEEDED') {\n      throw new Error(`Cannot refund payment with status ${payment.status}, must be SUCCEEDED`);\n    }\n\n    // Calculate refundable amount with concurrency protection\n    const refundable = await this.calculateRefundableAmount(input.paymentId, input.tenantId);\n\n    if (isMoneyZero(refundable.refundableAmount)) {\n      throw new Error(`Payment ${input.paymentId} has no refundable amount remaining`);\n    }\n\n    // Determine refund amount\n    let refundAmount: Money;\n    if (input.refundType === RefundType.FULL) {\n      refundAmount = refundable.refundableAmount;\n    } else {\n      if (!input.amount) {\n        throw new Error('Amount required for partial refund');\n      }\n      refundAmount = input.amount;\n\n      if (isMoneyNegative(refundAmount) || isMoneyZero(refundAmount)) {\n        throw new Error('Refund amount must be positive');\n      }\n\n      if (compareMoney(refundAmount, refundable.refundableAmount) > 0) {\n        throw new Error(`Refund amount ${refundAmount.amount} exceeds refundable ${refundable.refundableAmount.amount}`);\n      }\n\n      if (refundAmount.currency !== refundable.currency) {\n        throw new Error(`Refund currency ${refundAmount.currency} does not match payment currency ${refundable.currency}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Check provider capability\n    let adapter: any;\n    try {\n      adapter = this.providerFactory.getProvider(payment.provider as any);\n    } catch {\n      throw new Error(`No adapter for provider ${payment.provider}`);\n    }\n    if (!adapter) {\n      throw new Error(`No adapter for provider ${payment.provider}`);\n    }\n\n    // Create refund record as PENDING\n    const refundRecord = await this.createRefundRecord({\n      ...input,\n      amount: refundAmount,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.logRefundRequested(input.tenantId, refundRecord.id, input.paymentId, refundAmount.amount, refundAmount.currency, input.reason);\n\n    // Execute provider refund within transaction to prevent race conditions\n    try {\n      const providerResult = await this.executeProviderRefund(payment, refundRecord, refundAmount);\n\n      // Update refund record based on provider result\n      const updatedRecord = await this.updateRefundFromProviderResult(refundRecord.id, providerResult);\n\n      if (updatedRecord.status === RefundStatus.SUCCEEDED) {\n        // Update payment record with refunded amount\n        await this.updatePaymentRefundedAmount(input.paymentId, refundAmount);\n\n        // Invoice adjustment if linked\n        if (input.invoiceId) {\n          await this.adjustInvoiceForRefund(input.invoiceId, refundAmount, input.tenantId);\n        }\n\n        // Ledger reversal\n        await this.ledgerService.recordRefund({\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          refundId: refundRecord.id,\n          paymentId: input.paymentId,\n          invoiceId: input.invoiceId || undefined,\n          amount: refundAmount,\n          currency: refundAmount.currency,\n          reason: input.reason,\n          idempotencyKey: `refund_ledger_${refundRecord.id}`,\n          metadata: { refundType: input.refundType },\n        });\n\n        await this.auditService.logRefundSucceeded(input.tenantId, refundRecord.id, input.paymentId, refundAmount.amount, refundAmount.currency);\n\n        if (this.billingEventService) {\n          this.billingEventService.onRefundSucceeded({\n            tenantId: input.tenantId,\n            refundId: refundRecord.id,\n            paymentId: input.paymentId,\n            amount: refundAmount.amount,\n            currency: refundAmount.currency,\n            supportEmail: process.env.SUPPORT_EMAIL || 'support@example.com',\n            appName: process.env.APP_NAME || 'WLCT',\n          }).catch((e) => this.logger.warn(`Failed to trigger refund succeeded notification: ${e.message}`));\n        }\n      } else if (updatedRecord.status === RefundStatus.FAILED) {\n        await this.auditService.logRefundFailed(input.tenantId, refundRecord.id, input.paymentId, providerResult.failureReason || 'Unknown failure');\n        if (this.billingEventService) {\n          this.billingEventService.onRefundFailed({\n            tenantId: input.tenantId,\n            refundId: refundRecord.id,\n            paymentId: input.paymentId,\n            amount: refundAmount.amount,\n            currency: refundAmount.currency,\n            supportEmail: process.env.SUPPORT_EMAIL || 'support@example.com',\n            appName: process.env.APP_NAME || 'WLCT',\n          }).catch((e) => this.logger.warn(`Failed to trigger refund failed notification: ${e.message}`));\n        }\n      }\n\n      return updatedRecord;\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Mark refund as failed\n      await this.markRefundFailed(refundRecord.id, (error as Error).message);\n\n      await this.auditService.logRefundFailed(input.tenantId, refundRecord.id, input.paymentId, (error as Error).message);\n\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getRefundById(id: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<RefundRecord | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).refund?.findFirst({\n      where: {\n        id,\n        ...(tenantId ? { tenantId } : {}),\n      },\n    });\n\n    if (!result) return null;\n\n    return this.mapToRefundRecord(result);\n  }\n\n  async findByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey: string, tenantId: string): Promise<RefundRecord | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).refund?.findFirst({\n      where: { idempotencyKey, tenantId },\n    });\n\n    if (!result) return null;\n\n    return this.mapToRefundRecord(result);\n  }\n\n  async listRefunds(filter: RefundFilter): Promise<RefundRecord[]> {\n    const where: any = {};\n\n    if (filter.tenantId) where.tenantId = filter.tenantId;\n    if (filter.paymentId) where.paymentId = filter.paymentId;\n    if (filter.invoiceId) where.invoiceId = filter.invoiceId;\n    if (filter.status) where.status = filter.status;\n    if (filter.refundType) where.refundType = filter.refundType;\n    if (filter.reason) where.reason = filter.reason;\n    if (filter.provider) where.provider = filter.provider;\n    if (filter.currency) where.currency = filter.currency;\n    if (filter.idempotencyKey) where.idempotencyKey = filter.idempotencyKey;\n    if (filter.fromDate || filter.toDate) {\n      where.requestedAt = {};\n      if (filter.fromDate) where.requestedAt.gte = filter.fromDate;\n      if (filter.toDate) where.requestedAt.lte = filter.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).refund?.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { requestedAt: 'desc' },\n      take: 100,\n    });\n\n    if (!results) return [];\n\n    return results.map((r: any) => this.mapToRefundRecord(r));\n  }\n\n  async calculateRefundableAmount(paymentId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<RefundableAmount> {\n    const payment = await this.getPaymentRecord(paymentId);\n    if (!payment) {\n      throw new Error(`Payment not found: ${paymentId}`);\n    }\n\n    const originalAmount = createMoney(payment.amount, payment.currency);\n\n    // Get already refunded amount\n    const refunds = await this.listRefunds({ paymentId, tenantId });\n    let refundedMinor = 0;\n\n    for (const refund of refunds) {\n      if (refund.status === RefundStatus.SUCCEEDED) {\n        refundedMinor += parseToMinorUnits(refund.amount, refund.currency);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const originalMinor = parseToMinorUnits(originalAmount.amount, originalAmount.currency);\n    const refundableMinor = originalMinor - refundedMinor;\n\n    const refundedAmount = createMoney(formatFromMinorUnits(refundedMinor, payment.currency), payment.currency);\n    const refundableAmount = createMoney(formatFromMinorUnits(Math.max(0, refundableMinor), payment.currency), payment.currency);\n\n    return {\n      paymentId,\n      tenantId,\n      originalAmount,\n      refundedAmount,\n      refundableAmount,\n      currency: payment.currency,\n      isFullyRefunded: refundableMinor <= 0,\n      isPartiallyRefunded: refundedMinor > 0 && refundableMinor < originalMinor,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async retryFailedRefund(refundId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<RefundRecord> {\n    const refund = await this.getRefundById(refundId, tenantId);\n    if (!refund) {\n      throw new Error(`Refund not found: ${refundId}`);\n    }\n\n    if (refund.status !== RefundStatus.FAILED) {\n      throw new Error(`Only FAILED refunds can be retried, current status: ${refund.status}`);\n    }\n\n    if (!isValidRefundTransition(refund.status, RefundStatus.PENDING)) {\n      throw new Error(`Invalid transition from ${refund.status} to PENDING`);\n    }\n\n    const payment = await this.getPaymentRecord(refund.paymentId);\n    if (!payment) {\n      throw new Error(`Payment not found: ${refund.paymentId}`);\n    }\n\n    // Reset to PENDING\n    const updated = await this.updateRefundStatus(refundId, RefundStatus.PENDING, {\n      failureReason: null,\n      failureCode: null,\n    });\n\n    // Re-execute provider refund\n    try {\n      const refundAmount = createMoney(refund.amount, refund.currency);\n      const providerResult = await this.executeProviderRefund(payment, updated, refundAmount);\n      const finalRecord = await this.updateRefundFromProviderResult(refundId, providerResult);\n\n      if (finalRecord.status === RefundStatus.SUCCEEDED) {\n        await this.updatePaymentRefundedAmount(refund.paymentId, refundAmount);\n\n        if (refund.invoiceId) {\n          await this.adjustInvoiceForRefund(refund.invoiceId, refundAmount, tenantId);\n        }\n\n        await this.ledgerService.recordRefund({\n          tenantId,\n          refundId,\n          paymentId: refund.paymentId,\n          invoiceId: refund.invoiceId || undefined,\n          amount: refundAmount,\n          currency: refund.currency,\n          reason: refund.reason as any,\n          idempotencyKey: `refund_ledger_${refundId}_retry`,\n        });\n\n        await this.auditService.logRefundSucceeded(tenantId, refundId, refund.paymentId, refundAmount.amount, refundAmount.currency);\n      }\n\n      return finalRecord;\n    } catch (error) {\n      await this.markRefundFailed(refundId, (error as Error).message);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async cancelRefund(refundId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<RefundRecord> {\n    const refund = await this.getRefundById(refundId, tenantId);\n    if (!refund) {\n      throw new Error(`Refund not found: ${refundId}`);\n    }\n\n    if (![RefundStatus.PENDING, RefundStatus.REQUIRES_ACTION].includes(refund.status)) {\n      throw new Error(`Cannot cancel refund with status ${refund.status}`);\n    }\n\n    return this.updateRefundStatus(refundId, RefundStatus.CANCELED);\n  }\n\n  private async createRefundRecord(params: CreateRefundInput & { amount: Money }): Promise<RefundRecord> {\n    const payment = await this.getPaymentRecord(params.paymentId);\n\n    try {\n      const data = {\n        id: randomUUID(),\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        paymentId: params.paymentId,\n        invoiceId: params.invoiceId || null,\n        refundType: params.refundType,\n        reason: params.reason,\n        reasonDetails: params.reasonDetails || null,\n        amount: params.amount.amount,\n        currency: params.amount.currency,\n        status: RefundStatus.PENDING,\n        provider: payment?.provider || 'STRIPE',\n        providerRefundId: null,\n        providerStatus: null,\n        idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n        failureReason: null,\n        failureCode: null,\n        requestedBy: params.requestedBy || null,\n        requestedAt: new Date(),\n        processedAt: null,\n        succeededAt: null,\n        failedAt: null,\n        metadata: params.metadata ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(params.metadata)) : null,\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n      };\n\n      const result = await (this.prisma as any).refund?.create({ data });\n\n      if (!result) {\n        return this.createFallbackRecord(params);\n      }\n\n      return this.mapToRefundRecord(result);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        return this.createFallbackRecord(params);\n      }\n      if (error.code === 'P2002') {\n        // Duplicate idempotency key - return existing\n        const existing = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(params.idempotencyKey, params.tenantId);\n        if (existing) return existing;\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async executeProviderRefund(payment: any, refund: RefundRecord, amount: Money): Promise<ProviderRefundResult> {\n    let adapter: any;\n    try {\n      adapter = this.providerFactory.getProvider(payment.provider as any);\n    } catch {\n      throw new Error(`No adapter for provider ${payment.provider}`);\n    }\n\n    if (!adapter) {\n      throw new Error(`No adapter for provider ${payment.provider}`);\n    }\n\n    // Update to PROCESSING\n    await this.updateRefundStatus(refund.id, RefundStatus.PROCESSING, { processedAt: new Date() });\n\n    try {\n      const providerResult = await adapter.refund({\n        providerPaymentId: payment.providerPaymentId || payment.providerReference,\n        amount: { amount: amount.amount, currency: amount.currency },\n        reason: refund.reason,\n        idempotencyKey: refund.idempotencyKey,\n      });\n\n      return {\n        providerRefundId: providerResult.providerRefundId,\n        status: RefundStatus.SUCCEEDED,\n        providerStatus: providerResult.status?.toString() || 'SUCCEEDED',\n        amount,\n        currency: amount.currency,\n        metadata: providerResult.rawResponse as any,\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // Provider refund failed\n      return {\n        providerRefundId: '',\n        status: RefundStatus.FAILED,\n        providerStatus: 'FAILED',\n        amount,\n        currency: amount.currency,\n        failureReason: error.message || 'Provider refund failed',\n        failureCode: error.code || 'PROVIDER_ERROR',\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async updateRefundFromProviderResult(refundId: string, result: ProviderRefundResult): Promise<RefundRecord> {\n    const updates: any = {\n      providerRefundId: result.providerRefundId || undefined,\n      providerStatus: result.providerStatus,\n      status: result.status,\n      failureReason: result.failureReason || null,\n      failureCode: result.failureCode || null,\n      updatedAt: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    if (result.status === RefundStatus.SUCCEEDED) {\n      updates.succeededAt = new Date();\n    } else if (result.status === RefundStatus.FAILED) {\n      updates.failedAt = new Date();\n    }\n\n    return this.updateRefundStatus(refundId, result.status, updates);\n  }\n\n  private async updateRefundStatus(refundId: string, status: RefundStatus, extra?: any): Promise<RefundRecord> {\n    try {\n      const result = await (this.prisma as any).refund?.update({\n        where: { id: refundId },\n        data: {\n          status,\n          ...extra,\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (!result) {\n        throw new Error(`Refund not found: ${refundId}`);\n      }\n\n      return this.mapToRefundRecord(result);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        // Fallback - cannot update if model doesn't exist\n        throw new Error(`Refund model not available for update: ${refundId}`);\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async markRefundFailed(refundId: string, reason: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await this.updateRefundStatus(refundId, RefundStatus.FAILED, {\n        failureReason: reason,\n        failedAt: new Date(),\n      });\n    } catch {\n      // Ignore if model doesn't exist\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async updatePaymentRefundedAmount(paymentId: string, refundAmount: Money): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      const payment = await (this.prisma as any).payment?.findUnique({ where: { id: paymentId } });\n      if (!payment) return;\n\n      const currentRefunded = payment.refundedAmount ? parseToMinorUnits(payment.refundedAmount.toString(), payment.currency) : 0;\n      const additionalMinor = parseToMinorUnits(refundAmount.amount, refundAmount.currency);\n      const newRefundedMinor = currentRefunded + additionalMinor;\n      const newRefundedAmount = formatFromMinorUnits(newRefundedMinor, payment.currency);\n\n      await (this.prisma as any).payment?.update({\n        where: { id: paymentId },\n        data: {\n          refundedAmount: newRefundedAmount,\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      // Model may not exist - log but don't fail\n      this.logger.warn(`Could not update payment refunded amount for ${paymentId}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async adjustInvoiceForRefund(invoiceId: string, refundAmount: Money, tenantId: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      const invoice = await this.invoiceRepository.findById(invoiceId, tenantId);\n      if (!invoice) return;\n\n      // Calculate new refunded total\n      const currentRefundedMinor = parseToMinorUnits(invoice.amountRefunded || '0', invoice.currency);\n      const additionalMinor = parseToMinorUnits(refundAmount.amount, refundAmount.currency);\n      const newRefundedMinor = currentRefundedMinor + additionalMinor;\n\n      const totalMinor = parseToMinorUnits(invoice.total, invoice.currency);\n      const isFullyRefunded = newRefundedMinor >= totalMinor;\n\n      const newStatus = isFullyRefunded ? 'REFUNDED' : 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED';\n\n      await this.invoiceRepository.update(invoiceId, {\n        amountRefunded: formatFromMinorUnits(newRefundedMinor, invoice.currency),\n        status: newStatus as any,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Could not adjust invoice ${invoiceId} for refund: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async getPaymentRecord(paymentId: string): Promise<any> {\n    try {\n      const result = await (this.prisma as any).payment?.findUnique({ where: { id: paymentId } });\n      if (result) return result;\n\n      // Fallback to payment service\n      const payment = await this.paymentService.getPaymentById(paymentId);\n      return payment ? { ...payment, amount: payment.amount, currency: payment.currency, provider: payment.provider, providerPaymentId: payment.providerPaymentId, status: payment.status, tenantId: payment.tenantId } : null;\n    } catch {\n      const payment = await this.paymentService.getPaymentById(paymentId);\n      return payment ? { ...payment, amount: payment.amount, currency: payment.currency, provider: payment.provider, providerPaymentId: payment.providerPaymentId, status: payment.status, tenantId: payment.tenantId } : null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private validateRefundInput(input: CreateRefundInput): void {\n    if (!input.tenantId) throw new Error('Tenant ID required');\n    if (!input.paymentId) throw new Error('Payment ID required');\n    if (!input.idempotencyKey) throw new Error('Idempotency key required');\n    if (!input.reason) throw new Error('Refund reason required');\n\n    if (input.refundType === RefundType.PARTIAL && !input.amount) {\n      throw new Error('Amount required for partial refund');\n    }\n  }\n\n  private createFallbackRecord(params: CreateRefundInput & { amount: Money }): RefundRecord {\n    return {\n      id: randomUUID(),\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      paymentId: params.paymentId,\n      invoiceId: params.invoiceId || null,\n      refundType: params.refundType,\n      reason: params.reason,\n      reasonDetails: params.reasonDetails || null,\n      amount: params.amount.amount,\n      currency: params.amount.currency,\n      status: RefundStatus.PENDING,\n      provider: 'STRIPE' as any,\n      providerRefundId: null,\n      providerStatus: null,\n      idempotencyKey: 'VALID',\n    countryCode: country,\n    vatNumber,\n    source: 'vies',\n    consultationNumber: viesStatus === 'VALID' ? 'WAPI123' : undefined,\n    checkedAt: '2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z',\n  }));\n  (svc as any).vatChecker = { check };\n  return { svc, check };\n}\n\nconst b2b = (overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>\n  ({\n    tenantId: 't1',\n    amount: createMoney('100.00', 'EUR'),\n    currency: 'EUR',\n    billingCountry: 'DE',\n    vatNumber: 'DE123456789',\n    isBusinessCustomer: true,\n    ...overrides,\n  }) as any;\n\ndescribe('reverse charge needs a verified VAT number', () => {\n  it('format mode (default): a well-formed EU VAT number -> reverse charge, evidence attached', async () => {\n    const { svc, check } = taxService();\n    const r = await svc.calculateTax(b2b());\n    expect(r.reverseCharge).toBe(true);\n    expect(r.taxAmount.amount).toBe('0.00');\n    expect(r.vatCheck).toMatchObject({ status: 'VALID', source: 'format' });\n    expect(check).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('format mode: a malformed number is charged standard VAT (was: any string gave 0%)', async () => {\n    const { svc } = taxService();\n    const r = await svc.calculateTax(b2b({ vatNumber: 'not-a-vat' }));\n    expect(r.reverseCharge).toBe(false);\n    expect(r.taxRate).toBe(1900);\n    expect(r.taxAmount.amount).toBe('19.00');\n    expect(r.vatCheck?.status).toBe('INVALID');\n  });\n\n  it('vies mode: VALID -> reverse charge with the consultation number', async () => {\n    process.env.TAX_VAT_VALIDATION = 'vies';\n    const { svc, check } = taxService({}, 'VALID');\n    const r = await svc.calculateTax(b2b());\n    expect(check).toHaveBeenCalledWith('DE', 'DE123456789');\n    expect(r.taxCategory).toBe(TaxCategory.REVERSE_CHARGE);\n    expect(r.vatCheck?.consultationNumber).toBe('WAPI123');\n  });\n\n  it('vies mode: INVALID or UNAVAILABLE -> standard VAT (the seller cannot recover uncharged VAT)', async () => {\n    process.env.TAX_VAT_VALIDATION = 'vies';\n    for (const status of ['INVALID', 'UNAVAILABLE'] as const) {\n      const { svc } = taxService({}, status);\n      const r = await svc.calculateTax(b2b());\n      expect(r.reverseCharge).toBe(false);\n      expect(r.taxAmount.amount).toBe('19.00');\n      expect(r.vatCheck?.status).toBe(status);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('same member state as the seller -> domestic VAT, no reverse charge, no check', async () => {\n    process.env.TAX_SUPPLIER_COUNTRY = 'DE';\n    process.env.TAX_VAT_VALIDATION = 'vies';\n    const { svc, check } = taxService();\n    const r = await svc.calculateTax(b2b());\n    expect(r.reverseCharge).toBe(false);\n    expect(r.taxRate).toBe(1900);\n    expect(r.vatCheck).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(check).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('consumers and non-EU customers never trigger reverse charge', async () => {\n    const { svc } = taxService();\n    expect((await svc.calculateTax(b2b({ isBusinessCustomer: false }))).reverseCharge).toBe(false);\n    const gb = await svc.calculateTax(b2b({ billingCountry: 'GB', vatNumber: 'GB123456789' }));\n    expect(gb.reverseCharge).toBe(false);\n    expect(gb.taxRate).toBe(2000);\n  });\n\n  it('none mode keeps the historical trust-the-number behaviour, explicitly marked SKIPPED', async () => {\n    process.env.TAX_VAT_VALIDATION = 'none';\n    const { svc } = taxService();\n    const r = await svc.calculateTax(b2b({ vatNumber: 'whatever' }));\n    expect(r.reverseCharge).toBe(true);\n    expect(r.vatCheck?.status).toBe('SKIPPED');\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('validateTaxId', () => {\n  it('uses per-member-state formats for EU countries and VIES in vies mode', async () => {\n    const { svc } = taxService();\n    expect((await svc.validateTaxId('DE123456789', 'DE')).valid).toBe(true);\n    expect((await svc.validateTaxId('NL123456789', 'NL')).valid).toBe(false);\n\n    process.env.TAX_VAT_VALIDATION = 'vies';\n    const unavailable = taxService({}, 'UNAVAILABLE').svc;\n    const r = await unavailable.validateTaxId('DE123456789', 'DE');\n    expect(r).toMatchObject({ valid: false, validationSource: 'vies_unavailable' });\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('invoice generation passes the tenant tax profile to the tax engine', () => {\n  const STOP = new Error('stop after building the invoice input');\n\n  function invoiceHarness(\n    tenantRow: { countryCode: string | null; metadata: Record<string, unknown> } | null,\n  ) {\n    const prisma = {\n      subscriptionPlan: {\n        findUnique: jest.fn(async () => ({\n          id: 'plan1',\n          name: 'Pro',\n          code: 'pro',\n          price: '100.00',\n          interval: 'MONTHLY',\n        })),\n      },\n      tenant: {\n        findUnique: jest.fn(async (args: any) =>\n          args.select?.countryCode\n            ? tenantRow && { id: 't1', ...tenantRow }\n            : { id: 't1', name: 'Acme', slug: 'acme', contactEmail: 'billing@acme.test' },\n        ),\n      },\n    };\n    const tax = new TaxService(prisma as any, noProvider);\n    (tax as any).vatChecker = { check: jest.fn() };\n    const created: any[] = [];\n    const repo = {\n      findByPaymentId: jest.fn(async () => null),\n      create: jest.fn(async (input: any) => {\n        created.push(input);\n        throw STOP;\n      }),\n    };\n    const payments = {\n      getPaymentById: jest.fn(async () => ({\n        id: 'pay1',\n        tenantId: 't1',\n        planId: 'plan1',\n        status: 'SUCCEEDED',\n        currency: 'EUR',\n        provider: 'STRIPE',\n        subscriptionId: null,\n        providerPaymentId: 'pi_1',\n        paidAt: new Date('2026-09-28T00:00:00Z'),\n      })),\n    };\n    const svc = new InvoiceService(\n      prisma as any,\n      repo as any,\n      {} as any,\n      tax,\n      payments as any,\n      {} as any,\n      {} as any,\n    );\n    return { svc, created };\n  }\n\n  it('taxes a German consumer at 19% (was: country never selected -> \"US\" -> 0%)', async () => {\n    const { svc, created } = invoiceHarness({ countryCode: 'DE', metadata: {} });\n    await expect(svc.createInvoiceFromPayment('pay1')).rejects.toBe(STOP);\n    const taxLine = created[0].lines.find((l: any) => l.type === 'TAX');\n    expect(taxLine.amount.amount).toBe('19.00');\n    expect(created[0].taxSummary[0]).toMatchObject({ taxRate: 1900, reverseCharge: false });\n  });\n\n  it('a French business with a VAT number: reverse charge, VAT number on the invoice, evidence in metadata', async () => {\n    const { svc, created } = invoiceHarness({\n      countryCode: 'FR',\n      metadata: { isBusinessCustomer: true, vatNumber: 'FRXX123456789', taxId: 'FRXX123456789' },\n    });\n    await expect(svc.createInvoiceFromPayment('pay1')).rejects.toBe(STOP);\n    expect(created[0].lines.find((l: any) => l.type === 'TAX')).toBeUndefined();\n    expect(created[0].taxSummary[0]).toMatchObject({ reverseCharge: true, taxRate: 0 });\n    expect(created[0].customer.vatNumber).toBe('FRXX123456789');\n    expect(created[0].metadata.vatCheck).toMatchObject({\n      status: 'VALID',\n      source: 'format',\n      countryCode: 'FR',\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('a tax-exempt tenant is not charged', async () => {\n    const { svc, created } = invoiceHarness({ countryCode: 'DE', metadata: { isTaxExempt: true } });\n    await expect(svc.createInvoiceFromPayment('pay1')).rejects.toBe(STOP);\n    expect(created[0].lines.find((l: any) => l.type === 'TAX')).toBeUndefined();\n  });\n\n  it('no country on file + TAX_UNKNOWN_COUNTRY=reject -> no invoice instead of an untaxed one', async () => {\n    process.env.TAX_UNKNOWN_COUNTRY = 'reject';\n    const { svc, created } = invoiceHarness({ countryCode: null, metadata: {} });\n    await expect(svc.createInvoiceFromPayment('pay1')).rejects.toThrow(/Billing country required/);\n    expect(created).toHaveLength(0);\n  });\n\n  it('tax profile unavailable -> no invoice', async () => {\n    const { svc, created } = invoiceHarness(null);\n    await expect(svc.createInvoiceFromPayment('pay1')).rejects.toThrow(\n      /tax information unavailable/,\n    );\n    expect(created).toHaveLength(0);\n  });\n});\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/finance/tax.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected VatCheckResult): TaxCalculationResult {\n    const country = input.billingCountry.toUpperCase();\n    const amount = input.amount;\n\n    // Reverse charge: EU business customer, cross-border, VAT taxRateBasisPoints,\n      taxAmount,\n      taxCategory: TaxCategory.STANDARD,\n      jurisdiction: `${country}${input.billingRegion ? `-${input.billingRegion}` : ''}`,\n      taxType: false,\n      taxCalculationSource: 'internal_configurable_rules',\n      calculatedAt: new Date(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  private createExemptResult(input: TaxCalculationInput, reason: ExemptionReason):
