exemptionReason: reason,\n          reverseCharge: false,\n        },\n      ],\n      exemptionReason: reason,\n      reverseCharge: false,\n      taxCalculationSource: 'exemption',\n      calculatedAt: new Date(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  private createZeroTaxResult(input: TaxCalculationInput): TaxCalculationResult {\n    const zeroMoney = createMoney('0', input.currency);\n\n    return {\n ],\n      reverseCharge: false,\n      taxCalculationSource: 'zero_rate',\n      calculatedAt: new Date(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  private createReverseChargeResult(input: TaxCalculationInput): reverseCharge: true,\n      taxCalculationSource: 'reverse_charge',\n      calculatedAt: new Date(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  private getTaxRateForCountry(country: string, region?: string): number {\n    // DEFAULT_TAX_RATES overlaid with TAX_RATES_JSON (country or\n    // country-region keys, basis points). When a tenant is given, another tenant's limit is\n   * reported exactly like a missing one (no cross-tenant read or write by id).\n   */\n  private async findOwnedLimit(id: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<Limit> {\n    const limit = await this.repository.findById(id);\n    if (!limit || (tenantId !== undefined && limit.tenantId !== tenantId)) {\n      throw new Error(`Limit not found: ${id}`);\n    }\n    return limit;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get a limit by key\n   */\n  async getLimitByKey(key: string, tenantId: string): Promise<Limit> {\n    const limit = await this.repository.findByKey(key, tenantId);\n    if (!limit) {\n      throw new Error(`Limit not found with key: ${key}`);\n    }\n    return limit;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * List limits with optional filters\n   */\n  async listLimits(filter: LimitFilter, tenantId: string): Promise<Limit[]> {\n    return this.repository.findMany(filter, tenantId);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create a new limit\n   */\n  async createLimit(data: CreateLimitRequest, tenantId: string): Promise<Limit> {\n    // Validate the request\n    const errors = this.policy.validateLimitConfig(data);\n    if (errors.length > 0) {\n      throw new Error(`Validation failed: ${errors.join(', ')}`);\n    }\n\n    // Check if limit key already exists\n    const existing = await this.repository.findByKey(data.key, tenantId);\n    if (existing) {\n      throw new Error(`Limit with key '${data.key}' already exists`);\n    }\n\n    return this.repository.create(data, tenantId);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Update a limit\n   */\n  async updateLimit(id: string, data: UpdateLimitRequest, tenantId?: string): Promise<Limit> {\n    await this.findOwnedLimit(id, tenantId);\n\n    // Same value rule as creation: -1 (unlimited) or a non-negative number.\n    if (data.value !== undefined && (typeof data.value !== 'number' || Number.isNaN(data.value) || data.value < -1)) {\n      throw new Error('Validation failed: Limit value must be -1 (unlimited) or a positive number');\n    }\n\n    return this.repository.update(id, data);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Delete a limit\n   */\n  async deleteLimit(id: string, tenantId?: string): checkLimit(\n    limitKey: string,\n    tenantId: string,\n    entityId: string,\n    requestedAmount: number = 1\n  ): Promise<LimitCheckResult> {\n    const limit = await return {\n        allowed: false,\n        limit,\n        used: 0,\n        remaining: 0,\n      };\n    }\n\n    const usage = await this.repository.getUsage(limit.id, entityId);\n    const    throw new Error(`Limit not found with key: ${limitKey}`);\n    }\n\n    // Check if limit allows this usage\n    const checkResult = await this.checkLimit(limitKey, tenantId, entityId, amount);\n    if (!checkResult.allowed) {\n      throw new Error(`Limit exceeded: ${limitKey}`);\n    }\n\n    // Update usage\n    return this.repository.updateUsage(limit.id, entityId, amount);\n  }\n\n  /**\n }\n\n    // Get window start from usage metadata or calculate it\n    const windowStart = usage.lastUsedAt || new Date();\n    const currentCount = usage.used;\n\n    return of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":31,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { BillingNotificationEventKey, WebhookSubscription, SafeNotificationPayload } from './billing-notification.types';\nimport { BillingNotificationAuditService } from './billing-notification.audit';\nimport { randomUUID, createHmac } from 'crypto';\nimport { isRecordNotFound } from '../../../common/errors/prisma-not-found';\n\n/**\n * Tenant-configured outbound billing webhooks.\n * Events: invoice.paid, payment.failed, subscription.changed, etc.\n * Tenant must explicitly configure endpoint, signed event, timestamp, event ID, replay protection, retry, logging, isolation.\n * Never sends sensitive credentials.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class BillingWebhookNotificationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(BillingWebhookNotificationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly auditService: BillingNotificationAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createSubscription(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    endpointUrl: string;\n    eventTypes: BillingNotificationEventKey[];\n    secret: string;\n    enabled?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<WebhookSubscription> {\n    // Validate HTTPS\n    this.validateEndpointUrl(params.endpointUrl);\n\n    // Check cross-tenant ownership - endpoint unique per tenant\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).webhookSubscription?.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, endpointUrl: params.endpointUrl },\n      });\n      if (existing) {\n        throw new Error(`Webhook subscription already exists for endpoint ${params.endpointUrl} in tenant ${params.tenantId}`);\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.message.includes('already exists')) throw e;\n    }\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n    const secretHash = this.hashSecret(params.secret);\n    const secretMasked = this.maskSecret(params.secret);\n\n    const subscription: WebhookSubscription = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      endpointUrl: params.endpointUrl,\n      eventTypes: params.eventTypes,\n      enabled: params.enabled ?? true,\n      secretHash,\n      secretMasked,\n      lastDeliveryAt: null,\n      lastDeliveryStatus: null,\n      failureCount: 0,\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).webhookSubscription?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: subscription.id,\n          tenantId: subscription.tenantId,\n          endpointUrl: subscription.endpointUrl,\n          eventTypes: subscription.eventTypes,\n          enabled: subscription.enabled,\n          secretHash: subscription.secretHash,\n          secretMasked: subscription.secretMasked,\n          failureCount: 0,\n          createdAt: new Date(subscription.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(subscription.updatedAt),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (created) {\n        return this.mapSubscriptionToDomain(created);\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        this.logger.warn(`webhookSubscription table not found, fallback: ${error.message}`);\n        return subscription;\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    return subscription;\n  }\n\n  async listSubscriptions(tenantId: string): Promise<WebhookSubscription[]> {\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).webhookSubscription?.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (!results) return [];\n    return results.map((r: any) => this.mapSubscriptionToDomain(r));\n  }\n\n  async findSubscriptionById(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<WebhookSubscription | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).webhookSubscription?.findFirst({\n      where: { id, tenantId },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapSubscriptionToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async updateSubscription(\n    id: string,\n    tenantId: string,\n    updates: { endpointUrl?: string; eventTypes?: BillingNotificationEventKey[]; enabled?: boolean },\n  ): Promise<WebhookSubscription | null> {\n    if (updates.endpointUrl) {\n      this.validateEndpointUrl(updates.endpointUrl);\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const data: any = { updatedAt: new Date() };\n      if (updates.endpointUrl) data.endpointUrl = updates.endpointUrl;\n      if (updates.eventTypes) data.eventTypes = updates.eventTypes;\n      if (updates.enabled !== undefined) data.enabled = updates.enabled;\n\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).webhookSubscription?.update({\n        where: { id, tenantId },\n        data,\n      });\n\n      if (!updated) return null;\n      return this.mapSubscriptionToDomain(updated);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async rotateSecret(id: string, tenantId: string, newSecret: string): Promise<WebhookSubscription | null> {\n    try {\n      const secretHash = this.hashSecret(newSecret);\n      const secretMasked = this.maskSecret(newSecret);\n\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).webhookSubscription?.update({\n        where: { id, tenantId },\n        data: {\n          secretHash,\n          secretMasked,\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (!updated) return null;\n      return this.mapSubscriptionToDomain(updated);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async deleteSubscription(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).webhookSubscription?.delete({\n        where: { id, tenantId },\n      });\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return false;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async deliverWebhook(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    eventId: string;\n    eventType: BillingNotificationEventKey;\n    payload: SafeNotificationPayload;\n    idempotencyKey?: string;\n  }): Promise<{ delivered: number; failed: number; results: any[] }> {\n    const subscriptions = await this.listSubscriptions(params.tenantId);\n    const eligible = subscriptions.filter((s) => s.enabled && (s.eventTypes.includes(params.eventType) || s.eventTypes.includes('*' as any)));\n\n    if (eligible.length === 0) {\n      this.logger.log(`No webhook subscriptions for tenant=${params.tenantId} event=${params.eventType}`);\n      return { delivered: 0, failed: 0, results: [] };\n    }\n\n    const results: any[] = [];\n    let delivered = 0;\n    let failed = 0;\n\n    for (const subscription of eligible) {\n      try {\n        const result = await this.deliverToEndpoint({\n          subscription,\n          eventId: params.eventId,\n          eventType: params.eventType,\n          payload: params.payload,\n          idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey || `webhook_${params.eventId}_${subscription.id}`,\n        });\n\n        results.push({ subscriptionId: subscription.id, endpoint: subscription.endpointUrl, success: result.accepted, result });\n\n        if (result.accepted) {\n          delivered++;\n          await this.updateDeliveryStatus(subscription.id, 'DELIVERED');\n          await this.auditService.logWebhookSent(params.tenantId, subscription.id, params.eventType, result.providerReference);\n        } else {\n          failed++;\n          await this.updateDeliveryStatus(subscription.id, 'FAILED', result.failureReason);\n          await this.auditService.logWebhookFailed(params.tenantId, subscription.id, params.eventType, result.failureReason || 'Delivery failed', result.httpStatus);\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        failed++;\n        results.push({ subscriptionId: subscription.id, endpoint: subscription.endpointUrl, success: false, error: e.message });\n        await this.auditService.logWebhookFailed(params.tenantId, subscription.id, params.eventType, e.message);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { delivered, failed, results };\n  }\n\n  private async deliverToEndpoint(params: {\n    subscription: WebhookSubscription;\n    eventId: string;\n    eventType: BillingNotificationEventKey;\n    payload: SafeNotificationPayload;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n  }): Promise<{ accepted: boolean; providerReference: string | null; httpStatus?: number; failureReason?: string }> {\n    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();\n    const payloadToSign = {\n      eventId: params.eventId,\n      eventType: params.eventType,\n      timestamp,\n      tenantId: params.subscription.tenantId,\n      payload: this.sanitizePayload(params.payload),\n    };\n\n    const signature = this.signPayload(payloadToSign, params.subscription.secretHash);\n\n    // Idempotency check for webhook delivery\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).webhookDeliveryAttempt?.findFirst({\n        where: { eventId: params.eventId, subscriptionId: params.subscription.id },\n      });\n      if (existing && existing.status === 'DELIVERED') {\n        this.logger.log(`Idempotent webhook delivery return: event=${params.eventId} subscription=${params.subscription.id}`);\n        return { accepted: true, providerReference: existing.id, httpStatus: 200 };\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    try {\n      // Use fetch to deliver webhook\n      const controller = new AbortController();\n      const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000);\n\n      const response = await fetch(params.subscription.endpointUrl, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n          'X-Webhook-Event-Id': params.eventId,\n          'X-Webhook-Event-Type': params.eventType,\n          'X-Webhook-Timestamp': timestamp,\n          'X-Webhook-Signature': signature,\n          'X-Idempotency-Key': params.idempotencyKey,\n          'User-Agent': 'WLCT-Billing-Webhook/1.0',\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(payloadToSign),\n        signal: controller.signal,\n      });\n\n      clearTimeout(timeout);\n\n      const responseText = await response.text().catch(() => '');\n\n      if (response.ok) {\n        // Record delivery attempt\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).webhookDeliveryAttempt?.create({\n            data: {\n              id: randomUUID(),\n              subscriptionId: params.subscription.id,\n              tenantId: params.subscription.tenantId,\n              eventId: params.eventId,\n              eventType: params.eventType,\n              endpointUrl: params.subscription.endpointUrl,\n              payload: payloadToSign as any,\n              signature,\n              timestamp: new Date(timestamp),\n              status: 'DELIVERED',\n              attempt: 1,\n              providerReference: `http_${response.status}`,\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n        } catch {}\n\n        return { accepted: true, providerReference: `http_${response.status}`, httpStatus: response.status };\n      } else {\n        // Record failed attempt\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).webhookDeliveryAttempt?.create({\n            data: {\n              id: randomUUID(),\n              subscriptionId: params.subscription.id,\n              tenantId: params.subscription.tenantId,\n              eventId: params.eventId,\n              eventType: params.eventType,\n              endpointUrl: params.subscription.endpointUrl,\n              payload: payloadToSign as any,\n              signature,\n              timestamp: new Date(timestamp),\n              status: 'FAILED',\n              attempt: 1,\n              failureReason: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${responseText.substring(0, 500)}`,\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n        } catch {}\n\n        const retryable = response.status >= 500 || response.status === 429;\n        return {\n          accepted: false,\n          providerReference: null,\n          httpStatus: response.status,\n          failureReason: `HTTP ${response.status}: ${responseText.substring(0, 500)}`,\n        };\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      const isTimeout = error.name === 'AbortError' || error.message.includes('timeout');\n      const cannot send email');\n      return {\n        accepted: false,\n        providerReference: null,\n        resultType: ProviderDeliveryResultType.PERMANENT_FAILURE,\n        retryable: false,\n        errorCode: 'SMTP_NOT_CONFIGURED',\n        failureReason: 'Email provider not configured. {\n                  user: this.smtpConfig!.user,\n                  pass: this.smtpConfig!.pass,\n                }\n              : undefined,\n          });\n\n          const info = await transporter.sendMail({\n            from: this.smtpConfig!.from,\n            to: input.recipientEmail,\n            subject: sanitizedSubject,\n            text: sanitizedBody,\n            html: input.htmlBody ? this.sanitizeContent(input.htmlBody) : undefined,\n            headers: {\n              'X-Idempotency-Key': input.idempotencyKey,\n              'X-Tenant-Id': input.tenantId,\n              'X-Template-Key': input.templateKey,\n            },\n          });\n\n          messageId = info.messageId || `smtp_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;\n\n          this.logger.log(`Email sent via SMTP to=${input.recipientEmail} template=${input.templateKey} messageId=${messageId} tenant=${input.tenantId}`);\n        } else {\n          // nodemailer could not be loaded, so nothing was sent. Reporting\n          // acceptance here (the previous behaviour, with a `dev_` message id)\n          // marked invoices and dunning notices as delivered when no message\n          // left the process. A missing transport is a deployment fault, not a\n          // property of this message: non-retryable for this attempt, and the\n          // error code names the fix.\n          this.logger.error(\n            `Email transport unavailable (nodemailer not installed) - NOT sent to=${input.recipientEmail} template=${input.templateKey} tenant=${input.tenantId} idempotency=${input.idempotencyKey}`,\n          );\n          return {\n            accepted: false,\n            providerReference: null,\n            resultType: ProviderDeliveryResultType.PERMANENT_FAILURE,\n            retryable: false,\n            errorCode: 'EMAIL_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE',\n            failureReason: 'Email transport unavailable: the nodemailer package is not installed.',\n          };\n        }\n      } catch (smtpError: any) {\n        // Classify SMTP errors as temporary vs permanent\n        const isTemporary = this.isTemporarySmtpError(smtpError);\n\n        this.logger.error(`SMTP send failed to=${input.recipientEmail} error=${smtpError.message}`, smtpError.stack);\n\n        return {\n          accepted: false,\n          providerReference: null,\n          resultType: isTemporary ? ProviderDeliveryResultType.TEMPORARY_FAILURE : ProviderDeliveryResultType.PERMANENT_FAILURE,\n          retryable: isTemporary,\n          errorCode: isTemporary ? 'SMTP_TEMPORARY_FAILURE' : 'SMTP_PERMANENT_FAILURE',\n          failureReason: smtpError.message,\n        };\n      }\n\n      // Success - provider returned valid delivery acceptance\n      return {\n        accepted: true,\n        providerReference: messageId,\n        resultType: ProviderDeliveryResultType.ACCEPTED,\n        retryable: false,\n        deliveredAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      this.logger.error(`Email provider unexpected error: ${error.message}`, error.stack);\n\n      return {\n        accepted: false,\n        providerReference: null,\n        resultType: ProviderDeliveryResultType.TEMPORARY_FAILURE,\n        retryable: true,\n        errorCode: 'EMAIL_PROVIDER_ERROR',\n        failureReason: error.message,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** The nodemailer module, or null when it cannot be loaded. Static so a test can replace it. */\n  static async loadNodemailer(): Promise<typeof import('nodemailer') | null> {\n    return import('nodemailer').catch(() => null);\n  }\n\n  private buildSmtpConfig(): SmtpConfig | null {\n    const host = process.env.SMTP_HOST || process.env.EMAIL_HOST || '';\n    const port = parseInt(process.env.SMTP_PORT || process.env.EMAIL_PORT || '587', 10);\n    const user = process.env.SMTP_USER || process.env.EMAIL_USER || '';\n    const pass = process.env.SMTP_PASS || process.env.EMAIL_PASS || '';\n    const from = process.env.SMTP_FROM || process.env.EMAIL_FROM || process.env.SMTP_USER || '';\n    const secure = (process.env.SMTP_SECURE || 'false').toLowerCase() === 'true';\n\n    if (!host) {\n      this.logger.warn('SMTP_HOST not boolean {\n    const message = (error.message || '').toLowerCase();\n    const code = (error.code || '').toLowerCase();\n\n    // Temporary errors: network, timeout, rate limit, mailbox full, etc\n    const temporaryIndicators = ['timeout', 'econnreset', 'etimedout', 'esocket', 'rate', 'limit', 'try again', 'temporarily', '4.7', '4.3', '4.4', '450', '451', '452', '421'];\n\n    // Permanent errors: invalid recipient, authentication failure, etc\n    const permanentIndicators = ['invalid', 'auth', '5.1', '5.2', '550', '551', '553', '501', '535', 'authentication'];\n\n    if (temporaryIndicators.some((ind) => message.includes(ind) || code.includes(ind))) {\n      return true;\n    }\n    if (permanentIndicators.some((ind) => message.includes(ind) || code.includes(ind))) {\n      return false;\n    }\n\n    // Default to temporary for retry safety, unless clearly permanent\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  private sanitizeContent(content: string): string {\n    if (!content) return '';\n    // Never include secrets in email content\n    const forbiddenPatterns = [\n      /stripe[_-]?secret/gi,\n      /nowpayments[_-]?api[_-]?key/gi,\n      /exchange[_-]?secret/gi,\n      /private[_-]?key/gi,\n      /api[_-]?secret/gi,\n      /password/gi,\n    ];\n\n    let sanitized = content;\n    for (const pattern of forbiddenPatterns) {\n      if optional so unit tests and workers without realtime still build.\n    @Optional() private readonly realtime?: RealtimeService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createNotification(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    eventKey: BillingNotificationEventKey;\n    channel: NotificationChannel;\n    title: string;\n    body: string;\n    safePayload: any;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    // Idempotency check\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).notification?.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          userId: params.userId,\n          type: params.eventKey,\n          // Check idempotency via data field if possible\n        },\n      });\n\n      // Check by idempotency key in billingNotificationJob if exists\n      const existingBilling = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationJob?.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey },\n      });\n      if (existingBilling && existingBilling.deliveryStatus === 'SENT') {\n        this.logger.log(`Idempotent in-app notification return by idempotencyKey: ${params.idempotencyKey}`);\n        return existing;\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    try {\n      const record = await this.prisma.notification.create({\n        data: {\n          id: randomUUID(),\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          userId: params.userId,\n          channel: NotificationChannel.IN_APP as any,\n          type: params.eventKey,\n          title: params.title,\n          body: params.body,\n          data: params.safePayload as any,\n          deliveredAt: new Date(),\n          createdAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      this.logger.log(`In-app notification created tenant=${params.tenantId} user=${params.userId} event=${params.eventKey} id=${record.id}`);\n\n      // Realtime fan-out through the shared RealtimeService (Redis -> socket\n      // owner). The notification is already persisted, so a publish failure\n      // only delays the client until its next fetch; it is logged, not thrown.\n      if (this.realtime) {\n        try {\n          await this.realtime.emitToUser(params.tenantId, params.userId, RealtimeEvent.NOTIFICATION_CREATED, {\n            id: record.id,\n            type: params.eventKey,\n            title: params.title,\n          });\n        } catch (e) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Realtime publish failed for notification ${record.id}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n        }\n      }\n\n      return record;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        this.logger.warn(`notification table not found, fallback: ${error.message}`);\n        // Fallback to audit log\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).auditLog?.create({\n            data: {\n              id: randomUUID(),\n              tenantId: params.tenantId,\n              action: 'IN_APP_NOTIFICATION_CREATED',\n              resourceType: 'Notification',\n              resourceId: randomUUID(),\n              metadata: {\n                userId: params.userId,\n                eventKey: params.eventKey,\n                title: params.title,\n                body: params.body,\n                safePayload: params.safePayload,\n                idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n                fallback: true,\n              },\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n        } catch {}\n        return { id: randomUUID(), tenantId: params.tenantId, userId: params.userId, type: params.eventKey, title: params.title, fallback: true };\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async markRead(tenantId: string, userId: string, notificationId: string): Promise<any> {\n    try {\n      const existing = await this.prisma.notification.findFirst({\n        where: { id: notificationId, tenantId, userId },\n        select: { id: true },\n      });\n\n      if (!existing) {\n        throw new Error(`Notification not found: ${notificationId}`);\n      }\n\n      const updated = await this.prisma.notification.update({\n        where: { id: notificationId },\n        data: { readAt: new Date() },\n      });\n\n      return updated;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.message.includes('not found')) throw error;\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to mark notification read: ${error.message}`);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async markAllRead(tenantId: string, userId: string): Promise<{ updated: number }> {\n    try {\n      const result = await this.prisma.notification.updateMany({\n        where: { tenantId, userId, readAt: null },\n        data: { readAt: new Date() },\n      });\n      return { updated: result.count };\n    } catch {\n      return { updated: 0 };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getUnreadCount(tenantId: string, userId: string): Promise<number> {\n    const count = await this.prisma.notification.count({\n      where: { tenantId, userId, readAt: null },\n    });\n    return count;\n  }\n\n  async listNotifications(\n    tenantId: string,\n    userId: string,\n    filter?: { unreadOnly?: boolean; eventKey?: string; channel?: string; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date; limit?: number; offset?: number },\n  ): Promise<any[]> {\n    const where: any = { tenantId, userId };\n    if (filter?.unreadOnly) where.readAt = null;\n    if (filter?.eventKey) where.type = filter.eventKey;\n    if (filter?.channel) where.channel = filter.channel;\n    if (filter?.fromDate || filter?.toDate) {\n      where.createdAt = {};\n      if (filter.fromDate) where.createdAt.gte = filter.fromDate;\n      if (filter.toDate) where.createdAt.lte = filter.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const results = await this.prisma.notification.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      take: filter?.limit || 50,\n      skip: filter?.offset || 0,\n    });\n\n    return results;\n  }\n\n  async archiveNotification(tenantId: string, userId: string, notificationId: string): Promise<any> {\n    try {\n      const existing = await this.prisma.notification.findFirst({\n        where: { id: notificationId, tenantId, userId },\n      });\n      if (!existing) throw new Error(`Notification not found: ${notificationId}`);\n\n      // Archive by setting readAt and return updated;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to archive notification: ${error.message}`);\n      throw error;\n    }\n '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { BillingEventService } from './billing-event.service';\n\n/**\n * Invoice delivery service: safe totals + access link, no internal paths.\n * Ensures invoice delivery is tenant-safe, sanitized, idempotent.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class InvoiceDeliveryService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(InvoiceDeliveryService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly billingEventService: BillingEventService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async deliverInvoice(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    invoiceId: string;\n    userId?: string;\n    accessLinkBaseUrl?: string;\n  }): Promise<{ delivered: boolean; accessLink: string; safeTotals: any }> {\n    // Fetch invoice\n    let invoice: any;\n    try {\n      invoice = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findFirst({\n        where: { id: params.invoiceId, tenantId: params.tenantId },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n\n    if (!invoice) {\n      try {\n        const repo = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findFirst?.({ where: { id: params.invoiceId } });\n        invoice = repo;\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    // Build safe totals - never expose internal paths, only safe fields\n    const safeTotals = {\n      invoiceNumber: invoice?.invoiceNumber || params.invoiceId,\n      subtotal: invoice?.subtotal || '0',\n      taxTotal: invoice?.taxTotal || '0',\n      total: invoice?.total || '0',\n      amountPaid: invoice?.amountPaid || '0',\n      amountDue: invoice?.amountDue || invoice?.total || '0',\n      currency: invoice?.currency || 'USD',\n      status: invoice?.status || 'FINALIZED',\n      dueDate: invoice?.dueDate ? new Date(invoice.dueDate).toISOString() : null,\n      issuedAt: invoice?.issuedAt ? new Date(invoice.issuedAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    // Build safe access link - no internal paths, only via portal\n    const baseUrl = params.accessLinkBaseUrl || process.env.BILLING_PORTAL_URL || process.env.APP_URL || 'https://app.example.com';\n    // Ensure baseUrl is HTTPS in production and not internal\n    const safeBase = this.sanitizeBaseUrl(baseUrl);\n    const accessLink = `${safeBase}/billing/invoices/${params.invoiceId}`;\n\n    this.logger.log(`Invoice delivery prepared tenant=${params.tenantId} invoice=${params.invoiceId} link=${accessLink}`);\n\n    // Trigger notification via billing event service\n    try {\n      if (invoice?.status === 'PAID') {\n        await this.billingEventService.onInvoicePaid({\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          invoiceId: params.invoiceId,\n          invoiceNumber: safeTotals.invoiceNumber,\n          userId: params.userId,\n          amount: safeTotals.total,\n          currency: safeTotals.currency,\n          supportEmail: process.env.SUPPORT_EMAIL || 'support@example.com',\n          appName: process.env.APP_NAME || 'WLCT',\n        });\n      } else {\n        await this.billingEventService.onInvoiceFinalized({\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          invoiceId: params.invoiceId,\n          invoiceNumber: safeTotals.invoiceNumber,\n          userId: params.userId,\n          amount: safeTotals.total,\n          currency: safeTotals.currency,\n          supportEmail: process.env.SUPPORT_EMAIL || 'support@example.com',\n          appName: process.env.APP_NAME || 'WLCT',\n        });\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to trigger invoice delivery notification: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n\n    return { delivered: true, accessLink, safeTotals };\n  }\n\n  async deliverOverdueNotice(params: { tenantId: string; invoiceId: string; userId?: string }): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      let invoice: any;\n      try {\n        invoice = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findFirst({\n          where: { id: params.invoiceId, tenantId: params.tenantId },\n        });\n      } catch {}\n\n      await this.billingEventService.onInvoiceOverdue({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        invoiceId: params.invoiceId,\n        invoiceNumber: invoice?.invoiceNumber || params.invoiceId,\n        userId: params.userId,\n        amount: invoice?.total || '0',\n        currency: invoice?.currency || 'USD',\n        supportEmail: process.env.SUPPORT_EMAIL || 'support@example.com',\n        appName: process.env.APP_NAME || 'WLCT',\n      });\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to trigger overdue notice: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private sanitizeBaseUrl(url: string): string {\n    try {\n      const parsed = new URL(url);\n      // Prevent internal destinations\n      const blocked = ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '0.0.0.0', '169.254.', '10.', '192.168.'];\n      const hostname = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();\n      for (const b of blocked) {\n        if (hostname === b || hostname.startsWith(b)) {\n          if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {\n            return 'https://app.example.com';\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      // No internal paths, only origin\n      return `${parsed.protocol}//${parsed.host}`;\n    } catch {\n      return 'https://app.example.com';\n    }\n Prevents duplicate jobs from same canonical event.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class NotificationJobRepository {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(NotificationJobRepository.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async create(job: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId?: string;\n    recipient: any;\n    eventKey: BillingNotificationEventKey;\n    channel: NotificationChannel;\n    templateKey: string;\n    locale: string;\n    priority: NotificationPriority;\n    category: NotificationCategory;\n    deliveryStatus: DeliveryStatus;\n    maxAttempts: number;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n    safePayload: any;\n    renderedSubject?: string;\n    renderedBody?: string;\n  }): Promise<BillingNotificationJob> {\n    // Idempotency check\n    const existingByKey = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(job.idempotencyKey, job.tenantId);\n    if (existingByKey) {\n      this.logger.log(`Idempotent notification job return by key: ${job.idempotencyKey}`);\n      return existingByKey;\n    }\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    const notificationJob: BillingNotificationJob = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: job.tenantId,\n      userId: job.userId,\n      recipient: job.recipient,\n      eventKey: job.eventKey,\n      channel: job.channel,\n      templateKey: job.templateKey,\n      locale: job.locale,\n      priority: job.priority,\n      category: job.category,\n      deliveryStatus: job.deliveryStatus,\n      attemptCount: 0,\n      maxAttempts: job.maxAttempts,\n      nextAttemptAt: null,\n      providerReference: null,\n      idempotencyKey: job.idempotencyKey,\n      safePayload: job.safePayload,\n      renderedSubject: job.renderedSubject,\n      renderedBody: job.renderedBody,\n      failureReason: null,\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n      sentAt: null,\n      deliveredAt: null,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationJob?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: notificationJob.id,\n          tenantId: notificationJob.tenantId,\n          userId: notificationJob.userId || null,\n          recipient: notificationJob.recipient as any,\n          eventKey: notificationJob.eventKey,\n          channel: notificationJob.channel,\n          templateKey: notificationJob.templateKey,\n          locale: notificationJob.locale,\n          priority: notificationJob.priority,\n          category: notificationJob.category,\n          deliveryStatus: notificationJob.deliveryStatus,\n          attemptCount: notificationJob.attemptCount,\n          maxAttempts: notificationJob.maxAttempts,\n          nextAttemptAt: null,\n          providerReference: null,\n          idempotencyKey: notificationJob.idempotencyKey,\n          safePayload: notificationJob.safePayload as any,\n          renderedSubject: notificationJob.renderedSubject || null,\n          renderedBody: notificationJob.renderedBody || null,\n          failureReason: null,\n          createdAt: new Date(notificationJob.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(notificationJob.updatedAt),\n          sentAt: null,\n          deliveredAt: null,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (created) {\n        return this.mapToDomain(created);\n      }\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2002') {\n        this.logger.warn(`Duplicate notification job idempotency: ${job.idempotencyKey}`);\n        const existing = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(job.idempotencyKey, job.tenantId);\n        if (existing) return existing;\n      }\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        this.logger.warn(`billingNotificationJob table not found, fallback: ${error.message}`);\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).auditLog?.create({\n            data: {\n              id: randomUUID(),\n              tenantId: job.tenantId,\n              action: 'NOTIFICATION_CREATED',\n              resourceType: 'BillingNotificationJob',\n              resourceId: id,\n              metadata: { ...notificationJob, fallback: true },\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n        } catch {}\n        return notificationJob;\n      }\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to create notification job: ${error.message}`, error.stack);\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    return notificationJob;\n  }\n\n  async findById(id: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<BillingNotificationJob | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationJob?.findFirst({\n      where: { id, ...(tenantId ? { tenantId } : {}) },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async findByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey: string, tenantId: string): Promise<BillingNotificationJob | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationJob?.findFirst({\n      where: { idempotencyKey, tenantId },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async findPendingJobs(limit: number = 50): Promise<BillingNotificationJob[]> {\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationJob?.findMany({\n      where: {\n        deliveryStatus: { in: [DeliveryStatus.CREATED, DeliveryStatus.PENDING, DeliveryStatus.QUEUED] },\n      },\n      orderBy: [{ priority: 'desc' }, { createdAt: 'asc' }],\n      take: limit,\n    });\n    if (!results) return [];\n    return results.map((r: any) => this.mapToDomain(r));\n  }\n\n  async findRetryableJobs(limit: number = 50): Promise<BillingNotificationJob[]> {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationJob?.findMany({\n      where: {\n        deliveryStatus: DeliveryStatus.RETRY_SCHEDULED,\n        nextAttemptAt: { lte: now },\n        attemptCount: { lt: 10 },\n      },\n      orderBy: { nextAttemptAt: 'asc' },\n      take: limit,\n    });\n    if (!results) return [];\n    return results.map((r: any) => this.mapToDomain(r));\n  }\n\n  async findFailedJobs(limit: number = 50): Promise<BillingNotificationJob[]> {\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationJob?.findMany({\n      where: {\n        deliveryStatus: { in: [DeliveryStatus.FAILED, DeliveryStatus.PERMANENT_FAILURE] },\n      },\n      orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' },\n      take: limit,\n    });\n    if (!results) return [];\n    return results.map((r: any) => this.mapToDomain(r));\n  }\n\n  async listByTenant(\n    tenantId: string,\n    filter?: {\n      eventKey?: BillingNotificationEventKey;\n      channel?: NotificationChannel;\n      status?: DeliveryStatus;\n      userId?: string;\n      fromDate?: Date;\n      toDate?: Date;\n      limit?: number;\n      offset?: number;\n    },\n  ): Promise<BillingNotificationJob[]> {\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (filter?.eventKey) where.eventKey = filter.eventKey;\n    if (filter?.channel) where.channel = filter.channel;\n    if (filter?.status) where.deliveryStatus = filter.status;\n    if (filter?.userId) where.userId = filter.userId;\n    if (filter?.fromDate || filter?.toDate) {\n      where.createdAt = {};\n      if (filter.fromDate) where.createdAt.gte = filter.fromDate;\n      if (filter.toDate) where.createdAt.lte = filter.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationJob?.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      take: filter?.limit || 100,\n      skip: filter?.offset || 0,\n    });\n\n    if (!results) return [];\n    return results.map((r: any) => this.mapToDomain(r));\n  }\n\n  async updateStatus(\n    id: string,\n    updates: {\n      deliveryStatus?: DeliveryStatus;\n      attemptCount?: number;\n      nextAttemptAt?: string | null;\n      providerReference?: string | null;\n      failureReason?: string | null;\n      renderedSubject?: string;\n      renderedBody?: string;\n      sentAt?: string | null;\n      deliveredAt?: string | null;\n    },\n  ): Promise<BillingNotificationJob | null> {\n    try {\n      const data: any = { updatedAt: new Date() };\n      if (updates.deliveryStatus) data.deliveryStatus = updates.deliveryStatus;\n      if (updates.attemptCount !== undefined) data.attemptCount = updates.attemptCount;\n      if (updates.nextAttemptAt !== undefined) data.nextAttemptAt = updates.nextAttemptAt ? new Date(updates.nextAttemptAt) : null;\n      if (updates.providerReference !== undefined) data.providerReference = updates.providerReference;\n      if (updates.failureReason !== undefined) data.failureReason = updates.failureReason;\n      if (updates.renderedSubject) data.renderedSubject = updates.renderedSubject;\n      if (updates.renderedBody) data.renderedBody = updates.renderedBody;\n      if (updates.sentAt !== undefined) data.sentAt = updates.sentAt ? new Date(updates.sentAt) : null;\n      if (updates.deliveredAt !== undefined) data.deliveredAt = updates.deliveredAt ? new Date(updates.deliveredAt) : null;\n\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationJob?.update({\n        where: { id },\n        data,\n      });\n\n      if (!updated) return null;\n      return this.mapToDomain(updated);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private mapToDomain(raw: any): BillingNotificationJob {\n    return {\n      id: raw.id,\n      tenantId: raw.tenantId,\n      userId: raw.userId || undefined,\n      recipient: raw.recipient,\n      eventKey: raw.eventKey as BillingNotificationEventKey,\n      channel: raw.channel as NotificationChannel,\n      templateKey: raw.templateKey,\n      locale: raw.locale,\n      priority: raw.priority as any,\n      category: raw.category as any,\n      deliveryStatus: raw.deliveryStatus as DeliveryStatus,\n      attemptCount: raw.attemptCount,\n      maxAttempts: raw.maxAttempts,\n      nextAttemptAt: raw.nextAttemptAt ? new Date(raw.nextAttemptAt).toISOString() : null,\n      providerReference: raw.providerReference || null,\n      idempotencyKey: raw.idempotencyKey,\n      safePayload: raw.safePayload,\n      renderedSubject: raw.renderedSubject || undefined,\n      renderedBody: raw.renderedBody || undefined,\n      failureReason: raw.failureReason || null,\n      createdAt: raw.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: raw.updatedAt ? new Date(raw.updatedAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n      sentAt: raw.sentAt ? new Date(raw.sentAt).toISOString() : null,\n      deliveredAt: raw.deliveredAt ? new './billing-notification.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Tenant/user notification preferences, channel preferences, opt-in/out rules,\n * mandatory vs optional notification policy.\n * Mandatory billing notifications cannot be disabled.\n */\n\nexport interface NotificationPreference {\n  id: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  userId?: string;\n  eventKey?: BillingNotificationEventKey;\n  channel: NotificationChannel;\n  enabled: boolean;\n  category: string;\n  isMandatory: boolean;\n  locale: string;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class NotificationPreferenceService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(NotificationPreferenceService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async getPreferences(tenantId: string, userId?: string): Promise<NotificationPreference[]> {\n    try {\n      const where: any = { tenantId };\n      if (userId) where.userId = userId;\n\n      const results = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationPreference?.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { eventKey: 'asc' },\n      });\n\n      if (results && results.length > 0) {\n        return results.map((r: any) => this.mapToDomain(r));\n      }\n\n      // Return defaults if none configured\n      return this.getDefaultPreferences(tenantId, userId);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        return this.getDefaultPreferences(tenantId, userId);\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getChannelPreferences(tenantId: string, userId: string, category: string): Promise<{ channel: NotificationChannel; enabled: boolean }[]> {\n    // Reuse existing notification preferences from main notifications module if available\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).notificationPreference?.findMany({\n        where: { userId, category },\n      });\n\n      if (existing && existing.length > 0) {\n        return existing.map((p: any) => ({\n          channel: p.channel as NotificationChannel,\n          enabled: p.enabled,\n        }));\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Fallback to billing preferences\n    const billingPrefs = await this.getPreferences(tenantId, userId);\n    const grouped = new Map<NotificationChannel, boolean>();\n\n    for (const pref of billingPrefs) {\n      if (pref.category === category || !category) {\n        grouped.set(pref.channel, pref.enabled);\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (grouped.size === 0) {\n      // Default: all channels enabled\n      return [\n        { channel: NotificationChannel.EMAIL, enabled: true },\n        { channel: NotificationChannel.IN_APP, enabled: true },\n        { channel: NotificationChannel.PUSH, enabled: true },\n        { channel: NotificationChannel.WEBHOOK, enabled: false },\n      ];\n    }\n\n    return Array.from(grouped.entries()).map(([channel, enabled]) => ({ channel, enabled }));\n  }\n\n  async isChannelEnabled(tenantId: string, userId: string | undefined, eventKey: BillingNotificationEventKey, channel: NotificationChannel): Promise<{ enabled: boolean; isMandatory: boolean; reason?: string }> {\n    const isMandatory = MANDATORY_BILLING_EVENTS.has(eventKey);\n\n    // Mandatory billing notifications cannot be disabled\n    if (isMandatory && (channel === NotificationChannel.EMAIL || channel === NotificationChannel.IN_APP)) {\n      return { enabled: true, isMandatory: true, reason: 'Mandatory billing notification - cannot be disabled' };\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const pref = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationPreference?.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          tenantId,\n          ...(userId ? { userId } : {}),\n          eventKey,\n          channel,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (pref) {\n        // Even if user disabled, mandatory events remain enabled\n        if (isMandatory && !pref.enabled && (channel === NotificationChannel.EMAIL || channel === NotificationChannel.IN_APP)) {\n          return { enabled: true, isMandatory: true, reason: 'Mandatory billing notification overrides user preference' };\n        }\n        return { enabled: pref.enabled, isMandatory, reason: pref.enabled ? undefined : 'User disabled this channel for this event' };\n      }\n\n      // No specific preference - check category preference\n      const category = this.getCategoryForEvent(eventKey);\n      // A tenant-level billing event has no recipient user, so there is no\n      // per-user category preference to consult. Querying with a placeholder\n      // id put a non-UUID into a UUID column and logged a database error on\n      // every tenant-level delivery.\n      const categoryPrefs = userId ? await this.getChannelPreferences(tenantId, userId, category) : [];\n      const channelPref = categoryPrefs.find((p) => p.channel === channel);\n      if (channelPref) {\n        if (isMandatory && !channelPref.enabled && (channel === NotificationChannel.EMAIL || channel === NotificationChannel.IN_APP)) {\n          return { enabled: true, isMandatory: true, reason: 'Mandatory billing notification overrides category preference' };\n        }\n        return { enabled: channelPref.enabled, isMandatory };\n      }\n\n      // Default enabled for all except webhook\n      const defaultEnabled = channel !== NotificationChannel.WEBHOOK;\n      return { enabled: defaultEnabled, isMandatory };\n    } catch {\n      // On error, default to enabled for mandatory, disabled for optional webhook\n      const defaultEnabled = isMandatory || channel !== NotificationChannel.WEBHOOK;\n      return { enabled: defaultEnabled, isMandatory };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async updatePreference(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId?: string;\n    eventKey?: BillingNotificationEventKey;\n    channel: NotificationChannel;\n    enabled: boolean;\n    category?: string;\n    locale?: string;\n  }): Promise<NotificationPreference> {\n    // Prevent disabling mandatory billing notifications for EMAIL and IN_APP\n    if (params.eventKey && MANDATORY_BILLING_EVENTS.has(params.eventKey) && !params.enabled) {\n      if (params.channel === NotificationChannel.EMAIL || params.channel === NotificationChannel.IN_APP) {\n        throw new Error(`Cannot disable mandatory billing notification ${params.eventKey} for channel ${params.channel}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n    const isMandatory = params.eventKey ? MANDATORY_BILLING_EVENTS.has(params.eventKey) : false;\n    const category = params.category || (params.eventKey ? this.getCategoryForEvent(params.eventKey) : 'billing');\n\n    const preference: NotificationPreference = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: params.userId,\n      eventKey: params.eventKey,\n      channel: params.channel,\n      enabled: params.enabled,\n      category,\n      isMandatory,\n      locale: params.locale || 'en',\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const result = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationPreference?.upsert({\n        where: {\n          tenantId_userId_eventKey_channel: {\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            userId: params.userId || '',\n            eventKey: params.eventKey || '',\n            channel: params.channel,\n          },\n        },\n        update: {\n          enabled: params.enabled,\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n          locale: params.locale || 'en',\n        },\n        create: {\n          id: preference.id,\n          tenantId: preference.tenantId,\n          userId: preference.userId || null,\n          eventKey: preference.eventKey || null,\n          channel: preference.channel,\n          enabled: preference.enabled,\n          category: preference.category,\n          isMandatory: preference.isMandatory,\n          locale: preference.locale,\n          createdAt: new Date(preference.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(preference.updatedAt),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (result) return this.mapToDomain(result);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        this.logger.warn(`billingNotificationPreference table not found, fallback: ${error.message}`);\n        return preference;\n      }\n      if (error.code === 'P2002') {\n        // Try to find existing\n        try {\n          const existing = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationPreference?.findFirst({\n            where: {\n              tenantId: params.tenantId,\n              userId: params.userId || null,\n              eventKey: params.eventKey || null,\n              channel: params.channel,\n            },\n          });\n          if (existing) {\n            const updated = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationPreference?.update({\n              where: { id: existing.id },\n              data: { enabled: params.enabled, updatedAt: new Date() },\n            });\n            if (updated) return this.mapToDomain(updated);\n          }\n        } catch {}\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    return preference;\n  }\n\n  async updatePreferencesBulk(\n    tenantId: string,\n    userId: string | undefined,\n    preferences: { eventKey?: BillingNotificationEventKey; channel: NotificationChannel; enabled: boolean; category?: string }[],\n  ): Promise<NotificationPreference[]> {\n    const results: NotificationPreference[] = [];\n    for (const pref of preferences) {\n      try {\n        const updated = await this.updatePreference({\n          tenantId,\n          userId,\n          eventKey: pref.eventKey,\n          channel: pref.channel,\n          enabled: pref.enabled,\n          category: pref.category,\n        });\n        results.push(updated);\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to update preference ${pref.eventKey} ${pref.channel}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n        // For mandatory, we throw, but for bulk we skip and continue\n        if ((e as Error).message.includes('Cannot disable mandatory')) {\n          throw e;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return results;\n  }\n\n  private getDefaultPreferences(tenantId: string, userId?: string): NotificationPreference[] {\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n    const preferences: NotificationPreference[] = [];\n\n    for (const eventKey of Object.values(BillingNotificationEventKey)) {\n      const isMandatory = MANDATORY_BILLING_EVENTS.has(eventKey as BillingNotificationEventKey);\n      const category = this.getCategoryForEvent(eventKey as BillingNotificationEventKey);\n\n      for (const channel of [NotificationChannel.EMAIL, NotificationChannel.IN_APP, NotificationChannel.PUSH]) {\n        preferences.push({\n          id: `default_${tenantId}_${userId || 'tenant'}_${eventKey}_${channel}`,\n          tenantId,\n          userId,\n          eventKey: eventKey as BillingNotificationEventKey,\n          channel,\n          enabled: true,\n          category,\n          isMandatory,\n          locale: 'en',\n          createdAt: now,\n          updatedAt: now,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Webhook disabled by default\n      preferences.push({\n        id: `default_${tenantId}_${userId || 'tenant'}_${eventKey}_WEBHOOK`,\n        tenantId,\n        userId,\n        eventKey: eventKey as BillingNotificationEventKey,\n        channel: NotificationChannel.WEBHOOK,\n        enabled: false,\n        category,\n        isMandatory: false,\n        locale: 'en',\n        createdAt: now,\n        updatedAt: now,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return preferences;\n  }\n\n  private getCategoryForEvent(eventKey: BillingNotificationEventKey): string {\n    if (eventKey.startsWith('PAYMENT_') || eventKey.startsWith('REFUND_')) return 'billing';\n    if (eventKey.startsWith('INVOICE_')) return 'billing';\n    if (eventKey.startsWith('SUBSCRIPTION_') || eventKey.startsWith('TRIAL_')) return 'subscription';\n    if (eventKey.startsWith('DUNNING_')) return 'dunning';\n    if (eventKey.startsWith('USAGE_')) return 'usage';\n    if (eventKey.startsWith('FEE_') || eventKey.startsWith('PAYOUT_')) return 'fee';\n    if (eventKey.startsWith('CUSTOM_DOMAIN_') || eventKey.startsWith('WHITE_LABEL_') || eventKey.startsWith('SAAS_')) return 'saas_admin';\n    return 'billing';\n  }\n\n  private mapToDomain(raw: any): NotificationPreference {\n    return {\n      id: raw.id,\n      tenantId: raw.tenantId,\n      userId: raw.userId || undefined,\n      eventKey: raw.eventKey as BillingNotificationEventKey || undefined,\n      channel: raw.channel as NotificationChannel,\n      enabled: raw.enabled,\n      category: raw.category,\n      isMandatory: raw.isMandatory || false,\n      locale: raw.locale || 'en',\n      createdAt: raw.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: raw.updatedAt ? new Date(raw.updatedAt).toISOString() : new No fake success allowed.');\n  }\n}\n\nclass InAppOnlyProvider implements INotificationProvider {\n  readonly providerName = 'in_app_only';\n  readonly supportedChannels = [NotificationChannel.IN_APP] as NotificationChannel[];\n\n  isAvailable(): boolean {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  async send(input: any): Promise<any> {\n    // In-app is always available via DB\n    return {\n      accepted: true,\n      providerReference: `inapp_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`,\n      resultType: 'ACCEPTED',\n      retryable: false,\n      deliveredAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class NotificationProviderFactory {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(NotificationProviderFactory.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly emailProvider: EmailNotificationProvider,\n    private readonly pushProvider: PushNotificationService,\n  ) {}\n\n  getProvider(channel: NotificationChannel): INotificationProvider {\n    switch (channel) {\n      case NotificationChannel.EMAIL:\n        if (this.emailProvider.isAvailable()) {\n          this.logger.log(`Selected notification provider for EMAIL: ${this.emailProvider.providerName}`);\n          return this.emailProvider;\n        }\n        this.logger.warn(`Email provider not available, falling back to NoOp - will fail with config error`);\n        return new NoOpNotificationProvider();\n\n      case NotificationChannel.IN_APP:\n        return new InAppOnlyProvider();\n\n      case NotificationChannel.PUSH:\n        // The real FCM adapter. It reports PUSH_NOT_CONFIGURED /\n        // PUSH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE itself; previously a configured push\n        // channel was handed the in-app stub, which \"accepted\" every push\n        // without sending anything.\n        if (this.pushProvider.isAvailable()) {\n          return this.pushProvider;\n        }\n        this.logger.warn('Push provider not configured');\n        return new NoOpNotificationProvider();\n\n      case NotificationChannel.WEBHOOK:\n        // Webhook delivery is performed by NotificationDeliveryService\n        // (deliverWebhook) and never reaches this factory; answering here with\n        // an always-accepting stub would hide a routing mistake.\n        return new NoOpNotificationProvider();\n\n      case NotificationChannel.SMS: {\n        // SMS_PROVIDER=twilio selects the Twilio REST adapter; it is only\n        // returned when fully configured. Anything else (unset, unknown\n        // provider, incomplete Twilio settings) fails closed. SMS_PROVIDER\n        // used to select the in-app stub, which reported every SMS as sent.\n        const smsProvider = (process.env.SMS_PROVIDER || '').trim().toLowerCase();\n        if (smsProvider === 'twilio') {\n          const twilio = new TwilioSmsProvider();\n          if (twilio.isAvailable()) return twilio;\n          this.logger.warn(`SMS_PROVIDER=twilio but configuration incomplete (missing: ${twilio.configurationProblems().join(', ')})`);\n        } else if (smsProvider) {\n          this.logger.warn(`SMS_PROVIDER=${smsProvider} is not supported (supported: twilio); SMS deliveries will fail`);\n        }\n        return new NoOpNotificationProvider();\n      }\n\n      default:\n        this.logger.error(`Unsupported notification channel: ${channel}`);\n        return new NoOpNotificationProvider();\n    }\n  }\n\n  getEmailProvider(): INotificationProvider {\n    return this.getProvider(NotificationChannel.EMAIL);\n  }\n\n  getAvailableChannels(): NotificationChannel[] {\n    const available: NotificationChannel[] = [NotificationChannel.IN_APP];\n    if (this.emailProvider.isAvailable()) {\n      available.push(NotificationChannel.EMAIL);\n    }\n    if (this.pushProvider.isAvailable()) {\n      available.push(NotificationChannel.PUSH);\n    }\n    if ((process.env.SMS_PROVIDER || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'twilio' && new TwilioSmsProvider().isAvailable()) {\n      available.push(NotificationChannel.SMS);\n    }\n    return available;\n  }\n\n  validateProviderConfiguration(): { configured: boolean; channels: NotificationChannel[]; message: string } {\n    const channels = this.getAvailableChannels();\n    const emailAvailable = this.emailProvider.isAvailable();\n    return {\n      configured: channels.length > 0,\n      channels,\n      message: emailAvailable\n        ? `Notification providers configured: ${channels.join(',')}`\n        : `Only IN_APP channel available. Specify a different type.","line":372,"column":24,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":372,"endColumn":27,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[14602,14605],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[14602,14605],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":34,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { BillingNotificationAuditService } from './billing-notification.audit';\nimport { NotificationJobRepository } from './notification-job.repository';\nimport { DeliveryStatus } from './billing-notification.types';\n\n/**\n * Reconciles canonical billing Event ↔ Job ↔ Provider Result ↔ Final State.\n * Detects event without job / duplicate / stuck / provider accepted but pending / sent without ref /\n * impossible retry / missing tenant/recipient/template failure/webhook mismatch.\n * Deterministic severity/category/event/notification/tenant/expected/actual.\n * No silent repair.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class NotificationReconciliationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(NotificationReconciliationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly jobRepository: NotificationJobRepository,\n    private readonly auditService: BillingNotificationAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async reconcileTenant(tenantId: string): Promise<{ issues: any[]; summary: any }> {\n    const issues: any[] = [];\n\n    // 1. Detect stuck jobs (PROCESSING > 2 hours, RETRY_SCHEDULED overdue > 24h)\n    const stuckJobs = await this.detectStuckJobs(tenantId);\n    issues.push(...stuckJobs);\n\n    // 2. Detect duplicate jobs (same idempotency key but different IDs)\n    const duplicateJobs = await this.detectDuplicateJobs(tenantId);\n    issues.push(...duplicateJobs);\n\n    // 3. Detect jobs SENT without provider reference\n    const sentWithoutRef = await this.detectSentWithoutReference(tenantId);\n    issues.push(...sentWithoutRef);\n\n    // 4. Detect jobs FAILED but retryable with attempts < maxAttempts and no nextAttemptAt\n    const impossibleRetry = await this.detectImpossibleRetryState(tenantId);\n    issues.push(...impossibleRetry);\n\n    // 5. Detect jobs with missing tenant or recipient\n    const missingData = await this.detectMissingData(tenantId);\n    issues.push(...missingData);\n\n    // 6. Detect provider accepted but still PENDING (inconsistent state)\n    const providerAcceptedButPending = await this.detectProviderAcceptedButPending(tenantId);\n    issues.push(...providerAcceptedButPending);\n\n    // 7. Detect template render failures (jobs with no rendered subject/body but SENT)\n    const templateFailures = await this.detectTemplateFailures(tenantId);\n    issues.push(...templateFailures);\n\n    // 8. Detect webhook mismatch (webhook jobs but no subscription)\n    const webhookMismatch = await this.detectWebhookMismatch(tenantId);\n    issues.push(...webhookMismatch);\n\n    const summary = {\n      tenantId,\n      totalIssues: issues.length,\n      bySeverity: this.groupBy(issues, 'severity'),\n      byCategory: this.groupBy(issues, 'category'),\n      checkedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    // Audit reconciliation detection\n    for (const issue of issues) {\n      await this.auditService.logReconciliationDetected(\n        tenantId,\n        issue.category,\n        issue.referenceId,\n        issue.description,\n        issue.severity,\n      );\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`Reconciliation tenant=${tenantId} issues=${issues.length} summary=${JSON.stringify(summary.byCategory)}`);\n\n    return { issues, summary };\n  }\n\n  async reconcileAllTenants(limit: number = 100): Promise<{ tenantId: string; issues: any[] }[]> {\n    const results: { tenantId: string; issues: any[] }[] = [];\n\n    try {\n      // Get distinct tenantIds from notification jobs\n      const jobs = await (this.prisma as any).billingNotificationJob?.findMany({\n        select: { tenantId: true },\n        distinct: ['tenantId'],\n        take: limit,\n      });\n\n      if (jobs) {\n        for (const job of jobs) {\n          const result = await this.reconcileTenant(job.tenantId);\n          if (result.issues.length > 0) {\n            results.push({ tenantId: job.tenantId, issues: result.issues });\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to reconcile all tenants: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n\n    return results;\n  }\n\n  private async detectStuckJobs(tenantId: string): Promise<any[]> {\n    const issues: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      const jobs = await this.jobRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, { limit: 1000 });\n\n      for (const job of jobs) {\n        if (job.deliveryStatus === DeliveryStatus.PROCESSING) {\n          const hoursStuck = (Date.now() - new Date(job.updatedAt).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60);\n          if (hoursStuck > 2) {\n            issues.push({\n              category: 'STUCK_JOB',\n              severity: hoursStuck > 24 ? 'CRITICAL' : 'HIGH',\n              referenceId: job.id,\n              tenantId: job.tenantId,\n              eventKey: job.eventKey,\n              channel: job.channel,\n              expected: 'Job should complete or move to RETRY_SCHEDULED within 2 hours',\n              actual: `Job stuck in PROCESSING for ${hoursStuck.toFixed(1)} hours`,\n              description: `Notification job ${job.id} stuck in PROCESSING for ${hoursStuck.toFixed(1)} hours`,\n              detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n\n        if (job.deliveryStatus === DeliveryStatus.RETRY_SCHEDULED && job.nextAttemptAt) {\n          const overdue = (Date.now() - new Date(job.nextAttemptAt).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60);\n          if (overdue > 24) {\n            issues.push({\n              category: 'STUCK_RETRY',\n              severity: 'HIGH',\n              referenceId: job.id,\n              tenantId: job.tenantId,\n              eventKey: job.eventKey,\n              channel: job.channel,\n              expected: 'Retry should be attempted within 24h of scheduled time',\n              actual: `Retry overdue by ${overdue.toFixed(1)} hours`,\n              description: `Notification job ${job.id} retry overdue by ${overdue.toFixed(1)} hours`,\n              detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`detectStuckJobs failed for tenant ${tenantId}: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n    return issues;\n  }\n\n  private async detectDuplicateJobs(tenantId: string): Promise<any[]> {\n    const issues: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      const jobs = await this.jobRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, { limit: 1000 });\n      const byIdempotency = new Map<string, any[]>();\n\n      for (const job of jobs) {\n        if (!byIdempotency.has(job.idempotencyKey)) {\n          byIdempotency.set(job.idempotencyKey, []);\n        }\n        byIdempotency.get(job.idempotencyKey)!.push(job);\n      }\n\n      for (const [key, duplicates] of byIdempotency.entries()) {\n        if (duplicates.length > 1) {\n          issues.push({\n            category: 'DUPLICATE_JOB',\n            severity: 'MEDIUM',\n            referenceId: duplicates[0].id,\n            tenantId,\n            eventKey: duplicates[0].eventKey,\n hourly.\n * Bounded batch, no infinite retries, tenant-safe.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class NotificationSchedulerService implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(NotificationSchedulerService.name);\n  private intervals: NodeJS.Timeout[] = [];\n  private isEnabled: boolean;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly workerService: NotificationWorkerService,\n    private readonly reconciliationService: NotificationReconciliationService,\n  ) {\n    this.isEnabled = process.env.BILLING_NOTIFICATIONS_SCHEDULER_ENABLED !== 'false';\n  }\n\n  onModuleInit(): void {\n    if (!this.isEnabled) {\n      this.logger.log('Billing notification scheduler disabled via env BILLING_NOTIFICATIONS_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=false');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log('Starting billing notification scheduler: worker 30s, stuck detection 5m, reconciliation 1h');\n\n    // Process pending jobs every 30 seconds\n    const workerInterval = setInterval(async () => {\n      try {\n        const result = await this.workerService.processPendingJobs(50);\n        if (result.processed > 0) {\n          this.logger.log(`Scheduler worker batch processed=${result.processed} succeeded=${result.succeeded} failed=${result.failed} retried=${result.retried}`);\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Scheduler worker failed: ${e.message}`);\n      }\n    }, 30 * 1000);\n    this.intervals.push(workerInterval);\n\n    // Detect stuck jobs every 5 minutes\n    const stuckInterval = setInterval(async () => {\n      try {\n        const stuck = await this.workerService.detectStuckJobs(2);\n        if (stuck.length > 0) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Scheduler detected ${stuck.length} stuck notification jobs`);\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Scheduler stuck detection failed: ${e.message}`);\n      }\n    }, 5 * 60 * 1000);\n    this.intervals.push(stuckInterval);\n\n    // Reconciliation every hour (sample of tenants)\n    const reconInterval = setInterval(async () => {\n      try {\n        const results = await this.reconciliationService.reconcileAllTenants(20);\n        if (results.length > 0) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Scheduler reconciliation found ${results.length} tenants with issues`);\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Scheduler reconciliation failed: ${e.message}`);\n      }\n    }, 60 * 60 * 1000);\n    this.intervals.push(reconInterval);\n  }\n\n  onModuleDestroy(): void {\n    this.logger.log('Stopping billing notification scheduler');\n    for (const interval of this.intervals) {\n      clearInterval(interval);\n    }\n    this.intervals = [];\n  }\n\n  async triggerWorkerManually(batchSize: number = 50): Promise<any> {\n    return this.workerService.processPendingJobs(batchSize);\n  }\n\n  async string): Promise<any> {\n    if (tenantId) {\n      return this.reconciliationService.reconcileTenant(tenantId);\n    }\n    return this.reconciliationService.reconcileAllTenants(20);\n
