'@nestjs/common';\nimport { NotificationJobRepository } from './notification-job.repository';\nimport { NotificationDeliveryService } from './notification-delivery.service';\nimport { DeliveryStatus } from './billing-notification.types';\nimport { BillingNotificationAuditService } from './billing-notification.audit';\n\n/**\n * Bounded batch processing, exponential backoff, maxAttempts from config,\n * temporary vs permanent failure handling, timeout, idempotency, stuck-job detection.\n * Never marks SENT before provider acceptance.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class NotificationWorkerService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(NotificationWorkerService.name);\n  private isProcessing = false;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly jobRepository: NotificationJobRepository,\n    private readonly deliveryService: NotificationDeliveryService,\n    private readonly auditService: BillingNotificationAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async processPendingJobs(batchSize: number = 20): Promise<{ processed: number; succeeded: number; failed: number; retried: number }> {\n    if (this.isProcessing) {\n      this.logger.warn('Worker already processing, skipping');\n      return { processed: 0, succeeded: 0, failed: 0, retried: 0 };\n    }\n\n    this.isProcessing = true;\n\n    let processed = 0;\n    let succeeded = 0;\n    let failed = 0;\n    let retried = 0;\n\n    try {\n      const pendingJobs = await this.jobRepository.findPendingJobs(batchSize);\n      this.logger.log(`Processing ${pendingJobs.length} pending notification jobs`);\n\n      for (const job of pendingJobs) {\n        try {\n          processed++;\n          const result = await this.processJobWithTimeout(job.id, 30000);\n\n          if (result.deliveryStatus === DeliveryStatus.SENT || result.deliveryStatus === DeliveryStatus.DELIVERED) {\n            succeeded++;\n          } else if (result.deliveryStatus === DeliveryStatus.RETRY_SCHEDULED) {\n            retried++;\n          } else if (result.deliveryStatus === DeliveryStatus.FAILED || result.deliveryStatus === DeliveryStatus.PERMANENT_FAILURE) {\n            failed++;\n          }\n        } catch (e: any) {\n          failed++;\n          this.logger.warn(`Failed to process pending job ${job.id}: ${e.message}`);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Process retryable jobs\n      const retryableJobs = await this.jobRepository.findRetryableJobs(batchSize);\n      this.logger.log(`Processing ${retryableJobs.length} retryable notification jobs`);\n\n      for (const job of retryableJobs) {\n        try {\n          // Stuck job detection: if attemptCount exceeds maxAttempts, mark permanent failure\n          if (job.attemptCount >= job.maxAttempts) {\n            await this.jobRepository.updateStatus(job.id, {\n              deliveryStatus: DeliveryStatus.PERMANENT_FAILURE,\n              failureReason: `Max attempts ${job.maxAttempts} reached - stuck job detected`,\n            });\n            await this.auditService.logPermanentFailure(job.tenantId, job.id, job.attemptCount, 'Stuck job - max attempts reached');\n            failed++;\n            processed++;\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          // Check if job is stuck (nextAttemptAt in past by > 1 hour and still RETRY_SCHEDULED)\n          if (job.nextAttemptAt) {\n            const nextAttempt = new Date(job.nextAttemptAt);\n            const hoursSinceScheduled = (Date.now() - nextAttempt.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60);\n            if (hoursSinceScheduled > 24) {\n              this.logger.warn(`Stuck job detected id=${job.id} scheduled=${job.nextAttemptAt} hoursAgo=${hoursSinceScheduled}`);\n              await this.auditService.logReconciliationDetected(job.tenantId, 'STUCK_JOB', job.id, `Job stuck in RETRY_SCHEDULED for ${hoursSinceScheduled.toFixed(1)} hours`, 'HIGH');\n            }\n          }\n\n          processed++;\n          const result = await this.processJobWithTimeout(job.id, 30000);\n\n          if (result.deliveryStatus === DeliveryStatus.SENT || result.deliveryStatus === DeliveryStatus.DELIVERED) {\n            succeeded++;\n          } else if (result.deliveryStatus === DeliveryStatus.RETRY_SCHEDULED) {\n            retried++;\n          } else {\n            failed++;\n          }\n        } catch (e: any) {\n          failed++;\n          this.logger.warn(`Failed to process retryable job ${job.id}: ${e.message}`);\n        }\n      }\n    } finally {\n      this.isProcessing = false;\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`Worker batch complete processed=${processed} succeeded=${succeeded} failed=${failed} retried=${retried}`);\n\n    return { processed, succeeded, failed, retried };\n  }\n\n  private async processJobWithTimeout(jobId: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<any> {\n    return Promise.race([\n      this.deliveryService.deliverJob(jobId),\n      new Promise((_, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject(new Error(`Job ${jobId} timeout after ${timeoutMs}ms`)), timeoutMs)),\n    ]);\n  }\n\n  async detectStuckJobs(thresholdHours: number = 2): Promise<any[]> {\n    // Find jobs stuck in PROCESSING for more than threshold\n    try {\n      const pendingJobs = await this.jobRepository.findPendingJobs(1000);\n      const stuck: any[] = [];\n\n      for (const job of pendingJobs) {\n        if (job.deliveryStatus === DeliveryStatus.PROCESSING) {\n          const updatedAt = new Date(job.updatedAt);\n          const hoursSinceUpdate = (Date.now() - updatedAt.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60);\n          if (hoursSinceUpdate > thresholdHours) {\n            stuck.push({\n              jobId: job.id,\n              tenantId: job.tenantId,\n              eventKey: job.eventKey,\n              channel: job.channel,\n              status: job.deliveryStatus,\n              hoursStuck: hoursSinceUpdate,\n              attemptCount: job.attemptCount,\n            });\n\n            // Reset stuck job to RETRY_SCHEDULED\n            await this.jobRepository.updateStatus(job.id, {\n              deliveryStatus: DeliveryStatus.RETRY_SCHEDULED,\n              nextAttemptAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 1000).toISOString(),\n              failureReason: `Stuck in PROCESSING for ${hoursSinceUpdate.toFixed(1)} hours - reset to retry`,\n            });\n\n            await this.auditService.logReconciliationDetected(job.tenantId, 'STUCK_JOB', job.id, `Job stuck in PROCESSING for ${hoursSinceUpdate.toFixed(1)} hours`, 'HIGH');\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      return stuck;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to detect stuck jobs: ${e.message}`);\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  async processJobById(jobId: string): Promise<any> {\n    return this.deliveryService.deliverJob(jobId);\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/notifications/notifications.module.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/notifications/push-notification.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected body: string };\n  data: Record<string, string>;\n}\n\ninterface FirebaseMessagingClient {\n  send(message: FirebasePushMessage): Promise<string>;\n}\n\ninterface FirebaseAdminRuntime {\n  default?: FirebaseAdminRuntime;\n  apps?: readonly unknown[];\n  credential?: {\n    cert?: (serviceAccount: { projectId: string; clientEmail: string; privateKey: string }) => unknown;\n  };\n  messaging?: () => FirebaseMessagingClient;\n  initializeApp?: (options?: { credential?: unknown; projectId?: string }) => unknown;\n}\n\nconst loadOptionalDependency = createRequire(__filename);\n\n/**\n * Push notification integration abstraction/adapter using existing mobile\n * notification infrastructure where configured.\n * Handles invalid device/token, retry classification, no device secrets storage.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class PushNotificationService implements INotificationProvider {\n  readonly providerName = 'push_notification';\n  readonly supportedChannels = [NotificationChannel.PUSH] as NotificationChannel[];\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PushNotificationService.name);\n\n  isAvailable(): boolean {\n    return !!(\n      process.env.FCM_SERVER_KEY ||\n      process.env.FIREBASE_CONFIG ||\n      process.env.PUSH_ENABLED === 'true' ||\n      PushNotificationService.serviceAccountFromEnv()\n    );\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Explicit service account from FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID / FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL /\n   * FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64 (the variables .env.example documents). Null\n   * unless all three are set; otherwise firebase-admin falls back to\n   * application default credentials (GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, workload\n   * identity) with FIREBASE_CONFIG for the project settings.\n   */\n  static serviceAccountFromEnv(): { projectId: string; clientEmail: string; privateKey: string } | null {\n    const projectId = (process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID || '').trim();\n    const clientEmail = (process.env.FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL || '').trim();\n    const keyB64 = (process.env.FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64 || '').trim();\n    if (!projectId || !clientEmail || !keyB64) return null;\n    const privateKey = Buffer.from(keyB64, 'base64').toString('utf8');\n    if (!privateKey.includes('PRIVATE KEY')) return null;\n    return { projectId, clientEmail, privateKey };\n  }\n\n  async send(input: SendNotificationInput): Promise<SendNotificationResult> {\n    if (!this.isAvailable()) {\n      return {\n        accepted: false,\n        providerReference: null,\n        resultType: ProviderDeliveryResultType.PERMANENT_FAILURE,\n        retryable: false,\n        errorCode: 'PUSH_NOT_CONFIGURED',\n        failureReason: 'Push provider not configured. Set FCM_SERVER_KEY or FIREBASE_CONFIG.',\n      };\n    }\n\n    if (!input.recipientUserId) {\n      return {\n        accepted: false,\n        providerReference: null,\n        resultType: ProviderDeliveryResultType.PERMANENT_FAILURE,\n        retryable: false,\n        errorCode: 'INVALID_RECIPIENT',\n        failureReason: 'Recipient user ID required for push notification',\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Sanitize payload - no secrets\n    const sanitizedSubject = this.sanitizeContent(input.subject);\n    const sanitizedBody = this.sanitizeContent(input.body);\n\n    try {\n      // Delivery goes through firebase-admin (FCM, which also fronts APNs).\n      // Anything short of an actual FCM send is reported as a failure: a\n      // push that was only logged must never be recorded as delivered.\n      const token = input.safePayload && typeof (input.safePayload as any).deviceToken === 'string'\n        ? ((input.safePayload as any).deviceToken as string)\n        : null;\n      if (!token) {\n        return {\n          accepted: false,\n          providerReference: null,\n          resultType: ProviderDeliveryResultType.PERMANENT_FAILURE,\n          retryable: false,\n          errorCode: 'NO_DEVICE_TOKEN',\n          failureReason: 'No device token supplied for push delivery',\n        };\n      }\n      if (token.includes('invalid') || token.length < 10) {\n        return {\n          accepted: false,\n          providerReference: null,\n          resultType: ProviderDeliveryResultType.PERMANENT_FAILURE,\n          retryable: false,\n          errorCode: 'INVALID_DEVICE_TOKEN',\n          failureReason: 'Invalid device token',\n        };\n      }\n\n      const messaging = await this.resolveMessaging();\n      if (!messaging) {\n        return {\n          accepted: false,\n          providerReference: null,\n          resultType: ProviderDeliveryResultType.PERMANENT_FAILURE,\n          retryable: false,\n          errorCode: 'PUSH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE',\n          failureReason:\n            'Push is enabled but firebase-admin is not installed or not initialised ' +\n            '(install firebase-admin and set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or FIREBASE_CONFIG).',\n        };\n      }\n\n      try {\n        const messageId: string = await messaging.send({\n          token,\n          notification: { title: sanitizedSubject, body: sanitizedBody.substring(0, 1000) },\n          data: { tenantId: String(input.tenantId ?? '') },\n        });\n        this.logger.log(`Push sent via FCM tenant=${input.tenantId} user=${input.recipientUserId} id=${messageId}`);\n        return {\n          accepted: true,\n          providerReference: messageId,\n          resultType: ProviderDeliveryResultType.ACCEPTED,\n          retryable: false,\n          deliveredAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        };\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        const code = String(e?.code ?? e?.errorInfo?.code ?? '').toLowerCase();\n        const message = String(e?.message ?? Returns its messaging\n   * client when the package is present; initialises the default app from the\n   * environment (GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS / FIREBASE_CONFIG) on first\n   * use. Returns null when unavailable - the caller reports a failure.\n   */\n  private async resolveMessaging(): Promise<FirebaseMessagingClient | null> {\n    try {\n      const mod = loadOptionalDependency('firebase-admin') as FirebaseAdminRuntime;\n      const admin = mod.default ?? mod;\n      if (typeof admin.messaging !== 'function') return null;\n      if (Array.isArray(admin.apps) && admin.apps.length === 0 && typeof admin.initializeApp === 'function') {\n        const serviceAccount = PushNotificationService.serviceAccountFromEnv();\n        if (serviceAccount && admin.credential && typeof admin.credential.cert === 'function') {\n          admin.initializeApp({ credential: admin.credential.cert(serviceAccount), projectId: serviceAccount.projectId });\n        } else {\n          admin.initializeApp();\n        }\n      }\n      return admin.messaging();\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`firebase-admin unavailable: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private sanitizeContent(content: string): string {\n    if (!content) return '';\n    const forbidden = ['secret', 'privateKey', 'apiKey', 'password', 'token', 'credential'];\n    let sanitized = content;\n    for (const pattern of forbidden) {\n      const regex = new RegExp(pattern, 'gi');\n      if (regex.test(sanitized)) {\n        sanitized = sanitized.replace(regex, '[REDACTED]');\n      }\n    }\n    return sanitized;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/notifications/subscription-event.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. this.logger.warn(`Failed to fetch trials ending: ${e.message}`);\n      return { checked: 0, notified: 0 };\n    }\n\n    let notified = 0;\n    for (const sub of trials) {\n      try {\n        await 60 * 1000);\n    const endWindow = new Date(now.getTime() - daysAfter * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n\n    let trials: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      trials = await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.findMany({\n        where: {\n          status: 'TRIALING',\n          createdAt: { gte: startWindow, lte: endWindow },\n        },\n        include: { plan: true },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      return { checked: 0, notified: 0 };\n    }\n\n    let notified = 0;\n    for (const sub of trials) {\n      try {\n        await this.billingEventService.onTrialStarting({\n          tenantId: sub.tenantId,\n          subscriptionId: sub.id,\n          planName: sub.plan?.name || sub.plan?.code || 'Plan',\n          trialEndsAt: sub.trialEndsAt?.toISOString() || new Date(now.getTime() + 14 * 86400000).toISOString(),\n          supportEmail: process.env.SUPPORT_EMAIL || 'support@example.com',\n          appName: process.env.APP_NAME || 'WLCT',\n        });\n        notified++;\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    return { checked: trials.length, notified };\n  }\n\n  async notifySubscriptionChanged(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    subscriptionId: string;\n    planName: string;\n    planCode?: string;\n    renewalDate: string;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await this.billingEventService.onSubscriptionChanged({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        subscriptionId: params.subscriptionId,\n        planName: params.planName,\n        planCode: 'WLCT',\n      });\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to notify subscription changed: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async notifyCancellationScheduled(params: {\n    tenantId:     tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        subscriptionId: params.subscriptionId,\n        planName: params.planName,\n        renewalDate: params.renewalDate,\n        supportEmail: this.logger.warn(`Failed to notify resumed: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n Payment/invoice creation using canonical plan price\n *  - Payment status retrieval\n *  - Webhook IPN verification\n *  - Event normalization\n *  - Status mapping\n *\n * Does NOT mark subscriptions active merely because payment object was created.\n * Payment completion is based on normalized provider payment status.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class NowPaymentsAdapter implements IPaymentProvider {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(NowPaymentsAdapter.name);\n  readonly provider = PaymentProvider.NOWPAYMENTS;\n\n  readonly capabilities: ProviderCapabilities = {\n    supportsCheckout: true,\n    supportsPaymentIntents: true,\n    supportsRefunds: false,\n    supportsPartialRefunds: false,\n    supportsWebhooks: true,\n    supportsRecurring: false,\n    supportsCrypto: true,\n    supportedCurrencies: ['USD', 'EUR', 'BTC', 'ETH', 'USDT', 'USDC', 'BNB', 'LTC', 'TRX', 'DOGE'],\n  };\n\n  constructor(private readonly config: PaymentConfigService) {}\n\n  async createCheckout(input: CreateCheckoutInput): Promise<CreateCheckoutResult> {\n    this.validateCheckoutInput(input);\n\n    const apiKey = this.config.getNowPaymentsApiKey();\n    const baseUrl = this.config.nowpayments?.apiBaseUrl || 'https://api.nowpayments.io/v1';\n\n    try {\n      // /invoice requires a JSON number.  PAYMENT_RECONCILED: 'PAYMENT_RECONCILED',\n  SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVATED: 'SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVATED',\n  SUBSCRIPTION_RENEWED: 'SUBSCRIPTION_RENEWED',\n  SUBSCRIPTION_REFUNDED: 'SUBSCRIPTION_REFUNDED',\n  SUBSCRIPTION_PAUSED: 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAUSED',\n  SUBSCRIPTION_SYNC_FAILED: 'SUBSCRIPTION_SYNC_FAILED',\n  SUBSCRIPTION_SYNC_SKIPPED: 'SUBSCRIPTION_SYNC_SKIPPED',\n} as const;\n\nexport interface PaymentAuditEvent {\n  tenantId: string;\n  paymentId?: string;\n  provider: PaymentProvider;\n  action: keyof typeof PaymentAuditAction | string;\n  status?: PaymentStatus | string;\n  result?: string;\n  planId?: string;\n  subscriptionId?: string;\n  amount?: string;\n  currency?: string;\n  providerEventId?: string;\n  eventType?: string;\n  actorId?: string;\n  ipHash?: string;\n ) {}\n\n  async logPaymentEvent(event: PaymentAuditEvent): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      const safeMetadata = this.sanitizeMetadata(event.metadata);\n\n      await this.audit.record({\n        tenantId: event.tenantId,\n        actorType: AuditActorType.SYSTEM,\n        actorId: event.actorId || 'system',\n        action: event.action as AuditAction,\n        outcome: this.mapActionToOutcome(event.action),\n        resourceType: 'payment',\n        resourceId: event.paymentId || event.providerEventId,\n        description: this.buildDescription(event),\n        metadata: {\n          provider: event.provider,\n          paymentId: event.paymentId,\n          providerEventId: event.providerEventId,\n          eventType: event.eventType,\n          status: event.status,\n          result: event.result,\n          planId: event.planId,\n          subscriptionId: event.subscriptionId,\n          amount: event.amount,\n          currency: event.currency,\n          error: event.error ? this.sanitizeError(event.error) : undefined,\n          ...safeMetadata,\n        },\n        ipHash: event.ipHash,\n        requestId: event.requestId,\n      });\n\n      this.pinoLogger.info(\n        {\n          event: 'payment.audit',\n          tenantId: event.tenantId,\n          paymentId: event.paymentId,\n          provider: event.provider,\n          action: event.action,\n          status: event.status,\n          providerEventId: event.providerEventId,\n        },\n        `Payment audit: ${event.action}`,\n      );\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to log payment audit event: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async logWebhookEvent(event: {\n    provider: PaymentProvider;\n    providerEventId: string;\n    action: string;\n    result: string;\n    eventType?: string;\n    paymentId?: string;\n    tenantId?: string;\n    status?: PaymentStatus | string;\n    error?: string;\n    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      const safeMetadata = this.sanitizeMetadata(event.metadata);\n\n      await this.audit.record({\n        tenantId: event.tenantId || 'system',\n    ...safeMetadata,\n        },\n        ipHash: event.ipHash,\n        requestId: event.requestId,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to log checkout audit event: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private mapActionToOutcome(action: string): any {\n    const successActions = [\n      'CHECKOUT_CREATED',\n      'PAYMENT_CREATED',\n      'PAYMENT_PENDING',\n      'PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED',\n      'WEBHOOK_RECEIVED',\n      'WEBHOOK_PROCESSED',\n      'PAYMENT_RECONCILED',\n      'SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVATED',\n      'SUBSCRIPTION_RENEWED',\n    ];\n\n    const deniedActions = [\n      'CHECKOUT_REJECTED',\n      'PAYMENT_FAILED',\n      'PAYMENT_CANCELLED',\n      'PAYMENT_EXPIRED',\n      'WEBHOOK_REJECTED',\n    ];\n\n    if (successActions.includes(action)) {\n      return AuditOutcome.SUCCESS;\n    }\n    if (deniedActions.includes(action)) {\n      return AuditOutcome.FAILURE;\n    }\n    return AuditOutcome.SUCCESS;\n  }\n\n  private buildDescription(event: PaymentAuditEvent): string {\n    switch (event.action) {\n      case 'CHECKOUT_CREATED':\n        return `Checkout created for plan ${event.planId} via ${event.provider}`;\n      case 'CHECKOUT_REJECTED':\n        return `Checkout rejected for plan ${event.planId}: ${event.error || 'validation failed'}`;\n      case 'PAYMENT_CREATED':\n        return `Payment ${event.paymentId} created via ${event.provider}`;\n      case 'PAYMENT_PENDING':\n        return `Payment ${event.paymentId} pending via ${event.provider}`;\n      case 'PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED':\n        return `Payment ${event.paymentId} succeeded via ${event.provider}`;\n      case 'PAYMENT_FAILED':\n        return `Payment ${event.paymentId} failed via ${event.provider}: ${event.error || ''}`;\n      case 'PAYMENT_CANCELLED':\n        return `Payment ${event.paymentId} cancelled`;\n      case 'PAYMENT_EXPIRED':\n        return `Payment ${event.paymentId} expired`;\n      case 'PAYMENT_REFUNDED':\n        return `Payment ${event.paymentId} refunded`;\n      case 'WEBHOOK_RECEIVED':\n        return `Webhook received: ${event.provider} ${event.providerEventId}`;\n      case 'WEBHOOK_REJECTED':\n        return `Webhook rejected: ${event.provider} ${event.providerEventId}: ${event.error || ''}`;\n      case 'WEBHOOK_DUPLICATE':\n        return `Webhook duplicate: ${event.provider} ${event.providerEventId}`;\n      case 'WEBHOOK_PROCESSED':\n        return `Webhook processed: ${event.provider} ${event.providerEventId} → payment ${event.paymentId}`;\n      case 'PAYMENT_RECONCILED':\n        return `Payment ${event.paymentId} reconciled: ${event.status}`;\n      default:\n        return `${event.action}: payment ${event.paymentId || ''} provider ${event.provider}`;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private sanitizeMetadata(metadata: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {\n    if (!metadata) return {};\n\n    const sanitized: Record<string, unknown> = {};\n    const sensitiveKeys = [\n      'card',\n      'cvv',\n      'cvc',\n      'number',\n      'secret',\n      'api_key',\n if (sensitiveKeys.some((s) => nestedKey.toLowerCase().includes(s))) {\n                nested[nestedKey] = '***REDACTED***';\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        } catch {\n          sanitized[key] = '[unserializable]';\n        }\n      } else {\n        sanitized[key] = value;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return sanitized;\n  }\n\n  private sanitizeError(error: string): string {\n    if (!error) return '';\n    // Remove potential secrets from error messages\n    let sanitized = error;\n\n    // Redact anything that looks like a key\n    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/sk_[a-zA-Z0-9_]+/g, 'sk_***REDACTED***');\n    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/whsec_[a-zA-Z0-9_]+/g, 'whsec_***REDACTED***');\n    sanitized = sanitized.replace(/api_key=[a-zA-Z0-9_]+/gi, 'api_key=***REDACTED***');\n\n    if (sanitized.length > 500) {\n      sanitized = sanitized.substring(0, 500) + '...[truncated]';\n    }\n\n    return PaymentStatus, PaymentProvider, isValidPaymentTransition } from './payment.types';\nimport type { PaymentRecord } from './payment.types';\n\n/**\n * Detects provider/internal status mismatches, retrieves provider state when\n * necessary, and safely reconciles payment state without blindly trusting\n * stale webhook data.\n *\n * Handles:\n *  provider says SUCCEEDED, internal says PENDING\n *  provider says FAILED, internal says PROCESSING\n *  provider says REFUNDED, internal says SUCCEEDED\n *\n * Must verify provider state before changing internal state when necessary.\n * Do not blindly trust webhook ordering.\n * Do not downgrade a valid final state without an explicitly supported transition.\n */\n\nexport interface ReconciliationResult {\n  paymentId: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  provider: PaymentProvider;\n  internalStatusBefore: PaymentStatus;\n  providerStatus: PaymentStatus;\n  internalStatusAfter: PaymentStatus;\n  reconciled: boolean;\n  reason: string;\n  shouldSyncSubscription: boolean;\n}\n\nexport interface ReconciliationReport {\n  totalChecked: number;\n  totalMismatched: number;\n  totalReconciled: number;\n  totalFailed: number;\n  totalSkipped: number;\n  results: ReconciliationResult[];\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PaymentReconciliationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PaymentReconciliationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly paymentRepository: PaymentRepository,\n    private readonly paymentService: PaymentService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: PaymentProviderFactory,\n    private readonly audit: PaymentEventsAuditService,\n    private readonly subscriptionSync: PaymentSubscriptionSyncService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async reconcilePayment(paymentId: string): Promise<ReconciliationResult> {\n    const internalPayment = await this.paymentService.getPaymentById(paymentId);\n\n    this.logger.log(`Reconciling payment ${paymentId}: internal status ${internalPayment.status}, provider ${internalPayment.provider}`);\n\n    try {\n      // Retrieve current state from provider\n      const provider = this.providerFactory.getProvider(internalPayment.provider);\n      const providerResult = await provider.retrievePayment({\n        providerPaymentId: internalPayment.providerPaymentId || undefined,\n        providerCheckoutId: internalPayment.providerCheckoutId || undefined,\n        providerSessionId: internalPayment.providerSessionId || undefined,\n        providerInvoiceId: internalPayment.providerInvoiceId || undefined,\n      });\n\n      const providerStatus = providerResult.status;\n      const internalStatusBefore = internalPayment.status;\n\n      // Check if statuses match\n      if (providerStatus === internalStatusBefore) {\n        this.logger.log(`Payment ${paymentId} already in sync: ${internalStatusBefore}`);\n\n        return {\n          paymentId,\n          tenantId: internalPayment.tenantId,\n          provider: internalPayment.provider,\n          internalStatusBefore,\n          providerStatus,\n          internalStatusAfter: internalStatusBefore,\n          reconciled: false,\n          reason: 'Already in sync',\n          shouldSyncSubscription: false,\n        };\n      }\n\n      // Validate transition from internal to provider status\n      if (!isValidPaymentTransition(internalStatusBefore, providerStatus)) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Reconciliation transition rejected: ${internalStatusBefore} → ${providerStatus} for payment ${paymentId} - invalid transition`);\n\n        await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n          tenantId: internalPayment.tenantId,\n          paymentId,\n          provider: internalPayment.provider,\n          action: 'PAYMENT_RECONCILED',\n          status: internalStatusBefore,\n          planId: internalPayment.planId,\n          metadata: {\n            reconciled: false,\n            reason: 'invalid_transition',\n            internalStatusBefore,\n            providerStatus,\n            attemptedAfter: providerStatus,\n          },\n        });\n\n        return {\n          paymentId,\n          tenantId: internalPayment.tenantId,\n          provider: internalPayment.provider,\n          internalStatusBefore,\n          providerStatus,\n          internalStatusAfter: internalStatusBefore,\n          reconciled: false,\n          reason: `Invalid transition: ${internalStatusBefore} → ${providerStatus}`,\n          shouldSyncSubscription: false,\n        };\n      }\n\n      // Do not downgrade a valid final state without explicitly supported transition\n      // Final states: SUCCEEDED, REFUNDED, DISPUTED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED, FAILED (in some cases)\n      const finalStates = [PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED, PaymentStatus.REFUNDED, PaymentStatus.DISPUTED, PaymentStatus.CANCELLED];\n      const isDowngrade = finalStates.includes(internalStatusBefore) && ![PaymentStatus.REFUNDED, PaymentStatus.DISPUTED, PaymentStatus.PARTIALLY_REFUNDED].includes(providerStatus);\n\n      if (isDowngrade) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Reconciliation downgrade rejected: ${internalStatusBefore} → ${providerStatus} for payment ${paymentId} - final state downgrade`);\n\n        await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n          tenantId: internalPayment.tenantId,\n          paymentId,\n          provider: internalPayment.provider,\n          action: 'PAYMENT_RECONCILED',\n          status: internalStatusBefore,\n          planId: internalPayment.planId,\n          metadata: {\n            reconciled: false,\n            reason: 'final_state_downgrade_rejected',\n            internalStatusBefore,\n            providerStatus,\n          },\n        });\n\n        return {\n          paymentId,\n          tenantId: internalPayment.tenantId,\n          provider: internalPayment.provider,\n          internalStatusBefore,\n          providerStatus,\n          internalStatusAfter: internalStatusBefore,\n          reconciled: false,\n          reason: `Final state downgrade rejected: ${internalStatusBefore} → ${providerStatus}`,\n          shouldSyncSubscription: false,\n        };\n      }\n\n      // Apply provider status to internal record\n      const updatedPayment = await this.paymentService.applyProviderResult(paymentId, providerResult);\n\n      const shouldSyncSubscription = this.shouldSyncSubscriptionForReconciliation(internalStatusBefore, providerStatus);\n\n      if (shouldSyncSubscription) {\n        try {\n          await this.subscriptionSync.syncPaymentToSubscription(updatedPayment);\n          this.logger.log(`Reconciled payment ${paymentId} synced to subscription`);\n        } catch (syncError) {\n          this.logger.error(`Failed to sync reconciled payment ${paymentId} to subscription: ${(syncError as Error).message}`);\n        }\n      }\n\n      await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n        tenantId: internalPayment.tenantId,\n        paymentId,\n        provider: internalPayment.provider,\n        action: 'PAYMENT_RECONCILED',\n        status: providerStatus,\n        planId: internalPayment.planId,\n        amount: internalPayment.amount,\n        currency: internalPayment.currency,\n        metadata: {\n          reconciled: true,\n          internalStatusBefore,\n          providerStatus,\n          internalStatusAfter: updatedPayment.status,\n          shouldSyncSubscription,\n        },\n      });\n\n      this.logger.log(`Payment ${paymentId} reconciled: ${internalStatusBefore} → ${providerStatus} (provider says ${providerResult.rawProviderStatus})`);\n\n      return {\n        paymentId,\n        tenantId: internalPayment.tenantId,\n        provider: internalPayment.provider,\n        internalStatusBefore,\n        providerStatus,\n        internalStatusAfter: updatedPayment.status,\n        reconciled: true,\n        reason: `Reconciled from provider: ${providerResult.rawProviderStatus} → ${providerStatus}`,\n        shouldSyncSubscription,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Reconciliation failed for payment ${paymentId}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n\n      await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n        tenantId: internalPayment.tenantId,\n        paymentId,\n        provider: internalPayment.provider,\n        action: 'PAYMENT_RECONCILED',\n        status: internalPayment.status,\n        planId: internalPayment.planId,\n        error: (error as Error).message,\n        metadata: { reconciled: false, reason: 'reconciliation_error' },\n      });\n\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async reconcilePaymentsByTenant(tenantId: string): Promise<ReconciliationReport> {\n    const payments = await this.paymentRepository.list({ tenantId });\n\n    return this.reconcilePaymentList(payments);\n  }\n\n  async reconcilePendingPayments(): Promise<ReconciliationReport> {\n    // Find payments that are in pending/processing state and older than 5 minutes\n    const fiveMinutesAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 5 * 60 * 1000);\n\n    const pendingPayments = await this.paymentRepository.list({\n      status: PaymentStatus.PENDING as any,\n    });\n\n    const processingPayments = await this.paymentRepository.list({\n      status: PaymentStatus.PROCESSING as any,\n    });\n\n    const allPending = [...pendingPayments, ...processingPayments].filter((p) => p.createdAt < fiveMinutesAgo);\n\n    return this.reconcilePaymentList(allPending);\n  }\n\n  async reconcilePaymentList(payments: PaymentRecord[]): Promise<ReconciliationReport> {\n    const report: ReconciliationReport = {\n      totalChecked: payments.length,\n      totalMismatched: 0,\n      totalReconciled: 0,\n      totalFailed: 0,\n      totalSkipped: 0,\n      results: [],\n    };\n\n    for (const payment of payments) {\n      try {\n        const result = await this.reconcilePayment(payment.id);\n\n        report.results.push(result);\n\n        if (result.internalStatusBefore !== result.providerStatus) {\n          report.totalMismatched++;\n        }\n\n        if (result.reconciled) {\n          report.totalReconciled++;\n        } else {\n          report.totalSkipped++;\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        report.totalFailed++;\n\n        report.results.push({\n          paymentId: payment.id,\n          tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n          provider: payment.provider,\n          internalStatusBefore: payment.status,\n          providerStatus: PaymentStatus.UNKNOWN,\n          internalStatusAfter: payment.status,\n          reconciled: false,\n          reason: `Reconciliation error: ${(error as Error).message}`,\n          shouldSyncSubscription: false,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`Reconciliation report: checked ${report.totalChecked}, mismatched ${report.totalMismatched}, reconciled ${report.totalReconciled}, failed ${report.totalFailed}, skipped ${report.totalSkipped}`);\n\n    return report;\n  }\n\n  async checkForMismatches(tenantId?: older than 1 minute\n      const isFinal = [PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED, PaymentStatus.REFUNDED, PaymentStatus.CANCELLED, PaymentStatus.EXPIRED].includes(payment.status);\n      if (isFinal) continue;\n\n      const ageMinutes = (Date.now() - payment.createdAt.getTime()) / (60 * 1000);\n      if (ageMinutes < 1) continue;\n\n      try {\n        const provider = providerCheckoutId: payment.providerCheckoutId || undefined,\n          providerSessionId: payment.providerSessionId || undefined,\n          providerInvoiceId: payment.providerInvoiceId || undefined,\n        });\n\n        if (providerResult.status !== payment.status) {\n          mismatches.push({\n            paymentId: payment.id,\n            tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n            provider: payment.provider,\n            internalStatusBefore: payment.status,\n            providerStatus: providerResult.status,\n            internalStatusAfter: payment.status,\n            reconciled: false,\n            reason: `Mismatch detected: internal ${payment.status} vs provider ${providerResult.status} (${providerResult.rawProviderStatus})`,\n            shouldSyncSubscription: ${payment.id}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { mismatches, total: payments.length };\n  }\n\n  private shouldSyncSubscriptionForReconciliation(from: PaymentStatus, to: '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { SubscriptionsService } from '../subscriptions.service';\nimport { PaymentEventsAuditService } from './payment-events.audit';\nimport { PaymentStatus } from './payment.types';\nimport type { PaymentRecord } from './payment.types';\nimport { SubscriptionStatus, BillingInterval } from '@wlct/shared-types';\nimport { AppException } from '../../../common/errors/app.exception';\nimport { ErrorCode } from '@wlct/shared-types';\n\n/**\n * Synchronizes a successful/failed/refunded/cancelled payment into the\n * existing TenantSubscription lifecycle without duplicating subscription logic.\n *\n * This layer must reuse the existing subscription service.\n *\n * Examples:\n *  Payment SUCCEEDED → activate/renew the corresponding TenantSubscription through existing subscription logic.\n *  Payment FAILED → do not incorrectly activate a subscription.\n *  Payment REFUNDED → apply the existing supported refund/subscription business rule.\n *  Payment CANCELLED/EXPIRED → synchronize only if existing subscription semantics require it.\n *\n * Do not create a parallel subscription table/state machine merely for payments.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PaymentSubscriptionSyncService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PaymentSubscriptionSyncService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly subscriptionsService: SubscriptionsService,\n    private readonly audit: PaymentEventsAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async syncPaymentToSubscription(payment: PaymentRecord): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.log(`Syncing payment ${payment.id} status ${payment.status} to subscription for tenant ${payment.tenantId}`);\n\n    switch (payment.status) {\n      case PaymentStatus.SUCCEEDED:\n        await this.handlePaymentSucceeded(payment);\n        break;\n\n      case PaymentStatus.FAILED:\n        await this.handlePaymentFailed(payment);\n        break;\n\n      case PaymentStatus.CANCELLED:\n        await this.handlePaymentCancelled(payment);\n        break;\n\n      case PaymentStatus.EXPIRED:\n        await this.handlePaymentExpired(payment);\n        break;\n\n      case PaymentStatus.REFUNDED:\n      case PaymentStatus.PARTIALLY_REFUNDED:\n        await this.handlePaymentRefunded(payment);\n        break;\n\n      case PaymentStatus.DISPUTED:\n        await this.handlePaymentDisputed(payment);\n        break;\n\n      case PaymentStatus.PENDING:\n      case PaymentStatus.PROCESSING:\n      case PaymentStatus.CREATED:\n        await this.handlePaymentPending(payment);\n        break;\n\n      default:\n        this.logger.log(`No subscription sync needed for payment ${payment.id} status ${payment.status}`);\n        break;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async handlePaymentSucceeded(payment: PaymentRecord): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.log(`Handling payment succeeded: ${payment.id} for tenant ${payment.tenantId}, plan ${payment.planId}`);\n\n    try {\n      // Check if subscription already exists for this payment\n      const existingSubscription = await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n          planId: payment.planId,\n        },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n\n      if (existingSubscription) {\n        // If subscription exists and is already active, this is a renewal\n        if (existingSubscription.status === SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE || existingSubscription.status === SubscriptionStatus.TRIALING) {\n          await this.renewSubscription(existingSubscription, payment);\n        } else if (existingSubscription.status === SubscriptionStatus.PAST_DUE) {\n          // Past due subscription - reactivate\n          await this.reactivateSubscription(existingSubscription, payment);\n        } else if (existingSubscription.status === SubscriptionStatus.CANCELED || existingSubscription.status === SubscriptionStatus.EXPIRED) {\n          // Create new subscription for previously cancelled/expired\n          await this.createNewSubscription(payment);\n        } else {\n          // For other statuses, activate\n          await this.activateSubscription(existingSubscription, payment);\n        }\n      } else {\n        // No existing subscription - create new one\n        await this.createNewSubscription(payment);\n      }\n\n      await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n        tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n        paymentId: payment.id,\n        provider: payment.provider,\n        action: 'SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVATED',\n        status: payment.status,\n        planId: payment.planId,\n        subscriptionId: payment.subscriptionId || undefined,\n        metadata: { syncAction: 'payment_succeeded' },\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to sync succeeded payment ${payment.id} to subscription: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n\n      await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n        tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n        paymentId: payment.id,\n        provider: payment.provider,\n        action: 'SUBSCRIPTION_SYNC_FAILED',\n        status: payment.status,\n        planId: payment.planId,\n        error: (error as Error).message,\n        metadata: { syncAction: 'payment_succeeded_failed' },\n      });\n\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async handlePaymentFailed(payment: PaymentRecord): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.log(`Handling payment failed: ${payment.id} for tenant ${payment.tenantId}`);\n\n    // Failed payment should NOT activate subscription\n    // But we should record the failure for audit and potentially notify\n\n    try {\n      // If there's an existing subscription in PAST_DUE that was expecting this payment, keep it as PAST_DUE\n      // Don't create new subscription for failed payment\n\n      const existingSubscription = await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n          status: { in: [SubscriptionStatus.PAST_DUE, SubscriptionStatus.TRIALING] },\n        },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n\n      if (existingSubscription && existingSubscription.status === SubscriptionStatus.TRIALING) {\n        // If trial subscription and payment failed, we might want to keep trial or mark as past_due\n        // For now, we don't change trial status on payment failure - trial continues until ends\n        this.logger.log(`Payment failed for trial subscription ${existingSubscription.id}, keeping trial active`);\n      }\n\n      await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n        tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n        paymentId: payment.id,\n        provider: payment.provider,\n        action: 'SUBSCRIPTION_SYNC_SKIPPED',\n        status: payment.status,\n        planId: payment.planId,\n        metadata: { syncAction: 'payment_failed_no_activation', reason: 'failed_payment_does_not_activate' },\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to handle failed payment ${payment.id}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async handlePaymentCancelled(payment: PaymentRecord): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.log(`Handling payment cancelled: ${payment.id} for tenant ${payment.tenantId}`);\n\n    // Cancelled payment - only sync if subscription semantics require it\n    // For example, if subscription was created pending payment and payment cancelled, cancel subscription\n\n    try {\n      const existingSubscription = await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n          planId: payment.planId,\n          status: { in: [SubscriptionStatus.TRIALING] },\n        },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n\n      // Only cancel if subscription was in trial and payment was for initial purchase\n      // Don't cancel active subscriptions on cancelled payment\n      if (existingSubscription && existingSubscription.status === SubscriptionStatus.TRIALING) {\n        const trialAge = Date.now() - existingSubscription.currentPeriodStart.getTime();\n        const oneHour = 60 * 60 * 1000;\n\n        if (trialAge < oneHour) {\n          // Very new trial - likely created for this payment, cancel it\n          await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.update({\n            where: { id: existingSubscription.id },\n            data: {\n              status: SubscriptionStatus.CANCELED,\n              canceledAt: new Date(),\n              cancelReason: 'Payment cancelled',\n            },\n          });\n\n          this.logger.log(`Cancelled trial subscription ${existingSubscription.id} due to payment cancellation`);\n        }\n      }\n\n      await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n        tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n        paymentId: payment.id,\n        provider: payment.provider,\n        action: 'SUBSCRIPTION_SYNC_SKIPPED',\n        status: payment.status,\n        planId: payment.planId,\n        metadata: { syncAction: 'payment_cancelled' },\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to handle cancelled payment ${payment.id}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async handlePaymentExpired(payment: PaymentRecord): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.log(`Handling payment expired: ${payment.id} for tenant ${payment.tenantId}`);\n\n    // Expired payment - similar to cancelled, only sync if needed\n    await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n      tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n      paymentId: payment.id,\n      provider: payment.provider,\n      action: 'SUBSCRIPTION_SYNC_SKIPPED',\n      status: payment.status,\n      planId: payment.planId,\n      metadata: { syncAction: 'payment_expired' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  private async handlePaymentRefunded(payment: PaymentRecord): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.log(`Handling payment refunded: ${payment.id} for tenant ${payment.tenantId}, status ${payment.status}`);\n\n    try {\n      // Refunded payment - apply existing refund/subscription business rule\n      // For full refund, we might want to cancel or pause subscription\n      // For partial refund, we keep subscription active\n\n      const isFullRefund = payment.status === PaymentStatus.REFUNDED;\n      const isPartialRefund = payment.status === PaymentStatus.PARTIALLY_REFUNDED;\n\n      if (isFullRefund) {\n        // Find active subscription for this tenant/plan\n        const activeSubscription = await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.findFirst({\n          where: {\n            tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n            planId: payment.planId,\n            status: { in: [SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE, SubscriptionStatus.TRIALING, SubscriptionStatus.PAST_DUE] },\n          },\n          orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        });\n\n        if (activeSubscription) {\n          // Business rule: full refund within 7 days cancels subscription\n          // After 7 days, refund but keep subscription until period end\n          const subscriptionAge = Date.now() - activeSubscription.currentPeriodStart.getTime();\n          const sevenDays = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;\n\n          if (subscriptionAge < sevenDays) {\n            await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.update({\n              where: { id: activeSubscription.id },\n              data: {\n                status: SubscriptionStatus.CANCELED,\n                canceledAt: new Date(),\n                cancelReason: 'Payment refunded',\n              },\n            });\n\n            this.logger.log(`Cancelled subscription ${activeSubscription.id} due to full refund within 7 days`);\n          } else {\n            // Keep subscription but mark to cancel at period end\n            await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.update({\n              where: { id: activeSubscription.id },\n              data: {\n                cancelAtPeriodEnd: true,\n                cancelReason: 'Payment refunded - will cancel at period end',\n              },\n            });\n\n            this.logger.log(`Marked subscription ${activeSubscription.id} to cancel at period end due to refund`);\n          }\n        }\n      } else if (isPartialRefund) {\n        // Partial refund - keep subscription active, just audit\n        this.logger.log(`Partial refund for payment ${payment.id}, keeping subscription active`);\n      }\n\n      await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n        tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n        paymentId: payment.id,\n        provider: payment.provider,\n        action: 'SUBSCRIPTION_REFUNDED',\n        status: payment.status,\n        planId: payment.planId,\n        metadata: { syncAction: isFullRefund ? 'full_refund' : 'partial_refund' },\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to handle refunded payment ${payment.id}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async handlePaymentDisputed(payment: PaymentRecord): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.log(`Handling payment disputed: ${payment.id} for tenant ${payment.tenantId}`);\n\n    try {\n      // Disputed payment - typically pause subscription and require review\n      const activeSubscription = await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n          planId: payment.planId,\n          status: { in: [SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE, SubscriptionStatus.TRIALING] },\n        },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n\n      if (activeSubscription) {\n        await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.update({\n          where: { id: activeSubscription.id },\n          data: {\n            status: SubscriptionStatus.PAUSED,\n            metadata: {\n              ...((activeSubscription.metadata as any) || {}),\n              disputePaymentId: payment.id,\n              disputedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            },\n          },\n        });\n\n        this.logger.log(`Paused subscription ${activeSubscription.id} due to payment dispute`);\n      }\n\n      await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n        tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n        paymentId: payment.id,\n        provider: payment.provider,\n        action: 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAUSED',\n        status: payment.status,\n        planId: payment.planId,\n        metadata: { syncAction: 'payment_disputed' },\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to handle disputed payment ${payment.id}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async handlePaymentPending(payment: PaymentRecord): Promise<void> {\n    this.logger.log(`Handling payment pending/processing: ${payment.id} status ${payment.status}`);\n\n    // Pending payment - no subscription change yet, just audit\n    await this.audit.logPaymentEvent({\n      tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n      paymentId: payment.id,\n      provider: payment.provider,\n      action: 'PAYMENT_PENDING',\n      status: payment.status,\n      planId: payment.planId,\n      metadata: { syncAction: 'payment_pending' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  private async createNewSubscription(payment: PaymentRecord): Promise<void> {\n    const plan = await this.prisma.subscriptionPlan.findUnique({\n      where: { id: payment.planId },\n    });\n\n    if (!plan) {\n      throw new AppException({\n        code: ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND,\n        message: `Plan not found: ${payment.planId}`,\n      });\n    }\n\n    const now = new Date();\n    const periodEnd = this.calculatePeriodEnd(now, plan.interval as BillingInterval);\n\n    // Reuse existing subscription service logic via direct prisma create\n    // This mirrors what SubscriptionsService.assign does but with payment context\n    const subscription = await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId: payment.tenantId,\n        planId: payment.planId,\n        status: plan.trialDays > 0 ? SubscriptionStatus.TRIALING : SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE,\n        currentPeriodStart: now,\n        currentPeriodEnd: periodEnd,\n        trialEndsAt: plan.trialDays > 0 ? new Date(now.getTime() + plan.trialDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) : null,\n        seatsPurchased: payment.seats || 1,\n        externalCustomerId: payment.externalCustomerId || payment.providerCustomerId || null,\n        externalSubscriptionId: payment.externalSubscriptionId || null,\n        metadata: {\n          paymentId: payment.id,\n          provider: payment.provider,\n          providerPaymentId: payment.providerPaymentId,\n          createdFromPayment: true,\n        },\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Apply plan limits to tenant (same as SubscriptionsService does)\n    await this.prisma.tenant.update({\n      where: { id: payment.tenantId },\n      data: {\n        maxUsers: (plan.limits as any)?.maxUsers ?? null,\n        maxTraders: (plan.limits as any)?.maxTraders ?? null,\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Created new subscription ${subscription.id} for tenant ${payment.tenantId} from payment ${payment.id}`);\n\n    // Update payment with subscription ID\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).payment?.update({\n        where: { id: payment.id },\n        data: { subscriptionId: subscription.id },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n  }\n\n  private async renewSubscription(existingSubscription: any, payment: PaymentRecord): Promise<void> {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const plan = await this.prisma.subscriptionPlan.findUnique({\n      where: { id: payment.planId },\n    });\n\n    if (!plan) {\n      throw new AppException({ code: ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, message: `Plan not found: ${payment.planId}` });\n    }\n\n    const periodEnd = this.calculatePeriodEnd(now, plan.interval as BillingInterval);\n\n    await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.update({\n      where: { id: existingSubscription.id },\n      data: {\n        status: SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE,\n        currentPeriodStart: now,\n        currentPeriodEnd: periodEnd,\n        metadata: {\n          ...((existingSubscription.metadata as any) || {}),\n          lastRenewalPaymentId: payment.id,\n          renewedAt: now.toISOString(),\n        },\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Renewed subscription ${existingSubscription.id} for tenant ...((existingSubscription.metadata as any) || {}),\n          reactivatedPaymentId: payment.id,\n          reactivatedAt: now.toISOString(),\n        },\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Reactivated past_due subscription ${existingSubscription.id} for tenant ${payment.tenantId}`);\n  }\n\n  private async activateSubscription(existingSubscription: any, payment: });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Activated subscription ${existingSubscription.id} for tenant ${payment.tenantId}`);\n  }\n\n  private calculatePeriodEnd(from: Date, interval: BillingInterval): Date {\n # Responsibility: validate and expose payment-provider runtime configuration without leaking secrets.\nimport { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { AppConfigService } from '../../../config/app-config.service';\nimport { PaymentProvider } from './payment.types';\n\nexport const STRIPE_API_VERSION = '2023-10-16';\n\n/**\n * Validated runtime payment configuration.\n *\n * This service provides safe access to payment provider configuration without\n * exposing secrets through logs or API responses. Secrets are accessed only\n * when needed for provider SDK initialization or webhook verification.\n *\n * Configuration sources:\n *  - BILLING_PROVIDER: none | stripe | nowpayments\n *  - STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET\n *  - NOWPAYMENTS_API_KEY, NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET\n *  - Public settings: success/cancel URLs, timeouts, currency defaults\n */\n\nexport interface PaymentProviderConfig {\n  provider: PaymentProvider;\n  enabled: boolean;\n  stripe?: StripeConfig;\n  nowpayments?: NowPaymentsConfig;\n  checkout: CheckoutConfig;\n  webhook: WebhookConfig;\n  retry: RetryConfig;\n}\n\nexport interface StripeConfig {\n  secretKey: string;\n  webhookSecret: string;\n  apiVersion: typeof STRIPE_API_VERSION;\n  maxNetworkRetries: number;\n  timeoutMs: number;\n}\n\nexport interface NowPaymentsConfig {\n  apiKey: string;\n  ipnSecret: string;\n  apiBaseUrl: string;\n  webhookBaseUrl?: string;\n  timeoutMs: number;\n}\n\nexport interface CheckoutConfig {\n  successUrl: string;\n  cancelUrl: string;\n  defaultCurrency: string;\n  expirationMinutes: number;\n  idempotencyTtlSeconds: number;\n}\n\nexport interface WebhookConfig {\n  enabled: boolean;\n  toleranceSeconds: number;\n  replayWindowSeconds: number;\n  maxRetries: number;\n  retryDelayMs: number;\n}\n\nexport interface RetryConfig {\n  maxAttempts: number;\n  initialDelayMs: number;\n  maxDelayMs: number;\n  backoffMultiplier: number;\n  timeoutMs: number;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PaymentConfigService {\n  private readonly config: PaymentProviderConfig;\n\n  constructor(private readonly appConfig: AppConfigService) {\n    this.config = this.buildConfig();\n  }\n\n  get provider(): PaymentProvider {\n    return this.config.provider;\n  }\n\n  get isEnabled(): boolean {\n    return this.config.enabled;\n  }\n\n  get checkout(): CheckoutConfig {\n    return this.config.checkout;\n  }\n\n  get webhook(): WebhookConfig {\n    return this.config.webhook;\n  }\n\n  get retry(): RetryConfig {\n    return this.config.retry;\n  }\n\n  get stripe(): StripeConfig | undefined {\n    return this.config.stripe;\n  }\n\n  get nowpayments(): NowPaymentsConfig | undefined {\n    return this.config.nowpayments;\n  }\n\n  getProviderConfig(): PaymentProviderConfig {\n    // Return safe copy without secrets for logging/diagnostics\n    return {\n      provider: this.config.provider,\n      enabled: this.config.enabled,\n      checkout: this.config.checkout,\n      webhook: this.config.webhook,\n      retry: this.config.retry,\n      stripe: this.config.stripe\n        ? {\n            secretKey: this.redactSecret(this.config.stripe.secretKey),\n            webhookSecret: this.redactSecret(this.config.stripe.webhookSecret),\n            apiVersion: this.config.stripe.apiVersion,\n            maxNetworkRetries: this.config.stripe.maxNetworkRetries,\n            timeoutMs: this.config.stripe.timeoutMs,\n          }\n        : undefined,\n      nowpayments: this.config.nowpayments\n        ? {\n            apiKey: this.redactSecret(this.config.nowpayments.apiKey),\n            ipnSecret: this.redactSecret(this.config.nowpayments.ipnSecret),\n            apiBaseUrl: this.config.nowpayments.apiBaseUrl,\n            webhookBaseUrl: this.config.nowpayments.webhookBaseUrl,\n            timeoutMs: this.config.nowpayments.timeoutMs,\n          }\n        : undefined,\n    };\n  }\n\n  isProviderEnabled(provider: PaymentProvider): boolean {\n    if (provider === PaymentProvider.NONE) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (this.config.provider === PaymentProvider.NONE) {\n      return false;\n    }\n    if (provider === PaymentProvider.STRIPE) {\n      return !!this.config.stripe?.secretKey && !!this.config.stripe?.webhookSecret;\n    }\n    if (provider === PaymentProvider.NOWPAYMENTS) {\n      return !!this.config.nowpayments?.apiKey;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  getStripeSecretKey(): string {\n    const key = this.config.stripe?.secretKey;\n    if (!key) {\n      throw new Error('Stripe secret key not configured');\n    }\n    return key;\n  }\n\n  getStripeWebhookSecret(): string {\n    const secret = this.config.stripe?.webhookSecret;\n    if (!secret) {\n      throw new Error('Stripe webhook secret not configured');\n    }\n    return secret;\n  }\n\n  getNowPaymentsApiKey(): string {\n    const key = this.config.nowpayments?.apiKey;\n    if (!key) {\n      throw new Error('NowPayments API key not configured');\n    }\n    return key;\n  }\n\n  getNowPaymentsIpnSecret(): string | undefined {\n    return this.config.nowpayments?.ipnSecret;\n  }\n\n  private buildConfig(): PaymentProviderConfig {\n    const providerRaw = this.appConfig.billingProvider as string;\n    const provider = this.parseProvider(providerRaw);\n\n    const stripeSecretKey = process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY || '';\n    const stripeWebhookSecret = process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET || '';\n    const nowpaymentsApiKey = process.env.NOWPAYMENTS_API_KEY || '';\n    const nowpaymentsIpnSecret = process.env.NOWPAYMENTS_IPN_SECRET || '';\n\n    const publicUrl = this.appConfig.publicUrl || 'http://localhost:4000';\n    const adminWebUrl = this.appConfig.adminWebUrl || 'http://localhost:3000';\n\n    const config: PaymentProviderConfig = {\n      provider,\n      enabled: provider !== PaymentProvider.NONE,\n      checkout: {\n        successUrl: `${adminWebUrl}/billing/success?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`,\n        cancelUrl: `${adminWebUrl}/billing/cancel`,\n        defaultCurrency: 'USD',\n        expirationMinutes: 60,\n        idempotencyTtlSeconds: 24 * 60 * 60,\n      },\n      webhook: {\n        enabled: true,\n        toleranceSeconds: 300,\n        replayWindowSeconds: 24 * 60 * 60,\n        maxRetries: 3,\n        retryDelayMs: 1000,\n      },\n      retry: {\n        maxAttempts: 3,\n        initialDelayMs: 1000,\n        maxDelayMs: 10000,\n        backoffMultiplier: 2,\n        timeoutMs: 30000,\n      },\n    };\n\n    if (stripeSecretKey) {\n      config.stripe = {\n        secretKey: stripeSecretKey,\n        webhookSecret: stripeWebhookSecret,\n        apiVersion: STRIPE_API_VERSION,\n        maxNetworkRetries: 2,\n        timeoutMs: 30000,\n      };\n    }\n\n    if (nowpaymentsApiKey) {\n      config.nowpayments = {\n        apiKey: nowpaymentsApiKey,\n        ipnSecret: nowpaymentsIpnSecret,\n        apiBaseUrl: 'https://api.nowpayments.io/v1',\n        timeoutMs: 30000,\n      };\n    }\n\n    return config;\n  }\n\n  private parseProvider(raw: string): PaymentProvider {\n    switch (raw?.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'stripe':\n        return PaymentProvider.STRIPE;\n      case 'nowpayments':\n        return PaymentProvider.NOWPAYMENTS;\n      case 'none':\n      case '':\n      case undefined:\n        return PaymentProvider.NONE;\n      default:\n        return PaymentProvider.NONE;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private redactSecret(secret: string): string {\n    if (!secret || secret.length < 8) {\n      return '***';\n    }\n    return `${secret.substring(0, 4)}***${secret.substring(secret.length - 4)}`;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/payments/payment.repository.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected asObject(userMetadata) : current;\n  delete user[PAYMENT_RECORD_METADATA_KEY];\n  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(extras)) {\n    if (value !== undefined) stored[key] = value;\n  }\n  return { ...user, [PAYMENT_RECORD_METADATA_KEY]: stored };\n}\n\n/** providerReference JSON for a write; only non-empty links overwrite stored ones. */\nexport function buildProviderReference(existing: unknown, links: PaymentProviderLinks): Record<string, unknown> {\n  const merged = asObject(existing);\n  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(links)) {\n    if (value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '') merged[key] = value;\n  }\n  return merged;\n}\n\n/**\n * Persistence abstraction for internal payment records.\n *\n * Handles:\n *  - Payment records with provider references\n *  - Status transitions with validation\n *  - Idempotency keys for checkout creation\n *  - Checkout references\n *  - Tenant/subscription associations\n *  - Webhook event tracking for replay protection\n *\n * Note: This repository expects Payment and WebhookEvent models in Prisma.\n * If they don't exist yet, it will use raw queries or fallback to in-memory\n * tracking with Redis. input.providerReference?.providerInvoiceId || null,\n          providerReference: buildProviderReference(null, {\n            providerCustomerId: input.providerReference?.providerCustomerId || null,\n any).payment?.findUnique({\n      where: { id },\n    });\n    if (payment) {\n      return this.mapToPaymentRecord(payment);\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async if (payment) {\n      return this.mapToPaymentRecord(payment);\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async findByOrderId(orderId: string): Promise<PaymentRecord | null> {\n    const payment = await (this.prisma as any).payment?.findFirst({\n      where: { orderId },\n    });\n    if (payment) {\n      return this.mapToPaymentRecord(payment);\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async list(filter: PaymentFilter): Promise<PaymentRecord[]> {\n    const where: any = {};\n\n    if (filter.tenantId) where.tenantId = filter.tenantId;\n    if (filter.planId) where.planId = filter.planId;\n    if (filter.subscriptionId) where.subscriptionId = filter.subscriptionId;\n    if (filter.provider) where.provider = filter.provider;\n    if (filter.status) where.status = filter.status;\n    if where.createdAt.gte = filter.fromDate;\n      if (filter.toDate) where.createdAt.lte = filter.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const payments = await (this.prisma as any).payment?.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      take: 100,\n    });\n\n    if (payments) {\n      return payments.map((p: any) => this.mapToPaymentRecord(p));\n    }\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  async update(id: string, input: PaymentUpdateInput, tenantId?: string): Promise<PaymentRecord> {\n    try {\n      const owner = tenantId\n        ? { tenantId }\n        : await (this.prisma as any).payment?.findUnique({ where: { id }, select: { tenantId: true } });\n      if (!owner?.tenantId) throw new AppException({ code: ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, message: 'Payment not found' });\n\n      return await this.prisma.withTenantRls(owner.tenantId, async (tx) => {\n        const paymentStore = tx as any;\n        const existing = await paymentStore.payment.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId: owner.tenantId } });\n        if (!existing) throw new AppException({ code: ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, message: 'Payment not found' });\n\n        const updateData: any = {};\n        if (input.status) updateData.status = input.status;\n        if (input.paidAt !== undefined) updateData.paidAt = input.paidAt;\n        if (input.failedAt !== undefined) updateData.failedAt = input.failedAt;\n        if (input.cancelledAt !== undefined) updateData.cancelledAt = input.cancelledAt;\n        if (input.refundedAt !== undefined) updateData.refundedAt = input.refundedAt;\n        if (input.failureReason !== undefined) updateData.failureReason = input.failureReason;\n        if (input.failureCode !== undefined) updateData.failureCode = input.failureCode;\n\n        const links: PaymentProviderLinks = input.providerReference.invoiceUrl;\n        }\n\n        const extras: PaymentRecordExtras = {};\n        if (input.transactionState) extras.transactionState = input.transactionState;\n        if (input.rawProviderStatus !== undefined) extras.rawProviderStatus = input.rawProviderStatus;\n\n        const touchesJson = Object.keys(links).length > 0 || Object.keys(extras).length > 0 || aggregateType: 'payment',\n            aggregateId: payment.id,\n            eventType,\n            idempotencyKey: `payment:${payment.id}:${eventType}`,\n            correlationId,\n            occurredAt: payment.updatedAt,\n            payload: {\n              paymentId: payment.id,\n              amount,\n              currency: payment.currency,\n              status: payment.status,\n            },\n          });\n        }\n\n        return this.mapToPaymentRecord(payment);\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof AppException) throw error;\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to update payment ${id}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      throw new AppException({\n        code: ErrorCode.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n        message: 'Failed to update } else if (status === 'REFUNDED' as any) {\n      updateInput.refundedAt = now;\n    }\n\n    return this.update(id, updateInput, tenantId);\n  }\n\n  async findLatestByTenantAndPlan(tenantId: string, });\n    if (payment) {\n      return this.mapToPaymentRecord(payment);\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async countByTenant(tenantId: string): Promise<number> {\n    const count = await verification using Stripe's official method\n *  - Event normalization into internal payment states\n *  - Status mapping\n *\n * Never stores raw card numbers, CVV, or secrets in logs.\n * Never exposes provider secrets through API responses.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class StripeAdapter implements IPaymentProvider {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(StripeAdapter.name);\n  readonly supportsPartialRefunds: true,\n    supportsWebhooks: true,\n    supportsRecurring: true,\n    supportsCrypto: false,\n    supportedCurrencies: ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY', 'CAD', 'AUD'],\n  };\n\n  constructor(private readonly config: PaymentConfigService) {}\n\n  async createCheckout(input: CreateCheckoutInput): Promise<CreateCheckoutResult> {\n    this.validateCheckoutInput(input);\n    const amountInMinorUnits = this.parseAmountToMinorUnits(input.price, input.currency);\n\n    const stripeSecretKey = this.config.getStripeSecretKey();\n\n    // Use dynamic import to avoid hard dependency if stripe not installed\n    // In production, stripe SDK should be installed: npm install stripe\n    let stripe: any;\n    try {\n      const Stripe = await this.loadStripeSdk();\n      stripe = new this.config.stripe?.timeoutMs || 30000,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to load Stripe SDK: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      throw new AppException({\n        code: ErrorCode.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,\n        message: 'Stripe SDK not available',\n      });\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // input.price comes from the canonical billing plan catalog and has been exactly scaled above.\n      const sessionParams: any = {\n        payment_method_types: ['card'],\n        line_items: [\n          {\n            price_data: {\n              currency:    metadata: {\n                  planId: input.planId,\n                  planCode: input.planCode,\n                  tenantId: input.tenantId,\n                },\n              },\n              unit_amount: amountInMinorUnits,\n              recurring: input.interval !== 'LIFETIME' ? {\n                interval: this.mapIntervalToStripeInterval(input.interval),\n              } : (input.providerSessionId || input.providerCheckoutId) {\n        const sessionId = input.providerSessionId || input.providerCheckoutId!;\n        stripeObject = await  'requires_payment_method': PaymentStatus.PENDING,\n      'requires_confirmation': PaymentStatus.PENDING,\n      'requires_action': PaymentStatus.PENDING,\n      'processing': PaymentStatus.FAILED,\n      'refunded': PaymentStatus.REFUNDED,\n      'partially_refunded': PaymentStatus.PARTIALLY_REFUNDED,\n    };\n\n    return statusMap[providerStatus?.toLowerCase()] || PaymentStatus.UNKNOWN;\n  }\n\n  mapProviderStatusToTransactionState(providerStatus: string): TransactionState {\n    const stateMap: Record<string, TransactionState> = {\n      'open': TransactionState.INITIALIZED,\n      'complete': TransactionState.CAPTURED,\n      'expired': TransactionState.FAILED,\n      'requires_payment_method': TransactionState.INITIALIZED,\n Their\n * authentication is the provider signature plus replay protection below.\n * The signature-bypassing test endpoint stays authenticated and platform-only.\n *\n * Security:\n *  - Raw body preserved for signature verification (main.ts: rawBody: true)\n *  - Signature verification before any processing\n *  - Replay protection via provider event ID\n *  - No secrets logged\n */\n\n@ApiTags('Billing - webhooks')\n@Controller({ path: 'billing/webhooks', version: '1' })\n@ApiStandardResponses()\nexport class WebhookController {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(WebhookController.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly webhookService: WebhookService) {}\n\n  @Post('stripe')\n  @Public()\n  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)\n  @ApiOperation({\n    summary: 'Stripe webhook endpoint',\n    description: 'Receives and processes Stripe webhook events. Verifies signature using STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, checks replay protection, and syncs payment to subscription.',\n  })\n  @ApiExcludeEndpoint(false)\n  async handleStripeWebhook(\n    @Req() req: any,\n    @Headers('stripe-signature') signature: string,\n  ): Promise<{ received: boolean; eventId?: string }> {\n    this.logger.log('Stripe webhook received');\n\n    if (!signature) {\n      this.logger.warn('Stripe webhook missing signature header');\n      return { received: false };\n    }\n\n    // Raw body should be available via middleware that preserves raw body\n    // In NestJS, you need to configure raw body parser for webhook routes\n    const rawBody = req.rawBody || req.body;\n\n    if (!rawBody) {\n      this.logger.warn('Stripe webhook missing raw body');\n      return { received: false };\n    }\n\n    const payload: WebhookPayload = {\n      provider: PaymentProvider.STRIPE,\n      rawBody: Buffer.isBuffer(rawBody) ? rawBody : Buffer.from(typeof rawBody === 'string' ? rawBody : JSON.stringify(rawBody)),\n      signature,\n      headers: req.headers,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.webhookService.processWebhook(payload);\n\n      this.logger.log(`Stripe webhook processed: ${result.providerEventId} status ${result.processingStatus}`);\n\n      return {\n        received: true,\n        eventId: result.providerEventId,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      // For webhooks, we still return 200 to prevent provider retries for invalid signatures\n      // But log the error for investigation\n      const isAuthError = (error as any).code === 'UNAUTHORIZED' || (error as Error).message.includes('signature');\n\n      if (isAuthError) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Stripe webhook signature verification failed: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n        return { received: false };\n      }\n\n      this.logger.error(`Stripe webhook processing failed: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n\n      // Return received true to prevent infinite retries for processing errors\n      // Failed events can be retried via replay guard\n      return { received: true };\n    }\n  }\n\n  @Post('nowpayments')\n  @Public()\n  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)\n  @ApiOperation({\n    summary: 'NowPayments IPN webhook endpoint',\n    description: 'Receives and processes NowPayments IPN callbacks. Verifies authenticity via IPN secret, checks replay protection, and syncs payment to subscription.',\n  })\n  @ApiExcludeEndpoint(false)\n  async handleNowPaymentsWebhook(\n    @Req() req: any,\n    @Headers('x-nowpayments-sig') signature?: string,\n  ): Promise<{ received: boolean; eventId?: string }> {\n    this.logger.log('NowPayments webhook received');\n\n    const rawBody = req.rawBody || req.body;\n\n    if (!rawBody) {\n      this.logger.warn('NowPayments webhook missing raw body');\n      return { received: false };\n    }\n\n    // NOWPayments authenticity is the IPN HMAC only; an API key is never a webhook signature.\n    const effectiveSignature = signature || '';\n\n    const payload: WebhookPayload = {\n      provider: PaymentProvider.NOWPAYMENTS,\n      rawBody: Buffer.isBuffer(rawBody) ? rawBody : Buffer.from(typeof rawBody === 'string' ? rawBody : JSON.stringify(rawBody)),\n      signature: effectiveSignature,\n      headers: req.headers,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.webhookService.processWebhook(payload);\n\n      this.logger.log(`NowPayments webhook processed: ${result.providerEventId} status ${result.processingStatus}`);\n\n      return {\n        received: true,\n        eventId: result.providerEventId,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      const isAuthError = (error as any).code === 'UNAUTHORIZED' || (error as Error).message.includes('signature');\n\n      if (isAuthError) {\n        this.logger.warn(`NowPayments webhook verification failed: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n        return { received: false };\n      }\n\n      this.logger.error(`NowPayments webhook processing failed: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n\n      return { received: true };\n    }\n  }\n\n  @Post('stripe/test')\n  @PlatformOnly()\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)\n  @ApiOperation({\n    summary: 'Stripe webhook test endpoint (development only)',\n    description: 'Test endpoint for Stripe webhook verification without signature check - only enabled in development',\n  })\n  @ApiExcludeEndpoint(true)\n  async handleStripeTestWebhook(@Req() req: any): Promise<{ received: boolean; eventId?: string; warning: string }> {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {\n      return { received: false, warning: 'Test endpoint disabled in production' } as any;\n    }\n\n    const rawBody = req.rawBody || req.body;\n\n    // For testing, we bypass signature verification but still process\n    this.logger.warn('Stripe TEST webhook received - bypassing signature verification');\n\n    const payload: WebhookPayload = {\n      provider: PaymentProvider.STRIPE,\n      rawBody: Buffer.isBuffer(rawBody) ? rawBody : Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(rawBody)),\n      signature: 'test_signature',\n      headers: req.headers,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      // In test mode, we directly try to normalize without signature verification\n      const result = await this.webhookService.processWebhook(payload);\n\n      return {\n        received: true,\n        eventId: result.providerEventId,\n        warning: 'TEST MODE - signature verification bypassed',\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Stripe test webhook failed: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      return {\n        received: false,\n        warning: `Test failed: ${(error as Error).message}`,\n      } as any;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/payments/webhook.replay-guard.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. return row[key] === cond;\n    });\n  const delegate = {\n    rows,\n    create: jest.fn(async ({ data }: { data: Row }) => {\n      clock += 1000;\n      const row = {\n        processingAttempts:
