Object.entries(data)) {\n          if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && 'increment' in value) {\n            row[key] = (row[key] ?? 0) + value.increment;\n          } else if (value !== // which would hide what these tests are about.\n  receivedAt: new Date(),\n  providerCreatedAt: new Date(),\n  metadata: {},\n} as any;\n\ndescribe('WebhookReplayGuard (durable replay protection)', });\n\n  /** The order WebhookService uses for one delivery. */\n  async function deliver(): Promise<boolean> {\n    await guard.recordEventReceived(EVENT, { id: EVENT.providerEventId }, 'sig');\n    await guard.markEventVerified(EVENT.provider, EVENT.providerEventId);\n    const check = await guard.checkReplay(EVENT);\n    if (!check.shouldProcess) {\n      if (check.isDuplicate) {\n        await guard.markEventDuplicate(EVENT.provider, EVENT.providerEventId);\n      }\n      return false;\n    }\n    await guard.markEventProcessing(EVENT.provider, EVENT.providerEventId);\n    await guard.markEventProcessed(EVENT.provider, EVENT.providerEventId, 'pay_1', 'tenant-1');\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  it('processes the first delivery', async () => {\n    await expect(deliver()).resolves.toBe(true);\n    expect(\n      events.rows.filter((r) => r.processingStatus === WebhookProcessingStatus.PROCESSED),\n    ).toHaveLength(1);\n  });\n\n  it('refuses a replay from the database once the cache entry has expired', async () => {\n    await deliver();\n    // cache.get always returns null here: the Redis entry is gone.\n    await expect(deliver()).resolves.toBe(false);\n    await expect(deliver()).resolves.toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('never downgrades the PROCESSED row when later deliveries are marked', async () => {\n    await deliver();\n    await deliver();\n    await guard.markEventFailed(EVENT.provider, EVENT.providerEventId, 'late failure');\n    await guard.markEventProcessing(EVENT.provider, EVENT.providerEventId);\n    await guard.markEventProcessing(EVENT.provider, EVENT.providerEventId);\n    await guard.markEventFailed(EVENT.provider, EVENT.providerEventId, 'x');\n    await }\n  });\n\n  it('answers from the PROCESSED row even when a newer row exists', async () => {\n    await deliver();\n    await guard.recordEventReceived(EVENT, { id: EVENT.providerEventId }, 'sig');\n provider\n *  - provider event ID\n *  - event hash where appropriate\n *  - received timestamp\n *  - first-seen timestamp\n *  - processing status\n *  - successful/failed processing result\n *\n * Same provider event received twice must not apply the subscription transition twice.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class WebhookReplayGuard {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(WebhookReplayGuard.name);\n  private readonly CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 24 * 60 * 60;\n  private readonly PROCESSED_EVENT_TTL = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly cache: CacheService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async checkReplay(event: NormalizedWebhookEvent): Promise<WebhookReplayCheck> {\n    const provider = event.provider;\n    const providerEventId = event.providerEventId;\n\n    if (!providerEventId) {\n      return {\n        isDuplicate: false,\n        isReplay: false,\n        shouldProcess: true,\n        reason: 'No provider event ID - cannot deduplicate',\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Step 1: Check Redis cache for recently processed events (fast path)\n    const cacheKey = `webhook:processed:${provider}:${providerEventId}`;\n    const cached = await this.cache.get(cacheKey);\n\n    if (cached) {\n      this.logger.log(`Webhook replay detected (cache): ${provider}:${providerEventId} already processed`);\n\n      return {\n        isDuplicate: true,\n        isReplay: true,\n        shouldProcess: false,\n        reason: `Event ${providerEventId} already processed (cached)`,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Step 2: Check database for existing event record\n    try {\n      const existingRecord = await this.findExistingEvent(provider, providerEventId);\n\n      if (existingRecord) {\n        // Event already exists - check if it was successfully processed\n        if (existingRecord.processingStatus === WebhookProcessingStatus.PROCESSED) {\n          this.logger.log(`Webhook duplicate detected (DB): ${provider}:${providerEventId} already processed at ${existingRecord.processedAt}`);\n\n          return {\n            isDuplicate: true,\n            isReplay: true,\n            existingRecord,\n            shouldProcess: false,\n            reason: `Event ${providerEventId} already processed successfully`,\n          };\n        }\n\n        if (existingRecord.processingStatus === WebhookProcessingStatus.PROCESSING) {\n          // Event is currently being processed - possible concurrent delivery\n          const processingAge = Date.now() - existingRecord.updatedAt.getTime();\n          const processingTimeout = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes\n\n          if (processingAge < processingTimeout) {\n            this.logger.log(`Webhook concurrent processing detected: ${provider}:${providerEventId} is being processed`);\n\n            return {\n              isDuplicate: false,\n              isReplay: true,\n              existingRecord,\n              shouldProcess: false,\n              reason: `Event ${providerEventId} is currently being processed`,\n            };\n          }\n\n          // Processing timed out - allow retry\n          this.logger.log(`Webhook processing timeout for ${provider}:${providerEventId}, allowing retry`);\n        }\n\n        // For FAILED status, allow retry\n        if (existingRecord.processingStatus === WebhookProcessingStatus.FAILED) {\n          this.logger.log(`Webhook previous failure for ${provider}:${providerEventId}, allowing retry (attempt ${existingRecord.processingAttempts + 1})`);\n\n          return {\n            isDuplicate: false,\n            isReplay: false,\n            existingRecord,\n            shouldProcess: true,\n            reason: `Retrying failed event ${providerEventId}`,\n          };\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to check existing webhook event: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      // On DB failure, allow processing but log warning\n    }\n\n    // Step 3: Check event age for replay window only when the provider supplied a valid timestamp.\n    // Missing provider time is unknown evidence, not permission to substitute the receive time.\n    const replayWindowSeconds = 24 * 60 * 60; // 24 hours\n    const providerCreatedAtMs = event.providerCreatedAt?.getTime();\n\n    if (providerCreatedAtMs !== undefined && Number.isFinite(providerCreatedAtMs)) {\n      const eventAgeSeconds = (Date.now() - providerCreatedAtMs) / 1000;\n      if (eventAgeSeconds > replayWindowSeconds) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Webhook event too old: ${provider}:${providerEventId} age ${eventAgeSeconds}s exceeds window ${replayWindowSeconds}s`);\n\n        return {\n          isDuplicate: false,\n          isReplay: true,\n          shouldProcess: false,\n          reason: `Event too old: ${eventAgeSeconds}s old, window is ${replayWindowSeconds}s`,\n        };\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Event is new and should be processed\n    return {\n      isDuplicate: false,\n      isReplay: false,\n      shouldProcess: true,\n      reason: `New event ${providerEventId} should be processed`,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async recordEventReceived(event: NormalizedWebhookEvent, rawPayload?: any, signature?: string): Promise<WebhookEventRecord> {\n    const eventHash = this.computeEventHash(event);\n\n    try {\n      const record = await (this.prisma as any).webhookEvent?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: this.generateId(),\n          provider: event.provider,\n          providerEventId: event.providerEventId,\n          eventType: event.eventType,\n          eventCategory: event.eventCategory,\n          providerPaymentId: event.providerPaymentId || null,\n          providerCheckoutId: event.providerCheckoutId || null,\n          eventHash,\n          payload: rawPayload ? this.sanitizePayload(rawPayload) : null,\n          signature: signature ? '***REDACTED***' : null,\n          processingStatus: WebhookProcessingStatus.RECEIVED,\n          processingAttempts: 0,\n          paymentId: null,\n          tenantId: event.metadata?.tenantId || null,\n          receivedAt: event.receivedAt,\n          firstSeenAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (record) {\n        return this.mapToRecord(record);\n      }\n\n      return this.createFallbackRecord(event, eventHash);\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to record webhook event received: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      return this.createFallbackRecord(event, eventHash);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async markEventVerified(provider: PaymentProvider, providerEventId: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).webhookEvent?.updateMany({\n        where: { provider, providerEventId, processingStatus: { not: WebhookProcessingStatus.PROCESSED } },\n        data: {\n          processingStatus: WebhookProcessingStatus.VERIFIED,\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to mark event verified: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async markEventProcessing(provider: PaymentProvider, providerEventId: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).webhookEvent?.updateMany({\n        where: { provider, providerEventId, processingStatus: { not: WebhookProcessingStatus.PROCESSED } },\n        data: {\n          processingStatus: WebhookProcessingStatus.PROCESSING,\n          processingAttempts: { increment: 1 },\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to mark event processing: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async markEventProcessed(provider: PaymentProvider, providerEventId: string, paymentId?: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).webhookEvent?.updateMany({\n        where: { provider, providerEventId },\n        data: {\n          processingStatus: WebhookProcessingStatus.PROCESSED,\n          processedAt: new Date(),\n          paymentId: paymentId || undefined,\n          tenantId: tenantId || undefined,\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      // Cache processed event for fast replay detection\n      const cacheKey = `webhook:processed:${provider}:${providerEventId}`;\n      await this.cache.set(cacheKey, { processedAt: new Date().toISOString(), paymentId }, this.PROCESSED_EVENT_TTL);\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to mark event processed: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async markEventFailed(provider: PaymentProvider, providerEventId: string, errorMessage: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).webhookEvent?.updateMany({\n        where: { provider, providerEventId, processingStatus: { not: WebhookProcessingStatus.PROCESSED } },\n        data: {\n          processingStatus: WebhookProcessingStatus.FAILED,\n          lastProcessingError: errorMessage.substring(0, 1000),\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to mark event failed: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async markEventDuplicate(provider: PaymentProvider, providerEventId: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).webhookEvent?.updateMany({\n        where: { provider, providerEventId, processingStatus: { not: WebhookProcessingStatus.PROCESSED } },\n        data: {\n          processingStatus: WebhookProcessingStatus.DUPLICATE,\n          processedAt: new Date(),\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      const cacheKey = `webhook:processed:${provider}:${providerEventId}`;\n      await this.cache.set(cacheKey, { processedAt: new Date().toISOString(), duplicate: true }, this.PROCESSED_EVENT_TTL);\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to mark event duplicate: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async markEventRejected(provider: PaymentProvider, providerEventId: string, reason: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).webhookEvent?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: this.generateId(),\n          provider,\n          providerEventId,\n          eventType: 'REJECTED',\n          eventCategory: 'UNKNOWN',\n          eventHash: this.computeSimpleHash(`${provider}:${providerEventId}:${reason}`),\n          processingStatus: WebhookProcessingStatus.REJECTED,\n          lastProcessingError: reason.substring(0, 1000),\n          receivedAt: new Date(),\n          firstSeenAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to mark event rejected: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async findExistingEvent(provider: PaymentProvider, providerEventId: string): Promise<WebhookEventRecord | null> {\n    // A PROCESSED row wins over any newer one. The webhook service records\n    // every delivery (recordEventReceived runs before checkReplay), so for a\n    // replay the NEWEST row is always the fresh RECEIVED one; answering from\n    // it would let a replay through once the Redis entry has expired.\n    const processed = await (this.prisma as any).webhookEvent?.findFirst({\n      where: { provider, providerEventId, processingStatus: WebhookProcessingStatus.PROCESSED },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (processed) {\n      return this.mapToRecord(processed);\n    }\n    const record = await (this.prisma as any).webhookEvent?.findFirst({\n      where: { provider, providerEventId },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    if (record) {\n      return this.mapToRecord(record);\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  private computeEventHash(event: NormalizedWebhookEvent): string {\n    try {\n      const data = `${event.provider}:${event.providerEventId}:${event.eventType}:${event.providerPaymentId || ''}:${JSON.stringify(event.amount || {})}`;\n      return createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');\n    } catch {\n      return this.computeSimpleHash(`${event.provider}:${event.providerEventId}:${event.eventType}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private computeSimpleHash(data: string): string {\n    try {\n      return createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');\n    } catch {\n      return data.substring(0, 64);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private sanitizePayload(payload: any): any {\n    if (!payload) return null;\n    try {\n      const sanitized = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));\n      // Remove sensitive fields\n      const sensitiveFields = ['card', 'source', 'payment_method', 'api_key', 'secret', 'cvv', 'cvc', 'number'];\n      const removeSensitive = (obj: any) => {\n        if (typeof obj !== 'object' || obj === null) return;\n        for (const key of Object.keys(obj)) {\n          if (sensitiveFields.some((s) => key.toLowerCase().includes(s))) {\n            obj[key] = '***REDACTED***';\n          } else if (typeof obj[key] === 'object') {\n            removeSensitive(obj[key]);\n          }\n        }\n      };\n      removeSensitive(sanitized);\n      return sanitized;\n    } catch {\n      return { sanitized: true };\n    }\n  }\n\n  private mapToRecord(prismaRecord: any): WebhookEventRecord {\n    return {\n      id: prismaRecord.id,\n      provider: prismaRecord.provider as PaymentProvider,\n      providerEventId: prismaRecord.providerEventId,\n      eventType: prismaRecord.eventType,\n      eventCategory: prismaRecord.eventCategory as any,\n      providerPaymentId: prismaRecord.providerPaymentId || null,\n      providerCheckoutId: prismaRecord.providerCheckoutId || null,\n      eventHash: prismaRecord.eventHash,\n      payload: prismaRecord.payload || null,\n      signature: prismaRecord.signature || null,\n      processingStatus: prismaRecord.processingStatus as WebhookProcessingStatus,\n      processingAttempts: prismaRecord.processingAttempts,\n      lastProcessingError: prismaRecord.lastProcessingError || null,\n      processedAt: prismaRecord.processedAt || null,\n      paymentId: prismaRecord.paymentId || null,\n      tenantId: prismaRecord.tenantId || null,\n      receivedAt: prismaRecord.receivedAt,\n      firstSeenAt: prismaRecord.firstSeenAt,\n      createdAt: prismaRecord.createdAt,\n      updatedAt: prismaRecord.updatedAt,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private createFallbackRecord(event: NormalizedWebhookEvent, eventHash: string): WebhookEventRecord {\n    const now = new Date();\n    return {\n      id: this.generateId(),\n      provider: event.provider,\n      providerEventId: event.providerEventId,\n      eventType: event.eventType,\n      eventCategory: event.eventCategory,\n      providerPaymentId: event.providerPaymentId || null,\n      providerCheckoutId: event.providerCheckoutId || null,\n      eventHash,\n      payload: null,\n      signature: null,\n      processingStatus: WebhookProcessingStatus.RECEIVED,\n      processingAttempts: 0,\n      lastProcessingError: null,\n      processedAt: null,\n      paymentId: null,\n      tenantId: event.metadata?.tenantId || null,\n      receivedAt: event.receivedAt,\n      firstSeenAt: now,\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private generateId(): string {\n    try {\n      return randomUUID();\n    } catch {\n      return 'np-payment-123' : 'evt-stripe-123',\n    eventType: provider === PaymentProvider.NOWPAYMENTS ? 'finished' : 'checkout.session.completed',\n    eventCategory: WebhookEventCategory.PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED,\n    paymentStatus: PaymentStatus.PENDING,\n    providerPaymentId: provider === PaymentProvider.NOWPAYMENTS ? 'np-payment-123' : 'pi-stripe-123',\n    providerCheckoutId: provider === PaymentProvider.STRIPE ? 'cs-stripe-123' : undefined,\n    amount: { amount: '1.23', currency: provider === PaymentProvider.NOWPAYMENTS ? 'WEBHOOK_REJECTED',\n        result: 'REJECTED',\n        error: verificationResult.failureReason,\n        metadata: { reason: 'signature_verification_failed' },\n      });\n\n      await this.replayGuard.markEventRejected(provider, verificationResult.providerEventId || 'unknown', verificationResult.failureReason || 'Signature verification failed');\n\n      throw new AppException({\n        code: ErrorCode.UNAUTHORIZED,\n        message: 'Webhook signature verification failed',\n        context: { provider, reason: verificationResult.failureReason },\n      });\n    }\n\n    const action: 'WEBHOOK_RECEIVED',\n      result: 'RECEIVED',\n      eventType: verificationResult.eventType,\n    });\n\n    // Step 2: Record event received\n    const eventRecord = await this.replayGuard.recordEventReceived(\n      {\n        provider,\n        providerEventId,\n        eventType: verificationResult.eventType || 'unknown',\n        eventCategory: 'UNKNOWN' as any,\n        paymentStatus: 'UNKNOWN' as any,\n        receivedAt: new Date(),\n        providerCreatedAt: null,\n      } as NormalizedWebhookEvent,\n      rawEvent,\n      payload.signature,\n    );\n\n    // Step 3: Normalize only after signature verification has succeeded.\n    let normalizedEvent: NormalizedWebhookEvent;\n    let canonicalPaymentEvent: NormalizedPaymentWebhookEvent | undefined;\n    try {\n      canonicalPaymentEvent = normalizeVerifiedPaymentEvent(provider, rawEvent);\n      if (canonicalPaymentEvent && canonicalPaymentEvent.occurredAtIso === null) {\n        throw new this.logger.error(`Webhook event normalization failed for ${provider}:${providerEventId}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n\n      await this.replayGuard.markEventFailed(provider, providerEventId, this.audit.logWebhookEvent({\n          provider,\n          providerEventId,\n          action: 'WEBHOOK_DUPLICATE',\n          result: 'DUPLICATE',\n          eventType: normalizedEvent.eventType,\n          metadata: { reason: replayCheck.reason },\n        });\n\n        return {\n          success: true,\n          eventId: eventRecord.id,\n          providerEventId,\n success: false,\n        eventId: eventRecord.id,\n        providerEventId,\n        processingStatus: WebhookProcessingStatus.REJECTED,\n        error: replayCheck.reason,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // action: 'WEBHOOK_PROCESSED',\n          result: 'PROCESSED_NO_PAYMENT',\n          eventType: normalizedEvent.eventType,\n          metadata: { reason: 'no_internal_payment_found' },\n        });\n\n Tenant-scoped, no secrets.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class BillingInvoiceQueryService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(BillingInvoiceQueryService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly invoiceRepository: InvoiceRepository,\n    private readonly invoicePdfService: InvoicePdfService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async listInvoices(tenantId: string, filter?: { status?: string; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date; limit?: number }): Promise<PortalInvoiceSummary[]> {\n    const invoices = await this.invoiceRepository.list({\n      tenantId,\n      status: filter?.status as any,\n      fromDate: filter?.fromDate,\n      toDate: filter?.toDate,\n    } as any);\n\n    const mapped = invoices.map((inv) => this.mapToSummary(inv));\n\n    // Sort by issue date desc\n    mapped.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.issueDate).getTime() - new Date(a.issueDate).getTime());\n\n    if (filter?.limit) {\n      return mapped.slice(0, filter.limit);\n    }\n\n    return mapped;\n  }\n\n  async getInvoiceDetail(tenantId: string, invoiceId: string): Promise<PortalInvoiceSummary & { lines?: any[]; taxSummary?: any[]; paymentReference?: any }> {\n    const invoice = await this.invoiceRepository.findById(invoiceId, tenantId);\n    if (!invoice) {\n      throw new NotFoundException('Invoice not found');\n    }\n\n    // Ensure tenant isolation\n    if (invoice.tenantId !== tenantId) {\n      throw new NotFoundException('Invoice not found');\n    }\n\n    const summary = this.mapToSummary(invoice);\n\n    // Try to get detailed data via PDF service (which already handles tenant isolation)\n    let lines: any[] | undefined;\n    let taxSummary: any[] | undefined;\n    let paymentReference: any | undefined;\n\n    try {\n      const pdfData = await this.invoicePdfService.generateInvoicePdfData(invoiceId, tenantId);\n      lines = pdfData.lineItems as any;\n      taxSummary = pdfData.taxSummary as any;\n      paymentReference = pdfData.paymentReference;\n    } catch {\n      // Fallback: no detailed lines\n    }\n\n    return {\n      ...summary,\n      lines,\n      taxSummary,\n      paymentReference,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getInvoicePdfMetadata(tenantId: string, invoiceId: string): Promise<{ available: boolean; invoiceNumber: string; generatedAt?: string }> {\n    const invoice = await this.invoiceRepository.findById(invoiceId, tenantId);\n    if (!invoice) {\n      throw new NotFoundException('Invoice not found');\n    }\n\n    if (invoice.tenantId !== tenantId) {\n      throw new NotFoundException('Invoice not found');\n    }\n\n    // Check if invoice is finalized/paid - only those have PDF\n    const pdfAvailableStatuses = ['FINALIZED', 'PAID', 'PARTIALLY_PAID', 'REFUNDED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'OPEN'];\n    const available = pdfAvailableStatuses.includes(invoice.status);\n\n    return {\n      available,\n      invoiceNumber: invoice.invoiceNumber,\n      generatedAt: invoice.finalizedAt ? new Date(invoice.finalizedAt).toISOString() : undefined,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private mapToSummary(invoice: any): PortalInvoiceSummary {\n    return {\n      id: invoice.id,\n      invoiceNumber: invoice.invoiceNumber,\n      status: invoice.status,\n      issueDate: invoice.issueDate ? new Date(invoice.issueDate).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n      dueDate: invoice.dueDate ? new Date(invoice.dueDate).toISOString() : null,\n      currency: invoice.currency,\n      subtotal: invoice.subtotal,\n      discountTotal: invoice.discountTotal,\n      taxTotal: invoice.taxTotal,\n      total: invoice.total,\n      amountPaid: invoice.amountPaid,\n      amountDue: invoice.amountDue,\n      amountRefunded: invoice.amountRefunded,\n      billingPeriodStart: invoice.billingPeriodStart ? new Date(invoice.billingPeriodStart).toISOString() : null,\n      billingPeriodEnd: invoice.billingPeriodEnd ? new Date(invoice.billingPeriodEnd).toISOString() : null,\n      planCode: invoice.planCode || null,\n      planName: invoice.planName || null,\n      pdfAvailable: ['FINALIZED', 'PAID', 'PARTIALLY_PAID', 'REFUNDED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED', 'OPEN'].includes(invoice.status),\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/portal/billing-payment-history.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. No provider secrets.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class BillingPaymentHistoryService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(BillingPaymentHistoryService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly paymentService: PaymentService) {}\n\n  async listPayments(tenantId: string, filter?: { status?: string; provider?: string; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date; limit?: number }): Promise<PortalPaymentSummary[]> {\n    const payments = await this.paymentService.listPaymentsByTenant(tenantId);\n\n    let filtered = payments;\n\n    if (filter?.status) {\n      filtered = filtered.filter((p) => p.status === filter.status);\n    }\n\n    if (filter?.provider) {\n      filtered = filtered.filter((p) => p.provider === filter.provider);\n    }\n\n    if (filter?.fromDate) {\n      filtered = filtered.filter((p) => new Date(p.createdAt) >= filter.fromDate!);\n    }\n\n    if (filter?.toDate) {\n      filtered = filtered.filter((p) => new Date(p.createdAt) <= filter.toDate!);\n    }\n\n    // Sort by created desc\n    filtered.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());\n\n    if (filter?.limit) {\n      filtered = filtered.slice(0, filter.limit);\n    }\n\n    return filtered.map((p) => this.mapToSummary(p));\n  }\n\n  async getPaymentDetail(tenantId: string, paymentId: string): Promise<PortalPaymentSummary & { safeMetadata?: any }> {\n    const payment = await this.paymentService.getPaymentById(paymentId);\n\n    // Tenant isolation\n    if (payment.tenantId !== tenantId) {\n      throw new NotFoundException('Payment not found');\n    }\n\n    const summary = this.mapToSummary(payment);\n\n    // Safe metadata - exclude secrets\n    const safeMetadata = this.extractSafeMetadata(payment);\n\n    return {\n      ...summary,\n      safeMetadata,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getPaymentStatus(tenantId: string, paymentId: string): Promise<{ paymentId: string; status: string; provider: string; amount: string; currency: string; paidAt: string | null; verified: boolean }> {\n    const payment = await this.paymentService.getPaymentById(paymentId);\n\n    if (payment.tenantId !== tenantId) {\n      throw new NotFoundException('Payment not found');\n    }\n\n    // Always verify from backend/provider state, never trust frontend\n    let verifiedStatus = payment.status;\n    let verified = false;\n\n    try {\n      const providerResult = await this.paymentService.retrieveProviderPayment(paymentId);\n      verifiedStatus = providerResult.status;\n      verified = true;\n    } catch {\n      // If provider retrieval fails, use internal state but mark unverified\n      verified = false;\n    }\n\n    return {\n      paymentId: payment.id,\n      status: verifiedStatus,\n      provider: payment.provider,\n      amount: payment.amount,\n      currency: payment.currency,\n      paidAt: payment.paidAt ? payment.paidAt.toISOString() : null,\n      verified,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private mapToSummary(payment: any): PortalPaymentSummary {\n    return {\n      id: payment.id,\n      provider: payment.provider,\n      status: payment.status,\n      amount: payment.amount,\n      currency: payment.currency,\n      planId: payment.planId,\n      planCode: payment.planCode || (payment.metadata as any)?.planCode || null,\n      paidAt: payment.paidAt ? new Date(payment.paidAt).toISOString() : null,\n      failedAt: payment.failedAt ? new Date(payment.failedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      createdAt: new Date(payment.createdAt).toISOString(),\n      checkoutUrl: payment.checkoutUrl || null,\n      invoiceUrl: payment.invoiceUrl || null,\n      hasInvoice: !!payment.invoiceId || !!(payment.metadata as any)?.invoiceId,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private extractSafeMetadata(payment: any): any {\n    // Only expose safe fields, never secrets\n    const metadata = payment.metadata || {};\n    const safeFields = ['planCode', 'planName', 'billingInterval', 'orderId', 'description', 'seats'];\n\n    const safe: any = {};\n    for (const field of safeFields) {\n      if (metadata[field] !== undefined) {\n        safe[field] = metadata[field];\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Include safe references\n    safe.orderId = payment.orderId || safe.orderId;\n    safe.providerReference = payment.providerReference ? `${payment.providerReference.substring(0, 8)}...` : null;\n\n    return safe;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/portal/billing-portal-not-found.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/portal/billing-portal.controller.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected };\n  }\n\n  async getCurrentSubscriptionState(tenantId: string): Promise<PortalSubscriptionState> {\n    const subscription = await this.subscriptionsService.getCurrent(tenantId);\n\n    if   };\n    }\n\n    const now = new Date();\n    const trialEndsAt = subscription.trialEndsAt ? new Date(subscription.trialEndsAt) : null;\n    const trialActive = trialEndsAt ? trialEndsAt > now : false;\n\n    return {\n      id: subscription.id,\n      tenantId: subscription.tenantId,\n      planId: subscription.planId,\n      planCode: subscription.plan?.code || null,\n      planName: };\n  }\n\n  private mapInvoiceToSummary(invoice: any): PortalInvoiceSummary {\n    return {\n      id: invoice.id,\n      invoiceNumber: invoice.invoiceNumber,\n      status: invoice.status,\n names like if plan === \"premium\".\n * Uses canonical plan ID/code from existing catalog.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class PlanChangeService {\n  private readonly logger = new any;\n    currentPlan: any;\n    requestedPlan: any;\n    changeType: 'UPGRADE' | 'DOWNGRADE' | 'INTERVAL_CHANGE' | 'SAME_PLAN';\n    requiresPayment: boolean;\n    priceDelta: string | null;\n  }> {\n    // Get current subscription from canonical source\n    const currentSubscription = await this.subscriptionsService.getCurrent(tenantId);\n    if (!currentSubscription) {\n      throw new AppException({\n        code: ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND,\n        message: 'No active subscription found',\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Get requested plan from canonical catalog - never hardcoded\n    let requestedPlan: any;\n    try {\n      requestedPlan = await this.plansService.findById(requestedPlanId, {\n        tenantId: actor.tenantId || tenantId,\n        isPlatformUser: actor.isPlatformUser,\n      });\n    } catch {\n      throw new AppException({\n        code: ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND,\n        message: `Plan not found: ${requestedPlanId}`,\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (!requestedPlan.isActive) {\n      throw new AppException({\n        code: ErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR,\n        message: 'Requested plan is not active',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const currentPlan = currentSubscription.plan;\n\n    const changeType = this.determineChangeType(currentPlan, requestedPlan);\n    const { requiresPayment, priceDelta } = this.calculateFinancialDelta(currentPlan, requestedPlan, changeType);\n\n    return {\n      currentSubscription,\n      currentPlan,\n      requestedPlan,\n      changeType,\n      requiresPayment,\n      priceDelta,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async changePlan(\n    tenantId: string,\n    requestedPlanId: string,\n    options: { atPeriodEnd?: boolean; actorId: string; ipHash: string; requestId: string; actor: { tenantId: string | null; isPlatformUser: boolean } },\n  ): Promise<any> {\n    const validation = await this.validatePlanChange(tenantId, requestedPlanId, options.actor);\n\n    // For upgrades requiring payment, payment must be handled via checkout flow\n    // We do not bypass payment when new plan requires it\n    if (validation.requiresPayment && validation.changeType === 'UPGRADE' && !options.atPeriodEnd) {\n      this.logger.log(`Plan change requires payment: tenant ${tenantId} from ${validation.currentPlan.code} to ${validation.requestedPlan.code}, delta ${validation.priceDelta}`);\n      // Return info that checkout is required - actual payment via checkout service\n      return {\n        requiresCheckout: true,\n        currentPlan: validation.currentPlan,\n        requestedPlan: validation.requestedPlan,\n        changeType: validation.changeType,\n        priceDelta: validation.priceDelta,\n        message: 'Payment required for upgrade - proceed to checkout',\n      };\n    }\n\n    // For downgrade or same-price changes, use existing subscription service\n    // All state transitions go through existing architecture\n    const result = await this.subscriptionsService.changePlan(\n      tenantId,\n      { planId: requestedPlanId, atPeriodEnd: options.atPeriodEnd || false },\n      { actorId: options.actorId, ipHash: options.ipHash, requestId: options.requestId },\n    );\n\n    this.logger.log(`Plan changed: tenant ${tenantId} from ${validation.currentPlan.code} to ${validation.requestedPlan.code}, type ${validation.changeType}, atPeriodEnd ${options.atPeriodEnd}`);\n\n    return {\n      requiresCheckout: false,\n      subscription: result,\n      changeType: validation.changeType,\n      effectiveAt: options.atPeriodEnd ? result.currentPeriodEnd : new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async changeBillingInterval(\n    tenantId: string,\n    requestedPlanId: string,\n    newInterval: BillingInterval,\n    options: { actorId: string; ipHash: string; requestId: string; actor: { tenantId: string | null; isPlatformUser: boolean } },\n  ): Promise<any> {\n    // Validate plan exists and interval is supported\n    const requestedPlan = await this.plansService.findById(requestedPlanId, {\n      tenantId: options.actor.tenantId || tenantId,\n      isPlatformUser: options.actor.isPlatformUser,\n    });\n\n    // Find plan with same code but different interval\n    const allPlans = await this.plansService.list(\n      { includeInactive: false } as any,\n      { tenantId: options.actor.tenantId || tenantId, isPlatformUser: options.actor.isPlatformUser },\n    );\n\n    const targetPlan = allPlans.items.find((p) => p.code === requestedPlan.code && p.interval === newInterval);\n\n    if (!targetPlan) {\n      throw new AppException({\n        code: ErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR,\n        message: `No plan found with code ${requestedPlan.code} and interval ${newInterval}`,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return this.changePlan(tenantId, targetPlan.id, {\n      atPeriodEnd: true,\n      actorId: options.actorId,\n      ipHash: options.ipHash,\n      requestId: options.requestId,\n      actor: options.actor,\n    });\n  }\n\n  private determineChangeType(currentPlan: any, requestedPlan: any): 'UPGRADE' | 'DOWNGRADE' | 'INTERVAL_CHANGE' | 'SAME_PLAN' {\n    if (currentPlan.id === requestedPlan.id) {\n      return 'SAME_PLAN';\n    }\n\n    if (currentPlan.code === requestedPlan.code && currentPlan.interval !== requestedPlan.interval) {\n      return 'INTERVAL_CHANGE';\n    }\n\n    const currentPrice = parseFloat(currentPlan.price || '0');\n    const requestedPrice = parseFloat(requestedPlan.price || '0');\n\n    if (requestedPrice > currentPrice) {\n      return 'UPGRADE';\n    }\n\n    if (requestedPrice < currentPrice) {\n      return 'DOWNGRADE';\n    }\n\n    // Same price, different plan code - treat as upgrade for safety\n    return 'UPGRADE';\n  }\n\n  private calculateFinancialDelta(currentPlan: any, requestedPlan: any, changeType: string): { requiresPayment: boolean; priceDelta: string | null } {\n    const currentPrice = parseFloat(currentPlan.price || '0');\n    const requestedPrice = parseFloat(requestedPlan.price || '0');\n    const delta = requestedPrice - currentPrice;\n\n    if (changeType === 'UPGRADE') {\n      return { requiresPayment: delta > 0, priceDelta: delta.toFixed(2) };\n    }\n\n    if (changeType === 'INTERVAL_CHANGE') {\n      // Interval change may require payment if new interval is more expensive per period\n      return { requiresPayment: delta > 0, priceDelta: delta.toFixed(2) };\n    }\n\n    // Downgrade or same plan - no immediate payment\n    return { requiresPayment: false, priceDelta: delta.toFixed(2) };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/portal/portal.module.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/portal/subscription-management.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected this.subscriptionsService.getCurrent(tenantId);\n    if (!current) {\n      throw new AppException({ code: ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, message: 'No active subscription' });\n    }\n\n    if (current.cancelAtPeriodEnd) {\n      throw new AppException({ code: ErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR, message: 'Subscription already set to cancel at period end' });\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.subscriptionsService.cancel(\n      tenantId,\n      { atPeriodEnd: true, reason },\n      { actorId: context.actorId, ipHash: context.ipHash, requestId: context.requestId },\n    );\n\n    this.logger.log(`Subscription cancel at period end: tenant ${tenantId}, subscription ${result.id}, reason ${reason || 'N/A'}`);\n\n    return {\n      subscription: result,\n      effectiveAt: result.currentPeriodEnd,\n      message: `Subscription will be canceled at period end: ${result.currentPeriodEnd}`,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async resumeCancelled(tenantId: string, context: { actorId: string; ipHash: string; requestId: string }): Promise<any> {\n    const current = await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, cancelAtPeriodEnd: true, status: { in: ['ACTIVE', 'TRIALING', 'PAST_DUE'] } },\n      include: { plan: true },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    if (!current) {\n      throw new AppException({ code: ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, message: 'No subscription pending cancellation found' });\n    }\n\n    const updated = await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.update({\n      where: { id: current.id },\n      data: { cancelAtPeriodEnd: false, cancelReason: null },\n      include: { plan: true },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Subscription resumed: tenant ${tenantId}, subscription ${current.id}`);\n\n    return {\n      subscription: updated,\n      message: 'Subscription cancellation has been reversed - subscription will continue',\n    };\n  }\n\n  async changePlan(\n    tenantId: string,\n    requestedPlanId: string,\n    options: { atPeriodEnd?: boolean; actorId: string; ipHash: string; requestId: string; actor: { tenantId: string | null; isPlatformUser: boolean } },\n  ): Promise<any> {\n    return this.planChangeService.changePlan(tenantId, requestedPlanId, options);\n  }\n\n  async changeBillingInterval(\n    tenantId: string,\n    newInterval: BillingInterval,\n    options: { actorId: string; ipHash: string; requestId: string; actor: { tenantId: string | null; isPlatformUser: boolean } },\n  ): Promise<any> {\n    const current = await this.subscriptionsService.getCurrent(tenantId);\n    if (!current) {\n      throw new AppException({ code: ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, message: 'No active subscription' });\n    }\n\n    return this.planChangeService.changeBillingInterval(tenantId, current.planId, newInterval, options);\n  }\n\n  async getSubscriptionState(tenantId: string): Promise<{\n    subscription: any | null;\n    canCancel: boolean;\n    canResume: boolean;\n    canChangePlan: boolean;\n    canChangeInterval: boolean;\n    effectiveActions: string[];\n  }> {\n    const subscription = await this.subscriptionsService.getCurrent(tenantId);\n\n    if (!subscription) {\n      return {\n        subscription: null,\n        canCancel: false,\n        canResume: false,\n        canChangePlan: false,\n        canChangeInterval: false,\n        effectiveActions: ['CHECKOUT'],\n      };\n    }\n\n    const canCancel = !subscription.cancelAtPeriodEnd && ['ACTIVE', 'TRIALING', 'PAST_DUE'].includes(subscription.status);\n    const canResume = subscription.cancelAtPeriodEnd && ['ACTIVE', 'TRIALING', 'PAST_DUE'].includes(subscription.status);\n    const canChangePlan = ['ACTIVE', 'TRIALING'].includes(subscription.status);\n    const canChangeInterval = ['ACTIVE', 'TRIALING'].includes(subscription.status);\n\n    const effectiveActions: string[] = [];\n    if (canChangePlan) {\n      effectiveActions.push('UPGRADE', 'DOWNGRADE');\n    }\n    if (canChangeInterval) {\n      effectiveActions.push('CHANGE_INTERVAL');\n    }\n    if (canCancel) {\n      effectiveActions.push('CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END');\n    }\n    if (canResume) {\n      effectiveActions.push('RESUME');\n    }\n\n    return {\n      subscription,\n      canCancel,\n      canResume,\n      canChangePlan,\n      canChangeInterval,\n      effectiveActions,\n    };\n {}\n\n  async getDomainState(tenantId: string): Promise<SaasCustomDomainState> {\n    // Check entitlement first\n    const entitlement = await this.featureAccessService.checkFeatureAccess(tenantId, (!domainRecord) {\n      // Check any domain\n      const anyDomain = await this.prisma.tenantDomain.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n\n tenantId,\n      domain: domainRecord.domain,\n      isPrimary: domainRecord.isPrimary,\n      status: domainRecord.status,\n      verifiedAt: domainRecord.verifiedAt ? domainRecord.verifiedAt.toISOString() : null,\n      verificationRequired: domainRecord.status !== 'ACTIVE',\n      entitlementAllowed: entitlement.enabled,\n      entitlementReason: entitlement.reason,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async registerDomain(tenantId: string, domain: string, isPrimary: boolean | undefined, actorId: string): Promise<{ id: string; domain: string; status: string; verificationToken: string; message: string }> {\n    // Entitlement check - must have customDomain\n    const entitlement = await this.featureAccessService.checkFeatureAccess(tenantId, 'customDomain');\n    if (!entitlement.enabled) {\n      await this.auditService.logDomainVerificationFailed(tenantId, actorId, domain, `Entitlement check failed: ${entitlement.reason}`);\n      throw new Error(`Custom domain not allowed: ${entitlement.reason || 'Feature not included in current plan'}`);\n    }\n\n    // Validate domain format\n    this.validateDomainFormat(domain);\n\n    // capitalisation.\n    const normalised = domain.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\\.$/, '');\n\n    // Prevent cross-tenant ownership - check if domain already exists for any tenant\n    const tenant`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Prevent duplicate - already checked, but also check tenant has not exceeded limit (e.g., 1 custom domain)\n    // For simplicity, allow 1 primary custom domain per tenant\n    const tenantDomainsCount = await this.prisma.tenantDomain.count({ where: { tenantId } });\n    if (tenantDomainsCount >= 5) {\n      throw new Error('Maximum custom domains limit reached (5)');\n    }\n\n    const verificationToken = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');\n\n    const created = await this.prisma.tenantDomain.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        domain: normalised,\n        isPrimary: isPrimary ?? true,\n        status: 'PENDING_DNS' as any,\n        verificationToken,\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.logDomainRegistered(tenantId, actorId, domain);\n\n    this.logger.log(`Custom domain registered: ${domain} for tenant ${tenantId} by ${actorId}`);\n\n    return {\n      id: created.id,\n      domain: created.domain,\n      status: created.status,\n      verificationToken: `${verificationToken.substring(0, 8)}...`, // Only partial token exposed, full via verification service\n      message: `Domain ${domain} registered. Verification required via DNS TXT record.`,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async removeDomain(tenantId: string, domain: string, actorId: string): Promise<{ removed: boolean; domain: string }> {\n    const domainRecord = await this.prisma.tenantDomain.findFirst({ where: { domain, tenantId } });\n    if (!domainRecord) {\n      throw new Error(`Domain ${domain} not found for tenant ${tenantId}`);\n    }\n\n    // Tenant ownership already validated by query\n\n    await this.prisma.tenantDomain.delete({ where: { id: domainRecord.id } });\n\n    await this.auditService.logDomainRemoved(tenantId, actorId, domain);\n\n    this.logger.log(`Custom domain removed: ${domain} for tenant ${tenantId} by ${actorId}`);\n\n    return { removed: true, domain };\n  }\n\n  async listDomains(tenantId: string): Promise<Array<{ id: string; domain: string; isPrimary: boolean; status: string; verifiedAt: string | null; createdAt: string }>> {\n    const domains = await this.prisma.tenantDomain.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    return domains.map((d: any) => ({\n      id: d.id,\n      domain: d.domain,\n      isPrimary: d.isPrimary,\n      status: d.status,\n      verifiedAt: d.verifiedAt ? = 'TENANT_PLAN_CHANGED',\n  TENANT_PLAN_CHANGE_REJECTED = 'TENANT_PLAN_CHANGE_REJECTED',\n  FEATURE_ACCESS_CHECKED = 'FEATURE_ACCESS_CHECKED',\n  FEATURE_ACCESS_REJECTED = 'FEATURE_ACCESS_REJECTED',\n  BRANDING_UPDATED = 'BRANDING_UPDATED',\n  DOMAIN_REGISTERED = 'DOMAIN_REGISTERED',\n  DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_STARTED = 'DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_STARTED',\n  DOMAIN_VERIFIED = 'DOMAIN_VERIFIED',\n  DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED = 'DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED',\n  DOMAIN_REMOVED = 'DOMAIN_REMOVED',\n  WHITE_LABEL_REQUESTED = 'WHITE_LABEL_REQUESTED',\n  WHITE_LABEL_ENABLED = 'WHITE_LABEL_ENABLED',\n  WHITE_LABEL_REJECTED = 'WHITE_LABEL_REJECTED',\n  WHITE_LABEL_DISABLED = 'WHITE_LABEL_DISABLED',\n  TENANT_SUSPENDED = 'TENANT_SUSPENDED',\n  TENANT_ACTIVATED = 'TENANT_ACTIVATED',\n}\n\nexport interface SaasAuditInput {\n  tenantId: string;\n  operation: SaasAuditOperation;\n  actorId: string;\n  actorType?: string;\n  referenceId?: string;\n  referenceType?: string;\n  previousState?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  newState?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  result?: 'SUCCESS' | 'FAILURE' | 'REJECTED';\n  reason?: string;\n  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class SaasAdminAuditService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(SaasAdminAuditService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async log(input: SaasAuditInput): Promise<void> {\n    const sanitizedPrev = this.sanitize(input.previousState);\n    const sanitizedNew = this.sanitize(input.newState);\n    const sanitizedMeta = this.sanitize(input.metadata);\n\n    const record = {\n      id: randomUUID(),\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      operation: input.operation,\n      actorId: input.actorId,\n      actorType: input.actorType || 'USER',\n      referenceId: input.referenceId || input.tenantId,\n      referenceType: input.referenceType || 'TENANT',\n      previousState: sanitizedPrev,\n      newState: sanitizedNew,\n      result: input.result || 'SUCCESS',\n      reason: input.reason || null,\n      metadata: sanitizedMeta,\n      timestamp: new Date(),\n      createdAt: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    try {\n      // Try dedicated SaaS audit table, fallback to general audit\n      await (this.prisma as any).saasAuditLog?.create({ data: record });\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        // Fallback to general audit log\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).auditLog?.create({\n            data: {\n              id: record.id,\n              tenantId: record.tenantId,\n              action: record.operation,\n              resourceType: record.referenceType,\n              resourceId: record.referenceId,\n              actorId: record.actorId,\n              metadata: {\n                previousState: sanitizedPrev,\n                newState: sanitizedNew,\n                result: record.result,\n                reason: record.reason,\n                ...sanitizedMeta,\n              },\n              createdAt: record.createdAt,\n            },\n          });\n        } catch {\n          // Final fallback: log\n          this.logger.log(`[SAAS_AUDIT] ${record.operation} tenant=${record.tenantId} actor=${record.actorId} result=${record.result} reason=${record.reason || 'N/A'}`);\n        }\n        return;\n      }\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to create SaaS audit log: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`[SAAS_AUDIT] ${record.operation} tenant=${record.tenantId} actor=${record.actorId} result=${record.result}`);\n  }\n\n  async logTenantProvisioned(tenantId: string, actorId: string, planId: string | null, idempotent: boolean): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.TENANT_PROVISIONED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: tenantId,\n      referenceType: 'TENANT',\n      newState: { planId, idempotent },\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      metadata: { planId, idempotent },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logPlanChanged(tenantId: string, actorId: string, previousPlanId: string | null, newPlanId: string, changeType: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.TENANT_PLAN_CHANGED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: tenantId,\n      referenceType: 'TENANT_SUBSCRIPTION',\n      previousState: { planId: previousPlanId },\n      newState: { planId: newPlanId, changeType },\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      metadata: { previousPlanId, newPlanId, changeType },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logPlanChangeRejected(tenantId: string, actorId: string, requestedPlanId: string, reason: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.TENANT_PLAN_CHANGE_REJECTED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: requestedPlanId,\n      referenceType: 'SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN',\n      newState: { requestedPlanId },\n      result: 'REJECTED',\n      reason,\n      metadata: { requestedPlanId, reason },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logFeatureAccessChecked(tenantId: string, actorId: string, featureKey: string, allowed: boolean, source: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: allowed ? SaasAuditOperation.FEATURE_ACCESS_CHECKED : SaasAuditOperation.FEATURE_ACCESS_REJECTED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: featureKey,\n      referenceType: 'FEATURE',\n      newState: { featureKey, allowed, source },\n      result: allowed ? 'SUCCESS' : 'REJECTED',\n      reason: allowed ? undefined : `Feature ${featureKey} not allowed`,\n      metadata: { featureKey, allowed, source },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logBrandingUpdated(tenantId: string, actorId: string, previousState: Record<string, unknown>, newState: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.BRANDING_UPDATED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: tenantId,\n      referenceType: 'TENANT_BRANDING',\n      previousState,\n      newState,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logDomainRegistered(tenantId: string, actorId: string, domain: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.DOMAIN_REGISTERED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: domain,\n      referenceType: 'TENANT_DOMAIN',\n      newState: { domain },\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      metadata: { domain },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logDomainVerificationStarted(tenantId: string, actorId: string, domain: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_STARTED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: domain,\n      referenceType: 'TENANT_DOMAIN',\n      newState: { domain, verificationStarted: true },\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      metadata: { domain },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logDomainVerified(tenantId: string, actorId: string, domain: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.DOMAIN_VERIFIED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: domain,\n      referenceType: 'TENANT_DOMAIN',\n      newState: { domain, verified: true },\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      metadata: { domain },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logDomainVerificationFailed(tenantId: string, actorId: string, domain: string, reason: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: domain,\n      referenceType: 'TENANT_DOMAIN',\n      newState: { domain, verified: false },\n      result: 'FAILURE',\n      reason,\n      metadata: { domain, reason },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logDomainRemoved(tenantId: string, actorId: string, domain: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.DOMAIN_REMOVED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: domain,\n      referenceType: 'TENANT_DOMAIN',\n      previousState: { domain },\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      metadata: { domain },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logWhiteLabelRequested(tenantId: string, actorId: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.WHITE_LABEL_REQUESTED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: tenantId,\n      referenceType: 'WHITE_LABEL',\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logWhiteLabelEnabled(tenantId: string, actorId: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.WHITE_LABEL_ENABLED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: tenantId,\n      referenceType: 'WHITE_LABEL',\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n    });\n  }\n\n  async logWhiteLabelRejected(tenantId: string, actorId: string, reason: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.log({\n      tenantId,\n      operation: SaasAuditOperation.WHITE_LABEL_REJECTED,\n      actorId,\n      referenceId: tenantId,\n      referenceType: 'WHITE_LABEL',\n      result: 'REJECTED',\n      reason,\n      metadata: { reason },\n    });\n  }\n\n  private sanitize(data?: Record<string, unknown> | null): Record<string, unknown> | null {\n    if (!data) return null;\n    const forbidden = ['secret', 'apiKey', 'api_key', 'privateKey', 'private_key', 'accessToken', 'access_token', 'password', 'exchangeKey', 'exchangeSecret', 'providerSecret', 'stripeSecret', SaasCustomDomainState,\n  SaasWhiteLabelState,\n} from './saas-admin.types';\nimport { TenantLifecycleState, ProvisioningState, SaasAdminAction } from './saas-admin.types';\nimport { TenantStatus } from '@wlct/shared-types';\n\n/**\n * Main SaaS admin orchestration layer combining tenant, subscription, plan,\n * entitlement, branding, domain, billing services without duplicate state.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class SaasAdminService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(SaasAdminService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly plansService: PlansService,\n    private readonly subscriptionsService: SubscriptionsService,\n    private readonly featureAccessService: TenantFeatureAccessService,\n    private readonly brandingService: SaasTenantBrandingService,\n    private readonly domainService: CustomDomainService,\n    private readonly whiteLabelService: WhiteLabelProvisioningService,\n    private readonly billingCustomerService: BillingCustomerService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async listTenants(filter: SaasTenantListFilter): Promise<SaasTenantListResult> {\n    const page = filter.page || 1;\n    const limit = filter.limit || 20;\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n    const where: any = {};\n    if (!filter.includeDeleted) {\n      where.deletedAt = null;\n    }\n    if (filter.status) {\n      where.status = filter.status;\n    }\n    if (filter.search) {\n      where.OR = [\n        { name: { contains: filter.search, mode: 'insensitive' } },\n        { slug: { contains: filter.search.toLowerCase() } },\n        { contactEmail: { contains: filter.search, mode: 'insensitive' } },\n      ];\n    }\n\n    const [tenants, total] = await this.prisma.$transaction([\n      this.prisma.tenant.findMany({\n        where,\n        include: { branding: true, subscriptions: { include: { plan: true }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: 1 } },\n        orderBy: { [filter.sortBy || 'createdAt']: filter.sortOrder || 'desc' },\n        skip,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      this.prisma.tenant.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n\n    const items: SaasTenantSummary[] = await Promise.all(\n      tenants.map(async (tenant: any) => this.mapTenantToSummary(tenant)),\n    );\n\n    // Filter by planCode if requested\n    let filteredItems = items;\n    if (filter.planCode) {\n      filteredItems = items.filter((t) => t.subscriptionSummary?.planCode === filter.planCode);\n    }\n\n    return {\n      items: filteredItems,\n      total: filter.planCode ? filteredItems.length : total,\n      page,\n      limit,\n      totalPages: Math.ceil((filter.planCode ? filteredItems.length : total) / limit),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getTenantDetail(tenantId: string): Promise<SaasTenantDetail> {\n    const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({\n      where: { id: tenantId },\n      include: {\n        branding: true,\n        domains: true,\n        subscriptions: { include: { plan: true }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } },\n        featureFlags: true,\n      },\n    });\n\n    if (!tenant) {\n      throw new Error(`Tenant not found: ${tenantId}`);\n    }\n\n    const summary = await this.mapTenantToSummary(tenant);\n    const entitlements = await this.featureAccessService.getEffectiveFeatureAccess(tenantId);\n    const limits = await this.featureAccessService.getEffectiveLimits(tenantId);\n    const availableActions = this.determineAvailableActions(tenant, summary);\n\n    // Billing customer\n    let billingCustomer: SaasTenantDetail['billingCustomer'] = null;\n    try {\n      const customer = await this.billingCustomerService.getBillingCustomer(tenantId);\n      if (customer) {\n        billingCustomer = {\n          billingName: customer.billingName,\n          billingEmail: customer.billingEmail,\n          billingCountry: customer.billingCountry,\n          preferredCurrency: customer.preferredCurrency,\n        };\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const domains = (tenant.domains || []).map((d: any) => ({\n      id: d.id,\n      domain: d.domain,\n      isPrimary: d.isPrimary,\n      status: d.status,\n      verifiedAt: d.verifiedAt ? d.verifiedAt.toISOString() : null,\n      createdAt: d.createdAt.toISOString(),\n    }));\n\n    const featureFlags = (tenant.featureFlags || []).map((f: any) => ({\n      key: f.key,\n      enabled: f.enabled,\n      value: f.value,\n    }));\n\n    return {\n      ...summary,\n      entitlements,\n      limits,\n      availableActions,\n      billingCustomer,\n      domains,\n      featureFlags,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getTenantSummary(tenantId: string): Promise<SaasTenantSummary> {\n    const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({\n      where: { id: tenantId },\n      include: {\n        branding: true,\n        subscriptions: { include: { plan: true }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: 1 },\n      },\n    });\n\n    if (!tenant) {\n      throw new Error(`Tenant not found: ${tenantId}`);\n    }\n\n    return this.mapTenantToSummary(tenant);\n  }\n\n  private async mapTenantToSummary(tenant: any): Promise<SaasTenantSummary> {\n    const subscription = tenant.subscriptions?.[0] || null;\n\n    let subscriptionSummary: SaasSubscriptionSummary | null = null;\n    if (subscription) {\n      subscriptionSummary = {\n        id: subscription.id,\n        tenantId: tenant.id,\n        planId: subscription.planId,\n        planCode: subscription.plan?.code || null,\n        planName: subscription.plan?.name || null,\n        status: subscription.status,\n        interval: subscription.plan?.interval || null,\n        currentPeriodStart: subscription.currentPeriodStart?.toISOString() || null,\n        currentPeriodEnd: subscription.currentPeriodEnd?.toISOString() || null,\n        trialEndsAt: subscription.trialEndsAt?.toISOString() || null,\n        cancelAtPeriodEnd: subscription.cancelAtPeriodEnd || false,\n        isActive: ['ACTIVE', 'TRIALING'].includes(subscription.status),\n        isPastDue: subscription.status === 'PAST_DUE',\n        renewalDate: subscription.currentPeriodEnd?.toISOString() || null,\n        seatsPurchased: subscription.seatsPurchased || null,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Branding state\n    let brandingState: SaasBrandingState | null = null;\n    try {\n      brandingState = await this.brandingService.getBrandingState(tenant.id);\n    } catch {\n      brandingState = null;\n    }\n\n    // Domain state\n    let customDomainState: SaasCustomDomainState | null = null;\n    try {\n      customDomainState = await this.domainService.getDomainState(tenant.id);\n    } catch {\n      customDomainState = null;\n    }\n\n    // White-label state\n    let whiteLabelState: SaasWhiteLabelState | null = null;\n    try {\n      whiteLabelState = await this.whiteLabelService.getWhiteLabelState(tenant.id);\n    } catch {\n      whiteLabelState = null;\n    }\n\n    // Usage summary\n    let usageSummary: any = null;\n    try {\n      const usersCount = await this.prisma.user.count({ where: { tenantId: tenant.id, deletedAt: null } });\n      const tradersCount = await this.prisma.traderProfile.count({ where: { tenantId: tenant.id, deletedAt: null } });\n      usageSummary = {\n        tenantId: tenant.id,\n        maxUsers: tenant.maxUsers || (subscription?.plan?.limits as any)?.maxUsers || null,\n        currentUsers: usersCount,\n        maxTraders: tenant.maxTraders || (subscription?.plan?.limits as any)?.maxTraders || null,\n        currentTraders: tradersCount,\n        apiRequestsPerMinute: (subscription?.plan?.limits as any)?.maxApiRequestsPerMinute || null,\n        websocketConnections: (subscription?.plan?.limits as any)?.websocketConnections || null,\n      };\n    } catch {\n      usageSummary = null;\n    }\n\n    // Determine lifecycle and provisioning\n    const lifecycleState = this.mapTenantStatusToLifecycle(tenant.status, subscription?.status);\n    const provisioningState = this.determineProvisioningState(tenant, subscription);\n\n    return {\n      id: tenant.id,\n      slug: tenant.slug,\n      name: tenant.name,\n      legalName: tenant.legalName || null,\n      status: tenant.status as TenantStatus,\n      lifecycleState,\n      provisioningState,\n      contactEmail: tenant.contactEmail || null,\n      countryCode: tenant.countryCode || null,\n      defaultCurrency: tenant.defaultCurrency || 'USD',\n      createdAt: tenant.createdAt.toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: tenant.updatedAt.toISOString(),\n      subscriptionSummary,\n      brandingState,\n      customDomainState,\n      whiteLabelState,\n      usageSummary,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private mapTenantStatusToLifecycle(tenantStatus: string, subscriptionStatus: string | null): TenantLifecycleState {\n    switch (tenantStatus) {\n      case 'PENDING':\n        return TenantLifecycleState.PENDING;\n      case 'ACTIVE':\n        if (subscriptionStatus === 'PAST_DUE') return TenantLifecycleState.PAST_DUE;\n        if (subscriptionStatus === 'CANCELED') return TenantLifecycleState.CANCELED;\n        return TenantLifecycleState.ACTIVE;\n      case 'SUSPENDED':\n        return TenantLifecycleState.SUSPENDED;\n      case 'CANCELED':\n        return TenantLifecycleState.CANCELED;\n      default:\n        return TenantLifecycleState.ACTIVE;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private determineProvisioningState(tenant: any, subscription: any): ProvisioningState {\n {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(SaasTenantBrandingService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly existingBrandingService: ExistingBrandingService,\n    private readonly auditService: SaasAdminAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async getBrandingState(tenantId: string): Promise<SaasBrandingState> {\n    try {\n      const branding = await this.prisma.tenantBranding.findUnique({ where: { tenantId } });\n\n      if (!branding) {\n        // Return defaults if no branding yet\n        const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({ where: { id: tenantId }, select: { name: true } });\n        return {\n          tenantId,\n          appName: tenant?.name || 'App',\n          logoUrl: null,\n          logoDarkUrl: null,\n          faviconUrl: null,\n          primaryColor: '#1B2A4A',\n          secondaryColor: '#0F172A',\n          accentColor: '#22C55E',\n          backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',\n          textColor: '#0B1220',\n          fontFamily: 'Inter',\n          themeMode: 'system',\n          supportEmail: null,\n          supportUrl: null,\n          termsUrl: null,\n          privacyUrl: null,\n          hasCustomCss: false,\n          updatedAt: null,\n        };\n      }\n\n      return {\n        tenantId: branding.tenantId,\n        appName: branding.appName,\n branding.secondaryColor,\n        accentColor: branding.accentColor,\n        backgroundColor: branding.backgroundColor,\n        textColor: branding.textColor,\n        fontFamily: branding.fontFamily,\n        themeMode: branding.themeMode,\n        supportEmail: branding.supportEmail,\n        supportUrl: branding.supportUrl,\n        termsUrl: branding.termsUrl,\n        privacyUrl: branding.privacyUrl,\n        hasCustomCss: !!branding.customCss,\n        updatedAt: branding.updatedAt.toISOString(),\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to get branding for tenant ${tenantId}: ${error.message}`);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async updateBranding(\n    tenantId: string,\n    input: {\n      appName?: };\n\n    // Use existing branding service which already has sanitization\n    try {\n      // Ensure branding record exists\n      let branding = await this.prisma.tenantBranding.findUnique({ where: { tenantId } });\n      if (!branding) {\n        // Create default branding\n        const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({ where: { id: tenantId }, select: { name: true } });\n        branding = await this.prisma.tenantBranding.create({\n          data: {\n            tenantId,\n            appName: input.appName || tenant?.name || 'App',\n            logoUrl: input.logoUrl || to preserve sanitization logic\n        const updateDto: any = {};\n        if (input.appName !== undefined) updateDto.appName = input.appName;\n        if (input.logoUrl !== undefined) updateDto.logoUrl = input.logoUrl;\n        if (input.logoDarkUrl !== undefined) updateDto.logoDarkUrl = input.logoDarkUrl;\n        if (input.faviconUrl !== undefined) updateDto.faviconUrl = input.faviconUrl;\n        if (input.primaryColor !== undefined) updateDto.primaryColor = input.primaryColor;\n        if (input.secondaryColor !== undefined) updateDto.secondaryColor = input.secondaryColor;\n        if (input.accentColor !== undefined) updateDto.accentColor = input.accentColor;\n        if (input.backgroundColor !== undefined) updateDto.backgroundColor = input.backgroundColor;\n        if (input.textColor !== undefined) updateDto.textColor = input.textColor;\n        if (input.fontFamily !== undefined) updateDto.fontFamily = input.fontFamily;\n        if (input.themeMode !== undefined) updateDto.themeMode = input.themeMode;\n        if (input.supportEmail !== undefined) updateDto.supportEmail = input.supportEmail;\n        if (input.supportUrl !== undefined) updateDto.supportUrl = input.supportUrl;\n        if (input.termsUrl !== undefined) updateDto.termsUrl = input.termsUrl;\n        if (input.privacyUrl !== undefined) updateDto.privacyUrl = input.privacyUrl;\n        if (input.customCss !== undefined) updateDto.customCss = input.customCss;\n        if (input.socialLinks !== undefined) updateDto.socialLinks = input.socialLinks;\n\n        await this.existingBrandingService.update(tenantId, updateDto, {\n          actorId: context.actorId,\n          ipHash: context.ipHash,\n          requestId: context.requestId,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const newState = await this.getBrandingState(tenantId);\n\n      await this.auditService.logBrandingUpdated(tenantId, context.actorId, previousState as any, newState as any);\n\n      this.logger.log(`Branding updated for tenant ${tenantId} by ${context.actorId}`);\n\n      return newState;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to update branding for tenant ${tenantId}: ${error.message}`);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private validateBrandingInput(input: any): void {\n    // Validate hex colors\n    const hexColorRegex = /^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$/;\n    const colorFields = ['primaryColor', 'secondaryColor', 'accentColor', 'backgroundColor', 'textColor'];\n\n    for (const field of colorFields) {\n      if (input[field] !== undefined && input[field] !== null) {\n        if (!hexColorRegex.test(input[field])) {\n          throw new Error(`${field} must be a valid hex color`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Validate URLs\n    const urlFields = ['logoUrl', 'logoDarkUrl', 'faviconUrl', 'supportUrl', 'termsUrl', 'privacyUrl'];\n    for (const field of urlFields) {\n      if (input[field] !== undefined && input[field] !== null && input[field] !== '') {\n        try {\n          const url = new URL(input[field]);\n          if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(url.protocol)) Validate appName length\n    if (input.appName !== undefined && input.appName !== null) {\n      if (typeof input.appName !== 'string' || input.appName.length > 64 || input.appName.length < 1) {\n input.fontFamily !== 'string' || input.fontFamily.length > 64) {\n        throw new Error('fontFamily must be <= 64 characters');\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Validate themeMode\n    if (input.themeMode }\n\n    // Validate customCss length and block dangerous content\n    if (input.customCss !== undefined && input.customCss !== null) {\n      if (typeof input.customCss !== 'string' || attempts\n      const dangerous = ['<script', 'javascript:', 'vbscript:', 'expression(', 'behavior:', '-moz-binding'];\n      const lowerCss = input.customCss.toLowerCase();\n      for (const pattern of dangerous) {\n        if (lowerCss.includes(pattern)) {\n          throw new Error(`customCss contains forbidden pattern: ${pattern}`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Validate socialLinks - only URLs\n    if (input.socialLinks !== undefined && input.socialLinks !== null) {\n      if (typeof input.socialLinks !== 'object' || Array.isArray(input.socialLinks)) {\n        throw new Error(`socialLinks[${key}] must be a string`);\n        }\n        if (value) {\n          try {\n            new URL(value);\n          } catch {\n            throw new Error(`socialLinks[${key}] './saas-admin-audit.service';\nimport { BillingInterval } from '@wlct/shared-types';\nimport { BillingEventService } from '../notifications/billing-event.service';\n\n/**\n * Admin-driven plan string): Promise<any> {\n    const subscription = await this.subscriptionsService.getCurrent(tenantId);\n    if (!subscription) return null;\n    return subscription.plan;\n  }\n\n  async existing active subscription\n    const existing = await this.prisma.tenantSubscription.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, status: { in: ['TRIALING', 'ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE'] } },\n    });\n\n    if this.billingEventService.onSaasPlanChanged({\n        tenantId,\n        planName: plan.name,\n        planCode: plan.code,\n        supportEmail: process.env.SUPPORT_EMAIL || 'support@example.com',\n async changePlan(tenantId: string, requestedPlanId: string, options: { atPeriodEnd?: boolean; actorId: string; isPlatformUser: boolean; tenantId?: string | null; ipHash: string; requestId: string }): ...existingMetadata,\n            whiteLabel: {\n              ...(existingMetadata.whiteLabel || {}),\n              provisioningState: 'DISABLED',\n              disabledAt: new  id,\n      tenantId: data.tenantId,\n      meterKey: data.meterKey,\n      limitKey: data.limitKey,\n      periodId: data.periodId,\n      periodStart: data.periodStart.toISOString(),\n         status: record.status,\n          idempotencyKey: record.idempotencyKey,\n          calculationTimestamp: data.calculationTimestamp,\n          createdAt: new Date(record.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(record.updatedAt),\n          metadata: record.metadata,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (created) {\n        return this.mapToDomain(created);\n      }\n    } catch (error: (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        this.logger.warn(`overageRecord table not found, fallback: ${error.message}`);\n        try {\n          await resourceType: 'OverageRecord',\n              resourceId: id,\n              metadata: { ...record, fallback: true },\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n        } catch {}\n        return record;\n      }\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to create overage record: ${error.message}`, error.stack);\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    return record;\n  }\n\n  async findById(id: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<OverageRecord | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).overageRecord?.findFirst({\n      where: { id, ...(tenantId ? { tenantId } : {}) },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async findByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey: string, tenantId: string): Promise<OverageRecord | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).overageRecord?.findFirst({\n      where: { idempotencyKey, tenantId },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async findByTenantPeriodMeter(tenantId: string, periodId: string, meterKey: MeterKey): Promise<OverageRecord | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).overageRecord?.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, periodId, meterKey },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  async listByTenant(\n    tenantId: string,\n    filter?: {\n      meterKey?: MeterKey;\n      periodId?: string;\n      status?: OverageStatus;\n      fromDate?: Date;\n      toDate?: Date;\n      limit?: number;\n      offset?: number;\n    },\n  ): Promise<OverageRecord[]> {\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (filter?.meterKey) where.meterKey = filter.meterKey;\n    if (filter?.periodId) where.periodId = filter.periodId;\n    if (filter?.status) where.status = filter.status;\n    if (filter?.fromDate || filter?.toDate) {\n      where.periodStart = {};\n      if (filter.fromDate) where.periodStart.gte = filter.fromDate;\n      if (filter.toDate) where.periodStart.lte = filter.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).overageRecord?.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      take: filter?.limit || 100,\n      skip: filter?.offset || 0,\n    });\n\n    if (!results) return [];\n    return results.map((r: any) => this.mapToDomain(r));\n  }\n\n  async updateStatus(id: string, status: OverageStatus, metadata?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<OverageRecord | null> {\n    try {\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).overageRecord?.update({\n        where: { id },\n        data: {\n          status,\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n          ...(metadata ? { metadata } : {}),\n        },\n      });\n      if (!updated) return null;\n      return this.mapToDomain(updated);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private mapToDomain(raw: any): OverageRecord {\n    return {\n      id: raw.id,\n      tenantId: raw.tenantId,\n      meterKey: raw.meterKey as MeterKey,\n      limitKey: raw.limitKey,\n      periodId: raw.periodId,\n      periodStart: raw.periodStart ? new Date(raw.periodStart).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n      periodEnd: raw.periodEnd ? new Date(raw.periodEnd).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n      allowedQuantity: raw.allowedQuantity,\n      actualQuantity: raw.actualQuantity,\n      excessQuantity: raw.excessQuantity,\n      unit: raw.unit as MeterUnit,\n
