from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { OverageRepository } from './overage.repository';\nimport { OveragePolicy, OverageStatus, OverageCalculationInput, OverageCalculationResult } from './overage.types';\nimport { MeterKey, MeterUnit } from './usage-metering.types';\nimport { parseToMinorUnits, formatFromMinorUnits } from '../finance/money.types';\nimport { BillingEventService } from '../notifications/billing-event.service';\n\n/**\n * Calculates usage above configured limits ONLY when explicit overage policy exists.\n * Never invents rates, never charges automatically without policy.\n * If no policy, returns NOT_CONFIGURED deterministically.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class OverageService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(OverageService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly overageRepository: OverageRepository,\n    @Optional()\n    @Inject(forwardRef(() => BillingEventService))\n    private readonly billingEventService?: BillingEventService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async calculateOverage(input: OverageCalculationInput): Promise<OverageCalculationResult> {\n    const excessQuantity = Math.max(0, input.actualQuantity - input.allowedQuantity);\n    const isOverage = excessQuantity > 0;\n\n    const idempotencyKey = input.idempotencyKey || `overage_${input.tenantId}_${input.meterKey}_${input.periodId}`;\n\n    // Check existing\n    const existing = await this.overageRepository.findByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey, input.tenantId);\n    if (existing) {\n      this.logger.log(`Idempotent overage return by key: ${idempotencyKey}`);\n      return this.mapRecordToResult(existing, isOverage);\n    }\n\n    if (!isOverage) {\n      // No overage\n      const result: OverageCalculationResult = {\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        meterKey: input.meterKey,\n        limitKey: input.limitKey,\n        periodId: input.periodId,\n        allowedQuantity: input.allowedQuantity,\n        actualQuantity: input.actualQuantity,\n        excessQuantity: 0,\n        unit: input.unit,\n        policyReference: input.policy?.policyReference || null,\n        rateReference: null,\n        rateBps: null,\n        estimatedAmount: null,\n        currency: null,\n        status: OverageStatus.DETECTED,\n        calculatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        isOverage: false,\n        isBillable: false,\n        requiresReview: false,\n        notConfigured: false,\n      };\n      return result;\n    }\n\n    // Overage detected, check policy\n    if (!input.policy) {\n      this.logger.log(`Overage detected but no policy configured tenant=${input.tenantId} meter=${input.meterKey} excess=${excessQuantity}`);\n\n      // Persist NOT_CONFIGURED record for audit\n      const notConfiguredRecord = await this.overageRepository.create({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        meterKey: input.meterKey,\n        limitKey: input.limitKey,\n        periodId: input.periodId,\n        periodStart: new Date(input.periodStart),\n        periodEnd: new Date(input.periodEnd),\n        allowedQuantity: input.allowedQuantity,\n        actualQuantity: input.actualQuantity,\n        excessQuantity,\n        unit: input.unit,\n        policyReference: null,\n        rateReference: null,\n        rateBps: null,\n        estimatedAmount: null,\n        currency: null,\n        status: OverageStatus.NOT_CONFIGURED,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        calculationTimestamp: new Date(),\n        metadata: input.metadata,\n      });\n\n      return {\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        meterKey: input.meterKey,\n        limitKey: input.limitKey,\n        periodId: input.periodId,\n        allowedQuantity: input.allowedQuantity,\n        actualQuantity: input.actualQuantity,\n        excessQuantity,\n        unit: input.unit,\n        policyReference: null,\n        rateReference: null,\n        rateBps: null,\n        estimatedAmount: null,\n        currency: null,\n        status: OverageStatus.NOT_CONFIGURED,\n        calculatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        isOverage: true,\n        isBillable: false,\n        requiresReview: false,\n        notConfigured: true,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Policy exists - calculate estimated amount with Decimal-safe arithmetic if rate exists\n    let estimatedAmount: string | null = null;\n    let rateReference: string | null = null;\n    let rateBps: number | null = null;\n    const currency: string | null = input.policy.currency || null;\n    let status: OverageStatus = OverageStatus.DETECTED;\n\n    if (input.policy.overageRateBps && input.policy.overageRateBps > 0) {\n      // If policy has BPS rate, calculate amount: excess * rate? But overage for count meters typically per-unit price\n      // For count overage, if rateBps is present, we interpret as per-unit price in minor units? No, we need explicit ratePerUnit\n      // For this implementation, if overageRateBps exists, we do NOT invent dollar price - we store rate reference\n      // Estimated amount calculation only if overageRatePerUnit exists\n      rateBps = input.policy.overageRateBps;\n      rateReference = `BPS:${rateBps}`;\n      status = OverageStatus.CALCULATED;\n\n      if (input.policy.overageRatePerUnit) {\n        try {\n          // Decimal-safe: estimated = excess * ratePerUnit\n          const rateMinor = parseToMinorUnits(input.policy.overageRatePerUnit, currency || 'USD');\n          const estimatedMinor = rateMinor * excessQuantity;\n          estimatedAmount = formatFromMinorUnits(estimatedMinor, currency || 'USD');\n          rateReference = input.policy.overageRatePerUnit;\n        } catch (e) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Failed to calculate overage amount: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n        }\n      }\n    } else if (input.policy.overageRatePerUnit) {\n      // Per-unit rate\n      try {\n        const rateMinor = parseToMinorUnits(input.policy.overageRatePerUnit, currency || 'USD');\n        const estimatedMinor = rateMinor * excessQuantity;\n        estimatedAmount = formatFromMinorUnits(estimatedMinor, currency || 'USD');\n        rateReference = input.policy.overageRatePerUnit;\n        status = OverageStatus.CALCULATED;\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to calculate overage amount: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (input.policy.isBillable) {\n      status = input.policy.requiresReview ? OverageStatus.REVIEW_REQUIRED : OverageStatus.BILLABLE;\n    } else {\n      status = OverageStatus.DETECTED;\n    }\n\n    // If no rate at all, status is DETECTED but not billable\n    if (!input.policy.overageRateBps && !input.policy.overageRatePerUnit) {\n      status = OverageStatus.DETECTED;\n    }\n\n    const record = await this.overageRepository.create({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      meterKey: input.meterKey,\n      limitKey: input.limitKey,\n      periodId: input.periodId,\n      periodStart: new Date(input.periodStart),\n      periodEnd: new Date(input.periodEnd),\n      allowedQuantity: input.allowedQuantity,\n      actualQuantity: input.actualQuantity,\n      excessQuantity,\n      unit: input.unit,\n      policyReference: input.policy.policyReference,\n      rateReference,\n      rateBps,\n      estimatedAmount,\n      currency,\n      status,\n      idempotencyKey,\n      calculationTimestamp: new Date(),\n      metadata: input.metadata,\n    });\n\n    const result: OverageCalculationResult = {\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      meterKey: input.meterKey,\n      limitKey: input.limitKey,\n      periodId: input.periodId,\n      allowedQuantity: input.allowedQuantity,\n      actualQuantity: input.actualQuantity,\n      excessQuantity,\n      unit: input.unit,\n      policyReference: input.policy.policyReference,\n      rateReference,\n      rateBps,\n      estimatedAmount,\n      currency,\n      status,\n      calculatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      isOverage: true,\n      isBillable: input.policy.isBillable,\n      requiresReview: input.policy.requiresReview,\n      notConfigured: false,\n    };\n\n    this.logger.log(\n      `Overage calculated tenant=${input.tenantId} meter=${input.meterKey} allowed=${input.allowedQuantity} actual=${input.actualQuantity} excess=${excessQuantity} status=${status} estimated=${estimatedAmount || 'N/A'}`,\n    );\n\n    if (isOverage && this.billingEventService) {\n      this.billingEventService.onUsageOverageDetected({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        meterKey: input.meterKey,\n        limitKey: input.limitKey,\n        currentUsage: input.actualQuantity,\n        maxLimit: input.allowedQuantity,\n        overageQuantity: excessQuantity,\n        supportEmail: process.env.SUPPORT_EMAIL || 'support@example.com',\n        appName: process.env.APP_NAME || 'WLCT',\n      }).catch((e) => this.logger.warn(`Failed to trigger overage notification: ${e.message}`));\n    }\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  async resolveOveragePolicy(tenantId: string, meterKey: MeterKey, limitKey: string): Promise<OveragePolicy | null> {\n    // In real implementation, would check tenant-specific overage policy config or global policy\n    // For now, check env or tenant metadata for explicit policy\n    // Never invent default dollar price\n\n    // Check if overage policy is configured via env: OVERAGE_POLICY_{METER_KEY}\n    // Example: OVERAGE_POLICY_USERS_RATE_PER_UNIT=1.00\n    // This is explicit configurable policy, not hardcoded commercial rate\n\n    const envKey = `OVERAGE_POLICY_${meterKey}_RATE_PER_UNIT`;\n    const envRate = process.env[envKey];\n    const envCurrency = process.env[`OVERAGE_POLICY_${meterKey}_CURRENCY`] || 'USD';\n    const envBillable = process.env[`OVERAGE_POLICY_${meterKey}_BILLABLE`] === 'true';\n\n    if (envRate) {\n      return {\n        meterKey,\n        tenantId,\n        limitKey,\n        allowedQuantity: 0, // Will be overridden by actual limit\n        overageRatePerUnit: envRate,\n        currency: envCurrency,\n        unit: this.getUnitForMeter(meterKey),\n        policyReference: `env:${envKey}`,\n        isBillable: envBillable,\n        requiresReview: true,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // No policy configured - return null to trigger NOT_CONFIGURED\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async detectOverage(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    meterKey: MeterKey;\n    limitKey: string;\n    periodId: string;\n    periodStart: string;\n    periodEnd: string;\n    allowedQuantity: number;\n    actualQuantity: number;\n    unit: MeterUnit;\n    idempotencyKey?: string;\n  }): Promise<OverageCalculationResult> {\n    const policy = await this.resolveOveragePolicy(params.tenantId, params.meterKey, params.limitKey);\n\n    return this.calculateOverage({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      meterKey: params.meterKey,\n      limitKey: params.limitKey,\n      periodId: params.periodId,\n      periodStart: params.periodStart,\n      periodEnd: params.periodEnd,\n      allowedQuantity: params.allowedQuantity,\n      actualQuantity: params.actualQuantity,\n      unit: params.unit,\n      policy,\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async listOverages(\n    tenantId: string,\n    filter?: { meterKey?: MeterKey; periodId?: string; status?: OverageStatus; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date; limit?: number; offset?: number },\n  ): Promise<any[]> {\n    return this.overageRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, filter);\n  }\n\n  private mapRecordToResult(record: any, isOverage: boolean): OverageCalculationResult {\n    return {\n      tenantId: record.tenantId,\n      meterKey: record.meterKey,\n      limitKey: record.limitKey,\n      periodId: record.periodId,\n      allowedQuantity: record.allowedQuantity,\n      actualQuantity: record.actualQuantity,\n      excessQuantity: record.excessQuantity,\n      unit: record.unit,\n '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { PlansService } from '../plans.service';\nimport { SubscriptionsService } from QuotaSnapshot, ENFORCED_METER_TO_LIMIT_KEY } from './usage-metering.types';\n\n/**\n * Produces authoritative quota snapshots by combining canonical plan limits with metered usage.\n * Do NOT duplicate limit values - always resolve from plan.\n * Aligns with Part 2 enforcement limit keys.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class QuotaSnapshotService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(QuotaSnapshotService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly plansService: PlansService,\n    private readonly subscriptionsService: SubscriptionsService,\n    private readonly meterRepository: UsageMeterRepository,\n    private readonly periodService: UsagePeriodService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async getQuotaSnapshot(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    meterKey: MeterKey;\n    scope: UsageScope;\n    subjectId?: string;\n    periodId?: string;\n  }): Promise<QuotaSnapshot> {\n    const meterDef = this.meterRepository.getMeterDefinition(params.meterKey);\n    if (!meterDef) {\n      throw new Error(`Invalid meter key: ${params.meterKey}`);\n    }\n\n    const limitKey = ENFORCED_METER_TO_LIMIT_KEY[params.meterKey];\n    let maximum: number | null = null;\n    let planCode: string | null = null;\n    const isEnforced = meterDef.isEnforced;\n\n    // Resolve canonical plan limits if enforced meter\n    if (limitKey) {\n      try {\n        const subscription = await this.subscriptionsService.getCurrent(params.tenantId);\n        if (subscription) {\n          const plan = subscription.plan as any;\n          if (plan) {\n            planCode = plan.code || null;\n            const limits = plan.limits as any;\n            if (limits && limits[limitKey] !== undefined) {\n              maximum = limits[limitKey];\n              // Boolean limits mean unlimited or feature toggle, not numeric\n              if (typeof maximum === 'boolean') {\n                maximum = null;\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to resolve plan limits for ${params.tenantId} limitKey=${limitKey}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      }\n\n      // Also check tenant overrides (maxUsers, maxTraders) from tenant table\n      if (limitKey === 'maxUsers' || limitKey === 'maxTraders') {\n        try {\n          const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({\n            where: { id: params.tenantId },\n            select: { maxUsers: true, maxTraders: true },\n          });\n          if (tenant) {\n            if (limitKey === 'maxUsers' && tenant.maxUsers !== null) {\n              maximum = tenant.maxUsers;\n            }\n            if (limitKey === 'maxTraders' && tenant.maxTraders !== null) {\n              maximum = tenant.maxTraders;\n            }\n          }\n        } catch {}\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Get current usage from durable metering\n    let current = 0;\n    let periodId = params.periodId;\n    let periodStart: string;\n    let periodEnd: string;\n\n    if (!periodId) {\n      const period = this.periodService.getCurrentCalendarMonthPeriod(params.tenantId);\n      periodId = period.id;\n      periodStart = period.start;\n      periodEnd = period.end;\n    } else {\n      // Try to parse periodId to get start/end, fallback to current month\n      const period = this.periodService.getCurrentCalendarMonthPeriod(params.tenantId);\n      periodStart = period.start;\n      periodEnd = period.end;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const total = await this.meterRepository.getCurrentPeriodTotal({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        meterKey: params.meterKey,\n        scope: params.scope,\n        subjectId: params.subjectId,\n        periodId,\n      });\n      current = total.totalQuantity;\n\n      // For count-based meters that are not period-based (users, traders), get actual DB counts\n      // to ensure quota snapshot matches canonical truth, not just metered events\n      if ([MeterKey.USERS, MeterKey.TRADERS].includes(params.meterKey) && params.scope === UsageScope.TENANT) {\n        // Use actual counts from DB for these meters to align with enforcement\n        try {\n          if (params.meterKey === MeterKey.USERS) {\n            current = await this.prisma.user.count({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, deletedAt: null } });\n          } else if (params.meterKey === MeterKey.TRADERS) {\n            current = await (this.prisma as any).tradingAccount?.count({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, deletedAt: null } }) || current;\n          }\n        } catch {}\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to get current usage for ${params.tenantId} meter=${params.meterKey}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // Calculate remaining and utilization\n    let remaining: number | null = null;\n    let utilizationPercent: number | null = null;\n    let status: QuotaSnapshot['status'] = 'OK';\n\n    if (maximum === null) {\n      remaining = null;\n      utilizationPercent = null;\n      status = 'UNLIMITED';\n    } else {\n      remaining = Math.max(0, maximum - current);\n      utilizationPercent = maximum > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((current / maximum) * 100)) : current > 0 ? 100 : 0;\n\n      if (current >= maximum) {\n        status = current > maximum ? 'OVER_LIMIT' : 'AT_LIMIT';\n      } else if (utilizationPercent >= 90) {\n        status = 'APPROACHING';\n      } else {\n        status = 'OK';\n      }\n    }\n\n    const period = this.periodService.getCurrentCalendarMonthPeriod(params.tenantId);\n    if (!periodId) periodId = period.id;\n    if (!periodStart!) periodStart = period.start;\n    if (!periodEnd!) periodEnd = period.end;\n\n    const snapshot: QuotaSnapshot = {\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      meterKey: params.meterKey,\n      limitKey: limitKey || params.meterKey,\n      scope: params.scope,\n      subjectId: params.subjectId,\n      maximum,\n      current,\n      remaining,\n      utilizationPercent,\n      status,\n      periodId,\n      periodStart,\n      periodEnd,\n      fetchedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      planCode,\n      isEnforced,\n    };\n\n    this.logger.log(`Quota snapshot tenant=${params.tenantId} meter=${params.meterKey} current=${current} max=${maximum} remaining=${remaining} util=${utilizationPercent}% status=${status}`);\n\n    return snapshot;\n  }\n\n  async getTenantQuotaOverview(tenantId: string, periodId?: string): Promise<QuotaSnapshot[]> {\n    const snapshots: QuotaSnapshot[] = [];\n\n    // Get snapshots for all enforced meters\n    const enforcedMeters = [MeterKey.USERS, MeterKey.TRADERS, MeterKey.FOLLOWERS, MeterKey.EXCHANGE_ACCOUNTS, MeterKey.COPY_SUBSCRIPTIONS, MeterKey.API_REQUESTS, MeterKey.WEBSOCKET_CONNECTIONS];\n\n    for (const meterKey of enforcedMeters) {\n      try {\n        const meterDef = this.meterRepository.getMeterDefinition(meterKey);\n        if (!meterDef) continue;\n\n        // For per-trader/per-user scoped meters, we need to get tenant-level overview\n        // For simplicity, get tenant scope snapshot\n        const scope = meterKey === MeterKey.FOLLOWERS ? UsageScope.TENANT : meterKey === MeterKey.EXCHANGE_ACCOUNTS ? UsageScope.TENANT : meterKey === MeterKey.COPY_SUBSCRIPTIONS ? UsageScope.TENANT : UsageScope.TENANT;\n\n        const snapshot = await this.getQuotaSnapshot({\n          tenantId,\n          meterKey,\n          scope,\n          periodId,\n        });\n\n        snapshots.push(snapshot);\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to get quota snapshot for ${meterKey}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Also include informational meters\n    const infoMeters = [MeterKey.TRADING_VOLUME, MeterKey.COPY_TRADING_VOLUME, MeterKey.ORDERS, MeterKey.FILLS];\n    for (const meterKey of infoMeters) {\n      try {\n        const snapshot = await this.getQuotaSnapshot({\n          tenantId,\n          meterKey,\n          scope: UsageScope.TENANT,\n          periodId,\n        });\n        snapshots.push(snapshot);\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    return snapshots;\n  }\n\n  async getResourceQuotaSnapshot(params: { tenantId: string; scope: UsageScope; subjectId: string; meterKey: MeterKey; periodId?: string }): Promise<QuotaSnapshot> {\n    return this.getQuotaSnapshot({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      meterKey: params.meterKey,\n      scope: params.scope,\n      subjectId: params.subjectId,\n      periodId: params.periodId,\n    });\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/usage/usage-aggregation.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. No double counting, timezone-safe, source-event traceability.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class UsageAggregationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(UsageAggregationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly eventRepository: UsageEventRepository,\n    private readonly meterRepository: UsageMeterRepository,\n    private readonly periodService: UsagePeriodService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async aggregateHourly(tenantId: string, date: Date, meterKey?: MeterKey): Promise<UsageBucket[]> {\n    return this.aggregateForWindow(tenantId, date, AggregationWindow.HOURLY, PeriodType.CALENDAR_HOUR, meterKey);\n  }\n\n  async aggregateDaily(tenantId: string, date: Date, meterKey?: MeterKey): Promise<UsageBucket[]> {\n    return this.aggregateForWindow(tenantId, date, AggregationWindow.DAILY, PeriodType.CALENDAR_DAY, meterKey);\n  }\n\n  async aggregateMonthly(tenantId: string, date: Date, meterKey?: MeterKey): Promise<UsageBucket[]> {\n    return this.aggregateForWindow(tenantId, date, AggregationWindow.MONTHLY, PeriodType.CALENDAR_MONTH, meterKey);\n  }\n\n  async aggregateBillingPeriod(tenantId: string, meterKey?: MeterKey): Promise<UsageBucket[]> {\n    const period = await this.periodService.getSubscriptionPeriod(tenantId);\n    const start = new Date(period.start);\n    const end = new Date(period.end);\n\n    const events = await this.eventRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, {\n      meterKey,\n      fromDate: start,\n      toDate: end,\n      limit: 10000,\n    });\n\n    return this.buildBucketsFromEvents(tenantId, events, AggregationWindow.BILLING_PERIOD, period.id, start, end);\n  }\n\n  async rebuildAggregatesForPeriod(tenantId: string, periodId: string, meterKey?: MeterKey): Promise<UsageBucket[]> {\n    // Idempotent rebuild: re-aggregate from durable events\n    const events = await this.eventRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, {\n      meterKey,\n      periodId,\n      limit: 10000,\n    });\n\n    if (events.length === 0) {\n      this.logger.log(`No events to rebuild for tenant=${tenantId} period=${periodId}`);\n      return [];\n    }\n\n    const firstEvent = events[0];\n    const periodStart = new Date(firstEvent.periodStart);\n    const periodEnd = new Date(firstEvent.periodEnd);\n\n    // Determine window from period type\n    let window: AggregationWindow = AggregationWindow.MONTHLY;\n    if (firstEvent.periodType === PeriodType.CALENDAR_DAY) window = AggregationWindow.DAILY;\n    if (firstEvent.periodType === PeriodType.CALENDAR_HOUR) window = AggregationWindow.HOURLY;\n    if (firstEvent.periodType === PeriodType.SUBSCRIPTION_PERIOD) window = AggregationWindow.BILLING_PERIOD;\n\n    const buckets = await this.buildBucketsFromEvents(tenantId, events, window, periodId, periodStart, periodEnd);\n\n    this.logger.log(`Rebuilt aggregates tenant=${tenantId} period=${periodId} buckets=${buckets.length} events=${events.length}`);\n\n    return buckets;\n  }\n\n  async getAggregatedUsage(\n    tenantId: string,\n    filter: {\n      meterKey?: MeterKey;\n      scope?: UsageScope;\n      subjectId?: string;\n      window: AggregationWindow;\n      fromDate?: Date;\n      toDate?: Date;\n      limit?: number;\n    },\n  ): Promise<UsageBucket[]> {\n    try {\n      // Get buckets from repository\n      const where: any = { tenantId, window: filter.window };\n      if (filter.meterKey) where.meterKey = filter.meterKey;\n      if (filter.scope) where.scope = filter.scope;\n      if (filter.subjectId) where.subjectId = filter.subjectId;\n      if (filter.fromDate || filter.toDate) {\n        where.periodStart = {};\n        if (filter.fromDate) where.periodStart.gte = filter.fromDate;\n        if (filter.toDate) where.periodStart.lte = filter.toDate;\n      }\n\n      // Use meter repository's getTenantTotals or direct query\n      // For simplicity, fetch via event repository aggregation if bucket table missing\n      const buckets = await this.meterRepository.getPeriodTotals(tenantId, filter.fromDate ? `cal_${filter.fromDate.toISOString()}` : 'current', filter.meterKey);\n\n      if (buckets.length > 0) {\n        return buckets.filter((b) => {\n          if (filter.window && b.window !== filter.window) return false;\n          if (filter.scope && b.scope !== filter.scope) return false;\n          if (filter.subjectId && b.subjectId !== filter.subjectId) return false;\n          return true;\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Fallback: build from events\n      const events = await this.eventRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, {\n        meterKey: filter.meterKey,\n        scope: filter.scope,\n        subjectId: filter.subjectId,\n        fromDate: filter.fromDate,\n        toDate: filter.toDate,\n        limit: filter.limit || 1000,\n      });\n\n      if (events.length === 0) return [];\n\n      const periodStart = filter.fromDate || new Date(events[events.length - 1].timestamp);\n      const periodEnd = filter.toDate || new Date();\n\n      return this.buildBucketsFromEvents(tenantId, events, filter.window, `agg_${Date.now()}`, periodStart, periodEnd);\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to get aggregated usage: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async aggregateForWindow(\n    tenantId: string,\n    date: Date,\n    window: AggregationWindow,\n    periodType: PeriodType,\n    meterKey?: MeterKey,\n  ): Promise<UsageBucket[]> {\n    const period = this.periodService.getPeriodForTimestamp(tenantId, date, periodType);\n    const start = new Date(period.start);\n    const end = new Date(period.end);\n\n    const events = await this.eventRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, {\n      meterKey,\n      fromDate: start,\n      toDate: end,\n      limit: 10000,\n    });\n\n    return this.buildBucketsFromEvents(tenantId, events, window, period.id, start, end);\n  }\n\n  private async buildBucketsFromEvents(\n    tenantId: string,\n    events: any[],\n    window: AggregationWindow,\n    periodId: string,\n    periodStart: Date,\n    periodEnd: Date,\n  ): Promise<UsageBucket[]> {\n    // Deterministic aggregation: group by meterKey + scope + subjectId\n    const grouped = new Map<string, { meterKey: MeterKey; scope: UsageScope; subjectId?: string; unit: any; totalQuantity: number; eventCount: number; lastEventAt: string }>();\n\n    for (const event of events) {\n      const key = `${event.meterKey}_${event.scope}_${event.subjectId || 'global'}_${event.unit}`;\n      const existing = grouped.get(key);\n      if (existing) {\n        existing.totalQuantity += event.quantity;\n        existing.eventCount += 1;\n        if (new Date(event.timestamp) > new Date(existing.lastEventAt)) {\n          existing.lastEventAt = event.timestamp;\n        }\n      } else {\n        grouped.set(key, {\n          meterKey: event.meterKey,\n          scope: event.scope,\n          subjectId: event.subjectId,\n          unit: event.unit,\n          totalQuantity: event.quantity,\n          eventCount: 1,\n          lastEventAt: event.timestamp,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const buckets: UsageBucket[] = [];\n    for (const [groupKey, data] of grouped) {\n      buckets.push({\n        id: randomUUID(),\n        tenantId,\n        meterKey: data.meterKey,\n        scope: data.scope,\n        subjectId: data.subjectId,\n        window,\n        periodId,\n        periodStart: periodStart.toISOString(),\n        periodEnd: periodEnd.toISOString(),\n        totalQuantity: data.totalQuantity,\n        eventCount: data.eventCount,\n        unit: data.unit,\n        lastEventAt: data.lastEventAt,\n        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Sort deterministically by meterKey + scope\n    buckets.sort((a, b) => {\n      if (a.meterKey !== b.meterKey) return a.meterKey.localeCompare(b.meterKey);\n      if (a.scope !== b.scope) return a.scope.localeCompare(b.scope);\n      return (a.subjectId || '').localeCompare(b.subjectId || '');\n    });\n\n    return buckets;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/usage/usage-alert.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected Does NOT reject operations - alerting layer only.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class UsageAlertService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(UsageAlertService.name);\n\n  // Default thresholds for informational alerting (not commercial policy)\n  private readonly DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS = [\n    { percentage: 50, severity: AlertSeverity.INFO },\n    { percentage: 75, severity: AlertSeverity.WARNING },\n    { percentage: 90, severity: AlertSeverity.WARNING },\n    { percentage: 100, severity: AlertSeverity.CRITICAL },\n  ];\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    @Optional()\n    @Inject(forwardRef(() => BillingEventService))\n    private readonly billingEventService?: BillingEventService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async evaluateAndAlert(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    meterKey: MeterKey;\n    limitKey: string;\n    currentValue: number;\n    maximumValue: number | null;\n    utilizationPercent: number | null;\n    periodId: string;\n  }): Promise<UsageAlertEvent[]> {\n    if (params.maximumValue === null) {\n      // Unlimited - no alerts needed\n      return [];\n    }\n\n    const configs = await this.getAlertConfigs(params.tenantId, params.meterKey, params.limitKey);\n\n    const triggeredEvents: UsageAlertEvent[] = [];\n\n    for (const config of configs) {\n      if (!config.enabled) continue;\n\n      // Cooldown check\n      if (config.lastTriggeredAt) {\n        const lastTriggered = new Date(config.lastTriggeredAt);\n        const cooldownMs = config.cooldownMinutes * 60 * 1000;\n        const nextAllowed = new Date(lastTriggered.getTime() + cooldownMs);\n        if (new Date() < nextAllowed) {\n          this.logger.log(`Alert cooldown active for config ${config.id} tenant=${params.tenantId} meter=${params.meterKey} until ${nextAllowed.toISOString()}`);\n          continue;\n        }\n      }\n\n      let shouldTrigger = false;\n\n      if (config.thresholdType === AlertThresholdType.PERCENTAGE) {\n        if (params.utilizationPercent !== null && params.utilizationPercent >= config.thresholdValue) {\n          shouldTrigger = true;\n        }\n      } else if (config.thresholdType === AlertThresholdType.ABSOLUTE) {\n        if (params.currentValue >= config.thresholdValue) {\n          shouldTrigger = true;\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (shouldTrigger) {\n        const idempotencyKey = `alert_${params.tenantId}_${config.id}_${params.periodId}_${config.thresholdValue}`;\n\n        // Deduplication check\n        const existing = await this.findEventByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey, params.tenantId);\n        if (existing) {\n          this.logger.log(`Duplicate alert suppressed by idempotencyKey: ${idempotencyKey}`);\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        const event = await this.createAlertEvent({\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          configId: config.id,\n          meterKey: params.meterKey,\n          limitKey: params.limitKey,\n          thresholdType: config.thresholdType,\n          thresholdValue: config.thresholdValue,\n          currentValue: params.currentValue,\n          maximumValue: params.maximumValue,\n          utilizationPercent: params.utilizationPercent,\n          severity: config.severity,\n          periodId: params.periodId,\n          idempotencyKey,\n          safeMetadata: {\n            meterKey: params.meterKey,\n            limitKey: params.limitKey,\n            currentValue: params.currentValue,\n            maximumValue: params.maximumValue,\n          },\n        });\n\n        triggeredEvents.push(event);\n\n        // Update last triggered\n        await this.updateConfigLastTriggered(config.id);\n\n        // Trigger billing notification for usage threshold\n        if (this.billingEventService) {\n          this.billingEventService.onUsageThresholdReached({\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            meterKey: params.meterKey,\n            limitKey: params.limitKey,\n            usagePercentage: params.utilizationPercent || config.thresholdValue,\n            currentUsage: params.currentValue,\n            maxLimit: params.maximumValue,\n            supportEmail: process.env.SUPPORT_EMAIL || 'support@example.com',\n            appName: process.env.APP_NAME || 'WLCT',\n          }).catch((e) => this.logger.warn(`Failed to trigger usage threshold notification: ${e.message}`));\n        }\n\n        this.logger.log(\n          `Usage alert triggered tenant=${params.tenantId} meter=${params.meterKey} threshold=${config.thresholdValue}${config.thresholdType === AlertThresholdType.PERCENTAGE ? '%' : ''} current=${params.currentValue} max=${params.maximumValue} severity=${config.severity}`,\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    return triggeredEvents;\n  }\n\n  async getAlertConfigs(tenantId: string, meterKey?: MeterKey, limitKey?: string): Promise<UsageAlertConfig[]> {\n    try {\n      const where: any = { tenantId };\n      if (meterKey) where.meterKey = meterKey;\n      if (limitKey) where.limitKey = limitKey;\n\n      const results = await (this.prisma as any).usageAlertConfig?.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { thresholdValue: 'asc' },\n      });\n\n      if (results && results.length > 0) {\n        return results.map((r: any) => this.mapConfigToDomain(r));\n      }\n\n      // Fallback: return default thresholds as configs if none configured\n      if (meterKey && limitKey) {\n        return this.DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS.map((t) => ({\n          id: `default_${tenantId}_${meterKey}_${t.percentage}`,\n          tenantId,\n          meterKey: meterKey!,\n          limitKey: limitKey!,\n          thresholdType: AlertThresholdType.PERCENTAGE,\n          thresholdValue: t.percentage,\n          severity: t.severity,\n          enabled: true,\n          cooldownMinutes: 60,\n          lastTriggeredAt: null,\n          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          metadata: { default: true },\n        }));\n      }\n\n      return [];\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        // Return defaults if table missing\n        if (meterKey && limitKey) {\n          return this.DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS.map((t) => ({\n            id: `default_${tenantId}_${meterKey}_${t.percentage}`,\n            tenantId,\n            meterKey: meterKey!,\n            limitKey: limitKey!,\n            thresholdType: AlertThresholdType.PERCENTAGE,\n            thresholdValue: t.percentage,\n            severity: t.severity,\n            enabled: true,\n            cooldownMinutes: 60,\n            lastTriggeredAt: null,\n            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            metadata: { default: true },\n          }));\n        }\n        return [];\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async createAlertConfig(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    meterKey: MeterKey;\n    limitKey: string;\n    thresholdType: AlertThresholdType;\n    thresholdValue: number;\n    severity: AlertSeverity;\n    enabled?: boolean;\n    cooldownMinutes?: number;\n  }): Promise<UsageAlertConfig> {\n    // Validate threshold range\n    if (params.thresholdType === AlertThresholdType.PERCENTAGE) {\n      if (params.thresholdValue < 1 || params.thresholdValue > 200) {\n        throw new Error('Percentage threshold must be 1-200');\n      }\n    } else {\n      if (params.thresholdValue < 1) {\n        throw new Error('Absolute threshold must be >=1');\n      }\n    }\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    const config: UsageAlertConfig = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      meterKey: params.meterKey,\n      limitKey: params.limitKey,\n      thresholdType: params.thresholdType,\n      thresholdValue: params.thresholdValue,\n      severity: params.severity,\n      enabled: params.enabled ?? true,\n      cooldownMinutes: params.cooldownMinutes ?? 60,\n      lastTriggeredAt: null,\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n      metadata: null,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).usageAlertConfig?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: config.id,\n          tenantId: config.tenantId,\n          meterKey: config.meterKey,\n          limitKey: config.limitKey,\n          thresholdType: config.thresholdType,\n          thresholdValue: config.thresholdValue,\n          severity: config.severity,\n          enabled: config.enabled,\n          cooldownMinutes: config.cooldownMinutes,\n          lastTriggeredAt: null,\n          createdAt: new Date(config.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(config.updatedAt),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (created) return this.mapConfigToDomain(created);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        this.logger.warn(`usageAlertConfig table not found, fallback: ${error.message}`);\n        return config;\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    return config;\n  }\n\n  async updateAlertConfig(\n    id: string,\n    tenantId: string,\n    updates: { enabled?: boolean; thresholdValue?: number; severity?: AlertSeverity; cooldownMinutes?: number },\n  ): Promise<UsageAlertConfig | null> {\n    try {\n      const data: any = { updatedAt: new Date() };\n      if (updates.enabled !== undefined) data.enabled = updates.enabled;\n      if (updates.thresholdValue !== undefined) data.thresholdValue = updates.thresholdValue;\n      if (updates.severity !== undefined) data.severity = updates.severity;\n      if (updates.cooldownMinutes !== undefined) data.cooldownMinutes = updates.cooldownMinutes;\n\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).usageAlertConfig?.update({\n        where: { id, tenantId },\n        data,\n      });\n\n      if (!updated) return null;\n      return this.mapConfigToDomain(updated);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async listAlertEvents(\n    tenantId: string,\n    filter?: { meterKey?: MeterKey; severity?: AlertSeverity; state?: AlertState; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date; limit?: number; offset?: number },\n  ): Promise<UsageAlertEvent[]> {\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (filter?.meterKey) where.meterKey = filter.meterKey;\n    if (filter?.severity) where.severity = filter.severity;\n    if (filter?.state) where.state = filter.state;\n    if (filter?.fromDate || filter?.toDate) {\n      where.triggeredAt = {};\n      if (filter.fromDate) where.triggeredAt.gte = filter.fromDate;\n      if (filter.toDate) where.triggeredAt.lte = filter.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).usageAlertEvent?.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { triggeredAt: 'desc' },\n      take: filter?.limit || 100,\n      skip: filter?.offset || 0,\n    });\n\n    if (!results) return [];\n    return results.map((r: any) => this.mapEventToDomain(r));\n  }\n\n  private async createAlertEvent(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    configId: string;\n    meterKey: MeterKey;\n    limitKey: string;\n    thresholdType: AlertThresholdType;\n    thresholdValue: number;\n    currentValue: number;\n    maximumValue: number | null;\n    utilizationPercent: number | null;\n    severity: AlertSeverity;\n    periodId: string;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n    safeMetadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n  }): Promise<UsageAlertEvent> {\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    const event: UsageAlertEvent = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      configId: params.configId,\n      meterKey: params.meterKey,\n      limitKey: params.limitKey,\n      thresholdType: params.thresholdType,\n      thresholdValue: params.thresholdValue,\n      currentValue: params.currentValue,\n      maximumValue: params.maximumValue,\n      utilizationPercent: params.utilizationPercent,\n      severity: params.severity,\n      state: AlertState.TRIGGERED,\n      periodId: params.periodId,\n      triggeredAt: now,\n      acknowledgedAt: null,\n      resolvedAt: null,\n      deliveryState: 'PENDING',\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n      safeMetadata: params.safeMetadata || null,\n      createdAt: now,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).usageAlertEvent?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: event.id,\n          tenantId: event.tenantId,\n          configId: event.configId,\n          meterKey: event.meterKey,\n          limitKey: event.limitKey,\n          thresholdType: event.thresholdType,\n          thresholdValue: event.thresholdValue,\n          currentValue: event.currentValue,\n          maximumValue: event.maximumValue,\n          utilizationPercent: event.utilizationPercent,\n          severity: event.severity,\n          state: event.state,\n          periodId: event.periodId,\n          triggeredAt: new Date(event.triggeredAt),\n          deliveryState: event.deliveryState,\n          idempotencyKey: event.idempotencyKey,\n          safeMetadata: event.safeMetadata,\n          createdAt: new Date(event.createdAt),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (created) return this.mapEventToDomain(created);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        this.logger.warn(`usageAlertEvent table not found, fallback: ${error.message}`);\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).auditLog?.create({\n            data: {\n              id: randomUUID(),\n              tenantId: params.tenantId,\n              action: 'USAGE_ALERT_TRIGGERED',\n              resourceType: 'UsageAlert',\n              resourceId: id,\n              metadata: { ...event, fallback: true },\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n        } catch {}\n        return event;\n      }\n      if (error.code === 'P2002') {\n        const existing = await this.findEventByIdempotencyKey(params.idempotencyKey, params.tenantId);\n        if (existing) return existing;\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n\n    return event;\n  }\n\n  private async findEventByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey: string, tenantId: string): Promise<UsageAlertEvent | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).usageAlertEvent?.findFirst({\n      where: { idempotencyKey, tenantId },\n    });\n    if (!result) return null;\n    return this.mapEventToDomain(result);\n  }\n\n  private async updateConfigLastTriggered(id: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).usageAlertConfig?.update({\n        where: { id },\n        data: { lastTriggeredAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n  }\n\n  private mapConfigToDomain(raw: any): UsageAlertConfig {\n    return {\n      id: raw.id,\n      tenantId: raw.tenantId,\n      meterKey: raw.meterKey as MeterKey,\n      limitKey: raw.limitKey,\n      thresholdType: raw.thresholdType as AlertThresholdType,\n      thresholdValue: raw.thresholdValue,\n      severity: raw.severity as AlertSeverity,\n      enabled: raw.enabled,\n      cooldownMinutes: raw.cooldownMinutes,\n      lastTriggeredAt: raw.lastTriggeredAt ? new Date(raw.lastTriggeredAt).toISOString() : null,\n      createdAt: raw.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: raw.updatedAt ? new Date(raw.updatedAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n      metadata: raw.metadata || null,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private mapEventToDomain(raw: any): UsageAlertEvent {\n    return {\n      id: raw.id,\n      tenantId: raw.tenantId,\n      configId: raw.configId,\n      meterKey: raw.meterKey as MeterKey,\n      limitKey: raw.limitKey,\n      thresholdType: raw.thresholdType as AlertThresholdType,\n      thresholdValue: raw.thresholdValue,\n      currentValue: raw.currentValue,\n      maximumValue: raw.maximumValue,\n      utilizationPercent: raw.utilizationPercent,\n      severity: raw.severity as AlertSeverity,\n      state: raw.state as AlertState,\n      periodId: raw.periodId,\n      triggeredAt: raw.triggeredAt ? new Date(raw.triggeredAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n      acknowledgedAt: raw.acknowledgedAt ? new Date(raw.acknowledgedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      resolvedAt: raw.resolvedAt ? new Date(raw.resolvedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      deliveryState: raw.deliveryState,\n      idempotencyKey: raw.idempotencyKey,\n      safeMetadata: raw.safeMetadata || null,\n      createdAt: raw.createdAt ? new Date(raw.createdAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/usage/usage-alert.types.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/usage/usage-analytics.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":8,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { UsageEventRepository } from './usage-event.repository';\nimport { UsageMeterRepository } from './usage-meter.repository';\nimport { UsagePeriodService } from './usage-period.service';\nimport { QuotaSnapshotService } from './quota-snapshot.service';\nimport { OverageService } from './overage.service';\nimport { MeterKey, UsageScope } from './usage-metering.types';\n\n/**\n * Usage analytics for tenants/SaaS admins: period totals, trends, utilization,\n * top meters, limit pressure, overage exposure.\n * All based on canonical durable usage data, no independent counters.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class UsageAnalyticsService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(UsageAnalyticsService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly eventRepository: UsageEventRepository,\n    private readonly meterRepository: UsageMeterRepository,\n    private readonly periodService: UsagePeriodService,\n    private readonly quotaService: QuotaSnapshotService,\n    private readonly overageService: OverageService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async getCurrentUsageOverview(tenantId: string, periodId?: string): Promise<any> {\n    const quotaOverview = await this.quotaService.getTenantQuotaOverview(tenantId, periodId);\n    const tenantTotals = await this.meterRepository.getTenantTotals(tenantId);\n\n    const utilization = quotaOverview.map((q) => ({\n      meterKey: q.meterKey,\n      limitKey: q.limitKey,\n      current: q.current,\n      maximum: q.maximum,\n      remaining: q.remaining,\n      utilizationPercent: q.utilizationPercent,\n      status: q.status,\n      isEnforced: q.isEnforced,\n    }));\n\n    // Calculate limit pressure (how close to limits)\n    const pressure = utilization\n      .filter((u) => u.maximum !== null && u.utilizationPercent !== null)\n      .sort((a, b) => (b.utilizationPercent || 0) - (a.utilizationPercent || 0))\n      .slice(0, 5);\n\n    return {\n      tenantId,\n      periodId: periodId || this.periodService.getCurrentCalendarMonthPeriod(tenantId).id,\n      currentUsage: utilization,\n      tenantTotals,\n      limitPressure: pressure,\n      fetchedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getUsageTrends(\n    tenantId: string,\n    params: { meterKey?: MeterKey; days?: number; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date },\n  ): Promise<any> {\n    const days = params.days || 30;\n    const toDate = params.toDate || new Date();\n    const fromDate = params.fromDate || new Date(toDate.getTime() - days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n\n    const events = await this.eventRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, {\n      meterKey: params.meterKey,\n      fromDate,\n      toDate,\n      limit: 10000,\n    });\n\n    // Group by day\n    const dailyMap = new Map<string, { date: string; totalQuantity: number; eventCount: number; meters: Record<string, number> }>();\n\n    for (const event of events) {\n      const dateKey = new Date(event.timestamp).toISOString().split('T')[0];\n      const existing = dailyMap.get(dateKey) || { date: dateKey, totalQuantity: 0, eventCount: 0, meters: {} };\n      existing.totalQuantity += event.quantity;\n      existing.eventCount += 1;\n      existing.meters[event.meterKey] = (existing.meters[event.meterKey] || 0) + event.quantity;\n      dailyMap.set(dateKey, existing);\n    }\n\n    const dailyTrends = Array.from(dailyMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));\n\n    // Calculate trend direction\n    let trend: 'increasing' | 'decreasing' | 'stable' = 'stable';\n    if (dailyTrends.length >= 2) {\n      const recent = dailyTrends.slice(-7);\n      const older = dailyTrends.slice(-14, -7);\n      const recentAvg = recent.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.totalQuantity, 0) / (recent.length || 1);\n      const olderAvg = older.length > 0 ? older.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.totalQuantity, 0) / older.length : recentAvg;\n      if (recentAvg > olderAvg * 1.1) trend = 'increasing';\n      else if (recentAvg < olderAvg * 0.9) trend = 'decreasing';\n    }\n\n    return {\n      tenantId,\n      meterKey: params.meterKey || 'ALL',\n      period: { from: fromDate.toISOString(), to: toDate.toISOString(), days },\n      dailyTrends,\n      trend,\n      totalEvents: events.length,\n      totalQuantity: events.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.quantity, 0),\n      fetchedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getTopMeters(tenantId: string, limit: number = 10, fromDate?: Date, toDate?: Date): Promise<any[]> {\n    const totals = await this.meterRepository.getTenantTotals(tenantId, undefined, undefined, fromDate, toDate);\n\n    return totals\n      .sort((a, b) => b.totalQuantity - a.totalQuantity)\n      .slice(0, limit)\n      .map((t) => ({\n        meterKey: t.meterKey,\n        totalQuantity: t.totalQuantity,\n        eventCount: t.eventCount,\n        averagePerEvent: t.eventCount > 0 ? t.totalQuantity / t.eventCount : 0,\n      }));\n  }\n\n  async getLimitPressure(tenantId: string): Promise<any[]> {\n    const quotaOverview = await this.quotaService.getTenantQuotaOverview(tenantId);\n\n    return quotaOverview\n      .filter((q) => q.maximum !== null && q.utilizationPercent !== null)\n      .map((q) => ({\n        meterKey: q.meterKey,\n        limitKey: q.limitKey,\n        current: q.current,\n        maximum: q.maximum,\n        remaining: q.remaining,\n        utilizationPercent: q.utilizationPercent,\n        status: q.status,\n        pressure: q.utilizationPercent || 0,\n        isEnforced: q.isEnforced,\n      }))\n      .sort((a, b) => (b.utilizationPercent || 0) - (a.utilizationPercent || 0));\n  }\n\n  async getOverageExposure(tenantId: string, fromDate?: Date, toDate?: Date): Promise<any> {\n    const overages = await this.overageService.listOverages(tenantId, {\n      fromDate,\n      toDate,\n      limit: 100,\n    });\n\n    const totalExcess = overages.reduce((sum, o) => sum + (o.excessQuantity || 0), 0);\n    const byMeter: Record<string, number> = {};\n    const byStatus: Record<string, number> = {};\n\n    for (const o of overages) {\n      byMeter[o.meterKey] = (byMeter[o.meterKey] || 0) + o.excessQuantity;\n      byStatus[o.status] = (byStatus[o.status] || 0) + 1;\n    }\n\n    return {\n      tenantId,\n      totalOverages: overages.length,\n      totalExcessQuantity: totalExcess,\n      byMeter,\n      byStatus,\n      overages: overages.slice(0, 20),\n      fetchedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getApiUsageAnalytics(tenantId: string, days: number = 7): Promise<any> {\n    const toDate = new Date();\n    const fromDate = new Date(toDate.getTime() - days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n\n    const events = await this.eventRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, {\n      meterKey: MeterKey.API_REQUESTS,\n      fromDate,\n      toDate,\n      limit: 10000,\n    });\n\n    const byEndpoint: Record<string, number> = {};\n    const byIdentity: Record<string, number> = {};\n    const hourlyMap = new Map<string, number>();\n\n    for (const event of events) {\n      const endpoint = (event.dimensions as any)?.endpoint || 'unknown';\n      byEndpoint[endpoint] = (byEndpoint[endpoint] || 0) + 1;\n\n      const identity = event.subjectId || 'unknown';\n      byIdentity[identity] = (byIdentity[identity] || 0) + 1;\n\n      const hourKey = new Date(event.timestamp).toISOString().substring(0, 13);\n      hourlyMap.set(hourKey, (hourlyMap.get(hourKey) || 0) + event.quantity);\n    }\n\n    const hourlyTrends = Array.from(hourlyMap.entries())\n      .map(([hour, count]) => ({ hour, count }))\n      .sort((a, b) => a.hour.localeCompare(b.hour));\n\n    return {\n      tenantId,\n      period: { from: fromDate.toISOString(), to: toDate.toISOString(), days },\n      totalRequests: events.length,\n      byEndpoint: Object.entries(byEndpoint)\n        .map(([endpoint, count]) => ({ endpoint, count }))\n        .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)\n        .slice(0, 20),\n      byIdentity: Object.entries(byIdentity)\n        .map(([identity, count]) => ({ identity, count }))\n        .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)\n        .slice(0, 20),\n      hourlyTrends,\n      fetchedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getProjectedUsage(tenantId: string, meterKey: MeterKey): Promise<any> {\n    const currentPeriod = this.periodService.getCurrentCalendarMonthPeriod(tenantId);\n    const start = new Date(currentPeriod.start);\n    const now = new Date();\n    const end = new Date(currentPeriod.end);\n\n    const events = await this.eventRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, {\n      meterKey,\n      fromDate: start,\n      toDate: now,\n      limit: 10000,\n    });\n\n    const elapsedMs = now.getTime() - start.getTime();\n    const totalPeriodMs = end.getTime() - start.getTime();\n    const currentTotal = events.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.quantity, 0);\n\n    let projectedTotal = currentTotal;\n    if (elapsedMs > 0 && totalPeriodMs > 0) {\n      const progress = elapsedMs / totalPeriodMs;\n      projectedTotal = progress > 0 ? Math.round(currentTotal / progress) : currentTotal;\n    }\n\n    const quota = await this.quotaService.getQuotaSnapshot({\n      tenantId,\n      meterKey,\n      scope: UsageScope.TENANT,\n      periodId: currentPeriod.id,\n    });\n\n    return {\n      tenantId,\n      meterKey,\n      currentPeriod: {\n        id: currentPeriod.id,\n        start: currentPeriod.start,\n        end: currentPeriod.end,\n        elapsedDays: Math.floor(elapsedMs / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)),\n        totalDays: Math.floor(totalPeriodMs / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)),\n        progressPercent: totalPeriodMs > 0 ? Math.round((elapsedMs / totalPeriodMs) * 100) : 0,\n      },\n      currentTotal,\n      projectedTotal,\n      maximum: quota.maximum,\n      projectedUtilization: quota.maximum ? Math.round((projectedTotal / quota.maximum) * 100) : null,\n      willExceed: quota.maximum ? projectedTotal > quota.maximum : false,\n      fetchedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/usage/usage-event.repository.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Safe replay without double counting.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class UsageEventRepository {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(UsageEventRepository.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async create(event: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    meterKey: MeterKey;\n    scope: UsageScope;\n    subjectId?: string;\n    resourceId?: string;\n    quantity: number;\n    unit: MeterUnit;\n    sourceType: string;\n    sourceId: string;\n    sourceEventId?: string;\n    periodId: string;\n    periodType: PeriodType;\n    periodStart: Date;\n    periodEnd: Date;\n    timestamp: Date;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n    processingState: ProcessingState;\n    dimensions: any;\n    safeMetadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n  }): Promise<DurableUsageEvent> {\n    // Idempotency check\n    const existingByKey = await this.findByIdempotencyKey(event.idempotencyKey, event.tenantId);\n    if (existingByKey) {\n      this.logger.log(`Idempotent event return by idempotencyKey: ${event.idempotencyKey}`);\n      return existingByKey;\n    }\n\n    const existingBySource = await this.findBySourceId(event.tenantId, event.sourceId, event.meterKey);\n    if const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    const durableEvent: DurableUsageEvent = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: event.tenantId,\n      meterKey: event.meterKey,\n      scope: event.scope,\n      subjectId: event.subjectId,\n      resourceId: event.resourceId,\n      quantity: event.quantity,\n      unit: event.unit,\n      sourceType: event.sourceType,\n      sourceId: event.sourceId,\n { meterKey } : {}),\n      },\n    });\n    return count || 0;\n  }\n\n  private mapToDomain(raw: any): DurableUsageEvent {\n    const metadata = raw.metadata && typeof raw.metadata === 'object' ? raw.metadata : {};\n    const record: any = metadata[USAGE_RECORD_METADATA_KEY] && typeof metadata[USAGE_RECORD_METADATA_KEY] === 'object' ? '@nestjs/common';\nimport { UsageEventRepository } from './usage-event.repository';\nimport { UsageMeterRepository } from './usage-meter.repository';\nimport { UsagePeriodService } from './usage-period.service';\nimport { QuotaSnapshotService } from './quota-snapshot.service';\nimport { MeterKey, UsageScope } from './usage-metering.types';\n\n/**\n * Produces tenant/admin usage exports in safe structured formats using canonical metered data.\n * Safe fields only, no secrets, bounded pagination.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class UsageExportService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(UsageExportService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly eventRepository: UsageEventRepository,\n    private readonly meterRepository: UsageMeterRepository,\n    private readonly periodService: UsagePeriodService,\n    private readonly quotaService: QuotaSnapshotService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async exportUsageJson(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    format: 'json' | 'csv';\n    fromDate?: Date;\n    toDate?: Date;\n    meterKeys?: MeterKey[];\n    scope?: UsageScope;\n    subjectId?: string;\n    includeQuota?: boolean;\n    includeOverage?: boolean;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ format: string; data: any; exportedAt: string; tenantId: string; recordCount: number }> {\n    const limit = Math.min(params.limit || 1000, 10000); // Bounded\n\n    let events: any[] = [];\n\n    // Fetch events for each meter key or all\n    if (params.meterKeys && params.meterKeys.length > 0) {\n      for (const meterKey of params.meterKeys) {\n        const meterEvents = await this.eventRepository.listByTenant(params.tenantId, {\n          meterKey,\n          scope: params.scope,\n          subjectId: params.subjectId,\n          fromDate: params.fromDate,\n          toDate: params.toDate,\n          limit,\n        });\n        events = events.concat(meterEvents);\n      }\n    } else {\n      events = await this.eventRepository.listByTenant(params.tenantId, {\n        scope: params.scope,\n        subjectId: params.subjectId,\n        fromDate: params.fromDate,\n        toDate: params.toDate,\n        limit,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Sort deterministically by timestamp\n    events.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(b.timestamp).getTime());\n\n    // Build safe export records\n    const safeRecords = events.map((e) => ({\n      id: e.id,\n      tenantId: e.tenantId,\n      meterKey: e.meterKey,\n      scope: e.scope,\n      subjectId: e.subjectId || null,\n      resourceId: e.resourceId || null,\n      quantity: e.quantity,\n      unit: e.unit,\n      sourceType: e.sourceType,\n      sourceId: e.sourceId,\n      periodId: e.periodId,\n      periodType: e.periodType,\n      periodStart: e.periodStart,\n      periodEnd: e.periodEnd,\n      timestamp: e.timestamp,\n      processingState: e.processingState,\n      dimensions: this.sanitizeDimensions(e.dimensions),\n      createdAt: e.createdAt,\n    }));\n\n    let quotaSnapshots: any[] = [];\n    if (params.includeQuota) {\n      try {\n        quotaSnapshots = await this.quotaService.getTenantQuotaOverview(params.tenantId);\n        // Sanitize quota snapshots to safe fields\n        quotaSnapshots = quotaSnapshots.map((q) => ({\n          meterKey: q.meterKey,\n          limitKey: q.limitKey,\n          scope: q.scope,\n          subjectId: q.subjectId || null,\n          maximum: q.maximum,\n          current: q.current,\n          remaining: q.remaining,\n          utilizationPercent: q.utilizationPercent,\n          status: q.status,\n          periodId: q.periodId,\n          periodStart: q.periodStart,\n          periodEnd: q.periodEnd,\n          isEnforced: q.isEnforced,\n        }));\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    const exportData = {\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      period: {\n        from: params.fromDate ? params.fromDate.toISOString() : null,\n        to: params.toDate ? params.toDate.toISOString() : null,\n      },\n      filters: {\n        meterKeys: params.meterKeys || null,\n        scope: params.scope || null,\n        subjectId: params.subjectId || null,\n      },\n      summary: {\n        totalEvents: safeRecords.length,\n        totalQuantity: safeRecords.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.quantity || 0), 0),\n        meterBreakdown: this.buildMeterBreakdown(safeRecords),\n      },\n      events: safeRecords,\n      quotaSnapshots: params.includeQuota ? quotaSnapshots : undefined,\n    };\n\n    this.logger.log(`Usage export tenant=${params.tenantId} format=${params.format} records=${safeRecords.length}`);\n\n    return {\n      format: params.format,\n      data: exportData,\n      exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      recordCount: safeRecords.length,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async exportUsageCsv(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    fromDate?: Date;\n    toDate?: Date;\n    meterKeys?: MeterKey[];\n    scope?: UsageScope;\n    subjectId?: string;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ format: 'csv'; csv: string; exportedAt: string; tenantId: string; recordCount: number }> {\n    const jsonExport = await this.exportUsageJson({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      format: 'json',\n      fromDate: params.fromDate,\n      toDate: params.toDate,\n      meterKeys: params.meterKeys,\n      scope: params.scope,\n      subjectId: params.subjectId,\n      limit: params.limit,\n    });\n\n    const headers = ['id', 'meterKey', 'scope', 'subjectId', 'quantity', 'unit', 'sourceType', 'sourceId', 'periodId', 'timestamp'];\n    const rows = [headers.join(',')];\n\n    for (const event of jsonExport.data.events) {\n      const row = [\n        event.id,\n        event.meterKey,\n        event.scope,\n        event.subjectId || '',\n        event.quantity,\n        event.unit,\n        event.sourceType,\n        event.sourceId,\n        event.periodId,\n        event.timestamp,\n      ]\n        .map((v) => `\"${String(v).replace(/\"/g, '\"\"')}\"`)\n        .join(',');\n      rows.push(row);\n    }\n\n    const csv = rows.join('\\n');\n\n    return {\n      format: 'csv',\n      csv,\n      exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      recordCount: jsonExport.recordCount,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getExportStatus(exportId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<{ id: string; status: string; tenantId: string; createdAt: string }> {\n    // Exports are produced synchronously (exportJson / exportCsv return the\n    // data in the response) and no export job is persisted, so there is no\n    // status to report. Answering COMPLETED for any id was a fabricated result.\n    throw new NotFoundException(`Usage export ${exportId} is not tracked for tenant ${tenantId}: exports are synchronous and have no stored status`);\n  }\n\n  private buildMeterBreakdown(records: any[]): Record<string, { count: number; totalQuantity: number }> {\n    const breakdown: Record<string, { count: number; totalQuantity: number }> = {};\n    for (const r of records) {\n      if (!breakdown[r.meterKey]) {\n        breakdown[r.meterKey] = { count: 0, totalQuantity: 0 };\n      }\n      breakdown[r.meterKey].count += 1;\n      breakdown[r.meterKey].totalQuantity += r.quantity || 0;\n    }\n    return breakdown;\n  }\n\n  private sanitizeDimensions(dimensions: any): any {\n    if (!dimensions) return null;\n    const forbidden = ['secret', 'apiKey', 'privateKey', 'accessToken', 'password', 'exchangeSecret', 'providerSecret', 'credentials', 'apiSecret'];\n    const safe: any = {};\n    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(dimensions)) {\n      const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();\n      if (forbidden.some((f) => lowerKey.includes(f.toLowerCase()))) {\n        safe[key] = '[REDACTED]';\n      } else {\n        safe[key] = value;\n      }\n    }\n    return safe;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/usage/usage-meter.repository.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. {\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          meterKey: params.meterKey,\n          scope: params.scope,\n          subjectId: params.subjectId || '',\n          periodId: params.periodId,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (!result) {\n        return { totalQuantity: 0, eventCount: 0, bucketId: null };\n      }\n\n      return {\n        totalQuantity: result.totalQuantity || 0,\n        eventCount: result.eventCount || 0,\n        bucketId: result.id,\n      };\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      if (error.code === 'P2021' || error.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        return { totalQuantity: 0, eventCount: 0, bucketId: null };\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async incrementUsageAtomic(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    meterKey: MeterKey;\n sourceEventId: string;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n  }): Promise<UsageBucket> {\n    if (params.quantity < 0) {\n      throw new Error('Usage quantity cannot be negative');\n    }\n\n    if (params.quantity === 0) {\n      // Return current bucket without increment\n      const current = await this.getCurrentPeriodTotal({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        meterKey: params.meterKey,\n        scope: params.scope,\n        subjectId: params.subjectId,\n        periodId: params.periodId,\n      });\n\n      // Try to find bucket\n      try {\n        const existing = await (this.prisma as any).usageBucket?.findFirst({\n          where: {\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            meterKey: params.meterKey,\n            scope: params.scope,\n            subjectId: params.subjectId || '',\n            periodId: params.periodId,\n          },\n        });\n        if (existing) return this.mapBucketToDomain(existing);\n      } catch {}\n\n      // Return synthetic bucket\n      return {\n        id: current.bucketId || randomUUID(),\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        meterKey: params.meterKey,\n        scope: params.scope,\n        subjectId: params.subjectId,\n        window: params.window,\n        periodId: params.periodId,\n        periodStart: params.periodStart.toISOString(),\n        periodEnd: params.periodEnd.toISOString(),\n        totalQuantity: current.totalQuantity,\n        eventCount: current.eventCount,\n        unit: params.unit as any,\n        lastEventAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Idempotency check by source event ID and idempotency key\n    try {\n      const existingBySource = await (this.prisma as any).usageEvent?.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          sourceId: params.sourceEventId,\n          meterKey: params.meterKey,\n        },\n      });\n      if (existingBySource) {\n        this.logger.log(`Duplicate source event detected: ${params.sourceEventId} meter=${params.meterKey}`);\n        // Return existing bucket\n        const bucket = await (this.prisma as any).usageBucket?.findFirst({\n          where: {\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            meterKey: params.meterKey,\n            scope: params.scope,\n            subjectId: params.subjectId || '',\n            periodId: params.periodId,\n          },\n        });\n        if (bucket) return this.mapBucketToDomain(bucket);\n      }\n\n      const existingByIdempotency = await (this.prisma as any).usageEvent?.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n        },\n      });\n      if (existingByIdempotency) {\n        this.logger.log(`Duplicate idempotency key: ${params.idempotencyKey}`);\n        const bucket = await (this.prisma as any).usageBucket?.findFirst({\n          where: {\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            meterKey: params.meterKey,\n            scope: params.scope,\n            subjectId: params.subjectId || '',\n            periodId: params.periodId,\n          },\n        });\n        if (bucket) return this.mapBucketToDomain(bucket);\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.code !== 'P2021' && !e.message?.includes('does not exist')) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Idempotency check failed: ${e.message}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Atomic increment via transaction or tenantId_meterKey_scope_subjectId_periodId: {\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            meterKey: params.meterKey,\n            scope: params.scope,\n            subjectId: params.subjectId runtime enforcement already does that.\n * Records what actually happened after successful business operations.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class UsageMeterService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(UsageMeterService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly meterRepository: UsageMeterRepository,\n    private readonly eventRepository: UsageEventRepository,\n    private readonly periodService: UsagePeriodService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async recordUsage(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    meterKey: MeterKey;\n    scope: UsageScope;\n    subjectId?: string;\n    resourceId?: string;\n    quantity: number;\n    unit?: MeterUnit;\n    sourceType: string;\n    sourceId: string;\n    sourceEventId?: string;\n    idempotencyKey?: string;\n    timestamp?: Date;\n    dimensions?: any;\n    safeMetadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n  }): Promise<{ event: DurableUsageEvent; bucket: UsageBucket; isDuplicate: boolean }> {\n    // Validate meter key\n    const meterDef = this.meterRepository.getMeterDefinition(params.meterKey);\n    if (!meterDef) {\n      throw new Error(`Invalid meter key: ${params.meterKey}`);\n    }\n\n    // Validate scope\n    if (!meterDef.scope.includes(params.scope)) {\n      throw new Error(`Scope ${params.scope} not allowed for meter ${params.meterKey}. idempotencyKey: ${idempotencyKey} - returning existing`);\n      const bucket = await this.meterRepository.getCurrentPeriodTotal({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        meterKey: params.meterKey,\n        scope: params.scope,\n        subjectId: params.subjectId,\n        periodId: existingByIdempotency.periodId,\n      });\n\n      // Map to bucket domain for return\n      const bucketDomain: UsageBucket = {\n        id: bucket.bucketId || randomUUID(),\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        meterKey: params.meterKey,\n        scope: params.scope,\n        subjectId: params.subjectId,\n        window: AggregationWindow.MONTHLY,\n        periodId: existingByIdempotency.periodId,\n        periodStart: existingByIdempotency.periodStart,\n        periodEnd: existingByIdempotency.periodEnd,\n        totalQuantity: bucket.totalQuantity,\n        eventCount: bucket.eventCount,\n        unit: existingByIdempotency.unit,\n        lastEventAt: const bucket = await this.meterRepository.incrementUsageAtomic({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      meterKey: params.meterKey,\n      scope: params.scope,\n      subjectId: params.subjectId,\n async getResourceUsage(tenantId: string, scope: UsageScope, subjectId: string, meterKey?: MeterKey): Promise<UsageBucket[]> {\n    return this.meterRepository.getResourceTotals(tenantId, scope, subjectId, meterKey);\n  }\n\n  private determineAggregationWindow(meterKey: MeterKey): AggregationWindow {\n    const def = this.meterRepository.getMeterDefinition(meterKey);\n    if (!def) return AggregationWindow.MONTHLY;\n    // Prefer monthly for most, minute for API requests\n    if (meterKey === MeterKey.API_REQUESTS) return AggregationWindow.MINUTE;\n    if (meterKey === of Object.entries(metadata)) {\n      const lowerKey = key.toLowerCase();\n      if (forbidden.some((f) => lowerKey.includes(f.toLowerCase()))) {\n        safe[key] = '[REDACTED]';\n      } else {\n        safe[key] = value;\n      }\n    }\n    return safe;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/usage/usage-metering.types.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/usage/usage-period.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected PrismaService) {}\n\n  getCurrentCalendarMonthPeriod(tenantId: string, timezone: string = 'UTC'): UsagePeriod {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const start = this.startOfMonthUTC(now);\n    const end = this.endOfMonthUTC(now);\n\n    return {\n      id: `cal_month_${tenantId}_${start.getUTCFullYear()}_${start.getUTCMonth() + 1}`,\n      tenantId,\n      type: PeriodType.CALENDAR_MONTH,\n      status: PeriodStatus.CURRENT,\n      start: start.toISOString(),\n      end: end.toISOString(),\n      timezone,\n      isCurrent: true,\n      subscriptionId: null,\n      metadata: { year: start.getUTCFullYear(), month: start.getUTCMonth() + 1 },\n    };\n  }\n\n  getCurrentCalendarDayPeriod(tenantId: string, timezone: string = 'UTC'): UsagePeriod {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const start = this.startOfDayUTC(now);\n    const end = this.endOfDayUTC(now);\n\n    return {\n      id: `cal_day_${tenantId}_${start.toISOString().split('T')[0]}`,\n      tenantId,\n      type: PeriodType.CALENDAR_DAY,\n      status: PeriodStatus.CURRENT,\n      start: start.toISOString(),\n      end: end.toISOString(),\n      timezone,\n      isCurrent: true,\n      subscriptionId: null,\n    };\n  }\n\n  getCurrentHourPeriod(tenantId: string, timezone: string = 'UTC'): UsagePeriod {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const start = this.startOfHourUTC(now);\n    const end = new && now < end;\n      const status = isCurrent ? PeriodStatus.CURRENT : now < start ? start: start.toISOString(),\n        end: end.toISOString(),\n        timezone: 'UTC',\n        isCurrent,\n        subscriptionId: subscription.id,\n        metadata: {\n          subscriptionStatus: subscriptionId: null,\n        };\n      case PeriodType.CALENDAR_MONTH:\n        return {\n          id: `cal_month_${tenantId}_${timestamp.getUTCFullYear()}_${timestamp.getUTCMonth() + 1}`,\n          tenantId,\n          type,\n          status: this.getPeriodStatus(timestamp, this.startOfMonthUTC(timestamp), this.endOfMonthUTC(timestamp)),\n          start: this.startOfMonthUTC(timestamp).toISOString(),\n          end: this.endOfMonthUTC(timestamp).toISOString(),\n          timezone,\n          isCurrent: this.isCurrentPeriod(timestamp, this.startOfMonthUTC(timestamp), this.endOfMonthUTC(timestamp)),\n          subscriptionId: null,\n        };\n      case PeriodType.CALENDAR_HOUR:\n        const hourStart = this.startOfHourUTC(timestamp);\n        return {\n          id: `cal_hour_${tenantId}_${hourStart.toISOString()}`,\n          tenantId,\n          type,\n          status: PeriodStatus.CURRENT,\n          start: hourStart.toISOString(),\n          end: new Date(hourStart.getTime() + 3600 * 1000).toISOString(),\n          timezone,\n          isCurrent: true,\n          subscriptionId: null,\n        };\n      default:\n        return this.getCurrentCalendarMonthPeriod(tenantId, timezone);\n    }\n  }\n\n  getPreviousPeriod(currentPeriod: UsagePeriod): UsagePeriod {\n    const start = new currentPeriod.subscriptionId,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private startOfDayUTC(date: Date): Date {\n    return new Date(Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(), date.getUTCMonth(), date.getUTCDate(), 0, 0, 0, 0));\n   const now = new Date();\n    if (now < start) return PeriodStatus.FUTURE;\n    if (now >= start && now < end) return PeriodStatus.CURRENT;\n    return PeriodStatus.CLOSED;\n  }\n\n  private
