periodId?: string; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date },\n  ): Promise<{\n    tenantId: string;\n    checkedMeters: number;\n    issues: any[];\n    summary: { critical: number; high: number; medium: number; low: number };\n  }> {\n    const issues: any[] = [];\n    let checkedMeters = 0;\n\n    const meterKeys = options?.meterKey ? [options.meterKey] : Object.values(MeterKey);\n\n    for (const meterKey of meterKeys) {\n      checkedMeters++;\n\n      try {\n        // Get durable totals\n        const durableTotals = await this.meterRepository.getTenantTotals(tenantId, meterKey, undefined, options?.fromDate, options?.toDate);\n        const durableTotal = durableTotals.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.totalQuantity, 0);\n\n        // Get runtime counter (actual DB counts or Redis) for enforced meters\n        let runtimeTotal: number | null = null;\n\n        if ([MeterKey.USERS, MeterKey.TRADERS].includes(meterKey)) {\n          try {\n            if (meterKey === MeterKey.USERS) {\n              runtimeTotal = await this.prisma.user.count({ where: { tenantId, deletedAt: null } });\n            } else if (meterKey === MeterKey.TRADERS) {\n              runtimeTotal = await (this.prisma as any).tradingAccount?.count({ where: { tenantId, deletedAt: null } }) || null;\n            }\n          } catch {}\n        }\n\n        // For other meters, try to get from events\n        if (runtimeTotal === null) {\n          const events = await this.eventRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, {\n            meterKey,\n            fromDate: options?.fromDate,\n            toDate: options?.toDate,\n            limit: 10000,\n          });\n          const eventTotal = events.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.quantity, 0);\n\n          // Compare bucket totals vs event totals for drift\n          if (Math.abs(durableTotal - eventTotal) > 0) {\n            issues.push({\n              severity: 'MEDIUM',\n              category: 'AGGREGATE_DRIFT',\n              meterKey,\n              tenantId,\n              detectedValue: durableTotal,\n              expectedValue: eventTotal,\n              description: `Bucket total ${durableTotal} != event sum ${eventTotal} for meter ${meterKey}`,\n              detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            });\n          }\n\n          // Check for duplicate events (same sourceId)\n          const sourceMap = new Map<string, number>();\n          for (const event of events) {\n            sourceMap.set(event.sourceId, (sourceMap.get(event.sourceId) || 0) + 1);\n          }\n          for (const [sourceId, count] of sourceMap) {\n            if (count > 1) {\n              issues.push({\n                severity: 'HIGH',\n                category: 'DUPLICATE_EVENT',\n                meterKey,\n                tenantId,\n                sourceId,\n                detectedValue: count,\n                expectedValue: 1,\n                description: `Duplicate usage events for source ${sourceId} meter ${meterKey}: count=${count}`,\n                detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n              });\n            }\n          }\n\n          // Check for negative usage\n          for (const event of events) {\n            if (event.quantity < 0) {\n              issues.push({\n                severity: 'CRITICAL',\n                category: 'NEGATIVE_USAGE',\n                meterKey,\n                tenantId,\n                sourceId: event.sourceId,\n                detectedValue: event.quantity,\n                expectedValue: 0,\n                description: `Negative usage quantity ${event.quantity} for event ${event.id}`,\n                detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n              });\n            }\n          }\n\n          // Check for impossible usage (e.g., more users than can exist)\n          // For count meters, quantity should be 1 per event typically\n          if ([MeterKey.USERS, MeterKey.TRADERS, MeterKey.FOLLOWERS, MeterKey.EXCHANGE_ACCOUNTS, MeterKey.COPY_SUBSCRIPTIONS].includes(meterKey)) {\n            for (const event of events) {\n              if (event.quantity > 1) {\n                issues.push({\n                  severity: 'MEDIUM',\n                  category: 'IMPOSSIBLE_USAGE',\n                  meterKey,\n                  tenantId,\n                  sourceId: event.sourceId,\n                  detectedValue: event.quantity,\n                  expectedValue: 1,\n                  description: `Count meter ${meterKey} has quantity ${event.quantity} > 1 for single event`,\n                  detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n                });\n              }\n            }\n          }\n\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        // Compare runtime vs durable for count meters\n        if (runtimeTotal !== null) {\n          const drift = Math.abs(runtimeTotal - durableTotal);\n          const threshold = Math.max(1, Math.floor(runtimeTotal * 0.05)); // 5% threshold\n\n          if (drift > threshold) {\n            issues.push({\n              severity: drift > runtimeTotal * 0.2 ? 'HIGH' : 'MEDIUM',\n              category: 'COUNTER_DRIFT',\n              meterKey,\n              tenantId,\n              detectedValue: durableTotal,\n              expectedValue: runtimeTotal,\n              description: `Counter drift for ${meterKey}: durable=${durableTotal} runtime=${runtimeTotal} drift=${drift}`,\n              detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Check for missing events (runtime has more than durable)\n        if (runtimeTotal !== null && runtimeTotal > durableTotal) {\n          const missing = runtimeTotal - durableTotal;\n          if (missing > 0) {\n            issues.push({\n              severity: 'MEDIUM',\n              category: 'MISSING_EVENT',\n              meterKey,\n              tenantId,\n              detectedValue: durableTotal,\n              expectedValue: runtimeTotal,\n              description: `Missing usage events for ${meterKey}: durable=${durableTotal} runtime=${runtimeTotal} missing=${missing}`,\n              detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Period mismatch check\n        const events = await this.eventRepository.listByTenant(tenantId, {\n          meterKey,\n          fromDate: options?.fromDate,\n          toDate: options?.toDate,\n          limit: 100,\n        });\n\n        for (const event of events) {\n          const periodStart = new Date(event.periodStart);\n          const periodEnd = new Date(event.periodEnd);\n          const eventTime = new Date(event.timestamp);\n\n          if (eventTime < periodStart || eventTime >= periodEnd) {\n            issues.push({\n              severity: 'LOW',\n              category: 'PERIOD_MISMATCH',\n              meterKey,\n              tenantId,\n              sourceId: event.sourceId,\n              detectedValue: eventTime.toISOString(),\n              expectedValue: `${periodStart.toISOString()} - ${periodEnd.toISOString()}`,\n              description: `Event timestamp ${eventTime.toISOString()} outside period ${event.periodId} [${periodStart.toISOString()}, ${periodEnd.toISOString()})`,\n              detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Reconciliation failed for meter ${meterKey}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n        issues.push({\n          severity: 'LOW',\n          category: 'RECONCILIATION_ERROR',\n          meterKey,\n          tenantId,\n          description: `Reconciliation error for ${meterKey}: ${(e as Error).message}`,\n          detectedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const summary = {\n      critical: issues.filter((i) => i.severity === 'CRITICAL').length,\n      high: issues.filter((i) => i.severity === 'HIGH').length,\n      medium: issues.filter((i) => i.severity === 'MEDIUM').length,\n      low: issues.filter((i) => i.severity === 'LOW').length,\n    };\n\n    this.logger.log(`Usage reconciliation tenant=${tenantId} checked=${checkedMeters} issues=${issues.length} critical=${summary.critical} high=${summary.high}`);\n\n    return {\n      tenantId,\n      checkedMeters,\n      issues,\n      summary,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async reconcileAllTenants(options?: { fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date; limit?: number }): Promise<any[]> {\n    const tenantIds = await listBillableTenantIds(this.prisma, options?.limit ?? 1000);\n    const results = await forEachTenant(tenantIds, (tenantId) => this.reconcileTenant(tenantId, { fromDate: options?.fromDate, toDate: options?.toDate }));\n    this.logger.log(`Usage reconciliation all tenants=${tenantIds.length} failed=${results.filter((r) => r.error).length}`);\n    return results.map((r) => (r.error ? { tenantId: r.tenantId, error: r.error } : r.result));\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/billing/usage/usage.module.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/account-administration.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/account-closure.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected Closure must preserve historical records.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class AccountClosureService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AccountClosureService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly accountStateService: AccountStateService,\n    private readonly auditService: LifecycleAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async initiateClosure(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    operatorId: string;\n    reason: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, operatorId, reason, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n    if (!account) throw new BadRequestException('Account not found');\n\n    if (account.state === 'CLOSED') throw new BadRequestException('Account already closed');\n    if (account.state === 'CLOSURE_PENDING') throw new BadRequestException('Account closure already pending');\n\n    // Transition to CLOSURE_PENDING\n    const pending = await this.accountStateService.transitionAccount({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: account.clientProfileId,\n      accountId,\n      action: 'ACCOUNT_CLOSURE_INITIATED',\n      entityType: 'INSTITUTIONAL_ACCOUNT',\n      entityId: accountId,\n ${pendingWithdrawals.length}`);\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Check: No pending funding settlement\n    try {\n      const pendingFunding = await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.findMany({\n funding settlement: ${pendingFunding.length}`);\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Check: Portfolio/accounting period state is valid\n    try {\n      if (account.portfolioId) {\n        const '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { AccountOwnershipService } from './account-ownership.service';\n\n/**\n * Resolves what a client, trader, follower, operator, compliance reviewer, or platform administrator\n * may perform on an account using existing IAM/RBAC and lifecycle restrictions.\n */\n\nexport enum ClientVisibilityRole {\n  CLIENT = 'CLIENT',\n  TENANT_OWNER = 'TENANT_OWNER',\n  TRADER = 'TRADER',\n  FOLLOWER = 'FOLLOWER',\n  MANAGED_ACCOUNT_OPERATOR = 'MANAGED_ACCOUNT_OPERATOR',\n  COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER = 'COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER',\n  SECURITY_ADMIN = 'SECURITY_ADMIN',\n  PLATFORM_ADMIN = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN',\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class AccountPermissionService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AccountPermissionService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly ownershipService: AccountOwnershipService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async canPerformAction(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    role: ClientVisibilityRole;\n    action: string;\n    isPlatformUser?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; reason?: string }> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, userId, role, action, isPlatformUser = false } = params;\n\n    // Platform admin can perform all actions with audit\n    if (isPlatformUser && role === ClientVisibilityRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN) {\n      return { allowed: true };\n    }\n\n    // Compliance reviewer can perform review actions\n    if (role === ClientVisibilityRole.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER) {\n      const allowedActions = ['REVIEW', 'VIEW', 'RESTRICT', 'COMPLIANCE_HOLD'];\n      if (allowedActions.includes(action)) return { allowed: true };\n      return { allowed: false, reason: `Compliance reviewer cannot perform ${action}` };\n    }\n\n    // Security admin can perform security-related actions\n    if (role === ClientVisibilityRole.SECURITY_ADMIN) {\n      const allowedActions = ['VIEW', 'SECURITY_HOLD', 'REVIEW', 'RESTRICT'];\n      if (allowedActions.includes(action)) return { allowed: true };\n      return { allowed: false, reason: `Security admin cannot perform ${action}` };\n    }\n\n    // Tenant owner can perform all actions within tenant\n    if (role === ClientVisibilityRole.TENANT_OWNER) {\n      try {\n        const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n        if (!account) return { allowed: false, reason: 'Account not found or tenant mismatch' };\n        return { allowed: true };\n      } catch {\n        return { allowed: false, reason: 'Failed to verify tenant ownership' };\n      }\n    }\n\n    // For client/trader/follower/operator, verify ownership\n    try {\n      const isOwner = await this.ownershipService.verifyOwnership({ tenantId, accountId, ownerId: userId });\n      if (!isOwner) {\n        // Also check if user is client profile owner\n        const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n        if (account?.clientProfileId) {\n          const profile = await (this.prisma as any).clientProfile.findFirst({ where: { id: account.clientProfileId, tenantId } });\n          if (profile && profile.externalIdentityRef === userId) {\n            // Client owns profile, allow limited actions\n            const clientAllowedActions = ['VIEW', 'REQUEST_FUNDING', 'REQUEST_WITHDRAWAL', 'VIEW_OWN_FUNDING'];\n            if (clientAllowedActions.includes(action)) return { allowed: true };\n            return { allowed: false, reason: `Client cannot perform privileged action ${action}` };\n          }\n        }\n        return { allowed: false, reason: 'User does not own account' };\n      }\n\n      // Owner can perform most actions except privileged platform actions\n      const privilegedActions = ['APPROVE_ONBOARDING', 'ACTIVATE_LIVE', 'BYPASS_COMPLIANCE', 'BYPASS_RISK', 'BYPASS_SECURITY'];\n      if (privilegedActions.includes(action)) {\n        return { allowed: false, reason: `Owner cannot self-approve privileged action ${action}` };\n      }\n\n      return { allowed: true };\n    } catch (e) {\n      return { allowed: false, reason: `Permission check failed: ${(e as Error).message}` };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async enforcePermission(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    role: ClientVisibilityRole;\n    action: string;\n    isPlatformUser?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const result = await this.canPerformAction(params);\n    if (!result.allowed) {\n      throw new Error(`Permission denied: ${result.reason ?? 'not allowed'}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async listPermissionsForRole(role: ClientVisibilityRole): Promise<string[]> {\n    switch (role) {\n      case ClientVisibilityRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN:\n        return ['*'];\n      case ClientVisibilityRole.TENANT_OWNER:\n        return ['VIEW', 'CREATE', 'UPDATE', 'RESTRICT', 'SUSPEND', 'CLOSE', 'REVIEW', 'FUNDING', 'WITHDRAWAL', 'OWNERSHIP'];\n      case ClientVisibilityRole.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER:\n        return ['VIEW', 'REVIEW', 'RESTRICT', 'COMPLIANCE_HOLD'];\n      case ClientVisibilityRole.SECURITY_ADMIN:\n        return ['VIEW', 'REVIEW', 'RESTRICT', 'SECURITY_HOLD'];\n      case ClientVisibilityRole.CLIENT:\n        return ['VIEW', 'REQUEST_FUNDING', 'REQUEST_WITHDRAWAL', 'VIEW_OWN_FUNDING'];\n      case ClientVisibilityRole.TRADER:\n        return ['VIEW', 'TRADE', 'VIEW_OWN_ACCOUNT'];\n      case ClientVisibilityRole.FOLLOWER:\n        return ['VIEW', 'FOLLOW', 'VIEW_OWN_ACCOUNT'];\n      case ClientVisibilityRole.MANAGED_ACCOUNT_OPERATOR:\n        return ['VIEW', 'OPERATE', 'VIEW_OWN_ACCOUNT'];\n      default:\n        return ['VIEW'];\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/account-restriction.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/account-review.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Must preserve reviewer identity, decision reason, evidence references,\n * and review timestamp. Do not duplicate KYC/AML or risk scoring algorithms. Reference authoritative decisions.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class AccountReviewService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AccountReviewService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly auditService: LifecycleAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createReview(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    clientProfileId?: string | null;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    reviewType: ClientReviewType;\n    reviewerId?: string | null;\n    reason?: string | null;\n    reviewPeriodStart?: Date | null;\n    reviewPeriodEnd?: Date | null;\n    evidenceReferences?: string[];\n    riskSummaryReference?: string | null;\n    complianceSummaryReference?: string | null;\n    securitySummaryReference?: string | null;\n    activitySummary?: any;\n    nextReviewDate?: Date | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, clientProfileId = null, accountId = null, reviewType, reviewerId = null, reason = null, reviewPeriodStart = null, reviewPeriodEnd = null, evidenceReferences = [], riskSummaryReference = null, complianceSummaryReference = null, securitySummaryReference = null, activitySummary = null, nextReviewDate = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    if (!clientProfileId && !accountId) throw new BadRequestException('Either clientProfileId or accountId required');\n\n    if (clientProfileId) {\n      const profile = await (this.prisma as any).clientProfile.findFirst({ where: { id: clientProfileId, tenantId } });\n      if (!profile) throw new BadRequestException('Client profile not found');\n    }\n    if (accountId) {\n      const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n      if (!account) throw new BadRequestException('Account not found');\n    }\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `client-review:${reviewType}`,\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: clientProfileId ?? undefined,\n      accountId: accountId ?? undefined,\n      externalRef: `${reviewType}:${reviewPeriodStart?.toISOString() ?? ''}:${reviewPeriodEnd?.toISOString() ?? ''}`,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).clientReview.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    } catch {}\n\n    const review = await (this.prisma as any).clientReview.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        clientProfileId: clientProfileId ?? null,\n        accountId: accountId ?? null,\n        reviewType: reviewType as any,\n        decision: 'PENDING',\n        reviewerId: reviewerId ?? null,\n        reason: reason ?? null,\n        evidenceReferences: evidenceReferences as any,\n        riskSummaryReference: riskSummaryReference ?? null,\n        complianceSummaryReference: complianceSummaryReference ?? null,\n        securitySummaryReference: securitySummaryReference ?? null,\n        activitySummary: activitySummary ? redactPiiAndSecrets(activitySummary) as any : null,\n        reviewPeriodStart: reviewPeriodStart ?? null,\n        reviewPeriodEnd: reviewPeriodEnd ?? null,\n        nextReviewDate: nextReviewDate ?? null,\n        idempotencyKey,\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: clientProfileId ?? null,\n      accountId: accountId ?? null,\n      action: 'REVIEW_CREATED',\n      entityType: 'CLIENT_REVIEW',\n      entityId: review.id,\n      actorId: reviewerId,\n      toState: 'PENDING',\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { reviewType, reason, evidenceReferences },\n    });\n\n    return review;\n  }\n\n  async decideReview(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    reviewId: string;\n    decision: ClientReviewDecision;\n    reviewerId: string;\n    reason: string;\n    nextReviewDate?: Date | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, reviewId, decision, reviewerId, reason, nextReviewDate = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    if (!reason || reason.trim().length < 5) throw new BadRequestException('Review decision reason required');\n\n    const review = await (this.prisma as any).clientReview.findFirst({ where: { id: reviewId, tenantId } });\n    if (!review) throw new BadRequestException('Review not found');\n\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).clientReview.update({\n      where: { id: reviewId },\n      data: {\n        decision: decision as any,\n        reviewerId,\n        reason,\n        reviewedAt: new Date(),\n        ...(nextReviewDate ? { nextReviewDate } : {}),\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: review.clientProfileId,\n      accountId: review.accountId,\n      action: 'REVIEW_DECIDED',\n      entityType: 'CLIENT_REVIEW',\n      entityId: reviewId,\n      actorId: reviewerId,\n      fromState: review.decision,\n      toState: decision as any,\n      reason,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { decision, reason, reviewerId, riskSummaryReference: review.riskSummaryReference, complianceSummaryReference: review.complianceSummaryReference },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'client.review.decided', reviewId, decision, reviewerId });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async listReviews(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    clientProfileId?: string;\n    accountId?: string;\n    reviewType?: string;\n    decision?: string;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, clientProfileId, accountId, reviewType, decision, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (clientProfileId) where.clientProfileId = clientProfileId;\n    if (accountId) where.accountId = accountId;\n    if (reviewType) where.reviewType = reviewType;\n    if (decision) where.decision = decision;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).clientReview.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as any).clientReview.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/account-state.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. INSTITUTIONAL_ACCOUNT_VALID_TRANSITIONS, InstitutionalAccountState } from './client-lifecycle.types';\n\n/**\n * Enforces explicit account lifecycle transitions such as {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, toState, operatorId = null, reason, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: [];\n    if (!allowed.includes(toState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid account transition ${currentState} → ${toState}`);\n    }\n\n    // Never trust client-supplied account state — server authoritative\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.update({\n      where: { id: accountId },\n      data: {\n        state: toState as any,\n        ...(toState === InstitutionalAccountState.ACTIVE ? Must not silently mutate exchange state.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class AccountSuspensionService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AccountSuspensionService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly accountStateService: AccountStateService,\n    private readonly restrictionService: AccountRestrictionService,\n    private readonly auditService: LifecycleAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async suspendAccount(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    reason: string;\n    reasonCode?: string;\n    source: string;\n 'MANUAL', source, operatorId, effectiveAt = new Date(), affectedCapabilities = ['TRADING', 'WITHDRAWAL'], correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    if (!reason || reason.trim().length < 5) throw new BadRequestException('Suspension reason required');\n\n    const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n    if (!account) throw this.restrictionService.applyRestriction({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId,\n      restrictionType: AccountRestrictionType.ACCOUNT_LOCKED as any,\n      scope: RestrictionScope.ACCOUNT as any,\n      reason: `SUSPENSION: ${reason} [${reasonCode}]`,\n      source,\n      createdBy: operatorId,\n      effectiveAt,\n      correlationId,\n    });\n\n    // Transition account state to SUSPENDED\n    const suspended = await this.accountStateService.transitionAccount({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId,\n      toState: InstitutionalAccountState.SUSPENDED as any,\n      operatorId,\n      reason,\n      correlationId,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: account.clientProfileId,\n      accountId,\n      action: 'ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED',\n      entityType: 'INSTITUTIONAL_ACCOUNT',\n      entityId: accountId,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      fromState: account.state,\n      toState: 'SUSPENDED',\n      reason,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { reasonCode, source, affectedCapabilities, effectiveAt },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'client.account.suspended', tenantId, accountId, reasonCode, source });\n\n    return Any authenticated user of the\n * tenant reaches these routes, so the controller must keep a client inside\n * their own profile and accounts, and derive administrative roles from the\n * verified JWT permissions.\n */\n\nconst TENANT = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';\nconst ALICE = 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa';\nconst BOB = 'bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb';\nconst ADMIN = 'cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc';\n\nconst PROFILES: Record<string, { id: string; tenantId: string; externalIdentityRef: string }> = {\n  'cp-alice': { id: 'cp-alice', tenantId: TENANT, externalIdentityRef: ALICE },\n  'cp-bob': { id: 'cp-bob', tenantId: TENANT, externalIdentityRef: BOB },\n};\n\nconst ACCOUNTS: Record<string, { id: string; tenantId: string; clientProfileId: string; ownerId: string | null }> = {\n  'acc-alice': { id: 'acc-alice', tenantId: TENANT, clientProfileId: 'cp-alice', ownerId: null },\n  'acc-bob': { id: 'acc-bob', tenantId: TENANT, clientProfileId: 'cp-bob', ownerId: null },\n};\n\nfunction serviceMock(): any {\n  const target: Record<string | symbol, jest.Mock> = {};\n  return new Proxy(target, {\n    get: (store, key) => {\n      if (!store[key]) store[key] = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ id: 'result', data: [], total: 0, page: 1, limit: 50 });\n      return store[key];\n    },\n  });\n}\n\nfunction client(userId: string) {\n  return { user: { userId, tenantId: TENANT, permissions: [Permission.PORTFOLIO_READ], roles: ['FOLLOWER'] }, headers: {} };\n}\n\nfunction tenantAdmin() {\n  return { user: { userId: ADMIN, tenantId: TENANT, permissions: [Permission.TENANT_UPDATE, Permission.USER_UPDATE], roles: ['TENANT_ADMIN'] }, headers: {} };\n}\n\nfunction compliance() {\n  return { user: { userId: ADMIN, tenantId: TENANT, permissions: [Permission.KYC_READ, Permission.KYC_REVIEW], roles: ['COMPLIANCE'] }, headers: {} };\n}\n\ndescribe('ClientLifecycleController authorization', () => {\n  let prisma: any;\n  let services: Record<string, any>;\n  let controller: ClientLifecycleController;\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    prisma = {\n      accountOwnership: { findMany: jest.fn(async () => []) },\n      institutionalAccount: {\n        findMany: jest.fn(async ({ where }: any) =>\n          Object.values(ACCOUNTS).filter(\n            (a) =>\n              a.tenantId === where.tenantId &&\n              (where.OR ?? []).some(\n                (c: any) => (c.ownerId && a.ownerId === c.ownerId) || (c.clientProfileId?.in && c.clientProfileId.in.includes(a.clientProfileId)),\n              ),\n          ),\n        ),\n      },\n      clientOnboarding: {\n        findMany: jest.fn(async () => []),\n        count: jest.fn(async () => 0),\n      },\n    };\n    const names = [\n      'profileService', 'onboardingService', 'workflowService', 'accountStateService', 'ownershipService', 'permissionService',\n      'tradingActivationService', 'restrictionService', 'suspensionService', 'closureService', 'exchangeBindingService',\n      'portfolioBindingService', 'fundingRequestService', 'withdrawalRequestService', 'fundingApprovalService',\n      'fundingReconciliationService', 'reviewService', 'relationshipService', 'notificationService', 'auditService', 'reconciliationService',\n    ];\n    services = {};\n    for (const name of names) services[name] = serviceMock();\n    services.profileRepo = { getProfile: jest.fn(async ({ profileId }: any) => PROFILES[profileId] ?? null) };\n    services.accountAdminService = serviceMock();\n    services.accountAdminService.getAccount.mockImplementation(async ({ accountId }: any) => ACCOUNTS[accountId] ?? null);\n    services.visibilityService = {\n      resolveVisibleClientProfiles: jest.fn(async ({ userId, role }: any) =>\n        role === ClientVisibilityRole.CLIENT\n          ? Object.values(PROFILES)\n              .filter((p) => p.externalIdentityRef === userId)\n              .map((p) => ({ clientProfileId: p.id }))\n          : [],\n      ),\n      canViewClientProfile: jest.fn(async () => false),\n      canViewAccount: jest.fn(async () => false),\n    };\n    controller = new ClientLifecycleController(\n      prisma,\n      services.profileService,\n      services.profileRepo,\n      services.onboardingService,\n      services.workflowService,\n      services.accountAdminService,\n      services.accountStateService,\n      services.ownershipService,\n      services.permissionService,\n      services.tradingActivationService,\n      services.restrictionService,\n      services.suspensionService,\n      services.closureService,\n      services.exchangeBindingService,\n      services.portfolioBindingService,\n      services.fundingRequestService,\n      services.withdrawalRequestService,\n      services.fundingApprovalService,\n      services.fundingReconciliationService,\n      services.reviewService,\n      services.relationshipService,\n      services.notificationService,\n      services.auditService,\n      services.reconciliationService,\n      services.visibilityService,\n    );\n  });\n\n  describe('onboarding (KYC)', () => {\n    it(\"hides another client's onboarding record\", async () => {\n      services.onboardingService.getOnboarding.mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'ob-bob', clientProfileId: 'cp-bob' });\n      await expect(controller.getOnboarding(client(ALICE), 'ob-bob')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n      await expect(controller.getOnboardingByClient(client(ALICE), 'cp-bob')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n      await expect(controller.initiateOnboarding(client(ALICE), 'cp-bob')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n      expect(services.onboardingService.initiateOnboarding).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    });\n\n    it('lets a client read and start their own onboarding', async () => {\n      services.onboardingService.getOnboarding.mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'ob-alice', clientProfileId: 'cp-alice' });\n      await expect(controller.getOnboarding(client(ALICE), 'ob-alice')).resolves.toBeDefined();\n      await expect(controller.initiateOnboarding(client(ALICE), 'cp-alice')).resolves.toBeDefined();\n    });\n\n    it(\"restricts a client's onboarding list to their own profiles\", async () => {\n      await controller.listOnboardings(client(ALICE), {} as any);\n      expect(prisma.clientOnboarding.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n        expect.objectContaining({ where: expect.objectContaining({ clientProfileId: { in: ['cp-alice'] } }) }),\n      );\n      await expect(controller.listOnboardings(client(ALICE), { clientProfileId: 'cp-bob' } as any)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n    });\n\n    it('keeps the tenant-wide onboarding list for compliance', async () => {\n      await controller.listOnboardings(compliance(), {} as any);\n      expect(prisma.clientOnboarding.findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ where: { tenantId: TENANT } }));\n    });\n\n    it('lets a tenant administrator approve onboarding and never a client', async () => {\n      await expect(controller.approveOnboarding(client(ALICE), 'ob-bob')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ForbiddenException);\n      services.onboardingService.getOnboarding.mockResolvedValueOnce(null);\n      await expect(controller.approveOnboarding(tenantAdmin(), 'ob-bob')).resolves.toBeDefined();\n      expect(services.onboardingService.approveOnboarding).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ isSelfApproval: false }));\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('money requests', () => {\n    const request = { requestedAmount: '100', currency: 'USDT' };\n\n    it(\"rejects a withdrawal or funding request against another client's account\", async () => {\n      await expect(controller.createWithdrawal(client(ALICE), { ...request, accountId: 'acc-bob' } as any)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(\n        NotFoundException,\n      );\n      await expect(controller.createFunding(client(ALICE), { ...request, accountId: 'acc-bob' } as any)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n      expect(services.withdrawalRequestService.createWithdrawalRequest).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n      expect(services.fundingRequestService.createFundingRequest).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    });\n\n    it(\"rejects attributing an own-account request to another client's profile\", async () => {\n      await expect(\n        controller.createWithdrawal(client(ALICE), { ...request, accountId: from './account-restriction.service';\nimport { AccountSuspensionService } from './account-suspension.service';\nimport { AccountClosureService } from './account-closure.service';\nimport { CancelClosureDto,\n  BindExchangeAccountDto,\n  UnbindExchangeAccountDto,\n  BindPortfolioDto,\n  UnbindPortfolioDto,\n  CreateOwnershipDto,\n  CreateRelationshipDto,\n  CreateReviewDto,\n FundingRequestQueryDto,\n  WithdrawalRequestQueryDto,\n  RelationshipQueryDto,\n  RestrictionQueryDto,\n  ReviewQueryDto,\n  LifecycleAuditQueryDto,\n  OnboardingQueryDto,\n} from './dto/client-query.dto';\nimport { redactPiiAndSecrets, InstitutionalAccountState } from './client-lifecycle.types';\nimport { authTenantId, authUserIdOrNull, isPlatformPrincipal } from '../../common/guards/request-principal';\nimport { Permission, hasAnyPermission, hasPermission } from '@wlct/shared-types';\n\n/**\n * Tenant-safe and platform-safe API surface exposing client profiles, onboarding, accounts,\n * ownership, restrictions, reviews, funding workflows, withdrawal workflows, lifecycle status,\n * and controlled actions. Enforce existing RBAC, ownership, compliance visibility, and tenant isolation.\n */\n\n@Controller('client-lifecycle')\nexport class ClientLifecycleController {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly profileService: ClientProfileService,\n    private readonly profileRepo: ClientProfileRepository,\n    private readonly onboardingService: ClientOnboardingService,\n    private readonly workflowService: OnboardingWorkflowService,\n    private readonly accountAdminService: AccountAdministrationService,\n    private readonly accountStateService: AccountStateService,\n    private readonly ownershipService: AccountOwnershipService,\n    private readonly permissionService: AccountPermissionService,\n    private readonly tradingActivationService: TradingActivationService,\n    private readonly restrictionService: AccountRestrictionService,\n    private readonly suspensionService: AccountSuspensionService,\n    private readonly closureService: AccountClosureService,\n    private readonly exchangeBindingService: ExchangeAccountBindingService,\n    private readonly portfolioBindingService: PortfolioBindingService,\n    private readonly fundingRequestService: FundingRequestService,\n    private readonly withdrawalRequestService: WithdrawalRequestService,\n    private readonly fundingApprovalService: FundingApprovalService,\n    private readonly fundingReconciliationService: FundingReconciliationService,\n    private readonly reviewService: AccountReviewService,\n    private readonly relationshipService: RelationshipService,\n    private readonly notificationService: LifecycleNotificationService,\n    private readonly auditService: LifecycleAuditService,\n    private readonly reconciliationService: LifecycleReconciliationService,\n    private readonly visibilityService: ClientVisibilityService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private getTenantId(req: any): string {\n    // Token tenant only; headers and query strings can never select it.\n    return authTenantId(req);\n  }\n\n  private getUserId(req: any): string {\n    // The JWT principal carries `userId` (not `id`/`sub`); reading only the\n    // legacy keys attributed every action to 'anonymous'.\n    return authUserIdOrNull(req) ?? 'anonymous';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Derived from the verified JWT permissions. The token never carries a\n   * `clientRole`/`role` claim, so reading those always produced CLIENT and a\n   * tenant administrator could never act, while any value a client managed to\n   * place there would have been trusted.\n   */\n  private getUserRole(req: any): ClientVisibilityRole {\n    if (this.isPlatformUser(req)) return ClientVisibilityRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN;\n    const permissions: string[] = Array.isArray(req?.user?.permissions) ? req.user.permissions : [];\n    if (hasPermission(permissions, Permission.TENANT_UPDATE)) return ClientVisibilityRole.TENANT_OWNER;\n    if (hasAnyPermission(permissions, [Permission.KYC_REVIEW, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ])) return ClientVisibilityRole.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER;\n    return ClientVisibilityRole.CLIENT;\n  }\n\n  /** Platform staff, tenant owner and compliance see every client of the tenant. */\n  private isTenantWide(req: any): boolean {\n    const role = this.getUserRole(req);\n    return (\n      role === ClientVisibilityRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN ||\n      role === ClientVisibilityRole.TENANT_OWNER ||\n      role === ClientVisibilityRole.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER ||\n      role === ClientVisibilityRole.SECURITY_ADMIN\n    );\n  }\n\n  /** Client profiles and institutional accounts that belong to the caller. */\n  private async ownScope(req: any, tenantId: string): Promise<{ userId: string | null; profileIds: Set<string>; accountIds: Set<string> }> {\n    const userId = authUserIdOrNull(req);\n    const profileIds = new Set<string>();\n    const accountIds = new Set<string>();\n    if (!userId) return { userId, profileIds, accountIds };\n    for (const role of [ClientVisibilityRole.CLIENT, ClientVisibilityRole.FOLLOWER]) {\n      const visible = await this.visibilityService.resolveVisibleClientProfiles({ tenantId, userId, role, isPlatformUser: false });\n      for (const entry of visible) profileIds.add(entry.clientProfileId);\n    }\n    try {\n      const ownerships = await (this.prisma as any).accountOwnership.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, ownerId: userId, status: 'ACTIVE' },\n        select: { accountId: true },\n      });\n      for (const ownership of ownerships) accountIds.add(ownership.accountId);\n      const accounts = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, OR: [{ ownerId: userId }, ...(profileIds.size > 0 ? [{ clientProfileId: { in: [...profileIds] } }] : [])] },\n        select: { id: true },\n      });\n      for (const account of accounts) accountIds.add(account.id);\n    } catch {\n      // Without ownership data the caller keeps only the profile scope.\n    }\n    return { userId, profileIds, accountIds };\n  }\n\n  private inOwnScope(scope: { profileIds: Set<string>; accountIds: Set<string> }, item: any): boolean {\n    return Boolean(\n      (item?.clientProfileId && scope.profileIds.has(item.clientProfileId)) || (item?.accountId && scope.accountIds.has(item.accountId)),\n    );\n  }\n\n  /** Non-tenant-wide callers only get their own rows, and the total never counts other clients. */\n  private async restrictToOwnScope<T extends { data: any[]; total?: number }>(\n    req: any,\n    tenantId: string,\n    result: T,\n    extra?: (item: any, scope: { userId: string | null; profileIds: Set<string>; accountIds: Set<string> }) => boolean,\n  ): Promise<T> {\n    if (this.isTenantWide(req)) return result;\n    const scope = await this.ownScope(req, tenantId);\n    const data = result.data.filter((item: any) => this.inOwnScope(scope, item) || (extra ? extra(item, scope) : false));\n    return { ...result, data, total: data.length };\n  }\n\n  private async assertClientProfileAccess(req: any, tenantId: string, profileId: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.enforceTenantIsolationForProfile(tenantId, profileId);\n    if (this.isTenantWide(req)) return;\n    const scope = await this.ownScope(req, tenantId);\n    if (!scope.profileIds.has(profileId)) throw new NotFoundException('Client profile not found');\n  }\n\n  private async assertAccountAccess(req: any, tenantId: string, accountId: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.enforceTenantIsolationForAccount(tenantId, accountId);\n    if (this.isTenantWide(req)) return;\n    const scope = await this.ownScope(req, tenantId);\n    if (!scope.accountIds.has(accountId)) throw new NotFoundException('Account not found');\n  }\n\n  private isPlatformUser(req: any): boolean {\n    return isPlatformPrincipal(req);\n  }\n\n  private isSelfApproval(req: any, targetUserId?: string): boolean {\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n    if (!targetUserId) return false;\n    return userId === targetUserId;\n  }\n\n  private async enforceTenantIsolationForProfile(tenantId: string, profileId: string): Promise<void> {\n    const profile = await this.profileRepo.getProfile({ tenantId, profileId });\n    if (!profile) throw new BadRequestException('Client profile not found or tenant mismatch');\n    if (profile.tenantId !== tenantId) throw new ForbiddenException('Tenant isolation: profile belongs to different tenant');\n  }\n\n  private async enforceTenantIsolationForAccount(tenantId: string, accountId: string): Promise<void> {\n    const account = await this.accountAdminService.getAccount({ tenantId, accountId });\n    if (!account) throw new BadRequestException('Account not found or tenant mismatch');\n    if (account.tenantId !== tenantId) throw new ForbiddenException('Tenant isolation: account belongs to different tenant');\n  }\n\n  private async enforcePlatformRBAC(req: any, requiredPermission?: string): Promise<void> {\n    if (requiredPermission && this.isPlatformUser(req)) {\n      // Platform RBAC check — reuse existing RBAC if available\n      return;\n    }\n    // For platform-level client/account administration requires existing platform RBAC\n    if (requiredPermission === 'PLATFORM_MANAGE' && !this.isPlatformUser(req)) {\n      // Allow tenant owner for some operations, but platform-only for others\n      const role = this.getUserRole(req);\n      if (role !== ClientVisibilityRole.TENANT_OWNER && role !== ClientVisibilityRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN) {\n        throw new ForbiddenException('Platform operation requires platform RBAC');\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Client Profiles\n  @Post('clients')\n  async createClient(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: CreateClientProfileDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n    if (dto.externalIdentityRef !== authUserIdOrNull(req)) await this.enforcePlatformRBAC(req, 'PLATFORM_MANAGE');\n\n    const profile = await this.profileService.createProfile({\n      tenantId,\n      clientType: dto.clientType,\n      legalName: dto.legalName,\n      displayName: dto.displayName,\n      email: dto.email,\n      phone: dto.phone,\n      countryCode: dto.countryCode,\n      externalIdentityRef: dto.externalIdentityRef,\n      operatorId: userId,\n      correlationId: req.headers['x-correlation-id'] ?? null,\n    });\n\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(profile);\n  }\n\n  @Get('clients')\n  async listClients(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: ClientProfileQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n    const role = this.getUserRole(req);\n    const isPlatform = this.isPlatformUser(req);\n\n    const result = await this.profileService.listProfiles({\n      tenantId,\n      status: query.status,\n      clientType: query.clientType,\n      search: query.search,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n\n    // Visibility enforcement — client must never be able to view another client's profile\n    if (!isPlatform && role === ClientVisibilityRole.CLIENT) {\n      const visible = await this.visibilityService.resolveVisibleClientProfiles({ tenantId, userId, role, isPlatformUser: isPlatform });\n      const visibleIds = new Set(visible.map((v) => v.clientProfileId));\n      result.data = result.data.filter((p: any) => visibleIds.has(p.id));\n      result.total = result.data.length;\n    }\n\n    return { ...result, data: result.data.map((d: any) => redactPiiAndSecrets(d)) };\n  }\n\n  @Get('clients/:profileId')\n  async getClient(@Req() req: any, @Param('profileId') profileId: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n    const role = this.getUserRole(req);\n    const isPlatform = this.isPlatformUser(req);\n\n    await this.enforceTenantIsolationForProfile(tenantId, profileId);\n\n    const canView = await this.visibilityService.canViewClientProfile({ tenantId, userId, clientProfileId: profileId, role, isPlatformUser: isPlatform });\n    if (!canView && !isPlatform && role !== ClientVisibilityRole.TENANT_OWNER && role !== ClientVisibilityRole.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER && role !== ClientVisibilityRole.SECURITY_ADMIN) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Access denied to client profile');\n    }\n\n    const profile = await this.profileService.getProfile({ tenantId, profileId });\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(profile);\n  }\n\n  // Onboarding\n  @Post('clients/:profileId/onboarding')\n  async initiateOnboarding(@Req() req: any, @Param('profileId') profileId: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    await this.assertClientProfileAccess(req, tenantId, profileId);\n\n    const onboarding = await this.onboardingService.initiateOnboarding({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: profileId,\n      operatorId: this.getUserId(req),\n      correlationId: req.headers['x-correlation-id'] ?? null,\n    });\n\n    await this.notificationService.notifyOnboardingStarted({ tenantId, clientProfileId: profileId, onboardingId: onboarding.id });\n\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(onboarding);\n  }\n\n  @Get('onboarding/:onboardingId')\n  async getOnboarding(@Req() req: any, @Param('onboardingId') onboardingId: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const onboarding = await this.onboardingService.getOnboarding({ tenantId, onboardingId });\n    if (!onboarding) throw new BadRequestException('Onboarding not found');\n    await this.assertClientProfileAccess(req, tenantId, onboarding.clientProfileId);\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(onboarding);\n  }\n\n  @Get('clients/:profileId/onboarding')\n  async getOnboardingByClient(@Req() req: any, @Param('profileId') profileId: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    await this.assertClientProfileAccess(req, tenantId, profileId);\n    const onboarding = await this.onboardingService.getOnboardingByClientProfile({ tenantId, clientProfileId: profileId });\n    return onboarding ? redactPiiAndSecrets(onboarding) : null;\n  }\n\n  @Post('onboarding/:onboardingId/approve')\n  async approveOnboarding(@Req() req: any, @Param('onboardingId') onboardingId: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n    const role = this.getUserRole(req);\n\n    // Never allow a client to self-approve a privileged workflow\n    const isSelf = role === ClientVisibilityRole.CLIENT;\n    if (isSelf) throw new ForbiddenException('Client cannot self-approve onboarding');\n\n    await this.enforcePlatformRBAC(req, 'PLATFORM_MANAGE');\n\n    const approved = await this.onboardingService.approveOnboarding({\n      tenantId,\n      onboardingId,\n      operatorId: userId,\n      isSelfApproval: isSelf,\n      correlationId: req.headers['x-correlation-id'] ?? null,\n    });\n\n    const onboarding = await this.onboardingService.getOnboarding({ tenantId, onboardingId });\n    if (onboarding) {\n      await this.notificationService.notifyOnboardingApproved({ tenantId, clientProfileId: onboarding.clientProfileId, onboardingId });\n    }\n\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(approved);\n  }\n\n  @Post('onboarding/:onboardingId/reject')\n  async rejectOnboarding(@Req() req: any, @Param('onboardingId') onboardingId: string, @Body() body: { reason: string }) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n\n    await this.enforcePlatformRBAC(req, 'PLATFORM_MANAGE');\n\n    const rejected = await this.onboardingService.rejectOnboarding({\n      tenantId,\n      onboardingId,\n      operatorId: userId,\n      reason: body.reason,\n      correlationId: req.headers['x-correlation-id'] ?? null,\n    });\n\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(rejected);\n  }\n\n  @Get('onboarding')\n  async listOnboardings(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: OnboardingQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (query.clientProfileId) where.clientProfileId = query.clientProfileId;\n    if (!this.isTenantWide(req)) {\n      const scope = await this.ownScope(req, tenantId);\n      if (query.clientProfileId && !scope.profileIds.has(query.clientProfileId)) throw new NotFoundException('Client profile not found');\n      if (!query.clientProfileId) where.clientProfileId = { in: [...scope.profileIds] };\n    }\n    if (query.state) where.state = query.state;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        skip: ((query.page ?? 1) - 1) * (query.limit ?? 50),\n        take: query.limit ?? 50,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data: data.map((d: any) => redactPiiAndSecrets(d)), total, page: query.page ?? 1, limit: query.limit ?? 50 };\n  }\n\n  // Institutional Accounts\n  @Post('accounts')\n  async createAccount(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: CreateInstitutionalAccountDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    await this.enforceTenantIsolationForProfile(tenantId, dto.clientProfileId);\n    await this.enforcePlatformRBAC(req, 'PLATFORM_MANAGE');\n\n    const account = await this.accountAdminService.createAccount({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: dto.clientProfileId,\n      accountType: dto.accountType,\n      displayName: dto.displayName,\n      ownerId: dto.ownerId,\n      ownerType: dto.ownerType,\n      operatorId: this.getUserId(req),\n      correlationId: req.headers['x-correlation-id'] ?? null,\n    });\n\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(account);\n  }\n\n  @Get('accounts')\n  async listAccounts(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: InstitutionalAccountQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n    const role = this.getUserRole(req);\n    const isPlatform = this.isPlatformUser(req);\n\n    const result = await this.accountAdminService.listAccounts({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: query.clientProfileId,\n      state: query.state,\n      accountType: query.accountType,\n      ownerId: query.ownerId,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n\n    if (!isPlatform && role === ClientVisibilityRole.CLIENT) {\n      const visibleProfiles = await this.visibilityService.resolveVisibleClientProfiles({ tenantId, userId, role, isPlatformUser: isPlatform });\n      const visibleIds = new Set(visibleProfiles.map((v) => v.clientProfileId));\n      const scope = await this.ownScope(req, tenantId);\n      result.data = result.data.filter((a: any) => visibleIds.has(a.clientProfileId) || scope.accountIds.has(a.id));\n      result.total = result.data.length;\n    }\n\n    return { ...result, data: result.data.map((d: any) => redactPiiAndSecrets(d)) };\n  }\n\n  @Get('accounts/:accountId')\n  async getAccount(@Req() req: any, @Param('accountId') accountId: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n source: dto.source,\n      createdBy: this.getUserId(req),\n      effectiveAt: dto.effectiveAt ? new Date(dto.effectiveAt) : new Date(),\n      expiresAt: dto.expiresAt ? new Date(dto.expiresAt) : const funding = await this.fundingRequestService.createFundingRequest({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: dto.accountId,\n      clientProfileId: dto.clientProfileId ?? null,\n      requestedAmount: dto.requestedAmount,\n      currency: dto.currency,\n      externalReference: dto.externalReference ?? null,\n      sourceType: dto.sourceType ?? null,\n      requestedBy: this.getUserId(req),\n async listFunding(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: FundingRequestQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n    const role = this.getUserRole(req);\n    const isPlatform = this.isPlatformUser(req);\n\n    if (query.accountId) await this.assertAccountAccess(req, tenantId, query.accountId);\n    if (query.clientProfileId) await this.assertClientProfileAccess(req, tenantId, query.clientProfileId);\n\n    const result = await this.fundingRequestService.listFundingRequests({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: query.accountId,\n      clientProfileId: query.clientProfileId,\n      state: query.state,\n      currency: query.currency,\n      externalReference: query.externalReference,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n\n    // Client cannot access another client's funding data\n    if (!isPlatform && role === ClientVisibilityRole.CLIENT) {\n      const visibleProfiles = await this.visibilityService.resolveVisibleClientProfiles({ tenantId, userId, role, isPlatformUser: isPlatform });\n      const visibleIds = new Set(visibleProfiles.map((v) => v.clientProfileId));\n      const scope = await this.ownScope(req, tenantId);\n      result.data = result.data.filter((f: any) => visibleIds.has(f.clientProfileId) || scope.accountIds.has(f.accountId));\n      result.total = result.data.length;\n    }\n\n    return { ...result, data: result.data.map((d: any) => redactPiiAndSecrets(d)) };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * One funding request of the caller's tenant. Platform staff, the tenant\n   * owner and compliance see any request of the tenant; every other caller\n   * sees only a request on their own account or client profile (the same rule\n   * as the list). A request outside that scope is reported exactly like a\n   * missing one, so ids of other clients' requests cannot be probed.\n   */\n  @Get('funding/:fundingRequestId')\n  async getFunding(@Req() req: any, @Param('fundingRequestId') fundingRequestId: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const funding = await this.fundingRequestService.getFundingRequest({ tenantId, fundingRequestId });\n    if (!funding) throw new NotFoundException('Funding request not found');\n    if (!this.isTenantWide(req)) {\n      const scope = await this.ownScope(req, tenantId);\n      if (!this.inOwnScope(scope, funding)) throw new NotFoundException('Funding request not found');\n    }\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(funding);\n  }\n\n  @Post('funding/transition')\n  async transitionFunding(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: TransitionFundingRequestDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    await this.enforcePlatformRBAC(req, 'PLATFORM_MANAGE');\n\n    const updated = await this.fundingRequestService.transitionFundingRequest({\n      tenantId,\n      fundingRequestId: dto.fundingRequestId,\n      toState: dto.toState as any,\n      operatorId: this.getUserId(req),\n      reason: dto.reason,\n      approvedAmount: dto.approvedAmount ?? null,\n      submittedAmount: dto.submittedAmount ?? null,\n      confirmedAmount: dto.confirmedAmount ?? null,\n      settledAmount: dto.settledAmount ?? null,\n      externalReference: dto.externalReference ?? null,\n      correlationId: req.headers['x-correlation-id'] ?? null,\n    });\n\n    if (dto.toState === 'CONFIRMED') {\n      await this.notificationService.notifyFundingConfirmed({\n        tenantId,\n        accountId: updated.accountId,\n        fundingRequestId: updated.id,\n        confirmedAmount: dto.confirmedAmount ?? updated.confirmedAmount ?? updated.requestedAmount,\n        currency: updated.currency,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(updated);\n  }\n\n  // Withdrawals\n  @Post('withdrawals')\n  async createWithdrawal(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: CreateWithdrawalRequestDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    await this.assertAccountAccess(req, tenantId, dto.accountId);\n    if (dto.clientProfileId) await this.assertClientProfileAccess(req, tenantId, dto.clientProfileId);\n\n    const withdrawal = await this.withdrawalRequestService.createWithdrawalRequest({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: dto.accountId,\n      clientProfileId: dto.clientProfileId ?? null,\n      requestedAmount: dto.requestedAmount,\n      currency: dto.currency,\n      destinationAddress: dto.destinationAddress ?? null,\n      destinationType: dto.destinationType ?? null,\n      externalReference: dto.externalReference ?? null,\n      requestedBy: this.getUserId(req),\n      correlationId: req.headers['x-correlation-id'] ?? null,\n      metadata: dto.metadata,\n    });\n\n    await this.notificationService.notifyWithdrawalRequested({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: dto.accountId,\n      withdrawalRequestId: withdrawal.id,\n      amount: dto.requestedAmount,\n      currency: dto.currency,\n    });\n\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(withdrawal);\n  }\n\n  @Get('withdrawals')\n  async listWithdrawals(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: WithdrawalRequestQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n    const role = this.getUserRole(req);\n    const isPlatform = this.isPlatformUser(req);\n\n    if (query.accountId) await this.assertAccountAccess(req, tenantId, query.accountId);\n    if (query.clientProfileId) await this.assertClientProfileAccess(req, tenantId, query.clientProfileId);\n\n    const result = await this.withdrawalRequestService.listWithdrawalRequests({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: query.accountId,\n      clientProfileId: query.clientProfileId,\n      state: query.state,\n      currency: query.currency,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n\n    if (!isPlatform && role === ClientVisibilityRole.CLIENT) {\n      const visibleProfiles = await this.visibilityService.resolveVisibleClientProfiles({ tenantId, userId, role, isPlatformUser: isPlatform });\n      const visibleIds = new Set(visibleProfiles.map((v) => v.clientProfileId));\n      const scope = await this.ownScope(req, tenantId);\n      result.data = result.data.filter((w: any) => visibleIds.has(w.clientProfileId) || scope.accountIds.has(w.accountId));\n      result.total = result.data.length;\n    }\n\n    return { ...result, data: result.data.map((d: any) => redactPiiAndSecrets(d)) };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * One withdrawal request of the caller's tenant. Same rule as\n   * `GET funding/:fundingRequestId`: platform staff, the tenant owner and\n   * compliance see any request of the tenant; every other caller sees only a\n   * request on their own account or client profile. A request outside that\n   * scope is reported exactly like a missing one, so ids of other clients'\n   * withdrawals cannot be probed. The destination is redacted like the list.\n   */\n  @Get('withdrawals/:withdrawalRequestId')\n  async getWithdrawal(@Req() req: any, @Param('withdrawalRequestId') withdrawalRequestId: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const withdrawal = await this.withdrawalRequestService.getWithdrawalRequest({ tenantId, withdrawalRequestId });\n    if (!withdrawal) throw new NotFoundException('Withdrawal request not found');\n    if (!this.isTenantWide(req)) {\n      const scope = await this.ownScope(req, tenantId);\n      if (!this.inOwnScope(scope, withdrawal)) throw new NotFoundException('Withdrawal request not found');\n    }\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(withdrawal);\n  }\n\n  @Post('withdrawals/transition')\n  async transitionWithdrawal(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: TransitionWithdrawalRequestDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    await this.enforcePlatformRBAC(req, 'PLATFORM_MANAGE');\n\n    const updated = await this.withdrawalRequestService.transitionWithdrawalRequest({\n      tenantId,\n      withdrawalRequestId: dto.withdrawalRequestId,\n      toState: dto.toState as any,\n      operatorId: this.getUserId(req),\n      reason: dto.reason,\n      approvedAmount: dto.approvedAmount ?? null,\n      confirmedAmount: dto.confirmedAmount ?? null,\n      externalReference: dto.externalReference ?? null,\n      correlationId: req.headers['x-correlation-id'] ?? null,\n    });\n\n    return redactPiiAndSecrets(updated);\n  }\n\n  // Approvals\n  @Post('funding/approve')\n  async approveFunding(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: ApproveFundingDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n    const role = this.getUserRole(req);\n    const isSelf = role === ClientVisibilityRole.CLIENT;\n\n    await this.enforcePlatformRBAC(req, 'PLATFORM_MANAGE');\n\n    const approval = await this.fundingApprovalService.approveFundingRequest({\n      tenantId,\n      fundingRequestId: dto.fundingRequestId ?? try {\n      const existingByKey = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existingByKey) return existingByKey;\n    } catch {}\n\n    const onboarding = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        clientProfileId,\n        state: 'IN_PROGRESS',\n        requiredSteps: [\n          'ACCOUNT_CONFIGURATION',\n          'APPROVAL',\n          'ACTIVATION_ELIGIBILITY',\n        ],\n        completedSteps: ['PROFILE_CREATED'],\n        initiatedBy: operatorId,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        startedAt: new Date(),\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Create steps\n    await this.workflowService.initializeSteps({ tenantId, onboardingId: onboarding.id });\n\n    await correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, onboardingId, operatorId, isSelfApproval = false, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    // Never allow a client to '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\n\n/**\n * Resolves tenant-owner, client, trader, follower, managed-account operator, compliance reviewer,\n * security administrator, and platform-admin visibility using existing IAM/RBAC and ownership rules.\n * A client must never be able to view another client's profile, account, funding requests, etc.\n */\n\nexport enum ClientVisibilityRole {\n  CLIENT = 'CLIENT',\n  TENANT_OWNER = 'TENANT_OWNER',\n  TRADER = 'TRADER',\n  FOLLOWER = 'FOLLOWER',\n  MANAGED_ACCOUNT_OPERATOR = 'MANAGED_ACCOUNT_OPERATOR',\n  COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER = 'COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER',\n  SECURITY_ADMIN = 'SECURITY_ADMIN',\n  PLATFORM_ADMIN = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN',\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class ClientVisibilityService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ClientVisibilityService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async resolveVisibleClientProfiles(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    role: ClientVisibilityRole;\n    isPlatformUser?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<Array<{ clientProfileId: string }>> {\n    const { tenantId, userId, role, isPlatformUser = false } = params;\n\n    // Platform admin can view all profiles in tenant with audit\n    if (isPlatformUser && role === ClientVisibilityRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN) {\n      const profiles = await (this.prisma as any).clientProfile.findMany({ where: { tenantId } });\n      return profiles.map((p: any) => ({ clientProfileId: p.id }));\n    }\n\n    // Compliance reviewer and security admin can view all profiles for compliance/security purposes\n    if (role === ClientVisibilityRole.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER || role === ClientVisibilityRole.SECURITY_ADMIN) {\n      const profiles = await (this.prisma as any).clientProfile.findMany({ where: { tenantId } });\n      return profiles.map((p: any) => ({ clientProfileId: p.id }));\n    }\n\n    // Tenant owner can view all profiles in tenant\n    if (role === ClientVisibilityRole.TENANT_OWNER) {\n      const profiles = await (this.prisma as any).clientProfile.findMany({ where: { tenantId } });\n      return profiles.map((p: any) => ({ clientProfileId: p.id }));\n    }\n\n    // Client can view own profile only — based on externalIdentityRef or ownership\n    if (role === ClientVisibilityRole.CLIENT) {\n      const profiles = await (this.prisma as any).clientProfile.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, OR: [{ externalIdentityRef: userId }, { id: userId }] },\n      });\n      return profiles.map((p: any) => ({ clientProfileId: p.id }));\n    }\n\n    // Trader, follower, managed-account operator — view profiles they are related to via relationships\n    if ([ClientVisibilityRole.TRADER, ClientVisibilityRole.FOLLOWER, ClientVisibilityRole.MANAGED_ACCOUNT_OPERATOR].includes(role)) {\n      const relationships = await (this.prisma as any).accountRelationship.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, OR: [{ sourceId: userId }, { targetId: userId }], status: 'ACTIVE' },\n      });\n      const profileIds = new Set<string>();\n      for (const rel of relationships) {\n        if (rel.clientProfileId) profileIds.add(rel.clientProfileId);\n      }\n      // Also check ownership\n      const ownerships = await (this.prisma as any).accountOwnership.findMany({ where: { tenantId, ownerId: userId, status: 'ACTIVE' } });\n      for (const own of ownerships) {\n        if (own.clientProfileId) profileIds.add(own.clientProfileId);\n      }\n      return Array.from(profileIds).map((id) => ({ clientProfileId: id }));\n    }\n\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  async canViewClientProfile(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    clientProfileId: string;\n    role: ClientVisibilityRole;\n    isPlatformUser?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<boolean> {\n    const visible = await this.resolveVisibleClientProfiles({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: params.userId,\n      role: params.role,\n      isPlatformUser: params.isPlatformUser,\n    });\n    return visible.some((v) => v.clientProfileId === params.clientProfileId);\n  }\n\n  async canViewAccount(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    role: ClientVisibilityRole;\n    isPlatformUser?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<boolean> {\n    const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: params.accountId, tenantId: params.tenantId } });\n    if (!account) return false;\n\n    if (params.isPlatformUser && params.role === ClientVisibilityRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN) return true;\n    if (params.role === ClientVisibilityRole.TENANT_OWNER) return true;\n    if (params.role === ClientVisibilityRole.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER || params.role === ClientVisibilityRole.SECURITY_ADMIN) return true;\n\n    // Check if user's client profile owns account\n    if (account.clientProfileId) {\n      return await this.canViewClientProfile({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        userId: params.userId,\n        clientProfileId: account.clientProfileId,\n        role: params.role,\n        isPlatformUser: params.isPlatformUser,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Check ownership\n    const ownership = await (this.prisma as any).accountOwnership.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, accountId: params.accountId, ownerId: params.userId, status: 'ACTIVE' },\n    });\n    return !!ownership;\n  }\n\n  async canViewFundingRequest(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    fundingRequestId: string;\n    role: ClientVisibilityRole;\n    isPlatformUser?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<boolean> {\n    const fr = await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: params.fundingRequestId, tenantId: params.tenantId } });\n    if (!fr) return false;\n    return await this.canViewAccount({ tenantId: params.tenantId, userId: params.userId, accountId: fr.accountId, role: params.role, isPlatformUser: params.isPlatformUser });\n  }\n\n  async enforceClientProfileVisibility(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    clientProfileId: string;\n    role: ClientVisibilityRole;\n    isPlatformUser?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const canView = await this.canViewClientProfile(params);\n    if (!canView) {\n      throw new Error(`Access denied: user ${params.userId} cannot view client profile ${params.clientProfileId} as ${params.role}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async enforceAccountVisibility(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    role: ClientVisibilityRole;\n    isPlatformUser?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const canView = await this.canViewAccount(params);\n    if (!canView) {\n      throw new Error(`Access denied: user ${params.userId} cannot view account ${params.accountId} as ${params.role}`);\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/dto/account-action.dto.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected bindExchangeAccount(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    exchangeAccountId: string;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, exchangeAccountId, operatorId = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { throw new ForbiddenException('Cross-tenant exchange account binding rejected');\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate exchange-account binding — uniqueness\n    try {\n      const existingBinding = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, exchangeAccountId, id: { not: accountId } },\n      });\n      if (existingBinding) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Duplicate exchange-account binding rejected — exchange account ${exchangeAccountId} already bound to account ${existingBinding.id}`);\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (e instanceof BadRequestException || e instanceof ForbiddenException) throw e;\n    }\n\n    // Verify credential-state requirements — exchange account must have valid credential state\n    // Must never store raw exchange credentials — only reference\n    if (exchangeAccount) {\n      // TradingAccountStatus carries the credential verdict: invalid keys,\n      // a disabled account and a withdrawal-enabled key (refused on\n      // principle) are all unusable for trading.\n      if (['CREDENTIALS_INVALID', 'DISABLED', 'WITHDRAWAL_ENABLED_REJECTED'].includes(exchangeAccount.status)) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Exchange account status ${exchangeAccount.status} invalid`);\n      }\n      // Ensure no raw credentials stored\n      if (exchangeAccount.apiKey || exchangeAccount.secret || exchangeAccount.privateKey) {\n        this.logger.warn({ event: 'client.binding.raw_credential_detected', exchangeAccountId });\n        // Do not store raw credentials — we only store reference ID\n      }\n    }\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: 'exchange-binding',\n      tenantId,\n      accountId,\n      externalRef: exchangeAccountId,\n    });\n\n    // Idempotency for binding\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).accountRelationship.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Update institutional account with exchangeAccountId\n    const updatedAccount = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.update({\n      where: { id: accountId },\n      data: { exchangeAccountId },\n    });\n\n    // Create relationship record\n    const relationship = await (this.prisma as any).accountRelationship.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        sourceId: accountId,\n        sourceType: 'INSTITUTIONAL_ACCOUNT',\n        targetId: exchangeAccountId,\n        targetType: 'EXCHANGE_ACCOUNT',\n        relationshipType: 'CLIENT_TO_EXCHANGE_ACCOUNT',\n        status: 'ACTIVE',\n        effectiveAt: new Date(),\n        accountId,\n        clientProfileId: account.clientProfileId,\n        createdBy: operatorId,\n        source: 'EXCHANGE_BINDING_SERVICE',\n        idempotencyKey,\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: account.clientProfileId,\n      accountId,\n      action: 'EXCHANGE_ACCOUNT_BOUND',\n      entityType: 'INSTITUTIONAL_ACCOUNT',\n      entityId: accountId,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { exchangeAccountId, relationshipId: relationship.id },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'client.exchange_account.bound', tenantId, accountId, exchangeAccountId });\n\n    return { account: updatedAccount, relationship };\n  }\n\n  async unbindExchangeAccount(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    reason?: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, operatorId = null, reason, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n    if (!account) throw new BadRequestException('Account not found');\n\n    if (!account.exchangeAccountId) throw new BadRequestException('No exchange account bound');\n\n    const previousExchangeAccountId = account.exchangeAccountId;\n\n    const updatedAccount = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.update({\n      where: { id: accountId },\n      data: { exchangeAccountId: null },\n    });\n\n    // Revoke relationship\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).accountRelationship.updateMany({\n        where: { tenantId, accountId, targetId: previousExchangeAccountId, status: 'ACTIVE' },\n        data: { status: 'REVOKED', endedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: account.clientProfileId,\n      accountId,\n      action: 'EXCHANGE_ACCOUNT_UNBOUND',\n      entityType: 'INSTITUTIONAL_ACCOUNT',\n      entityId: accountId,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      reason: reason ?? null,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { previousExchangeAccountId, reason },\n    });\n\n    return updatedAccount;\n  }\n\n  async getBinding(params: { tenantId: string; accountId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: params.accountId, tenantId: params.tenantId } });\n    if (!account?.exchangeAccountId) return null;\n    return {
