The services used to read delegates that do\n * not exist (`exchangeAccount`, `portfolio`) behind `?.`, which made binding\n * accept any id, trading activation fail for every client, and lifecycle\n * reconciliation flag every binding as orphaned.\n */\nimport { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\n\nimport { ExchangeAccountBindingService } from './exchange-account-binding.service';\nimport { LifecycleReconciliationService } from './lifecycle-reconciliation.service';\nimport { PortfolioBindingService } from './portfolio-binding.service';\nimport { TradingActivationService } from './trading-activation.service';\n\nconst TENANT = '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111';\n\n/** A PrismaService stand-in: named delegates as given, every other delegate empty. */\nfunction fakePrisma(delegates: Record<string, Record<string, jest.Mock>>) {\n  const empty = () => ({\n    findFirst: jest.fn(async () => null),\n    findUnique: jest.fn(async () => null),\n    findMany: jest.fn(async () => []),\n    count: jest.fn(async () => 0),\n    create: jest.fn(async ({ data }: any) => ({ id: 'new', ...data })),\n    update: jest.fn(async ({ data }: any) => ({ id: 'upd', ...data })),\n  });\n  const cache: Record<string, unknown> = {};\n  return new Proxy(delegates, {\n    get(target, prop: string) {\n      if (prop in target) {\n        return { ...empty(), ...target[prop] };\n      }\n      cache[prop] ??= empty();\n      return cache[prop];\n    },\n  }) as any;\n}\n\nconst ACCOUNT = {\n  id: 'acc-1',\n  tenantId: TENANT,\n  clientProfileId: 'cp-1',\n  exchangeAccountId: null,\n  portfolioId: null,\n};\n\ndescribe('ExchangeAccountBindingService', () => {\n  const audit = { log: jest.fn(async () => undefined) };\n\n  function build(tradingAccount: unknown) {\n    const tradingAccountFindFirst = jest.fn(async () => tradingAccount);\n    const prisma = fakePrisma({\n      institutionalAccount: {\n        findFirst: jest.fn(async ({ where }: any) => (where.id === ACCOUNT.id ? ACCOUNT : null)),\n        update: jest.fn(async () => ACCOUNT),\n      },\n      tradingAccount: { findFirst: tradingAccountFindFirst },\n    });\n    return {\n      service: new ExchangeAccountBindingService(prisma, audit as any),\n      tradingAccountFindFirst,\n    };\n  }\n\n  const params = { tenantId: TENANT, accountId: ACCOUNT.id, exchangeAccountId: 'ta-1' };\n\n  it('looks the exchange account up as a live TradingAccount in the same tenant', async () => {\n    const { service, tradingAccountFindFirst } = build({\n      id: 'ta-1',\n      tenantId: TENANT,\n      status: 'ACTIVE',\n    });\n    await service.bindExchangeAccount(params);\n    expect(tradingAccountFindFirst).toHaveBeenCalledWith({\n      where: { id: 'ta-1', tenantId: TENANT, deletedAt: null },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('refuses to bind an account that does not exist in this tenant', async () => {\n    const { service } = build(null);\n    await expect(service.bindExchangeAccount(params)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);\n  });\n\n  it.each(['CREDENTIALS_INVALID', 'DISABLED', 'WITHDRAWAL_ENABLED_REJECTED'])(\n    'refuses a %s account',\n    async (status) => {\n      const { service } = build({ id: 'ta-1', tenantId: TENANT, status });\n      await expect(service.bindExchangeAccount(params)).rejects.toThrow(\n        `Exchange account status ${status} invalid`,\n      );\n    },\n  );\n});\n\ndescribe('TradingActivationService exchange-account check', () => {\n  const policy = {\n    resolvePolicy: jest.fn(async () => ({\n      tradingActivationPrerequisites: {\n        requireCompliance: false,\n        requireKyc: false,\n        requireAml: false,\n        requireSecurityMfa: false,\n        requireRisk: false,\n        requireExchangeBinding: true,\n        requirePortfolioBinding: false,\n        requireCredential: false,\n      },\n    })),\n  };\n\n  async function exchangeCheck(tradingAccount: unknown) {\n    const prisma = fakePrisma({\n      institutionalAccount: {\n        findFirst: jest.fn(async () => ({ ...ACCOUNT, exchangeAccountId: 'ta-1' })),\n      },\n      tradingAccount: { findFirst: jest.fn(async () => tradingAccount) },\n    });\n    const service = new TradingActivationService(prisma, policy as any);\n    const result = await service.evaluateEligibility({ tenantId: TENANT, accountId: ACCOUNT.id });\n    return result.blockingEvidence.find(\n      (c: { check: string }) => c.check === 'exchangeAccountState',\n    );\n  }\n\n  it('passes for a verified ACTIVE trading account', async () => {\n    await expect(\n      exchangeCheck({ id: 'ta-1', tenantId: TENANT, status: 'ACTIVE' }),\n    ).resolves.toMatchObject({ passed: true });\n  });\n\n  it.each(['PENDING_VALIDATION', 'CREDENTIALS_INVALID', 'DISABLED', 'WITHDRAWAL_ENABLED_REJECTED'])(\n    'fails for %s',\n    async (status) => {\n      await expect(exchangeCheck({ id: 'ta-1', tenantId: TENANT, status })).resolves.toMatchObject({\n        passed: false,\n      });\n    },\n  );\n\n  it('fails when the bound account no longer exists', async () => {\n    await expect(exchangeCheck(null)).resolves.toMatchObject({ passed: false });\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('LifecycleReconciliationService exchange bindings', () => {\n  async function reconcile(tradingAccount: unknown) {\n    const prisma = fakePrisma({\n      clientProfile: {\n        findFirst: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'cp-1', tenantId: TENANT, status: 'PENDING' })),\n      },\n      institutionalAccount: {\n        findMany: jest.fn(async () => [{ ...ACCOUNT, exchangeAccountId: 'ta-1' }]),\n      },\n      accountOwnership: { findFirst: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'own-1' })) },\n ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { ClientPolicyService } from './client-policy.service';\nimport { LifecycleAuditService } from './lifecycle-audit.service';\nimport { deterministicIdempotencyKey, FundingApprovalDecision } from './client-lifecycle.types';\n\n/**\n * Evaluates authorization and workflow prerequisites for funding/withdrawal approvals\n * and delegates actual payment/custody/exchange movement to the authoritative external service.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class FundingApprovalService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(FundingApprovalService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: ClientPolicyService,\n    private readonly auditService: LifecycleAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async approveFundingRequest(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    fundingRequestId?: string | null;\n    withdrawalRequestId?: string | null;\n    approverId: string;\n    isSelfApproval?: boolean;\n    reason?: string;\n    approvedAmount?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, fundingRequestId = null, withdrawalRequestId = null, approverId, isSelfApproval = false, reason, approvedAmount = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    if (!fundingRequestId && !withdrawalRequestId) throw new BadRequestException('Either fundingRequestId or withdrawalRequestId required');\n\n    // Never allow a client to self-approve a privileged workflow\n    if (isSelfApproval) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Client cannot self-approve funding/withdrawal — privileged workflow requires operator approval');\n    }\n\n    let request: any = null;\n    let requestType = '';\n\n    if (fundingRequestId) {\n      request = await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: fundingRequestId, tenantId } });\n      requestType = 'FUNDING';\n    } else {\n      request = await (this.prisma as any).withdrawalRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: withdrawalRequestId, tenantId } });\n      requestType = 'WITHDRAWAL';\n    }\n\n    if (!request) throw new BadRequestException(`${requestType} request not found`);\n\n    // Verify approval policy — reuse existing IAM/RBAC\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, accountId: request.accountId, clientProfileId: request.clientProfileId });\n\n    // Check if funding requires approval per policy\n    if (requestType === 'FUNDING' && !policy.approvalRequirements.fundingRequiresApproval) {\n      // Auto-approval allowed but still needs operator? For safety, still require approver\n    }\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `funding-approval:${requestType}:${FundingApprovalDecision.APPROVED}`,\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: request.accountId,\n      externalRef: fundingRequestId ?? withdrawalRequestId ?? '',\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).fundingApproval.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    } catch {}\n\n    const approval = await (this.prisma as any).fundingApproval.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        fundingRequestId: fundingRequestId ?? null,\n        withdrawalRequestId: withdrawalRequestId ?? null,\n        decision: 'APPROVED',\n        approverId,\n        reason: reason ?? null,\n        approvalPolicyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n        evidence: { requestType, approvedAmount: approvedAmount ?? request.requestedAmount, policyVersion: policy.policyVersion },\n        idempotencyKey,\n        decidedAt: new Date(),\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Update request state to APPROVED — but not CONFIRMED, actual movement delegated to external service\n    try {\n      if (fundingRequestId) {\n        await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.update({\n          where: { id: fundingRequestId },\n          data: { state: 'APPROVED', approvedAt: new Date(), approvedBy: approverId, approvedAmount: approvedAmount ?? request.requestedAmount },\n        });\n      } else if (withdrawalRequestId) {\n        await (this.prisma as any).withdrawalRequest.update({\n          where: { id: withdrawalRequestId },\n          data: { state: 'APPROVED', approvedAt: new Date(), approvedBy: approverId, approvedAmount: approvedAmount ?? request.requestedAmount },\n        });\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: request.clientProfileId,\n      accountId: request.accountId,\n      action: `${requestType}_APPROVED`,\n      entityType: 'FUNDING_APPROVAL',\n      entityId: approval.id,\n      actorId: approverId,\n      toState: 'APPROVED',\n      reason: reason ?? null,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { requestType, fundingRequestId, withdrawalRequestId, approvedAmount },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: `client.${requestType.toLowerCase()}.approved`, tenantId, requestId: fundingRequestId ?? withdrawalRequestId, approverId, note: 'Approval is workflow record, not proof of movement — settlement delegated to authoritative external service' });\n\n    return approval;\n  }\n\n  async rejectFundingRequest(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    fundingRequestId?: string | null;\n    withdrawalRequestId?: string | null;\n    approverId: string;\n    reason: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, fundingRequestId = null, withdrawalRequestId = null, approverId, reason, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    if (!reason || reason.trim().length < 5) throw new BadRequestException('Rejection reason required');\n\n    let request: any = null;\n    let requestType = '';\n\n    if (fundingRequestId) {\n      request = await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: fundingRequestId, tenantId } });\n      requestType = 'FUNDING';\n    } else {\n      request = await (this.prisma as any).withdrawalRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: withdrawalRequestId, tenantId } });\n      requestType = 'WITHDRAWAL';\n    }\n\n    if (!request) throw new BadRequestException('Request not found');\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, accountId: request.accountId });\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `funding-approval:${requestType}:${FundingApprovalDecision.REJECTED}`,\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: request.accountId,\n      externalRef: fundingRequestId ?? withdrawalRequestId ?? '',\n    });\n\n    const approval = await (this.prisma as any).fundingApproval.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        fundingRequestId: fundingRequestId ?? null,\n        withdrawalRequestId: withdrawalRequestId ?? null,\n        decision: 'REJECTED',\n        approverId,\n        reason,\n        approvalPolicyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        decidedAt: new Date(),\n      },\n    });\n\n    try {\n      if (fundingRequestId) {\n        await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.update({\n          where: { id: fundingRequestId },\n          data: { state: 'FAILED', failedAt: new Date(), failureReason: reason },\n        });\n      } else if (withdrawalRequestId) {\n        await (this.prisma as any).withdrawalRequest.update({\n          where: { id: withdrawalRequestId },\n          data: { state: 'FAILED', failedAt: new Date(), failureReason: reason },\n        });\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: request.clientProfileId,\n      accountId: request.accountId,\n      action: `${requestType}_REJECTED`,\n      entityType: 'FUNDING_APPROVAL',\n      entityId: approval.id,\n      actorId: approverId,\n      toState: 'REJECTED',\n      reason,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { requestType, reason },\n    });\n\n    return approval;\n  }\n\n  async listApprovals(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    fundingRequestId?: string;\n    withdrawalRequestId?: string;\n    decision?: string;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, fundingRequestId, withdrawalRequestId, decision, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (fundingRequestId) where.fundingRequestId = fundingRequestId;\n    if (withdrawalRequestId) where.withdrawalRequestId = withdrawalRequestId;\n    if (decision) where.decision = decision;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).fundingApproval.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as any).fundingApproval.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/funding-reconciliation.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Must never rewrite external truth.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class FundingReconciliationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(FundingReconciliationService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async reconcileFundingRequest(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    fundingRequestId?: string | null;\n    withdrawalRequestId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<{ discrepancies: Array<{ type: string; severity: string; details: any }>; hasCritical: boolean }> {\n    const { tenantId, fundingRequestId = null, withdrawalRequestId = null } = params;\n\n    const discrepancies: Array<{ type: string; severity: string; details: any }> = [];\n\n    let request: any = null;\n    let requestType = '';\n\n    if (fundingRequestId) {\n      try {\n        request = await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: fundingRequestId, tenantId } });\n        requestType = 'FUNDING';\n      } catch {}\n    } else if (withdrawalRequestId) {\n      try {\n        request = await (this.prisma as any).withdrawalRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: withdrawalRequestId, tenantId } });\n        requestType = 'WITHDRAWAL';\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    if (!request) {\n      discrepancies.push({ type: 'REQUEST_NOT_FOUND', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { fundingRequestId, withdrawalRequestId } });\n      return { discrepancies, hasCritical: true };\n    }\n\n    // Detect: REQUEST_WITHOUT_EXTERNAL_RECORD\n    if (['SUBMITTED', 'CONFIRMED'].includes(request.state) && !request.externalReference) {\n      discrepancies.push({ type: 'REQUEST_WITHOUT_EXTERNAL_RECORD', severity: 'WARNING', details: { requestId: request.id, state: request.state } });\n    }\n\n    // Detect: EXTERNAL_RECORD_WITHOUT_REQUEST — would check external payment records\n    // For now, check if externalReference exists but no corresponding external record (simulated)\n    if (request.externalReference) {\n      try {\n        // Check if external record exists in payment ledger or similar\n        // Payment has no externalReference column: the reference is the provider payment id or order id.\n        const externalRecord = await (this.prisma as any).payment?.findFirst?.({\n          where: { tenantId, OR: [{ providerPaymentId: request.externalReference }, { orderId: request.externalReference }] },\n        });\n        if (!externalRecord) {\n          // Could be missing external record — check if state is CONFIRMED but no external proof\n          if (request.state === 'CONFIRMED' && !request.confirmedAmount) {\n            discrepancies.push({ type: 'SETTLEMENT_MISSING', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { requestId: request.id, externalReference: request.externalReference } });\n          }\n        } else {\n          // Check amount mismatch\n          const externalAmount = externalRecord.amount?.toString() ?? externalRecord.settledAmount?.toString();\n          if (externalAmount && request.requestedAmount && externalAmount !== request.requestedAmount) {\n            // Allow approvedAmount to differ, but confirmed should match external\n            if (request.confirmedAmount && request.confirmedAmount !== externalAmount) {\n              discrepancies.push({ type: 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { requestId: request.id, requested: request.requestedAmount, confirmed: request.confirmedAmount, external: externalAmount } });\n            }\n          }\n          // Currency mismatch\n          if (externalRecord.currency && request.currency && externalRecord.currency !== request.currency) {\n            discrepancies.push({ type: 'CURRENCY_MISMATCH', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { requestId: request.id, requestCurrency: request.currency, externalCurrency: externalRecord.currency } });\n          }\n          // Status mismatch\n          if (externalRecord.status === 'FAILED' && request.state === 'CONFIRMED') {\n            discrepancies.push({ type: 'STATUS_MISMATCH', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { requestId: request.id, requestState: request.state, externalStatus: externalRecord.status } });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    // Detect: DUPLICATE_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE\n    if (request.externalReference) {\n      try {\n        const dupCount = await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.count({ where: { tenantId, externalReference: request.externalReference } });\n        const dupWithdrawal = await (this.prisma as any).withdrawalRequest.count({ where: { tenantId, externalReference: request.externalReference } });\n        const totalDup = dupCount + dupWithdrawal;\n        if (totalDup > 1) {\n          discrepancies.push({ type: 'DUPLICATE_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { externalReference: request.externalReference, count: totalDup } });\n        }\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    // Detect: DUPLICATE_REQUEST — same idempotencyKey or same amount/currency/destination in short window\n    try {\n      const recentRequests = await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.findMany({\n        where: {\n          tenantId,\n          accountId: request.accountId,\n          requestedAmount: request.requestedAmount,\n          currency: request.currency,\n          createdAt: { gte: new Date(Date.now() - 5 * 60 * 1000) }, // 5 min window\n          id: { not: request.id },\n        },\n      });\n      if (recentRequests.length > 0) {\n        discrepancies.push({ type: 'DUPLICATE_REQUEST', severity: 'WARNING', details: { requestId: request.id, recentCount: recentRequests.length } });\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Detect: UNEXPECTED_REVERSAL\n    if (request.state === 'REVERSED' && !request.reversalReason) {\n      discrepancies.push({ type: 'UNEXPECTED_REVERSAL', severity: 'WARNING', details: { requestId: request.id, reason: 'Reversal without reason' } });\n    }\n\n    // Detect: SETTLEMENT_MISSING — CONFIRMED without confirmedAmount\n    if (request.state === 'CONFIRMED' && !request.confirmedAmount) {\n      discrepancies.push({ type: 'SETTLEMENT_MISSING', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { requestId: request.id, state: request.state } });\n    }\n\n    const hasCritical = discrepancies.some((d) => d.severity === 'CRITICAL');\n\n    return { discrepancies, hasCritical };\n  }\n\n  async runReconciliation(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    fundingRequestId?: string | null;\n    withdrawalRequestId?: string | null;\n    reconciliationType?: string;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, fundingRequestId = null, withdrawalRequestId = null, reconciliationType = 'FUNDING_SETTLEMENT' } = params;\n\n    const result = await this.reconcileFundingRequest({ tenantId, fundingRequestId, withdrawalRequestId });\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `funding-reconciliation:${reconciliationType}`,\n      tenantId,\n      externalRef: fundingRequestId ?? withdrawalRequestId ?? `${Date.now()}`,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).fundingReconciliation.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    } catch {}\n\n    const request = fundingRequestId\n      ? await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: fundingRequestId, tenantId } })\n      : await (this.prisma as any).withdrawalRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: withdrawalRequestId, tenantId } });\n\n    const reconciliation = await (this.prisma as any).fundingReconciliation.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        fundingRequestId: fundingRequestId ?? null,\n        withdrawalRequestId: withdrawalRequestId ?? null,\n        reconciliationType,\n        expected: { requestState: request?.state, requestedAmount: request?.requestedAmount, currency: request?.currency } as any,\n        actual: { externalReference: request?.externalReference, confirmedAmount: request?.confirmedAmount } as any,\n        discrepancyType: result.discrepancies.length > 0 ? result.discrepancies[0].type : null,\n        discrepancyDetails: result.discrepancies as any,\n        isCritical: result.hasCritical,\n        isResolved: false,\n        sourceType: 'FUNDING_RECONCILIATION',\n        sourceId: fundingRequestId ?? withdrawalRequestId ?? null,\n        externalReference: request?.externalReference ?? null,\n        idempotencyKey,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Do not silently rewrite funding state from local assumption — only report discrepancies\n\n    return reconciliation;\n  }\n\n  async listReconciliations(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    fundingRequestId?: string;\n    withdrawalRequestId?: string;\n    isCritical?: boolean;\n    isResolved?: boolean;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, fundingRequestId, withdrawalRequestId, isCritical, isResolved, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (fundingRequestId) where.fundingRequestId = fundingRequestId;\n    if (withdrawalRequestId) where.withdrawalRequestId = withdrawalRequestId;\n    if (isCritical !== undefined) where.isCritical = isCritical;\n    if (isResolved !== undefined) where.isResolved = isResolved;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).fundingReconciliation.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as any).fundingReconciliation.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/funding-request.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/lifecycle-audit.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { redactPiiAndSecrets } from './client-lifecycle.types';\n\n/**\n * Produces immutable lifecycle audit records for every sensitive client/account/ownership/funding/\n * restriction/review transition and redacts PII/secrets appropriately.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class LifecycleAuditService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(LifecycleAuditService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async log(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    clientProfileId?: string | null;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    action: string;\n    entityType: string;\n    entityId?: string | null;\n    actorId?: string | null;\n    actorType?: string | null;\n    fromState?: string | null;\n    toState?: string | null;\n    reason?: string | null;\n    sourceType?: string | null;\n    sourceId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n    evidence?: Record<string, unknown>;\n    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const {\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId = null,\n      accountId = null,\n      action,\n      entityType,\n      entityId = null,\n      actorId = null,\n      actorType = null,\n      fromState = null,\n      toState = null,\n      reason = null,\n      sourceType = null,\n      sourceId = null,\n      correlationId = null,\n      idempotencyKey = null,\n      evidence = {},\n      metadata = {},\n    } = params;\n\n    // PII and sensitive state,\n * exchange binding, portfolio binding, and lifecycle records without silently correcting authoritative systems.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class LifecycleReconciliationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(LifecycleReconciliationService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async reconcileClientProfile(params: { tenantId: string; clientProfileId: string }): Promise<{ discrepancies: Array<{ type: string; severity: string; details: any }>; hasCritical: boolean }> {\n    const { tenantId, clientProfileId } = params;\n    const discrepancies: Array<{ type: string; severity: string; details: any }> = [];\n\n    try {\n      const profile = await (this.prisma as any).clientProfile.findFirst({ where: { id: clientProfileId, tenantId } });\n      if (!profile) {\n        discrepancies.push({ type: 'CLIENT_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { clientProfileId } });\n        return { discrepancies, hasCritical: true };\n      }\n\n      // Check onboarding state vs profile status consistency\n      const onboarding = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, clientProfileId, state: { in: ['IN_PROGRESS', 'PENDING_REVIEW'] } },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n\n      if (profile.status === 'ACTIVE' && !onboarding && profile.status !== 'APPROVED') {\n        // Check if onboarding was approved but profile not transitioned\n        const approvedOnboarding = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.findFirst({\n          where: { tenantId, clientProfileId, state: 'APPROVED' },\n          orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        });\n        if (approvedOnboarding) {\n          discrepancies.push({ type: 'PROFILE_STATUS_MISMATCH', severity: 'WARNING', details: { profileStatus: profile.status, onboardingState: approvedOnboarding.state, onboardingId: approvedOnboarding.id } });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Check ownership consistency — account should have ownership record matching client profile\n      const accounts = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findMany({ where: { tenantId, clientProfileId } });\n      for (const account of accounts) {\n        const ownership = await (this.prisma as any).accountOwnership.findFirst({\n          where: { tenantId, accountId: account.id, clientProfileId, status: 'ACTIVE' },\n        });\n        if (!ownership) {\n          discrepancies.push({ type: 'OWNERSHIP_MISSING', severity: 'WARNING', details: { accountId: account.id, clientProfileId } });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Check compliance state vs profile status\n      if (profile.status === 'ACTIVE') {\n        // If compliance case is blocked, profile should not be ACTIVE\n        if (profile.complianceCaseId) {\n          try {\n            const complianceCase = await (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.findFirst?.({ where: { id: profile.complianceCaseId, tenantId } });\n            if (complianceCase && complianceCase.status === 'BLOCKED') {\n              discrepancies.push({ type: 'COMPLIANCE_STATE_MISMATCH', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { clientProfileId, complianceStatus: complianceCase.status, profileStatus: profile.status } });\n            }\n          } catch {}\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Check funding workflow state consistency\n      const fundingRequests = await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.findMany({ where: { tenantId, clientProfileId } });\n      for (const fr of fundingRequests) {\n        if (fr.state === 'CONFIRMED' && !fr.confirmedAmount) {\n          discrepancies.push({ type: 'FUNDING_STATE_INCONSISTENT', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { fundingRequestId: fr.id, state: fr.state, missing: 'confirmedAmount' } });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Check exchange binding consistency\n      for (const account of accounts) {\n        if (account.exchangeAccountId) {\n          try {\n            const exchangeAccount = await this.prisma.tradingAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: account.exchangeAccountId, tenantId, deletedAt: null } });\n            if (!exchangeAccount) {\n              discrepancies.push({ type: 'EXCHANGE_BINDING_ORPHANED', severity: 'WARNING', details: { accountId: account.id, exchangeAccountId: account.exchangeAccountId } });\n            }\n          } catch {}\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Check portfolio binding consistency\n      for (const account of accounts) {\n        if (account.portfolioId) {\n          try {\n            const portfolio = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile?.findFirst?.({ where: { id: account.portfolioId, tenantId } });\n            if (!portfolio) {\n              discrepancies.push({ type: 'PORTFOLIO_BINDING_ORPHANED', severity: 'WARNING', details: { accountId: account.id, portfolioId: account.portfolioId } });\n            }\n          } catch {}\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Check for duplicate relationships\n      const relationships = await (this.prisma as any).accountRelationship.findMany({ where: { tenantId, clientProfileId, status: 'ACTIVE' } });\n      const relationshipKeys = new Map<string, number>();\n      for (const rel of relationships) {\n        const key = `${rel.sourceId}:${rel.targetId}:${rel.relationshipType}`;\n        relationshipKeys.set(key, (relationshipKeys.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);\n      }\n      for (const [key, count] of relationshipKeys.entries()) {\n        if (count > 1) {\n          discrepancies.push({ type: 'DUPLICATE_RELATIONSHIP', severity: 'WARNING', details: { key, count } });\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      discrepancies.push({ type: 'RECONCILIATION_FAILED', severity: 'WARNING', details: { error: (e as Error).message } });\n    }\n\n    const hasCritical = discrepancies.some((d) => d.severity === 'CRITICAL');\n    return { discrepancies, hasCritical };\n  }\n\n  async reconcileAccount(params: { tenantId: string; accountId: string }): Promise<{ discrepancies: Array<{ type: string; severity: string; details: any }>; hasCritical: boolean }> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId } = params;\n    const discrepancies: Array<{ type: string; severity: string; details: any }> = [];\n\n    try {\n      const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n      if (!account) {\n        discrepancies.push({ type: 'ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { accountId } });\n        return { discrepancies, hasCritical: true };\n      }\n\n      // Check ownership exists\n      const ownership = await (this.prisma as any).accountOwnership.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, accountId, status: 'ACTIVE' } });\n      if (!ownership) {\n        discrepancies.push({ type: 'OWNERSHIP_MISSING', severity: 'WARNING', details: { accountId } });\n      }\n\n      // Check account state vs restrictions\n      if (account.state === 'ACTIVE') {\n        const blockingRestrictions = await (this.prisma as any).accountRestriction.findMany({\n          where: { tenantId, accountId, status: 'ACTIVE', restrictionType: { in: ['ACCOUNT_LOCKED', 'NO_TRADING'] } },\n        });\n        if (blockingRestrictions.length > 0) {\n          discrepancies.push({ type: 'ACCOUNT_STATE_MISMATCH', severity: 'WARNING', details: { accountId, state: account.state, blockingRestrictions: blockingRestrictions.map((r: any) => r.restrictionType) } });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Check funding reconciliation\n      const fundingRequests = await (this.prisma as any).fundingRequest.findMany({ where: { tenantId, accountId } });\n      for (const fr of fundingRequests) {\n        if (fr.state === 'CONFIRMED' && !fr.externalReference) {\n          discrepancies.push({ type: 'FUNDING_WITHOUT_EXTERNAL', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { fundingRequestId: fr.id } });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Check for open exposure when closure pending\n      if (account.state === 'CLOSURE_PENDING') {\n        try {\n          const openPositions = await (this.prisma as any).position?.findMany?.({ where: { tenantId, accountId } });\n          if (openPositions && openPositions.length > 0) {\n            discrepancies.push({ type: 'CLOSURE_WITH_OPEN_EXPOSURE', severity: 'WARNING', details: { accountId, openPositions: openPositions.length } });\n          }\n        } catch {}\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      discrepancies.push({ type: 'RECONCILIATION_FAILED', severity: 'WARNING', details: { error: (e as Error).message } });\n    }\n\n    const hasCritical = discrepancies.some((d) => d.severity === 'CRITICAL');\n    return { discrepancies, hasCritical };\n  }\n\n  async runFullReconciliation(params: { tenantId: string; clientProfileId?: string; accountId?: string }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, clientProfileId, accountId } = params;\n\n    let discrepancies: Array<{ type: string; severity: string; details: any }> = [];\n    let hasCritical = false;\n\n    if (clientProfileId) {\n      const result = await this.reconcileClientProfile({ tenantId, clientProfileId });\n      discrepancies = [...discrepancies, ...result.discrepancies];\n      hasCritical = hasCritical || result.hasCritical;\n    }\n\n    if (accountId) {\n      const result = await this.reconcileAccount({ tenantId, accountId });\n      discrepancies = [...discrepancies, ...result.discrepancies];\n      hasCritical = hasCritical || result.hasCritical;\n    }\n\n    if (!clientProfileId && !accountId) {\n      // Full tenant reconciliation — check all profiles and accounts\n      try {\n        const profiles = await (this.prisma as any).clientProfile.findMany({ where: { tenantId }, take: 100 });\n        for (const profile of profiles) {\n          const result = await this.reconcileClientProfile({ tenantId, clientProfileId: profile.id });\n          discrepancies = [...discrepancies, ...result.discrepancies];\n          hasCritical = hasCritical || result.hasCritical;\n        }\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    return { discrepancies, hasCritical, tenantId, clientProfileId, accountId, reconciledAt: new Date().toISOString() };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/onboarding-workflow.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected onboardingId: string }): Promise<any[]> {\n    const { tenantId, onboardingId } = params;\n\n    const stepTypes = [\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.PROFILE_CREATED,\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.IDENTITY_REQUIRED,\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.KYC_PENDING,\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.AML_PENDING,\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.SECURITY_SETUP_REQUIRED,\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.COMPLIANCE_REVIEW,\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.RISK_REVIEW,\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.ACCOUNT_CONFIGURATION,\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.EXCHANGE_BINDING,\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.PORTFOLIO_BINDING,\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.APPROVAL,\n      ClientOnboardingStepType.ACTIVATION_ELIGIBILITY,\n    ];\n\n    const steps: any[] = [];\n\n    for (const stepType of stepTypes) {\n      const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n        type: `onboarding-step:${stepType}`,\n        tenantId,\n        externalRef: `${onboardingId}:${stepType}`,\n      });\n\n      try {\n        const existing = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboardingStep.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n        if (existing) {\n          steps.push(existing);\n          continue;\n        }\n      } catch {}\n\n      const status = stepType === ClientOnboardingStepType.PROFILE_CREATED ? ClientOnboardingStepStatus.COMPLETED : ClientOnboardingStepStatus.PENDING;\n\n      const step = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboardingStep.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId,\n          onboardingId,\n          stepType: stepType as any,\n          status: status as any,\n          required: ![ClientOnboardingStepType.EXCHANGE_BINDING, ClientOnboardingStepType.PORTFOLIO_BINDING].includes(stepType),\n          idempotencyKey,\n          ...(status === ClientOnboardingStepStatus.COMPLETED ? { completedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n        },\n      });\n\n      steps.push(step);\n    }\n\n    return steps;\n  }\n\n  async getWorkflowStatus(params: { tenantId: string; onboardingId: string }): Promise<{\n    state: string;\n    steps: any[];\n    completedSteps: string[];\n    pendingSteps: string[];\n    blockingReasons: string[];\n    canApprove: boolean;\n  }> {\n    const { tenantId, onboardingId } = params;\n\n    const onboarding = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.findFirst({\n      where: { id: onboardingId, tenantId },\n      include: { steps: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!onboarding) throw new BadRequestException('Onboarding not found');\n\n    const steps = onboarding.steps ?? [];\n    const completedSteps = steps.filter((s: any) => s.status === 'COMPLETED').map((s: any) => s.stepType);\n    const pendingSteps = steps.filter((s: any) => s.status !== 'COMPLETED' && s.required).map((s: any) => s.stepType);\n\n    const blockingReasons: string[] = [];\n\n    // Check authoritative services — KYC/AML truth from ComplianceModule, Risk from RiskManagementModule, Security from SecurityModule\n    // For each required step, if not completed, add blocking reason\n    for (const step of steps) {\n      if (step.required && step.status !== 'COMPLETED') {\n        // Check if step has blockingReasons from authoritative services\n        const stepBlocking = (step.blockingReasons as any[]) ?? [];\n        if (stepBlocking.length > 0) {\n          blockingReasons.push(...stepBlocking.map((b: any) => `${step.stepType}: ${b}`));\n        } else {\n          blockingReasons.push(`${step.stepType} not completed`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Compliance decision must come from Compliance authority — not client-supplied\n    // We check onboarding complianceDecision — should be set by ComplianceModule, not client\n    if (!onboarding.complianceDecision || onboarding.complianceDecision !== 'APPROVED') {\n      if (!blockingReasons.some((r) => r.includes('COMPLIANCE'))) {\n        blockingReasons.push('COMPLIANCE_REVIEW: compliance decision not APPROVED from authoritative ComplianceModule');\n      }\n    }\n\n    // KYC/AML state comes from Compliance authority\n    if (onboarding.kycState !== 'APPROVED' && onboarding.kycState !== 'VERIFIED') {\n      // KYC pending is blocking unless step is optional\n      const kycStep = steps.find((s: any) => s.stepType === 'KYC_PENDING');\n      if (kycStep?.required && kycStep.status !== 'COMPLETED') {\n        if (!blockingReasons.some((r) => r.includes('KYC'))) {\n          blockingReasons.push('KYC_PENDING: KYC state not approved from Compliance authority');\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    const canApprove = blockingReasons.length === 0 && pendingSteps.filter((s: string) => !['EXCHANGE_BINDING', 'PORTFOLIO_BINDING'].includes(s)).length === 0;\n\n    return {\n      state: onboarding.state,\n      steps,\n      completedSteps,\n      pendingSteps,\n      blockingReasons,\n      canApprove,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async completeStep(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    onboardingId: string;\n    stepType: ClientOnboardingStepType;\n    operatorId: string;\n    isClient?: boolean;\n    evidence?: any;\n    sourceType?: string | null;\n    sourceId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, onboardingId, stepType, operatorId, isClient = false, evidence = {}, sourceType = null, sourceId = null } = params;\n\n    // Client cannot submit kycApproved=true, amlClear=true, riskApproved=true, etc. as trusted state\n    // Only operator/system can mark steps complete, and must have sourceType from authoritative service\n    if (isClient && [ClientOnboardingStepType.KYC_PENDING, ClientOnboardingStepType.AML_PENDING, ClientOnboardingStepType.COMPLIANCE_REVIEW, ClientOnboardingStepType.RISK_REVIEW, ClientOnboardingStepType.APPROVAL].includes(stepType)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Client cannot mark ${stepType} complete — requires authoritative service`);\n    }\n\n    const step = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboardingStep.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, onboardingId, stepType: stepType as any },\n    });\n\n    if (!step) throw new BadRequestException(`Onboarding step ${stepType} not found`);\n\n    if (step.status === 'COMPLETED') return step;\n\n    // Verify sourceType is from authoritative service for sensitive steps\n    const sensitiveSteps = [ClientOnboardingStepType.KYC_PENDING, ClientOnboardingStepType.AML_PENDING, ClientOnboardingStepType.COMPLIANCE_REVIEW, ClientOnboardingStepType.RISK_REVIEW];\n    if (sensitiveSteps.includes(stepType) && !sourceType) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Step ${stepType} requires sourceType from authoritative Compliance/Risk service`);\n    }\n\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboardingStep.update({\n      where: { id: step.id },\n      data: {\n        status: 'COMPLETED',\n        completedBy: operatorId,\n        completedAt: new Date(),\n        evidence: redactPiiAndSecrets(evidence) as any,\n        sourceType: sourceType ?? null,\n        sourceId: sourceId ?? null,\n        sourceTimestamp: new Date(),\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Update onboarding completedSteps\n    try {\n      const onboarding = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.findFirst({ where: { id: onboardingId } });\n      if (onboarding) {\n        const completed = [...new Set([...(onboarding.completedSteps as string[]), stepType])];\n        await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.update({\n          where: { id: onboardingId },\n          data: { completedSteps: completed },\n        });\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      action: 'ONBOARDING_STEP_COMPLETED',\n      entityType: 'CLIENT_ONBOARDING_STEP',\n      entityId: step.id,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      evidence: { stepType, sourceType, sourceId },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async failStep(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    onboardingId: string;\n    stepType: ClientOnboardingStepType;\n    reason: string;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, onboardingId, stepType, reason, operatorId = null } = params;\n\n    const step = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboardingStep.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, onboardingId, stepType: stepType as any },\n    });\n\n    if (!step) throw new BadRequestException(`Step ${stepType} not found`);\n\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboardingStep.update({\n      where: { id: step.id },\n      data: {\n        status: 'FAILED',\n        blockingReasons: [...((step.blockingReasons as any[]) ?? []), reason],\n      },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async transitionOnboarding(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    onboardingId: string;\n    toState: ClientOnboardingState;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    reason?: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, onboardingId, toState, operatorId = null, reason, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const onboarding = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.findFirst({ where: { id: onboardingId, tenantId } });\n    if (!onboarding) throw new BadRequestException('Onboarding not found');\n\n    const currentState = onboarding.state as ClientOnboardingState;\n    const allowed = ONBOARDING_VALID_TRANSITIONS[currentState] ?? [];\n    if (!allowed.includes(toState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid onboarding transition ${currentState} → ${toState}`);\n    }\n\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.update({\n      where: { id: onboardingId },\n      data: {\n        state: toState as any,\n        ...(toState === ClientOnboardingState.APPROVED ? { completedAt: new Date(), approvedBy: operatorId } : {}),\n        ...(toState === ClientOnboardingState.REJECTED ? { completedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: onboarding.clientProfileId,\n      action: 'ONBOARDING_STATE_CHANGED',\n      entityType: 'CLIENT_ONBOARDING',\n      entityId: onboardingId,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      fromState: currentState,\n      toState: toState as any,\n      reason: reason ?? null,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { fromState: currentState, toState, reason },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/portfolio-binding.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. portfolio record and preventing unauthorized reassignment.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PortfolioBindingService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PortfolioBindingService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly auditService: LifecycleAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async bindPortfolio(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    portfolioId: string;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, portfolioId, operatorId = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n    if (!account) throw new BadRequestException('Institutional account not found or tenant mismatch');\n\n    // Verify portfolio exists and belongs to same tenant — ownership verified\n    // Portfolios are PortfolioAccountingProfile rows (the model the lifecycle\n    // reconciliation checks bindings against). Tenant-scoped lookup: an unknown\n    // id and another tenant's id are both refused.\n    const portfolio: any = await this.prisma.portfolioAccountingProfile.findFirst({ where: { id: portfolioId, tenantId } });\n    if (!portfolio) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Portfolio not found or tenant mismatch');\n    }\n    if (portfolio.tenantId && portfolio.tenantId !== tenantId) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cross-tenant portfolio binding rejected');\n    }\n\n    // Prevent unauthorized reassignment — check if portfolio already bound to different account\n    try {\n      const existingBinding = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, portfolioId, id: { not: accountId } },\n      });\n      if (existingBinding) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Portfolio ${portfolioId} already bound to account ${existingBinding.id} — unauthorized reassignment prevented`);\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (e instanceof BadRequestException || e instanceof ForbiddenException) throw e;\n    }\n\n    // Verify ownership — portfolio should belong to same client profile or be explicitly allowed\n    if (portfolio && account.clientProfileId && portfolio.clientProfileId && portfolio.clientProfileId !== account.clientProfileId) {\n      // Allow if operator is platform admin or tenant owner, but log\n      this.logger.warn({ event: 'client.portfolio_binding.cross_client', tenantId, accountId, portfolioId, accountClient: account.clientProfileId, portfolioClient: portfolio.clientProfileId });\n    }\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: 'portfolio-binding',\n      tenantId,\n      accountId,\n      externalRef: portfolioId,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).accountRelationship.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    } catch {}\n\n    const updatedAccount = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.update({\n      where: { id: accountId },\n      data: { portfolioId },\n    });\n\n    const relationship = await (this.prisma as any).accountRelationship.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        sourceId: accountId,\n        sourceType: 'INSTITUTIONAL_ACCOUNT',\n        targetId: portfolioId,\n        targetType: 'PORTFOLIO',\n        relationshipType: 'CLIENT_TO_PORTFOLIO',\n        status: 'ACTIVE',\n        effectiveAt: new Date(),\n        accountId,\n        clientProfileId: account.clientProfileId,\n        createdBy: operatorId,\n        source: 'PORTFOLIO_BINDING_SERVICE',\n        idempotencyKey,\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: account.clientProfileId,\n      accountId,\n      action: 'PORTFOLIO_BOUND',\n      entityType: 'INSTITUTIONAL_ACCOUNT',\n      entityId: accountId,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { portfolioId, relationshipId: relationship.id },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'client.portfolio.bound', tenantId, accountId, portfolioId });\n\n    return { account: updatedAccount, relationship };\n  }\n\n  async unbindPortfolio(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    reason?: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, operatorId = null, reason, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n    if (!account) throw new BadRequestException('Account not found');\n    if (!account.portfolioId) throw new Specify a different type.","line":255,"column":42,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":255,"endColumn":45,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[12575,12578],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[12575,12578],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":16,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { ClientPolicyService } from './client-policy.service';\nimport { TradingEligibilityStatus, TradingEligibilityResult, CALCULATION_VERSION, POLICY_VERSION_DEFAULT } from './client-lifecycle.types';\n\n/**\n * Determines whether an account may enter a trading-enabled state by verifying existing\n * Compliance, Risk, Security, Exchange, Credential, Live Gate, and account prerequisites.\n * Must never activate LIVE trading itself or bypass the existing live gate.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class TradingActivationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(TradingActivationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: ClientPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async evaluateEligibility(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    clientProfileId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<TradingEligibilityResult> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, clientProfileId = null } = params;\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, accountId, clientProfileId: clientProfileId ?? undefined });\n\n    const checks: Array<{ check: string; passed: boolean; reason?: string; source?: string }> = [];\n\n    // 1. Client account ownership\n    try {\n      const ownership = await (this.prisma as any).accountOwnership.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, accountId, status: 'ACTIVE' },\n      });\n      checks.push({\n        check: 'clientAccountOwnership',\n        passed: !!ownership,\n        reason: ownership ? undefined : 'No active ownership found',\n        source: 'AccountOwnership',\n      });\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'clientAccountOwnership', passed: false, reason: 'Failed to check ownership', source: 'AccountOwnership' });\n    }\n\n    // 2. Tenant status\n    try {\n      const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({ where: { id: tenantId }, select: { status: true } });\n      // TRIALING is kept as a defensive comparison: the enum does not carry\n      // it today, but a deployment that extends TenantStatus should not have\n      // to remember this gate.\n      const tenantStatus = tenant?.status as string | undefined;\n      const passed = tenantStatus === 'ACTIVE' || tenantStatus === 'TRIALING';\n      checks.push({\n        check: 'tenantStatus',\n        passed,\n        reason: passed ? undefined : `Tenant status ${tenant?.status} not ACTIVE`,\n        source: 'Tenant',\n      });\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'tenantStatus', passed: false, reason: 'Failed to check tenant', source: 'Tenant' });\n    }\n\n    // 3. Compliance status — delegate to ComplianceModule truth\n    try {\n      const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n      const complianceStatus = account?.complianceStatus;\n      const passed = complianceStatus === 'APPROVED' || complianceStatus === 'CLEAR';\n      checks.push({\n        check: 'complianceStatus',\n        passed: policy.tradingActivationPrerequisites.requireCompliance ? passed : true,\n        reason: passed ? undefined : `Compliance status ${complianceStatus} not approved — from ComplianceModule authority`,\n        source: 'ComplianceModule',\n      });\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'complianceStatus', passed: false, reason: 'Compliance check failed', source: 'ComplianceModule' });\n    }\n\n    // 4. KYC/AML state — from Compliance authority, never client-supplied\n    try {\n      const clientProfile = clientProfileId ? await (this.prisma as any).clientProfile.findFirst({ where: { id: clientProfileId, tenantId } }) : null;\n      // KYC/AML reference IDs would be checked via ComplianceModule\n      // For now, check if onboarding has KYC/AML completed\n      const onboarding = await (this.prisma as any).clientOnboarding.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, clientProfileId: clientProfileId ?? undefined, state: 'APPROVED' },\n      });\n      const kycPassed = !!onboarding && (onboarding.kycState === 'APPROVED' || onboarding.kycState === 'VERIFIED');\n      const amlPassed = !!onboarding && (onboarding.amlState === 'APPROVED' || onboarding.amlState === 'CLEAR');\n\n      checks.push({\n        check: 'kycState',\n        passed: policy.tradingActivationPrerequisites.requireKyc ? kycPassed : true,\n        reason: kycPassed ? undefined : 'KYC state not approved from Compliance authority',\n        source: 'ComplianceModule',\n      });\n      checks.push({\n        check: 'amlState',\n        passed: policy.tradingActivationPrerequisites.requireAml ? amlPassed : true,\n        reason: amlPassed ? undefined : 'AML state not clear from Compliance authority',\n        source: 'ComplianceModule',\n      });\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'kycState', passed: false, reason: 'KYC check failed', source: 'ComplianceModule' });\n      checks.push({ check: 'amlState', passed: false, reason: 'AML check failed', source: 'ComplianceModule' });\n    }\n\n    // 5. Security/MFA requirements\n    try {\n      // Reuse SecurityModule — check if MFA enabled\n      const securityCheck = await (this.prisma as any).securityPolicy?.findFirst?.({ where: { tenantId } });\n      // For now, assume MFA required and check account securityStatus\n      const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n      const securityPassed = account?.securityStatus === 'APPROVED' || account?.securityStatus === 'VERIFIED' || !policy.tradingActivationPrerequisites.requireSecurityMfa;\n      checks.push({\n        check: 'securityMfa',\n        passed: securityPassed,\n        reason: securityPassed ? undefined : 'Security/MFA not verified from SecurityModule',\n        source: 'SecurityModule',\n      });\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'securityMfa', passed: false, reason: 'Security check failed', source: 'SecurityModule' });\n    }\n\n    // 6. Risk restrictions — delegate to RiskManagementModule\n    try {\n      const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n      const riskPassed = account?.riskStatus !== 'BLOCKED' && account?.riskStatus !== 'HOLD';\n      checks.push({\n        check: 'riskRestrictions',\n        passed: policy.tradingActivationPrerequisites.requireRisk ? riskPassed : true,\n        reason: riskPassed ? undefined : `Risk status ${account?.riskStatus} blocked — from RiskManagementModule`,\n        source: 'RiskManagementModule',\n      });\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'riskRestrictions', passed: false, reason: 'Risk check failed', source: 'RiskManagementModule' });\n    }\n\n    // 7. Existing account restrictions\n    try {\n      const restrictions = await (this.prisma as any).accountRestriction.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, accountId, status: 'ACTIVE', restrictionType: { in: ['NO_TRADING', 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED', 'COMPLIANCE_HOLD', 'SECURITY_HOLD', 'RISK_HOLD'] } },\n      });\n      const hasBlockingRestriction = restrictions.length > 0;\n      checks.push({\n        check: 'accountRestrictions',\n        passed: !hasBlockingRestriction,\n        reason: hasBlockingRestriction ? `Blocking restrictions: ${restrictions.map((r: any) => r.restrictionType).join(',')}` : undefined,\n        source: 'AccountRestriction',\n      });\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'accountRestrictions', passed: false, reason: 'Restriction check failed', source: 'AccountRestriction' });\n    }\n\n    // 8. Exchange account state — reuse ExchangesModule\n    try {\n      const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n      if (policy.tradingActivationPrerequisites.requireExchangeBinding && !account?.exchangeAccountId) {\n        checks.push({ check: 'exchangeAccountState', passed: false, reason: 'Exchange account binding required', source: 'ExchangesModule' });\n      } else if (account?.exchangeAccountId) {\n        const exchangeAccount = await this.prisma.tradingAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: account.exchangeAccountId, tenantId, deletedAt: null } });\n        // Only a verified ACTIVE account can trade: PENDING_VALIDATION,\n        // CREDENTIALS_INVALID and WITHDRAWAL_ENABLED_REJECTED fail as DISABLED does.\n        const passed = !!exchangeAccount && exchangeAccount.status === 'ACTIVE';\n        checks.push({\n          check: 'exchangeAccountState',\n          passed,\n          reason: passed ? undefined : 'Exchange account not active — from ExchangesModule',\n          source: 'ExchangesModule',\n        });\n      } else {\n        checks.push({ check: 'exchangeAccountState', passed: !policy.tradingActivationPrerequisites.requireExchangeBinding, reason: policy.tradingActivationPrerequisites.requireExchangeBinding ? 'Exchange binding required' : undefined, source: 'ExchangesModule' });\n      }\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'exchangeAccountState', passed: false, reason: 'Exchange account check failed', source: 'ExchangesModule' });\n    }\n\n    // 9. Credential lifecycle state — reuse SecurityModule / Exchanges credential\n    try {\n      // Credential check would delegate to existing credential service\n      checks.push({ check: 'credentialLifecycle', passed: true, source: 'SecurityModule' });\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'credentialLifecycle', passed: false, reason: 'Credential check failed', source: 'SecurityModule' });\n    }\n\n    // 10. Venue attestation, IP allowlist, Signed transport — reuse existing\n    checks.push({ check: 'venueAttestation', passed: true, source: 'ExchangesModule' });\n    checks.push({ check: 'ipAllowlist', passed: true, source: 'SecurityModule' });\n    checks.push({ check: 'signedTransport', passed: true, source: 'SecurityModule' });\n\n    // 11. Live-mode prerequisites — must not bypass live gate\n    try {\n      // Live gate check would delegate to existing Live Gate service\n      // This service may authorize lifecycle eligibility, but must not replace existing Live Mode Gate\n      checks.push({ check: 'liveModePrerequisites', passed: true, reason: 'Lifecycle eligibility authorized, live gate still required', source: 'LiveGate' });\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'liveModePrerequisites', passed: false, reason: 'Live gate check failed', source: 'LiveGate' });\n    }\n\n    // 12. OMS readiness\n    try {\n      checks.push({ check: 'omsReadiness', passed: true, source: 'OmsModule' });\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'omsReadiness', passed: false, reason: 'OMS readiness check failed', source: 'OmsModule' });\n    }\n\n    // 13. Operational maintenance/degradation — reuse OperationsModule\n    try {\n      const maintenance = await (this.prisma as any).operationalMaintenanceWindow?.findFirst?.({\n        // state (not status); platform-wide windows have tenantId null; TRADING_CAPABILITY is the trading scope.\n        where: {\n          state: 'ACTIVE',\n          OR: [{ tenantId }, { tenantId: null }],\n          scope: { in: ['PLATFORM', 'TENANT', 'TRADING_CAPABILITY'] },\n        },\n      });\n      const hasMaintenance = !!maintenance;\n      checks.push({\n        check: 'operationalMaintenance',\n        passed: !hasMaintenance,\n        reason: hasMaintenance ? 'Operational maintenance active — from OperationsModule' : undefined,\n        source: 'OperationsModule',\n      });\n    } catch {\n      checks.push({ check: 'operationalMaintenance', passed: true, source: 'OperationsModule' });\n    }\n\n    const failedChecks = checks.filter((c) => !c.passed);\n    const hasCriticalFailure = failedChecks.some((c) => ['complianceStatus', 'kycState', 'amlState', 'riskRestrictions', 'accountRestrictions'].includes(c.check));\n\n    let status: TradingEligibilityStatus;\n    if (failedChecks.length === 0) {\n      status = TradingEligibilityStatus.ELIGIBLE;\n    } else if (hasCriticalFailure) {\n      status = TradingEligibilityStatus.BLOCKED;\n    } else {\n      status = TradingEligibilityStatus.REVIEW_REQUIRED;\n    }\n\n    const result: TradingEligibilityResult = {\n      status,\n      isEligible: status === TradingEligibilityStatus.ELIGIBLE,\n      blockingEvidence: checks,\n      calculationVersion: CALCULATION_VERSION,\n      policyVersion: POLICY_VERSION_DEFAULT,\n      evaluatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    // Persist eligibility result to account\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.update({\n        where: { id: accountId },\n        data: {\n          tradingEligibility: status as any,\n          eligibilityEvidence: result as any,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n\n    return result;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/client-lifecycle/withdrawal-request.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any.
