Must never directly transfer funds.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class WithdrawalRequestService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(WithdrawalRequestService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: ClientPolicyService,\n    private readonly auditService: LifecycleAuditService,\n    private readonly restrictionService: AccountRestrictionService,\n    @Optional() private readonly outbox?: OutboxService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createWithdrawalRequest(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    clientProfileId?: string | null;\n    requestedAmount: string;\n    currency: string;\n    destinationAddress?: string | null;\n    destinationType?: string | null;\n    externalReference?: string | null;\n    requestedBy?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    metadata?: any;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, clientProfileId = null, requestedAmount, currency, destinationAddress = null, destinationType = null, externalReference = null, requestedBy = null, correlationId = null, metadata = {} } = params;\n\n    if (!isValidDecimal(requestedAmount)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid requestedAmount: ${requestedAmount}`);\n    if (!isPositiveDecimal(requestedAmount)) throw new BadRequestException('requestedAmount must be greater than zero');\n\n    const account = await (this.prisma as any).institutionalAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n    if (!account) throw new BadRequestException('Account not found');\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, accountId, clientProfileId: clientProfileId ?? undefined });\n\n    // Withdrawals must require explicit evaluation of:\n    // Account ownership, status, NO_WITHDRAWAL restriction, Compliance, Risk, Security/MFA, Destination validation, etc.\n\n    // Account ownership is enforced before this service is reached:\n    // ClientLifecycleController.assertAccountAccess limits customers to the\n    // accounts in their own scope (404 otherwise) and lets tenant-wide staff\n    // act on a client's behalf; the controller is the only caller. Here a\n    // requester who is not a registered owner is recorded as an on-behalf\n    // request for the audit trail. (This lookup used to sit in `catch {}`\n    // behind a \"for test purposes, allow but log\" comment.)\n    if (requestedBy) {\n      const ownership = await this.prisma.accountOwnership.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, accountId, ownerId: requestedBy, status: 'ACTIVE' },\n        select: { id: true },\n      });\n      if (!ownership) {\n        this.logger.warn({ event: 'client.withdrawal.requested_on_behalf', accountId, requestedBy });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Account status\n    if (['CLOSED', 'CLOSURE_PENDING', 'SUSPENDED'].includes(account.state)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Account status ${account.state} cannot request withdrawal`);\n    }\n\n    // NO_WITHDRAWAL restriction blocks withdrawal\n    const hasNoWithdrawal = await this.restrictionService.hasRestriction({ tenantId, accountId, restrictionType: 'NO_WITHDRAWAL' as any });\n    if (hasNoWithdrawal) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('NO_WITHDRAWAL restriction active — withdrawal blocked');\n    }\n\n    // Compliance status\n    if (policy.withdrawalRules.requireComplianceCheck && account.complianceStatus && ['BLOCKED', 'HOLD', 'REJECTED'].includes(account.complianceStatus)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Compliance status ${account.complianceStatus} blocks withdrawal`);\n    }\n\n    // Risk state\n    if (policy.withdrawalRules.requireRiskCheck && account.riskStatus && ['BLOCKED', 'HOLD'].includes(account.riskStatus)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Risk state ${account.riskStatus} blocks withdrawal`);\n    }\n\n    // Security/MFA — would delegate to SecurityModule\n    // Destination validation\n    if (policy.fundingControls.requireDestinationValidation && !destinationAddress) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Destination validation required — destinationAddress missing');\n    }\n\n    // Available authoritative balance — would check via Finance/Exchange balance authority, not trust client\n    // For now, log that we would check authoritative balance\n    this.logger.debug({ event: 'client.withdrawal.balance_check', accountId, requestedAmount, currency, note: 'Would check authoritative balance from Finance/Exchange' });\n\n    // Pending withdrawals — check for existing pending withdrawals\n    try {\n      const pending = await (this.prisma as any).withdrawalRequest.count({\n        where: { tenantId, accountId, state: { in: ['REQUESTED', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'SUBMITTED'] } },\n      });\n      if (pending > 5) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Too many pending withdrawals (${pending}) — operational restriction`);\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (e instanceof BadRequestException) throw e;\n    }\n\n    if (!policy.fundingControls.allowedCurrencies.includes(currency)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Currency ${currency} not allowed`);\n    }\n\n    const idempotencyKey = params.idempotencyKey ?? deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: 'withdrawal-request',\n      tenantId,\n      accountId,\n      externalRef: externalReference ?? `${requestedAmount}:${currency}:${destinationAddress ?? ''}:${Date.now()}`,\n    });\n\n    if (!this.outbox) {\n      throw new Error('Transactional outbox is unavailable; refusing withdrawal request without its withdrawal.requested event');\n    }\n    const withdrawalRequest = await this.prisma.withTenantRls(tenantId, async (tx) => {\n      const store = tx as any;\n      const existing = await store.withdrawalRequest.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n      if (externalReference) {\n        const duplicate = await store.withdrawalRequest.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, externalReference } });\n        if (duplicate) throw new BadRequestException(`Duplicate external withdrawal reference: ${externalReference}`);\n      }\n      const created = await store.withdrawalRequest.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId,\n          accountId,\n          clientProfileId: clientProfileId ?? account.clientProfileId ?? null,\n          state: 'REQUESTED',\n          requestedAmount,\n          currency,\n          destinationAddress: destinationAddress ?? null,\n          destinationType: destinationType ?? null,\n          externalReference: externalReference ?? null,\n          requestedBy: requestedBy ?? null,\n          idempotencyKey,\n          metadata,\n          requestedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n      await this.outbox!.append(tx, {\n        tenantId,\n        aggregateType: 'withdrawal_request',\n        aggregateId: created.id,\n        eventType: 'withdrawal.requested',\n        idempotencyKey: `withdrawal-request:${created.id}:requested`,\n        correlationId: correlationId && correlationId.length <= 64 ? correlationId : null,\n        occurredAt: created.requestedAt,\n        payload: {\n          withdrawalRequestId: created.id,\n          amount: created.requestedAmount,\n          currency: created.currency,\n          status: created.state,\n        },\n      });\n      return created;\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: clientProfileId ?? account.clientProfileId,\n      accountId,\n      action: 'WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTED',\n      entityType: 'WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST',\n      entityId: withdrawalRequest.id,\n      actorId: requestedBy,\n      toState: 'REQUESTED',\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { requestedAmount, currency, destinationAddress, destinationType, externalReference },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'client.withdrawal.requested', tenantId, accountId, requestedAmount, currency });\n\n    return withdrawalRequest;\n  }\n\n  async transitionWithdrawalRequest(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    withdrawalRequestId: string;\n    toState: WithdrawalRequestState;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    reason?: string;\n    approvedAmount?: string | null;\n    submittedAmount?: string | null;\n    confirmedAmount?: string | null;\n    settledAmount?: string | null;\n    externalReference?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, withdrawalRequestId, toState, operatorId = null, reason, approvedAmount = null, submittedAmount = null, confirmedAmount = null, settledAmount = null, externalReference = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const request = await (this.prisma as any).withdrawalRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: withdrawalRequestId, tenantId } });\n    if (!request) throw new BadRequestException('Withdrawal request not found');\n\n    const currentState = request.state as WithdrawalRequestState;\n    const allowed = WITHDRAWAL_VALID_TRANSITIONS[currentState] ?? [];\n    if (!allowed.includes(toState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid withdrawal transition ${currentState} → ${toState}`);\n    }\n\n    if (currentState === WithdrawalRequestState.REQUESTED && toState === WithdrawalRequestState.CONFIRMED) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('REQUESTED → CONFIRMED not allowed — must go through approval and external confirmation');\n    }\n\n    if (toState === WithdrawalRequestState.CONFIRMED) {\n      if (!request.externalReference && !externalReference) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('CONFIRMED requires external reference from authoritative payment/custody/exchange');\n      }\n      if (!confirmedAmount) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('CONFIRMED requires confirmedAmount from external settlement');\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Must never directly transfer funds — actual settlement delegated to existing authoritative integration\n    if (toState === WithdrawalRequestState.CONFIRMED) {\n      this.logger.log({ event: 'client.withdrawal.confirmed_external', withdrawalRequestId, note: 'Settlement delegated to authoritative payment/custody/exchange integration, not direct transfer' });\n    }\n\n    if (toState === WithdrawalRequestState.CONFIRMED && !this.outbox) {\n      throw new Error('Transactional outbox is unavailable; refusing withdrawal confirmation without its withdrawal.confirmed event');\n    }\n    const updated = await this.prisma.withTenantRls(tenantId, async (tx) => {\n      const store = tx as any;\n      const current = await store.withdrawalRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: withdrawalRequestId, tenantId } });\n      if (!current || current.state !== currentState) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('Withdrawal request changed during transition; reload and retry');\n      }\n      const changed = await store.withdrawalRequest.update({\n        where: { id: withdrawalRequestId },\n        data: {\n          state: toState as any,\n          ...(approvedAmount ? { approvedAmount } : {}),\n          ...(submittedAmount ? { submittedAmount } : {}),\n          ...(confirmedAmount ? { confirmedAmount } : {}),\n          ...(settledAmount ? { settledAmount } : {}),\n          ...(externalReference ? { externalReference } : {}),\n          ...(toState === WithdrawalRequestState.APPROVED ? { approvedAt: new Date(), approvedBy: operatorId } : {}),\n          ...(toState === WithdrawalRequestState.SUBMITTED ? { submittedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n          ...(toState === WithdrawalRequestState.CONFIRMED ? { confirmedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n          ...(toState === WithdrawalRequestState.FAILED ? { failedAt: new Date(), failureReason: reason } : {}),\n          ...(toState === WithdrawalRequestState.REVERSED ? { reversalReason: reason } : {}),\n        },\n      });\n      if (toState === WithdrawalRequestState.CONFIRMED) {\n        await this.outbox!.append(tx, {\n          tenantId,\n          aggregateType: 'withdrawal_request',\n          aggregateId: changed.id,\n          eventType: 'withdrawal.confirmed',\n          idempotencyKey: `withdrawal-request:${changed.id}:confirmed`,\n          correlationId: correlationId && correlationId.length <= 64 ? correlationId : null,\n          occurredAt: changed.confirmedAt ?? changed.updatedAt,\n          payload: {\n            withdrawalRequestId: changed.id,\n            amount: changed.confirmedAmount,\n            currency: changed.currency,\n            status: changed.state,\n          },\n        });\n      }\n      return changed;\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      clientProfileId: request.clientProfileId,\n      accountId: request.accountId,\n      action: 'WITHDRAWAL_STATE_CHANGED',\n      entityType: 'WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST',\n      entityId: withdrawalRequestId,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      fromState: currentState,\n      toState: toState as any,\n      reason: reason ?? null,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { fromState: currentState, toState, approvedAmount, confirmedAmount },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async getWithdrawalRequest(params: { tenantId: string; withdrawalRequestId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    return await (this.prisma as any).withdrawalRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: params.withdrawalRequestId, tenantId: params.tenantId } });\n  }\n\n  async listWithdrawalRequests(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId?: string;\n    clientProfileId?: string;\n    state?: string;\n    currency?: string;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, clientProfileId, state, currency, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (accountId) where.accountId = accountId;\n    if (clientProfileId) where.clientProfileId = clientProfileId;\n    if (state) where.state = state;\n    if (currency) where.currency = currency;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).withdrawalRequest.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as generates regulatory export payloads\nimport { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { sanitizeMetadata } from './compliance.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Immutable compliance audit events for KYC, AML, screening, risk, cases, policy actions, and administrative decisions.\n * Never audits raw identity documents, passwords, provider secrets, API keys, private keys, full webhook payloads, financial credentials.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ComplianceAuditService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ComplianceAuditService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async record(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    caseId?: string;\n    userId?: string;\n    action: string;\n    actorId?: string;\n    actorType?: string;\n    outcome?: string;\n    safeMetadata?: Record<string, any>;\n    ipHash?: string;\n    requestId?: string;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const safeMeta = params.safeMetadata ? sanitizeMetadata(params.safeMetadata) : {};\n\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).complianceAuditLog?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: randomUUID(),\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          caseId: params.caseId || null,\n          userId: params.userId || null,\n          action: params.action,\n          actorId: params.actorId || null,\n          actorType: params.actorType || 'USER',\n          outcome: params.outcome || 'SUCCESS',\n failAppend?: boolean; existing?: any } = {}) {\n  let persisted = options.existing ?? null;\n  const tx = {\n    complianceCase: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(async () => persisted),\n      create: jest.fn(async ({ data }: { data: Record<string, unknown> }) => {\n        persisted = { ...data };\n        return persisted;\n      }),\n    },\n  };\n  const prisma = {\n    withTenantRls: jest.fn(async (_tenantId: string, work: (transaction: unknown) => Promise<unknown>) => {\n      const before = persisted;\n      try {\n        return await work(tx);\n      } catch (error) {\n        persisted = before;\n        throw error;\n      }\n    }),\n  };\n  const outbox = {\n    append: jest.fn(async (_transaction: unknown, _input: Record<string, unknown>) => {\n      if (options.failAppend) throw new Error('outbox unavailable');\n      return undefined;\n    }),\n  };\n  const repository = new ComplianceCaseRepository(prisma as never, outbox as never);\n  return { userId: 'user-1',\n      caseType: ComplianceCaseType.TRANSACTION_REVIEW,\n      severity: 'HIGH',\n      riskLevel: RiskLevel.HIGH,\n      safeSummary: 'Transaction crossed the tenant review threshold.',\n      ruleIds: ['TRANSACTION_REVIEW_THRESHOLD'],\n      idempotencyKey: 'case-request-1',\n    });\n\n    expect(prisma.withTenantRls).toHaveBeenCalledWith(TENANT_ID, expect.any(Function));\n    expect(tx.complianceCase.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    expect(outbox.append).toHaveBeenCalledWith(tx, expect.objectContaining({\n      tenantId: TENANT_ID,\n      aggregateType: 'compliance_review',\n      aggregateId: complianceCase.id,\n      eventType: 'compliance.review.required',\n      idempotencyKey: `compliance-review:${complianceCase.id}:required`,\n      payload: { reviewId: complianceCase.id, reasonCode: 'TRANSACTION_REVIEW' },\n    }));\n    const event = outbox.append.mock.calls[0]?.[1];\n    expect(validateDeveloperEventPayload('compliance.review.required', event?.payload)).toEqual({ valid: true, errors: [] });\n  });\n\n  it('does not return an in-memory case when the outbox write unavailable');\n\n    expect(tx.complianceCase.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    expect(outbox.append).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    expect(persisted()).toBeNull();\n decisions\nimport { Injectable, Logger, Optional } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { OutboxService } from '../../infrastructure/outbox/outbox.service';\nimport { ComplianceCaseState, ComplianceCaseType, RiskLevel, ComplianceDecision } from './compliance.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Persistence abstraction for cases, reviews, state transitions, assignments, idempotency, and tenant isolation.\n * Tenant isolation, immutable decision history, safe PII handling, concurrency protection, duplicate prevention.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ComplianceCaseRepository {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ComplianceCaseRepository.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    @Optional() private readonly outbox?: OutboxService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private async appendReviewRequired(tx: any, complianceCase: any): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.outbox) {\n      throw new Error('Transactional outbox is unavailable; refusing compliance review without its compliance.review.required event');\n    }\n    const occurredAt = complianceCase.createdAt ?? new Date();\n    await this.outbox.append(tx, {\n      tenantId: complianceCase.tenantId,\n      aggregateType: 'compliance_review',\n      aggregateId: complianceCase.id,\n      eventType: 'compliance.review.required',\n      idempotencyKey: `compliance-review:${complianceCase.id}:required`,\n      occurredAt,\n      payload: {\n        reviewId: complianceCase.id,\n        reasonCode: String(complianceCase.caseType),\n      },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async createCase(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    caseType: ComplianceCaseType;\n    severity?: string;\n    riskLevel?: RiskLevel;\n    safeSummary: string;\n    jurisdiction?: string;\n    policyVersion?: string;\n    ruleIds?: string[];\n    sourceRefs?: any[];\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n    metadata?: Record<string, any>;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date();\n    const data = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      userId: input.userId,\n      caseType: input.caseType,\n      state: ComplianceCaseState.OPEN,\n      severity: input.severity || 'MEDIUM',\n      riskLevel: input.riskLevel || RiskLevel.UNKNOWN,\n      safeSummary: input.safeSummary.substring(0, 1000),\n      jurisdiction: input.jurisdiction || 'DEFAULT',\n      policyVersion: input.policyVersion || 'v1.0.0',\n      ruleIds: input.ruleIds || [],\n      sourceRefs: input.sourceRefs || [],\n      metadata: input.metadata || {},\n      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey,\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n\n    const persist = async () => this.prisma.withTenantRls(input.tenantId, async (tx) => {\n      const store = tx as any;\n      const existing = await store.complianceCase.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey },\n      });\n      if (existing) {\n        this.logger.log(`Idempotent case return key=${input.idempotencyKey}`);\n        await this.appendReviewRequired(tx, existing);\n        return existing;\n      }\n\n      const openCase = await store.complianceCase.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          userId: input.userId,\n          caseType: input.caseType,\n          state: { in: [ComplianceCaseState.OPEN, ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW, ComplianceCaseState.ESCALATED] },\n        },\n      });\n      if (openCase) {\n        this.logger.log(`Duplicate open case prevented tenant=${input.tenantId} user=${input.userId} type=${input.caseType} existing=${openCase.id}`);\n        await this.appendReviewRequired(tx, openCase);\n        return openCase;\n      }\n\n      const created = await store.complianceCase.create({ data });\n      if (!created?.id) throw new Error('Compliance case persistence returned no durable record');\n      await this.appendReviewRequired(tx, created);\n      this.logger.log(`Compliance case created id=${created.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} type=${input.caseType}`);\n      return created;\n    });\n\n    try {\n      return await persist();\n    } catch (error) {\n      const candidate = error as { code?: string; message?: string };\n      if (candidate.code === 'P2002' || candidate.message?.includes('Unique constraint')) {\n        return this.prisma.withTenantRls(input.tenantId, async (tx) => {\n          const existing = await (tx as any).complianceCase.findFirst({\n            where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey },\n          });\n          if (!existing) throw error;\n          await this.appendReviewRequired(tx, existing);\n          return existing;\n        });\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async findById(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    try {\n      const result = await (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.findFirst({\n        where: { id, tenantId },\n        include: { reviews: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } }, evidences: true, auditLogs: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } } },\n      });\n      return result || null;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Find case failed: ${e.message}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async findByIdempotencyKey(idempotencyKey: string, tenantId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.findFirst({ where: { idempotencyKey, tenantId } });\n    return result || null;\n  }\n\n  async listTenantCases(tenantId: string, filters?: { state?: ComplianceCaseState; caseType?: ComplianceCaseType; riskLevel?: RiskLevel; assignedTo?: string; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n    try {\n      const where: any = { tenantId };\n      if (filters?.state) where.state = filters.state;\n      if (filters?.caseType) where.caseType = filters.caseType;\n      if (filters?.riskLevel) where.riskLevel = filters.riskLevel;\n      if (filters?.assignedTo) where.assignedTo = filters.assignedTo;\n      if (filters?.fromDate || filters?.toDate) {\n        where.createdAt = {};\n        if (filters.fromDate) where.createdAt.gte = filters.fromDate;\n        if (filters.toDate) where.createdAt.lte = filters.toDate;\n      }\n\n      const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n        (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: offset, take: limit, include: { reviews: true } }) || [],\n        (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.count({ where }) || 0,\n      ]);\n\n      return { data, total, page, limit };\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`List tenant cases failed: ${e.message}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async listReviewerCases(reviewerId: string, filters?: { state?: ComplianceCaseState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n    const where: any = { assignedTo: reviewerId };\n    if (filters?.state) where.state = filters.state;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: offset, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  async assignReviewer(caseId: string, tenantId: string, reviewerId: string, assignedBy: string, idempotencyKey?: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    try {\n      // Idempotency for assignment\n      if (idempotencyKey) {\n        const existingReview = await (this.prisma as any).complianceReview?.findFirst({ where: { caseId, reviewerId, action: 'ASSIGN' } });\n        if (existingReview) {\n          this.logger.log(`Idempotent assignment return case=${caseId} reviewer=${reviewerId}`);\n          return this.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n        }\n      }\n\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.update({\n        where: { id: caseId },\n        data: {\n          assignedTo: reviewerId,\n          assignedAt: new Date(),\n          state: ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW,\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      // Create immutable review record\n      try {\n        await (this.prisma as any).complianceReview?.create({\n          data: {\n            id: randomUUID(),\n            caseId,\n            tenantId,\n            reviewerId: assignedBy,\n            action: 'ASSIGN',\n            fromState: ComplianceCaseState.OPEN,\n            toState: ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW,\n            reason: `Assigned to reviewer ${reviewerId}`,\n            createdAt: new Date(),\n          },\n        });\n      } catch {}\n\n      return updated || null;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Assign reviewer failed: ${e.message}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async transitionState(caseId: string, tenantId: string, toState: ComplianceCaseState, reviewerId: string, reason: string, decision?: ComplianceDecision, idempotencyKey?: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    try {\n      const current = await this.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n      if (!current) return null;\n\n      const fromState = current.state as ComplianceCaseState;\n\n      // Validate transition\n      if (!this.isValidTransition(fromState, toState)) {\n        throw new Error(`Invalid state transition ${fromState} -> ${toState}`);\n      }\n\n      const updateData: any = {\n        state: toState,\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n      };\n\n      if (toState === ComplianceCaseState.ESCALATED) updateData.escalatedAt = new Date();\n      if (toState === ComplianceCaseState.RESOLVED) updateData.resolvedAt = new Date();\n      if (toState === ComplianceCaseState.CLOSED) updateData.closedAt = new Date();\n      if (decision) updateData.decision = decision;\n\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.update({\n        where: { id: caseId },\n        data: updateData,\n      });\n\n      // Immutable review record\n      try {\n        await (this.prisma as any).complianceReview?.create({\n          data: {\n            id: randomUUID(),\n            caseId,\n            tenantId,\n            reviewerId,\n            action: this.actionForTransition(toState),\n            fromState,\n            toState,\n            decision: decision || null,\n            reason: reason.substring(0, 1000),\n            createdAt: new Date(),\n          },\n        });\n      } catch {}\n\n      return updated || null;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Transition state failed: ${e.message}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async addEvidence(caseId: string, tenantId: string, input: { evidenceType: string; referenceId: string; referenceType: string; safeDescription?: string; addedBy: string }): Promise<any> {\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    try {\n      const evidence = await (this.prisma as any).complianceEvidence?.create({\n        data: {\n          id,\n          caseId,\n          tenantId,\n          evidenceType: input.evidenceType,\n          referenceId: input.referenceId,\n          referenceType: input.referenceType,\n          safeDescription: input.safeDescription?.substring(0, 1000) || null,\n          addedBy: input.addedBy,\n          createdAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n      return evidence || { id, caseId, tenantId, ...input, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() };\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Add evidence failed: ${e.message}`);\n      return { id, caseId, tenantId, ...input, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async addReviewNote(caseId: string, tenantId: string, reviewerId: string, safeNote: string, action: string = 'ADD_NOTE'): Promise<any> {\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    try {\n      const review = await (this.prisma as any).complianceReview?.create({\n        data: {\n          id,\n          caseId,\n          tenantId,\n          reviewerId,\n          action,\n          safeNote: safeNote.substring(0, 2000),\n          reason: safeNote.substring(0, 1000),\n          createdAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n      return review || { id, caseId, tenantId, reviewerId, safeNote, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() };\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Add review note failed: ${e.message}`);\n      return { id, caseId, tenantId, reviewerId, safeNote, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async findByUserId(userId: string, tenantId: string): Promise<any[]> {\n    return await (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.findMany({ where: { userId, tenantId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } }) || [];\n  }\n\n  private isValidTransition(from: ComplianceCaseState, to: ComplianceCaseState): boolean {\n    const allowed: Record<string, ComplianceCaseState[]> = {\n      [ComplianceCaseState.OPEN]: [ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW, ComplianceCaseState.ESCALATED, ComplianceCaseState.CLOSED, ComplianceCaseState.REJECTED],\n      [ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW]: [ComplianceCaseState.ESCALATED, ComplianceCaseState.RESOLVED, ComplianceCaseState.REJECTED, ComplianceCaseState.CLOSED],\n      [ComplianceCaseState.ESCALATED]: [ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW, ComplianceCaseState.RESOLVED, ComplianceCaseState.REJECTED, ComplianceCaseState.CLOSED],\n      [ComplianceCaseState.RESOLVED]: [ComplianceCaseState.CLOSED, ComplianceCaseState.OPEN],\n      [ComplianceCaseState.REJECTED]: [ComplianceCaseState.CLOSED, ComplianceCaseState.OPEN],\n      [ComplianceCaseState.CLOSED]: [ComplianceCaseState.OPEN],\n    };\n    return allowed[from]?.includes(to) || false;\n  }\n\n  private actionForTransition(toState: ComplianceCaseState): any {\n    switch (toState) {\n      case ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW:\n        return 'ASSIGN';\n      case ComplianceCaseState.ESCALATED:\n        return 'ESCALATE';\n      case ComplianceCaseState.RESOLVED:\n        return 'RESOLVE';\n      case ComplianceCaseState.REJECTED:\n        return 'REJECT';\n      case ComplianceCaseState.CLOSED:\n        return 'CLOSE';\n      default:\n        return 'ADD_NOTE';\n    }\n of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":21,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Implements compliance case state transitions and account restriction hooks\nimport { Injectable, Logger, NotFoundException, ForbiddenException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { ComplianceCaseRepository } from './compliance-case.repository';\nimport { ComplianceAuditService } from './compliance-audit.service';\nimport { CompliancePolicyService } from './compliance-policy.service';\nimport { RiskScoringService } from './risk-scoring.service';\nimport { ComplianceCaseState, ComplianceCaseType, RiskLevel, ComplianceDecision } from './compliance.types';\n\n\n/**\n * Manages compliance case lifecycle: create/assign/escalate/evidence/note/decision/EDD/reverification/hold/release/resolve/close\n * Controlled boundary for downstream effects - does NOT directly mutate financial tables.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ComplianceCaseService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ComplianceCaseService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly repository: ComplianceCaseRepository,\n    private readonly auditService: ComplianceAuditService,\n    private readonly policyService: CompliancePolicyService,\n    private readonly riskScoringService: RiskScoringService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createCase(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    caseType: ComplianceCaseType;\n    riskLevel?: RiskLevel;\n    safeSummary: string;\n    severity?: string;\n    jurisdiction?: string;\n    ruleIds?: string[];\n    sourceRefs?: any[];\n    idempotencyKey?: string;\n    actorId?: string;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const idempotencyKey = input.idempotencyKey || `case_${input.tenantId}_${input.userId}_${input.caseType}_${Date.now()}`;\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId: input.tenantId, jurisdiction: input.jurisdiction });\n\n    const created = await this.repository.createCase({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      userId: input.userId,\n      caseType: input.caseType,\n      riskLevel: input.riskLevel || RiskLevel.MEDIUM,\n      safeSummary: input.safeSummary,\n      severity: input.severity || 'MEDIUM',\n      jurisdiction: input.jurisdiction || 'DEFAULT',\n      policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      ruleIds: input.ruleIds || [],\n      sourceRefs: input.sourceRefs || [],\n      idempotencyKey,\n      metadata: { createdBy: input.actorId },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.recordCaseCreated(input.tenantId, created.id, input.userId, input.caseType, input.actorId);\n\n    return created;\n  }\n\n  async getCase(caseId: string, tenantId: string, requester: { userId: string; tenantId: string; roles?: string[] }): Promise<any> {\n    // Tenant isolation\n    if (requester.tenantId !== tenantId && !this.isPlatformAdmin(requester.roles)) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cross-tenant access denied');\n    }\n\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    // If tenant user requesting own data - allow if userId matches or is tenant admin\n    if (requester.tenantId === tenantId) {\n      // Tenant member can only see own cases unless has compliance role\n      const isComplianceReviewer = requester.roles?.some((r) => ['COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER', 'ADMIN', 'OWNER', 'PLATFORM_ADMIN'].includes(r));\n      if (!isComplianceReviewer && caseData.userId !== requester.userId) {\n        // Allow tenant admin to see all tenant cases\n        const isTenantAdmin = requester.roles?.some((r) => ['ADMIN', 'OWNER'].includes(r));\n        if (!isTenantAdmin) {\n          throw new ForbiddenException('Access denied to this case');\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return caseData;\n  }\n\n  async listTenantCases(tenantId: string, requester: { userId: string; tenantId: string; roles?: string[] }, filters?: any): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    if (requester.tenantId !== tenantId && !this.isPlatformAdmin(requester.roles)) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cross-tenant access denied');\n    }\n\n    // If regular user, filter to own cases only\n    const isPrivileged = requester.roles?.some((r) => ['ADMIN', 'OWNER', 'COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER', 'PLATFORM_ADMIN'].includes(r));\n    const effectiveFilters = { ...filters };\n    if (!isPrivileged) {\n      effectiveFilters.userId = requester.userId;\n    }\n\n    // Repository list method doesn't support userId filter directly, but we can filter after\n    const result = await this.repository.listTenantCases(tenantId, effectiveFilters);\n\n    if (!isPrivileged) {\n      const filtered = result.data.filter((c: any) => c.userId === requester.userId);\n      return { data: filtered, total: filtered.length, page: result.page, limit: result.limit };\n    }\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  async listReviewerQueue(reviewerId: string, filters?: { state?: ComplianceCaseState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    return this.repository.listReviewerCases(reviewerId, filters);\n  }\n\n  async assignCase(caseId: string, tenantId: string, reviewerId: string, actorId: string, idempotencyKey?: string): Promise<any> {\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    if (![ComplianceCaseState.OPEN, ComplianceCaseState.ESCALATED].includes(caseData.state as ComplianceCaseState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Cannot assign case in state ${caseData.state}`);\n    }\n\n    const updated = await this.repository.assignReviewer(caseId, tenantId, reviewerId, actorId, idempotencyKey);\n\n    await this.auditService.recordCaseAssigned(tenantId, caseId, reviewerId, actorId);\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async escalateCase(caseId: string, tenantId: string, actorId: string, reason: string, idempotencyKey?: string): Promise<any> {\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    if (![ComplianceCaseState.OPEN, ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW].includes(caseData.state as ComplianceCaseState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Cannot escalate case in state ${caseData.state}`);\n    }\n\n    const updated = await this.repository.transitionState(caseId, tenantId, ComplianceCaseState.ESCALATED, actorId, reason, undefined, idempotencyKey);\n\n    await this.auditService.recordCaseEscalated(tenantId, caseId, actorId, reason);\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async addEvidence(caseId: string, tenantId: string, input: { evidenceType: string; referenceId: string; referenceType: string; safeDescription?: string; addedBy: string }): Promise<any> {\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    const evidence = await this.repository.addEvidence(caseId, tenantId, input);\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId,\n      caseId,\n      action: 'COMPLIANCE_EVIDENCE_ADDED',\n      actorId: input.addedBy,\n      safeMetadata: { evidenceType: input.evidenceType, referenceType: input.referenceType },\n    });\n\n    return evidence;\n  }\n\n  async addNote(caseId: string, tenantId: string, reviewerId: string, safeNote: string): Promise<any> {\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    const review = await this.repository.addReviewNote(caseId, tenantId, reviewerId, safeNote, 'ADD_NOTE');\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId,\n      caseId,\n      action: 'COMPLIANCE_NOTE_ADDED',\n      actorId: reviewerId,\n      safeMetadata: { caseId },\n    });\n\n    return review;\n  }\n\n  async makeDecision(caseId: string, tenantId: string, input: { decision: ComplianceDecision; reviewerId: string; reason: string; idempotencyKey?: string }): Promise<any> {\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    if (![ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW, ComplianceCaseState.ESCALATED].includes(caseData.state as ComplianceCaseState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Cannot decide case in state ${caseData.state}`);\n    }\n\n    // Immutable decision history - reviewer must be assigned or platform admin\n    if (caseData.assignedTo && caseData.assignedTo !== input.reviewerId) {\n      // Allow if actor is escalated reviewer or admin\n      this.logger.warn(`Decision by non-assigned reviewer case=${caseId} assignedTo=${caseData.assignedTo} reviewer=${input.reviewerId}`);\n    }\n\n    // Determine target state based on decision\n    let targetState: ComplianceCaseState;\n    switch (input.decision) {\n      case ComplianceDecision.ALLOW:\n        targetState = ComplianceCaseState.RESOLVED;\n        break;\n      case ComplianceDecision.BLOCK:\n      case ComplianceDecision.RESTRICT:\n        targetState = ComplianceCaseState.RESOLVED;\n        break;\n      case ComplianceDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED:\n      case ComplianceDecision.PENDING:\n        targetState = ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW;\n        break;\n      default:\n        targetState = ComplianceCaseState.RESOLVED;\n    }\n\n    // If decision is BLOCK/RESTRICT, keep case RESOLVED but decision recorded - no direct ledger mutation here, downstream effects via controlled boundary\n    const updated = await this.repository.transitionState(caseId, tenantId, targetState, input.reviewerId, input.reason, input.decision, input.idempotencyKey);\n\n    await this.auditService.recordDecision(tenantId, caseId, input.decision, input.reviewerId, input.reason);\n\n    // Re-calculate risk score after decision\n    try {\n      await this.riskScoringService.calculateRiskScore({ tenantId, userId: caseData.userId, idempotencyKey: `risk_after_decision_${caseId}_${Date.now()}` });\n    } catch {}\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async requestEDD(caseId: string, tenantId: string, reviewerId: string, reason: string): Promise<any> {\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    const review = await this.repository.addReviewNote(caseId, tenantId, reviewerId, `EDD requested: ${reason}`, 'REQUEST_EDD');\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId,\n      caseId,\n      action: 'COMPLIANCE_EDD_REQUESTED',\n      actorId: reviewerId,\n      safeMetadata: { caseId, reason: reason.substring(0, 500) },\n    });\n\n    // Transition to IN_REVIEW if not already\n    if (caseData.state === ComplianceCaseState.OPEN) {\n      await this.repository.transitionState(caseId, tenantId, ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW, reviewerId, `EDD requested: ${reason}`);\n    }\n\n    return review;\n  }\n\n  async requestReverification(caseId: string, tenantId: string, reviewerId: string, reason: string): Promise<any> {\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    const review = await this.repository.addReviewNote(caseId, tenantId, reviewerId, `Re-verification requested: ${reason}`, 'REQUEST_REVERIFICATION');\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId,\n      caseId,\n      action: 'COMPLIANCE_REVERIFICATION_REQUESTED',\n      actorId: reviewerId,\n      safeMetadata: { caseId, reason: reason.substring(0, 500) },\n    });\n\n    return review;\n  }\n\n  async requestHold(caseId: string, tenantId: string, reviewerId: string, reason: string, idempotencyKey?: string): Promise<any> {\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    // Explicit policy check - no auto freeze without explicit policy + auditable action\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId, jurisdiction: caseData.jurisdiction });\n    if (!policy.manualReviewRequired && caseData.riskLevel !== RiskLevel.CRITICAL) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Hold requested but policy does not require manual review case=${caseId} risk=${caseData.riskLevel}`);\n    }\n\n    const review = await this.repository.addReviewNote(caseId, tenantId, reviewerId, `Hold requested: ${reason}`, 'REQUEST_HOLD');\n\n    await this.auditService.recordHoldRequested(tenantId, caseId, reviewerId, reason);\n\n    // Note: hold effect must be via controlled boundary, not direct DB mutation of financial tables - audit only here\n    this.logger.log(`Compliance hold requested case=${caseId} tenant=${tenantId} reviewer=${reviewerId} - requires explicit downstream action via controlled boundary`);\n\n    return review;\n  }\n\n  async requestRelease(caseId: string, tenantId: string, reviewerId: string, reason: string, idempotencyKey?: string): Promise<any> {\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    const review = await this.repository.addReviewNote(caseId, tenantId, reviewerId, `Release requested: ${reason}`, 'REQUEST_RELEASE');\n\n    await this.auditService.recordReleaseRequested(tenantId, caseId, reviewerId, reason);\n\n    this.logger.log(`Compliance release requested case=${caseId} tenant=${tenantId} reviewer=${reviewerId} - requires explicit downstream action via controlled boundary`);\n\n    return review;\n  }\n\n  async resolveCase(caseId: string, tenantId: string, reviewerId: string, reason: string, decision?: ComplianceDecision): Promise<any> {\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    if (![ComplianceCaseState.IN_REVIEW, ComplianceCaseState.ESCALATED].includes(caseData.state as ComplianceCaseState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Cannot resolve case in state ${caseData.state}`);\n    }\n\n    const updated = await this.repository.transitionState(caseId, tenantId, ComplianceCaseState.RESOLVED, reviewerId, reason, decision);\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId,\n      caseId,\n      action: 'COMPLIANCE_CASE_RESOLVED',\n      actorId: reviewerId,\n      safeMetadata: { caseId, decision: decision || caseData.decision, reason: reason.substring(0, 500) },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async closeCase(caseId: string, tenantId: string, reviewerId: string, reason: string): Promise<any> {\n    const caseData = await this.repository.findById(caseId, tenantId);\n    if (!caseData) throw new NotFoundException(`Case ${caseId} not found`);\n\n    if (caseData.state !== ComplianceCaseState.RESOLVED && caseData.state !== ComplianceCaseState.REJECTED) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Can only close RESOLVED or REJECTED cases, current=${caseData.state}`);\n    }\n\n    const updated = await this.repository.transitionState(caseId, tenantId, ComplianceCaseState.CLOSED, reviewerId, reason);\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId,\n      caseId,\n      action: 'COMPLIANCE_CASE_CLOSED',\n      actorId: reviewerId,\n      safeMetadata: { caseId, reason: reason.substring(0, 500) },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async fullScan?: boolean }): Promise<{\n    issues: { category: string; count: number; examples: any[] }[];\n    totalIssues: number;\n    scanned: number;\n  }> {\n    const issues: { category: string; count: number; examples: any[] }[] = [];\n    let totalIssues = 0;\n    let scanned = 0;\n\n    const tenantFilter = params.tenantId ? { tenantId: params.tenantId } : {};\n\n    // 1. Verification marked VERIFIED without provider reference\n    const verifiedWithoutProvider = await this.findVerifiedWithoutProvider(tenantFilter);\n    if (verifiedWithoutProvider.length > 0) {\n      issues.push({ category: 'VERIFIED_WITHOUT_PROVIDER_REF', count: verifiedWithoutProvider.length, examples: verifiedWithoutProvider.slice(0, 5) });\n      totalIssues += verifiedWithoutProvider.length;\n    }\n    scanned += verifiedWithoutProvider.length;\n\n    // 2. Stale PENDING verifications beyond SLA (7 days)\n    const stalePending = await this.findStalePending(tenantFilter);\n    if (stalePending.length > 0) {\n      issues.push({ category: 'STALE_PENDING_VERIFICATION', count: stalePending.length, examples: stalePending.slice(0, 5) });\n      totalIssues += stalePending.length;\n    }\n    scanned += stalePending.length;\n\n    // 3. CLEAR despite MATCH\n    const clearDespiteMatch = await this.findClearDespiteMatch(tenantFilter);\n    if (clearDespiteMatch.length > 0) {\n      issues.push({ category: 'CLEAR_DESPITE_MATCH', count: clearDespiteMatch.length, examples: clearDespiteMatch.slice(0, 5) });\n      totalIssues += clearDespiteMatch.length;\n    }\n    scanned += clearDespiteMatch.length;\n\n    // 4. Blocked with unrestricted - decision BLOCK but no case or case not resolved\n    const blockedWithUnrestricted = await this.findBlockedWithUnrestricted(tenantFilter);\n    if (blockedWithUnrestricted.length > 0) {\n      issues.push({ category: 'BLOCKED_WITH_UNRESTRICTED', count: blockedWithUnrestricted.length, examples: blockedWithUnrestricted.slice(0, 5) });\n      totalIssues += blockedWithUnrestricted.length;\n    }\n    scanned += blockedWithUnrestricted.length;\n\n    // 5. Decision without reviewer\n    const decisionWithoutReviewer = await this.findDecisionWithoutReviewer(tenantFilter);\n    if (decisionWithoutReviewer.length > 0) {\n      issues.push({ category: 'DECISION_WITHOUT_REVIEWER', count: decisionWithoutReviewer.length, examples: decisionWithoutReviewer.slice(0, 5) });\n      totalIssues += decisionWithoutReviewer.length;\n    }\n    scanned += decisionWithoutReviewer.length;\n\n    // 6. Duplicate case/screening\n    const duplicates = await this.findDuplicates(tenantFilter);\n    if (duplicates.length > 0) {\n      issues.push({ category: 'DUPLICATE_CASE_SCREENING', count: duplicates.length, examples: duplicates.slice(0, 5) });\n      totalIssues += duplicates.length;\n    }\n    scanned += duplicates.length;\n\n    // 7. Expired treated as valid\n    const expiredAsValid = await this.findExpiredTreatedAsValid(tenantFilter);\n    if (expiredAsValid.length > 0) {\n      issues.push({ category: 'EXPIRED_TREATED_AS_VALID', count: expiredAsValid.length, examples: expiredAsValid.slice(0, 5) });\n      totalIssues += expiredAsValid.length;\n    }\n    scanned += expiredAsValid.length;\n\n    // 8. State mismatch between KycProfile and ComplianceScreeningRequest\n    const stateMismatch = await this.findStateMismatch(tenantFilter);\n    if (stateMismatch.length > 0) {\n      issues.push({ category: 'STATE_MISMATCH', count: stateMismatch.length, examples: stateMismatch.slice(0, 5) });\n      totalIssues += stateMismatch.length;\n    }\n    scanned += stateMismatch.length;\n\n    // Audit reconciliation run\n    for (const issue of issues) {\n      for (const example of issue.examples) {\n        try {\n          await this.auditService.recordReconciliationDetected(\n            example.tenantId || params.tenantId || 'platform',\n            example.id || 'unknown',\n            issue.category,\n            'EXPECTED_CONSISTENT_STATE',\n            `DETECTED_${issue.category}`,\n          );\n        } catch {}\n      }\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`Compliance reconciliation completed tenant=${params.tenantId || 'all'} totalIssues=${totalIssues} scanned=${scanned}`);\n\n    return { issues, totalIssues, scanned };\n  }\n\n  private async findVerifiedWithoutProvider(tenantFilter: any): Promise<any[]> {\n    const results = await (this.prisma as any).complianceScreeningRequest?.findMany({\n      where: { ...tenantFilter, kycState: KycState.VERIFIED, providerRef: null },\n      take: 100,\n    }) || [];\n\n    const kycProfiles = await (this.prisma as any).kycProfile?.findMany({\n      where: { ...tenantFilter, status: 'APPROVED', externalApplicantId: null },\n      take: 100,\n    }) || [];\n\n    return [...results, ...kycProfiles].map((r: any) => ({ id: r.id, tenantId: r.tenantId, userId: r.userId, issue: 'VERIFIED without provider reference' }));\n  }\n\n  private async findStalePending(tenantFilter: any): Promise<any[]> {\n    const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n    const stale = await (this.prisma as any).complianceScreeningRequest?.findMany({\n      where: { ...tenantFilter, kycState: KycState.PENDING, createdAt: { lt: sevenDaysAgo } },\n      take: 100,\n    }) || [];\n\n    return stale.map((r: any) => ({ id: r.id, tenantId: r.tenantId, userId: r.userId, createdAt: r.createdAt, issue: 'Stale PENDING beyond 7 days' }));\n  }\n\n  private async findClearDespiteMatch(tenantFilter: any): Promise<any[]> {\n    // Find users with both CLEAR and MATCH screening results\n    const allRequests = await (this.prisma as any).complianceScreeningRequest?.findMany({\n      where: { ...tenantFilter, type: { in: ['AML', 'TRANSACTION'] } },\n      take: 500,\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    }) || [];\n\n    const userMap = new Map<string, any[]>();\n    for (const req of allRequests) {\n      const key = `${req.tenantId}_${req.userId}`;\n      if (!userMap.has(key)) userMap.set(key, []);\n      userMap.get(key)!.push(req);\n    }\n\n    const issues: any[] = [];\n    for (const [key, requests] of userMap.entries()) {\n      const hasMatch = requests.some((r: any) => r.amlState === AmlState.MATCH || r.amlState === AmlState.BLOCKED);\n      const hasClearAsLatest = requests[0]?.amlState === AmlState.CLEAR;\n      if (hasMatch && hasClearAsLatest) {\n        issues.push({ id: requests[0].id, tenantId: requests[0].tenantId, userId: requests[0].userId, issue: 'CLEAR despite previous MATCH', history: requests.slice(0, 3).map((r: any) => r.amlState) });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return issues;\n  }\n\n  private async findBlockedWithUnrestricted(tenantFilter: any): Promise<any[]> {\n    const blockedCases = await (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.findMany({\n      where: { ...tenantFilter, decision: ComplianceDecision.BLOCK },\n      take: 100,\n    }) || [];\n\n    // Check if user still has active trading/payout despite block - via canonical sources\n    const issues: any[] = [];\n    for (const c of blockedCases) {\n      // If case is RESOLVED with BLOCK but not CLOSED and user has recent payments, flag\n      if (c.state === 'RESOLVED' || c.state === 'OPEN') {\n        issues.push({ id: c.id, tenantId: c.tenantId, userId: c.userId, issue: 'BLOCKED decision but case still open/resolved without restriction enforcement', decision: c.decision });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return issues;\n  }\n\n  private async findDecisionWithoutReviewer(tenantFilter: any): Promise<any[]> {\n    const reviews = await (this.prisma as any).complianceReview?.findMany({\n      where: { ...tenantFilter, decision: { not: null }, reviewerId: null },\n      take: 100,\n    }) || [];\n\n    const cases = await (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.findMany({\n      where: { ...tenantFilter, decision: { not: null }, assignedTo: null },\n      take: 100,\n    }) || [];\n\n    return [\n      ...reviews.map((r: any) => ({ id: r.id, tenantId: r.tenantId, caseId: r.caseId, issue: 'Decision without reviewer in review' })),\n      ...cases.map((c: any) => ({ id: c.id, tenantId: c.tenantId, userId: c.userId, issue: 'Case decision without assigned reviewer' })),\n    ];\n  }\n\n  private async findDuplicates(tenantFilter: any): Promise<any[]> {\n    const allCases = await (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.findMany({\n      where: { ...tenantFilter, state: { in: ['OPEN', 'IN_REVIEW', 'ESCALATED'] } },\n      take: 500,\n    }) || [];\n\n    const seen = new Map<string, any[]>();\n    for (const c of allCases) {\n      const key = `${c.tenantId}_${c.userId}_${c.caseType}`;\n      if (!seen.has(key)) seen.set(key, []);\n      seen.get(key)!.push(c);\n    }\n\n    const duplicates: any[] = [];\n    for (const [key, cases] of seen.entries()) {\n      if (cases.length > 1) {\n        duplicates.push({ key, count: cases.length, ids: cases.map((c: any) => c.id), tenantId: cases[0].tenantId, userId: cases[0].userId, issue: 'Duplicate open cases' });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Screening duplicates by idempotencyKey\n    const screeningRequests = await (this.prisma as any).complianceScreeningRequest?.findMany({\n      where: tenantFilter,\n      take: 500,\n    }) || [];\n\n    const idempotencyMap = new Map<string, number>();\n    for (const req of screeningRequests) {\n      if (req.idempotencyKey) {\n        idempotencyMap.set(req.idempotencyKey, (idempotencyMap.get(req.idempotencyKey) || 0) + 1);\n      }\n    }\n\n    for (const [key, count] of idempotencyMap.entries()) {\n      if (count > 1) {\n        duplicates.push({ key, count, issue: 'Duplicate screening idempotencyKey' });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return duplicates;\n  }\n\n  private async findExpiredTreatedAsValid(tenantFilter: any): Promise<any[]> {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const expiredProfiles = await (this.prisma as any).kycProfile?.findMany({\n      where: { ...tenantFilter, expiresAt: { lt: now }, status: 'APPROVED' },\n      take: 100,\n    }) || [];\n\n    return expiredProfiles.map((p: any) => ({ id: p.id, tenantId: p.tenantId, userId: p.userId, expiresAt: p.expiresAt, issue: 'Expired KYC treated as valid APPROVED' }));\n  }\n\n  private async findStateMismatch(tenantFilter: any): Promise<any[]> {\n    const kycProfiles = await (this.prisma as any).kycProfile?.findMany({\n      where: tenantFilter,\n      take: 200,\n    }) || [];\n\n    const issues: any[] = [];\n\n    for (const profile of kycProfiles) {\n      const screeningRequest = await (this.prisma as any).complianceScreeningRequest?.findFirst({\n        where: { userId: profile.userId, type: 'KYC' },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n\n      if (screeningRequest) {\n        const profileState = profile.status;\n        const screeningState = screeningRequest.kycState;\n\n        // Map APPROVED to VERIFIED\n        const expectedScreeningState = profileState === 'APPROVED' ? KycState.VERIFIED : profileState === 'REJECTED' ? KycState.REJECTED : profileState === 'PENDING' ? KycState.PENDING : null;\n\n        if (expectedScreeningState && screeningState !== expectedScreeningState && screeningState !== KycState.PENDING) {\n          // Allow PENDING to be different, but VERIFIED vs REJECTED mismatch is issue\n          if ((profileState === 'APPROVED' && screeningState === KycState.REJECTED) || (profileState === 'REJECTED' && screeningState === KycState.VERIFIED)) {\n            issues.push({ id: profile.id, tenantId: profile.tenantId, userId: profile.userId, profileStatus: profileState, screeningState, issue: 'State mismatch between KycProfile and ComplianceScreeningRequest' });\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return issues;\n  }\n\n  async getReconciliationStats(tenantId?: string): Promise<any> {\n    const result = await this.runReconciliation({ tenantId, fullScan: true });\n    return {\n      tenantId: tenantId || 'all',\n      totalIssues: result.totalIssues,\n      scanned: result.scanned,\n      categories: result.issues.map((i) => ({ category: i.category, count: i.count })),\n      runAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/compliance/compliance.controller.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any.
