endpoints\nimport { Controller, Get, Post, Body, Param, Query, UseGuards, Req, ForbiddenException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { AuthGuard } from '@nestjs/passport';\nimport { RequirePermissions } from '../../common/decorators/permissions.decorator';\nimport { Permission } from '@wlct/shared-types';\nimport { CurrentUser } from '../../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';\nimport { CurrentTenant } from '../../common/decorators/current-tenant.decorator';\nimport { CompliancePolicyService } from './compliance-policy.service';\nimport { IdentityVerificationService } from './identity-verification.service';\nimport { AmlScreeningService } from './aml-screening.service';\nimport { RiskScoringService } from './risk-scoring.service';\nimport { TransactionMonitoringService } from './transaction-monitoring.service';\nimport { ComplianceCaseService } from './compliance-case.service';\nimport { ComplianceReconciliationService } from './compliance-reconciliation.service';\nimport { KycProviderFactory } from './kyc-provider.factory';\nimport { AmlProviderFactory } from './aml-provider.factory';\nimport { ComplianceQueryDto, KycStatusQueryDto, AmlStatusQueryDto, MonitoringSignalQueryDto, ReconciliationQueryDto } from './dto/compliance-query.dto';\nimport { StartKycVerificationDto, RetryKycVerificationDto, ScreenPersonDto, ScreenTransactionDto, CreateComplianceCaseDto } from './dto/kyc-action.dto';\nimport {\n  AssignCaseDto,\n  EscalateCaseDto,\n  AddEvidenceDto,\n  AddNoteDto,\n  MakeDecisionDto,\n  RequestEDDDto,\n  RequestReverificationDto,\n  RequestHoldDto,\n  RequestReleaseDto,\n  ResolveCaseDto,\n  CloseCaseDto,\n  EvaluateTransactionDto,\n  ResolveSignalDto,\n} from './dto/compliance-review.dto';\nimport { CreatePolicyDto, CalculateRiskScoreDto } from './dto/risk-policy.dto';\n\n\n/**\n * Compliance controller: RBAC tenant-only own data + compliance reviewers scoped + PLATFORM_MANAGE for platform admin/policy\n * Never expose PII/secrets, tenant isolation enforced, auditable.\n */\n@Controller('compliance')\n@UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))\nexport class ComplianceController {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly policyService: CompliancePolicyService,\n    private readonly identityService: IdentityVerificationService,\n    private readonly amlService: AmlScreeningService,\n    private readonly riskService: RiskScoringService,\n    private readonly monitoringService: TransactionMonitoringService,\n    private readonly caseService: ComplianceCaseService,\n    private readonly reconciliationService: ComplianceReconciliationService,\n    private readonly kycFactory: KycProviderFactory,\n    private readonly amlFactory: AmlProviderFactory,\n  ) {}\n\n  // ===== Policy =====\n\n  @Get('policy')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async getPolicy(@CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @Query('jurisdiction') jurisdiction?: string) {\n    const tenantId = tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    return this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId, jurisdiction });\n  }\n\n  @Get('policy/list')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async listPolicies(@Query() query: ComplianceQueryDto) {\n    return this.policyService.listPolicies({ tenantId: query.tenantId, jurisdiction: query.jurisdiction, isActive: true });\n  }\n\n  @Post('policy')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async createPolicy(@Body() dto: CreatePolicyDto, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    if (!dto.jurisdiction || !dto.policyVersion) throw new BadRequestException('jurisdiction and policyVersion required');\n    return this.policyService.createOrUpdatePolicy({\n      tenantId: dto.tenantId || null,\n      jurisdiction: dto.jurisdiction,\n      policyVersion: dto.policyVersion,\n      kycRequired: dto.kycRequired,\n      amlRequired: dto.amlRequired,\n      sanctionsRequired: dto.sanctionsRequired,\n      pepRequired: dto.pepRequired,\n      eddRequired: dto.eddRequired,\n      transactionThresholds: dto.transactionThresholds,\n      riskThresholds: dto.riskThresholds,\n      highRiskCountries: dto.highRiskCountries,\n      blockedCountries: dto.blockedCountries,\n      reverificationIntervalDays: dto.reverificationIntervalDays,\n      manualReviewRequired: dto.manualReviewRequired,\n      rules: dto.rules,\n      actorId: user.id || user.userId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('providers')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async getProviders() {\n    return {\n      kyc: {\n        configured: process.env.KYC_PROVIDER || 'UNAVAILABLE',\n        available: this.kycFactory.listAvailableProviders(),\n        capabilities: this.kycFactory.getProviderCapabilities(),\n      },\n      aml: {\n        configured: process.env.AML_PROVIDER || 'UNAVAILABLE',\n        available: this.amlFactory.listAvailableProviders(),\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  // ===== KYC =====\n\n  @Post('kyc/start')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.KYC_WRITE, Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE)\n  async startKyc(@Body() dto: StartKycVerificationDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any, @Req() req: any) {\n    const tenantId = dto.tenantId || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n\n    // Tenant-only own data unless compliance reviewer/admin\n    const requesterTenantId = tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId || user?.tenantId;\n    const roles = user?.roles || user?.permissions || [];\n    const isPrivileged = roles.includes('ADMIN') || roles.includes('OWNER') || roles.includes('COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER') || roles.includes('PLATFORM_ADMIN');\n\n    if (requesterTenantId !== tenantId && !roles.includes('PLATFORM_ADMIN')) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cross-tenant access denied');\n    }\n\n    if (!isPrivileged && dto.userId !== user.id && dto.userId !== user.userId) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cannot start KYC for other users');\n    }\n\n    return this.identityService.startVerification({\n      tenantId,\n      userId: dto.userId,\n      email: dto.email || user.email || `${dto.userId}@example.com`,\n      countryCode: dto.countryCode,\n      jurisdiction: dto.jurisdiction,\n      levelName: dto.levelName,\n      idempotencyKey: dto.idempotencyKey,\n      actorId: user.id || user.userId,\n      ipHash: req.ip ? `hash_${req.ip}` : undefined,\n      requestId: req.headers['x-request-id'] as string,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Post('kyc/retry')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.KYC_WRITE, Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE)\n  async retryKyc(@Body() dto: RetryKycVerificationDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any, @Req() req: any) {\n    const tenantId = dto.tenantId || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n\n    return this.identityService.retryVerification({\n      tenantId,\n      userId: dto.userId,\n      idempotencyKey: dto.idempotencyKey,\n      actorId: user.id || user.userId,\n      ipHash: req.ip ? `hash_${req.ip}` : undefined,\n      requestId: req.headers['x-request-id'] as string,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('kyc/status')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.KYC_READ, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async getKycStatus(@Query() query: KycStatusQueryDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId || user?.tenantId;\n    const userId = query.userId || user.id || user.userId;\n\n    // Tenant isolation: regular users can only check own status\n    const roles = user?.roles || user?.permissions || [];\n    const isPrivileged = roles.includes('ADMIN') || roles.includes('OWNER') || roles.includes('COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER') || roles.includes('PLATFORM_ADMIN');\n    if (!isPrivileged && query.userId && query.userId !== (user.id || user.userId)) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cannot check other users KYC status');\n    }\n\n    return this.identityService.getStatus({ tenantId, userId, providerReference: query.providerReference });\n  }\n\n  @Get('kyc/status/:userId')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.KYC_READ, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async getKycStatusByUser(@Param('userId') userId: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId || user?.tenantId;\n    const roles = user?.roles || user?.permissions || [];\n    const isPrivileged = roles.includes('ADMIN') || roles.includes('OWNER') || roles.includes('COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER') || roles.includes('PLATFORM_ADMIN');\n    if (!isPrivileged && userId !== (user.id || user.userId)) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cannot check other users KYC status');\n    }\n    return this.identityService.getStatus({ tenantId, userId });\n  }\n\n  // ===== AML =====\n\n  @Post('aml/screen-person')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.AML_WRITE, Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE)\n  async screenPerson(@Body() dto: ScreenPersonDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = dto.tenantId || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    return this.amlService.screenPerson({\n      tenantId,\n      userId: dto.userId,\n      firstName: dto.firstName,\n      lastName: dto.lastName,\n      countryCode: dto.countryCode,\n      dateOfBirth: dto.dateOfBirth,\n      jurisdiction: dto.jurisdiction,\n      idempotencyKey: dto.idempotencyKey,\n      actorId: user.id || user.userId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Post('aml/screen-transaction')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.AML_WRITE, Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE)\n  async screenTransaction(@Body() dto: ScreenTransactionDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = dto.tenantId || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    return this.amlService.screenTransaction({\n      tenantId,\n      userId: dto.userId,\n      transactionId: dto.transactionId,\n      transactionType: dto.transactionType,\n      amount: dto.amount,\n      currency: dto.currency,\n      counterparty: dto.counterparty,\n      jurisdiction: dto.jurisdiction,\n      idempotencyKey: dto.idempotencyKey,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('aml/status')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.AML_READ, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async getAmlStatus(@Query() query: AmlStatusQueryDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId || user?.tenantId;\n    const userId = query.userId || user.id || user.userId;\n    const roles = user?.roles || user?.permissions || [];\n    const isPrivileged = roles.includes('ADMIN') || roles.includes('OWNER') || roles.includes('COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER') || roles.includes('PLATFORM_ADMIN');\n    if (!isPrivileged && query.userId && query.userId !== (user.id || user.userId)) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cannot check other users AML status');\n    }\n    return this.amlService.getStatus({ tenantId, userId, providerReference: query.providerReference });\n  }\n\n  @Post('aml/rescreen/:providerReference')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.AML_WRITE, Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async rescreen(@Param('providerReference') providerReference: string, @Body() body: { userId: string; idempotencyKey?: string; tenantId?: string }, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = body.tenantId || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    return this.amlService.rescreen({ tenantId, userId: body.userId, providerReference, idempotencyKey: body.idempotencyKey });\n  }\n\n  // ===== Risk Scoring =====\n\n  @Post('risk/calculate')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ, Permission.RISK_READ, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async calculateRisk(@Body() dto: CalculateRiskScoreDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    return this.riskService.calculateRiskScore({ tenantId: tenantId || 'platform', userId: dto.userId, jurisdiction: dto.jurisdiction, idempotencyKey: dto.idempotencyKey });\n  }\n\n  @Get('risk/score/:userId')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ, Permission.RISK_READ)\n  async getRiskScore(@Param('userId') userId: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any, @Query('jurisdiction') jurisdiction?: string) {\n    const tenantId = tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId || user?.tenantId;\n    const roles = user?.roles || user?.permissions || [];\n    const isPrivileged = roles.includes('ADMIN') || roles.includes('OWNER') || roles.includes('COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER') || roles.includes('PLATFORM_ADMIN') || roles.includes('RISK_REVIEWER');\n    if (!isPrivileged && userId !== (user.id || user.userId)) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cannot check other users risk score');\n    }\n    const latest = await this.riskService.getLatestScore(tenantId, userId);\n    if (latest) return latest;\n    return this.riskService.calculateRiskScore({ tenantId, userId, jurisdiction });\n  }\n\n  @Get('risk/evaluate/:userId')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ, Permission.RISK_READ, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async evaluateDecision(@Param('userId') userId: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @Query('jurisdiction') jurisdiction?: string) {\n    const tenantId = tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    return this.riskService.evaluateDecision({ tenantId: tenantId || 'platform', userId, jurisdiction });\n  }\n\n  // ===== Transaction Monitoring =====\n\n  @Post('monitoring/evaluate')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async evaluateTransaction(@Body() dto: EvaluateTransactionDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    return this.monitoringService.evaluateTransaction({\n      tenantId: tenantId || (dto as any).tenantId || 'platform',\n      userId: dto.userId,\n      sourceType: dto.sourceType as any,\n      sourceId: dto.sourceId,\n      amount: dto.amount,\n      currency: dto.currency,\n      jurisdiction: dto.jurisdiction,\n      idempotencyKey: dto.idempotencyKey,\n      safeMetadata: dto.safeMetadata,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('monitoring/signals')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async listSignals(@Query() query: MonitoringSignalQueryDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId || (query as any).tenantId;\n    return this.monitoringService.listSignals(tenantId || 'platform', {\n      userId: query.userId,\n      ruleId: query.ruleId,\n      riskLevel: query.riskLevel as any,\n      decision: query.decision as any,\n      fromDate: query.fromDate ? new Date(query.fromDate) : undefined,\n      toDate: query.toDate ? new Date(query.toDate) : undefined,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Post('monitoring/signals/:signalId/resolve')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async resolveSignal(@Param('signalId') signalId: string, @Body() dto: ResolveSignalDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    return this.monitoringService.resolveSignal(signalId, tenantId || 'platform', user.id || user.userId, dto.resolution);\n  }\n\n  @Post('monitoring/scan-canonical')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async scanCanonical(@Body() body: { tenantId?: string; userId: string; fromDate?: string; toDate?: string }, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any) {\n    const tenantId = body.tenantId || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    return this.monitoringService.evaluateFromCanonicalSources({\n      tenantId: tenantId || 'platform',\n      userId: body.userId,\n      fromDate: body.fromDate ? new Date(body.fromDate) : undefined,\n      toDate: body.toDate ? new Date(body.toDate) : undefined,\n    });\n  }\n\n  // ===== Compliance Cases =====\n\n  @Post('cases')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async createCase(@Body() dto: CreateComplianceCaseDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = dto.tenantId || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    return this.caseService.createCase({\n      tenantId,\n      userId: dto.userId,\n      caseType: dto.caseType as any,\n      riskLevel: dto.riskLevel as any,\n      safeSummary: dto.safeSummary,\n      severity: dto.severity,\n      jurisdiction: dto.jurisdiction,\n      ruleIds: dto.ruleIds,\n      sourceRefs: dto.sourceRefs,\n      idempotencyKey: dto.idempotencyKey,\n      actorId: user.id || user.userId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('cases')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async listCases(@Query() query: ComplianceQueryDto, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = query.tenantId || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    const requester = { userId: user.id || user.userId, tenantId: tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId || user?.tenantId, roles: user?.roles || user?.permissions || [] };\n    return this.caseService.listTenantCases(tenantId, requester, {\n      state: query.state as any,\n      caseType: query.caseType as any,\n      riskLevel: query.riskLevel as any,\n      assignedTo: query.assignedTo,\n      fromDate: query.fromDate ? new Date(query.fromDate) : undefined,\n      toDate: query.toDate ? new Date(query.toDate) : undefined,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('cases/reviewer-queue')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ, Permission.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER)\n  async reviewerQueue(@Query() query: ComplianceQueryDto, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const reviewerId = user.id || user.userId;\n    return this.caseService.listReviewerQueue(reviewerId, { state: query.state as any, page: query.page, limit: query.limit });\n  }\n\n  @Get('cases/:caseId')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async getCase(@Param('caseId') caseId: string, @Query('tenantId') tenantIdQuery: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenantIdQuery || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    const requester = { userId: user.id || user.userId, tenantId: tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId || user?.tenantId, roles: user?.roles || user?.permissions || [] };\n    return this.caseService.getCase(caseId, tenantId, requester);\n  }\n\n  @Post('cases/:caseId/assign')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async assignCase(@Param('caseId') caseId: string, @Body() dto: AssignCaseDto, @Query('tenantId') tenantIdQuery: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenantIdQuery || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    return this.caseService.assignCase(caseId, tenantId, dto.reviewerId, user.id || user.userId, dto.idempotencyKey);\n  }\n\n  @Post('cases/:caseId/escalate')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async escalateCase(@Param('caseId') caseId: string, @Body() dto: EscalateCaseDto, @Query('tenantId') tenantIdQuery: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenantIdQuery || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    return this.caseService.escalateCase(caseId, tenantId, user.id || user.userId, dto.reason, dto.idempotencyKey);\n  }\n\n  @Post('cases/:caseId/evidence')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async addEvidence(@Param('caseId') caseId: string, @Body() dto: AddEvidenceDto, @Query('tenantId') tenantIdQuery: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenantIdQuery || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    return this.caseService.addEvidence(caseId, tenantId, {\n      evidenceType: dto.evidenceType,\n      referenceId: dto.referenceId,\n      referenceType: dto.referenceType,\n      safeDescription: dto.safeDescription,\n      addedBy: user.id || user.userId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Post('cases/:caseId/notes')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async addNote(@Param('caseId') caseId: string, @Body() dto: AddNoteDto, @Query('tenantId') tenantIdQuery: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenantIdQuery || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    return this.caseService.addNote(caseId, tenantId, user.id || user.userId, dto.safeNote);\n  }\n\n  @Post('cases/:caseId/decision')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.COMPLIANCE_WRITE, Permission.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n  async makeDecision(@Param('caseId') caseId: string, @Body() dto: MakeDecisionDto, @Query('tenantId') tenantIdQuery: string, @CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @CurrentUser() user: any) {\n    const tenantId = tenantIdQuery || tenant?.id || tenant?.tenantId;\n    if (!tenantId) throw new tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    email: string;\n    countryCode?: string;\n    jurisdiction?: string;\n    levelName?: string;\n    idempotencyKey?: string;\n    actorId?: string;\n Specify a different type.","line":313,"column":34,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":313,"endColumn":37,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[13612,13615],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[13612,13615],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":24,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Evaluates velocity, structuring, and high-risk jurisdiction rules; auto-opens compliance cases\nimport { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { CompliancePolicyService } from './compliance-policy.service';\nimport { ComplianceAuditService } from './compliance-audit.service';\nimport { ComplianceCaseRepository } from './compliance-case.repository';\nimport { RiskLevel, ComplianceDecision, ComplianceCaseType } from './compliance.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/** Summary text plus compact JSON of non-empty safe metadata (the signal model has no metadata column). */\nexport function withSafeMetadata(summary: string, safeMetadata: unknown): string {\n  if (!safeMetadata || typeof safeMetadata !== 'object' || Object.keys(safeMetadata as object).length === 0) return summary;\n  return `${summary} | meta=${JSON.stringify(safeMetadata)}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Transaction monitoring based on canonical sources: Payment/Refund/Payout/Fee/Trading\n * Emits monitoring signals for review/block per configured policy. No second financial ledger.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class TransactionMonitoringService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(TransactionMonitoringService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: CompliancePolicyService,\n    private readonly auditService: ComplianceAuditService,\n    private readonly caseRepository: ComplianceCaseRepository,\n  ) {}\n\n  async evaluateTransaction(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    sourceType: 'PAYMENT' | 'REFUND' | 'PAYOUT' | 'FEE' | 'TRADING' | 'INVOICE';\n    sourceId: string;\n    amount: string;\n    currency: string;\n    jurisdiction?: string;\n    idempotencyKey?: string;\n    safeMetadata?: Record<string, any>;\n  }): Promise<{\n    signalId?: string;\n    decision: ComplianceDecision;\n    riskLevel: RiskLevel;\n    ruleIds: string[];\n    caseId?: string;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n  }> {\n    const jurisdiction = params.jurisdiction || 'DEFAULT';\n    const idempotencyKey = params.idempotencyKey || `tx_mon_${params.tenantId}_${params.sourceType}_${params.sourceId}_${Date.now()}`;\n\n    // Idempotency\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).transactionMonitoringSignal?.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) {\n        this.logger.log(`Idempotent tx monitoring return key=${idempotencyKey}`);\n        return {\n          signalId: existing.id,\n          decision: existing.decision as ComplianceDecision,\n          riskLevel: existing.riskLevel as RiskLevel,\n          ruleIds: existing.ruleId ? [existing.ruleId] : [],\n          caseId: existing.caseId || undefined,\n          idempotencyKey,\n        };\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId, jurisdiction });\n    const amountNum = parseFloat(params.amount || '0');\n\n    let decision: ComplianceDecision = ComplianceDecision.ALLOW;\n    let riskLevel: RiskLevel = RiskLevel.LOW;\n    let triggeredRule: string | null = null;\n    let safeSummary = `Transaction ${params.sourceType} ${params.sourceId} amount [REDACTED] ${params.currency} tenant ${params.tenantId}`;\n\n    // Rule: TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_BLOCK\n    const blockThreshold = parseFloat(policy.transactionThresholds.blockAmount || '50000');\n    const reviewThreshold = parseFloat(policy.transactionThresholds.reviewAmount || '10000');\n    const highRiskMultiplier = policy.transactionThresholds.highRiskMultiplier || 0.5;\n\n    // Adjust thresholds for high-risk countries\n    const user = await this.getUser(params.userId);\n    const isHighRiskCountry = user?.countryCode ? await this.policyService.isCountryHighRisk(user.countryCode, policy) : false;\n    const effectiveBlockThreshold = isHighRiskCountry ? blockThreshold * highRiskMultiplier : blockThreshold;\n    const effectiveReviewThreshold = isHighRiskCountry ? reviewThreshold * highRiskMultiplier : reviewThreshold;\n\n    if (amountNum >= effectiveBlockThreshold) {\n      decision = ComplianceDecision.BLOCK;\n      riskLevel = RiskLevel.CRITICAL;\n      triggeredRule = 'TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_BLOCK';\n      safeSummary = `Transaction blocked: amount exceeds block threshold ${effectiveBlockThreshold} ${policy.transactionThresholds.currency} (original ${blockThreshold}), highRiskCountry=${isHighRiskCountry}`;\n    } else if (amountNum >= effectiveReviewThreshold) {\n      decision = ComplianceDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED;\n      riskLevel = RiskLevel.HIGH;\n      triggeredRule = 'TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_REVIEW';\n      safeSummary = `Transaction review required: amount exceeds review threshold ${effectiveReviewThreshold} ${policy.transactionThresholds.currency}, highRiskCountry=${isHighRiskCountry}`;\n    }\n\n    // Rule: RAPID_ACCOUNT_CHANGES / UNUSUAL_TRADING_ACTIVITY from canonical sources\n    if (decision === ComplianceDecision.ALLOW) {\n      const recentSignals = await this.getRecentSignals(params.tenantId, params.userId, 60 * 60 * 1000); // last hour\n      if (recentSignals.length >= 5) {\n        decision = ComplianceDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED;\n        riskLevel = RiskLevel.MEDIUM;\n        triggeredRule = 'UNUSUAL_TRADING_ACTIVITY';\n        safeSummary = `Unusual activity: ${recentSignals.length} signals in last hour for user ${params.userId}`;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Only persist signal if not ALLOW, or if policy requires audit of all\n    let signalId: string | undefined;\n    let caseId: string | undefined;\n\n    if (decision !== ComplianceDecision.ALLOW || triggeredRule) {\n      const id = randomUUID();\n      signalId = id;\n\n      try {\n        const signal = await (this.prisma as any).transactionMonitoringSignal?.create({\n          data: {\n            id,\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            userId: params.userId,\n            sourceType: params.sourceType,\n            sourceId: params.sourceId,\n            ruleId: triggeredRule || 'NO_RULE',\n            riskLevel,\n            decision,\n            // No safeMetadata column: non-empty metadata is appended to the summary.\n            safeSummary: withSafeMetadata(safeSummary, params.safeMetadata).substring(0, 1000),\n            idempotencyKey,\n            createdAt: new Date(),\n          },\n        });\n        if (signal) signalId = signal.id;\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        if (e.code === 'P2002') {\n          const existing = await (this.prisma as any).transactionMonitoringSignal?.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n          if (existing) {\n            signalId = existing.id;\n          }\n        } else {\n          this.logger.warn(`Failed to persist monitoring signal: ${e.message}`);\n        }\n      }\n\n      await this.auditService.recordMonitoringSignal(params.tenantId, params.userId, signalId || id, triggeredRule || 'NO_RULE', riskLevel);\n\n      // Create compliance case if BLOCK or REVIEW_REQUIRED per explicit policy - no auto freeze without auditable action\n      if ([ComplianceDecision.BLOCK, ComplianceDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED, ComplianceDecision.RESTRICT].includes(decision)) {\n        try {\n          const complianceCase = await this.caseRepository.createCase({\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            userId: params.userId,\n            caseType: ComplianceCaseType.TRANSACTION_REVIEW,\n            riskLevel,\n            safeSummary,\n            ruleIds: triggeredRule ? [triggeredRule] : [],\n            sourceRefs: [{ type: params.sourceType, id: params.sourceId, amount: '[REDACTED]', currency: params.currency }],\n            idempotencyKey: `case_tx_mon_${params.tenantId}_${params.sourceId}`,\n            metadata: { decision, riskLevel, sourceType: params.sourceType },\n          });\n          caseId = complianceCase.id;\n\n          // Update signal with caseId\n          try {\n            await (this.prisma as any).transactionMonitoringSignal?.update({\n              where: { id: signalId },\n              data: { caseId },\n            });\n          } catch {}\n        } catch (e: any) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Failed to create case for tx monitoring: ${e.message}`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return {\n      signalId,\n      decision,\n      riskLevel,\n      ruleIds: triggeredRule ? [triggeredRule] : [],\n      caseId,\n      idempotencyKey,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async evaluateFromCanonicalSources(params: { tenantId: string; userId: string; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date }): Promise<{ evaluated: number; signals: number; cases: number }> {\n    let evaluated = 0;\n    let signals = 0;\n    let cases = 0;\n\n    try {\n      // Read from canonical billing/payment sources - never second ledger\n      // Invoice, Payment, Refund, Payout, Fee, Trading - reuse existing tables if available\n\n      const from = params.fromDate || new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n      const to = params.toDate || new Date();\n\n      // Example: evaluate payments\n      let payments: any[] = [];\n      try {\n        payments = await (this.prisma as any).payment?.findMany({\n          where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } },\n          take: 100,\n          orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        }) || [];\n      } catch {}\n\n      for (const payment of payments) {\n        evaluated++;\n        const result = await this.evaluateTransaction({\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          userId: payment.userId || params.userId,\n          sourceType: 'PAYMENT',\n          sourceId: payment.id,\n          amount: payment.amount?.toString() || payment.amountCents?.toString() || '0',\n          currency: payment.currency || 'USD',\n          idempotencyKey: `canon_pay_${payment.id}`,\n        });\n        if (result.signalId) signals++;\n        if (result.caseId) cases++;\n      }\n\n      // Evaluate invoices\n      let invoices: any[] = [];\n      try {\n        invoices = await (this.prisma as any).invoice?.findMany({\n          where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } },\n          take: 100,\n          orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        }) || [];\n      } catch {}\n\n      for (const invoice of invoices) {\n        evaluated++;\n        const result = await this.evaluateTransaction({\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          userId: invoice.userId || params.userId,\n          sourceType: 'INVOICE',\n          sourceId: invoice.id,\n          amount: invoice.totalAmount?.toString() || invoice.amountDue?.toString() || '0',\n          currency: invoice.currency || 'USD',\n          idempotencyKey: `canon_inv_${invoice.id}`,\n        });\n        if (result.signalId) signals++;\n        if (result.caseId) cases++;\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Evaluate from canonical sources failed: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n\n    return { evaluated, signals, cases };\n  }\n\n  async listSignals(tenantId: string, filters?: { userId?: string; ruleId?: string; riskLevel?: RiskLevel; decision?: ComplianceDecision; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (filters?.userId) where.userId = filters.userId;\n    if (filters?.ruleId) where.ruleId = filters.ruleId;\n    if (filters?.riskLevel) where.riskLevel = filters.riskLevel;\n    if (filters?.decision) where.decision = filters.decision;\n    if (filters?.fromDate || filters?.toDate) {\n      where.createdAt = {};\n      if (filters.fromDate) where.createdAt.gte = filters.fromDate;\n      if (filters.toDate) where.createdAt.lte = filters.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).transactionMonitoringSignal?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: offset, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).transactionMonitoringSignal?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  async resolveSignal(signalId: string, tenantId: string, reviewerId: string, resolution: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    try {\n      // Tenant-scoped update (an id-only update could resolve another tenant's signal).\n      // No resolvedBy column: the reviewer is recorded in the audit entry below.\n      const result = await (this.prisma as any).transactionMonitoringSignal?.updateMany({\n        where: { id: signalId, tenantId },\n        data: { resolved: true, resolvedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n      if (!result || result.count === 0) return null;\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).transactionMonitoringSignal?.findFirst({ where: { id: signalId, tenantId } });\n\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId,\n        action: 'MONITORING_SIGNAL_RESOLVED',\n        actorId: reviewerId,\n        safeMetadata: { signalId, resolution: resolution.substring(0, 500) },\n      });\n\n      return updated || null;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Resolve signal failed: ${e.message}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async getUser(userId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    // The user's country lives on UserProfile (User has no countryCode column).\n    const user = await (this.prisma as any).user?.findUnique({ where: { id: userId }, select: { profile: { select: { countryCode: true } } } });\n    return user ? { countryCode: user.profile?.countryCode ?? null } : null;\n  }\n\n  private async getRecentSignals(tenantId: string, userId: string, windowMs: number): Promise<any[]> {\n    const since = new Date(Date.now() - windowMs);\n    return await (this.prisma as any).transactionMonitoringSignal?.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, userId, createdAt: { gte: since } },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    }) || [];\n These tests pin that:\n *   - a copy execution ends ROUTED only after createIntent AND routeIntent\n *     succeeded, and carries the canonical order id;\n *   - every OMS refusal / failure is recorded on the copy execution;\n *   - without the OMS wired, the execution fails closed (OMS_NOT_WIRED);\n *   - the idempotency key is deterministic (no Date.now()).\n */\n\nimport { BadRequestException, ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';\n\nimport {\n  CopyExecutionService,\n  accountKillSwitchBlocker,\n  eventKillSwitchBlocker,\n  copyEnvironmentFor,\n  copyIdempotencyKey,\n  copyOrderTypeFor,\n} from './copy-execution.service';\nimport { CopyExecutionStatus, CopyRiskDecision } from './copy-trading.types';\n\nconst LEADER_EVENT = {\n  eventId: 'evt-1',\n  orderId: 'lord-1',\n  fillId: null,\n  symbol: 'BTC-USDT',\n  exchangeSymbol: 'BTCUSDT',\n  side: 'BUY',\n  type: 'MARKET',\n  quantity: '1',\n  price: '50000',\n  venue: 'BINANCE',\n  timestamp: '2026-09-28T00:00:00.000Z',\n  isSimulated: true,\n};\n\nconst SUBSCRIPTION = {\n  id: 'sub-1',\n  followerId: 'user-f',\n  followerAccountId: 'acct-f',\n  allocationAmount: '1000',\n  allocationMode: 'FIXED',\n  maxAllocation: null,\n  minAllocation: null,\n  riskPolicy: {},\n};\n\ninterface Harness {\n  service: CopyExecutionService;\n  statuses: Array<{ status: CopyExecutionStatus; extra?: Record<string, unknown> }>;\n  created: any[];\n  createIntent: jest.Mock;\n  routeIntent: jest.Mock;\n}\n\nfunction harness(options: {\n  wired?: boolean;\n  createIntent?: jest.Mock;\n  routeIntent?: jest.Mock;\n  followerType?: string;\n  sandbox?: boolean;\n  traderProfile?: { userId: string; verificationState: string } | null;\n  complianceBlockedUserId?: string;\n  /** Make a pre-dispatch lookup throw. */\n  failing?: 'compliance' | 'health' | 'killSwitch' | 'maintenance' | 'followerAccount';\n  health?: Array<{ venue: string; state: string }>;\n  inMaintenance?: boolean;\n  /** Engaged kill-switch rows returned by the lookup. */\n  killSwitches?: Array<{ id?: string; scope: string; target: string | null; tenantId: string | null }>;\n} = {}): Harness {\n  const boom = (what: string) => async () => {\n    if (options.failing === what) throw new Error(`${what} lookup failed`);\n    return null;\n  };\n  const statuses: Harness['statuses'] = [];\n  const created: any[] = [];\n  const prisma = {\n    tradingAccount: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(async () => {\n        if (options.failing === 'followerAccount') throw new Error('followerAccount lookup failed');\n        return { id: 'acct-f', isSandbox: options.sandbox ?? true };\n      }),\n    },\n    killSwitch: {\n      findMany: jest.fn(async () => {\n        if (options.failing === 'killSwitch') throw new Error('killSwitch lookup failed');\n        return options.killSwitches ?? [];\n      }),\n    },\n    traderProfile: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(async (args: any) =>\n        args.where.id === 'trader-1' && args.where.tenantId === 'tenant-1'\n          ? options.traderProfile === undefined\n            ? { userId: 'trader-user-1', verificationState: 'VERIFIED' }\n            : options.traderProfile\n          : null,\n      ),\n    },\n    complianceCase: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(async (args: any) => {\n        if (options.failing === 'compliance') throw new Error('compliance lookup failed');\n        return options.complianceBlockedUserId && args.where.userId === options.complianceBlockedUserId ? { id: 'case-1' } : null;\n      }),\n    },\n    copyTradingAuditLog: { create: jest.fn(async () => ({})) },\n  };\n  const subscriptionRepo = {\n    listActive: jest.fn(async () => ({ data: [SUBSCRIPTION], total: 1 })),\n    updateState: jest.fn(async () => ({})),\n  };\n  const executionRepo = {\n    findByLeaderEventAndSubscription: jest.fn(async () => null),\n    create: jest.fn(async (input: any) => {\n      const row = { id: `exec-${created.length + 1}`, status: CopyExecutionStatus.PENDING, ...input };\n      created.push(row);\n      return row;\n    }),\n    updateStatus: jest.fn(async (_id: string, _tenant: string, status: CopyExecutionStatus, extra?: Record<string, unknown>) => {\n      statuses.push({ status, extra });\n      return {};\n    }),\n  };\n  const policyService = { resolveEffectivePolicy: jest.fn(async () => ({ slippageToleranceBps: 50, maxOrderNotional: null })) };\n  // The dispatch tests cover the *gates* around mapping (kill switches, venue\n  // health, OMS wiring), not the sizing arithmetic - that now lives in\n  // copy-order-mapper.service.spec.ts. The mapper is therefore stubbed at its\n  // public entry point, which returns a tagged result so a refusal can be\n  // recorded with its reason.\n  const orderMapper = {\n    planLeaderToFollower: jest.fn(async () => ({\n      ok: true as const,\n      intent: {\n        symbol: 'BTC-USDT',\n        exchangeSymbol: 'BTCUSDT',\n        side: 'BUY',\n        type: options.followerType ?? 'MARKET',\n        quantity: '0.02',\n        price: '50000',\n        stopPrice: null,\n        notional: '1000',\n        slippageUpper: null,\n        slippageLower: null,\n        isReduceOnly: false,\n        executionDelayMs: 0,\n        sizingMode: 'FIXED',\n        source: 'COPY',\n      },\n    })),\n  };\n  const allocationService = {\n    getAvailableBalance: jest.fn(async () => '10000'),\n    validateAllocation: jest.fn(async () => ({ valid: true })),\n  };\n  const riskService = { checkRisk: jest.fn(async () => ({ decision: CopyRiskDecision.ALLOW, ruleId: null, reason: null })) };\n  const exchangeRouting = {};\n  const exchangeHealth = {\n    listHealthByTenant: jest.fn(async () => {\n      if (options.failing === 'health') throw new Error('health lookup failed');\n      return options.health ?? [];\n    }),\n  };\n  const maintenance = {\n    isInMaintenance: jest.fn(async () => {\n      if (options.failing === 'maintenance') throw new Error('maintenance lookup failed');\n      return options.inMaintenance === true;\n    }),\n  };\n  const createIntent = options.createIntent ?? jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'intent-1', clientOrderId: 'oms1' }));\n  const routeIntent = options.routeIntent ?? jest.fn(async () => ({ intentId: 'intent-1', jobId: 'oms-submit-oms1', canonicalOrderId: 'order-1' }));\n  const wired = options.wired ?? true;\n  const service = new CopyExecutionService(\n    prisma as any,\n    subscriptionRepo as any,\n    executionRepo as any,\n    policyService as any,\n    orderMapper as any,\n    allocationService as any,\n    riskService as any,\n    exchangeRouting as any,\n    exchangeHealth as any,\n    maintenance as any,\n    { append: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'outbox-1' })) } as any,\n    wired ? ({ createIntent } as any) : undefined,\n    wired ? ({ routeIntent } as any) : undefined,\n  );\n  return { service, statuses, created, createIntent, routeIntent };\n}\n\nasync function run(h: Harness) {\n  return h.service.processLeaderEvent({ tenantId: 'tenant-1', leaderEvent: LEADER_EVENT as any, traderId: 'trader-1', strategyId: 'strategy-1' });\n}\n\ndescribe('copy execution dispatch (Phase 3)', () => {\n  it('creates and routes an OMS intent, then records ROUTED with the canonical order', async () => {\n    const h = harness();\n    const outcome = await run(h);\n    expect(outcome.processed).toBe(1);\n    expect(h.createIntent).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    const intentArgs = h.createIntent.mock.calls[0][0];\n    expect(intentArgs).toMatchObject({\n      tenantId: 'tenant-1',\n      accountId: 'acct-f',\n      symbol: 'BTC-USDT',\n      side: 'BUY',\n      orderType: 'MARKET',\n      quantity: '0.02',\n      price: null,\n      environment: 'PAPER',\n      source: 'COPY_TRADING',\n      followerId: 'user-f',\n      subscriptionId: 'sub-1',\n      metadata: { copyExecutionId: 'exec-1', leaderEventId: 'evt-1' },\n    });\n    expect(h.routeIntent).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ tenantId: 'tenant-1', intentId: 'intent-1' }));\n    const last = h.statuses[h.statuses.length - 1];\n    expect(last.status).toBe(CopyExecutionStatus.ROUTED);\n    expect(last.extra).toMatchObject({ followerOrderId: 'order-1' });\n    expect(outcome.executions[0]).toMatchObject({ status: CopyExecutionStatus.ROUTED, orderId: 'order-1', omsIntentId: 'intent-1' });\n    expect(h.created[0].idempotencyKey).toBe('copy_tenant-1_evt-1_sub-1');\n  });\n\n  it('ROUTED is never recorded before the OMS accepted the order', async () => {\n    const h = harness({ routeIntent: jest.fn(async () => { throw new ForbiddenException('Live gate BLOCK'); }) });\n    const outcome = await run(h);\n    expect(h.statuses.map((s) => s.status)).not.toContain(CopyExecutionStatus.ROUTED);\n    const last = h.statuses[h.statuses.length - 1];\n    expect(last.status).toBe(CopyExecutionStatus.REJECTED);\n    expect(String(last.extra?.failureReason)).toMatch(/Live gate BLOCK/);\n    expect(outcome.blocked).toBe(1);\n  });\n\n  it('an intent refusal (risk/compliance/precision) is recorded as REJECTED and routing is not attempted', async () => {\n    const h = harness({ createIntent: jest.fn(async () => { throw new BadRequestException('Risk blocked: DAILY_LOSS'); }) });\n    await run(h);\n    expect(h.routeIntent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    const last = h.statuses[h.statuses.length - 1];\n    expect(last.status).toBe(CopyExecutionStatus.REJECTED);\n    expect(String(last.extra?.failureReason)).toMatch(/OMS_INTENT_REFUSED: Risk blocked/);\n  });\n\n  it('an operational routing failure is FAILED, not REJECTED', async () => {\n    const h = harness({ routeIntent: jest.fn(async () => { throw new Error('redis down'); }) });\n    await run(h);\n    const last = h.statuses[h.statuses.length - 1];\n    expect(last.status).toBe(CopyExecutionStatus.FAILED);\n  });\n\n  it('without the OMS wired the execution fails closed as OMS_NOT_WIRED', async () => {\n    const h = harness({ wired: false });\n    await run(h);\n    const last = h.statuses[h.statuses.length - 1];\n    expect(last.status).toBe(CopyExecutionStatus.FAILED);\n    expect(String(last.extra?.failureReason)).toMatch(/OMS_NOT_WIRED/);\n  });\n\n  it('a stop order copy is refused before the OMS is called', async () => {\n    const h = harness({ followerType: 'STOP' });\n    await run(h);\n    expect(h.createIntent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(h.statuses[h.statuses.length - 1].status).toBe(CopyExecutionStatus.REJECTED);\n  });\n\n  it('pure helpers: idempotency key, environment and Applies resolved copy policy and follower risk decisions before dispatching orders to OMS\n// # Enforces slippage boundaries and execution delay during follower order dispatch\n// # Applies TP/SL and trailing stop parameters to follower order intents and stop-copy conditions\n// # Emits notification events on copy execution outcomes and stop-copy triggers\nimport { Injectable, Logger, Inject, Optional, forwardRef } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { OutboxService } from '../../infrastructure/outbox/outbox.service';\nimport { CopySubscriptionRepository } from './copy-subscription.repository';\nimport { CopyExecutionRepository } from './copy-execution.repository';\nimport { CopyPolicyService } from './copy-policy.service';\nimport { CopyOrderMapperService, LeaderEvent } from './copy-order-mapper.service';\nimport { FollowerAllocationService } from './follower-allocation.service';\nimport { FollowerRiskService } from './follower-risk.service';\nimport { ExchangeRoutingService } from '../exchanges/exchange-routing.service';\nimport { ExchangeHealthService } from '../exchanges/exchange-health.service';\nimport { CopyExecutionStatus, CopyRiskDecision, CopySubscriptionState } from './copy-trading.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\nimport { OrderIntentService } from '../oms/order-intent.service';\nimport { OrderRoutingService } from '../oms/order-routing.service';\nimport { MaintenanceModeService } from '../operations/maintenance-mode.service';\nimport { OperationalMaintenanceScope } from '../operations/operations.types';\n\n/** One copy execution per (tenant, leader event, subscription). Deterministic\n * on purpose: the previous key appended Date.now(), so two concurrent\n * deliveries of the same leader event produced two keys - and two follower\n * orders. With a stable key the second insert collides and is dropped. */\nexport function copyIdempotencyKey(tenantId: string, leaderEventId: string, subscriptionId: string): string {\n  return `copy_${tenantId}_${leaderEventId}_${subscriptionId}`;\n}\n\n/** The environment a follower order runs in, from the follower's own account.\n * A sandbox account is PAPER; anything else is LIVE - which the OMS live gate\n * and the simulated-only submission path then refuse explicitly. Unknown\n * (no account) is PAPER-never-LIVE: fail closed toward \"no real money\". */\nexport function copyEnvironmentFor(account: { isSandbox?: boolean | null } | null | undefined): 'PAPER' | 'LIVE' {\n  if (!account) return 'PAPER';\n  return account.isSandbox === false ? 'LIVE' : 'PAPER';\n}\n\n/** Copy mapper order types onto the OMS vocabulary; anything else is refused. */\nexport function copyOrderTypeFor(type: string | null | undefined): 'MARKET' | 'LIMIT' | null {\n  const upper = (type ?? '').toUpperCase();\n  if (upper === 'MARKET') return 'MARKET';\n  if (upper === 'LIMIT') return 'LIMIT';\n  return null;\n}\n\n/** An engaged kill-switch row as the copy path reads it. */\nexport interface EngagedKillSwitch {\n  id?: string;\n  scope: string;\n  target: string | null;\n  tenantId: string | null;\n}\n\nconst switchToken = (value: unknown): string => String(value ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();\n/** BTC-USDT, btc/usdt and BTCUSDT are one instrument for halting purposes. */\nconst symbolToken = (value: unknown): string => switchToken(value).replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');\n\n/**\n * The engaged switch that halts this leader event for EVERY follower, or null.\n *\n * Same matching as the engine's ledger (``_blocking_record_for`` in\n * wlct_trading/risk/protections.py): GLOBAL always; EXCHANGE when the target is\n * the leader's venue; STRATEGY when it is this strategy; SYMBOL when it is this\n * instrument. Venue and symbol compare case- and separator-insensitively, which\n * can only halt more, never less. ACCOUNT and RISK (``account:<id>``) switches\n * halt one trading account and are applied per follower by\n * {@link accountKillSwitchBlocker}. A non-GLOBAL row without a target, or a scope\n * this code does not know, cannot be matched safely and halts the event.\n */\nexport function eventKillSwitchBlocker(\n  switches: EngagedKillSwitch[],\n  event: { venue?: string | null; strategyId: string; symbol?: string | null; exchangeSymbol?: string | null },\n): EngagedKillSwitch | null {\n  const eventSymbols = new Set([symbolToken(event.symbol), symbolToken(event.exchangeSymbol)].filter((token) => token.length > 0));\n  for (const ks of switches) {\n    const target = ks.target === null || ks.target === undefined ? '' : String(ks.target).trim();\n    switch (ks.scope) {\n      case 'GLOBAL':\n        return ks;\n      case 'EXCHANGE':\n        if (!target || switchToken(target) === switchToken(event.venue)) return ks;\n        break;\n      case 'STRATEGY':\n        if (!target || target === event.strategyId) return ks;\n        break;\n      case 'SYMBOL':\n        if (!target || eventSymbols.has(symbolToken(target))) return ks;\n        break;\n      case 'ACCOUNT':\n      case 'RISK':\n        if (!target) return ks;\n        break;\n      default:\n        return ks;\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/**\n * The engaged ACCOUNT / RISK switch that halts one follower's trading account,\n * or null. Targets as the engine writes them: ACCOUNT = the account id, RISK =\n * ``account:<id>``.\n */\nexport function accountKillSwitchBlocker(switches: EngagedKillSwitch[], accountId: string | null | undefined): EngagedKillSwitch | null {\n  if (!accountId) return null;\n  for (const ks of switches) {\n    const target = ks.target === null || ks.target === undefined ? '' : String(ks.target).trim();\n    if (ks.scope === 'ACCOUNT' && target === accountId) return ks;\n    if (ks.scope === 'RISK' && target === `account:${accountId}`) return ks;\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\nexport interface CopyTradingOutcomeNotifier {\n  notifyExecutionOutcome(payload: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    followerId: string;\n    traderId: string;\n    strategyId: string;\n    subscriptionId: string;\n    executionId: string;\n    status: CopyExecutionStatus;\n    symbol: string;\n    side: string;\n    quantity: string | null;\n    reason?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<void>;\n}\n\n/**\n * Consumes validated leader trading events and fans them out into follower execution intents via existing execution/risk/compliance/security/exchange routing with fail-closed gates.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class CopyExecutionService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(CopyExecutionService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly subscriptionRepo: CopySubscriptionRepository,\n    private readonly executionRepo: CopyExecutionRepository,\n    private readonly policyService: CopyPolicyService,\n    private readonly orderMapper: CopyOrderMapperService,\n    private readonly allocationService: FollowerAllocationService,\n    private readonly riskService: FollowerRiskService,\n    private readonly exchangeRouting: ExchangeRoutingService,\n    private readonly exchangeHealth: ExchangeHealthService,\n    private readonly maintenance: MaintenanceModeService,\n    private readonly outbox: OutboxService,\n    @Optional() @Inject(forwardRef(() => OrderIntentService)) private readonly orderIntents?: OrderIntentService,\n    @Optional() @Inject(forwardRef(() => OrderRoutingService)) private readonly orderRouting?: OrderRoutingService,\n    @Optional() @Inject('COPY_TRADING_OUTCOME_NOTIFIER') private readonly outcomeNotifier?: CopyTradingOutcomeNotifier,\n  ) {}\n\n  async processLeaderEvent(input: { tenantId: string; leaderEvent: LeaderEvent; traderId: string; strategyId: string; actorId?: string }): Promise<{ processed: number; skipped: number; blocked: number; executions: any[] }> {\n    this.logger.log(`Processing leader event tenant=${input.tenantId} event=${input.leaderEvent.eventId} trader=${input.traderId} strategy=${input.strategyId} symbol=${input.leaderEvent.symbol}`);\n\n    let traderUserId: string;\n    try {\n      const profile = await (this.prisma as any).traderProfile?.findFirst({\n        where: { id: input.traderId, tenantId: input.tenantId },\n        select: { userId: true, verificationState: true },\n      });\n      if (!profile?.userId) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Leader event blocked: trader profile not found tenant=${input.tenantId} trader=${input.traderId}`);\n        return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 1, executions: [] };\n      }\n      if (profile.verificationState === 'SUSPENDED' || profile.verificationState === 'REJECTED') {\n        this.logger.warn(`Leader event blocked: trader ${input.traderId} is ${profile.verificationState}`);\n        return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 1, executions: [] };\n      }\n      traderUserId = profile.userId;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Leader event blocked: trader lookup failed trader=${input.traderId}: ${e?.message}`);\n      return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 1, executions: [] };\n    }\n\n    // Compliance BLOCK must prevent copy\n    try {\n      const complianceCase = await (this.prisma as any).complianceCase?.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, userId: traderUserId, decision: 'BLOCK', state: { in: ['OPEN', 'IN_REVIEW', 'ESCALATED'] } } });\n      if (complianceCase) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Leader event blocked by compliance trader=${input.traderId} user=${traderUserId}`);\n        return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 1, executions: [] };\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Leader event blocked: compliance lookup failed trader=${input.traderId}: ${e?.message}`);\n      return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 1, executions: [] };\n    }\n\n    // Leader venue health check\n    try {\n      const venue = String(input.leaderEvent.venue ?? '').toUpperCase();\n      const healthList = await this.exchangeHealth.listHealthByTenant(input.tenantId);\n      const outage = healthList.find((h: any) => String(h.venue ?? '').toUpperCase() === venue && h.state === 'UNAVAILABLE');\n      if (outage) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Leader event blocked: venue ${venue} unavailable tenant=${input.tenantId}`);\n        return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 1, executions: [] };\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Leader event blocked: exchange health unavailable tenant=${input.tenantId}: ${e?.message}`);\n      return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 1, executions: [] };\n    }\n\n    // Kill switches matched to this event\n    let engagedSwitches: EngagedKillSwitch[];\n    try {\n      engagedSwitches = (await this.prisma.killSwitch.findMany({\n        where: { isEngaged: true, OR: [{ tenantId: input.tenantId }, { tenantId: null }] },\n        select: { id: true, scope: true, target: true, tenantId: true },\n      })) as EngagedKillSwitch[];\n      const eventBlocker = eventKillSwitchBlocker(engagedSwitches, {\n        venue: input.leaderEvent.venue,\n        strategyId: input.strategyId,\n        symbol: input.leaderEvent.symbol,\n        exchangeSymbol: input.leaderEvent.exchangeSymbol,\n      });\n      if (eventBlocker) {\n        this.logger.warn(\n          `Leader event blocked by kill switch tenant=${input.tenantId} scope=${eventBlocker.scope} target=${eventBlocker.target ?? '-'}`,\n        );\n        return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 1, executions: [] };\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Leader event blocked: kill switch lookup failed tenant=${input.tenantId}: ${e?.message}`);\n      return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 1, executions: [] };\n    }\n\n    // Trading maintenance\n    try {\n      if (await this.maintenance.isInMaintenance({ scope: OperationalMaintenanceScope.TRADING_CAPABILITY, tenantId: input.tenantId })) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Leader event blocked by trading maintenance tenant=${input.tenantId}`);\n        return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 1, executions: [] };\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Leader event blocked: maintenance lookup failed tenant=${input.tenantId}: ${e?.message}`);\n      return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 1, executions: [] };\n    }\n\n    // Resolve active follower subscriptions\n    const { data: subscriptions } = await this.subscriptionRepo.listActive(input.tenantId, { strategyId: input.strategyId, limit: 1000 });\n\n    if (subscriptions.length === 0) {\n      this.logger.log(`No active subscriptions for strategy=${input.strategyId}`);\n      return { processed: 0, skipped: 0, blocked: 0, executions: [] };\n    }\n\n    let processed = 0;\n    let skipped = 0;\n    let blocked = 0;\n    const executions: any[] = [];\n\n    for (const sub of subscriptions) {\n      try {\n        const result = await this.processForSubscription({\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          leaderEvent: input.leaderEvent,\n          subscription: sub,\n          traderId: input.traderId,\n          strategyId: input.strategyId,\n          engagedSwitches,\n        });\n\n        if (result) {\n          if (result.status === CopyExecutionStatus.BLOCKED || result.status === CopyExecutionStatus.REJECTED) blocked++;\n          else if (result.status === CopyExecutionStatus.SKIPPED) skipped++;\n          else processed++;\n          executions.push(result);\n        } else {\n          skipped++;\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to process subscription=${sub.id} error=${e.message}`);\n        skipped++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { processed, skipped, blocked, executions };\n  }\n\n  private async transitionSubscriptionWithOutbox(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    subscription: Record<string, any>;\n    nextState: CopySubscriptionState;\n    eventType: string;\n    timestamps: { pausedAt?: Date; stoppedAt?: Date };\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const transitionEventId = randomUUID();\n\n    await this.prisma.withTenantRls(input.tenantId, async (tx) => {\n      const updated = await this.subscriptionRepo.updateState(\n        input.subscription.id,\n        input.tenantId,\n        input.nextState,\n        input.timestamps,\n        { tx, expectedState: input.subscription.state as CopySubscriptionState },\n      );\n      if (!updated) {\n        throw new Error('copy subscription state changed concurrently; refusing to publish a stale lifecycle event');\n      }\n\n      await this.outbox.append(tx, {\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        aggregateType: 'copy.subscription',\n        aggregateId: updated.id,\n        eventType: input.eventType,\n        idempotencyKey: `copy-subscription:${updated.id}:${input.eventType}:${transitionEventId}`,\n        payload: {\n          subscriptionId: updated.id,\n          followerId: updated.followerId,\n          traderId: updated.traderId,\n          strategyId: updated.strategyId,\n          state: input.nextState,\n        },\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  private async emitNotificationIfWired(payload: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    followerId: string;\n    traderId: string;\n    strategyId: string;\n    subscriptionId: string;\n    executionId: string;\n    status: CopyExecutionStatus;\n    symbol: string;\n    side: string;\n    quantity: string | null;\n    reason?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.outcomeNotifier) return;\n    try {\n      await this.outcomeNotifier.notifyExecutionOutcome(payload);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Copy notification hook failed execution=${payload.executionId}: ${e?.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async processForSubscription(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    leaderEvent: LeaderEvent;\n    subscription: any;\n    traderId: string;\n    strategyId: string;\n    engagedSwitches?: EngagedKillSwitch[];\n  }): Promise<any | null> {\n    const { tenantId, leaderEvent, subscription } = input;\n\n    // Prevent duplicate execution intent from same leader event/subscription\n    const existing = await this.executionRepo.findByLeaderEventAndSubscription(tenantId, leaderEvent.eventId, subscription.id);\n    if (existing) {\n      this.logger.log(`Duplicate execution prevented tenant=${tenantId} event=${leaderEvent.eventId} sub=${subscription.id}`);\n      return existing;\n    }\n\n    // Never copy a leader event that happened before this subscription started\n    const eventAt = Date.parse(String(leaderEvent.timestamp ?? ''));\n    if (subscription.startedAt && Number.isFinite(eventAt) && eventAt < new Date(subscription.startedAt).getTime()) {\n      this.logger.log(`Leader event predates subscription tenant=${tenantId} event=${leaderEvent.eventId} sub=${subscription.id}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // ACCOUNT / RISK kill switch on follower account\n    const accountBlocker = accountKillSwitchBlocker(input.engagedSwitches ?? [], subscription.followerAccountId);\n    if (accountBlocker) {\n      this.logger.warn(\n        `Copy blocked by kill switch tenant=${tenantId} sub=${subscription.id} scope=${accountBlocker.scope} target=${accountBlocker.target ?? '-'}`,\n      );\n      const halted = await this.executionRepo.create({\n        tenantId,\n        leaderEventId: leaderEvent.eventId,\n        leaderOrderId: leaderEvent.orderId || null,\n        leaderFillId: leaderEvent.fillId || null,\n        subscriptionId: subscription.id,\n        followerId: subscription.followerId,\n        traderId: input.traderId,\n        followerAccountId: subscription.followerAccountId,\n        sizingMode: subscription.allocationMode,\n        leaderQuantity: leaderEvent.quantity,\n        leaderPrice: leaderEvent.price || null,\n        followerQuantity: null,\n        followerPrice: null,\n        slippageTolerance: null,\n        maxNotional: null,\n        executionIntent: { reason: 'KILL_SWITCH', scope: accountBlocker.scope, target: accountBlocker.target, leaderEvent } as any,\n        idempotencyKey: copyIdempotencyKey(tenantId, leaderEvent.eventId, subscription.id),\n      });\n      await this.executionRepo.updateStatus(halted.id, tenantId, CopyExecutionStatus.BLOCKED, {\n        failureReason: `${accountBlocker.scope} kill switch engaged for ${accountBlocker.target}`,\n      });\n      return { ...halted, status: CopyExecutionStatus.BLOCKED };\n    }\n\n    // Resolve effective copy policy - Platform → Tenant → Trader Strategy → Follower Subscription\n    const effectivePolicy = await this.policyService.resolveEffectivePolicy({ tenantId, strategyId: input.strategyId, subscriptionId: subscription.id });\n\n    // Get follower balance from canonical data.\n    //\n    // This used to be wrapped in a bare `catch {}`.
