The copy record carries whichever it is.\n */\nexport type SlippageMeasurementState = 'MEASURED' | 'NOT_YET_MEASURED' | 'UNMEASURABLE';\n\n/**\n * Resolves effective copy settings: proportional sizing, fixed sizing, symbol filters, max concurrent copies, slippage tolerance, delay, notional caps, and risk controls.\n * Policy precedence: Platform → Tenant → Trader Strategy → Follower Subscription. Lower-level must never weaken mandatory higher-level safety rule.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class CopyPolicyService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(CopyPolicyService.name);\n\n  // Platform-level mandatory safety rules - never weakened\n  private readonly platformPolicy: CopyPolicy = {\n    sizingMode: CopySizingMode.PROPORTIONAL,\n    proportionalRatio: null,\n    fixedQuantity: null,\n    fixedNotional: null,\n    maxOrderNotional: '100000', // Platform cap 100k\n    maxDailyNotional: '500000', // Platform cap 500k\n    maxConcurrentCopies: 20,\n    slippageToleranceBps: 100, // 1% max slippage at platform level\n    executionDelayMs: 0,\n    allowedSymbols: null,\n    blockedSymbols: ['*WITHDRAWAL*'], // Never allow withdrawal symbols\n    allowedSides: ['BUY', 'SELL'],\n    leveragePolicy: 'SPOT_ONLY',\n    maxLeverage: '10',\n    marginMode: 'SPOT',\n    reduceOnly: null,\n    takeProfitBps: null,\n    stopLossBps: null,\n    trailingStopBps: null,\n    stopCopyConditions: null,\n  };\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async getPlatformPolicy(): Promise<CopyPolicy> {\n    return this.platformPolicy;\n  }\n\n  // The three lookups below let errors propagate. Lower levels may only\n  // tighten the policy, so silently dropping a level on a database error (as\n  // they used to, returning null) produced a LOOSER effective policy - e.g.\n  // tenant-blocked symbols or the follower's max notional disappeared. The\n  // copy engine skips the subscription when resolution fails (no order).\n\n  async getTenantPolicy(tenantId: string): Promise<CopyPolicy | null> {\n    const setting = await this.prisma.tenantSetting.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, key: 'copy_trading_policy' } });\n    if (setting && setting.value) {\n      return setting.value as any as CopyPolicy;\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * `tenantId` scopes the lookup; resolveEffectivePolicy always passes it, so\n   * GET copy-trading/policies/effective cannot read another tenant's\n   * strategy or subscription policy by id.\n   */\n  async getTraderStrategyPolicy(strategyId: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<CopyPolicy | null> {\n    const strategy = await this.prisma.traderStrategy.findFirst({\n      where: { id: strategyId, ...(tenantId ? { tenantId } : {}) },\n      select: { riskProfile: true, strategyConfig: true, supportedSymbols: true },\n    });\n    if (!strategy || !strategy.riskProfile) return null;\n    const risk = (strategy.riskProfile ?? {}) as Record<string, any>;\n    const config = (strategy.strategyConfig ?? {}) as Record<string, any>;\n    // Extract copy policy from riskProfile or strategyConfig\n    return {\n      sizingMode: config.sizingMode || CopySizingMode.PROPORTIONAL,\n      proportionalRatio: config.proportionalRatio || null,\n      fixedQuantity: config.fixedQuantity || null,\n      fixedNotional: config.fixedNotional || null,\n      maxOrderNotional: risk.maxOrderNotional || null,\n      maxDailyNotional: risk.maxDailyNotional || null,\n      maxConcurrentCopies: risk.maxConcurrentCopies || null,\n      slippageToleranceBps: config.slippageToleranceBps ?? null,\n      executionDelayMs: config.executionDelayMs ?? null,\n      allowedSymbols: strategy.supportedSymbols || null,\n      blockedSymbols: risk.blockedSymbols || null,\n      allowedSides: config.allowedSides || null,\n      leveragePolicy: risk.leveragePolicy || config.leveragePolicy || null,\n      maxLeverage: risk.maxLeverage || config.maxLeverage || null,\n      marginMode: risk.marginMode || config.marginMode || null,\n      reduceOnly: config.reduceOnly ?? null,\n      takeProfitBps: config.takeProfitBps ?? risk.takeProfitBps ?? null,\n      stopLossBps: config.stopLossBps ?? risk.stopLossBps ?? null,\n      trailingStopBps: config.trailingStopBps ?? risk.trailingStopBps ?? null,\n      stopCopyConditions: risk.stopCopyConditions || config.stopCopyConditions || null,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getSubscriptionPolicy(subscriptionId: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<CopyPolicy | null> {\n    const sub = await this.prisma.copySubscription.findFirst({ where: { id: subscriptionId, ...(tenantId ? { tenantId } : {}) } });\n    if (sub && sub.copyPolicy) {\n      return sub.copyPolicy as unknown as CopyPolicy;\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async resolveEffectivePolicy(input: { tenantId: string; strategyId?: string; subscriptionId?: string }): Promise<CopyPolicy> {\n    const platform = await this.getPlatformPolicy();\n    const tenant = await this.getTenantPolicy(input.tenantId);\n    const strategy = input.strategyId ? await this.getTraderStrategyPolicy(input.strategyId, input.tenantId) : null;\n    const subscription = input.subscriptionId ? await this.getSubscriptionPolicy(input.subscriptionId, input.tenantId) : null;\n\n    // Precedence: Platform → Tenant → Trader Strategy → Follower Subscription\n    // Lower-level must never weaken mandatory higher-level safety rule\n\n    let effective: CopyPolicy = { ...platform };\n\n    const merge = (base: CopyPolicy, override: CopyPolicy | null): CopyPolicy => {\n      if (!override) return base;\n      const merged: CopyPolicy = { ...base };\n\n      // Sizing mode - lower can override\n      if (override.sizingMode) merged.sizingMode = override.sizingMode;\n      if (override.proportionalRatio) merged.proportionalRatio = override.proportionalRatio;\n      if (override.fixedQuantity) merged.fixedQuantity = override.fixedQuantity;\n      if (override.fixedNotional) merged.fixedNotional = override.fixedNotional;\n\n      // Notional caps - lower cannot weaken higher (must be <= higher).\n      //\n      // Compared as exact decimals. These are money ceilings: deciding with a float means two\n      // nearly-equal limits can order differently than they read, and an unparseable override would\n      // be a silently-kept base. An override that cannot be parsed is treated as unweakenable too -\n      // it is not evidence that the ceiling is safe to move.\n      if (override.maxOrderNotional) {\n        const baseNotional = Decimal.tryParse(base.maxOrderNotional ?? '1000000') ?? Decimal.parse('1000000');\n        const overrideNotional = Decimal.tryParse(override.maxOrderNotional);\n        if (!overrideNotional || overrideNotional.gt(baseNotional)) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Policy override attempts to weaken maxOrderNotional base=${baseNotional.toString()} override=${override.maxOrderNotional} - keeping base`);\n        } else {\n          merged.maxOrderNotional = override.maxOrderNotional;\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (override.maxDailyNotional) {\n        const baseDaily = Decimal.tryParse(base.maxDailyNotional ?? '1000000') ?? Decimal.parse('1000000');\n        const overrideDaily = Decimal.tryParse(override.maxDailyNotional);\n        if (!overrideDaily || overrideDaily.gt(baseDaily)) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Policy override attempts to weaken maxDailyNotional base=${baseDaily.toString()} override=${override.maxDailyNotional} - keeping base`);\n        } else {\n          merged.maxDailyNotional = override.maxDailyNotional;\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (override.maxConcurrentCopies !== null && override.maxConcurrentCopies !== undefined) {\n        const baseVal = base.maxConcurrentCopies || 100;\n        if (override.maxConcurrentCopies > baseVal) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Policy override attempts to weaken maxConcurrentCopies base=${baseVal} override=${override.maxConcurrentCopies}`);\n        } else {\n          merged.maxConcurrentCopies = override.maxConcurrentCopies;\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (override.slippageToleranceBps !== null && override.slippageToleranceBps !== undefined) {\n        const baseVal = base.slippageToleranceBps ?? 100;\n        if (override.slippageToleranceBps > baseVal || override.slippageToleranceBps < 0) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Policy override attempts to weaken slippageTolerance base=${baseVal} override=${override.slippageToleranceBps}`);\n        } else {\n          merged.slippageToleranceBps = override.slippageToleranceBps;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Execution delay: lower level cannot set a negative delay or reduce below a higher-level mandatory floor, and is capped at 60,000ms\n      if (override.executionDelayMs !== null && override.executionDelayMs !== undefined) {\n        const baseDelay = base.executionDelayMs ?? 0;\n        if (override.executionDelayMs < baseDelay) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Policy override attempts to reduce executionDelayMs below base=${baseDelay} override=${override.executionDelayMs}`);\n        } else {\n          merged.executionDelayMs = Math.min(60000, Math.max(baseDelay, override.executionDelayMs));\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Symbol filters - intersection logic: allowed = intersection of all allowed, blocked = union of all blocked\n      if (override.allowedSymbols) {\n        if (base.allowedSymbols) {\n          merged.allowedSymbols = base.allowedSymbols.filter((s) => override.allowedSymbols!.includes(s));\n        } else {\n          merged.allowedSymbols = override.allowedSymbols;\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (override.blockedSymbols) {\n        const baseBlocked = base.blockedSymbols || [];\n        merged.blockedSymbols = Array.from(new Set([...baseBlocked, ...override.blockedSymbols]));\n      }\n\n      if (override.allowedSides) {\n        if (base.allowedSides) {\n          merged.allowedSides = base.allowedSides.filter((s) => override.allowedSides!.includes(s));\n        } else {\n          merged.allowedSides = override.allowedSides;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Leverage & Margin constraints: lower level cannot exceed higher-level maxLeverage or weaken SPOT_ONLY\n      if (override.leveragePolicy) {\n        // Both branches of the original condition assigned the same value, so it was dead code\n        // dressed as a rule. The rule that matters: SPOT_ONLY stays SPOT_ONLY unless a leverage\n        // limit above 1 is actually supplied, and `maxLeverage` may not exceed the level it is\n        // overriding.\n        const suppliedLeverage = Decimal.tryParse(override.maxLeverage ?? '') ?? Decimal.ZERO;\n        merged.leveragePolicy =\n          base.leveragePolicy === 'SPOT_ONLY' &&\n          override.leveragePolicy !== 'SPOT_ONLY' &&\n          suppliedLeverage.lte(Decimal.ONE)\n            ? base.leveragePolicy\n            : override.leveragePolicy;\n      }\n\n      if (override.maxLeverage) {\n        const baseMaxLev = Decimal.tryParse(base.maxLeverage ?? '10') ?? Decimal.parse('10');\n        const overrideLev = Decimal.tryParse(override.maxLeverage);\n        if (!overrideLev || !overrideLev.isPositive()) {\n          // An unreadable or non-positive leverage limit is not a limit. Keep the base ceiling and\n          // say so, rather than recording a value the venue would reject or read as unlimited.\n          this.logger.warn(`Policy override carries an unusable maxLeverage override=${override.maxLeverage} - keeping base=${baseMaxLev.toString()}`);\n        } else if (overrideLev.gt(baseMaxLev)) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Policy override attempts to weaken maxLeverage base=${baseMaxLev.toString()} override=${overrideLev.toString()}`);\n        } else {\n          merged.maxLeverage = override.maxLeverage;\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (override.marginMode) {\n        merged.marginMode = override.marginMode;\n      }\n\n      if (override.reduceOnly !== null && override.reduceOnly !== undefined) {\n        merged.reduceOnly = base.reduceOnly === true ? true : override.reduceOnly;\n      }\n\n      // TP/SL and trailing stop parameters: tighter stop-loss / trailing-stop (smaller bps) from higher level cannot be loosened\n      if (override.takeProfitBps !== null && override.takeProfitBps !== undefined && override.takeProfitBps > 0) {\n        merged.takeProfitBps = override.takeProfitBps;\n      }\n\n      if (override.stopLossBps !== null && override.stopLossBps !== undefined && override.stopLossBps > 0) {\n        if (base.stopLossBps && override.stopLossBps > base.stopLossBps) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Policy override attempts to loosen stopLossBps base=${base.stopLossBps} override=${override.stopLossBps}`);\n        } else {\n          merged.stopLossBps = override.stopLossBps;\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (override.trailingStopBps !== null && override.trailingStopBps !== undefined && override.trailingStopBps > 0) {\n        if (base.trailingStopBps && override.trailingStopBps > base.trailingStopBps) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Policy override attempts to loosen trailingStopBps base=${base.trailingStopBps} override=${override.trailingStopBps}`);\n        } else {\n          merged.trailingStopBps = override.trailingStopBps;\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (override.stopCopyConditions) {\n        merged.stopCopyConditions = {\n          ...(base.stopCopyConditions ?? {}),\n          ...override.stopCopyConditions,\n        };\n      }\n\n      return merged;\n    };\n\n    effective = merge(effective, tenant);\n    effective = merge(effective, strategy);\n    effective = merge(effective, subscription);\n\n    this.logger.log(`Effective copy policy resolved tenant=${input.tenantId} strategy=${input.strategyId} subscription=${input.subscriptionId} maxNotional=${effective.maxOrderNotional} slippage=${effective.slippageToleranceBps}`);\n\n    return effective;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Evaluates slippage tolerance and execution delay deterministically for a copy execution.\n   */\n  evaluateSlippageAndDelay(input: {\n    policy: CopyPolicy;\n    leaderPrice: string | null;\n    executionPrice?: string | null;\n    side: string;\n    leaderTimestamp?: string | null;\n    nowMs?: number;\n  }): {\n    allowed: boolean;\n    ruleId: string | null;\n    reason: string | null;\n    slippageBps: number | null;\n    slippageState: SlippageMeasurementState;\n    effectiveDelayMs: number;\n    scheduledReleaseAt: string | null;\n  } {\n    const now = input.nowMs ?? Date.now();\n    const effectiveDelayMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(60000, input.policy.executionDelayMs ?? 0));\n    const baseMs = input.leaderTimestamp && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(input.leaderTimestamp)) ? Date.parse(input.leaderTimestamp) : now;\n    const scheduledReleaseAt = effectiveDelayMs > 0 ? new Date(baseMs + effectiveDelayMs).toISOString() : null;\n\n    // No reference price means no baseline to measure against. The leader's fill price *is* the\n    // slippage reference (see leader-event-source.service.ts), so its absence is a data fault\n    // rather than an ordinary market order - and copying blind is the outcome this guardrail exists\n    // to prevent. Refuse, and say which input was missing, instead of reporting a pass that was\n    // never established.\n    if (!input.leaderPrice) {\n      return {\n        allowed: false,\n        ruleId: 'SLIPPAGE_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE',\n        reason: 'Leader reference price is unavailable, so adverse slippage cannot be measured',\n        slippageBps: null,\n        slippageState: 'UNMEASURABLE',\n        effectiveDelayMs,\n        scheduledReleaseAt,\n      };\n    }\n\n    if (!isDecimalString(input.leaderPrice)) {\n      return {\n        allowed: false,\n        ruleId: 'INVALID_SLIPPAGE_PRICE',\n        reason: 'Leader price is not a valid decimal string',\n        slippageBps: null,\n        slippageState: 'UNMEASURABLE',\n        effectiveDelayMs,\n        scheduledReleaseAt,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // The follower's price is not known until it trades. Its absence is not a pass: the measurement\n    // has not been taken, and the result says so rather than implying the movement was zero. What\n    // constrains the fill in the meantime are the venue-side bounds on the mapped intent\n    // (intent.slippageUpper / slippageLower), derived from this same tolerance.\n    if (!input.executionPrice) {\n      return {\n        allowed: true,\n        ruleId: null,\n        reason: 'Follower execution price is not known yet; adverse slippage is not yet measured',\n        slippageBps: null,\n        slippageState: 'NOT_YET_MEASURED',\n        effectiveDelayMs,\n        scheduledReleaseAt,\n      };\n    }\n\n    if (!isDecimalString(input.executionPrice)) {\n      return {\n        allowed: false,\n        ruleId: 'INVALID_SLIPPAGE_PRICE',\n        reason: 'Execution price is not a valid decimal string',\n        slippageBps: null,\n        slippageState: 'UNMEASURABLE',\n        effectiveDelayMs,\n        scheduledReleaseAt,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Exact decimals from here down. Prices arrive as decimal strings and are parsed into scale-12\n    // integers, so the comparison that decides whether a customer's order may proceed is made on\n    // exact values. The previous implementation divided IEEE doubles and rounded to two places\n    // before comparing, which is not a basis for a verdict expressed in basis points.\n    const leader = decimalFromScaled12(parseDecimalString(input.leaderPrice));\n    const execution = decimalFromScaled12(parseDecimalString(input.executionPrice));\n\n    if (!leader.isPositive() || !execution.isPositive()) {\n      return {\n        allowed: false,\n        ruleId: 'INVALID_SLIPPAGE_PRICE',\n        reason: 'Leader price and execution price must be positive',\n        slippageBps: null,\n        slippageState: 'UNMEASURABLE',\n        effectiveDelayMs,\n        scheduledReleaseAt,\n      };\n    }\n\n    const sideUpper = String(input.side || 'BUY').toUpperCase();\n    // Adverse slippage in bps: for BUY, paying higher than leaderPrice; for SELL, receiving lower\n    // than leaderPrice. Favourable movement reports zero, never a negative allowance.\n    const rawDiff = sideUpper === 'BUY' ? execution.sub(leader) : leader.sub(execution);\n    const adverseBpsExact = rawDiff.isPositive()\n      ? rawDiff.div(leader, 18, 'HALF_UP').mul(10_000).normalize()\n      : Decimal.ZERO;\n\n    // Compared unrounded; rounded only for the response field. Rounding first would let 25.004 bps\n    // satisfy a 25 bps tolerance.\n    const maxBpsExact = Decimal.parse(input.policy.slippageToleranceBps ?? 100);\n    const displayedBps = Number(adverseBpsExact.toFixed(2, 'HALF_UP'));\n\n    if (adverseBpsExact.gt(maxBpsExact)) {\n      return {\n        allowed: false,\n        ruleId: 'SLIPPAGE_TOLERANCE_EXCEEDED',\n        reason: `Adverse slippage ${adverseBpsExact.toString()} bps exceeds tolerance ${maxBpsExact.toString()} bps`,\n        slippageBps: displayedBps,\n        slippageState: 'MEASURED',\n        effectiveDelayMs,\n        scheduledReleaseAt,\n      };\n    }\n\n    return {\n      allowed: true,\n      ruleId: null,\n      reason: null,\n      slippageBps: displayedBps,\n      slippageState: 'MEASURED',\n      effectiveDelayMs,\n      scheduledReleaseAt,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Computes deterministic TP/SL, trailing stop distance, and stop-copy condition triggers.\n   */\n  resolveStopPolicy(input: {\n    policy: CopyPolicy;\n    entryPrice: string | null;\n    side: string;\n    currentDrawdownPercent?: string | null;\n    cumulativeLoss?: string | null;\n  }): CopyStopExecutionPlan {\n    const { policy, entryPrice, side } = input;\n    const sideUpper = String(side || 'BUY').toUpperCase();\n\n    let takeProfitPrice: string | null = null;\n    let stopLossPrice: string | null = null;\n    let trailingStopDistance: string | null = null;\n    let trailingActivationPrice: string | null = null;\n\n    if (entryPrice && isDecimalString(entryPrice)) {\n      const entry = decimalFromScaled12(parseDecimalString(entryPrice));\n      if (entry.isPositive()) {\n        // A bps delta is `entry * bps / 10000`, evaluated exactly at scale 18 and normalised. The\n        // exit prices this produces are order instructions, so they are derived the same way the\n        // order mapper derives its bounds rather than by scaling a double and trimming its digits.\n        const deltaFor = (bps: number): Decimal =>\n          entry.mul(Decimal.parse(bps)).div(10_000, 18, 'HALF_UP').normalize();\n        const isBuy = sideUpper === 'BUY';\n\n        if (policy.takeProfitBps && policy.takeProfitBps > 0) {\n          const delta = deltaFor(policy.takeProfitBps);\n          const raw = isBuy ? entry.add(delta) : entry.sub(delta);\n          // A non-positive exit price is not a price. Omit it rather than emit 0, which downstream\n          // would read as an instruction to exit at zero.\n          takeProfitPrice = raw.isPositive() ? raw.toString() : null;\n          if (!takeProfitPrice) {\n            this.logger.warn(`takeProfitBps=${policy.takeProfitBps} against entry=${entryPrice} yields no positive price for a ${sideUpper}`);\n          }\n        }\n\n        if (policy.stopLossBps && policy.stopLossBps > 0) {\n          const delta = deltaFor(policy.stopLossBps);\n          const raw = isBuy ? entry.sub(delta) : entry.add(delta);\n          stopLossPrice = raw.isPositive() ? raw.toString() : null;\n          if (!stopLossPrice) {\n            // A stop-loss that cannot be expressed is a control that will not exist. Loud, not silent.\n            this.logger.warn(`stopLossBps=${policy.stopLossBps} against entry=${entryPrice} yields no positive price for a ${sideUpper}; no stop-loss will be attached`);\n          }\n        }\n\n        if (policy.trailingStopBps && policy.trailingStopBps > 0) {\n          trailingStopDistance = deltaFor(policy.trailingStopBps).toString();\n          trailingActivationPrice = takeProfitPrice || entryPrice;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    let stopCopyTriggered = false;\n    let stopCopyReason: string | null = null;\n    const conds = policy.stopCopyConditions || null;\n    if (conds) {\n      if (conds.maxDrawdownPercent && input.currentDrawdownPercent && isDecimalString(String(conds.maxDrawdownPercent)) && isDecimalString(input.currentDrawdownPercent)) {\n        if (compareDecimalStrings(input.currentDrawdownPercent, String(conds.maxDrawdownPercent)) >= 0) {\n          stopCopyTriggered = true;\n          stopCopyReason = `Stop-copy drawdown threshold ${conds.maxDrawdownPercent}% reached (current ${input.currentDrawdownPercent}%)`;\n        }\n      }\n      if (!stopCopyTriggered && conds.maxCumulativeLoss && input.cumulativeLoss && isDecimalString(String(conds.maxCumulativeLoss)) && isDecimalString(input.cumulativeLoss)) {\n        if (compareDecimalStrings(input.cumulativeLoss, String(conds.maxCumulativeLoss)) >= 0) {\n          stopCopyTriggered = true;\n          stopCopyReason = `Stop-copy cumulative loss threshold ${conds.maxCumulativeLoss} reached (current ${input.cumulativeLoss})`;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return {\n      takeProfitPrice,\n      stopLossPrice,\n      trailingStopBps: policy.trailingStopBps ?? null,\n      trailingStopDistance,\n      trailingActivationPrice,\n      stopCopyTriggered,\n      stopCopyReason,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Validates the allow / deny symbol rules on a policy.\n   *\n   * Rules are globs (see `matchesSymbolRule`). Two failure modes are worth rejecting loudly because\n   * both leave an operator believing in a restriction that does not exist:\n   *\n   *   - a rule that can never match anything - empty, padded with whitespace, or carrying a\n   *     character no symbol contains. `'BTC USDT'` looks like a symbol and matches nothing.\n   *   - a rule set that contradicts itself - a literal appearing in both lists, or a blocked glob\n   *     that swallows an allowed entry, which makes the allow list unsatisfiable and blocks every\n   *     copy the operator expected to permit.\n   *\n   * The platform's own `*WITHDRAWAL*` deny rule is a valid glob and passes; it is the matcher, not\n   * this validator, that had to learn about patterns for that rule to mean anything.\n   */\n  validateSymbolRules(policy: CopyPolicy): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {\n    const errors: string[] = [];\n\n    const inspect = (rules: string[] | null | undefined, label: string): void => {\n      if (rules === null || rules === undefined) return;\n      if (!Array.isArray(rules)) {\n        errors.push(`${label} must be an array of symbol rules`);\n        return;\n      }\n      for (const rule of rules) {\n        if (typeof rule !== 'string' || rule.trim().length === 0) {\n          errors.push(`${label} contains an empty rule`);\n          continue;\n        }\n        if (rule !== rule.trim()) {\n          errors.push(`${label} rule \"${rule}\" has surrounding whitespace and will never match`);\n        }\n        if (/\\s/.test(rule)) {\n          errors.push(`${label} rule \"${rule}\" contains whitespace and will never match a symbol`);\n        }\n        if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9*._/$:-]+$/.test(rule)) {\n          errors.push(`${label} rule \"${rule}\" contains characters that are not valid in a symbol or glob`);\n        }\n      }\n    };\n\n    inspect(policy.allowedSymbols, 'allowedSymbols');\n    inspect(policy.blockedSymbols, 'blockedSymbols');\n\n    const blocked = Array.isArray(policy.blockedSymbols) ? policy.blockedSymbols : [];\n    const allowed = Array.isArray(policy.allowedSymbols) ? policy.allowedSymbols : [];\n\n    if (blocked.some((rule) => rule.trim() === '*')) {\n      errors.push(\"blockedSymbols '*' blocks every symbol\");\n    }\n\n    for (const entry of allowed) {\n      if (typeof entry !== 'string' || entry.length === 0) continue;\n      const conflicting = blocked.find(\n        (rule) => typeof rule === 'string' && !rule.includes('*') && rule.toUpperCase() === entry.toUpperCase(),\n      );\n      if (conflicting) {\n        errors.push(`symbol ${entry} appears in both allowedSymbols and blockedSymbols`);\n        continue;\n      }\n      // Only a literal allow entry can be swallowed unambiguously; comparing two globs would be a\n      // claim this validator cannot support.\n      if (!entry.includes('*')) {\n        const swallower = blocked.find((rule) => typeof rule === 'string' && rule.includes('*') && matchesSymbolRule(rule, entry));\n        if (swallower) {\n          errors.push(`allowedSymbols entry ${entry} is blocked by rule ${swallower}, so no symbol can satisfy both`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };\n  }\n\n  validatePolicy(policy: CopyPolicy): { valid: boolean; errors: string[] } {\n    const errors: Optional so a harness\n    // without it still reconciles executions; missing-copy detection then\n    // reports itself as skipped instead of silently passing.\n    @Optional() private readonly leaderEvents?: LeaderEventSourceService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async reconcileTenant(tenantId: string, filters?: { strategyId?: string; from?: Date; to?: Date; limit?: number }): Promise<{ records: any[]; summary: Record<string, number> }> {\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 100;\n    const from = filters?.from || new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n    const to = filters?.to || new Date();\n\n    // Get leader events - from orders/fills? For simplicity, we treat orders as leader events\n    // In real system, leader events would be stored in a separate table or derived from trader's orders\n\n    // Get all executions in time range\n    const executions = await (this.prisma as any).copyExecution?.findMany({ where: { tenantId, createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to }, ...(filters?.strategyId ? { traderId: filters.strategyId } : {}) }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: limit }) || [];\n\n    // Get all active subscriptions for tenant\n    const { data: subscriptions } = await this.subscriptionRepo.listByTenant(tenantId, { page: 1, limit: 1000 });\n\n    const records: any[] = [];\n    const summary: Record<string, number> = {};\n\n    const incrementSummary = (cat: string) => {\n      summary[cat] = (summary[cat] || 0) + 1;\n    };\n\n    // Check each execution\n    for (const exec of executions) {\n      try {\n        const sub = subscriptions.find((s: any) => s.id === exec.subscriptionId);\n\n        // Execution after stop-copy must be flagged\n        if (sub && (sub.state === 'STOPPED' || sub.state === 'CANCELLED')) {\n          if (new Date(exec.createdAt) > new Date(sub.stoppedAt || sub.cancelledAt || sub.updatedAt)) {\n            const rec = await this.createRecord({\n              tenantId,\n              leaderEventId: exec.leaderEventId,\n              subscriptionId: exec.subscriptionId,\n              executionId: exec.id,\n              category: CopyReconciliationCategory.EXECUTION_AFTER_STOP,\n              severity: CopyReconciliationSeverity.CRITICAL,\n              expected: { subscriptionState: sub.state, stoppedAt: sub.stoppedAt || sub.cancelledAt },\n              actual: { executionCreatedAt: exec.createdAt, status: exec.status },\n              leaderReference: { leaderEventId: exec.leaderEventId, leaderOrderId: exec.leaderOrderId },\n              followerReference: { followerOrderId: exec.followerOrderId, followerFillId: exec.followerFillId },\n            });\n            records.push(rec);\n            incrementSummary(CopyReconciliationCategory.EXECUTION_AFTER_STOP);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Duplicate copy detection - same leaderEvent + subscription\n        const duplicates = executions.filter((e: any) => e.leaderEventId === exec.leaderEventId && e.subscriptionId === exec.subscriptionId && e.id !== exec.id);\n        if (duplicates.length > 0) {\n          const rec = await this.createRecord({\n            tenantId,\n            leaderEventId: exec.leaderEventId,\n            subscriptionId: exec.subscriptionId,\n            executionId: exec.id,\n            category: CopyReconciliationCategory.DUPLICATE_COPY,\n            severity: CopyReconciliationSeverity.HIGH,\n            expected: { count: 1 },\n            actual: { count: duplicates.length + 1, duplicateIds: duplicates.map((d: any) => d.id) },\n            leaderReference: { leaderEventId: exec.leaderEventId },\n            followerReference: null,\n          });\n          records.push(rec);\n          incrementSummary(CopyReconciliationCategory.DUPLICATE_COPY);\n        }\n\n        // Stale intent - execution stuck in PENDING/VALIDATED for too long\n        if (['PENDING', 'VALIDATED', 'MAPPED', 'RISK_CHECKED', 'ROUTED'].includes(exec.status)) {\n          const ageMs = Date.now() - new Date(exec.createdAt).getTime();\n          if (ageMs > 5 * 60 * 1000) {\n            // 5 minutes stale\n            const rec = await this.createRecord({\n              tenantId,\n              leaderEventId: exec.leaderEventId,\n              subscriptionId: exec.subscriptionId,\n              executionId: exec.id,\n              category: CopyReconciliationCategory.STALE_INTENT,\n              severity: ageMs > 30 * 60 * 1000 ? CopyReconciliationSeverity.HIGH : CopyReconciliationSeverity.MEDIUM,\n              expected: { status: 'FILLED or FAILED within 5min' },\n              actual: { status: exec.status, ageMs },\n              leaderReference: null,\n              followerReference: null,\n            });\n            records.push(rec);\n            incrementSummary(CopyReconciliationCategory.STALE_INTENT);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Order mismatch - follower order not found or mismatched\n        if (exec.followerOrderId) {\n          try {\n            const followerOrder = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: exec.followerOrderId, tenantId } });\n            if (!followerOrder) {\n              const rec = await this.createRecord({\n                tenantId,\n                leaderEventId: exec.leaderEventId,\n                subscriptionId: exec.subscriptionId,\n                executionId: exec.id,\n                category: CopyReconciliationCategory.ORDER_MISMATCH,\n                severity: CopyReconciliationSeverity.HIGH,\n                expected: { followerOrderId: exec.followerOrderId },\n                actual: { found: false },\n                leaderReference: null,\n                followerReference: { followerOrderId: exec.followerOrderId },\n              });\n              records.push(rec);\n              incrementSummary(CopyReconciliationCategory.ORDER_MISMATCH);\n            } else {\n              // Quantity mismatch\n              if (exec.followerQuantity && followerOrder.quantity) {\n                const execQty = exec.followerQuantity.toString();\n                const orderQty = followerOrder.quantity.toString();\n                if (execQty !== orderQty) {\n                  const rec = await this.createRecord({\n                    tenantId,\n                    leaderEventId: exec.leaderEventId,\n                    subscriptionId: exec.subscriptionId,\n                    executionId: exec.id,\n                    category: CopyReconciliationCategory.QUANTITY_MISMATCH,\n                    severity: CopyReconciliationSeverity.MEDIUM,\n                    expected: { quantity: execQty },\n                    actual: { quantity: orderQty },\n                    leaderReference: null,\n                    followerReference: { orderId: followerOrder.id, quantity: orderQty },\n                  });\n                  records.push(rec);\n                  incrementSummary(CopyReconciliationCategory.QUANTITY_MISMATCH);\n                }\n              }\n\n              // Price mismatch / slippage\n              if (exec.followerPrice && followerOrder.price) {\n                const execPrice = parseFloat(exec.followerPrice.toString());\n                const orderPrice = parseFloat(followerOrder.price.toString());\n                const slippage = Math.abs(execPrice - orderPrice) / execPrice;\n                const tolerance = exec.slippageTolerance ? parseFloat(exec.slippageTolerance) / 10000 : 0.01;\n                if (slippage > tolerance) {\n                  const rec = await this.createRecord({\n                    tenantId,\n Prevent duplicate active subscription where business rules prohibit it.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class CopySubscriptionRepository {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(CopySubscriptionRepository.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async create(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    followerId: string;\n    traderId: string;\n    strategyId: string;\n    allocationMode: CopySizingMode;\n    allocationAmount: string;\n    maxAllocation?: string | null;\n    minAllocation?: string | null;\n    copyPolicy?: Record<string, any>;\n    riskPolicy?: Record<string, any>;\n    followerAccountId?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  }, tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient): Promise<any> {\n    const client = (tx ?? this.prisma) as any;\n\n    // Idempotent replay first: a retried request (same tenant, same key) gets\n    // its original subscription back. Checked before the duplicate-active rule,\n    // because the original subscription IS the active one - checking the rule\n    // first turned every retry into a \"duplicate\" error.\n    if (input.idempotencyKey) {\n      const existingByKey = await client.copySubscription.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existingByKey) {\n        this.logger.log(`Idempotent subscription return key=${input.idempotencyKey}`);\n        return existingByKey;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Prevent duplicate active subscription where business rules prohibit it\n    const existingActive = await client.copySubscription.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, followerId: input.followerId, strategyId: input.strategyId, state: { in: ['PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED'] } },\n    });\n\n    if (existingActive) {\n      throw new Error(`Duplicate active subscription for follower=${input.followerId} strategy=${input.strategyId} existing=${existingActive.id}`);\n    }\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date();\n\n    const data = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      followerId: input.followerId,\n      traderId: input.traderId,\n      strategyId: input.strategyId,\n      state: CopySubscriptionState.PENDING,\n      allocationMode: input.allocationMode,\n      allocationAmount: input.allocationAmount,\n      maxAllocation: input.maxAllocation || null,\n      minAllocation: input.minAllocation || null,\n      copyPolicy: input.copyPolicy || {},\n      riskPolicy: input.riskPolicy || {},\n      followerAccountId: input.followerAccountId || null,\n      startedAt: null,\n      pausedAt: null,\n      stoppedAt: null,\n      totalCopiedVolume: '0',\n      totalCopies: 0,\n      failedCopies: 0,\n      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey || randomUUID(),\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await client.copySubscription.create({ data });\n      this.logger.log(`Copy subscription created id=${created.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} follower=${input.followerId} trader=${input.traderId} strategy=${input.strategyId}`);\n      return created;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.code === 'P2002' && tx) {\n        // PostgreSQL marks the surrounding transaction failed after a unique\n        // violation; do not attempt a read through the aborted transaction.\n        throw e;\n      }\n      if (e.code === 'P2002') {\n        if (input.idempotencyKey) {\n          const existing = await client.copySubscription.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey } });\n          if (existing) return existing;\n        }\n        // Unique follower+strategy\n        const existing = await client.copySubscription.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, followerId: input.followerId, strategyId: input.strategyId } });\n        if (existing) return existing;\n      }\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async findById(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId } }) || null;\n  }\n\n  async findActiveByFollowerAndStrategy(tenantId: string, followerId: string, strategyId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, followerId, strategyId, state: { in: ['PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED'] } } }) || null;\n  }\n\n  async listByFollower(tenantId: string, followerId: string, filters?: { state?: CopySubscriptionState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, followerId, ...(filters?.state ? { state: filters.state } : {}) };\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  async listByTrader(tenantId: string, traderId: string, filters?: { state?: CopySubscriptionState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, traderId, ...(filters?.state ? { state: filters.state } : {}) };\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  async listActive(tenantId: string, filters?: { strategyId?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 100;\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, state: 'ACTIVE', ...(filters?.strategyId ? { strategyId: filters.strategyId } : {}) };\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' }, skip, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  async listByTenant(tenantId: string, filters?: { state?: CopySubscriptionState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, ...(filters?.state ? { state: filters.state } : {}) };\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  async updateState(\n    id: string,\n    tenantId: string,\n    state: CopySubscriptionState,\n    timestamps?: { startedAt?: Date; pausedAt?: Date; stoppedAt?: Date; cancelledAt?: Date },\n    options: { tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient; expectedState?: CopySubscriptionState } = {},\n  ): Promise<any | null> {\n    const client = (options.tx ?? this.prisma) as any;\n    const where = {\n      id,\n      tenantId,\n      ...(options.expectedState ? { state: options.expectedState } : {}),\n    };\n    const result = await client.copySubscription.updateMany({\n      where,\n      data: { state, ...timestamps, updatedAt: new Date() },\n    });\n    if (result.count !== 1) return null;\n    return client.copySubscription.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId } });\n  }\n\n  async updateAllocation(id: string, tenantId: string, allocation: { allocationAmount?: string; maxAllocation?: string | null; minAllocation?: string | null; allocationMode?: CopySizingMode }): Promise<any | null> {\n    try {\n      return await (this.prisma as any).copySubscription.update({ where: { id }, data: { ...allocation, updatedAt: new Date() } });\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async updatePolicy(id: string, tenantId: string, policy: { copyPolicy?: Record<string, any>; riskPolicy?: Record<string, any> }): Promise<any | null> {\n    try {\n      return await (this.prisma as any).copySubscription.update({ where: { id }, data: { ...policy, updatedAt: new Date() } });\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async incrementStats(id: string, tenantId: string, stats: { totalCopies?: number; failedCopies?: number; volume?: string }): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).copySubscription.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId } });\n      if (!existing) return;\n      const newTotal = (existing.totalCopies || 0) + (stats.totalCopies || 0);\n      const newFailed = (existing.failedCopies || 0) + (stats.failedCopies || 0);\n      // Decimal-safe volume addition - preserve as string via BigInt? Simplified: use string addition for integer part\n      let newVolume = existing.totalCopiedVolume || '0';\n      if (stats.volume) {\n        try {\n          // Simple decimal addition preserving precision for integer part\n          const [aInt, aDec = ''] = newVolume.split('.');\n          const [bInt, bDec = ''] = stats.volume.split('.');\n          const maxDec = Math.max(aDec.length, bDec.length);\n          const aFull = BigInt((aInt || '0') + aDec.padEnd(maxDec, '0'));\n          const bFull = BigInt((bInt || '0') + bDec.padEnd(maxDec, '0'));\n          const sum = aFull + bFull;\n          const sumStr = sum.toString().padStart(maxDec + 1, '0');\n          if (maxDec === 0) newVolume = sumStr;\n          else {\n            const intPart = sumStr.slice(0, -maxDec) || '0';\n            const decPart = sumStr.slice(-maxDec).replace(/0+$/, '');\n            newVolume = decPart ? `${intPart}.${decPart}` : intPart;\n          }\n        } catch {\n          newVolume = (parseFloat(newVolume) + parseFloat(stats.volume)).toString();\n        }\n      }\n\n      await (this.prisma as any).copySubscription.update({\n        where: { id },\n        data: { totalCopies: newTotal, failedCopies: newFailed, totalCopiedVolume: newVolume, updatedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n  }\n\n  async countActiveByFollower(tenantId: string, followerId: string): Promise<number> {\n    return (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.count({ where: { tenantId, followerId, state: { in: ['PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'PAUSED'] } } }) || 0;\n  }\n\n  async countActiveByTrader(tenantId: string, traderId: string): Promise<number> {\n    return (this.prisma as any).copySubscription?.count({ where: { tenantId, traderId, state: { in: ['PENDING', 'ACTIVE'] } } }) || 0;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/copy-trading-authorization.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/copy-trading-pagination.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/copy-trading-safety.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/copy-trading.contract.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/copy-trading.controller.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":48,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Controller, Get, Post, Put, Delete, Body, Param, Query, Request, BadRequestException, NotFoundException, ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { TraderProfileService } from './trader-profile.service';\nimport { TraderStrategyService } from './trader-strategy.service';\nimport { FollowerSubscriptionService } from './follower-subscription.service';\nimport { CopyExecutionService } from './copy-execution.service';\nimport { CopyPolicyService } from './copy-policy.service';\nimport {\n  toTraderProfileListingView,\n  toTraderProfilePublicView,\n} from './trader-profile.public-view';\nimport { TraderPerformanceService } from './trader-performance.service';\nimport { TraderRankingService } from './trader-ranking.service';\nimport { CopyReconciliationService } from './copy-reconciliation.service';\nimport { CopySubscriptionRepository } from './copy-subscription.repository';\nimport { CopyExecutionRepository } from './copy-execution.repository';\nimport { CreateTraderProfileDto, UpdateTraderProfileDto, CreateTraderStrategyDto, UpdateTraderStrategyDto, TraderStrategyFilterDto } from './dto/trader-strategy.dto';\nimport { CreateFollowerSubscriptionDto, UpdateFollowerSubscriptionDto, FollowerSubscriptionFilterDto, CopyExecutionFilterDto } from './dto/follower-subscription.dto';\nimport { LeaderEventDto } from './dto/copy-policy.dto';\nimport { TraderStrategy, TraderStrategyStatus, TraderVerificationState } from './copy-trading.types';\nimport { Permission } from '@wlct/shared-types';\nimport { RequireAnyPermission, RequirePermissions } from '../../common/decorators/permissions.decorator';\n\n/** Strategy states a non-owner may see: live, or paused with existing followers. */\nconst PUBLIC_STRATEGY_STATUSES: TraderStrategyStatus[] = [TraderStrategyStatus.PUBLISHED, TraderStrategyStatus.PAUSED];\nimport { authRoles, authTenantId, authUserIdOrNull, hasAdminRole } from '../../common/guards/request-principal';\nimport { limitParam, pageParam } from '../../common/dto/pagination-params';\n\n/**\n * Tenant-protected endpoints for trader/follower/platform capabilities.\n * Marketplace listing, trader profile management, strategy publishing, subscription lifecycle, execution inspection, policy resolution, ranking, performance, and reconciliation.\n */\n/**\n * Copy trading. Every route carries explicit permission metadata (it used to\n * carry none, so any authenticated tenant user passed the global guard):\n * - strategy:read            catalogue (traders, strategies, rankings, policies)\n * - strategy:manage          trader side (profiles, strategies, leader events)\n * - copy_subscription:read   own subscriptions and executions\n * - copy_subscription:manage subscribe / pause / resume / stop / cancel\n * The handlers keep their ownership checks on top of that. Non-owners see only\n * published/paused strategies and never a trader's strategyConfig.\n */\n@Controller('copy-trading')\nexport class CopyTradingController {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly traderProfileService: TraderProfileService,\n    private readonly traderStrategyService: TraderStrategyService,\n    private readonly followerSubscriptionService: FollowerSubscriptionService,\n    private readonly copyExecutionService: CopyExecutionService,\n    private readonly copyPolicyService: CopyPolicyService,\n    private readonly traderPerformanceService: TraderPerformanceService,\n    private readonly traderRankingService: TraderRankingService,\n    private readonly reconciliationService: CopyReconciliationService,\n    private readonly subscriptionRepo: CopySubscriptionRepository,\n    private readonly executionRepo: CopyExecutionRepository,\n  ) {}\n\n  private getContext(req: any): { tenantId: string; userId: string; roles: string[] } {\n    // Token tenant only; a header can never select the tenant.\n    const tenantId = authTenantId(req);\n    const userId = authUserIdOrNull(req);\n    const roles = authRoles(req);\n    if (!userId) throw new BadRequestException('userId required');\n    return { tenantId, userId, roles };\n  }\n\n  private isAdmin(roles: string[]): boolean {\n    return hasAdminRole(roles);\n  }\n\n  /** Owner or of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":13,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Defines canonical copy-trading policy, risk, subscription, execution, and reconciliation domain types\n/**\n * Canonical copy-trading domain types: trader profile, strategy, follower subscription, allocation, copy policy, risk settings, copier state, execution intent, and performance references.\n * Do not store raw secrets.\n */\n\nimport type { TraderRiskFactorResult } from '../risk/trader-risk-score.service';\n\nexport enum TraderVerificationState {\n  UNVERIFIED = 'UNVERIFIED',\n  PENDING = 'PENDING',\n  VERIFIED = 'VERIFIED',\n  REJECTED = 'REJECTED',\n  SUSPENDED = 'SUSPENDED',\n}\n\nexport enum TraderStrategyStatus {\n  DRAFT = 'DRAFT',\n  PENDING_VALIDATION = 'PENDING_VALIDATION',\n  VALIDATED = 'VALIDATED',\n  PUBLISHED = 'PUBLISHED',\n  PAUSED = 'PAUSED',\n  ARCHIVED = 'ARCHIVED',\n  REJECTED = 'REJECTED',\n}\n\nexport enum TraderStrategyType {\n  MANUAL = 'MANUAL',\n  ALGORITHMIC = 'ALGORITHMIC',\n  COPY = 'COPY',\n  HYBRID = 'HYBRID',\n}\n\nexport enum CopySubscriptionState {\n  PENDING = 'PENDING',\n  ACTIVE = 'ACTIVE',\n  PAUSED = 'PAUSED',\n  STOPPED = 'STOPPED',\n  CANCELLED = 'CANCELLED',\n  EXPIRED = 'EXPIRED',\n}\n\nexport enum CopyExecutionStatus {\n  PENDING = 'PENDING',\n  VALIDATED = 'VALIDATED',\n  MAPPED = 'MAPPED',\n  RISK_CHECKED = 'RISK_CHECKED',\n  ROUTED = 'ROUTED',\n  SUBMITTED = 'SUBMITTED',\n  FILLED = 'FILLED',\n  FAILED = 'FAILED',\n  REJECTED = 'REJECTED',\n  SKIPPED = 'SKIPPED',\n  BLOCKED = 'BLOCKED',\n}\n\nexport enum CopySizingMode {\n  PROPORTIONAL = 'PROPORTIONAL',\n  FIXED = 'FIXED',\n  PERCENTAGE_BALANCE = 'PERCENTAGE_BALANCE',\n}\n\nexport enum CopyRiskDecision {\n  ALLOW = 'ALLOW',\n  REDUCE = 'REDUCE',\n  BLOCK = 'BLOCK',\n  PAUSE = 'PAUSE',\n  STOP_COPY = 'STOP_COPY',\n}\n\nexport enum CopyReconciliationSeverity {\n  LOW = 'LOW',\n  MEDIUM = 'MEDIUM',\n  HIGH = 'HIGH',\n  CRITICAL = 'CRITICAL',\n}\n\nexport enum CopyReconciliationCategory {\n  MISSING_COPY = 'MISSING_COPY',\n  DUPLICATE_COPY = 'DUPLICATE_COPY',\n  STALE_INTENT = 'STALE_INTENT',\n  ORDER_MISMATCH = 'ORDER_MISMATCH',\n  QUANTITY_MISMATCH = 'QUANTITY_MISMATCH',\n  PRICE_MISMATCH = 'PRICE_MISMATCH',\n  STATUS_MISMATCH = 'STATUS_MISMATCH',\n  UNSUPPORTED_SYMBOL = 'UNSUPPORTED_SYMBOL',\n  EXECUTION_AFTER_STOP = 'EXECUTION_AFTER_STOP',\n  EXECUTION_AFTER_RISK_BLOCK = 'EXECUTION_AFTER_RISK_BLOCK',\n  SLIPPAGE_EXCEEDED = 'SLIPPAGE_EXCEEDED',\n}\n\nexport interface TraderProfile {\n  traderId: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  userId: string;\n  displayName: string;\n  bio: string | null;\n  avatarUrl: string | null;\n  verificationState: TraderVerificationState;\n  verifiedAt: string | null;\n  supportedVenues: string[];\n  supportedSymbols: string[];\n  riskProfile: Record<string, any>;\n  isPublic: boolean;\n  isFeatured: boolean;\n  followerCount: number;\n  totalVolume: string; // Decimal-safe\n  totalTrades: number;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n}\n\nexport interface TraderStrategy {\n  strategyId: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  traderId: string;\n  userId: string;\n  name: string;\n  description: string | null;\n  status: TraderStrategyStatus;\n  type: TraderStrategyType;\n  supportedSymbols: string[];\n  supportedVenues: string[];\n  riskProfile: Record<string, any>;\n  feePolicy: Record<string, any>;\n  strategyConfig: Record<string, any>;\n  publishedAt: string | null;\n  pausedAt: string | null;\n  archivedAt: string | null;\n  followerCount: number;\n  totalCopies: number;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n}\n\nexport interface FollowerSubscription {\n  subscriptionId: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  followerId: string;\n  traderId: string;\n  strategyId: string;\n  state: CopySubscriptionState;\n  allocationMode: CopySizingMode;\n  allocationAmount: string; // Decimal-safe\n  maxAllocation: string | null;\n  minAllocation: string | null;\n  copyPolicy: CopyPolicy;\n  riskPolicy: FollowerRiskPolicy;\n  followerAccountId: string | null;\n  startedAt: string | null;\n  pausedAt: string | null;\n  stoppedAt: string | null;\n  totalCopiedVolume: string;\n  totalCopies: number;\n  failedCopies: number;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n}\n\nexport interface CopyPolicy {\n  sizingMode: CopySizingMode;\n  proportionalRatio: string | null; // e.g. 0.1 for 10%\n  fixedQuantity: string | null;\n  fixedNotional: string | null;\n  maxOrderNotional: string | null;\n  maxDailyNotional: string | null;\n  maxConcurrentCopies: number | null;\n  slippageToleranceBps: number | null; // basis points\n  executionDelayMs: number | null;\n  allowedSymbols: string[] | null;\n  blockedSymbols: string[] | null;\n  allowedSides: string[] | null; // BUY, SELL\n  leveragePolicy: string | null;\n  maxLeverage?: string | null;\n  marginMode?: 'SPOT' | 'ISOLATED' | 'CROSS' | null;\n  reduceOnly: boolean | null;\n  takeProfitBps?: number | null;\n  stopLossBps?: number | null;\n  trailingStopBps?: number | null;\n  stopCopyConditions: Record<string, any> | null;\n}\n\nexport interface FollowerRiskPolicy {\n  maxDailyLoss: string | null;\n  maxTotalLoss: string | null;\n  maxDrawdown: string | null;\n  maxExposure: string | null;\n  maxPositionSize: string | null;\n  maxSymbolExposure: string | null;\n  maxCopyCount: number | null;\n  maxLeverage?: string | null;\n  minMarginRatio?: string | null;\n  allowedMarginModes?: string[] | null;\n  emergencyStopCopy: boolean;\n  dailyPauseEnabled: boolean;\n}\n\nexport interface CopyStopExecutionPlan {\n  takeProfitPrice: string | null;\n  stopLossPrice: string | null;\n  trailingStopBps: number | null;\n  trailingStopDistance: string | null;\n  trailingActivationPrice: string | null;\n  stopCopyTriggered: boolean;\n  stopCopyReason: string | null;\n}\n\nexport interface CopyExecutionIntent {\n  executionId: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  leaderEventId: string;\n  leaderOrderId: string | null;\n  leaderFillId: string | null;\n  subscriptionId: string;\n  followerId: string;\n  traderId: string;\n  followerAccountId: string | null;\n  status: CopyExecutionStatus;\n  sizingMode: CopySizingMode;\n  leaderQuantity: string;\n  leaderPrice: string | null;\n  followerQuantity: string | null;\n  followerPrice: string | null;\n  slippageTolerance: string | null;\n  maxNotional: string | null;\n  executionIntent: Record<string, any>;\n  followerOrderId: string | null;\n  riskDecision: CopyRiskDecision | null;\n  riskRuleId: string | null;\n  idempotencyKey: string;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n}\n\nexport interface TraderPerformance {\n  traderId: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  /**\n   * Fill-derived figures.\n   *\n   * Every one of these is nullable because the service that publishes this shape reads reconciled\n   * closed accounting periods and consults no fills at all. A fill-derived PnL is not a return: it\n   * ignores deposits and withdrawals, so the same trading result reads as profit after a deposit and\n   * as loss after a withdrawal. The fields are kept in the shape because consumers and stored\n   * clients still name them, but `null` is the only value this shape can honestly carry, and a\n   * consumer must render \"unavailable\" rather than zero.\n   */\n  realizedPnl: string | null;\n  unrealizedPnl: string | null;\n  totalReturn: string | null;\n  totalReturnPercent: string | null;\n  maxDrawdown: string | null;\n  maxDrawdownPercent: string | null;\n  winCount: number | null;\n  lossCount: number | null;\n  tradeCount: number | null;\n  winRate: string | null;\n  lossRate: string | null;\n  totalVolume: string | null;\n  averageTrade: string | null;\n  averageWin: string | null;\n  averageLoss: string | null;\n  profitFactor: string | null;\n  sharpeRatio: string | null;\n  historyLengthDays: number;\n  lastTradeAt: string | null;\n  isActual: boolean; // true only when the reconciled window was proven COMPLETE\n  source: string; // e.g. RECONCILED_CLOSED_PERIOD_RECORDS, FILLS, ORDERS, SETTLEMENT\n  /**\n   * TIME_WEIGHTED_RETURN provenance. These are the fields that distinguish a reconciled, linked\n   * closed-period return from a raw NAV comparison, and the schema stores each of them\n   * (`data_completeness`, `calculation_version`, `flow_boundary`) on the period records. Optional\n   * because a record produced before the TWR path existed cannot claim them, and a consumer that\n   * needs a proven return must treat their absence as \"not proven\" rather than as a default.\n   */\n  methodology?: string | null;\n  flowBoundary?: string | null;\n  dataCompleteness?: string | null;\n  sourceReferences?: string[] | null;\n  /** When the figures were observed. Absent means the freshness of the value cannot be shown. */\n  asOf?: string | null;\n  /**\n   * The calculation version applied to the published figures, and the version of the persisted\n   * source records they were derived from. When the two are shown together a reader can tell whether\n   * the number was recomputed under the current methodology or carried forward from an older one.\n   */\n  calculationVersion?: string | null;\n  sourceCalculationVersion?: string | null;\n  /** The accounting base currency of the window. Absent means no window was proven. */\n  baseCurrency?: string | null;\n  /**\n   * How many closed periods the window contained. Present even when the window failed, so a consumer\n   * can distinguish \"no evidence at all\" from \"evidence that was rejected\", which is the difference\n   * between an administration problem and a data-integrity one.\n   */\n  observationCount?: number | null;\n  /** Names what `asOf` is. See `TraderPerformanceService.CURRENTNESS_RULE`. */\n  currentnessRule?: string | null;\n  /** Why no return is published. Absent only when the window was proven COMPLETE. */\n  unavailableReason?: string;\n}\n\n/** One quote-asset bucket of traded volume, as an exact decimal string. */\nexport interface TraderQuoteAssetVolume {\n  asset: string;\n  amount: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * What a public trader profile may publish about a metric: the value, the canonical source it came\n * from, when it was read, and - when there is no value - why there is none. `value: null` with\n * `status: 'UNAVAILABLE'` is the only way to say \"not known\"; a zero is a measurement.\n */\nexport interface TraderActiveFollowersMetric {\n  status: 'AVAILABLE' | 'UNAVAILABLE';\n  value: number | null;\n  source: string | null;\n  asOf: string | null;\n  reason: string | null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Assets under management, withheld rather than estimated. There is no canonical follower-portfolio\n * valuation in this platform, and a published AUM would be a number nobody can reconcile.\n */\nexport interface TraderAumMetric {\n  status: 'UNAVAILABLE';\n  value: null;\n  currency: null;\n  source: null;\n  asOf: null;\n  reason: 'NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FOLLOWER_PORTFOLIO_VALUATION';\n}\n\nexport interface TraderActivityMetric {\n  status: 'AVAILABLE' | 'UNAVAILABLE';\n  source: string | null;\n  latestRecordedFillAt: string | null;\n  sampledFillCount: number | null;\n  sampleLimit: number;\n  hasMore: boolean;\n  /**\n   * How the published volume was derived: from the venue's own quote quantity, from quantity x\n   * price, or from both across the sample. `NONE` means there were no fills to measure.\n   */\n  calculationMethod: 'NONE' | 'QUOTE_QUANTITY' | 'PRICE_TIMES_QUANTITY' | 'MIXED';\n  volumeByQuoteAsset: TraderQuoteAssetVolume[];\n  asOf: string;\n  reason: string | null;\n}\n\nexport interface TraderRiskScoreView {\n  status: 'AVAILABLE' | 'PARTIAL' | 'UNAVAILABLE';\n  score: number | null;\n  band: 'LOW' | 'MODERATE' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL' | 'UNAVAILABLE';\n  confidence: 'COMPLETE' | 'PARTIAL' | 'UNAVAILABLE';\n  methodology: 'risk-score-v1';\n  asOf: string;\n  factors: TraderRiskFactorResult[];\n}\n\n/** The complete published statistics for one trader profile. */\nexport interface TraderSafePublicStatistics {\n  traderId: string;\n  activeFollowers: TraderActiveFollowersMetric;\n  aum: TraderAumMetric;\n  activity: TraderActivityMetric;\n  riskScore: TraderRiskScoreView;\n}\n\n/** The windows a ranking may be asked for. Only these three, so a window is never invented. */\nexport type TraderRankingTimeframe = '7D' | '30D' | '90D';\n\nexport const TRADER_RANKING_TIMEFRAMES: readonly TraderRankingTimeframe[] = ['7D', '30D', '90D'];\n\nexport const TRADER_RANKING_WINDOW_DAYS: Record<TraderRankingTimeframe, number> = {\n  '7D': 7,\n  '30D': 30,\n  '90D': 90,\n};\n\nexport type TraderRankingPeriodStatus = 'AVAILABLE' | 'UNAVAILABLE';\n\nexport interface TraderRankingMethodology {\n  status: 'AVAILABLE' | 'UNAVAILABLE';\n  key: 'RECONCILED_CLOSED_PERIOD_TWR';\n  /** The method in words, so a reader learns how the number was produced and what it excludes. */\n  description: string;\n  timeframe: TraderRankingTimeframe;\n  /** The exact instant the window opens, or null when no persisted period established an as-of. */\n  windowStart: string | null;\n  asOf: string | null;\n  /** Names the admission test: a window is used only if its periods tile it exactly. */\n  boundaryRule: 'EXACT_CONTIGUOUS_PERIODS_ONLY';\n  /** Names the ordering: ranked rows by window return descending, unranked rows after them. */\n  orderingRule: 'RETURN_DESCENDING_UNAVAILABLE_LAST';\n  currentnessRule: string;\n  minimumPeriodCount: number;\n  rankedCount: number;\n  unrankedCount: number;\n  /**\n   * Why any row is unranked, taken from those rows' own reasons; null when every row was ranked.\n   * Present even when `status` is AVAILABLE, because \"four of five ranked\" is exactly the case where\n   * a reader needs to know why the fifth was not - and a bare count does not say.\n   */\n  reason: string | null;\n}\n\nexport interface TraderRankingPage {\n  data: TraderRanking[];\n  total: number;\n  timeframe: TraderRankingTimeframe;\n  methodology: TraderRankingMethodology;\n}\n\nexport interface TraderRanking {\n  traderId: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  displayName: string;\n  verificationState: TraderVerificationState;\n  isPublic: boolean;\n  isFeatured: boolean;\n  followerCount: number;\n  performance: TraderPerformance | null;\n  score: number;\n  /**\n   * The rank within the requested window, or null when the trader has no window that proves one.\n   * Null is not \"last place\": an unranked trader is excluded from the ordering rather than sorted to\n   * the bottom, because a number would imply the window was measured and simply came out worst.\n   */\n  rank: number | null;\n  /**\n   * The reconciled closed-period window. `periodReturnPercent` is the only figure here that comes\n   * from the window itself; the `performance` object above is a separate, fill-derived view and is\n   * not what the rank is computed from.\n   */\n  timeframe: TraderRankingTimeframe;\n  periodStatus: TraderRankingPeriodStatus;\n  periodReturnPercent: string | null;\n  flowBoundary: string | null;\n  sourceCalculationVersion: string | null;\n  observationCount: number | null;\n  /** Why no window return is published. Present only when `periodStatus` is UNAVAILABLE. */\n  unavailableReason?: string;\n  metrics: {\n    riskAdjustedReturn: number | null;\n    drawdownScore: number | null;\n    consistencyScore: number | null;\n    historyLengthScore: number | null;\n    followerScore: number | null;\n    activityScore: number | null;\n    verifiedScore: number | null;\n  };\n  weighting: Record<string, number>;\n}\n\nexport interface CopyReconciliationResult {\n  id: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  leaderEventId: string;\n  subscriptionId: string | null;\n  executionId: string | null;\n  category: CopyReconciliationCategory;\n  severity: CopyReconciliationSeverity;\n  expected: Record<string, any> | null;\n  actual: Record<string, any> | null;\n  leaderReference: Record<string, any> | null;\n  followerReference: Record<string, any> | null;\n  resolved: boolean;\n  createdAt: string;\n}\n\nexport const FORBIDDEN_COPY_FIELDS = ['secret', 'apiKey', 'apiSecret', 'passphrase', 'privateKey', 'withdrawal', 'profit', 'roi', 'balance'] as const;\n\nexport function sanitizeCopyMetadata(metadata: Record<string, any>): Record<string, any> {\n  const sanitized: Record<string, any> = {};\n  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(metadata)) {\n    const lower = key.toLowerCase();\n    if (FORBIDDEN_COPY_FIELDS.some((f) => lower.includes(f.toLowerCase()))) {\n      if (['profit', 'roi', 'balance'].includes(lower)) {\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (['secret', 'apikey', 'apisecret', 'passphrase', 'privatekey', 'withdrawal'].some((s) => lower.includes(s))) {\n        continue;\n      }\n    }\n    if (typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 1000) {\n      sanitized[key] = value.substring(0, 1000);\n    } else if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)) {\n      sanitized[key] = sanitizeCopyMetadata(value);\n    } else {\n      sanitized[key] = value;\n    }\n  }\n  return sanitized;\n}\n\nexport function isDecimalString(value: string): boolean {\n  return /^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/.test(value.trim());\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether one symbol rule matches a symbol.\n *\n * Rules are globs, not literals: the platform policy blocks `*WITHDRAWAL*` and a bare `*` means\n * every symbol. Enforcement compared with `Array.includes`, so that platform rule could never fire\n * - no symbol is equal to the eleven-character string `*WITHDRAWAL*` - and the guardrail that\n * exists to make withdrawal-like instruments uncopyable was inert. Matching is case-insensitive\n * because venues disagree on the case of the same instrument.\n *\n * A rule with no `*` still matches exactly, so every existing exact-symbol policy behaves as before.\n * This is the one matcher: the copy mapper, the follower risk check and symbol-rule validation all\n * call it, so a rule cannot mean one thing in one place and something else in another.\n */\nexport function matchesSymbolRule(rule: string, symbol: string): boolean {\n  if (typeof rule !== 'string' || typeof symbol !== 'string') return false;\n  const trimmed = rule.trim();\n  if (trimmed.length === 0 || symbol.length === 0) return false;\n  const upperSymbol = symbol.toUpperCase();\n  if (!trimmed.includes('*')) return trimmed.toUpperCase() === upperSymbol;\n  const pattern = trimmed\n    .toUpperCase()\n    .replace(/[\\\\^$.*+?()[\\]{}|]/g, (character) => (character === '*' ? '.*' : `\\\\${character}`));\n  return new RegExp(`^${pattern}$`).test(upperSymbol);\n}\n\n/** Whether any rule in the list matches the symbol. Absent or empty lists match nothing. */\nexport function matchesAnySymbolRule(rules: string[] | null | undefined, symbol: string): boolean {\n  if (!Array.isArray(rules) || rules.length === 0) return false;\n  return rules.some((rule) => matchesSymbolRule(rule, symbol));\n}\n\nexport function compareDecimalStrings(a: string, b: string): number {\n  // Returns -1 if a<b, 0 if equal, 1 if a>b, without float\n  const [aInt, aDec = ''] = a.split('.');\n  const [bInt, bDec = ''] = b.split('.');\n  const aNeg = aInt.startsWith('-');\n  const bNeg = bInt.startsWith('-');\n  if (aNeg && !bNeg) return -1;\n  if (!aNeg && bNeg) return 1;\n  const maxDec = Math.max(aDec.length, bDec.length);\n  const aPadded = (aInt.replace('-', '') + aDec.padEnd(maxDec, '0')).padStart(20, '0');\n  const bPadded = (bInt.replace('-', '') + bDec.padEnd(maxDec, '0')).padStart(20, '0');\n  const aBig = BigInt(aPadded);\n  const bBig = BigInt(bPadded);\n  if (aNeg) {\n    if (aBig < bBig) return 1;\n    if (aBig > bBig) return -1;\n    return 0;\n  } else {\n    if (aBig < bBig) return -1;\n    if (aBig > bBig) return 1;\n    return 0;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/dto/allocation-rebalance.dto.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/dto/copy-policy.dto.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any.
