Do not trust frontend balances. Precision must be safe.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class FollowerAllocationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(FollowerAllocationService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async validateAllocation(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    followerId: string;\n    followerAccountId: string | null;\n    allocationMode: CopySizingMode;\n    allocationAmount: string;\n    maxAllocation?: string | null;\n    minAllocation?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<{ valid: boolean; availableBalance: string | null; reason?: string }> {\n    if (!isDecimalString(input.allocationAmount)) {\n      return { valid: false, availableBalance: null, reason: 'allocationAmount must be valid decimal string' };\n    }\n\n    if (compareDecimalStrings(input.allocationAmount, '0') <= 0) {\n      return { valid: false, availableBalance: null, reason: 'allocationAmount must be positive' };\n    }\n\n    if (input.maxAllocation && !isDecimalString(input.maxAllocation)) {\n      return { valid: false, availableBalance: null, reason: 'maxAllocation must be valid decimal string' };\n    }\n\n    if (input.minAllocation && !isDecimalString(input.minAllocation)) {\n      return { valid: false, availableBalance: null, reason: 'minAllocation must be valid decimal string' };\n    }\n\n    if (input.maxAllocation && compareDecimalStrings(input.allocationAmount, input.maxAllocation) > 0) {\n      return { valid: false, availableBalance: null, reason: 'allocationAmount exceeds maxAllocation' };\n    }\n\n    if (input.minAllocation && compareDecimalStrings(input.allocationAmount, input.minAllocation) < 0) {\n      return { valid: false, availableBalance: null, reason: 'allocationAmount below minAllocation' };\n    }\n\n    // All values must come from canonical follower exchange-account/balance data - do not trust frontend balances\n    let availableBalance: string | null = null;\n\n    if (input.followerAccountId) {\n      try {\n        const account = await this.prisma.tradingAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: input.followerAccountId, tenantId: input.tenantId, userId: input.followerId, deletedAt: null } });\n        if (!account) {\n          return { valid: false, availableBalance: null, reason: 'Follower account not found or not owned by follower' };\n        }\n\n        // Get canonical balances from AccountBalanceSnapshot\n        const balances = await this.prisma.accountBalanceSnapshot.findMany({ where: { accountId: input.followerAccountId, tenantId: input.tenantId } });\n\n        // For simplicity, assume USDT or USD as quote - sum free balances\n        // In real implementation, would check specific asset\n        let totalFree = '0';\n        for (const b of balances) {\n          try {\n            const free = b.free.toString();\n            if (isDecimalString(free)) {\n              // Add using string addition preserving precision\n              const [aInt, aDec = ''] = totalFree.split('.');\n              const [bInt, bDec = ''] = free.split('.');\n              const maxDec = Math.max(aDec.length, bDec.length);\n              const aFull = BigInt((aInt || '0') + aDec.padEnd(maxDec, '0'));\n              const bFull = BigInt((bInt || '0') + bDec.padEnd(maxDec, '0'));\n              const sum = aFull + bFull;\n              const sumStr = sum.toString().padStart(maxDec + 1, '0');\n              if (maxDec === 0) totalFree = sumStr;\n              else {\n                const intPart = sumStr.slice(0, -maxDec) || '0';\n                const decPart = sumStr.slice(-maxDec).replace(/0+$/, '');\n                totalFree = decPart ? `${intPart}.${decPart}` : intPart;\n              }\n            }\n          } catch {}\n        }\n\n        availableBalance = totalFree;\n\n        // For percentage mode, allocationAmount is percentage (e.g. 10 for 10%)\n        if (input.allocationMode === CopySizingMode.PERCENTAGE_BALANCE) {\n          const percent = parseFloat(input.allocationAmount);\n          if (isNaN(percent) || percent <= 0 || percent > 100) {\n            return { valid: false, availableBalance, reason: 'Percentage allocation must be between 0 and 100' };\n          }\n          // Validate percentage does not exceed available\n          // We don't need to check exact amount here, just that available >0\n          if (compareDecimalStrings(availableBalance, '0') <= 0) {\n            return { valid: false, availableBalance, reason: 'No available balance for percentage allocation' };\n          }\n        } else {\n          // Fixed or proportional - check allocationAmount <= availableBalance\n          if (availableBalance && compareDecimalStrings(input.allocationAmount, availableBalance) > 0) {\n            return { valid: false, availableBalance, reason: `Allocation ${input.allocationAmount} exceeds available balance ${availableBalance}` };\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to validate allocation from canonical data tenant=${input.tenantId} follower=${input.followerId} error=${e.message}`);\n        return { valid: false, availableBalance: null, reason: 'Failed to validate from canonical balance data' };\n      }\n    } else {\n      // No account provided - warn but allow? Per spec, allocation should use canonical data, so if no account, we cannot validate\n      this.logger.warn(`No follower account provided for allocation validation tenant=${input.tenantId} follower=${input.followerId}`);\n      // For draft subscriptions without account yet, allow but mark available as null\n      availableBalance = null;\n    }\n\n    return { valid: true, availableBalance };\n  }\n\n  async getAvailableBalance(tenantId: string, followerId: string, followerAccountId: string): Promise<string> {\n    const balances = await this.prisma.accountBalanceSnapshot.findMany({ where: { tenantId, accountId: followerAccountId } });\n    let totalFree = '0';\n    for (const b of balances) {\n      try {\n        const free = b.free.toString();\n        const [aInt, aDec = ''] = totalFree.split('.');\n        const [bInt, bDec = ''] = free.split('.');\n        const maxDec = Math.max(aDec.length, bDec.length);\n        const aFull = BigInt((aInt || '0') + aDec.padEnd(maxDec, '0'));\n        const bFull = BigInt((bInt || '0') + bDec.padEnd(maxDec, '0'));\n        const sum = aFull + bFull;\n        const sumStr = sum.toString().padStart(maxDec + 1, '0');\n        if (maxDec === 0) totalFree = sumStr;\n        else {\n          const intPart = sumStr.slice(0, -maxDec) || '0';\n          const decPart = sumStr.slice(-maxDec).replace(/0+$/, '');\n          totalFree = decPart ? `${intPart}.${decPart}` : intPart;\n        }\n      } catch {}\n    }\n    return totalFree;\n  }\n\n  calculateProportionalAllocation(leaderNotional: string, followerAllocation: string, leaderTotalBalance: string): string {\n    // proportional = leaderNotional * (followerAllocation / leaderTotalBalance) - Decimal-safe\n    // For simplicity, use integer arithmetic with 8 decimals\n    try {\n      const scale = 8;\n      const parse = (s: string): bigint => {\n        const [intPart, decPart = ''] = s.split('.');\n        const padded = decPart.padEnd(scale, '0').slice(0, scale);\n        return BigInt((intPart || '0') + padded);\n      };\n      const leaderNotionalBig = parse(leaderNotional);\n      const followerAllocBig = parse(followerAllocation);\n      const leaderTotalBig = parse(leaderTotalBalance);\n\n      if (leaderTotalBig === BigInt(0)) return '0';\n\n      const result = (leaderNotionalBig * followerAllocBig) / leaderTotalBig;\n      const resultStr = result.toString().padStart(scale + 1, '0');\n      const intPart = resultStr.slice(0, -scale) || '0';\n      const decPart = resultStr.slice(-scale).replace(/0+$/, '');\n      return decPart ? `${intPart}.${decPart}` : intPart;\n    } catch {\n      return '0';\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/follower-risk.service.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/follower-risk.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Enforces follower-specific risk rules, notional caps, symbol filters, and emergency stop-copy decisions\n// # Enforces follower leverage caps and margin requirement checks\nimport { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport {\n  CopyPolicy,\n  CopyRiskDecision,\n  FollowerRiskPolicy,\n  isDecimalString,\n  compareDecimalStrings,\n  matchesAnySymbolRule,\n} from './copy-trading.types';\n\nexport interface RiskCheckInput {\n  tenantId: string;\n  followerId: string;\n  subscriptionId: string;\n  traderId: string;\n  followerAccountId: string | null;\n  symbol: string;\n  side: string;\n  quantity: string;\n  price: string | null;\n  notional: string | null;\n  riskPolicy: FollowerRiskPolicy;\n  copyPolicy?: Partial<CopyPolicy> | null;\n  currentExposure?: string | null;\n  dailyLoss?: string | null;\n  totalLoss?: string | null;\n  currentDrawdown?: string | null;\n  dailyNotionalUsed?: string | null;\n  concurrentOpenCopies?: number | null;\n  requestedLeverage?: string | null;\n  marginMode?: string | null;\n  availableMarginRatio?: string | null;\n}\n\nexport interface RiskCheckResult {\n  decision: CopyRiskDecision;\n  allowed: boolean;\n  ruleId: string | null;\n  reason: string | null;\n  reducedQuantity?: string | null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Applies follower-specific risk rules: max loss, max drawdown, max exposure, daily limits, stop-copy conditions, concentration, leverage/margin constraints, and emergency pause.\n * Risk decision states: ALLOW, REDUCE, BLOCK, PAUSE, STOP_COPY. Every rejection must identify its policy/rule.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class FollowerRiskService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(FollowerRiskService.name);\n\n  constructor(private Logger,\n  NotFoundException,\n  UnprocessableEntityException,\n  ConflictException,\n} from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { CopySubscriptionRepository } from './copy-subscription.repository';\nimport { FollowerAllocationService } from './follower-allocation.service';\nimport { CopyPolicyService } from './copy-policy.service';\nimport { TraderProfileService } from './trader-profile.service';\nimport { TraderStrategyService } from './trader-strategy.service';\nimport { CopySubscriptionState, CopySizingMode } from './copy-trading.types';\nimport { PlanLimitFollowersGuard } from '../billing/enforcement/plan-limit-followers.guard';\nimport { PlanLimitCopySubscriptionsGuard } from '../billing/enforcement/plan-limit-copy-subscriptions.guard';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { OutboxService } from '../../infrastructure/outbox/outbox.service';\nimport { MaintenanceModeService } from '../operations/maintenance-mode.service';\nimport { OperationalMaintenanceScope } from '../operations/operations.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\nexport interface SubscribeInput {\n  tenantId: string;\n  followerId: string;\n  traderId: string;\n  strategyId: string;\n  allocationMode: CopySizingMode;\n  allocationAmount: string;\n  maxAllocation?: string | null;\n  minAllocation?: string | null;\n  copyPolicy?: Record<string, any>;\n  riskPolicy?: Record<string, any>;\n  followerAccountId?: string | null;\n  idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  actorId: string;\n  requestId?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Follower lifecycle: subscribe, activate, pause, resume, stop-copy, cancel, and retrieve subscription state while enforcing existing plan limits and subscription rules.\n * Must enforce maxCopySubscriptionsPerFollower using existing Part 2 enforcement, and maxFollowersPerTrader using existing system. Do not duplicate numeric limits.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class FollowerSubscriptionService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(FollowerSubscriptionService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly subscriptionRepo: CopySubscriptionRepository,\n    private readonly allocationService: FollowerAllocationService,\n    private readonly policyService: CopyPolicyService,\n    private readonly traderProfileService: TraderProfileService,\n    private readonly traderStrategyService: TraderStrategyService,\n    private readonly followersGuard: PlanLimitFollowersGuard,\n    private readonly copySubsGuard: PlanLimitCopySubscriptionsGuard,\n    private readonly maintenance: MaintenanceModeService,\n    private readonly outbox: OutboxService,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * Starting or resuming copying is a new trading action, so it is refused\n   * (503) while a PLATFORM, tenant or TRADING_CAPABILITY maintenance window is\n   * active - the same rule the customer web uses to disable the copy button\n   * (`blocksTrading` on GET /operations/maintenance/current). Pause and stop\n   * stay available: reducing exposure must always work.\n   */\n  private assertTradingOpen(tenantId: string, operation: string): Promise<void> {\n    return this.maintenance.enforceMaintenanceGate({\n      tenantId,\n      scope: OperationalMaintenanceScope.TRADING_CAPABILITY,\n      operation,\n    });\n  }\n\n  private async transitionWithOutbox(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    subscription: Record<string, any>;\n    expectedState: CopySubscriptionState;\n    nextState: CopySubscriptionState;\n    eventType: string;\n    timestamps?: { startedAt?: Date; pausedAt?: Date; stoppedAt?: Date; cancelledAt?: Date };\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const subscriptionId =\n      typeof input.subscription.id === 'string' ? input.subscription.id : input.subscription.subscriptionId;\n    if (typeof subscriptionId !== 'string' || subscriptionId.length === 0) {\n      throw new ConflictException('Copy subscription id is unavailable; refusing to record a lifecycle event');\n    }\n\n    const transitionEventId = randomUUID();\n    return this.prisma.withTenantRls(input.tenantId, async (tx) => {\n      const updated = await this.subscriptionRepo.updateState(\n        subscriptionId,\n        input.tenantId,\n        input.nextState,\n        input.timestamps,\n        { tx, expectedState: input.expectedState },\n      );\n      if (!updated) {\n        throw new ConflictException('Copy subscription state changed concurrently; reload and retry');\n      }\n\n      const updatedId = typeof updated.id === 'string' ? updated.id : subscriptionId;\n      await this.outbox.append(tx, {\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        aggregateType: 'copy.subscription',\n        aggregateId: updatedId,\n        eventType: input.eventType,\n        idempotencyKey: `copy-subscription:${updatedId}:${input.eventType}:${transitionEventId}`,\n        payload: {\n          subscriptionId: updatedId,\n          followerId: updated.followerId ?? input.subscription.followerId ?? null,\n          traderId: updated.traderId ?? input.subscription.traderId ?? null,\n          strategyId: updated.strategyId ?? input.subscription.strategyId ?? null,\n          state: input.nextState,\n        },\n      });\n      return updated;\n    });\n  }\n\n  async subscribe(input: SubscribeInput): Promise<any> {\n    await this.assertTradingOpen(input.tenantId, 'copy_trading.subscribe');\n\n    // Validate trader/strategy\n    const trader = await this.traderProfileService.getProfile(input.tenantId, input.traderId);\n    // Business-rule failures are HTTP exceptions: plain Errors surfaced to the\n    // follower as a generic 500 instead of the actual reason.\n    if (!trader) throw new NotFoundException(`Trader ${input.traderId} not found`);\n\n    const strategy = await this.traderStrategyService.getStrategy(input.tenantId, input.strategyId);\n    if (!strategy) throw new NotFoundException(`Strategy ${input.strategyId} not found`);\n    if (strategy.traderId !== input.traderId) throw new UnprocessableEntityException('Strategy does not belong to trader');\n    if (strategy.status !== 'PUBLISHED') {\n      throw new UnprocessableEntityException(`Strategy must be PUBLISHED to subscribe, current=${strategy.status}`);\n    }\n\n    // Validate follower eligibility - check compliance BLOCK\n    // Fail closed: this used an untyped query inside a catch that swallowed\n    // every error except its own, so any database failure skipped the block.\n    const complianceCase = await this.prisma.complianceCase.findFirst({\n      where: {\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        userId: input.followerId,\n        decision: 'BLOCK',\n        state: { in: ['OPEN', 'IN_REVIEW', 'ESCALATED'] },\n      },\n      select: { id: true },\n    });\n    if (complianceCase) throw new ForbiddenException('Follower account is blocked by compliance');\n\n    // Enforce existing plan limits - maxCopySubscriptionsPerFollower\n    const actor = { tenantId: input.tenantId, userId: input.actorId } as any;\n    try {\n      await this.copySubsGuard.reserve(actor, input.followerId);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Copy subscription limit exceeded follower=${input.followerId} tenant=${input.tenantId}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n\n    // Enforce maxFollowersPerTrader\n    try {\n      await this.followersGuard.reserve(actor, input.traderId);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      // Release copy sub slot if follower limit fails\n      try {\n        await this.copySubsGuard.release(actor, input.followerId);\n      } catch {}\n      this.logger.warn(`Follower limit exceeded trader=${input.traderId} tenant=${input.tenantId}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n\n    let subscription;\n    try {\n      // Validate allocation uses canonical follower balance\n      const allocationValidation = await this.allocationService.validateAllocation({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        followerId: input.followerId,\n        followerAccountId: input.followerAccountId || null,\n        allocationMode: input.allocationMode,\n        allocationAmount: input.allocationAmount,\n        maxAllocation: input.maxAllocation || null,\n        minAllocation: input.minAllocation || null,\n      });\n\n      if (!allocationValidation.valid) {\n        throw new UnprocessableEntityException(\n          `Allocation validation failed: ${allocationValidation.reason} available=${allocationValidation.availableBalance}`,\n        );\n      }\n\n      // Creation, activation and the durable domain event share one tenant-RLS\n      // transaction. A commit cannot expose ACTIVE without its outbox row.\n      subscription = await this.prisma.withTenantRls(input.tenantId, async (tx) => {\n        const created = await this.subscriptionRepo.create(\n          {\n            tenantId: input.tenantId,\n            followerId: input.followerId,\n            traderId: input.traderId,\n            strategyId: input.strategyId,\n            allocationMode: input.allocationMode,\n            allocationAmount: input.allocationAmount,\n            maxAllocation: input.maxAllocation || null,\n            minAllocation: input.minAllocation || null,\n            copyPolicy: input.copyPolicy || {},\n            riskPolicy: input.riskPolicy || {},\n            followerAccountId: input.followerAccountId || null,\n            idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey || null,\n          },\n          tx,\n        );\n        const activatedAt = new Date();\n        const expectedState = (created.state as CopySubscriptionState | undefined) ?? CopySubscriptionState.PENDING;\n        const activated = await this.subscriptionRepo.updateState(\n          created.id,\n          input.tenantId,\n          CopySubscriptionState.ACTIVE,\n          { startedAt: activatedAt },\n          { tx, expectedState },\n        );\n        if (!activated) {\n          throw new ConflictException('Copy subscription could not be activated from its current state');\n        }\n\n        await this.outbox.append(tx, {\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          aggregateType: 'copy.subscription',\n          aggregateId: activated.id,\n          eventType: 'copy.subscription.created',\n          idempotencyKey: `copy-subscription:${activated.id}:copy.subscription.created`,\n          payload: {\n            subscriptionId: activated.id,\n            followerId: activated.followerId,\n            traderId: activated.traderId,\n            strategyId: activated.strategyId,\n            state: CopySubscriptionState.ACTIVE,\n          },\n        });\n        return activated;\n      });\n\n      // Increment trader follower count\n      await this.traderProfileService.incrementFollowerCount(input.tenantId, input.traderId);\n\n      // Audit\n      await (this.prisma as any).copyTradingAuditLog?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: randomUUID(),\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          event: 'SUBSCRIPTION_CREATED',\n          actorId: input.actorId,\n          traderId: input.traderId,\n          followerId: input.followerId,\n          strategyId: input.strategyId,\n          subscriptionId: subscription.id,\n          result: 'SUCCESS',\n          safeMetadata: { allocationMode: input.allocationMode, allocationAmount: input.allocationAmount, followerAccountId: input.followerAccountId },\n          requestId: input.requestId,\n          createdAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      this.logger.log(`Subscription created and activated id=${subscription.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} follower=${input.followerId} trader=${input.traderId}`);\n\n      return subscription;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      // Release both slots on failure\n      try {\n        await this.copySubsGuard.release(actor, input.followerId);\n      } catch {}\n      try {\n        await this.followersGuard.release(actor, input.traderId);\n      } catch {}\n\n      if (subscription) {\n        try {\n          await this.transitionWithOutbox({\n            tenantId: input.tenantId,\n            subscription,\n            expectedState: subscription.state as CopySubscriptionState,\n            nextState: CopySubscriptionState.CANCELLED,\n            eventType: 'copy.subscription.cancelled',\n            timestamps: { cancelledAt: new Date() },\n          });\n        } catch {\n          // Preserve the original subscribe failure. The failed transaction\n          // remains visible through its own error and is never marked cancelled\n          // unless the state transition and event committed together.\n        }\n      }\n\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getSubscription(tenantId: string, subscriptionId: string, followerId?: string | null): Promise<any | null> {\n    const sub = await this.subscriptionRepo.findById(subscriptionId, tenantId);\n    if (!sub) return null;\n    if (followerId && sub.followerId !== followerId) {\n      // Check if privileged? For now, enforce follower ownership\n      const isTrader = sub.traderId === followerId; // trader can view own followers? Simplified\n      if (!isTrader) return null;\n    }\n    return sub;\n  }\n\n  async listByFollower(tenantId: string, followerId: string, filters?: { state?: CopySubscriptionState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    return this.subscriptionRepo.listByFollower(tenantId, followerId, filters);\n  }\n\n  async listByTrader(tenantId: string, traderId: string, filters?: { state?: CopySubscriptionState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    return this.subscriptionRepo.listByTrader(tenantId, traderId, filters);\n  }\n\n  async pauseSubscription(tenantId: string, subscriptionId: string, actorId: string, followerId?: string | null, requestId?: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const sub = await this.subscriptionRepo.findById(subscriptionId, tenantId);\n    if (!sub) return null;\n    if (followerId && sub.followerId !== followerId) throw new ForbiddenException('Not authorized to pause this subscription');\n\n    if (sub.state !== CopySubscriptionState.ACTIVE) throw new ConflictException(`Only ACTIVE subscription can be paused, current=${sub.state}`);\n\n    const updated = await this.transitionWithOutbox({\n      tenantId,\n      subscription: sub,\n      expectedState: CopySubscriptionState.ACTIVE,\n      nextState: CopySubscriptionState.PAUSED,\n      eventType: 'copy.subscription.paused',\n      timestamps: { pausedAt: new Date() },\n    });\n\n    await (this.prisma as any).copyTradingAuditLog?.create({\n      data: { id: randomUUID(), tenantId, event: 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAUSED', actorId, traderId: sub.traderId, followerId: sub.followerId, strategyId: sub.strategyId, subscriptionId, result: 'SUCCESS', safeMetadata: {}, requestId, createdAt: new Date() },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Subscription paused id=${subscriptionId} tenant=${tenantId}`);\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async resumeSubscription(tenantId: string, subscriptionId: string, actorId: string, followerId?: string | null, requestId?: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const sub = await this.subscriptionRepo.findById(subscriptionId, tenantId);\n    if (!sub) return null;\n    if (followerId && sub.followerId !== followerId) throw new ForbiddenException('Not authorized');\n\n    if (sub.state !== CopySubscriptionState.PAUSED) throw new ConflictException(`Only PAUSED subscription can be resumed, current=${sub.state}`);\n    await this.assertTradingOpen(tenantId, 'copy_trading.resume');\n\n    const updated = await this.transitionWithOutbox({\n      tenantId,\n      subscription: sub,\n      expectedState: CopySubscriptionState.PAUSED,\n      nextState: CopySubscriptionState.ACTIVE,\n      eventType: 'copy.subscription.resumed',\n      timestamps: { startedAt: new Date() },\n    });\n\n    await (this.prisma as any).copyTradingAuditLog?.create({\n      data: { id: randomUUID(), tenantId, event: 'SUBSCRIPTION_RESUMED', actorId, traderId: sub.traderId, followerId: sub.followerId, strategyId: sub.strategyId, subscriptionId, result: 'SUCCESS', safeMetadata: {}, requestId, createdAt: new Date() },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async stopCopy(tenantId: string, subscriptionId: string, actorId: string, followerId?: string | null, requestId?: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const sub = await this.subscriptionRepo.findById(subscriptionId, tenantId);\n    if (!sub) return null;\n    if (followerId && sub.followerId !== followerId) throw new ForbiddenException('Not authorized');\n\n    // Pausing/stopping copy must prevent future copy actions without corrupting already-executed orders\n    if (sub.state === CopySubscriptionState.STOPPED || sub.state === CopySubscriptionState.CANCELLED) throw new ConflictException(`Subscription already ${sub.state}`);\n\n    const updated = await this.transitionWithOutbox({\n      tenantId,\n      subscription: sub,\n      expectedState: sub.state as CopySubscriptionState,\n      nextState: CopySubscriptionState.STOPPED,\n      eventType: 'copy.subscription.stopped',\n      timestamps: { stoppedAt: new Date() },\n    });\n\n    // Release plan limits\n    try {\n      const actor = { tenantId, userId: actorId } as any;\n      await this.copySubsGuard.release(actor, sub.followerId);\n      await this.followersGuard.release(actor, sub.traderId);\n      await this.traderProfileService.decrementFollowerCount(tenantId, sub.traderId);\n    } catch {}\n\n    await (this.prisma as any).copyTradingAuditLog?.create({\n      data: { id: randomUUID(), tenantId, event: 'SUBSCRIPTION_STOPPED', actorId, traderId: sub.traderId, followerId: sub.followerId, strategyId: sub.strategyId, subscriptionId, result: 'SUCCESS', safeMetadata: {}, requestId, createdAt: new Date() },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Subscription stopped id=${subscriptionId} tenant=${tenantId}`);\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async cancelSubscription(tenantId: string, subscriptionId: string, actorId: string, followerId?: string | null, requestId?: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const sub = await this.subscriptionRepo.findById(subscriptionId, tenantId);\n    if (!sub) return null;\n    if (followerId && sub.followerId !== followerId) throw new ForbiddenException('Not authorized');\n\n    const updated = await this.transitionWithOutbox({\n      tenantId,\n      subscription: sub,\n      expectedState: sub.state as CopySubscriptionState,\n      nextState: CopySubscriptionState.CANCELLED,\n      eventType: 'copy.subscription.cancelled',\n      timestamps: { cancelledAt: new Date() },\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const actor = { tenantId, userId: actorId } as any;\n      await this.copySubsGuard.release(actor, sub.followerId);\n      await this.followersGuard.release(actor, sub.traderId);\n      await this.traderProfileService.decrementFollowerCount(tenantId, sub.traderId);\n    } catch {}\n\n    await (this.prisma as any).copyTradingAuditLog?.create({\n      data: { id: randomUUID(), tenantId, event: 'SUBSCRIPTION_CANCELLED', actorId, traderId: sub.traderId, followerId: sub.followerId, strategyId: sub.strategyId, subscriptionId, result: 'SUCCESS', safeMetadata: {}, requestId, createdAt: new Date() },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async updateSubscriptionSettings(\n    tenantId: string,\n    subscriptionId: string,\n    dto: {\n      allocationAmount?: string;\n      maxAllocation?: string | null;\n      minAllocation?: string | null;\n      allocationMode?: CopySizingMode;\n      copyPolicy?: Record<string, any>;\n      riskPolicy?: Record<string, any>;\n      followerAccountId?: string | null;\n    },\n    actorId: string,\n    followerId?: string | null,\n    requestId?: string,\n  ): Promise<any | null> {\n    const sub = await this.subscriptionRepo.findById(subscriptionId, tenantId);\n    if (!sub) return null;\n    if (followerId && sub.followerId !== followerId) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Not authorized to update this subscription');\n    }\n\n    const nextCopyPolicy = dto.copyPolicy\n      ? { ...(sub.copyPolicy || {}), ...dto.copyPolicy }\n      : (sub.copyPolicy || {});\n    const nextRiskPolicy = dto.riskPolicy\n      ? { ...(sub.riskPolicy || {}), ...dto.riskPolicy }\n      : (sub.riskPolicy || {});\n\n    const policyValidation = this.policyService.validatePolicy(nextCopyPolicy as any);\n    if (!policyValidation.valid) {\n      throw new UnprocessableEntityException(`Invalid copy policy: ${policyValidation.errors.join(', ')}`);\n    }\n\n    if (dto.allocationAmount !== undefined || dto.maxAllocation !== undefined || dto.minAllocation !== undefined || dto.allocationMode !== undefined) {\n      await !== undefined ? { maxAllocation: dto.maxAllocation } : {}),\n        ...(dto.minAllocation !== undefined ? { minAllocation: dto.minAllocation } : {}),\n        ...(dto.allocationMode !== undefined ? { Math.floor(n) : fallback;\n}\n\n/**\n * Phase 3: automatic leader-event ingestion.\n *\n * Safety properties:\n *  - Idempotent: event ids are stable (`fill:<id>`) and CopyExecution is\n *    unique per (tenant, leaderEvent, subscription); events every live\n *    subscription already has an execution for are not re-processed at all.\n *  - In-batch duplicate protection: duplicate records for the same eventId in\n *    one ingestion pass are deduplicated and counted as alreadyCopied.\n *  - Bounded staleness: a fill older than COPY_LEADER_EVENT_MAX_AGE_MS\n *    (default 30s) is never copied - the market has moved - and is left for\n *    reconciliation to report as MISSING_COPY instead of being filled late.\n *  - No history replay: a subscription is only eligible for events that\n *    happened while it was live (subscriptionWasLiveAt).\n *  - Off in tests; COPY_LEADER_INGESTION_ENABLED=false disables it.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class LeaderEventIngestionService implements OnModuleInit, OnModuleDestroy {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(LeaderEventIngestionService.name);\n  private timer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;\n  private running = false;\n\n  readonly intervalMs = positiveInt(process.env.COPY_LEADER_INGESTION_INTERVAL_MS, DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MS);\n  readonly maxAgeMs = positiveInt(process.env.COPY_LEADER_EVENT_MAX_AGE_MS, DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_MS);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly source: LeaderEventSourceService,\n    private readonly copyExecution: CopyExecutionService,\n  ) {}\n\n  onModuleInit(): void {\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' || (process.env.COPY_LEADER_INGESTION_ENABLED ?? '').toLowerCase() === 'false') {\n      this.logger.log('Leader-event ingestion disabled');\n      return;\n    }\n    this.timer = setInterval(() => {\n      void this.sweep().catch((error: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Leader-event sweep failed: ${error.message}`));\n    }, this.intervalMs);\n    this.timer.unref?.();\n    this.logger.log(`Leader-event ingestion every ${this.intervalMs}ms (max event age ${this.maxAgeMs}ms)`);\n  }\n\n  onModuleDestroy(): void {\n    if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer);\n    this.timer = null;\n  }\n\n  /** One pass over every tenant with at least one ACTIVE subscription. */\n  async sweep(now: Date = new Date()): Promise<IngestionResult> {\n    const total: IngestionResult = { events: 0, dispatched: 0, alreadyCopied: 0, expired: 0 };\n    if (this.running) return total; // never overlap passes in one process\n    this.running = true;\n    try {\n      const tenants = await this.prisma.copySubscription.findMany({ where: { state: 'ACTIVE' }, distinct: ['tenantId'], select: { tenantId: true } });\n      for (const { tenantId } of tenants) {\n        try {\n          const r = await this.ingestTenant(tenantId, now);\n          total.events += r.events;\n          total.dispatched += r.dispatched;\n          total.alreadyCopied += r.alreadyCopied;\n          total.expired += r.expired;\n        } catch (error) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Leader-event ingestion failed tenant=${tenantId}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n        }\n      }\n    } finally {\n      this.running = false;\n    }\n    return total;\n  }\n\n  async ingestTenant(tenantId: string, now: Date = new Date()): Promise<IngestionResult> {\n    const result: IngestionResult = { events: 0, dispatched: 0, alreadyCopied: 0, expired: 0 };\n    const subscriptions = await this.prisma.copySubscription.findMany({ where: { tenantId, state: 'ACTIVE' } });\n    if (subscriptions.length === 0) return result;\n\n    const byStrategy = new Map<string, any[]>();\n    for (const sub of subscriptions) {\n      const list = byStrategy.get(sub.strategyId) ?? [];\n      list.push(sub);\n      byStrategy.set(sub.strategyId, list);\n    }\n\n    const strategies = await this.source.listLeadingStrategies(tenantId, [...byStrategy.keys()]);\n    const from = new Date(now.getTime() - this.maxAgeMs - this.intervalMs);\n    const seenInPass = new Set<string>();\n\n    for (const strategy of strategies) {\n      const subs = byStrategy.get(strategy.id) ?? [];\n      const records = await this.source.listForStrategy(tenantId, strategy, from, now);\n      if (records.length === 0) continue;\n\n      const existing = await this.prisma.copyExecution.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, leaderEventId: { in: records.map((r) => r.event.eventId) } },\n        select: { leaderEventId: true, subscriptionId: true },\n      });\n      const copied = new Set(existing.map((e) => `${e.leaderEventId}|${e.subscriptionId}`));\n\n      for (const record of records) {\n        result.events += 1;\n        const passKey = `${tenantId}|${strategy.id}|${record.event.eventId}`;\n        if (seenInPass.has(passKey)) {\n          result.alreadyCopied += 1;\n          continue;\n        }\n        seenInPass.add(passKey);\n\n        const eligible = subs.filter((s) => subscriptionWasLiveAt(s, record.occurredAt));\n        if (eligible.length === 0 || eligible.every((s) => copied.has(`${record.event.eventId}|${s.id}`))) {\n          result.alreadyCopied += 1;\n          continue;\n        }\n        if (now.getTime() - record.occurredAt.getTime() > this.maxAgeMs) {\n          result.expired += 1;\n          continue;\n        }\n        await this.dispatch(tenantId, record);\n        for (const s of eligible) {\n          copied.add(`${record.event.eventId}|${s.id}`);\n        }\n        result.dispatched += 1;\n      }\n    }\n    if (result.dispatched > 0 || result.expired > 0) {\n      this.logger.log(`Leader events tenant=${tenantId} seen=${result.events} dispatched=${result.dispatched} expired=${result.expired}`);\n    }\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  private async dispatch(tenantId: string, record: LeaderEventRecord): Promise<void> {\n    await this.copyExecution.processLeaderEvent({\n      tenantId,\n      leaderEvent: record.event,\n      traderId: record.traderId,\n      strategyId: record.strategyId,\n    });\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/leader-event-source.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Dry-run orders\n * are excluded too - they were never transmitted.\n */\n\nexport interface LeaderStrategyRef {\n  id: string;\n  traderId: string;\n  userId: string;\n  supportedSymbols?: string[] | null;\n  supportedVenues?: string[] | null;\n  strategyConfig?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n}\n\nexport interface LeaderEventRecord {\n  event: LeaderEvent;\n  strategyId: string;\n  traderId: string;\n  /** When the fill happened (exchange time when known). */\n  occurredAt: Date;\n}\n\ninterface FillWithOrder {\n  id: string;\n  price: unknown;\n  quantity: unknown;\n  isSimulated: boolean;\n  exchangeTimestampMicros: bigint | number | null;\n  createdAt: Date;\n  order: {\n    id: string;\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    side: string;\n    venue: string;\n    isSimulated: boolean;\n    wasDryRun: boolean;\n    metadata: unknown;\n  };\n}\n\nfunction decimalString(value: unknown): string {\n  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '0';\n  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String((value as { toString(): string }).toString());\n}\n\nfunction occurredAt(fill: FillWithOrder): Date {\n  const micros = fill.exchangeTimestampMicros;\n  if (micros !== null && micros !== undefined) {\n    const ms = Number(BigInt(micros) / 1000n);\n    if (Number.isFinite(ms) && ms > 0) return new Date(ms);\n  }\n  return new Date(fill.createdAt);\n}\n\n/** True when the order was placed by copy trading (never a leader decision). */\nexport function isCopyOrder(metadata: unknown): boolean {\n  return typeof metadata === 'object' && metadata !== null && typeof (metadata as Record<string, unknown>).copyExecutionId === 'string';\n}\n\n/** Pure: one leader fill → the LeaderEvent the copy pipeline consumes. */\nexport function leaderEventFromFill(fill: FillWithOrder): { event: LeaderEvent; occurredAt: Date } {\n  const at = occurredAt(fill);\n  return {\n    occurredAt: at,\n    event: {\n      eventId: `fill:${fill.id}`,\n      orderId: fill.order.id,\n      fillId: fill.id,\n      symbol: fill.order.symbol,\n      exchangeSymbol: fill.order.symbol,\n      side: fill.order.side,\n      // A follower mirrors an execution that already happened, so it follows\n      // at market; the leader's fill price is the slippage reference.\n      type: 'MARKET',\n      quantity: decimalString(fill.quantity),\n      price: decimalString(fill.price),\n      stopPrice: null,\n      venue: fill.order.venue,\n      timestamp: at.toISOString(),\n      isSimulated: fill.isSimulated === true || fill.order.isSimulated === true,\n    },\n  };\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class LeaderEventSourceService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(LeaderEventSourceService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  /** Leader fills of one strategy in [from, to], oldest first. */\n  async listForStrategy(tenantId: string, strategy: LeaderStrategyRef, from: Date, to: Date, limit = 500): Promise<LeaderEventRecord[]> {\n    const pinnedAccount = typeof strategy.strategyConfig?.leaderAccountId === 'string' ? (strategy.strategyConfig.leaderAccountId as string) : null;\n    const accounts = await this.prisma.tradingAccount.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, userId: strategy.userId, ...(pinnedAccount ? { id: pinnedAccount } : {}) },\n      select: { id: true },\n    });\n    if (accounts.length === 0) return [];\n\n    const fills = (await this.prisma.fill.findMany({\n      where: {\n        createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to },\n        order: { tenantId, accountId: { in: accounts.map((a) => a.id) } },\n      },\n      include: {\n        order: {\n          select: { id: true, tenantId: true, accountId: true, symbol: true, side: true, venue: true, isSimulated: true, wasDryRun: true, metadata: true },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },\n      take: limit,\n    })) as unknown as FillWithOrder[];\n\n    const symbols = (strategy.supportedSymbols ?? []).map((s) => s.toUpperCase());\n    const venues = (strategy.supportedVenues ?? []).map((v) => v.toUpperCase());\n    const records: LeaderEventRecord[] = [];\n    for (const fill of fills) {\n      if (!fill.order || fill.order.tenantId !== tenantId) continue;\n      if (isCopyOrder(fill.order.metadata) || fill.order.wasDryRun) continue;\n      if (symbols.length > 0 && !symbols.includes(String(fill.order.symbol).toUpperCase())) continue;\n      if (venues.length > 0 && !venues.includes(String(fill.order.venue).toUpperCase())) continue;\n      const { event, occurredAt: at } = leaderEventFromFill(fill);\n      records.push({ event, strategyId: strategy.id, traderId: strategy.traderId, occurredAt: at });\n    }\n    if (fills.length >= limit) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Leader fill window truncated tenant=${tenantId} strategy=${strategy.id} limit=${limit}`);\n    }\n    return records;\n  }\n\n  /** Strategies that can currently lead (published) with their copy fields. */\n  async listLeadingStrategies(tenantId: string, strategyIds?: string[]): Promise<LeaderStrategyRef[]> {\n    const rows = await this.prisma.traderStrategy.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, deletedAt: null, ...(strategyIds ? { id: { in: strategyIds } } : { status: 'PUBLISHED' }) },\n      select: { id: true, traderId: true, userId: true, supportedSymbols: true, supportedVenues: true, strategyConfig: true },\n    });\n    return rows.map((r) => ({ ...r, strategyConfig: (r.strategyConfig ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown> }));\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether a subscription was live when a leader event happened: started at or\n * before it, and not stopped/cancelled/expired/paused before it. Shared by\n * ingestion (never copy history into a new subscription) and reconciliation\n * (only a subscription that was live can have MISSED a copy).\n */\nexport function subscriptionWasLiveAt(sub: Record<string, any>, at: Date): boolean {\n  const t = at.getTime();\n  const before = (value: unknown) => value !== null && value !== undefined && new Date(value as string).getTime() <= t;\n  if (!sub.startedAt || !before(sub.startedAt)) return false;\n  if (before(sub.stoppedAt) || before(sub.cancelledAt)) return false;\n  if (sub.expiresAt && new Date(sub.expiresAt).getTime() <= t) return false;\n  if (sub.state === 'PAUSED' && before(sub.pausedAt)) return false;\n  return true;\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/leader-event.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. benchmark observations without disclosing private trader records.\n\nimport { BadRequestException, Controller, Get, NotFoundException, Param, Query, Request } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { Permission } from '@wlct/shared-types';\nimport { RequirePermissions } from '../../common/decorators/permissions.decorator';\nimport { authRoles, authTenantId, authUserIdOrNull, hasAdminRole } from '../../common/guards/request-principal';\nimport { TraderProfileService } from './trader-profile.service';\nimport { PerformanceBenchmarkService } from './performance-benchmark.service';\n\n@Controller('copy-trading')\nexport class PerformanceBenchmarkController {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly traderProfileService: TraderProfileService,\n    private readonly benchmarkService: PerformanceBenchmarkService,\n  ) {}\n\n  @Get('traders/:traderId/benchmark')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.STRATEGY_READ)\n  async getBenchmark(@Request() req: any, @Param('traderId') traderId: string, @Query('benchmarkKey') benchmarkKey?: string) {\n    const tenantId = authTenantId(req);\n    const userId = authUserIdOrNull(req);\n    const roles = authRoles(req);\n    if (!userId) throw new BadRequestException('userId required');\n    if (benchmarkKey !== undefined && (benchmarkKey.trim().length === 0 || benchmarkKey.trim().length > 64)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('benchmarkKey must contain 1 to 64 characters');\n    }\n\n    const profile = await this.traderProfileService.getProfile(tenantId, traderId);\n    if (!profile || (!profile.isPublic && profile.userId !== userId && !hasAdminRole(roles))) {\n      throw new NotFoundException('Trader profile not found');\n    }\n\n    return this.benchmarkService.getTraderBenchmarkSeries(tenantId, traderId, benchmarkKey?.trim());\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/performance-benchmark.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/performance-benchmark.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/performance-calculation.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/performance-calculation.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/strategy-validation.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/copy-trading/trader-performance.service.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/ap Specify a different type.","line":468,"column":29,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":468,"endColumn":32,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[21339,21342],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[21339,21342],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":19,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { OutboxService } from '../../infrastructure/outbox/outbox.service';\nimport { PlanLimitTradersGuard } from '../billing/enforcement/plan-limit-traders.guard';\nimport { TraderVerificationState, TraderProfile } from './copy-trading.types';\nimport { Decimal, dec, isDecimalString } from '../../common/decimal-string';\nimport { TraderPerformanceService } from './trader-performance.service';\nimport { TraderRiskScoreService, TraderRiskFactorInput } from '../risk/trader-risk-score.service';\nimport { TWR_FLOW_BOUNDARY_RULE } from '../portfolio-accounting/portfolio-accounting.types';\nimport { TraderActivityMetric, TraderActiveFollowersMetric, TraderRiskScoreView, TraderSafePublicStatistics } from './copy-trading.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\nimport { isRecordNotFound } from '../../common/errors/prisma-not-found';\n\n/**\n * Trader profile and public marketplace metadata: display profile, supported venues, risk profile, verified state, performance references, followers, and safe public statistics.\n * Performance must come from canonical trading data. Never accept client-provided profit/ROI/drawdown/win rate as authoritative.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class TraderProfileService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(TraderProfileService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    // The maxTraders plan limit. Required, like the follower and\n    // copy-subscription guards in FollowerSubscriptionService: a wiring\n    // mistake must fail at boot, never silently switch the limit off.\n    // EnforcementModule exports it; BillingModule re-exports EnforcementModule.\n    private readonly tradersGuard: PlanLimitTradersGuard,\n    // The canonical performance read. Injected rather than recomputed so the figures a public\n    // profile publishes are the same ones the performance page shows, and so the TIME_WEIGHTED_RETURN\n    // provenance that qualifies them travels with them.\n    private readonly performanceService: TraderPerformanceService,\n    // The explainable risk score. This service was implemented, unit-tested and referenced by no\n    // production code at all; the public profile is where its output belongs, because a score whose\n    // factors and confidence are published cannot be mistaken for a rating.\n    private readonly riskScoreService: TraderRiskScoreService,\n    private readonly outbox: OutboxService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createProfile(input: { tenantId: string; userId: string; displayName: string; bio?: string | null; avatarUrl?: string | null; supportedVenues?: string[]; supportedSymbols?: string[]; riskProfile?: Record<string, any>; isPublic?: boolean }): Promise<TraderProfile> {\n    // Tenant ownership validation - user must belong to tenant\n    const user = await this.prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { id: input.userId, tenantId: input.tenantId } });\n    if (!user) throw new Error(`User ${input.userId} not found for tenant ${input.tenantId}`);\n\n    // Prevent duplicate profile\n    const existing = await (this.prisma as any).traderProfile?.findFirst({ where: { userId: input.userId, tenantId: input.tenantId } });\n    if (existing) throw new Error(`Trader profile already exists for user ${input.userId}`);\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date();\n\n    const data = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      userId: input.userId,\n      displayName: input.displayName,\n      bio: input.bio || null,\n      avatarUrl: input.avatarUrl || null,\n      verificationState: TraderVerificationState.UNVERIFIED,\n      supportedVenues: input.supportedVenues || [],\n      supportedSymbols: input.supportedSymbols || [],\n      riskProfile: input.riskProfile || {},\n      isPublic: input.isPublic || false,\n      isFeatured: false,\n      followerCount: 0,\n      totalVolume: '0',\n      totalTrades: 0,\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n\n    // Reserve a maxTraders slot before persisting (throws PlanLimitExceededError\n    // when the plan is full) and give it back if the insert fails, the same\n    // reserve/release contract the follower and exchange-account paths use.\n    const actor = { tenantId: input.tenantId, userId: input.userId, roles: [], ipHash: '', requestId: '', correlationId: '' };\n    await this.tradersGuard.reserve(actor);\n    let created: any;\n    try {\n      created = await (this.prisma as any).traderProfile.create({ data });\n    } catch (error) {\n      await this.tradersGuard.release(actor);\n      throw error;\n    }\n    this.logger.log(`Trader profile created id=${created.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} user=${input.userId}`);\n\n    return this.mapToProfile(created);\n  }\n\n  async getProfile(tenantId: string, traderId: string): Promise<TraderProfile | null> {\n    const profile = await (this.prisma as any).traderProfile?.findFirst({ where: { id: traderId, tenantId, deletedAt: null } });\n    return profile ? this.mapToProfile(profile) : null;\n  }\n\n  async getProfileByUserId(tenantId: string, userId: string): Promise<TraderProfile | null> {\n    const profile = await (this.prisma as any).traderProfile?.findFirst({ where: { userId, tenantId, deletedAt: null } });\n    return profile ? this.mapToProfile(profile) : null;\n  }\n\n  async listPublicProfiles(tenantId: string, filters?: { isFeatured?: boolean; verificationState?: TraderVerificationState; search?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: TraderProfile[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = Math.min(filters?.limit || 20, 100);\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n    const where: any = {\n      tenantId,\n      isPublic: true,\n      deletedAt: null,\n      ...(filters?.isFeatured !== undefined ? { isFeatured: filters.isFeatured } : {}),\n      ...(filters?.verificationState ? { verificationState: filters.verificationState } : {}),\n      ...(filters?.search ? { displayName: { contains: filters.search, mode: 'insensitive' } } : {}),\n    };\n\n    const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).traderProfile?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { followerCount: 'desc' }, skip, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).traderProfile?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n\n    return { data: rows.map((r: any) => this.mapToProfile(r)), total };\n  }\n\n  async listByTenant(tenantId: string, filters?: { userId?: string; verificationState?: TraderVerificationState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: TraderProfile[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, deletedAt: null, ...(filters?.userId ? { userId: filters.userId } : {}), ...(filters?.verificationState ? { verificationState: filters.verificationState } : {}) };\n    const [rows, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).traderProfile?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).traderProfile?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n    return { data: rows.map((r: any) => this.mapToProfile(r)), total };\n  }\n\n  async updateProfile(tenantId: string, traderId: string, updates: { displayName?: string; bio?: string | null; avatarUrl?: string | null; supportedVenues?: string[]; supportedSymbols?: string[]; riskProfile?: Record<string, any>; isPublic?: boolean }): Promise<TraderProfile | null> {\n    try {\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).traderProfile.update({\n        where: { id: traderId },\n        data: { ...updates, updatedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n      if (updated.tenantId !== tenantId) return null;\n      return this.mapToProfile(updated);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async verifyTrader(tenantId: string, traderId: string, verifierId: string): Promise<TraderProfile | null> {\n    const verifiedAt = new Date();\n    const updated = await this.prisma.withTenantRls(tenantId, async (tx) => {\n      const current = await tx.traderProfile.findFirst({\n        where: { id: traderId, tenantId },\n      });\n      if (!current) return null;\n      if (current.verificationState === TraderVerificationState.VERIFIED) return current;\n\n      const transition = await tx.traderProfile.updateMany({\n        where: { id: traderId, tenantId, verificationState: current.verificationState },\n        data: {\n          verificationState: TraderVerificationState.VERIFIED,\n          verifiedAt,\n          verifiedById: verifierId,\n          updatedAt: verifiedAt,\n        },\n      });\n      if (transition.count !== 1) return null;\n\n      const verified = await tx.traderProfile.findFirst({ where: { id: traderId, tenantId } });\n      if (!verified) throw new Error('verified trader row disappeared inside its transaction');\n      await this.outbox.append(tx, {\n        tenantId,\n        aggregateType: 'trader.profile',\n        aggregateId: traderId,\n        eventType: 'trader.verified',\n        idempotencyKey: `trader-profile:${traderId}:verified:${verifiedAt.getTime()}`,\n        payload: {\n          traderId,\n          verifiedAt: verifiedAt.toISOString(),\n          verificationState: TraderVerificationState.VERIFIED,\n        },\n      });\n      return verified;\n    });\n\n    if (!updated) return null;\n    this.logger.log(`Trader verified id=${traderId} tenant=${tenantId} by=${verifierId}`);\n    return this.mapToProfile(updated);\n  }\n\n  async incrementFollowerCount(tenantId: string, traderId: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).traderProfile.update({ where: { id: traderId }, data: { followerCount: { increment: 1 }, updatedAt: new Date() } });\n    } catch {}\n  }\n\n  async decrementFollowerCount(tenantId: string, traderId: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).traderProfile.update({ where: { id: traderId }, data: { followerCount: { decrement: 1 }, updatedAt: new Date() } });\n    } catch {}\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The published statistics for a trader profile.\n   *\n   * Every figure is either measured from canonical records or reported as `UNAVAILABLE` with a\n   * reason. Nothing here falls back to a stored counter when a read fails, and nothing is estimated:\n   * a public profile is read by people deciding where to put money, so \"we could not measure this\"\n   * and \"this is zero\" must never be the same answer.\n   *\n   * `suppliedProfile` lets a caller pass a profile it has already read. It is validated against the\n   * tenant and trader being asked about, so a supplied record cannot redirect the query at another\n   * tenant's trader.\n   */\n  async getSafePublicStatistics(\n    tenantId: string,\n    traderId: string,\n    suppliedProfile?: TraderProfile | null,\n  ): Promise<TraderSafePublicStatistics | null> {\n    let profile: TraderProfile | null;\n    if (suppliedProfile) {\n      if (suppliedProfile.traderId !== traderId || suppliedProfile.tenantId !== tenantId) return null;\n      profile = suppliedProfile;\n    } else {\n      profile = await this.getProfile(tenantId, traderId);\n    }\n    if (!profile) return null;\n\n    const userId = profile.userId;\n    const activeFollowers = await this.readActiveFollowers(tenantId, traderId);\n    const activity = await this.readActivity(tenantId, userId);\n    const riskScore = await this.readRiskScore(tenantId, traderId);\n\n    return {\n      traderId,\n      activeFollowers,\n      // Not measured, not estimated, not zero. There is no canonical valuation of follower\n      // portfolios in this platform, so publishing an AUM would mean inventing one.\n      aum: {\n        status: 'UNAVAILABLE',\n        value: null,\n        currency: null,\n        source: null,\n        asOf: null,\n        reason: 'NO_AUTHORITATIVE_FOLLOWER_PORTFOLIO_VALUATION',\n      },\n      activity,\n      riskScore,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /** Distinct active copy subscriptions, read from the canonical subscription table. */\n  private async readActiveFollowers(tenantId: string, traderId: string): Promise<TraderActiveFollowersMetric> {\n    try {\n      const rows = await this.prisma.copySubscription.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, traderId, state: 'ACTIVE' },\n        select: { followerId: true },\n        distinct: ['followerId'],\n      });\n      return {\n        status: 'AVAILABLE',\n        value: rows.length,\n        source: 'ACTIVE_COPY_SUBSCRIPTIONS',\n        asOf: new Date().toISOString(),\n        reason: null,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      // A failed read is not a follower count of zero. The stored `followerCount` column is\n      // deliberately not used as a fallback: it is a denormalised counter, and a reader cannot tell\n      // how fresh it is.\n      this.logger.warn(\n        `Active follower read failed for tenant ${tenantId} trader ${traderId} reason=${this.safeReason(error)}`,\n      );\n      return { status: 'UNAVAILABLE', value: null, source: null, asOf: null, reason: 'SOURCE_READ_FAILED' };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Recorded activity over the most recent fills, as exact decimal volume per quote asset.\n   *\n   * Only non-simulated fills from the trader's own tenant-scoped accounts count, so a paper or\n   * rehearsed fill never inflates a published figure. One row beyond the sample limit is requested\n   * so `hasMore` reports whether the sample is complete, rather than being assumed.\n   */\n  private async readActivity(tenantId: string, userId: string): Promise<TraderActivityMetric> {\n    const sampleLimit = 500;\n    try {\n      const rows = await this.prisma.fill.findMany({\n        where: {\n          isSimulated: false,\n          source: { not: 'SIMULATOR' },\n          order: { tenantId, isSimulated: false, account: { tenantId, userId } },\n        },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        take: sampleLimit + 1,\n        select: {\n          createdAt: true,\n          quantity: true,\n          price: true,\n          quoteQuantity: true,\n          order: { select: { symbolRef: { select: { quoteAsset: true } } } },\n        },\n      });\n\n      const hasMore = rows.length > sampleLimit;\n      const sampled = hasMore ? rows.slice(0, sampleLimit) : rows;\n      const volumes = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof dec>>();\n      let fromQuoteQuantity = 0;\n      let fromPriceTimesQuantity = 0;\n\n      for (const row of sampled) {\n        const asset = (row as { order?: { symbolRef?: { quoteAsset?: string | null } | null } | null }).order\n          ?.symbolRef?.quoteAsset;\n        if (!asset) continue;\n\n        const quoteQuantity = (row as { quoteQuantity?: unknown }).quoteQuantity;\n        let amount: ReturnType<typeof dec>;\n        if (quoteQuantity !== null && quoteQuantity !== undefined && String(quoteQuantity).trim() !== '') {\n          // The venue's own quote quantity is preferred: it is what the venue actually charged,\n          // whereas quantity x price recomputes it and can differ on a partial or a fee-adjusted fill.\n          amount = Decimal.parse(String(quoteQuantity));\n          fromQuoteQuantity += 1;\n        } else {\n          amount = Decimal.parse(String((row as { quantity: unknown }).quantity)).mul(\n            String((row as { price: unknown }).price),\n          );\n          fromPriceTimesQuantity += 1;\n        }\n        volumes.set(asset, (volumes.get(asset) ?? dec('0')).add(amount));\n      }\n\n      const calculationMethod: TraderActivityMetric['calculationMethod'] =\n        sampled.length === 0\n          ? 'NONE'\n          : fromQuoteQuantity > 0 && fromPriceTimesQuantity > 0\n            ? 'MIXED'\n            : fromQuoteQuantity > 0\n              ? 'QUOTE_QUANTITY'\n              : 'PRICE_TIMES_QUANTITY';\n\n      return {\n        status: 'AVAILABLE',\n        source: 'NON_SIMULATED_CANONICAL_FILL_RECORDS',\n        // The latest fill is derived from the sample rather than read off the first row. The query\n        // asks for newest-first, but \"the newest fill\" is a property of the data, not of the sort\n        // the database was asked to apply - and a caller that reorders or batches the rows would\n        // otherwise be able to change a published figure.\n        latestRecordedFillAt: this.latestTimestamp(sampled),\n        sampledFillCount: sampled.length,\n        sampleLimit,\n        hasMore,\n        calculationMethod,\n        volumeByQuoteAsset: [...volumes.entries()]\n          .map(([asset, amount]) => ({ asset, amount: amount.normalize().toString() }))\n          .sort((left, right) => (left.asset < right.asset ? -1 : left.asset > right.asset ? 1 : 0)),\n        asOf: new Date().toISOString(),\n        reason: null,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(\n        `Fill activity read failed for tenant ${tenantId} user ${userId} reason=${this.safeReason(error)}`,\n      );\n      return {\n        status: 'UNAVAILABLE',\n        source: null,\n        latestRecordedFillAt: null,\n        sampledFillCount: null,\n        sampleLimit,\n        hasMore: false,\n        calculationMethod: 'NONE',\n        volumeByQuoteAsset: [],\n        asOf: new Date().toISOString(),\n        reason: 'SOURCE_READ_FAILED',\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The explainable risk score.\n   *\n   * Only one factor is ever measured, and only from a return that is demonstrably a reconciled,\n   * linked, time-weighted one: actual (not estimated), owned by this tenant, closed and complete,\n   * carrying the recorded flow-boundary rule, and observed recently. Everything else is reported\n   * MISSING by the scorer, which is why a score built from one factor publishes `PARTIAL` confidence\n   * rather than a band implying a full picture.\n   */\n  private async readRiskScore(tenantId: string, traderId: string): Promise<TraderRiskScoreView> {\n    let performance: Awaited<ReturnType<TraderPerformanceService['getPerformance']>> | null = null;\n    try {\n      performance = await this.performanceService.getPerformance(tenantId, traderId);\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(\n        `Performance read failed for tenant ${tenantId} trader ${traderId} reason=${this.safeReason(error)}`,\n      );\n      performance = null;\n    }\n\n    const observedAt = this.observedAtOfRiskFactors(performance, tenantId);\n    const factors: TraderRiskFactorInput[] = [\n      {\n        key: 'maxDrawdownPercent',\n        value: observedAt ? 'UNAVAILABLE' : result.confidence === 'COMPLETE' ? 'AVAILABLE' : 'PARTIAL',\n      score: result.score,\n      band: result.band,\n      confidence: result.confidence,\n      methodology: result.methodology,\n      asOf: result.asOf,\n      factors: result.factors,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The observation time to attribute the drawdown factor to, or null when the record cannot be\n   * trusted as return evidence. Null leaves the factor MISSING, which is the fail-closed direction:\n   * an unproven drawdown must not lower or raise a published score.\n   */\n  private observedAtOfRiskFactors(\n    performance: Awaited<ReturnType<TraderPerformanceService['getPerformance']>> | null,\n    tenantId: string,\n  ): string | null {\n    if (!performance) return null;\n    if (performance.tenantId !== tenantId) return null;\n    if (!performance.isActual) return null;\n    if (performance.methodology !== 'TIME_WEIGHTED_RETURN') return null;\n    if (performance.flowBoundary !== TWR_FLOW_BOUNDARY_RULE) return null;\n    if (performance.dataCompleteness !== 'COMPLETE') return null;\n    if (!performance.maxDrawdownPercent || !isDecimalString(performance.maxDrawdownPercent)) return null;\n    const asOf = performance.asOf;\n    if (typeof asOf !== 'string' || asOf.length === 0) return null;\n    return asOf;\n  }\n\n  private toIso(value: unknown): string {\n    return value instanceof Date ? value.toISOString() : String(value);\n  }\n\n  /** The newest `createdAt` in the sample as an ISO string, or null when there is none usable. */\n  private latestTimestamp(rows: readonly unknown[]): string | null {\n    let latest: number | null = null;\n    for (const row of rows) {\n      const raw = (row as { createdAt?: unknown } | null)?.createdAt;\n      const time = raw instanceof Date ? error.name : 'UNKNOWN';\n  }\n\n  private mapToProfile(row: any): TraderProfile {\n    return {\n      traderId: row.id,\n      tenantId: row.tenantId,\n      userId: row.userId,\n      displayName: row.displayName,\n      bio: row.bio || null,\n      avatarUrl: row.avatarUrl || null,\n      verificationState: row.verificationState,\n      verifiedAt: row.verifiedAt ?
