'@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { TraderPerformanceService } from './trader-performance.service';\nimport {\n  MAX_VERIFIED_PERFORMANCE_PERIODS,\n  PerformanceCalculationService,\n  toPerformancePeriodEvidence,\n} from './performance-calculation.service';\nimport {\n  TraderRanking,\n  TraderRankingMethodology,\n  TraderRankingPage,\n  TraderRankingPeriodStatus,\n  TRADER_RANKING_WINDOW_DAYS,\n  TraderRankingTimeframe,\n  TraderVerificationState,\n} from './copy-trading.types';\n\n/**\n * Record limit for one ranking request: the engine's per-window maximum, times the number of\n * profiles being ranked, plus one per profile so an over-long window is detected by the engine\n * instead of being silently truncated to its newest periods.\n */\nconst RANKING_RECORD_LIMIT_PER_PROFILE = MAX_VERIFIED_PERFORMANCE_PERIODS + 1;\n\n/** The window columns a ranking row carries. `unavailableReason` is present only when UNAVAILABLE. */\ninterface UnrankedWindowOutcome {\n  periodStatus: TraderRankingPeriodStatus;\n  periodReturnPercent: string | null;\n  flowBoundary: string | null;\n  sourceCalculationVersion: string | null;\n  observationCount: number | null;\n  unavailableReason?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Ranking/search/filtering using only measurable, configured metrics and traceable performance data. Must not use opaque scores without explainability.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class TraderRankingService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(TraderRankingService.name);\n\n  // Configurable weights - must be traceable\n  private readonly defaultWeights = {\n    riskAdjustedReturn: 0.25,\n    drawdownScore: 0.20,\n    consistencyScore: 0.15,\n    historyLengthScore: 0.15,\n    followerScore: 0.10,\n    activityScore: 0.10,\n    verifiedScore: 0.05,\n  };\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly performanceService: TraderPerformanceService,\n    private readonly calculationService: PerformanceCalculationService,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * Ranks traders over an exact window of reconciled closed accounting periods.\n   *\n   * The window return is the only figure the rank is computed from, and it is compounded by the\n   * canonical engine from persisted evidence - never from a fill-derived PnL and never from a stored\n   * counter. A trader whose history does not tile the requested window is returned unranked with the\n   * reason, rather than being ranked over whatever slice of the window happens to exist: a 7-day\n   * ranking computed from 3 days of returns is not a 7-day ranking.\n   *\n   * Every trader is resolved against their own accounting profile before any period is read, so a\n   * trader with no profile, two profiles, or a non-time-weighted profile is excluded for a stated\n   * reason instead of quietly falling back to a weaker basis.\n   */\n  async getRanking(\n    tenantId: string,\n    filters?: {\n      verificationState?: TraderVerificationState;\n      isFeatured?: boolean;\n      search?: string;\n      page?: number;\n      limit?: number;\n      sortBy?: string;\n      timeframe?: TraderRankingTimeframe;\n    },\n  ): Promise<TraderRankingPage> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = Math.min(filters?.limit || 20, 100);\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n    const timeframe: TraderRankingTimeframe = filters?.timeframe ?? '30D';\n    const windowDays = TRADER_RANKING_WINDOW_DAYS[timeframe];\n    const currentnessRule = TraderPerformanceService.CURRENTNESS_RULE;\n\n    const where: any = {\n      tenantId,\n      isPublic: true,\n      deletedAt: null,\n      ...(filters?.verificationState ? { verificationState: filters.verificationState } : {}),\n      ...(filters?.isFeatured !== undefined ? { isFeatured: filters.isFeatured } : {}),\n      ...(filters?.search ? { displayName: { contains: filters.search, mode: 'insensitive' } } : {}),\n    };\n\n    const traders = await (this.prisma as any).traderProfile?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { followerCount: 'desc' }, skip, take: limit }) || [];\n    const total = await (this.prisma as any).traderProfile?.count({ where }) || 0;\n\n    const traderIds = traders.map((t: any) => t.id);\n\n    // A trader's accounting profile is scoped either to the trader profile id or to the owning user\n    // id, so both are resolved in one read and each trader is then matched against their own two.\n    const scopeIds: string[] = [];\n    for (const trader of traders) {\n      for (const scopeId of [trader.id, trader.userId]) {\n        if (typeof scopeId === 'string' && !scopeIds.includes(scopeId)) scopeIds.push(scopeId);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const profiles = scopeIds.length === 0\n      ? []\n      : await this.prisma.portfolioAccountingProfile.findMany({\n          where: { tenantId, scope: 'TRADER', isActive: true, scopeId: { in: scopeIds } },\n          select: { id: true, scopeId: true, baseCurrency: true, returnMethodology: true, calculationVersion: true },\n        });\n\n    const profileIds: string[] = [];\n    const outcomeByTrader = new Map<string, UnrankedWindowOutcome>();\n    const profileByTrader = new Map<string, (typeof profiles)[number]>();\n\n    for (const trader of traders) {\n      const scopes = [trader.id, trader.userId].filter((scopeId: unknown): scopeId is string => typeof scopeId === 'string');\n      const matches = profiles.filter((profile) => scopes.includes(profile.scopeId));\n\n      if (matches.length === 0) {\n        outcomeByTrader.set(trader.id, this.unranked('No active trader-scoped accounting profile establishes a verified return basis for this trader.'));\n        continue;\n      }\n      if (matches.length > 1) {\n        outcomeByTrader.set(trader.id, this.unranked('Multiple active trader-scoped accounting profiles establish conflicting return bases; they are never merged.'));\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      const profile = matches[0];\n      if (profile.returnMethodology !== 'TIME_WEIGHTED_RETURN') {\n        outcomeByTrader.set(trader.id, this.unranked('The active trader accounting profile does not use time-weighted return, so a deposit-independent return cannot be ranked.'));\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      profileByTrader.set(trader.id, profile);\n      if (!profileIds.includes(profile.id)) profileIds.push(profile.id);\n    }\n\n    // The as-of instant is the newest persisted period end, read after profile resolution so a trader\n    // excluded for profile reasons is excluded for that reason rather than for a missing window.\n    const latest = profileIds.length === 0\n      ? null\n      : await this.prisma.portfolioPerformanceRecord.findFirst({\n          where: { tenantId, profileId: { in: profileIds } },\n          orderBy: [{ periodEnd: 'desc' }, { id: 'asc' }],\n          select: { periodEnd: true },\n        });\n    const asOf = latest?.periodEnd ? new Date(latest.periodEnd) : null;\n    const windowStart = asOf === null ? null : new Date(asOf.getTime() - windowDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n\n    const records = asOf === null || profileIds.length === 0\n      ? []\n      : await this.prisma.portfolioPerformanceRecord.findMany({\n          where: {\n            tenantId,\n            periodId: { not: null },\n            methodology: 'TIME_WEIGHTED_RETURN',\n            dataCompleteness: 'COMPLETE',\n            period: {\n              is: {\n                tenantId,\n                profileId: { in: profileIds },\n                state: 'CLOSED',\n                closes: { some: { tenantId, validationPassed: true, reconciliationStatus: 'OK' } },\n              },\n            },\n          },\n          orderBy: [{ periodStart: 'asc' }, { periodEnd: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }],\n          take: RANKING_RECORD_LIMIT_PER_PROFILE * Math.max(1, profileIds.length),\n          select: {\n            periodId: true,\n            periodStart: true,\n            periodEnd: true,\n            returnPercent: true,\n            baseCurrency: true,\n            methodology: true,\n            calculationVersion: true,\n            dataCompleteness: true,\n            sourceReferences: true,\n            evidence: true,\n            profileId: true,\n            period: {\n              select: {\n                tenantId: true,\n                profileId: true,\n                state: true,\n                calculationVersion: true,\n                closes: {\n                  select: { validationPassed: true, reconciliationStatus: true, calculationVersion: true },\n                },\n              },\n            },\n          },\n        });\n\n    for (const trader of traders) {\n      const profile = profileByTrader.get(trader.id);\n      if (!profile) continue;\n      if (asOf === null || windowStart === null) {\n        outcomeByTrader.set(trader.id, this.unranked('No persisted accounting period establishes an as-of instant for this window.'));\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      const rows = records.filter((record) => record.profileId === profile.id);\n      const result = this.calculationService.calculatePeriods(\n        rows.map((row) => toPerformancePeriodEvidence(row, tenantId, profile.id)),\n        {\n          expectedStart: windowStart,\n          expectedEnd: asOf,\n          expectedBaseCurrency: profile.baseCurrency,\n          expectedCalculationVersion: profile.calculationVersion,\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (result.dataCompleteness !== 'COMPLETE') {\n        outcomeByTrader.set(trader.id, this.unranked(result.unavailableReason ?? 'The requested window is not fully covered by reconciled closed periods.'));\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      outcomeByTrader.set(trader.id, {\n        periodStatus: 'AVAILABLE',\n        periodReturnPercent: result.returnPercent,\n        // The engine names the rule even on a rejected window; here the window passed, so it is a fact.\n        flowBoundary: result.flowBoundary,\n        sourceCalculationVersion: result.sourceCalculationVersion,\n        observationCount: result.observationCount,\n      });\n    }\n\n    const performances = await this.performanceService.getBatchPerformance(tenantId, traderIds);\n\n    const rankings: TraderRanking[] = traders.map((trader: any) => {\n      const perf = performances[trader.id] || null;\n      const metrics = this.calculateMetrics(trader, perf);\n      const score = this.calculateScore(metrics, this.defaultWeights);\n      const outcome = outcomeByTrader.get(trader.id) ?? this.unranked('The window outcome could not be determined.');\n\n      return {\n        traderId: trader.id,\n        tenantId: trader.tenantId,\n        displayName: trader.displayName,\n        verificationState: trader.verificationState,\n        isPublic: trader.isPublic,\n        isFeatured: trader.isFeatured,\n        followerCount: trader.followerCount || 0,\n        performance: perf,\n        score,\n        rank: null,\n        metrics,\n        weighting: this.defaultWeights,\n        timeframe,\n        ...outcome,\n      };\n    });\n\n    // Ranked traders first, ordered by the window return descending. Unranked traders keep the order\n    // the filters returned them in: they are excluded from the ordering, not placed at the bottom of\n    // a comparison their history does not qualify them to enter.\n    const ranked = rankings\n      .filter((row) => row.periodStatus === 'AVAILABLE' && row.periodReturnPercent !== null)\n      .sort((left, right) => compareDecimalStrings(right.periodReturnPercent!, left.periodReturnPercent!)\n        || left.traderId.localeCompare(right.traderId));\n    ranked.forEach((row, index) => {\n      row.rank = index + 1;\n    });\n\n    if (filters?.sortBy === 'score') {\n      rankings.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);\n    } else if (filters?.sortBy === 'followers') {\n      rankings.sort((a, b) => b.followerCount - a.followerCount);\n    } else {\n      const rankedIds = new Set(ranked.map((row) => row.traderId));\n      rankings.sort((left, right) => {\n        const leftRanked = rankedIds.has(left.traderId);\n        const rightRanked = rankedIds.has(right.traderId);\n        if (leftRanked !== rightRanked) return leftRanked ? -1 : 1;\n        if (leftRanked && rightRanked) return (left.rank ?? 0) - (right.rank ?? 0);\n        return 0;\n      });\n    }\n\n    const rankedCount = rankings.filter((row) => row.rank !== null).length;\n\n    // The disclosure a reader needs is the union of the reasons the unranked rows carry. Distinct\n    // because a hundred rows citing one cause is one explanation, and counted because a reader\n    // looking at an unranked row should be told whether its cause is shared or particular to it.\n    const unrankedReasons = Array.from(\n      new Set(\n        rankings\n          .filter((row) => row.rank === null)\n          .map((row) => row.unavailableReason)\n          .filter((reason): reason is string => typeof reason === 'string' && reason.length > 0),\n      ),\n    );\n\n    const methodology: TraderRankingMethodology = {\n      status: rankedCount === 0 ? 'UNAVAILABLE' : 'AVAILABLE',\n      key: 'RECONCILED_CLOSED_PERIOD_TWR',\n      description: 'Compounded time-weighted return over exact contiguous closed, reconciled accounting periods. A trader with fewer than two qualifying periods is listed without a return rather than ranked over part of the window.',\n      timeframe,\n      windowStart: windowStart === null ? null : windowStart.toISOString(),\n      asOf: asOf === null ? null : asOf.toISOString(),\n      boundaryRule: 'EXACT_CONTIGUOUS_PERIODS_ONLY',\n      orderingRule: 'RETURN_DESCENDING_UNAVAILABLE_LAST',\n      currentnessRule,\n      minimumPeriodCount: 2,\n      rankedCount,\n      unrankedCount: rankings.length - rankedCount,\n      reason:\n        unrankedReasons.length === 0\n          ? null\n          : unrankedReasons.length === 1\n            ? unrankedReasons[0]\n            : `${unrankedReasons.length} distinct reasons leave traders unranked over ${timeframe}; each affected row carries its own unavailableReason.`,\n    };\n\n    return { data: rankings, total, timeframe, methodology };\n  }\n\n  /** The published window outcome for a trader whose window was not proven. No figure is invented. */\n  private unranked(unavailableReason: string): UnrankedWindowOutcome {\n    return {\n      periodStatus: 'UNAVAILABLE',\n      periodReturnPercent: null,\n      flowBoundary: null,\n      sourceCalculationVersion: null,\n      observationCount: null,\n      unavailableReason,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private calculateMetrics(trader: any, perf: any): TraderRanking['metrics'] {\n    // Risk-adjusted return - measurable: realizedPnl / (maxDrawdown || 1)\n    let riskAdjustedReturn: number | null = null;\n    if (perf && perf.realizedPnl) {\n      const pnl = parseFloat(perf.realizedPnl);\n      const dd = perf.maxDrawdown ? parseFloat(perf.maxDrawdown) : 1;\n      if (!isNaN(pnl) && dd > 0) {\n        riskAdjustedReturn = pnl / dd;\n      } else if (!isNaN(pnl)) {\n        riskAdjustedReturn = pnl;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Drawdown score - lower drawdown = higher score, measurable\n    let drawdownScore: number | null = null;\n    if (perf && perf.maxDrawdown) {\n      const dd = parseFloat(perf.maxDrawdown);\n      if (!isNaN(dd)) {\n        // Inverse: 0 drawdown = 100, 100% drawdown = 0\n        drawdownScore = Math.max(0, 100 - dd);\n      }\n    } else if (perf && perf.tradeCount > 0) {\n      drawdownScore = 80; // No drawdown recorded but trades exist\n    }\n\n    // Consistency score - win rate * trade count factor, measurable\n    let consistencyScore: number | null = null;\n    if (perf && perf.winRate) {\n      const wr = parseFloat(perf.winRate);\n      const countFactor = Math.min(1, (perf.tradeCount || 0) / 100); // Normalize by 100 trades\n      if (!isNaN(wr)) consistencyScore = wr * 100 * (0.5 + 0.5 * countFactor);\n    }\n\n    // History length score - measurable days\n    let historyLengthScore: number | null = null;\n    if (perf && perf.historyLengthDays !== undefined) {\n      historyLengthScore = Math.min(100, perf.historyLengthDays); // Cap at 100 days = 100 score\n    }\n\n    // Follower score - measurable follower count normalized\n    let followerScore: number | null = null;\n    if (trader.followerCount !== undefined) {\n      followerScore = Math.min(100, trader.followerCount); // Cap at 100 followers = 100 score\n    }\n\n    // Activity score - recent trade activity measurable\n    let activityScore: number | null = null;\n    if (perf && perf.lastTradeAt) {\n      const lastTrade = new Date(perf.lastTradeAt).getTime();\n      const now = Date.now();\n      const daysSince = (now - lastTrade) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);\n      activityScore = Math.max(0, 100 - daysSince * 2); // Decay 2 points per day\n    }\n\n    // Verified score - measurable verification state\n    let verifiedScore: number | null = null;\n    switch (trader.verificationState) {\n      case 'VERIFIED':\n        verifiedScore = 100;\n        break;\n      case 'PENDING':\n        verifiedScore = 50;\n        break;\n      case 'UNVERIFIED':\n        verifiedScore = 20;\n        break;\n      case 'REJECTED':\n      case 'SUSPENDED':\n        verifiedScore = 0;\n        break;\n      default:\n        verifiedScore = 0;\n    }\n\n    return {\n      riskAdjustedReturn,\n      drawdownScore,\n      consistencyScore,\n      historyLengthScore,\n      followerScore,\n      activityScore,\n      verifiedScore,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private calculateScore(metrics: TraderRanking['metrics'], weights: Record<string, number>): number {\n    let total = 0;\n    let weightSum = 0;\n\n    const entries: [keyof TraderRanking['metrics'], number][] = [\n      ['riskAdjustedReturn', weights.riskAdjustedReturn],\n      ['drawdownScore', weights.drawdownScore],\n      ['consistencyScore', weights.consistencyScore],\n      ['historyLengthScore', weights.historyLengthScore],\n      ['followerScore', weights.followerScore],\n      ['activityScore', weights.activityScore],\n      ['verifiedScore', weights.verifiedScore],\n    ];\n\n    for (const [key, weight] of entries) {\n      const value = metrics[key];\n      if (value !== null && value !== undefined && !isNaN(value)) {\n        total += value * weight;\n        weightSum += weight;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return weightSum > 0 ? total / weightSum : 0;\n  }\n\n  async getFeaturedTraders(tenantId: string, limit = 10): Promise<TraderRanking[]> {\n    const { data } = await this.getRanking(tenantId, { isFeatured: true, limit, sortBy: 'score' });\n    return data;\n  }\n\n  async searchTraders(tenantId: string, query: string, filters?: { verificationState?: TraderVerificationState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: TraderRanking[]; total: number }> {\n    return this.getRanking(tenantId, { ...filters, search: query, sortBy: 'score' });\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Compares two exact decimal strings by value. `Number()` is not used: a return percentage is a\n * published figure, and comparing it through a float could order two values that differ in the\n * digits the float cannot hold.\n */\nfunction compareDecimalStrings(left: string, right: string): number {\n  const leftParts = /^(-?)(\\d+)(?:\\.(\\d+))?$/.exec(left);\n  const rightParts = /^(-?)(\\d+)(?:\\.(\\d+))?$/.exec(right);\n  if (!leftParts || !rightParts) return 0;\n\n  const leftNegative = leftParts[1] === '-';\n  const rightNegative = rightParts[1] === '-';\n  if (leftNegative !== rightNegative) return leftNegative ? -1 : 1;\n\n  const leftInt = leftParts[2].replace(/^0+(?=\\d)/, '');\n  const rightInt = rightParts[2].replace(/^0+(?=\\d)/, '');\n  if (leftInt.length !== rightInt.length) return leftNegative ? rightInt.length - leftInt.length : leftInt.length - rightInt.length;\n\n  if (leftInt !== rightInt) {\n    const comparison = leftInt < rightInt ? -1 : 1;\n    return leftNegative ? -comparison : comparison;\n  }\n\n  const leftFraction = (leftParts[3] ?? ambiguous assets.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class AssetRegistryService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AssetRegistryService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async registerAsset(params: {\n    assetId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    name: string;\n    decimals: number;\n    isNative?: boolean;\n    contractAddress?: string | null;\n    tokenStandard?: string | null;\n    chainId?: string | null;\n    networkId?: string | null;\n    displayPrecision?: number;\n    isActive?: boolean;\n    metadata?: any;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { assetId, symbol, name, decimals, isNative = false, contractAddress = null, tokenStandard = null, chainId = null, networkId = null, displayPrecision = 8, isActive = true, metadata = {} } = params;\n\n    if (!assetId || !symbol || !name) throw new BadRequestException('assetId, symbol, name required');\n    if (decimals < 0 || decimals > 36) throw new BadRequestException('Invalid decimals — must be 0-36');\n\n    // Reject ambiguous assets — asset identity must preserve network/contract relationship\n    // For example, USDT without network context is ambiguous\n    if (!isNative && !contractAddress && !networkId) {\n      // For non-native tokens, require networkId or contractAddress for uniqueness\n      if (['USDT', 'USDC', 'DAI', 'WETH'].includes(symbol.toUpperCase())) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Ambiguous asset ${symbol} — networkId or contractAddress required for token identity`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).custodyAsset.findFirst({ where: { assetId } });\n      if (existing) {\n        return await (this.prisma as any).custodyAsset.update({\n          where: { id: existing.id },\n          data: {\n            symbol,\n            name,\n            decimals,\n            isNative,\n            contractAddress,\n            tokenStandard,\n            chainId,\n            networkId,\n            displayPrecision,\n            isActive,\n            metadata,\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const asset = await (this.prisma as any).custodyAsset.create({\n      data: {\n        assetId,\n        symbol,\n        name,\n        decimals,\n        isNative,\n        contractAddress,\n        tokenStandard,\n        chainId,\n        networkId,\n        displayPrecision,\n        isActive,\n        metadata,\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.asset.registered', assetId, symbol, networkId });\n\n    return asset;\n  }\n\n  async getAsset(params: { assetId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    return await (this.prisma as any).custodyAsset.findFirst({ where: { assetId: params.assetId } });\n  }\n\n  async getAssetBySymbolAndNetwork(params: { symbol: string; networkId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    // Never allow BTC/USDT/ETH/USDC to be treated as globally unique without network context\n    return await (this.prisma as any).custodyAsset.findFirst({\n      where: { symbol: params.symbol, networkId: params.networkId, isActive: true },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async listAssets(params: { networkId?: string; isActive?: boolean; symbol?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { networkId, isActive, symbol, page = 1, limit = 100 } = params;\n    const where: any = {};\n    if (networkId) where.networkId = networkId;\n    if (isActive !== undefined) where.isActive = isActive;\n    if (symbol) where.symbol = symbol;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyAsset.findMany({ where, orderBy: { symbol: 'asc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyAsset.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n\n  async isAssetSupported(params: { assetId: string; networkId: string }): Promise<boolean> {\n    const asset = await (this.prisma as any).custodyAsset.findFirst({ where: { assetId: params.assetId, networkId: params.networkId, isActive: true } });\n    return !!asset;\n  }\n\n  async getDecimals(params: { assetId: string }): Promise<number> {\n    const asset = await this.getAsset({ assetId: params.assetId });\n    if (!asset) throw new BadRequestException(`Unsupported asset ${params.assetId} — explicit capability error`);\n    return asset.decimals;\n  }\n\n  async validateAssetIdentity(identity: AssetIdentity): Promise<void> {\n    if (!identity.assetId || !identity.assetSymbol || !identity.networkId) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Asset identity must include assetId, assetSymbol, networkId');\n    }\n    if (identity.decimals < 0 || identity.decimals > 36) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid decimals in asset identity');\n    }\n    const supported = await this.isAssetSupported({ assetId: identity.assetId, networkId: identity.networkId });\n    if (!supported) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Unsupported asset/network: ${identity.assetId} on ${identity.networkId} — explicit capability error`);\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/blockchain-fee.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'tenantId' './custody.types';\n\n/**\n * Resolves the configured blockchain provider using explicit asset/network capability and configuration.\n * Must fail closed when no valid provider exists and must never silently fall back to a fake/mock provider.\n */\n\nclass NoOpBlockchainProvider implements BlockchainProvider {\n  readonly providerId = 'noop';\n  readonly providerName = 'NoOp Provider (not configured)';\n\n  async getCapabilities(): Promise<BlockchainProviderCapabilities> {\n    return {\n      canGetBalance: false,\n      canObserveAddress: false,\n      canSubmitTransaction: false,\n      canGetTransaction: false,\n      canGetReceipt: false,\n      canGetBlock: false,\n      canEstimateFee: false,\n      canObserveConfirmations: false,\n      supportedNetworks: [],\n      supportedAssets: [],\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getBalance(): Promise<BalanceObservation> {\n    throw new BadRequestException('No blockchain provider configured — missing provider configured');\n  }\n\n  async isHealthy(): Promise<{ healthy: boolean; reason?: string }> {\n    return { healthy: false, reason: 'No provider configured — missing credentials/configuration' };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Phase 3: the internal-ledger evidence provider. It answers from the\n * platform's own custody records (transactions it already holds evidence\n * for) and declares ONLY that. It cannot read chain balances, mint deposit\n * addresses, submit transactions or estimate fees, so its capabilities say so\n * and every caller that needs those fails closed. Previously this class\n * declared every capability true while implementing none of them.\n */\nexport const INTERNAL_LEDGER_PROVIDER_ID = 'internal-ledger';\n\nclass ConfiguredBlockchainProvider implements BlockchainProvider {\n  readonly providerId: string;\n  readonly providerName: string;\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ConfiguredBlockchainProvider.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly assetRegistry: AssetRegistryService,\n    private readonly networkRegistry: NetworkRegistryService,\n    private readonly config: { providerId: string; providerName: string; supportedNetworks: string[]; supportedAssets: string[] },\n  ) {\n    this.providerId = config.providerId;\n    this.providerName = config.providerName;\n  }\n\n  async getCapabilities(): Promise<BlockchainProviderCapabilities> {\n    return {\n      canGetBalance: false,\n      canObserveAddress: false,\n      canSubmitTransaction: false,\n      canGetTransaction: true,\n      canGetReceipt: false,\n      canGetBlock: false,\n      canEstimateFee: false,\n      canObserveConfirmations: false,\n      canGenerateAddress: false,\n      supportedNetworks: this.config.supportedNetworks,\n      supportedAssets: this.config.supportedAssets,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getBalance(params: { assetId: string; networkId: string; address: string }): Promise<BalanceObservation> {\n    // Must obtain verified balances from provider evidence, never invent blockchain balances\n    // Here we would call actual provider API — for now, we check if provider is configured and fail closed if not\n\n    // Verify asset/network explicit\n    if (!params.assetId || !params.networkId || !params.address) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Asset, network, and address must be explicit for balance lookup');\n    }\n\n    // Check if asset/network supported\n    const assetSupported = await this.assetRegistry.isAssetSupported({ assetId: params.assetId, networkId: params.networkId });\n    if (!assetSupported) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Unsupported asset/network: ${params.assetId} on ${params.networkId}`);\n    }\n\n    const networkSupported = await this.networkRegistry.isNetworkSupported({ networkId: params.networkId });\n    if (!networkSupported) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Unsupported network: ${params.networkId}`);\n    }\n\n    // In real implementation, call provider API to get balance\n    // For this control plane, we return a diagnostic observation that requires provider evidence\n    // Missing provider observation must never become zero — return UNKNOWN\n\n    // Simulate provider call failure closed — we cannot invent balance\n    // We check if there is any existing transaction that can give us balance hint? No, must be provider-derived\n    // For now, we return an observation that indicates provider call would happen\n\n    // This is a placeholder for actual provider integration — in production, this would call provider\n    // We must not invent balance, so we throw if provider not actually configured to return real data\n    // To satisfy interface without fake balances, we query existing custody transactions for this address as fallback diagnostic?\n\n    // For deterministic validation, we return a balance observation that is explicitly provider-derived but marked as requiring evidence\n    // In real production, this would be replaced with actual provider call\n\n    // For now, return a structure that indicates balance observation is provider-derived\n    // We will attempt to get balance from existing custody transaction confirmations as diagnostic, but mark as UNKNOWN if not available\n\n    try {\n      // Check if we have any confirmed deposits for this address\n      const deposits = await (this.prisma as any).custodyDeposit.findMany({\n        where: { toAddress: params.address, assetId: params.assetId, networkId: params.networkId, state: 'CONFIRMED' },\n        take: 100,\n      });\n\n      const available = '0';\n      let hasObservation = false;\n\n      for (const dep of deposits) {\n        if (dep.amount) {\n          // Sum confirmed deposits — but this is internal accounting, not chain truth, so we must mark as not chain truth\n          // For custody balance service, we distinguish AVAILABLE vs chain truth\n          hasObservation = true;\n          // We don't sum here for chain truth — we return UNKNOWN if no provider\n        }\n      }\n\n      // If no provider, return UNKNOWN — missing observation never becomes zero\n      if (!hasObservation) {\n        return {\n          assetId: params.assetId,\n          assetSymbol: params.assetId.split('-')[0] ?? params.assetId,\n          networkId: params.networkId,\n          walletId: 'unknown',\n          available: '0',\n          observationTimestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n          provider: this.providerId,\n          sourceReference: `no-provider-observation:${params.address}`,\n          dataCompleteness: 'UNKNOWN_NO_PROVIDER_OBSERVATION',\n        };\n      }\n\n      return {\n        assetId: params.assetId,\n        assetSymbol: params.assetId.split('-')[0] ?? params.assetId,\n        networkId: params.networkId,\n        walletId: 'unknown',\n        // Internal deposit records are not chain truth: the balance stays\n        // UNKNOWN (never a fabricated 0) and is labelled as ledger-derived.\n        available: '0',\n        observationTimestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        provider: this.providerId,\n        sourceReference: `ledger-deposits-only:${params.address}`,\n        dataCompleteness: 'UNKNOWN_LEDGER_ONLY_NOT_CHAIN_TRUTH',\n      };\n    } catch {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Provider balance lookup failed — missing provider credentials/configuration must never be reported as healthy');\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getTransaction(params: { transactionHash: string; networkId: string }): Promise<TransactionObservation | null> {\n    if (!params.transactionHash || !params.networkId) throw new BadRequestException('transactionHash and networkId must be explicit');\n\n    // Must obtain transaction from provider evidence, never invent transaction hashes\n    const tx = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({\n      where: { transactionHash: params.transactionHash, networkId: params.networkId },\n    });\n\n    if (!tx) return null;\n\n    return {\n      transactionHash: tx.transactionHash,\n      blockHash: tx.blockHash ?? null,\n      blockNumber: tx.blockNumber ?? null,\n      fromAddress: (tx.evidence as any)?.fromAddress ?? null,\n      toAddress: (tx.evidence as any)?.toAddress ?? null,\n      amount: tx.amount,\n      assetId: tx.assetId,\n      networkId: tx.networkId,\n      confirmationCount: tx.confirmationCount ?? 0,\n      requiredConfirmationCount: tx.requiredConfirmationCount ?? 6,\n      status: tx.status as any,\n      fee: tx.actualFee ?? tx.estimatedFee ?? null,\n      feeAsset: tx.feeAsset ?? null,\n      observedAt: tx.observedAt?.toISOString() ?? new Date().toISOString(),\n      providerReference: tx.providerReference ?? null,\n      rawProviderData: tx.evidence,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async estimateFee(params: { assetId: string; networkId: string; fromAddress: string; toAddress: string; amount: string }): Promise<FeeObservation> {\n    // Must obtain verified fee estimates from provider evidence, never invent network fees\n    // For now, return estimated fee as null to indicate requires provider\n    return {\n      estimatedFee: null,\n      actualFee: null,\n      feeAsset: params.assetId,\n      isActual: false,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async isHealthy(): Promise<{ healthy: boolean; reason?: string }> {\n    // Missing provider credentials/configuration must never be reported as healthy\n    // Check if provider config exists\n    // An internal ledger is not a blockchain provider: never report healthy.\n    return {\n      healthy: false,\n      reason: 'No external blockchain provider configured (internal ledger evidence only) - balances, deposit addresses, submission and fee estimation are unavailable',\n    };\n  }\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class BlockchainProviderFactory {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(BlockchainProviderFactory.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly assetRegistry: AssetRegistryService,\n    private readonly networkRegistry: NetworkRegistryService,\n    private readonly configService: AppConfigService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async getProviderForNetwork(params: { networkId: string; assetId: string }): Promise<BlockchainProvider> {\n    const { networkId, assetId } = params;\n\n    // Network and asset identifiers must always be explicit\n    if (!networkId || !assetId) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Network and asset must be explicit for provider resolution');\n    }\n\n    // Check if network supported\n    const networkSupported = await this.networkRegistry.isNetworkSupported({ networkId });\n    if (!networkSupported) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Unsupported network ${networkId} — explicit capability error`);\n    }\n\n    // Check if asset supported on network\n    const assetSupported = await this.assetRegistry.isAssetSupported({ assetId, networkId });\n    if (!assetSupported) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Unsupported asset ${assetId} on network ${networkId} — explicit capability error`);\n    }\n\n    // Resolve configured provider — provider-neutral, fail closed when no valid provider\n    // Do not hardcode single blockchain provider as authoritative\n    try {\n      // CUSTODY_BLOCKCHAIN_PROVIDER selects the evidence provider. Only the\n      // internal-ledger provider ships in this build: it reads recorded custody\n      // transactions, never reports healthy and cannot issue addresses. A real\n      // chain/custodian adapter (BitGo, Fireblocks, node RPC) must be added\n      // here before deposits or sweeps can run.\n\n      const configured = (process.env.CUSTODY_BLOCKCHAIN_PROVIDER ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();\n      if (configured && configured !== INTERNAL_LEDGER_PROVIDER_ID) {\n        // A named external provider was requested but no adapter for it ships\n        // in this codebase: refuse rather than silently substituting.\n        throw new Error(`CUSTODY_BLOCKCHAIN_PROVIDER=${configured} has no adapter in this build`);\n      }\n      const providerConfig = {\n        providerId: INTERNAL_LEDGER_PROVIDER_ID,\n        providerName: 'Internal ledger evidence (no external blockchain provider)',\n        supportedNetworks: [networkId],\n        supportedAssets: [assetId],\n      };\n\n      return new ConfiguredBlockchainProvider(this.prisma, this.assetRegistry, this.networkRegistry, providerConfig);\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to resolve provider for ${networkId}/${assetId}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      // Must fail closed when no valid provider exists and must never silently fall back to fake/mock provider\n      throw new BadRequestException(`No valid blockchain provider for network ${networkId} asset ${assetId} — fail closed, no fake/mock fallback`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getProviderById(providerId: string): Promise<BlockchainProvider> {\n    if (!providerId) throw new BadRequestException('providerId must be explicit');\n\n    // 'noop' is the explicit placeholder id reported by listAvailableProviders\n    // when nothing resolves; it always reports unhealthy.\n    if (providerId === 'noop' || !providerId) {\n      return new NoOpBlockchainProvider();\n    }\n\n    if (providerId === INTERNAL_LEDGER_PROVIDER_ID) {\n      return new ConfiguredBlockchainProvider(this.prisma, this.assetRegistry, this.networkRegistry, {\n        providerId,\n        providerName: 'Internal ledger evidence (no external blockchain provider)',\n        supportedNetworks: [],\n        supportedAssets: [],\n      });\n    }\n    // Unknown provider ids are an error, never a fabricated provider.\n    throw new BadRequestException(`Unknown blockchain provider ${providerId} - fail closed`);\n  }\n\n  async listAvailableProviders(): Promise<Array<{ providerId: string; providerName: string; healthy: boolean }>> {\n    // Lists the provider resolved from configuration. When resolution fails the\n    // result is an explicit unhealthy 'noop' entry, never an empty \"all good\".\n    try {\n      const provider = await this.getProviderForNetwork({ networkId: 'ethereum', assetId: 'ETH-ethereum' });\n      const health = await provider.isHealthy?.();\n      return [{ providerId: provider.providerId, providerName: provider.providerName, healthy: health?.healthy ?? false }];\n    } catch {\n      return [{ providerId: 'noop', providerName: 'NoOp Provider', healthy: false }];\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getProvidersHealth(params: { tenantId: string }): Promise<Array<{ providerId: string; providerName: string; healthy: boolean; reason?: string }>> {\n    try {\n      const providers = await this.listAvailableProviders();\n      const results: Array<{ providerId: string; providerName: string; healthy: boolean; reason?: string }> = [];\n      for (const p of providers) {\n        try {\n          const provider = await this.getProviderById(p.providerId);\n          const health = await provider.isHealthy?.();\n          results.push({ providerId: p.providerId, providerName: p.providerName, healthy: health?.healthy ?? false, reason: health?.reason });\n        } catch {\n          results.push({ providerId: p.providerId, providerName: p.providerName, healthy: false, reason: 'Health check failed' });\n        }\n      }\n      return results;\n    } catch {\n      return [{ providerId: 'noop', providerName: 'NoOp Provider', healthy: false, reason: 'No providers configured' }];\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/blockchain-provider.interface.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. blockHash?: string | null; blockNumber?: string | null; gasUsed?: string | null; actualFee?: string | null } | null>;\n\n  getBlock?(params: { networkId: string; blockHash?: string | null; blockNumber?: string | null }): Promise<{ blockHash: string; '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { CustodyPolicyService } from './custody-policy.service';\nimport { CustodyAuditService } from './custody-audit.service';\nimport { CustodyConfirmationState, CustodyTransactionState, deterministicIdempotencyKey } from './custody.types';\n\n/**\n * Evaluates confirmation/finality requirements using network policy and actual chain/provider evidence.\n * Must distinguish observed, required, confirmed, final, failed, and reorged states.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class ConfirmationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ConfirmationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly custodyPolicyService: CustodyPolicyService,\n    private readonly auditService: CustodyAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async observeConfirmation(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    transactionId: string;\n    blockHash?: string | null;\n    blockNumber?: string | null;\n    confirmationCount: number;\n    requiredConfirmationCount: number;\n    providerReference?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, transactionId, blockHash = null, blockNumber = null, confirmationCount, requiredConfirmationCount, providerReference = null } = params;\n\n    // Never invent confirmation counts — must be provider-derived, validated above\n    if (confirmationCount < 0) throw new BadRequestException('Invalid confirmation count');\n\n    const tx = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { id: transactionId, tenantId } });\n    if (!tx) throw new BadRequestException('Transaction not found');\n\n    // Determine confirmation state based on counts and finality\n    let state: CustodyConfirmationState;\n    if (confirmationCount === 0) {\n      state = CustodyConfirmationState.OBSERVED;\n    } else if (confirmationCount < requiredConfirmationCount) {\n      state = CustodyConfirmationState.REQUIRED;\n    } else if (confirmationCount >= requiredConfirmationCount && confirmationCount < requiredConfirmationCount * 2) {\n      state = CustodyConfirmationState.CONFIRMED;\n    } else {\n      state = CustodyConfirmationState.FINAL;\n    }\n\n    // Check if transaction was reorged — if blockHash changed, mark as REORGED\n    if (tx.blockHash && blockHash && tx.blockHash !== blockHash && tx.status === 'CONFIRMED') {\n      state = CustodyConfirmationState.REORGED;\n    }\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `confirmation:${transactionId}:${confirmationCount}`,\n      tenantId,\n      walletId: tx.walletId ?? undefined,\n      assetId: tx.assetId,\n      networkId: tx.networkId,\n      externalRef: `${blockHash ?? ''}:${blockNumber ?? ''}:${confirmationCount}`,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransactionConfirmation.findFirst({ where: { transactionId, confirmationCount } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    } catch {}\n\n    const confirmation = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransactionConfirmation.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        transactionId,\n        blockHash: blockHash ?? null,\n        blockNumber: blockNumber ?? null,\n        confirmationCount,\n        requiredConfirmationCount,\n        state: state as any,\n        isFinal: state === CustodyConfirmationState.FINAL,\n        providerReference: providerReference ?? null,\n        observedAt: new Date(),\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Update transaction confirmation count and status if needed\n    try {\n      let newTxStatus: CustodyTransactionState | null = null;\n      if (state === CustodyConfirmationState.CONFIRMED && tx.status !== 'CONFIRMED' && tx.status !== 'FINAL') {\n        newTxStatus = CustodyTransactionState.CONFIRMED as any;\n      } else if (state === CustodyConfirmationState.FINAL && tx.status !== 'FINAL') {\n        newTxStatus = CustodyTransactionState.FINAL as any;\n      } else if (state === CustodyConfirmationState.REORGED) {\n        newTxStatus = CustodyTransactionState.REORGED as any;\n      }\n\n      if (newTxStatus) {\n        await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.update({\n          where: { id: transactionId },\n          data: {\n            status: newTxStatus as any,\n            confirmationCount,\n            blockHash: blockHash ?? tx.blockHash,\n            blockNumber: blockNumber ?? tx.blockNumber,\n            ...(newTxStatus === 'CONFIRMED' ? { confirmedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n            ...(newTxStatus === 'FINAL' ? { confirmedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n          },\n        });\n\n        await this.auditService.log({\n          tenantId,\n          walletId: tx.walletId,\n          action: `TRANSACTION_${newTxStatus}` as any,\n          entityType: 'CUSTODY_TRANSACTION',\n          entityId: transactionId,\n          evidence: { confirmationCount, requiredConfirmationCount, blockHash, blockNumber, state },\n        });\n      } else {\n        await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.update({\n          where: { id: transactionId },\n          data: { confirmationCount, blockHash: blockHash ?? tx.blockHash, blockNumber: blockNumber ?? tx.blockNumber },\n        });\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    return confirmation;\n  }\n\n  async getConfirmations(params: { tenantId: string; transactionId: string }): Promise<any[]> {\n    return await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransactionConfirmation.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, transactionId: params.transactionId },\n      orderBy: { confirmationCount: 'asc' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async isTransactionConfirmed(params: { tenantId: string; transactionId: string }): Promise<{ confirmed: boolean; final: boolean; confirmationCount: number; requiredCount: number }> {\n    try {\n      const tx = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { id: params.transactionId, tenantId: params.tenantId } });\n      if (!tx) return { confirmed: false, final: false, confirmationCount: 0, requiredCount: 0 };\n      const confirmed = ['CONFIRMED', 'FINAL'].includes(tx.status);\n      const final = tx.status === 'FINAL';\n      return { confirmed, final, confirmationCount: tx.confirmationCount ?? 0, requiredCount: tx.requiredConfirmationCount ?? 6 };\n    } catch {\n      return { confirmed: false, final: false, confirmationCount: 0, requiredCount: 0 };\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/custody-adapter.contract.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Secrets and PII must be redacted and access must be audited.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class CustodyAuditService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(CustodyAuditService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async log(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    walletId?: string | null;\n    action: CustodyAuditAction;\n    entityType: string;\n    entityId: string;\n    actorId?: string | null;\n    fromState?: string | null;\n    toState?: string | null;\n    reason?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    evidence?: any;\n    metadata?: any;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, walletId = null, action, entityType, entityId, actorId = null, fromState = null, toState = null, reason = null, correlationId = null, evidence = {}, metadata = {} } = params;\n\n    // Privileged actions must be audited — secrets and PII must be redacted\n    const redactedEvidence = redactSecrets(evidence);\n    const redactedMetadata = redactSecrets(metadata);\n\n    try {\n      const audit = await (this.prisma as any).custodyAudit.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId,\n          walletId: walletId ?? null,\n          action: action as any,\n          entityType,\n          entityId,\n          actorId: actorId ?? null,\n          fromState: fromState ?? null,\n          toState: toState ?? null,\n          reason: reason ?? null,\n          correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n          evidence: redactedEvidence as any,\n          metadata: redactedMetadata as any,\n        },\n      });\n\n      this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.audit.logged', tenantId, action, entityType, entityId, actorId });\n\n      return audit;\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to create custody audit: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async listAudits(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    walletId?: string;\n    entityType?: string;\n    entityId?: string;\n    action?: string;\n    actorId?: string;\n    fromDate?: Date;\n    toDate?: Date;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, walletId, entityType, entityId, action, actorId, fromDate, toDate, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (walletId) where.walletId = walletId;\n    if (entityType) where.entityType = entityType;\n    if (entityId) where.entityId = entityId;\n    if (action) where.action = action;\n    if (actorId) where.actorId = actorId;\n    if (fromDate || toDate) {\n      where.createdAt = {};\n      if (fromDate) where.createdAt.gte = fromDate;\n      if (toDate) where.createdAt.lte = toDate;\n    }\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyAudit.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyAudit.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n\n  async exportAudits(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    fromDate: Date;\n    toDate: Date;\n    format?: 'json' | 'csv';\n  }): Promise<{ exportedAt: string; count: number; format: string; data: any[] }> {\n    const { tenantId, fromDate, toDate, format = 'json' } = params;\n\n    // Deterministic export — same inputs produce identical output\n    const where: any = { tenantId, createdAt: { gte: fromDate, lte: toDate } };\n\n    let data: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      data = await (this.prisma as any).custodyAudit.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' }, take: 10000 });\n    } catch {\n      data = [];\n    }\n\n    // Ensure deterministic ordering and redaction\n    const sorted = data.sort((a: any, b: any) => new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime());\n\n    return {\n      exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      count: sorted.length,\n      format,\n      data: sorted.map((audit: any) => ({\n        id: audit.id,\n        tenantId: audit.tenantId,\n        walletId: audit.walletId,\n        action: audit.action,\n        entityType: audit.entityType,\n        entityId: audit.entityId,\n        actorId: audit.actorId,\n        fromState: audit.fromState,\n        toState: audit.toState,\n        reason: audit.reason,\n }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/custody-authorization.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/custody-fail-closed.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/custody-policy.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/custody-reconciliation-persistence.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected jest.spyOn(Logger.prototype, 'log').mockImplementation(() => undefined);\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => jest.restoreAllMocks());\n\n  function build(create: jest.Mock) {\n    const prisma = {\n      custodyWallet: { findMany: jest.fn(async () => [{ id: 'wallet-1', tenantId: TENANT, networkId: 'ethereum', assetId: 'USDT' }]) },\n      custodyReconciliation: { findFirst: jest.fn(async () => null), it('marks a finding that could not be stored as not persisted and logs the error code only', async () => {\n    const { service, auditService } = build(\n      jest.fn(async () => {\n        throw });\n\n    expect(findings).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(findings[0]).toMatchObject({ id: null, persisted: false, type: 'WALLET_WITHOUT_PROVIDER_RECORD', walletId: 'wallet-1' });\n    expect(auditService.log).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(errorSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({ event: 'custody.reconciliation.finding_persist_failed', tenantId: TENANT, expect(errorSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n});\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/custody-reconciliation-read-failures.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected id: 'wallet-1', tenantId: TENANT, networkId: 'ethereum', assetId: 'USDT' };\n\n  function build(overrides: Record<string, any> = {}) {\n    const ok = jest.fn(async () => []);\n    const prisma: any = {\n      custodyWallet: { findMany: jest.fn(async () => [wallet]) },\n      custodyWalletAddress: { findMany: ok },\n      custodyDeposit: { findMany: ok, findFirst: jest.fn(async () => null) },\n      custodyTransaction: { findMany: ok, findFirst: jest.fn(async () => null) },\n      custodyWithdrawal: { findMany: ok },\n      custodyReconciliation: {\n        findFirst: jest.fn(async () => null),\n        create: jest.fn(async ({ data }: any) => ({ id: 'rec-1', createdAt: new Date(), ...data })),\n        findMany: jest.fn(async () => []),\n        count: jest.fn(async () => 0),\n      },\n      ...overrides,\n    };\n    const providerFactory = { getProviderForNetwork: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'internal-ledger' })) };\n    const auditService = { log: jest.fn(async () => undefined) };\n    return new CustodyReconciliationService(prisma, providerFactory as any, auditService as any);\n  }\n\n  it('a clean run is complete with no read failures', async () => {\n    const report = await build().runReconciliationReport({ tenantId: TENANT });\n\n    expect(report).toMatchObject({ findings: [], walletsChecked: 1, readFailures: [], unpersistedCount: 0, complete: true });\n    expect(errorSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('reports each failed check read, marks the run incomplete and logs the error code only', async () => {\n    const fail = jest.fn(async () => {\n      throw readFailure();\n    });\n    const service = build({\n      custodyDeposit: { findMany: fail, findFirst: fail },\n      custodyWithdrawal: { findMany: fail },\n    });\n\n    const report = await service.runReconciliationReport({ tenantId: TENANT });\n\n    expect(report.complete).toBe(false);\n    expect(report.readFailures).toEqual([\n      { check: 'deposits', walletId: 'wallet-1', error: 'P1017' },\n      { check: 'withdrawals', walletId: 'wallet-1', error: 'P1017' },\n    ]);\n    expect(errorSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({ event: 'custody.reconciliation.check_read_failed', tenantId: TENANT, check: 'deposits', error: 'P1017' }),\n    );\n    expect(warnSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({ event: 'custody.reconciliation.completed', readFailures: 2, complete: false }),\n    );\n    expect(JSON.stringify([...errorSpy.mock.calls, ...warnSpy.mock.calls])).not.toContain(SECRET_LOOKING_VALUE);\n  });\n\n  it('a failed wallet list read is an incomplete run, not an empty clean one', async () => {\n    const service = build({\n      custodyWallet: {\n        findMany: jest.fn(async () => {\n          throw readFailure();\n        }),\n      },\n    });\n\n    const report = await service.runReconciliationReport({ tenantId: TENANT });\n\n    expect(report).toMatchObject({ findings: [], walletsChecked: 0, complete: false });\n    expect(report.readFailures).toEqual([{ check: 'wallets', walletId: null, error: 'P1017' }]);\n  });\n\n  it('runReconciliation keeps returning the findings array (API shape unchanged)', async () => {\n    const findings = await build().runReconciliation({ tenantId: TENANT });\n    expect(Array.isArray(findings)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('listFindings propagates a read failure instead of answering with an empty page', async () => {\n    const service = build({\n      custodyReconciliation: {\n        findMany: jest.fn(async () => {\n          throw
