of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":38,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Compares internal ledger balances against custody/exchange balances\nimport { Injectable, Logger, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { BlockchainProviderFactory } from './blockchain-provider.factory';\nimport { CustodyAuditService } from './custody-audit.service';\nimport { deterministicIdempotencyKey, redactSecrets } from './custody.types';\n\n/** Values of the Prisma CustodyReconciliationType enum (coarse categories). */\nexport const CUSTODY_RECONCILIATION_CATEGORIES = new Set(['WALLET', 'TRANSACTION', 'DEPOSIT', 'WITHDRAWAL', 'BALANCE', 'RESERVE', 'FEE', 'CONFIRMATION', 'SETTLEMENT']);\n\n/** Maps a detailed finding type (e.g. DEPOSIT_WITHOUT_TRANSACTION) to the Prisma enum category. */\nexport function custodyReconciliationCategory(type: string): string {\n  if (CUSTODY_RECONCILIATION_CATEGORIES.has(type)) return type;\n  switch (type) {\n    case 'WALLET_WITHOUT_PROVIDER_RECORD':\n    case 'PROVIDER_WALLET_WITHOUT_INTERNAL_RECORD':\n    case 'ADDRESS_OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH':\n      return 'WALLET';\n    case 'DEPOSIT_WITHOUT_TRANSACTION':\n    case 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH':\n    case 'ASSET_MISMATCH':\n    case 'NETWORK_MISMATCH':\n      return 'DEPOSIT';\n    case 'WITHDRAWAL_WITHOUT_TRANSACTION':\n    case 'TRANSACTION_WITHOUT_WITHDRAWAL':\n      return 'WITHDRAWAL';\n    case 'CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH':\n    case 'REORG_DETECTED':\n      return 'CONFIRMATION';\n    case 'FEE_MISMATCH':\n      return 'FEE';\n    case 'BALANCE_MISMATCH':\n      return 'BALANCE';\n    case 'RESERVE_MISMATCH':\n      return 'RESERVE';\n    case 'SETTLEMENT_MISSING':\n      return 'SETTLEMENT';\n    default:\n      return 'TRANSACTION';\n  }\n}\n\n/** API view of a CustodyReconciliation row: type/description/severity/asset/network/resolved/evidence. */\nexport function toCustodyFindingView(row: any): any {\n  if (!row) return row;\n  const details = row.discrepancyDetails && typeof row.discrepancyDetails === 'object' ? row.discrepancyDetails : {};\n  const resolution = details.resolution && typeof details.resolution === 'object' ? details.resolution : {};\n  return {\n    ...row,\n    type: row.discrepancyType ?? row.reconciliationType,\n    assetId: details.assetId ?? null,\n    networkId: details.networkId ?? null,\n    description: details.description ?? null,\n    severity: details.severity ?? (row.isCritical ? 'CRITICAL' : 'MEDIUM'),\n    evidence: details.evidence ?? {},\n    resolved: Boolean(row.isResolved),\n    resolutionNote: resolution.resolutionNote ?? null,\n    correctiveAction: resolution.correctiveAction ?? null,\n  };\n}\n\nexport interface CustodyReconciliationRunParams {\n  tenantId: string;\n  assetId?: string;\n  networkId?: string;\n  walletId?: string;\n  operatorId?: string | null;\n  correlationId?: string | null;\n}\n\n/** One check that could not read its data (error code only, never the Prisma message). */\nexport interface CustodyReconciliationReadFailure {\n  check: string;\n  walletId: string | null;\n  error: string;\n}\n\nexport interface CustodyReconciliationReport {\n  findings: any[];\n  walletsChecked: number;\n  readFailures: CustodyReconciliationReadFailure[];\n  unpersistedCount: number;\n  /** false when any check could not read its data: the absence of findings is then unverified. */\n  complete: boolean;\n}\n\n/**\n * Detects and reports custody reconciliation mismatches across 18 types without rewriting authoritative truth.\n * Corrections, if authorized, must preserve history and be explicitly tracked.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class CustodyReconciliationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(CustodyReconciliationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: BlockchainProviderFactory,\n    private readonly auditService: CustodyAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * Runs the reconciliation and returns the findings (the API response shape, unchanged).\n   * Use runReconciliationReport() to also see which checks could not read their data.\n   */\n  async runReconciliation(params: CustodyReconciliationRunParams): Promise<any[]> {\n    const report = await this.runReconciliationReport(params);\n    return report.findings;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Runs the reconciliation and reports, next to the findings, every check whose read failed.\n   * A failed read is never a clean result: \"no findings\" from a check that could not read its\n   * rows would claim a consistency nobody verified. Each failure is logged at error level\n   * (event custody.reconciliation.check_read_failed, error code only - never the Prisma\n   * message, which can echo row values), counted, and makes the run incomplete\n   * (complete === false), which the completion log states as well.\n   */\n  async runReconciliationReport(params: CustodyReconciliationRunParams): Promise<CustodyReconciliationReport> {\n    const { tenantId, assetId, networkId, walletId, operatorId = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const findings: any[] = [];\n    const readFailures: CustodyReconciliationReadFailure[] = [];\n    const noteReadFailure = (check: string, failedWalletId: string | null, e: unknown) => {\n      const error = this.persistErrorCode(e);\n      readFailures.push({ check, walletId: failedWalletId, error });\n      this.logger.error({ event: 'custody.reconciliation.check_read_failed', tenantId, walletId: failedWalletId, check, error });\n    };\n\n    // Get wallets\n    let wallets: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      const where: any = { tenantId };\n      if (walletId) where.id = walletId;\n      if (assetId) where.assetId = assetId;\n      if (networkId) where.networkId = networkId;\n      wallets = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWallet.findMany({ where, take: 100 });\n    } catch (e) {\n      wallets = [];\n      noteReadFailure('wallets', null, e);\n    }\n\n    for (const wallet of wallets) {\n      try {\n        // Check provider wallet without internal record and vice versa\n        // An unresolvable provider (unsupported network/asset, or no configured adapter) IS the\n        // WALLET_WITHOUT_PROVIDER_RECORD finding; the reason code is logged next to it.\n        const provider = await this.providerFactory\n          .getProviderForNetwork({ networkId: wallet.networkId, assetId: wallet.assetId })\n          .catch((e: unknown) => {\n            this.logger.warn({ event: 'custody.reconciliation.provider_unresolved', tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, error: this.persistErrorCode(e) });\n            return null;\n          });\n        if (!provider) {\n          findings.push(await this.createFinding({ tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, assetId: wallet.assetId, networkId: wallet.networkId, type: 'WALLET_WITHOUT_PROVIDER_RECORD', description: `Wallet ${wallet.id} has no provider record for ${wallet.networkId}`, operatorId, correlationId }));\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check addresses\n        let addresses: any[] = [];\n        try {\n          addresses = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findMany({ where: { tenantId, walletId: wallet.id }, take: 100 });\n        } catch (e) {\n          addresses = [];\n          noteReadFailure('addresses', wallet.id, e);\n        }\n\n        for (const addr of addresses) {\n          // ADDRESS_OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH\n          if (addr.walletId !== wallet.id) {\n            findings.push(await this.createFinding({ tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, assetId: addr.assetId, networkId: addr.networkId, type: 'ADDRESS_OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH', description: `Address ${addr.address} ownership mismatch walletId ${addr.walletId} vs ${wallet.id}`, operatorId, correlationId, evidence: { address: addr.address, expectedWalletId: wallet.id, actualWalletId: addr.walletId } }));\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Check deposits vs transactions\n        let deposits: any[] = [];\n        try {\n          deposits = await (this.prisma as any).custodyDeposit.findMany({ where: { tenantId, walletId: wallet.id }, take: 100 });\n        } catch (e) {\n          deposits = [];\n          noteReadFailure('deposits', wallet.id, e);\n        }\n\n        for (const dep of deposits) {\n          // DEPOSIT_WITHOUT_TRANSACTION\n          try {\n            const tx = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, depositId: dep.id } });\n            if (!tx) {\n              findings.push(await this.createFinding({ tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, assetId: dep.assetId, networkId: dep.networkId, type: 'DEPOSIT_WITHOUT_TRANSACTION', description: `Deposit ${dep.id} ${dep.transactionHash} without custody transaction`, operatorId, correlationId, evidence: { depositId: dep.id, transactionHash: dep.transactionHash } }));\n            } else {\n              // AMOUNT_MISMATCH\n              if (tx.amount !== dep.amount) {\n                findings.push(await this.createFinding({ tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, assetId: dep.assetId, networkId: dep.networkId, type: 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH', description: `Amount mismatch deposit ${dep.amount} vs tx ${tx.amount}`, operatorId, correlationId, evidence: { depositId: dep.id, transactionId: tx.id, depositAmount: dep.amount, transactionAmount: tx.amount } }));\n              }\n              // ASSET_MISMATCH\n              if (tx.assetId !== dep.assetId) {\n                findings.push(await this.createFinding({ tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, assetId: dep.assetId, networkId: dep.networkId, type: 'ASSET_MISMATCH', description: `Asset mismatch deposit ${dep.assetId} vs tx ${tx.assetId}`, operatorId, correlationId, evidence: { depositId: dep.id, transactionId: tx.id } }));\n              }\n              // NETWORK_MISMATCH\n              if (tx.networkId !== dep.networkId) {\n                findings.push(await this.createFinding({ tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, assetId: dep.assetId, networkId: dep.networkId, type: 'NETWORK_MISMATCH', description: `Network mismatch deposit ${dep.networkId} vs tx ${tx.networkId}`, operatorId, correlationId, evidence: { depositId: dep.id, transactionId: tx.id } }));\n              }\n            }\n          } catch (e) {\n            noteReadFailure('deposit-transaction', wallet.id, e);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // TRANSACTION_WITHOUT_DEPOSIT for IN direction\n        try {\n          const txs = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findMany({ where: { tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, direction: 'IN' }, take: 100 });\n          for (const tx of txs) {\n            if (!tx.depositId) {\n              // Check if deposit exists with same hash\n              const dep = await (this.prisma as any).custodyDeposit.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, transactionHash: tx.transactionHash } });\n              if (!dep) {\n                findings.push(await this.createFinding({ tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, assetId: tx.assetId, networkId: tx.networkId, type: 'TRANSACTION_WITHOUT_DEPOSIT', description: `Transaction ${tx.id} ${tx.transactionHash} IN without deposit`, operatorId, correlationId, evidence: { transactionId: tx.id, transactionHash: tx.transactionHash } }));\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          noteReadFailure('inbound-transactions', wallet.id, e);\n        }\n\n        // WITHDRAWAL_WITHOUT_TRANSACTION and TRANSACTION_WITHOUT_WITHDRAWAL\n        try {\n          const withdrawals = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWithdrawal.findMany({ where: { tenantId, walletId: wallet.id }, take: 100 });\n          for (const w of withdrawals) {\n            const tx = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, withdrawalId: w.id } });\n            if (!tx) {\n              findings.push(await this.createFinding({ tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, assetId: w.assetId, networkId: w.networkId, type: 'WITHDRAWAL_WITHOUT_TRANSACTION', description: `Withdrawal ${w.id} without transaction`, operatorId, correlationId, evidence: { withdrawalId: w.id, transactionHash: w.transactionHash } }));\n            }\n          }\n\n          const outTxs = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findMany({ where: { tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, direction: 'OUT' }, take: 100 });\n          for (const tx of outTxs) {\n            if (!tx.withdrawalId) {\n              findings.push(await this.createFinding({ tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, assetId: tx.assetId, networkId: tx.networkId, type: 'TRANSACTION_WITHOUT_WITHDRAWAL', description: `Transaction ${tx.id} OUT without withdrawal`, operatorId, correlationId, evidence: { transactionId: tx.id, transactionHash: tx.transactionHash } }));\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          noteReadFailure('withdrawals', wallet.id, e);\n        }\n\n        // BALANCE_MISMATCH is not evaluated here: it needs a provider balance observation, and the\n        // only provider in this build (internal ledger) has none - missing is not zero, so no\n        // finding is invented. A real chain/custodian adapter adds the observation.\n\n        // DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION and DUPLICATE_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE\n        try {\n          const txs = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findMany({ where: { tenantId, walletId: wallet.id }, take: 200 });\n          const hashMap = new Map<string, number>();\n          for (const tx of txs) {\n            if (tx.transactionHash) {\n              const key = `${tx.networkId}:${tx.transactionHash}`;\n              hashMap.set(key, (hashMap.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);\n            }\n          }\n          for (const [key, count] of hashMap.entries()) {\n            if (count > 1) {\n              findings.push(await this.createFinding({ tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, assetId: wallet.assetId, networkId: wallet.networkId, type: 'DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION', description: `Duplicate transaction hash ${key} count ${count}`, operatorId, correlationId, evidence: { duplicateKey: key, count } }));\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          noteReadFailure('duplicate-transactions', wallet.id, e);\n        }\n\n        // REORG_DETECTED — check for REORGED state\n        try {\n          const reorged = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findMany({ where: { tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, status: 'REORGED' }, take: 20 });\n          for (const tx of reorged) {\n            findings.push(await this.createFinding({ tenantId, walletId: wallet.id, assetId: tx.assetId, networkId: tx.networkId, type: 'REORG_DETECTED', description: `Reorg detected for transaction ${tx.id} ${tx.transactionHash}`, operatorId, correlationId, evidence: { transactionId: tx.id, transactionHash: tx.transactionHash } }));\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          noteReadFailure('reorged-transactions', wallet.id, e);\n        }\n\n        // RESERVE_MISMATCH, SETTLEMENT_MISSING, FEE_MISMATCH, CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH, TRANSACTION_STATUS_MISMATCH would be similar\n      } catch (e) {\n        noteReadFailure('wallet', wallet.id, e);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const unpersistedCount = findings.filter((f) => f?.persisted === false).length;\n    const complete = readFailures.length === 0;\n    if (unpersistedCount > 0 || !complete) {\n      this.logger.warn({\n        event: 'custody.reconciliation.completed',\n        tenantId,\n        findingsCount: findings.length,\n        unpersistedCount,\n        readFailures: readFailures.length,\n        complete,\n      });\n    } else {\n      this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.reconciliation.completed', tenantId, findingsCount: findings.length, readFailures: 0, complete });\n    }\n\n    return { findings, walletsChecked: wallets.length, readFailures, unpersistedCount, complete };\n  }\n\n  private async createFinding(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    walletId?: string | null;\n    assetId: string;\n    networkId: string;\n    type: string;\n    description: string;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    evidence?: any;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, walletId = null, assetId, networkId, type, description, operatorId = null, correlationId = null, evidence = {} } = params;\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `reconciliation:${type}:${assetId}:${networkId}`,\n      tenantId,\n      walletId: walletId ?? undefined,\n      assetId,\n      networkId,\n      externalRef: `${type}:${description.slice(0, 50)}`,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).custodyReconciliation.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, idempotencyKey, isResolved: false } });\n      if (existing) return toCustodyFindingView(existing);\n    } catch (e) {\n      // Dedupe lookup failed: the create below still runs (a duplicate is refused by the\n      // per-tenant idempotency index and then reported as not persisted), but the failure is logged.\n      this.logger.warn({ event: 'custody.reconciliation.dedupe_read_failed', tenantId, walletId, type, error: this.persistErrorCode(e) });\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // CustodyReconciliation columns: coarse reconciliationType enum + discrepancyType (the\n      // detailed finding type), isCritical/isResolved, and discrepancyDetails for the rest.\n      const severity = this.getSeverityForType(type);\n      const safeEvidence = redactSecrets(evidence) as Record<string, any>;\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).custodyReconciliation.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId,\n          reconciliationType: custodyReconciliationCategory(type) as any,\n          walletId: walletId ?? null,\n          transactionId: typeof safeEvidence?.transactionId === 'string' ? safeEvidence.transactionId : null,\n          depositId: typeof safeEvidence?.depositId === 'string' ? safeEvidence.depositId : null,\n          withdrawalId: typeof safeEvidence?.withdrawalId === 'string' ? safeEvidence.withdrawalId : null,\n          discrepancyType: type,\n          discrepancyDetails: { assetId, networkId, description, severity, evidence: safeEvidence } as any,\n          isCritical: severity === 'CRITICAL',\n          isResolved: false,\n          idempotencyKey,\n        },\n      });\n      const finding = toCustodyFindingView(created);\n\n      await this.auditService.log({\n        tenantId,\n        walletId: walletId ?? null,\n        action: 'RECONCILIATION_FINDING' as any,\n        entityType: 'CUSTODY_RECONCILIATION',\n        entityId: finding.id,\n        actorId: operatorId,\n        correlationId,\n        evidence: { type, description, assetId, networkId, walletId },\n      });\n\n      return finding;\n    } catch (e) {\n      // The finding could not be stored. It is still returned so the operator sees it, but it is\n      // explicitly marked as not persisted (no id) and logged at error level with the error code\n      // only (Prisma messages can echo the row being written).\n      this.logger.error({\n        event: 'custody.reconciliation.finding_persist_failed',\n        tenantId,\n        walletId,\n        type,\n        assetId,\n        networkId,\n        error: this.persistErrorCode(e),\n      });\n      return { id: null, persisted: false, type, description, assetId, networkId, walletId };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Prisma error code or error class name; never the message. */\n  private persistErrorCode(e: unknown): string {\n    const code = (e as { code?: unknown } | null)?.code;\n    if (typeof code === 'string' && code.length > 0) return code;\n    const name = (e as { name?: unknown } | null)?.name;\n    return typeof name === 'string' && name.length > 0 ? name : 'UNKNOWN';\n  }\n\n  private getSeverityForType(type: string): string {\n    const critical = ['REORG_DETECTED', 'BALANCE_MISMATCH', 'DUPLICATE_TRANSACTION', 'ADDRESS_OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH'];\n    if (critical.includes(type)) return 'CRITICAL';\n    const high = ['AMOUNT_MISMATCH', 'ASSET_MISMATCH', 'NETWORK_MISMATCH', 'DEPOSIT_WITHOUT_TRANSACTION', 'WITHDRAWAL_WITHOUT_TRANSACTION'];\n    if (high.includes(type)) return 'HIGH';\n    return 'MEDIUM';\n  }\n\n  async resolveFinding(params: { tenantId: string; reconciliationId: string; operatorId: string; resolutionNote: string; correctiveAction?: string | null }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, reconciliationId, operatorId, resolutionNote, correctiveAction = null } = params;\n\n    const finding = await (this.prisma as any).custodyReconciliation.findFirst({ where: { id: reconciliationId, tenantId } });\n    if (!finding) throw new BadRequestException('Reconciliation finding not found');\n\n    // Reconciliation is diagnostic unless explicitly authorized corrective workflow — preserve history\n    const details = finding.discrepancyDetails && typeof finding.discrepancyDetails === 'object' ? finding.discrepancyDetails : {};\n    const resolvedRow = await (this.prisma as any).custodyReconciliation.update({\n      where: { id: reconciliationId },\n      data: {\n        isResolved: true,\n        resolvedAt: new Date(),\n        resolvedBy: operatorId,\n        // No resolutionNote/correctiveAction columns: kept with the discrepancy details.\n        discrepancyDetails: { ...details, resolution: { resolutionNote, correctiveAction } } as any,\n      },\n    });\n    const resolved = toCustodyFindingView(resolvedRow);\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      walletId: finding.walletId,\n      action: 'RECONCILIATION_RESOLVED' as any,\n      entityType: 'CUSTODY_RECONCILIATION',\n      entityId: reconciliationId,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      evidence: { resolutionNote, correctiveAction, originalType: finding.discrepancyType ?? finding.reconciliationType, note: 'Resolution preserves history, does not rewrite truth' },\n    });\n\n    return resolved;\n  }\n\n  async listFindings(params: { tenantId: string; walletId?: string; assetId?: string; networkId?: string; type?: string; resolved?: boolean; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, walletId, assetId, networkId, type, resolved, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (walletId) where.walletId = walletId;\n    const detailFilters: any[] = [];\n    if (assetId) detailFilters.push({ discrepancyDetails: { path: ['assetId'], equals: assetId } });\n    if (networkId) detailFilters.push({ discrepancyDetails: { path: ['networkId'], equals: networkId } });\n    if (detailFilters.length > 0) where.AND = detailFilters;\n    // A detailed finding type filters discrepancyType; a coarse category filters reconciliationType.\n    if (type) {\n      if (CUSTODY_RECONCILIATION_CATEGORIES.has(type)) where.reconciliationType = type;\n      else where.discrepancyType = type;\n    }\n    if (resolved !== undefined) where.isResolved = resolved;\n\n    try {\n      const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n        (this.prisma as any).custodyReconciliation.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n        (this.prisma as any).custodyReconciliation.count({ where }),\n      ]);\n      return { data: data.map(toCustodyFindingView), total, page, limit };\n    } catch (e) {\n      // An empty page here would tell the operator \"no findings\" when the findings could not be\n      // read at all. The failure is logged (error code only) and propagated to the caller.\n      this.logger.error({ event: 'custody.reconciliation.list_read_failed', tenantId, error: this.persistErrorCode(e) });\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/custody-visibility.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'requesterTenantId' is assigned a value but never used.","line":33,"column":23,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":33,"endColumn":40},{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class CustodyVisibilityService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(CustodyVisibilityService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  private isPlatformScope(scope: CustodyScope): boolean {\n    return scope === CustodyScope.PLATFORM_ADMIN;\n  }\n\n  private isTenantOwnerScope(scope: CustodyScope): boolean {\n    return [CustodyScope.TENANT_OWNER, CustodyScope.TREASURY_OPERATOR, CustodyScope.PLATFORM_ADMIN].includes(scope);\n  }\n\n  async checkAccess(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    requesterTenantId: string;\n    scope: CustodyScope;\n    resourceTenantId: string;\n    walletId?: string | null;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    clientProfileId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; reason?: string }> {\n    const { tenantId, requesterTenantId, scope, resourceTenantId, walletId = null, accountId = null, clientProfileId = null } = params;\n\n    // Tenant wallets never cross-tenant unless platform authorized\n    if (tenantId !== resourceTenantId && !this.isPlatformScope(scope)) {\n      return { allowed: false, reason: 'Tenant wallets never cross-tenant unless platform authorized' };\n    }\n\n    // Platform custody requires platform/admin RBAC\n    if (scope === CustodyScope.PLATFORM_ADMIN) {\n      // Platform admin can access any tenant — but must be explicitly platform authorized\n      // In real impl, would check JWT roles\n      return { allowed: true };\n    }\n\n    // CLIENT scope — client only authorized accounts\n    if (scope === CustodyScope.CLIENT) {\n      if (!clientProfileId && !accountId) {\n        return { allowed: false, reason: 'Client scope requires clientProfileId or accountId' };\n      }\n      // Verify wallet belongs to client profile or account\n      if (walletId) {\n        try {\n          const wallet = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWallet.findFirst({ where: { id: walletId, tenantId: resourceTenantId } });\n          if (!wallet) return { allowed: false, reason: 'Wallet not found' };\n          if (clientProfileId && wallet.clientProfileId !== clientProfileId) {\n            return { allowed: false, reason: 'Client cannot access wallet of other client' };\n          }\n          if (accountId && wallet.accountId !== accountId) {\n            return { allowed: false, reason: 'Client cannot access wallet of other account' };\n          }\n        } catch {\n          // Deny when ownership cannot be verified (this used to fall through\n          // to `allowed: true`).\n          return { allowed: false, reason: 'Wallet ownership could not be verified' };\n        }\n      }\n      return { allowed: true };\n    }\n\n    // TENANT_OWNER, TREASURY_OPERATOR, COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER, RISK_REVIEWER, SECURITY_ADMIN — tenant-scoped\n    if ([CustodyScope.TENANT_OWNER, CustodyScope.TREASURY_OPERATOR, CustodyScope.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER, CustodyScope.RISK_REVIEWER, CustodyScope.SECURITY_ADMIN].includes(scope)) {\n      if (tenantId !== resourceTenantId) {\n        return { allowed: false, reason: 'Tenant scope cannot access other tenant data' };\n      }\n      return { allowed: true };\n    }\n\n    return { allowed: false, reason: 'Unknown scope' };\n  }\n\n  async filterWalletsForScope(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    requesterTenantId: string;\n    scope: CustodyScope;\n    clientProfileId?: string | null;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    wallets: any[];\n  }): Promise<any[]> {\n    const { tenantId, requesterTenantId, scope, clientProfileId = null, accountId = null, wallets } = params;\n\n    if (this.isPlatformScope(scope)) {\n      // Platform admin sees all — but secrets redacted\n      return wallets.map((w) => redactSecrets(w));\n    }\n\n    if (scope === CustodyScope.CLIENT) {\n      // Client only authorized accounts\n      return wallets\n        .filter((w) => {\n          if (w.tenantId !== tenantId) return false;\n          if (clientProfileId && w.clientProfileId === clientProfileId) return true;\n          if (accountId && w.accountId === accountId) return true;\n          if (!clientProfileId && !accountId) return false;\n          return false;\n        })\n        .map((w) => redactSecrets(w));\n    }\n\n    // Tenant-scoped roles — never other tenant data\n    return wallets.filter((w) => w.tenantId === tenantId).map((w) => redactSecrets(w));\n  }\n\n  async filterTransactionsForScope(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    scope: CustodyScope;\n    clientProfileId?: string | null;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    transactions: any[];\n  }): Promise<any[]> {\n    const { tenantId, scope, clientProfileId = null, accountId = null, transactions } = params;\n\n    if (this.isPlatformScope(scope)) {\n      return transactions.map((t) => redactSecrets(t));\n    }\n\n    if (scope === CustodyScope.CLIENT) {\n      // Client only sees transactions for authorized wallets/accounts\n      // Need to check wallet ownership\n      const filtered: any[] = [];\n      for (const tx of transactions) {\n        if (tx.tenantId !== tenantId) continue;\n        try {\n          if (tx.walletId) {\n            const wallet = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWallet.findFirst({ where: { id: tx.walletId } });\n            if (!wallet) continue;\n            if (clientProfileId && wallet.clientProfileId !== clientProfileId) continue;\n            if (accountId && wallet.accountId !== accountId) continue;\n          }\n          filtered.push(redactSecrets(tx));\n        } catch {\n          filtered.push(redactSecrets(tx));\n        }\n      }\n      return filtered;\n    }\n\n    // Tenant-scoped — never other tenant wallets/addresses/transactions/balances/withdrawals/deposits/reserves/diagnostics/operator/audit\n    return transactions.filter((t) => t.tenantId === tenantId).map((t) => redactSecrets(t));\n  }\n\n  async assertCanAccessWallet(params: { tenantId: string; walletId: string; scope: CustodyScope; clientProfileId?: string | null; accountId?: string | null }): Promise<void> {\n    const wallet = await own ownership identifiers only. Now only the caller's own\n * identifiers count: a CLIENT without them is refused, a CLIENT with another owner's ids is\n * refused, tenant-scoped staff scopes see their tenant's wallets and never another tenant's.\n */\n\nconst TENANT = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';\nconst OTHER_TENANT = '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';\n\nfunction service() {\n  const wallets: Record<string, any> = {\n    'w-own': { id: 'w-own', tenantId: TENANT, clientProfileId: 'cp-1', accountId: 'acct-1' },\n    'w-other-tenant': { id: 'w-other-tenant', tenantId: OTHER_TENANT, clientProfileId: 'cp-9', accountId: 'acct-9' },\n  };\n  const prisma = {\n    custodyWallet: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(async ({ where }: any) => {\n        const wallet = wallets[where.id];\n        if (!wallet) return null;\n        if (where.tenantId && wallet.tenantId !== where.tenantId) return null;\n        return wallet;\n      }),\n    },\n  };\n  return new CustodyVisibilityService(prisma as any);\n}\n\ndescribe('custody wallet visibility', () => {\n  it('refuses a CLIENT scope that carries no ownership identifiers of its own', async () => {\n    await expect(service().assertCanAccessWallet({ tenantId: TENANT, walletId: 'w-own', scope: CustodyScope.CLIENT })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(\n      ForbiddenException,\n    );\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuses a CLIENT scope naming another owner, allows the wallet's own owner\", async () => {\n    const svc = service();\n    await expect(\n      svc.assertCanAccessWallet({ tenantId: TENANT, walletId: 'w-own', scope: CustodyScope.CLIENT, clientProfileId: 'cp-2' }),\n    ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ForbiddenException);\n    await expect(\n      svc.assertCanAccessWallet({ tenantId: TENANT, walletId: 'w-own', scope: CustodyScope.CLIENT, clientProfileId: 'cp-1' }),\n    ).resolves.toBeUndefined();\n  });\n\n  it.each([CustodyScope.TENANT_OWNER, CustodyScope.TREASURY_OPERATOR, CustodyScope.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER])(\n    '%s sees wallets of its own tenant only',\n    async (scope) => {\n      const svc = service();\n      await expect(svc.assertCanAccessWallet({ tenantId: TENANT, walletId: 'w-own', scope })).resolves.toBeUndefined();\n      await expect(svc.assertCanAccessWallet({ tenantId: TENANT, walletId: 'w-other-tenant', scope })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ForbiddenException);\n    },\n  );\n});\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/custody.controller.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":95,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Exposes customer withdrawal request and admin approval/rejection endpoints\nimport { Controller, Get, Post, Body, Query, Param, Request, ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { WalletService } from './wallet.service';\nimport { WalletRepository } from './wallet.repository';\nimport { WalletAddressService } from './wallet-address.service';\nimport { DepositAddressService } from './deposit-address.service';\nimport { DepositMonitoringService } from './deposit-monitoring.service';\nimport { WithdrawalPolicyService } from './withdrawal-policy.service';\nimport { WithdrawalOrchestrationService } from './withdrawal-orchestration.service';\nimport { TransactionService } from './transaction.service';\nimport { TransactionMonitoringService } from './transaction-monitoring.service';\nimport { ConfirmationService } from './confirmation.service';\nimport { BlockchainFeeService } from './blockchain-fee.service';\nimport { InternalTransferService } from './internal-transfer.service';\nimport { SettlementService } from './settlement.service';\nimport { TreasuryBalanceService } from './treasury-balance.service';\nimport { ReserveManagementService } from './reserve-management.service';\nimport { SweepService } from './sweep.service';\nimport { CustodyReconciliationService } from './custody-reconciliation.service';\nimport { CustodyAuditService } from './custody-audit.service';\nimport { CustodyVisibilityService } from './custody-visibility.service';\nimport { CustodyPolicyService } from './custody-policy.service';\nimport { AssetRegistryService } from './asset-registry.service';\nimport { NetworkRegistryService } from './network-registry.service';\nimport { BlockchainProviderFactory } from './blockchain-provider.factory';\nimport { CustodyScope } from './custody.types';\nimport { Permission, hasPermission } from '@wlct/shared-types';\nimport { isPlatformPrincipal } from '../../common/guards/request-principal';\nimport { PlatformOnly, RequireAnyPermission } from '../../common/decorators/permissions.decorator';\nimport { limitParam, pageParam } from '../../common/dto/pagination-params';\n\n/**\n * Read-only custody oversight: staff-only permissions (platform, finance, tenant\n * administration, compliance). report:read and reconciliation:read are not used\n * because the system TRADER / FOLLOWER roles hold them for their own data.\n */\nconst CUSTODY_READ = [Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE, Permission.PAYOUT_MANAGE, Permission.TENANT_UPDATE, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ] as const;\n\n/**\n * Custody is an operator surface: wallets, addresses, withdrawals, settlement,\n * sweeps, reserves and reconciliation move or attest to real funds. Nothing\n * here is scoped to an individual customer, so no customer role may call it;\n * customers ask for deposits and withdrawals through client-lifecycle funding\n * requests, which operators review.\n *\n * - default (every mutation): platform staff or finance (payout:manage)\n * - reads and audit export: additionally tenant administration / compliance (oversight)\n * - chain ingestion (observe, confirmations, reorg, poll): platform only, since\n *   a tenant user must never be able to fabricate an on-chain deposit\n * - reconciliation run / resolve: reconciliation:trigger / reconciliation:resolve\n */\n@Controller('custody')\n@RequireAnyPermission(Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE, Permission.PAYOUT_MANAGE)\nexport class CustodyController {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly walletService: WalletService,\n    private readonly walletRepository: WalletRepository,\n    private readonly walletAddressService: WalletAddressService,\n    private readonly depositAddressService: DepositAddressService,\n    private readonly depositMonitoringService: DepositMonitoringService,\n    private readonly withdrawalPolicyService: WithdrawalPolicyService,\n    private readonly withdrawalOrchestrationService: WithdrawalOrchestrationService,\n    private readonly transactionService: TransactionService,\n    private readonly transactionMonitoringService: TransactionMonitoringService,\n    private readonly confirmationService: ConfirmationService,\n    private readonly blockchainFeeService: BlockchainFeeService,\n    private readonly internalTransferService: InternalTransferService,\n    private readonly settlementService: SettlementService,\n    private readonly treasuryBalanceService: TreasuryBalanceService,\n    private readonly reserveService: ReserveManagementService,\n    private readonly sweepService: SweepService,\n    private readonly reconciliationService: CustodyReconciliationService,\n    private readonly auditService: CustodyAuditService,\n    private readonly visibilityService: CustodyVisibilityService,\n    private readonly policyService: CustodyPolicyService,\n    private readonly assetRegistry: AssetRegistryService,\n    private readonly networkRegistry: NetworkRegistryService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: BlockchainProviderFactory,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * The custody scope comes only from the authenticated principal (a client-supplied\n   * `x-custody-scope` header is ignored - A generated address is never treated as proof of funds received.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class DepositAddressService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(DepositAddressService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly walletAddressService: WalletAddressService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: BlockchainProviderFactory,\n    private readonly auditService: CustodyAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async getOrCreateDepositAddress(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    walletId: string;\n    assetId: string;\n    networkId: string;\n    clientProfileId?: string | null;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    label?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, walletId, assetId, networkId, clientProfileId = null, accountId = null, operatorId = null, correlationId = null, label = null } = params;\n\n    if (!assetId || !networkId) throw new BadRequestException('assetId and networkId must be explicit');\n\n    // Check if deposit address already exists for this wallet/account/asset/network\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, walletId, assetId, networkId, isDepositAddress: true, status: { in: ['ACTIVE', 'RESERVED'] } },\n      });\n      if (existing) {\n        this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.deposit_address.existing', tenantId, walletId, address: existing.address });\n        return existing;\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Verify wallet belongs to tenant and is active\n    const wallet = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWallet.findFirst({ where: { id: walletId, tenantId } });\n    if (!wallet) throw new BadRequestException('Wallet not found or tenant mismatch');\n    if (wallet.state !== 'ACTIVE') throw new BadRequestException(`Wallet must be ACTIVE to generate deposit address, current: ${wallet.state}`);\n\n    // Use authoritative custody provider or wallet system to generate address\n    // Must never invent address — must come from provider\n    let generatedAddress: string | null = null;\n    let providerReference: string | null = null;\n\n    try {\n      const provider = await this.providerFactory.getProviderForNetwork({ networkId, assetId });\n      const capabilities = await provider.getCapabilities();\n      // Phase 3 fail-closed: only a provider that controls the key material\n      // may hand out a deposit address. A locally derived string would look\n      // like an address and any funds sent to it would be unrecoverable, so\n      // there is no fallback of any kind.\n      if (!capabilities.canGenerateAddress || typeof provider.generateDepositAddress !== 'function') {\n        throw new BadRequestException(\n          `Provider ${provider.providerId} cannot generate deposit addresses for ${assetId} on ${networkId}; configure a custody provider with address generation`,\n        );\n      }\n\n      const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n        type: `deposit-address:${assetId}:${networkId}`,\n        tenantId,\n        walletId,\n        assetId,\n        networkId,\n        externalRef: `${clientProfileId ?? ''}:${accountId ?? ''}`,\n      });\n\n      // Check if address already generated via idempotency\n      const existingByKey = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existingByKey) return existingByKey;\n\n      const generated = await provider.generateDepositAddress({ assetId, networkId, walletId, tenantId, idempotencyKey, label });\n      if (!generated || typeof generated.address !== 'string' || generated.address.trim() === '') {\n        throw new BadRequestException('Provider did not return a deposit address');\n      }\n      generatedAddress = generated.address.trim();\n      providerReference = generated.providerReference;\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (e instanceof BadRequestException) throw e;\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Failed to generate deposit address via provider: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    if (!generatedAddress) throw new BadRequestException('Failed to generate deposit address — provider did not return address');\n\n    // Create address record — A generated address is never treated as proof of funds received\n    const addressRecord = await this.walletAddressService.createAddress({\n      tenantId,\n      walletId,\n      assetId,\n      networkId,\n      address: generatedAddress,\n      providerReference,\n      creationSource: 'DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_SERVICE',\n      label: label ?? `Deposit for ${accountId ?? clientProfileId ?? walletId}`,\n      isDepositAddress: true,\n      clientProfileId,\n      accountId,\n      operatorId,\n      correlationId,\n      metadata: { isDepositAddress: true, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), note: 'Generated address is not proof of funds received' },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      walletId,\n      action: 'ADDRESS_GENERATED' as any,\n      entityType: 'CUSTODY_WALLET_ADDRESS',\n      entityId: addressRecord.id,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { address: generatedAddress, assetId, networkId, walletId, providerReference, note: 'Address generation is not proof of funds' },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.deposit_address.generated', tenantId, walletId, address: generatedAddress, assetId, networkId });\n\n    return addressRecord;\n  }\n\n  async listDepositAddresses(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    walletId?: string;\n    accountId?: string;\n    clientProfileId?: string;\n    assetId?: string;\n    networkId?: string;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, walletId, accountId, clientProfileId, assetId, networkId, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, isDepositAddress: true };\n    if (walletId) where.walletId = walletId;\n    if (accountId) where.accountId = accountId;\n    if (clientProfileId) where.clientProfileId = clientProfileId;\n    if (assetId) where.assetId = assetId;\n    if (networkId) where.networkId = networkId;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/deposit-monitoring.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected BlockchainProviderFactory } from './blockchain-provider.factory';\nimport { CustodyPolicyService } from './custody-policy.service';\nimport { CustodyAuditService } from CustodyDepositState, DEPOSIT_VALID_TRANSITIONS, isValidDecimal, redactSecrets } from './custody.types';\n\n/**\n * Monitors blockchain/network observations for deposits, detects incoming transfers, required confirmations,\n * reorg/finality concerns, duplicate observations, amount/asset/network mismatches, and produces explicit deposit lifecycle state.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class DepositMonitoringService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(DepositMonitoringService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly providerFactory:  toAddress: string;\n    fromAddress?: string | null;\n    amount: string;\n    transactionHash: string;\n    blockHash?: string | null;\n    blockNumber?: string | null;\n    providerReference?: string | null;\n    observedAt?: Date;\n    fundingRequestId?: string | null;\n    walletId?: string | null;\n    addressId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, assetId, networkId, toAddress, fromAddress = null, amount, transactionHash, blockHash = null, blockNumber = null, providerReference = null, observedAt = new Date(), fundingRequestId = null, walletId = null, addressId = null } = params;\n\n    if (!assetId || !networkId || !toAddress || !transactionHash) throw new BadRequestException('assetId, networkId, toAddress, transactionHash must be explicit');\n    if (!isValidDecimal(amount)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid amount decimal: ${amount}`);\n\n    // Verify destination address belongs to tenant — never assume raw address belongs to tenant merely because client submitted it\n    let addressRecord: any = null;\n    try {\n      addressRecord = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, address: toAddress, networkId } });\n    } catch {}\n\n    if (!addressRecord) {\n      // Check if address is expected but not yet registered — create EXPECTED deposit\n      this.logger.warn({ event: 'custody.deposit.unknown_destination', tenantId, toAddress, networkId, note: 'Deposit to unknown address — will create EXPECTED but not CONFIRMED without verification' });\n    }\n\n    // Prevent duplicate observations — repeated blockchain observations must not create duplicate custody events\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `deposit:${networkId}:${transactionHash}:${toAddress}`,\n      tenantId,\n      assetId,\n      networkId,\n      externalRef: `${transactionHash}:${toAddress}`,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).custodyDeposit.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) {\n        this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.deposit.idempotent_hit', idempotencyKey, transactionHash });\n        return existing;\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Check for duplicate transaction hash across different tenants — network-aware uniqueness\n    try {\n      const dup = await (this.prisma as any).custodyDeposit.findFirst({ where: { networkId, transactionHash, toAddress } });\n      if (dup && dup.tenantId !== tenantId) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Duplicate transaction hash ${transactionHash} already observed for different tenant — ambiguous assignment prevented`);\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (e instanceof BadRequestException) throw e;\n    }\n\n    // Verify asset/network identity explicit — wrong network, wrong asset, wrong destination must not be silently treated as valid\n    const policy = await this.custodyPolicyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId });\n    if (!policy.supportedNetworks.includes(networkId)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Wrong network deposit rejected — network ${networkId} not supported`);\n    }\n\n    // Get required confirmations from network policy\n    const requiredConfirmations = await this.custodyPolicyService.getRequiredConfirmations({ tenantId, networkId });\n\n    // Create deposit as OBSERVED — not CONFIRMED without actual blockchain/provider evidence\n    const deposit = await (this.prisma as any).custodyDeposit.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        walletId: walletId ?? addressRecord?.walletId ?? null,\n        addressId: addressId ?? addressRecord?.id ?? null,\n        assetId,\n        networkId,\n        amount,\n        transactionHash,\n        blockHash: blockHash ?? null,\n        blockNumber: blockNumber ?? null,\n        fromAddress: fromAddress ?? null,\n        toAddress,\n        providerReference: providerReference ?? null,\n        state: 'OBSERVED',\n        confirmationCount: 0,\n        requiredConfirmationCount: requiredConfirmations,\n        isFinal: false,\n        observedAt,\n        fundingRequestId: fundingRequestId ?? null,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        evidence: redactSecrets({ transactionHash, blockHash, blockNumber, fromAddress, toAddress, amount, providerReference, observedAt }) as any,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Create corresponding custody transaction record\n    await this.transactionService.createTransaction({\n      tenantId,\n      walletId: deposit.walletId,\n      assetId,\n      networkId,\n      direction: 'IN',\n      amount,\n      transactionHash,\n      blockHash,\n      blockNumber,\n      providerReference,\n      status: 'OBSERVED',\n      confirmationCount: 0,\n      requiredConfirmationCount: requiredConfirmations,\n      sourceWorkflowType: 'DEPOSIT',\n      sourceWorkflowId: deposit.id,\n      depositId: deposit.id,\n      observedAt,\n      evidence: { fromAddress, toAddress, depositId: deposit.id },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      walletId: deposit.walletId,\n      action: 'DEPOSIT_OBSERVED' as any,\n      entityType: 'CUSTODY_DEPOSIT',\n      entityId: deposit.id,\n      evidence: { transactionHash, toAddress, amount, assetId, networkId, fundingRequestId },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.deposit.observed', tenantId, transactionHash, toAddress, amount, assetId, networkId });\n\n    return deposit;\n  }\n\n  async updateDepositConfirmations(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    depositId: string;\n    confirmationCount: number;\n    blockHash?: string | null;\n    blockNumber?: string | null;\n    providerReference?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, depositId, confirmationCount, blockHash = null, blockNumber = null, providerReference = null } = params;\n\n    const deposit = await (this.prisma as any).custodyDeposit.findFirst({ where: { id: depositId, tenantId } });\n    if (!deposit) throw new BadRequestException('Deposit not found');\n\n    // Never invent confirmation counts — must be provider-derived\n    if (confirmationCount < 0) throw new BadRequestException('Invalid confirmation count');\n\n    const currentState = deposit.state as CustodyDepositState;\n    let newState: CustodyDepositState = currentState;\n\n    if (confirmationCount >= deposit.requiredConfirmationCount && currentState !== CustodyDepositState.CONFIRMED) {\n      // Check if we have authoritative provider/chain evidence for confirmation\n      // For CONFIRMED, need blockHash and blockNumber and provider reference\n      if (blockHash && blockNumber) {\n        newState = CustodyDepositState.CONFIRMED;\n      } else {\n        newState = CustodyDepositState.CONFIRMING;\n      }\n    } else if (confirmationCount > 0 && confirmationCount < null, status = 'ACTIVE', providerCapabilities = [], metadata = {} } = params;\n\n    if (!networkId || !name) throw new BadRequestException('networkId and name required');\n\n    // Network identity data: {\n            chainId,\n            name,\n            nativeAssetId,\n            nativeAssetSymbol,\n            explorerUrl,\n            rpcUrl,\n            finalityModel,\n            confirmationPolicy,\n            status,\n            providerCapabilities,\n            metadata,\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const network = await (this.prisma as any).custodyNetwork.create({\n      data: {\n        networkId,\n        chainId,\n        name,\n        nativeAssetId,\n        nativeAssetSymbol,\n        explorerUrl,\n        rpcUrl,\n        finalityModel,\n        confirmationPolicy,\n        status,\n        providerCapabilities,\n        metadata,\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.network.registered', networkId, chainId, name });\n\n    return network;\n  }\n\n  async getNetwork(params: { networkId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    return await (this.prisma as any).custodyNetwork.findFirst({ };\n    return defaults[params.networkId] ?? 12;\n '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { BlockchainProviderFactory } from './blockchain-provider.factory';\nimport { TransactionService } from './transaction.service';\nimport { ConfirmationService } from './confirmation.service';\nimport { CustodyAuditService } from './custody-audit.service';\nimport { CustodyTransactionState, redactSecrets } from './custody.types';\n\n/**\n * Polls/subscribes to authoritative provider transaction observations, detects pending/confirmed/failed/replaced/dropped/reorged states,\n * stores raw-provider-safe metadata, and never fabricates blockchain status.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class TransactionMonitoringService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(TransactionMonitoringService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: BlockchainProviderFactory,\n    private readonly transactionService: TransactionService,\n    private readonly confirmationService: ConfirmationService,\n    private readonly auditService: CustodyAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async pollTransaction(params: { tenantId: string; transactionId: string }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, transactionId } = params;\n\n    const tx = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { id: transactionId, tenantId } });\n    if (!tx) throw new BadRequestException('Transaction not found');\n\n    if (!tx.transactionHash) {\n      // No hash yet — still pending submission\n      return tx;\n    }\n\n    let provider: any = null;\n    try {\n      provider = await this.providerFactory.getProviderForNetwork({ networkId: tx.networkId, assetId: tx.assetId });\n    } catch {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Provider unavailable for transaction polling');\n    }\n\n    let observation: any = null;\n    try {\n      observation = await provider.getTransaction({ transactionHash: tx.transactionHash, networkId: tx.networkId, assetId: tx.assetId });\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Provider getTransaction failed for ${tx.transactionHash}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      return tx;\n    }\n\n    if (!observation) {\n      // Transaction not yet observed on chain — could be pending or dropped\n      // Check if it's been pending too long — might be dropped\n      const ageMs = Date.now() - new Date(tx.createdAt).getTime();\n      if (ageMs > 30 * 60 * 1000 && tx.status === 'SUBMITTED') {\n        // After 30 min, mark as possibly dropped — but need provider evidence\n        // For now, keep as SUBMITTED\n      }\n      return tx;\n    }\n\n    // Update transaction with provider observation — never fabricate blockchain status\n    const newStatus = observation.status as CustodyTransactionState;\n    const currentStatus = tx.status as CustodyTransactionState;\n\n    if (newStatus !== currentStatus) {\n      try {\n        await this.transactionService.transitionTransaction({\n          tenantId,\n          transactionId,\n          toState: newStatus,\n          blockHash: observation.blockHash ?? null,\n          blockNumber: observation.blockNumber ?? null,\n          confirmationCount: observation.confirmationCount ?? null,\n          actualFee: observation.fee ?? null,\n        });\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to transition transaction ${transactionId} ${currentStatus}→${newStatus}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      }\n    } else {\n      // Update confirmation count even if status same\n      if (observation.confirmationCount !== undefined && observation.confirmationCount !== tx.confirmationCount) {\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.update({\n            where: { id: transactionId },\n            data: { confirmationCount: observation.confirmationCount, blockHash: observation.blockHash ?? tx.blockHash, blockNumber: observation.blockNumber ?? tx.blockNumber },\n          });\n        } catch {}\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Store raw-provider-safe metadata\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.update({\n        where: { id: transactionId },\n        data: { evidence: redactSecrets({ ...(tx.evidence as any), providerObservation: observation, lastPolledAt: new Date().toISOString() }) as any },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n\n    // If transaction is confirmed, observe confirmation\n    if (observation.confirmationCount > 0) {\n      try {\n        await this.confirmationService.observeConfirmation({\n          tenantId,\n          transactionId,\n          blockHash: observation.blockHash ?? null,\n          blockNumber: observation.blockNumber ?? null,\n          confirmationCount: observation.confirmationCount,\n          requiredConfirmationCount: tx.requiredConfirmationCount ?? 6,\n          providerReference: observation.providerReference ?? null,\n        });\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { id: transactionId, tenantId } });\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async handleReorg(params: { tenantId: string; transactionId: string; reason: string; newBlockHash?: string | null; newBlockNumber?: string | null }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, transactionId, reason, newBlockHash = null, newBlockNumber = null } = params;\n\n    const tx = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { id: transactionId, tenantId } });\n    if (!tx) throw new BadRequestException('Transaction not found');\n\n    // For transactions previously observed as confirmed but later invalidated: CONFIRMED → REORGED → CONFIRMING\n    const currentState = tx.status as CustodyTransactionState;\n    if (!['CONFIRMED', 'FINAL', 'CONFIRMING'].includes(currentState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Reorg handling only for CONFIRMED/FINAL/CONFIRMING, current: ${currentState}`);\n    }\n\n    const reorged = await this.transactionService.transitionTransaction({\n      tenantId,\n      transactionId,\n      toState: CustodyTransactionState.REORGED as any,\n      blockHash: newBlockHash,\n      blockNumber: newBlockNumber,\n    });\n\n    // Trigger reconciliation, audit, operations incident as appropriate\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      walletId: tx.walletId,\n      action: 'TRANSACTION_REORGED' as any,\n      entityType: 'CUSTODY_TRANSACTION',\n      entityId: transactionId,\n      evidence: { transactionHash: tx.transactionHash, reason, newBlockHash, newBlockNumber, previousState: currentState },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.warn({ event: 'custody.transaction.reorged', tenantId, transactionId, transactionHash: tx.transactionHash, reason });\n\n    return reorged;\n  }\n\n  async listPendingTransactions(params: { tenantId: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, status: { in: ['PENDING', 'SUBMITTED', 'OBSERVED', 'CONFIRMING'] } };\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/transaction.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected Duplicate transaction observations must be idempotent.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class TransactionService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(TransactionService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly auditService: CustodyAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createTransaction(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    walletId?: string | null;\n    assetId: string;\n    networkId: string;\n    direction: string;\n    amount: string;\n    transactionHash?: string | null;\n    blockHash?: string | null;\n    blockNumber?: string | null;\n    providerReference?: string | null;\n    providerMetadata?: any;\n    status?: string;\n    confirmationCount?: number;\n    requiredConfirmationCount?: number;\n    estimatedFee?: string | null;\n    actualFee?: string | null;\n    feeAsset?: string | null;\n    feeReference?: string | null;\n    sourceWorkflowType?: string | null;\n    sourceWorkflowId?: string | null;\n    depositId?: string | null;\n    withdrawalId?: string | null;\n    observedAt?: Date | null;\n    submittedAt?: Date | null;\n    confirmedAt?: Date | null;\n    failedAt?: Date | null;\n    evidence?: any;\n    idempotencyKey?: string;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, walletId = null, assetId, networkId, direction, amount, transactionHash = null, blockHash = null, blockNumber = null, providerReference = null, providerMetadata = null, status = 'PENDING', confirmationCount = 0, requiredConfirmationCount = 6, estimatedFee = null, actualFee = null, feeAsset = null, feeReference = null, sourceWorkflowType = null, sourceWorkflowId = null, depositId = null, withdrawalId = null, observedAt = null, submittedAt = null, confirmedAt = null, failedAt = null, evidence = {}, idempotencyKey: providedKey } = params;\n\n    if (!assetId || !networkId) throw new BadRequestException('assetId and networkId must be explicit');\n    if (!isValidDecimal(amount)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid amount decimal: ${amount}`);\n    if (!['IN', 'OUT', 'INTERNAL'].includes(direction)) throw new BadRequestException('Invalid direction');\n\n    // Never invent transaction hashes — transactionHash must be from authoritative provider/chain evidence if provided\n    // But allow null for PENDING transactions before submission\n\n    const idempotencyKey = providedKey ?? deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `custody-tx:${direction}:${assetId}:${networkId}`,\n      tenantId,\n      walletId: walletId ?? undefined,\n      assetId,\n      networkId,\n      externalRef: transactionHash ?? `${sourceWorkflowType ?? ''}:${sourceWorkflowId ?? ''}:${Date.now()}`,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) {\n        this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.transaction.idempotent_hit', idempotencyKey, transactionHash });\n        return existing;\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Duplicate transaction hash detection — network-aware uniqueness\n    if (transactionHash) {\n      try {\n        const dup = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, networkId, transactionHash } });\n        if (dup) {\n          // If same hash already exists, return existing — idempotent provider observation\n          this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.transaction.duplicate_hash', transactionHash, networkId });\n          return dup;\n        }\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    const transaction = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        walletId: walletId ?? null,\n        assetId,\n        networkId,\n        direction,\n        amount,\n        transactionHash: transactionHash ?? null,\n        blockHash: blockHash ?? null,\n        blockNumber: blockNumber ?? null,\n        providerReference: providerReference ?? null,\n        providerMetadata: providerMetadata ? redactSecrets(providerMetadata) as any : null,\n        status: status as any,\n        confirmationCount,\n        requiredConfirmationCount,\n        estimatedFee: estimatedFee ?? null,\n        actualFee: actualFee ?? null,\n        feeAsset: feeAsset ?? null,\n        feeReference: feeReference ?? null,\n        sourceWorkflowType: sourceWorkflowType ?? null,\n        sourceWorkflowId: sourceWorkflowId ?? null,\n        depositId: depositId ?? null,\n        withdrawalId: withdrawalId ?? null,\n        observedAt: observedAt ?? null,\n        submittedAt: submittedAt ?? null,\n        confirmedAt: confirmedAt ?? null,\n        failedAt: failedAt ?? null,\n        evidence: redactSecrets(evidence) as any,\n        idempotencyKey,\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      walletId: walletId ?? null,\n      action: 'TRANSACTION_CREATED' as any,\n      entityType: 'CUSTODY_TRANSACTION',\n      entityId: transaction.id,\n      evidence: { transactionHash, assetId, networkId, amount, direction, status },\n    });\n\n    return transaction;\n  }\n\n  async transitionTransaction(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    transactionId: string;\n    toState: CustodyTransactionState;\n    blockHash?: string | null;\n    blockNumber?: string | null;\n    confirmationCount?: number | null;\n    actualFee?: string | null;\n    failureReason?: string | null;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, transactionId, toState, blockHash = null, blockNumber = null, confirmationCount = null, actualFee = null, failureReason = null, operatorId = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const tx = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { id: transactionId, tenantId } });\n    if (!tx) throw new BadRequestException('Transaction not found');\n\n    const currentState = tx.status as CustodyTransactionState;\n    const allowed = TRANSACTION_VALID_TRANSITIONS[currentState] ?? [];\n    if (!allowed.includes(toState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid transaction transition ${currentState} → ${toState}`);\n    }\n\n    // Never mark CONFIRMED without authoritative provider/chain evidence\n    if (toState === CustodyTransactionState.CONFIRMED || toState === CustodyTransactionState.FINAL) {\n      if (!tx.transactionHash) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('Cannot mark CONFIRMED without authoritative transaction hash from provider/chain evidence');\n      }\n      if (!blockHash && !tx.blockHash) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('Cannot mark CONFIRMED without blockHash from provider evidence');\n      }\n    }\n\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.update({\n      where: { id: transactionId },\n      data: {\n        status: toState as any,\n        ...(blockHash ? { blockHash } : {}),\n        ...(blockNumber ? { blockNumber } : {}),\n        ...(confirmationCount !== null ? { confirmationCount } : {}),\n        ...(actualFee ? { actualFee } : {}),\n        ...(failureReason ? { failureReason } : {}),\n        ...(toState === CustodyTransactionState.CONFIRMED ? { confirmedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n        ...(toState === CustodyTransactionState.FINAL ? { confirmedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n        ...(toState === CustodyTransactionState.FAILED ? { failedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n        ...(toState === CustodyTransactionState.REORGED ? { isReorged: true, reorgedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      walletId: tx.walletId,\n      action: `TRANSACTION_${toState}` as any,\n      entityType: 'CUSTODY_TRANSACTION',\n      entityId: transactionId,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      fromState: currentState,\n      toState: toState as any,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { transactionHash: tx.transactionHash, blockHash, blockNumber, confirmationCount, actualFee },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async getTransaction(params: { tenantId: string; transactionId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    return await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { id: params.transactionId, tenantId: params.tenantId } });\n  }\n\n  async getTransactionByHash(params: { tenantId: string; transactionHash: string; networkId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    return await (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, transactionHash: params.transactionHash, networkId: params.networkId } });\n  }\n\n  async listTransactions(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    walletId?: string;\n    assetId?: string;\n    networkId?: string;\n    status?: string;\n    direction?: string;\n    sourceWorkflowId?: string;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, walletId, assetId, networkId, status, direction, sourceWorkflowId, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (walletId) where.walletId = walletId;\n    if (assetId) where.assetId = assetId;\n    if (networkId) where.networkId = networkId;\n    if (status) where.status = status;\n    if (direction) where.direction = direction;\n    if (sourceWorkflowId) where.sourceWorkflowId = sourceWorkflowId;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyTransaction.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/treasury-balance.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/wallet-address.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected
