Specify a different type.","line":204,"column":23,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":204,"endColumn":26,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[8207,8210],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[8207,8210],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":24,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger, BadRequestException, ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { CustodyAuditService } from './custody-audit.service';\nimport { deterministicIdempotencyKey, CustodyWalletAddressState, ADDRESS_VALID_TRANSITIONS, redactSecrets } from './custody.types';\n\n/**\n * Manages wallet addresses, address status, ownership, network/asset binding, labels, creation source,\n * verification, and lifecycle. Prevents the same address from being ambiguously assigned across\n * incompatible tenant/account contexts.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class WalletAddressService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(WalletAddressService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly auditService: CustodyAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createAddress(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    walletId: string;\n    assetId: string;\n    networkId: string;\n    address: string;\n    providerReference?: string | null;\n    creationSource?: string | null;\n    label?: string | null;\n    isDepositAddress?: boolean;\n    clientProfileId?: string | null;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    metadata?: any;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, walletId, assetId, networkId, address, providerReference = null, creationSource = null, label = null, isDepositAddress = false, clientProfileId = null, accountId = null, operatorId = null, correlationId = null, metadata = {} } = params;\n\n    if (!assetId || !networkId || !address) throw new BadRequestException('assetId, networkId, address must be explicit');\n\n    // Verify wallet belongs to tenant\n    const wallet = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWallet.findFirst({ where: { id: walletId, tenantId } });\n    if (!wallet) throw new BadRequestException('Wallet not found or tenant mismatch');\n\n    // Prevent same address from being ambiguously assigned across incompatible tenant/account contexts\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findFirst({\n        where: { address, networkId, tenantId: { not: tenantId } },\n      });\n      if (existing) {\n        throw new ForbiddenException('Address already assigned to different tenant — ambiguous assignment prevented');\n      }\n\n      // Same tenant but different wallet? Check if address already active for same network\n      const sameTenantSameAddress = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, networkId, address, status: { in: ['ACTIVE', 'RESERVED'] } },\n      });\n      if (sameTenantSameAddress && sameTenantSameAddress.walletId !== walletId) {\n        // Allow if same account, but prevent ambiguous across incompatible account contexts\n        if (sameTenantSameAddress.accountId && accountId && sameTenantSameAddress.accountId !== accountId) {\n          throw new BadRequestException(`Address ${address} already assigned to different account context — ambiguous assignment prevented`);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (e instanceof BadRequestException || e instanceof ForbiddenException) throw e;\n    }\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `wallet-address:${assetId}:${networkId}`,\n      tenantId,\n      walletId,\n      assetId,\n      networkId,\n      externalRef: address,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existingByKey = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existingByKey) return existingByKey;\n    } catch {}\n\n    const walletAddress = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        walletId,\n        assetId,\n        networkId,\n        address,\n        providerReference: providerReference ?? null,\n        creationSource: creationSource ?? null,\n        status: 'GENERATING',\n        label: label ?? null,\n        isDepositAddress,\n        clientProfileId: clientProfileId ?? null,\n        accountId: accountId ?? null,\n        verified: false,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        metadata: redactSecrets(metadata) as any,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Transition to ACTIVE after creation — address ownership must be explicit\n    const active = await this.transitionAddress({\n      tenantId,\n      addressId: walletAddress.id,\n      toState: CustodyWalletAddressState.ACTIVE as any,\n      operatorId,\n      correlationId,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      walletId,\n      action: 'ADDRESS_GENERATED' as any,\n      entityType: 'CUSTODY_WALLET_ADDRESS',\n      entityId: walletAddress.id,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      toState: 'ACTIVE',\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { address, assetId, networkId, providerReference, creationSource, walletId },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.address.created', tenantId, walletId, address, assetId, networkId });\n\n    return active;\n  }\n\n  async transitionAddress(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    addressId: string;\n    toState: CustodyWalletAddressState;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    reason?: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, addressId, toState, operatorId = null, reason, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const address = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findFirst({ where: { id: addressId, tenantId } });\n    if (!address) throw new BadRequestException('Address not found');\n\n    const currentState = address.status as CustodyWalletAddressState;\n    const allowed = ADDRESS_VALID_TRANSITIONS[currentState] ?? [];\n    if (!allowed.includes(toState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid address transition ${currentState} → ${toState}`);\n    }\n\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.update({\n      where: { id: addressId },\n      data: {\n        status: toState as any,\n        ...(toState === CustodyWalletAddressState.ACTIVE ? { activatedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n        ...(toState === CustodyWalletAddressState.DEPRECATED ? { deprecatedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n        ...(toState === CustodyWalletAddressState.ACTIVE ? { verified: true, verifiedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      walletId: address.walletId,\n      action: 'ADDRESS_STATUS_CHANGED' as any,\n      entityType: 'CUSTODY_WALLET_ADDRESS',\n      entityId: addressId,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      fromState: currentState,\n      toState: toState as any,\n      reason: reason ?? null,\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { fromState: currentState, toState, address: address.address },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async getAddress(params: { tenantId: string; addressId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    return await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findFirst({ where: { id: params.addressId, tenantId: params.tenantId } });\n  }\n\n  async getAddressByAddress(params: { tenantId: string; address: string; networkId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    return await (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, address: params.address, networkId: params.networkId } });\n  }\n\n  async listAddresses(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    walletId?: string;\n    assetId?: string;\n    networkId?: string;\n    status?: string;\n    accountId?: string;\n    clientProfileId?: string;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, walletId, assetId, networkId, status, accountId, clientProfileId, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (walletId) where.walletId = walletId;\n    if (assetId) where.assetId = assetId;\n    if (networkId) where.networkId = networkId;\n    if (status) where.status = status;\n    if (accountId) where.accountId = accountId;\n    if (clientProfileId) where.clientProfileId = clientProfileId;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).custodyWalletAddress.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/wallet.repository.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/wallet.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/withdrawal-action.dto.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/withdrawal-orchestration.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Must verify all prerequisites again immediately before submission\n * and must never bypass approval, compliance, risk, security, or operational restrictions.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class WithdrawalOrchestrationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(WithdrawalOrchestrationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly withdrawalPolicyService: WithdrawalPolicyService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: BlockchainProviderFactory,\n    private readonly transactionService: TransactionService,\n    private readonly auditService: CustodyAuditService,\n    private readonly custodyPolicyService: CustodyPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async submitWithdrawal(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    custodyWithdrawalId: string;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, custodyWithdrawalId, operatorId = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const withdrawal = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWithdrawal.findFirst({ where: { id: custodyWithdrawalId, tenantId } });\n    if (!withdrawal) throw new BadRequestException('Custody withdrawal not found');\n\n    const currentState = withdrawal.state as CustodyWithdrawalState;\n\n    // Must be APPROVED or QUEUED to submit\n    if (![CustodyWithdrawalState.APPROVED, CustodyWithdrawalState.QUEUED].includes(currentState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Withdrawal must be APPROVED/QUEUED to submit, current: ${currentState}`);\n    }\n\n    // Before provider submission, re-check all safety gates\n    const eligibility = await this.withdrawalPolicyService.evaluateWithdrawalEligibility({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: withdrawal.accountId,\n      walletId: withdrawal.walletId,\n      assetId: withdrawal.assetId,\n      networkId: withdrawal.networkId,\n      amount: withdrawal.amount,\n      destinationAddress: withdrawal.destinationAddress,\n      operatorId,\n    });\n\n    if (!eligibility.eligible) {\n      // DO NOT SUBMIT if any mandatory gate fails\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Withdrawal safety gates failed — DO NOT SUBMIT: ${eligibility.blockingReasons.join(', ')}`);\n    }\n\n    // Check approval exists — existing withdrawal approval requirements must not be bypassed\n    try {\n      const approval = await (this.prisma as any).fundingApproval.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, withdrawalRequestId: withdrawal.withdrawalRequestId, decision: 'APPROVED' },\n      });\n      if (!approval && withdrawal.withdrawalRequestId) {\n        // Also check fundingRequest approval\n        const fundingApproval = await (this.prisma as any).fundingApproval.findFirst({\n          where: { tenantId, fundingRequestId: withdrawal.fundingRequestId, decision: 'APPROVED' },\n        });\n        if (!fundingApproval && !withdrawal.fundingRequestId) {\n          // For custody withdrawal directly, require operator approval\n          if (!operatorId) throw new BadRequestException('Withdrawal approval required — existing approval requirements must not be bypassed');\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (e instanceof BadRequestException) throw e;\n    }\n\n    // Check provider available\n    let provider: any = null;\n    try {\n      provider = await this.providerFactory.getProviderForNetwork({ networkId: withdrawal.networkId, assetId: withdrawal.assetId });\n      const health = await provider.isHealthy?.();\n      if (health && !health.healthy) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Provider unavailable — prevents submission: ${health.reason}`);\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Provider unavailable prevents submission: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // Transition to SUBMITTED\n    const allowed = WITHDRAWAL_VALID_TRANSITIONS[currentState] ?? [];\n    if (!allowed.includes(CustodyWithdrawalState.SUBMITTED as any)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid transition ${currentState} → SUBMITTED`);\n    }\n\n    const submitted = await (this.prisma as any).custodyWithdrawal.update({\n      where: { id: custodyWithdrawalId },\n      data: { state: 'SUBMITTED', submittedAt: new Date(), submittedBy: operatorId },\n    });\n\n    // Submit to provider — must be idempotent where supported\n    let providerResult: any = null;\n    try {\n      if (provider.submitTransaction) {\n        // Convert amount to base-unit integer using token decimals from authoritative asset metadata\n        const decimals = await this.getDecimalsForAsset(withdrawal.assetId);\n        const baseUnitAmount = this.toBaseUnit(withdrawal.amount, decimals);\n\n        const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n          type: `withdrawal-submit:${withdrawal.assetId}:${withdrawal.networkId}`,\n          tenantId,\n          walletId: withdrawal.walletId ?? undefined,\n          assetId: withdrawal.assetId,\n          networkId: withdrawal.networkId,\n          externalRef: `${withdrawal.destinationAddress}:${baseUnitAmount}`,\n        });\n\n        providerResult = await provider.submitTransaction({\n          assetId: withdrawal.assetId,\n          networkId: withdrawal.networkId,\n          fromAddress: (withdrawal as any).fromAddress ?? 'unknown',\n          toAddress: withdrawal.destinationAddress,\n          amount: baseUnitAmount,\n          walletId: withdrawal.walletId ?? undefined,\n          idempotencyKey,\n        });\n\n        // Update withdrawal with transaction hash from provider — never invent transaction hashes\n        if (providerResult.transactionHash) {\n          await (this.prisma as any).custodyWithdrawal.update({\n            where: { id: custodyWithdrawalId },\n            data: { transactionHash: providerResult.transactionHash, providerReference: providerResult.providerReference, estimatedFee: providerResult.estimatedFee ?? null },\n          });\n\n          // Create custody transaction record\n          await this.transactionService.createTransaction({\n            tenantId,\n            walletId: withdrawal.walletId,\n            assetId: withdrawal.assetId,\n            networkId: withdrawal.networkId,\n            direction: 'OUT',\n            amount: withdrawal.amount,\n            transactionHash: providerResult.transactionHash,\n            providerReference: providerResult.providerReference,\n            status: 'SUBMITTED',\n            estimatedFee: providerResult.estimatedFee ?? null,\n            sourceWorkflowType: 'CUSTODY_WITHDRAWAL',\n            sourceWorkflowId: custodyWithdrawalId,\n            withdrawalId: custodyWithdrawalId,\n            submittedAt: new Date(),\n            evidence: { destinationAddress: withdrawal.destinationAddress, providerResult: redactSecrets(providerResult) },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      // If provider submission fails, transition to FAILED — never silently succeed\n      await (this.prisma as any).custodyWithdrawal.update({\n        where: { id: custodyWithdrawalId },\n        data: { state: 'FAILED', failedAt: new Date(), failureReason: `Provider submission failed: ${(e as Error).message}` },\n      });\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Withdrawal provider submission failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      walletId: withdrawal.walletId,\n      action: 'WITHDRAWAL_SUBMITTED' as any,\n      entityType: 'CUSTODY_WITHDRAWAL',\n      entityId: custodyWithdrawalId,\n      actorId: operatorId,\n      fromState: currentState,\n      toState: 'SUBMITTED',\n      correlationId,\n      evidence: { transactionHash: providerResult?.transactionHash, providerReference: providerResult?.providerReference, destinationAddress: withdrawal.destinationAddress },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'custody.withdrawal.submitted', tenantId, custodyWithdrawalId, transactionHash: providerResult?.transactionHash });\n\n    return submitted;\n  }\n\n  private async getDecimalsForAsset(assetId: string): Promise<number> {\n    try {\n      const asset = await (this.prisma as any).custodyAsset.findFirst({ where: { assetId } });\n      if (asset) return asset.decimals;\n    } catch {}\n    return 18; // default, but should be from authoritative metadata\n  }\n\n  private toBaseUnit(amount: string, decimals: number): string {\n    // Convert decimal string to base-unit integer string — Decimal-safe\n    try {\n      const [intPart, fracPart = ''] = amount.split('.');\n      const paddedFrac = (fracPart + '0'.repeat(decimals)).slice(0, decimals);\n      const combined = intPart + paddedFrac;\n      return combined.replace(/^0+/, '') || '0';\n    } catch {\n      return amount;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/custody/withdrawal-policy.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/datasets/dataset-ingestion.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/datasets/dataset-lifecycle.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/datasets/dataset-registry.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/datasets/datasets-safety.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/datasets/datasets.constants.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/datasets/datasets.controller.ts","messages":[] no secret logging.\n//\n// Lives in its own module (it used to be private to exchange-provider.factory.ts)\n// so that the per-venue providers under ./venues can extend it without an\n// import cycle through the factory that registers them.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport interface ProviderHttpRequest {\n  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'DELETE';\n  url: string;\n  headers?: Record<string, string>;\n  body?: string;\n  timeoutMs?: number;\n}\n\n/** Epoch microseconds for \"now\", as the decimal string every DTO carries. */\nexport function nowMicros(): string {\n  return (BigInt(Date.now()) * 1000n).toString();\n}\n\n/** Converts epoch milliseconds (number or numeric string) to an epoch-micros string. */\nexport function msToMicros(ms: number | string | null | undefined): string | null {\n  if (ms === null || ms === undefined || ms === '') return null;\n  const text = typeof ms === 'number' ? Math.trunc(ms).toString() : String(ms).trim();\n  if (!/^\\d+$/.test(text)) return null;\n  return (BigInt(text) * 1000n).toString();\n}\n\n/** Converts epoch seconds with an optional fraction (\"1700000000.1234\") to an epoch-micros string. */\nexport function secondsToMicros(seconds: number | string | null | undefined): string | null {\n  if (seconds === null || seconds === undefined || seconds === '') return null;\n  const text = typeof seconds === 'number' ? seconds.toFixed(6) : String(seconds).trim();\n  const match = /^(\\d+)(?:\\.(\\d+))?$/.exec(text);\n  if (!match) return null;\n  const whole = BigInt(match[1]);\n  const frac = BigInt(((match[2] ?? '') + '000000').slice(0, 6));\n  return (whole * 1_000_000n + frac).toString();\n}\n\n/** Converts an ISO-8601 timestamp to an epoch-micros string (millisecond resolution). */\nexport function isoToMicros(iso: string | null | undefined): string | null {\n  if (!iso) return null;\n  const ms = Date.parse(iso);\n  if (Number.isNaN(ms)) return null;\n  return (BigInt(ms) * 1000n).toString();\n}\n\nconst DECIMAL_RE = /^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/;\n\n/** True when the value is a plain decimal string (\"12\", \"-0.5\"); no exponent, no whitespace. */\nexport function isDecimalString(value: unknown): value is string {\n  return typeof value === 'string' && DECIMAL_RE.test(value);\n}\n\nfunction splitDecimal(value: string): { units: bigint; scale: number } {\n  const negative = value.startsWith('-');\n  const clean = negative ? value.slice(1) : value;\n  const [whole, frac = ''] = clean.split('.');\n  const units = BigInt(`${whole}${frac}` || '0');\n  return { units: negative ? -units : units, scale: frac.length };\n}\n\nfunction joinDecimal(units: bigint, scale: number): string {\n  const negative = units < 0n;\n  let digits = (negative ? -units : units).toString();\n  if (scale > 0) {\n    digits = digits.padStart(scale + 1, '0');\n    const whole = digits.slice(0, digits.length - scale);\n    const frac = digits.slice(digits.length - scale).replace(/0+$/, '');\n    digits = frac ? `${whole}.${frac}` : whole;\n  }\n  if (digits === '0') return '0';\n  return negative ? `-${digits}` : digits;\n}\n\n/**\n * Exact decimal addition over strings. Venue amounts are decimal strings and\n * must stay exact: `parseFloat('0.1') + parseFloat('0.2')` is not 0.3, and a\n * balance total that drifts in the 17th digit is a reconciliation break.\n * A non-decimal operand is a venue payload we do not understand - it throws\n * rather than being treated as zero.\n */\nexport function addDecimalStrings(...values: string[]): string {\n  let scale = 0;\n  const parts = values.map((value) => {\n    if (!isDecimalString(value)) throw new Error(`not a decimal string: ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);\n    const part = splitDecimal(value);\n    scale = Math.max(scale, part.scale);\n    return part;\n  });\n  let total = 0n;\n  for (const part of parts) total += part.units * 10n ** BigInt(scale - part.scale);\n  return joinDecimal(total, scale);\n}\n\n/** `a - b` over decimal strings, exact. */\nexport function subtractDecimalStrings(a: string, b: string): string {\n  if (!isDecimalString(b)) throw new Error(`not a decimal string: ${JSON.stringify(b)}`);\n  return addDecimalStrings(a, b.startsWith('-') ? b.slice(1) : `-${b}`);\n}\n\n/** Absolute value of a decimal string. */\nexport function absDecimalString(value: string): string {\n  if (!isDecimalString(value)) throw new Error(`not a decimal string: ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);\n  return value.startsWith('-') ? value.slice(1) : value;\n}\n\n/** Sign of a decimal string: -1, 0 or 1. */\nexport function signOfDecimalString(value: string): -1 | 0 | 1 {\n  if (!isDecimalString(value)) throw new Error(`not a decimal string: ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);\n  const { units } = splitDecimal(value);\n  return units < 0n ? -1 : units > 0n ? 1 : 0;\n}\n\n/** Number of fractional digits a step/tick string implies (\"0.001\" -> 3, \"1\" -> 0, \"1e-8\" -> 8). */\nexport function precisionOfStep(step: string | null | undefined, fallback = 8): number {\n  if (!step) return fallback;\n  const text = String(step).trim();\n  const exp = /^\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?e-(\\d+)$/i.exec(text);\n  if (exp) return Number(exp[1]);\n  if (!isDecimalString(text)) return fallback;\n  const frac = text.split('.')[1];\n  if (!frac) return 0;\n  const trimmed = frac.replace(/0+$/, '');\n  return trimmed.length;\n}\n\n/**\n * Quote assets recognised when a venue reports a concatenated symbol\n * (\"BTCUSDT\"), longest first so \"USDT\" wins over \"USD\". A symbol with no\n * recognised quote is returned unchanged rather than split at a guess.\n */\nconst KNOWN_QUOTES = ['FDUSD', 'USDT', 'USDC', 'USDE', 'TUSD', 'BUSD', 'EUR', 'USD', 'GBP', 'TRY', 'BRL', 'JPY', 'AUD', 'BTC', 'ETH', 'DAI', 'BNB', 'SOL'];\n\nexport function canonicalFromConcatenated(exchangeSymbol: string): string {\n  const upper = String(exchangeSymbol || '').toUpperCase();\n  for (const quote of KNOWN_QUOTES) {\n    if (upper.length > quote.length && upper.endsWith(quote)) {\n      return `${upper.slice(0, upper.length - quote.length)}-${quote}`;\n    }\n  }\n  return upper;\n}\n\nexport abstract class BaseExchangeProvider implements ExchangeProvider {\n  abstract readonly venue: ExchangeVenue;\n  abstract readonly displayName: string;\n  abstract readonly supportedEnvironments: ExchangeEnvironment[];\n  abstract readonly supportedCapabilities: ExchangeCapability[];\n\n  protected readonly logger = new Logger(this.constructor.name);\n\n  protected getRestBaseUrlForEnv(environment: ExchangeEnvironment): string {\n    switch (environment) {\n      case ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE:\n        return this.getLiveRestUrl();\n      case ExchangeEnvironment.TESTNET:\n        return this.getTestnetRestUrl();\n      case ExchangeEnvironment.SANDBOX:\n        return this.getSandboxRestUrl();\n      default:\n        return this.getLiveRestUrl();\n    }\n  }\n\n  protected abstract getLiveRestUrl(): string;\n  protected abstract getTestnetRestUrl(): string;\n  protected abstract getSandboxRestUrl(): string;\n  protected abstract getLiveWsUrl(): string;\n  protected abstract getTestnetWsUrl(): string;\n  protected abstract getSandboxWsUrl(): string;\n\n  validateEnvironmentBinding(environment: ExchangeEnvironment, isSandbox: boolean): boolean {\n    if (environment === ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE && isSandbox) return false;\n    if ((environment === ExchangeEnvironment.TESTNET || environment === ExchangeEnvironment.SANDBOX) && !isSandbox) return false;\n    return this.supportedEnvironments.includes(environment);\n  }\n\n  getRestBaseUrl(environment: ExchangeEnvironment): string {\n    return this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(environment);\n  }\n\n  getWebsocketBaseUrl(environment: ExchangeEnvironment): string {\n    switch (environment) {\n      case ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE:\n        return this.getLiveWsUrl();\n      case ExchangeEnvironment.TESTNET:\n        return this.getTestnetWsUrl();\n      case ExchangeEnvironment.SANDBOX:\n        return this.getSandboxWsUrl();\n      default:\n        return this.getLiveWsUrl();\n    }\n  }\n\n  protected async httpGet(url: string, headers: Record<string, string> = {}, timeoutMs = 5000): Promise<any> {\n    return this.httpRequest({ method: 'GET', url, headers, timeoutMs });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * One HTTP exchange with a hard timeout. A non-2xx answer throws an Error\n   * carrying `status`, `headers` and the parsed `data`, which is exactly the\n   * shape {@link normalizeError} classifies. Nothing about the request\n   * (headers carry signatures and keys) is ever put on the error message.\n   */\n  protected async httpRequest(request: ProviderHttpRequest): Promise<any> {\n    const controller = new AbortController();\n    const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), request.timeoutMs ?? 5000);\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(request.url, {\n        method: request.method,\n        headers: request.headers ?? {},\n        body: request.body,\n        signal: controller.signal,\n      });\n      const text = await res.text();\n      let data: any;\n      try {\n        data = JSON.parse(text);\n      } catch {\n        data = text;\n      }\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        const err: any = new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);\n        err.status = res.status;\n        err.headers = Object.fromEntries(res.headers.entries());\n        err.data = data;\n        throw err;\n      }\n      return data;\n    } finally {\n      clearTimeout(timeout);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Throws AUTH_FAILED when the context carries no key material at all. */\n  protected requireCredentials(context: ExchangeProviderContext, needPassphrase = false): void {\n    if (!context.credentials?.apiKey || !context.credentials?.apiSecret) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.AUTH_FAILED, 'Missing credentials', context.venue, context.environment, false);\n    }\n    if (needPassphrase && !context.credentials.passphrase) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(\n        ExchangeProviderErrorCode.INVALID_CREDENTIALS,\n        `${this.venue} requires an API passphrase in addition to key and secret`,\n        context.venue,\n        context.environment,\n        false,\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  protected normalizeError(e: any, venue: ExchangeVenue, environment: ExchangeEnvironment): ExchangeProviderError {\n    if (e instanceof ExchangeProviderError) return e;\n    const status = e.status || 0;\n    const msg = (e.message || '').toLowerCase();\n    const data = e.data;\n\n    if (status === 401 || status === 403 || msg.includes('api key') || msg.includes('signature') || msg.includes('auth') || (data && (data.code === -2015 || data.code === -2014))) {\n      return new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.AUTH_FAILED, `Authentication failed for ${venue}`, venue, environment, false, null, e);\n    }\n    if (status === 429 || msg.includes('rate limit') || msg.includes('too many requests') || (data && data.code === -1003)) {\n      const retryAfter = e.headers?.['retry-after'] ? parseInt(e.headers['retry-after'], 10) * 1000 : 1000;\n      return new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.RATE_LIMITED, `Rate limited for ${venue}`, venue, environment, true, retryAfter, e);\n    }\n    if (msg.includes('timeout') || msg.includes('aborted') || status === 504) {\n      return new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.TIMEOUT, `Timeout for ${venue}`, venue, environment, true, 1000, e);\n    }\n    if (status >= 500) {\n      return new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.SERVER_ERROR, `Server error for ${venue}: ${status}`, venue, environment, true, 1000, e);\n    }\n    return new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, e.message || `Unknown error for ${venue}`, venue, environment, false, null, e);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The shared connectivity proof for venues that expose key permissions:\n   * server time (clock drift), one authenticated read (the key works), and a\n   * refusal when the key can withdraw - the platform never accepts a key that\n   * could move funds off the venue, whatever else it can do.\n   */\n  protected async connectivityFromMetadata(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeConnectivityResult> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n    try {\n      const serverTime = await this.getServerTime(context);\n      const metadata = await this.getAccountMetadata(context);\n      if (metadata.canWithdraw) {\n        throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.WITHDRAWAL_NOT_ALLOWED, 'Withdrawal permission detected', context.venue, context.environment, false);\n      }\n      return {\n        connected: true,\n        degraded: !metadata.canTrade,\n        state: metadata.canTrade ? ExchangeConnectionState.CONNECTED : ExchangeConnectionState.DEGRADED,\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n        serverTimeMicros: serverTime.serverTimeMicros,\n        clockDriftMs: serverTime.driftMs,\n        capabilities: this.supportedCapabilities,\n        failureCode: null,\n        failureReason: metadata.canTrade ? null : 'API key is read-only: balances and history sync, order placement will be refused by the venue',\n        isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n        environment: context.environment,\n      };\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  protected serverTimeFromMs(serverTimeMs: number): ExchangeServerTime {\n    const localMs = Date.now();\n    return {\n      serverTimeMicros: (BigInt(Math.trunc(serverTimeMs)) * 1000n).toString(),\n      localTimeMicros: (BigInt(localMs) * 1000n).toString(),\n      driftMs: localMs - Math.trunc(serverTimeMs),\n    };\n  }\n\n  abstract testConnectivity(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<any>;\n  abstract getServerTime(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeServerTime>;\n  abstract getAccountMetadata(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeAccountMetadata>;\n  abstract getCapabilities(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeCapabilityDiscovery>;\n  abstract getBalances(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeBalance[]>;\n  abstract getPositions(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangePosition[]>;\n  abstract getOpenOrders(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]>;\n  abstract getOrderHistory(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string, limit?: number): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]>;\n  abstract getTradeHistory(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string, limit?: number): Promise<ExchangeFill[]>;\n  abstract getSymbols(context: ExchangeProviderContext): exchange-account orchestration: connect, validate, enable/disable, rotate credentials, capability discovery, health state, and account lifecycle.\n * Flow: Request → entitlement/plan limit check → secure credential reference → provider validation → capability discovery → health check → activate\n * Important: A connected account must NOT automatically receive live trading permission.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ExchangeAccountService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ExchangeAccountService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly accountRepo: ExchangeAccountRepository,\n    private readonly credentialService: ExchangeCredentialService,\n    private readonly registry: ExchangeRegistryService,\n    private safetyService: ExecutionSafetyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private async resolveExchangeId(venue: ExchangeVenue): Promise<string> {\n    // Find or create Exchange entry in Prisma\n    let exchange = await this.prisma.exchange.findFirst({ where: { venue: venue as any } });\n    if (!exchange) {\n      // Create exchange entry if not exists - safe metadata only\n      const registryEntry = this.registry.getVenue(venue);\n      if (!registryEntry) {\n        throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, `Venue ${venue} not in registry`, venue, ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE, false);\n      }\n      exchange = await this.prisma.exchange.create({\n        data: {\n          venue: venue as any,\n          name: registryEntry.displayName,\n          isEnabled: true,\n          tradingEnabled: false, // Must be explicitly enabled by operator\n          supportedMarketTypes: ['SPOT'] as any,\n          restBaseUrl: registryEntry.baseRestUrlLive,\n          wsBaseUrl: registryEntry.baseWsUrlLive,\n          requiresPassphrase: registryEntry.requiresPassphrase,\n          supportsSandbox: true,\n          weightLimitPerMinute: 1200,\n          maxOrdersPerSecond: 5,\n          maxLeverage: 1,\n          defaultBookDepth: 50,\n        },\n      });\n    }\n    return exchange.id;\n  }\n\n  async connectAccount(input: ConnectAccountInput): Promise<ExchangeSafeReference> {\n    // 1. Validate venue and environment\n    if (!this.registry.isVenueSupported(input.venue) && input.venue !== ExchangeVenue.OTHER_CONFIGURED) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, `Unknown venue ${input.venue}`, input.venue, input.environment, false);\n    }\n\n    if (!this.registry.isEnvironmentSupported(input.venue, input.environment)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(\n        ExchangeProviderErrorCode.NOT_SUPPORTED,\n        `Environment ${input.environment} not supported for ${input.venue}`,\n        input.venue,\n        input.environment,\n        false,\n      );\n    }\n\n    // 2. Environment binding validation - LIVE vs TESTNET fail closed\n    const isSandbox = input.environment !== ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE;\n    if (!this.registry.validateEnvironmentBinding(input.venue, input.environment, isSandbox)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(\n        ExchangeProviderErrorCode.ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH,\n        `Environment mismatch: ${input.environment} isSandbox=${isSandbox}`,\n        input.venue,\n        input.environment,\n        false,\n      );\n    }\n\n    // 3. Entitlement/plan limit check - use existing maxExchangeAccountsPerUser\n    const enforcementActor = { tenantId: input.tenantId, userId: input.actorId } as any;\n    try {\n      await this.limitGuard.reserve(enforcementActor, input.userId);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Plan limit exceeded tenant=${input.tenantId} user=${input.userId} venue=${input.venue}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n\n    let accountRecord;\n    try {\n      // 4. Resolve exchangeId\n      const exchangeId = await this.resolveExchangeId(input.venue);\n\n      // 5. Create account metadata first (without secrets)\n      accountRecord = await this.accountRepo.create({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        userId: input.userId,\n        exchangeId,\n        venue: input.venue,\n        label: input.label,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        isSandbox,\n        credentialSource: input.credentialSource,\n        credentialRef: input.credentialRef || null,\n        apiKeyLastFour: input.apiKey.slice(-4),\n        idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey || null,\n      });\n\n      // 6. Secure credential reference - never store plaintext\n      await this.credentialService.createCredentialReference({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        userId: input.userId,\n        accountId: accountRecord.id,\n        venue: input.venue,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        apiKey: input.apiKey,\n        apiSecret: input.apiSecret,\n        passphrase: input.passphrase,\n        credentialSource: input.credentialSource,\n        credentialRef: input.credentialRef || null,\n      });\n\n      // 7. Provider validation - connectivity check without placing orders\n      const connectivityResult = await this.connectivityService.checkConnectivity({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        accountId: accountRecord.id,\n        venue: input.venue,\n        environment: input.environment,\n      });\n\n      if (!connectivityResult.connected) {\n        await this.accountRepo.updateStatus(accountRecord.id, input.tenantId, ExchangeAccountState.ERROR, connectivityResult.failureCode, connectivityResult.failureReason);\n        await this.auditService.record({\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          accountId: accountRecord.id,\n          venue: input.venue,\n          environment: input.environment,\n          event: 'EXCHANGE_ACCOUNT_CONNECTED' as any,\n          result: 'FAILURE',\n          actorId: input.actorId,\n          safeMetadata: { failureCode: connectivityResult.failureCode, latencyMs: connectivityResult.latencyMs },\n          requestId: input.requestId,\n        });\n        // Keep the connectivity check's own classification: an unreachable\n        // venue is not a refused key, and the client message depends on it.\n        const knownFailure = Object.values(ExchangeProviderErrorCode).includes(connectivityResult.failureCode as ExchangeProviderErrorCode)\n          ? (connectivityResult.failureCode as ExchangeProviderErrorCode)\n          : ExchangeProviderErrorCode.AUTH_FAILED;\n        throw new ExchangeProviderError(\n          knownFailure,\n          `Connectivity check failed: ${connectivityResult.failureReason || connectivityResult.failureCode}`,\n          input.venue,\n          input.environment,\n          false,\n        );\n      }\n\n      // 8. Capability discovery\n      const capabilities = await this.connectivityService.discoverCapabilities({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        accountId: accountRecord.id,\n        venue: input.venue,\n        environment: input.environment,\n      });\n\n      // 9. Health check\n      await this.healthService.checkHealth({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        accountId: accountRecord.id,\n        venue: input.venue,\n        environment: input.environment,\n      });\n\n      // 10. ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.SERVER_ERROR, 'Failed to activate account', input.venue, input.environment, false);\n      }\n\n      await this.accountRepo.updateSyncMetadata(accountRecord.id, input.tenantId, {\n        lastSyncAt: new Date(),\n        capabilities: capabilities.capabilities,\n      });\n\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        accountId: accountRecord.id,\n        venue: input.venue,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        event: 'EXCHANGE_ACCOUNT_CONNECTED',\n        result: 'SUCCESS',\n        actorId: input.actorId,\n        safeMetadata: { capabilities: capabilities.capabilities, latencyMs: connectivityResult.latencyMs, isSandbox },\n        requestId: input.requestId,\n      });\n\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        accountId: accountRecord.id,\n        venue: input.venue,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        event: 'EXCHANGE_ACCOUNT_ACTIVATED',\n        result: 'SUCCESS',\n        actorId: input.actorId,\n        safeMetadata: { venue: input.venue, environment: input.environment },\n        requestId: input.requestId,\n      });\n\n      this.logger.log(`Account connected and activated id=${accountRecord.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} venue=${input.venue} env=${input.environment}`);\n\n      return this.toSafeReference(activated);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      // Release slot on failure\n      try {\n        await this.limitGuard.release(enforcementActor, input.userId);\n      } catch {}\n\n      // If the account row was created but the connect failed later, discard\n      // it: never leave it ACTIVE, and never let it keep holding the key.\n      if (accountRecord) {\n        try {\n          await this.accountRepo.discardFailedConnection(accountRecord.id, input.tenantId, String(e?.code || 'CONNECT_FAILED'));\n        } catch (discardError: any) {\n          this.logger.error(`Failed to discard failed connection id=${accountRecord.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} error=${discardError?.message}`);\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (e instanceof ExchangeProviderError || e instanceof HttpException) throw e;\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to connect account tenant=${input.tenantId} venue=${input.venue} error=${e.message}`);\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.SERVER_ERROR, `Failed to connect account: ${e.message}`, input.venue, input.environment, false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getAccount(tenantId: string, accountId: string, userId?: string | null): Promise<ExchangeSafeReference | null> {\n    const record = await this.accountRepo.findByIdWithUserCheck(accountId, tenantId, userId);\n    if (!record) return null;\n    return this.toSafeReference(record);\n  }\n\n  async listAccounts(\n    tenantId: requesterUserId?: string | null,\n    isPrivileged?: boolean,\n  ): Promise<{ data: ExchangeSafeReference[]; total: number }> {\n    // Tenant isolation + user isolation for non-privileged\n    const If exchange returns amount as string, preserve precision.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ExchangeBalanceSyncService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ExchangeBalanceSyncService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: ExchangeProviderFactory,\n    private readonly credentialService: ExchangeCredentialService,\n    private readonly accountRepo: ExchangeAccountRepository,\n    private readonly auditService: ExchangeAuditService,\n    private readonly cache: CacheService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private toDecimalString(value: string | number | null | undefined): string {\n    if (value === null || value === undefined) return '0';\n    if (typeof value === 'string') {\n      // Validate decimal string - preserve precision, no float conversion\n      if (!/^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/.test(value.trim())) {\n        // If not valid decimal, try to parse but log warning\n        this.logger.warn(`Invalid decimal string received: ${value}`);\n        return '0';\n      }\n      return value.trim();\n    }\n    // If number, convert to string preserving as much as possible - but warn that precision may be lost\n    // For financial quantities, provider should return string per spec\n    this.logger.warn(`Balance amount received as number ${value} - should be string for precision`);\n    return value.toString();\n  }\n\n  private addDecimalStrings(a: string, b: string): string {\n    // Decimal-safe addition without float - use BigInt for integer part and handle decimals\n    // Simplified: use decimal.js-like logic with string manipulation\n    try {\n      const [aInt, aDec = ''] = a.split('.');\n      const [bInt, bDec = ''] = b.split('.');\n      const maxDec = Math.max(aDec.length, bDec.length);\n      const aPadded = aDec.padEnd(maxDec, '0');\n      const bPadded = bDec.padEnd(maxDec, '0');\n\n      const aFull = BigInt(aInt + aPadded);\n      const bFull = BigInt(bInt + bPadded);\n      const sum = aFull + bFull;\n      const sumStr = sum.toString().padStart(maxDec + 1, '0');\n      if (maxDec === 0) return sumStr;\n      const intPart = sumStr.slice(0, -maxDec) || '0';\n      const decPart = sumStr.slice(-maxDec).replace(/0+$/, '') || '0';\n      // Return with preserved decimals if needed, but for total we need sum\n      // For simplicity, if decPart is 0, return intPart\n      if (decPart === '0') return intPart;\n      return `${intPart}.${decPart}`;\n    } catch {\n      // Fallback - should not happen, but avoid float\n      return (BigInt(a.split('.')[0] || '0') + BigInt(b.split('.')[0] || '0')).toString();\n    }\n  }\n\n  async syncBalances(input: { tenantId: string; accountId: string; venue: ExchangeVenue; environment: ExchangeEnvironment; actorId?: string; requestId?: string }): Promise<{ state: ExchangeSyncState; processed: number; created: number; updated: number; skipped: number; durationMs: number }> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n    const isSandbox = input.environment !== ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE;\n\n    const account = await this.accountRepo.findById(input.accountId, input.tenantId);\n    if (!account) {\n      throw new Error(`Account ${input.accountId} not found for tenant ${input.tenantId}`);\n    }\n\n    let provider;\n    try {\n      provider = this.providerFactory.getProvider(input.venue, input.environment);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Provider unavailable for balance sync tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${input.accountId} error=${e.message}`);\n      return { state: ExchangeSyncState.FAILED, processed: 0, created: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, durationMs: Date.now() - start };\n    }\n\n    let credentials;\n    try {\n      credentials = await this.credentialService.getDecryptedCredentialsForProvider(input.tenantId, input.accountId, input.venue, input.environment);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Credential unavailable for balance sync tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${input.accountId} error=${e.message}`);\n      return { state: ExchangeSyncState.FAILED, processed: 0, created: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, durationMs: Date.now() - start };\n    }\n\n    const context: ExchangeProviderContext = {\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      accountId: input.accountId,\n      venue: input.venue,\n      environment: input.environment,\n      isSandbox,\n      credentials: {\n        apiKey: credentials.apiKey,\n        apiSecret: credentials.apiSecret,\n        passphrase: credentials.passphrase,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        isSandbox,\n      },\n      credentialRef: null,\n    };\n\n    let balances: ExchangeBalance[];\n    try {\n      balances = await provider.getBalances(context);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to fetch balances tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${input.accountId} venue=${input.venue} error=${e.message}`);\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        accountId: input.accountId,\n        venue: input.venue,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        event: 'BALANCE_SYNCED',\n        result: 'FAILURE',\n        actorId: input.actorId,\n        safeMetadata: { errorCode: e.code || 'FETCH_FAILED', isSandbox },\n        requestId: input.requestId,\n      });\n      return { state: ExchangeSyncState.FAILED, processed: 0, created: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, durationMs: Date.now() - start };\n    }\n\n    // Idempotent upsert - tenant/account scoped, provider reference based, timestamp-aware\n    let created = 0;\n    let updated = 0;\n    let skipped = 0;\n\n    for (const balance of balances) {\n      try {\n        const free = this.toDecimalString(balance.free);\n        const locked = this.toDecimalString(balance.locked);\n        const total = this.toDecimalString(balance.total);\n\n        // Validate free+locked ≈ total within small tolerance? We preserve provider values, do not recalculate\n        // But we ensure total is at least free if provider gives inconsistent data\n        const observedAtMicros = BigInt(normalizeTimestampMicros(balance.timestampMicros));\n        const venueUpdatedAtMicros = balance.providerReference ? observedAtMicros : null;\n\n        // Use idempotency key: tenantId + accountId + asset + providerReference\n        const existing = await this.prisma.accountBalanceSnapshot.findFirst({\n          where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, accountId: input.accountId, asset: balance.asset },\n        });\n\n        if (existing) {\n          // Check if same timestamp and same values - skip duplicate\n          const existingObserved = existing.observedAtMicros ? BigInt(existing.observedAtMicros.toString()) : BigInt(0);\n          if (existingObserved === observedAtMicros && existing.free.toString() === free && existing.locked.toString() === locked) {\n            skipped++;\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          // Update with timestamp awareness - only update if newer\n          if (observedAtMicros >= existingObserved) {\n            await this.prisma.accountBalanceSnapshot.update({\n              where: { id: existing.id },\n              data: {\n                free: free as any,\n                locked: locked as any,\n                total: total as any,\n                observedAtMicros: observedAtMicros as any,\n                venueUpdatedAtMicros: venueUpdatedAtMicros as any,\n                isSimulated: balance.isSimulated,\n                updatedAt: new Date(),\n              },\n            });\n            updated++;\n          } else {\n            skipped++;\n          }\n        } else {\n          await this.prisma.accountBalanceSnapshot.create({\n            data: {\n              id: this.generateId(),\n              tenantId: input.tenantId,\n              accountId: input.accountId,\n              asset: balance.asset,\n              free: free as any,\n              locked: locked as any,\n              total: total as any,\n              observedAtMicros: observedAtMicros as any,\n              venueUpdatedAtMicros: venueUpdatedAtMicros as any,\n              isSimulated: balance.isSimulated,\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n              updatedAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n          created++;\n        }\n\n        // Cache latest balance for fast reads - idempotent\n        try {\n          await this.cache.set(`balance:${input.tenantId}:${input.accountId}:${balance.asset}`, { free, locked, total, observedAtMicros: observedAtMicros.toString() }, 300);\n        } catch {}\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to sync balance asset=${balance.asset} tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${input.accountId} error=${e.message}`);\n        skipped++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const durationMs = Date.now() - start;\n\n    // Update last sync metadata\n    await this.accountRepo.updateSyncMetadata(input.accountId, input.tenantId, { lastSyncAt: new Date() });\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      accountId: input.accountId,\n      venue: input.venue,\n      environment: input.environment,\n      event: 'BALANCE_SYNCED',\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      actorId: input.actorId,\n      safeMetadata: { processed: balances.length, created, updated, skipped, durationMs, isSandbox },\n      requestId: input.requestId,\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Balance sync completed tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${input.accountId} processed=${balances.length} created=${created} updated=${updated} skipped=${skipped} duration=${durationMs}ms`);\n\n    return { state: ExchangeSyncState.COMPLETED, processed: balances.length, created, updated, skipped, durationMs };\n  }\n\n  private generateId(): string {\n    return `${Date.now().toString(36)}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10)}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10)}`;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/exchange-connectivity.secret-manager.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. A store\n * that was only down (HTTP 503) therefore told the operator to reconfigure it.\n * The degraded, never-fake-success behaviour is unchanged; only the reason is\n * now the actual cause. These tests run the real ExchangeCredentialService.\n */\nimport { ExchangeConnectivityService } from './exchange-connectivity.service';\nimport { ExchangeCredentialService } from './exchange-credential.service';\nimport { ExchangeProviderErrorCode } from './exchange-provider.interface';\nimport { SecretStore, SecretStoreError } from './secret-store';\nimport { ExchangeConnectionState, ExchangeEnvironment, ExchangeVenue } from './exchange.types';\n\nconst TENANT = '11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111';\nconst ACCOUNT = '22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222';\n\nconst SECRET_ENV_KEYS = [\n  'SECRET_MANAGER_PROVIDER',\n  'VAULT_ADDR',\n  'VAULT_TOKEN',\n  'VAULT_TOKEN_FILE',\n  'AWS_SECRETS_MANAGER_ENABLED',\n] as const;\n\nfunction storeThatFails(error: unknown): SecretStore {\n  return {\n    kind: 'vault-kv2',\n    referenceFor: () => 'vault:secret/wlct/t/a/binance',\n    write: async () => undefined,\n    read: async () => {\n      throw error;\n    },\n    exists: async () => false,\n    destroy: async () => undefined,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction build(store: SecretStore | null) {\n  const prisma = {\n    tradingAccount: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(async () => ({\n        apiKeyCiphertext: null,\n        apiSecretCiphertext: null,\n        passphraseCiphertext: null,\n        credentialSource: 'SECRET_MANAGER',\n        credentialRef: 'vault:secret/wlct/t/a/binance',\n      })),\n    },\n  };\n  const credentials = new ExchangeCredentialService(prisma as any, {} as any, {} as any, store);\n  const providerFactory = {\n    validateEnvironmentBinding: jest.fn(),\n    getProvider: jest.fn(() => ({})),\n  };\n  const service = new ExchangeConnectivityService(\n    providerFactory as any,\n    {} as any,\n    credentials,\n    {} as any,\n    {} as any,\n  );\n  return { service };\n}\n\nconst check = (service: ExchangeConnectivityService) =>\n  service.checkConnectivity({\n    tenantId: TENANT,\n    accountId: ACCOUNT,\n    venue: ExchangeVenue.BINANCE,\n    environment: ExchangeEnvironment.TESTNET,\n  });\n\ndescribe('ExchangeConnectivityService - secret manager failure reasons', () => {\n  const saved: Record<string, string | undefined> = {};\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    for (const key of SECRET_ENV_KEYS) {\n      saved[key] = process.env[key];\n      delete process.env[key];\n    }\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => {\n    for (const key of SECRET_ENV_KEYS) {\n      if (saved[key] === undefined) delete process.env[key];\n      else process.env[key] = saved[key];\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('reports a store outage as unavailable with its HTTP status, not as unimplemented', async () => {\n    const { service } = build(\n      storeThatFails(\n        new SecretStoreError('UNAVAILABLE', 'read: secret manager unavailable (HTTP 503)', true),\n      ),\n    );\n\n    const result = await check(service);\n\n    expect(result.connected).toBe(false);\n Do not invent PnL when exchange provides validated values.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ExchangePositionSyncService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ExchangePositionSyncService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: ExchangeProviderFactory,\n    private readonly credentialService: ExchangeCredentialService,\n    private readonly accountRepo: ExchangeAccountRepository,\n    private readonly auditService: ExchangeAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private toDecimalString(value: string | number | null | undefined): string | null {\n    if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;\n    if (typeof value === 'string') {\n      if (!/^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/.test(value.trim())) {\n        if (value.trim() === '') return null;\n        this.logger.warn(`Invalid decimal string for position: ${value}`);\n        return null;\n      }\n      return value.trim();\n    }\n    this.logger.warn(`Position amount as number ${value} - should be string`);\n    return value.toString();\n  }\n\n  async syncPositions(input: { tenantId: string; accountId: string; venue: ExchangeVenue; environment: ExchangeEnvironment; actorId?: string; requestId?: string }): Promise<{ state: ExchangeSyncState; processed: number; created: number; updated: number; skipped: number; durationMs: number }> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n    const isSandbox = input.environment !== ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE;\n\n    const account = await this.accountRepo.findById(input.accountId, input.tenantId);\n    if (!account) throw new Error(`Account ${input.accountId} not found`);\n\n    let provider;\n    try {\n      provider = this.providerFactory.getProvider(input.venue, input.environment);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Provider unavailable for position sync tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${input.accountId} error=${e.message}`);\n      return { state: ExchangeSyncState.FAILED, processed: 0, created: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, durationMs: Date.now() - start };\n    }\n\n    let credentials;\n    try {\n      credentials = await this.credentialService.getDecryptedCredentialsForProvider(input.tenantId, input.accountId, input.venue, input.environment);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Credential unavailable for position sync tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${input.accountId} error=${e.message}`);\n      return { state: ExchangeSyncState.FAILED, processed: 0, created: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, durationMs: Date.now() - start };\n    }\n\n    const context: ExchangeProviderContext = {\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      accountId: input.accountId,\n      venue: input.venue,\n      environment: input.environment,\n      isSandbox,\n      credentials: {\n        apiKey: credentials.apiKey,\n        apiSecret: credentials.apiSecret,\n        passphrase: credentials.passphrase,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        isSandbox,\n      },\n      credentialRef: null,\n    };\n\n    let positions: ExchangePosition[];\n    try {\n      positions = await provider.getPositions(context);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to fetch positions tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${input.accountId} venue=${input.venue} error=${e.message}`);\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        accountId: input.accountId,\n        venue: input.venue,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        event: 'POSITION_SYNCED',\n        result: 'FAILURE',\n        actorId: input.actorId,\n        safeMetadata: { errorCode: e.code || 'FETCH_FAILED', isSandbox },\n        requestId: input.requestId,\n      });\n      return { state: ExchangeSyncState.FAILED, processed: 0, created: 0, updated: 0, skipped: 0, durationMs: Date.now() - start };\n    }\n\n    let created = 0;\n    let updated = 0;\n    let skipped = 0;\n\n    // For idempotency, we need to track providerPositionId or symbol+side\n    for (const pos of positions) {\n      try {\n        const quantity = this.toDecimalString(pos.quantity);\n        if (!quantity) {\n          skipped++;\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        const timestampMicros = normalizeTimestampMicros(pos.timestampMicros);\n\n        // Find existing position by accountId + symbol (unique per account+symbol per schema)\n        // TradingSymbol lookup required for position's symbolId\n        const symbolRecord = await this.prisma.tradingSymbol.findFirst({\n          where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, symbol: pos.symbol },\n          select: { id: true },\n        });\n\n        if (!symbolRecord) {\n          // If symbol not found, skip - do not create fake symbol\n          this.logger.warn(`Symbol not found for position sync tenant=${input.tenantId} symbol=${pos.symbol}`);\n          skipped++;\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        const existing = await this.prisma.position.findFirst({\n          where: { accountId: input.accountId, symbolId: symbolRecord.id },\n        });\n\n        const positionData = {\n          quantity: quantity as any,\n          side: pos.side as any,\n          averageEntryPrice: this.toDecimalString(pos.entryPrice) as any,\n          markPrice: this.toDecimalString(pos.markPrice) as any,\n          realisedPnl: this.toDecimalString(pos.realizedPnl) as any,\n          unrealisedPnl: this.toDecimalString(pos.unrealizedPnl) as any,\n          // cumulativeFee not in exchange position, keep existing or 0\n          containsSimulatedFills: pos.isSimulated,\n          lastFillAt: new Date(Number(BigInt(timestampMicros) / BigInt(1000))),\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n        };\n\n        if (existing) {\n          // Idempotent: check if same timestamp and same quantity - skip\n          const existingQty = existing.quantity.toString();\n          if (existingQty === quantity && existing.side === pos.side) {\n            // Check timestamp awareness - only update if newer\n            const existingLastFill = existing.lastFillAt ? existing.lastFillAt.getTime() : 0;\n            const newTime = Number(BigInt(timestampMicros) / BigInt(1000));\n            if (newTime <= existingLastFill) {\n              skipped++;\n              continue;\n            }\n          }\n\n          await this.prisma.position.update({\n            where: { id: existing.id },\n            data: positionData,\n          });\n          updated++;\n        } else {\n          // Only create if quantity non-zero (FLAT positions may be skipped per business rule, but we create for completeness)\n          if (quantity === '0' || pos.side === 'FLAT') {\n            skipped++;\n            continue;\n          }\n\n          await this.prisma.position.create({\n            data: {\n              id: randomUUID(),\n              tenantId: input.tenantId,\n              accountId: input.accountId,\n              symbolId: symbolRecord.id,\n              venue: input.venue as any,\n              symbol: pos.symbol,\n              quantity: quantity as any,\n              side: pos.side as any,\n              averageEntryPrice: this.toDecimalString(pos.entryPrice) as any,\n              markPrice: this.toDecimalString(pos.markPrice) as any,\n              realisedPnl: this.toDecimalString(pos.realizedPnl) as any || (0 as any),\n              unrealisedPnl: this.toDecimalString(pos.unrealizedPnl) as any,\n              cumulativeFee: 0 as any,\n              containsSimulatedFills: pos.isSimulated,\n              fillCount: 0,\n              openedAt: new Date(),\n              lastFillAt: new Date(Number(BigInt(timestampMicros) / BigInt(1000))),\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n              updatedAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n          created++;\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to sync position symbol=${pos.symbol} tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${input.accountId} error=${e.message}`);\n        skipped++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const durationMs = Date.now() - start;\n\n    await this.accountRepo.updateSyncMetadata(input.accountId, input.tenantId, { lastSyncAt: new Date() });\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      accountId: input.accountId,\n      venue: input.venue,\n      environment: input.environment,\n      event: 'POSITION_SYNCED',\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      actorId: input.actorId,\n      safeMetadata: { processed: positions.length, created, updated, skipped, durationMs, isSandbox },\n      requestId: input.requestId,\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Position sync completed tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${input.accountId} processed=${positions.length} created=${created} updated=${updated} skipped=${skipped}`);\n\n    return { state: ExchangeSyncState.COMPLETED, processed: positions.length, created, updated, skipped, durationMs };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/exchange-provider.factory.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/exchange-provider.interface.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected
