// 0-100\n}\n\nexport interface RateLimitCheckResult {\n  allowed: boolean;\n  remaining: number | null;\n  retryAfterMs: number | null;\n  pressure: number;\n  reason?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Normalizes exchange-specific rate limits and coordinates requests with existing rate-limit infrastructure without bypassing venue protections.\n * Do not replace existing Part 2 API rate-limit enforcement.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ExchangeRateLimitService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ExchangeRateLimitService.name);\n\n  // Venue-specific rate limit configs - authoritative\n  private readonly venueLimits: Map<ExchangeVenue, { requestsPerSecond: number; weightLimitPerMinute: number; isWeightBased: boolean }> = new Map([\n    [ExchangeVenue.BINANCE, { requestsPerSecond: 10, weightLimitPerMinute: 1200, isWeightBased: true }],\n    [ExchangeVenue.BYBIT, { requestsPerSecond: 10, weightLimitPerMinute: 600, isWeightBased: false }],\n    [ExchangeVenue.OKX, { requestsPerSecond: 10, weightLimitPerMinute: 600, isWeightBased: false }],\n    [ExchangeVenue.KRAKEN, { requestsPerSecond: 1, weightLimitPerMinute: 60, isWeightBased: false }],\n    [ExchangeVenue.COINBASE, { requestsPerSecond: 10, weightLimitPerMinute: 600, isWeightBased: false }],\n    [ExchangeVenue.OTHER_CONFIGURED, { requestsPerSecond: 5, weightLimitPerMinute: 300, isWeightBased: false }],\n  ]);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly cache: CacheService,\n    private readonly registry: ExchangeRegistryService,\n    private readonly auditService: ExchangeAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * The budget key names the tenant first.\n   *\n   * It did not, so two tenants routing to the same venue with no account selected shared one\n   * `global` bucket: one tenant's traffic consumed another tenant's budget, and a busy tenant could\n   * rate-limit a quiet one out of its own orders. In a white-label deployment that is a\n   * cross-tenant defect, not a tuning detail.\n   */\n  private getCacheKey(\n    tenantId: string,\n    venue: ExchangeVenue,\n    environment: ExchangeEnvironment,\n    accountId: string | null,\n    endpointClass: string,\n  ): string {\n    return `exchange:ratelimit:${tenantId}:${venue}:${environment}:${accountId || 'global'}:${endpointClass}`;\n  }\n\n  private getVenueLimit(venue: ExchangeVenue): { requestsPerSecond: number; weightLimitPerMinute: number; isWeightBased: boolean } {\n    return this.venueLimits.get(venue) || { requestsPerSecond: 5, weightLimitPerMinute: 300, isWeightBased: false };\n  }\n\n  async checkRateLimit(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    venue: ExchangeVenue;\n    environment: ExchangeEnvironment;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    endpointClass: string;\n    weight?: number;\n  }): Promise<RateLimitCheckResult> {\n    const venueLimit = this.getVenueLimit(input.venue);\n    const weight = input.weight === undefined || input.weight === null ? 1 : input.weight;\n\n    // A weight that is not a positive integer is not a request. It used to be coerced with `|| 1`,\n    // which turned 0 into 1 and silently dropped the fractional part of 1.5, so a caller asking for a\n    // heavier endpoint was charged for a lighter one and the budget under-counted.\n    if (!Number.isInteger(weight) || weight < 1) {\n      return { allowed: false, remaining: null, retryAfterMs: null, pressure: 100, reason: 'Rate-limit request weight is invalid' };\n    }\n\n    const key = this.getCacheKey(input.tenantId, input.venue, input.environment, input.accountId || null, input.endpointClass);\n    const maxRequests = this.maxRequestsFor(venueLimit, input.endpointClass);\n    const windowSeconds = 60;\n\n    let reservedUsage: number;\n    try {\n      // Reserve first, decide second, in one atomic increment. Checking and then recording is two\n      // steps with a gap: concurrent requests all read the same usage, all conclude they fit, and the\n      // venue is the one that finds out otherwise.\n      reservedUsage = await this.cache.incrementBy(key, weight, windowSeconds);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      // Fail closed. The budget could not be read, so whether this request is within the venue's\n      // limit is unknown - and the consequence of guessing \"yes\" is the venue throttling or banning\n      // the API key, which stops every copy for every follower on that account. A refusal that is\n      // retried costs a moment; a ban costs the account.\n      this.logger.error(`Rate limit reservation failed venue=${input.venue} tenant=${input.tenantId} error=${e.message} - denying request`);\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        accountId: input.accountId || 'global',\n        venue: input.venue,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        event: 'RATE_LIMIT_STATE_UNAVAILABLE',\n        result: 'FAILURE',\n        safeMetadata: { endpointClass: input.endpointClass, weight, maxRequests },\n      });\n      return { allowed: false, remaining: null, retryAfterMs: 1000, pressure: 100, reason: `Rate limit state unavailable for ${input.venue} ${input.endpointClass}` };\n    }\n\n    const pressure = Math.min(100, Math.floor((reservedUsage / maxRequests) * 100));\n\n    if (reservedUsage > maxRequests) {\n      // Hand the reservation back. The request is refused, so it did not consume budget, and leaving\n      // the weight charged would let one burst of refusals exhaust the window for the requests that\n      // are still allowed.\n      try {\n        await this.cache.incrementBy(key, -weight, windowSeconds);\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Rate limit refund failed venue=${input.venue} tenant=${input.tenantId} error=${e.message}`);\n      }\n\n      this.logger.warn(`Rate limit exceeded venue=${input.venue} env=${input.environment} account=${input.accountId} endpoint=${input.endpointClass} usage=${reservedUsage}/${maxRequests}`);\n\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        accountId: input.accountId || 'global',\n        venue: input.venue,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        event: 'RATE_LIMIT_TRIGGERED',\n        result: 'SUCCESS',\n        safeMetadata: { endpointClass: input.endpointClass, currentUsage: reservedUsage, maxRequests, pressure, retryAfterMs: 1000 },\n      });\n\n      return { allowed: false, remaining: 0, retryAfterMs: 1000, pressure, reason: `Rate limit exceeded for ${input.venue} ${input.endpointClass}` };\n    }\n\n    const remaining = Math.max(0, maxRequests - reservedUsage);\n    return { allowed: true, remaining, retryAfterMs: null, pressure };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The per-minute budget for an endpoint class: the venue's own limit, halved for order placement\n   * and reduced to 80% for private endpoints, so the account keeps headroom for cancellations and\n   * reconciliation instead of spending the venue's whole allowance on new orders.\n   */\n  private maxRequestsFor(\n    venueLimit: { requestsPerSecond: number; weightLimitPerMinute: number; isWeightBased: boolean },\n    endpointClass: string,\n  ): number {\n    const base = venueLimit.isWeightBased ? venueLimit.weightLimitPerMinute : venueLimit.requestsPerSecond * 60;\n    if (endpointClass === 'ORDER') return Math.max(1, Math.floor(base * 0.5));\n    if (endpointClass === 'PRIVATE') return Math.max(1, Math.floor(base * 0.8));\n    return base;\n  }\n\n  async recordRequest(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    venue: ExchangeVenue;\n    environment: ExchangeEnvironment;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    endpointClass: string;\n    weight?: number;\n    responseHeaders?: Record<string, string>;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const weight = input.weight || 1;\n    const key = this.getCacheKey(input.tenantId, input.venue, input.environment, input.accountId || null, input.endpointClass);\n\n    try {\n      // Increment usage counter with TTL\n      await this.cache.increment(key, 60);\n\n      // Parse response headers for remaining allowance if provided\n      if (input.responseHeaders) {\n        const remaining = this.parseRemainingFromHeaders(input.venue, input.responseHeaders);\n        const resetAt = this.parseResetFromHeaders(input.venue, input.responseHeaders);\n        const retryAfter = this.parseRetryAfterFromHeaders(input.responseHeaders);\n\n        if (remaining !== null || resetAt !== null || retryAfter !== null) {\n          const stateKey = `${key}:state`;\n          await this.cache.set(\n            stateKey,\n            {\n              remaining,\n              resetAtMs: resetAt,\n              retryAfterMs: retryAfter,\n              lastUpdated: Date.now(),\n            },\n            60,\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to record rate limit request venue=${input.venue} error=${e.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private parseRemainingFromHeaders(venue: ExchangeVenue, headers: Record<string, string>): number | null {\n    // Venue-specific header parsing\n    const lowerHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};\n    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(headers)) {\n      lowerHeaders[k.toLowerCase()] = v;\n    }\n\n    if (venue === ExchangeVenue.BINANCE) {\n      const usedWeight = lowerHeaders['x-mbx-used-weight'] || lowerHeaders['x-mbx-used-weight-1m'];\n      if (usedWeight) {\n        const limit = this.getVenueLimit(venue).weightLimitPerMinute;\n        return Math.max(0, limit - parseInt(usedWeight, 10));\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (venue === ExchangeVenue.BYBIT || venue === ExchangeVenue.OKX) {\n      // Bybit/OKX don't typically return remaining in headers, use our own tracking\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Generic fallback\n    const remaining = lowerHeaders['x-ratelimit-remaining'] || lowerHeaders['x-rate-limit-remaining'];\n    if (remaining) {\n      return parseInt(remaining, 10);\n    }\n\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  private parseResetFromHeaders(venue: ExchangeVenue, headers: Record<string, string>): number | null {\n    const lowerHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};\n    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(headers)) {\n      lowerHeaders[k.toLowerCase()] = v;\n    }\n\n    const reset = lowerHeaders['x-ratelimit-reset'] || lowerHeaders['x-rate-limit-reset'] || lowerHeaders['retry-after'];\n    if (reset) {\n      const resetSec = parseInt(reset, 10);\n      if (!isNaN(resetSec)) {\n        // If reset is seconds from now or timestamp\n        if (resetSec < 1000000000) {\n          return Date.now() + resetSec * 1000;\n        }\n        return resetSec * 1000;\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  private parseRetryAfterFromHeaders(headers: Record<string, string>): number | null {\n    const lowerHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};\n    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(headers)) {\n      lowerHeaders[k.toLowerCase()] = v;\n    }\n\n    const retryAfter = lowerHeaders['retry-after'];\n    if (retryAfter) {\n      const seconds = parseInt(retryAfter, 10);\n      if (!isNaN(seconds)) {\n        return seconds * 1000;\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The current budget state for an account. Requires the tenant: without it the key fell back to the\n   * shared `global` bucket, so an operator reading one tenant's pressure was reading every tenant's\n   * combined usage - and the number would have been wrong in whichever direction the neighbours were\n   * busier.\n   */\n  async getRateLimitState(input: { tenantId: string; venue: ExchangeVenue; environment: ExchangeEnvironment; accountId?: string | null; endpointClass: string }): Promise<RateLimitState | null> {\n    const key = this.getCacheKey(input.tenantId, input.venue, input.environment, input.accountId || null, input.endpointClass);\n    const stateKey = `${key}:state`;\n\n    try {\n      const currentUsage = (await this.cache.get<number>(key)) || 0;\n      const state = (await this.cache.get<any>(stateKey)) || {};\n\n      const venueLimit = this.getVenueLimit(input.venue);\n      const maxRequests = venueLimit.isWeightBased ? venueLimit.weightLimitPerMinute : venueLimit.requestsPerSecond * 60;\n      const pressure = Math.min(100, Math.floor((currentUsage / maxRequests) * 100));\n\n      return {\n        venue: input.venue,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        accountId: input.accountId || null,\n        endpointClass: input.endpointClass,\n        requestsPerInterval: venueLimit.requestsPerSecond,\n        intervalMs: 60000,\n        weightPerRequest: 1,\n        remaining: state.remaining ?? Math.max(0, maxRequests - currentUsage),\n        resetAtMs: state.resetAtMs || null,\n        retryAfterMs: state.retryAfterMs || null,\n        isWeightBased: venueLimit.isWeightBased,\n        scope: input.accountId ? 'ACCOUNT' : 'GLOBAL',\n        currentUsage,\n        pressure,\n      };\n    } catch {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  normalizeRateLimitResponse(venue: ExchangeVenue, error: any): { code: string; retryAfterMs: number | null; pressure: number } {\n    // Normalize venue-specific rate limit errors into safe internal format\n    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';\n    const status = error.status || error.statusCode || 0;\n\n    if (status === 429 || message.includes('rate limit') || message.includes('too many requests')) {\n      const retryAfter = error.retryAfterMs || this.parseRetryAfterFromHeaders(error.headers || {}) || 1000;\n      return { code: 'RATE_LIMITED', retryAfterMs: retryAfter, pressure: 90 };\n    }\n\n    if (status === 418 && venue === ExchangeVenue.BINANCE) {\n      // Binance IP ban\n      return { code: 'IP_BANNED', retryAfterMs: 60000, pressure: 100 };\n    }\n\n    return { code: 'UNKNOWN', retryAfterMs: null, pressure: 0 };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/exchange-registry.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/exchange-routing.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. // specific account requested\n  complianceAllowed?: boolean;\n  riskAllowed?: boolean;\n  actorId?: string;\n  requestId?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Determines eligible venue/account for read/market/trading operations based on capabilities, account state, environment, tenant policy, and existing live-mode safety gates.\n * CRITICAL: This service MUST call existing live safety gate for live trading. It must never independently decide \"live=true → place order\"\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ExchangeRoutingService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ExchangeRoutingService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly accountRepo: ExchangeAccountRepository,\n    private readonly healthService: ExchangeHealthService,\n    private readonly rateLimitService: ExchangeRateLimitService,\n    private readonly registry: ExchangeRegistryService,\n    private readonly safetyService: ExecutionSafetyService,\n    private readonly auditService: ExchangeAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async route(input: RoutingInput): Promise<ExchangeRoutingDecision> {\n    // 1. Tenant cannot access another tenant's exchange account - enforced via repo tenantId filter\n    // 2. List eligible accounts for tenant\n    const { data: accounts } = await this.accountRepo.listByTenant(input.tenantId, {\n      userId: input.userId,\n      environment: input.environment,\n      status: ExchangeAccountState.ACTIVE,\n      limit: 100,\n    });\n\n    // If specific account requested, filter to that account and verify ownership\n    let eligible = accounts;\n    if (input.accountId) {\n      eligible = accounts.filter((a) => a.id === input.accountId);\n      if (eligible.length === 0) {\n        // Check if account exists in other tenant - if so, reject with generic not found to avoid enumeration\n        const exists = await this.prisma.tradingAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: input.accountId } });\n        if (exists && exists.tenantId !== input.tenantId) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Cross-tenant access attempt tenant=${input.tenantId} requestedAccount=${input.accountId} actualTenant=${exists.tenantId}`);\n          await this.auditService.record({\n            tenantId: input.tenantId,\n            accountId: input.accountId,\n            venue: ExchangeVenue.BINANCE,\n            environment: input.environment,\n            event: 'ROUTING_DECISION',\n            result: 'FAILURE',\n            actorId: input.actorId,\n            safeMetadata: { reason: 'CROSS_TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED', requestedAccountId: input.accountId },\n            requestId: input.requestId,\n          });\n          return {\n            selectedAccountId: null,\n            selectedVenue: null,\n            environment: input.environment,\n            eligibleAccounts: [],\n            routingReason: 'CROSS_TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED',\n            capabilities: [],\n            health: null,\n            liveExecutionPermitted: false,\n            liveGateBlockingReasons: ['Cross-tenant access denied'],\n            complianceAllowed: false,\n            riskAllowed: false,\n          };\n        }\n\n        return {\n          selectedAccountId: null,\n          selectedVenue: null,\n          environment: input.environment,\n          eligibleAccounts: [],\n          routingReason: 'ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_ACTIVE',\n          capabilities: [],\n          health: null,\n          liveExecutionPermitted: false,\n          liveGateBlockingReasons: ['Account not found or not active'],\n          complianceAllowed: input.complianceAllowed ?? true,\n          riskAllowed: input.riskAllowed ?? true,\n        };\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 3. Routing respects capability requirements\n    const capabilityFiltered = eligible.filter((a) => {\n      // Check if account capabilities include required capability\n      // If capabilities empty (not yet discovered), fallback to registry\n      if (a.capabilities && a.capabilities.length > 0) {\n        return a.capabilities.includes(input.requiredCapability);\n      }\n      const registryCaps = this.registry.listCapabilities(a.venue);\n      return registryCaps.includes(input.requiredCapability);\n    });\n\n    if (capabilityFiltered.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        selectedAccountId: null,\n        selectedVenue: null,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        eligibleAccounts: eligible.map((a) => a.id),\n        routingReason: `NO_ACCOUNT_WITH_CAPABILITY_${input.requiredCapability}`,\n        capabilities: [],\n        health: null,\n        liveExecutionPermitted: false,\n        liveGateBlockingReasons: [`No account with capability ${input.requiredCapability}`],\n        complianceAllowed: input.complianceAllowed ?? true,\n        riskAllowed: input.riskAllowed ?? true,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // 4. Environment separation: testnet cannot route to live, live cannot route to testnet - fail closed\n    const envFiltered = capabilityFiltered.filter((a) => {\n      if (input.environment === ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE) {\n        return a.environment === ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE && !a.isSandbox;\n      } else {\n        return a.environment !== ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE && a.isSandbox;\n      }\n    });\n\n    if (envFiltered.length === 0) {\n      const reason = input.environment === ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE ? 'LIVE_CANNOT_ROUTE_TO_TESTNET' : 'TESTNET_CANNOT_ROUTE_TO_LIVE';\n      return {\n        selectedAccountId: null,\n        selectedVenue: null,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        eligibleAccounts: capabilityFiltered.map((a) => a.id),\n        routingReason: reason,\n        capabilities: [],\n        health: null,\n        liveExecutionPermitted: false,\n        liveGateBlockingReasons: [reason],\n        complianceAllowed: input.complianceAllowed ?? true,\n        riskAllowed: input.riskAllowed ?? true,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // 5. Routing respects account health\n    const healthyAccounts: { account: any; health: any }[] = [];\n    for (const account of envFiltered) {\n      try {\n        const health = await this.healthService.getHealth(input.tenantId, account.id);\n        if (!health) continue;\n\n        // Skip AUTH_FAILED, UNAVAILABLE, STALE for live operations\n        if (input.operation === 'TRADE') {\n          if (!this.healthService.isStaleHealthAllowsLiveTrading(health)) {\n            this.logger.warn(`Account unhealthy for live trading tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${account.id} health=${health.state}`);\n            continue;\n          }\n        } else {\n          // For read operations, allow DEGRADED but not AUTH_FAILED/UNAVAILABLE\n          if (health.state === ExchangeHealthState.AUTH_FAILED || health.state === ExchangeHealthState.UNAVAILABLE) {\n            continue;\n          }\n        }\n\n        healthyAccounts.push({ account, health });\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Health check failed for routing tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${account.id} error=${e.message}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (healthyAccounts.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        selectedAccountId: null,\n        selectedVenue: null,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        eligibleAccounts: envFiltered.map((a) => a.id),\n        routingReason: 'NO_HEALTHY_ACCOUNT',\n        capabilities: [],\n        health: null,\n        liveExecutionPermitted: false,\n        liveGateBlockingReasons: ['No healthy account available'],\n        complianceAllowed: input.complianceAllowed ?? true,\n        riskAllowed: input.riskAllowed ?? true,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // 6. Routing respects compliance restrictions\n    if (input.complianceAllowed === false) {\n      return {\n        selectedAccountId: null,\n        selectedVenue: null,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        eligibleAccounts: healthyAccounts.map((h) => h.account.id),\n        routingReason: 'COMPLIANCE_BLOCKED',\n        capabilities: [],\n        health: null,\n        liveExecutionPermitted: false,\n        liveGateBlockingReasons: ['Compliance blocked'],\n        complianceAllowed: false,\n        riskAllowed: input.riskAllowed ?? true,\n      };\n    }\n\n    if (input.riskAllowed === false) {\n      return {\n        selectedAccountId: null,\n        selectedVenue: null,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        eligibleAccounts: healthyAccounts.map((h) => h.account.id),\n        routingReason: 'RISK_BLOCKED',\n        capabilities: [],\n        health: null,\n        liveExecutionPermitted: false,\n        liveGateBlockingReasons: ['Risk blocked'],\n        complianceAllowed: true,\n        riskAllowed: false,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // 7. Rate-limit availability\n    //\n    // Two different refusals arrive here and they are not the same news. A budget that is spent says\n    // \"wait\"; a budget that could not be read says \"we do not know\", and the difference decides\n    // whether an operator should expect traffic to resume on its own. The reason is carried out in\n    // the routing decision instead of being flattened into \"rate limited\".\n    const rateLimitEligible: { account: any; health: any }[] = [];\n    let rateLimitStateUnavailable = false;\n    for (const { account, health } of healthyAccounts) {\n      try {\n        const rateLimitCheck = await this.rateLimitService.checkRateLimit({\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          venue: account.venue,\n          environment: account.environment,\n          accountId: account.id,\n          endpointClass: input.operation === 'TRADE' ? 'ORDER' : input.operation === 'READ' ? 'PRIVATE' : 'PUBLIC',\n        });\n\n        if (!rateLimitCheck.allowed) {\n          // `remaining === null` is the rate-limit service saying it could not establish the budget.\n          if (rateLimitCheck.remaining === null) {\n            rateLimitStateUnavailable = true;\n            this.logger.warn(`Rate limit state unavailable for routing tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${account.id} reason=${rateLimitCheck.reason}`);\n          } else {\n            this.logger.warn(`Rate limited for routing tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${account.id} pressure=${rateLimitCheck.pressure}`);\n          }\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        rateLimitEligible.push({ account, health });\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // Fail closed. An account whose exchange budget could not be established is not a safe target:\n        // routing to it risks the venue throttling or banning the API key, which stops every copy on\n        // that account rather than one request. It used to be pushed into the eligible list here.\n        rateLimitStateUnavailable = true;\n        this.logger.warn(`Rate-limit evaluation failed for routing tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${account.id} error=${error?.message} - account excluded`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (rateLimitEligible.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        selectedAccountId: null,\n        selectedVenue: null,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        eligibleAccounts: healthyAccounts.map((h) => h.account.id),\n        routingReason: rateLimitStateUnavailable ? 'RATE_LIMIT_STATE_UNAVAILABLE' : 'ALL_ACCOUNTS_RATE_LIMITED',\n        capabilities: [],\n        health: null,\n        liveExecutionPermitted: false,\n        liveGateBlockingReasons: [\n          rateLimitStateUnavailable\n            ? 'Exchange rate-limit state unavailable; refusing to route rather than risk a venue ban'\n            : 'All accounts rate limited',\n        ],\n        complianceAllowed: true,\n        riskAllowed: true,\n      };\n    }\n\n    // 8. Select best account - lowest latency, healthy, etc.\n    // Sort by health state HEALTHY first, then latency, then last verified\n    rateLimitEligible.sort((a, b) => {\n      const healthOrder: Record<string, number> = {\n        [ExchangeHealthState.HEALTHY]: 0,\n        [ExchangeHealthState.DEGRADED]: 1,\n        [ExchangeHealthState.RATE_LIMITED]: 2,\n        [ExchangeHealthState.STALE]: 3,\n        [ExchangeHealthState.UNAVAILABLE]: 4,\n        [ExchangeHealthState.AUTH_FAILED]: 5,\n      };\n      const aOrder = healthOrder[a.health.state] ?? 10;\n      const bOrder = healthOrder[b.health.state] ?? 10;\n      if (aOrder !== bOrder) return aOrder - bOrder;\n      const aLatency = a.health.latencyMs || 9999;\n      const bLatency = b.health.latencyMs || 9999;\n      return aLatency - bLatency;\n    });\n\n    const selected = rateLimitEligible[0];\n    const selectedAccount = selected.account;\n    const selectedHealth = selected.health;\n\n    // 9. Routing invokes existing live enablement gate for live trading\n    let liveExecutionPermitted = false;\n    let liveGateBlockingReasons: string[] = [];\n\n    if (input.environment === ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE && input.operation === 'TRADE') {\n      try {\n        const safety = await this.safetyService.safetySummary(input.tenantId);\n        liveExecutionPermitted = safety.wouldTransmitLiveOrder && selectedAccount.liveTradingEnabled;\n        liveGateBlockingReasons = safety.blockingReasons;\n        if (!selectedAccount.liveTradingEnabled) {\n          liveGateBlockingReasons.push('Account liveTradingEnabled is false');\n          liveExecutionPermitted = false;\n        }\n        if (!liveExecutionPermitted) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Live execution not permitted tenant=${input.tenantId} account=${selectedAccount.id} reasons=${liveGateBlockingReasons.join(', ')}`);\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.error(`Failed to check live gate tenant=${input.tenantId} error=${e.message}`);\n        liveExecutionPermitted = false;\n        liveGateBlockingReasons = ['Live gate check failed - fail closed'];\n      }\n    } else if (input.environment !== ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE) {\n      // Testnet/sandbox never permits live execution\n      liveExecutionPermitted = false;\n      liveGateBlockingReasons = [`Environment ${input.environment} is not LIVE - live execution never permitted`];\n    } else if (input.operation !== 'TRADE') {\n      // Read operations don't need live gate\n      liveExecutionPermitted = false;\n      liveGateBlockingReasons = ['Read operation - live execution not applicable'];\n    }\n\n    const decision: ExchangeRoutingDecision = {\n      selectedAccountId: selectedAccount.id,\n      selectedVenue: selectedAccount.venue,\n      environment: selectedAccount.environment,\n      eligibleAccounts: rateLimitEligible.map((r) => r.account.id),\n      routingReason: `SELECTED_${selectedAccount.venue}_HEALTH_${selectedHealth.state}_LATENCY_${selectedHealth.latencyMs || 'unknown'}`,\n      capabilities: selectedAccount.capabilities || this.registry.listCapabilities(selectedAccount.venue),\n      health: selectedHealth.state,\n      liveExecutionPermitted,\n      liveGateBlockingReasons,\n      complianceAllowed: true,\n      riskAllowed: true,\n    };\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      accountId: selectedAccount.id,\n      venue: selectedAccount.venue,\n      environment: selectedAccount.environment,\n      event: 'ROUTING_DECISION',\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      actorId: input.actorId,\n      safeMetadata: {\n        operation: input.operation,\n        symbol: input.symbol,\n        requiredCapability: input.requiredCapability,\n        selectedAccountId: selectedAccount.id,\n        selectedVenue: selectedAccount.venue,\n        routingReason: decision.routingReason,\n        liveExecutionPermitted,\n        liveGateBlockingReasons,\n        eligibleCount: eligible.length,\n        healthyCount: healthyAccounts.length,\n        rateLimitEligibleCount: rateLimitEligible.length,\n      },\n      requestId: input.requestId,\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Routing decision tenant=${input.tenantId} operation=${input.operation} selected=${selectedAccount.id} venue=${selectedAccount.venue} livePermitted=${liveExecutionPermitted}`);\n\n    return decision;\n  }\n\n  async getEligibleAccountsForSymbol(tenantId: string, userId: string, symbol: string, environment: ExchangeEnvironment): Promise<string[]> {\n    const { data } = await this.accountRepo.listByTenant(tenantId, { userId, environment, status: ExchangeAccountState.ACTIVE, limit: 100 });\n    // Further filter by symbol support - would check TradingSymbol table\n    const eligible: string[] = [];\n    for (const account of data) {\n      try {\n        const symbolExists = await this.prisma.tradingSymbol.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, symbol } });\n        if (symbolExists) eligible.push(account.id);\n      } catch {}\n    }\n    return eligible;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/exchange-symbol.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected Never guess exchange precision.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ExchangeSymbolService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ExchangeSymbolService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: ExchangeProviderFactory,\n    private readonly credentialService: ExchangeCredentialService,\n    private readonly accountRepo: ExchangeAccountRepository,\n    private readonly cache: CacheService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private toCanonicalSymbol(base: string, quote: string): string {\n    // Canonical format: BTC-USDT\n    return `${base.toUpperCase()}-${quote.toUpperCase()}`;\n  }\n\n  private parseSymbolFromExchangeFormat(venue: ExchangeVenue, exchangeSymbol: string): { base: string; quote: string } | null {\n    // Venue-specific parsing - must use provider metadata, never guess blindly\n    // But we implement basic parsing as fallback when provider metadata unavailable\n    try {\n      if (venue === ExchangeVenue.BINANCE || venue === ExchangeVenue.BYBIT) {\n        // BTCUSDT -> BTC + USDT (need to know quote assets)\n        const quotes = ['USDT', 'BUSD', 'USDC', 'BTC', 'ETH', 'BNB', 'USD', 'EUR'];\n        for (const q of quotes) {\n          if (exchangeSymbol.endsWith(q)) {\n            const base = exchangeSymbol.slice(0, -q.length);\n            if (base) return { base, quote: q };\n          }\n        }\n        return null;\n      }\n\n      if (venue === ExchangeVenue.OKX || venue === ExchangeVenue.COINBASE) {\n        // BTC-USDT or BTC-USD\n        const parts = exchangeSymbol.split('-');\n        if (parts.length === 2) return { base: parts[0], quote: parts[1] };\n        return null;\n      }\n\n      if (venue === ExchangeVenue.KRAKEN) {\n        // XBT/USD, XXBTZUSD or the altname XBTUSD; legacy asset codes are\n        // normalized (XBT -> BTC, ZUSD -> USD) so the canonical symbol matches\n        // the other venues.\n        return krakenPairParts(exchangeSymbol);\n      }\n\n      // Generic fallback: try dash, slash, then assume last 4 chars are quote\n      if (exchangeSymbol.includes('-')) {\n        const [b, q] = exchangeSymbol.split('-');\n        return { base: b, quote: q };\n      }\n      if (exchangeSymbol.includes('/')) {\n        const [b, q] = exchangeSymbol.split('/');\n        return { base: b, quote: q };\n      }\n      return null;\n    } catch {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async syncSymbols(input: { tenantId: string; accountId: string; venue: ExchangeVenue; environment: ExchangeEnvironment }): Promise<{ synced: number; created: number; updated: number }> {\n    const isSandbox = input.environment !== ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE;\n\n    let provider;\n    try {\n      provider = this.providerFactory.getProvider(input.venue, input.environment);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Provider unavailable for symbol sync tenant=${input.tenantId} venue=${input.venue} error=${e.message}`);\n      return { synced: 0, created: 0, updated: 0 };\n    }\n\n    let credentials;\n    try {\n      credentials = await this.credentialService.getDecryptedCredentialsForProvider(input.tenantId, input.accountId, input.venue, input.environment);\n    } catch {\n      // Symbols can often be fetched without auth - try with empty creds\n      credentials = { apiKey: '', apiSecret: '' } as any;\n    }\n\n    const context: ExchangeProviderContext = {\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      accountId: input.accountId,\n      venue: input.venue,\n      environment: input.environment,\n      isSandbox,\n      credentials: {\n        apiKey: credentials.apiKey,\n        apiSecret: credentials.apiSecret,\n        passphrase: (credentials as any).passphrase,\n        environment: input.environment,\n        isSandbox,\n      },\n      credentialRef: null,\n    };\n\n    let symbols: ExchangeSymbol[];\n    try {\n      symbols = await provider.getSymbols(context);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to fetch symbols tenant=${input.tenantId} venue=${input.venue} error=${e.message}`);\n      return { synced: 0, created: 0, updated: 0 };\n    }\n\n    let created = 0;\n    let updated = 0;\n\n    for (const sym of symbols) {\n      try {\n        // Symbol precision comes from provider metadata - never guess\n        if (!sym.tickSize || !sym.quantityStep) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Skipping symbol with missing precision tenant=${input.tenantId} symbol=${sym.exchangeSymbol}`);\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        const existing = await this.prisma.tradingSymbol.findFirst({\n          where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, exchangeId: (await this.getExchangeId(input.venue)), symbol: sym.canonicalSymbol },\n        });\n\n        if (existing) {\n          await this.prisma.tradingSymbol.update({\n            where: { id: existing.id },\n            data: {\n              venueSymbol: sym.exchangeSymbol,\n              baseAsset: sym.baseAsset,\n              quoteAsset: sym.quoteAsset,\n              priceTick: sym.tickSize as any,\n              quantityStep: sym.quantityStep as any,\n              minQuantity: sym.minQuantity as any,\n              maxQuantity: sym.maxQuantity as any,\n              minNotional: sym.minNotional as any,\n              pricePrecision: sym.pricePrecision,\n              quantityPrecision: sym.quantityPrecision,\n              isTradeable: sym.isTradeable,\n              updatedAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n          updated++;\n        } else {\n          const exchangeId = await this.getExchangeId(input.venue);\n          await this.prisma.tradingSymbol.create({\n            data: {\n              id: randomUUID(),\n              tenantId: input.tenantId,\n              exchangeId,\n              symbol: sym.canonicalSymbol,\n              venueSymbol: sym.exchangeSymbol,\n              baseAsset: sym.baseAsset,\n              quoteAsset: sym.quoteAsset,\n              marketType: (sym.contractType as any) || 'SPOT',\n              isTradeable: sym.isTradeable,\n              isSubscribed: false,\n              priceTick: sym.tickSize as any,\n              quantityStep: sym.quantityStep as any,\n              minQuantity: sym.minQuantity as any || (0 as any),\n              maxQuantity: sym.maxQuantity as any,\n              minNotional: sym.minNotional as any || (0 as any),\n              pricePrecision: sym.pricePrecision,\n              quantityPrecision: sym.quantityPrecision,\n              createdAt: new Date(),\n              updatedAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          });\n          created++;\n        }\n\n        // Cache symbol for fast lookup\n        try {\n          await this.cache.set(`symbol:${input.tenantId}:${sym.canonicalSymbol}`, sym, 3600);\n          await this.cache.set(`symbol:${input.tenantId}:${sym.exchangeSymbol}`, sym, 3600);\n        } catch {}\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to sync symbol ${sym.exchangeSymbol} tenant=${input.tenantId} error=${e.message}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`Symbol sync completed tenant=${input.tenantId} venue=${input.venue} synced=${symbols.length} created=${created} updated=${updated}`);\n\n    return { synced: symbols.length, created, updated };\n  }\n\n  async getSymbol(tenantId: string, canonicalSymbol: string): Promise<ExchangeSymbol | null> {\n    try {\n      const cached = await this.cache.get<ExchangeSymbol>(`symbol:${tenantId}:${canonicalSymbol}`);\n      if (cached) return cached;\n    } catch {}\n\n    const record = await this.prisma.tradingSymbol.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, symbol: canonicalSymbol },\n    });\n\n    if (!record) return null;\n\n    return {\n      canonicalSymbol: record.symbol,\n      exchangeSymbol: record.venueSymbol,\n      baseAsset: record.baseAsset,\n      quoteAsset: record.quoteAsset,\n      contractType: record.marketType as any,\n      tickSize: record.priceTick.toString(),\n      quantityStep: record.quantityStep.toString(),\n      minQuantity: record.minQuantity?.toString() || null,\n      maxQuantity: record.maxQuantity?.toString() || null,\n      minNotional: record.minNotional?.toString() || null,\n      maxNotional: (record as any).maxOrderNotional?.toString() || null,\n      pricePrecision: record.pricePrecision,\n      quantityPrecision: record.quantityPrecision,\n      minLeverage: null,\n      maxLeverage: null,\n      isTradeable: record.isTradeable,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async listSymbols(tenantId: string, filters?: { baseAsset?: string; quoteAsset?: string; isTradeable?: boolean; search?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: ExchangeSymbol[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = Math.min(filters?.limit || 50, 200);\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n    const where: any = {\n      tenantId,\n      ...(filters?.baseAsset ? { baseAsset: filters.baseAsset } : {}),\n      ...(filters?.quoteAsset ? { quoteAsset: filters.quoteAsset } : {}),\n      ...(filters?.isTradeable !== undefined ? { isTradeable: filters.isTradeable } : {}),\n      ...(filters?.search ? { symbol: { contains: filters.search, mode: 'insensitive' } } : {}),\n    };\n\n    const [rows, total] = await this.prisma.$transaction([\n      this.prisma.tradingSymbol.findMany({ where, orderBy: { symbol: 'asc' }, skip, take: limit }),\n      this.prisma.tradingSymbol.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n\n    const data = rows.map((r) => ({\n      canonicalSymbol: r.symbol,\n      exchangeSymbol: r.venueSymbol,\n      baseAsset: r.baseAsset,\n      quoteAsset: r.quoteAsset,\n      contractType: r.marketType as any,\n      tickSize: r.priceTick.toString(),\n      quantityStep: r.quantityStep.toString(),\n      minQuantity: r.minQuantity?.toString() || null,\n      maxQuantity: r.maxQuantity?.toString() || null,\n      minNotional: r.minNotional?.toString() || null,\n      maxNotional: (r as any).maxOrderNotional?.toString() || null,\n      pricePrecision: r.pricePrecision,\n      quantityPrecision: r.quantityPrecision,\n      minLeverage: null,\n      maxLeverage: null,\n      isTradeable: r.isTradeable,\n    }));\n\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  private async getExchangeId(venue: ExchangeVenue): Promise<string> {\n    const exchange = await this.prisma.exchange.findFirst({ where: { venue: venue as any } });\n    if (!exchange) throw new Error(`Exchange ${venue} not found`);\n    return exchange.id;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/exchange.types.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/exchanges.controller.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/exchanges.module.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/providers/base-exchange-provider.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/providers/bybit.provider.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected Specify a different type.","line":376,"column":57,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":376,"endColumn":60,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[16573,16576],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[16573,16576],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":15,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Implements signed V5 live REST/account/symbol/health probes when live trading enabled\nimport * as crypto from 'crypto';\nimport {\n  ExchangeVenue,\n  ExchangeEnvironment,\n  ExchangeCapability,\n  ExchangeOrderType,\n  ExchangeBalance,\n  ExchangePosition,\n  ExchangeOrder,\n  ExchangeFill,\n  ExchangeSymbol,\n  ExchangeCapabilityDiscovery,\n  ExchangePositionSide,\n  ExchangeOrderStatus,\n  ExchangeOrderSide,\n  ExchangeConnectivityResult,\n} from '../exchange.types';\nimport {\n  ExchangeProviderError,\n  ExchangeProviderErrorCode,\n  ExchangeProviderContext,\n  ExchangeServerTime,\n  ExchangeAccountMetadata,\n} from '../exchange-provider.interface';\nimport {\n  BaseExchangeProvider,\n  subtractDecimalStrings,\n  absDecimalString,\n  isDecimalString,\n  msToMicros,\n  nowMicros,\n  precisionOfStep,\n  canonicalFromConcatenated,\n} from '../base-exchange-provider';\n\n/** Categories this provider reads. Spot plus USDT/USDC-settled linear contracts. */\ntype BybitCategory = 'spot' | 'linear';\n\nconst RECV_WINDOW = '5000';\nconst MAX_PAGES = 10;\n\nfunction dec(value: unknown): string {\n  return isDecimalString(value) ? value : '0';\n}\n\nfunction decOrNull(value: unknown): string | null {\n  return isDecimalString(value) && value !== '' ? value : null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Bybit V5 unified API, read side: server time, key permissions, wallet,\n * positions, open orders, order history, executions and instruments.\n *\n * Authentication (V5): `X-BAPI-SIGN = hex(HMAC_SHA256(secret, timestamp + apiKey + recvWindow + queryString))`.\n * Every response is an envelope `{ retCode, retMsg, result }`; a non-zero\n * retCode is a venue refusal and is classified, never read as an empty list.\n * This provider places no orders - order transmission belongs to the execution\n * engine behind the live-mode gate.\n */\nexport class BybitProvider extends BaseExchangeProvider {\n  readonly venue = ExchangeVenue.BYBIT;\n  readonly displayName: string;\n  readonly supportedEnvironments: ExchangeEnvironment[] = [ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE, ExchangeEnvironment.TESTNET, ExchangeEnvironment.SANDBOX];\n  readonly supportedCapabilities: ExchangeCapability[] = [\n    ExchangeCapability.SPOT,\n    ExchangeCapability.PERPETUALS,\n    ExchangeCapability.MARKET_DATA,\n    ExchangeCapability.BALANCES,\n    ExchangeCapability.POSITIONS,\n    ExchangeCapability.ORDERS,\n    ExchangeCapability.TRADES,\n    ExchangeCapability.TESTNET,\n  ];\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly urls: { liveRest: string; testnetRest: string; sandboxRest: string; liveWs: string; testnetWs: string; sandboxWs: string },\n    displayName = 'Bybit',\n  ) {\n    super();\n    this.displayName = displayName;\n  }\n\n  protected getLiveRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveRest;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.testnetRest;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxRest;\n  }\n  protected getLiveWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveWs;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.testnetWs;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxWs;\n  }\n\n  /** Exposed for tests: the exact V5 signature over the canonical payload. */\n  static sign(secret: string, timestamp: string, apiKey: string, recvWindow: string, queryString: string): string {\n    return crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(timestamp + apiKey + recvWindow + queryString).digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  private buildQuery(params: Record<string, string | number | undefined>): string {\n    return Object.entries(params)\n      .filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== '')\n      .map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`)\n      .join('&');\n  }\n\n  private unwrap(context: ExchangeProviderContext, data: any): any {\n    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, 'Bybit returned a non-JSON body', context.venue, context.environment, true);\n    }\n    const code = Number(data.retCode);\n    if (code === 0) return data.result ?? {};\n    const message = `Bybit retCode ${data.retCode}: ${String(data.retMsg ?? '').slice(0, 200)}`;\n    if ([10003, 10004, 33004, 10007].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.AUTH_FAILED, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n    }\n    if ([10005, 10010].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.PERMISSION_DENIED, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n    }\n    if (code === 10002) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.CLOCK_DRIFT, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    if ([10006, 10018, 10429].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.RATE_LIMITED, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    if (code === 10001) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.INVALID_ORDER, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n    }\n    if (code === 10016) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.SERVER_ERROR, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n  }\n\n  private async publicGet(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {}): Promise<any> {\n    const query = this.buildQuery(params);\n    const url = `${this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(context.environment)}${path}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`;\n    try {\n      return this.unwrap(context, await this.httpGet(url));\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async privateGet(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {}): Promise<any> {\n    this.requireCredentials(context);\n    const query = this.buildQuery(params);\n    const timestamp = Date.now().toString();\n    const signature = BybitProvider.sign(context.credentials.apiSecret, timestamp, context.credentials.apiKey, RECV_WINDOW, query);\n    const url = `${this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(context.environment)}${path}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`;\n    try {\n      const data = await this.httpGet(url, {\n        'X-BAPI-API-KEY': context.credentials.apiKey,\n        'X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP': timestamp,\n        'X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW': RECV_WINDOW,\n        'X-BAPI-SIGN': signature,\n      });\n      return this.unwrap(context, data);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Follows `nextPageCursor` up to MAX_PAGES pages, concatenating `result.list`. */\n  private async privateList(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined>, maxItems: number): Promise<any[]> {\n    const rows: any[] = [];\n    let cursor: string | undefined;\n    for (let page = 0; page < MAX_PAGES && rows.length < maxItems; page += 1) {\n      const result = await this.privateGet(context, path, { ...params, cursor });\n      const list = Array.isArray(result?.list) ? result.list : [];\n      rows.push(...list);\n      cursor = typeof result?.nextPageCursor === 'string' && result.nextPageCursor !== '' ? result.nextPageCursor : undefined;\n      if (!cursor || list.length === 0) break;\n    }\n    return rows.slice(0, maxItems);\n  }\n\n  async getServerTime(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeServerTime> {\n    const result = await this.publicGet(context, '/v5/market/time');\n    const nano = typeof result?.timeNano === 'string' && /^\\d+$/.test(result.timeNano) ? BigInt(result.timeNano) : null;\n    const seconds = Number(result?.timeSecond);\n    const serverMs = nano !== null ? Number(nano / 1_000_000n) : seconds * 1000;\n    if (!Number.isFinite(serverMs) || serverMs <= 0) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, 'Bybit server time missing from response', context.venue, context.environment, true);\n    }\n    return this.serverTimeFromMs(serverMs);\n  }\n\n  async testConnectivity(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeConnectivityResult> {\n    return this.connectivityFromMetadata(context);\n  }\n\n  async getAccountMetadata(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeAccountMetadata> {\n    const info = await this.privateGet(context, '/v5/user/query-api');\n    const permissions: Record<string, string[]> = info?.permissions && typeof info.permissions === 'object' ? info.permissions : {};\n    const flat = Object.entries(permissions).flatMap(([group, values]) => (Array.isArray(values) ? values.map((v) => `${group}:${v}`) : []));\n    const readOnly = Number(info?.readOnly) === 1;\n    const canWithdraw = (permissions['Wallet'] ?? []).some((p) => /withdraw/i.test(p));\n    const canTrade =\n      !readOnly &&\n      ((permissions['Spot'] ?? []).includes('SpotTrade') ||\n        (permissions['ContractTrade'] ?? []).length > 0 ||\n        (permissions['Derivatives'] ?? []).length > 0 ||\n        (permissions['Options'] ?? []).length > 0);\n    const ips: string[] = Array.isArray(info?.ips) ? info.ips : [];\n    return {\n      accountId: context.accountId,\n      venue: context.venue,\n      environment: context.environment,\n      isSandbox: context.isSandbox,\n      canTrade,\n      canRead: true,\n      canWithdraw,\n      ipRestricted: ips.length > 0 && !ips.includes('*'),\n      permissions: flat,\n      uid: info?.userID !== undefined && info?.userID !== null ? String(info.userID) : null,\n      email: null,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getCapabilities(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeCapabilityDiscovery> {\n    return {\n      venue: context.venue,\n      environment: context.environment,\n      capabilities: this.supportedCapabilities,\n      supportedOrderTypes: [ExchangeOrderType.MARKET, ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT, ExchangeOrderType.STOP, ExchangeOrderType.STOP_LIMIT],\n      supportedEnvironments: this.supportedEnvironments,\n      apiVersion: 'v5',\n      restAvailable: true,\n      websocketAvailable: true,\n      rateLimitModel: 'REQUEST_COUNT',\n      authenticationModel: 'HMAC_SHA256',\n      symbolFormat: 'BTCUSDT',\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getBalances(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeBalance[]> {\n    const result = await this.privateGet(context, '/v5/account/wallet-balance', { accountType: 'UNIFIED' });\n    const account = Array.isArray(result?.list) ? result.list[0] : undefined;\n    const coins: any[] = Array.isArray(account?.coin) ? account.coin : [];\n    const timestampMicros = nowMicros();\n    return coins\n      .map((c) => {\n        const total = dec(c.walletBalance);\n        const locked = dec(c.locked);\n        let free = subtractDecimalStrings(total, locked);\n        if (free.startsWith('-')) free = '0';\n        return {\n          asset: String(c.coin),\n          free,\n          locked,\n          total,\n          providerReference: account?.accountType ? String(account.accountType) : null,\n          timestampMicros,\n          source: 'REST',\n          isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n        };\n      })\n      .filter((b) => b.total !== '0' || b.locked !== '0');\n  }\n\n  async getPositions(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangePosition[]> {\n    const rows: any[] = [];\n    for (const settleCoin of ['USDT', 'USDC']) {\n      rows.push(...(await this.privateList(context, '/v5/position/list', { category: 'linear', settleCoin, limit: 200 }, 1000)));\n    }\n    return rows\n      .filter((p) => isDecimalString(p.size) && p.size !== '0' && !/^0(\\.0+)?$/.test(p.size))\n      .map((p) => ({\n        providerPositionId: p.positionIdx !== undefined ? `${p.symbol}:${p.positionIdx}` : null,\n        symbol: canonicalFromConcatenated(p.symbol),\n        exchangeSymbol: String(p.symbol),\n        side: p.side === 'Buy' ? ExchangePositionSide.LONG : p.side === 'Sell' ? ExchangePositionSide.SHORT : ExchangePositionSide.FLAT,\n        quantity: absDecimalString(p.size),\n        entryPrice: decOrNull(p.avgPrice),\n        markPrice: decOrNull(p.markPrice),\n        liquidationPrice: decOrNull(p.liqPrice),\n        leverage: decOrNull(p.leverage),\n        unrealizedPnl: decOrNull(p.unrealisedPnl),\n        realizedPnl: decOrNull(p.cumRealisedPnl),\n        timestampMicros: msToMicros(p.updatedTime) ?? nowMicros(),\n        isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n      }));\n  }\n\n  private categoriesFor(symbol?: string): Array<{ category: BybitCategory; settleCoin?: string }> {\n    if (symbol) return [{ category: 'spot' }, { category: 'linear' }];\n    return [{ category: 'spot' }, { category: 'linear', settleCoin: 'USDT' }, { category: 'linear', settleCoin: 'USDC' }];\n  }\n\n  async getOpenOrders(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]> {\n    const exchangeSymbol = symbol ? symbol.replace(/[-/]/g, '').toUpperCase() : undefined;\n    const rows: any[] = [];\n    for (const scope of this.categoriesFor(exchangeSymbol)) {\n      rows.push(...(await this.privateList(context, '/v5/order/realtime', { ...scope, symbol: exchangeSymbol, limit: 50 }, 500)));\n    }\n    return rows.map((o) => this.mapOrder(context, o));\n  }\n\n  async getOrderHistory(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string, limit = 50): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]> {\n    const exchangeSymbol = symbol ? symbol.replace(/[-/]/g, '').toUpperCase() : undefined;\n    const rows: any[] = [];\n    for (const scope of this.categoriesFor(exchangeSymbol)) {\n      rows.push(...(await this.privateList(context, '/v5/order/history', { ...scope, symbol: exchangeSymbol, limit: Math.min(limit, 50) }, limit)));\n    }\n    return rows\n      .map((o) => this.mapOrder(context, o))\n      .sort((a, b) => Number(BigInt(b.createdAtMicros ?? '0') - BigInt(a.createdAtMicros ?? '0')))\n      .slice(0, limit);\n  }\n\n  async getTradeHistory(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string, limit = 50): Promise<ExchangeFill[]> {\n    const exchangeSymbol = symbol ? symbol.replace(/[-/]/g, '').toUpperCase() : undefined;\n    const rows: any[] = [];\n    for (const scope of this.categoriesFor(exchangeSymbol)) {\n      rows.push(...(await this.privateList(context, '/v5/execution/list', { ...scope, symbol: exchangeSymbol, limit: Math.min(limit, 100) }, limit)));\n    }\n    return rows\n      .map((t) => ({\n        providerTradeId: String(t.execId),\n        providerOrderId: t.orderId ? String(t.orderId) : null,\n        clientOrderId: t.orderLinkId ? String(t.orderLinkId) : null,\n        symbol: canonicalFromConcatenated(t.symbol),\n        side: t.side === 'Buy' ? ExchangeOrderSide.BUY : ExchangeOrderSide.SELL,\n        price: dec(t.execPrice),\n        quantity: dec(t.execQty),\n        quoteQuantity: decOrNull(t.execValue),\n        fee: decOrNull(t.execFee),\n        feeCurrency: t.feeCurrency ? String(t.feeCurrency) : null,\n        isMaker: typeof t.isMaker === 'boolean' ? t.isMaker : null,\n        timestampMicros: msToMicros(t.execTime) ?? nowMicros(),\n        isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n      }))\n      .sort((a, b) => Number(BigInt(b.timestampMicros) - BigInt(a.timestampMicros)))\n      .slice(0, limit);\n  }\n\n  async getSymbols(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeSymbol[]> {\n    const result = await this.publicGet(context, '/v5/market/instruments-info', { category: 'spot', limit: 1000 });\n    const list: any[] = Array.isArray(result?.list) ? result.list : [];\n    return list\n      .filter((s) => s.status === 'Trading')\n      .map((s) => {\n        const tick = s.priceFilter?.tickSize ?? '0.00000001';\n        const step = s.lotSizeFilter?.basePrecision ?? s.lotSizeFilter?.qtyStep ?? '0.00000001';\n        return {\n          canonicalSymbol: `${s.baseCoin}-${s.quoteCoin}`,\n          exchangeSymbol: String(s.symbol),\n          baseAsset: String(s.baseCoin),\n          quoteAsset: String(s.quoteCoin),\n          contractType: 'SPOT',\n          tickSize: String(tick),\n          quantityStep: String(step),\n          minQuantity: decOrNull(s.lotSizeFilter?.minOrderQty),\n          maxQuantity: decOrNull(s.lotSizeFilter?.maxOrderQty),\n          minNotional: decOrNull(s.lotSizeFilter?.minOrderAmt),\n          maxNotional: decOrNull(s.lotSizeFilter?.maxOrderAmt),\n          pricePrecision: precisionOfStep(String(tick)),\n          quantityPrecision: precisionOfStep(String(step)),\n          minLeverage: null,\n          maxLeverage: null,\n          isTradeable: true,\n        };\n      });\n  }\n\n  private mapOrder(context: ExchangeProviderContext, o: any): ExchangeOrder {\n    const hasTrigger = isDecimalString(o.triggerPrice) && !/^0(\\.0+)?$/.test(o.triggerPrice);\n    const isLimit = String(o.orderType) === 'Limit';\n    const type = hasTrigger ? (isLimit ? ExchangeOrderType.STOP_LIMIT : ExchangeOrderType.STOP) : isLimit ? ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT : ExchangeOrderType.MARKET;\n    return {\n      clientOrderId: o.orderLinkId ? String(o.orderLinkId) : String(o.orderId),\n      providerOrderId: o.orderId ? String(o.orderId) : null,\n      symbol: canonicalFromConcatenated(o.symbol),\n      exchangeSymbol: String(o.symbol),\n      side: o.side === 'Buy' ? ExchangeOrderSide.BUY : ExchangeOrderSide.SELL,\n      type,\n      status: BybitProvider.mapOrderStatus(String(o.orderStatus)),\n      providerRawStatus: o.orderStatus ? String(o.orderStatus) : null,\n      quantity: dec(o.qty),\n      price: isLimit ? decOrNull(o.price) : null,\n      stopPrice: hasTrigger ? String(o.triggerPrice) : null,\n      filledQuantity: dec(o.cumExecQty),\n      averagePrice: decOrNull(o.avgPrice) === '0' ? null : decOrNull(o.avgPrice),\n      fee: decOrNull(o.cumExecFee),\n      feeCurrency: null,\n      createdAtMicros: msToMicros(o.createdTime),\n      updatedAtMicros: msToMicros(o.updatedTime),\n      isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n    };\n  }\n\n  static mapOrderStatus(status: string): ExchangeOrderStatus {\n    switch (status) {\n      case 'New':\n      case 'Created':\n      case 'Untriggered':\n      case 'Triggered':\n      case 'Active':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.NEW;\n      case 'PartiallyFilled':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED;\n      case 'Filled':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.FILLED;\n      case 'Cancelled':\n      case 'PartiallyFilledCanceled':\n      case 'Deactivated':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.CANCELED;\n      case 'Rejected':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.REJECTED;\n      default:\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.NEW;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/providers/coinbase.provider.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. value : '0';\n}\n\nfunction decOrNull(value: unknown): string | null {\n  return isDecimalString(value) ? value : null;\n}\n\nconst MAX_PAGES = 10;\n/** PKCS#8 DER prefix for a raw 32-byte Ed25519 seed. */\nconst ED25519_PKCS8_PREFIX = Buffer.from('302e020100300506032b657004220420', 'hex');\n\nfunction base64url(input: Buffer | string): string {\n  return Buffer.from(input).toString('base64').replace(/=+$/, '').replace(/\\+/g, '-').replace(/\\//g, '_');\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads a Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP) API secret as a private key.\n * Accepts both key families CDP issues: an EC P-256 PEM (\"-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE\n * KEY-----\", often stored with literal \"\\n\" escapes) and an Ed25519 secret\n * delivered as base64 of 64 bytes (seed || public key).\n */\nexport function loadCoinbaseKey(secret: string): { key: crypto.KeyObject; alg: 'ES256' | 'EdDSA' } {\n  const normalized = secret.includes('\\\\n') ? secret.replace(/\\\\n/g, '\\n') : secret;\n  if (normalized.includes('-----BEGIN')) {\n    const key = crypto.createPrivateKey(normalized);\n    const type = key.asymmetricKeyType;\n    if (type === 'ec') return { key, alg: 'ES256' };\n    if (type === 'ed25519') return { key, alg: 'EdDSA' };\n    throw new Error(`unsupported Coinbase key type ${type}`);\n  }\n  const raw = Buffer.from(normalized.trim(), 'base64');\n  if (raw.length !== 64 && raw.length !== 32) throw new Error('Coinbase Ed25519 secret must be base64 of 32 or 64 bytes');\n  const key = crypto.createPrivateKey({ key: Buffer.concat([ED25519_PKCS8_PREFIX, raw.subarray(0, 32)]), format: 'der', type: 'pkcs8' });\n  return { key, alg: 'EdDSA' };\n}\n\n/**\n * Builds the short-lived bearer JWT Coinbase Advanced Trade requires on every\n * private request: `sub`/`kid` = API key name, `iss` = \"cdp\", a two-minute\n * validity window, and `uri` = \"METHOD host/path\" binding the token to exactly\n * one endpoint (query string excluded, as the venue specifies).\n */\nexport function buildCoinbaseJwt(keyName: string, secret: string, method: string, host: string, path: string, nowSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)): string {\n  const { key, alg } = loadCoinbaseKey(secret);\n  const header = { alg, kid: keyName, nonce: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'), typ: 'JWT' };\n  const payload = { iss: 'cdp', sub: keyName, nbf: nowSeconds, exp: nowSeconds + 120, uri: `${method.toUpperCase()} ${host}${path}` };\n  const signingInput = `${base64url(JSON.stringify(header))}.${base64url(JSON.stringify(payload))}`;\n  const signature =\n    alg === 'ES256'\n      ? crypto.sign('sha256', Buffer.from(signingInput), { key, dsaEncoding: 'ieee-p1363' })\n      : crypto.sign(null, Buffer.from(signingInput), key);\n  return `${signingInput}.${base64url(signature)}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Coinbase Advanced Trade API (v3 brokerage), read side.\n *\n * Authentication is a per-request ES256/EdDSA JWT built from a CDP API key\n * (key name + private key); there is no passphrase. The sandbox\n * (api-sandbox.coinbase.com) serves static responses and accepts no\n * authentication, so sandbox calls are sent without a token rather than with\n * a token signed by a key the sandbox cannot verify.\n */\nexport class CoinbaseProvider extends BaseExchangeProvider {\n  readonly venue = ExchangeVenue.COINBASE;\n  readonly displayName: string;\n  readonly supportedEnvironments: ExchangeEnvironment[] = [ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE, ExchangeEnvironment.SANDBOX];\n  readonly supportedCapabilities: ExchangeCapability[] = [\n    ExchangeCapability.SPOT,\n    ExchangeCapability.FUTURES,\n    ExchangeCapability.MARKET_DATA,\n    ExchangeCapability.BALANCES,\n    ExchangeCapability.POSITIONS,\n    ExchangeCapability.ORDERS,\n    ExchangeCapability.TRADES,\n  ];\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly urls: { liveRest: string; sandboxRest: string; liveWs: string; sandboxWs: string },\n    displayName = 'Coinbase Advanced Trade',\n  ) {\n    super();\n    this.displayName = displayName;\n  }\n\n  protected getLiveRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveRest;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxRest;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxRest;\n  }\n  protected getLiveWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveWs;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxWs;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxWs;\n  }\n\n  private buildQuery(params: Record<string, string | number | undefined>): string {\n    return Object.entries(params)\n      .filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== '')\n      .map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`)\n      .join('&');\n  }\n\n  private async privateGet(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {}): Promise<any> {\n    const base = this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(context.environment);\n    const query = this.buildQuery(params);\n    const headers: Record<string, string> = { Accept: 'application/json' };\n    if (context.environment === ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE) {\n      this.requireCredentials(context);\n      let token: string;\n      try {\n        token = buildCoinbaseJwt(context.credentials.apiKey, context.credentials.apiSecret, 'GET', new URL(base).host, path);\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        throw new ExchangeProviderError(\n          ExchangeProviderErrorCode.INVALID_CREDENTIALS,\n          `Coinbase API secret is not a usable CDP private key (${String(e?.message ?? e).slice(0, 120)})`,\n          context.venue,\n          context.environment,\n          false,\n        );\n      }\n      headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;\n    }\n    try {\n      return await this.httpGet(`${base}${path}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`, headers);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getServerTime(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeServerTime> {\n    let data: any;\n    try {\n      data = await this.httpGet(`${this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(context.environment)}/api/v3/brokerage/time`, { Accept: 'application/json' });\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n    const ms = Number(data?.epochMillis ?? (data?.epochSeconds !== undefined ? Number(data.epochSeconds) * 1000 : NaN));\n    if (!Number.isFinite(ms) || ms <= 0) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, 'Coinbase server time missing from response', context.venue, context.environment, true);\n    }\n    return this.serverTimeFromMs(ms);\n  }\n\n  async testConnectivity(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeConnectivityResult> {\n    return this.connectivityFromMetadata(context);\n  }\n\n  async getAccountMetadata(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeAccountMetadata> {\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v3/brokerage/key_permissions');\n    const permissions: string[] = [];\n    if (data?.can_view) permissions.push('view');\n    if (data?.can_trade) permissions.push('trade');\n    if (data?.can_transfer) permissions.push('transfer');\n    return {\n      accountId: context.accountId,\n      venue: context.venue,\n      environment: context.environment,\n      isSandbox: context.isSandbox,\n      canTrade: data?.can_trade === true,\n      canRead: data?.can_view === true,\n      // `can_transfer` is Coinbase's \"move funds out\" permission; anything but\n      // an explicit false is treated as present (fail closed).\n      canWithdraw: data?.can_transfer !== false,\n      ipRestricted: false,\n      permissions,\n      uid: data?.portfolio_uuid ? String(data.portfolio_uuid) : null,\n      email: null,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getCapabilities(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeCapabilityDiscovery> {\n    return {\n      venue: context.venue,\n      environment: context.environment,\n      capabilities: this.supportedCapabilities,\n      supportedOrderTypes: [ExchangeOrderType.MARKET, ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT, ExchangeOrderType.STOP_LIMIT],\n      supportedEnvironments: this.supportedEnvironments,\n      apiVersion: 'v3',\n      restAvailable: true,\n      websocketAvailable: true,\n      rateLimitModel: 'REQUEST_COUNT',\n      authenticationModel: 'JWT_ES256',\n      symbolFormat: 'BTC-USD',\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getBalances(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeBalance[]> {\n    const rows: any[] = [];\n    let cursor: string | undefined;\n    for (let page = 0; page < MAX_PAGES; page += 1) {\n      const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v3/brokerage/accounts', { limit: 250, cursor });\n      rows.push(...(Array.isArray(data?.accounts) ? data.accounts : []));\n      if (!data?.has_next || !data?.cursor) break;\n      cursor = String(data.cursor);\n    }\n    const timestampMicros = nowMicros();\n    return rows\n      .map((a) => {\n        const free = dec(a?.available_balance?.value);\n        const locked = dec(a?.hold?.value);\n        return {\n          asset: String(a?.currency ?? a?.available_balance?.currency ?? ''),\n          free,\n          locked,\n          total: addDecimalStrings(free, locked),\n          providerReference: a?.uuid ? String(a.uuid) : null,\n          timestampMicros,\n          source: 'REST',\n          isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n        };\n      })\n      .filter((b) => b.asset !== '' && (!/^0(\\.0+)?$/.test(b.total)));\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Coinbase spot holds balances, not positions, so a spot-only portfolio\n   * truthfully has none. Futures (CFM) positions are read when the portfolio\n   * has a futures account; the venue answers 4xx for one that does not, which\n   * is the \"no futures account\" fact, not an error to surface.\n   */\n  async getPositions(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangePosition[]> {\n    let data: any;\n    try {\n      data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v3/brokerage/cfm/positions');\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      const status = e?.originalError?.status;\n      if (e instanceof ExchangeProviderError && [400, 404].includes(status)) return [];\n      throw e;\n    }\n    const positions: any[] = Array.isArray(data?.positions) ? data.positions : [];\n    return positions\n      .filter((p) => isDecimalString(p?.number_of_contracts) && !/^0(\\.0+)?$/.test(p.number_of_contracts))\n      .map((p) => ({\n        providerPositionId: p?.product_id ? String(p.product_id) : null,\n        symbol: String(p?.product_id ?? ''),\n        exchangeSymbol: String(p?.product_id ?? ''),\n        side: String(p?.side).toUpperCase() === 'SHORT' ? ExchangePositionSide.SHORT : ExchangePositionSide.LONG,\n        quantity: String(p.number_of_contracts).replace(/^-/, ''),\n        entryPrice: decOrNull(p?.avg_entry_price),\n        markPrice: decOrNull(p?.current_price),\n        liquidationPrice: null,\n        leverage: null,\n        unrealizedPnl: decOrNull(p?.unrealized_pnl),\n        realizedPnl: decOrNull(p?.daily_realized_pnl),\n        timestampMicros: nowMicros(),\n        isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n      }));\n  }\n\n  private async listOrders(context: ExchangeProviderContext, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined>, maxItems: number): Promise<any[]> {\n    const rows: any[] = [];\n    let cursor: string | undefined;\n    for (let page = 0; page < MAX_PAGES && rows.length < maxItems; page += 1) {\n      const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v3/brokerage/orders/historical/batch', { ...params, cursor });\n      rows.push(...(Array.isArray(data?.orders) ? data.orders : []));\n      if (!data?.has_next || !data?.cursor) break;\n      cursor = String(data.cursor);\n    }\n    return rows.slice(0, maxItems);\n  }\n\n  async getOpenOrders(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]> {\n    const rows = await this.listOrders(context, { order_status: 'OPEN', product_ids: symbol?.toUpperCase(), limit: 100 }, 1000);\n    return rows.map((o) => this.mapOrder(context, o));\n  }\n\n  async getOrderHistory(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string, limit = 50): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]> {\n    const rows = await this.listOrders(context, { product_ids: symbol?.toUpperCase(), limit: Math.min(limit, 100) }, limit);\n    return rows.map((o) => this.mapOrder(context, o));\n  }\n\n  async getTradeHistory(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string, limit = 50): Promise<ExchangeFill[]> {\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v3/brokerage/orders/historical/fills', { product_ids: symbol?.toUpperCase(), limit: Math.min(limit, 100) });\n    const fills: any[] = Array.isArray(data?.fills) ? data.fills : [];\n    return fills.slice(0, limit).map((f) => {\n      const product = String(f?.product_id ?? '');\n      return {\n        providerTradeId: String(f?.trade_id ?? f?.entry_id),\n        providerOrderId: f?.order_id ? String(f.order_id) : null,\n        clientOrderId: null,\n        symbol: product,\n        side: String(f?.side).toUpperCase() === 'SELL' ? ExchangeOrderSide.SELL : ExchangeOrderSide.BUY,\n        price: dec(f?.price),\n        quantity: dec(f?.size),\n        quoteQuantity: f?.size_in_quote === true ? dec(f?.size) : null,\n        fee: decOrNull(f?.commission),\n        feeCurrency: product.includes('-') ? product.split('-')[1] : null,\n        isMaker: f?.liquidity_indicator === 'MAKER' ? true : f?.liquidity_indicator === 'TAKER' ? false : null,\n        timestampMicros: isoToMicros(f?.trade_time) ?? nowMicros(),\n        isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n      };\n    });\n  }\n\n  async getSymbols(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeSymbol[]> {\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v3/brokerage/products', { product_type: 'SPOT' });\n    const products: any[] = Array.isArray(data?.products) ? data.products : [];\n    return products\n      .filter((p) => p?.status === 'online' && !p?.trading_disabled && !p?.is_disabled && !p?.cancel_only)\n      .map((p) => {\n        const tick = String(p?.price_increment ?? p?.quote_increment ?? '0.01');\n        const step = String(p?.base_increment ?? '');\n    let type: ExchangeOrderType;\n    if (orderType === 'MARKET') type = ExchangeOrderType.MARKET;\n    else if (orderType === 'STOP_LIMIT') type = ExchangeOrderType.STOP_LIMIT;\n    else if (orderType === 'STOP') type = ExchangeOrderType.STOP;\n    else if (variant?.post_only === true) type = ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT_MAKER;\n    else type = ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT;\n    const product = String(o?.product_id ??
