Codes outside this table are returned unchanged -\n * newer Kraken assets already use plain tickers, and a staked/earn suffix\n * (\".S\", \".F\", \".B\") is kept because it is a different balance, not a typo.\n */\nconst KRAKEN_ASSETS: Record<string, string> = {\n  XXBT: 'BTC',\n  XBT: 'BTC',\n  XXDG: 'DOGE',\n  XDG: 'DOGE',\n  XETH: 'ETH',\n  XETC: 'ETC',\n  XLTC: 'LTC',\n  XXLM: 'XLM',\n  XXMR: 'XMR',\n  XXRP: 'XRP',\n  XZEC: 'ZEC',\n  XMLN: 'MLN',\n  XREP: 'REP',\n  ZUSD: 'USD',\n  ZEUR: 'EUR',\n  ZGBP: 'GBP',\n  ZCAD: 'CAD',\n  ZJPY: 'JPY',\n  ZAUD: 'AUD',\n  ZCHF: 'CHF',\n};\n\nexport function krakenAsset(code: string): string {\n  const upper = String(code || '').toUpperCase();\n  const [base, ...suffix] = upper.split('.');\n  const mapped = KRAKEN_ASSETS[base] ?? base;\n  return suffix.length > 0 ? `${mapped}.${suffix.join('.')}` : mapped;\n}\n\n/**\n * Splits a Kraken pair in any of its three spellings - websocket \"XBT/USD\",\n * legacy \"XXBTZUSD\" and altname \"XBTUSD\" - into normalized base/quote\n * tickers. Returns null when no known quote suffix matches.\n */\nexport function krakenPairParts(pair: string): { base: string; quote: string } | null {\n  const upper = String(pair || '').toUpperCase();\n  if (upper.includes('/')) {\n    const [b, q] = upper.split('/');\n    return b && q ? { base: krakenAsset(b), quote: krakenAsset(q) } : null;\n  }\n  if (upper.length === 8 && /^[XZ]/.test(upper) && /^[XZ]/.test(upper.slice(4)) && KRAKEN_ASSETS[upper.slice(4)] !== undefined) {\n    return { base: krakenAsset(upper.slice(0, 4)), quote: krakenAsset(upper.slice(4)) };\n  }\n  for (const quote of ['USDT', 'USDC', 'ZUSD', 'ZEUR', 'ZGBP', 'ZCAD', 'ZJPY', 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'CAD', 'JPY', 'XBT', 'ETH']) {\n    if (upper.length > quote.length && upper.endsWith(quote)) {\n      return { base: krakenAsset(upper.slice(0, upper.length - quote.length)), quote: krakenAsset(quote) };\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/** The probe key name used to learn whether a key may withdraw. No such key exists by construction. */\nexport const KRAKEN_WITHDRAW_PROBE_KEY = '__wlct_permission_probe_no_such_key__';\n\n/**\n * Kraken Spot REST API, read side.\n *\n * Authentication: `API-Sign = base64(HMAC_SHA512(base64decode(secret), uriPath || SHA256(nonce + postData)))`,\n * where `||` is byte concatenation of the path and the raw SHA-256 digest. } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async privatePost(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string> = {}): Promise<any> {\n    this.assertLive(context);\n    this.requireCredentials(context);\n    const nonce = this.nextNonce();\n    const postData = new URLSearchParams({ method: 'POST',\n        url: `${this.getLiveRestUrl()}${path}`,\n        headers: {\n          'API-Key': context.credentials.apiKey,\n          'API-Sign': signature,\n          'Content-Type': this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getServerTime(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeServerTime> {\n    const result = await this.publicGet(context, '/0/public/Time');\n    const seconds = Number(result?.unixtime);\n    if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds <= 0) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, 'Kraken server time missing from response', context.venue, context.environment, true);\n    }\n    // Kraken's clock has one-second resolution; drift below a second is noise.\n    return this.serverTimeFromMs(seconds * 1000);\n  }\n\n  async testConnectivity(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeConnectivityResult> {\n    return  });\n    const permissions = ['query_funds'];\n    if (!tradeRefused) permissions.push('create_modify_orders');\n    if (!withdrawRefused) permissions.push('withdraw_funds_or_unproven');\n    return     supportedOrderTypes: [ExchangeOrderType.MARKET, ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT, ExchangeOrderType.STOP, ExchangeOrderType.STOP_LIMIT, ExchangeOrderType.TAKE_PROFIT, rateLimitModel: 'TOKEN_BUCKET',\n      authenticationModel: 'HMAC_SHA512',\n      symbolFormat: 'XBTUSD',\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getBalances(context: !/^0(\\.0+)?$/.test(b.locked));\n  }\n\n  async getPositions(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangePosition[]> {\n    const result = await this.privatePost(context, '/0/private/OpenPositions', { docalcs: 'true' });\n    return Object.entries(result as Record<string, any>).map(([posId, p]) => {\n      const vol = dec(p?.vol);\n      const closed = dec(p?.vol_closed);\n      const open = subtractDecimalStrings(vol, closed);\n      return {\n        providerPositionId: posId,\n        symbol: this.canonicalPair(String(p?.pair ?? '')),\n        exchangeSymbol: String(p?.pair ?? ''),\n        side: p?.type === 'sell' ? ExchangePositionSide.SHORT : ExchangePositionSide.LONG,\n        quantity: open.startsWith('-') ? '0' : open,\n        entryPrice: null,\n        markPrice: null,\n        liquidationPrice: null,\n        leverage: decOrNull(p?.leverage),\n        unrealizedPnl: decOrNull(p?.net),\n        realizedPnl: null,\n        timestampMicros: secondsToMicros(p?.time) ?? nowMicros(),\n        isSimulated: false,\n      };\n    });\n  }\n\n  async getOpenOrders(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]> {\n    const result = await this.privatePost(context, '/0/private/OpenOrders');\n    const orders = Object.entries((result?.open ?? {}) as Record<string, any>).map(([txid, o]) => this.mapOrder(txid, o));\n    return symbol ? orders.filter((o) => o.symbol === symbol.toUpperCase() || o.exchangeSymbol === symbol.toUpperCase()) : orders;\n  }\n\n  async getOrderHistory(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string, limit = 50): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]> {\n    const result = await this.privatePost(context, '/0/private/ClosedOrders');\n    const orders = Object.entries((result?.closed ?? {}) as Record<string, any>)\n      .map(([txid, o]) => this.mapOrder(txid, o))\n      .filter((o) => !symbol || o.symbol === symbol.toUpperCase() || o.exchangeSymbol === symbol.toUpperCase())\n      .sort((a, b) => Number(BigInt(b.createdAtMicros ?? '0') - BigInt(a.createdAtMicros ?? '0')));\n    return orders.slice(0, limit);\n  }\n\n  async getTradeHistory(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string, limit = 50): Promise<ExchangeFill[]> {\n    const result = await this.privatePost(context, '/0/private/TradesHistory');\n    return Object.entries((result?.trades ?? {}) as Record<string, any>)\n      .map(([tradeId, t]) => ({\n        providerTradeId: tradeId,\n        providerOrderId: t?.ordertxid ? String(t.ordertxid) : null,\n        clientOrderId: null,\n        symbol: this.canonicalPair(String(t?.pair ?? '')),\n        side: t?.type === 'sell' ? ExchangeOrderSide.SELL : ExchangeOrderSide.BUY,\n        price: dec(t?.price),\n        quantity: dec(t?.vol),\n        quoteQuantity: decOrNull(t?.cost),\n        fee: decOrNull(t?.fee),\n        feeCurrency: null,\n        isMaker: typeof t?.maker === 'boolean' ? t.maker : null,\n        timestampMicros: secondsToMicros(t?.time) ?? nowMicros(),\n        isSimulated: false,\n      }))\n      .filter((f) => !symbol || f.symbol === symbol.toUpperCase())\n      .sort((a, b) => Number(BigInt(b.timestampMicros) - BigInt(a.timestampMicros)))\n      .slice(0, limit);\n  }\n\n  async getSymbols(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeSymbol[]> {\n    const result = await this.publicGet(context, '/0/public/AssetPairs');\n    return Object.entries(result as Record<string, any>)\n      .filter(([, p]) => (p?.status ?? 'online') === 'online' && typeof p?.wsname === 'string')\n      .map(([pairKey, p]) => {\n        const [wsBase, wsQuote] = String(p.wsname).split('/');\n        const base = krakenAsset(wsBase);\n        const quote = krakenAsset(wsQuote);\n        const pairDecimals = Number(p.pair_decimals ?? 8);\n        const lotDecimals = Number(p.lot_decimals ?? 8);\n        return {\n          canonicalSymbol: `${base}-${quote}`,\n          exchangeSymbol: String(p.altname ?? pairKey),\n          baseAsset: base,\n          quoteAsset: quote,\n          contractType: 'SPOT',\n          tickSize: isDecimalString(p.tick_size) ? p.tick_size : lotStep(pairDecimals),\n          quantityStep: lotStep(lotDecimals),\n          minQuantity: decOrNull(p.ordermin),\n          maxQuantity: null,\n          minNotional: decOrNull(p.costmin),\n          maxNotional: null,\n          pricePrecision: pairDecimals,\n          quantityPrecision: lotDecimals,\n          minLeverage: null,\n          maxLeverage: Array.isArray(p.leverage_buy) && p.leverage_buy.length > 0 ? Math.max(...p.leverage_buy.map(Number)) : null,\n          isTradeable: true,\n        };\n      });\n  }\n\n  /** \"XXBTZUSD\" / \"XBTUSD\" / \"XBT/USD\" -> \"BTC-USD\" using the legacy asset table. */\n  canonicalPair(pair: string): string {\n    const parts = krakenPairParts(pair);\n    return parts ? `${parts.base}-${parts.quote}` : pair.toUpperCase();\n  }\n\n  private mapOrder(txid: string, o: any): ExchangeOrder {\n    const descr = o?.descr ?? {};\n    const ordertype = String(descr.ordertype ?? '');\n    const typeMap: Record<string, ExchangeOrderType> = {\n      market: ExchangeOrderType.MARKET,\n      limit: ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT,\n      'stop-loss': ExchangeOrderType.STOP,\n      'stop-loss-limit': ExchangeOrderType.STOP_LIMIT,\n      'take-profit': ExchangeOrderType.TAKE_PROFIT,\n      'take-profit-limit': ExchangeOrderType.TAKE_PROFIT_LIMIT,\n    };\n    const type = typeMap[ordertype] ?? ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT;\n    const isStopFamily = type === ExchangeOrderType.STOP || type === ExchangeOrderType.STOP_LIMIT || type === ExchangeOrderType.TAKE_PROFIT || type === ExchangeOrderType.TAKE_PROFIT_LIMIT;\n    const pair = String(descr.pair ?? '');\n    const volExec = dec(o?.vol_exec);\n    return {\n      clientOrderId: o?.cl_ord_id ? String(o.cl_ord_id) : o?.userref ? String(o.userref) : txid,\n      providerOrderId: txid,\n      symbol: this.canonicalPair(pair),\n      exchangeSymbol: pair,\n      side: descr.type === 'sell' ? ExchangeOrderSide.SELL : ExchangeOrderSide.BUY,\n      type,\n      status: KrakenProvider.mapOrderStatus(String(o?.status ?? ''), volExec),\n      providerRawStatus: o?.status ? String(o.status) : null,\n      quantity: dec(o?.vol),\n      price: type === ExchangeOrderType.MARKET ? null : isStopFamily ? decOrNull(descr.price2) : decOrNull(descr.price),\n      stopPrice: isStopFamily ? decOrNull(descr.price) : null,\n      filledQuantity: volExec,\n      averagePrice: isDecimalString(o?.price) && !/^0(\\.0+)?$/.test(o.price) ? o.price : null,\n      fee: decOrNull(o?.fee),\n      feeCurrency: null,\n      createdAtMicros: secondsToMicros(o?.opentm),\n      updatedAtMicros: secondsToMicros(o?.closetm) ?? secondsToMicros(o?.opentm),\n      isSimulated: false,\n    };\n  }\n\n  static mapOrderStatus(status: string, volExec = '0'): ExchangeOrderStatus {\n    const executed = !/^0(\\.0+)?$/.test(volExec);\n    switch (status) {\n      case 'pending':\n      case 'open':\n        return executed ? ExchangeOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED : ExchangeOrderStatus.NEW;\n      case 'closed':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.FILLED;\n      case 'canceled':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.CANCELED;\n      case 'expired':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.EXPIRED;\n      default:\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.NEW;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nfunction lotStep(decimals: number): string {\n  if (!Number.isInteger(decimals) || decimals <= 0) return '1';\n  return `0.${'0'.repeat(decimals - 1)}1`;\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/providers/okx.provider.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. value : '0';\n}\n\nfunction decOrNull(value: unknown): string | null {\n  return isDecimalString(value) ? value : null;\n}\n\n/** \"BTC-USDT-SWAP\" -> \"BTC-USDT\"; spot ids are already canonical. */\nexport function okxCanonical(instId: string): string {\n  const parts = String(instId || '').toUpperCase().split('-');\n  return parts.length >= 2 ? `${parts[0]}-${parts[1]}` : String(instId || '').toUpperCase();\n}\n\nfunction instTypeOf(instId: string): 'SPOT' | 'SWAP' | 'FUTURES' | 'OPTION' {\n  const parts = String(instId).toUpperCase().split('-');\n  if (parts.length === 2) return 'SPOT';\n  if (parts[2] === 'SWAP') return 'SWAP';\n  if (parts.length >= 5) return 'OPTION';\n  return 'FUTURES';\n}\n\n/**\n * OKX V5 API, read side.\n *\n * Authentication: `OK-ACCESS-SIGN = base64(HMAC_SHA256(secret, timestamp + METHOD + requestPath + body))`\n * where `requestPath` includes the query string and `timestamp` is ISO-8601 with\n * milliseconds; the passphrase chosen at key creation rides in\n * `OK-ACCESS-PASSPHRASE`. OKX's demo trading uses the same host with\n * `x-simulated-trading: 1`, so TESTNET/SANDBOX differ from LIVE by that header,\n * which is added for every non-LIVE environment - a demo key sent without it\n * is rejected by the venue, and a live key sent with it is too.\n */\nexport class OkxProvider extends BaseExchangeProvider {\n  readonly venue = ExchangeVenue.OKX;\n  readonly displayName: string;\n  readonly supportedEnvironments: ExchangeEnvironment[] = [ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE, ExchangeEnvironment.TESTNET, ExchangeEnvironment.SANDBOX];\n  readonly supportedCapabilities: ExchangeCapability[] = [\n    ExchangeCapability.SPOT,\n    ExchangeCapability.MARGIN,\n    ExchangeCapability.FUTURES,\n    ExchangeCapability.PERPETUALS,\n    ExchangeCapability.MARKET_DATA,\n    ExchangeCapability.BALANCES,\n    ExchangeCapability.POSITIONS,\n    ExchangeCapability.ORDERS,\n    ExchangeCapability.TRADES,\n    ExchangeCapability.TESTNET,\n  ];\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly urls: { liveRest: string; testnetRest: string; sandboxRest: string; liveWs: string; testnetWs: string; sandboxWs: string },\n    displayName = 'OKX',\n  ) {\n    super();\n    this.displayName = displayName;\n  }\n\n  protected getLiveRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveRest;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.testnetRest;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxRest;\n  }\n  protected getLiveWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveWs;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.testnetWs;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxWs;\n  }\n\n  /** Exposed for tests: the exact V5 prehash signature. */\n  static sign(secret: string, timestamp: string, method: string, requestPath: string, body = ''): string {\n    return crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(timestamp + method.toUpperCase() + requestPath + body).digest('base64');\n  }\n\n  private buildQuery(params: Record<string, string | number | undefined>): string {\n    return Object.entries(params)\n      .filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== '')\n      .map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`)\n      .join('&');\n  }\n\n  private demoHeaders(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Record<string, string> {\n    return context.environment === ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE ? {} : { 'x-simulated-trading': '1' };\n  }\n\n  private unwrap(context: ExchangeProviderContext, data: any): any[] {\n    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, 'OKX returned a non-JSON body', context.venue, context.environment, true);\n    }\n    const code = String(data.code);\n    if (code === '0') return Array.isArray(data.data) ? data.data : [];\n    const message = `OKX code ${code}: ${String(data.msg ?? '').slice(0, 200)}`;\n    if (['50111', '50113', '50105', '50100', '50101', '50114'].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.AUTH_FAILED, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n    }\n    if (['50110', '50120', '50121'].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.PERMISSION_DENIED, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n    }\n    if (['50102', '50112'].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.CLOCK_DRIFT, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    if (['50011', '50061'].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.RATE_LIMITED, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    if (['50001', '50004', '50013', '50026'].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.SERVER_ERROR, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n  }\n\n  private async publicGet(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {}): Promise<any[]> {\n    const query = this.buildQuery(params);\n    const url = `${this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(context.environment)}${path}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`;\n    try {\n      return this.unwrap(context, await this.httpGet(url, this.demoHeaders(context)));\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async privateGet(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {}): Promise<any[]> {\n    this.requireCredentials(context, true);\n    const query = this.buildQuery(params);\n    const requestPath = `${path}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`;\n    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();\n    const signature = OkxProvider.sign(context.credentials.apiSecret, timestamp, 'GET', requestPath);\n    try {\n      const data = await this.httpGet(`${this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(context.environment)}${requestPath}`, {\n        'OK-ACCESS-KEY': context.credentials.apiKey,\n        'OK-ACCESS-SIGN': signature,\n        'OK-ACCESS-TIMESTAMP': timestamp,\n        'OK-ACCESS-PASSPHRASE': context.credentials.passphrase as string,\n        ...this.demoHeaders(context),\n      });\n      return this.unwrap(context, data);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getServerTime(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeServerTime> {\n    const data = await this.publicGet(context, '/api/v5/public/time');\n    const ts = Number(data[0]?.ts);\n    if (!Number.isFinite(ts) || ts <= 0) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, 'OKX server time missing from response', context.venue, context.environment, true);\n    }\n    return this.serverTimeFromMs(ts);\n  }\n\n  async testConnectivity(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeConnectivityResult> {\n    return this.connectivityFromMetadata(context);\n  }\n\n  async getAccountMetadata(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeAccountMetadata> {\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v5/account/config');\n    const config = data[0] ?? {};\n    const perms = String(config.perm ?? '')\n      .split(',')\n      .map((p: string) => p.trim())\n      .filter(Boolean);\n    const ip = String(config.ip ?? '').trim();\n    return {\n      accountId: context.accountId,\n      venue: context.venue,\n      environment: context.environment,\n      isSandbox: context.isSandbox,\n      canTrade: perms.includes('trade'),\n      canRead: perms.includes('read_only') || perms.includes('trade'),\n      canWithdraw: perms.includes('withdraw'),\n      ipRestricted: ip.length > 0,\n      permissions: perms,\n      uid: config.uid ? String(config.uid) : null,\n      email: null,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getCapabilities(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeCapabilityDiscovery> {\n    return {\n      venue: context.venue,\n      environment: context.environment,\n      capabilities: this.supportedCapabilities,\n      supportedOrderTypes: [ExchangeOrderType.MARKET, ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT, ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT_MAKER, ExchangeOrderType.STOP, ExchangeOrderType.STOP_LIMIT],\n      supportedEnvironments: this.supportedEnvironments,\n      apiVersion: 'v5',\n      restAvailable: true,\n      websocketAvailable: true,\n      rateLimitModel: 'REQUEST_COUNT',\n      authenticationModel: 'HMAC_SHA256_PASSPHRASE',\n      symbolFormat: 'BTC-USDT',\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getBalances(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeBalance[]> {\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v5/account/balance');\n    const details: any[] = Array.isArray(data[0]?.details) ? data[0].details : [];\n    const timestampMicros = msToMicros(data[0]?.uTime) ?? nowMicros();\n    return details\n      .map((d) => {\n        const free = dec(d.availBal);\n        const locked = dec(d.frozenBal);\n        const total = isDecimalString(d.cashBal) ? d.cashBal : addDecimalStrings(free, locked);\n        return {\n          asset: String(d.ccy),\n          free,\n          locked,\n          total,\n          providerReference: null,\n          timestampMicros,\n          source: 'REST',\n          isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n        };\n      })\n      .filter((b) => b.total !== '0' || b.locked !== '0');\n  }\n\n  async getPositions(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangePosition[]> {\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v5/account/positions');\n    return data\n      .filter((p) => isDecimalString(p.pos) && signOfDecimalString(p.pos) !== 0)\n      .map((p) => {\n        let side: ExchangePositionSide;\n        if (p.posSide === 'long') side = ExchangePositionSide.LONG;\n        else if (p.posSide === 'short') side = ExchangePositionSide.SHORT;\n        else side = signOfDecimalString(p.pos) > 0 ? ExchangePositionSide.LONG : ExchangePositionSide.SHORT;\n        return {\n          providerPositionId: p.posId ? String(p.posId) : null,\n          symbol: okxCanonical(p.instId),\n          exchangeSymbol: String(p.instId),\n          side,\n          quantity: absDecimalString(p.pos),\n          entryPrice: decOrNull(p.avgPx),\n          markPrice: decOrNull(p.markPx),\n          liquidationPrice: decOrNull(p.liqPx),\n          leverage: decOrNull(p.lever),\n          unrealizedPnl: decOrNull(p.upl),\n          realizedPnl: decOrNull(p.realizedPnl),\n          timestampMicros: msToMicros(p.uTime) ?? nowMicros(),\n          isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n        };\n      });\n  }\n\n  async getOpenOrders(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]> {\n    const params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = { limit: 100 };\n    if (symbol) {\n      params.instId = symbol.toUpperCase();\n      params.instType = instTypeOf(symbol);\n    }\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v5/trade/orders-pending', params);\n    return data.map((o) => this.mapOrder(context, o));\n  }\n\n  async getOrderHistory(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string, limit = 50): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]> {\n    const instTypes: Array<'SPOT' | 'SWAP' | 'FUTURES' | 'OPTION'> = symbol ? [instTypeOf(symbol)] : ['SPOT', 'SWAP'];\n    const rows: any[] = [];\n    for (const instType of instTypes) {\n      rows.push(...(await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v5/trade/orders-history', { instType, instId: symbol?.toUpperCase(), limit: Math.min(limit, 100) })));\n    }\n    return rows\n      .map((o) => this.mapOrder(context, o))\n      .sort((a, b) => Number(BigInt(b.createdAtMicros ?? factory.validateEnvironmentBinding(ExchangeVenue.BYBIT, ExchangeEnvironment.TESTNET, false),\n    ).toThrow(/Environment mismatch/);\n  });\n});\n\ntype Route = (url: string, init: any) => { status?: FetchCall[] {\n  const calls: FetchCall[] = [];\n  jest.spyOn(global as any, 'fetch').mockImplementation(async (...args: any[]) => {\n    const url = String(args[0]);\n    const init = args[1] ?? {};\n    calls.push({ url, method: init.method ?? const text = typeof answer.body === 'string' ? answer.body : JSON.stringify(answer.body);\n    return {\n      ok: status >= 200 && status < 300,\n      status,\n      statusText: String(status),\n  expect((caught as ExchangeProviderError).code).toBe(code);\n}\n\nconst URLS = {\n  liveRest: 'https://live.example',\n  testnetRest: 'https://testnet.example',\n  sandboxRest: });\n\n  test('decimal string arithmetic is exact', () => {\n    expect(addDecimalStrings('0.1', '0.2')).toBe('0.3');\n    expect(subtractDecimalStrings('1.00000001', Spot plus USDT/USDC-settled linear contracts. */\ntype BybitCategory = 'spot' | 'linear';\n\nconst RECV_WINDOW = '5000';\nconst MAX_PAGES = 10;\n\nfunction dec(value: unknown): string {\n  return isDecimalString(value) ? value : '0';\n}\n\nfunction decOrNull(value: unknown): string | null {\n  return isDecimalString(value) && value !== '' ? value : null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Bybit V5 unified API, read side: server time, key permissions, wallet,\n * positions, open orders, order history, executions and instruments.\n *\n * Authentication (V5): `X-BAPI-SIGN = hex(HMAC_SHA256(secret, timestamp + apiKey + recvWindow + queryString))`.\n * Every response is an envelope `{ retCode, retMsg, result }`; a non-zero\n * retCode is a venue refusal and is classified, never read as an empty list.\n * This provider places no orders - order transmission belongs to the execution\n * engine behind the live-mode gate.\n */\nexport class BybitProvider extends BaseExchangeProvider {\n  readonly venue = ExchangeVenue.BYBIT;\n  readonly displayName: string;\n  readonly supportedEnvironments: ExchangeEnvironment[] = [ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE, ExchangeEnvironment.TESTNET, ExchangeEnvironment.SANDBOX];\n  readonly supportedCapabilities: ExchangeCapability[] = [\n    ExchangeCapability.SPOT,\n    ExchangeCapability.PERPETUALS,\n    ExchangeCapability.MARKET_DATA,\n    ExchangeCapability.BALANCES,\n    ExchangeCapability.POSITIONS,\n    ExchangeCapability.ORDERS,\n    ExchangeCapability.TRADES,\n    ExchangeCapability.TESTNET,\n  ];\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly urls: { liveRest: string; testnetRest: string; sandboxRest: string; liveWs: string; testnetWs: string; sandboxWs: string },\n    displayName = 'Bybit',\n  ) {\n    super();\n    this.displayName = displayName;\n  }\n\n  protected getLiveRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveRest;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.testnetRest;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxRest;\n  }\n  protected getLiveWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveWs;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.testnetWs;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxWs;\n  }\n\n  /** Exposed for tests: the exact V5 signature over the canonical payload. */\n  static sign(secret: string, timestamp: string, apiKey: string, recvWindow: string, queryString: string): string {\n    return crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(timestamp + apiKey + recvWindow + queryString).digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  private buildQuery(params: Record<string, string | number | undefined>): string {\n    return Object.entries(params)\n      .filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== '')\n      .map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`)\n      .join('&');\n  }\n\n  private unwrap(context: ExchangeProviderContext, data: any): any {\n    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, 'Bybit returned a non-JSON body', context.venue, context.environment, true);\n    }\n    const code = Number(data.retCode);\n    if (code === 0) return data.result ?? {};\n    const message = `Bybit retCode ${data.retCode}: ${String(data.retMsg ?? '').slice(0, 200)}`;\n    if ([10003, 10004, 33004, 10007].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.AUTH_FAILED, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n    }\n    if ([10005, 10010].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.PERMISSION_DENIED, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n    }\n    if (code === 10002) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.CLOCK_DRIFT, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    if ([10006, 10018, 10429].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.RATE_LIMITED, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    if (code === 10001) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.INVALID_ORDER, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n    }\n    if (code === 10016) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.SERVER_ERROR, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n  }\n\n  private async publicGet(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {}): Promise<any> {\n    const query = this.buildQuery(params);\n    const url = `${this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(context.environment)}${path}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`;\n    try {\n      return this.unwrap(context, await this.httpGet(url));\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async privateGet(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {}): Promise<any> {\n    this.requireCredentials(context);\n    const query = this.buildQuery(params);\n    const timestamp = Date.now().toString();\n    const signature = BybitProvider.sign(context.credentials.apiSecret, timestamp, context.credentials.apiKey, RECV_WINDOW, query);\n    const url = `${this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(context.environment)}${path}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`;\n    try {\n      const data = await this.httpGet(url, {\n        'X-BAPI-API-KEY': context.credentials.apiKey,\n        'X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP': timestamp,\n        'X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW': RECV_WINDOW,\n        'X-BAPI-SIGN': signature,\n      });\n      return this.unwrap(context, data);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Follows `nextPageCursor` up to MAX_PAGES pages, concatenating `result.list`. */\n  private async privateList(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined>, maxItems: number): Promise<any[]> {\n    const rows: any[] = [];\n    let cursor: string | undefined;\n    for (let page = 0; page < MAX_PAGES && rows.length < maxItems; page += 1) {\n      const result = await this.privateGet(context, path, { ...params, cursor });\n      const list = Array.isArray(result?.list) ? result.list : [];\n      rows.push(...list);\n      cursor = typeof result?.nextPageCursor === 'string' && result.nextPageCursor !== '' ? result.nextPageCursor : undefined;\n      if (!cursor || list.length === 0) break;\n    }\n    return rows.slice(0, maxItems);\n  }\n\n  async getServerTime(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeServerTime> {\n    const result = await this.publicGet(context, '/v5/market/time');\n    const nano = typeof result?.timeNano === 'string' && /^\\d+$/.test(result.timeNano) ? BigInt(result.timeNano) : null;\n    const seconds = Number(result?.timeSecond);\n    const serverMs = nano !== null ? []).some((p) => /withdraw/i.test(p));\n    const canTrade =\n      !readOnly &&\n      ((permissions['Spot'] ?? []).includes('SpotTrade') ||\n        (permissions['ContractTrade'] ?? []).length > 0 ||\n        (permissions['Derivatives'] ?? []).length > 0 ||\n        (permissions['Options'] ?? []).length > 0);\n    const ips: string[] = Array.isArray(info?.ips) ? info.ips : [];\n    return {\n      accountId: context.accountId,\n      venue: context.venue,\n      environment: context.environment,\n      isSandbox: context.isSandbox,\n      canTrade,\n      canRead: true,\n      canWithdraw,\n      ipRestricted: ips.length > 0 && !ips.includes('*'),\n      permissions: flat,\n      uid: info?.userID !== undefined && info?.userID !== null ? String(info.userID) : null,\n      email: null,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getCapabilities(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeCapabilityDiscovery> {\n    return {\n      venue: context.venue,\n      environment: context.environment,\n      capabilities: this.supportedCapabilities,\n      supportedOrderTypes: [ExchangeOrderType.MARKET, ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT, ExchangeOrderType.STOP, ExchangeOrderType.STOP_LIMIT],\n      supportedEnvironments: this.supportedEnvironments,\n      apiVersion: 'v5',\n      restAvailable: true,\n      websocketAvailable: true,\n      rateLimitModel: 'REQUEST_COUNT',\n      authenticationModel: 'HMAC_SHA256',\n      symbolFormat: 'BTCUSDT',\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getBalances(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeBalance[]> {\n    const result = await this.privateGet(context, '/v5/account/wallet-balance', { accountType: 'UNIFIED' });\n    const account = Array.isArray(result?.list) ? result.list[0] : undefined;\n    const coins: any[] = Array.isArray(account?.coin) ? account.coin : [];\n    const timestampMicros = nowMicros();\n    return coins\n      .map((c) => {\n        const total = dec(c.walletBalance);\n        const locked = dec(c.locked);\n        let free = subtractDecimalStrings(total, locked);\n        if (free.startsWith('-')) free = '0';\n        return {\n          asset: String(c.coin),\n          free,\n          locked,\n          total,\n          providerReference: account?.accountType ? value : '0';\n}\n\nfunction decOrNull(value: unknown): string | null {\n  return isDecimalString(value) ? value : null;\n}\n\nconst MAX_PAGES = 10;\n/** PKCS#8 DER prefix for a raw 32-byte Ed25519 seed. */\nconst ED25519_PKCS8_PREFIX = Buffer.from('302e020100300506032b657004220420', 'hex');\n\nfunction base64url(input: Buffer | string): string {\n  return Buffer.from(input).toString('base64').replace(/=+$/, '').replace(/\\+/g, '-').replace(/\\//g, '_');\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads a Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP) API secret as a private key.\n * Accepts both key families CDP issues: an EC P-256 PEM (\"-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE\n * KEY-----\", often stored with literal \"\\n\" escapes) and an Ed25519 secret\n * delivered as base64 of 64 bytes (seed || public key).\n */\nexport function loadCoinbaseKey(secret: string): { key: crypto.KeyObject; alg: 'ES256' | 'EdDSA' } {\n  const normalized = secret.includes('\\\\n') ? secret.replace(/\\\\n/g, '\\n') : secret;\n  if (normalized.includes('-----BEGIN')) {\n    const key = crypto.createPrivateKey(normalized);\n    const type = key.asymmetricKeyType;\n    if (type === 'ec') return { key, alg: 'ES256' };\n    if (type === 'ed25519') return { key, alg: 'EdDSA' };\n    throw new Error(`unsupported Coinbase key type ${type}`);\n  }\n  const raw = Buffer.from(normalized.trim(), 'base64');\n  if (raw.length !== 64 && raw.length !== 32) throw new Error('Coinbase Ed25519 secret must be base64 of 32 or 64 bytes');\n  const key = crypto.createPrivateKey({ key: Buffer.concat([ED25519_PKCS8_PREFIX, raw.subarray(0, 32)]), format: 'der', type: 'pkcs8' });\n  return { key, alg: 'EdDSA' };\n}\n\n/**\n * Builds the short-lived bearer JWT Coinbase Advanced Trade requires on every\n * private request: `sub`/`kid` = API key name, `iss` = \"cdp\", a two-minute\n * validity window, and `uri` = \"METHOD host/path\" binding the token to exactly\n * one endpoint (query string excluded, as the venue specifies).\n */\nexport function buildCoinbaseJwt(keyName: string, secret: string, method: string, host: string, path: string, nowSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)): string {\n  const { key, alg } = loadCoinbaseKey(secret);\n  const header = { alg, kid: keyName, nonce: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'), typ: 'JWT' };\n  const payload = { iss: 'cdp', sub: keyName, nbf: nowSeconds, exp: nowSeconds + 120, uri: `${method.toUpperCase()} ${host}${path}` };\n  const signingInput = `${base64url(JSON.stringify(header))}.${base64url(JSON.stringify(payload))}`;\n  const signature =\n    alg === 'ES256'\n      ? crypto.sign('sha256', Buffer.from(signingInput), { key, dsaEncoding: 'ieee-p1363' })\n      : crypto.sign(null, Buffer.from(signingInput), key);\n  return `${signingInput}.${base64url(signature)}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Coinbase Advanced Trade API (v3 brokerage), read side.\n *\n * Authentication is a per-request ES256/EdDSA JWT built from a CDP API key\n * (key name + private key); there is no passphrase. The sandbox\n * (api-sandbox.coinbase.com) serves static responses and accepts no\n * authentication, so sandbox calls are sent without a token rather than with\n * a token signed by a key the sandbox cannot verify.\n */\nexport class CoinbaseProvider extends BaseExchangeProvider {\n  readonly venue = ExchangeVenue.COINBASE;\n  readonly displayName: string;\n  readonly supportedEnvironments: ExchangeEnvironment[] = [ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE, ExchangeEnvironment.SANDBOX];\n  readonly supportedCapabilities: ExchangeCapability[] = [\n    ExchangeCapability.SPOT,\n    ExchangeCapability.FUTURES,\n    ExchangeCapability.MARKET_DATA,\n    ExchangeCapability.BALANCES,\n    ExchangeCapability.POSITIONS,\n    ExchangeCapability.ORDERS,\n    ExchangeCapability.TRADES,\n  ];\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly urls: { liveRest: string; sandboxRest: string; liveWs: string; sandboxWs: string },\n    displayName = 'Coinbase Advanced Trade',\n  ) {\n    super();\n    this.displayName = displayName;\n  }\n\n  protected getLiveRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveRest;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxRest;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxRest;\n  }\n  protected getLiveWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveWs;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxWs;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxWs;\n  }\n\n  private buildQuery(params: Record<string, string | number | undefined>): string {\n    return Object.entries(params)\n      .filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== '')\n      .map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`)\n      .join('&');\n  }\n\n  private async privateGet(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {}): Promise<any> {\n    const base = this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(context.environment);\n    const query = this.buildQuery(params);\n    const headers: Record<string, string> = { Accept: 'application/json' };\n    if (context.environment Codes outside this table are returned unchanged -\n * newer Kraken assets already use plain tickers, and a staked/earn suffix\n * (\".S\", \".F\", \".B\") is kept because it is a different balance, not a typo.\n */\nconst KRAKEN_ASSETS: Record<string, string> = {\n  XXBT: 'BTC',\n  XBT: 'BTC',\n  XXDG: 'DOGE',\n  XDG: 'DOGE',\n  XETH: 'ETH',\n  XETC: 'ETC',\n  XLTC: 'LTC',\n  XXLM: 'XLM',\n  XXMR: 'XMR',\n  XXRP: 'XRP',\n  XZEC: 'ZEC',\n  XMLN: 'MLN',\n  XREP: 'REP',\n  ZUSD: 'USD',\n  ZEUR: 'EUR',\n  ZGBP: 'GBP',\n  ZCAD: 'CAD',\n  ZJPY: 'JPY',\n  ZAUD: 'AUD',\n  ZCHF: 'CHF',\n};\n\nexport function krakenAsset(code: string): string {\n  const upper = String(code || '').toUpperCase();\n  const [base, ...suffix] = upper.split('.');\n  const mapped = KRAKEN_ASSETS[base] ?? base;\n  return suffix.length > 0 ? `${mapped}.${suffix.join('.')}` : mapped;\n}\n\n/**\n * Splits a Kraken pair in any of its three spellings - websocket \"XBT/USD\",\n * legacy \"XXBTZUSD\" and altname \"XBTUSD\" - into normalized base/quote\n * tickers. Returns null when no known quote suffix matches.\n */\nexport function krakenPairParts(pair: string): { base: string; quote: string } | null {\n  const upper = String(pair || '').toUpperCase();\n  if (upper.includes('/')) {\n    const [b, q] = upper.split('/');\n    return b && q ? { base: krakenAsset(b), quote: krakenAsset(q) } : null;\n  }\n  if (upper.length === 8 && /^[XZ]/.test(upper) && /^[XZ]/.test(upper.slice(4)) && KRAKEN_ASSETS[upper.slice(4)] !== undefined) {\n    return { base: krakenAsset(upper.slice(0, 4)), quote: krakenAsset(upper.slice(4)) };\n  }\n  for (const quote of ['USDT', 'USDC', 'ZUSD', 'ZEUR', 'ZGBP', 'ZCAD', 'ZJPY', 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'CAD', 'JPY', 'XBT', 'ETH']) {\n    if (upper.length > quote.length && upper.endsWith(quote)) {\n      return { base: krakenAsset(upper.slice(0, upper.length - quote.length)), quote: krakenAsset(quote) };\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\n/** The probe key name used to learn whether a key may withdraw. No such key exists by construction. */\nexport const KRAKEN_WITHDRAW_PROBE_KEY = '__wlct_permission_probe_no_such_key__';\n\n/**\n * Kraken Spot REST API, read side.\n *\n * Authentication: `API-Sign = base64(HMAC_SHA512(base64decode(secret), uriPath || SHA256(nonce + postData)))`,\n * where `||` is byte concatenation of the path and the raw SHA-256 digest. Kraken exposes no\n * endpoint that lists a key's permissions, so {@link getAccountMetadata}\n * PROBES them with two calls that cannot move funds or place an order:\n * `WithdrawInfo` for a withdrawal key that does not exist (answers\n * \"Permission denied\" only when the key lacks withdraw rights) and `AddOrder`\n * with `validate=true` (validated, never submitted). readonly urls: { liveRest: string; liveWs: string },\n    displayName = 'Kraken',\n  ) {\n    super();\n    this.displayName = displayName;\n  }\n\n  protected getLiveRestUrl(): string {\n    return `${parts[0]}-${parts[1]}` : String(instId || '').toUpperCase();\n}\n\nfunction instTypeOf(instId: string): 'SPOT' | 'SWAP' | 'FUTURES' | 'OPTION' {\n  const parts = String(instId).toUpperCase().split('-');\n  if (parts.length === 2) return 'SPOT';\n  if (parts[2] === 'SWAP') return 'SWAP';\n  if (parts.length >= 5) return 'OPTION';\n  return 'FUTURES';\n}\n\n/**\n * OKX V5 API, read side.\n *\n * Authentication: `OK-ACCESS-SIGN = base64(HMAC_SHA256(secret, timestamp + METHOD + requestPath + body))`\n * where `requestPath` includes the query string and `timestamp` is ISO-8601 with\n * milliseconds; the passphrase chosen at key creation rides in\n * `OK-ACCESS-PASSPHRASE`. OKX's demo trading uses the same host with\n * `x-simulated-trading: 1`, so TESTNET/SANDBOX differ from LIVE by that header,\n * which is added for every non-LIVE environment - a demo key sent without it\n * is rejected by the venue, and a live key sent with it is too.\n */\nexport class OkxProvider extends BaseExchangeProvider {\n  readonly venue = ExchangeVenue.OKX;\n  readonly displayName: string;\n  readonly supportedEnvironments: ExchangeEnvironment[] = [ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE, ExchangeEnvironment.TESTNET, ExchangeEnvironment.SANDBOX];\n  readonly supportedCapabilities: ExchangeCapability[] = [\n    ExchangeCapability.SPOT,\n    ExchangeCapability.MARGIN,\n    ExchangeCapability.FUTURES,\n    ExchangeCapability.PERPETUALS,\n    ExchangeCapability.MARKET_DATA,\n    ExchangeCapability.BALANCES,\n    ExchangeCapability.POSITIONS,\n    ExchangeCapability.ORDERS,\n    ExchangeCapability.TRADES,\n    ExchangeCapability.TESTNET,\n  ];\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly urls: { liveRest: string; testnetRest: string; sandboxRest: string; liveWs: string; testnetWs: string; sandboxWs: string },\n    displayName = 'OKX',\n  ) {\n    super();\n    this.displayName = displayName;\n  }\n\n  protected getLiveRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveRest;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.testnetRest;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxRestUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxRest;\n  }\n  protected getLiveWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.liveWs;\n  }\n  protected getTestnetWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.testnetWs;\n  }\n  protected getSandboxWsUrl(): string {\n    return this.urls.sandboxWs;\n  }\n\n  /** Exposed for tests: the exact V5 prehash signature. */\n  static sign(secret: string, timestamp: string, method: string, requestPath: string, body = ''): string {\n    return crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(timestamp + method.toUpperCase() + requestPath + body).digest('base64');\n  }\n\n  private buildQuery(params: Record<string, string | number | undefined>): string {\n    return Object.entries(params)\n      .filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== '')\n      .map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(String(v))}`)\n      .join('&');\n  }\n\n  private demoHeaders(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Record<string, string> {\n    return context.environment === ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE ? {} : { 'x-simulated-trading': '1' };\n  }\n\n  private unwrap(context: ExchangeProviderContext, data: any): any[] {\n    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, 'OKX returned a non-JSON body', context.venue, context.environment, true);\n    }\n    const code = String(data.code);\n    if (code === '0') return Array.isArray(data.data) ? data.data : [];\n    const message = `OKX code ${code}: ${String(data.msg ?? '').slice(0, 200)}`;\n    if (['50111', '50113', '50105', '50100', '50101', '50114'].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.AUTH_FAILED, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n    }\n    if (['50110', '50120', '50121'].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.PERMISSION_DENIED, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n    }\n    if (['50102', '50112'].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.CLOCK_DRIFT, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    if (['50011', '50061'].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.RATE_LIMITED, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    if (['50001', '50004', '50013', '50026'].includes(code)) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.SERVER_ERROR, message, context.venue, context.environment, true, 1000);\n    }\n    throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, message, context.venue, context.environment, false);\n  }\n\n  private async publicGet(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {}): Promise<any[]> {\n    const query = this.buildQuery(params);\n    const url = `${this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(context.environment)}${path}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`;\n    try {\n      return this.unwrap(context, await this.httpGet(url, this.demoHeaders(context)));\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async privateGet(context: ExchangeProviderContext, path: string, params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = {}): Promise<any[]> {\n    this.requireCredentials(context, true);\n    const query = this.buildQuery(params);\n    const requestPath = `${path}${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`;\n    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();\n    const signature = OkxProvider.sign(context.credentials.apiSecret, timestamp, 'GET', requestPath);\n    try {\n      const data = await this.httpGet(`${this.getRestBaseUrlForEnv(context.environment)}${requestPath}`, {\n        'OK-ACCESS-KEY': context.credentials.apiKey,\n        'OK-ACCESS-SIGN': signature,\n        'OK-ACCESS-TIMESTAMP': timestamp,\n        'OK-ACCESS-PASSPHRASE': context.credentials.passphrase as string,\n        ...this.demoHeaders(context),\n      });\n      return this.unwrap(context, data);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      throw this.normalizeError(e, context.venue, context.environment);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getServerTime(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeServerTime> {\n    const data = await this.publicGet(context, '/api/v5/public/time');\n    const ts = Number(data[0]?.ts);\n    if (!Number.isFinite(ts) || ts <= 0) {\n      throw new ExchangeProviderError(ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN, 'OKX server time missing from response', context.venue, context.environment, true);\n    }\n    return this.serverTimeFromMs(ts);\n  }\n\n  async testConnectivity(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeConnectivityResult> {\n    return this.connectivityFromMetadata(context);\n  }\n\n  async getAccountMetadata(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeAccountMetadata> {\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v5/account/config');\n    const config = data[0] ?? {};\n    const perms = String(config.perm ?? '')\n      .split(',')\n      .map((p: string) => p.trim())\n      .filter(Boolean);\n    const ip = String(config.ip ?? '').trim();\n    return {\n      accountId: context.accountId,\n      venue: context.venue,\n      environment: context.environment,\n      isSandbox: context.isSandbox,\n      canTrade: perms.includes('trade'),\n      canRead: perms.includes('read_only') || perms.includes('trade'),\n      canWithdraw: perms.includes('withdraw'),\n      ipRestricted: ip.length > 0,\n      permissions: perms,\n      uid: config.uid ? String(config.uid) : null,\n      email: null,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getCapabilities(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeCapabilityDiscovery> {\n    return {\n      venue: context.venue,\n      environment: context.environment,\n      capabilities: this.supportedCapabilities,\n      supportedOrderTypes: [ExchangeOrderType.MARKET, ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT, ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT_MAKER, ExchangeOrderType.STOP, ExchangeOrderType.STOP_LIMIT],\n      supportedEnvironments: this.supportedEnvironments,\n      apiVersion: 'v5',\n      restAvailable: true,\n      websocketAvailable: true,\n      rateLimitModel: 'REQUEST_COUNT',\n      authenticationModel: 'HMAC_SHA256_PASSPHRASE',\n      symbolFormat: 'BTC-USDT',\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getBalances(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeBalance[]> {\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v5/account/balance');\n    const details: any[] = Array.isArray(data[0]?.details) ? data[0].details : [];\n    const timestampMicros = msToMicros(data[0]?.uTime) ?? nowMicros();\n    return details\n      .map((d) => {\n        const free = dec(d.availBal);\n        const locked = dec(d.frozenBal);\n        const total = isDecimalString(d.cashBal) ? d.cashBal : addDecimalStrings(free, locked);\n        return {\n          asset: String(d.ccy),\n          free,\n          locked,\n          total,\n          providerReference: null,\n          timestampMicros,\n          source: 'REST',\n          isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n        };\n      })\n      .filter((b) => b.total !== '0' || b.locked !== '0');\n  }\n\n  async getPositions(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangePosition[]> {\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v5/account/positions');\n    return data\n      .filter((p) => isDecimalString(p.pos) && signOfDecimalString(p.pos) !== 0)\n      .map((p) => {\n        let side: ExchangePositionSide;\n        if (p.posSide === 'long') side = ExchangePositionSide.LONG;\n        else if (p.posSide === 'short') side = ExchangePositionSide.SHORT;\n        else side = signOfDecimalString(p.pos) > 0 ? ExchangePositionSide.LONG : ExchangePositionSide.SHORT;\n        return {\n          providerPositionId: p.posId ? String(p.posId) : null,\n          symbol: okxCanonical(p.instId),\n          exchangeSymbol: String(p.instId),\n          side,\n          quantity: absDecimalString(p.pos),\n          entryPrice: decOrNull(p.avgPx),\n          markPrice: decOrNull(p.markPx),\n          liquidationPrice: decOrNull(p.liqPx),\n          leverage: decOrNull(p.lever),\n          unrealizedPnl: decOrNull(p.upl),\n          realizedPnl: decOrNull(p.realizedPnl),\n          timestampMicros: msToMicros(p.uTime) ?? nowMicros(),\n          isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n        };\n      });\n  }\n\n  async getOpenOrders(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]> {\n    const params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = { limit: 100 };\n    if (symbol) {\n      params.instId = symbol.toUpperCase();\n      params.instType = instTypeOf(symbol);\n    }\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v5/trade/orders-pending', params);\n    return data.map((o) => this.mapOrder(context, o));\n  }\n\n  async getOrderHistory(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string, limit = 50): Promise<ExchangeOrder[]> {\n    const instTypes: Array<'SPOT' | 'SWAP' | 'FUTURES' | 'OPTION'> = symbol ? [instTypeOf(symbol)] : ['SPOT', 'SWAP'];\n    const rows: any[] = [];\n    for (const instType of instTypes) {\n      rows.push(...(await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v5/trade/orders-history', { instType, instId: symbol?.toUpperCase(), limit: Math.min(limit, 100) })));\n    }\n    return rows\n      .map((o) => this.mapOrder(context, o))\n      .sort((a, b) => Number(BigInt(b.createdAtMicros ?? '0') - BigInt(a.createdAtMicros ?? '0')))\n      .slice(0, limit);\n  }\n\n  async getTradeHistory(context: ExchangeProviderContext, symbol?: string, limit = 50): Promise<ExchangeFill[]> {\n    const params: Record<string, string | number | undefined> = { limit: Math.min(limit, 100) };\n    if (symbol) {\n      params.instId = symbol.toUpperCase();\n      params.instType = instTypeOf(symbol);\n    }\n    const data = await this.privateGet(context, '/api/v5/trade/fills', params);\n    return data.slice(0, limit).map((t) => ({\n      providerTradeId: String(t.tradeId),\n      providerOrderId: t.ordId ? String(t.ordId) : null,\n      clientOrderId: t.clOrdId ? String(t.clOrdId) : null,\n      symbol: okxCanonical(t.instId),\n      side: t.side === 'buy' ? ExchangeOrderSide.BUY : ExchangeOrderSide.SELL,\n      price: dec(t.fillPx),\n      quantity: dec(t.fillSz),\n      quoteQuantity: null,\n      // OKX reports fees as negative numbers (a charge) and rebates as positive;\n      // the platform's convention is a positive fee paid, so the sign flips.\n      fee: isDecimalString(t.fee) ? (t.fee.startsWith('-') ? t.fee.slice(1) : t.fee === '0' ? '0' : `-${t.fee}`) : null,\n      feeCurrency: t.feeCcy ? String(t.feeCcy) : null,\n      isMaker: t.execType === 'M' ? true : t.execType === 'T' ? false : null,\n      timestampMicros: msToMicros(t.ts) ?? nowMicros(),\n      isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n    }));\n  }\n\n  async getSymbols(context: ExchangeProviderContext): Promise<ExchangeSymbol[]> {\n    const data = await this.publicGet(context, '/api/v5/public/instruments', { instType: 'SPOT' });\n    return data\n      .filter((s) => s.state === 'live')\n      .map((s) => ({\n        canonicalSymbol: `${s.baseCcy}-${s.quoteCcy}`,\n        exchangeSymbol: String(s.instId),\n        baseAsset: String(s.baseCcy),\n        quoteAsset: String(s.quoteCcy),\n        contractType: 'SPOT',\n        tickSize: String(s.tickSz),\n        quantityStep: String(s.lotSz),\n        minQuantity: decOrNull(s.minSz),\n        maxQuantity: decOrNull(s.maxLmtSz),\n        minNotional: null,\n        maxNotional: null,\n        pricePrecision: precisionOfStep(String(s.tickSz)),\n        quantityPrecision: precisionOfStep(String(s.lotSz)),\n        minLeverage: null,\n        maxLeverage: null,\n        isTradeable: true,\n      }));\n  }\n\n  private mapOrder(context: ExchangeProviderContext, o: any): ExchangeOrder {\n    const ordType = String(o.ordType);\n    let type: ExchangeOrderType;\n    if (ordType === 'market') type = ExchangeOrderType.MARKET;\n    else if (ordType === 'post_only') type = ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT_MAKER;\n    else type = ExchangeOrderType.LIMIT;\n    const fee = isDecimalString(o.fee) ? (o.fee.startsWith('-') ? o.fee.slice(1) : o.fee === '0' ? '0' : `-${o.fee}`) : null;\n    return {\n      clientOrderId: o.clOrdId ? String(o.clOrdId) : String(o.ordId),\n      providerOrderId: o.ordId ? String(o.ordId) : null,\n      symbol: okxCanonical(o.instId),\n      exchangeSymbol: String(o.instId),\n      side: o.side === 'buy' ? ExchangeOrderSide.BUY : ExchangeOrderSide.SELL,\n      type,\n      status: OkxProvider.mapOrderStatus(String(o.state)),\n      providerRawStatus: o.state ? String(o.state) : null,\n      quantity: dec(o.sz),\n      price: type === ExchangeOrderType.MARKET ? null : decOrNull(o.px),\n      stopPrice: null,\n      filledQuantity: dec(o.accFillSz),\n      averagePrice: decOrNull(o.avgPx),\n      fee,\n      feeCurrency: o.feeCcy ? String(o.feeCcy) : null,\n      createdAtMicros: msToMicros(o.cTime),\n      updatedAtMicros: msToMicros(o.uTime),\n      isSimulated: context.isSandbox,\n    };\n  }\n\n  static mapOrderStatus(state: string): ExchangeOrderStatus {\n    switch (state) {\n      case 'live':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.NEW;\n      case 'partially_filled':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED;\n      case 'filled':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.FILLED;\n      case 'canceled':\n      case 'mmp_canceled':\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.CANCELED;\n      default:\n        return ExchangeOrderStatus.NEW;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/exchanges/venues/venue-providers.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Signatures are checked against independent re-computations\n * of each venue's published algorithm.\n */\nimport { afterEach, describe, expect, jest, test } from '@jest/globals';\nimport * as crypto from 'crypto';\nimport { ExchangeEnvironment, ExchangeVenue, ExchangeOrderStatus, ExchangePositionSide, ExchangeOrderSide, ExchangeConnectionState, ExchangeOrderType } from '../exchange.types';\nimport { ExchangeProviderContext, ExchangeProviderError, ExchangeProviderErrorCode } from '../exchange-provider.interface';\nimport { BybitProvider } from './bybit.provider';\nimport { OkxProvider, okxCanonical } from './okx.provider';\nimport { KrakenProvider, krakenAsset, krakenPairParts, KRAKEN_WITHDRAW_PROBE_KEY } from './kraken.provider';\nimport { CoinbaseProvider, buildCoinbaseJwt, loadCoinbaseKey } from './coinbase.provider';\nimport { BybitProvider as RegisteredBybitProvider } from '../providers/bybit.provider';\nimport { OkxProvider as RegisteredOkxProvider } from '../providers/okx.provider';\nimport { KrakenProvider as RegisteredKrakenProvider } from '../providers/kraken.provider';\nimport { CoinbaseProvider as RegisteredCoinbaseProvider } from '../providers/coinbase.provider';\nimport { canonicalFromConcatenated, addDecimalStrings, subtractDecimalStrings } from '../base-exchange-provider';\nimport { ExchangeProviderFactory } from '../exchange-provider.factory';\nimport { ExchangeRegistryService } from '../exchange-registry.service';\n\ntype Route = (url: string, init: any) => { status?: number; body: any } | undefined;\n\ninterface FetchCall {\n  url: string;\n  method: string;\n  headers: Record<string, string>;\n  body?: string;\n}\n\nfunction installFetch(route: Route): FetchCall[] {\n  const calls: FetchCall[] = [];\n  jest.spyOn(global as any, 'fetch').mockImplementation(async (...args: any[]) => {\n    const url = String(args[0]);\n    const init = args[1] ?? {};\n    calls.push({ url, method: init.method ?? 'GET', headers: init.headers ?? {}, body: init.body });\n    const answer = route(url, init);\n    if (!answer) throw new Error(`unrouted fetch ${url}`);\n    const status = answer.status ?? 200;\n    const text = typeof answer.body === 'string' ? answer.body : JSON.stringify(answer.body);\n    return {\n      ok: status >= 200 && status < 300,\n      status,\n      statusText: String(status),\n      headers: new Map<string, string>(),\n      text: async () => text,\n    } as any;\n  });\n  return calls;\n}\n\nfunction ctx(venue: ExchangeVenue, environment: ExchangeEnvironment, passphrase?: string, secret = 'test-secret'): ExchangeProviderContext {\n  return {\n    tenantId: 'tenant-1',\n    accountId: 'acct-1',\n    venue,\n    environment,\n    isSandbox: environment !== ExchangeEnvironment.LIVE,\n    credentials: { apiKey: 'test-key', apiSecret: secret, passphrase } as any,\n    credentialRef: null,\n  };\n}\n\nasync function expectCode(promise: Promise<unknown>, code: ExchangeProviderErrorCode): Promise<void> {\n  let caught: unknown;\n  try {\n    await promise;\n  } catch (e) {\n    caught = e;\n  }\n  expect(caught).toBeInstanceOf(ExchangeProviderError);\n  expect((caught as ExchangeProviderError).code).toBe(code);\n}\n\nconst URLS = {\n  liveRest: 'https://live.example',\n  testnetRest: 'https://testnet.example',\n  sandboxRest: 'https://sandbox.example',\n  liveWs: 'wss://live.example',\n  testnetWs: 'wss://testnet.example',\n  sandboxWs: 'wss://sandbox.example',\n};\n\nafterEach(() => {\n  jest.restoreAllMocks();\n});\n\ndescribe('shared helpers', () => {\n  test('canonicalFromConcatenated prefers the longest known quote', () => {\n    expect(canonicalFromConcatenated('BTCUSDT')).toBe('BTC-USDT');\n    expect(canonicalFromConcatenated('ETHUSDC')).toBe('ETH-USDC');\n    expect(canonicalFromConcatenated('SOLBTC')).toBe('SOL-BTC');\n  });\n\n  test('decimal string arithmetic is exact', () => {\n    expect(addDecimalStrings('0.1', '0.2')).toBe('0.3');\n    expect(subtractDecimalStrings('1.00000001', '0.00000001')).toMatch(/^1(\\.0*)?$/);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('BybitProvider', () => {\n  const provider = new BybitProvider(URLS);\n\n  test('signature is HMAC-SHA256 hex over timestamp+key+recvWindow+query', () => {\n    const expected = crypto.createHmac('sha256', 's').update('1700000000000k5000a=1&b=2').digest('hex');\n    expect(BybitProvider.sign('s', '1700000000000', 'k', '5000', 'a=1&b=2')).toBe(expected);\n  });\n\n  test('signed request carries V5 headers and a verifiable signature', async () => {\n    const calls = installFetch((url) =>\n      url.includes('/v5/account/wallet-balance')\n        ? { body: { retCode: 0, result: { list: [{ accountType: 'UNIFIED', coin: [{ coin: 'USDT', walletBalance: '100.5', locked: '0.5' }, { coin: 'BTC', walletBalance: '0', locked: '0' }] }] } } }\n        : undefined,\n    );\n    const balances = await provider.getBalances(ctx(ExchangeVenue.BYBIT, ExchangeEnvironment.TESTNET));\n    expect(calls[0].url.startsWith('https://testnet.example/v5/account/wallet-balance?accountType=UNIFIED')).toBe(true);\n    const h = calls[0].headers;\n    const query = calls[0].url.split('?')[1];\n    expect(h['X-BAPI-SIGN']).toBe(BybitProvider.sign('test-secret', h['X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP'], 'test-key', h['X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW'], query));\n    expect(balances).toEqual([\n      expect.objectContaining({ asset: 'USDT', total: '100.5', locked: '0.5', free: '100', isSimulated: true }),\n    ]);\n  });\n\n  test.each([\n    [10003, ExchangeProviderErrorCode.AUTH_FAILED],\n    [10005, ExchangeProviderErrorCode.PERMISSION_DENIED],\n    [10002, ExchangeProviderErrorCode.CLOCK_DRIFT],\n    [10006, ExchangeProviderErrorCode.RATE_LIMITED],\n    [10016, ExchangeProviderErrorCode.SERVER_ERROR],\n    [99999, ExchangeProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN],\n  ])('retCode %s is classified, never returned as empty data', async (retCode, code) => {\n DataClassification.FINANCIAL);\n    map.set('billing_ledger_reference', DataClassification.FINANCIAL);\n    map.set('portfolio_position', DataClassification.FINANCIAL);\n    map.set('balance_reference', DataClassification.FINANCIAL);\n    map.set('payment_metadata', DataClassification.FINANCIAL);\n    map.set('password_hash', DataClassification.SECURITY_SENSITIVE);\n DataClassification.SECURITY_SENSITIVE);\n    map.set('device_information', DataClassification.SECURITY_SENSITIVE);\n    map.set('ip_address', DataClassification.PII);\n    map.set('withdrawal_destination', DataClassification.FINANCIAL);\n    return map;\n  }\n\n  classifyField(fieldName: string, sourceSystem: string): DataClassification {\n    if (!fieldName) throw new BadRequestException('fieldName required');\n    const normalized = fieldName.toLowerCase().trim();\n    if (this.classificationRules.has(normalized)) {\n      return this.classificationRules.get(normalized)!;\n    }\n    if (normalized.includes('email') || normalized.includes('phone') || normalized.includes('pii')) return DataClassification.PII;\n    if (normalized.includes('kyc') || normalized.includes('government') || normalized.includes('identity')) return DataClassification.KYC_SENSITIVE;\n    if (normalized.includes('transaction') || normalized.includes('balance') || normalized.includes('invoice') || normalized.includes('ledger') || normalized.includes('portfolio')) return DataClassification.FINANCIAL;\n    if  sourceField: string;\n    jurisdiction: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n    classifiedBy: string;\n  }): Promise<DataClassificationRecord> {\n any).governanceDataClassification?.create?.({\n        data: {\n          id: record.id,\n          tenantId: record.tenantId,\n          sourceSystem: record.sourceSystem,\n          sourceTable: record.sourceTable,\n          sourceField: record.sourceField,\n          dataClass: record.dataClass,\n          jurisdiction: record.jurisdiction,\n          sensitivityScore: record.classifiedBy,\n          policyVersion: record.policyVersion,\n          correlationId: record.correlationId,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`classification persist skipped id=${record.id}`);\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`classified tenant=${params.tenantId} field=${params.sourceField} class=${dataClass} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return record;\n  }\n\n  private sensitivityScore(dc: DataClassification): number {\n    switch (dc) {\n      case DataClassification.PUBLIC:\n        return 10;\n      case DataClassification.INTERNAL:\n        return 30;\n      case DataClassification.CONFIDENTIAL:\n        return 60;\n      case DataClassification.PII:\n        return 80;\n      case DataClassification.FINANCIAL:\n        return 85;\n      case DataClassification.KYC_SENSITIVE:\n        return 90;\n      case DataClassification.SECURITY_SENSITIVE:\n        return 95;\n      case DataClassification.REGULATED:\n        return 90;\n      case DataClassification.RESTRICTED:\n        return 95;\n      default:\n        return 50;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async listClassifications(tenantId: string): Promise<DataClassificationRecord[]> {\n sensitivityScore: r.sensitivityScore,\n          piiFlag: r.piiFlag,\n          regulatedFlag: r.regulatedFlag,\n          classifiedAt: r.classifiedAt instanceof Date ? r.classifiedAt.toISOString() : r.classifiedAt,\n          classifiedBy: r.classifiedBy,\n          policyVersion: r.policyVersion,\n          correlationId: r.correlationId,\n        }));\n      }\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`listClassifications fallback tenant=${tenantId}`);\n    }\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  isExportAllowed(dataClass: DataClassification, policy: { exportEligibility: Record<DataClassification, boolean> }): boolean {\n    return policy.exportEligibility[dataClass] ?? false;\n  }\n\n  isDeletionConstrained(dataClass: DataClassification, policy: { crypto from 'crypto';\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class EvidencePackageService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(EvidencePackageService.name);\n  private readonly inMemory: Map<string, EvidencePackage> = new Map();\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly policyService: GovernancePolicyService,\n    private readonly audit: GovernanceAuditService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createPackage(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    caseReference: string;\n    evidenceType: string;\n    sourceRecords: string[];\n    sourceReferences: string[];\n    redactionPolicy: string;\n    generator: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n    createdBy: string;\n    auditReference?: string;\n  }): Promise<EvidencePackage> {\n    if (!params.tenantId || !params.caseReference || !params.evidenceType) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId, caseReference, evidenceType required');\n    if (!params.sourceRecords || params.sourceRecords.length === 0) throw new BadRequestException('sourceRecords required');\n\n    // Validate source references come from authoritative systems\n    for (const ref of params.sourceReferences) {\n      const system = ref.split(':')[0];\n      if (system && !AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE_SYSTEMS.includes(system as any) && system !== 'ClientProfile' && system !== 'Users') {\n        // Allow any prefix that is in authoritative list, but log warning for unknown\n        this.logger.warn(`evidence source reference ${ref} not in authoritative list corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const fingerprint = crypto\n      .createHash('sha256')\n      .update(JSON.stringify({ tenantId: params.tenantId, caseReference: params.caseReference, sourceRecords: [...params.sourceRecords].sort(), policyVersion: this.policyService.getPolicyVersion() }))\n      .digest('hex');\n\n    const pkg: EvidencePackage = {\n      id: `evp_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      caseReference: params.caseReference,\n      evidenceType: params.evidenceType,\n      state: EvidenceState.DRAFT,\n      sourceRecords: params.sourceRecords,\n      sourceReferences: params.sourceReferences,\n      recordCount: params.sourceRecords.length,\n      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      finalizedAt: null,\n      fileLocation: `governance/evidence/${params.tenantId}/${params.caseReference}/${Date.now()}.json`,\n      fileHash: fingerprint,\n      fingerprint,\n      redactionPolicy: params.redactionPolicy,\n      generator: params.generator,\n      auditReference: params.auditReference ?? null,\n      policyVersion: this.policyService.getPolicyVersion(),\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      isImmutable: false,\n    };\n\n    this.inMemory.set(pkg.id, pkg);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).evidencePackage?.create?.({\n        data: {\n          id: pkg.id,\n          tenantId: pkg.tenantId,\n          caseReference: pkg.caseReference,\n          evidenceType: pkg.evidenceType,\n          state: pkg.state,\n          sourceRecords: pkg.sourceRecords,\n          sourceReferences: pkg.sourceReferences,\n          recordCount: pkg.recordCount,\n          generatedAt: new Date(pkg.generatedAt),\n          fileLocation: pkg.fileLocation,\n          fileHash: pkg.fileHash,\n          fingerprint: pkg.fingerprint,\n          redactionPolicy: pkg.redactionPolicy,\n          generator: pkg.generator,\n          auditReference: pkg.auditReference,\n          policyVersion: pkg.policyVersion,\n          correlationId: pkg.correlationId,\n          isImmutable: pkg.isImmutable,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`evidence persist skipped id=${pkg.id}`);\n    }\n\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      actionType: GovernanceActionType.EVIDENCE_PACKAGE_CREATE,\n      evidencePackageId: pkg.id,\n      state: pkg.state,\n      result: 'CREATED',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      createdBy: params.createdBy,\n      safeEvidence: { caseReference: params.caseReference, evidenceType: params.evidenceType, recordCount: pkg.recordCount, fingerprint },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`evidence package created id=${pkg.id} case=${params.caseReference} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return pkg;\n  }\n\n  async finalizePackage(params: { tenantId: string; packageId: string; correlationId: string; operatorId: string }): Promise<EvidencePackage> {\n    const pkg = await this.getPackage(params.tenantId, params.packageId);\n    if (pkg.isImmutable) throw new BadRequestException('evidence package already immutable');\n    if (pkg.state === EvidenceState.FINALIZED) throw new BadRequestException('already finalized');\n\n    pkg.state = EvidenceState.FINALIZED;\n    pkg.finalizedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    pkg.isImmutable = true;\n\n    this.inMemory.set(pkg.id, pkg);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).evidencePackage?.update?.({\n        where: { id: pkg.id },\n        data: { state: pkg.state, finalizedAt: new Date(pkg.finalizedAt), isImmutable: true },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`evidence finalize persist skipped id=${pkg.id}`);\n    }\n\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      actionType: GovernanceActionType.EVIDENCE_PACKAGE_FINALIZE,\n      evidencePackageId: pkg.id,\n      state: pkg.state,\n      result: 'FINALIZED',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      createdBy: params.operatorId,\n      safeEvidence: { caseReference: pkg.caseReference, fingerprint: pkg.fingerprint, recordCount: pkg.recordCount },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`evidence package finalized id=${pkg.id} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return pkg;\n  }\n\n  async getPackage(tenantId: string, packageId: string): Promise<EvidencePackage> {\n    const mem = this.inMemory.get(packageId);\n    if (mem) {\n      this.policyService.assertTenantIsolation(tenantId, mem.tenantId);\n      return mem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).evidencePackage?.findUnique?.({ where: { id: packageId } });\n      if (row) {\n        this.policyService.assertTenantIsolation(tenantId, row.tenantId);\n        const mapped = this.mapRow(row);\n        this.inMemory.set(mapped.id, mapped);\n        return mapped;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      /* ignore */\n    }\n    throw new NotFoundException(`evidence package ${packageId} not found`);\n  }\n\n  async listPackages(tenantId: string, filters?: { caseReference?: string; evidenceType?: string; state?: EvidenceState }): Promise<EvidencePackage[]> {\n    let list = [...this.inMemory.values()].filter((p) => p.tenantId === tenantId);\n    if (filters?.caseReference) list = list.filter((p) => p.caseReference === filters.caseReference);\n    if (filters?.evidenceType) list = list.filter((p) => p.evidenceType === filters.evidenceType);\n    if (filters?.state) list = list.filter((p) => p.state === filters.state);\n    try {\n      const where: any = { tenantId };\n      if (filters?.caseReference) where.caseReference = filters.caseReference;\n      if (filters?.evidenceType) where.evidenceType = filters.evidenceType;\n      if (filters?.state) where.state = filters.state;\n      const rows = await (this.prisma as any).evidencePackage?.findMany?.({ where, take: 500, orderBy: { generatedAt: 'desc' } });\n      if (rows && rows.length > 0) list = rows.map((r: any) => this.mapRow(r));\n    } catch {\n      /* ignore */\n    }\n    return list;\n  }\n\n  async assertImmutable(tenantId: string, packageId: string): Promise<void> {\n    const pkg = await this.getPackage(tenantId, packageId);\n    if (!pkg.isImmutable) throw new BadRequestException('evidence package not immutable yet');\n  }\n\n  private mapRow(row: any): EvidencePackage {\n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      tenantId: row.tenantId,\n      caseReference: row.caseReference,\n      evidenceType: row.evidenceType,\n      state: row.state,\n      sourceRecords: row.sourceRecords ?? [],\n      sourceReferences: row.sourceReferences ?? [],\n      recordCount: row.recordCount ?? 0,\n      generatedAt: row.generatedAt instanceof Date ? row.generatedAt.toISOString() : row.generatedAt,\n      finalizedAt: row.finalizedAt ? (row.finalizedAt instanceof Date ? row.finalizedAt.toISOString() : row.finalizedAt) : null,\n      fileLocation: row.fileLocation ?? null,\n      fileHash: row.fileHash ?? null,\n      fingerprint: row.fingerprint,\n      redactionPolicy: row.redactionPolicy,\n      generator: row.generator,\n      auditReference: row.auditReference ?? null,\n      policyVersion: row.policyVersion,\n      correlationId: row.correlationId,\n      isImmutable: !!row.isImmutable,\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/governance/governance-action.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. this.inMemory.set(action.id, action);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).governanceAction?.update?.({ where: { id: action.id }, data: { state: action.state, approvedBy: action.approvedBy, safeEvidence: { actionId: action.id, approverRole: params.approverRole },\n    });\n\n    return action;\n  }\n\n  async rejectAction(params: { tenantId: string; actionId: string; rejectedBy: string; actionType: action.actionType,\n      state: action.state,\n      result: 'REJECTED',\n      reason: params.reason,\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      createdBy: params.rejectedBy,\n      safeEvidence: { actionId: action.id },\n    });\n    return action;\n  }\n\n  async markExecuted(params: { tenantId: string; actionId: string; correlationId: string; operatorId: string }):
