GovernanceMetrics {\n  tenantId: string;\n  generatedAt: string;\n  policyVersion: string;\n  privacyRequests: { total: number; byState: Record<string, number>; byType: Record<string, number> };\n  retention: { total: number; byState: Record<string, number>; blockedByLegalHold: number };\n  legalHolds: { total: number; active: number; byJurisdiction: Record<string, number> };\n  reports: { total: number; byState: Record<string, number>; byType: Record<string, number>; certified: number; delivered: number };\n  evidencePackages: { total: number; byState: Record<string, number>; immutable: number };\n  consents: { total: number; active: number; withdrawn: number };\n  reconciliation: { openMismatches: number; byType: Record<string, number>; bySeverity: Record<string, number> };\n  audit: { totalEvents: number; byAction: Record<string, number> };\n  correlationId: string;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class GovernanceMetricsService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(GovernanceMetricsService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly policyService: GovernancePolicyService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async getMetrics(tenantId: string, correlationId: string): Promise<GovernanceMetrics> {\n    const metrics: GovernanceMetrics = {\n      tenantId,\n      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      policyVersion: this.policyService.getPolicyVersion(),\n      privacyRequests: { total: 0, byState: {}, byType: {} },\n      retention: { total: 0, byState: {}, blockedByLegalHold: 0 },\n      legalHolds: { total: 0, active: 0, byJurisdiction: {} },\n      reports: { total: 0, byState: {}, byType: {}, certified: 0, delivered: 0 },\n      evidencePackages: { total: 0, byState: {}, immutable: 0 },\n      consents: { total: 0, active: 0, withdrawn: 0 },\n      reconciliation: { openMismatches: 0, byType: {}, bySeverity: {} },\n      audit: { totalEvents: 0, byAction: {} },\n      correlationId,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const pr = await (this.prisma as any).privacyRequest?.groupBy?.({ by: ['state'], where: { tenantId }, _count: { _all: true } });\n      if (pr) {\n        for (const g of pr) {\n          metrics.privacyRequests.byState[g.state] = g._count._all;\n          metrics.privacyRequests.total += g._count._all;\n        }\n      }\n      const prType = await (this.prisma as any).privacyRequest?.groupBy?.({ by: ['requestType'], where: { tenantId }, _count: { _all: true } });\n      if (prType) {\n        for (const g of prType) metrics.privacyRequests.byType[g.requestType] = g._count._all;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug('metrics privacy fallback');\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const ret = await (this.prisma as any).retentionCandidate?.groupBy?.({ by: ['state'], where: { tenantId }, _count: { _all: true } });\n      if (ret) {\n        for (const g of ret) {\n          metrics.retention.byState[g.state] = g._count._all;\n          metrics.retention.total += g._count._all;\n        }\n      }\n      const blocked = await (this.prisma as any).retentionCandidate?.count?.({ where: { tenantId, blockedByLegalHold: true } });\n      if (typeof blocked === 'number') metrics.retention.blockedByLegalHold = blocked;\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug('metrics retention fallback');\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const lhTotal = await (this.prisma as any).legalHold?.count?.({ where: { OR: [{ tenantId }, { tenantId: null }] } });\n      const lhActive = await (this.prisma as any).legalHold?.count?.({ where: { state: 'ACTIVE', OR: [{ tenantId }, { tenantId: null }] } });\n      if (typeof lhTotal === 'number') metrics.legalHolds.total = lhTotal;\n      if (typeof lhActive === 'number') metrics.legalHolds.active = lhActive;\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug('metrics legalHold fallback');\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const rep = await (this.prisma as any).complianceReport?.groupBy?.({ by: ['state'], where: { tenantId }, _count: { _all: true } });\n      if (rep) {\n        for (const g of rep) {\n          metrics.reports.byState[g.state] = g._count._all;\n          metrics.reports.total += g._count._all;\n        }\n      }\n      const repType = await (this.prisma as any).complianceReport?.groupBy?.({ by: ['reportType'], where: { tenantId }, _count: { _all: true } });\n      if (repType) for (const g of repType) metrics.reports.byType[g.reportType] = g._count._all;\n      const certified = await (this.prisma as any).complianceReport?.count?.({ where: { tenantId, certificationStatus: 'APPROVED' } });\n      const delivered = await (this.prisma as any).complianceReport?.count?.({ where: { tenantId, deliveryStatus: 'DELIVERED' } });\n      if (typeof certified === 'number') metrics.reports.certified = certified;\n      if (typeof delivered === 'number') metrics.reports.delivered = delivered;\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug('metrics report fallback');\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const ev = await (this.prisma as any).evidencePackage?.groupBy?.({ by: ['state'], where: { tenantId }, _count: { _all: true } });\n      if (ev) {\n        for (const g of ev) {\n          metrics.evidencePackages.byState[g.state] = g._count._all;\n          metrics.evidencePackages.total += g._count._all;\n        }\n      }\n      const imm = await (this.prisma as any).evidencePackage?.count?.({ where: { tenantId, isImmutable: true } });\n      if (typeof imm === 'number') metrics.evidencePackages.immutable = imm;\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug('metrics evidence fallback');\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const cons = await (this.prisma as any).consentRecord?.groupBy?.({ by: ['status'], where: { tenantId }, _count: { _all: true } });\n      if (cons) {\n        for (const g of cons) {\n          if (g.status === 'ACTIVE') metrics.consents.active = g._count._all;\n          if (g.status === 'WITHDRAWN') metrics.consents.withdrawn = g._count._all;\n          metrics.consents.total += g._count._all;\n        }\n      }\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug('metrics consent fallback');\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const recon = await (this.prisma as any).governanceReconciliation?.groupBy?.({ by: ['type'], where: { tenantId }, _count: { _all: true } });\n      if (recon) {\n        for (const g of recon) {\n          metrics.reconciliation.byType[g.type] = g._count._all;\n          metrics.reconciliation.openMismatches += g._count._all;\n        }\n      }\n      const sev = await (this.prisma as any).governanceReconciliation?.groupBy?.({ by: ['severity'], where: { tenantId }, _count: { _all: true } });\n      if (sev) for (const g of sev) metrics.reconciliation.bySeverity[g.severity] = g._count._all;\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug('metrics reconciliation fallback');\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const auditTotal = await (this.prisma as any).governanceAudit?.count?.({ where: { tenantId } });\n      if (typeof auditTotal === 'number') metrics.audit.totalEvents = auditTotal;\n      const auditBy = await (this.prisma as any).governanceAudit?.groupBy?.({ by: ['actionType'], where: { tenantId }, _count: { _all: true } });\n      if (auditBy) for (const g of auditBy) metrics.audit.byAction[g.actionType] = g._count._all;\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug('metrics audit fallback');\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`metrics generated tenant=${tenantId} corr=${correlationId}`);\n    return metrics;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/governance/governance-policy.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'jurisdiction' { Injectable, Logger, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';\nimport {\n  GovernancePolicy,\n  DataClassification,\n  PrivacyRequestType,\n  PrivacyRequestState,\n  RetentionRule,\n  GovernanceActionType,\n} from './governance.types';\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class GovernancePolicyService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(GovernancePolicyService.name);\n\n  private readonly defaultPolicyVersion: string;\n  private readonly supportedJurisdictions: string[];\n  private readonly retentionDefaults: Record<string, number>;\n\n  constructor(private readonly config: ConfigService) {\n    this.defaultPolicyVersion = this.config.get<string>('GOVERNANCE_POLICY_VERSION', '2026-01');\n    const jurisdictionsRaw = this.config.get<string>('GOVERNANCE_JURISDICTIONS', 'US,EU,UK,SG,AE');\n    this.supportedJurisdictions = jurisdictionsRaw\n      .split(',')\n      .map((j) => j.trim().toUpperCase())\n      .filter(Boolean);\n\n    const retentionRaw = this.config.get<string>('GOVERNANCE_RETENTION_DAYS_DEFAULTS', '');\n    this.retentionDefaults = this.parseRetentionDefaults(retentionRaw);\n  }\n\n  private parseRetentionDefaults(raw: string): Record<string, number> {\n    const defaults: Record<string, number> = {\n      [DataClassification.PUBLIC]: 365,\n      [DataClassification.INTERNAL]: 1095,\n      [DataClassification.CONFIDENTIAL]: 2555,\n      [DataClassification.PII]: 1095,\n      [DataClassification.FINANCIAL]: 2555,\n      [DataClassification.SECURITY_SENSITIVE]: 2555,\n      [DataClassification.KYC_SENSITIVE]: 2555,\n      [DataClassification.REGULATED]: 2555,\n      [DataClassification.RESTRICTED]: 2555,\n    };\n    if (!raw) return defaults;\n    for (const pair of raw.split(',')) {\n      const [k, v] = pair.split('=').map((s) => s.trim());\n      if (k && v) {\n        const n = Number(v);\n        if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) defaults[k.toUpperCase()] = n;\n      }\n    }\n    return defaults;\n  }\n\n  validateJurisdiction(jurisdiction: string): void {\n    if (!jurisdiction) throw new BadRequestException('jurisdiction required');\n    const upper = jurisdiction.toUpperCase();\n    if (!this.supportedJurisdictions.includes(upper)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`unsupported jurisdiction ${jurisdiction}, supported: ${this.supportedJurisdictions.join(',')}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  getPolicyVersion(): string {\n    return this.defaultPolicyVersion;\n  }\n\n  getSupportedJurisdictions(): string[] {\n    return [...this.supportedJurisdictions];\n  }\n\n  buildPolicy(tenantId: string | null, jurisdiction: string): GovernancePolicy {\n    this.validateJurisdiction(jurisdiction);\n    const j = jurisdiction.toUpperCase();\n\n    const retentionRules: RetentionRule[] = Object.values(DataClassification).map((dc) => {\n      const days = this.retentionDefaults[dc] ?? 1095;\n      let eligible: RetentionRule['eligibleAction'] = 'REVIEW';\n      if (dc === DataClassification.PUBLIC) eligible = 'DELETE';\n      else if (dc === DataClassification.PII) eligible = 'ANONYMIZE';\n      else if (dc === DataClassification.FINANCIAL || dc === DataClassification.REGULATED || dc === DataClassification.KYC_SENSITIVE) eligible = 'PRESERVE';\n\n      return {\n        dataClass: dc as DataClassification,\n        jurisdiction: j,\n        retentionPeriodDays: days,\n        retentionStartEvent: this.getRetentionStartEvent(dc as DataClassification),\n        eligibleAction: eligible,\n        policyVersion: this.defaultPolicyVersion,\n        legalHoldOverride: true,\n        requiresApproval: dc === DataClassification.FINANCIAL || dc === DataClassification.REGULATED || dc === DataClassification.KYC_SENSITIVE,\n      };\n    });\n\n    return {\n      tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n      jurisdiction: j,\n      policyVersion: this.defaultPolicyVersion,\n      dataClassifications: Object.values(DataClassification) as DataClassification[],\n      retentionRules,\n      privacyWorkflows: this.buildPrivacyWorkflows(j),\n      reportRequirements: this.buildReportRequirements(j),\n      evidenceRequirements: this.buildEvidenceRequirements(j),\n      legalHoldPrecedence: true,\n      approvalRequirements: this.buildApprovalRequirements(),\n      piiFields: ['email', 'phone', 'address', 'government_id_reference', 'kyc_metadata'],\n      sensitiveFields: ['password', 'secret', 'privateKey', 'apiKey', 'token', 'card', 'cvv', 'ssn'],\n      exportEligibility: {\n        [DataClassification.PUBLIC]: true,\n        [DataClassification.INTERNAL]: true,\n        [DataClassification.CONFIDENTIAL]: false,\n        [DataClassification.PII]: true,\n        [DataClassification.FINANCIAL]: true,\n        [DataClassification.SECURITY_SENSITIVE]: false,\n        [DataClassification.KYC_SENSITIVE]: false,\n        [DataClassification.REGULATED]: true,\n        [DataClassification.RESTRICTED]: false,\n      },\n      deletionConstraints: {\n        [DataClassification.PUBLIC]: false,\n        [DataClassification.INTERNAL]: true,\n        [DataClassification.CONFIDENTIAL]: true,\n        [DataClassification.PII]: true,\n        [DataClassification.FINANCIAL]: true,\n        [DataClassification.SECURITY_SENSITIVE]: true,\n        [DataClassification.KYC_SENSITIVE]: true,\n        [DataClassification.REGULATED]: true,\n        [DataClassification.RESTRICTED]: true,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  private getRetentionStartEvent(dc: DataClassification): string {\n    switch (dc) {\n      case DataClassification.PII:\n        return 'ACCOUNT_CLOSURE_OR_LAST_INTERACTION';\n      case DataClassification.FINANCIAL:\n        return 'TRANSACTION_COMPLETION_OR_FISCAL_YEAR_END';\n      case DataClassification.KYC_SENSITIVE:\n        return 'KYC_COMPLETION_OR_ACCOUNT_CLOSURE';\n      case DataClassification.REGULATED:\n        return 'REGULATORY_EVENT_OR_ACCOUNT_CLOSURE';\n      case DataClassification.SECURITY_SENSITIVE:\n        return 'SECURITY_EVENT_OR_ACCOUNT_CLOSURE';\n      default:\n        return 'CREATION_OR_LAST_MODIFICATION';\n    }\n  }\n\n  private buildPrivacyWorkflows(jurisdiction: string) {\n    const base = [\n      { type: PrivacyRequestType.ACCESS, sla: 30 * 24 },\n      { type: PrivacyRequestType.EXPORT, sla: 30 * 24 },\n      { type: PrivacyRequestType.CORRECTION, sla: 30 * 24 },\n      { type: PrivacyRequestType.DELETION, sla: 30 * 24 },\n      { type: PrivacyRequestType.RESTRICTION, sla: 30 * 24 },\n      { type: PrivacyRequestType.OBJECTION, sla: 30 * 24 },\n    ];\n    return base.map((b) => ({\n      requestType: b.type,\n      jurisdiction,\n      requiresIdentityVerification: true,\n      requiresApproval: b.type === PrivacyRequestType.DELETION || b.type === PrivacyRequestType.EXPORT,\n      allowedStates: Object.values(PrivacyRequestState),\n      slaHours: b.sla,\n      policyVersion: this.defaultPolicyVersion,\n    }));\n  }\n\n  private buildReportRequirements(jurisdiction: string) {\n    const types = ['TRANSACTION_REPORT', 'TAX_SUMMARY', 'AUDIT_TRAIL', 'KYC_SUMMARY', 'AML_SUMMARY', 'FINANCIAL_STATEMENT', 'OPERATIONS_INCIDENT', 'DATA_GOVERNANCE'];\n    return types.map((rt) => ({\n      reportType: rt,\n      jurisdiction,\n      requiredFields: ['tenantId', 'periodStart', 'periodEnd', 'sourceReferences', 'methodology', 'policyVersion'],\n      sourceSystems: this.getSourceSystemsForReport(rt),\n      periodType: 'MONTHLY' as const,\n      requiresCertification: rt !== 'DATA_GOVERNANCE',\n      requiresApproval: true,\n      deliveryChannels: ['INTERNAL_STORAGE', 'REGULATOR_PORTAL'],\n      policyVersion: this.defaultPolicyVersion,\n    }));\n  }\n\n  private getSourceSystemsForReport(reportType: string): string[] {\n    switch (reportType) {\n      case 'TRANSACTION_REPORT':\n        return ['PortfolioAccounting', 'Finance', 'OMS', 'Billing'];\n      case 'TAX_SUMMARY':\n        return ['Finance', 'PortfolioAccounting', 'Billing'];\n      case 'AUDIT_TRAIL':\n        return ['Audit', 'Operations', 'Security', 'Compliance'];\n      case 'KYC_SUMMARY':\n        return ['Compliance', 'ClientProfile', 'Audit'];\n      case 'AML_SUMMARY':\n        return ['Compliance', 'ClientLifecycle', 'Audit'];\n      case 'FINANCIAL_STATEMENT':\n        return ['Finance', 'Billing', 'PortfolioAccounting'];\n      case 'OPERATIONS_INCIDENT':\n        return ['Operations', 'Audit'];\n      case 'DATA_GOVERNANCE':\n        return ['Audit', 'Security', 'Compliance'];\n      default:\n        return ['Audit'];\n    }\n GovernanceAuditService,\n    private readonly metrics: GovernanceMetricsService,\n    private readonly evidence: EvidencePackageService,\n    private readonly privacy: PrivacyRequestService,\n    private readonly policyService: GovernancePolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async queryReports(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    reportType?: string;\n    jurisdiction?: string;\n    state?: ReportState;\n    periodStart?: string;\n    periodEnd?: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n  }) {\n    if (!params.tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    if (params.jurisdiction) this.policyService.validateJurisdiction(params.jurisdiction);\n    const reports = await this.reportService.listReports(params.tenantId, {\n      reportType: params.reportType,\n      state: params.state,\n      jurisdiction: params.jurisdiction,\n    });\n\n    let filtered = reports;\n    if (params.periodStart) {\n      const ps = new Date(params.periodStart);\n      filtered = filtered.filter((r) => new Date(r.periodStart) >= ps);\n    }\n    if (params.periodEnd) {\n      const pe = new Date(params.periodEnd);\n      filtered = filtered.filter((r) => new Date(r.periodEnd) <= pe);\n    }\n\n    // Deterministic sort\n    filtered.sort((a, b) => {\n      if (a.generatedAt !== b.generatedAt) return b.generatedAt.localeCompare(a.generatedAt);\n      return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`queryReports tenant=${params.tenantId} count=${filtered.length} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return {\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      count: filtered.length,\n      reports: filtered,\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      isDeterministic: true,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async queryPrivacyRequests(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    subjectUserId?: string;\n    state?: PrivacyRequestState;\n    correlationId: string;\n  }) {\n    if (!params.tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    const requests = await this.privacy.listRequests(params.tenantId, {\n      subjectUserId: params.subjectUserId,\n      state: params.state,\n    });\n    requests.sort((a, b) => b.requestedAt.localeCompare(a.requestedAt));\n    return {\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      count: requests.length,\n      requests,\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      isDeterministic: true,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async queryEvidence(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    caseReference?: string;\n    evidenceType?: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n  }) {\n    if (!params.tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    const packages = await this.evidence.listPackages(params.tenantId, {\n      caseReference: params.caseReference,\n      evidenceType: params.evidenceType,\n    });\n    packages.sort((a, b) => b.generatedAt.localeCompare(a.generatedAt));\n    return {\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      count: packages.length,\n      evidencePackages: packages,\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      isDeterministic: true,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async queryAudit(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      isDeterministic: true,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async queryMetrics(params: { tenantId: string; correlationId: string }) {\n    if (!params.tenantId) throw new }\n\n    const exportRecord: PrivacyExport = {\n      id: `pex_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      requestId: params.requestId,\n { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';\nimport { readFileSync, statSync } from 'fs';\n\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { MobileReleasePolicyService } from './mobile-release-policy.service';\nimport {\n  AUDIT_ACTIONS,\n  MobileActor,\n  MobileReleaseError,\n  MOBILE_ERROR_CODES,\n  SECRET_VALUE_PATTERNS,\n} from './mobile-release.types';\nimport { MobileReleaseAuditService } from './mobile-release-audit.service';\n\n/**\n * Mobile artifact security scanner.\n *\n * What this actually does on real bytes (no fabricated \"clean\"):\n *  1. secret-pattern scan over the artifact bytes (private key blocks, JWTs,\n *     AWS/Stripe/Slack-style key shapes);\n *  2. build-metadata checks: debug artifacts are flagged for release builds;\n *  3. artifact-metadata consistency: platform/version/commit match the build;\n *  4. dependency-lock check: the parent build must carry a pubspec.lock\n *     digest, otherwise reproducibility (and therefore auditability) fails.\n *\n * `known vulnerable dependencies` requires an advisory database; when none is\n * reachable the scan records DEPENDENCY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE as a WARNING — it\n * never records a clean pass for a check it could not perform. Policy decides\n * which findings block release; BLOCKED is terminal for release gating.\n */\n\nexport interface SecurityFinding {\n  code: string;\n  severity: 'INFO' | 'WARNING' | 'CRITICAL';\n  detail: string;\n  blocked: boolean;\n}\n\nconst SCAN_WINDOW_BYTES = 256 * 1024 * 1024; // scan at most 256MB of head bytes\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class MobileSecurityScanService {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policy: MobileReleasePolicyService,\n    private readonly audit: MobileReleaseAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * Runs the scan over the artifact file and metadata. Returns the persisted\n   * scan row. Throws nothing on findings — findings are evidence; only\n   * unreadable artifacts throw (SCANNER cannot fake a pass on nothing).\n   */\n  async scanArtifact(input: {\n    artifactId: string;\n    tenantId: string;\n    actor: MobileActor;\n    correlationId: string;\n  }): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {\n    const artifact = await this.prisma.mobileArtifact.findFirst({\n      where: { id: input.artifactId, tenantId: input.tenantId },\n    });\n    if (!artifact) {\n      throw new MobileReleaseError(MOBILE_ERROR_CODES.ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND, 'artifact not found', 404);\n    }\n    const build = await this.prisma.mobileBuild.findUnique({ where: { id: artifact.buildId } });\n    if (!build) {\n      throw new MobileReleaseError(MOBILE_ERROR_CODES.BUILD_NOT_FOUND, 'parent build missing', 404);\n    }\n    const policy = this.policy.resolve();\n\n    const findings: SecurityFinding[] = [];\n\n    // ---- 1. bytes-level secret scan ------------------------------------\n    let sizeBytes = 0;\n    try {\n      sizeBytes = statSync(artifact.storageReference).size;\n    } catch {\n      throw new MobileReleaseError(\n        MOBILE_ERROR_CODES.ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND,\n        `artifact content unreadable at ${artifact.storageReference}; scan cannot run`,\n        404,\n      );\n    }\n    const fd = readFileSync(artifact.storageReference);\n    const head = fd.subarray(0, Math.min(fd.length, SCAN_WINDOW_BYTES));\n    const text = head.toString('latin1');\n    for (const rx of SECRET_VALUE_PATTERNS) {\n      if (rx.test(text)) {\n        findings.push({\n          code: 'SECRET_PATTERN_IN_ARTIFACT',\n          severity: 'CRITICAL',\n          detail: `artifact bytes match secret pattern ${rx.source.slice(0, 40)}`,\n          blocked: true,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n    if (/-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----/.test(text)) {\n      findings.push({\n        code: 'PRIVATE_KEY_EMBEDDED',\n        severity: 'CRITICAL',\n        detail: 'a PEM private key block is embedded in the artifact',\n        blocked: true,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // ---- 2. build-mode check --------------------------------------------\n    if (build.buildMode !== 'release' && build.environment === 'PRODUCTION') {\n      findings.push({\n        code: 'DEBUG_BUILD_FOR_PRODUCTION',\n        severity: 'CRITICAL',\n        detail: 'production environment with a debug-mode build',\n        blocked: true,\n      });\n    } else if (build.buildMode !== 'release') {\n      findings.push({\n        code: 'DEBUG_BUILD',\n        severity: 'WARNING',\n        detail: 'debug-mode artifact (allowed outside production by policy)',\n        blocked: false,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // ---- 3. metadata consistency ----------------------------------------\n    if (artifact.commitSha !== build.commitSha) {\n      findings.push({\n        code: 'METADATA_COMMIT_MISMATCH',\n        severity: 'CRITICAL',\n        detail: 'artifact commit differs from build commit',\n        blocked: true,\n      });\n    }\n    if (artifact.versionName !== build.versionName || artifact.versionCode !== build.versionCode) {\n      findings.push({\n        code: 'METADATA_VERSION_MISMATCH',\n        severity: 'CRITICAL',\n        detail: 'artifact version differs from build version',\n        blocked: true,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // ---- 4. dependency lock reproducibility ------------------------------\n    if (!build.toolchainVersion) {\n      findings.push({\n        code: 'TOOLCHAIN_VERSION_UNRECORDED',\n        severity: 'WARNING',\n        detail: 'build did not record a toolchain version; provenance is partial',\n        blocked: false,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // ---- 5. advisory DB: honest unavailability ---------------------------\n    const advisoryDb = process.env.MOBILE_ADVISORY_DB_URL;\n    if (!advisoryDb) {\n      findings.push({\n        code: 'DEPENDENCY_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE',\n        severity: 'WARNING',\n        detail: 'no advisory database configured; vulnerable-dependency check did NOT run',\n        blocked: build.environment === 'PRODUCTION',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const blockingCount = findings.filter((f) => f.blocked).length;\n    const state = blockingCount > 0 ? The ack row and\n    // state/outbox write do not share a database transaction; returning early here after an outbox\n    // failure would permanently suppress the retry that should finish delivery.\n    let ackRecord: any;\n    let ackAlreadyPersisted = false;\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).omsExecutionAck.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, clientOrderId, exchangeOrderId: exchangeOrderId ?? undefined },\n      });\n      if (existing) {\n        ackRecord = existing;\n        ackAlreadyPersisted = true;\n        this.logger.log(`Duplicate ack row reused for lifecycle recovery clientOrderId ${clientOrderId} exchangeOrderId ${exchangeOrderId}`);\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // model may not exist yet\n    }\n\n    // Persist ack only once; retry the authoritative lifecycle transition below even on a hit.\n    if (!ackAlreadyPersisted) try {\n      ackRecord = await (this.prisma as any).omsExecutionAck.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId,\n          orderIntentId: intent.id,\n          internalOrderId: orderId,\n          clientOrderId,\n          providerOrderId: providerOrderId ?? intent.status;\n    if (ackType === ExecutionAckType.ACCEPTED) {\n      if (currentState === OrderIntentState.SUBMITTED) {\n        await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n          tenantId,\n          intentId: intent.id,\n          toState: OrderIntentState.ACKNOWLEDGED,\n          source: 'EXECUTION_ENGINE',\n          reason: reason ?? 'pending'}`,\n          correlationId,\n          timestampMicros: occurredAtMicros,\n          metadata: { exchangeOrderId, providerOrderId, venue, latencyMicros },\n        });\n      }\n    } else {\n      // REJECTED\n      if (currentState !== OrderIntentState.REJECTED && currentState !== OrderIntentState.FILLED && currentState !== OrderIntentState.CANCELLED) {\n        await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n          tenantId,\n          intentId: intent.id,\n          toState: OrderIntentState.REJECTED,\n          source: 'EXECUTION_ENGINE',\n          reason: reason ?? `Rejected by venue ${venue} code ${providerErrorCode ?? intentMicros = BigInt(new Date(intent.createdAt).getTime()) * 1000n;\n    } else {\n      missing.push('intentTimestamp');\n    }\n\n    // Signal timestamp — try to get from metadata or copy }\n\n    // Submit timestamp\n    const submitTransition = transitions.find((t: any) => t.toState === 'SUBMITTED');\n    if (submitTransition?.timestampMicros) {\n      submitMicros = missing.push('submitTimestamp');\n    }\n\n    // Ack timestamp\n    const ackTransition = transitions.find((t: any) => t.toState === 'ACKNOWLEDGED');\n    if (ackTransition?.timestampMicros) {\n      ackMicros = this.parseMicros(ackTransition.timestampMicros);\n    } else {\n      try {\n        const ack = await (this.prisma as any).omsExecutionAck.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, orderIntentId: '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { isValidDecimal, parseScaled, formatScaled } from './oms.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Execution Quality Service — calculates slippage, implementation shortfall, fill ratio,\n * latency, price improvement, rejection rate, venue execution quality from canonical events.\n * Distinguishes ACTUAL_EXECUTION_METRIC from estimates.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class ExecutionQualityService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ExecutionQualityService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  private toNumberSafe(s: string | null): number | null {\n    if (!s || !isValidDecimal(s)) return null;\n    try {\n      const scaled = parseScaled(s);\n      return Number(scaled) / 1e12;\n    } catch {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async calculateForPeriod(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    symbol?: string | null;\n    venue?: string | null;\n    strategyId?: string | null;\n    traderId?: string | null;\n    from: Date;\n    to: Date;\n    benchmarkMethod?: string;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, symbol, venue, strategyId, from, to, benchmarkMethod } = params;\n\n    // Fetch OMS intents in period\n    let intents: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      intents = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findMany({\n        where: {\n          tenantId,\n          ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}),\n          ...(symbol ? { symbol } : {}),\n          ...(venue ? { venue } : {}),\n          ...(strategyId ? { strategyId } : {}),\n          createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to },\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      intents = await this.prisma.order.findMany({\n        where: {\n          tenantId,\n          ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}),\n          ...(symbol ? { symbol } : {}),\n          ...(venue ? { venue: venue as any } : {}),\n          ...(strategyId ? { strategyId } : {}),\n          createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to },\n        },\n      });\n    }\n\n    const totalOrders = intents.length;\n    const filledOrders = intents.filter((o) => (o.state ?? o.status) === 'FILLED').length;\n    const partiallyFilled = intents.filter((o) => (o.state ?? o.status) === 'PARTIALLY_FILLED').length;\n    const cancelled = intents.filter((o) => (o.state ?? o.status) === 'CANCELLED').length;\n    const rejected = intents.filter((o) => (o.state ?? o.status) === 'REJECTED').length;\n\n    const fillRatio = totalOrders > 0 ? filledOrders / totalOrders : null;\n    const rejectionRate = totalOrders > 0 ? rejected / totalOrders : null;\n    const completionRate = totalOrders > 0 ? (filledOrders + partiallyFilled) / totalOrders : null;\n\n    // Fetch fills for slippage, fees, latency\n    let fills: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      fills = await (this.prisma as any).omsFill.findMany({\n        // OmsFill has no accountId (it is on the order intent) and no timestamp column\n        // (timestampMicros is a string): filter the account through the intent and time by createdAt.\n        where: {\n          tenantId,\n          ...(accountId ? { orderIntent: { accountId } } : {}),\n          ...(symbol ? { symbol } : {}),\n          ...(venue ? { venue } : {}),\n          createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to },\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      // fallback to canonical fills\n      const orderIds = intents.map((o) => o.id);\n      if (orderIds.length > 0) {\n        fills = await this.prisma.fill.findMany({ where: { orderId: { in: orderIds } } });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Slippage: (fill price - intended price) / intended price — need intended price from intent\n    let slippageSum = 0;\n    let slippageCount = 0;\n    const slippages: number[] = [];\n    for (const fill of fills) {\n      const intent = intents.find((i) => i.id === fill.orderIntentId || i.clientOrderId === fill.clientOrderId || i.id === fill.orderId);\n      if (!intent) continue;\n      const intendedPrice = intent.price?.toString() ?? intent.price;\n      const fillPrice = fill.price?.toString() ?? fill.price;\n      if (!intendedPrice || !fillPrice) continue;\n      if (!isValidDecimal(intendedPrice) || !isValidDecimal(fillPrice)) continue;\n      const intended = this.toNumberSafe(intendedPrice);\n      const actual = this.toNumberSafe(fillPrice);\n      if (intended === null || actual === null || intended === 0) continue;\n      const side = intent.side;\n      let slip: number;\n      if (side === 'BUY') {\n        slip = ((actual - intended) / intended) * 100; // positive = worse\n      } else {\n        slip = ((intended - actual) / intended) * 100;\n      }\n      slippageSum += slip;\n      slippageCount++;\n      slippages.push(slip);\n    }\n\n    const avgSlippage = slippageCount > 0 ? slippageSum / slippageCount : null;\n    slippages.sort((a, b) => a - b);\n    const medianSlippage = slippages.length > 0 ? slippages[Math.floor(slippages.length / 2)] : null;\n    const p95Slippage = slippages.length > 0 ? slippages[Math.floor(slippages.length * 0.95)] ?? slippages[slippages.length - 1] : null;\n\n    // Fees\n    let totalFees = 0n;\n    let feeCount = 0;\n    for (const f of fills) {\n      const feeStr = f.fee?.toString() ?? f.fee;\n      if (feeStr && isValidDecimal(feeStr)) {\n        totalFees += parseScaled(feeStr);\n        feeCount++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Price improvement: when fill better than intended (negative slippage for BUY means improvement)\n    let improvementCount = 0;\n    let improvementSum = 0;\n    for (const s of slippages) {\n      if (s < 0) {\n        improvementCount++;\n        improvementSum += Math.abs(s);\n      }\n    }\n    const avgImprovement = improvementCount > 0 ? improvementSum / improvementCount : null;\n\n    // Latency — from execution-latency service or ack timestamps\n    let latencySum = 0;\n    let latencyCount = 0;\n    const latencies: number[] = [];\n    try {\n      const acks = await (this.prisma as any).omsExecutionAck.findMany({\n        // Acks have no accountId column: the account is on the order intent.\n        where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { orderIntent: { accountId } } : {}), ...(venue ? { venue } : {}), createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } },\n      });\n      for (const ack of acks) {\n        if (ack.latencyMicros && isValidDecimal(ack.latencyMicros)) {\n          const ms = Number(parseScaled(ack.latencyMicros)) / 1e9; // micros to ms: scaled 1e12, micros = value, ms = micros/1000\n          // Actually latencyMicros is string of micros, not scaled — handle both\n          let latencyMs: number;\n          if (isValidDecimal(ack.latencyMicros) && ack.latencyMicros.includes('.')) {\n            latencyMs = this.toNumberSafe(ack.latencyMicros)! / 1000;\n          } else {\n            const microsNum = parseInt(ack.latencyMicros, 10);\n            if (!isNaN(microsNum)) latencyMs = microsNum / 1000;\n            else continue;\n          }\n          if (!isNaN(latencyMs)) {\n            latencySum += latencyMs;\n            latencyCount++;\n            latencies.push(latencyMs);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    latencies.sort((a, b) => a - b);\n    const avgLatency = latencyCount > 0 ? latencySum / latencyCount : null;\n    const medianLatency = latencies.length > 0 ? latencies[Math.floor(latencies.length / 2)] : null;\n    const p95Latency = latencies.length > 0 ? latencies[Math.floor(latencies.length * 0.95)] ?? latencies[latencies.length - 1] : null;\n\n    const metrics = {\n      id: randomUUID(),\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: accountId ?? null,\n      symbol: symbol ?? null,\n      venue: venue ?? null,\n      strategyId: strategyId ?? null,\n      traderId: params.traderId ?? null,\n      periodStart: from.toISOString(),\n      periodEnd: to.toISOString(),\n      totalOrders,\n      filledOrders,\n      partiallyFilledOrders: partiallyFilled,\n      cancelledOrders: cancelled,\n      rejectedOrders: rejected,\n      fillRatio: fillRatio !== null ? fillRatio.toFixed(6) : null,\n      rejectionRate: rejectionRate !== null ? rejectionRate.toFixed(6) : null,\n      completionRate: completionRate !== null ? completionRate.toFixed(6) : null,\n      averageSlippage: avgSlippage !== null ? avgSlippage.toFixed(6) : null,\n      medianSlippage: medianSlippage !== null ? medianSlippage.toFixed(6) : null,\n      p95Slippage: p95Slippage !== null ? p95Slippage.toFixed(6) : null,\n      implementationShortfall: avgSlippage !== null ? avgSlippage.toFixed(6) : null, // simplified: shortfall ≈ slippage for now, benchmark methodology would refine\n      priceImprovement: avgImprovement !== null ? avgImprovement.toFixed(6) : null,\n      averageFillLatencyMs: avgLatency !== null ? avgLatency.toFixed(3) : null,\n      medianFillLatencyMs: medianLatency !== null ? medianLatency.toFixed(3) : null,\n      p95FillLatencyMs: p95Latency !== null ? p95Latency.toFixed(3) : null,\n      feeImpact: feeCount > 0 ? formatScaled(totalFees) : null,\n      totalFees: feeCount > 0 ? formatScaled(totalFees) : null,\n      benchmarkMethod: benchmarkMethod ?? 'INTENDED_VS_FILL',\n      observationCount: fills.length,\n      note: 'ACTUAL_EXECUTION_METRIC — calculated from canonical fills and intents, not estimated',\n      calculatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      metadata: { slippageCount, feeCount, latencyCount, improvementCount },\n    };\n\n    // Persist if model exists\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).omsExecutionQuality.create({ data: metrics });\n    } catch {}\n\n    this.logger.log(`Execution quality calculated tenant ${tenantId} period ${from.toISOString()}→${to.toISOString()} orders ${totalOrders} fills ${fills.length}`);\n    return metrics;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/fill-management.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. precision-safe remaining quantity and average price tracking\nimport { Injectable, Logger, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { OrderLifecycleService } from './order-lifecycle.service';\nimport { OrderIntentState, OmsFillState, isValidDecimal, parseScaled, formatScaled, add } from './oms.types';\n\n\n/**\n * Fill Management Service — normalizes and persists canonical fill events,\n * duplicate detection, cumulative fills, average price, fees, fill lifecycle.\n * Does not create synthetic fills unless existing execution model explicitly provides one.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class FillManagementService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(FillManagementService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly lifecycleService: OrderLifecycleService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private validateFill(params: { quantity: string; price: string; fee?: string }) {\n    if (!isValidDecimal(params.quantity)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid fill quantity ${params.quantity}`);\n    if (!isValidDecimal(params.price)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid fill price ${params.price}`);\n    if (parseScaled(params.quantity) <= 0n) throw new BadRequestException('Fill quantity must be > 0');\n    if (parseScaled(params.price) <= 0n) throw new BadRequestException('Fill price must be > 0');\n    if (params.fee && !isValidDecimal(params.fee)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid fee ${params.fee}`);\n  }\n\n  async processCanonicalFill(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    orderId: string; // internal Order id\n    venueTradeId: string;\n    providerOrderId?: string | null;\n    exchangeOrderId?: string | null;\n    symbol: string;\n    side: string;\n    quantity: string;\n    price: string;\n    fee?: string;\n    feeCurrency?: string;\n    quoteQuantity?: string | null;\n    isMaker?: boolean;\n    isSimulated?: boolean;\n    exchangeTimestampMicros?: string | null;\n    receivedTimestampMicros?: string;\n    source?: string;\n    venue?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }) {\n    const {\n      tenantId,\n      orderId,\n      venueTradeId,\n      providerOrderId,\n      exchangeOrderId,\n      symbol,\n      side,\n      quantity,\n      price,\n      fee,\n      feeCurrency,\n      quoteQuantity,\n      isMaker,\n      isSimulated,\n      exchangeTimestampMicros,\n      receivedTimestampMicros,\n      source,\n      venue,\n      correlationId,\n    } = params;\n\n    this.validateFill({ quantity, price, fee });\n\n    // Find OMS intent by internal orderId or clientOrderId\n    const order = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: orderId, tenantId } });\n    if (!order) throw new BadRequestException(`Order ${orderId} not found for tenant ${tenantId}`);\n\n    let intent: any;\n    try {\n      intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, clientOrderId: order.clientOrderId } });\n    } catch {\n      intent = order;\n    }\n    const intentId = intent?.id ?? orderId;\n\n    // Duplicate detection: provider fill ID + order\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).omsFill.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, providerFillId: venueTradeId, orderIntentId: intentId },\n      });\n      if (existing) {\n        this.logger.log(`Duplicate fill ignored tenant ${tenantId} fill ${venueTradeId} order ${orderId}`);\n        // Mark as DUPLICATE if not already\n        if (existing.state !== OmsFillState.DUPLICATE) {\n          await (this.prisma as any).omsFill.update({ where: { id: existing.id }, data: { state: OmsFillState.DUPLICATE } });\n        }\n        return existing;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // model may not exist, check canonical Fill table duplicate\n      const existingFill = const existingFills = await (this.prisma as any).omsFill.findMany({ where: { tenantId, orderIntentId: intentId, state: { not: OmsFillState.DUPLICATE } } });\n      if (existingFills && averagePrice = formatScaled(avgScaled);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // fallback: use canonical fills\n      const fills = await this.prisma.fill.findMany({ where: { orderId } });\n So\n    // the OMS-vs-canonical comparisons are skipped, the failure is logged with its error code and\n    // the result says so (omsFillsRead FAILED, readFailures 1). Canonical-only checks still run.\n    let omsFills: any[] = [];\n    let omsFillsRead: 'OK' | 'FAILED' = 'OK';\n    let omsFillsReadError: string | null = null;\n    try {\n      omsFills = await (this.prisma as any).omsFill.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, ...(intentId ? { orderIntentId: intentId } : { internalOrderId: orderId }), state: { not: 'DUPLICATE' } },\n        orderBy: { timestampMicros: 'asc' },\n      });\n    } catch (e) {\n      omsFills = [];\n      omsFillsRead = 'FAILED';\n      omsFillsReadError = reconciliationErrorCode(e);\n      this.logger.error(\n        `Fill reconciliation order ${orderId} tenant ${tenantId}: OMS fill read failed (error ${omsFillsReadError}); OMS comparisons skipped, not reported as missing fills`,\n      );\n    }\n    const compareWithOms = omsFillsRead === 'OK';\n\n    const findings: Array<{ category: string; severity: string; summary: string; expected: any; actual: any }> = [];\n\n    // Build maps by providerFillId\n    const canonicalById = new Map<string, any>();\n    for (const f of canonicalFills) canonicalById.set(f.venueTradeId, f);\n\n    const omsById = new Map<string, any>();\n    for (const f of omsFills) omsById.set(f.providerFillId, f);\n\n    // Missing fill: in canonical but not in OMS\n    for (const [fillId, cf] of canonicalById) {\n      if (!compareWithOms) break;\n      if (!omsById.has(fillId)) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.MISSING_FILL,\n          severity: 'MEDIUM',\n          summary: `Canonical fill ${fillId} order ${orderId} missing in OMS fills`,\n          expected: { fillId, existsInOms: true },\n          actual: { fillId, existsInOms: false, quantity: cf.quantity.toString(), price: cf.price.toString() },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Orphan fill: in OMS but not in canonical\n    for (const [fillId, ofill] of omsById) {\n      if (!canonicalById.has(fillId)) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.ORPHAN_FILL,\n          severity: 'MEDIUM',\n          summary: `OMS fill ${fillId} order ${orderId} orphan — no canonical fill`,\n          expected: { fillId, existsInCanonical: true },\n          actual: { fillId, existsInCanonical: false, quantity: ofill.quantity, price: ofill.price },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Quantity/price/fee drift for matching fills\n    for (const [fillId, cf] of canonicalById) {\n      const ofill = omsById.get(fillId);\n      if (!ofill) continue;\n\n      const cfQty = cf.quantity.toString();\n      const oQty = ofill.quantity?.toString() ?? ofill.quantity;\n      if (isValidDecimal(cfQty) && isValidDecimal(oQty) && cfQty !== oQty) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.QUANTITY_DRIFT,\n          severity: 'HIGH',\n          summary: `Quantity drift fill ${fillId} canonical ${cfQty} vs OMS ${oQty}`,\n          expected: { quantity: cfQty },\n          actual: { quantity: oQty },\n        });\n      }\n\n      const cfPrice = cf.price.toString();\n      const oPrice = ofill.price?.toString() ?? ofill.price;\n      if (isValidDecimal(cfPrice) && isValidDecimal(oPrice) && cfPrice !== oPrice) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.PRICE_DRIFT,\n          severity: 'HIGH',\n          summary: `Price drift fill ${fillId} canonical ${cfPrice} vs OMS ${oPrice}`,\n          expected: { price: cfPrice },\n          actual: { price: oPrice },\n        });\n      }\n\n      const cfFee = cf.fee.toString();\n      const oFee = ofill.fee?.toString() ?? ofill.fee;\n      if (isValidDecimal(cfFee) && isValidDecimal(oFee) && cfFee !== oFee) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.FEE_MISMATCH,\n          severity: 'MEDIUM',\n          summary: `Fee mismatch fill ${fillId} canonical ${cfFee} vs OMS ${oFee}`,\n          expected: { fee: cfFee },\n          actual: { fee: oFee },\n        });\n      }\n\n      if (cf.feeCurrency !== ofill.feeCurrency) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.FEE_MISMATCH,\n          severity: 'LOW',\n          summary: `Fee currency mismatch fill ${fillId} canonical ${cf.feeCurrency} vs OMS ${ofill.feeCurrency}`,\n          expected: { feeCurrency: cf.feeCurrency },\n          actual: { feeCurrency: ofill.feeCurrency },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Cumulative quantity check\n    let canonicalCumulative = 0n;\n    for (const f of canonicalFills) {\n      const qtyStr = f.quantity.toString();\n      if (isValidDecimal(qtyStr)) canonicalCumulative += parseScaled(qtyStr);\n    }\n\n    let omsCumulative = 0n;\n    for (const f of omsFills) {\n      const qtyStr = f.quantity?.toString() ?? f.quantity;\n      if (isValidDecimal(qtyStr)) omsCumulative += parseScaled(qtyStr);\n    }\n\n    if (compareWithOms && canonicalCumulative !== omsCumulative) {\n      findings.push({\n        category: ReconciliationCategory.QUANTITY_DRIFT,\n        severity: 'HIGH',\n        summary: `Cumulative quantity drift order ${orderId} canonical ${formatScaled(canonicalCumulative)} vs OMS ${formatScaled(omsCumulative)}`,\n        expected: { cumulative: formatScaled(canonicalCumulative) },\n        actual: { cumulative: formatScaled(omsCumulative) },\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Duplicate detection: same venueTradeId appears multiple times in canonical\n    const seen = new Set<string>();\n    for (const f of canonicalFills) {\n      if (seen.has(f.venueTradeId)) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.DUPLICATE_FILL,\n          severity: 'MEDIUM',\n          summary: `Duplicate canonical fill ${f.venueTradeId} order ${orderId}`,\n          expected: { count: 1 },\n          actual: { fillId: f.venueTradeId, duplicate: true },\n        });\n      }\n      seen.add(f.venueTradeId);\n    }\n\n    // Persist. A finding that cannot be stored is never dropped silently: it stays in the returned\n    // result, is counted in persistFailures and is logged at error level (error code only).\n    let persistedFindings = 0;\n    let persistFailures = 0;\n    for (const f of findings) {\n      try {\n        await (this.prisma as any).omsReconciliation.create({\n          data: {\n            tenantId,\n            orderIntentId: intentId ?? null,\n            internalOrderId: orderId,\n            providerFillId: (f.actual as any)?.fillId ?? null,\n            category: f.category,\n            severity: f.severity,\n            expected: f.expected,\n            actual: f.actual,\n            summary: f.summary.slice(0, 1000),\n            resolved: false,\n          },\n        });\n        persistedFindings++;\n      } catch (e) {\n        persistFailures++;\n        this.logger.error(\n          `Fill reconciliation finding NOT persisted order ${orderId} tenant ${tenantId} category ${f.category} severity ${f.severity} error ${reconciliationErrorCode(e)}`,\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (persistFailures > 0) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Fill reconciliation order ${orderId} tenant ${tenantId} findings ${findings.length} persisted ${persistedFindings} persistFailures ${persistFailures}`);\n    } else {\n      this.logger.log(`Fill reconciliation order ${orderId} tenant ${tenantId} findings ${findings.length} canonical ${canonicalFills.length} oms ${omsFills.length} omsRead ${omsFillsRead}`);\n    }\n    return {\n      orderId,\n      intentId: intentId ?? null,\n      canonicalCount: canonicalFills.length,\n      omsCount: omsFills.length,\n      omsFillsRead,\n      omsFillsReadError,\n      readFailures: omsFillsRead === 'FAILED' ? 1 : 0,\n      findings,\n      totalFindings: findings.length,\n      persistedFindings,\n      persistFailures,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async reconcileTenantFills(params: { tenantId: string; accountId?: string; limit?: number }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, limit = 20 } = params;\n    const orders = await this.prisma.order.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}), filledQuantity: { gt: 0 } as any },\n      orderBy: { updatedAt: 'desc' },\n      take: limit,\n    });\n\n    const results = [];\n    let intentLookupFailures = 0;\n    let readFailures = 0;\n    for (const order of orders) {\n      // Find intent id. Without it the fills are matched by internal order id instead - still a\n      // valid comparison, but the lookup failure is counted and logged, never swallowed.\n      let intentId: string | undefined;\n      try {\n        const intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, clientOrderId: order.clientOrderId } });\n        intentId = intent?.id;\n      } catch (e) {\n        intentLookupFailures++;\n        this.logger.warn(\n          `Fill reconciliation order ${order.id} tenant ${tenantId}: OMS intent lookup failed (error ${reconciliationErrorCode(e)}); matching fills by internal order id`,\n        );\n      }\n      const res = await this.reconcileFillsForOrder({ tenantId, orderId: order.id, intentId });\n      readFailures += res.readFailures;\n      if (res.totalFindings > 0 || res.readFailures > 0) results.push(res);\n    }\n\n    return { totalChecked: orders.length, withFindings: results.filter((r) => r.totalFindings > 0).length, intentLookupFailures, readFailures, results };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/final-allocation-and-operations.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/oms-audit.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Audit Service — immutable audit events for order intent, submit, ack, fill, cancel, replace,\n * rejection, reconciliation, recovery, operator actions.\n * Never logs API keys, exchange secrets, private keys, tokens, wallet credentials.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class OmsAuditService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(OmsAuditService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  private sanitizeMetadata(metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null): Record<string, unknown> | null {\n    if (!metadata) return null;\n    const forbiddenKeys = ['apiKey', 'secret', 'privateKey', 'token', 'credential', 'password', 'apiSecret', 'passphrase', 'wallet', 'mnemonic', 'seed'];\n    const sanitized: Record<string, unknown> = {};\n    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(metadata)) {\n      const lower = k.toLowerCase();\n      if (forbiddenKeys.some((fk) => lower.includes(fk))) {\n        sanitized[k] = '[REDACTED]';\n      } else if (typeof v === 'object' && v !== null) {\n        sanitized[k] = this.sanitizeMetadata(v as any);\n      } else {\n        sanitized[k] = v;\n      }\n    }\n    return sanitized;\n  }\n\n  async recordEvent(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    eventType: OmsAuditEventType | string;\n    orderIntentId?: string | null;\n    internalOrderId?: string | null;\n    fillId?: string | null;\n    tradeId?: string | null;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    symbol?: string | null;\n    venue?: string | null;\n    strategyId?: string | null;\n    traderId?: string | null;\n    followerId?: string | null;\n    actorId?: string | null;\n    actorType?: string;\n    reason?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    requestId?: string | null;\n    policyVersion?: string | null;\n    riskRuleId?: string | null;\n    metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, eventType, orderIntentId, internalOrderId, fillId, tradeId, accountId, symbol, venue, strategyId, traderId, followerId, actorId, actorType, reason, correlationId, requestId, policyVersion, riskRuleId, metadata } = params;\n\n    const safeMetadata = this.sanitizeMetadata(metadata ?? null);\n\n    const auditData = {\n      id: randomUUID(),\n      tenantId,\n      eventType,\n      orderIntentId: orderIntentId ?? null,\n      internalOrderId: internalOrderId ?? null,\n      fillId: fillId ?? null,\n      tradeId: tradeId ?? null,\n      accountId: accountId ?? null,\n      symbol: symbol ?? null,\n      venue: venue ?? null,\n      strategyId: strategyId ?? null,\n      traderId: traderId ?? null,\n      followerId: followerId ?? null,\n      actorId: actorId ?? null,\n      actorType: actorType ?? 'SYSTEM',\n      reason: reason ? reason.slice(0, 1000) : null,\n      correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n      requestId: requestId ?? null,\n      policyVersion: policyVersion ?? null,\n      riskRuleId: riskRuleId ?? null,\n      metadata: safeMetadata,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).omsAudit.create({ data: auditData });\n      // Also write to canonical auditLog for platform-wide audit\n      await this.prisma.auditLog.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId,\n          actorId: actorId ?? undefined,\n          actorType: (actorType as any) ?? 'SYSTEM',\n          action: eventType,\n          resourceType: 'OMS_ORDER',\n          resourceId: orderIntentId ?? internalOrderId ?? tradeId ?? fillId ?? undefined,\n          description: `${eventType} ${orderIntentId ?? ''} ${symbol ?? ''} ${reason ?? ''}`.slice(0, 500),\n          metadata: { ...safeMetadata, correlationId, requestId, policyVersion, riskRuleId } as any,\n          requestId: requestId ?? undefined,\n          correlationId: correlationId ?? undefined,\n        },\n      });\n      this.logger.log(`OMS audit ${eventType} intent ${orderIntentId ?? 'n/a'} tenant ${tenantId} actor ${actorId ?? 'system'}`);\n      return created;\n    } catch (e) {\n      // Fallback to auditLog only if omsAudit model missing\n      this.logger.warn(`OmsAudit model missing, using auditLog only: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      try {\n        const fallback = await this.prisma.auditLog.create({\n          data: {\n            tenantId,\n            actorId: actorId ?? undefined,\n            actorType: (actorType as any) ?? 'SYSTEM',\n            action: eventType,\n            resourceType: 'OMS_ORDER',\n            resourceId: orderIntentId ?? internalOrderId ?? undefined,\n            description: `${eventType} ${orderIntentId ?? ''} ${symbol ?? ''} ${reason ?? ''}`.slice(0, 500),\n            metadata: { ...safeMetadata, correlationId, requestId, policyVersion, riskRuleId, orderIntentId, fillId, tradeId } as any,\n            requestId: requestId ?? undefined,\n            correlationId: correlationId ?? undefined,\n          },\n        });\n        return fallback;\n      } catch {\n        return auditData;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getAuditForIntent(tenantId: string, orderIntentId: string) {\n    try {\n      return await (this.prisma as any).omsAudit.findMany({ where: { tenantId, orderIntentId }, orderBy: { timestamp: 'asc' } });\n    } catch {\n      return this.prisma.auditLog.findMany({ where: { tenantId, resourceId: orderIntentId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } });\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getAuditHistory(params: { tenantId: string; accountId?: string; symbol?: string; eventType?: string; from?: Date; to?: Date; page?: number; limit?: number }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, symbol, eventType, from, to, page = 1, limit = 20 } = params;\n    try {\n      const where: any = {\n        tenantId,\n        ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}),\n        ...(symbol ? { symbol } : {}),\n        ...(eventType ? { eventType } : {}),\n        ...(from || to ? { timestamp: { gte: from?.toISOString(), lte: to?.toISOString() } } : {}),\n      };\n      const [items, total] = await Promise.all([\n        (this.prisma as any).omsAudit.findMany({ where, orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n        (this.prisma as any).omsAudit.count({ where }),\n      ]);\n      return { items, total, page, limit };\n    } catch {\n      const where: any = {\n        tenantId,\n        ...(eventType ? { action: eventType } : {}),\n        ...(from || to ? { createdAt: { ...(from ? { gte: from } : {}), ...(to ? { lte: to } : {}) } } : {}),\n      };\n      const [items, total] = await Promise.all([\n        this.prisma.auditLog.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n        this.prisma.auditLog.count({ where }),\n      ]);\n      return { items, total, page, limit };\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/oms-execution-handoff.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/oms-reconciliation.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/oms.controller.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":42,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Controller, Get, Post, Body, Param, Query, Req, ForbiddenException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { Permission } from '@wlct/shared-types';\nimport { RequireAnyPermission, RequirePermissions } from '../../common/decorators/permissions.decorator';\nimport { OrderIntentService } from './order-intent.service';\nimport { OrderLifecycleService } from './order-lifecycle.service';\nimport { OrderRoutingService } from './order-routing.service';\nimport { ExecutionAckService } from './execution-ack.service';\nimport { FillManagementService } from './fill-management.service';\nimport { TradeLifecycleService } from './trade-lifecycle.service';\nimport { OrderCancelService } from './order-cancel.service';\nimport { OrderReplaceService } from './order-replace.service';\nimport { AllocationService } from './allocation.service';\nimport { ExecutionQualityService } from './execution-quality.service';\nimport { ExecutionLatencyService } from './execution-latency.service';\nimport { VenueExecutionScoreService } from './venue-execution-score.service';\nimport { OrderRejectionService } from './order-rejection.service';\nimport { OrderReconciliationService } from './order-reconciliation.service';\nimport { FillReconciliationService } from './fill-reconciliation.service';\nimport { PositionReconciliationService } from './position-reconciliation.service';\nimport { PostTradeService } from './post-trade.service';\nimport { TradeOperationsService } from './trade-operations.service';\nimport { OmsAuditService } from './oms-audit.service';\nimport { CreateOrderIntentDto } from './dto/order-intent.dto';\nimport { CancelOrderDto, ReplaceOrderDto, RetryOrderDto, RecoveryOrderDto, AcknowledgeExceptionDto, OperatorNoteDto, AcknowledgeReconciliationDto } from './dto/order-action.dto';\nimport { OmsOrdersQueryDto, OmsFillsQueryDto, OmsTradesQueryDto, OmsRejectionQueryDto, OmsReconciliationQueryDto, OmsExecutionQualityQueryDto, OmsAuditQueryDto } from './dto/oms-query.dto';\nimport { OmsAuditEventType } from './oms.types';\nimport { authTenantId, authUserIdOrNull, isPlatformPrincipal } from '../../common/guards/request-principal';\n\n/**\n * RBAC-protected OMS API.\n * Customer/trader: view own orders, fills, trades, execution quality\n * Operators: reconciliation queue, stale orders, rejected orders, recovery requests, operational actions\n * Platform operators: platform-level visibility per existing permissions\n * Never allow arbitrary order-status mutation from API.\n */\n\n/**\n * Order management console (intents, routing, cancels, fills, trades,\n * reconciliation, operator recovery).\n *\n * The handlers check the tenant but not account ownership, and the controller\n * carried no permission metadata: any tenant user could create order intents\n * against any account of the tenant, cancel or replace other users' orders\n * and read every fill. No customer client calls these routes. Reads now need\n * trading:read or compliance:read; every change needs trading:manage (class\n * default). The in-handler operator checks remain on top.\n */\n@RequirePermissions(Permission.TRADING_MANAGE)\n@Controller('oms')\nexport class OmsController {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly intentService: OrderIntentService,\n    private readonly lifecycleService: OrderLifecycleService,\n    private readonly routingService: OrderRoutingService,\n    private readonly ackService: ExecutionAckService,\n    private readonly fillService: FillManagementService,\n    private readonly tradeService: TradeLifecycleService,\n    private readonly cancelService: OrderCancelService,\n    private readonly replaceService: OrderReplaceService,\n    private readonly allocationService: AllocationService,\n    private readonly qualityService: ExecutionQualityService,\n    private readonly latencyService: ExecutionLatencyService,\n    private readonly venueScoreService: VenueExecutionScoreService,\n    private readonly rejectionService: OrderRejectionService,\n    private readonly orderReconService: OrderReconciliationService,\n    private readonly fillReconService: FillReconciliationService,\n    private readonly positionReconService: PositionReconciliationService,\n    private readonly postTradeService: PostTradeService,\n    private readonly opsService: TradeOperationsService,\n    private readonly auditService: OmsAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private getTenantId(req: any): string {\n    // Token tenant only; a header can never select the tenant.\n    return authTenantId(req);\n  }\n\n  private getUserId(req: any): string {\n    return authUserIdOrNull(req) ?? 'system';\n  }\n\n  private checkTenantAccess(req: any, targetTenantId: string): void {\n    const userTenantId = req.user?.tenantId;\n    // Platform reach comes from the server-side flag only: role keys are\n    // tenant-editable, so a tenant-created \"PLATFORM_ADMIN\" role must not\n    // unlock other tenants.\n    const isPlatform = isPlatformPrincipal(req);\n    if (!isPlatform && userTenantId && userTenantId !== targetTenantId) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cross-tenant access denied');\n    }\n  }\n\n  private isOperator(req: any): boolean {\n    return req.user?.roles?.includes('OPERATOR') || req.user?.roles?.includes('RISK_ADMIN') || req.user?.permissions?.includes('OMS_OPERATE') || req.user?.isPlatformUser;\n  }\n\n  // ---------- Order Intent ----------\n\n  @Post('intents')\n  async createIntent(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: CreateOrderIntentDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.checkTenantAccess(req, tenantId);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n\n    // Client cannot supply trusted execution state — DTO enforces\n    const intent = await this.intentService.createIntent({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: dto.accountId,\n      symbol: dto.symbol,\n      side: dto.side,\n      orderType: dto.orderType,\n      quantity: dto.quantity,\n      price: dto.price ?? null,\n      stopPrice: dto.stopPrice ?? null,\n      timeInForce: dto.timeInForce ?? 'GTC',\n      reduceOnly: dto.reduceOnly ?? false,\n      strategyId: dto.strategyId ?? null,\n      traderId: dto.traderId ?? null,\n      followerId: dto.followerId ?? null,\n      subscriptionId: dto.subscriptionId ?? null,\n      environment: dto.environment,\n      source: dto.source ?? 'MANUAL',\n      signalId: dto.signalId ?? null,\n      correlationId: dto.correlationId ?? null,\n      requestId: dto.requestId ?? null,\n      userId,\n      venue: dto.venue ?? null,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.recordEvent({\n      tenantId,\n      eventType: OmsAuditEventType.ORDER_INTENT_CREATED,\n      orderIntentId: intent.id,\n      accountId: dto.accountId,\n      symbol: dto.symbol,\n      venue: dto.venue ?? null,\n      strategyId: dto.strategyId ?? null,\n      traderId: dto.traderId ?? null,\n      followerId: dto.followerId ?? null,\n      actorId: userId,\n      actorType: 'USER',\n      reason: `Intent created ${dto.symbol} ${dto.side} ${dto.quantity}`,\n      correlationId: dto.correlationId ?? null,\n      requestId: dto.requestId ?? null,\n      metadata: { quantity: dto.quantity, price: dto.price, orderType: dto.orderType, environment: dto.environment },\n    });\n\n    // Track allocation intended\n    await this.allocationService.recordIntendedAllocation({\n      tenantId,\n      strategyId: dto.strategyId ?? null,\n      traderId: dto.traderId ?? null,\n      followerId: dto.followerId ?? null,\n      subscriptionId: dto.subscriptionId ?? null,\n      accountId: dto.accountId,\n      orderIntentId: intent.id,\n      symbol: dto.symbol,\n      side: dto.side,\n      intendedQuantity: dto.quantity,\n      allocationMode: null,\n      correlationId: dto.correlationId ?? null,\n    });\n\n    return intent;\n  }\n\n  @Post('intents/:id/route')\n  async routeIntent(@Req() req: any, @Param('id') id: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.checkTenantAccess(req, tenantId);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n\n    const result = await this.routingService.routeIntent({ tenantId, intentId: id, userId, correlationId: (req.headers['x-correlation-id'] as string) ?? null, requestId: (req.headers['x-request-id'] as string) ?? null });\n\n    await this.auditService.recordEvent({\n      tenantId,\n      eventType: OmsAuditEventType.ORDER_SUBMITTED,\n      orderIntentId: id,\n      actorId: userId,\n      actorType: 'USER',\n      reason: `Routed to execution engine job ${result.jobId}`,\n      metadata: { jobId: result.jobId },\n    });\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  @Get('intents')\n  @RequireAnyPermission(Permission.TRADING_READ, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async listIntents(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: OmsOrdersQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.checkTenantAccess(req, tenantId);\n    return this.intentService.listIntents({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: query.accountId,\n      strategyId: query.strategyId,\n      symbol: query.symbol,\n      state: query.state,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('intents/:id')\n  @RequireAnyPermission(Permission.TRADING_READ, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async getIntent(@Req() req: any, @Param('id') id: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.checkTenantAccess(req, tenantId);\n    return this.intentService.getIntent(tenantId, id);\n  }\n\n  @Get('intents/:id/lifecycle')\n  @RequireAnyPermission(Permission.TRADING_READ, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async getLifecycle(@Req() req: any, @Param('id') id: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.checkTenantAccess(req, tenantId);\n    const history = await this.lifecycleService.getHistory(tenantId, id);\n    const isTerminal = await this.lifecycleService.isTerminal(tenantId, id);\n    return { intentId: id, isTerminal, history };\n  }\n\n  // ---------- Cancel / Replace ----------\n\n  @Post('orders/cancel')\n  async cancelOrder(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: CancelOrderDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.checkTenantAccess(req, tenantId);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n\n    const result = await this.cancelService.requestCancel({ tenantId, intentId: dto.intentId, userId, reason: dto.reason, correlationId: dto.correlationId ?? null });\n\n    await this.auditService.recordEvent({\n      tenantId,\n      eventType: OmsAuditEventType.ORDER_CANCEL_REQUESTED,\n      orderIntentId: dto.intentId,\n      actorId: userId,\n      actorType: 'USER',\n      reason: dto.reason,\n      correlationId: dto.correlationId ?? null,\n    });\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  @Post('orders/replace')\n  async replaceOrder(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: ReplaceOrderDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.checkTenantAccess(req, tenantId);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n\n    const result = await this.replaceService.requestReplace({\n      tenantId,\n      intentId: dto.intentId,\n      userId,\n      newQuantity: dto.newQuantity ?? null,\n      newPrice: dto.newPrice ?? null,\n      newStopPrice: dto.newStopPrice ?? null,\n      reason: dto.reason,\n      correlationId: dto.correlationId ?? null,\n      requestId: dto.requestId ?? null,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.recordEvent({\n      tenantId,\n      eventType: OmsAuditEventType.ORDER_REPLACED,\n      orderIntentId: dto.intentId,\n      actorId: userId,\n      actorType: 'USER',\n      reason: dto.reason,\n      correlationId: dto.correlationId ?? null,\n      metadata: { newIntentId: result.newIntentId, newQuantity: dto.newQuantity, newPrice: dto.newPrice },\n    });\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  // ---------- Fills ----------\n\n  @Get('fills')\n  @RequireAnyPermission(Permission.TRADING_READ, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async listFills(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: OmsFillsQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.checkTenantAccess(req, tenantId);\n    return this.opsService.searchFills({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: query.accountId,\n      symbol: query.symbol,\n      venue: query.venue,\n      orderIntentId: query.orderIntentId,\n      from: query.from ? new Date(query.from) : undefined,\n      to: query.to ? new Date(query.to) : undefined,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('intents/:id/fills')\n  @RequireAnyPermission(Permission.TRADING_READ, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async getFillsForIntent(@Req() req: any, @Param('id') id: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.checkTenantAccess(req, tenantId);\n    return this.fillService.getFillsForIntent(tenantId, id);\n  }\n\n  // ---------- Trades ----------\n\n  @Get('trades')\n  @RequireAnyPermission(Permission.TRADING_READ, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async listTrades(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: OmsTradesQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.checkTenantAccess(req, tenantId);\n    return this.opsService.searchTrades({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: query.accountId,\n      symbol: query.symbol,\n      strategyId: query.strategyId,\n      state: query.state,\n      from: query.from ? new Date(query.from) :
