'../risk-management/risk-decision.service';\n\n/**\n * Order Cancel Service — coordinates cancellation through existing execution infrastructure\n * and validates cancellability against current order state.\n * Never marks CANCELLED before authoritative confirmation unless provider semantics says request itself is terminal.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class OrderCancelService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(OrderCancelService.name);\n\n  private static readonly CANCELLABLE_STATES = new Set<string>([\n    OrderIntentState.SUBMITTED,\n    OrderIntentState.ACKNOWLEDGED,\n    OrderIntentState.PARTIALLY_FILLED,\n    OrderIntentState.CREATED,\n    OrderIntentState.VALIDATING,\n    OrderIntentState.APPROVED,\n  ]);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly lifecycleService: OrderLifecycleService,\n    private readonly executionOrdersService: ExecutionOrdersService,\n    private readonly riskDecisionService: RiskDecisionService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async requestCancel(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    intentId: string;\n    userId?: string | null;\n    reason: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, intentId, userId, reason, correlationId } = params;\n\n    let intent: any;\n    try {\n      intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    } catch {\n      intent = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    }\n    if (!intent) throw new BadRequestException(`Intent ${intentId} not found`);\n\n    const currentState = intent.state ?? intent.status;\n    if (isTerminalState(currentState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Cannot cancel terminal order ${intentId} state ${currentState}`);\n    }\n    if (currentState === OrderIntentState.CANCEL_REQUESTED) {\n      this.logger.log(`Cancel already requested for ${intentId}, idempotent`);\n      return intent;\n    }\n    if (!OrderCancelService.CANCELLABLE_STATES.has(currentState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Order ${intentId} not cancellable in state ${currentState}`);\n    }\n    if (currentState === OrderIntentState.FILLED) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Cannot cancel already FILLED order ${intentId}`);\n    }\n\n    // Risk/compliance/security checks if policy requires — for cancel, usually allowed as risk-reducing\n    // But check if account is blocked for security\n    const threat = await this.prisma.securityThreatSignal.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, resolved: false, riskLevel: { in: ['HIGH', 'CRITICAL'] as any } },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (threat && threat.decision === 'DENY') {\n      // Even cancel should be allowed? For safety, allow cancel as risk-reducing unless policy explicitly blocks\n      this.logger.warn(`Security threat exists but allowing cancel as risk-reducing for ${intentId}`);\n    }\n\n    // Transition to CANCEL_REQUESTED\n    await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n      tenantId,\n      intentId,\n      toState: OrderIntentState.CANCEL_REQUESTED,\n      source: 'OMS_CANCEL',\n      reason: `Cancel requested: ${reason}`,\n      correlationId,\n      actorId: userId ?? null,\n      actorType: userId ? 'USER' : 'SYSTEM',\n    });\n\n    // Call existing execution cancel boundary — ExecutionOrdersService.requestCancel\n    try {\n      const canonicalOrder = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, clientOrderId: intent.clientOrderId } });\n      const orderIdToCancel = canonicalOrder?.id ?? intent.id;\n\n      const result = await this.executionOrdersService.requestCancel(\n        tenantId,\n        orderIdToCancel,\n        { userId: userId ?? 'system', requestId: correlationId ?? null },\n        reason,\n      );\n\n      this.logger.log(`Cancel command accepted for intent ${intentId} order ${orderIdToCancel} via ExecutionOrdersService`);\n      return { intentId, orderId: orderIdToCancel, state: OrderIntentState.CANCEL_REQUESTED, order: result };\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Cancel command failed for ${intentId}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Cancel request failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async confirmCancelled(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    intentId: string;\n    exchangeOrderId?: string | null;\n    reason?: string | null;\n    timestampMicros?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, intentId, exchangeOrderId, reason, timestampMicros, correlationId } = params;\n\n    let intent: any;\n    try {\n      intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    } catch {\n      intent = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    }\n    if (!intent) throw new BadRequestException(`Intent ${intentId} not found`);\n\n    const currentState = intent.state ?? intent.status;\n    if (currentState === OrderIntentState.CANCELLED) return intent;\n    if (currentState === OrderIntentState.FILLED) throw new BadRequestException(`Cannot confirm CANCELLED for already FILLED order ${intentId}`);\n\n    await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n      tenantId,\n      intentId,\n      toState: OrderIntentState.CANCELLED,\n      source: 'EXECUTION_ENGINE',\n      reason: reason ?? `Cancelled confirmed by provider exchangeOrderId ${exchangeOrderId ?? 'unknown'}`,\n      correlationId,\n      timestampMicros,\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Intent ${intentId} confirmed CANCELLED tenant ${tenantId}`);\n    return intent;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/order-intent.service.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/order-intent.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":33,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Validates order intent against symbol trading rules and account balance\nimport { Injectable, Logger, BadRequestException, ForbiddenException, Optional } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { OutboxService } from '../../infrastructure/outbox/outbox.service';\nimport { RiskDecisionService } from '../risk-management/risk-decision.service';\nimport { OrderIntentState, isValidDecimal, parseScaled } from './oms.types';\nimport { PositionLimitService } from '../risk/position-limit.service';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Order Intent Service — creates/validates normalized order intents from strategy/copy/risk-approved requests\n * without placing orders directly.\n *\n * Before creating an intent verify:\n * - strategy state, account state, symbol, quantity/price precision, risk decision, compliance, security, exchange capability, env, live gate\n * MUST NOT place order.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class OrderIntentService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(OrderIntentService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly riskDecisionService: RiskDecisionService,\n    // Every intent is reserved under the user's own concurrent-position and open-order ceilings.\n    // This reaches the canonical limiter rather than a copy of it, so the count a customer reads\n    // from their settings page is the count this path enforces.\n    private readonly positionLimitService: PositionLimitService,\n    @Optional() private readonly outbox?: OutboxService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private async appendOrderCreated(tx: any, created: any, input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    side: string;\n    quantity: string;\n    price?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.outbox) {\n      throw new Error('Transactional outbox is unavailable; refusing order intent without its order.created event');\n    }\n    await this.outbox.append(tx, {\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      aggregateType: 'order',\n      aggregateId: created.id,\n      eventType: 'order.created',\n      idempotencyKey: `order:${created.id}:created`,\n      correlationId: input.correlationId && input.correlationId.length <= 64 ? input.correlationId : null,\n      occurredAt: created.createdAt ?? new Date(),\n      payload: {\n        orderId: created.id,\n        status: 'CREATED',\n        symbol: input.symbol,\n        side: input.side,\n        quantity: input.quantity,\n        price: input.price ?? null,\n      },\n    });\n  }\n\n  private async validateAccountOwnership(params: { tenantId: string; accountId: string; userId?: string | null }) {\n    const account = await this.prisma.tradingAccount.findFirst({\n      where: { id: params.accountId, tenantId: params.tenantId },\n    });\n    if (!account) throw new ForbiddenException(`Account ${params.accountId} not found for tenant ${params.tenantId}`);\n    if (account.status === 'DISABLED') throw new BadRequestException(`Account ${params.accountId} is DISABLED`);\n    if (account.status === 'CREDENTIALS_INVALID') throw new BadRequestException(`Account credentials invalid`);\n    return account;\n  }\n\n  private async validateSymbol(params: { tenantId: string; symbol: string; venue?: string | null }) {\n    // Check trading symbol exists and is tradeable\n    const symbolRecord = await this.prisma.tradingSymbol.findFirst({\n      where: {\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        symbol: params.symbol,\n        isTradeable: true,\n        ...(params.venue ? { exchange: { venue: params.venue as any } } : {}),\n      },\n      include: { exchange: true },\n    });\n    if (!symbolRecord) throw new BadRequestException(`Symbol ${params.symbol} not tradeable for tenant ${params.tenantId}`);\n    return symbolRecord;\n  }\n\n  private validatePrecision(params: { quantity: string; price?: string | null; symbol: any }) {\n    if (!isValidDecimal(params.quantity)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid quantity decimal: ${params.quantity}`);\n    const qty = parseScaled(params.quantity);\n    if (qty <= 0n) throw new BadRequestException('Quantity must be > 0');\n\n    const minQty = params.symbol.minQuantity ? parseScaled(params.symbol.minQuantity.toString()) : 0n;\n    if (qty < minQty) throw new BadRequestException(`Quantity ${params.quantity} below min ${params.symbol.minQuantity}`);\n\n    if (params.symbol.maxQuantity) {\n      const maxQty = parseScaled(params.symbol.maxQuantity.toString());\n      if (qty > maxQty) throw new BadRequestException(`Quantity ${params.quantity} above max ${params.symbol.maxQuantity}`);\n    }\n\n    if (params.price) {\n      if (!isValidDecimal(params.price)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid price decimal: ${params.price}`);\n      const price = parseScaled(params.price);\n      if (price <= 0n) throw new BadRequestException('Price must be > 0');\n\n      if (params.symbol.tickSize) {\n        const tick = parseScaled(params.symbol.tickSize.toString());\n        if (tick > 0n && price % tick !== 0n) {\n          throw new BadRequestException(`Price ${params.price} does not match tickSize ${params.symbol.tickSize}`);\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (params.symbol.minNotional) {\n        const minNotional = parseScaled(params.symbol.minNotional.toString());\n        const notional = (qty * price) / 100000000n;\n        if (notional < minNotional) {\n          throw new BadRequestException(`Order notional below minNotional ${params.symbol.minNotional}`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (params.symbol.quantityStep) {\n      const step = parseScaled(params.symbol.quantityStep.toString());\n      if (step > 0n && qty % step !== 0n) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Quantity ${params.quantity} does not match quantityStep ${params.symbol.quantityStep}`);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async checkStrategyState(params: { tenantId: string; strategyId?: string | null }) {\n    if (!params.strategyId) return null;\n    const strategy = await this.prisma.strategy.findFirst({\n      where: { id: params.strategyId, tenantId: params.tenantId },\n    });\n    if (!strategy) throw new BadRequestException(`Strategy ${params.strategyId} not found`);\n    if (strategy.status === 'DISABLED') throw new BadRequestException(`Strategy ${params.strategyId} DISABLED`);\n    if (strategy.status === 'ERROR') throw new BadRequestException(`Strategy ${params.strategyId} in ERROR state`);\n    return strategy;\n  }\n\n  async createIntent(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    side: string;\n    orderType: string;\n    quantity: string;\n    price?: string | null;\n    stopPrice?: string | null;\n    timeInForce?: string;\n    reduceOnly?: boolean;\n    strategyId?: string | null;\n    traderId?: string | null;\n    followerId?: string | null;\n    subscriptionId?: string | null;\n    environment: string;\n    source: string;\n    signalId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    requestId?: string | null;\n    userId?: string | null;\n    venue?: string | null;\n    /** Phase 3: producer links carried on the intent (e.g. copyExecutionId),\n     * forwarded by routeIntent onto the canonical order and the SUBMIT_ORDER\n     * job. String values only; never used for any decision. */\n    metadata?: Record<string, string> | null;\n  }) {\n    const {\n      tenantId,\n      accountId,\n      symbol,\n      side,\n      orderType,\n      quantity,\n      price,\n      stopPrice,\n      timeInForce,\n      reduceOnly,\n      strategyId,\n      traderId,\n      followerId,\n      subscriptionId,\n      environment,\n      source,\n      signalId,\n      correlationId,\n      requestId,\n      userId,\n      venue,\n      metadata: producerMetadata,\n    } = params;\n\n    // Tenant ownership validation\n    await this.validateAccountOwnership({ tenantId, accountId, userId });\n    const symbolRecord = await this.validateSymbol({ tenantId, symbol, venue });\n    this.validatePrecision({ quantity, price, symbol: symbolRecord });\n    await this.checkStrategyState({ tenantId, strategyId });\n\n    if (!['BUY', 'SELL'].includes(side)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid side ${side}`);\n    if (!['MARKET', 'LIMIT', 'STOP', 'STOP_LIMIT'].includes(orderType)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid orderType ${orderType}`);\n    if (orderType === 'LIMIT' && !price) throw new BadRequestException('LIMIT order requires price');\n    if (['STOP', 'STOP_LIMIT'].includes(orderType) && !stopPrice) throw new BadRequestException(`${orderType} requires stopPrice`);\n    if (!['PAPER', 'LIVE'].includes(environment)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid environment ${environment}`);\n    if (!['STRATEGY', 'COPY_TRADING', 'MANUAL', 'RESEARCH_PROMOTION'].includes(source)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid source ${source}`);\n\n    // Risk decision — must be APPROVED before intent creation if policy requires\n    // We do a pre-check via RiskDecisionService but do not trust client-supplied risk approval\n    let riskDecisionId: string | null = null;\n    let riskPolicyVersion: string | null = null;\n    try {\n      const riskResult = await this.riskDecisionService.evaluateUnifiedRisk({\n        tenantId,\n        userId: (userId ?? undefined) as any,\n        accountId,\n        symbol,\n        traderId: traderId as any,\n        followerId: followerId as any,\n        strategyId: strategyId as any,\n        orderIntent: { side: side as any, quantity, price: price ?? null, orderType: orderType as any } as any,\n        environment: environment as any,\n        requestId: requestId as any,\n      } as any);\n      riskDecisionId = riskResult.id;\n      riskPolicyVersion = riskResult.policyVersion;\n      if (riskResult.decision === 'BLOCK' || riskResult.decision === 'KILL_SWITCH_REQUIRED') {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Risk blocked: ${riskResult.blockingReasons.join(', ')}`);\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (e instanceof BadRequestException) throw e;\n      this.logger.warn(`Risk check failed for intent creation tenant ${tenantId} symbol ${symbol}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      // Fail closed if risk unavailable for LIVE\n      if (environment === 'LIVE') throw new BadRequestException(`Risk check unavailable for LIVE order: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // Compliance check — reuse compliance screening\n    const complianceScreen = await this.prisma.complianceScreeningRequest.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, status: 'BLOCKED' as any },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (complianceScreen) {\n      // If tenant has active compliance block, prevent\n      const isBlocked = complianceScreen.decision === 'BLOCK';\n      if (isBlocked) throw new ForbiddenException(`Compliance BLOCK prevents order intent`);\n    }\n\n    // Security state — check threat signals\n    const threat = await this.prisma.securityThreatSignal.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, resolved: false, riskLevel: { in: ['HIGH', 'CRITICAL'] as any } },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (threat && threat.decision === 'DENY') {\n      throw new ForbiddenException(`Security BLOCK prevents order intent: ${threat.safeSummary}`);\n    }\n\n    // Exchange capability check\n    const exchange = symbolRecord.exchange;\n    if (!exchange.isEnabled) throw new BadRequestException(`Exchange ${exchange.venue} not enabled`);\n    if (environment === 'LIVE' && !exchange.tradingEnabled) throw new BadRequestException(`Exchange ${exchange.venue} trading not enabled for LIVE`);\n\n    // Live gate requirements — check account liveTradingEnabled for LIVE\n    const account = await this.prisma.tradingAccount.findUnique({ where: { id: accountId } });\n    if (environment === 'LIVE' && !account?.liveTradingEnabled) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException(`Live trading not enabled for account ${accountId}`);\n    }\n\n    // 35 characters of [A-Za-z0-9]: fits Order.clientOrderId (VarChar(36)) and\n    // the execution core's CLIENT_ORDER_ID_PATTERN ([A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,36}). The\n    // previous `oms-${uuid}` form was 40 characters and could not be stored on\n    // the canonical order row nor accepted by the engine.\n    const clientOrderId = `oms${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, '')}`;\n    const safeProducerMetadata: Record<string, string> = {};\n    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(producerMetadata ?? {})) {\n      if (typeof value === 'string' && value.length <= 128 && /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$/.test(key)) {\n        safeProducerMetadata[key] = value;\n      }\n    }\n    const now = new Date();\n    const nowIso = now.toISOString();\n    const micros = (BigInt(now.getTime()) * 1000n).toString();\n\n    const transition = {\n      eventId: randomUUID(),\n      fromState: null,\n      toState: OrderIntentState.CREATED,\n      timestamp: nowIso,\n      timestampMicros: micros,\n      source: 'OMS',\n      reason: `Order intent created from ${source} symbol ${symbol} side ${side} qty ${quantity}`,\n      correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n      policyVersion: riskPolicyVersion,\n      riskRuleId: null,\n      actorId: userId ?? null,\n      actorType: userId ? 'USER' : 'SYSTEM',\n      metadata: { strategyId, traderId, followerId, subscriptionId, environment, signalId },\n    };\n\n    // The ceiling check and the write are one atomic unit: the limiter takes the per-user\n    // advisory lock, measures canonical active reservations, and only then runs this callback.\n    // The callback must write through the supplied client - a write on `this.prisma` would commit\n    // outside the lock, and two intents racing would both observe the pre-insert count and pass a\n    // ceiling they jointly exceed.\n    return this.positionLimitService.persistOrderIntentWithLimits({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId,\n      symbol,\n      persist: async (tx) => {\n        // The write is wrapped in a savepoint because it has a fallback. A failed statement aborts\n        // the surrounding transaction in PostgreSQL, so without the savepoint the fallback insert\n        // would run inside an aborted transaction and fail too - the fallback would look defensive\n        // and be unreachable. Rolling back to the savepoint restores the transaction to a usable\n        // state first.\n        await (tx as any).$executeRaw`SAVEPOINT oms_order_intent_persist`;\n        // Persist as OmsOrderIntent if model exists, else fallback to Order with metadata\n        try {\n          const created = await (tx as any).omsOrderIntent.create({\n            data: {\n              tenantId,\n              accountId,\n              strategyId: strategyId ?? undefined,\n              traderId: traderId ?? undefined,\n              followerId: followerId ?? undefined,\n              subscriptionId: subscriptionId ?? undefined,\n              symbol,\n              venue: exchange.venue,\n              side,\n              orderType,\n              timeInForce: timeInForce ?? 'GTC',\n              quantity,\n              price: price ?? undefined,\n              stopPrice: stopPrice ?? undefined,\n              reduceOnly: reduceOnly ?? false,\n              environment,\n              state: OrderIntentState.CREATED,\n              clientOrderId,\n              signalId: signalId ?? undefined,\n              riskDecisionId,\n              riskPolicyVersion: riskPolicyVersion ?? undefined,\n              correlationId: correlationId ?? undefined,\n              requestId: requestId ?? undefined,\n              source,\n              metadata: { ...safeProducerMetadata, transitions: [transition], symbolId: symbolRecord.id },\n              filledQuantity: '0',\n              cumulativeFee: '0',\n              isSimulated: environment === 'PAPER',\n              wasDryRun: false,\n            },\n          });\n          await this.appendOrderCreated(tx, created, { tenantId, symbol, side, quantity, price, correlationId });\n          await (tx as any).$executeRaw`RELEASE SAVEPOINT oms_order_intent_persist`;\n          this.logger.log(`OMS intent ${created.id} CREATED tenant ${tenantId} symbol ${symbol} qty ${quantity}`);\n          return created;\n        } catch (e) {\n          await (tx as any).$executeRaw`ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT oms_order_intent_persist`;\n          const error = e as { code?: string; meta?: { modelName?: string }; message?: string };\n          const missingIntentModel = !(tx as any).omsOrderIntent?.create ||\n            ((error.code === 'P2021' || error.code === 'P2022') && error.meta?.modelName === 'OmsOrderIntent');\n          if (!missingIntentModel) throw e;\n          // Fallback only when the OmsOrderIntent model/table is unavailable; event validation and\n          // outbox failures must never be mistaken for a persistence-model migration gap.\n          this.logger.warn(`OmsOrderIntent model missing, falling back to Order table: ${error.message ?? 'model unavailable'}`);\n          const created = await (tx as any).order.create({\n            data: {\n              tenantId,\n              accountId,\n              strategyId: strategyId ?? undefined,\n              symbolId: symbolRecord.id,\n              clientOrderId,\n              venue: exchange.venue,\n              symbol,\n              side: side as any,\n              orderType: orderType as any,\n              timeInForce: (timeInForce as any) ?? 'GTC',\n              status: 'PENDING' as any,\n              quantity: quantity as any,\n              price: price as any,\n              stopPrice: stopPrice as any,\n              reduceOnly: reduceOnly ?? false,\n              isSimulated: environment === 'PAPER',\n              wasDryRun: false,\n              metadata: { ...safeProducerMetadata, omsIntent: true, transitions: [transition], source, correlationId, riskDecisionId, environment, signalId } as any,\n            },\n          });\n          await this.appendOrderCreated(tx, created, { tenantId, symbol, side, quantity, price, correlationId });\n          return created;\n        }\n      },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async getIntent(tenantId: string, intentId: string) {\n    try {\n      const intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n      if (intent) return intent;\n    } catch {}\n    return this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n  }\n\n  async listIntents(params: { tenantId: string; accountId?: string; strategyId?: string; symbol?: string; state?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, strategyId, symbol, state, page = 1, limit = 20 } = params;\n    try {\n      return await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}), ...(strategyId ? { strategyId } : {}), ...(symbol ? { symbol } : {}), ...(state ? { state } : {}) },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      });\n    } catch {\n      return this.prisma.order.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}), ...(strategyId ? { strategyId } : {}), ...(symbol ? { symbol } : {}), ...(state ? { status: state as any } : {}) },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/order-lifecycle-outbox.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. '');\n  }\n\n  async transition(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    intentId: string;\n    toState: OrderIntentState | string;\n    source: string;\n    reason: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    policyVersion?: string | null;\n    riskRuleId?: string | null;\n    actorId?: string | null;\n    actorType?: string;\n    metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;\n    timestampMicros?: string | null;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, intentId, toState, source, reason, correlationId, policyVersion, riskRuleId, actorId, actorType, metadata, timestampMicros } = params;\n    const now = new Date();\n    const nowIso = now.toISOString();\n    const micros = timestampMicros ?? (BigInt(now.getTime()) * 1000n).toString();\n\n    return this.prisma.withTenantRls(tenantId, async (tx) => {\n      const store = tx as any;\n      const intentDelegate = store.omsOrderIntent;\n      let useIntentModel = typeof intentDelegate?.findFirst === 'function';\n      let intent: any = null;\n      if (useIntentModel) {\n        try {\n          intent = await intentDelegate.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n        } catch (error) {\n          if (!this.isMissingIntentModel(error)) throw error;\n          useIntentModel = false;\n        }\n      }\n      if (!useIntentModel) {\n        intent = await store.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n      }\n      if (!intent) throw new BadRequestException(`Intent ${intentId} not found for tenant ${tenantId}`);\n\n      const currentState = intent.state ?? intent.status;\n      if (!currentState) throw new BadRequestException(`Intent ${intentId} has no state`);\n\n      // Idempotency: same-state transition is allowed and is no-op.\n      if (currentState === toState) {\n        this.logger.log(`Idempotent transition ${intentId} ${currentState} → ${toState} source ${source}`);\n        return intent;\n      }\n      if (isTerminalState(currentState)) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Cannot transition from terminal state ${currentState} to ${toState} for intent ${intentId}`);\n      }\n      if (!isValidTransition(currentState, toState)) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid transition ${currentState} → ${toState} for intent ${intentId}. Allowed: ${(VALID_TRANSITIONS[currentState] || []).join(', ')}`);\n      }\n\n      const developerEventType = toState === OrderIntentState.ACKNOWLEDGED\n        ? 'order.acknowledged'\n        : toState === OrderIntentState.FILLED\n          ? 'order.filled'\n          : toState === OrderIntentState.REJECTED\n            ? 'order.rejected'\n            : null;\n      if (developerEventType && !this.outbox) {\n        throw new Error(`Transactional outbox is unavailable; refusing ${toState} order transition without ${developerEventType}`);\n      }\n\n      const transitions = (intent.metadata?.transitions as any[]) ?? [];\n      if (transitions.length > 0) {\n        const last = transitions[transitions.length - 1];\n        if (last?.timestampMicros) {\n          const lastMicros = BigInt(last.timestampMicros);\n          const newMicros = BigInt(micros);\n          if (newMicros < lastMicros) {\n            this.logger.warn(`Out-of-order event detected for intent ${intentId}: last ${last.timestampMicros} new ${micros} transition ${currentState}→${toState}`);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      const event = {\n        eventId: randomUUID(),\n        fromState: currentState,\n        toState,\n        timestamp: nowIso,\n        timestampMicros: micros,\n        source,\n        reason: reason.slice(0, 1000),\n        correlationId: correlationId ?? intent.correlationId ?? null,\n        policyVersion: policyVersion ?? null,\n        riskRuleId: riskRuleId ?? null,\n        actorId: actorId ?? null,\n        actorType: actorType ?? 'SYSTEM',\n        metadata: metadata ?? null,\n      };\n      const newMetadata = {\n        ...(intent.metadata as any),\n        transitions: [...transitions, event],\n      };\n      const omsData = {\n        state: toState,\n        metadata: newMetadata,\n        ...(toState === OrderIntentState.SUBMITTED ? { submittedAt: now } : {}),\n        ...(toState === OrderIntentState.ACKNOWLEDGED ? { acknowledgedAt: now } : {}),\n        ...(TERMINAL_STATES.has(toState) ? { terminalAt: now } : {}),\n        updatedAt: now,\n      };\n\n      let updated: any;\n      if (useIntentModel) {\n        try {\n          updated = await intentDelegate.update({ where: { id: intentId }, data: omsData });\n        } catch (error) {\n          if (!this.isMissingIntentModel(error)) throw error;\n          useIntentModel = false;\n        }\n      }\n      if (!useIntentModel) {\n        updated = await store.order.update({\n          where: { id: intentId },\n          data: {\n            status: toState as any,\n            metadata: newMetadata as any,\n            ...(TERMINAL_STATES.has(toState) ? { terminalAt: now } : {}),\n            updatedAt: now,\n          },\n        });\n      }\n\n      if (developerEventType) {\n        const decimalString = (value: unknown): string | null => {\n          if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;\n          return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value);\n        };\n        const orderId = intent.id;\n        const rawQuantity = toState === OrderIntentState.FILLED\n          ? (intent.filledQuantity ?? intent.quantity)\n          : intent.quantity;\n        const rawPrice = toState === OrderIntentState.FILLED\n          ? (intent.averageFillPrice ?? intent.price)\n          : intent.price;\n        const side = intent.side === 'BUY' || intent.side === 'SELL' ? intent.side : null;\n        const outboxPayload = {\n          orderId,\n          status: toState,\n          symbol: typeof intent.symbol === 'string' ? intent.symbol : null,\n          side,\n          quantity: decimalString(rawQuantity),\n          price: decimalString(rawPrice),\n        };\n        await this.outbox!.append(tx, {\n          tenantId,\n          aggregateType: 'order',\n          aggregateId: orderId,\n          eventType: developerEventType,\n          idempotencyKey: `order:${orderId}:transition:${event.eventId}`,\n          correlationId: event.correlationId && event.correlationId.length <= 64 ? event.correlationId : null,\n          occurredAt: now,\n          payload: outboxPayload,\n        });\n      }\n\n      this.logger.log(`Intent ${intentId} transitioned ${currentState} → ${toState} via ${source} reason ${reason}`);\n      return updated;\n    });\n  }\n\n  async getHistory(tenantId: string, intentId: string) {\n    let intent: any;\n    try {\n      intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    } catch {\n      intent = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    }\n    if (!intent) throw new BadRequestException(`Intent ${intentId} not found`);\n    return (intent.metadata?.transitions as any[]) ?? [];\n  }\n\n  async isTerminal(tenantId: string, intentId: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    let intent: any;\n    try {\n      intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    } catch {\n      intent = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    }\n    if (!intent) return false;\n    return isTerminalState(intent.state ?? intent.status);\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/order-reconciliation.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. If reading it fails, the canonical order row is\n    // used instead - and that substitution is never silent: it is logged with the error code and\n    // reported as intentSource / intentReadError in the result.\n    let intent: any;\n    let intentSource: 'OMS_INTENT' | 'CANONICAL_ORDER_FALLBACK' = 'OMS_INTENT';\n    let intentReadError: string | null = null;\n    try {\n      intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    } catch (e) {\n      intentSource = 'CANONICAL_ORDER_FALLBACK';\n      intentReadError = reconciliationErrorCode(e);\n      this.logger.warn(\n        `Order reconciliation intent ${intentId} tenant ${tenantId}: OMS intent read failed (error ${intentReadError}); reconciling from the canonical order row`,\n      );\n      intent = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    }\n    if (!intent) throw new Error(`Intent ${intentId} not found`);\n\n    const findings: Array<{ category: string; severity: string; summary: string; expected: any; actual: any }> = [];\n\n    const clientOrderId = intent.clientOrderId;\n    const exchangeOrderId = intent.exchangeOrderId ?? intent.exchangeOrderId;\n    const currentState = intent.state ?? intent.status;\n\n    // Fetch canonical order by clientOrderId\n    const canonicalOrder = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, clientOrderId } });\n    if (!canonicalOrder) {\n      findings.push({\n        category: ReconciliationCategory.MISSING_EXCHANGE_ORDER,\n        severity: 'HIGH',\n        summary: `OMS intent ${intentId} clientOrderId ${clientOrderId} has no canonical Order record`,\n        expected: { canonicalOrderExists: true },\n        actual: { clientOrderId, found: false },\n      });\n    } else {\n      // Check exchangeOrderId presence\n      if (!canonicalOrder.exchangeOrderId && ['ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'FILLED'].includes(currentState)) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.MISSING_EXCHANGE_ORDER,\n          severity: 'MEDIUM',\n          summary: `Intent ${intentId} state ${currentState} but canonical order ${canonicalOrder.id} has no exchangeOrderId`,\n          expected: { exchangeOrderIdExists: true },\n          actual: { state: currentState, exchangeOrderId: null },\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Check ack\n      if (!canonicalOrder.exchangeOrderId && currentState === 'SUBMITTED') {\n        // Check if ack exists in execution events\n        const ackEvent = await this.prisma.orderEvent.findFirst({ where: { orderId: canonicalOrder.id, status: { in: ['ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'FILLED'] as any } } });\n        if (!ackEvent) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: ReconciliationCategory.MISSING_ACK,\n            severity: 'MEDIUM',\n            summary: `Intent ${intentId} SUBMITTED but no ack event for canonical order ${canonicalOrder.id}`,\n            expected: { ackExists: true },\n            actual: { state: currentState, ackFound: false },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Provider status mismatch\n      if (canonicalOrder && (canonicalOrder.status as any) !== currentState) {\n        // Allow some valid differences: OMS SUBMITTED vs canonical ACKNOWLEDGED is okay (timing)\n        const validMismatch = (currentState === 'SUBMITTED' && ['ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'FILLED'].includes(canonicalOrder.status as any)) ||\n          (currentState === 'ACKNOWLEDGED' && ['PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'FILLED'].includes(canonicalOrder.status as any));\n        if (!validMismatch) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: ReconciliationCategory.PROVIDER_STATUS_MISMATCH,\n            severity: currentState === 'FILLED' || canonicalOrder.status === 'FILLED' ? 'HIGH' : 'MEDIUM',\n            summary: `Status mismatch intent ${intentId} OMS ${currentState} vs canonical ${canonicalOrder.status}`,\n            expected: { omsState: currentState },\n            actual: { canonicalStatus: canonicalOrder.status },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Quantity mismatch\n      const intentQty = intent.quantity?.toString() ?? intent.quantity;\n      const canonicalQty = canonicalOrder.quantity.toString();\n      if (isValidDecimal(intentQty) && isValidDecimal(canonicalQty) && intentQty !== canonicalQty) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.ORDER_QUANTITY_MISMATCH,\n          severity: 'HIGH',\n          summary: `Quantity mismatch intent ${intentId} OMS ${intentQty} vs canonical ${canonicalQty}`,\n          expected: { quantity: intentQty },\n          actual: { quantity: canonicalQty },\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Terminal state mismatch\n      const omsTerminal = isTerminalState(currentState);\n      const canonicalTerminal = ['FILLED', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'EXPIRED', 'FAILED'].includes(canonicalOrder.status as any);\n      if (omsTerminal !== canonicalTerminal) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.TERMINAL_STATE_MISMATCH,\n          severity: 'MEDIUM',\n          summary: `Terminal mismatch intent ${intentId} OMS terminal ${omsTerminal} state ${currentState} vs canonical terminal ${canonicalTerminal} state ${canonicalOrder.status}`,\n          expected: { omsTerminal },\n          actual: { canonicalTerminal, canonicalStatus: canonicalOrder.status },\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Stale order detection: SUBMITTED/ACKNOWLEDGED for > 5 minutes without update\n      if (['SUBMITTED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED'].includes(currentState)) {\n        const updatedAt = intent.updatedAt ? new Date(intent.updatedAt) : new Date(intent.createdAt);\n        const ageMs = Date.now() - updatedAt.getTime();\n        if (ageMs > 5 * 60 * 1000) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: ReconciliationCategory.STALE_ORDER,\n            severity: ageMs > 30 * 60 * 1000 ? 'HIGH' : 'MEDIUM',\n            summary: `Stale order intent ${intentId} state ${currentState} age ${Math.floor(ageMs / 1000)}s`,\n            expected: { maxAgeMs: 5 * 60 * 1000 },\n            actual: { ageMs, state: currentState },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Duplicate provider order: same clientOrderId appears multiple times\n      const dupOrders = await this.prisma.order.findMany({ where: { tenantId, clientOrderId } });\n      if (dupOrders.length > 1) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.DUPLICATE_PROVIDER_ORDER,\n          severity: 'HIGH',\n          summary: `Duplicate provider orders for clientOrderId ${clientOrderId} count ${dupOrders.length}`,\n          expected: { count: 1 },\n          actual: { count: dupOrders.length, orderIds: dupOrders.map((o) => o.id) },\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Impossible lifecycle transition check via transitions\n      const transitions = (intent.metadata?.transitions as any[]) ?? [];\n      for (let i = 1; i < transitions.length; i++) {\n        const from = transitions[i - 1].toState;\n        const to = transitions[i].toState;\n        // Use same VALID_TRANSITIONS check\n        if (!isValidTransition(from, to)) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: ReconciliationCategory.IMPOSSIBLE_LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION,\n            severity: 'HIGH',\n            summary: `Impossible transition ${from} → ${to} in intent ${intentId} at ${transitions[i].timestamp}`,\n            expected: { valid: true },\n            actual: { from, to, eventId: transitions[i].eventId },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Persist findings. A finding that cannot be stored is never dropped silently: it stays in the\n    // returned result, is counted in persistFailures and is logged at error level (error code only,\n    // never row values).\n    let persistedFindings = 0;\n    let persistFailures = 0;\n    for (const f of findings) {\n      try {\n        await (this.prisma as any).omsReconciliation.create({\n          data: {\n            tenantId,\n            orderIntentId: intentId,\n            internalOrderId: canonicalOrder?.id ?? null,\n            providerOrderId: exchangeOrderId ?? null,\n            category: f.category,\n            severity: f.severity,\n            expected: f.expected,\n            actual: f.actual,\n            summary: f.summary.slice(0, 1000),\n            resolved: false,\n          },\n        });\n        persistedFindings++;\n      } catch (e) {\n        persistFailures++;\n        this.logger.error(\n          `Order reconciliation finding NOT persisted intent ${intentId} tenant ${tenantId} category ${f.category} severity ${f.severity} error ${reconciliationErrorCode(e)}`,\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (persistFailures > 0) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Order reconciliation intent ${intentId} tenant ${tenantId} findings ${findings.length} persisted ${persistedFindings} persistFailures ${persistFailures} source ${intentSource}`);\n    } else {\n      this.logger.log(`Order reconciliation intent ${intentId} tenant ${tenantId} findings ${findings.length} source ${intentSource}`);\n    }\n    return {\n      intentId,\n      intentSource,\n      intentReadError,\n      findings,\n      totalFindings: findings.length,\n      persistedFindings,\n      persistFailures,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async reconcileTenant(params: { tenantId: string; accountId?: string; limit?: number }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, limit = 20 } = params;\n    let intents: any[] = [];\n    let intentSource: 'OMS_INTENT' | 'CANONICAL_ORDER_FALLBACK' = 'OMS_INTENT';\n    let intentReadError: string | null = null;\n    try {\n      intents = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}), state: { in: ['SUBMITTED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'] } },\n        orderBy: { updatedAt: 'asc' },\n        take: limit,\n      });\n    } catch (e) {\n      intentSource = 'CANONICAL_ORDER_FALLBACK';\n      intentReadError = reconciliationErrorCode(e);\n      this.logger.warn(\n        `Order reconciliation tenant ${tenantId}: OMS intent list read failed (error ${intentReadError}); selecting open canonical orders instead`,\n      );\n      intents = await this.prisma.order.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}), status: { in: ['SUBMITTED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED'] as any } },\n        orderBy: { updatedAt: 'asc' },\n        take: limit,\n      });\n    }\n\n    const results = [];\n    for (const intent of intents) {\n      const res = await this.reconcileOrder({ tenantId, intentId: intent.id });\n      results.push(res);\n    }\n    return {\n      totalChecked: intents.length,\n      totalFindings: results.reduce((s, r) => s + r.totalFindings, 0),\n      intentSource,\n      intentReadError,\n      readFallbacks: results.filter((r) => r.intentSource === 'CANONICAL_ORDER_FALLBACK').length,\n      results,\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/order-rejection.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. ''} ${message ?? ''} ${source}`.toUpperCase();\n\n    if (source === 'RISK' || text.includes('RISK') || text.includes('LIMIT') || text.includes('EXPOSURE') || text.includes('LEVERAGE') || text.includes('MARGIN_WARNING') || text.includes('DRAWDOWN') || text.includes('CONCENTRATION')) return RejectionCategory.RISK_BLOCK;\n    if (source === 'COMPLIANCE' || text.includes('COMPLIANCE') || text.includes('KYC') || text.includes('AML') || text.includes('SANCTION')) return RejectionCategory.COMPLIANCE_BLOCK;\n    if (source === 'SECURITY' || text.includes('SECURITY') || text.includes('THREAT') || text.includes('BLOCKED_IP')) return RejectionCategory.SECURITY_BLOCK;\n    if (text.includes('SYMBOL') && (text.includes('INVALID') || text.includes('UNKNOWN') || text.includes('NOT_FOUND'))) return RejectionCategory.INVALID_SYMBOL;\n    if (text.includes('PRECISION') || text.includes('LOT_SIZE') || text.includes('TICK_SIZE') || text.includes('MIN_NOTIONAL') || text.includes('STEP')) return RejectionCategory.INVALID_PRECISION;\n    if (text.includes('BALANCE') || text.includes('INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS') || text.includes('FUNDS')) return RejectionCategory.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE;\n    if (text.includes('MARGIN') && text.includes('INSUFFICIENT')) return RejectionCategory.INSUFFICIENT_MARGIN;\n    if (text.includes('RATE_LIMIT') || text.includes('TOO_MANY_REQUESTS') || text.includes('429')) return RejectionCategory.RATE_LIMITED;\n    if (text.includes('STALE') || text.includes('MARKET_DATA')) return RejectionCategory.MARKET_DATA_STALE;\n    if (text.includes('LIVE_GATE') || text.includes('LIVE_TRADING_DISABLED') || text.includes('NOT_LIVE_ENABLED')) return RejectionCategory.LIVE_GATE_BLOCK;\n    if (text.includes('CREDENTIAL') || text.includes('API_KEY') || text.includes('SIGNATURE') || text.includes('AUTH')) return RejectionCategory.CREDENTIAL_FAILURE;\n    if (text.includes('EXCHANGE') || text.includes('VENUE') || text.includes('BINANCE') || text.includes('BYBIT') || text.includes('REJECTED_BY_VENUE')) return RejectionCategory.EXCHANGE_REJECT;\n    return RejectionCategory.UNKNOWN;\n  }\n\n  private isRetriable(category: RejectionCategory): boolean {\n    return [RejectionCategory.RATE_LIMITED, RejectionCategory.MARKET_DATA_STALE, RejectionCategory.UNKNOWN].includes(category);\n  }\n\n  async recordRejection(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    orderIntentId: string;\n    source: string;\n    providerCode?: string | null;\n    providerMessage?: string | null;\n    riskRuleId?: string | null;\n    complianceRuleId?: string | null;\n    venue?: string | null;\n    symbol?: string | null;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n    strategyId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    reason: string;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, orderIntentId, source, providerCode, providerMessage, riskRuleId, complianceRuleId, venue, symbol, accountId, strategyId, correlationId, reason } = params;\n\n    const category = this.categorizeRejection({ code: providerCode, message: providerMessage ?? reason, source });\n\n    // Safe reason — never expose secrets, truncate\n    const safeReason = reason.slice(0, 1000);\n    const safeProviderMessage = providerMessage ? providerMessage.slice(0, 500) : null;\n\n    const record = {\n      id: randomUUID(),\n      tenantId,\n      orderIntentId,\n      category,\n      reason: safeReason,\n      providerCode: providerCode ? providerCode.slice(0, 100) : null,\n      providerMessage: safeProviderMessage,\n      riskRuleId: riskRuleId ?? null,\n      complianceRuleId: complianceRuleId ?? null,\n      venue: venue ?? null,\n      symbol: symbol ?? null,\n      accountId: accountId ?? null,\n      strategyId: strategyId ?? null,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n      isRetriable: this.isRetriable(category),\n      metadata: { source },\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).omsRejection.create({ data: record });\n      this.logger.log(`Rejection recorded intent ${orderIntentId} category ${category} reason ${safeReason} tenant ${tenantId}`);\n      return created;\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`OmsRejection model missing, logging only: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      return record;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getRejections(params: { tenantId: string; accountId?: string; symbol?: string; category?: string; from?: Date; to?: Date; page?: number; limit?: number }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, symbol, category, from, to, page = 1, limit = 20 } = params;\n    return await (this.prisma as any).omsRejection.findMany({\n      where: {\n        tenantId,\n        ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}),\n        ...(symbol ? { symbol } : {}),\n        ...(category ? { category } : {}),\n        ...(from || to ? { timestamp: { gte: from?.toISOString(), lte: to?.toISOString() } as any } : {}),\n      },\n      orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' },\n      skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n      take: limit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async getRejectionStats(tenantId: string, from?: Date, to?: Date) {\n    const rejections = await this.getRejections({ tenantId, from, to, page: 1, limit: 1000 });\n    const byCategory: Record<string, number> = {};\n    for (const r of rejections) {\n      byCategory[r.category] = (byCategory[r.category] ?? 0) + 1;\n    }\n    return { total: rejections.length, byCategory, retriable: rejections.filter((r: any) => r.isRetriable).length };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/order-replace.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected parseScaled } from './oms.types';\nimport { ExchangeSymbolService } from '../exchanges/exchange-symbol.service';\n\n/**\n * Order Replace/Amend Service — coordinates replace/amend requests where venue/execution engine supports them\n * without bypassing risk validation.\n * Requirements: re-run risk, re-run precision, preserve original identity/reference, preserve audit trail, never mutate filled data.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class OrderReplaceService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(OrderReplaceService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly lifecycleService: OrderLifecycleService,\n    private readonly intentService: OrderIntentService,\n    private readonly riskDecisionService: RiskDecisionService,\n    private readonly symbolService: ExchangeSymbolService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async requestReplace(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    intentId: string;\n    userId?: string | null;\n    newQuantity?: string | null;\n    newPrice?: string | null;\n    newStopPrice?: string | null;\n    reason: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    requestId?: string | null;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, intentId, userId, newQuantity, newPrice, newStopPrice, reason, correlationId, requestId } = params;\n\n    let intent: any;\n    try {\n      intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    } catch {\n      intent = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    }\n    if (!intent) throw new BadRequestException(`Intent ${intentId} not found`);\n\n    const currentState = intent.state ?? intent.status;\n    if (!REPLACEABLE_STATES.has(currentState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Order ${intentId} not replaceable in state ${currentState}`);\n    }\n\n    // Validate provider capability — check if venue supports amend\n    const symbolRecord = await this.prisma.tradingSymbol.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, symbol: intent.symbol, isTradeable: true },\n      include: { exchange: true },\n    });\n    if (!symbolRecord) throw new BadRequestException(`Symbol ${intent.symbol} not found`);\n\n    // Some venues don't support amend — we must check via symbol service or exchange metadata\n    // For now, we assume cancel-replace is supported if exchange is enabled\n    if (!symbolRecord.exchange.isEnabled) throw new BadRequestException(`Exchange ${symbolRecord.exchange.venue} not enabled for replace`);\n\n    // Re-run precision validation\n    if (newQuantity) {\n      if (!isValidDecimal(newQuantity)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid newQuantity ${newQuantity}`);\n      if (parseScaled(newQuantity) <= 0n) throw new BadRequestException('newQuantity must be > 0');\n      // Cannot reduce below already filled quantity\n      const filledQty = intent.filledQuantity?.toString() ?? '0';\n      if (isValidDecimal(filledQty) && parseScaled(newQuantity) < parseScaled(filledQty)) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`newQuantity ${newQuantity} cannot be less than already filled ${filledQty}`);\n      }\n    }\n    if (newPrice && !isValidDecimal(newPrice)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid newPrice ${newPrice}`);\n    if (newStopPrice && !isValidDecimal(newStopPrice)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid newStopPrice ${newStopPrice}`);\n\n    // Re-run risk validation with new qty/price\n    const riskResult = await this.riskDecisionService.evaluateUnifiedRisk({\n      tenantId,\n      userId: userId ?? null,\n      accountId: intent.accountId,\n      symbol: intent.symbol,\n      traderId: intent.traderId as any,\n      followerId: intent.followerId as any,\n      strategyId: intent.strategyId as any,\n      orderIntent: {\n        side: intent.side,\n        quantity: newQuantity ?? intent.quantity?.toString() ?? intent.quantity,\n        price: newPrice ?? intent.price?.toString() ?? intent.price ?? null,\n        orderType: intent.orderType,\n      } as any,\n      environment: intent.environment ?? 'PAPER',\n      requestId: requestId as any,\n    } as any);\n\n    if (riskResult.decision === 'BLOCK' || riskResult.decision === 'KILL_SWITCH_REQUIRED') {\n      throw new ForbiddenException(`Risk BLOCK prevents replace for intent ${intentId}: ${riskResult.blockingReasons.join(', ')}`);\n    }\n\n    // Preserve original identity/reference — create new intent that references original\n    const newIntent = await this.intentService.createIntent({\n      tenantId,\n      accountId: intent.accountId,\n      symbol: intent.symbol,\n      side: intent.side,\n      orderType: intent.orderType,\n      quantity: newQuantity ?? intent.quantity?.toString() ?? intent.quantity,\n      price: newPrice ?? intent.price?.toString() ?? intent.price ?? null,\n      stopPrice: newStopPrice ?? intent.stopPrice?.toString() ?? intent.stopPrice ?? null,\n      timeInForce: intent.timeInForce ?? 'GTC',\n      reduceOnly: intent.reduceOnly ?? false,\n      strategyId: intent.strategyId ?? undefined,\n      traderId: intent.traderId ?? undefined,\n      followerId: intent.followerId ?? undefined,\n      subscriptionId: intent.subscriptionId ?? undefined,\n      environment: intent.environment ?? 'PAPER',\n      source: intent.source ?? 'MANUAL',\n      signalId: intent.signalId ?? undefined,\n      correlationId: correlationId ?? intent.correlationId ?? undefined,\n      requestId: requestId ?? undefined,\n      userId: userId ?? undefined,\n      venue: intent.venue ?? undefined,\n    });\n\n    // Mark original as REPLACED — preserve audit trail\n    await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n      tenantId,\n      intentId,\n      toState: OrderIntentState.REPLACED,\n      source: 'OMS_REPLACE',\n      reason: `Replaced by new intent ${newIntent.id} reason ${reason}`,\n      correlationId,\n      policyVersion: riskResult.policyVersion,\n      actorId: userId ?? null,\n      actorType: userId ? 'USER' : 'SYSTEM',\n      metadata: { newIntentId: newIntent.id, newQuantity, newPrice, newStopPrice },\n    });\n\n    // Link replacement in new intent metadata\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.update({\n        where: { id: newIntent.id },\n        data: { metadata: { ...(newIntent.metadata as any), replacedFrom: intentId, replaceReason: reason } },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n\n    this.logger.log(`Intent ${intentId} REPLACED by ${newIntent.id} tenant ${tenantId} qty ${newQuantity ?? 'same'} price ${newPrice ?? 'same'}`);\n    return { originalIntentId: intentId, newIntentId: newIntent.id, riskDecisionId: riskResult.id };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/order-routing.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { OrderIntentService } from './order-intent.service';\nimport { OrderLifecycleService } from './order-lifecycle.service';\nimport { RiskDecisionService } from '../risk-management/risk-decision.service';\nimport { OrderIntentState } from './oms.types';\nimport { ExchangeRoutingService } from '../exchanges/exchange-routing.service';\nimport { ExchangeAccountService } from '../exchanges/exchange-account.service';\nimport { ExecutionSafetyService } from '../execution/execution-safety.service';\nimport { QueueService } from '../queue/queue.service';\nimport { JOB_NAMES, QUEUE_NAMES } from '@wlct/config';\nimport {\n  SubmitOrderRefused,\n  buildSubmitOrderJob,\n  buildSubmitSpecification,\n  computeSubmitExposure,\n  submitOrderJobId,\n} from './order-submission.payload';\n\n/**\n * Order Routing Service — coordinates approved intents with:\n * ExchangeRoutingService, ExchangeAccountService, RiskDecisionService, Compliance, Live Gate, Execution Engine\n *\n * Flow: Approved Intent → Final Risk Check → Compliance Check → Exchange Routing → Live Safety Gate → Existing Execution Engine\n * Never directly call raw exchange REST endpoint here.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class OrderRoutingService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(OrderRoutingService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly intentService: OrderIntentService,\n    private readonly lifecycleService: OrderLifecycleService,\n    private readonly riskDecisionService: RiskDecisionService,\n    private readonly routingService: ExchangeRoutingService,\n    private readonly accountService: ExchangeAccountService,\n    private readonly safetyService: ExecutionSafetyService,\n    private readonly queueService: QueueService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async routeIntent(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    intentId: string;\n    userId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    requestId?: string | null;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, intentId, userId, correlationId, requestId } = params;\n\n    let intent: any;\n    try {\n      intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    } catch {\n      intent = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    }\n    if (!intent) throw new BadRequestException(`Intent ${intentId} not found`);\n\n    const currentState = intent.state ?? intent.status;\n    if (currentState !== OrderIntentState.APPROVED && currentState !== OrderIntentState.CREATED && currentState !== OrderIntentState.VALIDATING) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Intent ${intentId} not in routable state, current ${currentState}`);\n    }\n\n    // Step 1: VALIDATING\n    if (currentState === OrderIntentState.CREATED) {\n      await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n        tenantId,\n        intentId,\n        toState: OrderIntentState.VALIDATING,\n        source: 'OMS_ROUTING',\n        reason: 'Starting final validation before routing',\n        correlationId,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Step 2: Final Risk Check — must not trust client-supplied risk approval\n    const riskResult = await this.riskDecisionService.evaluateUnifiedRisk({\n      tenantId,\n      userId: userId ?? null,\n      accountId: intent.accountId,\n      symbol: intent.symbol,\n      traderId: intent.traderId as any,\n      followerId: intent.followerId as any,\n      strategyId: intent.strategyId as any,\n      orderIntent: { side: intent.side, quantity: intent.quantity?.toString() ?? intent.quantity, price: intent.price?.toString() ?? intent.price ?? null, orderType: intent.orderType } as any,\n      environment: intent.environment ?? 'PAPER',\n      requestId: requestId as any,\n    } as any);\n\n    if (riskResult.decision === 'BLOCK' || riskResult.decision === 'KILL_SWITCH_REQUIRED') {\n      await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n        tenantId,\n        intentId,\n        toState: OrderIntentState.REJECTED,\n        source: 'RISK',\n        reason: `Risk blocked: ${riskResult.blockingReasons.join(', ')}`,\n        correlationId,\n        policyVersion: riskResult.policyVersion,\n      });\n      throw new ForbiddenException(`Risk blocked routing for intent ${intentId}: ${riskResult.blockingReasons.join(', ')}`);\n    }\n\n    // APPROVED\n    await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n      tenantId,\n      intentId,\n      toState: OrderIntentState.APPROVED,\n      source: 'RISK',\n      reason: `Risk approved: ${riskResult.decision} rules ${riskResult.ruleIds.join(',')}`,\n      correlationId,\n      policyVersion: riskResult.policyVersion,\n    });\n\n    // Step 3: Compliance Check\n    const complianceBlocked = await this.prisma.complianceScreeningRequest.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, userId: userId ?? undefined, status: { in: ['BLOCKED', 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'] as any } },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (complianceBlocked && complianceBlocked.decision === 'BLOCK') {\n      await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n        tenantId,\n        intentId,\n        toState: OrderIntentState.REJECTED,\n        source: 'COMPLIANCE',\n        reason: `Compliance BLOCK: ${complianceBlocked.id}`,\n        correlationId,\n      });\n      throw new ForbiddenException(`Compliance BLOCK prevents routing for intent ${intentId}`);\n    }\n\n    // Step 4: Exchange Routing — use existing ExchangeRoutingService\n    let routingResult: any;\n    try {\n      routingResult = await this.routingService.route({\n        tenantId,\n        accountId: intent.accountId,\n        symbol: intent.symbol,\n        side: intent.side,\n        orderType: intent.orderType,\n        environment: intent.environment ?? 'PAPER',\n      } as any);\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Routing failed for intent ${intentId}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n        tenantId,\n        intentId,\n        toState: OrderIntentState.FAILED,\n        source: 'EXCHANGE_ROUTING',\n        reason: `Routing failed: ${(e as Error).message}`,\n        correlationId,\n      });\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Exchange routing failed for intent ${intentId}`);\n    }\n\n    // Step 5: Live Safety Gate — existing ExecutionSafetyService\n    if (intent.environment === 'LIVE') {\n      const safety = await this.safetyService.safetySummary(tenantId);\n      if (!safety.wouldTransmitLiveOrder) {\n        await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n          tenantId,\n          intentId,\n          toState: OrderIntentState.REJECTED,\n          source: 'LIVE_GATE',\n          reason: `Live gate BLOCK: ${safety.blockingReasons.join(', ')}`,\n          correlationId,\n        });\n        throw new ForbiddenException(`Live gate BLOCK: ${safety.blockingReasons.join(', ')}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Step 6: Existing Execution Engine — create canonical Order and hand to worker via queue\n    // Never directly call raw exchange REST endpoint here\n    await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n      tenantId,\n      intentId,\n      toState: OrderIntentState.SUBMITTED,\n      source: 'OMS_ROUTING',\n      reason: `Routed to execution engine via ${routingResult?.venue ?? intent.venue ?? 'unknown'} venue`,\n      correlationId,\n      metadata: { routing: routingResult },\n    });\n\n    let canonicalOrderId: string | null = null;\n    try {\n      // Resolve the symbol WITH its trading rules: the engine validates the\n      // order against exactly these before any gate runs.\n      const symbolRecord = await this.prisma.tradingSymbol.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, symbol: intent.symbol } });\n      if (!symbolRecord) throw new BadRequestException(`Symbol ${intent.symbol} not found for canonical order creation`);\n\n      const intentMetadata = (intent.metadata ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;\n      const copyExecutionId = typeof intentMetadata.copyExecutionId === 'string' ? intentMetadata.copyExecutionId : null;\n\n      // Create canonical Order if not exists — existing execution engine remains authoritative\n      let canonicalOrder = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, clientOrderId: intent.clientOrderId } });\n      if (!canonicalOrder) {\n        canonicalOrder = await this.prisma.order.create({\n          data: {\n            tenantId,\n            accountId: intent.accountId,\n            strategyId: intent.strategyId ?? undefined,\n            symbolId: symbolRecord.id,\n            clientOrderId: intent.clientOrderId,\n            venue: (routingResult?.venue ?? intent.venue ?? symbolRecord.exchangeId) as any,\n            symbol: intent.symbol,\n            side: intent.side as any,\n            orderType: intent.orderType as any,\n            timeInForce: (intent.timeInForce as any) ?? 'GTC',\n            status: 'SUBMITTED' as any,\n            quantity: intent.quantity as any,\n            price: intent.price as any,\n            stopPrice: intent.stopPrice as any,\n            reduceOnly: intent.reduceOnly ?? false,\n            isSimulated: intent.environment === 'PAPER',\n            riskDecisionId: riskResult.id ?? undefined,\n            submittedAt: new Date(),\n            metadata: {\n              omsIntentId: intentId,\n              correlationId,\n              riskDecisionId: riskResult.id,\n              source: intent.source,\n              ...(copyExecutionId ? { copyExecutionId } : {}),\n            } as any,\n          },\n        });\n      }\n      canonicalOrderId = canonicalOrder.id;\n\n      // Exposure from the canonical ledger; incomplete marks make the engine refuse.\n      const positions = await this.prisma.position.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, accountId: intent.accountId },\n        select: { symbolId: true, quantity: true, markPrice: true },\n      });\n\n      const jobData = buildSubmitOrderJob({\n        tenantId,\n        accountId: intent.accountId,\n        orderId: canonicalOrder.id,\n        clientOrderId: intent.clientOrderId,\n        symbol: intent.symbol,\n        side: intent.side,\n        orderType: intent.orderType,\n        quantity: intent.quantity,\n        price: intent.price,\n        timeInForce: intent.timeInForce,\n        reduceOnly: intent.reduceOnly,\n        strategyId: intent.strategyId,\n        riskDecisionId: riskResult.id,\n        environment: intent.environment ?? 'PAPER',\n        specification: buildSubmitSpecification(symbolRecord as any),\n        exposure: computeSubmitExposure(positions as any, symbolRecord.id),\n        omsIntentId: intentId,\n        metadata: {\n          ...(copyExecutionId ? { copyExecutionId } : {}),\n          ...(correlationId ? { correlationId: String(correlationId).slice(0, 128) } : {}),\n          source: String(intent.source ?? 'OMS'),\n        },\n        requestedByUserId: userId ?? null,\n      });\n\n      // Enqueue to trade-execution under the job name the worker actually\n      // consumes (JOB_NAMES.SUBMIT_ORDER). A failed enqueue is a FAILED\n      // submission, not a silent success: nothing else would ever pick the\n      // order up, so swallowing the error here would strand it in SUBMITTED.\n      const deterministicJobId = submitOrderJobId(intent.clientOrderId);\n      const enqueued = await this.queueService.enqueueOrThrow(\n        QUEUE_NAMES.TRADE_EXECUTION,\n        JOB_NAMES.SUBMIT_ORDER,\n        jobData,\n        { jobId: deterministicJobId, attempts: 3, backoff: { type: 'exponential', delay: 2000 } },\n      );\n      const jobId = enqueued || deterministicJobId;\n\n      this.logger.log(`Intent ${intentId} submitted to execution engine job ${jobId} tenant ${tenantId} canonicalOrder ${canonicalOrder.id}`);\n      return { intentId, jobId, routing: routingResult, riskDecisionId: riskResult.id, canonicalOrderId: canonicalOrder.id };\n    } catch (e) {\n      const refusal = e instanceof SubmitOrderRefused ? e : null;\n      this.logger.warn(`Execution engine submission failed for intent ${intentId}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      if (canonicalOrderId) {\n        await this.prisma.order\n          .update({\n            where: { id: canonicalOrderId },\n            data: {\n              status: (refusal ? 'REJECTED' : 'FAILED') as any,\n              rejectionCode: refusal ? refusal.code : 'SUBMISSION_ENQUEUE_FAILED',\n              rejectionReason: (e as Error).message.slice(0, 500),\n              terminalAt: new Date(),\n            },\n          })\n          .catch((updateErr: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Could not mark order ${canonicalOrderId} failed: ${updateErr.message}`));\n      }\n      await this.lifecycleService.transition({\n        tenantId,\n        intentId,\n        toState: refusal ? OrderIntentState.REJECTED : OrderIntentState.FAILED,\n        source: 'EXECUTION_ENGINE',\n        reason: `Execution submission ${refusal ? 'refused' : 'failed'}: ${(e as Error).message}`,\n        correlationId,\n      });\n      if (refusal) throw new ForbiddenException(`${refusal.code}: ${refusal.message}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/order-state-machine.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/order-submission-result.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any.
