Specify a different type.","line":404,"column":29,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":404,"endColumn":32,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[18301,18304],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[18301,18304],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":13,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger, OnApplicationBootstrap, OnModuleDestroy, Optional } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { QueueEvents } from 'bullmq';\nimport { JOB_NAMES, QUEUE_NAMES } from '@wlct/config';\n\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { AppConfigService } from '../../config/app-config.service';\nimport { QueueService } from '../queue/queue.service';\nimport { ExecutionAckService } from './execution-ack.service';\nimport { OrderLifecycleService } from './order-lifecycle.service';\nimport { OrderIntentState } from './oms.types';\nimport { clientOrderIdFromJobId } from './order-submission.payload';\n\n/**\n * Phase 3 — records what the execution engine decided about a SUBMIT_ORDER\n * job back onto the platform's own records.\n *\n * The worker holds no database (worker.module.ts), so the verdict travels as\n * the job's return value: the engine's SubmitOrderResponse plus the platform\n * ids the worker echoes (platformOrderId, omsIntentId, tenantId). This\n * service reads it from BullMQ's own event stream - the truth BullMQ reports,\n * not a guess - and applies it to three records:\n *\n *   1. the canonical `order` row (status, fills summary, rejection);\n *   2. the OMS intent, via ExecutionAckService (ACK/REJECT) and the lifecycle\n *      service (FILLED / PARTIALLY_FILLED);\n *   3. the copy execution the order was created for, when there is one.\n *\n * Every write is idempotent: a replayed event (two API replicas, a restart\n * sweep) re-applies the same terminal facts. Events missed while the API was\n * down are recovered by {@link sweepPending}, which asks BullMQ for the job by\n * its deterministic id.\n */\n\nexport type SubmissionVerdict =\n  | { kind: 'accepted'; orderStatus: 'ACKNOWLEDGED' | 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' | 'FILLED' }\n  | { kind: 'rejected'; code: string; reason: string }\n  | { kind: 'unknown'; reason: string };\n\nexport interface SubmissionResultView {\n  tenantId: string;\n  platformOrderId: string;\n  omsIntentId: string | null;\n  clientOrderId: string;\n  outcome: string;\n  engineOrderId: string | null;\n  exchangeOrderId: string | null;\n  orderStatus: string;\n  filledQuantity: string;\n  averageFillPrice: string | null;\n  cumulativeFee: string;\n  feeCurrency: string | null;\n  errorCode: string | null;\n  message: string | null;\n  latencyMicros: number | null;\n  isSimulated: boolean;\n}\n\nconst DECIMAL = /^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/;\n\nfunction str(value: unknown): string | null {\n  return typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0 ? value : null;\n}\n\nfunction decimalOr(value: unknown, fallback: string): string {\n  return typeof value === 'string' && DECIMAL.test(value) ? value : fallback;\n}\n\n/** Parse a SUBMIT_ORDER job's return value. Returns null for anything that is\n * not one (another command's receipt, a truncated value) so the caller\n * ignores it instead of writing guesses. */\nexport function parseSubmissionResult(raw: unknown): SubmissionResultView | null {\n  let value: unknown = raw;\n  if (typeof value === 'string') {\n    try {\n      value = JSON.parse(value);\n    } catch {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return null;\n  const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;\n  const tenantId = str(record.tenantId);\n  const platformOrderId = str(record.platformOrderId);\n  const clientOrderId = str(record.clientOrderId);\n  const outcome = str(record.outcome);\n  if (!tenantId || !platformOrderId || !clientOrderId || !outcome) return null;\n  return {\n    tenantId,\n    platformOrderId,\n    omsIntentId: str(record.omsIntentId),\n    clientOrderId,\n    outcome,\n    engineOrderId: str(record.engineOrderId),\n    exchangeOrderId: str(record.exchangeOrderId),\n    orderStatus: str(record.orderStatus) ?? 'UNKNOWN',\n    filledQuantity: decimalOr(record.filledQuantity, '0'),\n    averageFillPrice: typeof record.averageFillPrice === 'string' && DECIMAL.test(record.averageFillPrice) ? record.averageFillPrice : null,\n    cumulativeFee: decimalOr(record.cumulativeFee, '0'),\n    feeCurrency: str(record.feeCurrency),\n    errorCode: str(record.errorCode),\n    message: typeof record.message === 'string' ? record.message : null,\n    latencyMicros: typeof record.latencyMicros === 'number' && Number.isFinite(record.latencyMicros) ? record.latencyMicros : null,\n    isSimulated: record.isSimulated === true,\n  };\n}\n\n/** The engine's outcome vocabulary mapped onto the platform's order states.\n * UNKNOWN (an ambiguous venue answer) is deliberately NOT mapped to a\n * rejection: the order may exist, so it stays SUBMITTED and is flagged for\n * reconciliation. */\nexport function interpretSubmission(result: SubmissionResultView): SubmissionVerdict {\n  switch (result.outcome) {\n    case 'ACCEPTED':\n    case 'DUPLICATE': {\n      if (result.orderStatus === 'FILLED') return { kind: 'accepted', orderStatus: 'FILLED' };\n      if (result.orderStatus === 'PARTIALLY_FILLED') return { kind: 'accepted', orderStatus: 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' };\n      if (result.orderStatus === 'REJECTED') {\n        return { kind: 'rejected', code: result.errorCode ?? 'REJECTED', reason: result.message ?? 'Rejected' };\n      }\n      if (result.outcome === 'DUPLICATE' && result.orderStatus === 'UNKNOWN') {\n        return { kind: 'unknown', reason: 'Duplicate submission; original order state not visible to the engine' };\n      }\n      return { kind: 'accepted', orderStatus: 'ACKNOWLEDGED' };\n    }\n    case 'REJECTED_LOCALLY':\n    case 'REJECTED_BY_EXCHANGE':\n      return { kind: 'rejected', code: result.errorCode ?? result.outcome, reason: result.message ?? result.outcome };\n    case 'DRY_RUN':\n      return { kind: 'rejected', code: 'DRY_RUN', reason: 'Engine is in dry-run mode; the order was not transmitted' };\n    default:\n      return { kind: 'unknown', reason: result.message ?? `Engine outcome ${result.outcome}` };\n  }\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class OrderSubmissionResultService implements OnApplicationBootstrap, OnModuleDestroy {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(OrderSubmissionResultService.name);\n  private events: QueueEvents | null = null;\n  private sweepTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly ackService: ExecutionAckService,\n    private readonly lifecycleService: OrderLifecycleService,\n    private readonly queueService: QueueService,\n    @Optional() private readonly config?: AppConfigService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async onApplicationBootstrap(): Promise<void> {\n    // Test harnesses and queue-less tools construct the module without Redis\n    // settings; the recorder is then inert and says so once.\n    const connection = (this.config as any)?.queueRedisOptions;\n    if (!connection || process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test') {\n      this.logger.log('Submission result listener not started (no queue connection or test environment)');\n      return;\n    }\n    try {\n      this.events = new QueueEvents(QUEUE_NAMES.TRADE_EXECUTION, { connection });\n      this.events.on('completed', ({ jobId, returnvalue }) => {\n        void this.onCompleted(jobId, returnvalue).catch((error: Error) =>\n          this.logger.warn(`Recording submission result for job ${jobId} failed: ${error.message}`),\n        );\n      });\n      this.events.on('failed', ({ jobId, failedReason }) => {\n        void this.onFailed(jobId, failedReason).catch((error: Error) =>\n          this.logger.warn(`Recording submission failure for job ${jobId} failed: ${error.message}`),\n        );\n      });\n      this.sweepTimer = setInterval(() => {\n        void this.sweepPending().catch((error: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Submission sweep failed: ${error.message}`));\n      }, 60_000);\n      this.sweepTimer.unref?.();\n      void this.sweepPending().catch((error: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Initial submission sweep failed: ${error.message}`));\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Submission result listener could not start: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async onModuleDestroy(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.sweepTimer) clearInterval(this.sweepTimer);\n    this.sweepTimer = null;\n    if (this.events) await this.events.close().catch(() => undefined);\n    this.events = null;\n  }\n\n  private async onCompleted(jobId: string, returnvalue: unknown): Promise<void> {\n    if (!clientOrderIdFromJobId(jobId)) return; // not a submission job\n    const result = parseSubmissionResult(returnvalue);\n    if (!result) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Submission job ${jobId} completed without a parseable result; leaving order for reconciliation`);\n      return;\n    }\n    await this.recordResult(result);\n  }\n\n  private async onFailed(jobId: string, failedReason: string): Promise<void> {\n    const clientOrderId = clientOrderIdFromJobId(jobId);\n    if (!clientOrderId) return;\n    // A 'failed' event fires for every failed attempt; only the final one is\n    // terminal. Ask BullMQ whether retries remain before recording anything.\n    const job = await this.queueService.getQueue(QUEUE_NAMES.TRADE_EXECUTION).getJob(jobId).catch(() => null);\n    if (job) {\n      const attempts = typeof job.opts?.attempts === 'number' ? job.opts.attempts : 1;\n      const unrecoverable = /Unrecoverable|payload rejected|ENGINE_|HTTP_4/.test(failedReason ?? '');\n      if (job.attemptsMade < attempts && !unrecoverable) return;\n      const data = (job.data ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;\n      await this.recordFailure({\n        tenantId: typeof data.tenantId === 'string' ? data.tenantId : null,\n        clientOrderId,\n        reason: failedReason ?? 'Submission job failed',\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n    await this.recordFailure({ tenantId: null, clientOrderId, reason: failedReason ?? 'Submission job failed' });\n  }\n\n  /** Re-read every order still SUBMITTED by the OMS and apply the job's\n   * outcome if BullMQ has one. Covers events missed while the API was down. */\n  async sweepPending(limit = 200): Promise<number> {\n    const pending = await this.prisma.order.findMany({\n      where: { status: 'SUBMITTED' as any, exchangeOrderId: null },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },\n      take: limit,\n      select: { id: true, tenantId: true, clientOrderId: true, metadata: true },\n    });\n    let applied = 0;\n    const queue = this.queueService.getQueue(QUEUE_NAMES.TRADE_EXECUTION);\n    for (const order of pending) {\n      const metadata = (order.metadata ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;\n      if (typeof metadata.omsIntentId !== 'string') continue;\n      const job = await queue.getJob(`oms-submit-${order.clientOrderId}`).catch(() => null);\n      if (!job || job.name !== JOB_NAMES.SUBMIT_ORDER) continue;\n      if (job.finishedOn && job.returnvalue) {\n        const result = parseSubmissionResult(job.returnvalue);\n        if (result) {\n          await this.recordResult(result);\n          applied += 1;\n        }\n      } else if (job.finishedOn && job.failedReason) {\n        await this.recordFailure({ tenantId: order.tenantId, clientOrderId: order.clientOrderId, reason: job.failedReason });\n        applied += 1;\n      }\n    }\n    return applied;\n  }\n\n  async recordResult(result: SubmissionResultView): Promise<SubmissionVerdict> {\n    const verdict = interpretSubmission(result);\n    const order = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: result.platformOrderId, tenantId: result.tenantId } });\n    if (!order) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Submission result for unknown order ${result.platformOrderId} tenant ${result.tenantId}; ignoring`);\n      return verdict;\n    }\n    const existingMetadata = (order.metadata ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;\n    const engineMetadata = {\n      engineOutcome: result.outcome,\n      engineOrderId: result.engineOrderId,\n      engineOrderStatus: result.orderStatus,\n      engineErrorCode: result.errorCode,\n      engineRecordedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n    const now = new Date();\n\n    if (verdict.kind === 'accepted') {\n      await this.prisma.order.update({\n        where: { id: order.id },\n        data: {\n          status: verdict.orderStatus as any,\n          exchangeOrderId: result.exchangeOrderId ? result.exchangeOrderId.slice(0, 64) : undefined,\n          filledQuantity: result.filledQuantity as any,\n          averageFillPrice: (result.averageFillPrice ?? undefined) as any,\n          cumulativeFee: result.cumulativeFee as any,\n          feeCurrency: result.feeCurrency ?? undefined,\n          submitLatencyMicros: result.latencyMicros ?? undefined,\n          terminalAt: verdict.orderStatus === 'FILLED' ? now : undefined,\n          metadata: { ...existingMetadata, ...engineMetadata } as any,\n        },\n      });\n    } else if (verdict.kind === 'rejected') {\n      await this.prisma.order.update({\n        where: { id: order.id },\n        data: {\n          status: 'REJECTED' as any,\n          rejectionCode: verdict.code.slice(0, 64),\n          rejectionReason: verdict.reason.slice(0, 500),\n          wasDryRun: verdict.code === 'DRY_RUN' ? true : undefined,\n          terminalAt: now,\n          metadata: { ...existingMetadata, ...engineMetadata } as any,\n        },\n      });\n    } else {\n      await this.prisma.order.update({\n        where: { id: order.id },\n        data: {\n          reconciliationState: 'UNKNOWN' as any,\n          reconciliationDetail: verdict.reason.slice(0, 500),\n          metadata: { ...existingMetadata, ...engineMetadata } as any,\n        },\n      });\n    }\n\n    await this.applyToIntent(result, verdict, order.venue as unknown as string);\n    await this.applyToCopyExecution(result, verdict, existingMetadata);\n    return verdict;\n  }\n\n  async recordFailure(input: { tenantId: string | null; clientOrderId: string; reason: string }): Promise<void> {\n    const order = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({\n      where: { clientOrderId: input.clientOrderId, ...(input.tenantId ? { tenantId: input.tenantId } : {}) },\n    });\n    if (!order) return;\n    if (!['SUBMITTED', 'PENDING'].includes(order.status as unknown as string)) return; // already resolved\n    const metadata = (order.metadata ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;\n    await this.prisma.order.update({\n      where: { id: order.id },\n      data: {\n        status: 'FAILED' as any,\n        rejectionCode: 'SUBMISSION_JOB_FAILED',\n        rejectionReason: input.reason.slice(0, 500),\n        terminalAt: new Date(),\n      },\n    });\n    const omsIntentId = typeof metadata.omsIntentId === 'string' ? metadata.omsIntentId : null;\n    if (omsIntentId) {\n      await this.lifecycleService\n        .transition({\n          tenantId: order.tenantId,\n          intentId: omsIntentId,\n          toState: OrderIntentState.FAILED,\n          source: 'EXECUTION_ENGINE',\n          reason: `Submission job failed: ${input.reason}`.slice(0, 500),\n        })\n        .catch((error: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Intent ${omsIntentId} failure transition skipped: ${error.message}`));\n    }\n    const copyExecutionId = typeof metadata.copyExecutionId === 'string' ? metadata.copyExecutionId : null;\n    if (copyExecutionId) {\n      await this.updateCopyExecution(order.tenantId, copyExecutionId, 'FAILED', {\n        followerOrderId: order.id,\n        failureReason: `Submission failed: ${input.reason}`.slice(0, 500),\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async applyToIntent(result: SubmissionResultView, verdict: SubmissionVerdict, venue: string): Promise<void> {\n    if (verdict.kind === 'unknown') return;\n    await this.ackService.processAckFromExecutionEvent({\n      tenantId: result.tenantId,\n      orderId: result.platformOrderId,\n      clientOrderId: result.clientOrderId,\n      exchangeOrderId: result.exchangeOrderId,\n      providerOrderId: result.engineOrderId,\n      venue,\n      status: verdict.kind === 'accepted' ? 'ACKNOWLEDGED' : 'REJECTED',\n      occurredAtMicros: (BigInt(Date.now()) * 1000n).toString(),\n      reason: verdict.kind === 'rejected' ? `${verdict.code}: ${verdict.reason}` : null,\n      source: result.isSimulated ? 'EXECUTION_ENGINE_SIMULATED' : 'EXECUTION_ENGINE',\n      providerErrorCode: verdict.kind === 'rejected' ? verdict.code : null,\n      providerErrorMessage: verdict.kind === 'rejected' ? verdict.reason : null,\n      latencyMicros: result.latencyMicros !== null ? String(result.latencyMicros) : null,\n    });\n    if (verdict.kind === 'accepted' && verdict.orderStatus !== 'ACKNOWLEDGED' && result.omsIntentId) {\n      const toState = verdict.orderStatus === 'FILLED' ? OrderIntentState.FILLED : OrderIntentState.PARTIALLY_FILLED;\n      await this.lifecycleService\n        .transition({\n          tenantId: result.tenantId,\n          intentId: result.omsIntentId,\n          toState,\n          source: 'EXECUTION_ENGINE',\n          reason: `Engine reported ${verdict.orderStatus} filled ${result.filledQuantity}${result.isSimulated ? ' (simulated)' : ''}`,\n          metadata: { filledQuantity: result.filledQuantity, averageFillPrice: result.averageFillPrice, isSimulated: result.isSimulated },\n        })\n        .catch((error: Error) => this.logger.warn(`Intent ${result.omsIntentId} fill transition skipped: ${error.message}`));\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async applyToCopyExecution(\n    result: SubmissionResultView,\n    verdict: SubmissionVerdict,\n    metadata: Record<string, unknown>,\n  ): Promise<void> {\n    const copyExecutionId = typeof metadata.copyExecutionId === 'string' ? metadata.copyExecutionId : null;\n    if (!copyExecutionId) return;\n    if (verdict.kind === 'accepted') {\n      await this.updateCopyExecution(result.tenantId, copyExecutionId, verdict.orderStatus === 'FILLED' ? 'FILLED' : 'SUBMITTED', {\n        followerOrderId: result.platformOrderId,\n        providerOrderId: result.exchangeOrderId ?? result.engineOrderId ?? undefined,\n        followerPrice: result.averageFillPrice ?? undefined,\n      });\n    } else if (verdict.kind === 'rejected') {\n      await this.updateCopyExecution(result.tenantId, copyExecutionId, 'REJECTED', {\n        followerOrderId: result.platformOrderId,\n        failureReason: `${verdict.code}: ${verdict.reason}`.slice(0, 500),\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async updateCopyExecution(\n    tenantId: string,\n    copyExecutionId: string,\n    status: 'SUBMITTED' | 'FILLED' | 'FAILED' | 'REJECTED',\n    extra: { followerOrderId?: string; providerOrderId?: string; followerPrice?: string; failureReason?: string },\n  ): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).copyExecution.updateMany({\n        // FILLED is terminal for a copy execution: a late or replayed event\n        // must never move it backwards (same law as CopyExecutionRepository).\n        where: { id: copyExecutionId, tenantId, ...(status === 'FILLED' ? {} : { NOT: { status: 'FILLED' } }) },\n        data: {\n          status,\n          ...(extra.followerOrderId ? { followerOrderId: extra.followerOrderId } : {}),\n          ...(extra.providerOrderId ? BullMQ (no single ':');\n *  - exposure is computed from the canonical ledger and is INCOMPLETE when a\n *    non-flat position has no mark;\n *  - LIVE / stop orders are refused with a typed reason, never enqueued;\n *  - the engine's outcome vocabulary maps onto platform order states, with\n *    UNKNOWN left for reconciliation rather than guessed;\n *  - the recorder writes the order, the intent and the copy execution, and a\n *    FILLED copy execution is never moved backwards.\n */\n\nimport { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';\n\nimport {\n  SubmitOrderRefused,\n  buildSubmitOrderJob,\n  buildSubmitSpecification,\n  clientOrderIdFromJobId,\n  computeSubmitExposure,\n  submitOrderJobId,\n  type SubmitOrderJobInput,\n} from './order-submission.payload';\nimport {\n  OrderSubmissionResultService,\n  interpretSubmission,\n  parseSubmissionResult,\n  type SubmissionResultView,\n} from './order-submission-result.service';\nimport { OrderIntentState } from './oms.types';\nimport { FillManagementService } from './fill-management.service';\nimport { OrderLifecycleService } from './order-lifecycle.service';\n\nconst SPEC = buildSubmitSpecification({\n  baseAsset: 'BTC',\n  quoteAsset: 'USDT',\n  marketType: 'SPOT',\n  priceTick: new Prisma.Decimal('0.010000000000'),\n  quantityStep: new Prisma.Decimal('0.000010000000'),\n  minQuantity: new Prisma.Decimal('0.00001'),\n  maxQuantity: null,\n  minNotional: new Prisma.Decimal('10.000000'),\n  isTradeable: true,\n  pricePrecision: 2,\n  quantityPrecision: 5,\n});\n\nfunction jobInput(overrides: Partial<SubmitOrderJobInput> = {}): SubmitOrderJobInput {\n  return {\n    tenantId: 't-1',\n    accountId: 'a-1',\n    orderId: 'o-1',\n    clientOrderId: 'oms0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',\n    symbol: 'BTC-USDT',\n    side: 'BUY',\n    orderType: 'LIMIT',\n    quantity: new Prisma.Decimal('0.010000000000'),\n    price: new Prisma.Decimal('50000.000000000000'),\n    timeInForce: 'GTC',\n    reduceOnly: false,\n    strategyId: null,\n    riskDecisionId: 'r-1',\n    environment: 'PAPER',\n    specification: SPEC,\n    exposure: { positionQuantity: '0', symbolExposureNotional: '0', accountExposureNotional: '0', complete: true },\n    omsIntentId: 'i-1',\n    metadata: { copyExecutionId: 'c-1', 'bad.key': 'x' },\n    ...overrides,\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('SUBMIT_ORDER producer helpers', () => {\n  it('job ids are deterministic, reversible and contain no colon', () => {\n    const id = submitOrderJobId('oms0123');\n    expect(id).toBe('oms-submit-oms0123');\n    expect(id.includes(':')).toBe(false);\n    expect(clientOrderIdFromJobId(id)).toBe('oms0123');\n    expect(clientOrderIdFromJobId('other-job')).toBeNull();\n    expect(clientOrderIdFromJobId(undefined)).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('specification decimals are plain strings (no exponent, no float)', () => {\n    expect(SPEC).toMatchObject({ priceTick: '0.01', quantityStep: '0.00001', minQuantity: '0.00001', minNotional: '10', maxQuantity: null });\n    expect(() => buildSubmitSpecification({ ...(SPEC as any), marketType: 'OPTIONS' })).toThrow(/Unsupported market type/);\n  });\n\n  it('exposure sums marked positions and flags an unmarked one as incomplete', () => {\n    const exposure = computeSubmitExposure(\n      [\n        { symbolId: 's-btc', quantity: '0.5', markPrice: '50000' },\n        { symbolId: 's-btc', quantity: '-0.2', markPrice: '50000' },\n        { symbolId: 's-eth', quantity: '-2', markPrice: '3000' },\n        { symbolId: 's-sol', quantity: '0', markPrice: null },\n      ],\n      's-btc',\n    );\n    expect(exposure).toEqual({\n      positionQuantity: '0.3',\n      symbolExposureNotional: '35000',\n      accountExposureNotional: '41000',\n      complete: true,\n    });\n    const incomplete = computeSubmitExposure([{ symbolId: 's-eth', quantity: '1', markPrice: null }], 's-btc');\n    expect(incomplete.complete).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('builds a PAPER job with plain decimals and filtered metadata', () => {\n    const job = buildSubmitOrderJob(jobInput());\n    expect(job).toMatchObject({\n      quantity: '0.01',\n      price: '50000',\n      environment: 'PAPER',\n      riskDecisionId: 'r-1',\n      omsIntentId: 'i-1',\n      metadata: { copyExecutionId: 'c-1' },\n    });\n    expect((job.metadata as Record<string, string>)['bad.key']).toBeUndefined();\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    [{ environment: 'LIVE' }, 'LIVE_SUBMISSION_NOT_WIRED'],\n    [{ orderType: 'STOP' }, 'ORDER_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED'],\n    [{ side: 'HOLD' }, 'SIDE_INVALID'],\n    [{ timeInForce: 'DAY' }, 'TIME_IN_FORCE_NOT_SUPPORTED'],\n    [{ price: null }, 'PRICE_REQUIRED'],\n  ] as Array<[Partial<SubmitOrderJobInput>, string]>)('refuses %j with %s', (patch, code) => {\n    try {\n      buildSubmitOrderJob(jobInput(patch));\n      throw new Error('expected refusal');\n    } catch (error) {\n      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(SubmitOrderRefused);\n      expect((error as SubmitOrderRefused).code).toBe(code);\n    }\n  });\n});\n\nfunction result(overrides: Partial<SubmissionResultView> = {}): SubmissionResultView {\n  return {\n    tenantId: 't-1',\n    platformOrderId: 'o-1',\n    omsIntentId: 'i-1',\n    clientOrderId: 'oms0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',\n    outcome: 'ACCEPTED',\n    engineOrderId: 'eng-1',\n    exchangeOrderId: 'paper-1',\n    orderStatus: 'FILLED',\n    filledQuantity: '0.01',\n    averageFillPrice: '50000',\n    cumulativeFee: '0.5',\n    feeCurrency: 'USDT',\n    errorCode: null,\n    message: null,\n    latencyMicros: 42,\n    isSimulated: true,\n    ...overrides,\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe('submission result interpretation', () => {\n  it('parses a worker receipt (object or JSON string) and ignores anything else', () => {\n    const raw = { ...result(), platformOrderId: 'o-1', tenantId: 't-1' };\n    expect(parseSubmissionResult(raw)?.platformOrderId).toBe('o-1');\n    expect(parseSubmissionResult(JSON.stringify(raw))?.outcome).toBe('ACCEPTED');\n    expect(parseSubmissionResult({ verified: true })).toBeNull();\n    expect(parseSubmissionResult('not json')).toBeNull();\n    expect(parseSubmissionResult({ ...raw, filledQuantity: '1e3' })?.filledQuantity).toBe('0');\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    [{ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', orderStatus: 'FILLED' }, { kind: 'accepted', orderStatus: 'FILLED' }],\n    [{ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', orderStatus: 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' }, { kind: 'accepted', orderStatus: 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' }],\n    [{ outcome: 'ACCEPTED', orderStatus: 'ACKNOWLEDGED' }, { kind: 'accepted', orderStatus: 'ACKNOWLEDGED' }],\n    [{ outcome: 'DUPLICATE', orderStatus: 'FILLED' }, { kind: 'accepted', orderStatus: 'FILLED' }],\n    [{ outcome: 'DUPLICATE', orderStatus: 'UNKNOWN' }, { kind: 'unknown' }],\n    [{ outcome: 'REJECTED_LOCALLY', errorCode: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', message: 'bad tick' }, { kind: 'rejected', code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', reason: 'bad tick' }],\n    [{ outcome: 'REJECTED_BY_EXCHANGE' }, { kind: 'rejected', code: 'REJECTED_BY_EXCHANGE' }],\n    [{ outcome: 'DRY_RUN' }, { kind: 'rejected', code: 'DRY_RUN' }],\n    [{ outcome: 'UNKNOWN' }, { kind: 'unknown' }],\n  ] as Array<[Partial<SubmissionResultView>, Record<string, unknown>]>)('%j -> %j', (patch, expected) => {\n    expect(interpretSubmission(result(patch))).toMatchObject(expected);\n  });\n});\n\nfunction fakeRecorder(order: Record<string, unknown> | null) {\n  const orderUpdates: any[] = [];\n  const copyUpdates: any[] = [];\n  const transitions: any[] = [];\n  const acks: any[] = [];\n  const prisma },\n  };\n  const ackService = { processAckFromExecutionEvent: jest.fn(async (args: any) => acks.push(args)) };\n  const lifecycle = { transition: jest.fn(async (args: any) => transitions.push(args))  status: 'SUBMITTED',\n  venue: 'PAPER',\n  metadata: { omsIntentId: 'i-1', copyExecutionId: 'c-1' },\n};\n\ndescribe('OrderSubmissionResultService', () => {\n  it('a filled result updates the order, acks and fills the intent, and fills the copy execution', async () => {\n    const { service, orderUpdates, copyUpdates, transitions, acks } = fakeRecorder(ORDER);\n    const verdict = await 'paper-1', filledQuantity: '0.01', averageFillPrice: '50000' });\n    expect(orderUpdates[0].data.metadata).toMatchObject({ omsIntentId: 'i-1', engineOutcome: 'ACCEPTED', engineOrderId: 'eng-1' });\n    expect(acks[0]).toMatchObject({ status: 'ACKNOWLEDGED', clientOrderId: ORDER.clientOrderId, source: 'EXECUTION_ENGINE_SIMULATED' });\n    expect(transitions[0]).toMatchObject({ intentId: 'i-1', toState: OrderIntentState.FILLED });\n    expect(copyUpdates[0]).toMatchObject({ where: { id: 'c-1', tenantId: 't-1' }, data: { status: 'FILLED', followerOrderId: 'o-1' } });\n  });\n\n  it('a expect(orderUpdates[0].data).toMatchObject({ status: 'REJECTED', rejectionCode: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', rejectionReason: 'tick' });\n    expect(acks[0]).toMatchObject({ status: 'REJECTED', used.","line":139,"column":22,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":139,"endColumn":28}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":1,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Proves the order path enforces the user's position and open-order ceilings\n//\n// The ceiling service was complete, tested and correct, and it was in no module's `providers`;\n// `UserPositionLimitController` was in no module's `controllers`; and nothing on the order path\n// called `persistOrderIntentWithLimits`. A customer could set a limit, read it back from the API,\n// and have it never consulted when an order was placed.\n//\n// This file is the evidence that the wiring exists, and it is written so that removing the wiring\n// fails it. Two independent angles:\n//\n// 1. Behaviour - `createIntent` is driven with a limiter whose reservation refuses, and with a\n//    limiter that hands back a transaction client. If `createIntent` stops routing through the\n//    limiter, the refusal is never seen and the intent is written on the plain client: both halves\n//    of that are asserted, so either change fails here.\n// 2. Structure - the module metadata is read directly, so deleting `PositionLimitService` from\n//    `RiskManagementModule` or the controller from `controllers` fails a test even if some other\n//    path kept the behaviour alive.\nimport 'reflect-metadata';\nimport { MODULE_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';\nimport { RiskManagementModule } from '../risk-management/risk-management.module';\nimport { UserPositionLimitController } from '../risk-management/user-position-limit.controller';\nimport { PositionLimitService } from '../risk/position-limit.service';\nimport { OrderIntentService } from './order-intent.service';\nimport { OrderIntentState } from './oms.types';\n\nconst TENANT_ID = 'tenant-1';\nconst ACCOUNT_ID = 'account-1';\nconst SYMBOL = 'BTC-USDT';\n\n/**\n * A limiter that records every reservation it is asked to make and answers with the given verdict.\n * `verified` is what an intent must reach when the reservation is allowed, so a test can tell a\n * written intent from a refused one.\n */\nfunction limiterThat(verdict: 'ALLOW' | 'REFUSE') {\n  const reservations: { tenantId: string; accountId: string; symbol: string }[] = [];\n  const tx = {\n    // Tagged-template call, matching how the service issues its savepoint statements.\n    $executeRaw: jest.fn(async (_strings: TemplateStringsArray) => 1),\n    omsOrderIntent: {\n      create: jest.fn(async ({ data }: { data: Record<string, unknown> }) => ({\n        id: 'intent-1',\n        ...data,\n        state: OrderIntentState.CREATED,\n      })),\n    },\n    order: { create: jest.fn() },\n  };\n  const service = {\n    persistOrderIntentWithLimits: jest.fn(\n      async (params: {\n        tenantId: string;\n        accountId: string;\n        symbol: string;\n        persist: (client: unknown) => Promise<unknown>;\n      }) => {\n        reservations.push({ tenantId: params.tenantId, accountId: params.accountId, symbol: params.symbol });\n        if (verdict === 'REFUSE') {\n          const refusal = new Error('USER_CONCURRENT_POSITION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED');\n          (refusal as Error & { code?: string }).code = 'USER_CONCURRENT_POSITION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED';\n          throw refusal;\n        }\n        return params.persist(tx);\n      },\n    ),\n  };\n  return { service, reservations, tx };\n}\n\nfunction buildService(limiter: { persistOrderIntentWithLimits: jest.Mock }, prismaOverrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {\n  const prisma = {\n    tradingAccount: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: ACCOUNT_ID, userId: 'user-1', status: 'ACTIVE', liveTradingEnabled: true })),\n      findUnique: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: ACCOUNT_ID, userId: 'user-1', status: 'ACTIVE', liveTradingEnabled: true })),\n    },\n    tradingSymbol: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(async () => ({\n        id: 'symbol-1',\n        symbol: SYMBOL,\n        minQuantity: '0.0001',\n        maxQuantity: '100',\n        quantityStep: '0.0001',\n        priceStep: '0.01',\n        exchange: { id: 'exchange-1', venue: 'BINANCE', isEnabled: true, tradingEnabled: true },\n      })),\n    },\n    exchangeCredential: { findFirst: jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'cred-1' })) },\n    complianceScreeningRequest: { findFirst: jest.fn(async () => null) },\n    securityThreatSignal: { findFirst: jest.fn(async () => null) },\n    ...prismaOverrides,\n  };\n  const riskDecisionService = {\n    evaluateUnifiedRisk: jest.fn(async () => ({ decision: 'ALLOW', blockingReasons: [], policyVersion: 'v1' })),\n  };\n  const outbox = { append: jest.fn(async () => undefined) };\n  const service = new OrderIntentService(\n    prisma as never,\n    riskDecisionService as never,\n    limiter as unknown as PositionLimitService,\n    outbox as never,\n  );\n  return { service, prisma, riskDecisionService, outbox };\n}\n\nfunction intentParams() {\n  return {\n    tenantId: TENANT_ID,\n    accountId: ACCOUNT_ID,\n    symbol: SYMBOL,\n    side: 'BUY',\n    orderType: 'LIMIT',\n    quantity: '0.5',\n    price: '60000',\n    environment: 'PAPER',\n    source: 'MANUAL',\n    userId: 'user-1',\n  } as never;\n}\n\ndescribe('OrderIntentService routes every intent through the position-limit reservation', () => {\n  it('asks the limiter to reserve before it writes anything', async () => {\n    const limiter = limiterThat('ALLOW');\n    const { service } = buildService(limiter.service);\n\n    await service.createIntent(intentParams());\n\n    expect(limiter.service.persistOrderIntentWithLimits).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    expect(limiter.reservations).toEqual([\n      { tenantId: TENANT_ID, accountId: ACCOUNT_ID, symbol: SYMBOL },\n    ]);\n  });\n\n  it('writes the intent on the limiter\\'s client, not on this.prisma', async () => {\n    // The lock only means anything if the insert commits inside it. A write on the plain client\n    // would slip past the reservation and two concurrent intents could both pass a ceiling they\n    // jointly exceed, so the client identity is asserted rather than assumed.\n    const limiter = limiterThat('ALLOW');\n    const plainCreate = jest.fn(async () => ({ id: 'wrong-client' }));\n    const { service, prisma } = buildService(limiter.service, {\n      omsOrderIntent: { create: plainCreate },\n      order: { create: plainCreate },\n    });\n\n    const created = await service.createIntent(intentParams());\n\n    expect(limiter.tx.omsOrderIntent.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    expect(plainCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect((created as { id: string }).id).toBe('intent-1');\n  });\n\n  it('surfaces the limiter\\'s refusal instead of placing the order', async () => {\n    const limiter = limiterThat('REFUSE');\n    const omsCreate = jest.fn();\n    const orderCreate = jest.fn();\n    const { service } = buildService(limiter.service, {\n      omsOrderIntent: { create: omsCreate },\n      order: { create: orderCreate },\n    });\n\n    await expect(service.createIntent(intentParams())).rejects.toThrow(\n      'USER_CONCURRENT_POSITION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',\n    );\n    // Nothing was written anywhere: the refusal is a refusal, not a warning.\n    expect(omsCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(orderCreate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('reserves against the account the intent names, not a caller-supplied owner', async () => {\n    // The limiter derives the user from the TradingAccount owner row internally; this asserts the\n    // order path hands it the account identity to do that with, so a caller cannot nominate which\n    // user's ceiling applies.\n    const limiter = limiterThat('ALLOW');\n    const { service } = buildService(limiter.service);\n\n    await service.createIntent(intentParams());\n\n    const call = limiter.service.persistOrderIntentWithLimits.mock.calls[0]?.[0] as {\n      tenantId: string;\n      accountId: string;\n    };\n    expect(call.tenantId).toBe(TENANT_ID);\n    expect(call.accountId).toBe(ACCOUNT_ID);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('the ceiling is registered where Nest can mount and inject it', () => {\n  it('mounts the settings controller', () => {\n    // Without this the routes do not exist and a customer has nowhere to set the limit that the\n    // order path enforces. Read through Reflect because that is where @Module records the arrays\n    // Nest builds the module from - a static property would prove nothing.\n    const controllers = Reflect.getMetadata(MODULE_METADATA.CONTROLLERS, RiskManagementModule) as unknown[];\n    expect(controllers).toContain(UserPositionLimitController);\n  });\n\n  it('provides and exports one PositionLimitService for both the settings route and the order path', () => {\n    const providers = Reflect.getMetadata(MODULE_METADATA.PROVIDERS, RiskManagementModule) as unknown[];\n    const exports = Reflect.getMetadata(MODULE_METADATA.EXPORTS, RiskManagementModule) as unknown[];\n    expect(providers).toContain(PositionLimitService);\n    // Exported, so the order path resolves the same instance the settings route writes to.\n    expect(exports).toContain(PositionLimitService);\n  });\n});\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/position-reconciliation.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Specify a different type.","line":110,"column":31,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":110,"endColumn":34,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[5016,5019],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[5016,5019],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":3,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { ReconciliationCategory, isValidDecimal, parseScaled, formatScaled, reconciliationErrorCode } from './oms.types';\n\n/**\n * Position Reconciliation Service — cross-checks cumulative fills ↔ canonical position ↔ exchange snapshot\n * without becoming a position source. Does not directly overwrite authoritative position source.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PositionReconciliationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PositionReconciliationService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async reconcilePosition(params: { tenantId: string; accountId: string; symbol: string }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, symbol } = params;\n\n    const position = await this.prisma.position.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, accountId, symbol } });\n    const orders = await this.prisma.order.findMany({ where: { tenantId, accountId, symbol } });\n    const orderIds = orders.map((o) => o.id);\n    const fills = orderIds.length > 0 ? await this.prisma.fill.findMany({ where: { orderId: { in: orderIds } }, orderBy: { receivedTimestampMicros: 'asc' } }) : [];\n\n    const findings: Array<{ category: string; severity: string; summary: string; expected: any; actual: any }> = [];\n\n    // Calculate net quantity from fills\n    let netQty = 0n;\n    for (const fill of fills) {\n      const qtyStr = fill.quantity.toString();\n      const side = fill.side ?? orders.find((o) => o.id === fill.orderId)?.side;\n      if (!isValidDecimal(qtyStr)) continue;\n      const qty = parseScaled(qtyStr);\n      if (side === 'BUY') netQty += qty;\n      else if (side === 'SELL') netQty -= qty;\n    }\n\n    if (position) {\n      const posQtyStr = position.quantity.toString();\n      if (isValidDecimal(posQtyStr)) {\n        const posQty = parseScaled(posQtyStr);\n        if (posQty !== netQty) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: ReconciliationCategory.POSITION_QUANTITY_MISMATCH,\n            severity: 'HIGH',\n            summary: `Position quantity mismatch ${symbol} account ${accountId}: position ${posQtyStr} vs net fills ${formatScaled(netQty)}`,\n            expected: { netFills: formatScaled(netQty) },\n            actual: { positionQuantity: posQtyStr },\n          });\n        }\n\n        // Side mismatch\n        const expectedSide = netQty > 0n ? 'LONG' : netQty < 0n ? 'SHORT' : 'FLAT';\n        if (position.side !== expectedSide) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: ReconciliationCategory.SIDE_MISMATCH,\n            severity: 'MEDIUM',\n            summary: `Side mismatch ${symbol} account ${accountId}: position side ${position.side} vs expected ${expectedSide} from fills`,\n            expected: { side: expectedSide },\n            actual: { side: position.side },\n          });\n        }\n\n        // Position without fills\n        if (fills.length === 0 && posQty !== 0n) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: ReconciliationCategory.POSITION_WITHOUT_FILLS,\n            severity: 'MEDIUM',\n            summary: `Position ${symbol} account ${accountId} qty ${posQtyStr} exists but no fills found`,\n            expected: { fillsExist: true },\n            actual: { fillCount: 0, positionQuantity: posQtyStr },\n          });\n        }\n\n        // Stale position\n        const ageMs = Date.now() - new Date(position.updatedAt).getTime();\n        if (ageMs > 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: ReconciliationCategory.STALE_POSITION,\n            severity: 'LOW',\n            summary: `Stale position ${symbol} account ${accountId} age ${Math.floor(ageMs / 1000 / 60)}m`,\n            expected: { maxAgeMs: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 },\n            actual: { ageMs, updatedAt: position.updatedAt.toISOString() },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    } else {\n      // No position but fills exist\n      if (netQty !== 0n) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: ReconciliationCategory.FILLS_WITHOUT_POSITION,\n          severity: 'MEDIUM',\n          summary: `Fills exist for ${symbol} account ${accountId} net ${formatScaled(netQty)} but no position record`,\n          expected: { positionExists: true },\n          actual: { netFills: formatScaled(netQty), fillCount: fills.length },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Compare with exchange position snapshot if available (from exchange-position-sync)\n    // We don't have a dedicated snapshot table in this schema, but we can check accountBalanceSnapshot as proxy for health\n    // For now, we skip exchange snapshot unless model exists\n\n    // Persist findings. A finding that cannot be stored is never dropped silently: it stays in the\n    // returned result, is counted in persistFailures and is logged at error level (error code only,\n    // never row values) - the same contract as order and fill reconciliation.\n    let persistedFindings = 0;\n    let persistFailures = 0;\n    for (const f of findings) {\n      try {\n        await (this.prisma as any).omsReconciliation.create({\n          data: {\n            tenantId,\n            internalOrderId: null,\n            providerOrderId: null,\n            category: f.category,\n            severity: f.severity,\n            expected: f.expected,\n            actual: f.actual,\n            summary: f.summary.slice(0, 1000),\n            resolved: false,\n          },\n        });\n        persistedFindings++;\n      } catch (e) {\n        persistFailures++;\n        this.logger.error(\n          `Position reconciliation finding NOT persisted ${symbol} account ${accountId} tenant ${tenantId} category ${f.category} severity ${f.severity} error ${reconciliationErrorCode(e)}`,\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (persistFailures > 0) {\n      this.logger.warn(\n        `Position reconciliation ${symbol} account ${accountId} tenant ${tenantId} findings ${findings.length} persisted ${persistedFindings} persistFailures ${persistFailures}`,\n      );\n    } else {\n      this.logger.log(`Position reconciliation ${symbol} account ${accountId} tenant ${tenantId} findings ${findings.length} netFills ${formatScaled(netQty)} pos ${position?.quantity.toString() ?? 'none'}`);\n    }\n    return {\n      accountId,\n      symbol,\n      position: position ? { quantity: position.quantity.toString(), side: position.side } : null,\n      netFills: formatScaled(netQty),\n      fillCount: fills.length,\n      findings,\n      totalFindings: findings.length,\n      persistedFindings,\n      persistFailures,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async reconcileAccountPositions(params: { tenantId: string; accountId: string }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId } = params;\n    const positions = await this.prisma.position.findMany({ where: { tenantId, accountId } });\n    const results = [];\n    for (const pos of positions) {\n      const res = await this.reconcilePosition({ tenantId, accountId, symbol: pos.symbol });\n      results.push(res);\n    }\n\n    // Also check symbols that have fills but no position\n    const orders = await this.prisma.order.findMany({ where: { tenantId, accountId } });\n    const symbolsWithFills = new Set<string>();\n    for (const order of orders) {\n      const fills = await this.prisma.fill.findMany({ where: { orderId: order.id } });\n      if (fills.length > 0) symbolsWithFills.add(order.symbol);\n    }\n    const positionSymbols = new Set(positions.map((p) => p.symbol));\n    for (const sym of symbolsWithFills) {\n      if (!positionSymbols.has(sym)) {\n        const res = await this.reconcilePosition({ tenantId, accountId, symbol: sym });\n        results.push(res);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { accountId, totalPositions: positions.length, totalFindings: results.reduce((s, r) => s + r.totalFindings, 0), results };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/post-trade.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'traderId' is assigned a value but never used.","line":33,"column":71,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":33,"endColumn":79},{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'followerId' is assigned a value but never used.","line":33,"column":81,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":33,"endColumn":91},{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { TradeLifecycleService } from './trade-lifecycle.service';\nimport { isValidDecimal, parseScaled, formatScaled } from './oms.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Post-Trade Service — coordinates post-trade completion, fee/fill aggregation,\n * settlement references, and downstream fee/usage/audit events.\n * Does NOT duplicate Part 7 fee calculation.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PostTradeService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PostTradeService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly tradeLifecycleService: TradeLifecycleService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async processPostTrade(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    intentId: string;\n    accountId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    venue?: string | null;\n    strategyId?: string | null;\n    traderId?: string | null;\n    followerId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, intentId, accountId, symbol, venue, strategyId, traderId, followerId, correlationId } = params;\n\n    let intent: any;\n    try {\n      intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    } catch {\n      intent = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    }\n    if (!intent) throw new Error(`Intent ${intentId} not found`);\n\n    const currentState = intent.state ?? intent.status;\n    if (!['FILLED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'CANCELLED'].includes(currentState)) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Post-trade called for intent ${intentId} in state ${currentState}, skipping`);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Aggregate execution results from fills\n    let fills: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      fills = await (this.prisma as any).omsFill.findMany({ where: { tenantId, orderIntentId: intentId, state: { not: 'DUPLICATE' } } });\n    } catch {\n      const order = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, clientOrderId: intent.clientOrderId } });\n      if (order) fills = await this.prisma.fill.findMany({ where: { orderId: order.id } });\n    }\n\n    if (fills.length === 0) {\n      this.logger.warn(`No fills for post-trade intent ${intentId}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    let totalQty = 0n;\n    let totalNotional = 0n;\n    let totalFee = 0n;\n    let feeCurrency: string | null = null;\n    for (const f of fills) {\n      const qtyStr = f.quantity?.toString() ?? f.quantity;\n      const priceStr = f.price?.toString() ?? f.price;\n      const feeStr = f.fee?.toString() ?? f.fee ?? '0';\n      if (isValidDecimal(qtyStr) && isValidDecimal(priceStr)) {\n        const qty = parseScaled(qtyStr);\n        const price = parseScaled(priceStr);\n        totalQty += qty;\n        totalNotional += (qty * price) / BigInt(1_000_000_000_000);\n      }\n      if (isValidDecimal(feeStr)) totalFee += parseScaled(feeStr);\n      if (!feeCurrency && f.feeCurrency) feeCurrency = f.feeCurrency;\n    }\n\n    const avgPrice = totalQty > 0n ? formatScaled((totalNotional * BigInt(1_000_000_000_000)) / totalQty) : null;\n\n    // Link fee references — check if fee accrual already exists (idempotency)\n    let feeAccrualRef: string | null = null;\n    try {\n      const existingAccrual = await (this.prisma as any).feeAccrual.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, sourceId: intentId } });\n      if (existingAccrual) {\n        feeAccrualRef = existingAccrual.id;\n        this.logger.log(`Fee accrual already exists for intent ${intentId}: ${feeAccrualRef}, not duplicating`);\n      } else if (totalFee > 0n) {\n        // Create fee accrual when existing commercial policy requires it — simplified: create if fee >0 and env LIVE\n        if (intent.environment === 'LIVE') {\n          const accrual = await (this.prisma as any).feeAccrual.create({\n            data: {\n              tenantId,\n              feeType: 'TRADING',\n              feeSourceType: 'ORDER_FILL',\n              sourceId: intentId,\n              sourceAmount: formatScaled(totalQty),\n              feeAmount: formatScaled(totalFee),\n              currency: feeCurrency ?? 'USDT',\n              status: 'ACCRUED',\n              settlementState: 'DRAFT',\n              idempotencyKey: `fee-${intentId}`,\n              metadata: { symbol, venue, accountId, fillCount: fills.length } as any,\n              safeMetadata: { symbol, fillCount: fills.length } as any,\n            },\n          });\n          feeAccrualRef = accrual.id;\n          this.logger.log(`Fee accrual created ${feeAccrualRef} for intent ${intentId} fee ${formatScaled(totalFee)}`);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Fee accrual check failed for ${intentId}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // Usage event — idempotent\n    let usageEventRef: string | null = null;\n    try {\n      const existingUsage = await (this.prisma as any).usageEvent.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, sourceId: intentId } });\n      if (existingUsage) {\n        usageEventRef = existingUsage.id;\n        this.logger.log(`Usage event already exists for intent ${intentId}: ${usageEventRef}, not duplicating`);\n      } else {\n        const periodId = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7); // YYYY-MM\n        const usage = await (this.prisma as any).usageEvent.create({\n          data: {\n            tenantId,\n            meterKey: 'order_fills',\n            eventType: 'ORDER_FILLED',\n            sourceId: intentId,\n            sourceType: 'OMS_ORDER',\n            quantity: fills.length,\n            periodId,\n            idempotencyKey: `usage-${intentId}`,\n            status: 'RECEIVED',\n            metadata: { symbol, venue, accountId } as any,\n            safeMetadata: { symbol, fillCount: fills.length } as any,\n          },\n        });\n        usageEventRef = usage.id;\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Usage event check failed for ${intentId}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // Trade lifecycle already updated via FillManagementService, but ensure\n    // For each fill, buildOrUpdateTradeFromFill already called, we can fetch latest trade\n    let tradeLifecycleRef: string | null = null;\n    try {\n      const trades = await this.tradeLifecycleService.getOpenTrades({ tenantId, accountId, symbol, strategyId: strategyId as any });\n      // Also include recently closed trades\n      const history = await this.tradeLifecycleService.getTradeHistory({ tenantId, accountId, symbol, limit: 5 });\n      const allTrades = [...trades, ...history];\n      const related = allTrades.find((t: any) => t.orderIds?.includes(intentId) || t.fillIds?.some((fid: string) => fills.map((f: any) => f.id).includes(fid)));\n      if (related) tradeLifecycleRef = related.id;\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Settlement reference — simplified: use fill aggregation as settlement evidence\n    const settlementRef = `settlement-${intentId}-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;\n\n    // Notifications — emit where applicable, but don't duplicate\n    let notificationRef: string | null = null;\n    try {\n      // Check if notification already sent for this intent\n      const existingNotif = await this.prisma.notification.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, type: 'ORDER_FILLED' } as any });\n      if (existingNotif) {\n        notificationRef = existingNotif.id;\n      } else if (intent.environment === 'LIVE') {\n        // Only notify for LIVE filled orders\n        const notif = await this.prisma.notification.create({\n          data: {\n            tenantId,\n            userId: intent.followerId ?? intent.traderId ?? accountId, // simplified\n            channel: 'IN_APP' as any,\n            type: 'ORDER_FILLED',\n            title: `Order ${intent.symbol} ${intent.side} filled`,\n            body: `Order ${intent.symbol} ${intent.side} qty ${formatScaled(totalQty)} avg ${avgPrice ?? 'unknown'} filled`,\n            data: { orderIntentId: intentId, symbol, side: intent.side, quantity: formatScaled(totalQty), averagePrice: avgPrice, fee: formatScaled(totalFee) } as any,\n          },\n        });\n        notificationRef = notif.id;\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Notification failed for ${intentId}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // Determine if reconciliation should be triggered — e.g., if filled qty != order qty\n    const orderQtyStr = intent.quantity?.toString() ?? intent.quantity;\n    let reconciliationTriggered = false;\n    if (isValidDecimal(orderQtyStr)) {\n      const orderQty = parseScaled(orderQtyStr);\n      if (totalQty !== orderQty && currentState === 'FILLED') {\n        reconciliationTriggered = true;\n        this.logger.warn(`Post-trade quantity mismatch intent ${intentId} order ${orderQtyStr} vs filled ${formatScaled(totalQty)}, triggering reconciliation`);\n        // Would enqueue reconciliation job via queue — simplified log\n      }\n    }\n\n    const result = {\n      id: randomUUID(),\n      tenantId,\n      orderIntentId: intentId,\n      tradeId: tradeLifecycleRef,\n      accountId,\n      symbol,\n      venue: venue ?? null,\n      totalFilledQuantity: formatScaled(totalQty),\n      averageFillPrice: avgPrice,\n      totalFees: formatScaled(totalFee),\n      feeCurrency,\n      settlementRef,\n      feeAccrualRef,\n      usageEventRef,\n      notificationRef,\n      tradeLifecycleRef,\n      reconciliationTriggered,\n      completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      metadata: { fillCount: fills.length, correlationId },\n    };\n\n    // Persist post-trade result if model exists\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).omsPostTrade.create({ data: result });\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Audit\n    try {\n      await this.prisma.auditLog.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId,\n          actorType: 'SYSTEM',\n          action: 'POST_TRADE_COMPLETED',\n          resourceType: 'OMS_ORDER',\n          resourceId: intentId,\n          description: `Post-trade completed intent ${intentId} ${symbol} qty ${formatScaled(totalQty)} avg ${avgPrice ?? 'n/a'} fee ${formatScaled(totalFee)}`.slice(0, 500),\n          metadata: { settlementRef, feeAccrualRef, usageEventRef, tradeLifecycleRef, reconciliationTriggered } as any,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n\n    this.logger.log(`Post-trade completed intent ${intentId} tenant ${tenantId} qty ${formatScaled(totalQty)} avg ${avgPrice} fee ${formatScaled(totalFee)}`);\n    return result;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/reconciliation-persistence.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. OrderReconciliationService } from './order-reconciliation.service';\nimport { FillReconciliationService } from './fill-reconciliation.service';\nimport { reconciliationErrorCode } from './oms.types';\n\n/**\n * Reconciliation findings that cannot be stored are never dropped silently:\n * they stay in the returned result, are counted (persistedFindings /\n * persistFailures) and are expect(result).toMatchObject({ intentSource: 'CANONICAL_ORDER_FALLBACK', intentReadError: 'P2021' });\n      const warned = JSON.stringify(warnSpy.mock.calls);\n      expect(warned).toContain('OMS expect(result).toMatchObject({ omsFillsRead: 'OK', omsFillsReadError: null, readFailures: 0 });\n      expect(result.findings.map((f: any) => f.category)).toEqual(['MISSING_FILL', 'QUANTITY_DRIFT', Specify a different type.","line":290,"column":66,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":290,"endColumn":69,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[11862,11865],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[11862,11865],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":28,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { OrderIntentState } from './oms.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Trade Operations Service — operational control plane for search, filtering,\n * retry/recovery requests, stale-order handling, exception queues, operator workflows.\n * Retry/recovery must re-enter existing execution boundaries. Do not directly alter final exchange execution state.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class TradeOperationsService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(TradeOperationsService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async searchOrders(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId?: string;\n    strategyId?: string;\n    traderId?: string;\n    followerId?: string;\n    symbol?: string;\n    venue?: string;\n    state?: string;\n    from?: Date;\n    to?: Date;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n    search?: string;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, strategyId, traderId, followerId, symbol, venue, state, from, to, page = 1, limit = 20, search } = params;\n\n    try {\n      const where: any = {\n        tenantId,\n        ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}),\n        ...(strategyId ? { strategyId } : {}),\n        ...(traderId ? { traderId } : {}),\n        ...(followerId ? { followerId } : {}),\n        ...(symbol ? { symbol } : {}),\n        ...(venue ? { venue } : {}),\n        ...(state ? { state } : {}),\n        ...(from || to ? { createdAt: { ...(from ? { gte: from } : {}), ...(to ? { lte: to } : {}) } } : {}),\n        ...(search ? { OR: [{ symbol: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } }, { clientOrderId: { contains: search } }] } : {}),\n      };\n      const [items, total] = await Promise.all([\n        (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n        (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.count({ where }),\n      ]);\n      return { items, total, page, limit };\n    } catch {\n      // Fallback to Order table\n      const where: any = {\n        tenantId,\n        ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}),\n        ...(strategyId ? { strategyId } : {}),\n        ...(symbol ? { symbol } : {}),\n        ...(venue ? { venue } : {}),\n        ...(state ? { status: state } : {}),\n        ...(from || to ? { createdAt: { ...(from ? { gte: from } : {}), ...(to ? { lte: to } : {}) } } : {}),\n      };\n      const [items, total] = await Promise.all([\n        this.prisma.order.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n        this.prisma.order.count({ where }),\n      ]);\n      return { items, total, page, limit };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async searchFills(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId?: string;\n    symbol?: string;\n    venue?: string;\n    orderIntentId?: string;\n    from?: Date;\n    to?: Date;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, symbol, venue, orderIntentId, from, to, page = 1, limit = 20 } = params;\n    const where: any = {\n      tenantId,\n      ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}),\n      ...(symbol ? { symbol } : {}),\n      ...(venue ? { venue } : {}),\n      ...(orderIntentId ? { orderIntentId } : {}),\n      ...(from || to ? { timestamp: { gte: from?.toISOString(), lte: to?.toISOString() } } : {}),\n    };\n    const [items, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).omsFill.findMany({ where, orderBy: { timestampMicros: 'desc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).omsFill.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { items, total, page, limit };\n  }\n\n  async searchTrades(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId?: string;\n    symbol?: string;\n    strategyId?: string;\n    state?: string;\n    from?: Date;\n    to?: Date;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, symbol, strategyId, state, from, to, page = 1, limit = 20 } = params;\n    const where: any = {\n      tenantId,\n      ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}),\n      ...(symbol ? { symbol } : {}),\n      ...(strategyId ? { strategyId } : {}),\n      ...(state ? { state } : {}),\n      ...(from || to ? { openedAt: { ...(from ? { gte: from } : {}), ...(to ? { lte: to } : {}) } } : {}),\n    };\n    const [items, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).omsTrade.findMany({ where, orderBy: { openedAt: 'desc' }, skip: (page - 1) * limit, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).omsTrade.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { items, total, page, limit };\n  }\n\n  async getStaleOrders(params: { tenantId: string; accountId?: string; thresholdMs?: number }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, thresholdMs = 5 * 60 * 1000 } = params;\n    const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - thresholdMs);\n    try {\n      return await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}), state: { in: [OrderIntentState.SUBMITTED, OrderIntentState.ACKNOWLEDGED, OrderIntentState.PARTIALLY_FILLED, OrderIntentState.CANCEL_REQUESTED] }, updatedAt: { lt: cutoff } },\n        orderBy: { updatedAt: 'asc' },\n        take: 100,\n      });\n    } catch {\n      return await this.prisma.order.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}), status: { in: ['SUBMITTED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED'] as any }, updatedAt: { lt: cutoff } },\n        orderBy: { updatedAt: 'asc' },\n        take: 100,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getReconciliationQueue(params: { tenantId: string; accountId?: string }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId } = params;\n    return await (this.prisma as any).omsReconciliation.findMany({\n      // OmsReconciliation has no accountId column: filter through the (optional) order intent.\n      where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { orderIntent: { is: { accountId } } } : {}), resolved: false },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      take: 100,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async getRejectedOrders(params: { tenantId: string; accountId?: string }) {\n    const { tenantId, accountId } = params;\n    return await (this.prisma as any).omsRejection.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}), isRetriable: false },\n      orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' },\n      take: 100,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async acknowledgeException(params: { tenantId: string; operationalId: string; userId: string; note: string }) {\n    const { tenantId, operationalId, userId, note } = params;\n    try {\n      const record = await (this.prisma as any).omsOperational.findFirst({ where: { id: operationalId, tenantId } });\n      if (!record) throw new BadRequestException(`Operational record ${operationalId} not found`);\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).omsOperational.update({\n        where: { id: operationalId },\n        data: { state: 'ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledgedBy: userId, acknowledgedAt: new Date(), operatorNotes: { push: note } as any },\n      });\n      this.logger.log(`Operational ${operationalId} acknowledged by ${userId} tenant ${tenantId}`);\n      return updated;\n    } catch (e) {\n      if ((e as any).message?.includes('not found')) throw e;\n      // Fallback: create operational record as acknowledged\n      return { id: operationalId, state: 'ACKNOWLEDGED', acknowledgedBy: userId, note };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async requestRetry(params: { tenantId: string; intentId: string; userId: string; reason: string }) {\n    const { tenantId, intentId, userId, reason } = params;\n\n    let intent: any;\n    try {\n      intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    } catch {\n      intent = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    }\n    if (!intent) throw new BadRequestException(`Intent ${intentId} not found`);\n\n    const currentState = intent.state ?? intent.status;\n    if (!['REJECTED', 'FAILED', 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED'].includes(currentState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Retry only allowed for REJECTED/FAILED/RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED, current ${currentState}`);\n    }\n\n    // Retry must re-enter existing execution boundaries — create new intent that references original\n    // Do NOT directly alter final exchange execution state\n    const operational = {\n      id: randomUUID(),\n      tenantId,\n      type: 'RETRY_REQUESTED',\n      state: 'PENDING',\n      orderIntentId: intentId,\n      internalOrderId: intent.internalOrderId ?? null,\n      symbol: intent.symbol,\n      venue: intent.venue ?? null,\n      accountId: intent.accountId,\n      summary: `Retry requested for intent ${intentId} reason ${reason}`,\n      retryCount: 0,\n      operatorNotes: [reason],\n      correlationId: intent.correlationId ?? null,\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).omsOperational.create({ data: { ...operational, requestedBy: userId, reason } });\n    } catch {}\n\n    this.logger.log(`Retry requested intent ${intentId} tenant ${tenantId} by ${userId} reason ${reason}`);\n    return operational;\n  }\n\n  async requestRecovery(params: { tenantId: string; intentId: string; userId: string; reason: string; recoveryType: string }) {\n    const { tenantId, intentId, userId, reason, recoveryType } = params;\n\n    let intent: any;\n    try {\n      intent = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    } catch {\n      intent = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({ where: { id: intentId, tenantId } });\n    }\n    if (!intent) throw new BadRequestException(`Intent ${intentId} not found`);\n\n    // Recovery cannot bypass execution engine/live gate — it must re-enter boundaries\n    // We only allow recovery for RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED or stale orders\n    const currentState = intent.state ?? intent.status;\n    if (!['RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED', 'SUBMITTED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED', 'FAILED'].includes(currentState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Recovery not allowed for state ${currentState}`);\n    }\n\n    const operational = {\n      id: randomUUID(),\n      tenantId,\n      type: 'RECOVERY_REQUESTED',\n      state: 'PENDING',\n      orderIntentId: intentId,\n      internalOrderId: intent.internalOrderId ?? null,\n      symbol: intent.symbol,\n      venue: intent.venue ?? null,\n      accountId: intent.accountId,\n      summary: `Recovery ${recoveryType} requested for intent ${intentId} reason ${reason}`,\n      retryCount: 0,\n      operatorNotes: [reason],\n      correlationId: intent.correlationId ?? null,\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).omsOperational.create({ data: { ...operational, requestedBy: userId, reason, recoveryType } });\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Audit recovery request\n    try {\n      await this.prisma.auditLog.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId,\n          actorId: userId,\n          actorType: 'USER',\n          action: 'OMS_RECOVERY_REQUESTED',\n          resourceType: 'OMS_ORDER',\n          resourceId: intentId,\n          description: `Recovery ${recoveryType} requested for intent ${intentId} reason ${reason}`.slice(0, 500),\n          metadata: { recoveryType, reason } as any,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n\n    this.logger.log(`Recovery requested intent ${intentId} type ${recoveryType} tenant ${tenantId} by ${userId}`);\n    return operational;\n  }\n\n  async addOperatorNote(params: { tenantId: string; operationalId: string; userId: string; note: string }) {\n    const { tenantId, operationalId, userId, note } = params;\n    try {\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).omsOperational.update({\n        where: { id: operationalId },\n        data: { operatorNotes: { push: `${userId}: ${note}` } as any, updatedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n      return updated;\n    } catch {\n      return { id: operationalId, note: `${userId}: ${note}` };\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/oms/venue-execution-score.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Output contains metric values, methodology, observation count, period, venue.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class VenueExecutionScoreService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(VenueExecutionScoreService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async calculateForVenue(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    venue: string;\n    from: Date;\n    to: Date;\n    accountId?: string | null;\n  }) {\n    const { tenantId, venue, from, to, accountId } = params;\n\n    let intents: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      intents = await (this.prisma as any).omsOrderIntent.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, venue, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}), createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      intents = await this.prisma.order.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, venue: venue as any, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}), createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } },\n      });\n    }\n\n    const totalOrders = intents.length;\n    const filledOrders = intents.filter((o) => (o.state ?? o.status) === 'FILLED').length;\n    const rejectedOrders = intents.filter((o) => (o.state ?? o.status) === 'REJECTED').length;\n\n    const fillRatio = totalOrders > 0 ? filledOrders / totalOrders : null;\n    const rejectionRate = totalOrders > 0 ? rejectedOrders / totalOrders : null;\n\n    // Latency\n    let latencySum = 0;\n    let latencyCount = 0;\n    const latencies: number[] = [];\n    try {\n      const acks = await (this.prisma as any).omsExecutionAck.findMany({ where: { tenantId, venue, createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } } });\n      for (const ack of acks) {\n        if (ack.latencyMicros) {\n          const micros = parseInt(ack.latencyMicros, 10);\n          if (!isNaN(micros)) {\n            const ms = micros / 1000;\n            latencySum += ms;\n            latencyCount++;\n            latencies.push(ms);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    latencies.sort((a, b) => a - b);\n    const avgLatency = latencyCount > 0 ? latencySum / latencyCount : null;\n    const medianLatency = latencies.length > 0 ? latencies[Math.floor(latencies.length / 2)] : null;\n    const p95Latency = latencies.length > 0 ? latencies[Math.floor(latencies.length * 0.95)] ?? latencies[latencies.length - 1] : null;\n\n    // Slippage\n    let slippageSum = 0;\n    let slippageCount = 0;\n    try {\n      // OmsFill has no timestamp column (timestampMicros is a string): filter by createdAt.\n      const fills = await (this.prisma as any).omsFill.findMany({ where: { tenantId, venue, createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } } });\n      for (const fill of fills) {\n        const intent = intents.find((i) => i.id === fill.orderIntentId);\n        if (!intent) continue;\n        const intendedPriceStr = intent.price?.toString() ?? intent.price;\n        const fillPriceStr = fill.price?.toString() ?? fill.price;\n        if (!intendedPriceStr || !fillPriceStr) continue;\n        if (!isValidDecimal(intendedPriceStr) || !isValidDecimal(fillPriceStr)) continue;\n        const intended = Number(parseScaled(intendedPriceStr)) / 1e12;\n        const actual = Number(parseScaled(fillPriceStr)) / 1e12;\n        if (intended === 0) continue;\n        const slip = intent.side === 'BUY' ? ((actual - intended) / intended) * 100 : ((intended - actual) / intended) * 100;\n        slippageSum += slip;\n        slippageCount++;\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const avgSlippage = slippageCount > 0 ? slippageSum / slippageCount : null;\n\n    // Provider errors, rate limits, stale data from rejection records\n    let providerErrorCount = 0;\n    let rateLimitCount = 0;\n    let staleDataCount = 0;\n    try {\n      const rejections = await (this.prisma as any).omsRejection.findMany({ where: { tenantId, venue, timestamp: { gte: from.toISOString(), lte: to.toISOString() } as any } });\n      for (const r of rejections) {\n        if (r.category === 'EXCHANGE_REJECT') providerErrorCount++;\n        if (r.category === 'RATE_LIMITED') rateLimitCount++;\n        if (r.category === 'MARKET_DATA_STALE') staleDataCount++;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // fallback to Order rejectionCode\n      for (const intent of intents) {\n        if ((intent.state ?? intent.status) === 'REJECTED') {\n          const cat = (intent.metadata as any)?.rejectionCategory ?? intent.rejectionCategory;\n          if (cat === 'EXCHANGE_REJECT') providerErrorCount++;\n          if (cat === 'RATE_LIMITED') rateLimitCount++;\n          if (cat === 'MARKET_DATA_STALE') staleDataCount++;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    const score = {\n      id: randomUUID(),\n      tenantId,\n      venue,\n      periodStart: from.toISOString(),\n      periodEnd: to.toISOString(),\n      totalOrders,\n      filledOrders,\n      rejectedOrders,\n      averageLatencyMs: avgLatency !== null ? avgLatency.toFixed(3) : null,\n      medianLatencyMs: medianLatency !== null ? medianLatency.toFixed(3) : null,\n      p95LatencyMs: p95Latency !== null ? p95Latency.toFixed(3) : null,\n      fillRatio: fillRatio !== null ? fillRatio.toFixed(6) : null,\n      rejectionRate: rejectionRate !== null ? rejectionRate.toFixed(6) : null,\n      averageSlippage: avgSlippage !== null ? avgSlippage.toFixed(6) : null,\n      providerErrorCount,\n      rateLimitCount,\n      staleDataCount,\n      methodology: 'EXPLAINABLE_METRICS: fillRatio = filled/total, rejectionRate = rejected/total, latency = submit→ack micros, slippage = (fill-intended)/intended*100 per side, errors counted from rejection categories',\n      observationCount: totalOrders,\n      scoreComponents: {\n        fillRatio: fillRatio !== null ? fillRatio.toFixed(6) : null,\n        rejectionRate: rejectionRate !== null ? rejectionRate.toFixed(6) : null,\n        avgLatencyMs: avgLatency !== null ? avgLatency.toFixed(3) : null,\n        avgSlippage: avgSlippage !== null ? avgSlippage.toFixed(6) : null,\n        providerErrorCount: providerErrorCount.toString(),\n        rateLimitCount: rateLimitCount.toString(),\n        staleDataCount: staleDataCount.toString(),\n      },\n      note: 'Venue execution score is measurable and explainable, not subjective. Higher fillRatio and lower latency/slippage/rejection indicate better execution. Observation count shows sample size.',\n      calculatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).omsVenueScore.create({ data: score });\n    } catch {}\n\n    this.logger.log(`Venue score calculated venue ${venue} tenant ${tenantId} orders ${totalOrders} fillRatio ${fillRatio} avgLatency ${avgLatency}`);\n    return score;\n  }\n\n  async listVenueScores(params: { tenantId: string; from?: Date; to?: Date }) {\n    const { tenantId, from, to } = params;\n    return await (this.prisma as any).omsVenueScore.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, ...(from || to ? { periodStart: { gte: from?.toISOString(), lte: to?.toISOString() } as any } : {}) },\n      orderBy: { calculatedAt: 'desc' },\n      take: 100,\n    });\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/operations/dependency-health.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any.
