worker availability, and processing latency using the existing queue infrastructure.\n * Must not create a second queue implementation.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class QueueHealthService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(QueueHealthService.name);\n\n  private readonly STALE_JOB_THRESHOLD_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes waiting is stale\n  private readonly RETRY_PRESSURE_FAILED_THRESHOLD = 100;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly queueService: QueueService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly auditService: OperationalAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async evaluate(): Promise<QueueHealthResult[]> {\n    const checkedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    try {\n      const depths = await this.queueService.getDepths();\n      const results: QueueHealthResult[] = depths.map((depth) => {\n        const hasStaleJobs = depth.oldestWaitingAgeMs !== null && depth.oldestWaitingAgeMs > this.STALE_JOB_THRESHOLD_MS;\n        const hasRetryPressure = depth.failed > this.RETRY_PRESSURE_FAILED_THRESHOLD;\n        return {\n          queueName: depth.name as string,\n          isConnected: true,\n          waiting: depth.waiting,\n          active: depth.active,\n          delayed: depth.delayed,\n          failed: depth.failed,\n          paused: depth.paused,\n          oldestWaitingAgeMs: depth.oldestWaitingAgeMs,\n          hasStaleJobs,\n          hasRetryPressure,\n          evidence: redactSecrets({\n            waiting: depth.waiting,\n            active: depth.active,\n            delayed: depth.delayed,\n            failed: depth.failed,\n            paused: depth.paused,\n            oldestWaitingAgeMs: depth.oldestWaitingAgeMs,\n          }),\n          checkedAt,\n        };\n      });\n\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: null,\n        eventType: 'QUEUE_HEALTH_CHECK' as any,\n        actorId: null,\n        actorType: 'SYSTEM',\n        targetType: 'QUEUE',\n        targetId: 'all',\n        evidence: redactSecrets({\n          queueCount: results.length,\n          totalWaiting: results.reduce((a, r) => a + r.waiting, 0),\n          totalFailed: results.reduce((a, r) => a + r.failed, 0),\n          hasStale: results.some((r) => r.hasStaleJobs),\n          hasRetryPressure: results.some((r) => r.hasRetryPressure),\n        }),\n        correlationId: null,\n      });\n\n      return results;\n    } catch (e) {\n      const msg = (e as Error).message;\n      this.logger.error(`Queue health check failed: ${msg}`);\n      // Never report healthy unless actually verified — on failure, report UNAVAILABLE via empty result with evidence\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: null,\n        eventType: 'QUEUE_HEALTH_CHECK' as any,\n        actorId: null,\n        actorType: 'SYSTEM',\n        targetType: 'QUEUE',\n        targetId: 'all',\n        evidence: redactSecrets({ error: msg, isConnected: false }),\n        correlationId: null,\n      });\n      // Return a synthetic result indicating failure detected correctly\n      return [\n        {\n          queueName: 'unknown',\n          isConnected: false,\n          waiting: 0,\n          active: 0,\n          delayed: 0,\n          failed: 0,\n          paused: false,\n          oldestWaitingAgeMs: null,\n          hasStaleJobs: false,\n          hasRetryPressure: false,\n          evidence: redactSecrets({ error: msg, isConnected: false }),\n          checkedAt,\n        },\n      ];\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getQueueDepth(queueName: string): Promise<QueueHealthResult | null> {\n    const all = await this.evaluate();\n    return all.find((q) => q.queueName === queueName) ?? null;\n  }\n\n  async isQueueHealthy(queueName: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    const depth = await this.getQueueDepth(queueName);\n    if (!depth) return false;\n    if (!depth.isConnected) return false;\n    if (depth.paused) return false;\n    if (depth.hasStaleJobs) return false;\n    if (depth.failed > this.RETRY_PRESSURE_FAILED_THRESHOLD) return false;\n    return true;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/operations/reconciliation-orchestrator.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":50,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { RedisService } from '../../infrastructure/redis/redis.service';\nimport { OperationalAuditService } from './operational-audit.service';\nimport { OperationsPolicyService } from './operations-policy.service';\nimport {\n  OperationalReconciliationType,\n  OperationalReconciliationRunState,\n  OperationalTriggerType,\n  ReconciliationSubsystemResult,\n  deterministicIdempotencyKey,\n  redactSecrets,\n} from './operations.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Orchestrates existing authoritative reconciliation services across OMS, fills, positions,\n * exchanges, fees, finance, subscriptions, usage, notifications, compliance, risk, copy-trading, etc.\n * Must deduplicate runs and preserve each subsystem as source of truth.\n * Must never overwrite source-of-truth data merely because mismatch detected.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class ReconciliationOrchestratorService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ReconciliationOrchestratorService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly redis: RedisService,\n    private readonly auditService: OperationalAuditService,\n    private readonly policyService: OperationsPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private getLockKey(tenantId: string | null, type: OperationalReconciliationType): string {\n    return `ops:reconciliation:${type}:${tenantId ?? 'platform'}`;\n  }\n\n  async runReconciliation(params: {\n    tenantId?: string | null;\n    type: OperationalReconciliationType;\n    requestedBy?: string | null;\n    triggerType?: OperationalTriggerType;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    parentRunId?: string | null;\n    force?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId = null, type, requestedBy = null, triggerType = OperationalTriggerType.MANUAL, correlationId = null, parentRunId = null, force = false } = params;\n\n    if (!Object.values(OperationalReconciliationType).includes(type)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid reconciliation type ${type}`);\n    }\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `reconciliation:${type}`,\n      tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n      scope: type,\n      correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n      timestampBucket: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), // daily bucket for scheduled, but manual will have correlation\n    });\n\n    // Idempotency: check existing pending/running/succeeded recently\n    if (!force) {\n      try {\n        const existing = await (this.prisma as any).operationalReconciliationRun.findFirst({\n          where: {\n            tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n            reconciliationType: type as any,\n            idempotencyKey,\n            status: { in: ['PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'SUCCEEDED'] as any },\n            createdAt: { gte: new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 60 * 1000) }, // 1h window\n          },\n        });\n        if (existing) {\n          this.logger.log({\n            event: 'operations.reconciliation.deduplicated',\n            type,\n            tenantId: tenantId ?? '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { RedisService } from '../../infrastructure/redis/redis.service';\nimport { QueueService } from '../queue/queue.service';\nimport { ReconciliationOrchestratorService } from './reconciliation-orchestrator.service';\nimport { OperationalAuditService } from './operational-audit.service';\nimport {\n  OperationalReconciliationType,\n  OperationalTriggerType,\n  deterministicIdempotencyKey,\n  redactSecrets,\n} from './operations.types';\n\n/**\n * Defines and executes reconciliation schedules using existing scheduler/queue infrastructure.\n * Must support tenant-scoped and platform-scoped runs, idempotency, lock protection, retry policy,\n * and safe failure handling.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class ReconciliationScheduleService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ReconciliationScheduleService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly redis: RedisService,\n    private readonly queueService: QueueService,\n    private readonly orchestrator: ReconciliationOrchestratorService,\n    private readonly auditService: OperationalAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  // Schedule definitions — reuse existing scheduler/queue infrastructure\n  private readonly SCHEDULES: Array<{\n    type: OperationalReconciliationType;\n    cron: string;\n    scope: 'PLATFORM' | 'TENANT';\n    description: string;\n  }> = [\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.OMS_ORDER, cron: '*/15 * * * *', scope: 'TENANT', description: 'OMS order reconciliation every 15m per tenant' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.OMS_FILL, cron: '*/15 * * * *', scope: 'TENANT', description: 'OMS fill reconciliation every 15m per tenant' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.OMS_POSITION, cron: '*/30 * * * *', scope: 'TENANT', description: 'OMS position reconciliation every 30m' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.EXCHANGE_ACCOUNT, cron: '0 * * * *', scope: 'TENANT', description: 'Exchange account reconciliation hourly' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.RISK, cron: '*/30 * * * *', scope: 'TENANT', description: 'Risk reconciliation every 30m' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.COMPLIANCE, cron: '0 */6 * * *', scope: 'TENANT', description: 'Compliance reconciliation every 6h' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.COPY_TRADING, cron: '*/30 * * * *', scope: 'TENANT', description: 'Copy trading reconciliation every 30m' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.PAYMENT, cron: '0 */2 * * *', scope: 'PLATFORM', description: 'Payment reconciliation every 2h platform' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.BILLING_FINANCE, cron: '0 2 * * *', scope: 'PLATFORM', description: 'Billing finance reconciliation daily 2am' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.FEE, cron: '0 */4 * * *', scope: 'TENANT', description: 'Fee reconciliation every 4h' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.USAGE, cron: '0 * * * *', scope: 'TENANT', description: 'Usage reconciliation hourly' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.NOTIFICATION, cron: '*/30 * * * *', scope: 'PLATFORM', description: 'Notification reconciliation every 30m platform' },\n    { type: OperationalReconciliationType.SUBSCRIPTION, cron: '0 */6 * * *', scope: 'PLATFORM', description: 'Subscription reconciliation every 6h platform' },\n  ];\n\n  getSchedules() {\n    return this.SCHEDULES;\n  }\n\n  async scheduleAll(): Promise<void> {\n    // Use existing queue scheduler — do not create second queue implementation\n    for (const sched of this.SCHEDULES) {\n      try {\n        await this.queueService.schedule(\n          'MAINTENANCE' as any,\n          `reconciliation-${sched.type.toLowerCase()}`,\n          {\n            type: sched.type,\n            scope: sched.scope,\n            triggerType: OperationalTriggerType.SCHEDULED,\n            correlationId: `sched-${sched.type}-${Date.now()}`,\n          },\n          sched.cron,\n        );\n        this.logger.log({\n          event: 'operations.reconciliation.scheduled',\n          type: sched.type,\n          cron: sched.cron,\n          scope: sched.scope,\n        });\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to schedule ${sched.type}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  async executeScheduledRun(params: {\n    type: OperationalReconciliationType;\n    scope: 'PLATFORM' | 'TENANT';\n    tenantId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { type, scope, tenantId = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `scheduled-reconciliation:${type}`,\n      tenantId: scope === 'PLATFORM' ? null : tenantId ?? null,\n      scope,\n      correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n      timestampBucket: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 13), // hourly bucket\n    });\n\n    // Lock protection\n    const lockKey = `ops:scheduled-reconciliation:${type}:${scope === 'PLATFORM' ? 'platform' : tenantId ?? 'all'}`;\n    const token = `sched-${Date.now()}`;\n    const release = await this.redis.acquireLock(lockKey, 10 * 60 * 1000, token).catch(() => null);\n    if (!release) {\n      this.logger.log({ event: 'operations.reconciliation.scheduled_skipped_lock', type, scope });\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      if (scope === 'PLATFORM') {\n        return await this.orchestrator.runReconciliation({\n          tenantId: null,\n          type,\n          requestedBy: null,\n          triggerType: OperationalTriggerType.SCHEDULED,\n          correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n        });\n      } else {\n        // TENANT scope — if tenantId provided, run for that tenant, else run for all tenants with recent activity\n        if (tenantId) {\n          return await this.orchestrator.runReconciliation({\n            tenantId,\n            type,\n            requestedBy: null,\n            triggerType: OperationalTriggerType.SCHEDULED,\n            correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n          });\n        } else {\n          // Find active tenants\n          const tenants = await this.prisma.tenant.findMany({\n            where: { status: 'ACTIVE' as any },\n            select: { id: true },\n            take: 100,\n          });\n          const results = [];\n          for (const t of tenants) {\n            const res = await this.orchestrator.runReconciliation({\n              tenantId: t.id,\n              type,\n              requestedBy: null,\n              triggerType: OperationalTriggerType.SCHEDULED,\n              correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n            }).catch((e) => {\n              this.logger.warn(`Scheduled reconciliation failed for tenant ${t.id} type ${type}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n              return null;\n            });\n            if (res) results.push(res);\n          }\n          return results;\n        }\n      }\n    } finally {\n      try {\n        await release();\n      } catch {}\n    }\n  }\n\n  async triggerManualRun(params: {\n    tenantId?: string | null;\n    type: OperationalReconciliationType;\n    requestedBy?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    if (!Object.values(OperationalReconciliationType).includes(params.type)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid reconciliation type ${params.type}`);\n    }\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId ?? null,\n      eventType: 'RECONCILIATION_RUN_STARTED' as any,\n      actorId: params.requestedBy ?? null,\n      actorType: params.requestedBy ? 'USER' : 'SYSTEM',\n      targetType: 'RECONCILIATION_RUN',\n      targetId: params.type,\n      evidence: redactSecrets({\n        type: params.type,\n        triggerType: 'MANUAL',\n        correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      }),\n      correlationId: params.correlationId ?? null,\n    });\n\n    return this.orchestrator.runReconciliation({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId ?? null,\n      type: params.type,\n      requestedBy: params.requestedBy ?? null,\n      triggerType: OperationalTriggerType.MANUAL,\n      correlationId: params.correlationId ?? null,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async handleJob(jobData: { type: OperationalReconciliationType; scope: string; tenantId?: string; correlationId?: string }): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await this.executeScheduledRun({\n        type: jobData.type,\n        scope: jobData.scope as any,\n        tenantId: jobData.tenantId ?? null,\n        correlationId: jobData.correlationId ?? null,\n      });\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.error(`Reconciliation scheduled job failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      // Safe failure handling — do not crash worker, record audit\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: jobData.tenantId ?? null,\n        eventType: 'RECONCILIATION_RUN_FAILED' as any,\n        actorId: null,\n        actorType: 'SYSTEM',\n        targetType: 'RECONCILIATION_RUN',\n        targetId: jobData.type,\n        evidence: redactSecrets({ error: (e as Error).message, type: jobData.type }),\n        correlationId: jobData.correlationId ?? null,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/operations/recovery-plan.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. ForbiddenException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { RedisService } from '../../infrastructure/redis/redis.service';\nimport { OperationalAuditService } from './operational-audit.service';\nimport { OperationsPolicyService } from './operations-policy.service';\nimport { OperationalRecoveryState, deterministicIdempotencyKey, redactSecrets } from './operations.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Stores and executes structured recovery procedures referencing existing authoritative services.\n * Recovery must be step-based, idempotent where possible, auditable, and incapable of bypassing\n * risk, compliance, live-gate, credential, OMS, or execution controls.\n */\n\nexport interface RecoveryStep {\n  stepId: string;\n  name: string;\n  description: string;\n  service: string; // e.g., 'queue', 'exchange', 'oms', 'risk', etc\n  action: string; // e.g., 'retry', 'reconnect', 'resync'\n  preconditions?: string[];\n  isIdempotent?: boolean;\n  requiresApproval?: boolean;\n  forbiddenBypasses?: string[];\n}\n\nexport interface RecoveryPlanDefinition {\n  planId: string;\n  name: string;\n  description: string;\n  applicableIncidentTypes: string[];\n  steps: RecoveryStep[];\n  requiresPlatformRole?: boolean;\n  estimatedDurationMinutes?: number;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class RecoveryPlanService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(RecoveryPlanService.name);\n\n  private readonly PLANS: RecoveryPlanDefinition[] = [\n    {\n      planId: 'queue-retry',\n      name: 'Queue Retry Recovery',\n      description: 'Retry failed jobs in queue using existing queue infrastructure',\n      applicableIncidentTypes: ['QUEUE_FAILURE', 'JOB_FAILURE', 'STALE_JOB'],\n      steps: [\n        { stepId: 'check-queue-health', name: 'Check queue health', description: 'Verify queue connectivity', service: 'queue', action: 'health-check', isIdempotent: true },\n        { stepId: 'retry-failed-jobs', name: 'Retry failed jobs', description: 'Retry failed jobs via existing queue service', service: 'queue', action: 'retry-failed', isIdempotent: true },\n        { stepId: 'verify-recovery', name: 'Verify recovery', description: 'Run reconciliation to verify', service: 'reconciliation', action: 'verify', isIdempotent: true },\n      ],\n    },\n    {\n      planId: 'exchange-reconnect',\n      name: 'Exchange Reconnect Recovery',\n      description: 'Reconnect exchange streams using existing execution safety boundaries',\n      applicableIncidentTypes: ['EXCHANGE_DISCONNECT', 'STREAM_FAILURE', 'CREDENTIAL_FAILURE'],\n      steps: [\n        { stepId: 'check-credential', name: 'Check credential', description: 'Verify credential source via existing service', service: 'credential', action: 'verify', isIdempotent: true, preconditions: ['credential exists'] },\n        { stepId: 'check-live-gate', name: 'Check live gate', description: 'Verify live gate prerequisites', service: 'live-gate', action: 'check', isIdempotent: true },\n        { stepId: 'reconnect-stream', name: 'Reconnect stream', description: 'Reconnect via existing execution service', service: 'execution', action: 'reconnect', isIdempotent: false },\n        { stepId: 'reconcile-orders', name: 'Reconcile orders', description: 'Run OMS order reconciliation', service: 'oms', action: 'reconcile-orders', isIdempotent: true },\n      ],\n      requiresPlatformRole: true,\n    },\n    {\n      planId: 'oms-resync',\n      name: 'OMS Resync Recovery',\n      description: 'Resync OMS state via existing OMS reconciliation, never direct DB patch',\n      applicableIncidentTypes: ['OMS_STALE', 'POSITION_MISMATCH', 'FILL_MISMATCH'],\n      steps: [\n        { stepId: 'check-oms-health', name: 'Check OMS health', description: 'Verify OMS tables accessible', service: 'oms', action: 'health-check', isIdempotent: true },\n        { stepId: 'run-order-reconciliation', name: 'Run order reconciliation', description: 'Delegate to OMS order reconciliation service', service: 'oms', action: 'reconcile-orders', isIdempotent: true },\n        { stepId: 'run-fill-reconciliation', name: 'Run fill reconciliation', description: 'Delegate to OMS fill reconciliation', service: 'oms', action: 'reconcile-fills', isIdempotent: true },\n        { stepId: 'run-position-reconciliation', name: 'Run position reconciliation', description: 'Delegate to position reconciliation', service: 'oms', action: 'reconcile-positions', isIdempotent: true },\n        { stepId: 'verify-post-trade', name: 'Verify post-trade', description: 'Run post-trade verification', service: 'oms', action: 'post-trade-verify', isIdempotent: true },\n      ],\n    },\n    {\n      planId: 'risk-compliance-recovery',\n      name: 'Risk Compliance Recovery',\n      description: 'Recover risk/compliance blocks via existing authoritative services, never bypass',\n      applicableIncidentTypes: ['RISK_BLOCK', 'COMPLIANCE_BLOCK', 'SECURITY_BLOCK'],\n      steps: [\n        { stepId: 'check-risk-policy', name: 'Check risk policy', description: 'Verify risk policy via existing risk service', service: 'risk', action: 'check-policy', isIdempotent: true },\n        { stepId: 'check-compliance-case', name: 'Check compliance case', description: 'Check compliance case via compliance service', service: 'compliance', action: 'check-case', isIdempotent: true },\n        { stepId: 'request-review', name: 'Request review', description: 'Request manual review via existing compliance flow', service: 'compliance', action: 'request-review', isIdempotent: false, requiresApproval: true },\n      ],\n      requiresPlatformRole: true,\n    },\n  ];\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly redis: RedisService,\n    private readonly auditService: OperationalAuditService,\n    private readonly policyService: OperationsPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  getPlans(): RecoveryPlanDefinition[] {\n    return this.PLANS;\n  }\n\n  getPlan(planId: string): RecoveryPlanDefinition | null {\n    return this.PLANS.find((p) => p.planId === planId) ?? null;\n  }\n\n  async createRecoveryRun(params: {\n    tenantId?: string | null;\n    planId: string;\n    incidentId?: string | null;\n    maintenanceWindowId?: string | null;\n    requestedBy?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    requiresApproval?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const plan = this.getPlan(params.planId);\n    if (!plan) throw new BadRequestException(`Recovery plan ${params.planId} not found`);\n\n    // Recovery requires authorization — check policy\n    const permissions = this.policyService.getRecoveryPermissions();\n    if (plan.requiresPlatformRole && params.tenantId !== null) {\n      // Platform role required — will be enforced in controller RBAC, but also check here for safety\n      // For tenant-scoped recovery that requires platform, we still allow creation but state will be REQUIRES_APPROVAL\n    }\n\n    // Validate no forbidden bypasses in plan steps\n    for (const step of plan.steps) {\n      const forbidden = step.forbiddenBypasses ?? permissions.forbiddenBypasses;\n      if (forbidden) {\n        for (const fb of forbidden) {\n          if (permissions.forbiddenBypasses.includes(fb)) {\n            throw new BadRequestException(`Recovery plan step ${step.stepId} attempts forbidden bypass ${fb}`);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `recovery:${params.planId}`,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId ?? null,\n      scope: params.incidentId ?? params.maintenanceWindowId ?? params.planId,\n      correlationId: params.correlationId ?? null,\n      timestampBucket: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 13),\n    });\n\n    // Idempotency check\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).operationalRecoveryRun.findFirst({\n        where: { idempotencyKey, tenantId: params.tenantId ?? null },\n      });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    } catch {}\n\n    const initialState = params.requiresApproval || plan.requiresPlatformRole ? OperationalRecoveryState.REQUIRES_APPROVAL : OperationalRecoveryState.PENDING;\n\n    const created = await (this.prisma as any).operationalRecoveryRun.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId: params.tenantId ?? null,\n        planId: params.planId,\n        incidentId: params.incidentId ?? null,\n        maintenanceWindowId: params.maintenanceWindowId ?? null,\n        state: initialState as any,\n        requestedBy: params.requestedBy ?? null,\n        steps: plan.steps as any,\n        currentStep: 0,\n        totalSteps: plan.steps.length,\n        result: {} as any,\n        correlationId: params.correlationId ?? null,\n        idempotencyKey,\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId ?? null,\n      eventType: 'RECOVERY_STARTED' as any,\n      actorId: params.requestedBy ?? null,\n      actorType: params.requestedBy ? 'USER' : 'SYSTEM',\n      targetType: 'RECOVERY_RUN',\n      targetId: created.id,\n      evidence: redactSecrets({\n        planId: params.planId,\n        incidentId: params.incidentId,\n        state: initialState,\n        totalSteps: plan.steps.length,\n      }),\n      correlationId: params.correlationId ?? null,\n    });\n\n    return created;\n  }\n\n  async approveRecoveryRun(params: {\n    tenantId: string | null;\n    recoveryRunId: string;\n    approvedBy: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const run = await this.getRecoveryRun(params.tenantId, params.recoveryRunId);\n    if (run.state !== OperationalRecoveryState.REQUIRES_APPROVAL && run.state !== OperationalRecoveryState.PENDING) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Cannot approve recovery run in state ${run.state}`);\n    }\n\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).operationalRecoveryRun.update({\n      where: { id: run.id },\n      data: {\n        state: OperationalRecoveryState.APPROVED as any,\n        approvedBy: params.approvedBy,\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId ?? null,\n      eventType: 'RECOVERY_STARTED' as any,\n      actorId: params.approvedBy,\n      actorType: 'USER',\n      targetType: 'RECOVERY_RUN',\n      targetId: run.id,\n      evidence: { approvedBy: params.approvedBy },\n      correlationId: params.correlationId ?? null,\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async executeRecoveryRun(params: {\n    tenantId: string | null;\n    recoveryRunId: string;\n    actorId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const run = await this.getRecoveryRun(params.tenantId, params.recoveryRunId);\n\n    // Precondition Check → Authorization → Distributed Lock → Existing Authoritative Service → Result Verification → Reconciliation → Audit\n    if (run.state !== OperationalRecoveryState.PENDING && run.state !== OperationalRecoveryState.APPROVED) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Recovery run must be PENDING or APPROVED to execute, current ${run.state}`);\n    }\n\n    // Authorization already checked via RBAC in controller; here we ensure approval if required\n    if (run.state === OperationalRecoveryState.REQUIRES_APPROVAL) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Recovery run requires approval before execution');\n    }\n\n    // Distributed Lock\n    const lockKey = `ops:recovery:${run.id}`;\n    const token = randomUUID();\n    const release = await this.redis.acquireLock(lockKey, 10 * 60 * 1000, token).catch(() => null);\n    if (!release) throw new BadRequestException('Recovery run already executing (lock held)');\n\n    try {\n      // Transition to RUNNING\n      await (this.prisma as any).operationalRecoveryRun.update({\n        where: { id: run.id },\n        data: {\n          state: OperationalRecoveryState.RUNNING as any,\n          startedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      const steps = (run.steps as any[]) ?? [];\n      const results: any[] = [];\n      let currentStep = 0;\n      let failed = false;\n      let failureReason: string | null = null;\n\n      for (const step of steps) {\n        currentStep++;\n        // Precondition Check\n        if (step.preconditions) {\n          for (const precondition of step.preconditions) {\n            // Simulate precondition check — in real implementation, would call existing service\n            this.logger.debug(`Checking precondition ${precondition} for step ${step.stepId}`);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // Authorization — step-level\n        if (step.requiresApproval && !run.approvedBy) {\n          failed = true;\n          failureReason = `Step ${step.stepId} requires approval`;\n          results.push({ stepId: step.stepId, status: 'FAILED', error: failureReason });\n          break;\n        }\n\n        // Existing Authoritative Service — recovery must re-enter existing service boundary, never direct DB patch\n        try {\n          const stepResult = await this.executeRecoveryStep({\n            tenantId: params.tenantId ?? null,\n            runId: run.id,\n            step,\n            correlationId: params.correlationId ?? null,\n          });\n          results.push({ stepId: step.stepId, status: 'SUCCEEDED', result: stepResult });\n\n          // Update current step\n          await (this.prisma as any).operationalRecoveryRun.update({\n            where: { id: run.id },\n            data: { currentStep, result: { steps: results } as any },\n          });\n        } catch (e) {\n          failed = true;\n          failureReason = (e as Error).message.slice(0, 1000);\n          results.push({ stepId: step.stepId, status: 'FAILED', error: failureReason });\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const finishTime = new Date();\n      const startTime = run.startedAt ? new Date(run.startedAt) : new Date(run.createdAt);\n      const durationMs = finishTime.getTime() - startTime.getTime();\n\n      const finalState = failed ? OperationalRecoveryState.FAILED : OperationalRecoveryState.SUCCEEDED;\n\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).operationalRecoveryRun.update({\n        where: { id: run.id },\n        data: {\n          state: finalState as any,\n          finishedAt: finishTime,\n          durationMs,\n          result: { steps: results, totalSteps: steps.length, completedSteps: currentStep } as any,\n          failureReason: failed ? failureReason : null,\n        },\n      });\n\n      const auditEvent = failed ? 'RECOVERY_FAILED' : 'RECOVERY_COMPLETED';\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId ?? null,\n        eventType: auditEvent as any,\n        actorId: params.actorId ?? null,\n        actorType: params.actorId ? 'USER' : 'SYSTEM',\n        targetType: 'RECOVERY_RUN',\n        targetId: run.id,\n        evidence: redactSecrets({\n          planId: run.planId,\n          state: finalState,\n          durationMs,\n          failureReason,\n          stepsCompleted: currentStep,\n        }),\n        correlationId: params.correlationId ?? null,\n      });\n\n      // Reconciliation verification after recovery\n      if (!failed) {\n        // Trigger reconciliation verification — safe, does not bypass controls\n        this.logger.log({ event: 'operations.recovery.trigger_reconciliation_verification', runId: run.id });\n      }\n\n      return updated;\n    } finally {\n      try {\n        await release();\n      } catch {}\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async executeRecoveryStep(params: {\n    tenantId: string | null;\n    runId: string;\n    step: RecoveryStep;\n    correlationId: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    // No recovery procedure may directly patch database state to simulate\n    // success, and (Phase 3) no step may REPORT success it did not verify.\n    // Each step either performs a real read-only verification against the\n    // authoritative stores (DB, Redis) and throws when the system is not in\n    // the required state, or - where the action belongs to a boundary this\n    // service cannot drive (stream reconnect, queue replay, manual review) -\n    // throws RECOVERY_MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED so the run stops as FAILED with\n    // an explicit reason instead of pretending the action happened.\n    const { step, tenantId } = params;\n    const tenantWhere = tenantId ? { tenantId } : {};\n    const manual = (what: string): never => {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`RECOVERY_MANUAL_ACTION_REQUIRED: ${what}`);\n    };\n\n    const unsyncedOrders = () =>\n      this.prisma.order.count({ where: { ...tenantWhere, reconciliationState: { not: 'IN_SYNC' } as any } });\n\n    switch (step.service) {\n      case 'queue':\n        if (step.action === 'health-check') {\n          const health = await this.redis.healthCheck().catch(() => ({ ok: false, latencyMs: -1 }));\n          if (!health.ok) throw new BadRequestException('Queue backend (Redis) is not reachable');\n          return { checked: true, healthy: true, latencyMs: health.latencyMs };\n        }\n        if (step.action === 'retry-failed') {\n          return manual('replay failed jobs from the queue admin (BullMQ) after the root cause is fixed; replay is not automated because non-idempotent jobs must be reviewed');\n        }\n        break;\n      case 'credential':\n        if (step.action === 'verify') {\n          if (!tenantId) throw new BadRequestException('Credential verification requires a tenant');\n          const accounts = await this.prisma.tradingAccount.findMany({\n            where: { tenantId },\n            select: { id: true, credentialSource: true, credentialRef: true, apiKeyCiphertext: true, apiSecretCiphertext: true },\n            take: 1000,\n          });\n          if (accounts.length === 0) throw new BadRequestException('No trading accounts for credential verification');\n          const broken = accounts.filter((a: any) =>\n            a.credentialSource === 'SECRET_MANAGER' ? !a.credentialRef : a.credentialSource ? !(a.apiKeyCiphertext && a.apiSecretCiphertext) : false,\n          );\n          if (broken.length > 0) throw new BadRequestException(`${broken.length} trading account(s) have an incomplete credential record`);\n          return { verified: true, accountsChecked: accounts.length };\n        }\n        break;\n      case 'live-gate':\n        if (step.action === 'check') {\n          const engaged = await this.prisma.killSwitch.count({ where: { isEngaged: true, OR: [{ tenantId: tenantId ?? undefined }, { tenantId: null }] } });\n          if (engaged > 0) throw new BadRequestException(`${engaged} kill switch(es) engaged - live gate closed`);\n          const unsynced = await unsyncedOrders();\n          if (unsynced > 0) throw new BadRequestException(`${unsynced} order(s) not reconciled - live gate stays closed until they are`);\n          return { killSwitchEngaged: false, unreconciledOrders: 0 };\n        }\n        break;\n      case 'execution':\n        if (step.action === 'reconnect') {\n          return manual('restart/reconnect the execution-engine private stream (the engine owns venue connections; the API cannot reconnect them)');\n        }\n        break;\n      case 'oms':\n        if (step.action === 'health-check') {\n          await this.prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;\n          return { healthy: true };\n        }\n        if (step.action === 'reconcile-orders' || step.action === 'post-trade-verify') {\n          const unsynced = await unsyncedOrders();\n          if (unsynced > 0) throw new BadRequestException(`${unsynced} order(s) are not IN_SYNC with the venue`);\n          return { verified: true, unsyncedOrders: 0, type: step.action };\n        }\n        if (step.action === Represents controlled DEGRADED/READ_ONLY/PAUSED states for individual services or capabilities.\n * Must define allowed operations in each state and integrate with existing safety boundaries\n * instead of bypassing them.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class ServiceDegradationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ServiceDegradationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly auditService: OperationalAuditService,\n    private readonly policyService: OperationsPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async setDegradation(params: {\n    tenantId?: string | null;\n    serviceName: string;\n    capability?: string | null;\n    level: OperationalDegradationLevel;\n    reason: string;\n    requestedBy?: string | null;\n    approvedBy?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    startsAt?: Date;\n    endsAt?: Date | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId = null, serviceName, capability = null, level, reason, requestedBy = null, approvedBy = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    if (!serviceName) throw new BadRequestException('serviceName required');\n    if (!Object.values(OperationalDegradationLevel).includes(level)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid degradation level ${level}`);\n\n    const { allowed, blocked } = this.policyService.getDegradationAllowedOperations(level);\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `degradation:${serviceName}`,\n      tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n      scope: capability ?? serviceName,\n      correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n      timestampBucket: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 13),\n    });\n\n    // Check existing active degradation for same service\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).operationalServiceDegradation.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n          serviceName,\n          capability: capability ?? null,\n          endsAt: null,\n        },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n      if (existing && existing.level === level) {\n        return existing; // idempotent\n      }\n      if (existing) {\n        // Close previous\n        await (this.prisma as any).operationalServiceDegradation.update({\n          where: { id: existing.id },\n          data: { endsAt: new Date() },\n        });\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const created = await (this.prisma as any).operationalServiceDegradation.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n        serviceName,\n        capability: capability ?? null,\n        level: level as any,\n        previousLevel: null,\n        reason: reason.slice(0, 1000),\n        requestedBy: requestedBy ?? null,\n        approvedBy: approvedBy ?? null,\n        allowedOperations: allowed,\n        blockedOperations: blocked,\n        startsAt: params.startsAt ?? new Date(),\n        endsAt: params.endsAt ?? null,\n        correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n        idempotencyKey,\n      },\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n      eventType: 'DEGRADATION_CHANGED' as any,\n      actorId: requestedBy ?? null,\n      actorType: requestedBy ? Must return structured blocking reasons and evidence.\n * Never fabricate readiness.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class SystemReadinessService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(SystemReadinessService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly dependencyHealth: DependencyHealthService,\n    private readonly policyService: OperationsPolicyService,\n    private readonly auditService: OperationalAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async evaluate(params: {\n    tenantId?: string | null;\n    requestedBy?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<ReadinessResult> {\n    const { tenantId = null, requestedBy = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n    const checkedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    const policy = this.policyService.getReadinessPolicy(tenantId);\n\n    const dependencyResults = await this.dependencyHealth.checkAll(tenantId);\n\n    const blockingReasons: string[] = [];\n    const degradedComponents: string[] = [];\n\n    // Fail closed for unavailable critical dependencies where safety requires it\n    for (const dep of dependencyResults) {\n      if (dep.state === OperationalDependencyState.UNAVAILABLE || dep.state === OperationalDependencyState.MISCONFIGURED) {\n        if (policy.criticalDependencies.includes(dep.dependencyType) || policy.failClosedOn.includes(dep.dependencyType)) {\n          blockingReasons.push(`${dep.dependencyType}:${dep.dependencyName} is ${dep.state} ${dep.errorCode ?? ''}`.trim());\n        } else if (!policy.allowedDegraded.includes(dep.dependencyType)) {\n          degradedComponents.push(`${dep.dependencyType}:${dep.dependencyName}`);\n        }\n      } else if (dep.state === OperationalDependencyState.DEGRADED) {\n        if (policy.criticalDependencies.includes(dep.dependencyType) && !policy.allowedDegraded.includes(dep.dependencyType)) {\n          // Critical degraded is blocking unless explicitly allowed\n          degradedComponents.push(`${dep.dependencyType}:${dep.dependencyName}`);\n          if (policy.failClosedOn.includes(dep.dependencyType)) {\n            blockingReasons.push(`${dep.dependencyType} degraded and fail-closed required`);\n          }\n        } else {\n          degradedComponents.push(`${dep.dependencyType}:${dep.dependencyName}`);\n        }\n      } else if (dep.state === OperationalDependencyState.UNKNOWN) {\n        if (policy.failClosedOn.includes(dep.dependencyType)) {\n          blockingReasons.push(`${dep.dependencyType}:${dep.dependencyName} UNKNOWN and fail-closed required`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Check maintenance windows\n    try {\n      const now = new Date();\n      const activeMaintenance = await (this.prisma as any).operationalMaintenanceWindow.findMany({\n        where: {\n          state: 'ACTIVE',\n          scheduledStart: { lte: now },\n          scheduledEnd: { gte: now },\n          OR: [{ tenantId: tenantId ?? undefined }, { tenantId: null }, { scope: 'PLATFORM' }],\n        },\n      });\n      if (activeMaintenance.length > 0) {\n        blockingReasons.push(`Maintenance active: ${activeMaintenance.map((m: any) => m.title).join(', ')}`);\n      }\n    } catch {\n      // If maintenance check fails, do not fabricate readiness — treat as degraded evidence\n      degradedComponents.push('MAINTENANCE_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE');\n    }\n\n    // Check degradation\n    try {\n      const degradations = await (this.prisma as any).operationalServiceDegradation.findMany({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: tenantId ?? undefined,\n          endsAt: null,\n        },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        take: 10,\n      });\n      const blockingDegradation = degradations.filter((d: any) => d.level === 'DISABLED' || d.level === 'PAUSED');\n      if (blockingDegradation.length > 0) {\n        blockingReasons.push(`Service degradation active: ${blockingDegradation.map((d: any) => `${d.serviceName}:${d.level}`).join(', ')}`);\n      }\n      degradations.forEach((d: any) => {\n        if (d.level !== 'NORMAL') degradedComponents.push(`${d.serviceName}:${d.level}`);\n      });\n    } catch {\n      // No degradation table yet is not blocking\n    }\n\n    let state: OperationalReadinessState;\n    let isReady: boolean;\n\n    if (blockingReasons.length > 0) {\n      state = OperationalReadinessState.NOT_READY;\n      isReady = false;\n    } else if (degradedComponents.length > 0) {\n      state = OperationalReadinessState.DEGRADED;\n      isReady = true; // Degraded but still ready for limited operations\n    } else {\n      state = OperationalReadinessState.READY;\n      isReady = true;\n    }\n\n    // If maintenance is active for this tenant/platform, override to MAINTENANCE unless NOT_READY already\n    if (state !== OperationalReadinessState.NOT_READY) {\n      try {\n        const maintenanceActive = await (this.prisma as any).operationalMaintenanceWindow.findFirst({\n          where: {\n            state: 'ACTIVE',\n            OR: [{ tenantId: tenantId ?? undefined }, { tenantId: null }],\n          },\n        });\n        if (maintenanceActive) {\n          state = OperationalReadinessState.MAINTENANCE;\n          isReady = false;\n        }\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    const result: ReadinessResult = {\n      state,\n      isReady,\n      blockingReasons,\n      degradedComponents,\n      evidence: redactSecrets({\n        policyVersion: this.policyService.getPolicyVersion(),\n        dependencyCount: dependencyResults.length,\n        blockingCount: blockingReasons.length,\n        degradedCount: degradedComponents.length,\n        tenantId: tenantId ?? 'platform',\n      }),\n      dependencyResults,\n      checkedAt,\n      tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n      correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n    };\n\n    // Audit immutable record\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n      eventType: 'READINESS_CHECK' as any,\n      actorId: requestedBy ?? null,\n      actorType: requestedBy ? 'USER' : 'SYSTEM',\n      targetType: 'READINESS',\n      targetId: tenantId ?? 'platform',\n      evidence: redactSecrets({\n        state,\n        isReady,\n        blockingReasons,\n        degradedComponents,\n        dependencyResults: dependencyResults.map((d) => ({ type: d.dependencyType, state: d.state, isCritical: d.isCritical })),\n        correlationId,\n      }),\n      correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n    });\n\n    // Persist readiness check history\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).operationalReadinessCheck.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n          state: state as any,\n          isReady,\n          blockingReasons,\n          degradedComponents,\n          evidence: redactSecrets(result.evidence) as any,\n          requestedBy: requestedBy ?? null,\n          correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n          checkedAt: new Date(checkedAt),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to persist readiness check: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log({\n      event: 'operations.readiness.evaluated',\n      tenantId: tenantId ?? 'platform',\n      state,\n      isReady,\n      blockingReasons: blockingReasons.length,\n    });\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  async getLatest(tenantId?: string | null): Promise<any | null> {\n    const where = tenantId ? { tenantId } : { tenantId: null };\n    return await (this.prisma as any).operationalReadinessCheck.findFirst({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { checkedAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/ops/production/release-manifest.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/orders/order-intent.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partner/dto/partner-campaign.dto.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partner/partner-commission-ledger.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partner/partner-payout.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partner/partner-reconciliation.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partner/partner.controller.s @IsString()\n  @MinLength(2)\n  @MaxLength(120)\n  name!: string;\n\n  @IsOptional()\n  @IsString()\n  @MaxLength(160)\n  legalName?: string;\n\n  @IsEnum(PartnerType)\n  type!: PartnerType;\n\n  @IsString()\n  @MinLength(5)\n  ownerUserId!: string;\n\n  @IsEmail()\n  contactEmail!: string;\n\n  @IsOptional()\n  @IsString()\n  @MaxLength(120)\n  contactName?: string;\n\n  @IsOptional()\n  @IsString()\n  @MaxLength(2048)\n  website?: string;\n\n  @IsOptional()\n  @IsString()\n  @MaxLength(2)\n  countryCode?: string;\n\n  @IsOptional()\n  @IsString()\n  taxId?: string;\n\n agreement.supersededAt = new Date().toISOString();\n      agreement.isImmutable = true;\n    }\n    if (params.targetState === PartnerAgreementState.TERMINATED) {\n      agreement.terminatedAt = new any).partnerAgreement?.findFirst?.({ where: { partnerId, state: 'ACTIVE' }, orderBy: { version: 'desc' } });\n      if (row) return this.mapRow(row);\n    } catch {}\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async tenantCount: number; revenue: string; commission: string }>;\n  cohortByCampaign: Array<{ campaignId: string; tenantCount: number; revenue: string; commission: string }>;\n  generatedAt: string;\n  calculationVersion: string;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerAnalyticsService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerAnalyticsService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly profileService: PartnerProfileService,\n    private readonly tenantService: PartnerTenantService,\n    private readonly commissionLedger: PartnerCommissionLedgerService,\n    private readonly performanceService: PartnerPerformanceService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async getAnalytics(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    granularity: 'DAILY' | 'WEEKLY' | 'MONTHLY' | 'QUARTERLY' | 'LIFETIME';\n    periodStart: string;\n    periodEnd: string;\n    currency?: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n  }): Promise<PartnerAnalytics> {\n    if (!params.partnerId || !params.periodStart || !params.periodEnd) throw new BadRequestException('partnerId, periodStart, periodEnd required');\n    await this.profileService.getProfile(params.partnerId);\n\n    const currency = (params.currency ?? 'USD').toUpperCase();\n    const periodStart = new Date(params.periodStart);\n    const periodEnd = new Date(params.periodEnd);\n    if (isNaN(periodStart.getTime()) || isNaN(periodEnd.getTime()) || periodStart >= periodEnd) throw new BadRequestException('invalid period');\n\n    // No floating-point financial aggregation, no silent cross-currency summation\n    const commissions = await this.commissionLedger.listCommissions(params.partnerId, { currency });\n    const relationships = await this.tenantService.listTenantsForPartner(params.partnerId);\n\n    const timeSeries = this.buildTimeSeries({\n      granularity: params.granularity,\n      periodStart,\n      periodEnd,\n      commissions,\n      relationships,\n      currency,\n    });\n\n    const cohortByPlan = await this.buildPlanCohort(params.partnerId, commissions, relationships, currency);\n    const cohortByCampaign = await this.buildCampaignCohort(params.partnerId, commissions, relationships, currency);\n\n    const analytics: PartnerAnalytics = {\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      granularity: params.granularity,\n      currency,\n      periodStart: periodStart.toISOString(),\n      periodEnd: periodEnd.toISOString(),\n      timeSeries,\n      cohortByPlan,\n      cohortByCampaign,\n      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      calculationVersion: '2026-01',\n    };\n\n    this.logger.log(`analytics generated partner=${params.partnerId} granularity=${params.granularity} points=${timeSeries.length} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return analytics;\n  }\n\n  private buildTimeSeries(params: {\n    granularity: string;\n    periodStart: Date;\n    periodEnd: Date;\n    commissions: any[];\n    relationships: any[];\n    currency: string;\n  }): TimeSeriesPoint[] {\n    const points: TimeSeriesPoint[] = [];\n    const intervals = this.generateIntervals(params.granularity as any, params.periodStart, params.periodEnd);\n\n    for (const interval of intervals) {\n      const commissionsInInterval = params.commissions.filter(c => {\n        const accrued = new Date(c.accruedAt);\n        return accrued >= interval.start && accrued <= interval.end && c.currency.toUpperCase() === params.currency;\n      });\n\n      let gross = '0';\n      let netEligible = '0';\n      let accrued = '0';\n      let reversed = '0';\n      let refunds = 0;\n      let chargebacks = 0;\n\n      for (const com of commissionsInInterval) {\n        gross = this.addDecimal(gross, com.grossRevenue, params.currency);\n        netEligible = this.addDecimal(netEligible, com.netEligibleRevenue, params.currency);\n        if (['ACCRUED', 'SETTLED', 'PAID', 'PAYOUT_PENDING'].includes(com.state)) {\n          accrued = this.addDecimal(accrued, com.commissionAmount, params.currency);\n        } else if (com.state === 'REVERSED') {\n          reversed = this.addDecimal(reversed, com.commissionAmount, params.currency);\n          if (com.sourceEventType === 'REFUND') refunds++;\n          if (com.sourceEventType === 'CHARGEBACK') chargebacks++;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const payable = this.addDecimal(accrued, reversed, params.currency);\n\n      const newTenants = params.relationships.filter(r => {\n        const assigned = new Date(r.assignedAt);\n        return assigned >= interval.start && assigned <= interval.end;\n      }).length;\n\n      const activeTenants = params.relationships.filter(r => {\n        const assigned = new Date(r.assignedAt);\n        const terminated = r.terminatedAt ? new Date(r.terminatedAt) : null;\n        return assigned <= interval.end && (!terminated || terminated > interval.end) && r.state === 'ACTIVE';\n      }).length;\n\n      const churnedTenants = params.relationships.filter(r => {\n        if (!r.terminatedAt) return false;\n        const terminated = new Date(r.terminatedAt);\n        return terminated >= interval.start && terminated <= interval.end;\n      }).length;\n\n      points.push({\n        period: interval.label,\n        periodStart: interval.start.toISOString(),\n        periodEnd: interval.end.toISOString(),\n        grossRevenue: gross,\n        netEligibleRevenue: netEligible,\n        commissionAccrued: accrued,\n        commissionReversed: reversed,\n        commissionPayable: payable,\n        newTenants,\n        activeTenants,\n        churnedTenants,\n        activeSubscriptions: activeTenants, // simplified\n        refunds,\n        chargebacks,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return points;\n  }\n\n  private async buildPlanCohort(partnerId: string, commissions: any[], relationships: any[], currency: string) {\n    const map = new Map<string, { tenantCount: Set<string>; revenue: string; commission: string }>();\n    for (const com of commissions) {\n      if (com.currency.toUpperCase() !== currency) continue; // no silent cross-currency summation\n      // Try to resolve plan from subscription\n      const planCode = 'UNKNOWN';\n      if (!map.has(planCode)) map.set(planCode, { tenantCount: new Set(), revenue: '0', commission: '0' });\n      const entry = map.get(planCode)!;\n      entry.tenantCount.add(com.tenantId);\n      entry.revenue = this.addDecimal(entry.revenue, com.netEligibleRevenue, currency);\n      if (['ACCRUED', 'SETTLED', 'PAID'].includes(com.state)) {\n        entry.commission = this.addDecimal(entry.commission, com.commissionAmount, currency);\n      }\n    }\n    return [...map.entries()].map(([planCode, data]) => ({\n      planCode,\n      tenantCount: data.tenantCount.size,\n      revenue: data.revenue,\n      commission: data.commission,\n    }));\n  }\n\n  private async buildCampaignCohort(partnerId: string, commissions: any[], relationships: any[], currency: string) {\n    const map = new Map<string, { tenantCount: Set<string>; revenue: string; commission: string }>();\n    for (const rel of relationships) {\n      const campaignId = rel.campaignId ?? 'DIRECT';\n      if (!map.has(campaignId)) map.set(campaignId, { tenantCount: new Set(), revenue: '0', commission: '0' });\n      map.get(campaignId)!.tenantCount.add(rel.tenantId);\n    }\n    for (const com of commissions) {\n      if (com.currency.toUpperCase() !== currency) continue;\n      // Find relationship for tenant to get campaign\n      const rel = relationships.find(r => r.tenantId === com.tenantId);\n      const campaignId = rel?.campaignId ?? 'DIRECT';\n      if (!map.has(campaignId)) map.set(campaignId, { tenantCount: new Set(), revenue: '0', commission: '0' });\n      const entry = map.get(campaignId)!;\n      entry.revenue = this.addDecimal(entry.revenue, com.netEligibleRevenue, currency);\n      if (['ACCRUED', 'SETTLED', 'PAID'].includes(com.state)) {\n        entry.commission = this.addDecimal(entry.commission, com.commissionAmount, currency);\n      }\n    }\n    return [...map.entries()].map(([campaignId, data]) => ({\n      campaignId,\n      tenantCount: data.tenantCount.size,\n      revenue: data.revenue,\n      commission: data.commission,\n    }));\n  }\n\n  private generateIntervals(granularity: 'DAILY' | 'WEEKLY' | 'MONTHLY' | 'QUARTERLY' | 'LIFETIME', start: Date, end: Date): Array<{ start: Date; end: Date; label: string }> {\n    const intervals: Array<{ start: Date; end: Date; label: string }> = [];\n    if (granularity === 'LIFETIME') {\n      intervals.push({ start, end, label: 'LIFETIME' });\n      return intervals;\n    }\n\n    let current = new Date(start);\n    while (current < end) {\n      let next: Date;\n      let label: string;\n      switch (granularity) {\n        case 'DAILY':\n          next = new Date(current.getTime() + 24 * 3600000);\n          label = current.toISOString().slice(0, 10);\n          break;\n        case 'WEEKLY':\n          next = new Date(current.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 3600000);\n          label = `W${current.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`;\n          break;\n        case 'MONTHLY':\n          next = new Date(current.getFullYear(), current.getMonth() + 1, 1);\n          label = `${current.getFullYear()}-${String(current.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;\n          break;\n        case 'QUARTERLY':\n          const quarter = Math.floor(current.getMonth() / 3) + 1;\n          next = new Date(current.getFullYear(), quarter * 3, 1);\n          label = `${current.getFullYear()}-Q${quarter}`;\n          break;\n        default:\n          next = new Date(current.getTime() + 24 * 3600000);\n          label = current.toISOString().slice(0, 10);\n      }\n      if (next > end) next = new Date(end);\n      intervals.push({ start: new Date(current), end: new Date(next), label });\n      current = next;\n    }\n    return intervals;\n  }\n\n  private getMinorUnit(currency: string): number {\n    const map: Record<string, number> = { USD: 2, EUR: 2, GBP: 2, JPY: 0, USDT: 6, USDC: 6 };\n    return map[currency.toUpperCase()] ?? 2;\n  }\n\n  private toMinorUnits(amount: string, currency: string): bigint {\n    const minor = this.getMinorUnit(currency);\n    const factor = Math.pow(10, minor);\n    const parts = amount.toString().split('.');\n    const intPart = BigInt(parts[0] || '0');\n    let frac = parts[1] || '';\n    if (frac.length > minor) frac = frac.slice(0, minor);\n    while (frac.length < minor) frac += '0';\n    const fracPart = BigInt(frac || '0');\n    if (intPart < BigInt(0)) return intPart * BigInt(factor) - fracPart;\n    return intPart * BigInt(factor) + fracPart;\n  }\n\n  private fromMinorUnits(minor: bigint, currency: string): string {\n    const minorUnit = this.getMinorUnit(currency);\n    const factor = BigInt(Math.pow(10, minorUnit));\n    const isNegative = minor < BigInt(0);\n    const abs = isNegative ? -minor : minor;\n    const intPart = abs / factor;\n    const fracPart = abs % factor;\n    let fracStr = fracPart.toString().padStart(minorUnit, '0');\n    if (minorUnit > 0) {\n      fracStr = fracStr.replace(/0+$/, '');\n      if (fracStr === '') fracStr = '0'.repeat(Math.min(2, minorUnit));\n    }\n    const result = minorUnit === 0 ? intPart.toString() : `${intPart.toString()}.${fracStr}`;\n    return isNegative ? `-${result}` : result;\n  }\n\n  private addDecimal(a: string, b: string, currency: string): string {\n    return this.fromMinorUnits(this.toMinorUnits(a, currency) + this.toMinorUnits(b, currency), currency);\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partners/partner-attribution.service.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected };\n  }\n\n  function input(idempotencyKey = 'attrib-idem-1') {\n    return {\n      partnerId: 'partner-a',\n      tenantId: 'tenant-a',\n      attributionSource: 'TENANT_PROVISIONING',\n PrismaService) {}\n\n  async recordEvent(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    tenantId?: string | null;\n    actorId: string;\n    actorRole?: string | null;\n    action: PartnerAuditAction;\n    source: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n    agreementVersion?: string | null;\n    policyVersion?: string | null;\n    safeEvidence?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  }): Promise<PartnerAuditEvent> {\n    const redacted = this.redactEvidence(params.safeEvidence ?? {});\n\n    const event: PartnerAuditEvent = {\n      id: `paud_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId ?? null,\n      actorId: params.actorId,\n      actorRole: params.actorRole ?? null,\n      action: params.action,\n      source: params.source,\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      agreementVersion: params.agreementVersion ?? null,\n      policyVersion: params.policyVersion ?? null,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      safeEvidence: redacted,\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    this.inMemory.push(event);\n    if (this.inMemory.length > 5000) this.inMemory.splice(0, 1000);\n\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerAudit?.create?.({\n        data: {\n          id: event.id,\n          partnerId: event.partnerId,\n          tenantId: event.tenantId,\n          actorId: event.actorId,\n          actorRole: event.actorRole,\n          action: event.action,\n          source: event.source,\n          correlationId: event.correlationId,\n          agreementVersion: event.agreementVersion,\n          policyVersion: event.policyVersion,\n          timestamp: new Date(event.timestamp),\n          safeEvidence: redacted as any,\n          createdAt: new Date(event.createdAt),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`partner audit persist skipped id=${event.id}`);\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`audit partner=${params.partnerId} action=${params.action} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return event;\n  }\n\n  private redactEvidence(evidence: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {\n    const sensitive = ['password', 'secret', 'privateKey', 'apiKey', 'token', 'card', 'cvv', 'ssn', 'email', 'phone', 'address', 'government_id', 'kyc_doc', 'credential', 'signingSecret', 'private_key', 'jwt', 'bearer', 'iban', 'accountNumber'];\n    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};\n    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(evidence)) {\n      const lower = k.toLowerCase();\n      const isSensitive = sensitive.some(s => lower.includes(s.toLowerCase()));\n      if (isSensitive) out[k] = '***REDACTED***';\n      else if (typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 500) out[k] = v.slice(0, 500) + '...TRUNCATED';\n      else out[k] = v;\n    }\n    return out;\n  }\n\n  async listEvents(partnerId: string, filters?: { tenantId?: string; action?: PartnerAuditAction; correlationId?: string; take?: number }): Promise<PartnerAuditEvent[]> {\n    let list = this.inMemory.filter(e => e.partnerId === partnerId);\n    if (filters?.tenantId) list = list.filter(e => e.tenantId === filters.tenantId);\n    if (filters?.action) list = list.filter(e => e.action === filters.action);\n    if (filters?.correlationId) list = list.filter(e => e.correlationId === filters.correlationId);\n    list = list.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime());\n    if (filters?.take) list = list.slice(0, filters.take);\n\n    try {\n      const where: any = { partnerId };\n      if (filters?.tenantId) where.tenantId = filters.tenantId;\n      if (filters?.action) where.action = filters.action;\n      if (filters?.correlationId) where.correlationId = filters.correlationId;\n      const rows = await (this.prisma as any).partnerAudit?.findMany?.({ where, take: filters?.take ?? 200, orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' } });\n      if (rows && rows.length > 0) {\n        list = rows.map((r: any) => ({\n          id: r.id,\n          partnerId: r.partnerId,\n          tenantId: r.tenantId ?? null,\n          actorId: r.actorId,\n          actorRole: r.actorRole ?? null,\n          action: r.action,\n          source: r.source,\n          correlationId: r.correlationId,\n          agreementVersion: r.agreementVersion ?? null,\n          policyVersion: r.policyVersion ?? null,\n          timestamp: r.timestamp instanceof Date ? r.timestamp.toISOString() : r.timestamp,\n          safeEvidence: r.safeEvidence ?? {},\n
