'@nestjs/common';\nimport { PartnerCommission, PartnerCommissionState, PartnerCommissionModel, PartnerCommissionBasis } from './partner.types';\nimport { PartnerPolicyService } from './partner-policy.service';\nimport { PartnerAgreementService } from './partner-agreement.service';\nimport { PartnerAuditService } from './partner-audit.service';\nimport { PartnerAttributionService } from './partner-attribution.service';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerCommissionService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerCommissionService.name);\n  private readonly calculationVersion = '2026-01';\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly policyService: PartnerPolicyService,\n    private readonly agreementService: PartnerAgreementService,\n    private readonly audit: PartnerAuditService,\n    private readonly attributionService: PartnerAttributionService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * Calculates commission from authoritative payments/invoices/subscriptions/fees\n   * Supports revenue-share, fixed-fee, percentage, first-period, recurring-period\n   * No hardcoded rates, Decimal-safe\n   */\n  async calculateCommission(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    tenantId: string;\n    sourcePaymentId?: string | null;\n    sourceInvoiceId?: string | null;\n    sourceSubscriptionId?: string | null;\n    sourceFeeId?: string | null;\n    sourceEventId: string;\n    sourceEventType: 'PAYMENT' | 'INVOICE' | 'SUBSCRIPTION' | 'FEE' | 'REFUND' | 'CHARGEBACK';\n    grossRevenue: string;\n    discountAmount: string;\n    currency: string;\n    sourceCurrency?: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n    createdBy: string;\n    isTrial?: boolean;\n    isLifetime?: boolean;\n    isFirstPeriod?: boolean;\n    periodNumber?: number;\n    planCode?: string;\n    paymentStatus?: string;\n    invoiceStatus?: string;\n  }): Promise<PartnerCommission | null> {\n    if (!params.partnerId || !params.tenantId || !params.sourceEventId || !params.grossRevenue || !params.currency) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('partnerId, tenantId, sourceEventId, grossRevenue, currency required');\n    }\n\n    // Commission must NOT be generated from unpaid/failed/cancelled/unconfirmed/fake/test/unverified\n    if (params.paymentStatus) {\n      const invalidPaymentStatuses = ['FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'UNCONFIRMED', 'FAKE', 'TEST', 'PENDING', 'UNPAID'];\n      if (invalidPaymentStatuses.includes(params.paymentStatus.toUpperCase())) {\n        this.logger.log(`commission blocked - invalid payment status ${params.paymentStatus} event=${params.sourceEventId} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n        return null;\n      }\n    }\n    if (params.invoiceStatus) {\n      const invalidInvoiceStatuses = ['DRAFT', 'VOID', 'UNPAID', 'UNCOLLECTED', 'FAILED'];\n      if (invalidInvoiceStatuses.includes(params.invoiceStatus.toUpperCase())) {\n        this.logger.log(`commission blocked - invalid invoice status ${params.invoiceStatus} event=${params.sourceEventId} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n        return null;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const agreement = await this.agreementService.getActiveAgreement(params.partnerId);\n    if (!agreement) {\n      this.logger.warn(`no active agreement for partner ${params.partnerId}, commission blocked`);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    const policy = agreement.commissionPolicy;\n\n    // Trial handling\n    if (params.isTrial && !policy.trialCommissionEligible) {\n      this.logger.log(`trial commission not eligible per policy partner=${params.partnerId} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Lifetime handling\n    let commissionModel = policy.commissionModels[0] ?? PartnerCommissionModel.PERCENTAGE_REVENUE;\n    if (params.isLifetime) {\n      commissionModel = policy.lifetimeCommissionModel;\n    } else if (params.isFirstPeriod) {\n      // Prefer FIRST_PERIOD if configured\n      const firstPeriodModel = policy.commissionModels.find(m => m === PartnerCommissionModel.FIRST_PERIOD);\n      if (firstPeriodModel) commissionModel = firstPeriodModel;\n    }\n\n    // Find applicable rate config\n    const rateConfig = this.findApplicableRate(policy, commissionModel, params.planCode, params.grossRevenue);\n    if (!rateConfig) {\n      this.logger.warn(`no applicable commission rate for partner=${params.partnerId} model=${commissionModel} plan=${params.planCode}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Validate attribution exists\n    const attribution = await this.attributionService.getPrimaryAttributionForTenant(params.tenantId);\n    if (!attribution || attribution.partnerId !== params.partnerId) {\n      this.logger.warn(`no valid attribution for tenant=${params.tenantId} partner=${params.partnerId}, commission blocked`);\n      return null;\n    }\n    if (new Date(attribution.expiresAt) < new Date()) {\n      this.logger.warn(`attribution expired for tenant=${params.tenantId}, commission blocked`);\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Resolve commission basis\n    const basis = rateConfig.basis ?? policy.commissionBasis;\n    let netEligibleRevenue: string;\n    switch (basis) {\n      case PartnerCommissionBasis.LIST_PRICE:\n        netEligibleRevenue = params.grossRevenue;\n        break;\n      case PartnerCommissionBasis.DISCOUNTED_PRICE:\n      case PartnerCommissionBasis.NET_REVENUE:\n        netEligibleRevenue = this.subtractDecimal(params.grossRevenue, params.discountAmount, params.currency);\n        break;\n      case PartnerCommissionBasis.COLLECTED_REVENUE:\n        // For collected revenue, use gross - discount as eligible (actual collected)\n        netEligibleRevenue = this.subtractDecimal(params.grossRevenue, params.discountAmount, params.currency);\n        break;\n      default:\n        netEligibleRevenue = this.subtractDecimal(params.grossRevenue, params.discountAmount, params.currency);\n    }\n\n    // Check min eligible amount\n    if (rateConfig.minEligibleAmount) {\n      if (this.compareDecimal(netEligibleRevenue, rateConfig.minEligibleAmount, params.currency) < 0) {\n        this.logger.log(`net eligible ${netEligibleRevenue} below min ${rateConfig.minEligibleAmount}, commission blocked`);\n        return null;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Calculate commission amount Decimal-safe\n    let commissionAmount: string;\n    let commissionRateStr: string;\n\n    if (rateConfig.rateBasisPoints !== undefined) {\n      commissionRateStr = `${rateConfig.rateBasisPoints}bps`;\n      commissionAmount = this.calculatePercentage(netEligibleRevenue, rateConfig.rateBasisPoints, params.currency);\n    } else if (rateConfig.fixedAmount) {\n      commissionRateStr = `fixed:${rateConfig.fixedAmount}`;\n      commissionAmount = rateConfig.fixedAmount;\n      // Ensure fixed amount currency matches or FX required\n      if (rateConfig.currency && rateConfig.currency.toUpperCase() !== params.currency.toUpperCase()) {\n        // FX required - if unavailable, settlement blocked, but we still accrue with fxRequired=true\n      }\n    } else {\n      throw new BadRequestException('commission rate config must have rateBasisPoints or fixedAmount');\n    }\n\n    // Apply max commission cap\n    if (rateConfig.maxCommissionAmount) {\n      if (this.compareDecimal(commissionAmount, rateConfig.maxCommissionAmount, params.currency) > 0) {\n        commissionAmount = rateConfig.maxCommissionAmount;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Multi-currency handling\n    const sourceCurrency = (params.sourceCurrency ?? params.currency).toUpperCase();\n    const commissionCurrency = (rateConfig.currency ?? policy.currencyPolicy.settlementCurrency ?? params.currency).toUpperCase();\n    const fxRequired = sourceCurrency !== commissionCurrency;\n    let fxRate: string | null = null;\n    let fxTimestamp: string | null = null;\n    let fxSource: string | null = null;\n\n    if (fxRequired) {\n      // Try to fetch FX rate - if unavailable, mark fxRequired but keep commission for later settlement blocking\n      try {\n        const fx = await this.getFxRate(sourceCurrency, commissionCurrency);\n        if (fx) {\n          fxRate = fx.rate;\n          fxTimestamp = fx.timestamp;\n          fxSource = fx.source;\n          // Convert commission amount if needed - here we assume commissionAmount is already in source currency, need conversion\n          // For simplicity, if fixed amount in different currency, we keep as is and settlement will handle FX\n        } else {\n          this.logger.warn(`FX rate unavailable ${sourceCurrency}->${commissionCurrency}, commission accrued with fxRequired=true`);\n        }\n      } catch {\n        this.logger.warn(`FX fetch failed ${sourceCurrency}->${commissionCurrency}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const commission: PartnerCommission = {\n      id: `pcom_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      sourcePaymentId: params.sourcePaymentId ?? null,\n      sourceInvoiceId: params.sourceInvoiceId ?? null,\n      sourceSubscriptionId: params.sourceSubscriptionId ?? null,\n      sourceFeeId: params.sourceFeeId ?? null,\n      sourceEventId: params.sourceEventId,\n      sourceEventType: params.sourceEventType,\n      grossRevenue: params.grossRevenue,\n      discountAmount: params.discountAmount,\n      netEligibleRevenue,\n      commissionRate: commissionRateStr,\n      commissionBasis: basis,\n      commissionModel,\n      commissionAmount,\n      currency: params.currency.toUpperCase(),\n      sourceCurrency,\n      commissionCurrency,\n      fxRequired,\n      fxRate,\n      fxTimestamp,\n      fxSource,\n      agreementVersion: `v${agreement.version}`,\n      policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      calculationVersion: this.calculationVersion,\n      state: PartnerCommissionState.ACCRUED,\n      settlementId: null,\n      payoutId: null,\n      reversalOfId: null,\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      accruedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n    };\n\n    // Idempotency check via ledger service will be done there, but also check here\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).partnerCommission?.findFirst?.({ where: { idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) {\n        this.logger.log(`commission idempotent hit key=${params.idempotencyKey}`);\n        return this.mapRow(existing);\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    this.logger.log(`commission calculated partner=${params.partnerId} amount=${commissionAmount} ${params.currency} model=${commissionModel} basis=${basis} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return commission;\n  }\n\n  private findApplicableRate(policy: any, model: PartnerCommissionModel, planCode?: string, grossRevenue?: string): any {\n    // Find rate matching model and planCode, with effective dates\n    const now = new Date();\n    const candidates = policy.commissionRates.filter((r: any) => {\n      if (r.model !== model) return false;\n      const from = new Date(r.effectiveFrom);\n      if (from > now) return false;\n      if (r.effectiveTo) {\n        const to = new Date(r.effectiveTo);\n        if (to < now) return false;\n      }\n      if (r.planCodes && r.planCodes.length > 0 && planCode) {\n        if (!r.planCodes.includes(planCode)) return false;\n      }\n      return true;\n    });\n    // Prefer most specific (with planCodes) then highest rate\n    candidates.sort((a: any, b: any) => {\n      const aSpecific = a.planCodes?.length ? 1 : 0;\n      const bSpecific = b.planCodes?.length ? 1 : 0;\n      if (aSpecific !== bSpecific) return bSpecific - aSpecific;\n      return (b.rateBasisPoints ?? 0) - (a.rateBasisPoints ?? 0);\n    });\n    return candidates[0] ?? policy.commissionRates.find((r: any) => r.model === model) ?? policy.commissionRates[0] ?? null;\n  }\n\n  private async getFxRate(from: string, to: string): Promise<{ rate: string; timestamp: string; source: string } | null> {\n    // In production, this would call FX provider - here we return null to trigger SETTLEMENT_BLOCKED if FX required\n    // Never invent FX\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Decimal-safe helpers using BigInt minor units\n  private getMinorUnit(currency: string): number {\n    const map: Record<string, number> = { USD: 2, EUR: 2, GBP: 2, JPY: 0, USDT: 6, USDC: 6, BTC: 8, ETH: 18 };\n    return map[currency.toUpperCase()] ?? 2;\n  }\n\n  private toMinorUnits(amount: string, currency: string): bigint {\n    const minor = this.getMinorUnit(currency);\n    const factor = Math.pow(10, minor);\n    const parts = amount.toString().split('.');\n    const integerPart =  }\n\n  private fromMinorUnits(minor: bigint, currency: string): string {\n    const minorUnit = this.getMinorUnit(currency);\n    const factor = BigInt(Math.pow(10, minorUnit));\n    const isNegative = minor < BigInt(0);\n    const abs = isNegative ? -minor : minor;\n    const integerPart = abs / factor;\n    const fractionalPart = abs % factor;\n    let fractionalStr = return this.fromMinorUnits(aMinor - bMinor, currency);\n  }\n\n  private calculatePercentage(amount: string, basisPoints: number, currency: string): string {\n    const minor = throw new BadRequestException('partnerId, name, code, startsAt, idempotencyKey required');\n    }\n\n    await this.profileService.getProfile(params.partnerId);\n    const agreement = await (params.endsAt) {\n      const endsAt = new Date(params.endsAt);\n      if (isNaN(endsAt.getTime()) || endsAt <= startsAt) throw new BadRequestException('endsAt must be after startsAt');\n    }\n\n    if (params.discountType && params.discountValue) {\n      if (params.discountType === PartnerDiscountType.PERCENTAGE) {\n        const bps = Math.round(parseFloat(params.discountValue) * 100);\n        if (isNaN(bps) || bps <= 0 || bps > 10000) throw new BadRequestException('invalid percentage discount');\n        this.policyService.validateDiscount(agreement.commissionPolicy, bps, if (params.attributionWindowHours <= 0 || params.attributionWindowHours > 8760) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('attributionWindowHours must be 1-8760');\n    }\n\n    const campaign: campaign.discountCurrency,\n          maxUses: campaign.maxUses,\n          currentUses: campaign.currentUses,\n          allowedPlans: campaign.allowedPlans as any,\n          attributionWindowHours: campaign.attributionWindowHours,\n          startsAt: new Date(campaign.startsAt),\n          endsAt: campaign.endsAt ? new Date(campaign.endsAt) : null,\n          createdBy: campaign.createdBy,\n          createdAt: new Date(campaign.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(campaign.updatedAt),\n          idempotencyKey: campaign.idempotencyKey,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`campaign persist skipped id=${campaign.id}`);\n    }\n\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      actorId: params.createdBy,\n      action: agreement.commissionPolicy.policyVersion,\n      safeEvidence: { campaignId: campaign.id, code: campaign.code, discountType: campaign.discountType, discountValue: campaign.discountValue },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`campaign created id=${campaign.id} partner=${params.partnerId} code=${campaign.code} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return campaign;\n  }\n\n  async activateCampaign(params: { campaignId: string; partnerId: string; activatedBy: string; correlationId: string }): Promise<PartnerCampaign> {\n    const camp = await this.getCampaign(params.campaignId, camp.state = PartnerCampaignState.ACTIVE;\n    camp.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    this.inMemory.set(camp.id, camp);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerCampaign?.update?.({ where: { id: camp.id }, data: { state: camp.state, updatedAt: new Date(camp.updatedAt) } });\n    } catch {}\n    return camp;\n  }\n\n  async pauseCampaign(params: { campaignId: string; partnerId: string; pausedBy: string; correlationId: string }): Promise<PartnerCampaign> {\n    const camp = await this.getCampaign(params.campaignId, params.partnerId);\n    if Date(camp.updatedAt) } });\n    } catch {}\n    return camp;\n  }\n\n  async getCampaign(campaignId: string, partnerId: string): Promise<PartnerCampaign> {\n    const mem = row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerCampaign?.findUnique?.({ where: { id: campaignId } });\n      if (row) {\n        if (row.partnerId !== partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partner [...this.inMemory.values()].filter(c => c.partnerId === partnerId);\n    if (filters?.state) list = list.filter(c => c.state === filters.state);\n    try {\n      const where: any = { partnerId };\n      if (filters?.state) where.state = filters.state;\n      const rows = await (this.prisma as any).partnerCampaign?.findMany?.({ where, take: 200, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } });\n      if (rows && rows.length > 0) list = rows.map((r: any) => this.mapRow(r));\n    } catch {}\n    return list;\n  }\n\n  async incrementUsage(campaignId: string, partnerId: string): Promise<PartnerCampaign> {\n statements from persisted billing/finance/commission records\n * Does not create a second invoice authority - references authoritative billing truth only\n * Never mutates invoice directly - derivative statement layer\n */\nexport interface PartnerInvoiceStatement {\n  id: string;\n  partnerId: string;\n  settlementId?: string | null;\n  periodStart: string;\n  periodEnd: string;\n  currency: string;\n  grossRevenue: string;\n  discount: string;\n  netEligibleRevenue: string;\n  commissionAccrued: string;\n  commissionReversed: string;\n  commissionPayable: string;\n  commissionCount: number;\n  invoiceReferences: string[];\n  paymentReferences: string[];\n  subscriptionReferences: string[];\n  generatedAt: string;\n  calculationVersion: string;\n  policyVersion: string;\n  agreementVersion: string;\n  isImmutable: boolean;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerInvoiceService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerInvoiceService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly profileService: PartnerProfileService,\n    private readonly commissionLedger: PartnerCommissionLedgerService,\n    private readonly settlementService: PartnerSettlementService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async generateStatement(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    periodStart: string;\n    periodEnd: string;\n    currency: string;\n    settlementId?: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n  }): Promise<PartnerInvoiceStatement> {\n    if (!params.partnerId || !params.periodStart || !params.periodEnd || !params.currency) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('partnerId, periodStart, periodEnd, currency required');\n    }\n\n    await this.profileService.getProfile(params.partnerId);\n\n    const periodStart = new Date(params.periodStart);\n    const periodEnd = new Date(params.periodEnd);\n    if (isNaN(periodStart.getTime()) || isNaN(periodEnd.getTime()) || periodStart >= periodEnd) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('invalid period');\n    }\n\n    let settlement: any = null;\n    if (params.settlementId) {\n      settlement = await this.settlementService.getSettlement(params.settlementId, params.partnerId);\n    }\n\n    const commissions = await this.commissionLedger.listCommissions(params.partnerId, { currency: params.currency });\n    const inPeriod = commissions.filter(c => {\n      const accrued = new Date(c.accruedAt);\n      return accrued >= periodStart && accrued <= periodEnd;\n    });\n\n    let gross = '0';\n    let discount = '0';\n    let netEligible = '0';\n    let accrued = '0';\n    let reversed = '0';\n    const invoiceRefs: string[] = [];\n    const paymentRefs: string[] = [];\n    const subRefs: string[] = [];\n\n    for (const com of inPeriod) {\n      gross = this.addDecimal(gross, com.grossRevenue, params.currency);\n      discount = this.addDecimal(discount, com.discountAmount, params.currency);\n      netEligible = this.addDecimal(netEligible, com.netEligibleRevenue, params.currency);\n      if (com.state === 'ACCRUED' || com.state === 'SETTLED' || com.state === 'PAID') {\n        accrued = this.addDecimal(accrued, com.commissionAmount, params.currency);\n      } else if (com.state === 'REVERSED') {\n        reversed = this.addDecimal(reversed, com.commissionAmount, params.currency);\n      }\n      if (com.sourceInvoiceId) invoiceRefs.push(com.sourceInvoiceId);\n      if (com.sourcePaymentId) paymentRefs.push(com.sourcePaymentId);\n      if (com.sourceSubscriptionId) subRefs.push(com.sourceSubscriptionId);\n    }\n\n    const payable = this.addDecimal(accrued, reversed, params.currency);\n\n    const statement: PartnerInvoiceStatement = {\n      id: `pstmt_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      settlementId: settlement?.id ?? null,\n      periodStart: periodStart.toISOString(),\n      periodEnd: periodEnd.toISOString(),\n      currency: params.currency.toUpperCase(),\n      grossRevenue: gross,\n      discount,\n      netEligibleRevenue: '2026-01',\n      agreementVersion: settlement?.agreementVersion ?? 'v1',\n      isImmutable: false,\n    };\n\n    this.logger.log(`partner invoice statement generated partner=${params.partnerId} payable=${payable} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return statement;\n  }\n\n  async listStatements(partnerId: string, filters?: { currency?: string }): Promise<PartnerInvoiceStatement[]> {\n    // In production, this would query persisted statements\n    // For now, generate from settlements\n    const settlements = await this.settlementService.listSettlements(partnerId, { currency: filters?.currency });\n    return settlements.map(s => ({\n      id: `pstmt_${s.id}`,\n      partnerId: s.partnerId,\n      settlementId: s.id,\n      periodStart: s.periodStart,\n      periodEnd: s.periodEnd,\n      currency: s.currency,\n      grossRevenue: s.totalGrossRevenue,\n      discount: s.totalDiscount,\n      netEligibleRevenue: s.totalNetEligibleRevenue,\n      commissionAccrued: s.totalCommissionAccrued,\n      commissionReversed: s.totalCommissionReversed,\n      commissionPayable: s.totalCommissionPayable,\n      commissionCount: s.commissionCount,\n      invoiceReferences: [],\n      paymentReferences: [],\n      subscriptionReferences: [],\n      generatedAt: s.createdAt,\n      calculationVersion: s.calculationVersion,\n      policyVersion: s.policyVersion,\n      agreementVersion: s.agreementVersion,\n      isImmutable: true,\n    }));\n  }\n\n  private getMinorUnit(currency: string): number {\n    const map: Record<string, number> = { USD: 2, EUR: 2, GBP: 2, JPY: 0, USDT: 6, USDC: 6 };\n    return map[currency.toUpperCase()] ?? 2;\n  }\n\n  private toMinorUnits(amount: string, currency: string): bigint {\n    const minor = this.getMinorUnit(currency);\n    const factor = Math.pow(10, minor);\n    const parts = amount.toString().split('.');\n    const intPart = BigInt(parts[0] || '0');\n    let frac = parts[1] || '';\n    if (frac.length > minor) frac = frac.slice(0, minor);\n    while (frac.length < minor) frac += '0';\n    const fracPart = BigInt(frac || '0');\n    if (intPart < BigInt(0)) return intPart * BigInt(factor) - fracPart;\n    return intPart * BigInt(factor) + fracPart;\n  }\n\n  private fromMinorUnits(minor: bigint, currency: string): string {\n    const minorUnit = this.getMinorUnit(currency);\n    const factor = BigInt(Math.pow(10, minorUnit));\n    const isNegative = minor < BigInt(0);\n    const abs = isNegative ? Map<string, PartnerPayout> = new Map();\n  private readonly idemIndex: Map<string, string> = new Map();\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly audit: PartnerAuditService,\n    private readonly profileService: PartnerProfileService,\n    private readonly settlementService: PartnerSettlementService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async requestPayout(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    settlementId: string;\n    amount: string;\n    currency: string;\n    method: string;\n    requestedBy: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n  }): settlementId, amount, currency, idempotencyKey required');\n    }\n\n    await this.profileService.getProfile(params.partnerId);\n\n    // Idempotency\n    if (this.idemIndex.has(params.idempotencyKey)) {\n      const existingId = this.idemIndex.get(params.idempotencyKey)!;\n      const existing = this.inMemory.get(existingId);\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    }\n\n    // Settlement must exist and be in appropriate state\n    const settlement = await this.settlementService.getSettlement(params.settlementId, params.partnerId);\n    if (settlement.state !== PartnerSettlementState.LOCKED && settlement.state !== PartnerSettlementState.PAYOUT_REQUESTED && settlement.state !== PartnerSettlementState.COMPLETED) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`settlement must be LOCKED to request payout, current ${settlement.state}`);\n    }\n\n    if (settlement.totalCommissionPayable !== params.amount && this.compareDecimal(settlement.totalCommissionPayable, params.amount, params.currency) !== 0) {\n      // Allow but warn if mismatch - should match\n      this.logger.warn(`payout amount ${params.amount} differs from settlement payable ${settlement.totalCommissionPayable}`);\n    }\n\n    if (settlement.currency.toUpperCase() !== params.currency.toUpperCase()) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`currency mismatch settlement ${settlement.currency} vs payout ${params.currency}`);\n    }\n\n    const payout: PartnerPayout = {\n      id: `ppay_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      settlementId: params.settlementId,\n      amount: params.amount,\n      currency: params.currency.toUpperCase(),\n      state: PartnerPayoutState.REQUESTED,\n      method: params.method,\n      providerPayoutId: null,\n      providerReference: null,\n      failureReason: null,\n      requestedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      requestedBy: params.requestedBy,\n      approvedAt: null,\n      approvedBy: null,\n      submittedAt: null,\n      completedAt: null,\n      failedAt: null,\n      reversedAt: null,\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n    };\n\n    this.inMemory.set(payout.id, payout);\n    this.idemIndex.set(params.idempotencyKey, payout.id);\n\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerPayout?.create?.({\n        data: {\n          id: payout.id,\n          partnerId: payout.partnerId,\n          settlementId: payout.settlementId,\n          amount: payout.amount,\n          currency: payout.currency,\n          state: payout.state,\n          method: payout.method,\n          requestedAt: new Date(payout.requestedAt),\n          requestedBy: payout.requestedBy,\n          createdAt: new Date(payout.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(payout.updatedAt),\n          idempotencyKey: payout.idempotencyKey,\n          correlationId: payout.correlationId,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`payout persist skipped id=${payout.id}`);\n    }\n\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      actorId: params.requestedBy,\n      action: PartnerAuditAction.PAYOUT_REQUESTED,\n      source: 'PARTNER_PAYOUT_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      safeEvidence: { payoutId: payout.id, settlementId: params.settlementId, amount: payout.amount, currency: payout.currency },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`payout requested id=${payout.id} partner=${params.partnerId} amount=${params.amount} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return payout;\n  }\n\n  async transitionState(params: {\n    payoutId: string;\n    partnerId: string;\n    targetState: PartnerPayoutState;\n    correlationId: string;\n    actorId: string;\n    providerPayoutId?: string;\n    providerReference?: string;\n    failureReason?: string;\n  }): Promise<PartnerPayout> {\n    const payout = await this.getPayout(params.payoutId, params.partnerId);\n    const allowed = PARTNER_PAYOUT_TRANSITIONS[payout.state];\n    if (!allowed.includes(params.targetState)) throw new Date().toISOString();\n    }\n\n    if (params.targetState === PartnerPayoutState.APPROVED) {\n      payout.approvedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n      payout.approvedBy = params.actorId;\n    }\n    if (params.targetState === PartnerPayoutState.SUBMITTED) payout.submittedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    if (params.targetState === PartnerPayoutState.FAILED) {\n      if (!params.failureReason) throw new BadRequestException('failureReason required for FAILED');\n      payout.failureReason = params.failureReason;\n      payout.failedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    }\n    if (params.targetState === PartnerPayoutState.REVERSED) payout.reversedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    const prev = payout.state;\n    payout.state = params.targetState;\n    payout.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    this.inMemory.set(payout.id, payout);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerPayout?.update?.({\n        where: { id: payout.id },\n        data: {\n          state: payout.state,\n          providerPayoutId: payout.providerPayoutId,\n          providerReference: payout.providerReference,\n          failureReason: payout.failureReason,\n          approvedAt: payout.approvedAt ? new Date(payout.approvedAt) : null,\n          approvedBy: payout.approvedBy,\n          submittedAt: payout.submittedAt ? new Date(payout.submittedAt) : null,\n          completedAt: payout.completedAt ? new Date(payout.completedAt) : null,\n          failedAt: payout.failedAt ? new Date(payout.failedAt) : null,\n          reversedAt: payout.reversedAt ? new Date(payout.reversedAt) : null,\n          updatedAt: new Date(payout.updatedAt),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`payout transition persist skipped id=${payout.id}`);\n    }\n\n    const auditAction = params.targetState === PartnerPayoutState.COMPLETED ? PartnerAuditAction.PAYOUT_COMPLETED\n      : params.targetState === PartnerPayoutState.FAILED ? PartnerAuditAction.PAYOUT_FAILED\n      : params.targetState === PartnerPayoutState.REVERSED ? PartnerAuditAction.PAYOUT_REVERSED\n      : PartnerAuditAction.PAYOUT_REQUESTED;\n\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      actorId: params.actorId,\n      action: auditAction,\n      source: 'PARTNER_PAYOUT_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      safeEvidence: { payoutId: payout.id, from: prev, to: params.targetState, providerPayoutId: payout.providerPayoutId },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`payout transition id=${payout.id} ${prev} -> ${params.targetState} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return payout;\n  }\n\n  async getPayout(payoutId: string, partnerId: string): Promise<PartnerPayout> {\n    const mem = this.inMemory.get(payoutId);\n    if (mem) {\n      if (mem.partnerId !== partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partner isolation violation');\n      return mem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerPayout?.findUnique?.({ where: { id: payoutId } });\n      if (row) {\n        if (row.partnerId !== partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partner isolation violation');\n        const mapped = this.mapRow(row);\n        this.inMemory.set(mapped.id, mapped);\n        return mapped;\n      }\n    } catch {}\n    throw new NotFoundException(`payout ${payoutId} not found`);\n  }\n\n  async listPayouts(partnerId: string, filters?: { settlementId?: string; state?: PartnerPayoutState }): Promise<PartnerPayout[]> {\n    let list = [...this.inMemory.values()].filter(p => p.partnerId === partnerId);\n    if (filters?.settlementId) list = list.filter(p => p.settlementId === filters.settlementId);\n    if (filters?.state) list = list.filter(p => p.state === filters.state);\n    try {\n      const where: any = { partnerId };\n      if (filters?.settlementId) where.settlementId = filters.settlementId;\n      if (filters?.state) where.state = filters.state;\n      const rows = await (this.prisma as any).partnerPayout?.findMany?.({ where, take: 500, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } });\n      if (rows && rows.length > 0) list = rows.map((r: any) => this.mapRow(r));\n    } catch {}\n    return list;\n  }\n\n  private compareDecimal(a: string, b: string, currency: string): number {\n    const getMinor = (c: string) => {\n      const map: Record<string, number> = { USD: 2, EUR: 2, GBP: 2, JPY: 0, USDT: 6, USDC: 6 };\n      return map[c.toUpperCase()] ?? 2;\n    };\n    const toMinor = (amt: string, curr: string) => {\n      const minor = getMinor(curr);\n      const factor = Math.pow(10, minor);\n      const parts = amt.toString().split('.');\n      const intPart = BigInt(parts[0] || '0');\n      let frac = parts[1] || '';\n      if (frac.length > minor) frac = frac.slice(0, minor);\n      while (frac.length < minor) frac += '0';\n      const fracPart = BigInt(frac || '0');\n      return intPart * BigInt(factor) + fracPart;\n    };\n    const aMinor = toMinor(a, currency);\n    const bMinor = toMinor(b, currency);\n    if (aMinor < bMinor) return -1;\n    if (aMinor > bMinor) return 1;\n    return 0;\n  }\n\n  private mapRow(row: any): PartnerPayout {\n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      partnerId: row.partnerId,\n      settlementId: row.settlementId,\n      amount: row.amount,\n      currency: row.currency,\n      state: row.state,\n      method: row.method,\n      providerPayoutId: row.requestedAt.toISOString() : row.requestedAt,\n      requestedBy: row.requestedBy,\n      approvedAt: row.approvedAt ? (row.approvedAt instanceof Date ? row.approvedAt.toISOString() : row.approvedAt) : null,\n      approvedBy: row.approvedBy ?? null,\n      submittedAt: row.submittedAt ? '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PartnerProfileService } from './partner-profile.service';\nimport { PartnerTenantService } from './partner-tenant.service';\nimport { PartnerCommissionLedgerService } from './partner-commission-ledger.service';\nimport { PartnerSettlementService } from './partner-settlement.service';\nimport { PartnerPayoutService } from './partner-payout.service';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\n\nexport interface PartnerPerformance {\n  partnerId: string;\n  periodStart?: string;\n  periodEnd?: string;\n  referredTenants: number;\n  activeTenants: number;\n  conversionRate: string;\n  mrrAttributed: string;\n  grossAttributedRevenue: string;\n  netEligibleRevenue: string;\n  commissionAccrued: string;\n  commissionReversed: string;\n  commissionPayable: string;\n  commissionPaid: string;\n  pendingSettlement: string;\n  pendingPayout: string;\n  refunds: number;\n  chargebacks: number;\n  churnRate: string;\n  activeSubscriptions: number;\n  customerRetentionRate: string;\n  generatedAt: string;\n  currency: string;\n  calculationVersion: string;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerPerformanceService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerPerformanceService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly profileService: PartnerProfileService,\n    private readonly tenantService: PartnerTenantService,\n    private readonly commissionLedger: PartnerCommissionLedgerService,\n    private readonly settlementService: PartnerSettlementService,\n    private readonly payoutService: PartnerPayoutService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async calculatePerformance(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    periodStart?: string;\n    periodEnd?: string;\n    currency?: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n  }): Promise<PartnerPerformance> {\n    if (!params.partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partnerId required');\n    await this.profileService.getProfile(params.partnerId);\n\n    const currency = (params.currency ?? 'USD').toUpperCase();\n    const periodStart = params.periodStart ? new Date(params.periodStart) : null;\n    const periodEnd = params.periodEnd ? new Date(params.periodEnd) : null;\n\n    const relationships = await this.tenantService.listTenantsForPartner(params.partnerId);\n    const referredTenants = relationships.length;\n    const activeTenants = relationships.filter(r => r.state === 'ACTIVE').length;\n\n    const commissions = await this.commissionLedger.listCommissions(params.partnerId, { currency });\n    let filteredCommissions = commissions;\n    if (periodStart && periodEnd) {\n      filteredCommissions = commissions.filter(c => {\n        const accrued = new Date(c.accruedAt);\n        return accrued >= periodStart && accrued <= periodEnd;\n      });\n    }\n\n    let grossAttributed = '0';\n    let netEligible = '0';\n    let commissionAccrued = '0';\n    let commissionReversed = '0';\n    let refunds = 0;\n    let chargebacks = 0;\n\n    for (const com of filteredCommissions) {\n      grossAttributed = this.addDecimal(grossAttributed, com.grossRevenue, currency);\n      netEligible = this.addDecimal(netEligible, com.netEligibleRevenue, currency);\n      if (com.state === 'ACCRUED' || com.state === 'SETTLED' || com.state === 'PAID' || com.state === 'PAYOUT_PENDING') {\n        commissionAccrued = this.addDecimal(commissionAccrued, com.commissionAmount, currency);\n      } else if (com.state === 'REVERSED') {\n        commissionReversed = this.addDecimal(commissionReversed, com.commissionAmount, currency);\n        if (com.sourceEventType === 'REFUND') refunds++;\n        if (com.sourceEventType === 'CHARGEBACK') chargebacks++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const commissionPayable = this.addDecimal(commissionAccrued, commissionReversed, currency);\n\n    const settlements = await this.settlementService.listSettlements(params.partnerId, { currency });\n    let pendingSettlement = '0';\n    for (const s of Without this the policy would\n * carry \"3000\" / \"720\" as strings into persisted JSON and Int columns.\n * A malformed value is a misconfiguration and fails loudly.\n */\nfunction envInteger(raw: unknown, fallback: number, name: string, min: number, max: number): number {\n  if (raw === undefined || raw === null || (typeof raw === 'string' && raw.trim() === '')) return fallback;\n  const n = typeof raw === 'number' ? raw : Number(String(raw).trim());\n  if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < min || n > max) {\n    throw new Error(`partner policy: ${name} must be an integer between ${min} and ${max}, got ${JSON.stringify(raw)}`);\n  }\n  return n;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerPolicyService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerPolicyService.name);\n  private readonly policyVersion: string;\n  private readonly defaultCommissionBasis: PartnerCommissionBasis;\n  private readonly settlementCurrency: string;\n  private readonly allowedCurrencies: string[];\n  private readonly maxDiscountBasisPoints: number;\n  private readonly attributionWindowHours: number;\n\n  constructor(private readonly config: ConfigService) {\n    this.policyVersion = this.config.get<string>('PARTNER_POLICY_VERSION', '2026-01') ?? this.defaultCommissionBasis,\n      commissionModels: params.storedPolicy?.commissionModels ?? this.getCommissionModels(params.partnerType),\n      commissionRates: params.storedPolicy?.commissionRates ?? baseRates,\n      discountRules: params.storedPolicy?.discountRules ?? {\n        maxDiscountBasisPoints: this.maxDiscountBasisPoints,\n        allowedDiscountTypes: [PartnerDiscountType.PERCENTAGE, PartnerDiscountType.FIXED_AMOUNT, PartnerDiscountType.CAMPAIGN],\n        stackingAllowed: false,\n        requiresApproval: true,\n        allowedCurrencies: this.allowedCurrencies,\n        maxActiveDiscounts: 10,\n      },\n      attributionWindowHours: params.storedPolicy?.attributionWindowHours ?? this.attributionWindowHours,\n      settlementSchedule: params.storedPolicy?.settlementSchedule ?? {\n        frequency: 'MONTHLY',\n        dayOfMonth: 1,\n        minPayoutAmount: this.config.get<string>('PARTNER_MIN_PAYOUT_AMOUNT', '50.00') ?? default:\n        return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  private getOnboardingRequirements(partnerType: PartnerType): string[] {\n    const base = ['KYC', 'BUSINESS_VERIFICATION', 'TAX_FORM'];\n    if private getCommissionModels(partnerType: PartnerType): PartnerCommissionModel[] {\n    switch (partnerType) {\n      case PartnerType.AFFILIATE:\n      case PartnerType.REFERRAL_PARTNER:\n        return [PartnerCommissionModel.PERCENTAGE_REVENUE, PartnerCommissionModel.FIRST_PERIOD];\n      case PartnerType.RESELLER:\n      case PartnerType.AGENCY:\n        return [PartnerCommissionModel.PERCENTAGE_REVENUE, PartnerCommissionModel.RECURRING_PERIOD, PartnerCommissionModel.FIXED_AMOUNT];\n      case PartnerType.WHITE_LABEL_PARTNER:\n      case PartnerType.MANAGED_SERVICE_PROVIDER:\n      case PartnerType.INSTITUTIONAL_DISTRIBUTOR:\n        return [PartnerCommissionModel.PERCENTAGE_REVENUE, PartnerCommissionModel.RECURRING_PERIOD, agreement\n    const raw = this.config.get<string>('PARTNER_COMMISSION_RATES_JSON', '');\n    if (raw) {\n      try {\n        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);\n        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {\n fixedAmount: r.fixedAmount,\n            currency: r.currency ?? this.settlementCurrency,\n            firstPeriodOnly: r.firstPeriodOnly,\n            recurringPeriods: r.recurringPeriods,\n            minEligibleAmount: r.minEligibleAmount,\n            maxCommissionAmount: r.maxCommissionAmount,\n            planCodes: r.planCodes,\n            effectiveFrom: r.effectiveFrom ?? new Date().toISOString(),\n            effectiveTo: r.effectiveTo ?? null,\n          }));\n        }\n      } catch {\n        this.logger.warn('Failed to parse PARTNER_COMMISSION_RATES_JSON, using empty rates - agreement must provide rates');\n      }\n    }\n    // Return empty - forces agreement to provide explicit rates, never invent\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  private validatePolicy(policy: PartnerPolicy): void {\n    if (!policy.commissionBasis) throw new BadRequestException('commissionBasis required');\n    if (!Object.values(PartnerCommissionBasis).includes(policy.commissionBasis)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`invalid commissionBasis ${policy.commissionBasis}`);\n    }\n    if (policy.attributionWindowHours <= 0 || policy.attributionWindowHours > 8760 * 2) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('attributionWindowHours must be 1-17520');\n    }\n    if (policy.commissionRates.length > 0) {\n      for (const rate of policy.commissionRates) {\n        if (rate.rateBasisPoints !== undefined && (rate.rateBasisPoints < 0 || rate.rateBasisPoints > 10000)) {\n          throw new BadRequestException(`invalid rateBasisPoints ${rate.rateBasisPoints}`);\n        }\n        if (rate.fixedAmount !== undefined) {\n          const amt = parseFloat(rate.fixedAmount);\n          if (isNaN(amt) || amt < 0) throw new BadRequestException(`invalid fixedAmount ${rate.fixedAmount}`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    if (!policy.currencyPolicy.allowedCurrencies.includes(policy.currencyPolicy.settlementCurrency)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('settlementCurrency must be in allowedCurrencies');\n    }\n  }\n\n  resolveCommissionBasis(policy: PartnerPolicy): PartnerCommissionBasis {\n    return policy.commissionBasis;\n  }\n\n  isTrialCommissionEligible(policy: PartnerPolicy): boolean {\n    return policy.trialCommissionEligible;\n  }\n\n  getAttributionWindowHours(policy: PartnerPolicy): number {\n    return policy.attributionWindowHours;\n  }\n\n  isSubPartnerAllowed(policy: PartnerPolicy): boolean {\n    return policy.subPartnerAllowed;\n  }\n\n  validateDiscount(policy: PartnerPolicy, discountBasisPoints: number, currency: string, fixedAmount?: string): void {\n    if (discountBasisPoints > policy.discountRules.maxDiscountBasisPoints) {\n      throw new validateCurrency(policy: PartnerPolicy, currency: string): void {\n    if (!policy.currencyPolicy.allowedCurrencies.includes(currency.toUpperCase())) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`currency '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PartnerAgreementService } from './partner-agreement.service';\nimport { PartnerPolicyService } from './partner-policy.service';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\n\nexport interface EffectivePrice {\n  platformListPrice: string;\n  partnerDiscount: string;\n  customerNetPrice: string;\n  currency: string;\n  pricingPolicyVersion: string;\n  agreementVersion: string;\n  planCode: string;\n  discountBasisPoints?: number;\n  calculationVersion: string;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerPricingService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerPricingService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly agreementService: PartnerAgreementService,\n    private readonly policyService: PartnerPolicyService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * Resolves effective customer price from canonical SubscriptionPlan + approved partner pricing/discount policy\n   * Uses Decimal-safe arithmetic and preserves original platform price, discount, net customer price\n   */\n  async resolveEffectivePrice(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    planCode: string;\n    currency?: string;\n    campaignId?: string;\n    discountCode?: string;\n  }): Promise<EffectivePrice> {\n    if (!params.partnerId || !params.planCode) throw new BadRequestException('partnerId and planCode required');\n\n    const agreement = await this.agreementService.getActiveAgreement(params.partnerId);\n    if (!agreement) throw new BadRequestException(`no active agreement for partner ${params.partnerId}`);\n\n    // Fetch canonical plan price - never hardcode\n    let canonicalPlan: any = null;\n    try {\n      canonicalPlan = await (this.prisma as any).subscriptionPlan?.findFirst?.({ where: { code: params.planCode, deletedAt: null } })\n        ?? await (this.prisma as any).subscriptionPlan?.findFirst?.({ where: { id: params.planCode } });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`canonical plan fetch fallback planCode=${params.planCode}`);\n    }\n\n    if (!canonicalPlan) throw new BadRequestException(`canonical plan ${params.planCode} not found`);\n\n    const platformListPrice = (canonicalPlan.price ?? canonicalPlan.amount ?? '0').toString();\n    const planCurrency = (canonicalPlan.currency ?? 'USD').toUpperCase();\n    const targetCurrency = (params.currency ?? planCurrency).toUpperCase();\n\n    if (targetCurrency !== planCurrency) {\n      // Multi-currency must remain explicit - check policy\n      this.policyService.validateCurrency(agreement.commissionPolicy, targetCurrency);\n    }\n\n    // Resolve pricing rule from agreement\n    const pricingRule = agreement.pricingRules.find(r => r.planCode === params.planCode || r.planCode === canonicalPlan.code);\n    let partnerDiscount = '0';\n    let discountBps = 0;\n\n    if (pricingRule) {\n      if (!pricingRule.allowed) throw new BadRequestException(`plan ${params.planCode} not allowed per agreement`);\n      if (pricingRule.partnerPriceOverride) {\n        // Partner price override - calculate discount as difference\n        const override = pricingRule.partnerPriceOverride;\n        partnerDiscount = this.subtractDecimal(platformListPrice, override, planCurrency);\n        if (this.isNegative(partnerDiscount)) partnerDiscount = '0';\n      } else if (pricingRule.discountBasisPoints) {\n        discountBps = pricingRule.discountBasisPoints;\n        this.policyService.validateDiscount(agreement.commissionPolicy, discountBps, targetCurrency);\n        partnerDiscount = this.calculatePercentage(platformListPrice, discountBps, planCurrency);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Campaign discount if provided - must not mutate invoice directly\n    if (params.campaignId) {\n      try {\n        const campaign = await (this.prisma as any).partnerCampaign?.findUnique?.({ where: { id: params.campaignId } });\n        if (campaign && campaign.partnerId === params.partnerId && campaign.state === 'ACTIVE') {\n          const now = new Date();\n          const startsAt = new Date(campaign.startsAt);\n          const endsAt = campaign.endsAt ? new Date(campaign.endsAt) : null;\n          if (now >= startsAt && (!endsAt || now <= endsAt)) {\n            if (campaign.discountType === 'PERCENTAGE' && campaign.discountValue) {\n              const campBps = Math.round(parseFloat(campaign.discountValue) * 100);\n              if (!agreement.commissionPolicy.discountRules.stackingAllowed && discountBps > 0) {\n                throw new BadRequestException('discount stacking not allowed per policy');\n              }\n              const campDiscount = this.calculatePercentage(platformListPrice, campBps, planCurrency);\n              partnerDiscount = this.addDecimal(partnerDiscount, campDiscount, planCurrency);\n              discountBps += campBps;\n            } else if (campaign.discountType === 'FIXED_AMOUNT' && campaign.discountValue) {\n              if (!agreement.commissionPolicy.discountRules.stackingAllowed && this.compareDecimal(partnerDiscount, '0', planCurrency) > 0) {\n                throw new BadRequestException('discount stacking not allowed');\n              }\n              partnerDiscount = this.addDecimal(partnerDiscount, campaign.discountValue, planCurrency);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        if (e instanceof BadRequestException) throw e;\n        this.logger.debug(`campaign discount lookup skipped campaignId=${params.campaignId}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const customerNetPrice = this.subtractDecimal(platformListPrice, partnerDiscount, planCurrency);\n    if (this.isNegative(customerNetPrice)) throw new BadRequestException('discount exceeds platform price');\n\n    const effective: EffectivePrice = {\n      platformListPrice,\n      partnerDiscount,\n      customerNetPrice,\n      currency: targetCurrency,\n      pricingPolicyVersion: agreement.commissionPolicy.policyVersion,\n      agreementVersion: `v${agreement.version}`,\n      planCode: canonicalPlan.code ?? params.planCode,\n      discountBasisPoints: discountBps || undefined,\n      calculationVersion: `calc_${agreement.commissionPolicy.policyVersion}_${agreement.version}`,\n    };\n\n    this.logger.log(`effective price partner=${params.partnerId} plan=${params.planCode} list=${platformListPrice} discount=${partnerDiscount} net=${customerNetPrice} corr=pricing`);\n    return effective;\n  }\n\n  // Decimal-safe arithmetic using minor units to avoid floating point\n  private getMinorUnit(currency: string): number {\n    const map: Record<string, number> = { USD: 2, EUR: 2, GBP: 2, JPY: 0, USDT: 6, USDC: 6, BTC: 8, ETH: 18 };\n    return map[currency.toUpperCase()] ?? 2;\n  }\n\n  private toMinorUnits(amount: string, currency: string): bigint {\n    const minor = this.getMinorUnit(currency);\n    const factor = Math.pow(10, minor);\n    // Parse string safely\n    const parts = amount.toString().split('.');\n    const integerPart = BigInt(parts[0] || '0');\n    let fractional = parts[1] || '';\n    if (fractional.length > minor) fractional = fractional.slice(0, minor);\n    while (fractional.length < minor) fractional += '0';\n    const fractionalPart = BigInt(fractional || '0');\n    if (integerPart < BigInt(0)) {\n      return integerPart * BigInt(factor) - fractionalPart;\n    }\n    return integerPart * BigInt(factor) + fractionalPart;\n  }\n\n  private fromMinorUnits(minor: bigint, currency: string): string {\n    const minorUnit = this.getMinorUnit(currency);\n    const factor = BigInt(Math.pow(10, minorUnit));\n    const isNegative = minor < BigInt(0);\n    const abs = isNegative ? -minor : minor;\n    const integerPart = abs / factor;\n    const fractionalPart = abs % factor;\n    let fractionalStr = fractionalPart.toString().padStart(minorUnit, '0');\n    // Trim trailing zeros but keep at least 2 decimals for USD-like\n    if (minorUnit > 0) {\n      fractionalStr = fractionalStr.replace(/0+$/, '');\n      if (fractionalStr === '') fractionalStr = '0'.repeat(Math.min(2, minorUnit));\n      else if (fractionalStr.length < 2 && ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'].includes(currency.toUpperCase())) {\n        fractionalStr = fractionalStr.padEnd(2, '0');\n      }\n    }\n    const result = minorUnit === 0 ? integerPart.toString() : `${integerPart.toString()}.${fractionalStr}`;\n    return isNegative ? `-${result}` : result;\n  }\n\n  private addDecimal(a: string, b: string, currency: string): string {\n    const aMinor = this.toMinorUnits(a, currency);\n    const bMinor = this.toMinorUnits(b, currency);\n    return this.fromMinorUnits(aMinor + bMinor, currency);\n  }\n\n  private subtractDecimal(a: string, b: string, currency: string): string {\n    const aMinor = this.toMinorUnits(a, currency);\n    const bMinor = this.toMinorUnits(b, currency);\n    return this.fromMinorUnits(aMinor - bMinor, currency);\n  }\n\n  private calculatePercentage(amount: string, basisPoints: number, currency: string): string {\n    const minor = this.toMinorUnits(amount, currency);\n    // basisPoints / 10000\n    const result = (minor * BigInt(basisPoints)) / BigInt(10000);\n    return this.fromMinorUnits(result, currency);\n  }\n\n  private isNegative(amount: string): boolean {\n    return amount.trim().startsWith('-');\n  }\n\n  private compareDecimal(a: string, b: string, currency: string): number {\n    const aMinor = this.toMinorUnits(a, currency);\n    const bMinor = this.toMinorUnits(b, currency);\n    if (aMinor < bMinor) return -1;\n    if (aMinor > bMinor) return 1;\n    return 0;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partners/partner-profile.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. NotFoundException, ConflictException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PartnerProfile, PartnerState, PartnerType, PARTNER_STATE_TRANSITIONS, PartnerAuditAction } from './partner.types';\nimport { PartnerPolicyService } from './partner-policy.service';\nimport { PartnerAuditService } from './partner-audit.service';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerProfileService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerProfileService.name);\n  private readonly inMemory: Map<string, PartnerProfile> = new Map();\n  private readonly codeIndex: Map<string, string> = new Map(); // code -> id\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly policyService: PartnerPolicyService,\n    private readonly audit: PartnerAuditService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createProfile(params: {\n    name: string;\n    legalName?: string;\n    type: PartnerType;\n    ownerUserId: string;\n    contactEmail: string;\n    contactName?: string;\n    website?: string;\n    countryCode?: string;\n    taxId?: string;\n    billingEmail?: string;\n    currency: string;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n    createdBy: string;\n    code?: string;\n    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  }): Promise<PartnerProfile> {\n    if (!params.name || !params.type || !params.ownerUserId || !params.contactEmail || !params.idempotencyKey) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('name, type, ownerUserId, contactEmail, idempotencyKey required');\n    }\n    if (!Object.values(PartnerType).includes(params.type)) throw new BadRequestException(`invalid partner type ${params.type}`);\n\n    // Idempotency check\n    const existingByIdem = [...this.inMemory.values()].find(p => p.idempotencyKey === params.idempotencyKey);\n    if (existingByIdem) {\n      this.logger.log(`partner create idempotent hit key=${params.idempotencyKey}`);\n      return existingByIdem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerProfile?.findFirst?.({ where: { idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey } });\n      if (row) return this.mapRow(row);\n    } catch {}\n\n    const code = params.code ?? this.generateCode(params.name);\n    if (this.codeIndex.has(code)) throw new ConflictException(`partner code ${code} already exists`);\n\n    const profile: PartnerProfile = {\n      id: `part_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      code,\n      name: params.name,\n      legalName: params.legalName ?? null,\n      type: params.type,\n      state: PartnerState.PENDING,\n      ownerUserId: params.ownerUserId,\n      contactEmail: params.contactEmail,\n      contactName: params.contactName ?? null,\n      website: params.website ?? null,\n      countryCode: params.countryCode ?? null,\n      taxId: params.taxId ?? null,\n      billingEmail: params.billingEmail ?? null,\n      currency: params.currency.toUpperCase(),\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      activatedAt: null,\n      suspendedAt: null,\n      terminatedAt: null,\n      metadata: params.metadata ?? null,\n      policyVersion: this.policyService.getPolicyVersion(),\n      agreementVersion: null,\n    };\n\n    this.inMemory.set(profile.id, profile);\n    this.codeIndex.set(code, profile.id);\n\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerProfile?.create?.({\n        data: {\n          id: profile.id,\n          code: profile.code,\n          name: profile.name,\n          legalName: profile.legalName,\n          type: profile.type,\n          state: profile.state,\n          ownerUserId: profile.ownerUserId,\n          contactEmail: profile.contactEmail,\n          contactName: profile.contactName,\n          website: profile.website,\n          countryCode: profile.countryCode,\n          taxId: profile.taxId,\n          billingEmail: profile.billingEmail,\n          currency: profile.currency,\n          idempotencyKey: profile.idempotencyKey,\n          createdAt: new Date(profile.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(profile.updatedAt),\n          policyVersion: profile.policyVersion,\n          metadata: profile.metadata as any,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`partner persist skipped id=${profile.id}`);\n    }\n\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: profile.id,\n      actorId: params.createdBy,\n      action: PartnerAuditAction.PARTNER_CREATED,\n      source: 'PARTNER_PROFILE_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      policyVersion: profile.policyVersion,\n      safeEvidence: { code: profile.code, type: profile.type, state: profile.state },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`partner created id=${profile.id} code=${code} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return profile;\n  }\n\n  async transitionState(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    targetState: PartnerState;\n    correlationId: string;\n    actorId: string;\n    actorRole?: string;\n    reason?: string;\n  }): Promise<PartnerProfile> {\n    const profile = await this.getProfile(params.partnerId);\n    const allowed = PARTNER_STATE_TRANSITIONS[profile.state];\n    if (!allowed.includes(params.targetState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`invalid transition ${profile.state} -> ${params.targetState}`);\n    }\n\n    const prevState = profile.state;\n    profile.state = params.targetState;\n    profile.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    if (params.targetState === PartnerState.ACTIVE) profile.activatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    if (params.targetState === PartnerState.SUSPENDED) profile.suspendedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    if (params.targetState === PartnerState.TERMINATED) profile.terminatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    this.inMemory.set(profile.id, profile);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerProfile?.update?.({\n        where: { id: profile.id },\n        data: {\n          state: profile.state,\n          updatedAt: new Date(profile.updatedAt),\n          activatedAt: profile.activatedAt ? new Date(profile.activatedAt) : null,\n          suspendedAt: profile.suspendedAt ? new Date(profile.suspendedAt) : null,\n          terminatedAt: profile.terminatedAt ? new Date(profile.terminatedAt) : null,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`partner transition persist skipped id=${profile.id}`);\n    }\n\n    const auditAction = this.mapStateToAudit(params.targetState);\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: profile.id,\n      actorId: params.actorId,\n      actorRole: params.actorRole,\n      action: auditAction,\n      source: 'PARTNER_PROFILE_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      policyVersion: profile.policyVersion,\n      safeEvidence: { from: prevState, to: params.targetState, reason: params.reason },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`partner transition id=${profile.id} ${prevState} -> ${params.targetState} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return profile;\n  }\n\n  private mapStateToAudit(state: PartnerState): PartnerAuditAction {\n    switch (state) {\n      case PartnerState.ACTIVE: return PartnerAuditAction.PARTNER_APPROVED;\n      case PartnerState.SUSPENDED: return PartnerAuditAction.PARTNER_SUSPENDED;\n      case PartnerState.TERMINATED: return PartnerAuditAction.PARTNER_TERMINATED;\n      case PartnerState.REACTIVATION_REVIEW: return PartnerAuditAction.PARTNER_REACTIVATED;\n      default: return PartnerAuditAction.PARTNER_APPROVED;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getProfile(partnerId: string): Promise<PartnerProfile> {\n    const mem = this.inMemory.get(partnerId);\n    if (mem) return mem;\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerProfile?.findUnique?.({ where: { id: partnerId } });\n      if (row) {\n        const mapped = this.mapRow(row);\n        this.inMemory.set(mapped.id, mapped);\n        this.codeIndex.set(mapped.code, mapped.id);\n        return mapped;\n      }\n    } catch {}\n    throw new NotFoundException(`partner ${partnerId} not found`);\n  }\n\n  async getByCode(code: string): Promise<PartnerProfile> {\n    const id = this.codeIndex.get(code);\n    if (id) {\n      const mem = this.inMemory.get(id);\n      if (mem) return mem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerProfile?.findFirst?.({ where: { code } });\n      if (row) return this.mapRow(row);\n    } catch {}\n    throw new NotFoundException(`partner code ${code} not found`);\n  }\n\n  async listProfiles(filters?: { state?: PartnerState; type?: PartnerType; ownerUserId?: string }): Promise<PartnerProfile[]> {\n    let list = [...this.inMemory.values()];\n    if (filters?.state) list = list.filter(p => p.state === filters.state);\n    if (filters?.type) list = list.filter(p => p.type === filters.type);\n    if (filters?.ownerUserId) list = list.filter(p => p.ownerUserId === filters.ownerUserId);\n    try {\n      const where: any = {};\n      if (filters?.state) where.state = filters.state;\n      if (filters?.type) where.type = filters.type;\n      if (filters?.ownerUserId) where.ownerUserId = filters.ownerUserId;\n      const rows = await (this.prisma as any).partnerProfile?.findMany?.({ where, take: 500, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } });\n      if (rows && rows.length > 0) list = rows.map((r: any) => this.mapRow(r));\n    } catch {}\n    return list;\n  }\n\n  async updateProfile(partnerId: string, updates: { name?: string; legalName?: string; contactEmail?: string; contactName?: string; website?: string; billingEmail?: string; metadata?: Record<string, unknown> }, correlationId: string, actorId: string): Promise<PartnerProfile> {\n    const profile = await this.getProfile(partnerId);\n    if (profile.state === PartnerState.TERMINATED) throw new BadRequestException('cannot update terminated partner');\n\n    if (updates.name) profile.name = updates.name;\n    if (updates.legalName !== undefined) profile.legalName = updates.legalName || null;\n    if (updates.contactEmail) profile.contactEmail = updates.contactEmail;\n    if (updates.contactName !== undefined) profile.contactName = updates.contactName || null;\n    if (updates.website !== undefined) profile.website = updates.website || null;\n    if (updates.billingEmail !== undefined) profile.billingEmail = updates.billingEmail || null;\n    if (updates.metadata) profile.metadata = { ...(profile.metadata ?? {}), ...updates.metadata };\n    profile.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    this.inMemory.set(profile.id, profile);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerProfile?.update?.({\n        where: { id: profile.id },\n        data: {\n          name: profile.name,\n          legalName: profile.legalName,\n          contactEmail: profile.contactEmail,\n          contactName: profile.contactName,\n          website: profile.website,\n          billingEmail: profile.billingEmail,\n          metadata: profile.metadata as any,\n          updatedAt: new Date(profile.updatedAt),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`partner update persist skipped id=${profile.id}`);\n    }\n\n    return profile;\n  }\n\n  private generateCode(name: string): string {\n    const base = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 8);\n    const suffix = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6).toUpperCase();\n    return `${base}_${suffix}`.toUpperCase();\n  }\n\n  private mapRow(row: any): PartnerProfile {\n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      code: row.code,\n      name: row.name,\n      legalName: row.legalName ?? null,\n      type: row.type,\n      state: row.state,\n      ownerUserId: row.ownerUserId,\n      contactEmail: row.contactEmail,\n      contactName: row.contactName ?? null,\n      website: row.website ?? null,\n      countryCode: row.countryCode ?? null,\n      taxId: row.taxId ?? null,\n      billingEmail: row.billingEmail ?? null,\n      currency: row.currency,\n      idempotencyKey: row.idempotencyKey,\n      createdAt: row.createdAt instanceof Date ? row.createdAt.toISOString() : row.createdAt,\n      updatedAt: row.updatedAt instanceof Date ? row.updatedAt.toISOString() : row.updatedAt,\n      activatedAt: row.activatedAt ? (row.activatedAt instanceof Date ? row.activatedAt.toISOString() : row.activatedAt) : null,\n      suspendedAt: row.suspendedAt ? (row.suspendedAt instanceof Date ? row.suspendedAt.toISOString() : row.suspendedAt) : null,\n      terminatedAt: row.terminatedAt ? (row.terminatedAt instanceof Date ? row.terminatedAt.toISOString() : row.terminatedAt) : null,\n      metadata: row.metadata ?? null,\n      policyVersion: row.policyVersion,\n      agreementVersion: row.agreementVersion ?? null,\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partners/partner-reconciliation.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Reconciles partner commission accruals against fee ledger and payout records\nimport { Injectable, Logger, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PartnerReconciliationMismatchType } from './partner.types';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\n\nexport interface ReconciliationMismatch {\n  type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType;\n  partnerId: string;\n  tenantId?: string | null;\n  entityId: string;\n  severity: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL';\n  description: string;\n  detectedAt: string;\n  correlationId: string;\n  sourceReferences?: string[];\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerReconciliationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerReconciliationService.name);\n  private readonly inMemory: Map<string, ReconciliationMismatch> = new Map();\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async reconcilePartner(partnerId: string, correlationId: string): Promise<ReconciliationMismatch[]> {\n    if (!partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partnerId required');\n    const mismatches: ReconciliationMismatch[] = [];\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    try {\n      // PARTNER_WITHOUT_AGREEMENT\n      const agreements = await (this.prisma as any).partnerAgreement?.findMany?.({ where: { partnerId } }) ?? [];\n      if (agreements.length === 0) {\n        mismatches.push({\n          type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.PARTNER_WITHOUT_AGREEMENT,\n          partnerId,\n          entityId: partnerId,\n          severity: 'HIGH',\n          description: `partner ${partnerId} has no agreement`,\n          detectedAt: now,\n          correlationId,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // TENANT_WITHOUT_VALID_PARTNER_RELATION\n      const relationships = await (this.prisma as any).partnerTenantRelationship?.findMany?.({ where: { partnerId } }) ?? [];\n      for (const rel of relationships) {\n        if (!rel.tenantId) {\n          mismatches.push({\n            type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.TENANT_WITHOUT_VALID_PARTNER_RELATION,\n            partnerId,\n            entityId: rel.id,\n            severity: 'MEDIUM',\n            description: `relationship ${rel.id} missing tenantId`,\n            detectedAt: now,\n            correlationId,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // MULTIPLE_PRIMARY_PARTNERS\n      const tenantGroups = new Map<string, any[]>();\n      for (const rel of relationships.filter((r: any) => r.isPrimary && r.state === 'ACTIVE')) {\n        if (!tenantGroups.has(rel.tenantId)) tenantGroups.set(rel.tenantId, []);\n        tenantGroups.get(rel.tenantId)!.push(rel);\n      }\n      for (const [tenantId, rels] of tenantGroups.entries()) {\n        if (rels.length > 1) {\n          mismatches.push({\n            type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.MULTIPLE_PRIMARY_PARTNERS,\n            partnerId,\n            tenantId,\n            entityId: tenantId,\n            severity: 'CRITICAL',\n            description: `tenant ${tenantId} has ${rels.length} primary partners`,\n            detectedAt: now,\n            correlationId,\n            sourceReferences: rels.map((r: any) => r.id),\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // ATTRIBUTION_CONFLICT and ATTRIBUTION_EXPIRED\n      const attributions = await (this.prisma as any).partnerAttribution?.findMany?.({ where: { partnerId } }) ?? [];\n      const attributionByTenant = new Map<string, any[]>();\n      for (const attr of attributions) {\n        if (!attributionByTenant.has(attr.tenantId)) attributionByTenant.set(attr.tenantId, []);\n        attributionByTenant.get(attr.tenantId)!.push(attr);\n        if (attr.expiresAt && new Date(attr.expiresAt) < new Date() && attr.state === 'ACTIVE') {\n          mismatches.push({\n            type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.ATTRIBUTION_EXPIRED,\n            partnerId,\n            tenantId: attr.tenantId,\n            entityId: attr.id,\n            severity: 'MEDIUM',\n            description: `attribution ${attr.id} expired but still ACTIVE`,\n            detectedAt: now,\n            correlationId,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n      for (const [tenantId, attrs] of attributionByTenant.entries()) {\n        const activePrimary = attrs.filter((a: any) => a.isPrimary && a.state === 'ACTIVE');\n        if (activePrimary.length > 1) {\n          mismatches.push({\n            type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.ATTRIBUTION_CONFLICT,\n            partnerId,\n            tenantId,\n            entityId: tenantId,\n            severity: 'CRITICAL',\n            description: `tenant ${tenantId} has ${activePrimary.length} active primary attributions`,\n            detectedAt: now,\n            correlationId,\n            sourceReferences: activePrimary.map((a: any) => a.id),\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // COMMISSION checks\n      const commissions = await (this.prisma as any).partnerCommission?.findMany?.({ where: { partnerId }, take: 1000 }) ?? [];\n      const sourceEventIds = new Set<string>();\n      for (const com of commissions) {\n        if (!com.sourceEventId) {\n          mismatches.push({\n            type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.COMMISSION_WITHOUT_SOURCE_PAYMENT,\n            partnerId,\n            tenantId: com.tenantId,\n            entityId: com.id,\n            severity: 'HIGH',\n            description: `commission ${com.id} missing source event`,\n            detectedAt: now,\n            correlationId,\n          });\n        }\n        const key = `${com.partnerId}:${com.sourceEventId}`;\n        if (sourceEventIds.has(key)) {\n          mismatches.push({\n            type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.COMMISSION_DUPLICATE,\n            partnerId,\n            tenantId: com.tenantId,\n            entityId: com.id,\n            severity: 'HIGH',\n            description: `duplicate commission for source event ${com.sourceEventId}`,\n            detectedAt: now,\n            correlationId,\n          });\n        }\n        sourceEventIds.add(key);\n\n        // COMMISSION_AMOUNT_MISMATCH - check if calculation matches expected\n        // For now, check if amount is zero when gross is positive\n        try {\n          const gross = parseFloat(com.grossRevenue);\n          const amount = parseFloat(com.commissionAmount);\n          if (gross > 0 && amount === 0 && com.state !== 'REVERSED') {\n            mismatches.push({\n              type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.COMMISSION_AMOUNT_MISMATCH,\n              partnerId,\n              tenantId: com.tenantId,\n              entityId: com.id,\n              severity: 'MEDIUM',\n              description: `commission ${com.id} has zero amount but gross ${com.grossRevenue} positive`,\n              detectedAt: now,\n              correlationId,\n            });\n          }\n        } catch {}\n\n        // CURRENCY_MISMATCH and MISSING_FX\n        if (com.sourceCurrency && com.commissionCurrency && com.sourceCurrency !== com.commissionCurrency) {\n          if (com.fxRequired && !com.fxRate) {\n            mismatches.push({\n              type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.MISSING_FX,\n              partnerId,\n              tenantId: com.tenantId,\n              entityId: com.id,\n              severity: 'HIGH',\n              description: `commission ${com.id} requires FX ${com.sourceCurrency}->${com.commissionCurrency} but rate missing`,\n              detectedAt: now,\n              correlationId,\n            });\n          }\n          if (com.currency !== com.commissionCurrency && com.currency !== com.sourceCurrency) {\n            mismatches.push({\n              type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.CURRENCY_MISMATCH,\n              partnerId,\n              tenantId: com.tenantId,\n              entityId: com.id,\n              severity: 'MEDIUM',\n              description: `commission ${com.id} currency ${com.currency} mismatches source ${com.sourceCurrency} and commission ${com.commissionCurrency}`,\n              detectedAt: now,\n              correlationId,\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      // REFUND_WITHOUT_COMMISSION_REVERSAL and CHARGEBACK_WITHOUT_REVERSAL\n      // Check refunds/chargebacks without corresponding reversals\n      const refunds = commissions.filter((c: any) => c.sourceEventType === 'REFUND' || c.sourceEventType === 'CHARGEBACK');\n      for (const refund of refunds) {\n        const hasReversal = commissions.some((c: any) => c.reversalOfId && c.sourceEventId.includes(refund.sourceEventId));\n        if (!hasReversal) {\n          const type = refund.sourceEventType === 'REFUND' ? PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.REFUND_WITHOUT_COMMISSION_REVERSAL : PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.CHARGEBACK_WITHOUT_REVERSAL;\n          mismatches.push({\n            type,\n            partnerId,\n            tenantId: refund.tenantId,\n            entityId: refund.id,\n            severity: 'HIGH',\n            description: `${refund.sourceEventType} ${refund.id} without commission reversal`,\n            detectedAt: now,\n            correlationId,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // SETTLEMENT_WITHOUT_RECONCILIATION\n      const settlements = await (this.prisma as any).partnerSettlement?.findMany?.({ where: { partnerId }, take: 500 }) ?? [];\n      for (const set of settlements) {\n        if ((set.state === 'LOCKED' || set.state === 'COMPLETED') && !set.reconciledAt) {\n          mismatches.push({\n            type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.SETTLEMENT_WITHOUT_RECONCILIATION,\n            partnerId,\n            entityId: set.id,\n            severity: 'HIGH',\n            description: `settlement ${set.id} locked/completed without reconciliation`,\n            detectedAt: now,\n            correlationId,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // PAYOUT checks\n      const payouts = await (this.prisma as any).partnerPayout?.findMany?.({ where: { partnerId }, take: 500 }) ?? [];\n      for (const payout of payouts) {\n        const settlementExists = settlements.some((s: any) => s.id === payout.settlementId);\n        if (!settlementExists) {\n          mismatches.push({\n            type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.PAYOUT_WITHOUT_SETTLEMENT,\n            partnerId,\n            entityId: payout.id,\n            severity: 'CRITICAL',\n            description: `payout ${payout.id} without settlement ${payout.settlementId}`,\n            detectedAt: now,\n            correlationId,\n          });\n        }\n        if (payout.state === 'COMPLETED' && !payout.providerPayoutId) {\n          mismatches.push({\n            type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType.PAYOUT_STATUS_MISMATCH,\n            partnerId,\n            entityId: payout.id,\n            severity: 'HIGH',\n            description: `payout ${payout.id} COMPLETED without provider evidence`,\n            detectedAt: now,\n            correlationId,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.debug(`reconciliation fallback partner=${partnerId} err=${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    for (const m of mismatches) {\n      this.inMemory.set(`${m.entityId}_${m.type}`, m);\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`reconciliation partner=${partnerId} mismatches=${mismatches.length} corr=${correlationId}`);\n    return mismatches;\n  }\n\n  async listMismatches(partnerId: string, filters?: { type?: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType; severity?: string }): Promise<ReconciliationMismatch[]> {\n    let list = [...this.inMemory.values()].filter(m => m.partnerId === partnerId);\n    if (filters?.type) list = list.filter(m => m.type === filters.type);\n    if (filters?.severity) list = list.filter(m => m.severity === filters.severity);\n    return list;\n  }\n\n  async resolveMismatch(entityId: string, type: PartnerReconciliationMismatchType, partnerId: string, correlationId: string, resolution: string): Promise<void> {\n    const key = `${entityId}_${type}`;\n    this.inMemory.delete(key);\n    this.logger.log(`mismatch resolved entity=${entityId} type=${type} partner=${partnerId} corr=${correlationId} resolution=${resolution}`);\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partners/partner-referral.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any.
