of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":9,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger, BadRequestException, NotFoundException, ConflictException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PartnerReferral, PartnerReferralState, PartnerAuditAction } from './partner.types';\nimport { PartnerAuditService } from './partner-audit.service';\nimport { PartnerProfileService } from './partner-profile.service';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport * as crypto from 'crypto';\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerReferralService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerReferralService.name);\n  private readonly inMemory: Map<string, PartnerReferral> = new Map();\n  private readonly codeIndex: Map<string, string> = new Map(); // code -> id\n  private readonly tokenIndex: Map<string, string> = new Map(); // token -> id\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly audit: PartnerAuditService,\n    private readonly profileService: PartnerProfileService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createReferral(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    campaignId?: string;\n    code?: string;\n    maxUses?: number;\n    expiresAt?: string | null;\n    createdBy: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n  }): Promise<PartnerReferral> {\n    if (!params.partnerId || !params.idempotencyKey) throw new BadRequestException('partnerId, idempotencyKey required');\n    await this.profileService.getProfile(params.partnerId);\n\n    const existingByIdem = [...this.inMemory.values()].find(r => r.idempotencyKey === params.idempotencyKey);\n    if (existingByIdem) return existingByIdem;\n\n    const code = params.code ? params.code.toUpperCase() : this.generateCode();\n    const token = this.generateToken(params.partnerId, code);\n\n    if (this.codeIndex.has(code)) throw new ConflictException(`referral code ${code} already exists`);\n    if (this.tokenIndex.has(token)) throw new ConflictException(`referral token collision`);\n\n    if (params.expiresAt) {\n      const exp = new Date(params.expiresAt);\n      if (isNaN(exp.getTime()) || exp <= new Date()) throw new BadRequestException('expiresAt must be future');\n    }\n\n    const referral: PartnerReferral = {\n      id: `pref_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      campaignId: params.campaignId ?? null,\n      code,\n      token,\n      state: PartnerReferralState.ACTIVE,\n      createdBy: params.createdBy,\n      expiresAt: params.expiresAt ? new Date(params.expiresAt).toISOString() : null,\n      convertedAt: null,\n      convertedTenantId: null,\n      maxUses: params.maxUses ?? null,\n      currentUses: 0,\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n    };\n\n    this.inMemory.set(referral.id, referral);\n    this.codeIndex.set(code, referral.id);\n    this.tokenIndex.set(token, referral.id);\n\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerReferral?.create?.({\n        data: {\n          id: referral.id,\n          partnerId: referral.partnerId,\n          campaignId: referral.campaignId,\n          code: referral.code,\n          token: referral.token,\n          state: referral.state,\n          createdBy: referral.createdBy,\n          expiresAt: referral.expiresAt ? new Date(referral.expiresAt) : null,\n          maxUses: referral.maxUses,\n          currentUses: referral.currentUses,\n          createdAt: new Date(referral.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(referral.updatedAt),\n          idempotencyKey: referral.idempotencyKey,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`referral persist skipped id=${referral.id}`);\n    }\n\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      actorId: params.createdBy,\n      action: PartnerAuditAction.REFERRAL_CREATED,\n      source: 'PARTNER_REFERRAL_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      safeEvidence: { referralId: referral.id, code: referral.code, campaignId: referral.campaignId },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`referral created id=${referral.id} partner=${params.partnerId} code=${code} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return referral;\n  }\n\n  async getByCode(code: string): Promise<PartnerReferral> {\n    const upper = code.toUpperCase();\n    const id = this.codeIndex.get(upper);\n    if (id) {\n      const mem = this.inMemory.get(id);\n      if (mem) return mem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerReferral?.findFirst?.({ where: { code: upper } });\n      if (row) return this.mapRow(row);\n    } catch {}\n    throw new NotFoundException(`referral code ${code} not found`);\n  }\n\n  async getByToken(token: string): Promise<PartnerReferral> {\n    const id = this.tokenIndex.get(token);\n    if (id) {\n      const mem = this.inMemory.get(id);\n      if (mem) return mem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerReferral?.findFirst?.({ where: { token } });\n      if (row) return this.mapRow(row);\n    } catch {}\n    throw new NotFoundException(`referral token not found`);\n  }\n\n  async getReferral(referralId: string, partnerId: string): Promise<PartnerReferral> {\n    const mem = this.inMemory.get(referralId);\n    if (mem) {\n      if (mem.partnerId !== partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partner isolation violation');\n      return mem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerReferral?.findUnique?.({ where: { id: referralId } });\n      if (row) {\n        if (row.partnerId !== partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partner isolation violation');\n        return this.mapRow(row);\n      }\n    } catch {}\n    throw new NotFoundException(`referral ${referralId} not found`);\n  }\n\n  async listReferrals(partnerId: string): Promise<PartnerReferral[]> {\n    let list = [...this.inMemory.values()].filter(r => r.partnerId === partnerId);\n    try {\n      const rows = await (this.prisma as any).partnerReferral?.findMany?.({ where: { partnerId }, take: 500 });\n      if (rows && rows.length > 0) list = rows.map((r: any) => this.mapRow(r));\n    } catch {}\n    return list;\n  }\n\n  async markConverted(params: { referralId: string; partnerId: string; tenantId: string; correlationId: string }): Promise<PartnerReferral> {\n    const referral = await this.getReferral(params.referralId, params.partnerId);\n    if (referral.state !== PartnerReferralState.ACTIVE) throw new BadRequestException(`cannot convert from state ${referral.state}`);\n    if (referral.expiresAt && new Date(referral.expiresAt) < new Date()) throw new BadRequestException('referral expired');\n    if (referral.maxUses && referral.currentUses >= referral.maxUses) throw new BadRequestException('referral max uses reached');\n\n    referral.currentUses += 1;\n    if (referral.maxUses && referral.currentUses >= referral.maxUses) {\n      referral.state = PartnerReferralState.CONVERTED;\n    }\n    referral.convertedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    referral.convertedTenantId = params.tenantId;\n    referral.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    this.inMemory.set(referral.id, referral);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerReferral?.update?.({\n        where: { id: referral.id },\n        data: {\n          currentUses: referral.currentUses,\n          state: referral.state,\n          convertedAt: new Date(referral.convertedAt),\n          convertedTenantId: referral.convertedTenantId,\n          updatedAt: new Date(referral.updatedAt),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n\n    return referral;\n  }\n\n  async revokeReferral(params: { referralId: string; partnerId: string; revokedBy: string; correlationId: string }): Promise<PartnerReferral> {\n    const referral = await this.getReferral(params.referralId, params.partnerId);\n    if (referral.state !== PartnerReferralState.ACTIVE) throw new BadRequestException(`cannot revoke from state ${referral.state}`);\n    referral.state = PartnerReferralState.REVOKED;\n    referral.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    this.inMemory.set(referral.id, referral);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerReferral?.update?.({ where: { id: referral.id }, data: { state: referral.state, updatedAt: new Date(referral.updatedAt) } });\n    } catch {}\n    return referral;\n  }\n\n  private generateCode(): string {\n    const chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789';\n    let code = '';\n    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) code += chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];\n    return code;\n  }\n\n  private generateToken(partnerId: string, code: string): string {\n    const raw = `${partnerId}:${code}:${Date.now()}:${Math.random()}`;\n    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex').slice(0, 32);\n  }\n\n  private mapRow(row: any): PartnerReferral {\n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      partnerId: row.partnerId,\n      campaignId: row.campaignId ?? null,\n      code: row.code,\n      token: row.token,\n      state: row.state,\n      createdBy: row.createdBy,\n      expiresAt: row.expiresAt ? (row.expiresAt instanceof Date ? row.expiresAt.toISOString() : row.expiresAt) : null,\n      convertedAt: row.convertedAt ? (row.convertedAt instanceof Date ? row.convertedAt.toISOString() : row.convertedAt) : null,\n      convertedTenantId: row.convertedTenantId ?? null,\n      maxUses: row.maxUses ?? null,\n      currentUses: row.currentUses ?? 0,\n      createdAt: row.createdAt instanceof Date ? row.createdAt.toISOString() : row.createdAt,\n      updatedAt: row.updatedAt instanceof Date ? row.updatedAt.toISOString() : row.updatedAt,\n      idempotencyKey: row.idempotencyKey,\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partners/partner-settlement.contract.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'partnerA' is assigned a value but never used.","line":197,"column":11,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":197,"endColumn":19}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":1,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"/**\n * Partner Settlement Contract Spec - deterministic settlement-focused tests\n */\n\n\n\nfunction toMinorUnits(amount: string, minorUnit: number): bigint {\n  const parts = amount.split('.');\n  const intPart = BigInt(parts[0] || '0');\n  let frac = parts[1] || '';\n  if (frac.length > minorUnit) frac = frac.slice(0, minorUnit);\n  while (frac.length < minorUnit) frac += '0';\n  const fracPart = BigInt(frac || '0');\n  return intPart * BigInt(Math.pow(10, minorUnit)) + fracPart;\n}\n\nfunction fromMinorUnits(minor: bigint, minorUnit: number): string {\n  const factor = BigInt(Math.pow(10, minorUnit));\n  const intPart = minor / factor;\n  const fracPart = minor % factor;\n  let fracStr = fracPart.toString().padStart(minorUnit, '0').replace(/0+$/, '');\n  if (fracStr === '') fracStr = '00';\n  return `${intPart.toString()}.${fracStr}`;\n}\n\nfunction addDecimal(a: string, b: string, minorUnit: number): string {\n  return fromMinorUnits(toMinorUnits(a, minorUnit) + toMinorUnits(b, minorUnit), minorUnit);\n}\n\ndescribe('Settlement Period Isolation Contract', () => {\n  it('settlement period isolation - different periods different fingerprints', () => {\n    const fp1 = `partner_a:2026-01-01:2026-01-31:USD:hash1`;\n    const fp2 = `partner_a:2026-02-01:2026-02-28:USD:hash1`;\n    expect(fp1).not.toBe(fp2);\n  });\n\n  it('settlement excludes reversed commission from payable', () => {\n    const accrued = '100.00';\n    const reversed = '-20.00';\n    const payable = addDecimal(accrued, reversed, 2);\n    expect(payable).toBe('80.00');\n  });\n\n  it('settlement duplicate prevented via fingerprint', () => {\n    const fingerprint = 'abc123';\n    const seen = new Set([fingerprint]);\n    expect(seen.has(fingerprint)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('settlement reconciliation required - critical mismatch blocks', () => {\n    const mismatches = [{ severity: 'CRITICAL', type: 'MULTIPLE_PRIMARY_PARTNERS' }];\n    const critical = mismatches.filter(m => m.severity === 'CRITICAL' || m.severity === 'HIGH');\n    expect(critical.length).toBe(1);\n  });\n\n  it('settlement excludes commissions outside period', () => {\n    const periodStart = new Date('2026-01-01');\n    const periodEnd = new Date('2026-01-31');\n    const commissions = [\n      { accruedAt: '2026-01-15T00:00:00Z', amount: '20.00' },\n      { accruedAt: '2026-02-15T00:00:00Z', amount: '30.00' },\n    ];\n    const inPeriod = commissions.filter(c => {\n      const d = new Date(c.accruedAt);\n      return d >= periodStart && d <= periodEnd;\n    });\n    expect(inPeriod.length).toBe(1);\n  });\n\n  it('settlement currency validation - mismatch rejected', () => {\n    const settlementCurrency = 'USD';\n    const commissionCurrency = 'EUR';\n    expect(settlementCurrency).not.toBe(commissionCurrency);\n  });\n\n  it('FX missing blocks settlement', () => {\n    const commission = { fxRequired: true, fxRate: null };\n    const blocked = commission.fxRequired && !commission.fxRate;\n    expect(blocked).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('refund adjustment reduces payable', () => {\n    const payableBefore = '100.00';\n    const refundReversal = '-10.00';\n    const after = addDecimal(payableBefore, refundReversal, 2);\n    expect(after).toBe('90.00');\n  });\n\n  it('chargeback adjustment reduces payable and creates outstanding if needed', () => {\n    const payableBefore = '100.00';\n    const chargebackReversal = '-100.00';\n    const after = addDecimal(payableBefore, chargebackReversal, 2);\n    expect(after).toBe('0.00');\n  });\n\n  it('settlement idempotency - same idempotencyKey same settlement', () => {\n    const idemKey = 'idem_settle_123';\n    const s1 = { id: 'set_1', idempotencyKey: idemKey };\n    const s2 = { id: 'set_1', idempotencyKey: idemKey };\n    expect(s1.id).toBe(s2.id);\n  });\n\n  it('settlement fingerprint deterministic', () => {\n    const input = { partnerId: 'p1', periodStart: '2026-01-01', periodEnd: '2026-01-31', currency: 'USD', commissionIds: ['c1', 'c2'].sort() };\n    const fp1 = JSON.stringify(input);\n    const fp2 = JSON.stringify(input);\n    expect(fp1).toBe(fp2);\n  });\n\n  it('settlement total payable calculation', () => {\n    const accrued = '200.00';\n    const reversed = '-30.00';\n    const payable = addDecimal(accrued, reversed, 2);\n    expect(payable).toBe('170.00');\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('Payout Contract', () => {\n  it('payout requires authorized settlement - settlement must be LOCKED', () => {\n    const settlementState = 'LOCKED';\n    const allowed = ['LOCKED', 'PAYOUT_REQUESTED', 'COMPLETED'];\n    expect(allowed.includes(settlementState)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('payout submission does not mean completion', () => {\n    const state = 'SUBMITTED';\n    expect(state).not.toBe('COMPLETED');\n  });\n\n  it('payout provider evidence required for COMPLETED', () => {\n    const payout = { state: 'COMPLETED', providerPayoutId: null };\n    const valid = payout.state === 'COMPLETED' ? !!payout.providerPayoutId : true;\n    expect(valid).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('payout duplicate prevented via idempotencyKey', () => {\n    const idemKey = 'idem_payout_123';\n    const seen = new Set([idemKey]);\n    expect(seen.has(idemKey)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('payout completion evidence - providerPayoutId and reference required', () => {\n    const payout = { providerPayoutId: 'prov_123', providerReference: 'ref_123' };\n    expect(payout.providerPayoutId).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(payout.providerReference).toBeTruthy();\n  });\n\n  it('failed payout preserved', () => {\n    const payout = { state: 'FAILED', failureReason: 'Insufficient funds' };\n    expect(payout.state).toBe('FAILED');\n    expect(payout.failureReason).toBeTruthy();\n  });\n\n  it('reversed payout preserved', () => {\n    const payout = { state: 'REVERSED', reversedAt: new Date().toISOString() };\n    expect(payout.state).toBe('REVERSED');\n  });\n\n  it('payout amount matches settlement payable', () => {\n    const settlementPayable = '150.00';\n    const payoutAmount = '150.00';\n    expect(settlementPayable).toBe(payoutAmount);\n  });\n\n  it('payout idempotency - same key same payout', () => {\n    const key = 'idem_payout_456';\n    const p1 = { id: 'pay_1', idempotencyKey: key };\n    const p2 = { id: 'pay_1', idempotencyKey: key };\n    expect(p1.id).toBe(p2.id);\n  });\n\n  it('payout authorization - requires approval if policy says', () => {\n    const policy = { requiresApproval: true };\n    const state = 'REQUESTED';\n    const needsApproval = policy.requiresApproval && state === 'REQUESTED';\n    expect(needsApproval).toBe(true);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('Settlement Audit & Isolation Contract', () => {\n  it('settlement audit - every settlement creation audited', () => {\n    const auditEvents = [{ action: 'SETTLEMENT_CREATED', settlementId: 'set_1' }];\n    expect(auditEvents.length).toBe(1);\n  });\n\n  it('tenant isolation - settlement only includes partner tenants', () => {\n    const partnerId = 'partner_a';\n    const commissions = [\n      { partnerId: 'partner_a', tenantId: 'tenant_1' },\n      { partnerId: 'partner_b', tenantId: 'tenant_2' },\n    ];\n    const filtered = commissions.filter(c => c.partnerId === partnerId);\n    expect(filtered.length).toBe(1);\n  });\n\n  it('partner isolation - partner cannot see another partner settlement', () => {\n    const partnerA = 'partner_a';\n    const partnerB = 'partner_b';\n    const settlements = [{ partnerId: 'partner_a', id: 'set_1' }];\n    const bSettlements = settlements.filter(s => s.partnerId === partnerB);\n    expect(bSettlements.length).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('Decimal precision exact in settlement', () => {\n    const a = '100.00';\n    const b = '33.33';\n    const sum = addDecimal(a, b, 2);\n    expect(sum).toBe('133.33');\n  });\n\n  it('settlement locks prevent further modification', () => {\n    const settlement = { state: 'LOCKED' };\n    const canModify = settlement.state === 'OPEN';\n    expect(canModify).toBe(false);\n  });\n});\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partners/partner-settlement.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PartnerSettlement, PartnerSettlementState, PARTNER_SETTLEMENT_TRANSITIONS, PartnerAuditAction, PartnerCommissionState } from './partner.types';\nimport { PartnerAuditService } from './partner-audit.service';\nimport { PartnerProfileService } from './partner-profile.service';\nimport { PartnerAgreementService } from './partner-agreement.service';\nimport { PartnerCommissionLedgerService } from './partner-commission-ledger.service';\nimport { PartnerReconciliationService } from './partner-reconciliation.service';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport * as crypto from 'crypto';\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerSettlementService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerSettlementService.name);\n  private readonly inMemory: Map<string, PartnerSettlement> = new Map();\n  private readonly idemIndex: Map<string, string> = new Map();\n  private readonly fingerprintIndex: Map<string, string> = new Map(); // partnerId:periodStart:periodEnd:currency:fingerprint -> id\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly audit: PartnerAuditService,\n    private readonly profileService: PartnerProfileService,\n    private readonly agreementService: PartnerAgreementService,\n    private readonly commissionLedger: PartnerCommissionLedgerService,\n    private readonly reconciliation: PartnerReconciliationService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createSettlement(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    periodStart: string;\n    periodEnd: string;\n    currency: string;\n    createdBy: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n  }): Promise<PartnerSettlement> {\n    if (!params.partnerId || !params.periodStart || !params.periodEnd || !params.currency || !params.idempotencyKey) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('partnerId, periodStart, periodEnd, currency, idempotencyKey required');\n    }\n\n    await this.profileService.getProfile(params.partnerId);\n    const agreement = await this.agreementService.getActiveAgreement(params.partnerId);\n    if (!agreement) throw new BadRequestException(`no active agreement for partner ${params.partnerId}`);\n\n    const periodStart = new Date(params.periodStart);\n    const periodEnd = new Date(params.periodEnd);\n    if (isNaN(periodStart.getTime()) || isNaN(periodEnd.getTime()) || periodStart >= periodEnd) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('invalid period');\n    }\n\n    // Idempotency\n    if (this.idemIndex.has(params.idempotencyKey)) {\n      const existingId = this.idemIndex.get(params.idempotencyKey)!;\n      const existing = this.inMemory.get(existingId);\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    }\n\n    // Collect eligible commissions\n    const allCommissions = await this.commissionLedger.listCommissions(params.partnerId, { currency: params.currency });\n    const eligible = allCommissions.filter(c => {\n      const accruedAt = new Date(c.accruedAt);\n      return accruedAt >= periodStart && accruedAt <= periodEnd && c.state === PartnerCommissionState.ACCRUED && c.currency.toUpperCase() === params.currency.toUpperCase();\n    });\n\n    // Check FX missing - if any commission has fxRequired true without fxRate, settlement blocked\n    const missingFx = eligible.filter(c => c.fxRequired && !c.fxRate);\n    if (missingFx.length > 0) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`settlement blocked - missing FX for ${missingFx.length} commissions: ${missingFx.map(c => c.id).join(',')}`);\n    }\n\n    // Calculate totals Decimal-safe\n    let totalGross = '0';\n    let totalDiscount = '0';\n    let totalNetEligible = '0';\n    let totalAccrued = '0';\n    let totalReversed = '0';\n\n    // Need to also include reversals in period\n    const reversals = allCommissions.filter(c => {\n      const accruedAt = new Date(c.accruedAt);\n      return accruedAt >= periodStart && accruedAt <= periodEnd && c.state === PartnerCommissionState.REVERSED;\n    });\n\n    for (const com of eligible) {\n      totalGross = this.addDecimal(totalGross, com.grossRevenue, params.currency);\n      totalDiscount = this.addDecimal(totalDiscount, com.discountAmount, params.currency);\n      totalNetEligible = this.addDecimal(totalNetEligible, com.netEligibleRevenue, params.currency);\n      totalAccrued = this.addDecimal(totalAccrued, com.commissionAmount, params.currency);\n    }\n\n    for (const rev of reversals) {\n      totalReversed = this.addDecimal(totalReversed, rev.commissionAmount, params.currency); // reversal amounts are negative\n    }\n\n    const totalPayable = this.addDecimal(totalAccrued, totalReversed, params.currency);\n\n    // Reconciliation required\n    const mismatches = await this.reconciliation.reconcilePartner(params.partnerId, params.correlationId);\n    const criticalMismatches = mismatches.filter(m => m.severity === 'CRITICAL' || m.severity === 'HIGH');\n    if (criticalMismatches.length > 0) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`settlement blocked - reconciliation has ${criticalMismatches.length} critical/high mismatches`);\n    }\n\n    // Fingerprint for duplicate prevention\n    const fingerprintInput = {\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      periodStart: periodStart.toISOString(),\n      periodEnd: periodEnd.toISOString(),\n      currency: params.currency.toUpperCase(),\n      commissionIds: eligible.map(c => c.id).sort(),\n      reversalIds: reversals.map(c => c.id).sort(),\n      totalPayable,\n      policyVersion: agreement.commissionPolicy.policyVersion,\n      agreementVersion: `v${agreement.version}`,\n    };\n    const fingerprint = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(fingerprintInput)).digest('hex');\n    const fingerprintKey = `${params.partnerId}:${periodStart.toISOString()}:${periodEnd.toISOString()}:${params.currency.toUpperCase()}:${fingerprint}`;\n    if (this.fingerprintIndex.has(fingerprintKey)) {\n      const existingId = this.fingerprintIndex.get(fingerprintKey)!;\n      const existing = this.inMemory.get(existingId);\n      if (existing) {\n        this.logger.log(`settlement duplicate prevented fingerprint=${fingerprint} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n        return existing;\n      }\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const existingByFingerprint = await (this.prisma as any).partnerSettlement?.findFirst?.({ where: { fingerprint } });\n      if (existingByFingerprint) {\n        this.logger.log(`settlement duplicate DB prevented fingerprint=${fingerprint}`);\n        return this.mapRow(existingByFingerprint);\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const settlement: PartnerSettlement = {\n      id: `pset_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      periodStart: periodStart.toISOString(),\n      periodEnd: periodEnd.toISOString(),\n      currency: params.currency.toUpperCase(),\n      state: PartnerSettlementState.OPEN,\n      totalGrossRevenue: totalGross,\n      totalDiscount,\n      totalNetEligibleRevenue: totalNetEligible,\n      totalCommissionAccrued: totalAccrued,\n      totalCommissionReversed: totalReversed,\n      totalCommissionPayable: totalPayable,\n      commissionCount: eligible.length,\n      reversalCount: reversals.length,\n      refundCount: reversals.filter(r => r.sourceEventType === 'REFUND').length,\n      chargebackCount: reversals.filter(r => r.sourceEventType === 'CHARGEBACK').length,\n      fingerprint,\n      calculationVersion: '2026-01',\n      policyVersion: agreement.commissionPolicy.policyVersion,\n      agreementVersion: `v${agreement.version}`,\n      reconciledAt: null,\n      lockedAt: null,\n      completedAt: null,\n      payoutId: null,\n      createdBy: params.createdBy,\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n    };\n\n    this.inMemory.set(settlement.id, settlement);\n    this.idemIndex.set(params.idempotencyKey, settlement.id);\n    this.fingerprintIndex.set(fingerprintKey, settlement.id);\n\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerSettlement?.create?.({\n        data: {\n          id: settlement.id,\n          partnerId: settlement.partnerId,\n          periodStart: new Date(settlement.periodStart),\n          periodEnd: new Date(settlement.periodEnd),\n          currency: settlement.currency,\n          state: settlement.state,\n          totalGrossRevenue: settlement.totalGrossRevenue,\n          totalDiscount: settlement.totalDiscount,\n          totalNetEligibleRevenue: settlement.totalNetEligibleRevenue,\n          totalCommissionAccrued: settlement.totalCommissionAccrued,\n          totalCommissionReversed: settlement.totalCommissionReversed,\n          totalCommissionPayable: settlement.totalCommissionPayable,\n          commissionCount: settlement.commissionCount,\n          reversalCount: settlement.reversalCount,\n          refundCount: settlement.refundCount,\n          chargebackCount: settlement.chargebackCount,\n          fingerprint: settlement.fingerprint,\n          calculationVersion: settlement.calculationVersion,\n          policyVersion: settlement.policyVersion,\n          agreementVersion: settlement.agreementVersion,\n          createdBy: settlement.createdBy,\n          createdAt: new Date(settlement.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(settlement.updatedAt),\n          idempotencyKey: settlement.idempotencyKey,\n          correlationId: settlement.correlationId,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`settlement persist skipped id=${settlement.id}`);\n    }\n\n    // Atomically link commissions to settlement\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).$transaction?.(async (tx: any) => {\n        for (const com of [...eligible, ...reversals]) {\n          await tx.partnerCommission?.update?.({ where: { id: com.id }, data: { settlementId: settlement.id, state: 'SETTLED' } });\n        }\n      });\n    } catch {\n      // Fallback\n      for (const com of [...eligible, ...reversals]) {\n        const memCom = this.inMemory.get(com.id) ?? (await this.commissionLedger.getCommission(com.id, params.partnerId).catch(() => null));\n        if (memCom) {\n          // Update in ledger in-memory via direct map access not possible, but we track via commissionLedger\n          // We'll update via ledger's internal map if accessible, else via prisma\n          try {\n            await (this.prisma as any).partnerCommission?.update?.({ where: { id: com.id }, data: { settlementId: settlement.id } });\n          } catch {}\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      actorId: params.createdBy,\n      action: PartnerAuditAction.SETTLEMENT_CREATED,\n      source: 'PARTNER_SETTLEMENT_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      agreementVersion: settlement.agreementVersion,\n      policyVersion: settlement.policyVersion,\n      safeEvidence: { settlementId: settlement.id, periodStart: settlement.periodStart, periodEnd: settlement.periodEnd, totalPayable, commissionCount: settlement.commissionCount, fingerprint },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`settlement created id=${settlement.id} partner=${params.partnerId} payable=${totalPayable} ${params.currency} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return settlement;\n  }\n\n  async transitionState(params: { settlementId: string; partnerId: string; targetState: PartnerSettlementState; correlationId: string; actorId: string }): Promise<PartnerSettlement> {\n    const settlement = await this.getSettlement(params.settlementId, params.partnerId);\n    const allowed = PARTNER_SETTLEMENT_TRANSITIONS[settlement.state];\n    if (!allowed.includes(params.targetState)) throw new BadRequestException(`invalid transition ${settlement.state} -> ${params.targetState}`);\n\n    const prev = settlement.state;\n    settlement.state = params.targetState;\n    settlement.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    if (params.targetState === PartnerSettlementState.RECONCILED) settlement.reconciledAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    if (params.targetState === PartnerSettlementState.LOCKED) settlement.lockedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    if (params.targetState === PartnerSettlementState.COMPLETED) settlement.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    this.inMemory.set(settlement.id, settlement);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerSettlement?.update?.({\n        where: { id: settlement.id },\n        data: {\n          state: settlement.state,\n          reconciledAt: settlement.reconciledAt ? new Date(settlement.reconciledAt) : null,\n          lockedAt: settlement.lockedAt ? new Date(settlement.lockedAt) : null,\n          completedAt: settlement.completedAt ? new Date(settlement.completedAt) : null,\n          updatedAt: new Date(settlement.updatedAt),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n\n    const auditAction = params.targetState === PartnerSettlementState.LOCKED ? PartnerAuditAction.SETTLEMENT_LOCKED : PartnerAuditAction.SETTLEMENT_CREATED;\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      actorId: params.actorId,\n      action: auditAction,\n      source: 'PARTNER_SETTLEMENT_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      agreementVersion: settlement.agreementVersion,\n      policyVersion: settlement.policyVersion,\n      safeEvidence: { settlementId: settlement.id, from: prev, to: params.targetState },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`settlement transition id=${settlement.id} ${prev} -> ${params.targetState} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return settlement;\n  }\n\n  async getSettlement(settlementId: string, partnerId: string): Promise<PartnerSettlement> {\n    const mem = this.inMemory.get(settlementId);\n    if (mem) {\n      if (mem.partnerId !== partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partner isolation violation');\n      return mem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerSettlement?.findUnique?.({ where: { id: settlementId } });\n      if (row) {\n        if (row.partnerId !== partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partner isolation violation');\n        const mapped = this.mapRow(row);\n        this.inMemory.set(mapped.id, mapped);\n        return mapped;\n      }\n    } catch {}\n    throw new NotFoundException(`settlement ${settlementId} not found`);\n  }\n\n  async listSettlements(partnerId: string, filters?: { state?: PartnerSettlementState; currency?: string }): Promise<PartnerSettlement[]> {\n    let list = [...this.inMemory.values()].filter(s => s.partnerId === partnerId);\n    if (filters?.state) list = list.filter(s => s.state === filters.state);\n    if (filters?.currency) {\n      const curUpper = filters.currency.toUpperCase();\n      list = list.filter(s => s.currency === curUpper);\n    }\n    try {\n      const where: any = { partnerId };\n      if (filters?.state) where.state = filters.state;\n      if (filters?.currency) where.currency = filters.currency.toUpperCase();\n      const rows = await (this.prisma as any).partnerSettlement?.findMany?.({ where, take: 500, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } });\n      if (rows && rows.length > 0) list = rows.map((r: any) => this.mapRow(r));\n    } catch {}\n    return list;\n  }\n\n  private getMinorUnit(currency: string): number {\n    const map: Record<string, number> = { USD: 2, EUR: 2, GBP: 2, JPY: 0, USDT: 6, USDC: 6 };\n    return map[currency.toUpperCase()] ?? 2;\n  }\n\n  private toMinorUnits(amount: string, currency: string): bigint {\n    const minor = this.getMinorUnit(currency);\n    const factor = Math.pow(10, minor);\n    const parts = amount.toString().split('.');\n    const intPart = BigInt(parts[0] || '0');\n    let frac = parts[1] || '';\n    if (frac.length > minor) frac = frac.slice(0, minor);\n    while (frac.length < minor) frac += '0';\n    const fracPart = BigInt(frac || '0');\n    if (intPart < BigInt(0)) return intPart * BigInt(factor) - fracPart;\n    return intPart * BigInt(factor) + fracPart;\n  }\n\n  private fromMinorUnits(minor: bigint, currency: string): string {\n    const minorUnit = this.getMinorUnit(currency);\n    const factor = BigInt(Math.pow(10, minorUnit));\n    const isNegative = minor < BigInt(0);\n    const abs = isNegative ? -minor : minor;\n    const intPart = abs / factor;\n    const fracPart = abs % factor;\n    let fracStr = fracPart.toString().padStart(minorUnit, '0');\n    if (minorUnit > 0) {\n      fracStr = fracStr.replace(/0+$/, '');\n      if (fracStr === '') fracStr = '0'.repeat(Math.min(2, minorUnit));\n    }\n    const result = minorUnit === 0 ? intPart.toString() : `${intPart.toString()}.${fracStr}`;\n    return isNegative ? `-${result}` : result;\n  }\n\n  private addDecimal(a: string, b: string, currency: string): string {\n    return this.fromMinorUnits(this.toMinorUnits(a, currency) + this.toMinorUnits(b, currency), currency);\n  }\n\n  private mapRow(row: any): PartnerSettlement {\n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      partnerId: row.partnerId,\n      periodStart: row.periodStart instanceof Date ? row.periodStart.toISOString() : row.periodStart,\n      periodEnd: row.periodEnd instanceof Date ? row.periodEnd.toISOString() : row.periodEnd,\n      currency: row.currency,\n      state: row.state,\n      totalGrossRevenue: row.totalGrossRevenue,\n      totalDiscount: row.totalDiscount,\n      totalNetEligibleRevenue: row.totalNetEligibleRevenue,\n      totalCommissionAccrued: row.totalCommissionAccrued,\n      totalCommissionReversed: row.totalCommissionReversed,\n      totalCommissionPayable: row.totalCommissionPayable,\n      commissionCount: row.commissionCount,\n      reversalCount: row.reversalCount,\n      refundCount: row.refundCount,\n      chargebackCount: row.chargebackCount,\n      fingerprint: row.fingerprint,\n      calculationVersion: row.calculationVersion,\n      policyVersion: row.policyVersion,\n      agreementVersion: row.agreementVersion,\n      reconciledAt: row.reconciledAt ? (row.reconciledAt instanceof Date ? row.reconciledAt.toISOString() : row.reconciledAt) : null,\n      lockedAt: row.lockedAt ? (row.lockedAt instanceof Date ? row.lockedAt.toISOString() : row.lockedAt) : null,\n      completedAt: row.completedAt ? campaignId?: string;\n    referralCode?: string;\n    attributionId?: string;\n    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;\n  }): Promise<PartnerTenantRelationship> {\n    if (!params.partnerId || this.profileService.getProfile(params.partnerId);\n\n    // Idempotency\n    const existingByIdem = [...this.inMemory.values()].find(r => r.idempotencyKey === params.idempotencyKey);\n    if (existingByIdem) {\n      this.logger.log(`tenant assign idempotent hit key=${params.idempotencyKey}`);\n      return existingByIdem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerTenantRelationship?.findFirst?.({ where: { idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey } });\n      if (row) return this.mapRow(row);\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Prevent duplicate primary ownership\n    const isPrimary = params.isPrimary ?? true;\n    if (isPrimary) {\n      const existingPrimary = this.tenantPrimaryIndex.get(params.tenantId);\n      if (existingPrimary) {\n        const existingRel = this.inMemory.get(existingPrimary);\n        if (existingRel && existingRel.partnerId !== params.partnerId && existingRel.state === PartnerTenantRelationshipState.ACTIVE) {\n          throw new ConflictException(`tenant ${params.tenantId} already has primary partner ${existingRel.partnerId}, transfer required`);\n        }\n      }\n      try {\n        const primaryRows = await (this.prisma as any).partnerTenantRelationship?.findMany?.({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, isPrimary: true, state: 'ACTIVE' } });\n        if (primaryRows && primaryRows.length > 0) {\n          const other = primaryRows.find((r: any) => r.partnerId !== params.partnerId);\n          if (other) throw new ConflictException(`tenant ${params.tenantId} already has primary partner ${other.partnerId}`);\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        if (e instanceof ConflictException) throw e;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const relationship: PartnerTenantRelationship = {\n      id: `ptrel_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      relationshipType: params.relationshipType,\n      state: PartnerTenantRelationshipState.ACTIVE,\n      attributionId: params.attributionId ?? null,\n      campaignId: params.campaignId ?? null,\n      referralCode: params.referralCode ?? null,\n      assignedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      assignedBy: params.assignedBy,\n      activatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      terminatedAt: null,\n      isPrimary,\n      metadata: params.metadata ?? null,\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n\n    this.inMemory.set(relationship.id, relationship);\n    if (isPrimary) this.tenantPrimaryIndex.set(params.tenantId, relationship.id);\n\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerTenantRelationship?.create?.({\n        data: {\n          id: relationship.id,\n          partnerId: relationship.partnerId,\n          tenantId: relationship.tenantId,\n          relationshipType: relationship.relationshipType,\n          state: relationship.state,\n          attributionId: relationship.attributionId,\n          campaignId: relationship.campaignId,\n          referralCode: relationship.referralCode,\n          assignedAt: new Date(relationship.assignedAt),\n          assignedBy: relationship.assignedBy,\n          activatedAt: relationship.activatedAt ? new Date(relationship.activatedAt) : null,\n          isPrimary: relationship.isPrimary,\n          metadata: relationship.metadata as any,\n          idempotencyKey: relationship.idempotencyKey,\n          createdAt: new Date(relationship.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(relationship.updatedAt),\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`tenant relationship persist skipped id=${relationship.id}`);\n    }\n\n    // Delegate actual tenant creation to existing SaaS tenant provisioning service - we only record relationship\n    // No fake tenant creation - relationship is derivative\n\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      actorId: params.assignedBy,\n      action: PartnerAuditAction.TENANT_ASSIGNED,\n      source: 'PARTNER_TENANT_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      safeEvidence: { relationshipType: params.relationshipType, isPrimary, tenantId: params.tenantId },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`tenant assigned partner=${params.partnerId} tenant=${params.tenantId} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return relationship;\n  }\n\n  async transferTenant(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    fromPartnerId: string;\n    toPartnerId: string;\n    transferredBy: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n    reason: string;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n  }): Promise<PartnerTenantRelationship> {\n    if (!params.tenantId || !params.fromPartnerId || !params.toPartnerId) throw new BadRequestException('tenantId, fromPartnerId, toPartnerId required');\n    if (params.fromPartnerId === params.toPartnerId) throw new BadRequestException('cannot transfer to same partner');\n\n    const fromRel = [...this.inMemory.values()].find(r => r.tenantId === params.tenantId && r.partnerId === params.fromPartnerId && r.isPrimary && r.state === PartnerTenantRelationshipState.ACTIVE);\n    if (!fromRel) throw new NotFoundException(`primary relationship for tenant ${params.tenantId} with partner ${params.fromPartnerId} not found`);\n\n    // Terminate old\n    fromRel.state = PartnerTenantRelationshipState.TERMINATED;\n    fromRel.terminatedAt = new (this.prisma as any).partnerTenantRelationship?.update?.({ where: { id: fromRel.id }, data: { state: fromRel.state, terminatedAt: new Date(fromRel.terminatedAt), updatedAt: new Date(fromRel.updatedAt) } });\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Create new primary\n    const newRel = await this.assignTenant({\n      partnerId: params.toPartnerId,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      relationshipType: fromRel.relationshipType,\n      assignedBy: params.transferredBy,\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n      isPrimary: true,\n      metadata: { transferredFrom: params.fromPartnerId, reason: params.reason },\n    });\n\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: params.toPartnerId,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      actorId: params.transferredBy,\n      action: PartnerAuditAction.TENANT_TRANSFERRED,\n      source: 'PARTNER_TENANT_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      safeEvidence: { fromPartnerId: params.fromPartnerId, toPartnerId: params.toPartnerId, tenantId: params.tenantId, reason: params.reason },\n    });\n\n    return newRel;\n  }\n\n  async unassignTenant(params: { relationshipId: string; partnerId: string; unassignedBy: string; correlationId: string; reason: string }): Promise<PartnerTenantRelationship> {\n    const rel = await this.getRelationship(params.relationshipId, params.partnerId);\n    if (rel.state === PartnerTenantRelationshipState.TERMINATED) throw new BadRequestException('already terminated');\n    rel.state = PartnerTenantRelationshipState.TERMINATED;\n    rel.terminatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    rel.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    this.inMemory.set(rel.id, rel);\n    if (rel.isPrimary) this.tenantPrimaryIndex.delete(rel.tenantId);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerTenantRelationship?.update?.({ where: { id: rel.id }, data: { state: rel.state, terminatedAt: new Date(rel.terminatedAt), updatedAt: new Date(rel.updatedAt) } });\n    } catch {}\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      tenantId: rel.tenantId,\n      actorId: params.unassignedBy,\n      action: PartnerAuditAction.TENANT_UNASSIGNED,\n      source: 'PARTNER_TENANT_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      safeEvidence: { relationshipId: rel.id, tenantId: rel.tenantId, reason: params.reason },\n    });\n    return rel;\n  }\n\n  async getRelationship(relationshipId: string, partnerId: string): Promise<PartnerTenantRelationship> {\n    const mem = this.inMemory.get(relationshipId);\n    if (mem) {\n      if (mem.partnerId !== partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partner isolation violation');\n      return mem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerTenantRelationship?.findUnique?.({ where: { id: relationshipId } });\n      if (row) {\n        if (row.partnerId !== partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partner isolation violation');\n        return this.mapRow(row);\n      }\n    } catch {}\n    throw new NotFoundException(`relationship ${relationshipId} not found`);\n  }\n\n  async listTenantsForPartner(partnerId: string, filters?: { state?: PartnerTenantRelationshipState; relationshipType?: PartnerTenantRelationshipType }): Promise<PartnerTenantRelationship[]> {\n    let list = [...this.inMemory.values()].filter(r => r.partnerId === partnerId);\n    if (filters?.state) list = list.filter(r => r.state === filters.state);\n    if (filters?.relationshipType) list = list.filter(r => r.relationshipType === filters.relationshipType);\n    try {\n      const where: any = { partnerId };\n      if (filters?.state) where.state = filters.state;\n      if (filters?.relationshipType) where.relationshipType = filters.relationshipType;\n      const rows = await (this.prisma as any).partnerTenantRelationship?.findMany?.({ where, take: 500, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } });\n      if (rows && rows.length > 0) list = rows.map((r: any) => this.mapRow(r));\n    } catch {}\n    return list;\n  }\n\n  async getPrimaryPartnerForTenant(tenantId: string): Promise<PartnerTenantRelationship | null> {\n    const id = this.tenantPrimaryIndex.get(tenantId);\n    if (id) {\n      const mem = this.inMemory.get(id);\n      if (mem) return mem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerTenantRelationship?.findFirst?.({ where: { tenantId, isPrimary: true, state: 'ACTIVE' } });\n      if (row) return this.mapRow(row);\n    } catch {}\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  private mapRow(row: any): PartnerTenantRelationship {\n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      partnerId: row.partnerId,\n      tenantId: row.tenantId,\n      relationshipType: row.relationshipType,\n      state: row.state,\n      attributionId: row.attributionId ?? null,\n      campaignId: row.campaignId ?? null,\n      referralCode: row.referralCode ?? (row.activatedAt instanceof Date ? row.activatedAt.toISOString() : row.activatedAt) : null,\n      terminatedAt: row.terminatedAt ? '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\n\nexport interface PartnerUsageAggregate {\n  partnerId: string;\n  periodStart: string;\n  periodEnd: string;\n  totalTenants: number;\n  activeTenants: number;\n  totalUsers: number;\n  activeSubscriptions: number;\n  totalApiCalls: number;\n  totalTradingVolume: string;\n  totalCopyTrades: number;\n  usageByTenant: Array<{ tenantId: string; apiCalls: number; tradingVolume: string; activeUsers: number; subscriptionStatus: string }>;\n  generatedAt: string;\n  currency: string;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerUsageService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerUsageService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly profileService: PartnerProfileService,\n    private readonly tenantService: PartnerTenantService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async aggregateUsage(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    periodStart: string;\n    periodEnd: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n  }): Promise<PartnerUsageAggregate> {\n    if (!params.partnerId || !params.periodStart || !params.periodEnd) throw new BadRequestException('partnerId, periodStart, periodEnd required');\n\n    await this.profileService.getProfile(params.partnerId);\n    const periodStart = new Date(params.periodStart);\n    const periodEnd = new Date(params.periodEnd);\n    if totalUsers = 0;\n    let activeSubscriptions = 0;\n    let totalApiCalls = 0;\n    let totalTradingVolumeMinor = BigInt(0);\n    let totalCopyTrades = 0;\n    const usageByTenant: PartnerUsageAggregate['usageByTenant'] = [];\n\n    for (const tenantId of tenantIds) {\n      try {\n        // Aggregate from existing UsageModule records - never create second metering source\n        const users = await (this.prisma as any).user?.count?.({ where: { tenantId } }) ?? 0;\n        const subs = await (this.prisma as any).tenantSubscription?.count?.({ where: { tenantId, status: { in: ['ACTIVE', 'TRIALING'] } } }) ?? 0;\n        // UsageMeter rows are per metering period with an Int currentValue (no timestamp/count columns).\n        const apiCalls = await (this.prisma as any).usageMeter?.aggregate?.({\n          where: { tenantId, meterKey: 'API_REQUESTS', periodStart: { gte: periodStart }, periodEnd: { lte: periodEnd } },\n          _sum: { currentValue: true },\n        }).then((r: any) => r._sum?.currentValue ?? 0);\n        // Cash-ledger amounts are decimal strings (Prisma cannot _sum a String column): sum trade settlements here.\n        const tradingVolume = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry?.findMany?.({\n          where: { tenantId, cashFlowType: { in: ['TRADE_SETTLEMENT_BUY', 'TRADE_SETTLEMENT_SELL'] }, occurredAt: { gte: periodStart, lte: periodEnd } },\n          select: { amount: true },\n        }).then((rows: Array<{ amount: string }>) => String(rows.reduce((sum, row) => sum + Math.abs(parseFloat(row.amount) || 0), 0)));\n        const copyTrades = await (this.prisma as any).copyExecution?.count?.({ where: { tenantId, createdAt: { gte: periodStart, lte: periodEnd } } }) ?? 0;\n\n        totalUsers += users;\n        activeSubscriptions += subs;\n        totalApiCalls += apiCalls;\n        try {\n          totalTradingVolumeMinor += BigInt(Math.round(parseFloat(tradingVolume) * 100));\n        } catch {}\n        totalCopyTrades += copyTrades;\n\n        usageByTenant.push({\n          tenantId,\n          apiCalls,\n          tradingVolume: tradingVolume.toString(),\n          activeUsers: users,\n          subscriptionStatus: subs > 0 ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE',\n        });\n      } catch (error) {\n        // Recorded as UNKNOWN (not as zero usage) so the aggregate never presents an unread tenant as an idle one.\n        this.logger.warn(`usage aggregate read failed tenant=${tenantId}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n        usageByTenant.push({ tenantId, apiCalls: 0, tradingVolume: '0', activeUsers: 0, subscriptionStatus: 'UNKNOWN' });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const aggregate: PartnerUsageAggregate = {\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      periodStart: periodStart.toISOString(),\n      periodEnd: periodEnd.toISOString(),\n      totalTenants: tenantIds.length,\n      activeTenants: activeRels.length,\n      totalUsers,\n      activeSubscriptions,\n      totalApiCalls,\n      totalTradingVolume: (Number(totalTradingVolumeMinor) / 100).toFixed(2),\n      totalCopyTrades,\n      usageByTenant,\n      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      currency: 'USD',\n    };\n\n    this.logger.log(`usage aggregated partner=${params.partnerId} tenants=${tenantIds.length} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return aggregate;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partners/partner-user.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PartnerUserRole, PartnerUserState, PartnerAuditAction } from './partner.types';\nimport { PartnerAuditService } from './partner-audit.service';\nimport { PartnerProfileService } from './partner-profile.service';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\n\nexport interface PartnerUser {\n  id: string;\n  partnerId: string;\n  userId: string;\n  role: PartnerUserRole;\n  state: PartnerUserState;\n  invitedBy: string;\n  invitedAt: string;\n  activatedAt?: string | null;\n  suspendedAt?: string | null;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n  idempotencyKey: string;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PartnerUserService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PartnerUserService.name);\n  private readonly inMemory: Map<string, PartnerUser> = new Map();\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly audit: PartnerAuditService,\n    private readonly profileService: PartnerProfileService,\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async inviteUser(params: {\n    partnerId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    role: PartnerUserRole;\n    invitedBy: string;\n    correlationId: string;\n    idempotencyKey: string;\n  }): Promise<PartnerUser> {\n    if (!params.partnerId || !params.userId || !params.role || !params.idempotencyKey) throw new BadRequestException('partnerId, userId, role, idempotencyKey required');\n    if (!Object.values(PartnerUserRole).includes(params.role)) throw new BadRequestException(`invalid role ${params.role}`);\n\n    await this.profileService.getProfile(params.partnerId);\n\n    const existingByIdem = [...this.inMemory.values()].find(u => u.idempotencyKey === params.idempotencyKey);\n    if (existingByIdem) return existingByIdem;\n\n    const duplicate = [...this.inMemory.values()].find(u => u.partnerId === params.partnerId && u.userId === params.userId && u.state !== PartnerUserState.DEACTIVATED);\n    if (duplicate) throw new BadRequestException(`user ${params.userId} already has role in partner ${params.partnerId}`);\n\n    const partnerUser: PartnerUser = {\n      id: `puser_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      userId: params.userId,\n      role: params.role,\n      state: PartnerUserState.INVITED,\n      invitedBy: params.invitedBy,\n      invitedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      activatedAt: null,\n      suspendedAt: null,\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n    };\n\n    this.inMemory.set(partnerUser.id, partnerUser);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerUser?.create?.({\n        data: {\n          id: partnerUser.id,\n          partnerId: partnerUser.partnerId,\n          userId: partnerUser.userId,\n          role: partnerUser.role,\n          state: partnerUser.state,\n          invitedBy: partnerUser.invitedBy,\n          invitedAt: new Date(partnerUser.invitedAt),\n          createdAt: new Date(partnerUser.createdAt),\n          updatedAt: new Date(partnerUser.updatedAt),\n          idempotencyKey: partnerUser.idempotencyKey,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      this.logger.debug(`partner user persist skipped id=${partnerUser.id}`);\n    }\n\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      actorId: params.invitedBy,\n      action: PartnerAuditAction.PARTNER_USER_INVITED,\n      source: 'PARTNER_USER_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      safeEvidence: { userId: params.userId, role: params.role },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`partner user invited partner=${params.partnerId} user=${params.userId} role=${params.role} corr=${params.correlationId}`);\n    return partnerUser;\n  }\n\n  async activateUser(params: { partnerUserId: string; partnerId: string; activatedBy: string; correlationId: string }): Promise<PartnerUser> {\n    const pu = await this.getPartnerUser(params.partnerUserId, params.partnerId);\n    if (pu.state !== PartnerUserState.INVITED && pu.state !== PartnerUserState.SUSPENDED) throw new BadRequestException(`cannot activate from state ${pu.state}`);\n    pu.state = PartnerUserState.ACTIVE;\n    pu.activatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    pu.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    this.inMemory.set(pu.id, pu);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerUser?.update?.({ where: { id: pu.id }, data: { state: pu.state, activatedAt: new Date(pu.activatedAt), updatedAt: new Date(pu.updatedAt) } });\n    } catch {}\n    return pu;\n  }\n\n  async suspendUser(params: { partnerUserId: string; partnerId: string; suspendedBy: string; correlationId: string; reason: string }): Promise<PartnerUser> {\n    const pu = await this.getPartnerUser(params.partnerUserId, params.partnerId);\n    if (pu.state !== PartnerUserState.ACTIVE) throw new BadRequestException(`cannot suspend from state ${pu.state}`);\n    pu.state = PartnerUserState.SUSPENDED;\n    pu.suspendedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    pu.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    this.inMemory.set(pu.id, pu);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerUser?.update?.({ where: { id: pu.id }, data: { state: pu.state, suspendedAt: new Date(pu.suspendedAt), updatedAt: new Date(pu.updatedAt) } });\n    } catch {}\n    await this.audit.recordEvent({\n      partnerId: params.partnerId,\n      actorId: params.suspendedBy,\n      action: PartnerAuditAction.PARTNER_USER_SUSPENDED,\n      source: 'PARTNER_USER_SERVICE',\n      correlationId: params.correlationId,\n      safeEvidence: { userId: pu.userId, reason: params.reason },\n    });\n    return pu;\n  }\n\n  async changeRole(params: { partnerUserId: string; partnerId: string; newRole: PartnerUserRole; changedBy: string; correlationId: string }): Promise<PartnerUser> {\n    const pu = await this.getPartnerUser(params.partnerUserId, params.partnerId);\n    if (!Object.values(PartnerUserRole).includes(params.newRole)) throw new BadRequestException(`invalid role ${params.newRole}`);\n    if (pu.state !== PartnerUserState.ACTIVE) throw new BadRequestException('only active users can change role');\n    pu.role = params.newRole;\n    pu.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    this.inMemory.set(pu.id, pu);\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).partnerUser?.update?.({ where: { id: pu.id }, data: { role: pu.role, updatedAt: new Date(pu.updatedAt) } });\n    } catch {}\n    return pu;\n  }\n\n  async getPartnerUser(partnerUserId: string, partnerId: string): Promise<PartnerUser> {\n    const mem = this.inMemory.get(partnerUserId);\n    if (mem) {\n      if (mem.partnerId !== partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partner isolation violation');\n      return mem;\n    }\n    try {\n      const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerUser?.findUnique?.({ where: { id: partnerUserId } });\n      if (row) {\n        if (row.partnerId !== partnerId) throw new BadRequestException('partner isolation violation');\n        const mapped = this.mapRow(row);\n        this.inMemory.set(mapped.id, mapped);\n        return mapped;\n      }\n    } catch {}\n    throw new NotFoundException(`partner user ${partnerUserId} not found`);\n  }\n\n  async listUsersForPartner(partnerId: string): Promise<PartnerUser[]> {\n    let list = [...this.inMemory.values()].filter(u => u.partnerId === partnerId);\n    try {\n      const rows = await (this.prisma as any).partnerUser?.findMany?.({ where: { partnerId }, take: 500 });\n      if (rows && rows.length > 0) list = rows.map((r: any) => this.mapRow(r));\n    } catch {}\n    return list;\n  }\n\n  async assertUserHasPartnerAccess(userId: string, partnerId: string, requiredRoles?: PartnerUserRole[]): Promise<PartnerUser> {\n    const pu = [...this.inMemory.values()].find(u => u.userId === userId && u.partnerId === partnerId && u.state === PartnerUserState.ACTIVE);\n    if (!pu) {\n      try {\n        const row = await (this.prisma as any).partnerUser?.findFirst?.({ where: { userId, partnerId, state: 'ACTIVE' } });\n        if (row) return this.mapRow(row);\n      } catch {}\n      throw new BadRequestException(`user ${userId} has no active access to partner ${partnerId}`);\n    }\n    if (requiredRoles && requiredRoles.length > 0 && !requiredRoles.includes(pu.role)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`user role ${pu.role} not authorized, required ${requiredRoles.join(',')}`);\n    }\n    return pu;\n  }\n\n  private mapRow(row: any): PartnerUser {\n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      partnerId: row.partnerId,\n      userId: row.userId,\n      role: row.role,\n      state: row.state,\n      invitedBy: row.invitedBy,\n      invitedAt: row.invitedAt instanceof Date ? row.invitedAt.toISOString() : row.invitedAt,\n      activatedAt: row.activatedAt ? (row.activatedAt instanceof Date ? row.activatedAt.toISOString() : row.activatedAt) : null,\n      suspendedAt: row.suspendedAt ? (row.suspendedAt instanceof Date ? row.suspendedAt.toISOString() : row.suspendedAt) : null,\n      createdAt: row.createdAt instanceof Date ? row.createdAt.toISOString() : row.createdAt,\n      updatedAt: row.updatedAt instanceof Date ? row.updatedAt.toISOString() : row.updatedAt,\n      idempotencyKey: row.idempotencyKey,\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/partners/partner.contract.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'redactEvidence' used.","line":382,"column":11,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":382,"endColumn":26}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":7,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"/**\n * Partner Contract Spec - deterministic full-module contract tests\n */\n\n\n\n// Helpers mimicking service logic\nconst PARTNER_STATE_TRANSITIONS: Record<string, string[]> = {\n  PENDING: ['UNDER_REVIEW', 'TERMINATED'],\n  UNDER_REVIEW: ['ACTIVE', 'TERMINATED', 'PENDING'],\n  ACTIVE: ['SUSPENDED', 'TERMINATION_PENDING'],\n  SUSPENDED: ['REACTIVATION_REVIEW', 'TERMINATION_PENDING', 'TERMINATED'],\n  REACTIVATION_REVIEW: ['ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'TERMINATED'],\n  TERMINATION_PENDING: ['TERMINATED', 'ACTIVE'],\n  TERMINATED: [],\n};\n\nfunction isValidTransition(from: string, to: string): boolean {\n  return (PARTNER_STATE_TRANSITIONS[from] ?? []).includes(to);\n}\n\nfunction toMinorUnits(amount: string, minorUnit: number): bigint {\n  const parts = amount.split('.');\n  const intPart = BigInt(parts[0] || '0');\n  let frac = parts[1] || '';\n  if (frac.length > minorUnit) frac = frac.slice(0, minorUnit);\n  while (frac.length < minorUnit) frac += '0';\n  const fracPart = BigInt(frac || '0');\n  return intPart * BigInt(Math.pow(10, minorUnit)) + fracPart;\n}\n\nfunction fromMinorUnits(minor: bigint, minorUnit: number): string {\n  const factor = BigInt(Math.pow(10, minorUnit));\n  const intPart = minor / factor;\n  const fracPart = minor % factor;\n  let fracStr = fracPart.toString().padStart(minorUnit, '0').replace(/0+$/, '');\n  if (fracStr === '') fracStr = '00';\n  return `${intPart.toString()}.${fracStr}`;\n}\n\nfunction addDecimal(a: string, b: string, minorUnit: number): string {\n  return fromMinorUnits(toMinorUnits(a, minorUnit) + toMinorUnits(b, minorUnit), minorUnit);\n}\n\nfunction calculatePercentage(amount: string, bps: number, minorUnit: number): string {\n  const minor = toMinorUnits(amount, minorUnit);\n  const result = (minor * BigInt(bps)) / BigInt(10000);\n  return fromMinorUnits(result, minorUnit);\n}\n\nfunction redactEvidence(evidence: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {\n  const sensitive = ['password', 'secret', 'privateKey', 'apiKey', 'token', 'card', 'cvv', 'ssn', 'email', 'phone', 'iban'];\n  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};\n  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(evidence)) {\n    const lower = k.toLowerCase();\n    const isSensitive = sensitive.some(s => lower.includes(s.toLowerCase()));\n    out[k] = isSensitive ? '***REDACTED***' : v;\n  }\n  return out;\n}\n\ndescribe('Partner Lifecycle Contract', () => {\n  it('partner lifecycle PENDING -> UNDER_REVIEW valid', () => {\n    expect(isValidTransition('PENDING', 'UNDER_REVIEW')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('partner lifecycle UNDER_REVIEW -> ACTIVE valid', () => {\n    expect(isValidTransition('UNDER_REVIEW', 'ACTIVE')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('partner lifecycle ACTIVE -> SUSPENDED valid', () => {\n    expect(isValidTransition('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('partner lifecycle SUSPENDED -> REACTIVATION_REVIEW valid', () => {\n    expect(isValidTransition('SUSPENDED', 'REACTIVATION_REVIEW')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('partner lifecycle REACTIVATION_REVIEW -> ACTIVE valid', () => {\n    expect(isValidTransition('REACTIVATION_REVIEW', 'ACTIVE')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('partner lifecycle ACTIVE -> TERMINATION_PENDING valid', () => {\n    expect(isValidTransition('ACTIVE', 'TERMINATION_PENDING')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('partner lifecycle TERMINATION_PENDING -> TERMINATED valid', () => {\n    expect(isValidTransition('TERMINATION_PENDING', 'TERMINATED')).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it('invalid transition PENDING -> ACTIVE rejected', () => {\n    expect(isValidTransition('PENDING', 'ACTIVE')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('invalid transition ACTIVE -> PENDING rejected', () => {\n    expect(isValidTransition('ACTIVE', 'PENDING')).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('TERMINATED has no outgoing', () => {\n    expect(PARTNER_STATE_TRANSITIONS['TERMINATED'].length).toBe(0);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('Agreement Lifecycle Contract', () => {\n  it('agreement version immutability - new version creates new record', () => {\n    const agreements = [{ version: 1, state: 'ACTIVE', isImmutable: false }, { version: 2, state: 'DRAFT', isImmutable: false }];\n    const active = agreements.find(a => a.state === 'ACTIVE');\n    expect(active!.version).toBe(1);\n    // Activating v2 should supersede v1\n    const v1Superseded = { ...active!, state: 'SUPERSEDED', isImmutable: true };\n    expect(v1Superseded.isImmutable).toBe(true);\n    expect(v1Superseded.state).toBe('SUPERSEDED');\n  });\n\n  it('inactive agreement blocks commission', () => {\n    const agreement = { state: 'DRAFT' };\n    const canCommission = agreement.state === 'ACTIVE';\n    expect(canCommission).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  it('past commissions retain original agreement/version', () => {\n    const commission = { agreementVersion: 'v1', policyVersion: '2026-01' };\n    const newAgreement = { version: 2 };\n    expect(commission.agreementVersion).toBe('v1');\n    expect(commission.agreementVersion).not.toBe(`v${newAgreement.version}`);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('Tenant Isolation & RBAC Contract', () => {\n  it('partner tenant isolation - row.adjustedValues : {};\n  const reversal = values.reversal && typeof values.reversal === 'object' ? values.reversal : null;\n  return {\n    ...row,\n    adjustedAmount: values.amount ?? row.amount ?? null,\n    adjustedQuantity: values.quantity ?? null,\n    asset: values.asset ?? null,\n    operatorId: row.requestedBy ?? null,\n    evidence: values.evidence ?? {},\n    isReversed: Boolean(reversal),\n    reversedAt: reversal?.reversedAt ?? null,\n    reversedBy: reversal?.reversedBy ?? null,\n    reversalReason: reversal?.reason ?? null,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates auditable adjustments/reversals referencing original event, reason, operator,\n * policy/version, preserves immutable history. Never mutate history — corrections via reversal only.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class AccountingAdjustmentService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AccountingAdjustmentService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createAdjustment(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    originalEventId?: string | null;\n    adjustmentType: PortfolioAdjustmentType;\n    reason: string;\n    adjustedAmount?: string | null;\n    adjustedQuantity?: string | null;\n    asset?: string | null;\n    operatorId: string;\n    evidence?: Record<string, unknown>;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, originalEventId = null, adjustmentType, reason, adjustedAmount = null, adjustedQuantity = null, asset = null, operatorId, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    if (!reason || reason.trim().length < 5) throw new BadRequestException('Reason required (min 5 chars) for adjustment');\n\n    if (adjustedAmount && !isValidDecimal(adjustedAmount)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid adjustedAmount: ${adjustedAmount}`);\n    if (adjustedQuantity && !isValidDecimal(adjustedQuantity)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid adjustedQuantity: ${adjustedQuantity}`);\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `adjustment:${adjustmentType}:${originalEventId ?? 'manual'}`,\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      sourceId: originalEventId ?? `${adjustmentType}:${Date.now()}`,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingAdjustment.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return toAdjustmentView(existing);\n    } catch {}\n\n    // If originalEventId provided, verify it exists and belongs to tenant/profile\n    if (originalEventId) {\n      try {\n        const original = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingEvent.findFirst({\n          where: { id: originalEventId, tenantId, profileId },\n        });\n        if (!original) throw new BadRequestException('Original event not found or tenant mismatch');\n\n        // Check if period is closed — closed periods immutable, corrections via reversal only (allowed but audited)\n        // We allow adjustment but must note it is post-close\n        const period = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.findFirst({\n          where: {\n            tenantId,\n            profileId,\n            periodStart: { lte: original.sourceTimestamp },\n            periodEnd: { gte: original.sourceTimestamp },\n            state: 'CLOSED',\n          },\n        });\n        if (period) {\n          this.logger.warn({ event: 'portfolio.adjustment.post_close', tenantId, profileId, periodId: period.id, originalEventId });\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        if (e instanceof BadRequestException) throw e;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const adjustment = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingAdjustment.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        profileId,\n        originalEventId: originalEventId ?? null,\n        adjustmentType: adjustmentType as any,\n        reason,\n        // Model columns: amount + requestedBy; the adjusted values (required Json) carry the rest.\n        amount: adjustedAmount ?? null,\n        requestedBy: operatorId,\n        adjustedValues: {\n          amount: adjustedAmount ?? null,\n          quantity: adjustedQuantity ?? null,\n          asset: asset ?? null,\n          evidence: redactSecrets(params.evidence ?? {}),\n        } as any,\n        calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // If reversal, mark original as reversed — preserve history, never mutate history destructively\n    if (adjustmentType === PortfolioAdjustmentType.REVERSAL && originalEventId) {\n      try {\n        const originalEvent = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingEvent.findFirst({ where: { id: originalEventId } });\n        const eventMetadata = originalEvent?.metadata && typeof originalEvent.metadata === 'object' ? originalEvent.metadata : {};\n        await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingEvent.update({\n          where: { id: originalEventId },\n          data: {\n            isReversed: true,\n            metadata: {\n              ...eventMetadata,\n              reversal: { reversedAt: new Date().toISOString(), reversedBy: operatorId, reason, adjustmentId: adjustment.id },\n            } as any,\n          },\n        });\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    // For correction, create a new accounting event that is the correction — original stays\n    if (adjustmentType === PortfolioAdjustmentType.CORRECTION && originalEventId) {\n      try {\n        const original = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingEvent.findFirst({ where: { id: originalEventId } });\n        if (original) {\n          // Create reversal of original + new corrected event — both preserved\n          const reversalKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n            type: `reversal_for_correction:${originalEventId}`,\n            tenantId,\n            profileId,\n            sourceId: originalEventId,\n          });\n\n          await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingEvent.create({\n            data: {\n              tenantId,\n              profileId,\n              eventType: 'REVERSAL',\n              cashFlowType: original.cashFlowType,\n              sourceType: 'ADJUSTMENT_REVERSAL',\n              sourceId: `reversal_${originalEventId}_${Date.now()}`,\n              sourceTimestamp: new Date(),\n              asset: asset ?? original.asset,\n              quantity: adjustedQuantity ?? original.quantity,\n              amount: adjustedAmount ?? original.amount,\n              currency: original.currency,\n              baseCurrency: original.baseCurrency,\n              calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n              policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n              idempotencyKey: reversalKey,\n              fingerprint: `reversal_${originalEventId}`,\n              correlationId,\n              metadata: redactSecrets({ originalEventId, adjustmentId: adjustment.id, reason }) as any,\n              evidence: redactSecrets({ originalEventId, reason, operatorId }) as any,\n            },\n          });\n        }\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'portfolio.adjustment.created', tenantId, profileId, adjustmentType, originalEventId });\n\n    return toAdjustmentView(adjustment);\n  }\n\n  async listAdjustments(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId?: string;\n    originalEventId?: string;\n    adjustmentType?: string;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, originalEventId, adjustmentType, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (profileId) where.profileId = profileId;\n    if (originalEventId) where.originalEventId = originalEventId;\n    if (adjustmentType) where.adjustmentType = adjustmentType;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingAdjustment.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingAdjustment.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data: data.map(toAdjustmentView), total, page, limit };\n  }\n\n  async reverseAdjustment(params: { tenantId: string; adjustmentId: string; operatorId: string; reason: string }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, adjustmentId, operatorId, reason } = params;\n\n    const adjustment = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingAdjustment.findFirst({ where: { id: adjustmentId, tenantId } });\n    if (!adjustment) throw new BadRequestException('Adjustment not found');\n\n    if (toAdjustmentView(adjustment).isReversed) throw new BadRequestException('Adjustment already reversed');\n\n    const adjustedValues = adjustment.adjustedValues && typeof adjustment.adjustedValues === 'object' ? adjustment.adjustedValues : {};\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingAdjustment.update({\n      where: { id: adjustmentId },\n      data: {\n        adjustedValues: {\n          ...adjustedValues,\n          reversal: { reversedAt: new Date().toISOString(), reversedBy: operatorId, reason },\n        } as any,\n      },\n    });\n\n    return toAdjustmentView(updated);\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/accounting-event.repository.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected
