Every event must preserve sourceType/sourceId/sourceTimestamp\n * and deterministic idempotency.\n *\n * Source-of-truth rules enforced:\n * - Exchange balance = authoritative for exchange balance truth (we reference, not overwrite)\n * - Exchange position / existing position service = authoritative for live position state\n * - OMS fill = authoritative execution event\n * - Fees module = authoritative platform/performance fee accounting\n * - Finance ledger = authoritative billing/financial ledger\n * - Portfolio Accounting = authoritative accounting/reporting interpretation\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class AccountingEventService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AccountingEventService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly eventRepo: AccountingEventRepository,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async ingestFromOmsFill(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    fill: any;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, fill, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    if (!fill) throw new BadRequestException('Fill required');\n    // Authoritative OMS fill is used as source — must have providerFillId, qty, price, timestamp\n    const sourceType = 'OMS_FILL';\n    const sourceId = fill.providerFillId ?? fill.id ?? fill.fillId;\n    if (!sourceId) throw new BadRequestException('Fill missing providerFillId');\n\n    const quantity = fill.quantity?.toString() ?? fill.qty?.toString();\n    const price = fill.price?.toString();\n    const fee = fill.fee?.toString() ?? '0';\n    const symbol = fill.symbol;\n    const side = fill.side;\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `accounting:${sourceType}`,\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      sourceId,\n      timestampBucket: new Date(fill.timestampMicros ? Number(fill.timestampMicros) / 1000 : Date.now()).toISOString().slice(0, 10),\n    });\n\n    const cashFlowType = side === 'BUY' ? PortfolioCashFlowType.TRADE_SETTLEMENT_BUY : PortfolioCashFlowType.TRADE_SETTLEMENT_SELL;\n\n    const amount = this.calculateTradeAmount(quantity, price);\n\n    const event = await this.eventRepo.createEvent({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      eventType: 'TRADE_FILL',\n      cashFlowType: cashFlowType as any,\n      sourceType,\n      sourceId,\n      sourceTimestamp: fill.timestampMicros ? new Date(Number(fill.timestampMicros) / 1000) : fill.createdAt ? new Date(fill.createdAt) : new Date(),\n      asset: symbol,\n      quantity,\n      price,\n      amount,\n      feeAmount: fee,\n      currency: fill.feeCurrency ?? PortfolioPeriodState,\n  PERIOD_VALID_TRANSITIONS,\n  deterministicIdempotencyKey,\n  redactSecrets,\n} from './portfolio-accounting.types';\n\n/**\n * Manages accounting periods with states OPEN→CLOSING→CLOSED only when required events present,\n * no critical reconciliation failures, valuation sufficient, NAV consistent, PnL reproducible,\n * fees/cash/positions reconcile; failure CLOSING→OPEN with evidence.\n * Closed periods immutable.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class AccountingPeriodService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AccountingPeriodService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createPeriod(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    periodStart: Date;\n    periodEnd: Date;\n    periodType?: string;\n    baseCurrency?: string;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, periodStart, periodEnd, periodType = 'DAILY' } = params;\n\n    if (periodEnd <= periodStart) throw new BadRequestException('periodEnd must be after periodStart');\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n    const baseCurrency = params.baseCurrency ?? policy.baseCurrency;\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `period:${periodType}:${periodStart.toISOString()}:${periodEnd.toISOString()}`,\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      sourceId: `${periodStart.toISOString()}_${periodEnd.toISOString()}`,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Check for overlapping periods — conflict check\n    try {\n      const overlapping = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.findFirst({\n        where: {\n          tenantId,\n          profileId,\n          periodStart: { lte: periodEnd },\n          periodEnd: { gte: periodStart },\n          state: { not: 'CLOSED' },\n        },\n      });\n      if (overlapping) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Overlapping period exists: ${overlapping.id}`);\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      if (e instanceof BadRequestException) throw e;\n    }\n\n    const period = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        profileId,\n        periodStart,\n        periodEnd,\n        state: PortfolioPeriodState.OPEN as any,\n        // No periodType column: it is kept in closeMetadata.\n        closeMetadata: { periodType } as any,\n        baseCurrency,\n        calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n        idempotencyKey,\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'portfolio.period.created', tenantId, profileId, periodId: period.id });\n\n    return period;\n  }\n\n  async transitionPeriod(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    periodId: string;\n    toState: PortfolioPeriodState;\n    reason?: string;\n    operatorId?: string;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, periodId, toState, reason, operatorId } = params;\n\n    const period = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.findFirst({ where: { id: periodId, tenantId } });\n    if (!period) throw new BadRequestException('Period not found or tenant mismatch');\n\n    const currentState = period.state as PortfolioPeriodState;\n\n    // Closed periods immutable — cannot be silently rewritten\n    if (currentState === PortfolioPeriodState.CLOSED) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Closed periods immutable — cannot transition');\n    }\n\n    const allowed = PERIOD_VALID_TRANSITIONS[currentState] ?? [];\n    if (!allowed.includes(toState)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid period transition ${currentState} → ${toState}`);\n    }\n\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.update({\n      where: { id: periodId },\n      data: {\n        state: toState as any,\n        ...(toState === PortfolioPeriodState.CLOSED ? { closedAt: new Date() } : {}),\n        // closedBy / closingStartedAt / transition evidence have no columns: kept in closeMetadata.\n        closeMetadata: redactSecrets({\n          ...((period.closeMetadata as any) ?? {}),\n          ...(toState === PortfolioPeriodState.CLOSED ? { closedBy: operatorId ?? null } : {}),\n          ...(toState === PortfolioPeriodState.CLOSING ? { closingStartedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : {}),\n          lastTransition: { from: currentState, to: toState, reason, operatorId, at: new Date().toISOString() },\n        }) as any,\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'portfolio.period.transition', periodId, from: currentState, to: toState });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async getPeriod(params: { tenantId: string; periodId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    return await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.findFirst({\n      where: { id: params.periodId, tenantId: params.tenantId },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async listPeriods(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId?: string;\n    state?: string;\n    from?: Date;\n    to?: Date;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, state, from, to, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (profileId) where.profileId = profileId;\n    if (state) where.state = state;\n    if (from || to) {\n      where.periodStart = {};\n      if (from) where.periodStart.gte = from;\n      if (to) where.periodStart.lte = to;\n    }\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { periodStart: 'desc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n\n  async isPeriodClosed(params: { tenantId: string; profileId: string; at: Date }): Promise<boolean> {\n    const period = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.findFirst({\n      where: {\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        profileId: params.profileId,\n        periodStart: { lte: params.at },\n        periodEnd: { gte: params.at },\n        state: 'CLOSED',\n      },\n    });\n    return !!period;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/accounting-policy.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Must reuse existing configuration/policy\n * sources where available.\n */\n\nexport interface AccountingPolicy {\n  baseCurrency: string;\n  valuationCurrency: string;\n  valuationFrequency: string;\n  returnMethodology: PortfolioReturnMethodology;\n  costBasisMethod: string;\n  feeTreatment: string;\n  periodBoundary: string;\n  roundingMode: string;\n  roundingScale: number;\n  supportedAssets: string[];\n  closeRules: {\n    requireReconciliation: boolean;\n    requireValuation: boolean;\n    requireFeeReconciliation: boolean;\n    requireCashReconciliation: boolean;\n    requirePositionReconciliation: boolean;\n    allowIncompleteValuation: boolean;\n  };\n  policyVersion: string;\n  calculationVersion: string;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class AccountingPolicyService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AccountingPolicyService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly config: AppConfigService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async resolvePolicy(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    scope: PortfolioAccountingScope;\n    scopeId: string;\n  }): Promise<AccountingPolicy> {\n    const { tenantId, scope, scopeId } = params;\n\n    // Reuse existing configuration/policy sources where available — check TenantSetting, TenantFeatureFlag, etc.\n    let baseCurrency = 'USD';\n    let supportedAssets: string[] = ['BTC', 'ETH', 'USDT', 'USDC', 'BNB', 'SOL'];\n\n    try {\n      const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({ where: { id: tenantId }, select: { defaultCurrency: true, supportedCurrencies: true } });\n      if (tenant?.defaultCurrency) baseCurrency = tenant.defaultCurrency;\n      if (tenant?.supportedCurrencies && tenant.supportedCurrencies.length > 0) {\n        // supportedCurrencies are fiat, but we also support crypto — merge\n        supportedAssets = [...new Set([...supportedAssets, ...tenant.supportedCurrencies])];\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Check for existing accounting profile — if exists, use its policy\n    try {\n      const profile = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, scope: scope as any, scopeId },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n      if (profile) {\n        return {\n          baseCurrency: profile.baseCurrency,\n          valuationCurrency: profile.valuationCurrency ?? profile.baseCurrency,\n          valuationFrequency: profile.valuationFrequency,\n          returnMethodology: profile.returnMethodology as PortfolioReturnMethodology,\n          costBasisMethod: profile.costBasisMethod,\n          feeTreatment: profile.feeTreatment,\n          periodBoundary: profile.periodBoundary,\n          roundingMode: profile.roundingMode,\n          roundingScale: profile.roundingScale,\n          supportedAssets,\n          closeRules: {\n            requireReconciliation: true,\n            requireValuation: true,\n            requireFeeReconciliation: true,\n            requireCashReconciliation: true,\n            requirePositionReconciliation: true,\n            allowIncompleteValuation: false,\n          },\n          policyVersion: profile.policyVersion,\n          calculationVersion: profile.calculationVersion,\n        };\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Default policy — explicit, auditable, not invented thresholds from nowhere\n    const policy: AccountingPolicy = {\n      baseCurrency,\n      valuationCurrency: baseCurrency,\n      valuationFrequency: 'DAILY',\n      returnMethodology: PortfolioReturnMethodology.TIME_WEIGHTED_RETURN,\n      costBasisMethod: 'FIFO',\n      feeTreatment: 'NET',\n      periodBoundary: 'UTC_MIDNIGHT',\n      roundingMode: 'HALF_UP',\n      roundingScale: 8,\n      supportedAssets,\n      closeRules: {\n        requireReconciliation: true,\n        requireValuation: true,\n        requireFeeReconciliation: true,\n        requireCashReconciliation: true,\n        requirePositionReconciliation: true,\n        allowIncompleteValuation: false,\n      },\n      policyVersion: POLICY_VERSION_DEFAULT,\n      calculationVersion: CALCULATION_VERSION,\n    };\n\n    this.logger.debug({\n      event: 'portfolio.policy.resolved',\n      tenantId,\n      scope,\n      scopeId,\n      baseCurrency,\n      policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n    });\n\n    return policy;\n  }\n\n  async createOrUpdateProfile(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    scope: PortfolioAccountingScope;\n    scopeId: string;\n    portfolioType?: PortfolioType;\n    baseCurrency?: string;\n    returnMethodology?: PortfolioReturnMethodology;\n    costBasisMethod?: string;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const policy = await this.resolvePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId, scope: params.scope, scopeId: params.scopeId });\n\n    const baseCurrency = params.baseCurrency ?? policy.baseCurrency;\n    const returnMethodology = params.returnMethodology ?? policy.returnMethodology;\n    const costBasisMethod = params.costBasisMethod ?? policy.costBasisMethod;\n    const portfolioType = params.portfolioType ?? PortfolioType.SPOT;\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, scope: params.scope as any, scopeId: params.scopeId },\n      });\n      if (existing) {\n        return await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile.update({\n          where: { id: existing.id },\n          data: {\n            baseCurrency,\n            returnMethodology: returnMethodology as any,\n            costBasisMethod,\n            portfolioType: portfolioType as any,\n            policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n            calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n          },\n        });\n      }\n      return await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          scope: params.scope as any,\n          scopeId: params.scopeId,\n          portfolioType: portfolioType as any,\n          baseCurrency,\n          valuationCurrency: baseCurrency,\n          returnMethodology: returnMethodology as any,\n          costBasisMethod,\n          feeTreatment: policy.feeTreatment,\n          valuationFrequency: policy.valuationFrequency,\n          periodBoundary: policy.periodBoundary,\n          roundingMode: policy.roundingMode,\n          roundingScale: policy.roundingScale,\n          policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n          calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to create accounting profile: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  getCalculationVersion(): string {\n    return CALCULATION_VERSION;\n  }\n\n  getPolicyVersion(): string {\n    return POLICY_VERSION_DEFAULT;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/accounting-reconciliation.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected 'y' : 'ies'} (${critical} critical): ${types}`;\n  return summary.length > 1000 ? `${summary.slice(0, 997)}...` : summary;\n}\n\n/** API view of a PortfolioAccountingReconciliation row: keeps scope/trigger/discrepancies/hasCriticalFailure/requestedBy. */\nexport function toReconciliationView(row: any): any {\n  if (!row) return row;\n  const detail = row.discrepancy && typeof row.discrepancy === 'object' ? row.discrepancy : {};\n  return {\n    ...row,\n    scope: row.reconciliationType,\n    trigger: detail.trigger ?? row.sourceType ?? null,\n    discrepancies: Array.isArray(detail.items) ? detail.items : [],\n    hasCriticalFailure: Boolean(row.isCritical),\n    requestedBy: detail.requestedBy ?? null,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Reconciles against OMS fills, positions, balances, fees, finance ledger, copy allocations.\n * Detects missing events, double counting, quantity drift, cash drift, valuation inconsistencies,\n * period discrepancies without silently rewriting.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class AccountingReconciliationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AccountingReconciliationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async reconcilePeriod(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    periodStart: Date;\n    periodEnd: Date;\n  }): Promise<{ hasCriticalFailure: boolean; discrepancies: Array<{ type: string; severity: string; details: any }> }> {\n    const discrepancies: Array<{ type: string; severity: string; details: any }> = [];\n\n    // Check for duplicate events (same sourceId counted twice)\n    try {\n      const events = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingEvent.findMany({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          profileId: params.profileId,\n          sourceTimestamp: { gte: params.periodStart, lte: params.periodEnd },\n          isReversed: false,\n        },\n      });\n\n      const sourceMap = new Map<string, number>();\n      for (const ev of events) {\n        const key = `${ev.sourceType}:${ev.sourceId}`;\n        sourceMap.set(key, (sourceMap.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);\n      }\n      for (const [key, count] of sourceMap.entries()) {\n        if (count > 1) {\n          discrepancies.push({ type: 'DUPLICATE_EVENT', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { sourceKey: key, count } });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Check against OMS fills — missing events\n      try {\n        // OMS fills live in OmsFill (the OMS fill ledger).\n        const omsFills = await this.prisma.omsFill.findMany({\n          where: {\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            createdAt: { gte: params.periodStart, lte: params.periodEnd },\n          },\n          select: { id: true, providerFillId: true },\n        });\n        if (omsFills) {\n          for (const fill of omsFills) {\n            const exists = events.some((e: any) => e.sourceType === 'OMS_FILL' && e.sourceId === (fill.providerFillId ?? fill.id));\n            if (!exists) {\n              discrepancies.push({ type: 'MISSING_EVENT', severity: 'WARNING', details: { sourceType: 'OMS_FILL', sourceId: fill.providerFillId ?? fill.id } });\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch {}\n\n      // Cash drift vs exchange balance — compare accounting cash vs exchange balance if available\n      try {\n        const cashEntries = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry.findMany({\n          where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, profileId: params.profileId, occurredAt: { gte: params.periodStart, lte: params.periodEnd } },\n        });\n\n        let accountingCash = '0';\n        for (const entry of cashEntries) {\n          const isOutflow = ['WITHDRAWAL', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'FEE', 'PLATFORM_FEE', 'PERFORMANCE_FEE', 'TRADE_SETTLEMENT_BUY'].includes(entry.cashFlowType);\n          const amt = entry.baseCurrencyAmount ?? entry.amount;\n          if (!isValidDecimal(amt)) continue;\n          accountingCash = isOutflow ? sub(accountingCash, amt) : add(accountingCash, amt);\n        }\n\n        // If exchange balance available, compare\n        // For now, just check if cash entries have missing FX\n        const missingFxEntries = cashEntries.filter((e: any) => e.conversionStatus === 'MISSING_FX');\n        if (missingFxEntries.length > 0) {\n          discrepancies.push({ type: 'MISSING_FX', severity: 'WARNING', details: { count: missingFxEntries.length, entries: missingFxEntries.map((e: any) => e.id) } });\n        }\n      } catch {}\n\n      // Position mismatch — compare accounting lots vs OMS positions\n      try {\n        const lots = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.findMany({\n          where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, profileId: params.profileId, isClosed: false },\n        });\n\n        const holdingsMap = new Map<string, string>();\n        for (const lot of lots) {\n          const existing = holdingsMap.get(lot.symbol) ?? '0';\n          holdingsMap.set(lot.symbol, add(existing, lot.remainingQuantity));\n        }\n\n        // Try to get authoritative positions from existing position service\n        const authoritativePositions = await (this.prisma as any).position?.findMany?.({\n          where: { tenantId: params.tenantId },\n        });\n\n        if (authoritativePositions) {\n          for (const pos of authoritativePositions) {\n            const accountingQty = holdingsMap.get(pos.symbol) ?? '0';\n            const authQty = pos.quantity?.toString() ?? '0';\n            if (isValidDecimal(accountingQty) && isValidDecimal(authQty)) {\n              const drift = sub(accountingQty, authQty);\n              if (cmp(drift, '0') !== 0) {\n                discrepancies.push({\n                  type: 'POSITION_MISMATCH',\n                  severity: cmp(this.absSafe(drift), '0.0001') > 0 ? 'WARNING' : 'INFO',\n                  details: { symbol: pos.symbol, accountingQty, authoritativeQty: authQty, drift },\n                });\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch {}\n\n      // Fee mismatch — compare fee accruals vs cash ledger fees\n      try {\n        const feeAccruals = await (this.prisma as any).feeAccrual?.findMany?.({\n          where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, createdAt: { gte: params.periodStart, lte: params.periodEnd } },\n        });\n        const feeCashEntries = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry.findMany({\n          where: {\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            profileId: params.profileId,\n            cashFlowType: { in: ['FEE', 'PLATFORM_FEE', 'PERFORMANCE_FEE'] },\n            occurredAt: { gte: params.periodStart, lte: params.periodEnd },\n          },\n        });\n\n        if (feeAccruals && feeAccruals.length !== feeCashEntries.length) {\n          discrepancies.push({\n            type: 'FEE_MISMATCH',\n            severity: 'WARNING',\n            details: { feeAccrualsCount: feeAccruals.length, cashFeeEntriesCount: feeCashEntries.length },\n          });\n        }\n      } catch {}\n\n      // Valuation staleness\n      try {\n        const valuations = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioValuation.findMany({\n          where: {\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            profileId: params.profileId,\n            valuationTimestamp: { gte: params.periodStart, lte: params.periodEnd },\n          },\n        });\n\n        const stale = valuations.filter((v: any) => v.valuationState === 'STALE');\n        const missing = valuations.filter((v: any) => v.valuationState === 'MISSING_PRICE' || v.valuationState === 'MISSING_FX');\n\n        if (stale.length > 0) {\n          discrepancies.push({ type: 'VALUATION_STALENESS', severity: 'WARNING', details: { count: stale.length } });\n        }\n        if (missing.length > 0) {\n          discrepancies.push({ type: 'MISSING_PRICE', severity: 'WARNING', details: { count: missing.length } });\n        }\n      } catch {}\n\n      // Closed-period mutation check — if period is CLOSED, ensure no new events after close\n      try {\n        const closedPeriod = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.findFirst({\n          where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, profileId: params.profileId, periodStart: params.periodStart, periodEnd: params.periodEnd, state: 'CLOSED' },\n        });\n        if (closedPeriod && closedPeriod.closedAt) {\n          const eventsAfterClose = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingEvent.count({\n            where: {\n              tenantId: params.tenantId,\n              profileId: params.profileId,\n              sourceTimestamp: { gte: params.periodStart, lte: params.periodEnd },\n              createdAt: { gt: closedPeriod.closedAt },\n              isReversed: false,\n            },\n          });\n          if (eventsAfterClose > 0) {\n            discrepancies.push({ type: 'CLOSED_PERIOD_MUTATION', severity: 'CRITICAL', details: { eventsAfterClose, closedAt: closedPeriod.closedAt } });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch {}\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Reconciliation failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      discrepancies.push({ type: 'RECONCILIATION_FAILED', severity: 'WARNING', details: { error: (e as Error).message } });\n    }\n\n    const hasCriticalFailure = discrepancies.some((d) => d.severity === 'CRITICAL');\n\n    return { hasCriticalFailure, discrepancies };\n  }\n\n  async runReconciliation(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    scope: string;\n    periodId?: string | null;\n    trigger?: string;\n    requestedBy?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, scope, periodId = null, trigger = 'MANUAL', requestedBy = null } = params;\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n\n    let periodStart = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n    let periodEnd = new Date();\n\n    if (periodId) {\n      try {\n        const period = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.findFirst({ where: { id: periodId, tenantId } });\n        if (period) {\n          periodStart = period.periodStart;\n          periodEnd = period.periodEnd;\n        }\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.reconcilePeriod({ tenantId, profileId, periodStart, periodEnd });\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `reconciliation:${scope}:${periodStart.toISOString()}:${periodEnd.toISOString()}`,\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      sourceId: periodId ?? `${periodStart.toISOString()}_${periodEnd.toISOString()}`,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingReconciliation.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return toReconciliationView(existing);\n    } catch {}\n\n    const recon = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingReconciliation.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        profileId,\n        periodId: periodId ?? null,\n        // Model columns: reconciliationType (= scope), summary, severity, isCritical;\n        // the discrepancy list, trigger, requester and evidence go into the discrepancy Json.\n        reconciliationType: String(scope).slice(0, 64),\n        state: result.hasCriticalFailure ? 'MISMATCH' : result.discrepancies.length > 0 ? 'MISMATCH' : 'MATCHED',\n        summary: summarizeDiscrepancies(result.discrepancies),\n        severity: result.hasCriticalFailure ? 'CRITICAL' : result.discrepancies.length > 0 ? 'WARNING' : 'NONE',\n        isCritical: result.hasCriticalFailure,\n        sourceType: trigger ? String(trigger).slice(0, 64) : null,\n        discrepancy: redactSecrets({\n          items: result.discrepancies,\n          trigger,\n          requestedBy: requestedBy ?? null,\n          periodStart: periodStart.toISOString(),\n          periodEnd: periodEnd.toISOString(),\n        }) as any,\n        calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n        idempotencyKey,\n      },\n    });\n\n    return toReconciliationView(recon);\n  }\n\n  async listReconciliations(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId?: string;\n    periodId?: string;\n    state?: string;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, periodId, state, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (profileId) where.profileId = profileId;\n    if (periodId) where.periodId = periodId;\n    if (state) where.state = state;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingReconciliation.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingReconciliation.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data: data.map(toReconciliationView), total, page, limit };\n  }\n\n  private absSafe(val: string): string {\n    return val.startsWith('-') ? val.slice(1) : val;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/attribution.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. row.evidence : {};\n  return { ...row, dimensionValue: row.dimensionId, pnl: row.pnlContribution, percentage: evidence.percentage ?? null };\n}\n\n/**\n * Produces deterministic attribution by strategy, trader, follower, symbol, asset, venue,\n * copy allocation, and fee, explaining total PnL without becoming a second PnL source.\n * Must detect and report unattributed, double-attributed, missing allocation, quantity mismatch,\n * and fee mismatch conditions.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class AttributionService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(AttributionService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async calculateAttribution(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    periodStart: Date;\n    periodEnd: Date;\n    dimension: PortfolioAttributionDimension;\n    totalPnl: string;\n    baseCurrency?: string;\n  }): Promise<{\n    attributions: Array<{ dimensionValue: string; pnl: string; percentage: string }>;\n    totalAttributed: string;\n    unattributed: string;\n    discrepancy: string;\n    hasDiscrepancy: boolean;\n    evidence: any;\n  }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, periodStart, periodEnd, dimension, totalPnl } = params;\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n    const baseCurrency = params.baseCurrency ?? policy.baseCurrency;\n\n    // Fetch accounting events for period and attribute\n    let events: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      events = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingEvent.findMany({\n        where: {\n          tenantId,\n          profileId,\n          sourceTimestamp: { gte: periodStart, lte: periodEnd },\n          isReversed: false,\n        },\n        orderBy: { sourceTimestamp: 'asc' },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      events = [];\n    }\n\n    const attributionMap = new Map<string, string>();\n\n    for (const event of events) {\n      let dimensionValue: string | null = null;\n\n      switch (dimension) {\n        case PortfolioAttributionDimension.SYMBOL:\n          dimensionValue = event.asset ?? 'UNKNOWN';\n          break;\n        case PortfolioAttributionDimension.ASSET:\n          dimensionValue = event.asset ?? 'UNKNOWN';\n          break;\n        case PortfolioAttributionDimension.STRATEGY:\n          dimensionValue = (event.metadata as any)?.strategyId ?? (event.metadata as any)?.strategy ?? 'UNKNOWN';\n          break;\n        case PortfolioAttributionDimension.TRADER:\n          dimensionValue = (event.metadata as any)?.traderId ?? 'UNKNOWN';\n          break;\n        case PortfolioAttributionDimension.FOLLOWER:\n          dimensionValue = (event.metadata as any)?.followerId ?? 'UNKNOWN';\n          break;\n        case PortfolioAttributionDimension.VENUE:\n          dimensionValue = (event.metadata as any)?.venue ?? 'UNKNOWN';\n          break;\n        case PortfolioAttributionDimension.COPY_ALLOCATION:\n          dimensionValue = event.copyAllocationId ?? 'UNKNOWN';\n          break;\n        case PortfolioAttributionDimension.FEE:\n          dimensionValue = event.cashFlowType ?? 'UNKNOWN';\n          break;\n        default:\n          dimensionValue = 'UNKNOWN';\n      }\n\n      if (!dimensionValue) dimensionValue = 'UNKNOWN';\n\n      // For attribution, we need PnL per event — from metadata or calculate\n      // Simplified: use amount as proxy for attribution, real would use realized PnL per event\n      const eventPnl = event.amount ?? '0';\n      if (!isValidDecimal(eventPnl)) continue;\n\n      const existing = attributionMap.get(dimensionValue) ?? '0';\n      attributionMap.set(dimensionValue, add(existing, eventPnl));\n    }\n\n    // Also fetch cash ledger fees for fee attribution\n    if (dimension === PortfolioAttributionDimension.FEE) {\n      try {\n        const feeEntries = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry.findMany({\n          where: {\n            tenantId,\n            profileId,\n            cashFlowType: { in: ['FEE', 'PLATFORM_FEE', 'PERFORMANCE_FEE'] },\n            occurredAt: { gte: periodStart, lte: periodEnd },\n          },\n        });\n        for (const fee of feeEntries) {\n          const feeValue = fee.baseCurrencyAmount ?? fee.amount;\n          const existing = attributionMap.get(fee.cashFlowType) ?? '0';\n          attributionMap.set(fee.cashFlowType, add(existing, `-${feeValue}`)); // fees negative attribution\n        }\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    let totalAttributed = '0';\n    const attributions: Array<{ dimensionValue: string; pnl: string; percentage: string }> = [];\n\n    for (const [dimValue, pnl] of attributionMap.entries()) {\n      totalAttributed = add(totalAttributed, pnl);\n    }\n\n    // Calculate percentages and detect discrepancies\n    for (const [dimValue, pnl] of attributionMap.entries()) {\n      let percentage = '0';\n      try {\n        if (cmp(totalPnl, '0') !== 0) {\n          percentage = mul(div(pnl, totalPnl), '100');\n        }\n      } catch {\n        percentage = '0';\n      }\n      attributions.push({ dimensionValue: dimValue, pnl, percentage });\n    }\n\n    const unattributed = sub(totalPnl, totalAttributed);\n    const discrepancy = unattributed; // difference between total and sum of attributions\n    const hasDiscrepancy = cmp(this.absSafe(unattributed), '0.0001') !== 0; // rounding tolerance 0.0001\n\n    // Detect double-attributed, missing allocation, quantity mismatch, fee mismatch\n    const diagnostics: string[] = [];\n    if (hasDiscrepancy) {\n      diagnostics.push(`ATTRIBUTION_DISCREPANCY: total=${totalPnl} attributed=${totalAttributed} unattributed=${unattributed}`);\n    }\n    if (attributionMap.has('UNKNOWN') && cmp(attributionMap.get('UNKNOWN') ?? '0', '0') !== 0) {\n      diagnostics.push(`UNATTRIBUTED: ${attributionMap.get('UNKNOWN')} assigned to UNKNOWN dimension`);\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate source counting — if same sourceId appears multiple times\n    const sourceIds = events.map((e: any) => e.sourceId);\n    const duplicateSources = sourceIds.filter((id: string, idx: number) => sourceIds.indexOf(id) !== idx);\n    if (duplicateSources.length > 0) {\n      diagnostics.push(`DUPLICATE_SOURCE_DETECTED: ${[...new Set(duplicateSources)].join(',')}`);\n    }\n\n    const evidence = {\n      dimension,\n      periodStart: periodStart.toISOString(),\n      periodEnd: periodEnd.toISOString(),\n      totalPnl,\n      totalAttributed,\n      unattributed,\n      discrepancy,\n      hasDiscrepancy,\n      diagnostics,\n      baseCurrency,\n      calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n      policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      methodology: `ATTRIBUTION_BY_${dimension}`,\n      dataCompleteness: hasDiscrepancy ? 'DISCREPANCY_DETECTED' : 'COMPLETE',\n      sourceReferences: [...new Set(events.map((e: any) => `${e.sourceType}:${e.sourceId}`))],\n    };\n\n    return { attributions, totalAttributed, unattributed, discrepancy, hasDiscrepancy, evidence };\n  }\n\n  async persistAttribution(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    periodId?: string | null;\n    dimension: PortfolioAttributionDimension;\n    dimensionValue: string;\n    pnl: string;\n    percentage: string;\n    periodStart: Date;\n    periodEnd: Date;\n    baseCurrency: string;\n    calculationVersion: string;\n    policyVersion: string;\n    evidence: any;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `attribution:${params.dimension}:${params.dimensionValue}:${params.periodStart.toISOString()}:${params.periodEnd.toISOString()}`,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      profileId: params.profileId,\n      sourceId: params.periodId ?? `${params.dimension}:${params.dimensionValue}`,\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAttributionRecord.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return toAttributionRecordView(existing);\n    } catch {}\n\n    try {\n      // Columns: dimensionId (the dimension value) and pnlContribution; the percentage is kept in evidence.\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAttributionRecord.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          profileId: params.profileId,\n          periodId: params.periodId ?? null,\n          dimension: params.dimension as any,\n          dimensionId: params.dimensionValue,\n          pnlContribution: params.pnl,\n          periodStart: params.periodStart,\n          periodEnd: params.periodEnd,\n          baseCurrency: params.baseCurrency,\n          calculationVersion: params.calculationVersion,\n          policyVersion: params.policyVersion,\n          evidence: redactSecrets({ ...(params.evidence ?? {}), percentage: params.percentage }) as any,\n          idempotencyKey,\n        },\n      });\n      return toAttributionRecordView(created);\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to persist attribution: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private absSafe(val: string): string {\n    return val.startsWith('-') ? val.slice(1) : val;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/benchmark.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { AccountingPolicyService } from './accounting-policy.service';\nimport { sub, mul, div } from './portfolio-accounting.types';\n\n/**\n * Manages benchmark definitions and observations using verified market/index data, never fabricated.\n * Calculates alpha vs benchmark.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class BenchmarkService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(BenchmarkService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async defineBenchmark(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    benchmarkId: string;\n    name: string;\n    description?: string | null;\n    source: string;\n    baseCurrency: string;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    // Benchmark definition stored in evidence/metadata — for now return definition\n    // In full implementation, would have Benchmark model, but we reuse existing structure\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: params.profileId });\n    return {\n      benchmarkId: params.benchmarkId,\n      name: params.name,\n      description: params.description ?? null,\n      source: params.source,\n      baseCurrency: params.baseCurrency ?? policy.baseCurrency,\n      calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n      policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /** Candle intervals in order of preference for a benchmark series. */\n  private static readonly SERIES_INTERVALS: readonly string[] = ['1d', '4h', '1h', '15m', '5m', '1m'];\n\n  /**\n   * One venue/interval series out of mixed candle rows. Interleaving a 1m and\n   * a 1d series (or two venues) would fabricate returns between unrelated\n   * closes, so exactly one series is kept: the most preferred interval, and\n   * within it the venue with the most observations. Input order is kept.\n   */\n  static pickSeries<T extends { venue: string; interval: string }>(rows: readonly T[]): T[] {\n    if (rows.length === 0) {\n      return [];\n    }\n    const groups = new Map<string, T[]>();\n    for (const row of rows) {\n      const key = `${row.venue}|${row.interval}`;\n      const group = groups.get(key);\n      if (group === undefined) {\n        groups.set(key, [row]);\n      } else {\n        group.push(row);\n      }\n    }\n    const rank = (interval: string): number => {\n      const i = BenchmarkService.SERIES_INTERVALS.indexOf(interval);\n      return i === -1 ? BenchmarkService.SERIES_INTERVALS.length : i;\n    };\n    let best: T[] | null = null;\n    for (const group of groups.values()) {\n      if (best === null) {\n        best = group;\n        continue;\n      }\n      const g = rank((group[0] as T).interval);\n      const b = rank((best[0] as T).interval);\n      if (g < b || (g === b && group.length > best.length)) {\n        best = group;\n      }\n    }\n    return best ?? [];\n  }\n\n  async getBenchmarkObservations(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    benchmarkId: string;\n    from: Date;\n    to: Date;\n  }): Promise<Array<{ timestamp: Date; value: string; source: string }>> {\n    // Must use verified market/index data: MarketDataRecord candles, keyed by\n    // symbol (benchmarkId is a symbol such as BTCUSDT). No such data -> [].\n    const rows = await this.prisma.marketDataRecord.findMany({\n      where: { symbol: params.benchmarkId, closeTime: { gte: params.from, lte: params.to } },\n      orderBy: { closeTime: 'asc' },\n      select: { close: true, closeTime: true, venue: true, interval: true },\n    });\n\n    const series = BenchmarkService.pickSeries(rows);\n    if (series.length > 0) {\n      return series.map((p) => ({\n        timestamp: p.closeTime,\n        value: p.close.toString(),\n        source: `MARKET_DATA:${p.venue}:${p.interval}`,\n      }));\n    }\n\n    // No benchmark data — explicit, not fabricated\n    return [];\n  }\n\n  async calculateBenchmarkReturn(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    benchmarkId: string;\n    periodStart: Date;\n    periodEnd: Date;\n    baseCurrency?: string;\n  }): Promise<{ returnPercent: string | null; evidence: any; canCalculate: boolean }> {\n    const observations = await this.getBenchmarkObservations({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      benchmarkId: params.benchmarkId,\n      from: params.periodStart,\n      to: params.periodEnd,\n    });\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: params.profileId });\n\n    if (observations.length < 2) {\n      return {\n        returnPercent: null,\n        canCalculate: false,\n        evidence: {\n          benchmarkId: params.benchmarkId,\n          periodStart: params.periodStart.toISOString(),\n          periodEnd: params.periodEnd.toISOString(),\n          observationsCount: observations.length,\n          returnPercent: null,\n          calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n          policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n          dataCompleteness: 'MISSING_BENCHMARK_OBSERVATIONS',\n          sourceReferences: [],\n        },\n      };\n    }\n\n    const startValue = observations[0].value;\n    const endValue = observations[observations.length - 1].value;\n\n    try {\n      const ratio = div(endValue, startValue);\n      const ret = mul(sub(ratio, '1'), '100');\n      return {\n        returnPercent: ret,\n        canCalculate: true,\n        evidence: {\n          benchmarkId: params.benchmarkId,\n          periodStart: params.periodStart.toISOString(),\n          periodEnd: params.periodEnd.toISOString(),\n          startValue,\n          endValue,\n          observationsCount: observations.length,\n          returnPercent: ret,\n          calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n          policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n          dataCompleteness: 'COMPLETE',\n          sourceReferences: [...new Set(observations.map((o) => o.source))],\n        },\n      };\n    } catch {\n      return {\n        returnPercent: null,\n        canCalculate: false,\n        evidence: {\n          benchmarkId: params.benchmarkId,\n          periodStart: params.periodStart.toISOString(),\n          periodEnd: params.periodEnd.toISOString(),\n          observationsCount: observations.length,\n          returnPercent: null,\n          calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n          policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n          dataCompleteness: 'CALCULATION_FAILED',\n          sourceReferences: [],\n        },\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async calculateAlpha(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    portfolioReturn: string | null;\n    benchmarkReturn: string | null;\n    benchmarkId: string;\n  }): Promise<{ alpha: string | null; evidence: any }> {\n    if (params.portfolioReturn === null || params.benchmarkReturn === null) {\n      return { alpha: null, evidence: { benchmarkId: params.benchmarkId, portfolioReturn: params.portfolioReturn, benchmarkReturn: params.benchmarkReturn, alpha: null, dataCompleteness: 'MISSING_OBSERVATIONS' } };\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const alpha = sub(params.portfolioReturn, params.benchmarkReturn);\n      return {\n        alpha,\n        evidence: {\n          benchmarkId: params.benchmarkId,\n          portfolioReturn: params.portfolioReturn,\n          benchmarkReturn: params.benchmarkReturn,\n          alpha,\n          dataCompleteness: 'COMPLETE',\n        },\n      };\n    } catch {\n      return { alpha: null, of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":13,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Responsibility: maintain portfolio cash accounting from authoritative financial events.\nimport { Injectable, Logger, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { AccountingEventRepository } from './accounting-event.repository';\nimport { AccountingPolicyService } from './accounting-policy.service';\nimport { PortfolioCashFlowType, deterministicIdempotencyKey, add, sub, mul, isValidDecimal } from './portfolio-accounting.types';\n\n/**\n * Maintains portfolio-level accounting cash movements derived from authoritative deposits,\n * withdrawals, transfers, trading settlement, fees, and other supported financial events.\n * Must never become an independent exchange-balance truth.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class CashLedgerService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(CashLedgerService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly eventRepo: AccountingEventRepository,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async recordCashMovement(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    accountingEventId?: string | null;\n    cashFlowType: PortfolioCashFlowType;\n    asset: string;\n    amount: string;\n    currency: string;\n    occurredAt: Date;\n    sourceType?: string | null;\n    sourceId?: string | null;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n    baseCurrency?: string | null;\n    conversionRate?: string | null;\n    conversionSource?: string | null;\n    conversionStatus?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, accountingEventId = null, cashFlowType, asset, amount, currency, occurredAt, sourceType = null, sourceId = null, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    if (!isValidDecimal(amount)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid amount decimal: ${amount}`);\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `cash:${cashFlowType}`,\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      sourceId: sourceId ?? accountingEventId ?? `${cashFlowType}:${asset}:${amount}:${occurredAt.toISOString()}`,\n      timestampBucket: occurredAt.toISOString().slice(0, 10),\n    });\n\n    // Idempotency mandatory\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Calculate running balance — deterministic from prior entries, Decimal-safe\n    let runningBalance = amount;\n    try {\n      const lastEntry = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, profileId, asset },\n        orderBy: { occurredAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n      if (lastEntry && lastEntry.runningBalance) {\n        // Running balance = previous + current (for deposits/buys) or - for withdrawals/sells/fees\n        const isOutflow = [PortfolioCashFlowType.WITHDRAWAL, PortfolioCashFlowType.TRANSFER_OUT, PortfolioCashFlowType.FEE, PortfolioCashFlowType.PLATFORM_FEE, PortfolioCashFlowType.PERFORMANCE_FEE, PortfolioCashFlowType.TRADE_SETTLEMENT_BUY].includes(cashFlowType);\n        runningBalance = isOutflow ? sub(lastEntry.runningBalance, amount) : add(lastEntry.runningBalance, amount);\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const baseCurrency = params.baseCurrency ?? policy.baseCurrency;\n    let baseCurrencyAmount: string | null = null;\n    if (params.conversionRate && baseCurrency !== currency) {\n      try {\n        baseCurrencyAmount = mul(amount, params.conversionRate);\n      } catch {\n        baseCurrencyAmount = null;\n      }\n    } else if (baseCurrency === currency) {\n      baseCurrencyAmount = amount;\n    }\n\n    const created = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        profileId,\n        accountingEventId: accountingEventId ?? null,\n        cashFlowType: cashFlowType as any,\n        asset,\n        amount,\n        currency,\n        runningBalance,\n        baseCurrency,\n        baseCurrencyAmount,\n        conversionRate: params.conversionRate ?? null,\n        conversionSource: params.conversionSource ?? null,\n        conversionTimestamp: new Date(),\n        conversionStatus: params.conversionStatus ?? (baseCurrency === currency ? 'SAME_CURRENCY' : params.conversionRate ? 'CONVERTED' : 'MISSING_FX'),\n        sourceType: sourceType ?? null,\n        sourceId: sourceId ?? null,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n        correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n        occurredAt,\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'portfolio.cash.recorded', tenantId, profileId, cashFlowType, asset, amount });\n\n    return created;\n  }\n\n  async getCashBalance(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    asset?: string;\n    currency?: string;\n    at?: Date;\n  }): Promise<{ asset: string; balance: string; currency: string; baseCurrency: string; baseCurrencyBalance: string | null }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, asset, at = new Date() } = params;\n\n    try {\n      const where: any = { tenantId, profileId, occurredAt: { lte: at } };\n      if (asset) where.asset = asset;\n\n      const entries = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { occurredAt: 'asc' },\n      });\n\n      // Deterministic sum using Decimal-safe arithmetic\n      let balance = '0';\n      let baseBalance: string | null = null;\n      let currency = asset ?? 'USD';\n      let baseCurrency = 'USD';\n\n      for (const entry of entries) {\n        if (asset && entry.asset !== asset) continue;\n        currency = entry.currency;\n        baseCurrency = entry.baseCurrency;\n        const isOutflow = [PortfolioCashFlowType.WITHDRAWAL, PortfolioCashFlowType.TRANSFER_OUT, PortfolioCashFlowType.FEE, PortfolioCashFlowType.PLATFORM_FEE, PortfolioCashFlowType.PERFORMANCE_FEE, PortfolioCashFlowType.TRADE_SETTLEMENT_BUY].includes(entry.cashFlowType as any);\n        balance = isOutflow ? sub(balance, entry.amount) : add(balance, entry.amount);\n        if (entry.baseCurrencyAmount) {\n          if (baseBalance === null) baseBalance = '0';\n          baseBalance = isOutflow ? sub(baseBalance, entry.baseCurrencyAmount) : add(baseBalance, entry.baseCurrencyAmount);\n        }\n      }\n\n      return { asset: asset ?? 'CASH', balance, currency, baseCurrency, baseCurrencyBalance: baseBalance };\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to get cash balance: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      return { asset: asset ?? 'CASH', balance: '0', currency: 'USD', baseCurrency: 'USD', baseCurrencyBalance: null };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async listCashEntries(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    asset?: string;\n    cashFlowType?: string;\n    from?: Date;\n    to?: Date;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, asset, cashFlowType, from, to, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, profileId };\n    if (asset) where.asset = asset;\n    if (cashFlowType) where.cashFlowType = cashFlowType;\n    if (from || to) {\n      where.occurredAt = {};\n      if (from) where.occurredAt.gte = from;\n      if (to) where.occurredAt.lte = to;\n    }\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { occurredAt: 'asc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n\n  async reconcileAgainstExchangeBalance(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    exchangeBalance: string;\n    asset: string;\n  }): Promise<{ matched: boolean; accountingBalance: string; exchangeBalance: string; drift: string }> {\n    // Never become independent exchange-balance truth — we compare, not overwrite\n    const accounting = await this.getCashBalance({ tenantId: params.tenantId, profileId: params.profileId, asset: params.asset });\n    const drift = sub(accounting.balance, params.exchangeBalance);\n    const matched = drift === '0';\n    return {\n      matched,\n      accountingBalance: accounting.balance,\n      exchangeBalance: params.exchangeBalance,\n      drift,\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/cost-basis.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Must never silently switch methods.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class CostBasisService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(CostBasisService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly eventRepo: AccountingEventRepository,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async calculateCostBasisForFill(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    fill: any;\n    symbol: string;\n    quantity: string;\n    price: string;\n    side: string;\n    occurredAt: Date;\n    accountingEventId: string;\n  }): Promise<{ costBasisPerUnit: string; totalCostBasis: string; realizedPnl: string; method: string }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, fill, symbol, quantity, price, side, occurredAt, accountingEventId } = params;\n\n    if (!isValidDecimal(quantity) || !isValidDecimal(price)) throw new BadRequestException('Invalid quantity/price');\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n\n    // FIFO deterministic — check open lots\n    const openLots = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, profileId, symbol, isClosed: false, isReversed: false },\n      orderBy: { openedAt: 'asc' },\n    });\n\n    if (side === 'BUY') {\n      // Opening/increasing long — cost basis is fill price\n      const costBasisPerUnit = price;\n      const totalCostBasis = mul(quantity, price);\n      return {\n        costBasisPerUnit,\n        totalCostBasis,\n        realizedPnl: '0',\n        method: policy.costBasisMethod,\n      };\n    } else {\n      // SELL — reduce FIFO lots, realized PnL = proceeds - cost basis\n      let remainingQty = quantity;\n      let totalCost = '0';\n      let realizedPnl = '0';\n\n      for (const lot of openLots) {\n        if (cmp(remainingQty, '0') <= 0) break;\n        const lotQty = lot.remainingQuantity;\n        const closeQty = cmp(remainingQty, lotQty) >= 0 ? lotQty : remainingQty;\n        const lotCostPerUnit = lot.costBasisPerUnit ?? '0';\n        const lotCost = mul(closeQty, lotCostPerUnit);\n        const proceeds = mul(closeQty, price);\n        const pnlForLot = sub(proceeds, lotCost);\n\n        totalCost = add(totalCost, lotCost);\n        realizedPnl = add(realizedPnl, pnlForLot);\n        remainingQty = sub(remainingQty, closeQty);\n      }\n\n      // If remainingQty > 0 and no open lots, this is short or insufficient history — mark but don't invent cost basis\n      // Realized PnL only for matched quantity\n      const matchedQty = sub(quantity, remainingQty);\n      const costBasisPerUnit = cmp(matchedQty, '0') > 0 ? this.divSafe(totalCost, matchedQty) : price;\n\n      return {\n        costBasisPerUnit,\n        totalCostBasis: totalCost,\n        realizedPnl,\n        method: policy.costBasisMethod,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async recordCostBasis(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    lotId?: string | null;\n    accountingEventId: string;\n    quantity: string;\n    costBasisPerUnit: string;\n    totalCostBasis: string;\n    realizedPnl?: string | null;\n    method: string;\n    occurredAt: Date;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    // Cost basis record is part of position lot — update lot or create evidence record\n    // For audit, we store evidence in lot's evidence/metadata\n    try {\n      if (params.lotId) {\n        const lot = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.findUnique({ where: { id: params.lotId } });\n        if (lot) {\n          return await (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.update({\n            where: { id: params.lotId },\n            data: {\n              costBasisPerUnit: params.costBasisPerUnit,\n              totalCostBasis: params.totalCostBasis,\n              evidence: redactSecrets({\n                ...((lot.evidence as any) ?? {}),\n                costBasisPerUnit: params.costBasisPerUnit,\n                totalCostBasis: params.totalCostBasis,\n                realizedPnl: params.realizedPnl ?? '0',\n                method: params.method,\n                calculationVersion: (await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: params.profileId })).calculationVersion,\n              }) as any,\n            },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n      return { costBasisPerUnit: params.costBasisPerUnit, totalCostBasis: params.totalCostBasis, realizedPnl: params.realizedPnl };\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to record cost basis: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      return { costBasisPerUnit: params.costBasisPerUnit, totalCostBasis: params.totalCostBasis, realizedPnl: params.realizedPnl };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getRealizedPnl(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    symbol?: string;\n    from?: Date;\n    to?: Date;\n  }): Promise<{ realizedPnl: string; disposals: number }> {\n    // Realized PnL from closed lots — deterministic, reproducible\n    try {\n      const where: any = { tenantId: params.tenantId, profileId: params.profileId, isClosed: true };\n      if (params.symbol) where.symbol = params.symbol;\n      if (params.from || params.to) {\n        where.closedAt = {};\n        if (params.from) where.closedAt.gte = params.from;\n        if (params.to) where.closedAt.lte = params.to;\n      }\n\n      const lots = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.findMany({ where });\n\n      let realizedPnl = '0';\n      for (const lot of lots) {\n        // Realized PnL stored in evidence or need to compute — for now sum from cost basis\n        // We treat closed lots as having realized PnL evidence\n        const evidence = lot.evidence as any;\n        if (evidence?.realizedPnl && isValidDecimal(evidence.realizedPnl)) {\n          realizedPnl = add(realizedPnl, evidence.realizedPnl);\n        }\n      }\n\n      return { realizedPnl, disposals: lots.length };\n    } catch {\n      return { realizedPnl: '0', disposals: 0 };\n    }\n  }\n\n  private divSafe(a: string, b: string): string {\n    try {\n      return div(a, b);\n    } catch {\n      return '0';\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/dto/accounting-action.dto.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/dto/portfolio-query.dto.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/dto/statement-query.dto.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected InvestorVisibilityService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(InvestorVisibilityService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async scopeId: string }>> {\n    const { tenantId, userId, role, isPlatformUser = false } = params;\n\n    // Platform admin can view all profiles in tenant (with audit)\n    if (isPlatformUser && role === InvestorVisibilityRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN) {\n      const profiles = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile.findMany({ where: { tenantId } });\n      return profiles.map((p: any) => ({ profileId: p.id, scope: p.scope, scopeId: p.scopeId }));\n    }\n\n    // Compliance reviewer can view all profiles in tenant for compliance purposes\n    if (role === InvestorVisibilityRole.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER) {\n      const profiles = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile.findMany({ where: { tenantId } });\n      return profiles.map((p: any) => ({ profileId: p.id, scope: p.scope, scopeId: p.scopeId }));\n    }\n\n    // Tenant owner can view all profiles in tenant\n    if (role === InvestorVisibilityRole.TENANT_OWNER) {\n      const profiles = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile.findMany({ where: { tenantId } });\n      return profiles.map((p: any) => ({ profileId: p.id, scope: p.scope, scopeId: p.scopeId }));\n    }\n\n    // Trader can view own trader-scoped profiles and strategy profiles they own\n    if (role === InvestorVisibilityRole.TRADER) {\n      const profiles = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, scopeId: userId, scope: { in: ['TRADER', 'STRATEGY'] } },\n      });\n      return profiles.map((p: any) => ({ profileId: p.id, scope: p.scope, scopeId: p.scopeId }));\n    }\n\n    // Follower can view own follower-scoped profiles\n    if (role === InvestorVisibilityRole.FOLLOWER) {\n      const profiles = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, scopeId: userId, scope: 'FOLLOWER' },\n      });\n      return profiles.map((p: any) => ({ profileId: p.id, scope: p.scope, },\n      });\n      const accountIds = relationships.map((r) => r.targetId);\n      if (accountIds.length === 0) {\n        return [];\n      }\n      const profiles = await (this.prisma as });\n\n  it('measures staleness against the valuation instant, not the wall clock', async () => {\n    const fresh = await build(\n      jest.fn(async () => candle('2026-09-20T11:56:00Z', '1')),\n '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { CashLedgerService } from './cash-ledger.service';\nimport { PositionAccountingService } from './position-accounting.service';\nimport { ValuationService } from './valuation.service';\nimport { AccountingPolicyService } from './accounting-policy.service';\nimport { add, sub, redactSecrets, isValidDecimal } from './portfolio-accounting.types';\nimport { isAdjustmentReversed } from './accounting-adjustment.service';\n\n/**\n * Calculates NAV from cash + valued positions + adjustments, currency-safe, evidence.\n * Missing FX → explicit incomplete state never invent rate/NAV.\n * Must be deterministic and preserve calculationVersion/policyVersion/baseCurrency/valuationTimestamp/sourceReferences/methodology/dataCompleteness.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class NavService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(NavService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly cashLedger: CashLedgerService,\n    private readonly positionAccounting: PositionAccountingService,\n    private readonly valuationService: ValuationService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async calculateNav(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    at: Date;\n    baseCurrency?: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<{\n    nav: string | null;\n    cash: string;\n    grossAssetValue: string;\n    grossLiability: string;\n    adjustments: string;\n    baseCurrency: string;\n    valuationTimestamp: string;\n    calculationVersion: string;\n    policyVersion: string;\n    sourceReferences: string[];\n    methodology: string;\n    dataCompleteness: string;\n    evidences: any[];\n    canPublish: boolean;\n  }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, at } = params;\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n    const baseCurrency = params.baseCurrency ?? policy.baseCurrency;\n\n    // Cash — from cash ledger, not exchange balance truth overwrite\n    const cashEntries = await this.cashLedger.listCashEntries({ tenantId, profileId, page: 1, limit: 1000 });\n    let cashBase = '0';\n    for (const entry of cashEntries.data) {\n      if (entry.occurredAt > at) continue;\n      if (entry.baseCurrencyAmount) {\n        const isOutflow = ['WITHDRAWAL', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'FEE', 'PLATFORM_FEE', 'PERFORMANCE_FEE', 'TRADE_SETTLEMENT_BUY'].includes(entry.cashFlowType);\n        cashBase = isOutflow ? sub(cashBase, entry.baseCurrencyAmount) : add(cashBase, entry.baseCurrencyAmount);\n      } else if (entry.baseCurrency === baseCurrency) {\n        const isOutflow = ['WITHDRAWAL', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'FEE', 'PLATFORM_FEE', 'PERFORMANCE_FEE', 'TRADE_SETTLEMENT_BUY'].includes(entry.cashFlowType);\n        cashBase = isOutflow ? sub(cashBase, entry.amount) : add(cashBase, entry.amount);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Holdings\n    const holdings = await this.positionAccounting.getHoldings({ tenantId, profileId, at });\n\n    // Valuation\n    const valuation = await this.valuationService.valuePortfolio({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      holdings,\n      at,\n      baseCurrency,\n    });\n\n    // NAV = cash + grossAsset - grossLiability + adjustments (adjustments from adjustment service — for now 0)\n    let adjustments = '0';\n    try {\n      // Only manual adjustments (no originalEventId) move NAV directly: event-linked\n      // reversals/corrections already act through isReversed and the correction event.\n      const adjustmentRecords = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingAdjustment.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, profileId, createdAt: { lte: at }, originalEventId: null },\n      });\n      for (const adj of adjustmentRecords) {\n        if (isAdjustmentReversed(adj)) continue;\n        if (adj.amount && isValidDecimal(adj.amount)) {\n          adjustments = add(adjustments, adj.amount);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    let nav: string | null = null;\n    let canPublish = true;\n    let dataCompleteness = valuation.completeness;\n\n    // Missing FX → no NAV, explicit incomplete state never invent rate/NAV\n    if (valuation.hasMissingFx) {\n      nav = null;\n      canPublish = false;\n      dataCompleteness = 'MISSING_FX_NO_NAV';\n    } else if (valuation.hasMissingPrice) {\n      // Missing price → NAV incomplete, but we can still calculate with evidence\n      // For portfolio accounting, missing price means incomplete NAV — mark accordingly\n      // We still compute NAV from available valuations, but completeness is MISSING_PRICE\n      try {\n        const grossNet = valuation.netValued;\n        nav = add(add(cashBase, grossNet), adjustments);\n      } catch {\n        nav = null;\n      }\n      dataCompleteness = 'MISSING_PRICE_INCOMPLETE';\n    } else {\n      try {\n        const grossNet = valuation.netValued;\n        nav = add(add(cashBase, grossNet), adjustments);\n      } catch {\n        nav = null;\n        canPublish = false;\n        dataCompleteness = 'CALCULATION_FAILED';\n      }\n    }\n\n    const sourceReferences = [\n      ...new Set([\n        ...valuation.evidences.flatMap((e: any) => e.sourceReferences ?? []),\n        ...cashEntries.data.map((c: any) => c.sourceType ?? reason: string,\n      externalCashFlows: TWRExternalCashFlowEvidence[] | null = [],\n      startingNav: string | null = null,\n      endingNav: string | null = null,\n      sourceReferences: string[] endingNav,\n        externalCashFlows,\n        feesTreatment: policy.feeTreatment,\n        returnPercent: null,\n        calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n        policyVersion: PortfolioReturnMethodology.TIME_WEIGHTED_RETURN,\n          flowBoundary: TWR_FLOW_BOUNDARY_RULE,\n          periodStart: periodStartIso,\n          periodEnd: periodEndIso,\n          startingNav:
