this.validateAndClose({ tenantId, periodId, closeId: existing.id, operatorId, correlationId });\n    }\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: period.profileId });\n\n    // PortfolioAccountingClose columns: requestedBy, calculation/policy versions\n    // (required), validationEvidence Json. Initiation details live in the evidence.\n    const closeRecord = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingClose.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        periodId,\n        requestedBy: operatorId,\n        validationPassed: false,\n        validationEvidence: redactSecrets({\n          state: 'CLOSING',\n          profileId: period.profileId,\n          initiatedBy: operatorId,\n          initiatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n        }) as any,\n        calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n        idempotencyKey,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Async validation — for now synchronous\n    return await this.validateAndClose({ tenantId, periodId, closeId: closeRecord.id, operatorId, correlationId });\n  }\n\n  async validateAndClose(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    periodId: string;\n    closeId: string;\n    operatorId: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, periodId, closeId, operatorId } = params;\n\n    const period = await this.periodService.getPeriod({ tenantId, periodId });\n    if (!period) throw new BadRequestException('Period not found');\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: period.profileId });\n\n    const validationSteps: Array<{ step: string; passed: boolean; evidence: any }> = [];\n\n    // 1. Required events present\n    let eventsCount = 0;\n    try {\n      eventsCount = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingEvent.count({\n        where: { tenantId, profileId: period.profileId, sourceTimestamp: { gte: period.periodStart, lte: period.periodEnd } },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      eventsCount = 0;\n    }\n    validationSteps.push({\n      step: 'REQUIRED_EVENTS_PRESENT',\n      passed: true, // Even 0 events could be valid for empty portfolio — but we log\n      evidence: { eventsCount, periodStart: period.periodStart, periodEnd: period.periodEnd },\n    });\n\n    // 2. No critical reconciliation failures\n    const reconciliation = await this.reconciliationService.reconcilePeriod({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: period.profileId,\n      periodStart: period.periodStart,\n      periodEnd: period.periodEnd,\n    });\n\n    const hasCriticalReconciliationFailure = reconciliation.hasCriticalFailure;\n    validationSteps.push({\n      step: 'RECONCILIATION_NO_CRITICAL',\n      passed: !hasCriticalReconciliationFailure,\n      evidence: { hasCriticalFailure: hasCriticalReconciliationFailure, discrepancies: reconciliation.discrepancies },\n    });\n\n    // 3. Valuation sufficient\n    const navResult = await this.navService.calculateNav({ tenantId, profileId: period.profileId, at: period.periodEnd, baseCurrency: period.baseCurrency });\n    const valuationSufficient = navResult.nav !== null && navResult.dataCompleteness !== 'MISSING_FX_NO_NAV';\n    validationSteps.push({\n      step: 'VALUATION_SUFFICIENT',\n      passed: policy.closeRules.allowIncompleteValuation ? true : valuationSufficient,\n      evidence: { nav: navResult.nav, dataCompleteness: navResult.dataCompleteness, canPublish: navResult.canPublish },\n    });\n\n    // 4. NAV consistent — compare with previous snapshot if exists\n    let navConsistent = true;\n    try {\n      const prevSnapshot = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioSnapshot.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, profileId: period.profileId, timestamp: { lt: period.periodEnd } },\n        orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' },\n      });\n      if (prevSnapshot && navResult.nav && prevSnapshot.nav) {\n        // NAV should be within reasonable bounds — not a full consistency check but detect huge jumps without cash flows\n        // For now, always consistent if both exist\n        navConsistent = true;\n      }\n    } catch {\n      navConsistent = true;\n    }\n    validationSteps.push({ step: 'NAV_CONSISTENT', passed: navConsistent, evidence: { nav: navResult.nav } });\n\n    // 5. PnL reproducible\n    const pnlResult = await this.pnlService.calculateNetPnl({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: period.profileId,\n      from: period.periodStart,\n      to: period.periodEnd,\n      at: period.periodEnd,\n      baseCurrency: period.baseCurrency,\n    });\n    const pnlReproducible = pnlResult.netPnl !== null || pnlResult.grossPnl !== null;\n    validationSteps.push({ step: 'PNL_REPRODUCIBLE', passed: pnlReproducible, evidence: { netPnl: pnlResult.netPnl, grossPnl: pnlResult.grossPnl } });\n\n    // 6. Fees/cash/positions reconcile\n    const feesReconciled = !reconciliation.discrepancies.some((d: any) => d.type === 'FEE_MISMATCH' && d.severity === 'CRITICAL');\n    const cashReconciled = !reconciliation.discrepancies.some((d: any) => d.type === 'CASH_MISMATCH' && d.severity === 'CRITICAL');\n    const positionsReconciled = !reconciliation.discrepancies.some((d: any) => d.type === 'POSITION_MISMATCH' && d.severity === 'CRITICAL');\n\n    validationSteps.push({ step: 'FEES_RECONCILED', passed: feesReconciled, evidence: {} });\n    validationSteps.push({ step: 'CASH_RECONCILED', passed: cashReconciled, evidence: {} });\n    validationSteps.push({ step: 'POSITIONS_RECONCILED', passed: positionsReconciled, evidence: {} });\n\n    const allPassed = validationSteps.every((s) => s.passed);\n\n    if (!allPassed) {\n      // Failure CLOSING→OPEN with evidence\n      await this.periodService.transitionPeriod({\n        tenantId,\n        periodId,\n        toState: PortfolioPeriodState.OPEN,\n        reason: `Close validation failed: ${validationSteps.filter((s) => !s.passed).map((s) => s.step).join(',')}`,\n        operatorId,\n      });\n\n      await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingClose.update({\n        where: { id: closeId },\n        data: {\n          validationPassed: false,\n          reconciliationStatus: hasCriticalReconciliationFailure ? 'CRITICAL_FAILURE' : 'OK',\n          failureEvidence: redactSecrets({\n            state: 'FAILED',\n            failedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n            failureReason: validationSteps.filter((s) => !s.passed).map((s) => s.step).join(','),\n            validationSteps,\n            reconciliation,\n          }) as any,\n        },\n      });\n\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Period close validation failed: ${validationSteps.filter((s) => !s.passed).map((s) => s.step).join(', ')}`);\n    }\n\n    // All passed — create final snapshot\n    const finalSnapshot = await this.snapshotService.createSnapshot({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: period.profileId,\n      timestamp: period.periodEnd,\n      baseCurrency: period.baseCurrency,\n      scope: 'TENANT',\n      scopeId: period.profileId,\n    });\n\n    // Persist performance\n    const twr = await this.performanceService.calculateTWR({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: period.profileId,\n      periodStart: period.periodStart,\n      periodEnd: period.periodEnd,\n      baseCurrency: period.baseCurrency,\n    });\n\n    await this.performanceService.persistPerformanceRecord({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: period.profileId,\n      periodId,\n      methodology: 'TIME_WEIGHTED_RETURN' as any,\n      periodStart: period.periodStart,\n      periodEnd: period.periodEnd,\n      startingNav: twr.evidence.startingNav ?? null,\n      endingNav: twr.evidence.endingNav ?? null,\n      externalCashFlows: twr.evidence.externalCashFlows ?? [],\n      feesTreatment: policy.feeTreatment,\n      returnPercent: twr.returnPercent,\n      calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n      policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      baseCurrency: period.baseCurrency,\n      dataCompleteness: twr.evidence.dataCompleteness,\n      sourceReferences: twr.evidence.sourceReferences ?? [],\n      evidence: twr.evidence,\n    });\n\n    // Record the closing figures on the period while it is still CLOSING (it is immutable once CLOSED).\n    await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingPeriod.update({\n      where: { id: periodId },\n      data: {\n        closingNav: navResult.nav ?? null,\n        realizedPnl: pnlResult.evidence?.gross?.realized ?? null,\n        unrealizedPnl: pnlResult.evidence?.gross?.unrealized ?? null,\n        netPnl: pnlResult.netPnl ?? null,\n        returnPercent: twr.returnPercent ?? null,\n        validationEvidence: redactSecrets({ validationSteps }) as any,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Transition to CLOSED\n    await this.periodService.transitionPeriod({\n      tenantId,\n      periodId,\n      toState: PortfolioPeriodState.CLOSED,\n      reason: 'Close validation passed',\n      operatorId,\n    });\n\n    const closed = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingClose.update({\n      where: { id: closeId },\n      data: {\n        closedBy: operatorId,\n        validationPassed: true,\n        closingNav: navResult.nav ?? null,\n        reconciliationStatus: 'OK',\n        failureEvidence: Prisma.DbNull,\n        validationEvidence: redactSecrets({\n          state: 'CLOSED',\n          closedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n          grossAssetValue: navResult.grossAssetValue,\n          grossLiability: navResult.grossLiability,\n          realizedPnl: pnlResult.evidence?.gross?.realized ?? null,\n          unrealizedPnl: pnlResult.evidence?.gross?.unrealized ?? null,\n          netPnl: pnlResult.netPnl,\n          snapshotId: finalSnapshot.id,\n          validationSteps,\n          nav: navResult,\n          pnl: pnlResult,\n          twr: twr.evidence,\n          reconciliation,\n        }) as any,\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'portfolio.period.closed', periodId, nav: navResult.nav });\n\n    return toCloseView(closed);\n  }\n}\n\n/** API view of a PortfolioAccountingClose row: exposes state/nav/snapshotId kept in validationEvidence. */\nexport function toCloseView(row: any): any {\n  if (!row) return row;\n  const evidence = row.validationEvidence && typeof row.validationEvidence === 'object' ? row.validationEvidence : {};\n  return {\n    ...row,\n    state: row.validationPassed ? 'CLOSED' : row.failureEvidence ? 'FAILED' : 'CLOSING',\n    nav: row.closingNav ?? null,\n    snapshotId: evidence.snapshotId ?? null,\n    netPnl: evidence.netPnl ?? null,\n    closedAt: evidence.closedAt ?? null,\n  };\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/pnl.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":11,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Responsibility: calculate realized and unrealized PnL from fills, cost basis, valuation, and fees.\nimport { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { CostBasisService } from './cost-basis.service';\nimport { ValuationService } from './valuation.service';\nimport { AccountingPolicyService } from './accounting-policy.service';\nimport { AccountingEventRepository } from './accounting-event.repository';\nimport { PortfolioPnLType, add, sub, mul, div, isValidDecimal } from './portfolio-accounting.types';\n\n/**\n * Calculates realized, unrealized, gross, fee-adjusted, net PnL using fills,\n * cost basis, valuation, and fee records, not as a second execution PnL truth.\n * Distinguishes REALIZED/UNREALIZED/GROSS/FEE_ADJUSTED/NET with cost-basis/valuation refs,\n * missing/stale price not zero.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PnLService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PnLService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly costBasisService: CostBasisService,\n    private readonly valuationService: ValuationService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n    private readonly eventRepo: AccountingEventRepository,\n  ) {}\n\n  async calculateRealizedPnl(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    from?: Date;\n    to?: Date;\n    symbol?: string;\n  }): Promise<{ realizedPnl: string; evidence: any }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, from, to, symbol } = params;\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n\n    const result = await this.costBasisService.getRealizedPnl({ tenantId, profileId, symbol, from, to });\n\n    return {\n      realizedPnl: result.realizedPnl,\n      evidence: {\n        type: PortfolioPnLType.REALIZED,\n        amount: result.realizedPnl,\n        baseCurrency: policy.baseCurrency,\n        calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n        methodology: `${policy.costBasisMethod}_FIFO_REALIZED`,\n        dataCompleteness: 'COMPLETE',\n        disposals: result.disposals,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  async calculateUnrealizedPnl(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    at: Date;\n    baseCurrency?: string;\n  }): Promise<{ unrealizedPnl: string | null; evidence: any; hasMissingPrice: boolean; hasStalePrice: boolean }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, at } = params;\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n    const baseCurrency = params.baseCurrency ?? policy.baseCurrency;\n\n    // Get open lots\n    let openLots: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      openLots = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId, profileId, isClosed: false, isReversed: false, openedAt: { lte: at } },\n        orderBy: { openedAt: 'asc' },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      openLots = [];\n    }\n\n    let unrealizedPnl = '0';\n    let hasMissingPrice = false;\n    let hasStalePrice = false;\n    const valuationRefs: string[] = [];\n    const costBasisRefs: string[] = [];\n\n    for (const lot of openLots) {\n      const valuation = await this.valuationService.valuePosition({\n        tenantId,\n        profileId,\n        symbol: lot.symbol,\n        asset: lot.asset,\n        quantity: lot.remainingQuantity,\n        at,\n        baseCurrency,\n      });\n\n      if (valuation.evidence.valuationState === 'MISSING_PRICE' || valuation.evidence.valuationState === 'MISSING_FX' || valuation.valuedAmount === null || valuation.baseCurrencyAmount === null) {\n        hasMissingPrice = true;\n        continue; // missing/stale price not zero — skip, mark incomplete\n      }\n      if (valuation.evidence.valuationState === 'STALE') hasStalePrice = true;\n\n      const currentValue = valuation.baseCurrencyAmount ?? '0';\n      const costBasis = lot.totalCostBasis ? this.proportionalCostBasis(lot.totalCostBasis, lot.quantity, lot.remainingQuantity) : '0';\n\n      try {\n        const lotUnrealized = sub(currentValue, costBasis);\n        unrealizedPnl = add(unrealizedPnl, lotUnrealized);\n        valuationRefs.push(`${lot.symbol}:${valuation.evidence.marketPriceSource ?? 'UNKNOWN'}`);\n        costBasisRefs.push(lot.id);\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    if (hasMissingPrice) {\n      return {\n        unrealizedPnl: null,\n        evidence: {\n          type: PortfolioPnLType.UNREALIZED,\n          amount: null,\n          baseCurrency,\n          calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n          policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n          methodology: 'MARKET_MINUS_COST_BASIS',\n          dataCompleteness: 'MISSING_PRICE_INCOMPLETE',\n          hasMissingPrice,\n          hasStalePrice,\n          valuationRefs,\n          costBasisRefs,\n        },\n        hasMissingPrice,\n        hasStalePrice,\n      };\n    }\n\n    return {\n      unrealizedPnl,\n      evidence: {\n        type: PortfolioPnLType.UNREALIZED,\n        amount: unrealizedPnl,\n        baseCurrency,\n        calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n        methodology: 'MARKET_MINUS_COST_BASIS',\n        dataCompleteness: hasStalePrice ? 'STALE_PRICE' : 'COMPLETE',\n        hasMissingPrice,\n        hasStalePrice,\n        valuationRefs,\n        costBasisRefs,\n      },\n      hasMissingPrice,\n      hasStalePrice,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async calculateGrossPnl(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    from?: Date;\n    to?: Date;\n    at: Date;\n    baseCurrency?: string;\n  }): Promise<{ grossPnl: string | null; realized: string; unrealized: string | null; evidence: any }> {\n    const realized = await this.calculateRealizedPnl({ tenantId: params.tenantId, profileId: params.profileId, from: params.from, to: params.to });\n    const unrealized = await this.calculateUnrealizedPnl({ tenantId: params.tenantId, profileId: params.profileId, at: params.at, baseCurrency: params.baseCurrency });\n\n    let grossPnl: string | null = null;\n    if (realized.realizedPnl !== null && unrealized.unrealizedPnl !== null) {\n      grossPnl = add(realized.realizedPnl, unrealized.unrealizedPnl);\n    } else if (realized.realizedPnl !== null && unrealized.hasMissingPrice) {\n      // Gross incomplete if unrealized missing — explicit, not zero\n      grossPnl = null;\n    } else {\n      grossPnl = realized.realizedPnl;\n    }\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: params.profileId });\n\n    return {\n      grossPnl,\n      realized: realized.realizedPnl,\n      unrealized: unrealized.unrealizedPnl,\n      evidence: {\n        type: PortfolioPnLType.GROSS,\n        amount: grossPnl,\n        realized: realized.realizedPnl,\n        unrealized: unrealized.unrealizedPnl,\n        baseCurrency: params.baseCurrency ?? policy.baseCurrency,\n        calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n        methodology: 'REALIZED_PLUS_UNREALIZED',\n        dataCompleteness: grossPnl === null ? 'MISSING_PRICE_INCOMPLETE' : unrealized.evidence.dataCompleteness,\n        costBasisRefs: unrealized.evidence.costBasisRefs,\n        valuationRefs: unrealized.evidence.valuationRefs,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  async calculateNetPnl(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    from?: Date;\n    to?: Date;\n    at: Date;\n    baseCurrency?: string;\n  }): Promise<{ netPnl: string | null; grossPnl: string | null; fees: string; evidence: any }> {\n    const gross = await this.calculateGrossPnl(params);\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: params.profileId });\n    const baseCurrency = params.baseCurrency ?? policy.baseCurrency;\n\n    // Fees from cash ledger — authoritative Fees module, not duplicated\n    let fees = '0';\n    try {\n      const feeEntries = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry.findMany({\n        where: {\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          profileId: params.profileId,\n          cashFlowType: { in: ['FEE', 'PLATFORM_FEE', 'PERFORMANCE_FEE'] },\n          occurredAt: { gte: params.from ?? new Date(0), lte: params.to ?? params.at },\n        },\n      });\n      for (const entry of feeEntries) {\n        const amt = entry.baseCurrencyAmount ?? entry.amount;\n        if (amt && isValidDecimal(amt)) fees = add(fees, amt);\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    let netPnl: string | null = null;\n    if (gross.grossPnl !== null) {\n      netPnl = sub(gross.grossPnl, fees);\n    }\n\n    const feeAdjusted = gross.grossPnl !== null ? sub(gross.grossPnl, fees) : null;\n\n    return {\n      netPnl,\n      grossPnl: gross.grossPnl,\n      fees,\n      evidence: {\n        gross: gross.evidence,\n        feeAdjusted: {\n          type: PortfolioPnLType.FEE_ADJUSTED,\n          amount: feeAdjusted,\n          fees,\n          baseCurrency,\n          calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n          policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n          methodology: 'GROSS_MINUS_FEES',\n          dataCompleteness: gross.evidence.dataCompleteness,\n        },\n        net: {\n          type: PortfolioPnLType.NET,\n          amount: netPnl,\n          gross: gross.grossPnl,\n          fees,\n          baseCurrency,\n          calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n          policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n          methodology: 'GROSS_MINUS_FEES',\n          dataCompleteness: gross.evidence.dataCompleteness,\n        },\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  private proportionalCostBasis(totalCostBasis: string, totalQuantity: string, remainingQuantity: string): string {\n    try {\n      if (totalQuantity === remainingQuantity) return totalCostBasis;\n      const ratio = div(remainingQuantity, totalQuantity);\n      return mul(totalCostBasis, ratio);\n    } catch {\n      return totalCostBasis;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/portfolio-accounting.authorization.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. */\n\nconst TENANT = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';\nconst OTHER_TENANT = '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';\nconst ALICE = 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa';\nconst BOB = 'bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb';\nconst ADMIN = 'cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc';\nconst CAROL = 'dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd';\n\nconst PROFILES: Record<string, { id: string; tenantId: string; scope: string; scopeId: string }> = {\n  'p-alice': { id: 'p-alice', tenantId: TENANT, scope: 'FOLLOWER', scopeId: ALICE },\n  'p-bob': { id: 'p-bob', tenantId: TENANT, scope: 'FOLLOWER', scopeId: BOB },\n  'p-foreign': { id: 'p-foreign', tenantId: OTHER_TENANT, scope: 'FOLLOWER', scopeId: ALICE },\n};\n\nfunction serviceMock(): any {\n  const target: Record<string | symbol, jest.Mock> = {};\n  return new Proxy(target, {\n    get: (store, key) => {\n      if (!store[key]) store[key] = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ id: 'result', data: [], total: 0, page: 1, limit: 50 });\n      return store[key];\n    },\n  });\n}\n\n/** Principals carry the real system-role permission sets, not hand-picked ones. */\nfunction principal(userId: string, role: SystemRole) {\n  const definition = SYSTEM_ROLE_DEFINITIONS.find((d) => d.key === role);\n  if (!definition) throw new Error(`unknown role ${role}`);\n  return { user: { userId, tenantId: TENANT, permissions: [...definition.permissions] as string[], roles: [role] }, headers: {} };\n}\n\nfunction follower(userId: string) {\n  return principal(userId, SystemRole.FOLLOWER);\n}\n\nfunction trader(userId: string) {\n  return principal(userId, SystemRole.TRADER);\n}\n\nfunction tenantAdmin() {\n  return principal(ADMIN, SystemRole.TENANT_ADMIN);\n}\n\nfunction finance() {\n  return principal(ADMIN, SystemRole.FINANCE);\n}\n\nfunction compliance() {\n  return principal(ADMIN, SystemRole.COMPLIANCE);\n}\n\n/** Mimics StatementService.listStatements: the visibility restriction is part of the query. */\nfunction pageOfStatements(rows: Array<{ id: string; profileId: string }>, params: { profileIds?: string[] }) {\n  const visible = params.profileIds ? rows.filter((row) => params.profileIds!.includes(row.profileId)) : rows;\n  return { data: visible, total: visible.length, page: 1, limit: 50 };\n}\n\ndescribe('PortfolioAccountingController authorization', () => {\n  let prisma: any;\n  let visibility: any;\n  let services: Record<string, any>;\n  let controller: PortfolioAccountingController;\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    prisma = {\n      portfolioAccountingProfile: {\n        findFirst: jest.fn(async ({ where }: any) => PROFILES[where.id] ?? null),\n        findMany: jest.fn(async ({ where }: any) =>\n          Object.values(PROFILES).filter((p) => p.tenantId === where.tenantId && (!where.id?.in || where.id.in.includes(p.id))),\n        ),\n      },\n    };\n    visibility = {\n      resolveVisibleProfiles: jest.fn(async ({ userId, role }: any) => {\n        if (role === InvestorVisibilityRole.FOLLOWER) {\n          return Object.values(PROFILES)\n            .filter((p) => p.tenantId === TENANT && p.scope === 'FOLLOWER' && p.scopeId === userId)\n            .map((p) => ({ profileId: p.id }));\n        }\n        return [];\n      }),\n      canViewStatement: jest.fn(async () => false),\n    };\n    services = {};\n    const names = [\n      'policyService', 'eventService', 'eventRepo', 'cashLedger', 'positionAccounting', 'costBasis', 'valuation', 'navService',\n      'pnlService', 'performanceService', 'benchmarkService', 'attributionService', 'snapshotService', 'periodService',\n      'periodCloseService', 'statementService', 'exportService', 'reconciliationService', 'adjustmentService', 'auditService',\n    ];\n    for (const name of names) services[name] = serviceMock();\n    controller = new PortfolioAccountingController(\n      prisma,\n      services.policyService,\n      services.eventService,\n      services.eventRepo,\n      services.cashLedger,\n      services.positionAccounting,\n      services.costBasis,\n      services.valuation,\n      services.navService,\n      services.pnlService,\n      services.performanceService,\n      services.benchmarkService,\n      services.attributionService,\n      services.snapshotService,\n      services.periodService,\n      services.periodCloseService,\n      services.statementService,\n      services.exportService,\n      services.reconciliationService,\n      services.adjustmentService,\n      visibility,\n      services.auditService,\n    );\n  });\n\n  describe('profile reads', () => {\n    it('lets a follower read the holdings of their own profile', async () => {\n      await expect(controller.getHoldings(follower(ALICE), { profileId: 'p-alice' } as any)).resolves.toBeDefined();\n    });\n\n    it(\"hides another follower's profile of the same tenant as 404\", async () => {\n      await expect(controller.getHoldings(follower(ALICE), { profileId: 'p-bob' } as any)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n      await expect(controller.getNav(follower(ALICE), { profileId: 'p-bob' } as any)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n      await expect(controller.getPnl(follower(ALICE), { profileId: 'p-bob' } as any)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n      await expect(controller.listCash(follower(ALICE), { profileId: 'p-bob' } as any)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n      await expect(controller.listPositions(follower(ALICE), { profileId: 'p-bob' } as any)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n      await expect(\n        controller.getPerformance(follower(ALICE), { profileId: 'p-bob', periodStart: '2026-01-01', periodEnd: '2026-02-01' } as any),\n      ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n      await expect(\n        controller.getAttribution(follower(ALICE), { profileId: 'p-bob', periodStart: '2026-01-01', periodEnd: '2026-02-01' } as any),\n      ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n      expect(services.positionAccounting.getHoldings).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    });\n\n    it('answers 404 for a profile of another tenant, even for a tenant administrator', async () => {\n      await expect(controller.getHoldings(tenantAdmin(), { profileId: 'p-foreign' } as } as any)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n    });\n\n    it('lets tenant staff (finance, compliance, tenant admin) read any profile of their tenant', async () => {\n      await expect(controller.getHoldings(finance(), { profileId: 'p-bob' } as any)).resolves.toBeDefined();\n      await expect(controller.getHoldings(compliance(), { profileId: 'p-bob' } as any)).resolves.toBeDefined();\n      await expect(controller.getHoldings(tenantAdmin(), { profileId: 'p-alice' } as any)).resolves.toBeDefined();\n    });\n\n    it('keeps a trader inside their own expect(controller.listEvents(trader(CAROL), {} as any)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);\n      const profiles = await controller.listProfiles(trader(CAROL), {} as any);\n      expect(profiles.data).toEqual([]);\n\n      services.statementService.getStatement.mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 'st1', profileId: 'p-bob' });\n      await expect(controller.getStatement(trader(CAROL), expect(services.statementService.listStatements).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ profileIds: [] }));\n      expect(statements).toMatchObject({ data: [], total: 0 });\n      expect(services.positionAccounting.getHoldings).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    });\n\n    it('answers 404 (not 400) for an unknown statement id', async () => {\n      services.statementService.getStatement.mockResolvedValueOnce(null);\n      await expect(controller.getStatement(tenantAdmin(), 'missing')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);\n    });\n\n    it('lists only the profiles a follower owns', async () => {\n      const own = await controller.listProfiles(follower(ALICE), {} as any);\n      expect(own.data.map((p: any) => p.id)).toEqual(['p-alice']);\n      const all = await controller.listProfiles(tenantAdmin(), {} as any);\n      expect(all.data.map((p: any) => p.id).sort()).toEqual(['p-alice', 'p-bob']);\n    });\n\n    it('requires a follower to name an owned profile on list endpoints', async () => {\n      await expect(controller.listEvents(follower(ALICE), {} as expect(controller.listPeriods(follower(ALICE), {} as any)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);\n      await expect(controller.listAdjustments(follower(ALICE), {} as });\n\n    it(\"hides another follower's snapshot, statement and export\", async () => {\n      services.snapshotService.getSnapshot.mockResolvedValueOnce({ id: 's1', profileId: 'p-bob' });\n BadRequestException, ForbiddenException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { AccountingPolicyService } from './accounting-policy.service';\nimport { AccountingEventService } from './accounting-event.service';\nimport { AccountingEventRepository } from './accounting-event.repository';\nimport { CashLedgerService } from './cash-ledger.service';\nimport { PositionAccountingService } from './position-accounting.service';\nimport { CostBasisService } from './cost-basis.service';\nimport { ValuationService } from './valuation.service';\nimport { NavService } from './nav.service';\nimport { PnLService } from './pnl.service';\nimport { PerformanceService } from './performance.service';\nimport { BenchmarkService } from './benchmark.service';\nimport { AttributionService } from './attribution.service';\nimport { PortfolioSnapshotService } from './portfolio-snapshot.service';\nimport { AccountingPeriodService } from './accounting-period.service';\nimport { PeriodCloseService } from './period-close.service';\nimport { StatementService } from './statement.service';\nimport { ReportExportService } from './report-export.service';\nimport { AccountingReconciliationService } from './accounting-reconciliation.service';\nimport { AccountingAdjustmentService } from './accounting-adjustment.service';\nimport { InvestorVisibilityService, InvestorVisibilityRole } from './investor-visibility.service';\nimport { PortfolioAuditService } from './portfolio-audit.service';\nimport { PortfolioQueryDto, PortfolioPeriodQueryDto, PortfolioSnapshotQueryDto } from './dto/portfolio-query.dto';\nimport { StatementQueryDto } from './dto/statement-query.dto';\nimport {\n  CreateProfileDto,\n  CreatePeriodDto,\n  ClosePeriodDto,\n  CreateSnapshotDto,\n  GenerateStatementDto,\n  CreateAdjustmentDto,\n  ReconciliationActionDto,\n  PerformanceQueryDto,\n  AttributionQueryDto,\n} from './dto/accounting-action.dto';\nimport { PortfolioReturnMethodology, redactSecrets } from './portfolio-accounting.types';\nimport { authTenantId, authUserIdOrNull, isPlatformPrincipal } from '../../common/guards/request-principal';\nimport { Permission, hasAnyPermission, hasPermission } from '@wlct/shared-types';\n\n/** Staff permissions that grant read access to every portfolio profile of the tenant. */\nconst TENANT_WIDE_READ_PERMISSIONS = [Permission.TENANT_UPDATE, Permission.PAYOUT_MANAGE, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ];\n\n/**\n * Tenant-safe and platform-safe API surface for portfolio accounting.\n * Must enforce RBAC, ownership, compliance visibility, and tenant isolation.\n * Statement cannot expose other user.\n */\n@Controller('portfolio-accounting')\nexport class PortfolioAccountingController {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n    private readonly eventService: AccountingEventService,\n    private readonly eventRepo: AccountingEventRepository,\n    private readonly cashLedger: CashLedgerService,\n    private readonly positionAccounting: PositionAccountingService,\n    private readonly costBasis: CostBasisService,\n    private readonly valuation: ValuationService,\n    private readonly navService: NavService,\n    private readonly pnlService: PnLService,\n    private readonly performanceService: PerformanceService,\n    private readonly benchmarkService: BenchmarkService,\n    private readonly attributionService: AttributionService,\n    private readonly snapshotService: PortfolioSnapshotService,\n    private readonly periodService: AccountingPeriodService,\n    private readonly periodCloseService: PeriodCloseService,\n    private readonly statementService: StatementService,\n    private readonly exportService: ReportExportService,\n    private readonly reconciliationService: AccountingReconciliationService,\n    private readonly adjustmentService: AccountingAdjustmentService,\n    private readonly visibilityService: InvestorVisibilityService,\n    private readonly auditService: PortfolioAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private getTenantId(req: any): string {\n    // Token tenant only; headers and query strings can never select it.\n    return authTenantId(req);\n  }\n\n  private getUserId(req: any): string {\n    // The JWT principal carries `userId` (not `id`/`sub`); reading only the\n    // legacy keys attributed every action to 'anonymous'.\n    return authUserIdOrNull(req) ?? 'anonymous';\n  }\n\n  private isPlatformUser(req: any): boolean {\n    return isPlatformPrincipal(req);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The profile must exist in the caller's tenant. A missing profile and a\n   * profile of another tenant answer the same 404 so ids cannot be probed, and\n   * a lookup failure never skips the check.\n   */\n  private async enforceTenantIsolation(tenantId: string, profileId: string): Promise<void> {\n    let profile: { tenantId: string } | null = null;\n    try {\n      profile = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile.findFirst({ where: { id: profileId }, select: { tenantId: true } });\n    } catch {\n      profile = null;\n    }\n    if (!profile || profile.tenantId !== tenantId) throw new NotFoundException('Profile not found');\n  }\n\n  private actorPermissions(req: any): string[] {\n    const permissions = req?.user?.permissions;\n    return Array.isArray(permissions) ? permissions : [];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Tenant administrators (tenant:update), finance (payout:manage) and\n   * compliance (compliance:read) read every profile of their tenant; platform\n   * staff too. Everyone else - followers and traders - only reaches their own\n   * profiles. report:read is deliberately not a tenant-wide marker: the system\n   * TRADER role holds it for its own reports, and treating it as tenant-wide\n   * let any signal provider read every follower's NAV, holdings and statements.\n   * Computed from permissions, never from a client-supplied role.\n   */\n  private hasTenantWideRead(req: any): boolean {\n    return this.isPlatformUser(req) || hasAnyPermission(this.actorPermissions(req), TENANT_WIDE_READ_PERMISSIONS);\n  }\n\n  /** Ledger-changing operations (adjustments, period close, statements, snapshots, reconciliation). */\n  private canAdministerAccounting(req: any): boolean {\n    return this.isPlatformUser(req) || hasPermission(this.actorPermissions(req), Permission.RECONCILIATION_TRIGGER);\n  }\n\n  private requireAccountingAdmin(req: any): void {\n    if (!this.canAdministerAccounting(req)) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Accounting administration requires the reconciliation:trigger permission');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Profiles the caller owns (follower, trader, strategy scopes) or operates (managed accounts). */\n  private async ownProfileIds(req: any, tenantId: string): Promise<Set<string>> {\n    const userId = authUserIdOrNull(req);\n    const ids = new Set<string>();\n    if (!userId) return ids;\n    const roles = [InvestorVisibilityRole.FOLLOWER, InvestorVisibilityRole.TRADER, InvestorVisibilityRole.MANAGED_ACCOUNT_OPERATOR];\n    for (const role of roles) {\n      const visible = await this.visibilityService.resolveVisibleProfiles({ tenantId, userId, role, isPlatformUser: false });\n      for (const entry of visible) ids.add(entry.profileId);\n    }\n    return ids;\n  }\n\n  private async assertProfileAccess(req: any, tenantId: string, profileId: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.enforceTenantIsolation(tenantId, profileId);\n    if (this.hasTenantWideRead(req)) return;\n    const own = await this.ownProfileIds(req, tenantId);\n    if (!own.has(profileId)) throw new NotFoundException('Profile not found');\n  }\n\n  /** profileId of a list query: optional for tenant-wide readers, required and owned for everyone else. */\n  private async scopedProfileId(req: any, tenantId: string, profileId?: string): Promise<string | undefined> {\n    if (profileId) {\n      await this.assertProfileAccess(req, tenantId, profileId);\n      return profileId;\n    }\n    if (this.hasTenantWideRead(req)) return undefined;\n    throw new BadRequestException('profileId required');\n  }\n\n  private visibilityRoleFor(req: any): InvestorVisibilityRole {\n    if (this.isPlatformUser(req)) return InvestorVisibilityRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN;\n    const permissions = this.actorPermissions(req);\n    if (hasAnyPermission(permissions, [Permission.TENANT_UPDATE, Permission.PAYOUT_MANAGE])) return InvestorVisibilityRole.TENANT_OWNER;\n    if (hasPermission(permissions, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)) return InvestorVisibilityRole.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER;\n    return InvestorVisibilityRole.FOLLOWER;\n  }\n\n  // Profile\n  @Post('profiles')\n  async createProfile(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: CreateProfileDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n    if (!this.canAdministerAccounting(req)) {\n      const selfScoped = (dto.scope === 'FOLLOWER' || dto.scope === 'TRADER') && dto.scopeId === authUserIdOrNull(req);\n      if (!selfScoped) throw new ForbiddenException('You can only create a follower or trader profile for yourself');\n    }\n\n    const profile = await this.policyService.createOrUpdateProfile({\n      tenantId,\n      scope: dto.scope as any,\n      scopeId: dto.scopeId,\n      portfolioType: dto.portfolioType as any,\n      baseCurrency: dto.baseCurrency,\n      returnMethodology: dto.returnMethodology as any,\n      costBasisMethod: dto.costBasisMethod,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: profile.id,\n      action: 'PROFILE_CREATED',\n      entityType: 'PORTFOLIO_ACCOUNTING_PROFILE',\n      entityId: profile.id,\n      operatorId: userId,\n      evidence: { scope: dto.scope, scopeId: dto.scopeId },\n    });\n\n    return profile;\n  }\n\n  @Get('profiles')\n  async listProfiles(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: PortfolioQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const ownIds = this.hasTenantWideRead(req) ? null : [...(await this.ownProfileIds(req, tenantId))];\n    const profiles = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingProfile.findMany({\n      where: {\n        tenantId,\n        ...(ownIds ? { id: { in: ownIds } } : {}),\n        ...(query.scope ? { scope: query.scope as any } : {}),\n        ...(query.scopeId ? { scopeId: query.scopeId } : {}),\n      },\n    });\n    return { data: profiles.map((p: any) => redactSecrets(p)) };\n  }\n\n  // Events\n  @Get('events')\n  async listEvents(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: PortfolioQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const profileId = await this.scopedProfileId(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    return await this.eventRepo.listEvents({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      from: query.from ? new Date(query.from) : undefined,\n      to: query.to ? new Date(query.to) : undefined,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Cash ledger\n  @Get('cash')\n  async listCash(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: PortfolioQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    if (!query.profileId) throw new BadRequestException('profileId required');\n    await this.assertProfileAccess(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    return await this.cashLedger.listCashEntries({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: query.profileId,\n      asset: query.asset,\n      from: query.from ? new Date(query.from) : undefined,\n      to: query.to ? new Date(query.to) : undefined,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('cash/balance')\n  async getCashBalance(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: PortfolioQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    if (!query.profileId) throw new BadRequestException('profileId required');\n    await this.assertProfileAccess(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    return await this.cashLedger.getCashBalance({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: query.profileId,\n      asset: query.asset,\n      at: query.at ? new Date(query.at) : new Date(),\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Positions\n  @Get('positions')\n  async listPositions(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: PortfolioQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    if (!query.profileId) throw new BadRequestException('profileId required');\n    await this.assertProfileAccess(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    return await this.positionAccounting.listLots({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: query.profileId,\n      symbol: query.symbol,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('holdings')\n  async getHoldings(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: PortfolioQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    if (!query.profileId) throw new BadRequestException('profileId required');\n    await this.assertProfileAccess(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    return await this.positionAccounting.getHoldings({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: query.profileId,\n      at: query.at ? new Date(query.at) : new Date(),\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Valuation & NAV\n  @Get('nav')\n  async getNav(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: PortfolioQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    if (!query.profileId) throw new BadRequestException('profileId required');\n    await this.assertProfileAccess(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    const result = await this.navService.calculateNav({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: query.profileId,\n      at: query.at ? new Date(query.at) : new Date(),\n      baseCurrency: query.baseCurrency,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.logNav({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: query.profileId,\n      nav: result.nav,\n      baseCurrency: result.baseCurrency,\n      calculationVersion: result.calculationVersion,\n      policyVersion: result.policyVersion,\n      dataCompleteness: result.dataCompleteness,\n      sourceReferences: result.sourceReferences,\n    });\n\n    return redactSecrets(result);\n  }\n\n  // PnL\n  @Get('pnl')\n  async getPnl(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: PortfolioQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    if (!query.profileId) throw new BadRequestException('profileId required');\n    await this.assertProfileAccess(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    const at = query.at ? new Date(query.at) : new Date();\n    const from = query.from ? new Date(query.from) : undefined;\n    const to = query.to ? new Date(query.to) : undefined;\n\n    const realized = await this.pnlService.calculateRealizedPnl({ tenantId, profileId: query.profileId, from, to, symbol: query.symbol });\n    const unrealized = await this.pnlService.calculateUnrealizedPnl({ tenantId, profileId: query.profileId, at, baseCurrency: query.baseCurrency });\n    const gross = await this.pnlService.calculateGrossPnl({ tenantId, profileId: query.profileId, from, to, at, baseCurrency: query.baseCurrency });\n    const net = await this.pnlService.calculateNetPnl({ tenantId, profileId: query.profileId, from, to, at, baseCurrency: query.baseCurrency });\n\n    return redactSecrets({ realized, unrealized, gross, net });\n  }\n\n  // Performance\n  @Get('performance')\n  async getPerformance(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: PerformanceQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    await this.assertProfileAccess(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    const periodStart = new Date(query.periodStart);\n    const periodEnd = new Date(query.periodEnd);\n    const methodology = (query.methodology as PortfolioReturnMethodology) ?? PortfolioReturnMethodology.TIME_WEIGHTED_RETURN;\n\n    let result;\n    if (methodology === PortfolioReturnMethodology.MONEY_WEIGHTED_RETURN) {\n      result = await this.performanceService.calculateMWR({ tenantId, profileId: query.profileId, periodStart, periodEnd, baseCurrency: query.baseCurrency });\n    } else {\n      result = await this.performanceService.calculateTWR({ tenantId, profileId: query.profileId, periodStart, periodEnd, baseCurrency: query.baseCurrency });\n    }\n\n    if (query.benchmarkId) {\n      const benchmark = await this.benchmarkService.calculateBenchmarkReturn({\n        tenantId,\n        profileId: query.profileId,\n        benchmarkId: query.benchmarkId,\n        periodStart,\n        periodEnd,\n        baseCurrency: query.baseCurrency,\n      });\n      const alpha = await this.benchmarkService.calculateAlpha({\n        tenantId,\n        profileId: query.profileId,\n        portfolioReturn: result.returnPercent,\n        benchmarkReturn: benchmark.returnPercent,\n        benchmarkId: query.benchmarkId,\n      });\n      return redactSecrets({ performance: result, benchmark, alpha });\n    }\n\n    return redactSecrets(result);\n  }\n\n  // Attribution\n  @Get('attribution')\n  async getAttribution(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: AttributionQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    await this.assertProfileAccess(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    // For attribution, need total PnL — calculate\n    const pnl = await this.pnlService.calculateNetPnl({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: query.profileId,\n      from: new Date(query.periodStart),\n      to: new Date(query.periodEnd),\n      at: new Date(query.periodEnd),\n      baseCurrency: query.baseCurrency,\n    });\n\n    const totalPnl = pnl.netPnl ?? pnl.grossPnl ?? '0';\n\n    const result = await this.attributionService.calculateAttribution({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: query.profileId,\n      periodStart: new Date(query.periodStart),\n      periodEnd: new Date(query.periodEnd),\n      dimension: query.dimension as any,\n      totalPnl,\n      baseCurrency: query.baseCurrency,\n    });\n\n    return redactSecrets(result);\n  }\n\n  // Snapshots\n  @Post('snapshots')\n  async createSnapshot(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: CreateSnapshotDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.requireAccountingAdmin(req);\n    await this.enforceTenantIsolation(tenantId, dto.profileId);\n\n    const snapshot = await this.snapshotService.createSnapshot({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: dto.profileId,\n      timestamp: dto.timestamp ? new Date(dto.timestamp) : new Date(),\n      baseCurrency: dto.baseCurrency,\n      scope: dto.scope as any,\n      scopeId: dto.scopeId,\n      correlationId: req.headers['x-correlation-id'] ?? null,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: dto.profileId,\n      action: 'SNAPSHOT_CREATED',\n      entityType: 'PORTFOLIO_SNAPSHOT',\n      entityId: snapshot.id,\n      operatorId: this.getUserId(req),\n      evidence: { snapshotId: snapshot.snapshotId, timestamp: snapshot.timestamp },\n      calculationVersion: snapshot.calculationVersion,\n      policyVersion: snapshot.policyVersion,\n      dataCompleteness: snapshot.dataCompleteness,\n    });\n\n    return redactSecrets(snapshot);\n  }\n\n  @Get('snapshots')\n  async listSnapshots(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: PortfolioSnapshotQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const profileId = await this.scopedProfileId(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    return await this.snapshotService.listSnapshots({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      from: query.from ? new Date(query.from) : undefined,\n      to: query.to ? new Date(query.to) : undefined,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('snapshots/:snapshotId')\n  async getSnapshot(@Req() req: any, @Param('snapshotId') snapshotId: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const snapshot = await this.snapshotService.getSnapshot({ tenantId, snapshotId });\n    if (!snapshot) throw new NotFoundException('Snapshot not found');\n    await this.assertProfileAccess(req, tenantId, snapshot.profileId);\n    return redactSecrets(snapshot);\n  }\n\n  // Periods\n  @Post('periods')\n  async createPeriod(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: CreatePeriodDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.requireAccountingAdmin(req);\n    await this.enforceTenantIsolation(tenantId, dto.profileId);\n\n    const period = await this.periodService.createPeriod({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: dto.profileId,\n      periodStart: new Date(dto.periodStart),\n      periodEnd: new Date(dto.periodEnd),\n      periodType: dto.periodType,\n      baseCurrency: dto.baseCurrency,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.log({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: dto.profileId,\n      action: 'PERIOD_CREATED',\n      entityType: 'PORTFOLIO_ACCOUNTING_PERIOD',\n      entityId: period.id,\n      operatorId: this.getUserId(req),\n      evidence: { periodStart: dto.periodStart, periodEnd: dto.periodEnd },\n      calculationVersion: period.calculationVersion,\n      policyVersion: period.policyVersion,\n    });\n\n    return redactSecrets(period);\n  }\n\n  @Get('periods')\n  async listPeriods(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: PortfolioPeriodQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const profileId = await this.scopedProfileId(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    return await this.periodService.listPeriods({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      state: query.state,\n      from: query.from ? new Date(query.from) : undefined,\n      to: query.to ? new Date(query.to) : undefined,\n      page: query.page,\n      limit: query.limit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Post('periods/close')\n  async closePeriod(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: ClosePeriodDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.requireAccountingAdmin(req);\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n\n    const period = await this.periodService.getPeriod({ tenantId, periodId: dto.periodId });\n    if (!period) throw new BadRequestException('Period not found');\n    await this.enforceTenantIsolation(tenantId, period.profileId);\n\n    const closed = await this.periodCloseService.initiateClose({\n      tenantId,\n      periodId: dto.periodId,\n      operatorId: userId,\n      correlationId: req.headers['x-correlation-id'] ?? null,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.logPeriodClose({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: period.profileId,\n      periodId: dto.periodId,\n      state: 'CLOSED',\n      operatorId: userId,\n      nav: closed.nav ?? null,\n      calculationVersion: period.calculationVersion,\n      policyVersion: period.policyVersion,\n    });\n\n    return redactSecrets(closed);\n  }\n\n  // Statements\n  @Post('statements')\n  async generateStatement(@Req() req: any, @Body() dto: GenerateStatementDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    this.requireAccountingAdmin(req);\n    await this.enforceTenantIsolation(tenantId, dto.profileId);\n\n    const statement = await this.statementService.generateStatement({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: dto.profileId,\n      periodId: dto.periodId,\n      operatorId: this.getUserId(req),\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.logStatement({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: dto.profileId,\n      statementId: statement.statementId,\n      periodId: dto.periodId,\n      operatorId: this.getUserId(req),\n      calculationVersion: statement.calculationVersion,\n      policyVersion: statement.policyVersion,\n    });\n\n    return redactSecrets(statement);\n  }\n\n  @Get('statements')\n  async listStatements(@Req() req: any, @Query() query: StatementQueryDto) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    if (query.profileId) await this.assertProfileAccess(req, tenantId, query.profileId);\n\n    // Statement cannot expose other user — enforce visibility\n    const userId = this.getUserId(req);\n    const role = this.visibilityRoleFor(req);\n    const isPlatform = this.isPlatformUser(req);\n\n    // Visibility is part of the query (not a filter over one page): a restricted caller's\n    // page/limit/total then count only the statements it may see.\n    const restricted = !isPlatform && role !== InvestorVisibilityRole.TENANT_OWNER && role !== InvestorVisibilityRole.COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER;\n    const profileIds = restricted ? [...(await this.ownProfileIds(req, tenantId))] : undefined;\n\n    const result = await this.statementService.listStatements({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId: query.profileId,\n      profileIds,\n      periodId: query.periodId,\n      state: query.state,\n      from: query.from ? new Date(query.from) : undefined,\n      to: query.to ? new Date(query.to) : undefined,\n      page: query.page,\n of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":19,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger, Optional } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { OutboxService } from '../../infrastructure/outbox/outbox.service';\nimport { NavService } from './nav.service';\nimport { PnLService } from './pnl.service';\nimport { PerformanceService } from './performance.service';\nimport { PositionAccountingService } from './position-accounting.service';\nimport { CashLedgerService } from './cash-ledger.service';\nimport { AccountingPolicyService } from './accounting-policy.service';\nimport { deterministicIdempotencyKey } from './portfolio-accounting.types';\nimport { createHash } from 'crypto';\n\n/** API view of a PortfolioSnapshot row: performance/methodology/fingerprint/correlationId from performanceMetrics. */\nexport function toSnapshotView(row: any): any {\n  if (!row) return row;\n  const metrics = row.performanceMetrics && typeof row.performanceMetrics === 'object' ? row.performanceMetrics : {};\n  return {\n    ...row,\n    performance: metrics.twr ?? null,\n    methodology: metrics.methodology ?? null,\n    fingerprint: metrics.fingerprint ?? null,\n    correlationId: metrics.correlationId ?? null,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Provides immutable point-in-time snapshots containing NAV, cash, positions, exposure refs,\n * PnL, fees, valuation evidence, source refs, calculationVersion, policyVersion, data completeness.\n * Must be idempotent and prevent duplicate snapshot creation.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PortfolioSnapshotService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PortfolioSnapshotService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly navService: NavService,\n    private readonly pnlService: PnLService,\n    private readonly performanceService: PerformanceService,\n    private readonly positionAccounting: PositionAccountingService,\n    private readonly cashLedger: CashLedgerService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n    @Optional() private readonly outbox?: OutboxService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createSnapshot(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    snapshotId?: string;\n    timestamp: Date;\n    baseCurrency?: string;\n    scope: string;\n    scopeId: string;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, timestamp, scope, scopeId, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: scope as any, scopeId });\n    const baseCurrency = params.baseCurrency ?? policy.baseCurrency;\n\n    const snapshotId = params.snapshotId ?? `snap_${tenantId.slice(0, 8)}_${profileId.slice(0, 8)}_${timestamp.toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')}`;\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `snapshot:${snapshotId}`,\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      sourceId: snapshotId,\n      timestampBucket: timestamp.toISOString().slice(0, 10),\n    });\n\n    // Calculate NAV\n    const navResult = await this.navService.calculateNav({ tenantId, profileId, at: timestamp, baseCurrency });\n\n    // Calculate PnL\n    const pnlResult = await this.pnlService.calculateNetPnl({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      at: timestamp,\n      baseCurrency,\n      from: new Date(timestamp.getTime() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // last 24h for daily\n      to: timestamp,\n    });\n\n    // Get holdings\n    const holdings = await this.positionAccounting.getHoldings({ tenantId, profileId, at: timestamp });\n\n    // Get cash\n    const cash = await this.cashLedger.getCashBalance({ tenantId, profileId, at: timestamp });\n\n    // Get performance (since inception)\n    const inception = new Date('2020-01-01'); // would be profile creation date in real\n    const twr = await this.performanceService.calculateTWR({ tenantId, profileId, periodStart: inception, periodEnd: timestamp, baseCurrency });\n\n    // Fees from cash ledger\n    let fees: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      const feeEntries = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioCashLedgerEntry.findMany({\n        where: {\n          tenantId,\n          profileId,\n          cashFlowType: { in: ['FEE', 'PLATFORM_FEE', 'PERFORMANCE_FEE'] },\n          occurredAt: { lte: timestamp },\n        },\n        orderBy: { occurredAt: 'desc' },\n        take: 100,\n      });\n      fees = feeEntries;\n    } catch {\n      fees = [];\n    }\n\n    const fingerprint = createHash('sha256')\n      .update(JSON.stringify({ tenantId, profileId, snapshotId, timestamp: timestamp.toISOString(), nav: navResult.nav, holdings }))\n      .digest('hex');\n\n    if (!this.outbox) {\n      throw new Error('Transactional outbox is unavailable; refusing portfolio snapshot without its portfolio.snapshot.created event');\n    }\n    const snapshot = await this.prisma.withTenantRls(tenantId, async (tx) => {\n      const store = tx as any;\n      const existing = await store.portfolioSnapshot.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, OR: [{ idempotencyKey }, { snapshotId }] },\n      });\n      if (existing) {\n        this.logger.log({ event: 'portfolio.snapshot.idempotent_hit', snapshotId, tenantId });\n        await this.outbox!.append(tx, {\n          tenantId,\n          aggregateType: 'portfolio_snapshot',\n          aggregateId: existing.id,\n          eventType: 'portfolio.snapshot.created',\n          idempotencyKey: `portfolio-snapshot:${existing.id}:created`,\n          correlationId: correlationId && correlationId.length <= 64 ? correlationId : null,\n          occurredAt: existing.timestamp,\n          payload: { snapshotId: existing.snapshotId, asOf: new Date(existing.timestamp).toISOString() },\n        });\n        return existing;\n      }\n\n      const created = await store.portfolioSnapshot.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId,\n          profileId,\n          snapshotId,\n          timestamp,\n          baseCurrency,\n          cash: cash.balance,\n          positions: holdings as any,\n          nav: navResult.nav,\n          grossAssetValue: navResult.grossAssetValue,\n          grossLiability: navResult.grossLiability,\n          realizedPnl: pnlResult.grossPnl ? (await this.pnlService.calculateRealizedPnl({ tenantId, profileId })).realizedPnl : null,\n          unrealizedPnl: pnlResult.evidence?.gross?.unrealized ?? null,\n          grossPnl: pnlResult.grossPnl,\n          netPnl: pnlResult.netPnl,\n          // fees is a decimal-string column: the fee total of the same window as gross/net PnL\n          // (netPnl = grossPnl - fees). The fee ledger rows are kept as cash-breakdown evidence.\n          fees: pnlResult.fees ?? null,\n          cashBreakdown: {\n            balance: cash.balance,\n            currency: cash.currency,\n            baseCurrencyBalance: cash.baseCurrencyBalance ?? null,\n            recentFeeEntries: fees.map((entry: any) => ({\n              id: entry.id,\n              cashFlowType: entry.cashFlowType,\n              amount: entry.amount,\n              currency: entry.currency,\n              baseCurrencyAmount: entry.baseCurrencyAmount ?? null,\n              occurredAt: entry.occurredAt,\n            })),\n          } as any,\n          // No performance/methodology/fingerprint/correlationId columns: kept in performanceMetrics.\n          performanceMetrics: {\n            twr: twr.evidence ?? null,\n            methodology: navResult.methodology ?? null,\n            fingerprint,\n            correlationId: correlationId ?? null,\n          } as any,\n          valuationEvidence: navResult.evidences as any,\n          sourceReferences: navResult.sourceReferences,\n          calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n          policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n          dataCompleteness: navResult.dataCompleteness,\n          idempotencyKey,\n        },\n      });\n      await this.outbox!.append(tx, {\n        tenantId,\n        aggregateType: 'portfolio_snapshot',\n        aggregateId: created.id,\n        eventType: 'portfolio.snapshot.created',\n        idempotencyKey: `portfolio-snapshot:${created.id}:created`,\n        correlationId: correlationId && correlationId.length <= 64 ? correlationId : null,\n        occurredAt: created.timestamp,\n        payload: { snapshotId: created.snapshotId, asOf: new Date(created.timestamp).toISOString() },\n      });\n      return created;\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'portfolio.snapshot.created', snapshotId, tenantId, nav: navResult.nav });\n\n    return toSnapshotView(snapshot);\n  }\n\n  async getSnapshot(params: { tenantId: string; snapshotId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    const snapshot = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioSnapshot.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, snapshotId: params.snapshotId },\n    });\n    return snapshot ? toSnapshotView(snapshot) : null;\n  }\n\n  async listSnapshots(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId?: string;\n    from?: Date;\n    to?: Date;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, from, to, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (profileId) where.profileId = profileId;\n    if (from || to) {\n      where.timestamp = {};\n      if (from) where.timestamp.gte = from;\n      if (to) where.timestamp.lte = to;\n    }\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioSnapshot.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioSnapshot.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data: data.map(toSnapshotView), total, page, limit };\n  }\n\n  async verifySnapshotImmutability(snapshotId: string, currentHash: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    const snapshot = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioSnapshot.findFirst({ where: { snapshotId } });\n    if (!snapshot) return false;\n    return toSnapshotView(snapshot).fingerprint === currentHash;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/position-accounting.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":19,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"// # Responsibility: build tenant-scoped position and lot accounting from authoritative positions and fills.\nimport { Injectable, Logger, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { AccountingPolicyService } from './accounting-policy.service';\nimport {\n  PortfolioPositionClassification,\n  deterministicIdempotencyKey,\n  add,\n  sub,\n  cmp,\n  mul,\n  redactSecrets,\n  isValidDecimal,\n} from './portfolio-accounting.types';\n\n/**\n * Builds accounting views of holdings and position lots from authoritative positions/fills.\n * Must support opening, increasing, reducing, closing, realized/unrealized classification,\n * and lot continuity without changing the authoritative position engine.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PositionAccountingService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PositionAccountingService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async openLot(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    accountingEventId?: string | null;\n    symbol: string;\n    asset: string;\n    venue?: string | null;\n    quantity: string;\n    costBasisPerUnit?: string | null;\n    currency: string;\n    occurredAt: Date;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, accountingEventId = null, symbol, asset, venue = null, quantity, costBasisPerUnit = null, currency, occurredAt, correlationId = null } = params;\n\n    if (!isValidDecimal(quantity)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid quantity: ${quantity}`);\n    if (cmp(quantity, '0') <= 0) throw new BadRequestException('Quantity must be > 0');\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n\n    const totalCostBasis = costBasisPerUnit ? this.mulSafe(quantity, costBasisPerUnit) : null;\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `position-lot:open:${symbol}`,\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      sourceId: accountingEventId ?? `${symbol}:${quantity}:${occurredAt.toISOString()}`,\n      timestampBucket: occurredAt.toISOString().slice(0, 10),\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    } catch {}\n\n    const lot = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId,\n        profileId,\n        accountingEventId: accountingEventId ?? null,\n        symbol,\n        asset,\n        venue: venue ?? null,\n        classification: quantity.startsWith('-') ? PortfolioPositionClassification.SHORT : PortfolioPositionClassification.LONG,\n        quantity,\n        remainingQuantity: quantity,\n        costBasisPerUnit: costBasisPerUnit ?? null,\n        totalCostBasis: totalCostBasis ?? null,\n        currency,\n        baseCurrency: policy.baseCurrency,\n        costBasisMethod: policy.costBasisMethod,\n        calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n        isClosed: false,\n        openedAt: occurredAt,\n        idempotencyKey,\n        metadata: redactSecrets({ symbol, venue }) as any,\n        evidence: redactSecrets({ quantity, costBasisPerUnit, source: 'Position accounting from authoritative fills' }) as any,\n      },\n    });\n\n    return lot;\n  }\n\n  async reduceLot(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    quantity: string;\n    closingEventId?: string | null;\n    occurredAt: Date;\n    correlationId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<{ closedLots: any[]; remainingQuantity: string; realizedPnl: string }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, symbol, quantity, closingEventId = null, occurredAt } = params;\n\n    if (!isValidDecimal(quantity)) throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid quantity: ${quantity}`);\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n\n    // FIFO reduction — deterministic\n    const openLots = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, profileId, symbol, isClosed: false, isReversed: false },\n      orderBy: { openedAt: 'asc' },\n    });\n\n    let remainingToClose = quantity;\n    const totalRealizedPnl = '0';\n    const closedLots: any[] = [];\n\n    for (const lot of openLots) {\n      if (cmp(remainingToClose, '0') <= 0) break;\n      const lotRemaining = lot.remainingQuantity;\n      const closeQty = cmp(remainingToClose, lotRemaining) >= 0 ? lotRemaining : remainingToClose;\n\n      // Realized PnL = (closeQty * currentPrice?) — here we calculate as proportional cost basis release, actual PnL calculated in cost-basis service\n      // For position accounting, we just reduce remainingQuantity\n      const newRemaining = sub(lotRemaining, closeQty);\n      const isNowClosed = cmp(newRemaining, '0') === 0;\n\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.update({\n        where: { id: lot.id },\n        data: {\n          remainingQuantity: newRemaining,\n          isClosed: isNowClosed,\n          closedAt: isNowClosed ? occurredAt : null,\n          closingEventId: isNowClosed ? closingEventId : null,\n        },\n      });\n\n      closedLots.push(updated);\n      remainingToClose = sub(remainingToClose, closeQty);\n    }\n\n    return { closedLots, remainingQuantity: remainingToClose, realizedPnl: totalRealizedPnl };\n  }\n\n  async getHoldings(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    at?: Date;\n  }): Promise<Array<{ symbol: string; asset: string; quantity: string; classification: string; costBasis: string | null }>> {\n    const where: any = { tenantId: params.tenantId, profileId: params.profileId, isClosed: false, isReversed: false };\n    if (params.at) where.openedAt = { lte: params.at };\n\n    const lots = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.findMany({\n      where,\n      orderBy: { openedAt: 'asc' },\n    });\n\n    // Aggregate by symbol — deterministic\n    const holdingsMap = new Map<string, { asset: string; quantity: string; classification: string; costBasis: string | null }>();\n    for (const lot of lots) {\n      const existing = holdingsMap.get(lot.symbol);\n      if (!existing) {\n        holdingsMap.set(lot.symbol, {\n          asset: lot.asset,\n          quantity: lot.remainingQuantity,\n          classification: lot.classification,\n          costBasis: lot.totalCostBasis,\n        });\n      } else {\n        existing.quantity = add(existing.quantity, lot.remainingQuantity);\n        if (existing.costBasis && lot.totalCostBasis) {\n          existing.costBasis = add(existing.costBasis, lot.totalCostBasis);\n        } else if (lot.totalCostBasis) {\n          existing.costBasis = lot.totalCostBasis;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return Array.from(holdingsMap.entries()).map(([symbol, data]) => ({\n      symbol,\n      asset: data.asset,\n      quantity: data.quantity,\n      classification: data.classification,\n      costBasis: data.costBasis,\n    }));\n  }\n\n  async listLots(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    symbol?: string;\n    isClosed?: boolean;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, symbol, isClosed, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, profileId };\n    if (symbol) where.symbol = symbol;\n    if (isClosed !== undefined) where.isClosed = isClosed;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { openedAt: 'asc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioPositionLot.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n\n  private mulSafe(a: string, b: string): string {\n    try {\n      return mul(a, b);\n    } catch {\n      return '0';\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/report-export.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. statementId: string }): Promise<{ csv: string; filename: string }> {\n    const statement = await this.statementService.getStatement({ tenantId: params.tenantId, statementId: params.statementId });\n    if (!statement) throw new BadRequestException('Statement not found');\n\n    // Tenant isolation — statement already filtered by tenantId\n    // Deterministic CSV from persisted records\n    const headers = [\n      'portfolioId',\n      'periodStart',\n      'periodEnd',\n      'openingNav',\n      'closingNav',\n      'realizedPnl',\n      'unrealizedPnl',\n      'grossPnl',\n      'fees',\n      'netPnl',\n      'baseCurrency',\n      'returnMethodology',\n      'calculationVersion',\n      'policyVersion',\n      'dataCompleteness',\n    ];\n\n    const evidence = (statement.evidence as any) ?? {};\n    const isoDate = (value: unknown): string => (value instanceof Date ? value.toISOString() : value ? String(value) : '');\n    const row = [\n      statement.profileId,\n      isoDate(statement.periodStart),\n      isoDate(statement.periodEnd),\n      statement.openingNav ?? '',\n      statement.closingNav ?? '',\n      statement.realizedPnl ?? '',\n      statement.unrealizedPnl ?? '',\n      (statement.fees as any)?.grossPnl ?? '',\n      (statement.fees as any)?.total ?? '',\n      statement.netPnl ?? '',\n      statement.baseCurrency,\n      statement.returnMethodology,\n      statement.calculationVersion,\n      statement.policyVersion,\n      evidence.dataCompleteness ?? '',\n    ];\n\n    const csv = [headers.join(','), row.map((v) => `\"${String(v).replace(/\"/g, '\"\"')}\"`).join(',')].join('\\n');\n\n    return { csv, filename: `statement_${statement.statementId}.csv` };\n  }\n\n  async exportStatementJson(params: { tenantId: string; statementId: string }): Promise<{ json: any; filename: string }> {\n    const statement = await this.statementService.getStatement({ tenantId: params.tenantId, statementId: params.statementId });\n    if (!statement) throw new BadRequestException('Statement not found');\n\n    // Export deterministic from persisted records, secrets redacted\n    const evidence = (statement.evidence as any) ?? {};\n    const json = redactSecrets({\n      statementId: statement.statementId,\n      portfolioId: statement.profileId,\n      periodId: statement.periodId,\n      periodStart: statement.periodStart,\n      periodEnd: statement.periodEnd,\n      openingNav: statement.openingNav,\n      closingNav: statement.closingNav,\n      deposits: statement.deposits,\n      withdrawals: statement.withdrawals,\n      transfers: statement.transfers,\n      tradingActivity: statement.tradingActivity,\n      realizedPnl: statement.realizedPnl,\n      unrealizedPnl: statement.unrealizedPnl,\n      grossPnl: (statement.fees as any)?.grossPnl ??
