'' : String(entry.amount);\n    if (!isValidDecimal(value)) continue;\n    total = entry.type === 'TRANSFER_OUT' ? sub(total, value) : add(total, value);\n  }\n  return total;\n}\n\n/**\n * Generates statements from persisted periods and snapshots, including holdings, cash,\n * transactions, fees, PnL, returns, and methodology. Statements from persisted accounting include\n * portfolio ID, period, opening/closing NAV, deposits/withdrawals/transfers, trading activity,\n * realized/unrealized PnL, fees, net PnL, return methodology, holdings, cash, performance,\n * benchmark, reconciliation status, versions.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class StatementService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(StatementService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n    private readonly periodService: AccountingPeriodService,\n    private readonly snapshotService: PortfolioSnapshotService,\n    private readonly pnlService: PnLService,\n    private readonly performanceService: PerformanceService,\n    private readonly cashLedger: CashLedgerService,\n    private readonly positionAccounting: PositionAccountingService,\n    @Optional() private readonly outbox?: OutboxService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async generateStatement(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    periodId: string;\n    statementId?: string;\n    operatorId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, periodId, operatorId = null } = params;\n\n    const period = await this.periodService.getPeriod({ tenantId, periodId });\n    if (!period) throw new BadRequestException('Period not found');\n    if (period.profileId !== profileId) throw new BadRequestException('Period profile mismatch');\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolvePolicy({ tenantId, scope: 'TENANT' as any, scopeId: profileId });\n\n    const statementId = params.statementId ?? `stmt_${tenantId.slice(0, 8)}_${periodId.slice(0, 8)}_${Date.now()}`;\n\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `statement:${statementId}`,\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      sourceId: periodId,\n    });\n\n    // Fetch persisted records — statements from persisted accounting\n    const openingSnapshot = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioSnapshot.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, profileId, timestamp: { lte: period.periodStart } },\n      orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    const closingSnapshot = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioSnapshot.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, profileId, timestamp: { gte: period.periodEnd, lte: new Date(period.periodEnd.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) } },\n      orderBy: { timestamp: 'asc' },\n    });\n\n    const cashEntries = await this.cashLedger.listCashEntries({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      from: period.periodStart,\n      to: period.periodEnd,\n      page: 1,\n      limit: 1000,\n    });\n\n    const deposits = cashEntries.data.filter((e: any) => e.cashFlowType === 'DEPOSIT');\n    const withdrawals = cashEntries.data.filter((e: any) => e.cashFlowType === 'WITHDRAWAL');\n    const transfers = cashEntries.data.filter((e: any) => ['TRANSFER_IN', 'TRANSFER_OUT'].includes(e.cashFlowType));\n\n    const holdings = await this.positionAccounting.getHoldings({ tenantId, profileId, at: period.periodEnd });\n\n    const pnl = await this.pnlService.calculateNetPnl({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      from: period.periodStart,\n      to: period.periodEnd,\n      at: period.periodEnd,\n      baseCurrency: period.baseCurrency,\n    });\n\n    const twr = await this.performanceService.calculateTWR({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      periodStart: period.periodStart,\n      periodEnd: period.periodEnd,\n      baseCurrency: period.baseCurrency,\n    });\n\n    const mwr = await this.performanceService.calculateMWR({\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      periodStart: period.periodStart,\n      periodEnd: period.periodEnd,\n      baseCurrency: period.baseCurrency,\n    });\n\n    // Reconciliation status\n    let reconciliationStatus = 'UNKNOWN';\n    try {\n      const recon = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioAccountingReconciliation.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, profileId, periodId },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n      if (recon) reconciliationStatus = recon.state;\n    } catch {\n      reconciliationStatus = 'PENDING';\n    }\n\n    // Build statement from persisted records\n    const statementData = {\n      portfolioId: profileId,\n      period: { id: period.id, start: period.periodStart, end: period.periodEnd, type: (period.closeMetadata as any)?.periodType ?? null },\n      openingNav: openingSnapshot?.nav ?? null,\n      closingNav: closingSnapshot?.nav ?? pnl.evidence?.gross?.endingNav ?? null,\n      deposits: deposits.map((d: any) => ({ amount: d.baseCurrencyAmount ?? d.amount, currency: d.currency, occurredAt: d.occurredAt })),\n      withdrawals: withdrawals.map((w: any) => ({ amount: w.baseCurrencyAmount ?? w.amount, currency: w.currency, occurredAt: w.occurredAt })),\n      transfers: transfers.map((t: any) => ({ amount: t.baseCurrencyAmount ?? t.amount, currency: t.currency, type: t.cashFlowType, occurredAt: t.occurredAt })),\n      tradingActivity: cashEntries.data.filter((e: any) => ['TRADE_SETTLEMENT_BUY', 'TRADE_SETTLEMENT_SELL'].includes(e.cashFlowType)).length,\n      realizedPnl: pnl.evidence?.gross?.realized ?? null,\n      unrealizedPnl: pnl.evidence?.gross?.unrealized ?? null,\n      grossPnl: pnl.grossPnl,\n      fees: pnl.fees,\n      netPnl: pnl.netPnl,\n      returnMethodology: policy.returnMethodology,\n      holdings,\n      cash: { balance: closingSnapshot?.cash ?? '0', currency: period.baseCurrency },\n      performance: { twr: twr.returnPercent, mwr: mwr.returnPercent, twrEvidence: twr.evidence, mwrEvidence: mwr.evidence },\n      benchmark: null, // Would include benchmark if configured\n      reconciliationStatus,\n      versions: { calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion, policyVersion: policy.policyVersion },\n    };\n\n    const dataCompleteness = closingSnapshot?.dataCompleteness ?? 'COMPLETE';\n    const returnPercent =\n      policy.returnMethodology === PortfolioReturnMethodology.MONEY_WEIGHTED_RETURN ? mwr.returnPercent : twr.returnPercent;\n\n    // Only columns of the PortfolioStatement model: Prisma rejects unknown\n    // fields, so line items and evidence remain in the model's Json columns.\n    const finalizedAt = new Date();\n    const persistenceData = {\n      tenantId,\n      profileId,\n      periodId,\n      statementId,\n      state: PortfolioStatementState.FINALIZED as any,\n      periodStart: period.periodStart,\n      periodEnd: period.periodEnd,\n      openingNav: statementData.openingNav,\n      closingNav: statementData.closingNav,\n      deposits: sumLedgerAmounts(statementData.deposits),\n      withdrawals: sumLedgerAmounts(statementData.withdrawals),\n      transfers: sumLedgerAmounts(statementData.transfers),\n      tradingActivity: {\n        count: statementData.tradingActivity,\n        deposits: statementData.deposits,\n        withdrawals: statementData.withdrawals,\n        transfers: statementData.transfers,\n      } as any,\n      realizedPnl: statementData.realizedPnl,\n      unrealizedPnl: statementData.unrealizedPnl,\n      fees: { total: statementData.fees, grossPnl: statementData.grossPnl } as any,\n      netPnl: statementData.netPnl,\n      returnMethodology: policy.returnMethodology as any,\n      returnPercent: returnPercent ?? null,\n      benchmarkReturn: null,\n      endingHoldings: holdings as any,\n      cash: statementData.cash.balance,\n      reconciliationStatus,\n      baseCurrency: period.baseCurrency,\n      calculationVersion: policy.calculationVersion,\n      policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      sourceReferences: [...new Set([...(closingSnapshot?.sourceReferences ?? []), ...(openingSnapshot?.sourceReferences ?? [])])],\n      evidence: redactSecrets({\n        statementData,\n        period,\n        openingSnapshotId: openingSnapshot?.id,\n        closingSnapshotId: closingSnapshot?.id,\n        performance: statementData.performance,\n        methodology: `STATEMENT_${policy.returnMethodology}`,\n        dataCompleteness,\n        createdBy: operatorId,\n      }) as any,\n      idempotencyKey,\n      finalizedAt,\n    };\n    if (!this.outbox) {\n      throw new Error('Transactional outbox is unavailable; refusing statement generation without its statement.generated event');\n    }\n    const statement = await this.prisma.withTenantRls(tenantId, async (tx) => {\n      const store = tx as any;\n      const existing = await store.portfolioStatement.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      const persisted = existing ?? await store.portfolioStatement.create({ data: persistenceData });\n      const generatedAt = persisted.finalizedAt ?? persisted.createdAt ?? finalizedAt;\n      await this.outbox!.append(tx, {\n        tenantId,\n        aggregateType: 'statement',\n        aggregateId: persisted.id,\n        eventType: 'statement.generated',\n        idempotencyKey: `statement:${persisted.id}:generated`,\n        occurredAt: generatedAt,\n        payload: {\n          statementId: persisted.statementId,\n          generatedAt: new Date(generatedAt).toISOString(),\n        },\n      });\n      return persisted;\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log({ event: 'portfolio.statement.generated', statementId, tenantId, periodId });\n\n    return statement;\n  }\n\n  async getStatement(params: { tenantId: string; statementId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    return await (this.prisma as any).portfolioStatement.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, statementId: params.statementId },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async listStatements(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId?: string;\n    /**\n     * Visibility restriction: only statements of these profiles. Applied in the WHERE clause,\n     * i.e. BEFORE pagination, so page/limit/total describe the visible rows (filtering a page\n     * afterwards produced short or empty pages and a total that counted one page only).\n     */\n    profileIds?: string[];\n    periodId?: string;\n    /** PortfolioStatementState; StatementQueryDto validated it but it was never applied. */\n    state?: string;\n    from?: Date;\n    to?: Date;\n    page?: number;\n    limit?: number;\n  }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, profileIds, periodId, state, from, to, page = 1, limit = 50 } = params;\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (profileIds) {\n      if (profileId && !profileIds.includes(profileId)) return { data: [], total: 0, page, limit };\n      where.profileId = profileId ? profileId : { in: profileIds };\n    } else if (profileId) {\n      where.profileId = profileId;\n    }\n    if (periodId) where.periodId = periodId;\n    if (state) where.state = state;\n    if (from || to) {\n      where.createdAt = {};\n      if (from) where.createdAt.gte = from;\n      if (to) where.createdAt.lte = to;\n    }\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioStatement.findMany({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        skip: (page - 1) * limit,\n        take: limit,\n      }),\n      (this.prisma as any).portfolioStatement.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/portfolio-accounting/valuation.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'tenantId' is assigned a value but never used.","line":30,"column":13,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":30,"endColumn":21},{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'asset' is assigned a value but never used.","line":30,"column":31,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":30,"endColumn":36},{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'altSymbol' is assigned a value but never used.","line":79,"column":13,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":79,"endColumn":22},{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'profileId' is assigned a value but never used.","line":126,"column":23,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":126,"endColumn":32},{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Missing, stale, or unavailable\n * market data must produce an explicit valuation state, not fabricated prices or fallback estimates.\n * Missing FX → explicit incomplete state never invent rate/NAV. Missing price → incomplete state never invent.\n * Explicit INCOMPLETE state for MISSING_PRICE, never invent rate/NAV.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class ValuationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ValuationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: AccountingPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async getVerifiedMarketPrice(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    asset: string;\n    at: Date;\n  }): Promise<{ price: string | null; source: string | null; timestamp: Date | null; state: PortfolioValuationState }> {\n    const { tenantId, symbol, asset, at } = params;\n\n    // Reuse the existing market-price source: MarketDataRecord candles written by\n    // the market-data pipeline. The price at `at` is the close of the latest\n    // candle that had closed by then - never a later candle (look-ahead).\n    try {\n      const candle = await this.prisma.marketDataRecord.findFirst({\n        where: { symbol, closeTime: { lte: at } },\n        orderBy: { closeTime: 'desc' },\n        select: { close: true, closeTime: true, venue: true, interval: true },\n      });\n\n      if (candle) {\n        // Staleness is measured against the valuation instant, so a historical\n        // valuation is not STALE merely for being historical. 5 min threshold -\n        // explicit, not hidden; a daily candle is honestly reported as STALE.\n        const ageMs = at.getTime() - candle.closeTime.getTime();\n        const isStale = ageMs > 5 * 60 * 1000;\n        return {\n          price: candle.close.toString(),\n          source: `MARKET_DATA:${candle.venue}:${candle.interval}`,\n          timestamp: candle.closeTime,\n          state: isStale ? PortfolioValuationState.STALE : PortfolioValuationState.VALID,\n        };\n      }\n\n      // No price — explicit incomplete state, never invent rate/NAV\n      return { price: null, source: null, timestamp: null, state: PortfolioValuationState.MISSING_PRICE };\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Valuation price fetch failed for ${symbol}: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      return { price: null, source: null, timestamp: null, state: PortfolioValuationState.UNAVAILABLE };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getFxRate(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    fromCurrency: string;\n    toCurrency: string;\n    at: Date;\n  }): Promise<{ rate: string | null; source: string | null; timestamp: Date | null; status: string }> {\n    const { fromCurrency, toCurrency, at } = params;\n\n    if (fromCurrency === toCurrency) {\n      return { rate: '1', source: 'SAME_CURRENCY', timestamp: at, status: 'SAME_CURRENCY' };\n    }\n\n    try {\n      // Reuse existing FX or market data — check if there's a conversion pair\n      const symbol = `${fromCurrency}${toCurrency}`;\n      const altSymbol = `${fromCurrency}/${toCurrency}`;\n      const reverseSymbol = `${toCurrency}${fromCurrency}`;\n\n      const price = await this.getVerifiedMarketPrice({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        symbol,\n        asset: fromCurrency,\n        at,\n      });\n\n      if (price.price) {\n        return { rate: price.price, source: price.source, timestamp: price.timestamp, status: 'CONVERTED' };\n      }\n\n      // Try reverse\n      const reversePrice = await this.getVerifiedMarketPrice({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        symbol: reverseSymbol,\n        asset: toCurrency,\n        at,\n      });\n\n      if (reversePrice.price) {\n        try {\n          const inverted = div('1', reversePrice.price);\n          return { rate: inverted, source: reversePrice.source, timestamp: reversePrice.timestamp, status: 'CONVERTED_INVERSE' };\n        } catch {\n          // fall through to missing\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Missing FX — explicit incomplete state, never invent rate/NAV\n      return { rate: null, source: null, timestamp: null, status: 'MISSING_FX' };\n    } catch {\n      return { rate: null, source: null, timestamp: null, status: 'MISSING_FX' };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async valuePosition(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    asset: string;\n    quantity: string;\n    at: Date;\n    baseCurrency: string;\n  }): Promise<{ valuedAmount: string | null; baseCurrencyAmount: string | null; evidence: ValuationEvidence }> {\n    const { tenantId, profileId, symbol, asset, quantity, at, baseCurrency } = params;\n\n    const market = await this.getVerifiedMarketPrice({ tenantId, symbol, asset, at });\n\n    if (!market.price) {\n      // Missing price — incomplete, not zero\n      const evidence: ValuationEvidence = {\n        symbol,\n        asset,\n        quantity,\n        marketPrice: null,\n        marketPriceSource: null,\n        marketPriceTimestamp: null,\n        valuationState: market.state,\n        conversionRate: null,\n        conversionSource: null,\n        conversionTimestamp: null,\n        conversionStatus: 'MISSING_PRICE',\n        baseCurrency,\n        valuationTimestamp: at.toISOString(),\n        dataCompleteness: `MISSING_PRICE for ${symbol}`,\n        sourceReferences: [],\n      };\n\n      return { valuedAmount: null, baseCurrencyAmount: null, evidence };\n    }\n\n    // Calculate valued amount = quantity * marketPrice\n    let valuedAmount: string;\n    try {\n      valuedAmount = mul(quantity, market.price);\n    } catch {\n      valuedAmount = '0';\n    }\n\n    // Convert to base currency if needed\n    let baseCurrencyAmount: string | null = valuedAmount;\n    let conversionRate: string | null = null;\n    let conversionSource: string | null = null;\n    let conversionTimestamp: string | null = null;\n    let conversionStatus: string | null = null;\n\n    // Assume market price quoted in USDT/USD — if baseCurrency != quote, need FX\n    // For simplicity, assume quote is USDT; if baseCurrency is USD, use 1:1 or FX\n    if (baseCurrency !== 'USDT' && baseCurrency !== 'USD') {\n      const fx = await this.getFxRate({ tenantId, fromCurrency: 'USDT', toCurrency: baseCurrency, at });\n      if (fx.rate) {\n        try {\n          baseCurrencyAmount = mul(valuedAmount, fx.rate);\n          conversionRate = fx.rate;\n          conversionSource = fx.source;\n          conversionTimestamp = fx.timestamp?.toISOString() ?? null;\n          conversionStatus = fx.status;\n        } catch {\n          baseCurrencyAmount = null;\n          conversionStatus = 'CONVERSION_FAILED';\n        }\n      } else {\n        baseCurrencyAmount = null;\n        conversionStatus = 'MISSING_FX';\n      }\n    } else {\n      conversionRate = '1';\n      conversionSource = 'SAME_CURRENCY';\n      conversionTimestamp = at.toISOString();\n      conversionStatus = 'SAME_CURRENCY';\n    }\n\n    const evidence: ValuationEvidence = {\n      symbol,\n      asset,\n      quantity,\n      marketPrice: market.price,\n      marketPriceSource: market.source,\n      marketPriceTimestamp: market.timestamp?.toISOString() ?? null,\n      valuationState: baseCurrencyAmount === null ? PortfolioValuationState.MISSING_FX : market.state,\n      conversionRate,\n      conversionSource,\n      conversionTimestamp,\n      conversionStatus,\n      baseCurrency,\n      valuationTimestamp: at.toISOString(),\n      dataCompleteness: baseCurrencyAmount === null ? `MISSING_FX ${baseCurrency}` : market.state === PortfolioValuationState.VALID ? 'COMPLETE' : market.state,\n      sourceReferences: [market.source ?? 'UNKNOWN'].filter(Boolean) as string[],\n    };\n\n    return { valuedAmount, baseCurrencyAmount, evidence };\n  }\n\n  async valuePortfolio(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    holdings: Array<{ symbol: string; asset: string; quantity: string }>;\n    at: Date;\n    baseCurrency: string;\n  }): Promise<{\n    grossAssetValue: string;\n    grossLiability: string;\n    netValued: string;\n    evidences: ValuationEvidence[];\n    completeness: string;\n    hasMissingPrice: boolean;\n    hasMissingFx: boolean;\n    hasStalePrice: boolean;\n  }> {\n    let grossAssetValue = '0';\n    let grossLiability = '0';\n    const evidences: ValuationEvidence[] = [];\n    let hasMissingPrice = false;\n    let hasMissingFx = false;\n    let hasStalePrice = false;\n\n    for (const holding of params.holdings) {\n      const valuation = await this.valuePosition({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        profileId: params.profileId,\n        symbol: holding.symbol,\n        asset: holding.asset,\n        quantity: holding.quantity,\n        at: params.at,\n        baseCurrency: params.baseCurrency,\n      });\n\n      evidences.push(valuation.evidence);\n\n      if (valuation.evidence.valuationState === PortfolioValuationState.MISSING_PRICE) hasMissingPrice = true;\n      if (valuation.evidence.valuationState === PortfolioValuationState.MISSING_FX || valuation.evidence.conversionStatus === 'MISSING_FX') hasMissingFx = true;\n      if (valuation.evidence.valuationState === PortfolioValuationState.STALE) hasStalePrice = true;\n\n      if (valuation.baseCurrencyAmount) {\n        if (valuation.baseCurrencyAmount.startsWith('-')) {\n          grossLiability = add(grossLiability, valuation.baseCurrencyAmount.replace('-', ''));\n        } else {\n          grossAssetValue = add(grossAssetValue, valuation.baseCurrencyAmount);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    const netValued = (() => {\n      try {\n        return sub(grossAssetValue, grossLiability);\n      } catch {\n        return grossAssetValue;\n      }\n    })();\n\n    let completeness = 'COMPLETE';\n    if (hasMissingPrice) completeness = 'MISSING_PRICE';\n    else if (hasMissingFx) completeness = 'MISSING_FX';\n    else if (hasStalePrice) completeness = 'STALE_PRICE';\n\n    return { grossAssetValue, grossLiability, netValued, evidences, completeness, hasMissingPrice, hasMissingFx, hasStalePrice };\n  }\n\n  async persistValuation(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    profileId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    asset: string;\n    quantity: string;\n    marketPrice: string | null;\n    marketPriceSource: string | null;\n    marketPriceTimestamp: Date | null;\n    valuationState: PortfolioValuationState;\n    valuedAmount: string | null;\n    baseCurrency: string;\n    baseCurrencyAmount: string | null;\n    conversionRate: string | null;\n    conversionSource: string | null;\n    conversionTimestamp: Date | null;\n    conversionStatus: string | null;\n    dataCompleteness: string;\n    calculationVersion: string;\n    policyVersion: string;\n    valuationTimestamp: Date;\n    sourceReferences?: string[];\n    accountingEventId?: string | null;\n    /** Currency of valuedAmount (the market price quote currency); defaults to baseCurrency. */\n    currency?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const idempotencyKey = deterministicIdempotencyKey({\n      type: `valuation:${params.symbol}:${params.asset}`,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      profileId: params.profileId,\n      sourceId: `${params.symbol}:${params.valuationTimestamp.toISOString()}`,\n      timestampBucket: params.valuationTimestamp.toISOString().slice(0, 10),\n    });\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).portfolioValuation.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    } catch {}\n\n    try {\n      return await (this.prisma as any).portfolioValuation.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          profileId: params.profileId,\n          symbol: params.symbol,\n          asset: params.asset,\n          quantity: params.quantity,\n          marketPrice: params.marketPrice,\n          marketPriceSource: params.marketPriceSource,\n          marketPriceTimestamp: params.marketPriceTimestamp,\n          valuationState: params.valuationState as any,\n          // Columns: grossValue (+ required currency) and baseCurrencyValue; accountingEventId goes to evidence.\n          grossValue: params.valuedAmount,\n          currency: params.currency ?? params.baseCurrency,\n          baseCurrency: params.baseCurrency,\n          baseCurrencyValue: params.baseCurrencyAmount,\n          conversionRate: params.conversionRate,\n          conversionSource: params.conversionSource,\n          conversionTimestamp: params.conversionTimestamp,\n          conversionStatus: params.conversionStatus,\n          dataCompleteness: params.dataCompleteness,\n          calculationVersion: params.calculationVersion,\n          policyVersion: params.policyVersion,\n          valuationTimestamp: params.valuationTimestamp,\n          sourceReferences: params.sourceReferences ?? [],\n          evidence: { accountingEventId: params.accountingEventId ?? null } as any,\n          idempotencyKey,\n        },\n      });\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to persist valuation: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/providers/adapters/aml/aml.adapter.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. * Production AML/Sanctions Adapter Bridge\n * Uses existing AML provider interface and selected configured provider.\n * Normalizes screening results and never fabricates CLEAR/BLOCK decisions.\n */\n\nimport { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { ProviderDomain, ProviderName, ProviderCapability, ProviderResult, NormalizedAmlResult, ProviderErrorCode, ProviderOperationType } from '../../provider.types';\nimport { ProviderRequestService } from '../../provider-request.service';\nimport { ProviderObservationService } from '../../provider-observation.service';\n\nexport interface AmlScreenInput {\n  tenantId: string;\n  userId: string;\n  jurisdiction: string;\n  idempotencyKey: string;\n  correlationId: string;\n  safeMetadata?: Record<string, assetId: data.assetId || input.assetId,\n        assetSymbol: data.assetSymbol || data.symbol || 'UNKNOWN',\n        amount: data.amount?.toString() || '0',\n        fee: data.fee?.toString() || },\n        correlationId: input.correlationId,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        operation: ProviderOperationType.CREATE,\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n exchange-provider interface for capabilities supported by repository,\n * including authentication, balances, positions, orders, fills, symbols, and account health.\n *\n * Preserves OMS as authoritative, never bypasses OMS.\n * Flow: OMS → ExchangeRoutingService → Execution Safety → Provider Factory → Selected Adapter → Exchange → ACK/FILL → OMS\n */\n\nimport { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport * as crypto from 'crypto';\nimport { ProviderDomain, ProviderName, ProviderCapability, ProviderResult, NormalizedExchangeOrderResult, ProviderErrorCode, RetryClassification, ProviderOperationType } from '../../provider.types';\nimport { ProviderPolicyService } from '../../provider-policy.service';\nimport { ProviderRequestService } from '../../provider-request.service';\nimport { ProviderObservationService } from '../../provider-observation.service';\n\nexport interface BinanceContext {\n  apiKey: string;\n  apiSecret: string;\n  isSandbox: boolean;\n  tenantId: string;\n  accountId: string;\n  correlationId: string;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class BinanceProductionAdapter {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(BinanceProductionAdapter.name);\n  readonly provider = ProviderName.BINANCE;\n  readonly domain = ProviderDomain.EXCHANGE;\n\n  readonly capabilities: ProviderCapability[] = [\n    ProviderCapability.BALANCE_READ,\n    ProviderCapability.POSITION_READ,\n    ProviderCapability.ORDER_CREATE,\n    ProviderCapability.ORDER_CANCEL,\n    ProviderCapability.ORDER_READ,\n    ProviderCapability.FILL_READ,\n    ProviderCapability.SYMBOL_READ,\n    ProviderCapability.ACCOUNT_HEALTH,\n  ];\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly policyService: ProviderPolicyService,\n    private readonly requestService: ProviderRequestService,\n    private readonly observationService: ProviderObservationService,\n  ) {}\n\n  /**\n   * Whether this adapter may be used at all in the current deployment.\n   *\n   * Binance credentials are per tenant account and arrive with every call in\n   * {@link BinanceContext}, so a process-wide BINANCE_API_KEY says nothing\n   * about availability (the previous `!!process.env['BINANCE_API_KEY'] || true`\n   * was always true, even with no policy and no key anywhere). Availability is\n   * a policy decision: the provider policy must exist, be enabled, and allow\n   * the current environment, and the environment policy must allow Binance.\n   * Anything missing answers `false` - fail closed.\n   */\n  isAvailable(): boolean {\n    const policy = this.policyService.getPolicy(this.domain, this.provider);\n    if (!policy || !policy.enabled) return false;\n    const environment = process.env['NODE_ENV'] || 'development';\n    if (!policy.allowedEnvironments.includes(environment)) return false;\n    return this.policyService.isProviderAllowed(this.provider, environment);\n  }\n\n  getCapabilities(): ProviderCapability[] {\n    return this.capabilities;\n  }\n\n  supportsCapability(capability: ProviderCapability): boolean {\n    return this.capabilities.includes(capability);\n  }\n\n  private getBaseUrl(isSandbox: boolean): string {\n    if (isSandbox) return 'https://testnet.binance.vision';\n    return this.policyService.getPolicy(this.domain, this.provider)?.baseUrl || 'https://api.binance.com';\n  }\n\n  private signRequest(apiSecret: string, queryString: string): string {\n    return crypto.createHmac('sha256', apiSecret).update(queryString).digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  private buildSignedQuery(params: Record<string, string>, apiSecret: string): string {\n    const query = new URLSearchParams(params).toString();\n    const signature = this.signRequest(apiSecret, query);\n    return `${query}&signature=${signature}`;\n  }\n\n  async testConnectivity(context: BinanceContext): Promise<{ healthy: boolean; latencyMs: number; evidence: Record<string, unknown> }> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n    const baseUrl = this.getBaseUrl(context.isSandbox);\n\n    try {\n      const response = await this.requestService.request<any>({\n        method: 'GET',\n        url: `${baseUrl}/api/v3/ping`,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        operation: ProviderOperationType.HEALTH_CHECK,\n        tenantId: context.tenantId,\n        isIdempotent: true,\n      });\n\n      const latencyMs = Date.now() - start;\n\n      await this.observationService.recordExchangeObservation(\n        this.provider,\n        ProviderOperationType.HEALTH_CHECK,\n        context.correlationId,\n        `health_${Date.now()}`,\n        null,\n        'HEALTHY',\n        { latencyMs, httpStatus: response.status, baseUrl: this.redactUrl(baseUrl) },\n        context.tenantId,\n        context.accountId,\n      );\n\n      return {\n        healthy: true,\n        latencyMs,\n        evidence: { httpStatus: response.status, latencyMs, baseUrl: this.redactUrl(baseUrl) },\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      const latencyMs = Date.now() - start;\n      return {\n        healthy: false,\n        latencyMs,\n        evidence: { error: (error as Error).message.slice(0, 200), latencyMs },\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getBalances(context: BinanceContext): Promise<ProviderResult<Array<{ asset: string; free: string; locked: string; total: string }>>> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n\n    if (!context.apiKey || !context.apiSecret) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        error: {\n          code: ProviderErrorCode.NOT_CONFIGURED,\n          message: 'Binance credentials missing',\n          provider: this.provider,\n          domain: this.domain,\n          isRetryable: false,\n          retryClassification: RetryClassification.NO_RETRY,\n          correlationId: context.correlationId,\n          safeEvidence: {},\n        },\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n      };\n    }\n\n    const baseUrl = this.getBaseUrl(context.isSandbox);\n    const timestamp = Date.now().toString();\n    const params: Record<string, string> = { timestamp };\n    const query = this.buildSignedQuery(params, context.apiSecret);\n\n    try {\n      const response = await this.requestService.requestWithRetry<any>({\n        method: 'GET',\n        url: `${baseUrl}/api/v3/account?${query}`,\n        headers: { 'X-MBX-APIKEY': context.apiKey },\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        operation: ProviderOperationType.READ,\n        tenantId: context.tenantId,\n        isIdempotent: true,\n      });\n\n      const balances = (response.data.balances || [])\n        .filter((b: any) => parseFloat(b.free) > 0 || parseFloat(b.locked) > 0)\n        .map((b: any) => ({\n          asset: b.asset,\n          free: b.free,\n          locked: b.locked,\n          total: (parseFloat(b.free) + parseFloat(b.locked)).toString(),\n        }));\n\n      await this.observationService.recordExchangeObservation(\n        this.provider,\n        ProviderOperationType.READ,\n        context.correlationId,\n        `balances_${Date.now()}`,\n        null,\n        'BALANCES_READ',\n        { count: balances.length, latencyMs: response.latencyMs },\n        context.tenantId,\n        context.accountId,\n      );\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        data: balances,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: response.latencyMs,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      const err = (error as any).code ? error : this.requestService.normalizeError(error as Error, this.provider, this.domain, context.correlationId);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        error: err as any,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async createOrder(\n    context: BinanceContext,\n    order: { symbol: string; side: string; type: string; quantity: string; price?: string; clientOrderId: string; isSimulated: boolean },\n  ): Promise<ProviderResult<NormalizedExchangeOrderResult>> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n\n    if (order.isSimulated) {\n      const simulated: NormalizedExchangeOrderResult = {\n        providerOrderId: null,\n        clientOrderId: order.clientOrderId,\n        symbol: this.normalizeSymbol(order.symbol),\n        exchangeSymbol: order.symbol.replace('-', ''),\n        side: order.side,\n        orderType: order.type,\n        requestedQuantity: order.quantity,\n        executedQuantity: '0',\n        averagePrice: null,\n        status: 'NEW',\n        fee: null,\n        feeAsset: null,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        venue: 'BINANCE',\n        isSimulated: true,\n        safeRawStatus: 'NEW',\n      };\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        data: simulated,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n      };\n    }\n\n    const baseUrl = this.getBaseUrl(context.isSandbox);\n    const timestamp = Date.now().toString();\n    const params: Record<string, string> = {\n      symbol: order.symbol.replace('-', ''),\n      side: order.side.toUpperCase(),\n      type: order.type.toUpperCase(),\n      quantity: order.quantity,\n      newClientOrderId: order.clientOrderId,\n      timestamp,\n    };\n    if (order.price) params['price'] = order.price;\n    if (order.type.toUpperCase() === 'LIMIT') params['timeInForce'] = 'GTC';\n\n    const query = this.buildSignedQuery(params, context.apiSecret);\n\n    try {\n      const response = await this.requestService.request<any>({\n        method: 'POST',\n        url: `${baseUrl}/api/v3/order?${query}`,\n        headers: { 'X-MBX-APIKEY': context.apiKey },\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        operation: ProviderOperationType.CREATE,\n        tenantId: context.tenantId,\n        isIdempotent: false,\n      });\n\n      const data = response.data;\n\n      const normalized: NormalizedExchangeOrderResult = {\n        providerOrderId: data.orderId?.toString() || null,\n        clientOrderId: data.clientOrderId || order.clientOrderId,\n        symbol: this.normalizeSymbol(order.symbol),\n        exchangeSymbol: data.symbol,\n        side: data.side,\n        orderType: data.type,\n        requestedQuantity: data.origQty,\n        executedQuantity: data.executedQty || '0',\n        averagePrice: null,\n        status: data.status || 'NEW',\n        fee: null,\n        feeAsset: null,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        venue: 'BINANCE',\n        isSimulated: false,\n        safeRawStatus: data.status || null,\n      };\n\n      await this.observationService.recordExchangeObservation(\n        this.provider,\n        ProviderOperationType.CREATE,\n        context.correlationId,\n        order.clientOrderId,\n        normalized.providerOrderId,\n        normalized.status,\n        { symbol: order.symbol, side: order.side, type: order.type, quantity: order.quantity },\n        context.tenantId,\n        context.accountId,\n      );\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        data: normalized,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        providerReference: normalized.providerOrderId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: response.latencyMs,\n        rawStatus: data.status,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      const err = (error as any).code ? error : this.requestService.normalizeError(error as Error, this.provider, this.domain, context.correlationId);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        error: err as any,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  private normalizeSymbol(symbol: string): string {\n    if (symbol.includes('-')) return symbol.toUpperCase();\n    if (symbol.endsWith('USDT')) return `${symbol.slice(0, -4)}-USDT`;\n    if (symbol.endsWith('BTC')) return `${symbol.slice(0, -3)}-BTC`;\n    return symbol;\n  }\n\n  private redactUrl(url: string): string {\n    try {\n      const parsed = new URL(url);\n      return `${parsed.protocol}//${parsed.host}${parsed.pathname}`;\n    } catch {\n      return url.slice(0, 100);\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/providers/adapters/exchange/bybit.adapter.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected + recvWindow + queryString;\n    return crypto.createHmac('sha256', apiSecret).update(paramStr).digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  async getBalances(context: BybitContext): Promise<ProviderResult<Array<{ asset: string; free: string; locked: string; total: string }>>> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n    const baseUrl = this.getBaseUrl(context.isSandbox);\n    const timestamp = Date.now().toString();\n    const recvWindow = '5000';\n    const queryString = 'accountType=UNIFIED';\n\n    const signature = this.signRequest(context.apiSecret, timestamp, context.apiKey, recvWindow, queryString);\n\n    try {\n      const response = await this.requestService.requestWithRetry<any>({\n        method: 'GET',\n        url: `${baseUrl}/v5/account/wallet-balance?${queryString}`,\n        headers: {\n          'X-BAPI-API-KEY': context.apiKey,\n          'X-BAPI-SIGN': signature,\n          'X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP': timestamp,\n          'X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW': recvWindow,\n        },\n        correlationId: domain: this.domain,\n        data: balances,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: response.latencyMs,\n      };\n    } success: false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        error: err as any,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new 1000).toString();\n    const method = 'GET';\n    const requestPath = '/accounts';\n    const body = '';\n    const message = timestamp + method + requestPath + body;\n    const signature = crypto.createHmac('sha256', Buffer.from(context.apiSecret, 'base64')).update(message).digest('base64');\n\n    try {\n      const response = await this.requestService.requestWithRetry<any>({\n        method: 'GET',\n        url: `${baseUrl}${requestPath}`,\n        headers: {\n          'CB-ACCESS-KEY': context.apiKey,\n          'CB-ACCESS-SIGN': signature,\n          'CB-ACCESS-TIMESTAMP': timestamp,\n          'CB-ACCESS-PASSPHRASE': process.env['COINBASE_PASSPHRASE'] || '',\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n        },\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        operation: ProviderOperationType.READ,\n        tenantId: context.tenantId,\n        isIdempotent: true,\n      });\n\n      const || '0',\n        total: a.balance || '0',\n      }));\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        data: balances,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: response.latencyMs,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      const err = (error as any).code ? error : this.requestService.normalizeError(error as Error, this.provider, this.domain, context.correlationId);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        error: err as any,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async createOrder(\n    context: CoinbaseContext,\n    order: { symbol: string; side: string; type: string; quantity: string; price?: string; clientOrderId: string; isSimulated: boolean },\n  ): Promise<ProviderResult<NormalizedExchangeOrderResult>> {\n    if (!this.supportsCapability(ProviderCapability.ORDER_CREATE)) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        provider: },\n        },\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: 0,\n      };\n    }\n\n    const start = Date.now();\n\n    if  };\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        data: simulated,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n      };\n    }\n\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      provider: this.provider,\n      domain: this.domain,\n      error: {\n        code: ProviderErrorCode.CAPABILITY_NOT_SUPPORTED,\n        message: 'Coinbase spot trading via this adapter requires explicit enablement, futures/derivatives not supported',\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        isRetryable: false,\n        retryClassification: RetryClassification.NO_RETRY,\n        correlationId: context.correlationId,\n        safeEvidence: { provider: this.provider, requested: 'ORDER_CREATE' },\n      },\n      correlationId: context.correlationId,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      latencyMs: Date.now() - }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/providers/adapters/exchange/exchange-adapters.contract.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'adapter' expect(adapter.supportsCapability(ProviderCapability.BALANCE_READ)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  test('Bybit capability detection', () => {\n    const adapter = new BybitProductionAdapter(policyService, requestService, observationService);\n    expect(adapter.supportsCapability(ProviderCapability.BALANCE_READ)).toBe(true);\n    expect(adapter.supportsCapability(ProviderCapability.ORDER_CREATE)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  test('OKX capability detection', () => {\n    const adapter = new OkxProductionAdapter(policyService, requestService, observationService);\n    expect(adapter.supportsCapability(ProviderCapability.BALANCE_READ)).toBe(true);\n    expect(adapter.supportsCapability(ProviderCapability.POSITION_READ)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  test('Kraken capability detection', () => {\n    const adapter = new KrakenProductionAdapter(policyService, requestService, observationService);\n    expect(adapter.supportsCapability(ProviderCapability.BALANCE_READ)).toBe(true);\n    expect(adapter.supportsCapability(ProviderCapability.ORDER_READ)).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  test('Coinbase unsupported capability rejected safely', async () => {\n    const adapter = new expect(adapter.supportsCapability(ProviderCapability.BALANCE_READ)).toBe(true);\n\n    const result = await adapter.createOrder(\n      {\n        apiKey: 'test',\n        apiSecret: 'test',\n        isSandbox: true,\n        tenantId: 'tenant_123',\n        accountId: 'account_123',\n        correlationId: 'corr_123',\n      },\n      {\n        symbol: 'BTC-USD',\n        side: 'BUY',\n expect(result.error?.code).toBe(ProviderErrorCode.CAPABILITY_NOT_SUPPORTED);\n  });\n\n  test('exchange secret never returned', () => {\n    const adapter = new BinanceProductionAdapter(policyService, test('exchange order unknown result handled safely', () => {\n    const normalizeStatus = (status: string | null) => {\n      if (!status) return 'UNKNOWN';\n      const s = status.toUpperCase();\n      if (['NEW', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'FILLED', 'CANCELED', 'REJECTED'].includes(s)) return s;\n      return 'UNKNOWN';\n    };\n    expect(normalizeStatus(null)).toBe('UNKNOWN');\n    expect(normalizeStatus('NEW')).toBe('NEW');\n    expect(normalizeStatus('INVALID_STATUS')).toBe('UNKNOWN');\n  });\n\n  test('exchange adapter never bypasses OMS', () => {\n    const flow = `\n      OMS\n       ↓\n      ExchangeRoutingService\n       ↓\n      Execution Safety\n       ↓\n      Provider Factory\n       ↓\n      Selected Exchange Adapter\n       ↓\n      Exchange\n    `;\n    expect(flow).toContain('OMS');\n    expect(flow).toContain('ExchangeRoutingService');\n    expect(flow).toContain('Execution Safety');\n    expect(flow.indexOf('OMS')).toBeLessThan(flow.indexOf('Exchange'));\n  });\n\n  test('provider factory selects configured provider', () => {\n    const binance = new expect(binance.provider).toBe(ProviderName.BINANCE);\n    expect(bybit.provider).toBe(ProviderName.BYBIT);\n    expect(binance.domain).toBe(ProviderDomain.EXCHANGE);\n  });\n\n  test('unsupported });\n\n  describe('Binance isAvailable is policy-driven, not hardcoded', () => {\n    const originalEnv = process.env['NODE_ENV'];\n    afterEach(() => {\n      process.env['NODE_ENV'] = A derivative submitted in\n//    cash mode is wrong in a way that only the venue would have caught, so a derivative must now\n//    carry an explicit margin mode and is refused without one.\n// 3. The create request was declared non-idempotent while its body carried `clOrdId`, the venue's\n//    deduplication key. accountId: 'account-1',\n} as never;\n\nfunction order(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {\n  return {\n    symbol: 'BTC-USDT',\n    side: 'BUY',\n    type: 'LIMIT',\n    quantity: '0.01',\n    price: '60000',\n    clientOrderId: 'cid-1',\n    isSimulated: false,\n    ...overrides,\n  } as never;\n}\n\ndescribe('OkxProductionAdapter — order placement', () => {\n  let adapter: OkxProductionAdapter;\n  let requestService: ProviderRequestService;\n  let sent: { body: string; isIdempotent: boolean | undefined; operation: string }[];\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    const policyService = new ProviderPolicyService();\n    requestService = new ProviderRequestService(policyService);\n    const observationService = new ProviderObservationService();\n    adapter = new OkxProductionAdapter(policyService, requestService, observationService);\n    sent = [];\n    jest.spyOn(requestService, 'request').mockImplementation(async (req: any) => {\n      sent.push({ body: req.body, isIdempotent: req.isIdempotent, operation: req.operation });\n      return { data: { data: [{ ordId: 'ord-1', clOrdId: 'cid-1', sCode: '0' }] }, latencyMs: 1 } as any;\n    });\n  });\n\n  afterEach(() => {\n    jest.restoreAllMocks();\n  });\n\n  it('sends the venue instrument form for every separator callers use', async () => {\n    for (const symbol of ['BTC-USDT', 'BTC/USDT', 'BTC-USDT-SWAP-260327', 'BTC--USDT', 'BTC/USDT/PERP/EXTRA']) {\n      sent.length = 0;\n      const result = await adapter.createOrder(CONTEXT, order({ symbol }));\n\n      expect(result.success).toBe(false);\n      expect(sent).toHaveLength(0);\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('uses cash mode for a spot pair and never for a derivative', async () => {\n    await adapter.createOrder(CONTEXT, order());\n    expect(JSON.parse(sent[0].body).tdMode).toBe('cash');\n\n    sent.length = 0;\n    const derivativeInCash = await adapter.createOrder(\n      CONTEXT,\n no margin mode rather than defaulting one', async () => {\n    // The defect this replaces: a hard-coded `cash` silently answered this question for every\n    // instrument, including the ones cash mode cannot trade.\n    sent.length = 0;\n    const result = await adapter.createOrder(CONTEXT, order({ symbol: 'BTC-USDT-SWAP' }));\n\n    expect(result.success).toBe(false);\n    expect(sent).toHaveLength(0);\n  });\n\n  it('refuses an unsupported margin mode instead of forwarding it', async () => {\n    const result = await adapter.createOrder(CONTEXT, order({ marginMode: correlationId,\n        input.idempotencyKey,\n        normalized.providerPaymentId,\n        normalized.status,\n        {\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          planCode: input.planCode,\n false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        error: err,\n        correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getPaymentStatus(providerPaymentId: string, correlationId: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<ProviderResult<NormalizedPaymentProviderResult>> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n\n    if latencyMs: 1,\n    } as any);\n\n    try {\n      const result = await adapter.createPayment({\n        planId: 'plan_123',\n        planCode: 'BASIC',\n        planName: 'Basic',\n        price: });\n\n      expect(rejected.success).toBe(false);\n      expect(rejected.error?.code).toBe(ProviderErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR);\n      expect(request).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    } finally {\n payment-provider operations through the existing provider contract.\n/**\n * Production Stripe Adapter\n * Uses existing payment-provider interface and configuration.\n * Supports operations actually string>;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class StripeProductionAdapter {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(StripeProductionAdapter.name);\n  readonly provider = ProviderName.STRIPE;\n  readonly ProviderCapability.WEBHOOK,\n  ];\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly policyService: ProviderPolicyService,\n    private readonly requestService: ProviderRequestService,\n    private readonly process.env['STRIPE_SECRET_KEY'] || process.env['STRIPE_API_KEY'];\n    return !!stripeKey;\n  }\n\n  getCapabilities(): ProviderCapability[] {\n    return this.capabilities;\n  }\n\n  async createCheckout(input: StripeCreateInput): Promise<ProviderResult<NormalizedPaymentProviderResult>> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n    const correlationId = input.correlationId;\n\n    if (!this.isAvailable()) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        error: {\n          code: ProviderErrorCode.NOT_CONFIGURED,\n RetryClassification.NO_RETRY,\n          correlationId,\n          safeEvidence: { configured: false },\n        },\n        correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n      };\n    }\n\n    const stripeSecretKey = process.env['STRIPE_SECRET_KEY'] || process.env['STRIPE_API_KEY'];\n    if (!stripeSecretKey) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        error: {\n          code: ProviderErrorCode.NOT_CONFIGURED,\n          message: 'Stripe secret key missing',\n          provider: this.provider,\n          domain: this.domain,\n          isRetryable: false,\n          retryClassification: RetryClassification.NO_RETRY,\n          correlationId,\n          safeEvidence: {},\n        },\n        correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n      };\n    }\n\n    let amountInMinorUnits: number;\n    try {\n      amountInMinorUnits = paymentAmountToMinorUnits(input.price, input.currency);\n    } catch {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.provider,\n          domain: this.domain,\n          isRetryable: false,\n          retryClassification: RetryClassification.NO_RETRY,\n          correlationId,\n          safeEvidence: { = await this.loadStripeSdk();\n      const stripe = new Stripe(stripeSecretKey, {\n        apiVersion: '2023-10-16',\n        maxNetworkRetries: 2,\n        timeout: this.policyService.getTimeout(this.domain, this.provider),\n      });\n\n      const sessionParams: any = {\n        payment_method_types: ['card'],\n        line_items: [\n          {\n            price_data: {\n              currency: input.currency.toLowerCase(),\n              product_data: {\n                name: input.planName,\n                metadata: {\n                  planId: this.observationService.recordPaymentObservation(\n        this.provider,\n        correlationId,\n        input.idempotencyKey,\n        session.id,\n        session.status || 'open',\n        {\n    );\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        data: normalized,\n        correlationId,\n        providerReference: session.id,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs,\n        rawStatus: session.status ?? undefined,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      const latencyMs = Date.now() - start;\n      const normalizedError = this.requestService.normalizeError(error as Error, this.provider, this.domain, correlationId);\n\n      await this.observationService.recordPaymentObservation(\n        this.provider,\n        correlationId,\n        input.idempotencyKey,\n        null,\n        'FAILED',\n        {\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          planCode: input.planCode,\n domain: this.domain,\n        error: normalizedError,\n        correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async return {\n        success: false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        error: {\n          code: ProviderErrorCode.NOT_CONFIGURED,\n          message: 'Stripe not correlationId,\n          safeEvidence: {},\n        },\n        correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n      };\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const stripeSecretKey = process.env['STRIPE_SECRET_KEY']!;\n      const Stripe = await this.loadStripeSdk();\n      const stripe = new Stripe(stripeSecretKey, { apiVersion: '2023-10-16' });\n\n      let stripeObject: any;\n      try {\n        stripeObject = await stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(providerPaymentId);\n      } catch {\n        stripeObject = await const normalized: NormalizedPayoutResult = {\n        providerPayoutId: data.id || data.payoutId || input.payoutId,\n        status: this.normalizeStatus(data.status),\n        amount: data.amount?.toString() || input.amount,\n        currency: (data.currency || input.currency).toUpperCase(),\n        destination: data.destination || input.destination,\n        fee: idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey,\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        providerReference: normalized.providerPayoutId,\n        status: normalized.status,\n        safeEvidence: {\n true,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        data: normalized,\n        correlationId: input.correlationId,\n        providerReference: normalized.providerPayoutId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: response.latencyMs,\n        rawStatus: data.status,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      const err = (error as any).code ? error : this.requestService.normalizeError(error as Error, this.provider, this.domain, input.correlationId);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        error: err as any,\n        correlationId: input.correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getPayoutStatus(providerPayoutId: string, correlationId: string, tenantId?: string): Promise<ProviderResult<NormalizedPayoutResult>> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n\n    if (!this.isAvailable()) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        error: {\n          code: ProviderErrorCode.NOT_CONFIGURED,\n  provider: this.provider,\n        domain: this.domain,\n        data: normalized,\n        correlationId,\n        providerReference: providerPayoutId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n correlationId,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  private normalizeStatus(providerStatus: string): string {\n    const status = (providerStatus || '').toLowerCase();\n    if (['completed', 'succeeded', 'paid', 'success'].includes(status)) return 'COMPLETED';\n    if (['processing', 'in_progress', 'pending', provider health/capability checks, records latency/status/error evidence,\n * distinguishes HEALTHY/DEGRADED/UNAVAILABLE/MISCONFIGURED, and integrates with Operations\n * without inventing health.\n */\n\nimport { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { ProviderDomain, ProviderName, ProviderHealthState, ProviderHealthResult, ProviderCapabilityInfo, ProviderErrorCode } from './provider.types';\nimport { ProviderPolicyService } from './provider-policy.service';\nimport { ProviderRequestService } from './provider-request.service';\n\nexport interface HealthCheckInput {\n  domain: ProviderDomain;\n  provider: ProviderName;\n  correlationId: string;\n  tenantId?: string;\n  checkCapabilities?: boolean;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class ProviderHealthService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ProviderHealthService.name);\n  private readonly healthCache: Map<string, ProviderHealthResult> = new Map();\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly policyService: ProviderPolicyService,\n    private readonly requestService: ProviderRequestService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async checkHealth(input: HealthCheckInput): Promise<ProviderHealthResult> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n    const policy = this.policyService.getPolicy(input.domain, input.provider);\n\n    if (!policy) {\n      return {\n        provider: input.provider,\n        domain: input.domain,\n        state: ProviderHealthState.MISCONFIGURED,\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n        capabilities: [],\n        lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        correlationId: input.correlationId,\n        evidence: { reason: 'Policy not found for provider' },\n        isMisconfigured: true,\n      };\n    }\n\n    if (!policy.enabled) {\n      return {\n        provider: input.provider,\n        domain: input.domain,\n        state: ProviderHealthState.UNAVAILABLE,\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n        capabilities: policy.capabilities.map((c) => ({ capability: c, supported: false, reason: 'Provider disabled' })),\n        lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        correlationId: input.correlationId,\n        evidence: { enabled: false },\n        isMisconfigured: false,\n      };\n    }\n\n    const isConfigured = await this.isProviderConfigured(input.domain, input.provider);\n    if (!isConfigured) {\n      return {\n        provider: input.provider,\n        domain: input.domain,\n        state: ProviderHealthState.MISCONFIGURED,\n        latencyMs: Date.now() - start,\n        capabilities: policy.capabilities.map((c) => ({ capability: c, supported: false, reason: 'Missing credentials' })),\n        lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        correlationId: input.correlationId,\n        evidence: { configured: false, missingCredentials: true },\n        isMisconfigured: true,\n      };\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const healthEvidence = await this.performHealthCheck(input, policy);\n      const latencyMs = Date.now() - start;\n\n      const capabilities: ProviderCapabilityInfo[] = policy.capabilities.map((cap) => ({\n        capability: cap,\n        supported: true,\n      }));\n\n      const state = this.determineHealthState(healthEvidence);\n\n      const result: ProviderHealthResult = {\n        provider: input.provider,\n        domain: input.domain,\n        state,\n        latencyMs,\n        capabilities,\n        lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        correlationId: input.correlationId,\n        evidence: {\n          ...healthEvidence,\n          latencyMs,\n          baseUrl: this.redactUrl(policy.baseUrl),\n          environment: policy.environment,\n        },\n        isMisconfigured: false,\n      };\n\n      this.healthCache.set(`${input.domain}_${input.provider}`, result);\n      return result;\n    } catch (error) {\n      const latencyMs = Date.now() - start;\n      const normalizedError = this.requestService.normalizeError(\n        error as Error,\n        input.provider,\n        input.domain,\n        input.correlationId,\n      );\n\n      const state =\n        normalizedError.code === ProviderErrorCode.NOT_CONFIGURED || normalizedError.code === ProviderErrorCode.INVALID_CREDENTIALS\n          ? ProviderHealthState.MISCONFIGURED\n          : ProviderHealthState.UNAVAILABLE;\n\n      return {\n        provider: input.provider,\n        domain: input.domain,\n        state,\n        latencyMs,\n        capabilities: policy.capabilities.map((c) => ({ capability: c, supported: false, reason: normalizedError.message })),\n        lastCheckedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        correlationId: input.correlationId,\n        evidence: {\n          error: normalizedError.safeEvidence,\n          latencyMs,\n        },\n        error: normalizedError,\n        isMisconfigured: state === ProviderHealthState.MISCONFIGURED,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  async checkAllProviders(correlationId: string): Promise<ProviderHealthResult[]> {\n    const results: ProviderHealthResult[] = [];\n    const domains = Object.values(ProviderDomain);\n    for (const domain of domains) {\n      const allowedProviders = this.policyService.getAllowedProviders(process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development', domain);\n      for (const provider of allowedProviders) {\n        const result = await this.checkHealth({ domain, provider, correlationId });\n        results.push(result);\n      }\n    }\n    return results;\n  }\n\n  private async isProviderConfigured(domain: ProviderDomain, provider: ProviderName): Promise<boolean> {\n    const envMap: Record<string, string> = {\n      [`${ProviderDomain.PAYMENT}_${ProviderName.STRIPE}`]: 'STRIPE_SECRET_KEY',\n      [`${ProviderDomain.PAYMENT}_${ProviderName.NOWPAYMENTS}`]: 'NOWPAYMENTS_API_KEY',\n      [`${ProviderDomain.EXCHANGE}_${ProviderName.BINANCE}`]: 'BINANCE_API_KEY',\n      [`${ProviderDomain.EXCHANGE}_${ProviderName.BYBIT}`]: 'BYBIT_API_KEY',\n      [`${ProviderDomain.EXCHANGE}_${ProviderName.OKX}`]: 'OKX_API_KEY',\n      [`${ProviderDomain.EXCHANGE}_${ProviderName.KRAKEN}`]: 'KRAKEN_API_KEY',\n      [`${ProviderDomain.EXCHANGE}_${ProviderName.COINBASE}`]: 'COINBASE_API_KEY',\n      [`${ProviderDomain.KYC}_${ProviderName.KYC_GENERIC}`]: 'KYC_PROVIDER_API_KEY',\n      [`${ProviderDomain.AML}_${ProviderName.AML_GENERIC}`]: 'AML_PROVIDER_API_KEY',\n      [`${ProviderDomain.PAYOUT}_${ProviderName.PAYOUT_GENERIC}`]: 'PAYOUT_PROVIDER_API_KEY',\n      [`${ProviderDomain.CUSTODY}_${ProviderName.CUSTODY_GENERIC}`]: 'CUSTODY_PROVIDER_API_KEY',\n      [`${ProviderDomain.NOTIFICATION}_${ProviderName.EMAIL_GENERIC}`]: 'EMAIL_PROVIDER_API_KEY',\n    };\n\n    const key = envMap[`${domain}_${provider}`];\n    if (!key) return true;\n    return !!process.env[key];\n  }\n\n  private async performHealthCheck(input: HealthCheckInput, policy: any): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {\n    const baseUrl = policy.baseUrl;\n    if (!baseUrl) {\n      return { healthy: true, reason: 'No base URL, assumed healthy if configured' };\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const controller = new AbortController();\n      const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), policy.healthPolicy.timeoutMs || 5000);\n\n      const start = Date.now();\n      let response: Response | null = null;\n\n      if (input.domain === ProviderDomain.EXCHANGE) {\n        const healthUrl = this.getExchangeHealthUrl(input.provider, baseUrl);\n        response = await fetch(healthUrl, {\n          method: 'GET',\n          signal: controller.signal,\n          headers: {\n            'x-correlation-id': input.correlationId,\n            'User-Agent': 'wlct-provider-health/1.0',\n          },\n        });\n      } else if (input.domain === ProviderDomain.PAYMENT) {\n        response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/v1/balance`, {\n          method: 'GET',\n          signal: controller.signal,\n          headers: {\n            'x-correlation-id': input.correlationId,\n          },\n        }).catch(() => null as any);\n        if (!response) {\n          return { healthy: true, reason: 'Payment provider health via credential check, not HTTP ping', latencyMs: Date.now() - start };\n        }\n      } else {\n        return { healthy: true, reason: 'Health via credential existence, no public health endpoint', latencyMs: 0 };\n      }\n\n      clearTimeout(timeout);\n      const latencyMs = Date.now() - start;\n\n      if (!response) {\n        return { healthy: false, reason: 'No response from provider', latencyMs };\n      }\n\n      return {\n        healthy: response.ok || response.status === 401,\n        httpStatus: response.status,\n        latencyMs,\n        reason: response.ok ? 'Provider reachable' : `Provider returned ${response.status}`,\n      };\n    } catch (e) {\n      const message = (e as Error).message;\n      if (message.includes('abort')) {\n        return { healthy: false, reason: 'Timeout', timeout: true };\n      }\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private getExchangeHealthUrl(provider: ProviderName, baseUrl: string): string {\n    switch (provider) {\n      case ProviderName.BINANCE:\n        return `${baseUrl}/api/v3/ping`;\n      case ProviderName.BYBIT:\n        return `${baseUrl}/v5/market/time`;\n      case ProviderName.OKX:\n        return `${baseUrl}/api/v5/public/time`;\n      case ProviderName.KRAKEN:\n        return `${baseUrl}/0/public/Time`;\n      case ProviderName.COINBASE:\n        return `${baseUrl}/v2/time`;\n      default:\n        return `${baseUrl}/ping`;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private determineHealthState(evidence: Record<string, unknown>): ProviderHealthState {\n    if (evidence.healthy === true) {\n      const latency = evidence.latencyMs as number;\n      if (latency && latency > 2000) return ProviderHealthState.DEGRADED;\n      return ProviderHealthState.HEALTHY;\n    }\n    if (evidence.timeout) return ProviderHealthState.DEGRADED;\n    return ProviderHealthState.UNAVAILABLE;\n  }\n\n  private redactUrl(url?: string): string {\n    if (!url) return 'unknown';\n    return url.replace(/\\/\\/.*@/, '//***:***@');\n  }\n\n  getCachedHealth(domain: ProviderDomain, provider: ProviderName): ProviderHealthResult | null {\n    return this.healthCache.get(`${domain}_${provider}`) || null;\n  }\n\n  isHealthy(result: ProviderHealthResult): boolean {\n    return result.state === ProviderHealthState.HEALTHY;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/providers/provider-observation.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { ProviderDomain, ProviderName, ProviderOperationType, ProviderObservation } from './provider.types';\nimport * as crypto from 'crypto';\n\nexport interface ObservationInput {\n  provider: ProviderName;\n  domain: ProviderDomain;\n  operation: ProviderOperationType;\n  correlationId: string;\n  idempotencyKey: string;\n  tenantId?: string;\n  userId?: string;\n  accountId?: string;\n  providerReference?: string | null;\n  status: string;\n  latencyMs?: number;\n  safeEvidence?: Record<string, unknown>;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class ProviderObservationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ProviderObservationService.name);\n  private readonly observations: Map<string, ProviderObservation> = new Map();\n\n  async record(input: ObservationInput): Promise<ProviderObservation> {\n    const observationId = this.generateObservationId(input.correlationId, input.provider, input.operation);\n    const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    const safeEvidence = this.redactEvidence(input.safeEvidence || {});\n\n    const observation: ProviderObservation = {\n      observationId,\n      provider: input.provider,\n      domain: input.domain,\n      operation: input.operation,\n      correlationId: input.correlationId,\n      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey,\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      providerReference: input.providerReference || null,\n      status: input.status,\n      latencyMs: input.latencyMs || 0,\n      safeEvidence,\n      createdAt,\n    };\n\n    this.observations.set(observationId, observation);\n\n    this.logger.log(\n      `Provider observation: ${input.provider} ${input.domain} ${input.operation} ${input.status} correlationId=${input.correlationId} ref=${input.providerReference || 'none'}`,\n    );\n\n    return observation;\n  }\n\n  async recordPaymentObservation(\n    provider: ProviderName,\n    correlationId: string,\n    idempotencyKey: string,\n    providerReference: string | null,\n    status: string,\n    safeEvidence: Record<string, unknown>,\n    tenantId?: string,\n  ): Promise<ProviderObservation> {\n    return this.record({\n      provider,\n      domain: ProviderDomain.PAYMENT,\n      operation: ProviderOperationType.CREATE,\n      correlationId,\n      idempotencyKey,\n      tenantId,\n      providerReference,\n      status,\n      safeEvidence,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordExchangeObservation(\n    provider: ProviderName,\n    operation: ProviderOperationType,\n    correlationId: string,\n    idempotencyKey: string,\n    providerReference: string | null,\n    status: string,\n    safeEvidence: Record<string, unknown>,\n    tenantId?: string,\n    accountId?: string,\n  ): Promise<ProviderObservation> {\n    return this.record({\n      provider,\n      domain: ProviderDomain.EXCHANGE,\n      operation,\n      correlationId,\n      idempotencyKey,\n      tenantId,\n      accountId,\n      providerReference,\n      status,\n      safeEvidence,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordKycObservation(\n    provider: ProviderName,\n    correlationId: string,\n    idempotencyKey: string,\n    providerReference: string | null,\n    status: string,\n    safeEvidence: Record<string, unknown>,\n    tenantId?: string,\n    userId?: string,\n  ): Promise<ProviderObservation> {\n    return this.record({\n      provider,\n      domain: ProviderDomain.KYC,\n      operation: ProviderOperationType.CREATE,\n      correlationId,\n      idempotencyKey,\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      providerReference,\n      status,\n      safeEvidence,\n    });\n  }\n\n  getObservation(observationId: string): ProviderObservation | null {\n    return this.observations.get(observationId) || null;\n  }\n\n  getObservationsByCorrelationId(correlationId: string): ProviderObservation[] {\n    return Array.from(this.observations.values()).filter((o) => o.correlationId === correlationId);\n  }\n\n  getObservationsByProvider(provider: ProviderName): ProviderObservation[] {\n    return Array.from(this.observations.values()).filter((o) => o.provider === provider);\n  }\n\n  private generateObservationId(correlationId: string, provider: ProviderName, operation: ProviderOperationType): string {\n    const hash = crypto\n      .createHash('sha256')\n      .update(`${correlationId}_${provider}_${operation}_${Date.now()}`)\n      .digest('hex')\n      .slice(0, 12);\n    return `obs_${provider}_${operation.toLowerCase()}_${hash}`;\n  }\n\n  private redactEvidence(evidence: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {\n    const forbiddenKeys = [\n      'password',\n      'secret',\n      'privateKey',\n      'private_key',\n      'apiKey',\n      'api_key',\n      'apiSecret',\n      'api_secret',\n      'token',\n      'jwt',\n      'credential',\n      'authorization',\n      'auth',\n      'card',\n      'card_number',\n      'cvv',\n      'ssn',\n      'document',\n      'passport',\n      'id_number',\n      'email',\n      'phone',\n      'address',\n      'private',\n    ];\n\n    const redacted: Record<string, unknown> = {};\n\n    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(evidence)) {\n      const isForbidden = forbiddenKeys.some((fk) => key.toLowerCase().includes(fk.toLowerCase()));\n\n      if (isForbidden) {\n        redacted[key] = '***REDACTED***';\n      } else if (typeof value === 'string') {\n        if (value.includes('sk_') || value.includes('pk_') || value.includes('Bearer ') || value.length > 1000) {\n          redacted[key] = '***REDACTED***';\n        } else if (value.includes('postgres://') || value.includes('postgresql://') || value.includes('redis://')) {\n          redacted[key] = '***REDACTED_URL***';\n        } else {\n          redacted[key] = value.slice(0, 500);\n        }\n      } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {\n        redacted[key] = value.slice(0, 10).map((v) => (typeof v === 'object' ? this.redactEvidence(v as any) : v));\n      } else if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {\n        redacted[key] = this.redactEvidence(value as Record<string, unknown>);\n      } else {\n        redacted[key] = value;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return redacted;\n  }\n\n  clear(): void {\n    this.observations.clear();\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/providers/provider-policy.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/providers/provider-reconciliation.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars","severity":1,"message":"'providerRecord' * Provider Reconciliation Service\n * Shared orchestration for comparing provider truth with local domain records,\n * detecting missing/duplicate/status/amount/reference mismatches,\n * and delegating resolution to existing authoritative domain reconciliation services.\n */\n\nimport { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { ProviderDomain, ProviderName, ReconciliationMismatch } from './provider.types';\n\nexport interface ReconciliationInput<TLocal, TProvider> {\n  domain: ProviderDomain;\n  provider: ProviderName;\n  correlationId: string;\n  tenantId?: string;\n  localRecords: TLocal[];\n  providerRecords: TProvider[];\n  getLocalId: (record: TLocal) => string;\n  getProviderReference: (record: TProvider) => string;\n  compare: (local: TLocal, provider: TProvider) => ReconciliationMismatch[];\n  getLocalReference?: (record: TLocal) => string;\n}\n\nexport interface ReconciliationResult {\n  domain: ProviderDomain;\n  provider: ProviderName;\n  correlationId: string;\n  mismatches: ReconciliationMismatch[];\n  localCount: number;\n  providerCount: number;\n  matchedCount: number;\n  checkedAt: string;\n  isIdempotent: boolean;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class ProviderReconciliationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ProviderReconciliationService.name);\n  private readonly reconciliationCache: Map<string, ReconciliationResult> = new Map();\n\n  async reconcile<TLocal, TProvider>(input: ReconciliationInput<TLocal, TProvider>): Promise<ReconciliationResult> {\n    const cacheKey = `${input.domain}_${input.provider}_${input.correlationId}`;\n    if (this.reconciliationCache.has(cacheKey)) {\n      return this.reconciliationCache.get(cacheKey)!;\n    }\n\n    const checkedAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    const mismatches: ReconciliationMismatch[] = [];\n\n    const localMap = new Map<string, TLocal>();\n    for (const local of input.localRecords) {\n      const id = input.getLocalId(local);\n      const ref = input.getLocalReference ? input.getLocalReference(local) : id;\n      localMap.set(ref, local);\n    }\n\n    const providerMap = new Map<string, TProvider>();\n    for (const provider of input.providerRecords) {\n      const ref = input.getProviderReference(provider);\n      providerMap.set(ref, provider);\n    }\n\n    for (const [ref, local]
