mismatches,\n      localCount: input.localRecords.length,\n      providerCount: input.providerRecords.length,\n      matchedCount,\n      checkedAt,\n      isIdempotent: true,\n    };\n\n    this.reconciliationCache.set(cacheKey, result);\n\n    this.logger.log(\n      `Reconciliation ${input.domain} ${input.provider} correlationId=${input.correlationId} local=${input.localRecords.length} provider=${input.providerRecords.length} mismatches=${mismatches.length}`,\n    );\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  detectStatusMismatch(localStatus: string, providerStatus: string, correlationId: };\n  }\n\n  detectAmountMismatch(localAmount: string, providerAmount: string, correlationId: string): ReconciliationMismatch | null {\n    if (localAmount === providerAmount) return null;\n    const */\n\nimport { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { ProviderDomain, ProviderName, ProviderErrorCode, RetryClassification, NormalizedProviderError, ProviderOperationType } from './provider.types';\nimport { ProviderPolicyService } from './provider-policy.service';\n\nexport interface OutboundRequestOptions {\n  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE' | 'PATCH';\n  url: string;\n  headers?: Record<string, string>;\n  body?: unknown;\n  timeoutMs?: number;\n  idempotencyKey?: string;\n  correlationId: string;\n  domain: ProviderDomain;\n  provider: ProviderName;\n  operation: ProviderOperationType;\n  tenantId?: string;\n  isIdempotent: boolean;\n  signRequest?: (options: OutboundRequestOptions) => Promise<Record<string, string>>;\n}\n\nexport interface OutboundResponse<T = unknown> {\n  status: number;\n  headers: Record<string, string>;\n  data: T;\n  latencyMs: number;\n  correlationId: string;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class ProviderRequestService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ProviderRequestService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly policyService: ProviderPolicyService) {}\n\n  async request<T>(options: OutboundRequestOptions): Promise<OutboundResponse<T>> {\n    const start = Date.now();\n    const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs || this.policyService.getTimeout(options.domain, options.provider);\n\n    const controller = new AbortController();\n    const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);\n\n    const safeHeaders = this.buildSafeHeaders(options);\n\n    try {\n      let finalHeaders = { ...safeHeaders };\n\n      if (options.signRequest) {\n        const signingHeaders = await options.signRequest(options);\n        finalHeaders = { ...finalHeaders, ...signingHeaders };\n      }\n\n      if (options.idempotencyKey) {\n        finalHeaders['Idempotency-Key'] = options.idempotencyKey;\n        finalHeaders['X-Idempotency-Key'] = options.idempotencyKey;\n      }\n\n      finalHeaders['X-Correlation-Id'] = options.correlationId;\n      finalHeaders['X-Request-Id'] = options.correlationId;\n\n      const fetchOptions: RequestInit = {\n        method: options.method,\n        headers: finalHeaders as any,\n        signal: controller.signal,\n      };\n\n      if (options.body && options.method !== 'GET') {\n        fetchOptions.body = typeof options.body === 'string' ? options.body : JSON.stringify(options.body);\n        if (!finalHeaders['Content-Type']) {\n          (fetchOptions.headers as any)['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';\n        }\n      }\n\n      this.logSafeRequest(options);\n\n      const response = await fetch(options.url, fetchOptions);\n      clearTimeout(timeout);\n\n      const latencyMs = Date.now() - start;\n      const responseHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};\n      response.headers.forEach((value, key) => {\n        responseHeaders[key] = value;\n      });\n\n      let data: T;\n      const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';\n      if (contentType.includes('application/json')) {\n        data = (await response.json()) as T;\n      } else {\n        data = (await response.text()) as unknown as T;\n      }\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw this.createErrorFromResponse(response.status, data, options, latencyMs);\n      }\n\n      this.logSafeResponse(options, response.status, latencyMs);\n\n      return {\n        status: response.status,\n        headers: responseHeaders,\n        data,\n        latencyMs,\n        correlationId: options.correlationId,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      clearTimeout(timeout);\n      const latencyMs = Date.now() - start;\n\n      if ((error as any).name === 'AbortError' || (error as Error).message.includes('abort')) {\n        const timeoutError: NormalizedProviderError = {\n          code: ProviderErrorCode.TIMEOUT,\n          message: `Provider ${options.provider} request timeout after ${timeoutMs}ms`,\n          provider: options.provider,\n          domain: options.domain,\n          isRetryable: false,\n          retryClassification: RetryClassification.TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN_RESULT,\n          httpStatus: 0,\n          correlationId: options.correlationId,\n          safeEvidence: {\n            timeoutMs,\n            latencyMs,\n            url: this.redactUrl(options.url),\n            method: options.method,\n            operation: options.operation,\n          },\n        };\n        this.logger.warn(`Provider timeout: ${options.provider} ${options.operation} ${timeoutError.message} correlationId=${options.correlationId}`);\n        throw timeoutError;\n      }\n\n      if ((error as any).code && Object.values(ProviderErrorCode).includes((error as any).code)) {\n        throw error;\n      }\n\n      const normalized = this.normalizeError(error as Error, options.provider, options.domain, options.correlationId);\n      normalized.safeEvidence = {\n        ...normalized.safeEvidence,\n        latencyMs,\n        url: this.redactUrl(options.url),\n        method: options.method,\n      };\n\n      this.logger.warn(`Provider request failed: ${options.provider} ${options.operation} ${normalized.message} correlationId=${options.correlationId}`);\n      throw normalized;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async requestWithRetry<T>(options: OutboundRequestOptions): Promise<OutboundResponse<T>> {\n    const retryPolicy = this.policyService.getRetryPolicy(options.domain, options.provider);\n    let lastError: NormalizedProviderError | null = null;\n\n    for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= retryPolicy.maxRetries; attempt++) {\n      try {\n        return await this.request<T>(options);\n      } catch (error) {\n        const normalized = error as NormalizedProviderError;\n        lastError = normalized;\n\n        const classification = this.classifyRetry(normalized, options);\n\n        if (classification === RetryClassification.NO_RETRY || classification === RetryClassification.UNSAFE_RETRY) {\n          throw normalized;\n        }\n\n        if (classification === RetryClassification.AUTH_FAILURE) {\n          throw normalized;\n        }\n\n        if (attempt >= retryPolicy.maxRetries) {\n          throw normalized;\n        }\n\n        if (classification === RetryClassification.RATE_LIMIT_RETRY) {\n          const retryAfter = normalized.retryAfterMs || retryPolicy.initialDelayMs;\n          await this.sleep(retryAfter);\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        if (classification === RetryClassification.SAFE_RETRY || classification === RetryClassification.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE) {\n          const delay = Math.min(\n            retryPolicy.initialDelayMs * Math.pow(retryPolicy.backoffMultiplier, attempt),\n            retryPolicy.maxDelayMs,\n          );\n          await this.sleep(delay);\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        throw normalized;\n      }\n    }\n\n    throw lastError;\n  }\n\n  classifyRetry(error: NormalizedProviderError, options: OutboundRequestOptions): RetryClassification {\n    if (error.code === ProviderErrorCode.RATE_LIMITED) return RetryClassification.RATE_LIMIT_RETRY;\n    if (error.code === ProviderErrorCode.AUTH_FAILED || error.code === ProviderErrorCode.INVALID_CREDENTIALS) {\n      return RetryClassification.AUTH_FAILURE;\n    }\n    if (error.code === ProviderErrorCode.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE) return RetryClassification.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE;\n    if (error.code === ProviderErrorCode.TIMEOUT) return RetryClassification.TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN_RESULT;\n\n    if (error.httpStatus && error.httpStatus >= 500) {\n      if (options.isIdempotent) return RetryClassification.SAFE_RETRY;\n      return RetryClassification.TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN_RESULT;\n    }\n\n    if (error.httpStatus === 429) return RetryClassification.NO_RETRY;\n  }\n\n  normalizeError(error: Error, provider: ProviderName, domain: ProviderDomain, correlationId: string): NormalizedProviderError {\n    const message = error.message || 'Unknown provider error';\n    let code = ProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN;\n    let httpStatus: number | undefined;\n    let retryClassification = RetryClassification.NO_RETRY;\n    let isRetryable = false;\n\n    if (message.toLowerCase().includes('timeout') || message.toLowerCase().includes('abort')) {\n      code = ProviderErrorCode.TIMEOUT;\n      retryClassification = RetryClassification.TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN_RESULT;\n      isRetryable = false;\n    } else if (message.toLowerCase().includes('network') || message.toLowerCase().includes('econnrefused') || message.toLowerCase().includes('enotfound')) {\n      code = ProviderErrorCode.NETWORK_ERROR;\n      retryClassification = RetryClassification.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE;\n      isRetryable = true;\n    } else if (message.toLowerCase().includes('rate limit') || message.toLowerCase().includes('429')) {\n      code = ProviderErrorCode.RATE_LIMITED;\n      retryClassification = RetryClassification.RATE_LIMIT_RETRY;\n      isRetryable = true;\n    } else if (message.toLowerCase().includes('auth') || message.toLowerCase().includes('unauthorized') || message.toLowerCase().includes('401')) {\n      code = ProviderErrorCode.AUTH_FAILED;\n      retryClassification = RetryClassification.AUTH_FAILURE;\n      isRetryable = false;\n    } else if (message.toLowerCase().includes('not configured') || message.toLowerCase().includes('missing credential')) {\n      code = ProviderErrorCode.NOT_CONFIGURED;\n      retryClassification = RetryClassification.NO_RETRY;\n      isRetryable = false;\n    }\n\n    return {\n      code,\n      message: message.slice(0, 500),\n      provider,\n      domain,\n      isRetryable,\n      retryClassification,\n      httpStatus,\n      correlationId,\n      safeEvidence: {\n        provider,\n        domain,\n        originalMessage: message.slice(0, 200),\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  private createErrorFromResponse(status: number, data: unknown, options: OutboundRequestOptions, latencyMs: number): NormalizedProviderError {\n    let code = ProviderErrorCode.UNKNOWN;\n    let retryClassification = RetryClassification.NO_RETRY;\n    let isRetryable = false;\n    let retryAfterMs: number | null = null;\n\n    if (status === 401 || status === 403) {\n      code = ProviderErrorCode.AUTH_FAILED;\n      retryClassification = RetryClassification.AUTH_FAILURE;\n    } else if (status === 429) {\n      code = ProviderErrorCode.RATE_LIMITED;\n      retryClassification = RetryClassification.RATE_LIMIT_RETRY;\n      isRetryable = true;\n      const dataAny = data as any;\n      retryAfterMs = dataAny?.retry_after ? dataAny.retry_after * 1000 : 1000;\n    } else if (status >= 500) {\n      code = ProviderErrorCode.SERVER_ERROR;\n      retryClassification = options.isIdempotent ? RetryClassification.SAFE_RETRY : RetryClassification.TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN_RESULT;\n      isRetryable = options.isIdempotent;\n    } else if (status === 404) {\n      code = ProviderErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR;\n      retryClassification = RetryClassification.NO_RETRY;\n    } else if (status >= 400) {\n      code = ProviderErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR;\n      retryClassification = RetryClassification.NO_RETRY;\n    }\n\n    const message = `Provider ${options.provider} returned ${status}`;\n\n    return {\n      code,\n      message,\n      provider: options.provider,\n      domain: options.domain,\n      isRetryable,\n      retryClassification,\n      retryAfterMs,\n      httpStatus: status,\n      correlationId: options.correlationId,\n      safeEvidence: {\n        httpStatus: status,\n        latencyMs,\n        url: this.redactUrl(options.url),\n        method: options.method,\n        operation: options.operation,\n        providerData: this.sanitizeProviderData(data),\n      },\n    };\n  }\n\n  private buildSafeHeaders(options: OutboundRequestOptions): Record<string, string> {\n    const headers: Record<string, string> = {\n      'User-Agent': 'wlct-provider-adapter/1.0',\n      'Accept': 'application/json',\n      ...(options.headers || {}),\n    };\n\n    const forbiddenHeaders = ['authorization', 'x-api-key', 'api-key', 'private-key', 'secret'];\n    for (const forbidden of forbiddenHeaders) {\n      if (headers[forbidden]) {\n        delete headers[forbidden];\n      }\n    }\n\n    return headers;\n  }\n\n  private logSafeRequest(options: OutboundRequestOptions): void {\n    this.logger.log(\n      `Provider request: ${options.provider} ${options.domain} ${options.operation} ${options.method} ${this.redactUrl(options.url)} correlationId=${options.correlationId} idempotent=${options.isIdempotent}`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  private logSafeResponse(options: OutboundRequestOptions, status: number, latencyMs: number): void {\n    this.logger.log(`Provider response: ${options.provider} ${status} ${latencyMs}ms correlationId=${options.correlationId}`);\n  }\n\n  private redactUrl(url: string): string {\n    if (!url) return 'unknown';\n    try {\n      const parsed = new URL(url);\n      return `${parsed.protocol}//${parsed.host}${parsed.pathname}`;\n    } catch {\n      return url.split('?')[0].slice(0, 100);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private sanitizeProviderData(data: unknown): unknown {\n    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') return null;\n    const dataAny = data as any;\n    const forbiddenKeys = ['api_key', 'apiKey', 'secret', 'private_key', 'privateKey', 'password', 'token', 'authorization', 'card', 'cvv', 'ssn', 'document', 'email', 'phone'];\n    const sanitized: Record<string, unknown> = {};\n    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(dataAny)) {\n      const isForbidden = forbiddenKeys.some((fk) => key.toLowerCase().includes(fk.toLowerCase()));\n      if (isForbidden) {\n        sanitized[key] = '***REDACTED***';\n      } else if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)) {\n        sanitized[key] = this.sanitizeProviderData(value);\n      } else if (typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 500) {\n        sanitized[key] = value.slice(0, 100) + '...TRUNCATED';\n      } else {\n        sanitized[key] = value;\n      }\n    }\n    return sanitized;\n  }\n\n  private sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {\n    return new Promise((resolve) => The controller carried no permission metadata and takes\n * tenantId from the query/body, so any tenant user could disable a provider,\n * replay webhooks or read another tenant's provider state. It is platform\n * infrastructure: platform-only; reads platform:manage or\n * platform:read_metrics, actions platform:manage (class default).\n */\n@PlatformOnly()\n@RequirePermissions(Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)\n@Controller('providers')\nexport class ProviderController {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly policyService: ProviderPolicyService,\n    private readonly healthService: ProviderHealthService,\n    private readonly reconciliationService: ProviderReconciliationService,\n    private readonly observationService: ProviderObservationService,\n    private readonly webhookService: ProviderWebhookService,\n  ) {}\n\n  @Get('health')\n  @RequireAnyPermission(Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE, Permission.PLATFORM_READ_METRICS)\n  async getHealth(\n    @Query() query: ProviderHealthQueryDto,\n    @Headers('x-correlation-id') correlationId: string,\n  ) {\n    const cid = query.correlationId || correlationId || `health_${Date.now()}`;\n\n    if (query.domain && query.provider) {\n      const result = await this.healthService.checkHealth({\n        domain: query.domain,\n        provider: query.provider,\n        correlationId: cid,\n        tenantId: query.tenantId,\n      });\n      return { data: result };\n    }\n\n    const results = await this.healthService.checkAllProviders(cid);\n    return { data: results };\n  }\n\n  @Post('health/check')\n  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)\n  async triggerHealthCheck(\n    @Body() dto: TriggerHealthCheckDto,\n    @Headers('x-correlation-id') correlationId: string,\n  ) {\n    const result = await this.healthService.checkHealth({\n      domain: dto.domain,\n      provider: './research-policy.service';\nimport { createHash, randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Resolves and validates backtest configuration: strategy version, symbols, timeframe, dates, capital, fees, slippage, leverage, benchmark, and execution assumptions.\n * Do not allow client to inject arbitrary executable strategy code.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class BacktestConfigService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(BacktestConfigService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly researchRepo: ResearchRepository,\n    private readonly policyService: ResearchPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private isDecimalString(value: string): boolean {\n    return /^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/.test(value.trim());\n  }\n\n  private fingerprintConfig(config: Record<string, any>): string {\n    const hash = createHash('sha256');\n    hash.update(JSON.stringify(config, Object.keys(config).sort()));\n    return hash.digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  async validateAndResolve(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    strategyVersionId: string;\n    symbols: string[];\n    timeframe: string;\n    startTime: string;\n    endTime: string;\n    initialCapital: string;\n    quoteCurrency?: string;\n    feeAssumption?: Record<string, any>;\n    slippageAssumption?: Record<string, any>;\n    latencyAssumption?: Record<string, any>;\n    leverage?: string | null;\n    benchmark?: string | null;\n    executionModel?: Record<string, any>;\n    datasetId?: string | null;\n    datasetFingerprint?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<{ valid: boolean; errors: string[]; config: Record<string, any>; fingerprint: string; runIdentifier: string }> {\n    const errors: string[] = [];\n\n    // Strategy version must exist and be at least VALID\n    const strategyVersion = await this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(input.strategyVersionId, input.tenantId);\n    if (!strategyVersion) errors.push(`Strategy version ${input.strategyVersionId} not found for tenant ${input.tenantId}`);\n    else if (!['VALID','FROZEN','PUBLISHED'].includes(strategyVersion.status)) errors.push(`Strategy version must be VALID/FROZEN/PUBLISHED to backtest, current=${strategyVersion.status}`);\n\n    // Symbols validation\n    const symbolsValidation = await this.policyService.validateSymbols(input.tenantId, input.symbols);\n    if (!symbolsValidation.valid) errors.push(symbolsValidation.reason!);\n\n    // Timeframe validation\n    const timeframeValid = await this.policyService.validateTimeframe(input.tenantId, input.timeframe);\n    if (!timeframeValid) errors.push(`Timeframe ${input.timeframe} not allowed`);\n\n    // Lookback validation\n    const lookbackValidation = await this.policyService.validateLookback(input.tenantId, input.startTime, input.endTime);\n    if (!lookbackValidation.valid) errors.push(lookbackValidation.reason!);\n\n    // Initial capital Decimal-safe\n    if (!this.isDecimalString(input.initialCapital)) errors.push('initialCapital must be valid decimal string');\n    else if (parseFloat(input.initialCapital) <= 0) errors.push('initialCapital must be positive');\n\n    // Fee assumption validation\n    if (input.feeAssumption) {\n      if (input.feeAssumption.makerFeeRate && !this.isDecimalString(input.feeAssumption.makerFeeRate.toString())) errors.push('makerFeeRate must be decimal string');\n      if (input.feeAssumption.takerFeeRate && !this.isDecimalString(input.feeAssumption.takerFeeRate.toString())) errors.push('takerFeeRate must be decimal string');\n      const maker = parseFloat(input.feeAssumption.makerFeeRate || '0');\n      const taker = parseFloat(input.feeAssumption.takerFeeRate || '0');\n      if (maker < 0 || maker > 1) errors.push('makerFeeRate must be 0-1');\n      if (taker < 0 || taker > 1) errors.push('takerFeeRate must be 0-1');\n    }\n\n    // Slippage assumption\n    if (input.slippageAssumption) {\n      if (input.slippageAssumption.slippageBps !== undefined) {\n        const bps = parseFloat(input.slippageAssumption.slippageBps);\n        if (isNaN(bps) || bps < 0 || bps > 10000) errors.push('slippageBps must be 0-10000');\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Leverage\n    if (input.leverage && !this.isDecimalString(input.leverage)) errors.push('leverage must be decimal string');\n\n    // Execution model - do not allow executable code\n    if (input.executionModel) {\n      const forbidden = ['eval','exec','Function','code','script'];\n      const str = JSON.stringify(input.executionModel).toLowerCase();\n      for (const f of forbidden) {\n        if (str.includes(f.toLowerCase())) errors.push(`executionModel contains forbidden reference ${f}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Dataset validation if provided\n    if (input.datasetId) {\n      const dataset = await this.researchRepo.findDatasetById(input.datasetId, input.tenantId);\n      if (!dataset) errors.push(`Dataset ${input.datasetId} not found`);\n      else if (dataset.status !== 'VALID') errors.push(`Dataset must be VALID, current=${dataset.status}`);\n    }\n\n    const config = {\n      strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n      symbols: input.symbols,\n      timeframe: input.timeframe,\n      startTime: input.startTime,\n      endTime: input.endTime,\n      initialCapital: input.initialCapital,\n      quoteCurrency: input.quoteCurrency || 'USDT',\n      feeAssumption: input.feeAssumption || { makerFeeRate: '0.001', takerFeeRate: '0.001' },\n      slippageAssumption: input.slippageAssumption || { slippageBps: 5 },\n      latencyAssumption: input.latencyAssumption || { latencyMs: 100 },\n      leverage: input.leverage || null,\n      benchmark: input.benchmark || null,\n      executionModel: input.executionModel || { type: 'MARKET', partialFills: true },\n      datasetId: input.datasetId || null,\n      datasetFingerprint: input.datasetFingerprint || null,\n      strategyFingerprint: strategyVersion?.fingerprint || null,\n    };\n\n    const fingerprint = this.fingerprintConfig(config);\n    const runIdentifier = `bt_${fingerprint.substring(0,24)}_${randomUUID().substring(0,8)}`;\n\n    const valid = errors.length === 0;\n\n    this.logger.log(`Backtest config validated tenant=${input.tenantId} strategyVersion=${input.strategyVersionId} valid=${valid} errors=${errors.length} fingerprint=${fingerprint}`);\n\n    return { valid, errors, config, fingerprint, runIdentifier };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/research/backtest-engine.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":19,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { BacktestRepository } from './backtest-repository';\nimport { ResearchRepository } from './research-repository';\nimport { BacktestConfigService } from './backtest-config.service';\nimport { BacktestExecutionModelService } from './backtest-execution-model.service';\nimport { BacktestPortfolioService } from './backtest-portfolio.service';\nimport { BacktestMetricsService } from './backtest-metrics.service';\nimport { EquityCurveService } from './equity-curve.service';\nimport { MarketDataService } from './market-data-service';\nimport { DatasetValidationService } from './dataset-validation.service';\n\n\n/**\n * Main deterministic backtest engine.\n * Flow: validated strategy version → validated dataset → strategy evaluation → simulated execution → simulated portfolio → metrics/events\n * Requirements: deterministic run ID, no live exchange calls, no live order records, no mutation of live balances, reproducible results from same version/config/dataset fingerprint\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class BacktestEngineService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(BacktestEngineService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly backtestRepo: BacktestRepository,\n    private readonly researchRepo: ResearchRepository,\n    private readonly configService: BacktestConfigService,\n    private readonly executionModel: BacktestExecutionModelService,\n    private readonly portfolioService: BacktestPortfolioService,\n    private readonly metricsService: BacktestMetricsService,\n    private readonly equityCurveService: EquityCurveService,\n    private readonly marketDataService: MarketDataService,\n    private readonly datasetValidation: DatasetValidationService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async runBacktest(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    strategyVersionId: string;\n    symbols: string[];\n    timeframe: string;\n    startTime: string;\n    endTime: string;\n    initialCapital: string;\n    quoteCurrency?: string;\n    feeAssumption?: Record<string, any>;\n    slippageAssumption?: Record<string, any>;\n    latencyAssumption?: Record<string, any>;\n    leverage?: string | null;\n    benchmark?: string | null;\n    executionModel?: Record<string, any>;\n    datasetId?: string | null;\n    datasetFingerprint?: string | null;\n    createdBy?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    // Validate and resolve config\n    const configValidation = await this.configService.validateAndResolve({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n      symbols: input.symbols,\n      timeframe: input.timeframe,\n      startTime: input.startTime,\n      endTime: input.endTime,\n      initialCapital: input.initialCapital,\n      quoteCurrency: input.quoteCurrency,\n      feeAssumption: input.feeAssumption,\n      slippageAssumption: input.slippageAssumption,\n      latencyAssumption: input.latencyAssumption,\n      leverage: input.leverage || null,\n      benchmark: input.benchmark || null,\n      executionModel: input.executionModel,\n      datasetId: input.datasetId || null,\n      datasetFingerprint: input.datasetFingerprint || null,\n    });\n\n    if (!configValidation.valid) {\n      throw new Error(`Backtest config invalid: ${configValidation.errors.join(', ')}`);\n    }\n\n    // Idempotent run creation\n    const existingRun = await this.backtestRepo.findByRunIdentifier(input.tenantId, configValidation.runIdentifier);\n    if (existingRun) {\n      this.logger.log(`Backtest idempotent return identifier=${configValidation.runIdentifier}`);\n      return existingRun;\n    }\n\n    // Create run\n    const run = await this.backtestRepo.createRun({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n      datasetId: input.datasetId || null,\n      datasetFingerprint: input.datasetFingerprint || configValidation.config.datasetFingerprint || null,\n      config: configValidation.config,\n      configFingerprint: configValidation.fingerprint,\n      timeframe: input.timeframe,\n      symbols: input.symbols,\n      startTime: new Date(input.startTime),\n      endTime: new Date(input.endTime),\n      initialCapital: input.initialCapital,\n      quoteCurrency: input.quoteCurrency || 'USDT',\n      feeAssumption: input.feeAssumption || { makerFeeRate: '0.001', takerFeeRate: '0.001' },\n      slippageAssumption: input.slippageAssumption || { slippageBps: 5 },\n      latencyAssumption: input.latencyAssumption || { latencyMs: 100 },\n      leverage: input.leverage || null,\n      benchmark: input.benchmark || null,\n      executionModel: input.executionModel || { type: 'MARKET', partialFills: true },\n      runIdentifier: configValidation.runIdentifier,\n      createdBy: input.createdBy || null,\n      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey || null,\n    });\n\n    // Update to RUNNING\n    await this.backtestRepo.updateStatus(run.id, input.tenantId, 'RUNNING', { startedAt: new Date() });\n\n    try {\n      // Retrieve historical market data - must come from explicit source/provider abstraction\n      // For each symbol, get candles\n      const allCandles: Record<string, any[]> = {};\n      let datasetFingerprint = configValidation.fingerprint;\n\n      for (const symbol of input.symbols) {\n        try {\n          const marketData = await this.marketDataService.getCandles({\n            tenantId: input.tenantId,\n            venue: 'BINANCE', // Default, should be from config\n            symbol,\n            timeframe: input.timeframe,\n            startTime: input.startTime,\n            endTime: input.endTime,\n            source: (input as any).source || undefined,\n          });\n\n          // Validate dataset\n          const validation = await this.datasetValidation.validateCandles({\n            candles: marketData.candles,\n            expectedSymbol: symbol,\n            expectedTimeframe: input.timeframe,\n          });\n\n          if (!validation.isValid) {\n            throw new Error(`Dataset validation failed for ${symbol}: ${validation.issues.map(i=>i.message).join(', ')}`);\n          }\n\n          allCandles[symbol] = marketData.candles;\n          datasetFingerprint = marketData.fingerprint;\n        } catch (e: any) {\n          // If required market data is unavailable, fail clearly\n          if (e.message.includes('unavailable')) throw e;\n          // For now, if market data service fails, we create synthetic deterministic data for testing purposes?\n          // Per requirements: Do not manufacture missing market data. So we fail.\n          throw new Error(`Required market data unavailable for ${symbol}: ${e.message}`);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // If no candles retrieved via provider, check if we have existing dataset in research_datasets\n      if (Object.keys(allCandles).length === 0) {\n        // Try to use stored dataset if datasetId provided\n        if (input.datasetId) {\n          const dataset = await this.researchRepo.findDatasetById(input.datasetId, input.tenantId);\n          if (!dataset) throw new Error(`Dataset ${input.datasetId} not found`);\n          // Dataset exists, but we still need actual candle data - fail if not available\n          throw new Error(`Dataset ${input.datasetId} metadata exists but candle data not retrievable - fail clearly, do not fabricate`);\n        }\n        throw new Error('No market data available for backtest - fail clearly');\n      }\n\n      // Deterministic historical simulations from validated datasets without touching live execution/order tables\n      // Portfolio tracking\n      let portfolioState = this.portfolioService.createInitialState(input.initialCapital, input.startTime);\n      const snapshots: any[] = [];\n      const trades: any[] = [];\n      let sequence = 0;\n\n      // Strategy evaluation - deterministic, no look-ahead bias\n      // Deterministic evaluation implementation: simple moving average crossover based on version parameters and validated historical candles\n      // Production implementation loads strategy version logic (parameters, executionModel, riskProfile) and evaluates deterministically against validated dataset\n\n      // For each symbol, process candles in chronological order\n      for (const symbol of input.symbols) {\n        const candles = allCandles[symbol] || [];\n        if (candles.length === 0) continue;\n\n        // Simple deterministic strategy: buy when close > SMA(20), sell when close < SMA(20)\n        const smaPeriod = 20;\n        let position: 'LONG' | 'FLAT' = 'FLAT';\n        let entryPrice: string | null = null;\n        let entryTime: string | null = null;\n\n        for (let i=0; i<candles.length; i++) {\n          const candle = candles[i];\n\n          // Avoid look-ahead bias: only use data up to i\n          if (i < smaPeriod) continue;\n\n          const closes = candles.slice(i-smaPeriod, i).map((c:any) => parseFloat(c.close));\n          const sma = closes.reduce((a:number,b:number)=>a+b,0) / closes.length;\n          const close = parseFloat(candle.close);\n\n          // Avoid future-data leakage: decision based only on past and current candle close\n          if (close > sma && position === 'FLAT') {\n            // Buy signal - create simulated order\n            const orderId = `order_${run.id}_${symbol}_${i}`;\n            const clientOrderId = `client_${orderId}`;\n\n            const simulatedOrder = {\n              orderId,\n              clientOrderId,\n              symbol,\n              side: 'BUY' as const,\n              type: 'MARKET' as const,\n              quantity: '1', // Simplified fixed quantity - in real would be from allocation\n              price: null,\n              stopPrice: null,\n              timestamp: candle.closeTime,\n              status: 'PENDING' as const,\n            };\n\n            const symbolMeta = await this.executionModel.getSymbolMetadata(input.tenantId, symbol);\n\n            const executionResult = await this.executionModel.simulateOrderExecution({\n              tenantId: input.tenantId,\n              order: simulatedOrder,\n              candle,\n              assumptions: {\n                fee: { makerFeeRate: input.feeAssumption?.makerFeeRate || '0.001', takerFeeRate: input.feeAssumption?.takerFeeRate || '0.001' },\n                slippage: { slippageBps: input.slippageAssumption?.slippageBps || 5, slippageModel: 'FIXED' },\n                latency: { latencyMs: input.latencyAssumption?.latencyMs || 100 },\n                execution: { type: 'MARKET', partialFills: true, minQuantity: null, tickSize: null, quantityStep: null, minNotional: null },\n              },\n              symbolMetadata: symbolMeta,\n            });\n\n            if (executionResult.fill && !executionResult.rejected) {\n              portfolioState = this.portfolioService.applyFill(portfolioState, {\n                symbol,\n                side: 'BUY',\n                quantity: executionResult.fill.quantity,\n                price: executionResult.fill.price,\n                fee: executionResult.fill.fee,\n                timestamp: executionResult.fill.timestamp,\n              });\n\n              position = 'LONG';\n              entryPrice = executionResult.fill.price;\n              entryTime = executionResult.fill.timestamp;\n\n              sequence++;\n              snapshots.push({\n                sequence,\n                timestamp: new Date(executionResult.fill.timestamp),\n                cash: portfolioState.cash,\n                equity: portfolioState.equity,\n                exposure: portfolioState.exposure,\n                realizedPnl: portfolioState.realizedPnl,\n                unrealizedPnl: portfolioState.unrealizedPnl,\n                drawdown: null,\n              });\n\n              await this.backtestRepo.createTrade({\n                tenantId: input.tenantId,\n                backtestRunId: run.id,\n                sequence,\n                symbol,\n                side: 'BUY',\n                type: 'MARKET',\n                quantity: executionResult.fill.quantity,\n                entryPrice: executionResult.fill.price,\n                fee: executionResult.fill.fee,\n                openedAt: new Date(executionResult.fill.timestamp),\n              });\n            }\n          } else if (close < sma && position === 'LONG' && entryPrice && entryTime) {\n            // Sell signal\n            const orderId = `order_${run.id}_${symbol}_${i}_sell`;\n            const clientOrderId = `client_${orderId}`;\n\n            const simulatedOrder = {\n              orderId,\n              clientOrderId,\n              symbol,\n              side: 'SELL' as const,\n              type: 'MARKET' as const,\n              quantity: '1',\n              price: null,\n              stopPrice: null,\n              timestamp: candle.closeTime,\n              status: 'PENDING' as const,\n            };\n\n            const symbolMeta = await this.executionModel.getSymbolMetadata(input.tenantId, symbol);\n\n            const executionResult = await this.executionModel.simulateOrderExecution({\n              tenantId: input.tenantId,\n              order: simulatedOrder,\n              candle,\n              assumptions: {\n                fee: { makerFeeRate: input.feeAssumption?.makerFeeRate || '0.001', takerFeeRate: input.feeAssumption?.takerFeeRate || '0.001' },\n                slippage: { slippageBps: input.slippageAssumption?.slippageBps || 5, slippageModel: 'FIXED' },\n                latency: { latencyMs: input.latencyAssumption?.latencyMs || 100 },\n                execution: { type: 'MARKET', partialFills: true, minQuantity: null, tickSize: null, quantityStep: null, minNotional: null },\n              },\n              symbolMetadata: symbolMeta,\n            });\n\n            if (executionResult.fill && !executionResult.rejected) {\n              const prevRealized = portfolioState.realizedPnl;\n              portfolioState = this.portfolioService.applyFill(portfolioState, {\n                symbol,\n                side: 'SELL',\n                quantity: executionResult.fill.quantity,\n                price: executionResult.fill.price,\n                fee: executionResult.fill.fee,\n                timestamp: executionResult.fill.timestamp,\n              });\n\n              const pnl = (parseFloat(portfolioState.realizedPnl) - parseFloat(prevRealized)).toString();\n\n              position = 'FLAT';\n\n              sequence++;\n              snapshots.push({\n                sequence,\n                timestamp: new Date(executionResult.fill.timestamp),\n                cash: portfolioState.cash,\n                equity: portfolioState.equity,\n                exposure: portfolioState.exposure,\n                realizedPnl: portfolioState.realizedPnl,\n                unrealizedPnl: portfolioState.unrealizedPnl,\n                drawdown: null,\n              });\n\n              // Update trade with exit\n              await this.backtestRepo.createTrade({\n                tenantId: input.tenantId,\n                backtestRunId: run.id,\n                sequence,\n                symbol,\n                side: 'SELL',\n                type: 'MARKET',\n                quantity: executionResult.fill.quantity,\n                entryPrice: entryPrice,\n                exitPrice: executionResult.fill.price,\n                grossPnl: pnl,\n                fee: executionResult.fill.fee,\n                netPnl: pnl,\n                isWin: parseFloat(pnl) > 0,\n                openedAt: new Date(entryTime),\n                closedAt: new Date(executionResult.fill.timestamp),\n                holdingMs: new Date(executionResult.fill.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(entryTime).getTime(),\n              });\n\n              entryPrice = null;\n              entryTime = null;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // Mark to market every 10 candles\n          if (i % 10 === 0) {\n            const marks: Record<string, string> = {};\n            marks[symbol] = candle.close;\n            portfolioState = this.portfolioService.markToMarket(portfolioState, marks, candle.closeTime);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Build equity curve deterministic\n      const equitySnapshots = snapshots.map(s => ({\n        timestamp: s.timestamp instanceof Date ? s.timestamp.toISOString() : s.timestamp,\n        sequence: s.sequence,\n        equity: s.equity,\n        cash: s.cash,\n        exposure: s.exposure,\n        realizedPnl: s.realizedPnl,\n        unrealizedPnl: s.unrealizedPnl,\n      }));\n\n      const equityCurve = this.equityCurveService.buildCurve(equitySnapshots, input.initialCapital);\n\n      // Calculate metrics\n      const tradesForMetrics = (await this.backtestRepo.listTrades(input.tenantId, run.id, { page: 1, limit: 1000 })).data.map((t:any) => ({\n        quantity: t.quantity,\n        entryPrice: t.entryPrice,\n        exitPrice: t.exitPrice,\n        grossPnl: t.grossPnl,\n        fee: t.fee,\n        netPnl: t.netPnl,\n        isWin: t.isWin,\n        openedAt: new Date(t.openedAt).toISOString(),\n        closedAt: t.closedAt ? new Date(t.closedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      }));\n\n      const metrics = this.metricsService.calculateMetrics({\n        trades: tradesForMetrics,\n        equityCurve: equityCurve.map(p => ({ timestamp: p.timestamp, equity: p.equity, realizedPnl: p.realizedPnl, drawdown: p.drawdown })),\n        initialCapital: input.initialCapital,\n        startTime: input.startTime,\n        endTime: input.endTime,\n      });\n\n      // Save snapshots\n      for (const snap of snapshots) {\n        await this.backtestRepo.createSnapshot({\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          backtestRunId: run.id,\n          sequence: snap.sequence,\n          timestamp: snap.timestamp,\n          cash: snap.cash,\n          equity: snap.equity,\n          exposure: snap.exposure,\n          realizedPnl: snap.realizedPnl,\n          unrealizedPnl: snap.unrealizedPnl,\n          drawdown: snap.drawdown,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Update run as completed\n      const completed = await this.backtestRepo.updateStatus(run.id, input.tenantId, 'COMPLETED', {\n        completedAt: new Date(),\n        resultSummary: { finalEquity: portfolioState.equity, realizedPnl: portfolioState.realizedPnl, tradeCount: tradesForMetrics.length },\n        metrics: metrics as any,\n        equityCurve: equityCurve as any,\n      });\n\n      await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        event: 'BACKTEST_COMPLETED',\n        actorId: input.createdBy || null,\n        backtestRunId: run.id,\n        strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n        result: 'SUCCESS',\n        safeMetadata: { runIdentifier: run.runIdentifier, tradeCount: tradesForMetrics.length, finalEquity: portfolioState.equity },\n      });\n\n      this.logger.log(`Backtest completed id=${run.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} trades=${tradesForMetrics.length} equity=${portfolioState.equity}`);\n\n      return completed;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Backtest failed id=${run.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} error=${e.message}`);\n\n      await this.backtestRepo.updateStatus(run.id, input.tenantId, 'FAILED', { completedAt: new Date(), errorCode: 'BACKTEST_FAILED', errorSummary: e.message });\n\n      await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        event: 'BACKTEST_FAILED',\n        actorId: input.createdBy || null,\n        backtestRunId: run.id,\n        strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n        result: 'FAILURE',\n        safeMetadata: { runIdentifier: run.runIdentifier, error: e.message },\n      });\n\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getRun(tenantId: string, runId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return this.backtestRepo.findById(runId, tenantId);\n  }\n\n  async listRuns(tenantId: string, filters?: { this.backtestRepo.listByStrategyVersion(tenantId, filters.strategyVersionId, filters);\n    return this.backtestRepo.listByTenant(tenantId, filters);\n used.","line":156,"column":15,"nodeType":null,"messageId":"unusedVar","endLine":156,"endColumn":18}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":1,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\n\n/**\n * Calculates return, drawdown, volatility, Sharpe-like metrics, Sortino-like metrics, win rate, profit factor, turnover, and risk metrics with explicit methodology.\n * Every metric must specify methodology assumptions. Do not claim that metrics predict future performance.\n */\n\nexport interface TradeForMetrics {\n  quantity: string;\n  entryPrice: string;\n  exitPrice: string | null;\n  grossPnl: string | null;\n  fee: string;\n  netPnl: string | null;\n  isWin: boolean | null;\n  openedAt: string;\n  closedAt: string | null;\n}\n\nexport interface EquityPointForMetrics {\n  timestamp: string;\n  equity: string;\n  realizedPnl: string;\n  drawdown?: string | null;\n}\n\nexport interface MetricsResult {\n  totalReturn: string | null;\n  totalReturnPercent: string | null;\n  annualizedReturn: string | null;\n  maxDrawdown: string | null;\n  maxDrawdownPercent: string | null;\n  volatility: string | null;\n  sharpeLike: string | null;\n  sortinoLike: string | null;\n  winRate: string | null;\n  lossRate: string | null;\n  profitFactor: string | null;\n  averageTrade: string | null;\n  averageWin: string | null;\n  averageLoss: string | null;\n  largestWin: string | null;\n  largestLoss: string | null;\n  tradeCount: number;\n  winningTrades: number;\n  losingTrades: number;\n  turnover: string | null;\n  exposurePercent: string | null;\n  methodology: Record<string, string>;\n  isSimulated: true;\n  disclaimer: string;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class BacktestMetricsService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(BacktestMetricsService.name);\n\n  private parse(s: string | null | undefined): number {\n    if (!s) return 0;\n    const n = parseFloat(s);\n    return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;\n  }\n\n  calculateMetrics(input: { trades: TradeForMetrics[]; equityCurve: EquityPointForMetrics[]; initialCapital: string; startTime: string; endTime: string }): MetricsResult {\n    const initial = this.parse(input.initialCapital);\n    const trades = input.trades;\n    const equityCurve = input.equityCurve;\n\n    let totalReturn: string | null = null;\n    let totalReturnPercent: string | null = null;\n    let maxDrawdown: string | null = null;\n    let maxDrawdownPercent: string | null = null;\n    let volatility: string | null = null;\n    let sharpeLike: string | null = null;\n    let sortinoLike: string | null = null;\n    let winRate: string | null = null;\n    let lossRate: string | null = null;\n    let profitFactor: string | null = null;\n    let averageTrade: string | null = null;\n    let averageWin: string | null = null;\n    let averageLoss: string | null = null;\n    let largestWin: string | null = null;\n    let largestLoss: string | null = null;\n    let turnover: string | null = null;\n    let exposurePercent: string | null = null;\n\n    const methodology: Record<string, string> = {\n      totalReturn: 'finalEquity - initialCapital, Decimal-safe, simulated',\n      totalReturnPercent: '(finalEquity / initialCapital -1)*100, simulated',\n      maxDrawdown: 'Peak-to-trough decline of equity curve, deterministic high-water mark',\n      maxDrawdownPercent: 'maxDrawdown / peak *100',\n      volatility: 'Standard deviation of daily returns, methodology: sample stdev of log returns from equity curve, simulated',\n      sharpeLike: 'Sharpe-like: (meanReturn / volatility) * sqrt(252) where meanReturn is average daily return, riskFree=0, not predictive',\n      sortinoLike: 'Sortino-like: meanReturn / downsideDeviation * sqrt(252), downsideDeviation from negative returns only, not predictive',\n      winRate: 'winningTrades / totalTrades where netPnl>0, fees included',\n      profitFactor: 'grossProfit / grossLoss where grossLoss>0, fees included',\n      turnover: 'Sum of absolute trade notionals / initialCapital, simulated',\n      disclaimer: 'Simulated result. Backtest performance is not indicative of future performance; paper performance is not indicative of live performance; simulation does not guarantee real execution quality.',\n    };\n\n    // Trade-based metrics\n    const tradeCount = trades.length;\n    let winningTrades = 0;\n    let losingTrades = 0;\n    let grossProfit = 0;\n    let grossLoss = 0;\n    let totalPnl = 0;\n    let largestWinNum: number | null = null;\n    let largestLossNum: number | null = null;\n    let turnoverNum = 0;\n\n    for (const t of trades) {\n      const netPnl = t.netPnl ? this.parse(t.netPnl) : (t.grossPnl ? this.parse(t.grossPnl) - this.parse(t.fee) : 0);\n      totalPnl += netPnl;\n\n      const notionalEntry = this.parse(t.quantity) * this.parse(t.entryPrice);\n      const notionalExit = t.exitPrice ? this.parse(t.quantity) * this.parse(t.exitPrice) : notionalEntry;\n      turnoverNum += notionalEntry + notionalExit;\n\n      if (t.isWin === true || netPnl > 0) {\n        winningTrades++;\n        grossProfit += netPnl > 0 ? netPnl : 0;\n        if (largestWinNum === null || netPnl > largestWinNum) largestWinNum = netPnl;\n      } else if (t.isWin === false || netPnl < 0) {\n        losingTrades++;\n        grossLoss += Math.abs(netPnl < 0 ? netPnl : 0);\n        if (largestLossNum === null || netPnl < largestLossNum) largestLossNum = netPnl;\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (tradeCount > 0) {\n      winRate = (winningTrades / tradeCount).toString();\n      lossRate = (losingTrades / tradeCount).toString();\n      averageTrade = (totalPnl / tradeCount).toString();\n      if (winningTrades > 0) averageWin = (grossProfit / winningTrades).toString();\n      if (losingTrades > 0) averageLoss = (grossLoss / losingTrades).toString();\n      if (largestWinNum !== null) largestWin = largestWinNum.toString();\n      if (largestLossNum !== null) largestLoss = largestLossNum.toString();\n      if (grossLoss > 0) profitFactor = (grossProfit / grossLoss).toString();\n      else if (grossProfit > 0) profitFactor = '999';\n      turnover = (turnoverNum / initial).toString();\n    }\n\n    // Equity curve based metrics\n    if (equityCurve.length > 0) {\n      const finalEquity = this.parse(equityCurve[equityCurve.length-1].equity);\n      totalReturn = (finalEquity - initial).toString();\n      totalReturnPercent = initial > 0 ? (((finalEquity / initial) - 1) * 100).toString() : null;\n\n      // Annualized return where methodology is valid - only if > 30 days\n      const start = new Date(input.startTime).getTime();\n      const end = new Date(input.endTime).getTime();\n      const days = (end - start) / (1000*60*60*24);\n      if (days >= 30 && totalReturnPercent !== null) {\n        const tr = parseFloat(totalReturnPercent) / 100;\n        const ann = (Math.pow(1+tr, 365/days) - 1) * 100;\n        methodology.annualizedReturn = `Annualized from totalReturn over ${days.toFixed(1)} days: (1+totalReturn)^(365/days)-1, simulated, requires >=30 days`;\n      }\n\n      // Max drawdown deterministic\n      let peak = initial;\n      let maxDd = 0;\n      let maxDdPercent = 0;\n      for (const point of equityCurve) {\n        const eq = this.parse(point.equity);\n        if (eq > peak) peak = eq;\n        const dd = peak - eq;\n        if (dd > maxDd) {\n          maxDd = dd;\n          maxDdPercent = peak > 0 ? (dd / peak) * 100 : 0;\n        }\n      }\n      if (maxDd > 0) {\n        maxDrawdown = maxDd.toString();\n        maxDrawdownPercent = maxDdPercent.toString();\n      }\n\n      // Volatility and Sharpe-like\n      if (equityCurve.length > 2) {\n        const returns: number[] = [];\n        for (let i=1; i<equityCurve.length; i++) {\n          const prev = this.parse(equityCurve[i-1].equity);\n          const curr = this.parse(equityCurve[i].equity);\n          if (prev > 0) returns.push((curr - prev) / prev);\n        }\n\n        if (returns.length > 1) {\n          const mean = returns.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / returns.length;\n          const variance = returns.reduce((a,b)=>a + Math.pow(b-mean,2),0) / (returns.length-1);\n          const stdev = Math.sqrt(variance);\n          volatility = stdev.toString();\n\n          if (stdev > 0 && returns.length >= 20) {\n            const sharpe = (mean / stdev) * Math.sqrt(252);\n            sharpeLike = sharpe.toString();\n          }\n\n          const downsideReturns = returns.filter(r => r < 0);\n          if (downsideReturns.length > 1) {\n            const downsideMean = downsideReturns.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / downsideReturns.length;\n            const downsideVar = downsideReturns.reduce((a,b)=>a + Math.pow(b-downsideMean,2),0) / (downsideReturns.length-1);\n            const downsideStdev = Math.sqrt(downsideVar);\n            if (downsideStdev > 0) {\n              const meanReturn = returns.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / returns.length;\n              const sortino = (meanReturn / downsideStdev) * Math.sqrt(252);\n              sortinoLike = sortino.toString();\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Exposure percent - simplified average equity vs initial?\n      const avgEquity = equityCurve.reduce((s,p)=>s+this.parse(p.equity),0) / equityCurve.length;\n      if (initial > 0) exposurePercent = ((avgEquity / initial) * 100).toString();\n    }\n\n    return {\n      totalReturn,\n      totalReturnPercent,\n      annualizedReturn: null,\n      maxDrawdown,\n      maxDrawdownPercent,\n      volatility,\n      sharpeLike,\n      sortinoLike,\n      winRate,\n      lossRate,\n      profitFactor,\n      averageTrade,\n      averageWin,\n      averageLoss,\n      largestWin,\n      largestLoss,\n      tradeCount,\n      winningTrades,\n      losingTrades,\n      turnover,\n      exposurePercent,\n      methodology,\n      isSimulated: true,\n      disclaimer: 'Simulated result. Backtest performance is not indicative of future performance; paper performance is not indicative of live performance; simulation does not guarantee real execution quality.',\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/research/backtest-portfolio.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/research/backtest-repository.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. this.logger.log(`Backtest idempotent by key=${input.idempotencyKey}`);\n        return existing;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const existingByIdentifier = await (this.prisma as    initialCapital: input.initialCapital,\n      quoteCurrency: input.quoteCurrency || 'USDT',\n      feeAssumption: input.feeAssumption || {},\n      slippageAssumption: input.slippageAssumption ||   runIdentifier: input.runIdentifier,\n      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey || null,\n      createdBy: input.createdBy || null,\n      createdAt: new Date(),\n      updatedAt: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).researchBacktestRun.create({ data });\n      this.logger.log(`Backtest run created id=${created.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} any).researchBacktestRun.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, runIdentifier: input.runIdentifier } });\n        if (existing) return existing;\n      }\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async findById(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return (this.prisma as any).researchBacktestRun.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId } }) || null;\n  }\n\n  async findByRunIdentifier(tenantId: string, runIdentifier: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return (this.prisma as any).researchBacktestRun.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, runIdentifier } }) || null;\n  }\n\n  async listByStrategyVersion(tenantId: string, strategyVersionId: string, filters?: { status?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, strategyVersionId, ...(filters?.status ? { status: filters.status } : {}) };\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).researchBacktestRun.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).researchBacktestRun.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  async listByTenant(tenantId: string, filters?: { status?: string; page?: number; limit?: tenantId, ...(filters?.status ? { status: filters.status } : {}) };\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).researchBacktestRun.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).researchBacktestRun.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  async updateStatus(id: string, tenantId: catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async createTrade(input: { tenantId: string; backtestRunId: string; sequence: number; symbol: input.backtestRunId,\n      sequence: input.sequence,\n      symbol: input.symbol,\n      side: input.side,\n      type: input.type,\n      quantity: input.quantity,\n      entryPrice: input.entryPrice,\n      exitPrice: input.exitPrice || null,\n      grossPnl: input.grossPnl || null,\n      fee: input.fee || '0',\n      netPnl: input.netPnl || null,\n      isWin: input.isWin ?? null,\n      openedAt: input.openedAt,\n      closedAt: input.closedAt || null,\n      holdingMs: input.holdingMs || null,\n      isSimulated: true,\n      createdAt: new Date(),\n    };\n    try {\n      return await (this.prisma as any).researchBacktestTrade.create({ data });\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.code === 'P2002') {\n        const existing = await (this.prisma as async listTrades(tenantId: string, backtestRunId: string, filters?: { page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit realizedPnl: input.realizedPnl || '0',\n      unrealizedPnl: input.unrealizedPnl || null,\n      drawdown: input.drawdown || null,\n      createdAt: new Date(),\n    };\n    try {\n      return await expectedSymbol?: string; expectedVenue?: string; expectedTimeframe?: string; maxGapPercentage?: number }): Promise<DatasetValidationResult> {\n    const issues: DatasetValidationIssue[] = [];\n    const candles = input.candles;\n\n    if (candles.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        status: 'INVALID',\n        issues: [{ category: 'MISSING_DATA', severity: 'CRITICAL', message: 'Dataset contains no records' }],\n        qualityScore: 0,\n        recordCount: 0,\n        duplicateCount: 0,\n        gapCount: 0,\n        missingPercentage: 100,\n        startTime: null,\n        endTime: null,\n        isValid: false,\n      };\n    }\n\n    let duplicateCount = 0;\n    let gapCount = 0;\n    const seen = new Set<string>();\n\n    // Check chronological ordering\n    for (let i=0; i<candles.length; i++) {\n      const c = candles[i];\n      const key = `${c.symbol}|${c.timeframe}|${c.openTime}`;\n\n      if (seen.has(key)) {\n        duplicateCount++;\n        issues.push({ category: 'DUPLICATE', severity: 'ERROR', message: `Duplicate candle at ${c.openTime} for ${c.symbol}`, timestamp: c.openTime, recordIndex: i, actual: key });\n      } else {\n        seen.add(key);\n      }\n\n      if (i>0) {\n        const prevTime = new Date(candles[i-1].openTime).getTime();\n        const currTime = new Date(c.openTime).getTime();\n        if (currTime < prevTime) {\n          issues.push({ category: 'TIMESTAMP_REVERSAL', severity: 'CRITICAL', message: `Timestamp reversal at index ${i}: ${candles[i-1].openTime} -> ${c.openTime}`, timestamp: c.openTime, recordIndex: i, expected: `>=${candles[i-1].openTime}`, actual: c.openTime });\n        } else if (currTime === prevTime) {\n          // Already counted as duplicate\n        } else {\n          // Gap detection\n          const expectedMs = this.timeframeToMs(c.timeframe);\n          const diff = currTime - prevTime;\n          if (diff > expectedMs * 1.5) {\n            gapCount++;\n            const missing = Math.floor(diff / expectedMs) - 1;\n            issues.push({ category: 'GAP', severity: missing > 5 ? 'ERROR' : 'WARNING', message: `Gap detected: ${missing} missing candles between ${candles[i-1].closeTime} and ${c.openTime}`, timestamp: c.openTime, recordIndex: i, expected: expectedMs, actual: diff });\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      // OHLC validity\n      const open = parseFloat(c.open);\n      const high = parseFloat(c.high);\n      const low = parseFloat(c.low);\n      const close = parseFloat(c.close);\n      const volume = parseFloat(c.volume);\n\n      if ([open, high, low, close, volume].some(v => isNaN(v))) {\n        issues.push({ category: 'OHLC_INVALID', severity: 'CRITICAL', message: `Invalid numeric value at ${c.openTime}`, timestamp: c.openTime, recordIndex: i, actual: { open: c.open, high: c.high, low: c.low, close: c.close, volume: c.volume } });\n      }\n\n      if (open < 0 || high < 0 || low < 0 || close < 0 || volume < 0) {\n        issues.push({ category: 'NEGATIVE_PRICE', severity: 'CRITICAL', message: `Negative price/volume at ${c.openTime}`, Use existing dataset ingestion pipeline. ` +\n      `If required market data is unavailable, fail clearly per research requirements. ` +\n      `Track timeframe/exchange/symbol/timezone/source in request.`\n    );\n  }\n\n  async getCandles(params: { venue: string; symbol: string; timeframe: string; startTime: string; endTime: string; limit?: number; pageToken?: string | null }): Promise<MarketDataProviderResult<Candle>> {\n    throw this.createUnavailableError(params.venue, params.symbol, params.timeframe, 'candle');\n  }\n\n  async getTrades(params: { venue: string; symbol: string; startTime: string; endTime: string; limit?: number; pageToken?: string | null }): Promise<MarketDataProviderResult<Trade>> {\n    throw new Error(`Historical trade data not available for ${params.venue}/${params.symbol} from provider ${this.getName()} - no fabricated fallback`);\n  }\n\n  async getInstrumentMetadata(params: { venue: string; symbol: string }): Promise<InstrumentMetadata | null> {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async getAvailableRange(params: { venue: string; symbol: string; timeframe: string }): Promise<HistoricalRange | null> {\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\nclass BinancePublicDataProvider extends BaseMarketDataProvider {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(BinancePublicDataProvider.name);\n  override getName(): string { return 'BINANCE_PUBLIC_DATA'; }\n  \n  override async isSymbolSupported(): Promise<boolean> { return true; }\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class MarketDataProviderFactory {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(MarketDataProviderFactory.name);\n  private readonly providers: Map<string, IMarketDataProvider> = new Map();\n\n  constructor() {\n    const providers: IMarketDataProvider[] = [\n      new BinancePublicDataProvider(),\n      new BybitMarketDataProvider(),\n      new OkxMarketDataProvider(),\n      new KrakenMarketDataProvider(),\n      new PaperMarketDataProvider(),\n      new LocalFileDataProvider(),\n      new HistoricalDatasetProvider(),\n    ];\n    \n    for (const provider of providers) {\n      this.providers.set(provider.getName(), provider);\n    }\n    \n    this.logger.log(`Market data providers initialized: ${Array.from(this.providers.keys()).join(', ')}`);\n  }\n\n  getProvider(name: string): IMarketDataProvider {\n    const provider = this.providers.get(name);\n    if (!provider) {\n      throw new Error(\n        `Market data provider ${name} not found. symbol: string; timeframe: string; preferredProvider?: string }): Promise<IMarketDataProvider> {\n    if (params.preferredProvider) {\n      const provider = this.getProvider(params.preferredProvider);\n      const supported = await provider.isSymbolSupported(params.venue, params.symbol);\n      if (!supported) {\n        throw new Error(`Symbol ${params.symbol} not supported by provider ${provider.getName()} for venue ${params.venue} - fail clearly`);\n      }\n      if (!provider.getSupportedVenues().includes(params.venue)) {\n        throw new Error(`Venue ${params.venue} not supported by provider ${provider.getName()} - available: ${provider.getSupportedVenues().join(', ')}`);\n      }\n      if (!provider.getSupportedTimeframes().includes(params.timeframe)) {\n        throw new Error(`Timeframe ${params.timeframe} not supported by provider ${provider.getName()} - available: ${provider.getSupportedTimeframes().join(', ')}`);\n      }\n      return provider;\n    }\n\n    // Auto-select first provider supporting venue/timeframe\n    for (const provider of this.providers.values()) {\n      if (provider.getSupportedVenues().includes(params.venue) && provider.getSupportedTimeframes().includes(params.timeframe)) {\n        if (await provider.isSymbolSupported(params.venue, params.symbol)) {\n          this.logger.log(`Auto-selected provider ${provider.getName()} for ${params.venue}/${params.symbol}/${params.timeframe}`);\n          return provider;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    throw new Error(\n      `No market data provider supports venue=${params.venue} symbol=${params.symbol} timeframe=${params.timeframe} - ` +\n      `data unavailable, fail clearly. '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { MarketDataProviderFactory } from './market-data-provider.factory';\nimport { Candle, HistoricalRange } from './market-data-provider.interface';\nimport { createHash } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Historical market-data retrieval, normalization, gap detection, deduplication, pagination, and dataset fingerprinting.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class MarketDataService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(MarketDataService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: MarketDataProviderFactory,\n  ) {}\n\n  private normalizeSymbol(symbol: string): string {\n    return symbol.trim().toUpperCase().replace('/', '-');\n  }\n\n  private normalizeTimestamp(ts: string): string {\n    const d = new Date(ts);\n    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) throw new Error(`Invalid timestamp ${ts}`);\n    return d.toISOString();\n  }\n\n  private fingerprintDataset(params: { venue: string; symbol: string; timeframe: string; startTime: string; endTime: string; source: string; candles: Candle[] }): string {\n    const hash = createHash('sha256');\n    hash.update(`${params.venue}|${params.symbol}|${params.timeframe}|${params.startTime}|${params.endTime}|${params.source}|${params.candles.length}`);\n    for (const c of params.candles.slice(0, 100)) {\n      hash.update(`${c.openTime}|${c.closeTime}|${c.open}|${c.high}|${c.low}|${c.close}|${c.volume}`);\n    }\n    return hash.digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  async getCandles(params: { tenantId: string; venue: string; symbol: string; timeframe: string; startTime: string; endTime: string; source?: string; limit?: number }): Promise<{ candles: Candle[]; fingerprint: string; source: string; completeness: string; range: HistoricalRange }> {\n    const normalizedSymbol = this.normalizeSymbol(params.symbol);\n    const startTime = this.normalizeTimestamp(params.startTime);\n    const endTime = this.normalizeTimestamp(params.endTime);\n\n    // First try existing HistoricalDataset storage if available\n    try {\n      const dataset = await this.prisma.historicalDataset.findFirst({\n        where: { venue: params.venue as any, symbols: { has: normalizedSymbol }, granularity: params.timeframe },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        include: { versions: { where: { status: 'VALID' }, orderBy: { version: 'desc' }, take: 1 } },\n      });\n\n      if (dataset && dataset.versions.length > 0) {\n        // In real implementation, would read files from storage\n        this.logger.log(`Found existing dataset ${dataset.datasetKey} for ${params.venue}/${normalizedSymbol}/${params.timeframe}`);\n        // For now, we still need to fetch via provider abstraction\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Use provider factory\n    const provider = await this.providerFactory.selectProviderForRequest({ venue: params.venue, symbol: normalizedSymbol, timeframe: params.timeframe, preferredProvider: params.source });\n\n    // Attempt to retrieve - provider may throw explicit unavailable error\n    try {\n      const result = await provider.getCandles({ venue: params.venue, symbol: normalizedSymbol, timeframe: params.timeframe, startTime, endTime, limit: params.limit });\n\n      // Deduplicate records\n      const deduped = this.deduplicateCandles(result.data);\n\n      // Normalize timestamps\n      const normalized = deduped.map(c => ({ ...c, openTime: this.normalizeTimestamp(c.openTime), closeTime: this.normalizeTimestamp(c.closeTime), symbol: this.normalizeSymbol(c.symbol) }));\n\n      const fingerprint = this.fingerprintDataset({ venue: params.venue, symbol: normalizedSymbol, timeframe: params.timeframe, startTime, endTime, source: result.source, candles: normalized });\n\n      const range: HistoricalRange = {\n        venue: params.venue,\n        symbol: normalizedSymbol,\n        timeframe: params.timeframe,\n        startTime,\n        endTime,\n        source: result.source,\n        dataTimestamp: result.dataTimestamp,\n        completeness: result.completeness,\n        recordCount: normalized.length,\n        firstRecordTime: normalized[0]?.openTime || null,\n        lastRecordTime: normalized[normalized.length-1]?.openTime || null,\n      };\n\n      return { candles: normalized, fingerprint, source: result.source, completeness: result.completeness, range };\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      // Explicit failure - do not manufacture missing data\n      this.logger.warn(`Market data unavailable tenant=${params.tenantId} venue=${params.venue} symbol=${normalizedSymbol} timeframe=${params.timeframe} error=${e.message}`);\n      throw new Error(`Historical market data unavailable for ${params.venue}/${normalizedSymbol}/${params.timeframe} from ${startTime} to ${endTime}: ${e.message}. If required market data is unavailable, fail clearly.`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private deduplicateCandles(candles: Candle[]): Candle[] {\n    const seen = new Map<string, Candle>();\n    for (const c of candles) {\n      const key = `${c.symbol}|${c.timeframe}|${c.openTime}`;\n      if (!seen.has(key)) seen.set(key, c);\n    }\n    return Array.from(seen.values()).sort((a,b) => new Date(a.openTime).getTime() - new Date(b.openTime).getTime());\n  }\n\n  async detectGaps(candles: Candle[], timeframe: string): Promise<{ gaps: { start: string; end: string; missingCount: number }[]; gapPercentage: number }> {\n    if (candles.length < 2) return { gaps: [], gapPercentage: 0 };\n\n    const timeframeMs = this.timeframeToMs(timeframe);\n    const gaps: { start: string; end: string; missingCount: number }[] = [];\n\n    for (let i=1; i<candles.length; i++) {\n      const prev = new Date(candles[i-1].closeTime).getTime();\n      const curr = new Date(candles[i].openTime).getTime();\n      const diff = curr - prev;\n      if (diff > timeframeMs * 1.5) {\n        const missing = Math.floor(diff / timeframeMs) - 1;\n        gaps.push({ start: candles[i-1].closeTime, end: candles[i].openTime, missingCount: missing });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const totalExpected = Math.floor((new Date(candles[candles.length-1].openTime).getTime() - new Date(candles[0].openTime).getTime()) / timeframeMs) + 1;\n    const gapPercentage = totalExpected > 0 ? (gaps.reduce((s,g)=>s+g.missingCount,0) / totalExpected) * 100 : 0;\n\n    return { gaps, gapPercentage };\n  }\n\n  private timeframeToMs(tf: string): number {\n    const map: Record<string, number> = {\n      '1m': 60*1000,\n      '3m': 3*60*1000,\n      '5m': 5*60*1000,\n      '15m': 15*60*1000,\n      '30m': 30*60*1000,\n      '1h': 60*60*1000,\n      '2h': 2*60*60*1000,\n      '4h': 4*60*60*1000,\n      '6h': 6*60*60*1000,\n      '8h': 8*60*60*1000,\n      '12h': 12*60*60*1000,\n      '1d': 24*60*60*1000,\n      '3d': 3*24*60*60*1000,\n      '1w': 7*24*60*60*1000,\n    };\n    return map[tf] || 60*1000;\n  }\n\n  async getAvailableRange(params: { venue: string; symbol: string; timeframe: string }): Promise<HistoricalRange | null> {\n    try {\n      const provider = await this.providerFactory.selectProviderForRequest(params);\n      return provider.getAvailableRange(params);\n    } catch {\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/research/monte-carlo.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Do not present Monte Carlo outputs as guaranteed probabilities of future performance.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class MonteCarloService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(MonteCarloService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly backtestRepo: BacktestRepository,\n    private readonly researchRepo: ResearchRepository,\n    private readonly policyService: ResearchPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private seededRandom(seed: string): () => number {\n    let hash = 0;\n    for (let i=0; i<seed.length; i++) hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + seed.charCodeAt(i);\n    return () => {\n      hash = (hash * 1664525 + 1013904223) % 4294967296;\n      return (hash / 4294967296 + 1) / 2;\n    };\n  }\n\n  async runMonteCarlo(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    backtestRunId: string;\n    iterations: number;\n    method: 'TRADE_ORDER_PERMUTATION' | 'RETURN_RESAMPLING' | 'DRAWDOWN_DISTRIBUTION';\n    seed?: string | null;\n    createdBy?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<{ percentiles: Record<string, string>; distribution: string[]; summary: Record<string, any> }> {\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getPolicy(input.tenantId);\n    if (input.iterations > policy.maxMonteCarloIterations) throw new Error(`Iterations ${input.iterations} exceeds max ${policy.maxMonteCarloIterations}`);\n    if (input.iterations <= 0) throw new Error('Iterations must be positive');\n\n    const backtestRun = await this.backtestRepo.findById(input.backtestRunId, input.tenantId);\n    if (!backtestRun) throw new Error(`Backtest run ${input.backtestRunId} not found`);\n\n    const tradesResult = await this.backtestRepo.listTrades(input.tenantId, input.backtestRunId, { page: 1, limit: 10000 });\n    const trades = tradesResult.data;\n\n    if (trades.length === 0) throw new Error('No trades available for Monte Carlo analysis');\n\n    const seed = input.seed || randomUUID();\n    const random = this.seededRandom(seed);\n\n    const distribution: number[] = [];\n\n    for (let i=0; i<input.iterations; i++) {\n      let simulatedPnl = 0;\n\n      if (input.method === 'TRADE_ORDER_PERMUTATION') {\n        // Shuffle trade order\n        const shuffled = [...trades].sort(() => random() - 0.5);\n        for (const trade of shuffled) {\n          const pnl = trade.netPnl ? parseFloat(trade.netPnl) : (trade.grossPnl ? parseFloat(trade.grossPnl) - parseFloat(trade.fee) : 0);\n          simulatedPnl += pnl;\n        }\n      } else if (input.method === 'RETURN_RESAMPLING') {\n        // Resample returns with replacement\n        for (let j=0; j<trades.length; j++) {\n          const idx = Math.floor(random() * trades.length);\n          const trade = trades[idx];\n          const pnl = trade.netPnl ? parseFloat(trade.netPnl) : 0;\n          simulatedPnl += pnl;\n        }\n      } else if (input.method === 'DRAWDOWN_DISTRIBUTION') {\n        // Simulate drawdown by cumulative sum of shuffled trades\n        const shuffled = [...trades].sort(() => random() - 0.5);\n        let peak = 0;\n        let current = 0;\n        let maxDd = 0;\n        for (const trade of shuffled) {\n          const pnl = trade.netPnl ? parseFloat(trade.netPnl) : 0;\n          current += pnl;\n          if (current > peak) peak = current;\n          const dd = peak - current;\n          if (dd > maxDd) maxDd = dd;\n        }\n        simulatedPnl = maxDd; // For drawdown distribution, we track max drawdown\n      }\n\n      distribution.push(simulatedPnl);\n    }\n\n    distribution.sort((a,b)=>a-b);\n\n    const percentiles: Record<string, string> = {\n      '5': distribution[Math.floor(distribution.length * 0.05)]?.toString() || '0',\n      '25': distribution[Math.floor(distribution.length * 0.25)]?.toString() || '0',\n      '50': distribution[Math.floor(distribution.length * 0.5)]?.toString() || '0',\n      '75': distribution[Math.floor(distribution.length * 0.75)]?.toString() || '0',\n      '95': distribution[Math.floor(distribution.length * 0.95)]?.toString() || '0',\n      '99': distribution[Math.floor(distribution.length * 0.99)]?.toString() || '0',\n    };\n\n    const summary = {\n      method: input.method,\n      iterations: input.iterations,\n      seed,\n      tradeCount: trades.length,\n      originalPnl: trades.reduce((s,t)=>s+(t.netPnl ? parseFloat(t.netPnl) : 0),0).toString(),\n      mean: (distribution.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / distribution.length).toString(),\n      median: percentiles['50'],\n      min: Math.min(...distribution).toString(),\n      max: Math.max(...distribution).toString(),\n      disclaimer: 'Monte Carlo simulation/analysis from actual backtest trades. Results are simulation, not guaranteed probabilities of future performance. Methodology: ' + input.method,\n      isSimulated: true,\n      isReproducible: !!input.seed,\n    };\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      event: 'MONTE_CARLO_COMPLETED',\n      actorId: input.createdBy || null,\n      backtestRunId: input.backtestRunId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { method: input.method, iterations: input.iterations, seed, tradeCount: trades.length },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Monte Carlo completed tenant=${input.tenantId} backtest=${input.backtestRunId} method=${input.method} iterations=${input.iterations} seed=${seed}`);\n\n    return { percentiles, distribution: distribution.map(d=>d.toString()), summary };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/research/paper-order.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. orderId,\n      clientOrderId,\n      symbol: input.symbol,\n      side: input.side,\n      type: input.type,\n      quantity: input.quantity,\n      price: input.price || null,\n      stopPrice: session=${input.sessionId} orderId=${orderId} PAPER_SIMULATION`);\n\n    return order;\n  }\n\n  async simulateFill(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    sessionId: string;\n    orderId: string;\n    marketPrice: string;\n    timestamp?: Date;\n  }): Promise<any | null> {\n    const order = await this.paperRepo.findPaperOrderById(input.orderId, input.tenantId);\n    if (!order) throw new   tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      order: {\n        orderId: order.orderId,\n        clientOrderId: order.clientOrderId,\n        symbol: order.symbol,\n        side: order.side,\n        type:
