   candle: {\n        open: input.marketPrice,\n        high: input.marketPrice,\n        low: input.marketPrice,\n        close: input.marketPrice,\n        openTime: new Date().toISOString(),\n        closeTime: new Date().toISOString(),\n      },\n      assumptions: {\n        fee: { makerFeeRate: '0.001', takerFeeRate: '0.001' },\n        slippage: { slippageBps: 5, slippageModel: 'FIXED' },\n        latency: { latencyMs: 100 },\n        execution: { type: 'MARKET', partialFills: true, minQuantity: null, tickSize: null, quantityStep: null, minNotional: null },\n      },\n      symbolMetadata: symbolMeta,\n    });\n\n    if (executionResult.rejected) {\n      await this.paperRepo.updatePaperOrderStatus(order.orderId, input.tenantId, 'REJECTED');\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    if (!executionResult.fill) return null;\n\n    // Create fill in paper fill table - never live order/fill records\n    const fill = await this.paperRepo.createPaperFill({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      sessionId: input.sessionId,\n      orderId: order.orderId,\n      fillId: executionResult.fill.fillId,\n      tradeId: `trade_${randomUUID().substring(0,8)}`,\n      symbol: order.symbol,\n      side: order.side,\n      quantity: executionResult.fill.quantity,\n      price: executionResult.fill.price,\n      fee: executionResult.fill.fee,\n      isMaker: executionResult.fill.isMaker,\n      timestamp: input.timestamp || new Date(),\n    });\n\n    // Update order as filled\n    await this.paperRepo.updatePaperOrderStatus(order.orderId, input.tenantId, 'FILLED', {\n      filledQuantity: executionResult.fill.quantity,\n      averageFillPrice: executionResult.fill.price,\n      fee: executionResult.fill.fee,\n    });\n\n    // Update session equity - simplified\n    try {\n      const session = await this.paperRepo.findSessionById(input.sessionId, input.tenantId);\n      if (session) {\n        const currentEquity = parseFloat(session.currentEquity || session.initialCapital);\n        const fee = parseFloat(executionResult.fill.fee);\n        // Simplified: just subtract fee for now\n        const newEquity = fee).toString() });\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    this.logger.log(`Paper order filled tenant=${input.tenantId} orderId=${order.orderId} fillId=${fill.fillId} price=${executionResult.fill.price} }\n\n  async listOrders(tenantId: string, sessionId: string, filters?: { status?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    return '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PaperTradingRepository } from './paper-trading-repository';\n\n/**\n * Aggregates paper session performance from simulated portfolio/order/fill records and exposes ACTUAL_SIMULATION status, never live performance.\n * Every result must clearly identify PAPER_SIMULATION\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class PaperPerformanceService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PaperPerformanceService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly paperRepo: PaperTradingRepository) {}\n\n  async getPerformance(tenantId: string, sessionId: string): Promise<{\n    sessionId: string;\n    tenantId: string;\n    initialCapital: string;\n    currentEquity: string | null;\n    realizedPnl: string;\n    unrealizedPnl: string | null;\n    totalReturn: string | null;\n    totalReturnPercent: string | null;\n    maxDrawdown: string | null;\n    maxDrawdownPercent: string | null;\n    tradeCount: number;\n    winCount: number;\n    lossCount: number;\n    winRate: string | null;\n    feesPaid: string;\n    exposure: string | null;\n    isSimulated: true;\n    status: string;\n    disclaimer: string;\n    source: string;\n  } | null> {\n    const session = await this.paperRepo.findSessionById(sessionId, tenantId);\n    if (!session) return null;\n\n    const fillsResult = await this.paperRepo.listPaperFills(tenantId, sessionId, { page: 1, limit: 10000 });\n    const fills = fillsResult.data;\n\n    const snapshots = await this.paperRepo.listSnapshots(tenantId, sessionId);\n\n    const initial = parseFloat(session.initialCapital);\n    const current = session.currentEquity ? parseFloat(session.currentEquity) : initial;\n\n    const totalReturn = (current - initial).toString();\n    const totalReturnPercent = initial > 0 ? (((current / initial) - 1) * 100).toString() : null;\n\n    // Calculate win/loss from fills - pair buys and sells FIFO\n    let winCount = 0;\n    let lossCount = 0;\n    let realizedPnl = 0;\n\n    const buys: { qty: number; price: number; cost: number }[] = [];\n\n    for (const fill of fills.sort((a:any,b:any) => new Date(a.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(b.timestamp).getTime())) {\n      const qty = parseFloat(fill.quantity);\n      const price = parseFloat(fill.price);\n      const fee = parseFloat(fill.fee || '0');\n      const notional = qty * price;\n\n      if (fill.side === 'BUY') {\n        buys.push({ qty, price, cost: notional + fee });\n      } else {\n        let remainingSellQty = qty;\n        let tradePnl = 0;\n        while (remainingSellQty > 0 && buys.length > 0) {\n          const buy = buys[0];\n          const matchedQty = Math.min(remainingSellQty, buy.qty);\n          const buyCost = (buy.cost / buy.qty) * matchedQty;\n          const sellProceeds = (notional / qty) * matchedQty;\n          const pnl = sellProceeds - buyCost - fee;\n          tradePnl += pnl;\n          realizedPnl += pnl;\n\n          buy.qty -= matchedQty;\n          if (buy.qty <= 0.00000001) buys.shift();\n          else buy.cost -= buyCost;\n\n          remainingSellQty -= matchedQty;\n        }\n\n        if (tradePnl > 0) winCount++;\n        else if (tradePnl < 0) lossCount++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const tradeCount = winCount + lossCount;\n    const winRate = tradeCount > 0 ? (winCount / tradeCount).toString() : null;\n\n    // Max drawdown from snapshots\n    let maxDrawdown: string | null = null;\n    let maxDrawdownPercent: string | null = null;\n    if (snapshots.length > 0) {\n      let peak = initial;\n      let maxDd = 0;\n      let maxDdPercent = 0;\n      for (const snap of snapshots) {\n        const eq = parseFloat(snap.equity);\n        if (eq > peak) peak = eq;\n        const dd = peak - eq;\n        if (dd > maxDd) {\n          maxDd = dd;\n          maxDdPercent = peak > 0 ? (dd / peak) * 100 : 0;\n        }\n      }\n      if (maxDd > 0) {\n        maxDrawdown = maxDd.toString();\n        maxDrawdownPercent = maxDdPercent.toString();\n      }\n    }\n\n    return {\n      sessionId,\n      tenantId,\n      initialCapital: session.initialCapital,\n      currentEquity: session.currentEquity || null,\n      realizedPnl: session.realizedPnl || realizedPnl.toString(),\n      unrealizedPnl: session.unrealizedPnl || null,\n      totalReturn,\n      totalReturnPercent,\n      maxDrawdown,\n      maxDrawdownPercent,\n      tradeCount,\n      winCount,\n      lossCount,\n      winRate,\n      feesPaid: session.feesPaid || '0',\n      exposure: null,\n      isSimulated: true,\n      status: 'PAPER_SIMULATION',\n      disclaimer: 'PAPER_SIMULATION: This is simulated paper trading performance, not live performance. Paper performance is not indicative of live performance; simulation does not guarantee real execution quality.',\n      source: 'PAPER_TRADING',\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getEquityCurve(tenantId: string, sessionId: string): Promise<any[]> {\n    const snapshots = await this.paperRepo.listSnapshots(tenantId, sessionId);\n    return snapshots.map((s:any) => ({\n      timestamp: new Date(s.timestamp).toISOString(),\n      sequence: s.sequence,\n      equity: s.equity,\n      cash: s.cash,\n      realizedPnl: s.realizedPnl,\n      unrealizedPnl: s.unrealizedPnl,\n      drawdown: s.drawdown,\n      isSimulated: true,\n    }));\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/research/paper-trading-repository.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":44,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\nimport { isRecordNotFound } from '../../common/errors/prisma-not-found';\n\n/**\n * Persistence abstraction for paper sessions, paper orders, paper fills, portfolio snapshots, and session lifecycle.\n * Keep paper data separated from live trading data.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class PaperTradingRepository {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PaperTradingRepository.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async createSession(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    strategyVersionId: string;\n    sessionIdentifier: string;\n    config?: Record<string, any>;\n    initialCapital: string;\n    symbols?: string[];\n    timeframe?: string;\n    expiresAt?: Date | null;\n    createdBy?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    if (input.idempotencyKey) {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).researchPaperSession.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    }\n\n    const existingByIdentifier = await (this.prisma as any).researchPaperSession.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, sessionIdentifier: input.sessionIdentifier } });\n    if (existingByIdentifier) return existingByIdentifier;\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const data = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n      status: 'CREATED',\n      sessionIdentifier: input.sessionIdentifier,\n      config: input.config || {},\n      initialCapital: input.initialCapital,\n      currentEquity: input.initialCapital,\n      symbols: input.symbols || [],\n      timeframe: input.timeframe || '1m',\n      realizedPnl: '0',\n      unrealizedPnl: null,\n      maxDrawdown: null,\n      feesPaid: '0',\n      isSimulated: true,\n      expiresAt: input.expiresAt || null,\n      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey || null,\n      createdBy: input.createdBy || null,\n      createdAt: new Date(),\n      updatedAt: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).researchPaperSession.create({ data });\n      this.logger.log(`Paper session created id=${created.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} identifier=${input.sessionIdentifier}`);\n      return created;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.code === 'P2002') {\n        const existing = await (this.prisma as any).researchPaperSession.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, sessionIdentifier: input.sessionIdentifier } });\n        if (existing) return existing;\n      }\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async findSessionById(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return (this.prisma as any).researchPaperSession.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId } }) || null;\n  }\n\n  async findSessionByIdentifier(tenantId: string, sessionIdentifier: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return (this.prisma as any).researchPaperSession.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, sessionIdentifier } }) || null;\n  }\n\n  async listSessions(tenantId: string, filters?: { strategyVersionId?: string; status?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, ...(filters?.strategyVersionId ? { strategyVersionId: filters.strategyVersionId } : {}), ...(filters?.status ? { status: filters.status } : {}) };\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).researchPaperSession.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).researchPaperSession.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  async updateSessionStatus(id: string, tenantId: string, status: string, extra?: { startedAt?: Date; stoppedAt?: Date; currentEquity?: string; realizedPnl?: string; unrealizedPnl?: string | null; maxDrawdown?: string | null; feesPaid?: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    try {\n      return await (this.prisma as any).researchPaperSession.update({ where: { id, tenantId }, data: { status, ...extra, updatedAt: new Date() } });\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Paper Orders - Never write paper orders into live order records\n  async createPaperOrder(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    sessionId: string;\n    orderId: string;\n    clientOrderId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    side: string;\n    type: string;\n    quantity: string;\n    price?: string | null;\n    stopPrice?: string | null;\n    status?: string;\n Logger(PaperTradingService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly paperRepo: PaperTradingRepository,\n    private readonly researchRepo: ResearchRepository,\n    private readonly policyService: ResearchPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createSession(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    strategyVersionId: string;\n    initialCapital: string;\n    symbols?: string[];\n    timeframe?: string;\n    config?: Record<string, any>;\n    expiresAt?: Date | null;\n    createdBy?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    // Validate strategy version exists and is at least FROZEN\n    const strategyVersion = await this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(input.strategyVersionId, input.tenantId);\n    if (!strategyVersion) throw new Error(`Strategy version ${input.strategyVersionId} not found`);\n    if (!['FROZEN','PUBLISHED'].includes(strategyVersion.status)) throw new Error(`Strategy version must be FROZEN/PUBLISHED to start paper trading, current=${strategyVersion.status}`);\n\n    // Validate initial capital Decimal-safe\n    if (!/^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/.test(input.initialCapital)) throw new Error('initialCapital must be valid decimal string');\n    if (parseFloat(input.initialCapital) <= 0) throw new Error('initialCapital must be positive');\n\n    const sessionIdentifier = `paper_${input.strategyVersionId.substring(0,8)}_${Date.now()}_${randomUUID().substring(0,6)}`;\n\n    const session = await this.paperRepo.createSession({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n      sessionIdentifier,\n      config: input.config || {},\n      initialCapital: input.initialCapital,\n      symbols: input.symbols || [],\n      timeframe: input.timeframe || '1m',\n      expiresAt: input.expiresAt || null,\n      createdBy: input.createdBy || null,\n      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey || null,\n    });\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      event: 'PAPER_SESSION_CREATED',\n      actorId: input.createdBy || null,\n      strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n      paperSessionId: session.id,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { sessionIdentifier, initialCapital: input.initialCapital, symbols: input.symbols },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Paper session created id=${session.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} strategyVersion=${input.strategyVersionId}`);\n\n    return session;\n  }\n\n  async startSession(tenantId: string, sessionId: string, actorId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const session = await this.paperRepo.findSessionById(sessionId, tenantId);\n    if (!session) return null;\n\n    if (session.status !== 'CREATED') throw new Error(`Only CREATED session can be started, current=${session.status}`);\n\n    const updated = await this.paperRepo.updateSessionStatus(sessionId, tenantId, 'RUNNING', { startedAt: new Date() });\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId,\n      event: 'PAPER_SESSION_STARTED',\n      actorId,\n      strategyVersionId: session.strategyVersionId,\n      paperSessionId: sessionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { sessionIdentifier: session.sessionIdentifier },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Paper session started id=${sessionId} tenant=${tenantId} PAPER_SIMULATION`);\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async pauseSession(tenantId: string, sessionId: string, actorId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const session = await this.paperRepo.findSessionById(sessionId, tenantId);\n    if (!session) return null;\n    if (session.status !== 'RUNNING') throw new Error(`Only RUNNING session can be paused, current=${session.status}`);\n\n    const updated = await this.paperRepo.updateSessionStatus(sessionId, tenantId, 'PAUSED');\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId,\n      event: 'PAPER_SESSION_PAUSED',\n      actorId,\n      strategyVersionId: session.strategyVersionId,\n      paperSessionId: sessionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: {},\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async resumeSession(tenantId: string, sessionId: string, actorId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const session = await this.paperRepo.findSessionById(sessionId, tenantId);\n    if (!session) return null;\n    if (session.status !== 'PAUSED') throw new Error(`Only PAUSED session can be resumed, current=${session.status}`);\n\n    const updated = await this.paperRepo.updateSessionStatus(sessionId, tenantId, 'RUNNING');\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId,\n      event: 'PAPER_SESSION_RESUMED',\n      actorId,\n      strategyVersionId: session.strategyVersionId,\n      paperSessionId: sessionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: {},\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async stopSession(tenantId: string, sessionId: string, actorId: string, reason?: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const session = await this.paperRepo.findSessionById(sessionId, tenantId);\n    if (!session) return null;\n\n    if (['STOPPED','FAILED','EXPIRED'].includes(session.status)) throw new Error(`Session already ${session.status}`);\n\n    const updated = await this.paperRepo.updateSessionStatus(sessionId, tenantId, 'STOPPED', { stoppedAt: new Date() });\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId,\n      event: 'PAPER_SESSION_STOPPED',\n      actorId,\n      strategyVersionId: session.strategyVersionId,\n      paperSessionId: sessionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { reason: reason || 'Manual stop' },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Paper session stopped id=${sessionId} tenant=${tenantId} reason=${reason}`);\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async getSession(tenantId: string, sessionId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return this.paperRepo.findSessionById(sessionId, tenantId);\n  }\n\n  async listSessions(tenantId: string, filters?: { strategyVersionId?: string; status?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    return this.paperRepo.listSessions(tenantId, filters);\n  }\n\n  async checkMinimumDuration(tenantId: string, sessionId: string): Promise<{ meets: boolean; durationMinutes: number; requiredMinutes: number }> {\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getPolicy(tenantId);\n    const session = await this.paperRepo.findSessionById(sessionId, tenantId);\n    if (!session) throw new Error('Session not found');\n\n    const start = session.startedAt ? new Date(session.startedAt).getTime() : new Date(session.createdAt).getTime();\n    const end = session.stoppedAt ? new Date(session.stoppedAt).getTime() : Date.now();\n    const durationMinutes = (end - start) / (1000*60);\n\n    return { meets: durationMinutes >= policy.paperTradingMinimumDurationMinutes, durationMinutes, requiredMinutes: policy.paperTradingMinimumDurationMinutes };\n Parameter selection must remain separate from production strategy publication.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ParameterSweepService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ParameterSweepService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly backtestRepo: BacktestRepository,\n    private readonly researchRepo: ResearchRepository,\n    private readonly backtestEngine: BacktestEngineService,\n    private readonly policyService: ResearchPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private fingerprintParams(params: Record<string, any>): string {\n    const hash = createHash('sha256');\n    hash.update(JSON.stringify(params, Object.keys(params).sort()));\n    return hash.digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  private generateCombinations(paramRanges: Record<string, any[]>): Record<string, any>[] {\n    const keys = Object.keys(paramRanges);\n    const combinations: Record<string, any>[] = [];\n\n    const recurse = (index: number, current: Record<string, any>) => {\n      if (index === keys.length) {\n        combinations.push({ ...current });\n        return;\n      }\n      const key = keys[index];\n      const values = paramRanges[key];\n      for (const val of values) {\n        current[key] = val;\n        recurse(index+1, current);\n      }\n    };\n\n    recurse(0, {});\n    return combinations;\n  }\n\n  async runParameterSweep(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    strategyVersionId: string;\n    symbols: string[];\n    timeframe: string;\n    startTime: string;\n    endTime: string;\n    initialCapital: string;\n    paramRanges: Record<string, any[]>;\n    concurrency?: number;\n    createdBy?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<{ sweepId: string; combinations: number; results: any[]; bestResult: any | null; ranking: string[]; overfittingRisk: string | null }> {\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getPolicy(input.tenantId);\n    const combinations = this.generateCombinations(input.paramRanges);\n\n    if (combinations.length > policy.maxParameterCombinations) throw new Error(`Parameter combinations ${combinations.length} exceeds max ${policy.maxParameterCombinations}`);\n    if (combinations.length === 0) throw new Error('No parameter combinations generated');\n\n    const concurrency = Math.min(input.concurrency || 3, policy.maxBacktestConcurrency);\n    const sweepId = `sweep_${randomUUID().substring(0,8)}_${Date.now()}`;\n\n    const results: { parameters: Record<string, any>; metrics: Record<string, any>; fingerprint: string; runId: string }[] = [];\n\n    // Bounded concurrency - process in batches\n    for (let i=0; i<combinations.length; i+=concurrency) {\n      const batch = combinations.slice(i, i+concurrency);\n      const batchPromises = batch.map(async (params) => {\n        const fingerprint = this.fingerprintParams(params);\n        try {\n          const run = await this.backtestEngine.runBacktest({\n            tenantId: input.tenantId,\n            strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n            symbols: input.symbols,\n            timeframe: input.timeframe,\n            startTime: input.startTime,\n            endTime: input.endTime,\n            initialCapital: input.initialCapital,\n            createdBy: input.createdBy || null,\n            idempotencyKey: `sweep_${sweepId}_${fingerprint}`,\n          });\n\n          // Merge sweep params into run config for tracking\n          return { parameters: params, metrics: run.metrics || {}, fingerprint, runId: run.id };\n        } catch (e: any) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Parameter sweep combination failed fingerprint=${fingerprint} error=${e.message}`);\n          return { parameters: params, metrics: { error: e.message }, fingerprint, runId: '' };\n        }\n      });\n\n      const batchResults = await Promise.all(batchPromises);\n      results.push(...batchResults);\n    }\n\n    // Ranking by totalReturn\n    const ranked = [...results].sort((a,b) => {\n      const aRet = parseFloat(a.metrics.totalReturn || a.metrics.totalReturnPercent || '0');\n      const bRet = parseFloat(b.metrics.totalReturn || b.metrics.totalReturnPercent || '0');\n      return bRet - aRet;\n    });\n\n    const bestResult = ranked.length > 0 ? ranked[0] : null;\n\n    // Overfitting safeguards - if best is much better than median, flag risk\n    let overfittingRisk: string | null = null;\n    if (ranked.length >= 10) {\n      const returns = ranked.map(r => parseFloat(r.metrics.totalReturn || '0')).filter(n => !isNaN(n));\n      if (returns.length > 0) {\n        const median = returns[Math.floor(returns.length/2)];\n        const best = returns[0];\n        if (median !== 0 && best / median > 3) {\n          overfittingRisk = `Best result ${best} is ${(best/median).toFixed(1)}x median ${median} - high overfitting risk. Do not automatically promote highest historical result.`;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    const ranking = ranked.map(r => r.fingerprint);\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      event: 'PARAMETER_SWEEP_COMPLETED',\n      actorId: input.createdBy || null,\n      strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { sweepId, combinations: combinations.length, bestFingerprint: bestResult?.fingerprint, overfittingRisk },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Parameter sweep completed sweepId=${sweepId} tenant=${input.tenantId} combinations=${combinations.length} best=${bestResult?.fingerprint}`);\n\n    return { sweepId, combinations: combinations.length, results, bestResult, ranking, overfittingRisk };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/research/research-audit.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any.    safeMetadata: this.sanitizeMetadata(metadata),\n    });\n  }\n\n  private sanitizeMetadata(metadata: Record<string, any>): Record<string, any> {\n    const forbidden = ['secret','apiKey','apiSecret','passphrase','privateKey','token','password','credential'];\n    const sanitized: Record<string, any> = {};\n    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(metadata)) {\n '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { ResearchRepository } from './research-repository';\nimport { BacktestRepository } from './backtest-repository';\nimport { PaperTradingRepository } from './paper-trading-repository';\nimport { ResearchPolicyService } from './research-policy.service';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Controls research → paper → publish/promotion workflow with explicit validation requirements and existing compliance/risk/live-gate checks.\n * Required progression: Strategy Version → Backtest Validation → Out-of-Sample Validation → Optional Paper Trading → Risk Review → Compliance Review → Existing Strategy Validation → Publish\n * For live execution: Promotion → Existing Live Enablement Gate → Copy-Trading → Exchange Routing → Execution Engine\n * Never: profitable backtest → automatically enable live trading\n * \n * Reuses: strategy system, trader profiles, copy-trading, execution engine, exchange registry, symbol metadata, accounts, risk, compliance, fees, usage, audit, notifications, security, live gate\n * No second engine/order source/fill source/account source/PnL source\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ResearchPromotionService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ResearchPromotionService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly researchRepo: ResearchRepository,\n    private readonly backtestRepo: BacktestRepository,\n    private readonly paperRepo: PaperTradingRepository,\n    private readonly policyService: ResearchPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async createPromotionRequest(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    strategyVersionId: string;\n    backtestRunId?: string | null;\n    paperSessionId?: string | null;\n    requestedBy?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const strategyVersion = await tenantId,\n      event: 'RESEARCH_PROMOTION_REQUESTED',\n      actorId,\n      strategyVersionId: promotion.strategyVersionId,\n      promotionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: {         const backtestRun = await this.backtestRepo.findById(promotion.backtestRunId, tenantId);\n          if (!backtestRun || backtestRun.status !== 'COMPLETED') throw new Error('Backtest validation checklist.outOfSampleValidation = true;\n        nextState = 'PENDING_PAPER_TRADING';\n        break;\n        \n      case 'PAPER_TRADING':\n        if (promotion.state !== 'PENDING_PAPER_TRADING') \n          // Check KYC/AML if required\n          const kycProfile = await (this.prisma as any).kycProfile?.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, status: { notIn: ['APPROVED'] } } });\n          if \n      case 'PUBLICATION':\n        if (promotion.state !== 'PENDING_PUBLICATION') throw new Error(`Invalid state for publication: ${promotion.state}`);\n        // Existing strategy validation - promoteToProduction(tenantId: string, promotionId: string, actorId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const promotion = await (this.prisma as any).researchPromotionRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: reuse existing compliance`);\n\n      // Check risk halted - reuse existing risk module\n      const riskConfig = await (this.prisma as any).riskConfiguration?.findFirst({ where: { tenantId } });\n      if (riskConfig && riskConfig.tradingHalted) {\n        throw new Error('Risk trading halted - live gate blocks promotion');\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.message.includes('Kill switch') || e.message.includes('live') || e.message.includes('Compliance') || e.message.includes('Risk')) throw e;\n    }\n\n    // Publish strategy version - no second engine\n    try {\n      if (strategyVersion.traderStrategyId) {\n        const traderStrategy = await (this.prisma as any).traderStrategy?.findFirst({ \n          where: { id: strategyVersion.traderStrategyId, tenantId } \n        });\n        if (traderStrategy) {\n          this.logger.log(`Research promotion handoff to copy-trading traderStrategyId=${strategyVersion.traderStrategyId} tenant=${tenantId} - exchange routing validation`);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Exchange routing validation failed tenant=${tenantId} error=${e.message}`);\n    }\n\n    const promoted = await (this.prisma as any).researchPromotionRequest.update({\n      where: { id: promotionId, tenantId },\n      data: { state: 'PROMOTED', reviewedBy: actorId, reviewedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() },\n    });\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId,\n      event: 'RESEARCH_PROMOTION_PROMOTED',\n      actorId,\n      strategyVersionId: promotion.strategyVersionId,\n      promotionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { \n        strategyVersion: strategyVersion.version, \n        fingerprint: strategyVersion.fingerprint,\n        liveGateChecked: true,\n        copyTradingHandoff: true,\n        exchangeRoutingChecked: true,\n        disclaimer: 'Promotion does not auto-enable live trading. auditable');\n\n    const updated = await (this.prisma as any).researchPromotionRequest.update({\n      where: { id: promotionId, tenantId },\n      data: { state: 'REJECTED', reviewedBy: reviewerId, reviewedAt: new Date(), reason: reason.trim(), updatedAt: new Date() },\n    });\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId,\n      event: 'RESEARCH_PROMOTION_REJECTED',\n      actorId: reviewerId,\n      strategyVersionId: promotion.strategyVersionId,\n      promotionId,\n      result: 'REJECTED',\n      safeMetadata: { reason: reason.trim().substring(0, 500) },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Promotion rejected tenant=${tenantId} promotion=${promotionId} reason=${reason.substring(0,100)}`);\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async getPromotion(tenantId: string, promotionId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return (this.prisma as any).researchPromotionRequest.findFirst({ where: { id: promotionId, tenantId } }) || null;\n  }\n\n  async listPromotions(tenantId: string, filters?: { strategyVersionId?: string; state?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = Math.min(filters?.limit || 20, 100);\n    const skip = (page - '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { randomUUID, createHash } from 'crypto';\nimport { ResearchDatasetStatus, ResearchStrategyVersionStatus } from './research.types';\nimport { isRecordNotFound } from '../../common/errors/prisma-not-found';\n\n/**\n * Persistence abstraction for research project, strategy version reference, dataset metadata, backtest run, metrics, validation state, promotion state, and result references with tenant isolation.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ResearchRepository {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ResearchRepository.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  // Datasets\n  async createDataset(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    name: string;\n    description?: string | null;\n    venue: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    timeframe: string;\n    timezone?: string;\n    source: string;\n    sourceMetadata?: Record<string, any>;\n    startTime: Date;\n    endTime: Date;\n    fingerprint: string;\n    checksum?: string | null;\n    status?: ResearchDatasetStatus;\n    recordCount?: number;\n    gapCount?: number;\n    duplicateCount?: number;\n    validationResult?: Record<string, any> | null;\n    qualityScore?: number | null;\n    createdBy?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    if (input.idempotencyKey) {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).researchDataset.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    }\n\n    const existingByFingerprint = await (this.prisma as any).researchDataset.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, fingerprint: input.fingerprint } });\n    if (existingByFingerprint) {\n      this.logger.log(`Dataset idempotent by fingerprint tenant=${input.tenantId} fp=${input.fingerprint}`);\n      return existingByFingerprint;\n    }\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const data = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      name: input.name,\n      description: input.description || null,\n      venue: input.venue,\n      symbol: input.symbol,\n      timeframe: input.timeframe,\n      timezone: input.timezone || 'UTC',\n      source: input.source,\n      sourceMetadata: input.sourceMetadata || {},\n      startTime: input.startTime,\n      endTime: input.endTime,\n      fingerprint: input.fingerprint,\n      checksum: input.checksum || null,\n      status: input.status || 'DRAFT',\n      recordCount: input.recordCount || 0,\n      gapCount: input.gapCount || 0,\n      duplicateCount: input.duplicateCount || 0,\n      validationResult: input.validationResult || null,\n      qualityScore: input.qualityScore || null,\n      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey || null,\n      createdBy: input.createdBy || null,\n      createdAt: new Date(),\n      updatedAt: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).researchDataset.create({ data });\n      this.logger.log(`Research dataset created id=${created.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} fingerprint=${input.fingerprint}`);\n      return created;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.code === 'P2002') {\n        const existing = await (this.prisma as any).researchDataset.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, fingerprint: input.fingerprint } });\n        if (existing) return existing;\n      }\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async findDatasetById(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return (this.prisma as any).researchDataset.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId, deletedAt: null } }) || null;\n  }\n\n  async findDatasetByFingerprint(tenantId: string, fingerprint: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return (this.prisma as any).researchDataset.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, fingerprint, deletedAt: null } }) || null;\n  }\n\n  async listDatasets(tenantId: string, filters?: { venue?: string; symbol?: string; timeframe?: string; status?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const skip = (page - 1) * limit;\n    const where: any = { tenantId, deletedAt: null, ...(filters?.venue ? { venue: filters.venue } : {}), ...(filters?.symbol ? { symbol: filters.symbol } : {}), ...(filters?.timeframe ? { timeframe: filters.timeframe } : {}), ...(filters?.status ? { status: filters.status } : {}) };\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).researchDataset.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip, take: limit }),\n      (this.prisma as any).researchDataset.count({ where }),\n    ]);\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  async updateDatasetStatus(id: string, tenantId: string, status: ResearchDatasetStatus, validationResult?: Record<string, any> | null): Promise<any | null> {\n    try {\n      return await (this.prisma as any).researchDataset.update({ where: { id, tenantId }, data: { status, validationResult, updatedAt: new Date() } });\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Strategy Versions\n  async createStrategyVersion(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    strategyId?: string | null;\n    traderStrategyId?: string | null;\n    definitionId?: string | null;\n    version: string;\n    name: string;\n    description?: string | null;\n    logicHash: string;\n    configHash: string;\n    fingerprint: string;\n    parameters?: Record<string, any>;\n    riskProfile?: Record<string, any>;\n    executionModel?: Record<string, any>;\n    parentVersionId?: string | null;\n    changeNote?: string | null;\n    createdBy?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    if (input.idempotencyKey) {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).researchStrategyVersion.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existing) return existing;\n    }\n\n    const existingFp = await (this.prisma as any).researchStrategyVersion.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, fingerprint: input.fingerprint } });\n    if (existingFp) return existingFp;\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const data = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      strategyId: input.strategyId || null,\n      traderStrategyId: input.traderStrategyId || null,\n      definitionId: input.definitionId || null,\n      version: input.version,\n      name: input.name,\n      description: input.description || null,\n      status: 'DRAFT',\n      logicHash: input.logicHash,\n      configHash: input.configHash,\n      fingerprint: input.fingerprint,\n      parameters: input.parameters || {},\n      riskProfile: input.riskProfile || {},\n      executionModel: input.executionModel || {},\n      parentVersionId: input.parentVersionId || null,\n      changeNote: input.changeNote || null,\n      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey || null,\n      createdBy: input.createdBy || null,\n      createdAt: new Date(),\n      updatedAt: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).researchStrategyVersion.create({ data });\n      this.logger.log(`Research strategy version created id=${created.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} version=${input.version}`);\n      return created;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.code === 'P2002') {\n        const existing = await (this.prisma as any).researchStrategyVersion.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, fingerprint: Request, BadRequestException, NotFoundException, ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { StrategyVersionService } from './strategy-version.service';\nimport { MarketDataService } from './market-data-service';\nimport { MarketDataProviderFactory } from './market-data-provider.factory';\nimport { DatasetValidationService } from './dataset-validation.service';\nimport { ResearchRepository } from './research-repository';\nimport { BacktestRepository } from './backtest-repository';\nimport { BacktestEngineService } from './backtest-engine.service';\nimport { BacktestConfigService } from './backtest-config.service';\nimport { WalkForwardService } from './walk-forward.service';\nimport { MonteCarloService } from './monte-carlo.service';\nimport { ParameterSweepService } from './parameter-sweep.service';\nimport { StrategyBenchmarkService } from './strategy-benchmark.service';\nimport { PaperTradingService } from './paper-trading.service';\nimport { PaperOrderService } from './paper-order.service';\nimport { PaperPerformanceService } from './paper-performance.service';\nimport { SignalService } from './signal.service';\nimport { SignalFilterService } from './signal-filter.service';\nimport { ResearchPromotionService } from './research-promotion.service';\nimport { PaperTradingRepository } from './paper-trading-repository';\nimport { CreateDatasetDto, CreateStrategyVersionDto, CreateBacktestDto, WalkForwardDto, MonteCarloDto, ParameterSweepDto, BenchmarkDto, CreatePaperSessionDto, CreatePaperOrderDto, CreateSignalDto, CreatePromotionDto, PromotionActionDto } from './dto/backtest.dto';\nimport { authRoles, authTenantId, authUserIdOrNull, hasAdminRole } from '../../common/guards/request-principal';\nimport { Permission } from '@wlct/shared-types';\nimport { RequireAnyPermission, RequirePermissions } from '../../common/decorators/permissions.decorator';\nimport { boundedIntParam, limitParam, pageParam } from '../../common/dto/pagination-params';\n\n/**\n * RBAC/tenant-protected API for research, datasets, strategy versions, backtests, paper sessions, signals, and promotion actions.\n */\n/**\n * Research surface: datasets, market data, strategy versions, backtests,\n * paper sessions, signals and promotions.\n *\n * The controller carried no permission metadata, so a follower could ingest\n * datasets, run backtests, publish strategy versions and signals, or read any\n * trader's strategy versions in the tenant. Permissions now follow the RBAC\n * matrix: dataset:read/ingest/validate, backtest:read/submit,\n * paper_session:read/operate; strategy versions, signals and promotions need\n * strategy:manage to change (class default) and strategy:manage or\n * compliance:read to read (strategy_version:read is deliberately not used:\n * followers hold it, and versions carry the strategy configuration).\n * Promotion approve/reject/promote need trading:manage on top of the\n * existing in-handler admin-role check.\n */\n@RequirePermissions(Permission.STRATEGY_MANAGE)\n@Controller('research')\nexport class ResearchController {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly strategyVersionService: StrategyVersionService,\n    private readonly marketDataService: MarketDataService,\n    private readonly providerFactory: MarketDataProviderFactory,\n    private readonly datasetValidation: DatasetValidationService,\n    private readonly researchRepo: ResearchRepository,\n    private readonly backtestRepo: BacktestRepository,\n    private readonly backtestEngine: BacktestEngineService,\n    private readonly backtestConfigService: BacktestConfigService,\n    private readonly walkForwardService: WalkForwardService,\n    private readonly monteCarloService: MonteCarloService,\n    private readonly parameterSweepService: ParameterSweepService,\n    private readonly benchmarkService: StrategyBenchmarkService,\n    private readonly paperTradingService: PaperTradingService,\n    private readonly paperOrderService: PaperOrderService,\n    private readonly paperPerformanceService: PaperPerformanceService,\n    private readonly signalService: SignalService,\n    private readonly signalFilterService: SignalFilterService,\n    private readonly promotionService: ResearchPromotionService,\n    private readonly paperRepo: PaperTradingRepository,\n  ) {}\n\n  private getContext(req: any): { tenantId: string; userId: string; roles: string[] } {\n    // Token tenant only; a header can never select the tenant.\n    const tenantId = authTenantId(req);\n    const userId = authUserIdOrNull(req);\n    const roles = authRoles(req);\n    if (!userId) throw new BadRequestException('userId required');\n    return { tenantId, userId, roles };\n  }\n\n  private isAdmin(roles: string[]): boolean {\n    return hasAdminRole(roles, ['research_admin']);\n  }\n\n  // Datasets\n  @Post('datasets')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.DATASET_INGEST)\n  async createDataset(@Request() req: any, @Body() dto: CreateDatasetDto) {\n    const { tenantId, userId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const fingerprint = this.researchRepo.computeFingerprint({ venue: dto.venue, symbol: dto.symbol, timeframe: dto.timeframe, startTime: dto.startTime, endTime: dto.endTime, source: dto.source });\n    const dataset = await this.researchRepo.createDataset({\n      tenantId,\n      name: dto.name,\n      description: dto.description || null,\n      venue: dto.venue,\n      symbol: dto.symbol,\n      timeframe: dto.timeframe,\n      timezone: dto.timezone || 'UTC',\n      source: dto.source,\n      sourceMetadata: dto.sourceMetadata || {},\n      startTime: new Date(dto.startTime),\n      endTime: new Date(dto.endTime),\n      fingerprint,\n      checksum: null,\n      status: 'DRAFT' as any,\n      recordCount: 0,\n      createdBy: userId,\n      idempotencyKey: dto.idempotencyKey || null,\n    });\n    return dataset;\n  }\n\n  @Get('datasets')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.DATASET_READ)\n  async listDatasets(@Request() req: any, @Query() query: any) {\n    const { tenantId } = this.getContext(req);\n    return this.researchRepo.listDatasets(tenantId, { venue: query.venue, symbol: query.symbol, timeframe: query.timeframe, status: query.status, page: pageParam(query.page), limit: limitParam(query.limit, 20) });\n  }\n\n  @Get('datasets/:datasetId')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.DATASET_READ)\n  async getDataset(@Request() req: any, @Param('datasetId') datasetId: string) {\n    const { tenantId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const dataset = await this.researchRepo.findDatasetById(datasetId, tenantId);\n    if (!dataset) throw new NotFoundException('Dataset not found');\n    return dataset;\n  }\n\n  @Post('datasets/:datasetId/validate')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.DATASET_VALIDATE)\n  async validateDataset(@Request() req: any, @Param('datasetId') datasetId: string) {\n    const { tenantId, userId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const dataset = await this.researchRepo.findDatasetById(datasetId, tenantId);\n    if (!dataset) throw new NotFoundException('Dataset not found');\n\n    // Try to get candles for validation\n    try {\n      const marketData = await this.marketDataService.getCandles({\n        tenantId,\n        venue: dataset.venue,\n        symbol: dataset.symbol,\n        timeframe: dataset.timeframe,\n        startTime: new Date(dataset.startTime).toISOString(),\n        endTime: new Date(dataset.endTime).toISOString(),\n        source: dataset.source,\n      });\n\n      const validation = await this.datasetValidation.validateCandles({\n        candles: marketData.candles,\n        expectedSymbol: dataset.symbol,\n        expectedVenue: dataset.venue,\n        expectedTimeframe: dataset.timeframe,\n      });\n\n      const status = validation.isValid ? (validation.status === 'WARNING' ? 'VALID' : 'VALID') : 'INVALID';\n\n      const updated = await this.researchRepo.updateDatasetStatus(datasetId, tenantId, status as any, validation as any);\n\n      await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n        tenantId,\n        event: validation.isValid ? 'DATASET_VALIDATED' : 'DATASET_REJECTED',\n        actorId: userId,\n        datasetId,\n        result: validation.isValid ? 'SUCCESS' : 'FAILURE',\n        safeMetadata: { qualityScore: validation.qualityScore, recordCount: validation.recordCount, issues: validation.issues.length },\n      });\n\n      return { dataset: updated, validation };\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      await this.researchRepo.updateDatasetStatus(datasetId, tenantId, 'INVALID' as any, { error: e.message });\n      throw new BadRequestException(`Dataset validation failed: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  @Get('market-data/providers')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.DATASET_READ)\n  async listProviders(@Request() req: any) {\n    this.getContext(req);\n    return this.providerFactory.listProviders();\n  }\n\n  @Get('market-data/candles')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.DATASET_READ)\n  async getCandles(@Request() req: any, @Query() query: any) {\n    const { tenantId } = this.getContext(req);\n    if (!query.venue || !query.symbol || !query.timeframe || !query.startTime || !query.endTime) throw new BadRequestException('venue, symbol, timeframe, startTime, endTime required');\n    return this.marketDataService.getCandles({\n      tenantId,\n      venue: query.venue,\n      symbol: query.symbol,\n      timeframe: query.timeframe,\n      startTime: query.startTime,\n      endTime: query.endTime,\n      source: query.source,\n      limit: boundedIntParam(query.limit, 'limit', 1, 1000),\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Strategy Versions\n  @Post('strategy-versions')\n  async createStrategyVersion(@Request() req: any, @Body() dto: CreateStrategyVersionDto) {\n    const { tenantId, userId } = this.getContext(req);\n    return this.strategyVersionService.createDraftVersion({\n      tenantId,\n      strategyId: dto.strategyId || null,\n      traderStrategyId: dto.traderStrategyId || null,\n      definitionId: dto.definitionId || null,\n      version: dto.version,\n      name: dto.name,\n      description: dto.description || null,\n      parameters: dto.parameters,\n      riskProfile: dto.riskProfile,\n      executionModel: dto.executionModel,\n      logic: dto.logic,\n      parentVersionId: dto.parentVersionId || null,\n      changeNote: dto.changeNote || null,\n      createdBy: userId,\n      idempotencyKey: dto.idempotencyKey || null,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('strategy-versions')\n  @RequireAnyPermission(Permission.STRATEGY_MANAGE, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async listStrategyVersions(@Request() req: any, @Query() query: any) {\n    const { tenantId } = this.getContext(req);\n    return this.strategyVersionService.listVersions(tenantId, { strategyId: query.strategyId, status: query.status, page: pageParam(query.page), limit: limitParam(query.limit, 20) });\n  }\n\n  @Get('strategy-versions/:versionId')\n  @RequireAnyPermission(Permission.STRATEGY_MANAGE, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async getStrategyVersion(@Request() req: any, @Param('versionId') versionId: string) {\n    const { tenantId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const version = await this.strategyVersionService.getVersion(tenantId, versionId);\n    if (!version) throw new NotFoundException('Strategy version not found');\n    return version;\n  }\n\n  @Put('strategy-versions/:versionId')\n  async updateStrategyVersion(@Request() req: any, @Param('versionId') versionId: string, @Body() body: any) {\n    const { tenantId, userId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const updated = await this.strategyVersionService.updateDraft(tenantId, versionId, userId, body);\n    if (!updated) throw new NotFoundException('Strategy version not found');\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  @Post('strategy-versions/:versionId/validate')\n  async validateStrategyVersion(@Request() req: any, @Param('versionId') versionId: string) {\n    const { tenantId, userId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const validated = await this.strategyVersionService.validateVersion(tenantId, versionId, userId);\n    if (!validated) throw new NotFoundException('Strategy version not found');\n    return validated;\n  }\n\n  @Post('strategy-versions/:versionId/freeze')\n  async freezeStrategyVersion(@Request() req: any, @Param('versionId') versionId: string) {\n    const { tenantId, userId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const frozen = await this.strategyVersionService.freezeVersion(tenantId, versionId, userId);\n    if (!frozen) throw new NotFoundException('Strategy version not found');\n    return frozen;\n  }\n\n  @Post('strategy-versions/:versionId/publish')\n  async publishStrategyVersion(@Request() req: any, @Param('versionId') versionId: string) {\n    const { tenantId, userId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const published = await this.strategyVersionService.publishVersion(tenantId, versionId, userId);\n    if (!published) throw new NotFoundException('Strategy version not found');\n    return published;\n  }\n\n  @Post('strategy-versions/:versionId/deprecate')\n  async deprecateStrategyVersion(@Request() req: any, @Param('versionId') versionId: string) {\n    const { tenantId, userId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const deprecated = await this.strategyVersionService.deprecateVersion(tenantId, versionId, userId);\n    if (!deprecated) throw new NotFoundException('Strategy version not found');\n    return deprecated;\n  }\n\n  @Get('strategy-versions/:versionId/compare/:otherVersionId')\n  @RequireAnyPermission(Permission.STRATEGY_MANAGE, Permission.COMPLIANCE_READ)\n  async compareVersions(@Request() req: any, @Param('versionId') versionId: string, @Param('otherVersionId') otherVersionId: string) {\n    const { tenantId } = this.getContext(req);\n    return this.strategyVersionService.compareVersions(tenantId, versionId, otherVersionId);\n  }\n\n  // Backtests\n  @Post('backtests')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.BACKTEST_SUBMIT)\n  async createBacktest(@Request() req: any, @Body() dto: CreateBacktestDto) {\n    const { tenantId, userId } = this.getContext(req);\n    return this.backtestEngine.runBacktest({\n      tenantId,\n      strategyVersionId: dto.strategyVersionId,\n      symbols: dto.symbols,\n      timeframe: dto.timeframe,\n      startTime: dto.startTime,\n      endTime: dto.endTime,\n      initialCapital: dto.initialCapital,\n      quoteCurrency: dto.quoteCurrency,\n      feeAssumption: dto.feeAssumption,\n      slippageAssumption: dto.slippageAssumption,\n      latencyAssumption: dto.latencyAssumption,\n      leverage: dto.leverage || null,\n      benchmark: dto.benchmark || null,\n      executionModel: dto.executionModel,\n      datasetId: dto.datasetId || null,\n      datasetFingerprint: dto.datasetFingerprint || null,\n      createdBy: userId,\n      idempotencyKey: dto.idempotencyKey || null,\n    });\n  }\n\n  @Get('backtests')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.BACKTEST_READ)\n  async listBacktests(@Request() req: any, @Query() query: any) {\n    const { tenantId } = this.getContext(req);\n    return this.backtestEngine.listRuns(tenantId, { strategyVersionId: query.strategyVersionId, status: query.status, page: pageParam(query.page), limit: limitParam(query.limit, 20) });\n  }\n\n  @Get('backtests/:runId')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.BACKTEST_READ)\n  async getBacktest(@Request() req: any, @Param('runId') runId: string) {\n    const { tenantId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const run = await this.backtestEngine.getRun(tenantId, runId);\n    if (!run) throw new NotFoundException('Backtest run not found');\n    return run;\n  }\n\n  @Get('backtests/:runId/trades')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.BACKTEST_READ)\n  async listBacktestTrades(@Request() req: any, @Param('runId') runId: string, @Query() query: any) {\n    const { tenantId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const run = await this.backtestEngine.getRun(tenantId, runId);\n    if (!run) throw new NotFoundException('Backtest run not found');\n    return this.backtestRepo.listTrades(tenantId, runId, { page: pageParam(query.page), limit: limitParam(query.limit, 100) });\n  }\n\n  @Get('backtests/:runId/equity-curve')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.BACKTEST_READ)\n  async getBacktestEquityCurve(@Request() req: any, @Param('runId') runId: string) {\n    const { tenantId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const run = await this.backtestEngine.getRun(tenantId, runId);\n    if (!run) throw new NotFoundException('Backtest run not found');\n    const snapshots = await this.backtestRepo.listSnapshots(tenantId, runId);\n    return { equityCurve: run.equityCurve || snapshots, metrics: run.metrics, resultSummary: run.resultSummary, isSimulated: true, disclaimer: 'Simulated result. Backtest performance is not indicative of future performance.' };\n  }\n\n  @Get('backtests/:runId/metrics')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.BACKTEST_READ)\n  async getBacktestMetrics(@Request() req: any, @Param('runId') runId: string) {\n    const { tenantId } = this.getContext(req);\n    const run = await this.backtestEngine.getRun(tenantId, runId);\n    if (!run) throw new NotFoundException('Backtest run not found');\n    return { metrics: run.metrics, resultSummary: run.resultSummary, isSimulated: true };\n  }\n\n  @Post('backtests/walk-forward')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.BACKTEST_SUBMIT)\n  async runWalkForward(@Request() req: any, @Body() dto: WalkForwardDto) {\n    const { tenantId, userId } = this.getContext(req);\n    return this.walkForwardService.runWalkForward({\n      tenantId,\n      strategyVersionId: dto.strategyVersionId,\n      symbols: dto.symbols,\n      timeframe: dto.timeframe,\n      startTime: dto.startTime,\n      endTime: dto.endTime,\n      initialCapital: dto.initialCapital,\n      trainingWindowDays: dto.trainingWindowDays,\n      testingWindowDays: dto.testingWindowDays,\n      validationWindowDays: dto.validationWindowDays,\n      mode: dto.mode,\n      stepDays: dto.stepDays,\n      createdBy: userId,\n      idempotencyKey: dto.idempotencyKey || null,\n    });\n  }\n\n The compliance check matched ANY open BLOCK case\n * in the tenant (one blocked customer stopped every research signal) and,\n * like the exchange-capability check, ignored lookup errors; a non-array\n * risk-profile blockedSymbols matched substrings or threw into an empty catch.\n */\nfunction build(opts: {\n  createdBy?: string | null;\n  blockCaseFor?: string[];\n  riskProfile?: unknown;\n  tradingSymbol?: { isTradeable: boolean } | null;\n  failing?: 'compliance' | 'tradingSymbol';\n}) {\n  const fail = (what: string) => async () => {\n    throw new Error(`${what} lookup failed`);\n  };\n  const complianceFindFirst = jest.fn(\n    opts.failing === 'compliance'\n      ? fail('compliance')\n      : async (args: any) => {\n          const ids: string[] = args.where.userId?.in ?? [];\n          return ids.some((id) => (opts.blockCaseFor ?? []).includes(id)) ? { id: 'case-1' } : null;\n        },\n  );\n  const prisma = {\n    researchSignal: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(async (args: any) =>\n        args.where.id === 'sig-1'\n          ? { id: 'sig-1', tenantId: 't1', strategyVersionId: 'v1', symbol: 'ETH-USDT', side: 'BUY', signalKey: 'k1', expiresAt: null }\n          : null,\n      ),\n      update: jest.fn(async () => ({})),\n    },\n    complianceCase: { findFirst: complianceFindFirst },\n    tradingSymbol: {\n      findFirst: jest.fn(opts.failing === 'tradingSymbol' ? fail('tradingSymbol') : async () => opts.tradingSymbol ?? { isTradeable: true }),\n    },\n  };\n  const researchRepo = {\n    findStrategyVersionById: jest.fn(async () => ({\n      id: 'v1',\n      status: 'PUBLISHED',\n      createdBy: opts.createdBy === undefined ? 'author-1' : opts.createdBy,\n      riskProfile: opts.riskProfile ?? {},\n    })),\n    createAuditLog: jest.fn(async () => ({})),\n  };\n  return { service: new SignalFilterService(prisma as never, researchRepo as never), complianceFindFirst };\n}\n\nconst run = (s: SignalFilterService, actorUserId: string | null = 'actor-1') => s.filterSignal({ tenantId: 't1', signalId: 'sig-1', actorUserId });\n\ndescribe('SignalFilterService compliance and capability checks', () => {\n  it(\"a BLOCK case on some other tenant user no longer stops the signal\", async () => {\n    const { service, complianceFindFirst } = build({ blockCaseFor: ['someone-else'] });\n    await expect(run(service)).resolves.toMatchObject({ allowed: true, filteredState: 'VALID' });\n    expect(complianceFindFirst).toHaveBeenCalledWith(\n      expect.objectContaining({ where: expect.objectContaining({ tenantId: 't1', userId: { in: ['author-1', 'actor-1'] } }) }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it(\"a BLOCK case on the version's author or on the acting user stops it\", async () => {\n    await expect(run(build({ blockCaseFor: ['author-1'] }).service)).resolves.toMatchObject({ allowed: false, ruleId: 'COMPLIANCE_BLOCK' });\n    await expect(run(build({ blockCaseFor: ['actor-1'] }).service)).resolves.toMatchObject({ allowed: false, ruleId: 'COMPLIANCE_BLOCK' });\n  });\n\n  it('failed compliance or symbol lookups propagate instead of allowing', async () => {\n    await expect(run(build({ failing: 'compliance' }).service)).rejects.toThrow('compliance lookup failed');\n    await expect(run(build({ failing: 'tradingSymbol' }).service)).rejects.toThrow('tradingSymbol lookup failed');\n  });\n\n  it('a known non-tradeable symbol is rejected; an unknown one is allowed with a warning', async () => {\n    await expect(run(build({ tradingSymbol: { isTradeable: false } }).service)).resolves.toMatchObject({\n      allowed: false,\n      ruleId: 'EXCHANGE_NOT_TRADEABLE',\n    });\n    const unknown = build({});\n    (unknown.service as any).prisma.tradingSymbol.findFirst.mockResolvedValueOnce(null);\n    await expect(run(unknown.service)).resolves.toMatchObject({ allowed: true });\n  });\n\n  it('risk-profile blockedSymbols must be an array (a string matched substrings)', async () => {\n    await expect(run(build({ riskProfile: { blockedSymbols: ['ETH-USDT'] } }).service)).resolves.toMatchObject({\n      allowed: false,\n      ruleId: 'RISK_BLOCKED_SYMBOL',\n    });\n    await expect(run(build({ riskProfile: { blockedSymbols: 'BTC-ETH-USDT-X' } }).service)).resolves.toMatchObject({ allowed: true });\n  });\n\n  it('with no author and no actor there is no compliance subject to look up', async () => {\n    const { service, complianceFindFirst } = build({ createdBy: null });\n    await expect(run(service, null)).resolves.toMatchObject({ allowed: true });\n    expect(complianceFindFirst).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n});\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/research/signal-filter.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. input.allowedSides.length > 0 && !input.allowedSides.includes(signal.side)) {\n      await this.rejectSignal(input.tenantId, input.signalId, `Side ${signal.side} not allowed`, 'ALLOWED_SIDE');\n      return { allowed: false, reason: `Side ${signal.side} not allowed`, ruleId: 'ALLOWED_SIDE', filteredState: 'FILTERED' };\n    }\n\n    // Cooldown check - prevent duplicate signals within cooldown\n    if (input.cooldownMs && input.cooldownMs > 0) {\n      const cooldownSince = new Date(Date.now() - input.cooldownMs);\n      const recentDuplicate = await (this.prisma as `Cooldown active: duplicate signal within ${input.cooldownMs}ms`, ruleId: 'COOLDOWN', filteredState: 'FILTERED' };\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Strategy state check - strategy version must be PUBLISHED\n    const strategyVersion = await this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(signal.strategyVersionId, input.tenantId);\n    if (!strategyVersion) {\n      await this.rejectSignal(input.tenantId, input.signalId, 'Strategy version not found', 'STRATEGY_NOT_FOUND');\n      return { allowed: false, reason: 'Strategy version not found', ruleId: 'STRATEGY_NOT_FOUND', filteredState: 'REJECTED' };\n    }\n\n    if (!['PUBLISHED','FROZEN'].includes(strategyVersion.status)) {\n      await this.rejectSignal(input.tenantId, input.signalId, `Strategy version status ${strategyVersion.status} not allowed for signal publishing`, 'STRATEGY_STATE');\n      return { allowed: false, reason: `Strategy version status ${strategyVersion.status} not allowed`, ruleId: 'STRATEGY_STATE', filteredState: 'REJECTED' };\n    }\n\n    // Risk constraints - the version's risk profile may block symbols. Only an\n    // array counts: a string used to match substrings ('BTC-USDT,ETH' blocked\n    // 'ETH') and anything else threw into an empty catch and allowed.\n    const blockedByProfile = (strategyVersion.riskProfile as { blockedSymbols?: unknown } | null)?.blockedSymbols;\n    if (Array.isArray(blockedByProfile) && blockedByProfile.includes(signal.symbol)) {\n      await this.rejectSignal(input.tenantId, input.signalId, `Symbol ${signal.symbol} blocked by risk profile`, 'RISK_BLOCKED_SYMBOL');\n      return { allowed: false, reason: `Symbol ${signal.symbol} blocked by risk profile`, ruleId: 'RISK_BLOCKED_SYMBOL', filteredState: 'REJECTED' };\n    }\n\n    // Compliance: an open BLOCK case on the version's author or on the user\n    // acting now stops the signal. This used to match ANY open BLOCK case in\n    // the tenant (one blocked customer stopped every research signal) and to\n    // ignore lookup errors. A failed lookup now propagates (no publish).\n    const subjects = [strategyVersion.createdBy, input.actorUserId].filter((u): u is string => typeof u === 'string' && u.length > 0);\n    if (subjects.length > 0) {\n      const complianceCase = await this.prisma.complianceCase.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, userId: { in: subjects }, decision: 'BLOCK', state: { in: ['OPEN', 'IN_REVIEW', 'ESCALATED'] } },\n        select: { id: true },\n      });\n      if (complianceCase) {\n        await this.rejectSignal(input.tenantId, input.signalId, 'Compliance BLOCK prevents signal', 'COMPLIANCE_BLOCK');\n        return { allowed: false, reason: 'Compliance BLOCK prevents signal', ruleId: 'COMPLIANCE_BLOCK', filteredState: 'REJECTED' };\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Exchange capability - a known, non-tradeable symbol is rejected; an\n    // unknown symbol is allowed with a warning (research may precede venue\n    // listing). A failed lookup propagates instead of allowing.\n    const tradingSymbol = await this.prisma.tradingSymbol.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, symbol: signal.symbol } });\n    if (!tradingSymbol) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Symbol ${signal.symbol} not found in trading symbols tenant=${input.tenantId} - allowing but flagged`);\n    } else if (!tradingSymbol.isTradeable) {\n      await this.rejectSignal(input.tenantId, input.signalId, `Symbol ${signal.symbol} not tradeable`, 'EXCHANGE_NOT_TRADEABLE');\n      return { allowed: false, reason: `Symbol ${signal.symbol} not tradeable`, ruleId: 'EXCHANGE_NOT_TRADEABLE', filteredState: 'REJECTED' };\n    }\n\n    // Time validity - check expiry\n    if (signal.expiresAt && new Date(signal.expiresAt).getTime() < Date.now()) {\n      await this.rejectSignal(input.tenantId, input.signalId, 'Signal expired', 'EXPIRED');\n      return { allowed: false, reason: 'Signal expired', ruleId: 'EXPIRED', filteredState: 'EXPIRED' };\n    }\n\n    // Duplicate event - check if same signalKey already published\n    const duplicateEvent = await (this.prisma as any).researchSignal.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, signalKey: signal.signalKey, state: 'PUBLISHED', id: { not: signal.id } },\n    });\n    if (duplicateEvent) {\n      await this.rejectSignal(input.tenantId, input.signalId, `Duplicate event: signalKey ${signal.signalKey} already published as ${duplicateEvent.id}`, 'DUPLICATE_EVENT');\n      return { allowed: false, reason: `Duplicate event: signalKey ${signal.signalKey} already published`, ruleId: 'DUPLICATE_EVENT', filteredState: 'FILTERED' };\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`Signal filter passed tenant=${input.tenantId} signal=${input.signalId} symbol=${signal.symbol} side=${signal.side}`);\n\n    return { allowed: true, reason: null, ruleId: null, filteredState: 'VALID' };\n  }\n\n  private async rejectSignal(tenantId: string, signalId: string, reason: string, ruleId: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).researchSignal.update({ where: { id: signalId, tenantId }, data: { state: 'REJECTED', updatedAt: new Date() } });\n\n      await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n        tenantId,\n        event: 'SIGNAL_REJECTED',\n        signalId,\n        result: 'REJECTED',\n        safeMetadata: { reason, ruleId },\n      });\n\n      this.logger.log(`Signal rejected tenant=${tenantId} signal=${signalId} reason=${reason} rule=${ruleId}`);\n    } catch {}\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/research/signal.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. './signal.types';\nimport { randomUUID, createHash } from 'crypto';\nimport { isRecordNotFound } from '../../common/errors/prisma-not-found';\n\n/**\n * Creates, validates, deduplicates, stores, and publishes strategy signals to the existing strategy/copy-trading integration boundary.\n * Do not place exchange orders here.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class SignalService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(SignalService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly researchRepo: ResearchRepository,\n  ) {}\n\n  private fingerprintSignal(input: { strategyVersionId: string; symbol: string; side: string; timestamp: string; price?: string | null; quantity?: string | null }): string {\n    const hash = createHash('sha256');\n    hash.update(`${input.strategyVersionId}|${input.symbol}|${input.side}|${input.timestamp}|${input.price||''}|${input.quantity||''}`);\n    return hash.digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  async createSignal(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    strategyVersionId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    side: ResearchSignalSide;\n    strength?: string | null;\n    confidence?: string | null;\n    price?: string | null;\n    quantity?: string | null;\n    timestamp: Date;\n    expiresAt?: Date | null;\n    sourceEvent?: Record<string, any> | null;\n    metadata?: Record<string, any>;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n    createdBy?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    // Validate strategy version exists and is PUBLISHED\n    const strategyVersion = await this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(input.strategyVersionId, input.tenantId);\n    if (!strategyVersion) throw new Error(`Strategy version ${input.strategyVersionId} not found`);\n    if (!['PUBLISHED','FROZEN'].includes(strategyVersion.status)) throw new Error(`Strategy version must be PUBLISHED/FROZEN to create signals, current=${strategyVersion.status}`);\n\n    // Validate symbol format\n    if (!input.symbol || input.symbol.length < 2) throw new Error('Symbol required');\n\n    // Validate side\n    if (!Object.values(ResearchSignalSide).includes(input.side as any)) throw new Error(`Invalid signal side ${input.side}`);\n\n    // Decimal validation\n    if (input.price && !/^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/.test(input.price)) throw new Error('price must be valid decimal string');\n    if (input.quantity && !/^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/.test(input.quantity)) throw new Error('quantity must be valid decimal string');\n\n    const fingerprint = this.fingerprintSignal({\n      strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n      symbol: input.symbol,\n      side: input.side,\n      timestamp: input.timestamp.toISOString(),\n      price: input.price || null,\n      quantity: input.quantity || null,\n    });\n\n    const signalKey = `sig_${fingerprint.substring(0,16)}_${Date.now()}`;\n\n    // Idempotency - deduplicate\n    if (input.idempotencyKey) {\n      const existingByKey = await (this.prisma as any).researchSignal.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey } });\n      if (existingByKey) {\n        this.logger.log(`Signal idempotent by key=${input.idempotencyKey}`);\n        return existingByKey;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const existingByFingerprint = await (this.prisma as any).researchSignal.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: Do not invent benchmark data.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class StrategyBenchmarkService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(StrategyBenchmarkService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly backtestRepo: BacktestRepository,\n    private readonly researchRepo: ResearchRepository,\n    private readonly marketDataService: MarketDataService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async compareBenchmark(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    backtestRunId: string;\n    benchmarkSymbol: string;\n    benchmarkType?: 'BUY_AND_HOLD' | 'MARKET_INDEX';\n    createdBy?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<{ benchmarkSymbol: string; benchmarkReturn: string | null; strategyReturn: string | null; excessReturn: string | null; correlation: string | null; methodology: string; isSimulated: true }> {\n    const backtestRun = await this.backtestRepo.findById(input.backtestRunId, input.tenantId);\n    if (!backtestRun) throw new Error(`Backtest run ${input.backtestRunId} not found`);\n\n    // Use identical period boundaries and currency assumptions\n    const startTime = new Date(backtestRun.startTime).toISOString();\n    const endTime = new Date(backtestRun.endTime).toISOString();\n    const timeframe = backtestRun.timeframe;\n\n    // Get benchmark data - do not invent benchmark data\n    let benchmarkReturn: string | null = null;\n    let benchmarkCandles: any[] = [];\n\n    try {\n      const benchmarkData = await this.marketDataService.getCandles({\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        venue: 'BINANCE',\n        symbol: input.benchmarkSymbol,\n        timeframe,\n        startTime,\n        endTime,\n      });\n\n      benchmarkCandles = benchmarkData.candles;\n\n      if (benchmarkCandles.length >= 2) {\n        const firstClose = parseFloat(benchmarkCandles[0].close);\n        const lastClose = parseFloat(benchmarkCandles[benchmarkCandles.length-1].close);\n        if (firstClose > 0) {\n          const ret = ((lastClose - firstClose) / firstClose) * 100;\n          benchmarkReturn = ret.toString();\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Benchmark data unavailable symbol=${input.benchmarkSymbol} error=${e.message} - do not invent benchmark data`);\n      throw new Error(`Benchmark data unavailable for ${input.benchmarkSymbol} from ${startTime} to ${endTime}: ${e.message}. Do not invent benchmark data.`);\n    }\n\n    const strategyReturn = backtestRun.metrics ? (backtestRun.metrics as any).totalReturnPercent || (backtestRun.metrics as any).totalReturn || null : null;\n\n    let excessReturn: string | null = null;\n    if (benchmarkReturn !== null && strategyReturn !== null) {\n      const b = parseFloat(benchmarkReturn);\n      const s = parseFloat(strategyReturn);\n      if (!isNaN(b) && !isNaN(s)) excessReturn = (s - b).toString();\n    }\n\n    // Correlation - simplified\n    let correlation: string | null = null;\n    try {\n      const snapshots = await this.backtestRepo.listSnapshots(input.tenantId, input.backtestRunId);\n      if (snapshots.length > 1 && benchmarkCandles.length > 1) {\n        // Align by timestamp and calculate correlation of returns\n        const stratReturns: number[] = [];\n        const benchReturns: number[] = [];\n\n        for (let i=1; i<Math.min(snapshots.length, benchmarkCandles.length); i++) {\n          const prevStrat = parseFloat(snapshots[i-1].equity);\n          const currStrat = parseFloat(snapshots[i].equity);\n          if (prevStrat > 0) stratReturns.push((currStrat - prevStrat) / prevStrat);\n\n          const prevBench = parseFloat(benchmarkCandles[i-1].close);\n          const currBench = parseFloat(benchmarkCandles[i].close);\n          if (prevBench > 0) benchReturns.push((currBench - prevBench) / prevBench);\n        }\n\n        if (stratReturns.length > 2 && benchReturns.length === stratReturns.length) {\n          const meanStrat = stratReturns.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / stratReturns.length;\n          const meanBench = benchReturns.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0) / benchReturns.length;\n          let num = 0, denStrat = 0, denBench = 0;\n          for (let i=0; i<stratReturns.length; i++) {\n            num += (stratReturns[i] - meanStrat) * (benchReturns[i] - meanBench);\n            denStrat += Math.pow(stratReturns[i] - meanStrat, 2);\n            denBench += Math.pow(benchReturns[i] - meanBench, 2);\n          }\n          const den = Math.sqrt(denStrat * denBench);\n          if (den > 0) correlation = (num / den).toString();\n        }\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const methodology = `Benchmark comparison using identical period boundaries ${startTime} to ${endTime}, timeframe ${timeframe}, currency ${backtestRun.quoteCurrency}. Benchmark type ${input.benchmarkType || 'BUY_AND_HOLD'}. Do not invent benchmark data. Simulated result.`;\n\n    this.logger.log(`Benchmark comparison completed tenant=${input.tenantId} backtest=${input.backtestRunId} benchmark=${input.benchmarkSymbol} strategyReturn=${strategyReturn} benchmarkReturn=${benchmarkReturn}`);\n\n    return {\n      benchmarkSymbol: input.benchmarkSymbol,\n      benchmarkReturn,\n      strategyReturn,\n      excessReturn,\n      correlation,\n      methodology,\n      isSimulated: true,\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/research/strategy-version.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any.
