Create new version instead.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class StrategyVersionService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(StrategyVersionService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly researchRepo: ResearchRepository) {}\n\n  private hashLogic(logic: Record<string, any>): string {\n    const h = createHash('sha256');\n    h.update(JSON.stringify(logic, Object.keys(logic).sort()));\n    return h.digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  private hashConfig(config: Record<string, any>): string {\n    const h = createHash('sha256');\n    h.update(JSON.stringify(config, Object.keys(config).sort()));\n    return h.digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  private fingerprintVersion(input: { logicHash: string; configHash: string; parameters: Record<string, any>; name: string; version: string }): string {\n    const h = createHash('sha256');\n    h.update(`${input.logicHash}|${input.configHash}|${JSON.stringify(input.parameters)}|${input.name}|${input.version}`);\n    return h.digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  async createDraftVersion(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    strategyId?: string | null;\n    traderStrategyId?: string | null;\n    definitionId?: string | null;\n    version: string;\n    name: string;\n    description?: string | null;\n    parameters?: Record<string, any>;\n    riskProfile?: Record<string, any>;\n    executionModel?: Record<string, any>;\n    logic?: Record<string, any>;\n    parentVersionId?: string | null;\n    changeNote?: string | null;\n    createdBy?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    // Validate version format\n    if (!/^\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+$/.test(input.version)) {\n      throw new Error(`Version must be semver format x.y.z, got ${input.version}`);\n    }\n\n    const logicHash = this.hashLogic(input.logic || { name: input.name, version: input.version });\n    const configHash = this.hashConfig({ parameters: input.parameters, riskProfile: input.riskProfile, executionModel: input.executionModel });\n    const fingerprint = this.fingerprintVersion({ logicHash, configHash, parameters: input.parameters || {}, name: input.name, version: input.version });\n\n    const created = await this.researchRepo.createStrategyVersion({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      strategyId: input.strategyId || null,\n      traderStrategyId: input.traderStrategyId || null,\n      definitionId: input.definitionId || null,\n      version: input.version,\n      name: input.name,\n      description: input.description || null,\n      logicHash,\n      configHash,\n      fingerprint,\n      parameters: input.parameters || {},\n      riskProfile: input.riskProfile || {},\n      executionModel: input.executionModel || {},\n      parentVersionId: input.parentVersionId || null,\n      changeNote: input.changeNote || null,\n      createdBy: input.createdBy || null,\n      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey || null,\n    });\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      event: 'STRATEGY_VERSION_CREATED',\n      actorId: input.createdBy || null,\n      strategyVersionId: created.id,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { version: input.version, name: input.name, fingerprint },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Strategy version draft created id=${created.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} version=${input.version}`);\n\n    return created;\n  }\n\n  async getVersion(tenantId: string, versionId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    return this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(versionId, tenantId);\n  }\n\n  async listVersions(tenantId: string, filters?: { strategyId?: string; status?: string; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    return this.researchRepo.listStrategyVersions(tenantId, filters);\n  }\n\n  async updateDraft(tenantId: string, versionId: string, actorId: string, updates: { name?: string; description?: string | null; parameters?: Record<string, any>; riskProfile?: Record<string, any>; executionModel?: Record<string, any>; changeNote?: string | null }): Promise<any | null> {\n    const existing = await this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(versionId, tenantId);\n    if (!existing) return null;\n\n    // Once frozen/published, do not mutate in place\n    if (['FROZEN','PUBLISHED','DEPRECATED','ARCHIVED'].includes(existing.status)) {\n      throw new Error(`Strategy version ${versionId} is ${existing.status} and immutable. Create a new version instead.`);\n    }\n\n    // Only DRAFT and VALID can be updated\n    if (!['DRAFT','VALIDATING','VALID'].includes(existing.status)) {\n      throw new Error(`Strategy version ${versionId} status ${existing.status} cannot be updated`);\n    }\n\n    const newParams = updates.parameters || existing.parameters;\n    const newRisk = updates.riskProfile || existing.riskProfile;\n    const newExec = updates.executionModel || existing.executionModel;\n    const newName = updates.name || existing.name;\n\n    const configHash = this.hashConfig({ parameters: newParams, riskProfile: newRisk, executionModel: newExec });\n    const fingerprint = this.fingerprintVersion({ logicHash: existing.logicHash, configHash, parameters: newParams, name: newName, version: existing.version });\n\n    try {\n      const updated = await (this.researchRepo as any).prisma.researchStrategyVersion.update({\n        where: { id: versionId, tenantId },\n        data: {\n          name: newName,\n          description: updates.description !== undefined ? updates.description : existing.description,\n          parameters: newParams,\n          riskProfile: newRisk,\n          executionModel: newExec,\n          configHash,\n          fingerprint,\n          changeNote: updates.changeNote || existing.changeNote,\n          updatedAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n        tenantId,\n        event: 'STRATEGY_VERSION_UPDATED',\n        actorId,\n        strategyVersionId: versionId,\n        result: 'SUCCESS',\n        safeMetadata: { name: newName, fingerprint },\n      });\n\n      return updated;\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async validateVersion(tenantId: string, versionId: string, actorId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const existing = await this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(versionId, tenantId);\n    if (!existing) return null;\n\n    if (existing.status !== 'DRAFT') throw new Error(`Only DRAFT can be validated, current=${existing.status}`);\n\n    // Perform validation - check parameters not contain executable code\n    const params = existing.parameters as any;\n    if (params && typeof params === 'object') {\n      const forbiddenKeys = ['eval','exec','Function','code','script','__proto__'];\n      for (const key of Object.keys(params)) {\n        if (forbiddenKeys.some(f => key.toLowerCase().includes(f.toLowerCase()))) {\n          throw new Error(`Parameter key ${key} contains forbidden executable reference`);\n        }\n        const val = params[key];\n        if (typeof val === 'string' && (val.includes('eval(') || val.includes('Function(') || val.includes('<script'))) {\n          throw new Error(`Parameter ${key} contains forbidden executable code`);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    const updated = await this.researchRepo.updateStrategyVersionStatus(versionId, tenantId, ResearchStrategyVersionStatus.VALID as any);\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId,\n      event: 'STRATEGY_VERSION_VALIDATED',\n      actorId,\n      strategyVersionId: versionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { version: existing.version },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async freezeVersion(tenantId: string, versionId: string, actorId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const existing = await this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(versionId, tenantId);\n    if (!existing) return null;\n\n    if (!['VALID','DRAFT'].includes(existing.status)) throw new Error(`Only VALID/DRAFT can be frozen, current=${existing.status}`);\n\n    const updated = await this.researchRepo.updateStrategyVersionStatus(versionId, tenantId, ResearchStrategyVersionStatus.FROZEN as any, { frozenAt: new Date() });\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId,\n      event: 'STRATEGY_VERSION_FROZEN',\n      actorId,\n      strategyVersionId: versionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { version: existing.version, fingerprint: existing.fingerprint },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Strategy version frozen id=${versionId} tenant=${tenantId}`);\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async publishVersion(tenantId: string, versionId: string, actorId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const existing = await this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(versionId, tenantId);\n    if (!existing) return null;\n\n    if (existing.status !== 'FROZEN') throw new Error(`Only FROZEN can be published, current=${existing.status}. Freeze first.`);\n\n    const updated = await this.researchRepo.updateStrategyVersionStatus(versionId, tenantId, ResearchStrategyVersionStatus.PUBLISHED as any, { publishedAt: new Date() });\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId,\n      event: 'STRATEGY_VERSION_PUBLISHED',\n      actorId,\n      strategyVersionId: versionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { version: existing.version, fingerprint: existing.fingerprint },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Strategy version published id=${versionId} tenant=${tenantId}`);\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async deprecateVersion(tenantId: string, versionId: string, actorId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const existing = await this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(versionId, tenantId);\n    if (!existing) return null;\n\n    if (existing.status !== 'PUBLISHED') throw new Error(`Only PUBLISHED can be deprecated, current=${existing.status}`);\n\n    const updated = await this.researchRepo.updateStrategyVersionStatus(versionId, tenantId, ResearchStrategyVersionStatus.DEPRECATED as any, { deprecatedAt: new Date() });\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId,\n      event: 'STRATEGY_VERSION_DEPRECATED',\n      actorId,\n      strategyVersionId: versionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { version: existing.version },\n    });\n\n    return updated;\n  }\n\n  async compareVersions(tenantId: string, versionIdA: string, versionIdB: string): Promise<{ differences: Record<string, any>; isSameLogic: boolean; isSameConfig: boolean }> {\n    const a = await this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(versionIdA, tenantId);\n    const b = await this.researchRepo.findStrategyVersionById(versionIdB, tenantId);\n    if (!a || !b) throw new Error('One or both versions not found');\n\n    const isSameLogic = a.logicHash === b.logicHash;\n    const isSameConfig = a.configHash === b.configHash;\n\n    const differences: Record<string, any> = {};\n    if (a.version !== b.version) differences.version = { a: a.version, b: b.version };\n    if (a.name !== b.name) differences.name = { a: a.name, b: b.name };\n    if (JSON.stringify(a.parameters) !== JSON.stringify(b.parameters)) differences.parameters = { a: a.parameters, b: b.parameters };\n    if (JSON.stringify(a.riskProfile) !== JSON.stringify(b.riskProfile)) differences.riskProfile = { a: a.riskProfile, b: b.riskProfile };\n    if (JSON.stringify(a.executionModel) !== JSON.stringify(b.executionModel)) differences.executionModel = { a: a.executionModel, b: b.executionModel };\n    if (a.logicHash !== b.logicHash) differences.logicHash = { a: a.logicHash, b: b.logicHash };\n    if (a.configHash !== b.configHash) differences.configHash = { a: a.configHash, b: b.configHash };\n\n    return { differences, isSameLogic, isSameConfig };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/research/walk-forward.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. Every split must be explicit.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class WalkForwardService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(WalkForwardService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly backtestRepo: BacktestRepository,\n    private readonly researchRepo: ResearchRepository,\n    private readonly backtestEngine: BacktestEngineService,\n    private readonly policyService: ResearchPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async runWalkForward(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    strategyVersionId: string;\n    symbols: string[];\n    timeframe: string;\n    startTime: string;\n    endTime: string;\n    initialCapital: string;\n    trainingWindowDays: number;\n    testingWindowDays: number;\n    validationWindowDays?: number;\n    mode: 'ROLLING' | 'EXPANDING';\n    stepDays?: number;\n    createdBy?: string | null;\n    idempotencyKey?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<{ windows: any[]; results: any[]; aggregatedMetrics: Record<string, any>; outOfSampleMetrics: Record<string, any> }> {\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getPolicy(input.tenantId);\n    if (input.trainingWindowDays <= 0 || input.testingWindowDays <= 0) throw new Error('Training and testing windows must be positive');\n    \n    const totalDurationDays = (new Date(input.endTime).getTime() - new Date(input.startTime).getTime()) / (1000*60*60*24);\n    const expectedWindows = Math.floor(totalDurationDays / (input.trainingWindowDays + input.testingWindowDays));\n    if (expectedWindows > policy.maxWalkForwardWindows) throw new Error(`Walk-forward windows ${expectedWindows} exceeds max ${policy.maxWalkForwardWindows}`);\n\n    // Idempotency\n    if (input.idempotencyKey) {\n      const existing = await (this.researchRepo as any).prisma.researchAuditLog.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, event: 'WALK_FORWARD_COMPLETED', safeMetadata: { path: ['idempotencyKey'], equals: input.idempotencyKey } } });\n      // Simplified idempotency check\n    }\n\n    const windows: { windowId: string; type: 'TRAINING' | 'VALIDATION' | 'TEST'; startTime: string; endTime: string; trainingStart: string | null; trainingEnd: string | null; isOutOfSample: boolean }[] = [];\n    const results: any[] = [];\n\n    const start = new Date(input.startTime).getTime();\n    const end = new Date(input.endTime).getTime();\n    const trainingMs = input.trainingWindowDays * 24*60*60*1000;\n    const testingMs = input.testingWindowDays * 24*60*60*1000;\n    const validationMs = (input.validationWindowDays || 0) * 24*60*60*1000;\n    const stepMs = (input.stepDays || input.testingWindowDays) * 24*60*60*1000;\n\n    let currentStart = start;\n    let windowIndex = 0;\n\n    while (currentStart + trainingMs + validationMs + testingMs <= end) {\n      const trainingStart = currentStart;\n      const trainingEnd = input.mode === 'EXPANDING' ? start + trainingMs + windowIndex * stepMs : currentStart + trainingMs;\n      const actualTrainingStart = input.mode === 'EXPANDING' ? start : trainingStart;\n      \n      const validationStart = trainingEnd;\n      const validationEnd = validationStart + validationMs;\n      \n      const testingStart = validationMs > 0 ? validationEnd : trainingEnd;\n      const testingEnd = testingStart + testingMs;\n\n      // Ensure no future test data enters training - strict train/test separation\n      // Training uses only data up to trainingEnd, testing uses only data from testingStart to testingEnd\n\n      if (validationMs > 0) {\n        windows.push({\n          windowId: `wf_${windowIndex}_training`,\n          type: 'TRAINING',\n          startTime: new Date(actualTrainingStart).toISOString(),\n          endTime: new Date(trainingEnd).toISOString(),\n          trainingStart: new Date(actualTrainingStart).toISOString(),\n          trainingEnd: new Date(trainingEnd).toISOString(),\n          isOutOfSample: false,\n        });\n        windows.push({\n          windowId: `wf_${windowIndex}_validation`,\n          type: 'VALIDATION',\n          startTime: new Date(validationStart).toISOString(),\n          endTime: new Date(validationEnd).toISOString(),\n          trainingStart: new Date(actualTrainingStart).toISOString(),\n          trainingEnd: new Date(trainingEnd).toISOString(),\n          isOutOfSample: false,\n        });\n        windows.push({\n          windowId: `wf_${windowIndex}_test`,\n          type: 'TEST',\n          startTime: new Date(testingStart).toISOString(),\n          endTime: new Date(testingEnd).toISOString(),\n          trainingStart: new Date(actualTrainingStart).toISOString(),\n          trainingEnd: new Date(trainingEnd).toISOString(),\n          isOutOfSample: true,\n        });\n      } else {\n        windows.push({\n          windowId: `wf_${windowIndex}_training`,\n          type: 'TRAINING',\n          startTime: new Date(actualTrainingStart).toISOString(),\n          endTime: new Date(trainingEnd).toISOString(),\n          trainingStart: new Date(actualTrainingStart).toISOString(),\n          trainingEnd: new Date(trainingEnd).toISOString(),\n          isOutOfSample: false,\n        });\n        windows.push({\n          windowId: `wf_${windowIndex}_test`,\n          type: 'TEST',\n          startTime: new Date(testingStart).toISOString(),\n          endTime: new Date(testingEnd).toISOString(),\n          trainingStart: new Date(actualTrainingStart).toISOString(),\n          trainingEnd: new Date(trainingEnd).toISOString(),\n          isOutOfSample: true,\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Run backtest for training window (in-sample)\n      try {\n        const trainingRun = await this.backtestEngine.runBacktest({\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n          symbols: input.symbols,\n          timeframe: input.timeframe,\n          startTime: new Date(actualTrainingStart).toISOString(),\n          endTime: new Date(trainingEnd).toISOString(),\n          initialCapital: input.initialCapital,\n          createdBy: input.createdBy || null,\n          idempotencyKey: `wf_training_${input.tenantId}_${input.strategyVersionId}_${windowIndex}`,\n        });\n        results.push({ windowId: `wf_${windowIndex}_training`, type: 'TRAINING', runId: trainingRun.id, metrics: trainingRun.metrics, isOutOfSample: false });\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Walk-forward training window ${windowIndex} failed: ${e.message}`);\n      }\n\n      // Run backtest for test window (out-of-sample) - critical leakage protection\n      try {\n        const testingRun = await this.backtestEngine.runBacktest({\n          tenantId: input.tenantId,\n          strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n          symbols: input.symbols,\n          timeframe: input.timeframe,\n          startTime: new Date(testingStart).toISOString(),\n          endTime: new Date(testingEnd).toISOString(),\n          initialCapital: input.initialCapital,\n          createdBy: input.createdBy || null,\n          idempotencyKey: `wf_test_${input.tenantId}_${input.strategyVersionId}_${windowIndex}`,\n        });\n        results.push({ windowId: `wf_${windowIndex}_test`, type: 'TEST', runId: testingRun.id, metrics: testingRun.metrics, isOutOfSample: true });\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Walk-forward test window ${windowIndex} failed: ${e.message}`);\n      }\n\n      currentStart += => !r.isOutOfSample);\n    const outOfSampleResults = results.filter(r => r.isOutOfSample);\n\n    const aggregatedMetrics = this.aggregateMetrics(results);\n    const outOfSampleMetrics = this.aggregateMetrics(outOfSampleResults);\n\n    await this.researchRepo.createAuditLog({\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      event: 'WALK_FORWARD_COMPLETED',\n      actorId: input.createdBy || null,\n      strategyVersionId: input.strategyVersionId,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      safeMetadata: { windows: windows.length, results: results.length, mode: input.mode, trainingWindowDays: input.trainingWindowDays, testingWindowDays: input.testingWindowDays },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Walk-forward completed tenant=${input.tenantId} strategyVersion=${input.strategyVersionId} windows=${windows.length} results=${results.length} mode=${input.mode}`);\n\n    return { windows, results, aggregatedMetrics, outOfSampleMetrics };\n  }\n\n  private aggregateMetrics(results: any[]): Record<string, any> {\n    if (results.length === 0) return {};\n\n    let totalReturn = 0;\n    let maxDrawdown = 0;\n    let winRateSum = 0;\n    let tradeCount = 0;\n    let count = 0;\n\n    for (const r of results) {\n      if (r.metrics) {\n        if (r.metrics.totalReturn) totalReturn += parseFloat(r.metrics.totalReturn);\n        if (r.metrics.maxDrawdown) maxDrawdown = Math.max(maxDrawdown, parseFloat(r.metrics.maxDrawdown));\n        if (r.metrics.winRate) winRateSum += parseFloat(r.metrics.winRate);\n        if (r.metrics.tradeCount) tradeCount += r.metrics.tradeCount;\n        count++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return {\n      averageReturn: count > 0 ? (totalReturn / count).toString() : null,\n      maxDrawdown: maxDrawdown.toString(),\n      averageWinRate: count > 0 ? (winRateSum / count).toString() : null,\n      totalTrades: tradeCount,\n      windowCount: count,\n      methodology: 'Average of window metrics, out-of-sample separated, no look-ahead leakage',\n      isSimulated: true,\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/risk-management/circuit-breaker.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. scope: CircuitBreakerScope; scopeId: string }): Promise<any | null> {\n    const { tenantId, scope, scopeId } = params;\n    return this.prisma.circuitBreakerRecord.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId: tenantId ?? undefined, scope: scope as any, scopeId },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  async listBreakers(params: { tenantId?: string | null; state?: CircuitBreakerState }): Promise<any[]> {\n    const { tenantId, state } = params;\n    return this.prisma.circuitBreakerRecord.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId: tenantId ?? undefined, state: state as any },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      take: 100,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async triggerBreaker(params: {\n    tenantId?: string | null;\n    scope: CircuitBreakerScope;\n    scopeId: string;\n    triggerType: string; // loss/drawdown/outage/stale data/execution failure/rate-limit/liquidation/concentration/compliance/security\n    triggerRuleId?: string;\n    reason: string;\n    policyVersion: string;\n    triggeredByUserId?: string;\n    traderId?: string;\n    strategyId?: string;\n    accountId?: string;\n  }): Promise<{ id: string; state: CircuitBreakerState }> {\n    const { tenantId, scope, scopeId, triggerType, triggerRuleId, reason, policyVersion, triggeredByUserId, traderId, strategyId, accountId } = params;\n\n    if (!reason || reason.trim().length < 10) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Circuit breaker reason must be at least 10 characters');\n    }\n\n    // Check existing breaker: if already OPEN, do not duplicate unless reason changed significantly\n    const existing = await this.prisma.circuitBreakerRecord.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId: tenantId ?? undefined, scope: scope as any, scopeId, state: 'OPEN' as any },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (existing) {\n      this.logger.log(`Circuit breaker already OPEN for ${scope} ${scopeId}, existing ${existing.id}`);\n      return { id: existing.id, state: CircuitBreakerState.OPEN };\n    }\n\n    const created = await this.prisma.circuitBreakerRecord.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n        scope: scope as any,\n        scopeId,\n        state: 'OPEN' as any,\n        triggerType,\n        triggerRuleId: triggerRuleId ?? null,\n        reason: reason.slice(0, 1000),\n        policyVersion,\n        triggeredAt: new Date(),\n        triggeredByUserId: triggeredByUserId ?? null,\n        metadata: { traderId, strategyId, accountId } as any,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Audit log\n    await this.prisma.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId: tenantId ?? undefined,\n        actorId: triggeredByUserId ?? undefined,\n        actorType: triggeredByUserId ? 'USER' : 'SYSTEM',\n        action: 'CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIGGERED',\n        resourceType: 'CIRCUIT_BREAKER',\n        resourceId: created.id,\n        description: `Breaker OPEN ${scope} ${scopeId} trigger ${triggerType} rule ${triggerRuleId ?? ''} reason ${reason}`.slice(0, 500),\n        metadata: { scope, scopeId, triggerType, triggerRuleId, reason, policyVersion } as any,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Emit risk event\n    if (tenantId) {\n      await this.eventService.emitThresholdBreached({\n        tenantId,\n        type: RiskEventType.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIGGERED,\n        ruleId: triggerRuleId ?? 'CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIGGERED',\n        policyVersion,\n        scope: this.mapScopeToPolicyScope(scope),\n        scopeId,\n        accountId: accountId ?? null,\n        strategyId: strategyId ?? null,\n        traderId: traderId ?? null,\n        symbol: scope === CircuitBreakerScope.SYMBOL ? scopeId : null,\n        venue: scope === CircuitBreakerScope.VENUE ? scopeId : null,\n        severity: RiskSeverity.CRITICAL,\n        message: `Circuit breaker TRIGGERED for ${scope} ${scopeId}: ${reason}`,\n        sourceRefs: { breakerId: created.id, triggerType },\n      });\n    }\n\n    this.logger.warn(`Circuit breaker TRIGGERED ${scope} ${scopeId} type ${triggerType} reason ${reason}`);\n    return { id: created.id, state: CircuitBreakerState.OPEN };\n  }\n\n  async acknowledgeBreaker(params: { breakerId: string; acknowledgedByUserId: string; reason: string; tenantId?: string }): Promise<{ id: string }> {\n    const { breakerId, acknowledgedByUserId, reason, tenantId } = params;\n    const breaker = await this.prisma.circuitBreakerRecord.findUnique({ where: { id: breakerId } });\n    if (!breaker) throw new ForbiddenException(`Breaker ${breakerId} not found`);\n    if (breaker.state !== 'OPEN') throw new ForbiddenException(`Breaker ${breakerId} not in OPEN state, current ${breaker.state}`);\n\n    await this.prisma.circuitBreakerRecord.update({\n      where: { id: breakerId },\n      data: { acknowledgedAt: new Date(), metadata: { ...(breaker.metadata as any), acknowledgedByUserId, acknowledgeReason: reason } as any },\n    });\n\n    await this.prisma.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId: tenantId ?? breaker.tenantId ?? undefined,\n        actorId: acknowledgedByUserId,\n        actorType: 'USER',\n        action: 'CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ACKNOWLEDGED',\n        resourceType: 'CIRCUIT_BREAKER',\n        resourceId: breakerId,\n        description: `Breaker ACKNOWLEDGED ${breaker.scope} ${breaker.scopeId} by ${acknowledgedByUserId} reason ${reason}`.slice(0, 500),\n      },\n    });\n\n    return { id: breakerId };\n  }\n\n  async clearBreaker(params: {\n    breakerId: string;\n    clearedByUserId: string;\n    reason: string;\n    tenantId?: string;\n    requireExplicitClear?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<{ id: string; state: CircuitBreakerState }> {\n    const { breakerId, clearedByUserId, reason, tenantId } = params;\n    if (!reason || reason.trim().length < 20) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Clear reason must be at least 20 characters');\n    }\n    const breaker = await this.prisma.circuitBreakerRecord.findUnique({ where: { id: breakerId } });\n    if (!breaker) throw new ForbiddenException(`Breaker ${breakerId} not found`);\n    if (breaker.state !== 'OPEN' && breaker.state !== 'HALF_OPEN') {\n      throw new ForbiddenException(`Breaker ${breakerId} not in clearable state, current ${breaker.state}`);\n    }\n\n    // Policy-controlled recovery: check if policy requires explicit clear\n    // For now allow if reason provided\n\n    await this.prisma.circuitBreakerRecord.update({\n      where: { id: breakerId },\n      data: { state: 'CLOSED' as any, clearedAt: new Date(), clearedByUserId, metadata: { ...(breaker.metadata as any), clearReason: reason } as any },\n    });\n\n    await this.prisma.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId: tenantId ?? '-' : '') + (fracStr ? `${intP}.${fracStr}` : `${intP}`);\n}\n\nconst DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;\n\n/**\n * How old the newest aligned daily candle may be before a coefficient computed from it is withheld.\n *\n * This is 36 hours rather than a policy threshold because it is a property of the observation\n * interval, not of a tenant's risk appetite: a daily series whose newest close is more than a day\n * and a half old has missed the most recent session, so the number would describe a market that no\n * longer exists. The institutional `marketDataMaxAgeMs` threshold answers a different question -\n * how fresh a tick may be to price an order - and is far too strict for a daily close.\n */\nconst ALIGNED_DAILY_MAX_SOURCE_AGE_MS = 129_600_000;\n\n/** Upper bound on pairs evaluated per request, so one request cannot fan out without limit. */\nconst MAX_CANDIDATE_PAIRS = 20;\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class CorrelationRiskService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(CorrelationRiskService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: InstitutionalRiskPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async evaluateCorrelation(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    traderId?: string;\n    strategyId?: string;\n    followerId?: string;\n    pairs?: Array<{ assetA: string; assetB: string }>;\n  }): Promise<CorrelationResult[]> {\n    const { tenantId, traderId, strategyId, followerId, pairs } = params;\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolveEffectivePolicy({\n      tenantId,\n      traderId: traderId ?? null,\n      strategyId: strategyId ?? null,\n      followerId: followerId ?? null,\n    });\n\n    const lookbackDays = policy.thresholds.correlationLookbackDays;\n    const minObs = policy.thresholds.correlationMinObservations;\n    const threshold = policy.thresholds.maxCorrelation;\n    const method = `PEARSON_${lookbackDays}D`;\n    const methodVersion = 'v1.0.0';\n\n    // Determine pairs: if not provided, derive from positions\n    let effectivePairs = pairs;\n    if (!effectivePairs || effectivePairs.length === 0) {\n      const positions = await this.prisma.position.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId },\n        distinct: ['symbol'],\n        select: { symbol: true },\n      });\n      const symbols = positions.map((p) => p.symbol);\n      effectivePairs = [];\n      for (let i = 0; i < symbols.length; i++) {\n        for (let j = i + 1; j < symbols.length; j++) {\n          effectivePairs.push({ assetA: symbols[i], assetB: symbols[j] });\n        }\n      }\n      // Limit to first 20 pairs to avoid explosion\n      effectivePairs = effectivePairs.slice(0, 20);\n    }\n\n    const results: CorrelationResult[] = [];\n    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    for (const pair of effectivePairs) {\n      const pairKey = `${pair.assetA}:${pair.assetB}`;\n\n      // Fetch historical market data for both assets\n      const startDate = new Date(Date.now() - lookbackDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n\n      const dataA = await this.prisma.marketDataRecord.findMany({\n        where: { symbol: pair.assetA, openTime: { gte: startDate } },\n        orderBy: { openTime: 'asc' },\n        take: lookbackDays * 2,\n      });\n      const dataB = await this.prisma.marketDataRecord.findMany({\n        where: { symbol: pair.assetB, openTime: { gte: startDate } },\n        orderBy: { openTime: 'asc' },\n        take: lookbackDays * 2,\n      });\n\n      const observations = Math.min(dataA.length, dataB.length);\n\n      if (observations < minObs) {\n        results.push({\n          tenantId,\n          method,\n          methodVersion,\n          lookbackDays,\n          minObservations: minObs,\n          observations,\n          pairKey,\n          correlation: null,\n          threshold: threshold ??       isUnknown: true,\n        });\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Compute Pearson correlation on close returns\n      // Returns = (close_t / close_{t-1} -1)\n      // We need decimal-safe but correlation calculation involves floating math; we will use number for correlation but keep decimal string output.\n      // This is acceptable for correlation analytics (not financial ledger) but we still avoid inventing.\n      try {\n        const returnsA: number[] = [];\n        const returnsB: number[] = [];\n        for (let i = 1; i < Math.min(dataA.length, dataB.length); i++) {\n 1].close);\n          if (prevCloseA === 0 || prevCloseB === 0) continue;\n          returnsA.push(closeA / prevCloseA - 1);\n          returnsB.push(closeB / prevCloseB - 1);\n        }\n\n        if RiskState.UNKNOWN,\n            ruleId: 'MAX_CORRELATION',\n            policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n            reason: `Insufficient return observations for ${pairKey}: 0;\n        for (let i = 0; i < returnsA.length; i++) {\n          const da = returnsA[i] - meanA;\n          const db = returnsB[i] - meanB;\n          num += da * db;\n          denA += da * da;\n The institutional method above\n   * is left as it is because it answers for an operator-selected scope; this one answers only for\n   * the caller, and takes no scope selector at all.\n   *\n   * Observations are paired by candle timestamp, never by array index. Two series that start on\n   * different days are not the same 30 days of market, and pairing them positionally would compute a\n   * coefficient from returns that never happened on the same day.\n   */\n  async evaluateMyCorrelation(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    asOf?: Date | string;\n  }): Promise<CustomerCorrelationAssessment> {\n    const { tenantId, userId } = params;\n    const asOfDate = params.asOf === undefined ? new Date() : new Date(params.asOf);\n    const asOfTime = asOfDate.getTime();\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolveEffectivePolicy({ tenantId });\n    const lookbackDays = policy.thresholds.correlationLookbackDays;\n    const minObs = policy.thresholds.correlationMinObservations;\n    const threshold = policy.thresholds.maxCorrelation;\n    const method = `PEARSON_${lookbackDays}D_ALIGNED_DAILY`;\n    const methodVersion = 'v1.0.0';\n\n    const base = {\n      tenantId,\n      asOf: asOfDate.toISOString(),\n      dataScope: 'SIGNED_IN_USER_NON_SANDBOX_NON_SIMULATED_ACCOUNTS' as const,\n      method,\n      methodVersion,\n      interval: '1d' as const,\n      lookbackDays,\n      minObservations: minObs,\n      maxSourceAgeMs: ALIGNED_DAILY_MAX_SOURCE_AGE_MS,\n      notice:\n        'A pair is evaluated only when both instruments share a quote asset and a market type and their daily candles align by timestamp. A coefficient is withheld, never estimated, when the aligned window is short, stale, or has no variance.',\n    };\n\n    if (!Number.isFinite(asOfTime)) {\n      return {\n        ...base,\n        state: 'UNKNOWN',\n        activePositionCount: null,\n        instrumentCount: null,\n        omittedPositionCount: null,\n        candidatePairCount: null,\n        evaluatedPairCount: 0,\n        truncatedPairCount: null,\n        pairs: [],\n      };\n    }\n\n    const accounts = await this.prisma.tradingAccount.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, deletedAt: null, isSandbox: false, userId },\n      select: { id: true },\n    });\n    const accountIds = accounts.map((account) => account.id);\n    if (accountIds.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        ...base,\n        state: 'EMPTY',\n        activePositionCount: 0,\n        instrumentCount: 0,\n        omittedPositionCount: 0,\n        candidatePairCount: 0,\n        evaluatedPairCount: 0,\n        truncatedPairCount: 0,\n        pairs: [],\n      };\n    }\n\n    const positions = await this.prisma.position.findMany({\n      where: {\n        tenantId,\n        accountId: { in: accountIds },\n        containsSimulatedFills: false,\n        closedAt: null,\n      },\n      select: { symbolId: true, symbol: true, venue: true, quantity: true },\n    });\n    if (positions.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        ...base,\n        state: 'EMPTY',\n        activePositionCount: 0,\n        instrumentCount: 0,\n        omittedPositionCount: 0,\n        candidatePairCount: 0,\n        evaluatedPairCount: 0,\n        truncatedPairCount: 0,\n        pairs: [],\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Insertion order is preserved deliberately: the instrument id list is part of the query that\n    // resolves tenant instrument identity, and a stable order keeps that query reproducible.\n    const symbolIds: string[] = [];\n    for (const position of positions) {\n      if (!symbolIds.includes(position.symbolId)) Different quote\n        // assets, or different market types, means the pair has no shared denominator.\n        if (!left.quoteAsset || !right.quoteAsset) continue;\n        if (left.quoteAsset !== right.quoteAsset) continue;\n        if (!left.marketType || !right.marketType) continue;\n        if (left.marketType !== right.marketType) continue;\n        candidates.push({ left, right });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const evaluated = candidates.slice(0, MAX_CANDIDATE_PAIRS);\n    const truncatedPairCount = candidates.length - evaluated.length;\n\n    const candleCache = new Map<string, AlignedCandle[]>();\n    const loadCandles = async (instrument: Instrument): Promise<AlignedCandle[]> => {\n      const cached = candleCache.get(instrument.symbolId);\n      if (cached) return cached;\n      const rows = await this.prisma.marketDataRecord.findMany({\n        where: {\n          symbolId: instrument.symbolId,\n          venue: instrument.venue,\n          interval: '1d',\n          openTime: { gte: new Date(asOfTime - (lookbackDays + 2) * DAY_MS) },\n        },\n        orderBy: { openTime: 'asc' },\n        select: { openTime: true, closeTime: true, close: true },\n      });\n      const candles = normalizeCandles(rows);\n      candleCache.set(instrument.symbolId, candles);\n      return candles;\n    };\n\n    const pairs: CorrelationResult[] = [];\n    for (const { left, right } of evaluated) {\n      const leftCandles = await loadCandles(left);\n      const rightCandles = await loadCandles(right);\n\n      const pairKey = `${left.symbol}:${right.symbol}`;\n      const aligned = alignByTimestamp(leftCandles, rightCandles);\n      const returns = alignedReturns(aligned);\n      const observations = returns.length;\n      const newestCloseTime = aligned.length > 0\n        ? Math.max(...aligned.map((observation) => observation.closeTimeMs))\n        : null;\n      const sourceTimestamp = newestCloseTime === null ? null : new Date(newestCloseTime).toISOString();\n      const isStale = newestCloseTime !== null && asOfTime - newestCloseTime > ALIGNED_DAILY_MAX_SOURCE_AGE_MS;\n\n      const common = {\n        tenantId,\n        method,\n        methodVersion,\n        lookbackDays,\n        minObservations: minObs,\n        observations,\n        pairKey,\n        threshold: threshold ?? null,\n        ruleId: 'MAX_CORRELATION',\n        policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n        sourceInterval: '1d',\n        sourceMethodology: 'ALIGNED_DAILY_CLOSE_RETURNS',\n        sourceTimestamp,\n        sourceMaxAgeMs: ALIGNED_DAILY_MAX_SOURCE_AGE_MS,\n      };\n\n      // Freshness is decided before sufficiency. Concentration check\n    try {\n      const concResults = await this.concentrationService.evaluateConcentration({\n        tenantId,\n        accountId,\n        symbol,\n        orderIntent: orderNotional ? { notional: orderNotional, symbol } : null,\n      });\n      for (const c of concResults) {\n        if (c.isBreach) {\n          const d: RiskDecisionDetail = {\n            dimension: RiskDimension.CONCENTRATION,\n            decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n            state: c.state,\n            ruleId: c.ruleId,\n            policyVersion: c.policyVersion,\n            current: c.currentPercent,\n            threshold: c.thresholdPercent,\n            severity: c.severity,\n            reason: c.reason,\n            timestamp: nowIso,\n            scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n            scopeId: tenantId,\n            isBlocking: true,\n            isWarning: false,\n          };\n          details.push(d);\n          blockingReasons.push(d.reason);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Concentration check failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // 7. Drawdown check\n    try {\n      const ddResults = await this.drawdownService.evaluateDrawdown({ tenantId, accountId, traderId, strategyId, followerId });\n      for (const dd of ddResults) {\n        if (dd.isBreach) {\n          const d: RiskDecisionDetail = {\n            dimension: RiskDimension.DRAWDOWN,\n            decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n            state: dd.state,\n            ruleId: dd.ruleId,\n            policyVersion: dd.policyVersion,\n            current: dd.drawdownPercent,\n            threshold: dd.thresholdPercent,\n            severity: dd.severity,\n            reason: dd.reason,\n            timestamp: nowIso,\n            scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n            scopeId: accountId,\n            isBlocking: true,\n            isWarning: false,\n          };\n          details.push(d);\n          blockingReasons.push(d.reason);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Drawdown check failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // 8. Daily loss check\n    try {\n      const dlResults = await this.dailyLossService.evaluateDailyLoss({ tenantId, accountId, traderId, strategyId, followerId });\n      for (const dl of dlResults) {\n        if (dl.isBreach) {\n          const d: RiskDecisionDetail = {\n            dimension: RiskDimension.DAILY_LOSS,\n            decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n            state: dl.state,\n            ruleId: dl.ruleId,\n            policyVersion: dl.policyVersion,\n            current: dl.dailyPnl,\n            threshold: dl.threshold,\n            severity: dl.severity,\n            reason: dl.reason,\n            timestamp: nowIso,\n            scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n            scopeId: accountId,\n            isBlocking: true,\n            isWarning: false,\n          };\n          details.push(d);\n          blockingReasons.push(d.reason);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Daily loss check failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // 9. Compliance check (reuse existing ComplianceModule)\n    try {\n      // Compliance check via canonical compliance status — if user blocked, prevent ALLOW\n      const screening = await this.prisma.complianceScreeningRequest.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, userId: userId ?? undefined, status: 'BLOCKED' },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n      if (screening) {\n        const d: RiskDecisionDetail = {\n          dimension: RiskDimension.COMPLIANCE,\n          decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n          state: RiskState.BLOCKED,\n          ruleId: 'COMPLIANCE_BLOCK',\n          policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n          current: null,\n          threshold: null,\n          severity: RiskSeverity.CRITICAL,\n          reason: `Compliance BLOCK for user ${userId ?? 'unknown'} — screening ${screening.id} blocked`,\n          timestamp: nowIso,\n          scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n          scopeId: tenantId,\n          isBlocking: true,\n          isWarning: false,\n        };\n        details.push(d);\n        blockingReasons.push(d.reason);\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Compliance check failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      // Fail-closed for compliance: if compliance unavailable and policy requires, block\n      const d: RiskDecisionDetail = {\n        dimension: RiskDimension.COMPLIANCE,\n        decision: RiskDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED,\n        state: RiskState.UNKNOWN,\n        ruleId: 'COMPLIANCE_BLOCK',\n        policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n        current: null,\n        threshold: null,\n        severity: RiskSeverity.WARNING,\n        reason: `Compliance evaluation unavailable: ${(e as Error).message}, fail-closed to REVIEW_REQUIRED`,\n        timestamp: nowIso,\n        scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n        scopeId: tenantId,\n        isBlocking: false,\n        isWarning: true,\n      };\n      details.push(d);\n      warnings.push(d.reason);\n    }\n\n    // 10. Security check\n    try {\n      const threat = await this.prisma.securityThreatSignal.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, userId: userId ?? undefined, resolved: false, riskLevel: { in: ['HIGH', 'CRITICAL'] } },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n      if (threat) {\n        const d: RiskDecisionDetail = {\n          dimension: RiskDimension.SECURITY,\n          decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n          state: RiskState.BLOCKED,\n          ruleId: 'SECURITY_BLOCK',\n          policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n          current: null,\n          threshold: null,\n          severity: RiskSeverity.CRITICAL,\n          reason: `Security BLOCK for user ${userId ?? 'unknown'} — threat ${threat.ruleId} level ${threat.riskLevel}`,\n          timestamp: nowIso,\n          scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n          scopeId: tenantId,\n          isBlocking: true,\n          isWarning: false,\n        };\n        details.push(d);\n        blockingReasons.push(d.reason);\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Security check failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // 11. Exchange health\n    try {\n      const account = await this.prisma.tradingAccount.findFirst({ where: { id: accountId, tenantId } });\n      if (account) {\n        const ageMs = account.lastVerifiedAt ? Date.now() - new Date(account.lastVerifiedAt).getTime() : Infinity;\n        if (ageMs > policy.thresholds.exchangeHealthMaxAgeMs) {\n          const d: RiskDecisionDetail = {\n            dimension: RiskDimension.EXCHANGE_HEALTH,\n            decision: environment === 'LIVE' ? RiskDecision.BLOCK : RiskDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED,\n            state: RiskState.STALE,\n            ruleId: 'EXCHANGE_HEALTH_DEGRADED',\n            policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n            current: ageMs.toString(),\n            threshold: policy.thresholds.exchangeHealthMaxAgeMs.toString(),\n            severity: RiskSeverity.WARNING,\n            reason: `Exchange health stale for account ${accountId}, last verified ${ageMs}ms ago > ${policy.thresholds.exchangeHealthMaxAgeMs}ms`,\n            timestamp: nowIso,\n            scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n            scopeId: accountId,\n            isBlocking: environment === 'LIVE',\n            isWarning: environment !== 'LIVE',\n          };\n          details.push(d);\n          if (d.isBlocking) blockingReasons.push(d.reason);\n          else warnings.push(d.reason);\n        }\n        if (account.status !== 'ACTIVE') {\n          const d: RiskDecisionDetail = {\n            dimension: RiskDimension.EXCHANGE_HEALTH,\n            decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n            state: RiskState.BLOCKED,\n            ruleId: 'EXCHANGE_HEALTH_DEGRADED',\n            policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n            current: account.status,\n            threshold: 'ACTIVE',\n            severity: RiskSeverity.CRITICAL,\n            reason: `Trading account ${accountId} status ${account.status} not ACTIVE`,\n            timestamp: nowIso,\n            scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n            scopeId: accountId,\n            isBlocking: true,\n            isWarning: false,\n          };\n          details.push(d);\n          blockingReasons.push(d.reason);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Exchange health check failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    return this.finalizeDecision({\n      tenantId,\n      userId: userId ?? null,\n      accountId,\n      symbol,\n      traderId: traderId ?? null,\n      followerId: followerId ?? null,\n      strategyId: strategyId ?? null,\n      environment,\n      policy,\n      details,\n      blockingReasons,\n      warnings,\n      requestId: requestId ?? null,\n    });\n  }\n\n  private finalizeDecision(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string | null;\n    accountId: string;\n    symbol: string;\n    traderId: string | null;\n    followerId: string | null;\n    strategyId: string | null;\n    environment: string;\n    policy: any;\n    details: RiskDecisionDetail[];\n    blockingReasons: string[];\n    warnings: string[];\n    requestId: string | null;\n  }): UnifiedRiskDecision {\n    const { tenantId, userId, accountId, symbol, traderId, followerId, strategyId, environment, policy, details, blockingReasons, warnings, requestId } = params;\n\n    let finalDecision: RiskDecision = RiskDecision.ALLOW;\n    let finalState = RiskState.NORMAL;\n\n    // Priority: BLOCKED/KILL_SWITCH never becomes ALLOW\n    const hasBlock = details.some((d) => d.decision === RiskDecision.BLOCK || d.decision === RiskDecision.KILL_SWITCH_REQUIRED);\n    const hasReview = details.some((d) => d.decision === RiskDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED);\n    const hasReduce = details.some((d) => d.decision === RiskDecision.REDUCE);\n    const hasPause = details.some((d) => d.decision === RiskDecision.PAUSE);\n    const hasStopCopy = details.some((d) => d.decision === RiskDecision.STOP_COPY);\n\n    if (hasBlock) {\n      finalDecision = RiskDecision.BLOCK;\n      finalState = RiskState.BLOCKED;\n    } else if (details.some((d) => d.decision === RiskDecision.KILL_SWITCH_REQUIRED)) {\n      finalDecision = RiskDecision.KILL_SWITCH_REQUIRED;\n      finalState = RiskState.CRITICAL;\n    } else if (hasPause) {\n      finalDecision = RiskDecision.PAUSE;\n      finalState = RiskState.HIGH;\n    } else if (hasStopCopy) {\n      finalDecision = RiskDecision.STOP_COPY;\n      finalState = RiskState.HIGH;\n    } else if (hasReview) {\n      finalDecision = RiskDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED;\n      finalState = RiskState.UNKNOWN;\n    } else if (hasReduce) {\n      finalDecision = RiskDecision.REDUCE;\n      finalState = RiskState.ELEVATED;\n    }\n\n    // If any STALE and live, block\n    if (environment === 'LIVE' && details.some((d) => d.state === RiskState.STALE)) {\n      finalDecision = RiskDecision.BLOCK;\n      finalState = RiskState.STALE;\n    }\n\n    const ruleIds = Array.from(new Set(details.map((d) => d.ruleId)));\n\n    return {\n      id: `risk-dec-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      accountId,\n      symbol,\n      venue: null,\n      traderId,\n      followerId,\n      strategyId,\n      orderIntentId: requestId,\n      decision: finalDecision,\n      state: finalState,\n      blockingReasons,\n      warnings,\n      details,\n      policies: policy.scopeChain.map((s: any) => ({ scope: s.scope, scopeId: s.scopeId, version: s.version.toString(), digest: s.digest })),\n      ruleIds,\n      policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      requestId,\n      environment,\n      complianceDecision: details.find((d) => d.dimension === RiskDimension.COMPLIANCE)?.decision ?? null,\n      securityDecision: details.find((d) => d.dimension === RiskDimension.SECURITY)?.decision ?? null,\n      exchangeHealth: details.find((d) => d.dimension === RiskDimension.EXCHANGE_HEALTH)?.state ?? null,\n      circuitBreaker: null,\n      killSwitch: null,\n    };\n Specify a different type.","line":435,"column":62,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":435,"endColumn":65,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[15622,15625],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[15622,15625],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":7,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { InstitutionalRiskPolicyService } from './risk-policy.service';\nimport {\n  PortfolioExposure,\n  SymbolExposure,\n  VenueExposure,\n  AccountExposure,\n  RiskState,\n} from './risk-management.types';\n\n/**\n * Portfolio exposure aggregation from canonical sources only:\n * - Position (canonical, derived from fills, never venue snapshot)\n * - Order (open orders, canonical)\n * - AccountBalanceSnapshot (canonical, not client-provided)\n * - MarketDataRecord / TradingSymbol mark prices\n *\n * Decimal-safe arithmetic mandatory: uses scaled BigInt (1e12).\n * Never trusts client-provided balances/equity/exposure.\n * Stale/missing market data => explicit STALE/UNKNOWN, never invented.\n */\n\nconst SCALE = 1_000_000_000_000n; // 1e12\nconst SCALE_DIGITS = 12;\n\nfunction isValidDecimalString(v: string | null | undefined): boolean {\n  if (!v) return false;\n  return /^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/.test(v);\n}\n\nfunction parseScaled(s: string): bigint {\n  const negative = s.startsWith('-');\n  const clean = negative ? s.slice(1) : s;\n  const [intPart = '0', fracPart = ''] = clean.split('.');\n  const fracPadded = (fracPart + '0'.repeat(SCALE_DIGITS)).slice(0, SCALE_DIGITS);\n  const scaled = BigInt(intPart || '0') * SCALE + BigInt(fracPadded || '0');\n  return negative ? -scaled : scaled;\n}\n\nfunction formatScaled(b: bigint): string {\n  const negative = b < 0n;\n  const abs = negative ? -b : b;\n  const intPart = abs / SCALE;\n  const fracPart = abs % SCALE;\n  const fracStr = fracPart.toString().padStart(SCALE_DIGITS, '0').replace(/0+$/, '');\n  const result = fracStr ? `${intPart}.${fracStr}` : `${intPart}`;\n  return negative ? `-${result}` : result;\n}\n\nfunction add(a: string, b: string): string {\n  return formatScaled(parseScaled(a) + parseScaled(b));\n}\nfunction sub(a: string, b: string): string {\n  return formatScaled(parseScaled(a) - parseScaled(b));\n}\nfunction absStr(a: string): string {\n  return a.startsWith('-') ? a.slice(1) : a;\n}\nfunction mul(a: string, b: string): string {\n  // (a*1e12 * b*1e12)/1e12\n  const av = parseScaled(a);\n  const bv = parseScaled(b);\n  return formatScaled((av * bv) / SCALE);\n}\nfunction cmp(a: string, b: string): number {\n  const av = parseScaled(a);\n  const bv = parseScaled(b);\n  if (av < bv) return -1;\n  if (av > bv) return 1;\n  return 0;\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class PortfolioExposureService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(PortfolioExposureService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: InstitutionalRiskPolicyService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async calculateExposure(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    accountId?: string;\n    traderId?: string;\n    strategyId?: string;\n    followerId?: string;\n    userId?: string;\n  }): Promise<PortfolioExposure> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, traderId, strategyId, followerId } = params;\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolveEffectivePolicy({\n      tenantId,\n      traderId: traderId ?? null,\n      strategyId: strategyId ?? null,\n      followerId: followerId ?? null,\n    });\n\n    // Canonical positions\n    const positions = await this.prisma.position.findMany({\n      where: {\n        tenantId,\n        ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}),\n      },\n      include: { symbolRef: true },\n    });\n\n    // Canonical open orders\n    const openOrders = await this.prisma.order.findMany({\n      where: {\n        tenantId,\n        ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}),\n        status: { in: ['PENDING', 'SUBMITTED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED'] },\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Canonical balances (latest per account asset, but we have snapshot table)\n    const balances = await this.prisma.accountBalanceSnapshot.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}) },\n    });\n\n    // Trading symbols for price metadata\n    const symbols = await this.prisma.tradingSymbol.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId },\n    });\n    const symbolMap = new Map(symbols.map((s) => [s.symbol, s]));\n\n    const now = new Date();\n    const nowIso = now.toISOString();\n    const staleSymbols: string[] = [];\n    const unknownPrices: string[] = [];\n\n    // Aggregate per symbol\n    const symbolAgg = new Map<string, { long: bigint; short: bigint; net: bigint; gross: bigint; openOrder: bigint; venue: string; base: string | null; quote: string | null; price: string | null; priceTs: string | null; isStale: boolean }>();\n\n    for (const pos of positions) {\n      const sym = pos.symbol;\n      const venue = pos.venue as string;\n      const qtyStr = pos.quantity.toString();\n      if (!isValidDecimalString(qtyStr)) continue;\n      const markPrice = pos.markPrice?.toString() ?? pos.averageEntryPrice?.toString() ?? null;\n      const priceValid = isValidDecimalString(markPrice);\n      let notionalStr: string | null = null;\n      if (priceValid) {\n        notionalStr = mul(absStr(qtyStr), markPrice!);\n      } else {\n        unknownPrices.push(sym);\n      }\n\n      let agg = symbolAgg.get(sym);\n      if (!agg) {\n        agg = {\n          long: 0n,\n          short: 0n,\n          net: 0n,\n          gross: 0n,\n          openOrder: 0n,\n          venue,\n          base: pos.symbolRef?.baseAsset ?? null,\n          quote: pos.symbolRef?.quoteAsset ?? null,\n          price: markPrice,\n          priceTs: pos.updatedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,\n          isStale: false,\n        };\n        symbolAgg.set(sym, agg);\n      }\n      if (notionalStr) {\n        const signedQty = parseScaled(qtyStr);\n        if (signedQty >= 0n) {\n          agg.long += parseScaled(notionalStr);\n        } else {\n          agg.short += parseScaled(notionalStr);\n        }\n        agg.net += signedQty >= 0n ? parseScaled(notionalStr) : -parseScaled(notionalStr);\n        agg.gross += parseScaled(notionalStr);\n      }\n      // Check stale: if markPrice older than policy marketDataMaxAgeMs\n      const ageMs = now.getTime() - new Date(pos.updatedAt).getTime();\n      if (ageMs > policy.thresholds.marketDataMaxAgeMs) {\n        agg.isStale = true;\n        if (!staleSymbols.includes(sym)) staleSymbols.push(sym);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Add open order notional per symbol\n    for (const ord of openOrders) {\n      const sym = ord.symbol;\n      const qtyStr = ord.quantity.toString();\n      const priceStr = ord.price?.toString() ?? null;\n      let notionalStr: string | null = null;\n      if (isValidDecimalString(qtyStr) && isValidDecimalString(priceStr)) {\n        notionalStr = mul(qtyStr, priceStr!);\n      } else if (isValidDecimalString(qtyStr)) {\n        // If market order without price, use mark price if available\n        const agg = symbolAgg.get(sym);\n        if (agg?.price && isValidDecimalString(agg.price)) {\n          notionalStr = mul(qtyStr, agg.price);\n        }\n      }\n      if (notionalStr) {\n        let agg = symbolAgg.get(sym);\n        if (!agg) {\n          agg = {\n            long: 0n,\n            short: 0n,\n            net: 0n,\n            gross: 0n,\n            openOrder: 0n,\n            venue: ord.venue as string,\n            base: null,\n            quote: null,\n            price: null,\n            priceTs: null,\n            isStale: false,\n          };\n          symbolAgg.set(sym, agg);\n        }\n        agg.openOrder += parseScaled(notionalStr);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Compute totals\n    let totalGross = 0n;\n    let totalNet = 0n;\n    let totalLong = 0n;\n    let totalShort = 0n;\n    let totalOpenOrder = 0n;\n\n    for (const agg of symbolAgg.values()) {\n      totalGross += agg.gross;\n      totalNet += agg.net;\n      totalLong += agg.long;\n      totalShort += agg.short;\n      totalOpenOrder += agg.openOrder;\n    }\n\n    const grossExposure = formatScaled(totalGross);\n    const netExposure = formatScaled(totalNet);\n    const longExposure = formatScaled(totalLong);\n    const shortExposure = formatScaled(totalShort);\n    const openOrderExposure = formatScaled(totalOpenOrder);\n    const totalExposure = formatScaled(totalGross + totalOpenOrder);\n\n    // Symbol exposures\n    const symbolExposures: SymbolExposure[] = [];\n    for (const [symbol, agg] of symbolAgg.entries()) {\n      const grossStr = formatScaled(agg.gross);\n      const conc = totalGross > 0n ? formatScaled((agg.gross * 100n * SCALE) / totalGross / SCALE) : null;\n      // Actually percent = gross / totalGross *100\n      const concPercent = totalGross > 0n ? formatScaled((agg.gross * 100n * SCALE) / totalGross) : null; // wait we already divided?\n      // Let's compute properly: (agg.gross / totalGross)*100\n      let concentrationPercent: string | null = null;\n      if (totalGross > 0n) {\n        const pctScaled = (agg.gross * 100n * SCALE) / totalGross;\n        concentrationPercent = formatScaled(pctScaled);\n      }\n      symbolExposures.push({\n        symbol,\n        venue: agg.venue,\n        baseAsset: agg.base,\n        quoteAsset: agg.quote,\n        longNotional: formatScaled(agg.long),\n        shortNotional: formatScaled(agg.short),\n        netNotional: formatScaled(agg.net),\n        grossNotional: grossStr,\n        openOrderNotional: formatScaled(agg.openOrder),\n        totalExposure: formatScaled(agg.gross + agg.openOrder),\n        concentrationPercent,\n        price: agg.price,\n        priceTimestamp: agg.priceTs,\n        isStale: agg.isStale,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Venue exposures\n    const venueMap = new Map<string, { gross: bigint; net: bigint; accounts: Set<string>; symbols: Set<string> }>();\n    for (const [sym, agg] of symbolAgg.entries()) {\n      const v = agg.venue;\n      let vm = venueMap.get(v);\n      if (!vm) {\n        vm = { gross: 0n, net: 0n, accounts: new Set(), symbols: new Set() };\n        venueMap.set(v, vm);\n      }\n      vm.gross += agg.gross;\n      vm.net += agg.net;\n      vm.symbols.add(sym);\n    }\n    // Add account info for venue\n    for (const pos of positions) {\n      const vm = venueMap.get(pos.venue as string);\n      if (vm) vm.accounts.add(pos.accountId);\n    }\n    const venueExposures: VenueExposure[] = [];\n    for (const [venue, vm] of venueMap.entries()) {\n      const conc = totalGross > 0n ? formatScaled((vm.gross * 100n * SCALE) / totalGross) : null;\n      venueExposures.push({\n        venue,\n        grossNotional: formatScaled(vm.gross),\n        netNotional: formatScaled(vm.net),\n        concentrationPercent: conc,\n        accountCount: vm.accounts.size,\n        symbolCount: vm.symbols.size,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Account exposures\n    const accountMap = new Map<string, { venue: string; gross: bigint; net: bigint; long: bigint; short: bigint; openOrder: bigint; symbols: Set<string> }>();\n    for (const pos of positions) {\n      const qtyStr = pos.quantity.toString();\n      const markPrice = pos.markPrice?.toString() ?? pos.averageEntryPrice?.toString() ?? null;\n      let notional = 0n;\n      if (isValidDecimalString(qtyStr) && isValidDecimalString(markPrice)) {\n        notional = parseScaled(mul(absStr(qtyStr), markPrice!));\n      }\n      let am = accountMap.get(pos.accountId);\n      if (!am) {\n        am = { venue: pos.venue as string, gross: 0n, net: 0n, long: 0n, short: 0n, openOrder: 0n, symbols: new Set() };\n        accountMap.set(pos.accountId, am);\n      }\n      am.gross += notional;\n      const signed = parseScaled(qtyStr);\n      if (signed >= 0n) {\n        am.long += notional;\n        am.net += notional;\n      } else {\n        am.short += notional;\n        am.net -= notional;\n      }\n      am.symbols.add(pos.symbol);\n    }\n    for (const ord of openOrders) {\n      const qtyStr = ord.quantity.toString();\n      const priceStr = ord.price?.toString() ?? null;\n      let notional = 0n;\n      if (isValidDecimalString(qtyStr) && isValidDecimalString(priceStr)) {\n        notional = parseScaled(mul(qtyStr, priceStr!));\n      }\n      let am = accountMap.get(ord.accountId);\n      if (!am) {\n        am = { venue: ord.venue as string, gross: 0n, net: 0n, long: 0n, short: 0n, openOrder: 0n, symbols: new Set() };\n        accountMap.set(ord.accountId, am);\n      }\n      am.openOrder += notional;\n    }\n    const accountExposures: AccountExposure[] = [];\n    for (const [accountId, am] of accountMap.entries()) {\n      accountExposures.push({\n        accountId,\n        venue: am.venue,\n        grossNotional: formatScaled(am.gross),\n        netNotional: formatScaled(am.net),\n        longNotional: formatScaled(am.long),\n        shortNotional: formatScaled(am.short),\n        openOrderNotional: formatScaled(am.openOrder),\n        totalExposure: formatScaled(am.gross + am.openOrder),\n        symbolCount: am.symbols.size,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Strategy exposures: need to map positions via orders? For now aggregate via strategyId in orders\n    // If strategyId present in positions? Position doesn't have strategyId, so we use orders.\n    const strategyMap = new Map<string, { gross: bigint; net: bigint; traderId: string | null }>();\n    // Use copyTrading? For simplicity, use orders grouped by strategyId\n    const ordersByStrategy = openOrders.filter((o) => o.strategyId);\n    for (const o of ordersByStrategy) {\n      const sid = o.strategyId!;\n      let sm = strategyMap.get(sid);\n      if (!sm) {\n        sm = { gross: 0n, net: 0n, traderId: null };\n        strategyMap.set(sid, sm);\n      }\n      const qtyStr = o.quantity.toString();\n      const priceStr = o.price?.toString() ?? '0';\n      if (isValidDecimalString(qtyStr) && isValidDecimalString(priceStr)) {\n        const notional = parseScaled(mul(qtyStr, priceStr));\n        sm.gross += notional >= 0n ? notional : -notional;\n        sm.net += notional;\n      }\n    }\n    const strategyExposures = Array.from(strategyMap.entries()).map(([strategyId, v]) => ({\n      strategyId,\n      grossNotional: formatScaled(v.gross),\n      netNotional: formatScaled(v.net),\n      traderId: v.traderId,\n    }));\n\n    // Trader exposures via TraderStrategy relation\n    const traderExposures: PortfolioExposure['traderExposures'] = [];\n    const followerExposures: PortfolioExposure['followerExposures'] = [];\n\n    // Notional utilization\n    let notionalUtilizationPercent: string | null = null;\n    if (policy.thresholds.maxGrossExposure && isValidDecimalString(policy.thresholds.maxGrossExposure)) {\n      const maxGross = parseScaled(policy.thresholds.maxGrossExposure);\n      if (maxGross > 0n) {\n        notionalUtilizationPercent = formatScaled((totalGross * 100n * SCALE) / maxGross);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const state = this.determineExposureState(totalGross, policy, staleSymbols);\n\n    const sourceTimestamps: Record<string, string> = {\n      positions: positions.length ? (positions[0].updatedAt?.toISOString() ?? nowIso) : nowIso,\n      orders: openOrders.length ? (openOrders[0].updatedAt?.toISOString() ?? nowIso) : nowIso,\n      balances: balances.length ? (balances[0].updatedAt?.toISOString() ?? nowIso) : nowIso,\n      calculatedAt: nowIso,\n    };\n\n    return {\n      tenantId,\n      asOf: nowIso,\n      policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n      grossExposure,\n      netExposure,\n      longExposure,\n      shortExposure,\n      openOrderExposure,\n      totalExposure,\n      notionalUtilizationPercent,\n      symbolExposures,\n      venueExposures,\n      accountExposures,\n      strategyExposures,\n      traderExposures,\n      followerExposures,\n      staleSymbols,\n      unknownPrices,\n      sourceTimestamps,\n      state,\n      warnings: [...(staleSymbols.length ? [`Stale market data for: ${staleSymbols.join(',')}`] : []), ...(unknownPrices.length ? [`Unknown prices for: ${unknownPrices.join(',')}`] : [])],\n    };\n  }\n\n  private determineExposureState(totalGross: bigint, policy: any, staleSymbols: string[]): RiskState {\n    if (staleSymbols.length > 0) return RiskState.STALE;\n    if (totalGross === 0n) return RiskState.NORMAL;\n    const thresholds = policy.thresholds;\n    if (thresholds.maxGrossExposure && isValidDecimalString(thresholds.maxGrossExposure)) {\n      const max = parseScaled(thresholds.maxGrossExposure);\n      if (totalGross > max) return RiskState.BLOCKED;\n      if (totalGross > (max * 80n) / 100n) return RiskState.HIGH;\n      if (totalGross > (max * 60n) / 100n) return RiskState.ELEVATED;\n    }\n    return RiskState.NORMAL;\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/risk-management/position-risk.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/risk-management/risk-calculations.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any.
