Prisma and the policy service are in-memory fakes.\n */\nimport { resolveDayStartEquity, scopeAccountIdsOf } from './day-start-equity';\nimport { DailyLossLimitService } from './daily-loss-limit.service';\nimport { DrawdownRiskService } from './drawdown-risk.service';\nimport { StressTestService, computeScenarioImpact } from './stress-test.service';\nimport { PortfolioExposure, RiskState, StressScenario } from './risk-management.types';\n\nconst TENANT = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000000a';\nconst ACC1 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001';\nconst ACC2 = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002';\nconst today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);\n\nfunction dec(v: string) {\n  return { toString: () => v };\n}\n\ninterface Meta {\n  accountId: string;\n  tradingDay: string;\n  equity: string | null;\n  capturedAt: Date;\n}\n\nfunction fakePrisma(opts: { metas?: Meta[]; balances?: Array<{ accountId: string; total: string }>; positions?: Array<{ accountId: string; unrealisedPnl: string | null }> }) {\n  const settings = new Map<string, any>();\n  return {\n    settings,\n    riskSnapshotMetadata: {\n      findMany: jest.fn(async (args: any) => {\n        const ids: string[] = args.where.accountId.in;\n        return (opts.metas ?? [])\n          .filter((m) => m.tradingDay === args.where.tradingDay && ids.includes(m.accountId) && m.equity !== null)\n          .sort((a, b) => a.capturedAt.getTime() - b.capturedAt.getTime())\n          .map((m) => ({ accountId: m.accountId, equity: m.equity === null ? null : dec(m.equity), capturedAt: m.capturedAt }));\n      }),\n    },\n    accountBalanceSnapshot: {\n      findMany: jest.fn(async (args: any) =>\n        (opts.balances ?? []).filter((b) => !args.where.accountId || b.accountId === args.where.accountId).map((b) => ({ ...b, total: dec(b.total), updatedAt: new Date() })),\n      ),\n    },\n    position: {\n      findMany: jest.fn(async (args: any) =>\n        (opts.positions ?? [])\n          .filter((p) => !args.where.accountId || p.accountId === args.where.accountId)\n          .map((p) => ({ ...p, unrealisedPnl: p.unrealisedPnl === null ? null : dec(p.unrealisedPnl), updatedAt: new Date() })),\n      ),\n    },\n    fill: { findMany: jest.fn(async () => []) },\n  } as any;\n}\n\nfunction fakePolicy(thresholds: Record<string, any>) {\n  return { resolveEffectivePolicy: jest.fn(async () => ({ effectiveVersion: 'v-test', thresholds })) } as any;\n}\n\nfunction fakeSnapshotRepo() {\n  const store = new Map<string, { highWaterMark: string; timestamp: string }>();\n  return {\n    store,\n    getHighWaterMark: jest.fn(async (p: any) => store.get(`${p.scope}:${p.scopeId}`) ?? null),\n    persistHighWaterMark: jest.fn(async (p: any) => {\n      store.set(`${p.scope}:${p.scopeId}`, { highWaterMark: p.highWaterMark, timestamp: p.timestamp });\n    }),\n  } as any;\n}\n\ndescribe('resolveDayStartEquity', () => {\n  test('earliest snapshot of the day per account, summed', async () => {\n    const d = today();\n    const prisma = fakePrisma({\n      metas: [\n        { accountId: ACC1, tradingDay: d, equity: '1200', capturedAt: new Date(`${d}T05:00:00Z`) },\n        { accountId: ACC1, tradingDay: d, equity: '1000', capturedAt: new Date(`${d}T00:01:00Z`) },\n        { accountId: ACC2, tradingDay: d, equity: '500.5', capturedAt: new Date(`${d}T00:02:00Z`) },\n        { accountId: ACC2, tradingDay: '1999-01-01', equity: '9', capturedAt: new Date('1999-01-01T00:00:00Z') },\n      ],\n    });\n    await expect(resolveDayStartEquity(prisma, TENANT, d, [ACC1, ACC2])).resolves.toBe('1500.5');\n  });\n\n  test('any account without a snapshot makes the reference unknown', async () => {\n    const d = today();\n    const prisma = fakePrisma({ metas: [{ accountId: ACC1, tradingDay: d, equity: '1000', capturedAt: new Date() }] });\n    await expect(resolveDayStartEquity(prisma, TENANT, d, [ACC1, ACC2])).resolves.toBeNull();\n    await expect(resolveDayStartEquity(prisma, TENANT, d, [])).resolves.toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  test('scopeAccountIdsOf: explicit account wins, else distinct rows', () => {\n    expect(Array.from(scopeAccountIdsOf(ACC1, [{ accountId: ACC2 }]))).toEqual([ACC1]);\n    expect(Array.from(scopeAccountIdsOf(undefined, [{ accountId: ACC2 }, { accountId: ACC1 }, { accountId: ACC2 }])).sort()).toEqual([ACC1, ACC2]);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('DailyLossLimitService', () => {\n  test('uses day-start EQUITY (not gross exposure) and breaches on a real loss', async () => {\n    const d = today();\n    const prisma = fakePrisma({\n      metas: [{ accountId: ACC1, tradingDay: d, equity: '10000', capturedAt: new Date(`${d}T00:00:30Z`) }],\n      balances: [{ accountId: ACC1, total: '8500' }],\n      positions: [{ accountId: ACC1, unrealisedPnl: '-300' }],\n    });\n    const service = new DailyLossLimitService(prisma, fakePolicy({ maxDailyLoss: '1000', dailyLossIncludesUnrealized: true }));\n    const [r] = await service.evaluateDailyLoss({ tenantId: TENANT, accountId: ACC1 });\n    expect(r.startingEquity).toBe('10000');\n    expect(r.currentEquity).toBe('8200');\n    expect(r.dailyPnl).toBe('-1800');\n    expect(r.isBreach).toBe(true);\n    expect(r.state).toBe(RiskState.BLOCKED);\n  });\n\n  test('no day-start snapshot => UNKNOWN, never a fabricated reference', async () => {\n    const prisma = fakePrisma({ balances: [{ accountId: ACC1, total: '8500' }] });\n    const service = new DailyLossLimitService(prisma, fakePolicy({ maxDailyLoss: '1000', dailyLossIncludesUnrealized: true }));\n    const [r] = await service.evaluateDailyLoss({ tenantId: TENANT, accountId: ACC1 });\n    expect(r.startingEquity).toBeNull();\n    expect(r.dailyPnl).toBeNull();\n    expect(r.state).toBe(RiskState.UNKNOWN);\n  });\n\n  test('tenant scope requires a reference for every account holding balances', async () => {\n    const d = today();\n    const prisma = fakePrisma({\n      metas: [{ accountId: ACC1, tradingDay: d, equity: '10000', capturedAt: new Date() }],\n      balances: [\n        { accountId: ACC1, total: '10000' },\n        { accountId: ACC2, total: '5000' },\n      ],\n    });\n    const service = new DailyLossLimitService(prisma, fakePolicy({ maxDailyLoss: '1000', dailyLossIncludesUnrealized: true }));\n    const [r] = await service.evaluateDailyLoss({ tenantId: TENANT });\n    expect(r.state).toBe(RiskState.UNKNOWN);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('DrawdownRiskService intraday drawdown', () => {\n  test('peak seeded with day-start equity, ratchets up, persists per day', async () => {\n    const d = today();\n    let balance = '10500';\n    const prisma = fakePrisma({ metas: [{ accountId: ACC1, tradingDay: d, equity: '10000', capturedAt: new Date() }], balances: [] });\n    prisma.accountBalanceSnapshot.findMany = jest.fn(async () => [{ accountId: ACC1, total: dec(balance), updatedAt: new Date() }]);\n    const repo = fakeSnapshotRepo();\n    const service = new DrawdownRiskService(prisma, fakePolicy({ maxDrawdownPercent: '50' }), repo);\n\n    const [first] = await service.evaluateDrawdown({ tenantId: TENANT, accountId: ACC1 });\n    expect(first.intradayDrawdownPercent).toBe('0'); // new intraday peak 10500\n    const key = `TENANT:${ACC1}:${d.replace(/-/g, '')}`;\n    expect(repo.store.get(key)?.highWaterMark).toBe('10500');\n\n    balance = '9450';\n    const [second] = await service.evaluateDrawdown({ tenantId: TENANT, accountId: ACC1 });\n    expect(second.intradayDrawdownPercent).toBe('10'); // (10500-9450)/10500\n    expect(repo.store.get(key)?.highWaterMark).toBe('10500');\n  });\n\n  test('without day-start equity the intraday figure is null, not the rolling one', async () => {\n    const prisma = fakePrisma({ balances: [{ accountId: ACC1, total: '9000' }] });\n    const repo = fakeSnapshotRepo();\n    repo.store.set(`TENANT:${ACC1}`, { highWaterMark: '10000', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n    const service = new DrawdownRiskService(prisma, fakePolicy({ maxDrawdownPercent: '50' }), repo);\n    const [r] = await service.evaluateDrawdown({ tenantId: TENANT, accountId: ACC1 });\n    expect(r.rollingDrawdownPercent).toBe('10');\n    expect(r.intradayDrawdownPercent).toBeNull();\n  });\n});\n\nfunction exposure(partial: Partial<PortfolioExposure>): PortfolioExposure {\n  return {\n    tenantId: TENANT,\n    asOf: new Date().toISOString(),\n    policyVersion: 'v',\n    grossExposure: '0',\n    netExposure: '0',\n    longExposure: '0',\n    shortExposure: '0',\n    openOrderExposure: '0',\n    totalExposure: '0',\n    notionalUtilizationPercent: null,\n    symbolExposures: [],\n    venueExposures: [],\n    accountExposures: [],\n    strategyExposures: [],\n    traderExposures: [],\n    followerExposures: [],\n    staleSymbols: [],\n    unknownPrices: [],\n    sourceTimestamps: {},\n    state: RiskState.NORMAL,\n    warnings: [],\n    ...partial,\n  };\n}\n\nfunction sym(symbol: string, base: string, net: string, gross: string) {\n  return { symbol, venue: 'BINANCE', baseAsset: base, quoteAsset: 'USDT', longNotional: '0', shortNotional: '0', netNotional: net, grossNotional: gross, openOrderNotional: '0', totalExposure: gross, concentrationPercent: null, price: null, priceTimestamp: null, isStale: false };\n}\n\nfunction scenario(type: any, parameters: Record<string, string>, shockedAssets: string[] = []): StressScenario {\n  return { scenarioId: `T_${type}`, type, name: type, description: type, parameters, shockedAssets };\n}\n\ndescribe('computeScenarioImpact', () => {\n  // Long 10k BTC, short 4k ETH: gross 14k, net +6k.\n  const book = exposure({\n    grossExposure: '14000',\n    netExposure: '6000',\n    symbolExposures: [sym('BTC-USDT', 'BTC', '10000', '10000'), sym('ETH-USDT', 'ETH', '-4000', '4000')],\n    venueExposures: [{ venue: 'BINANCE', grossNotional: '14000', netNotional: '6000', concentrationPercent: '100', accountCount: 1, symbolCount: 2 }],\n  });\n  const equity = 20000n * 1_000_000_000_000n;\n\n  test('market shock revalues the signed net book (shorts gain on a down move)', () => {\n    const r = computeScenarioImpact(scenario('MARKET_SHOCK', { shockPercent: '-10' }), book, equity);\n    expect(r.pnl).toBe('-600'); // -1000 on BTC long, +400 on ETH short\n    expect(r.exposure).toBe('12600');\n    expect(r.margin).toBe('3'); // 600 / 20000\n  });\n\n  test('correlated shock only touches the listed assets', () => {\n    const r = computeScenarioImpact(scenario('CORRELATED_SHOCK', { shockPercent: '-20' }, ['BTC']), book, equity);\n    expect(r.pnl).toBe('-2000');\n    expect(r.exposure).toBe('12000'); // BTC 10000 -> 8000, ETH unchanged 4000\n  });\n\n  test('gains consume no margin', () => {\n    const r = computeScenarioImpact(scenario('GAP_MOVE', { gapPercent: '15' }), book, equity);\n    expect(r.pnl).toBe('900');\n    expect(r.margin).toBe('0');\n  });\n\n  test('margin impact is null when equity is unknown', () => {\n    expect(computeScenarioImpact(scenario('MARKET_SHOCK', { shockPercent: '-10' }), book, null).margin).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  test('slippage prices liquidation of the gross book from bps', () => {\n    const r = computeScenarioImpact(scenario('SLIPPAGE_EXPANSION', { slippageBpsIncrease: '100' }), book, equity);\n    expect(r.pnl).toBe('-140');\n  });\n\n  test('liquidity reduction uses stated parameters, no hidden 1%', () => {\n    const r = computeScenarioImpact(scenario('LIQUIDITY_REDUCTION', { baseMarketImpactBps: '25', marketImpactMultiplier: '2' }), book, equity);\n    expect(r.pnl).toBe('-70'); // 14000 * 0.25% * 2\n    expect(computeScenarioImpact(scenario('LIQUIDITY_REDUCTION', { marketImpactMultiplier: '2' }), book, equity).pnl).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  test('vol expansion needs an initial margin rate; otherwise margin impact is null', () => {\n    expect(computeScenarioImpact(scenario('VOL_EXPANSION', { marginIncreasePercent: '50' }), book, equity).margin).toBeNull();\n    const r = computeScenarioImpact(scenario('VOL_EXPANSION', { marginIncreasePercent: '50', initialMarginRatePercent: '10' }), book, equity);\n    expect(r.margin).toBe('3.5'); // IM 1400, +50% = 700, / 20000\n  });\n\n  test('exchange outage traps only the named venue exposure', () => {\n    expect(computeScenarioImpact(scenario('EXCHANGE_OUTAGE', { venue: 'BINANCE' }), book, equity)).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ exposure: '14000', elevate: true }));\n    expect(computeScenarioImpact(scenario('EXCHANGE_OUTAGE', { venue: 'OKX' }), book, equity)).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ exposure: '0', elevate: false }));\n  });\n\n  test('empty book is zero impact', () => {\n    expect(computeScenarioImpact(scenario('MARKET_SHOCK', { shockPercent: '-10' }), exposure({}), equity)).toEqual({ pnl: '0', exposure: '0', margin: '0', elevate: false });\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe('StressTestService', () => {\n  test('breach only on losses; levels never downgraded; unknown estimates are UNKNOWN', async () => {\n    const book = exposure({ grossExposure: '14000', netExposure: '6000', symbolExposures: [sym('BTC-USDT', 'BTC', '10000', '10000'), sym('ETH-USDT', 'ETH', '-4000', '4000')] });\n    const prisma = fakePrisma({ balances: [{ accountId: ACC1, total: '20000' }] });\n    const exposureService = { calculateExposure: jest.fn(async () => book) } as any;\n    const service = new StressTestService(prisma, fakePolicy({ stressLossThreshold: '500' }), exposureService);\n    const results = await service.runStressTests({\n      tenantId: TENANT,\n      accountId: ACC1,\n      scenarios: [\n        scenario('MARKET_SHOCK', { shockPercent: '-10' }),\n        scenario('MARKET_SHOCK', { shockPercent: '20' }),\n        scenario('LIQUIDITY_REDUCTION', { marketImpactMultiplier: '2' }),\n      ],\n    });\n    expect(results[0].isBreach).toBe(true);\n    expect(results[0].riskLevel).toBe(RiskState.HIGH);\n    expect(results[0].estimatedMarginImpact).toBe('3');\n    expect(results[1].estimatedPnlImpact).toBe('1200');\n    expect(results[1].isBreach).toBe(false);\n    expect(results[2].estimatedPnlImpact).toBeNull();\n    expect(results[2].riskLevel).toBe(RiskState.UNKNOWN);\n  });\n});\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/risk-management/risk-decision.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":9,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { OutboxService } from '../../infrastructure/outbox/outbox.service';\nimport { InstitutionalRiskPolicyService } from './risk-policy.service';\nimport { PortfolioExposureService } from './portfolio-exposure.service';\nimport { PositionRiskService } from './position-risk.service';\nimport { MarginRiskService } from './margin-risk.service';\nimport { LeverageRiskService } from './leverage-risk.service';\nimport { LiquidationRiskService } from './liquidation-risk.service';\nimport { ConcentrationRiskService } from './concentration-risk.service';\nimport { DrawdownRiskService } from './drawdown-risk.service';\nimport { DailyLossLimitService } from './daily-loss-limit.service';\nimport { CorrelationRiskService } from './correlation-risk.service';\nimport { VarRiskService } from './var-risk.service';\nimport { StressTestService } from './stress-test.service';\nimport { CircuitBreakerService } from './circuit-breaker.service';\nimport { KillSwitchOrchestratorService } from './kill-switch-orchestrator.service';\nimport { RiskManagementSnapshotRepository } from './risk-snapshot.repository';\nimport { RiskEventService } from './risk-event.service';\nimport {\n  UnifiedRiskDecision,\n  RiskDecision,\n  RiskState,\n  RiskDimension,\n  RiskPolicyScope,\n  RiskDecisionDetail,\n  RiskSeverity,\n  RiskEventType,\n  CircuitBreakerScope,\n} from './risk-management.types';\n\n/**\n * Unified risk decision orchestration.\n * Input: tenant/user/account/order intent/strategy/follower/symbol/env\n * Compose: exposure/position/margin/leverage/liquidation/concentration/drawdown/daily loss/correlation/compliance/security/exchange health/circuit-breaker/kill-switch\n * Explicit priority: BLOCKED/KILL_SWITCH never becomes ALLOW.\n * Returns final decision/state/blocking reasons/warnings/policies/ruleIds/policy version/timestamp.\n *\n * Reuses existing RiskModule, ExecutionEngine, ExchangesModule, Compliance, Security, CopyTrading, etc via Prisma reads.\n * Never directly places order, never bypasses compliance/live-mode gate, never mutates ledger.\n * Decimal-safe, deterministic.\n */\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class RiskDecisionService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(RiskDecisionService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: InstitutionalRiskPolicyService,\n    private readonly exposureService: PortfolioExposureService,\n    private readonly positionService: PositionRiskService,\n    private readonly marginService: MarginRiskService,\n    private readonly leverageService: LeverageRiskService,\n    private readonly liquidationService: LiquidationRiskService,\n    private readonly concentrationService: ConcentrationRiskService,\n    private readonly drawdownService: DrawdownRiskService,\n    private readonly dailyLossService: DailyLossLimitService,\n    private readonly correlationService: CorrelationRiskService,\n    private readonly varService: VarRiskService,\n    private readonly stressService: StressTestService,\n    private readonly breakerService: CircuitBreakerService,\n    private readonly killSwitchService: KillSwitchOrchestratorService,\n    private readonly snapshotRepo: RiskManagementSnapshotRepository,\n    private readonly eventService: RiskEventService,\n    private readonly outbox: OutboxService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async evaluateUnifiedRisk(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId?: string;\n    accountId?: string;\n    symbol?: string;\n    venue?: string;\n    traderId?: string;\n    followerId?: string;\n    strategyId?: string;\n    orderIntent?: { side: 'BUY' | 'SELL'; quantity: string; price?: string | null; orderType: 'MARKET' | 'LIMIT' | 'STOP' | 'STOP_LIMIT' } | null;\n    environment?: 'PAPER' | 'LIVE';\n    requestId?: string;\n  }): Promise<UnifiedRiskDecision> {\n    const {\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      accountId,\n      symbol,\n      venue,\n      traderId,\n      followerId,\n      strategyId,\n      orderIntent,\n      environment = 'PAPER',\n      requestId,\n    } = params;\n\n    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolveEffectivePolicy({\n      tenantId,\n      traderId: traderId ?? null,\n      strategyId: strategyId ?? null,\n      followerId: followerId ?? null,\n    });\n\n    const details: RiskDecisionDetail[] = [];\n    const blockingReasons: string[] = [];\n    const warnings: string[] = [];\n\n    // Helper to push detail\n    const pushDetail = (d: RiskDecisionDetail) => {\n      details.push(d);\n      if (d.isBlocking) blockingReasons.push(d.reason);\n      if (d.isWarning) warnings.push(d.reason);\n    };\n\n    // 1. Exposure\n    try {\n      const exposure = await this.exposureService.calculateExposure({ tenantId, accountId, traderId, strategyId, followerId });\n      if (exposure.state === RiskState.BLOCKED) {\n        pushDetail({\n          dimension: RiskDimension.EXPOSURE,\n          decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n          state: RiskState.BLOCKED,\n          ruleId: 'MAX_GROSS_EXPOSURE',\n          policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n          current: exposure.grossExposure,\n          threshold: policy.thresholds.maxGrossExposure,\n          severity: RiskSeverity.CRITICAL,\n          reason: `Gross exposure ${exposure.grossExposure} exceeds limit ${policy.thresholds.maxGrossExposure}`,\n          timestamp: nowIso,\n          scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n          scopeId: tenantId,\n          isBlocking: true,\n          isWarning: false,\n        });\n      } else if (exposure.state === RiskState.STALE) {\n        pushDetail({\n          dimension: RiskDimension.MARKET_DATA,\n          decision: environment === 'LIVE' ? RiskDecision.BLOCK : RiskDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED,\n          state: RiskState.STALE,\n          ruleId: 'MARKET_DATA_STALE',\n          policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n          current: null,\n          threshold: policy.thresholds.marketDataMaxAgeMs.toString(),\n          severity: RiskSeverity.WARNING,\n          reason: `Exposure stale due to market data: ${exposure.staleSymbols.join(',')}`,\n          timestamp: nowIso,\n          scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n          scopeId: tenantId,\n          isBlocking: environment === 'LIVE',\n          isWarning: environment !== 'LIVE',\n        });\n      }\n      // Check symbol exposure if order intent present\n      if (orderIntent && symbol) {\n        const symExp = exposure.symbolExposures.find((s) => s.symbol === symbol);\n        if (symExp && policy.thresholds.maxSymbolExposure) {\n          // Compare grossNotional vs threshold\n          const gross = symExp.grossNotional;\n          if (gross && policy.thresholds.maxSymbolExposure) {\n            const cmp = this.cmpDecimal(gross, policy.thresholds.maxSymbolExposure);\n            if (cmp > 0) {\n              pushDetail({\n                dimension: RiskDimension.EXPOSURE,\n                decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n                state: RiskState.BLOCKED,\n                ruleId: 'MAX_SYMBOL_EXPOSURE',\n                policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n                current: gross,\n                threshold: policy.thresholds.maxSymbolExposure,\n                severity: RiskSeverity.CRITICAL,\n                reason: `Symbol exposure ${gross} for ${symbol} exceeds max ${policy.thresholds.maxSymbolExposure}`,\n                timestamp: nowIso,\n                scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n                scopeId: tenantId,\n                isBlocking: true,\n                isWarning: false,\n              });\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      pushDetail({\n        dimension: RiskDimension.EXPOSURE,\n        decision: RiskDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED,\n        state: RiskState.UNKNOWN,\n        ruleId: 'MAX_GROSS_EXPOSURE',\n        policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n        current: null,\n        threshold: policy.thresholds.maxGrossExposure,\n        severity: RiskSeverity.WARNING,\n        reason: `Exposure evaluation failed: ${(e as Error).message}, fail-closed to REVIEW_REQUIRED`,\n        timestamp: nowIso,\n        scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n        scopeId: tenantId,\n        isBlocking: false,\n        isWarning: true,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 2. Position risk\n    try {\n      const posResults = await this.positionService.evaluatePositionRisk({ tenantId, accountId, symbol, traderId, strategyId, followerId });\n      for (const pr of posResults) {\n        if (pr.state === RiskState.BLOCKED || pr.state === RiskState.CRITICAL) {\n          pushDetail({\n            dimension: RiskDimension.POSITION,\n            decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n            state: pr.state,\n            ruleId: pr.ruleId,\n            policyVersion: pr.policyVersion,\n            current: pr.notional,\n            threshold: policy.thresholds.maxPositionNotional,\n            severity: pr.severity,\n            reason: pr.reason,\n            timestamp: nowIso,\n            scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n            scopeId: pr.accountId,\n            isBlocking: true,\n            isWarning: false,\n          });\n        } else if (pr.state === RiskState.STALE || pr.state === RiskState.UNKNOWN) {\n          pushDetail({\n            dimension: RiskDimension.POSITION,\n            decision: RiskDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED,\n            state: pr.state,\n            ruleId: pr.ruleId,\n            policyVersion: pr.policyVersion,\n            current: pr.notional,\n            threshold: null,\n            severity: pr.severity,\n            reason: pr.reason,\n            timestamp: nowIso,\n            scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n            scopeId: pr.accountId,\n            isBlocking: false,\n            isWarning: true,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Position risk failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // 3. Margin\n    if (accountId) {\n      try {\n        const marginResults = await this.marginService.evaluateMargin({ tenantId, accountId, orderIntent: orderIntent ? { symbol: symbol ?? '', quantity: orderIntent.quantity, price: orderIntent.price ?? null, side: orderIntent.side } : null });\n        for (const mr of marginResults) {\n          if (mr.state === RiskState.BLOCKED || mr.state === RiskState.CRITICAL) {\n            pushDetail({\n              dimension: RiskDimension.MARGIN,\n              decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n              state: mr.state,\n              ruleId: mr.ruleId,\n              policyVersion: mr.policyVersion,\n              current: mr.marginUtilizationPercent,\n              threshold: policy.thresholds.marginCriticalUtilization,\n              severity: mr.severity,\n              reason: mr.reason,\n              timestamp: nowIso,\n              scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n              scopeId: accountId,\n              isBlocking: true,\n              isWarning: false,\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Margin risk failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 4. Leverage\n    if (accountId) {\n      try {\n        const levResults = await this.leverageService.evaluateLeverage({\n          tenantId,\n          accountId,\n          symbol,\n          orderIntent: orderIntent ? { quantity: orderIntent.quantity, price: orderIntent.price ?? null, side: orderIntent.side } : null,\n        });\n        for (const lr of levResults) {\n          if (lr.isBreach) {\n            pushDetail({\n              dimension: RiskDimension.LEVERAGE,\n              decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n              state: lr.state,\n              ruleId: lr.ruleId,\n              policyVersion: lr.policyVersion,\n              current: lr.projectedGrossLeverage ?? lr.grossLeverage,\n              threshold: lr.policyMaxLeverage,\n              severity: lr.severity,\n              reason: lr.reason,\n              timestamp: nowIso,\n              scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n              scopeId: accountId,\n              isBlocking: true,\n              isWarning: false,\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Leverage risk failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 5. Liquidation\n    try {\n      const liqResults = await this.liquidationService.evaluateLiquidationRisk({ tenantId, accountId, symbol, traderId, strategyId, followerId });\n      for (const l of liqResults) {\n        if (l.isCritical) {\n          pushDetail({\n            dimension: RiskDimension.LIQUIDATION,\n            decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n            state: l.state,\n            ruleId: l.ruleId,\n            policyVersion: l.policyVersion,\n            current: l.distancePercent,\n            threshold: policy.thresholds.liquidationCriticalDistance,\n            severity: l.severity,\n            reason: l.reason,\n            timestamp: nowIso,\n            scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n            scopeId: l.accountId,\n            isBlocking: true,\n            isWarning: false,\n          });\n        } else if (l.isWarning) {\n          pushDetail({\n            dimension: RiskDimension.LIQUIDATION,\n            decision: RiskDecision.REDUCE,\n            state: l.state,\n            ruleId: l.ruleId,\n            policyVersion: l.policyVersion,\n            current: l.distancePercent,\n            threshold: policy.thresholds.liquidationWarningDistance,\n            severity: l.severity,\n            reason: l.reason,\n            timestamp: nowIso,\n            scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n            scopeId: l.accountId,\n            isBlocking: false,\n            isWarning: true,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Liquidation risk failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // 6. Concentration\n    try {\n      const concResults = await this.concentrationService.evaluateConcentration({\n        tenantId,\n        accountId,\n        symbol,\n        orderIntent: orderIntent && orderIntent.price ? { notional: this.mulDecimal(orderIntent.quantity, orderIntent.price), symbol: symbol ?? '' } : null,\n      });\n      for (const c of concResults) {\n        if (c.isBreach) {\n          pushDetail({\n            dimension: RiskDimension.CONCENTRATION,\n            decision: RiskDecision.BLOCK,\n            state: c.state,\n            ruleId: c.ruleId,\n            policyVersion: c.policyVersion,\n            current: c.currentPercent,\n            threshold: c.thresholdPercent,\n            severity: c.severity,\n            reason: c.reason,\n            timestamp: nowIso,\n            scope: RiskPolicyScope.TENANT,\n            scopeId: tenantId,\n            isBlocking: true,\n            isWarning: false,\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Concentration risk failed: ${(e as Error).message}`);\n    }\n\n    // 7. '' },\n        requestId: requestId ?? null,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return decision;\n  }\n\n  private cmpDecimal(a: string, b: string): number {\n    const SCALE = 1_000_000_000_000n;\n    const parse = (s: string): bigint => {\n      const neg = s.startsWith('-');\n      const clean = neg ? s.slice(1) : s;\n      const [intP = '0', fracP = ''] = clean.split('.');\n      const frac = (fracP + '0'.repeat(12)).slice(0, 12);\n      const val = BigInt(intP) * SCALE + BigInt(frac || '0');\n      return neg ? -val : val;\n    };\n    const av = parse(a);\n    const bv = parse(b);\n    if (av < bv) return -1;\n    if (av > bv) return 1;\n    return 0;\n  }\n\n  private mulDecimal(a: string, b: string): string {\n    const SCALE = 1_000_000_000_000n;\n    const parse = (s: string): bigint => {\n      const neg = s.startsWith('-');\n      const clean = neg ? s.slice(1) : s;\n      const [intP = '0', fracP = ''] = clean.split('.');\n      const frac = (fracP + '0'.repeat(12)).slice(0, 12);\n      const val = BigInt(intP) * SCALE + BigInt(frac || '0');\n      return neg ? -val : val;\n    };\n    const format = (bb: bigint): string => {\n      const neg = bb < 0n;\n      const abs = neg ? -bb : bb;\n      const intP = abs / SCALE;\n      const frac = abs % SCALE;\n      const fracStr = frac.toString().padStart(12, '0').replace(/0+$/, '');\n      return (neg ?   varConfidence: '95',\n    varHorizonDays: 1,\n    varWindowDays: 90,\n    varMinObservations: 30,\n    varThreshold: null,\n    stressLossThreshold: null,\n    marketDataMaxAgeMs: 30_000,\n ''}`;\n      const dbPol = latestByScope.get(key);\n      if (!dbPol) continue;\n      const policyJson = dbPol.policyJson as Partial<RiskPolicyThresholds>;\n      validateThresholds(policyJson);\n      const jsonStr = canonicalJson(policyJson);\n      if (Buffer.byteLength(jsonStr, 'utf8') > MAX_POLICY_SIZE_BYTES) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Policy too large for scope ${step.scope}`);\n      }\n      // Check no executable\n      if (/__proto__|constructor|process|require|eval/.test(jsonStr)) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Policy contains disallowed pattern for scope ${step.scope}`);\n      }\n      const isPlatform = step.scope === RiskPolicyScope.PLATFORM;\n      effective = mergeThresholds(effective, policyJson, isPlatform);\n      scopeChain.push({ scope: step.scope, scopeId: step.scopeId, version: dbPol.version, digest: dbPol.digest });\n      sourcePolicies.push({\n        scope: step.scope,\n        scopeId: step.scopeId,\n        version: dbPol.version,\n        digest: dbPol.digest,\n        thresholds: policyJson,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Also incorporate existing RiskConfiguration per account if tenantId provided? For institutional we keep separate but note.\n    const effectiveDigest = sha256Hex(canonicalJson(effective));\n    const effectiveVersion = sha256Hex(scopeChain.map((s) => `${s.scope}:${s.scopeId}:${s.version}:${s.digest}`).join('|')).slice(0, 16);\n\n    const ruleIds = Array.from(\n      new Set([\n        'MAX_GROSS_EXPOSURE',\n        'MAX_NET_EXPOSURE',\n        'MAX_SYMBOL_EXPOSURE',\n        'MAX_VENUE_EXPOSURE',\n        'MAX_ACCOUNT_EXPOSURE',\n        'MAX_STRATEGY_EXPOSURE',\n        'MAX_TRADER_EXPOSURE',\n        'MAX_FOLLOWER_EXPOSURE',\n        'MAX_POSITION_NOTIONAL',\n        'MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL',\n        'MAX_OPEN_ORDERS',\n        'MAX_LEVERAGE_GROSS',\n        'MAX_LEVERAGE_NET',\n        'MARGIN_UTILIZATION',\n        'LIQUIDATION_DISTANCE',\n        'MAX_CONCENTRATION_ASSET',\n        'MAX_CONCENTRATION_SYMBOL',\n        'MAX_CONCENTRATION_VENUE',\n        'MAX_DRAWDOWN',\n        'MAX_INTRADAY_DRAWDOWN',\n        'DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT',\n        'MAX_CORRELATION',\n        'VAR_LIMIT',\n        'STRESS_LOSS_LIMIT',\n        'MARKET_DATA_STALE',\n        'EXCHANGE_HEALTH_DEGRADED',\n        'EXECUTION_FAILURE_BURST',\n        'CIRCUIT_BREAKER_LOSS',\n        'COMPLIANCE_BLOCK',\n        'SECURITY_BLOCK',\n      ]),\n    );\n\n    return {\n      tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n      scopeChain,\n      effectiveVersion,\n      effectiveDigest,\n      thresholds: effective,\n      ruleIds,\n      precedence: [RiskPolicyScope.PLATFORM, RiskPolicyScope.TENANT, RiskPolicyScope.TRADER, RiskPolicyScope.STRATEGY, RiskPolicyScope.FOLLOWER],\n      resolvedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      sourcePolicies,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async upsertPolicy(params: {\n    scope: RiskPolicyScope;\n    scopeId?: string | null;\n    tenantId?: string | null;\n    thresholds: Partial<RiskPolicyThresholds>;\n    changeReason: string;\n    changedByUserId: string;\n    actorTenantId?: string;\n  }): Promise<{ id: string; version: number; digest: string }> {\n    const { scope, scopeId, tenantId, thresholds, changeReason, changedByUserId } = params;\n    if (!changeReason || changeReason.trim().length < 10) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('changeReason must be at least 10 characters');\n    }\n    validateThresholds(thresholds);\n    const canonical = canonicalJson(thresholds);\n    if (Buffer.byteLength(canonical, 'utf8') > MAX_POLICY_SIZE_BYTES) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Policy payload too large');\n    }\n    if (/__proto__|constructor|process|require|eval/.test(canonical)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Policy contains disallowed executable pattern');\n    }\n    const digest = sha256Hex(canonical);\n\n    // Platform scope requires PLATFORM_MANAGE (checked in controller) and tenantId must be null\n    if (scope === RiskPolicyScope.PLATFORM && tenantId) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('PLATFORM scope must have null tenantId');\n    }\n\n    // Fetch existing latest version for this scope\n    const existing = await this.prisma.institutionalRiskPolicy.findFirst({\n      where: { scope: scope as any, scopeId: scopeId ?? null, tenantId: tenantId ?? undefined },\n      orderBy: { version: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    // If existing, ensure not weakening higher-level (will be checked on resolve, but also here for immediate feedback)\n    if (existing) {\n      // If this is not platform, fetch platform policy to ensure not weakening\n      if (scope !== RiskPolicyScope.PLATFORM) {\n        const platformPolicy = await this.resolveEffectivePolicy({ tenantId: tenantId ?? null });\n        // merge check will throw if weakening\n        mergeThresholds(platformPolicy.thresholds, thresholds, false);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const nextVersion = (existing?.version ?? 0) + 1;\n\n    const created = await this.prisma.institutionalRiskPolicy.create({\n      data: {\n        scope: scope as any,\n        scopeId: scopeId ?? null,\n        tenantId: tenantId ?? null,\n        version: nextVersion,\n        digest,\n        policyJson: thresholds as any,\n        ruleIds: Object.keys(thresholds).map((k) => k.toUpperCase()),\n        changeReason,\n        changedByUserId,\n        isActive: true,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Deactivate older versions for same scope (keep history but mark inactive)\n    if (existing) {\n      await this.prisma.institutionalRiskPolicy.updateMany({\n        where: { scope: scope as any, scopeId: scopeId ?? null, tenantId: tenantId ?? undefined, id: { not: created.id } },\n        data: { isActive: false },\n      });\n      // Reactivate the newly created one (in case updateMany deactivated it)\n      await this.prisma.institutionalRiskPolicy.update({ where: { id: created.id }, data: { isActive: true } });\n    }\n\n    // Audit log\n    await this.prisma.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId: tenantId ?? undefined,\n        actorId: changedByUserId,\n        actorType: 'USER',\n        action: 'RISK_POLICY_UPSERT',\n        resourceType: 'INSTITUTIONAL_RISK_POLICY',\n        resourceId: created.id,\n        description: `Upsert ${scope} ${scopeId ?? ''} v${nextVersion} digest ${digest}`,\n        changes: { before: existing?.policyJson ?? null, after: thresholds } as any,\n      },\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`Risk policy upsert ${scope} ${scopeId ?? ''} v${nextVersion} digest ${digest}`);\n    return { id: created.id, version: nextVersion, digest };\n  }\n\n  async getPolicyHistory(params: { scope: RiskPolicyScope; scopeId?: string | null; tenantId?: string | null }): Promise<any[]> {\n    return this.prisma.institutionalRiskPolicy.findMany({\n      where: { scope: params.scope as any, scopeId: params.scopeId ?? undefined, tenantId: params.tenantId ?? undefined },\n      orderBy: { version: 'desc' },\n      take: 50,\n    });\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/risk-management/risk-reconciliation.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. s.slice(1) : s;\n  const [intP = '0', fracP = ''] = clean.split('.');\n  const frac = (fracP + '0'.repeat(12)).slice(0, 12);\n  const val = BigInt(intP) * SCALE + BigInt(frac || '0');\n  return neg ? -val : val;\n}\nfunction formatScaled(b: bigint): string {\n  const neg = b < 0n;\n  const abs = neg ? -b : b;\n  const intP = abs / SCALE;\n  const frac = abs % SCALE;\n  const fracStr = frac.toString().padStart(12, '0').replace(/0+$/, '');\n  return (neg ? '-' : '') + (fracStr ? `${intP}.${fracStr}` : `${intP}`);\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class RiskReconciliationService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(RiskReconciliationService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: InstitutionalRiskPolicyService,\n    private readonly exposureService: PortfolioExposureService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async reconcile(params: { tenantId: string; accountId?: string }): Promise<{\n    findings: Array<{ category: string; severity: string; summary: string; expected: any; actual: any }>;\n    totalFindings: number;\n    timestamp: string;\n  }> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId } = params;\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolveEffectivePolicy({ tenantId });\n    const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();\n\n    const positions = await this.prisma.position.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}) },\n    });\n    const orders = await this.prisma.order.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}) },\n    });\n    const balances = await this.prisma.accountBalanceSnapshot.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}) },\n    });\n    const snapshots = await this.prisma.riskManagementSnapshot.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, ...(accountId ? { accountId } : {}) },\n      orderBy: { capturedAt: 'desc' },\n      take: 5,\n    });\n    const breakers = await this.prisma.circuitBreakerRecord.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, state: 'OPEN' as any },\n    });\n    const killSwitches = await this.prisma.killSwitch.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId, isEngaged: true },\n    });\n\n    const findings: Array<{ category: string; severity: string; summary: string; expected: any; actual: any }> = [];\n\n    // 1. Position without exposure: position exists but exposure service reports zero for that symbol?\n    try {\n      const exposure = await this.exposureService.calculateExposure({ tenantId, accountId });\n      const exposureSymbols = new Set(exposure.symbolExposures.map((s) => s.symbol));\n      for (const pos of positions) {\n        const qtyStr = pos.quantity.toString();\n        if (!isValidDecimal(qtyStr) || parseScaled(qtyStr) === 0n) continue;\n        if (!exposureSymbols.has(pos.symbol)) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: 'POSITION_WITHOUT_EXPOSURE',\n            severity: 'MEDIUM',\n            summary: `Position ${pos.symbol} qty ${qtyStr} exists but no exposure reported for account ${pos.accountId}`,\n            expected: { symbol: pos.symbol, shouldHaveExposure: true },\n            actual: { symbol: pos.symbol, exposureFound: false, quantity: qtyStr },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      findings.push({\n        category: 'EXPOSURE_WITHOUT_POSITION',\n        severity: 'LOW',\n        summary: `Exposure calculation failed during reconciliation: ${(e as Error).message}`,\n        expected: { exposureCalculable: true },\n        actual: { error: (e as Error).message },\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 2. Order exposure mismatch: open orders notional vs exposure openOrderNotional\n    const openOrders = orders.filter((o) => ['PENDING', 'SUBMITTED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED'].includes(o.status as string));\n    // We don't have exact expected, but we can flag if open order count differs from exposure openOrderExposure?\n    // Simplified: if open orders exist but exposure openOrderExposure is zero, flag.\n\n    // 3. Balance mismatch: wallet total vs sum of free+locked?\n    for (const b of balances) {\n      const freeStr = b.free.toString();\n      const lockedStr = b.locked.toString();\n      const totalStr = b.total.toString();\n      if (isValidDecimal(freeStr) && isValidDecimal(lockedStr) && isValidDecimal(totalStr)) {\n        const free = parseScaled(freeStr);\n        const locked = parseScaled(lockedStr);\n        const total = parseScaled(totalStr);\n        if (free + locked !== total) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: 'BALANCE_MISMATCH',\n            severity: 'HIGH',\n            summary: `Balance mismatch for ${b.asset} account ${b.accountId}: free ${freeStr} + locked ${lockedStr} != total ${totalStr}`,\n            expected: { freePlusLocked: formatScaled(free + locked) },\n            actual: { total: totalStr, free: freeStr, locked: lockedStr },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 4. PnL drift: realized PnL vs fills? For now check if unrealized is null when mark price exists?\n    for (const pos of positions) {\n      if (pos.markPrice && !pos.unrealisedPnl) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: 'PNL_DRIFT',\n          severity: 'LOW',\n          summary: `Position ${pos.symbol} has mark price ${pos.markPrice} but no unrealized PnL`,\n          expected: { unrealizedShouldExist: true },\n          actual: { markPrice: pos.markPrice.toString(), unrealizedPnl: null },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 5. Snapshot stale\n    if (snapshots.length > 0) {\n      const latest = snapshots[0];\n      const ageMs = Date.now() - new Date(latest.capturedAt).getTime();\n      if (ageMs > policy.thresholds.marketDataMaxAgeMs * 10) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: 'SNAPSHOT_STALE',\n          severity: 'MEDIUM',\n          summary: `Latest risk snapshot ${latest.id} stale: age ${ageMs}ms > ${policy.thresholds.marketDataMaxAgeMs * 10}ms`,\n          expected: { maxAgeMs: policy.thresholds.marketDataMaxAgeMs * 10 },\n          actual: { snapshotId: latest.id, ageMs, capturedAt: latest.capturedAt.toISOString() },\n        });\n      }\n    } else {\n      findings.push({\n        category: 'MISSING_SOURCE',\n        severity: 'LOW',\n        summary: `No risk snapshots found for tenant ${tenantId} account ${accountId ?? 'all'}`,\n        expected: { snapshotExists: true },\n        actual: { count: 0 },\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 6. Breaker mismatch: if breaker OPEN but no corresponding risk event?\n    for (const br of breakers as any[]) {\n      const event = await this.prisma.riskEvent.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId, ruleId: br.triggerRuleId ?? undefined, createdAt: { gte: new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) } },\n      });\n      if (!event) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: 'BREAKER_MISMATCH',\n          severity: 'MEDIUM',\n          summary: `Circuit breaker OPEN for ${br.scope} ${br.scopeId} but no recent risk event for rule ${br.triggerRuleId ?? 'unknown'}`,\n          expected: { riskEventExists: true },\n          actual: { breakerId: br.id, scope: br.scope, scopeId: br.scopeId, triggerRuleId: br.triggerRuleId },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 7. Kill-switch inconsistency: if kill-switch engaged but breaker not?\n    for (const ks of killSwitches as any[]) {\n      // For account-level kill-switch, expect breaker OPEN for same account?\n      if (ks.scope === 'ACCOUNT' && ks.target) {\n        const breaker = (breakers as any[]).find((b: any) => b.scope === 'ACCOUNT' && b.scopeId === ks.target);\n        if (!breaker) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: 'KILL_SWITCH_INCONSISTENCY',\n            severity: 'MEDIUM',\n            summary: `Kill-switch engaged for ACCOUNT ${ks.target} but no circuit breaker OPEN for same account`,\n            expected: { breakerOpen: true },\n            actual: { killSwitchId: ks.id, scope: ks.scope, target: ks.target },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 8. Impossible leverage: gross leverage <0 or >1000?\n    // We need to compute leverage from positions+balances\n    let walletTotal = 0n;\n    for (const b of balances) {\n      const totalStr = b.total.toString();\n      if (isValidDecimal(totalStr)) walletTotal += parseScaled(totalStr);\n    }\n    if (walletTotal > 0n) {\n      let grossNotional = 0n;\n      for (const pos of positions) {\n        const qtyStr = pos.quantity.toString();\n        const markPrice = pos.markPrice?.toString() ?? pos.averageEntryPrice?.toString() ?? null;\n        if (isValidDecimal(qtyStr) && markPrice && isValidDecimal(markPrice)) {\n          const absQty = qtyStr.startsWith('-') ? qtyStr.slice(1) : qtyStr;\n          const notionalStr = formatScaled((parseScaled(absQty) * parseScaled(markPrice)) / SCALE);\n          if (isValidDecimal(notionalStr)) grossNotional += parseScaled(notionalStr);\n        }\n      }\n      if (grossNotional > 0n) {\n        const leverage = (grossNotional * SCALE) / walletTotal;\n        const leverageNum = Number(leverage) / Number(SCALE);\n        if (leverageNum > 1000) {\n          findings.push({\n            category: 'IMPOSSIBLE_LEVERAGE',\n            severity: 'CRITICAL',\n            summary: `Impossible leverage ${leverageNum.toFixed(2)}x for tenant ${tenantId} account ${accountId ?? 'all'}: gross ${formatScaled(grossNotional)} / wallet ${formatScaled(walletTotal)}`,\n            expected: { maxLeverage: 100 },\n            actual: { leverage: leverageNum, grossNotional: formatScaled(grossNotional), walletTotal: formatScaled(walletTotal) },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 9. Negative margin: wallet total negative?\n    if (walletTotal < 0n) {\n      findings.push({\n        category: 'NEGATIVE_MARGIN',\n        severity: 'CRITICAL',\n        summary: `Negative wallet total ${formatScaled(walletTotal)} for tenant ${tenantId} account ${accountId ?? 'all'}`,\n        expected: { walletNonNegative: true },\n        actual: { walletTotal: formatScaled(walletTotal) },\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 10. Stale market data\n    for (const pos of positions) {\n      const ageMs = Date.now() - new Date(pos.updatedAt).getTime();\n      if (ageMs > policy.thresholds.marketDataMaxAgeMs * 5) {\n        findings.push({\n          category: 'STALE_MARKET_DATA',\n          severity: 'MEDIUM',\n          summary: `Position ${pos.symbol} stale: age ${ageMs}ms > ${policy.thresholds.marketDataMaxAgeMs * 5}ms`,\n          expected: { maxAgeMs: policy.thresholds.marketDataMaxAgeMs * 5 },\n          actual: { symbol: pos.symbol, ageMs, updatedAt: pos.updatedAt.toISOString() },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Persist findings\n    for (const f of findings) {\n      await this.prisma.riskReconciliationRecord.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId,\n          accountId: accountId ?? null,\n          category: f.category as any,\n          severity: f.severity,\n          expected: f.expected as any,\n          actual: f.actual as any,\n          summary: f.summary.slice(0, 1000),\n          policyVersion: policy.effectiveVersion,\n        },\n      });\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`Risk reconciliation for tenant ${tenantId} account ${accountId ?? 'all'}: ${findings.length} findings`);\n    return { findings, totalFindings: findings.length, timestamp: nowIso };\n  }\n\n  async getReconciliationHistory(tenantId: string, limit = 50): Promise<any[]> {\n    return this.prisma.riskReconciliationRecord.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      take: limit,\n    });\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/risk-management/risk-snapshot.repository.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. undefined,\n        policyVersion: snapshot.policyVersion,\n        capturedAt: { gte: new Date(new Date(snapshot.timestamp).getTime() - 1000), lte: new Date(new Date(snapshot.timestamp).getTime() + 1000) },\n      },\n    });\n\n    if (existing) {\n      // Check if metric values identical (prevent duplicate)\n      const existingMetrics = JSON.stringify(existing.exposureJson ?? {});\n      const newMetrics = JSON.stringify(snapshot.exposure ?? {});\n      if (existingMetrics === newMetrics && existing.policyVersion === snapshot.policyVersion) {\n        this.logger.log(`Duplicate snapshot detected for tenant ${snapshot.tenantId} account ${snapshot.accountId} policy ${snapshot.policyVersion}, skipping`);\n        return { id: existing.id };\n      }\n    }\n\n    const created = await this.prisma.riskManagementSnapshot.create({\n      data: {\n        tenantId: snapshot.tenantId,\n        userId: snapshot.userId ?? null,\n        traderId: snapshot.traderId ?? null,\n        followerId: snapshot.followerId ?? null,\n        accountId: snapshot.accountId ?? null,\n        strategyId: snapshot.strategyId ?? null,\n        policyVersion: snapshot.policyVersion,\n        policyDigest: snapshot.policyDigest ?? null,\n        state: snapshot.state as any,\n        grossExposure: snapshot.exposure?.grossExposure ?? null,\n        netExposure: snapshot.exposure?.netExposure ?? null,\n        longExposure: snapshot.exposure?.longExposure ?? null,\n        shortExposure: snapshot.exposure?.shortExposure ?? null,\n        marginUtilization: snapshot.margin?.[0]?.marginUtilizationPercent ?? null,\n        leverageGross: snapshot.leverage?.[0]?.grossLeverage ?? null,\n        leverageNet: snapshot.leverage?.[0]?.netLeverage ?? null,\n        drawdownAbs: snapshot.drawdown?.[0]?.drawdownAbs ?? null,\n        drawdownPercent: snapshot.drawdown?.[0]?.drawdownPercent ?? null,\n        dailyPnl: snapshot.dailyLoss?.[0]?.dailyPnl ?? null,\n        dailyLossBudget: snapshot.dailyLoss?.[0]?.remainingBudget ?? null,\n        concentrationJson: snapshot.concentration as any,\n        exposureJson: snapshot.exposure as any,\n        marginJson: snapshot.margin as any,\n        leverageJson: snapshot.leverage as any,\n        liquidationJson: snapshot.liquidation as any,\n        correlationJson: snapshot.correlation as any,\n        varJson: snapshot.var as any,\n        stressJson: snapshot.stress as any,\n        sourceTimestamps: snapshot.sourceTimestamps as any,\n        capturedAt: new Date(snapshot.timestamp),\n      },\n    });\n\n    return { id: created.id };\n  }\n\n  async getLatestSnapshot(params: { tenantId: string; accountId?: string; traderId?: string; followerId?: string; strategyId?: string }): Promise<RiskSnapshot | null> {\n    const { tenantId, accountId, traderId, followerId, strategyId } = params;\n    const row = await this.prisma.riskManagementSnapshot.findFirst({\n      where: {\n        tenantId,\n        accountId: accountId ?? undefined,\n        traderId: traderId ?? undefined,\n        followerId: followerId ?? undefined,\n        strategyId: strategyId ?? undefined,\n      },\n      orderBy: { capturedAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (!row) return null;\n\n    return {\n      id: row.id,\n      tenantId: row.tenantId,\n      userId: row.userId ?? null,\n      traderId: row.traderId ?? null,\n      followerId: row.followerId ?? null,\n      accountId: row.accountId ?? null,\n      strategyId: row.strategyId ?? null,\n      timestamp: row.capturedAt.toISOString(),\n      policyVersion: row.policyVersion,\n      policyDigest: row.policyDigest ?? null,\n      state: row.state as RiskState,\n      exposure: row.exposureJson as any,\n      margin: (row.marginJson as any) ?? [],\n      leverage: (row.leverageJson as any) ?? [],\n      drawdown: [],\n      concentration: (row.concentrationJson as any) ?? [],\n      liquidation: (row.liquidationJson as any) ?? [],\n      dailyLoss: [],\n      var: (row.varJson as any) ?? [],\n      stress: (row.stressJson as any) ?? [],\n      correlation: (row.correlationJson as any) ?? [],\n      circuitBreakers: [],\n      killSwitch: null,\n      metricValues: {},\n      sourceTimestamps: (row.sourceTimestamps as any) ?? {},\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getSnapshotsByTenant(tenantId: string, limit = 50): Promise<any[]> {\n    return this.prisma.riskManagementSnapshot.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId },\n      orderBy: { capturedAt: 'desc' },\n      take: limit,\n    });\n  }\n\n  // High-water mark persistence for drawdown (separate from snapshot, but stored via snapshots table + TenantSetting fallback)\n\n  async getHighWaterMark(params: { tenantId: string; scope: string; scopeId: string }): Promise<{ highWaterMark: string; timestamp: string } | null> {\n    const { tenantId, scope, scopeId } = params;\n    // Use TenantSetting with key hwm:<scope>:<scopeId> for quick lookup, plus snapshot history\n    const key = `risk_hwm:${scope}:${scopeId}`;\n    const setting = await this.prisma.tenantSetting.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, key },\n    });\n    if (setting?.value && typeof setting.value === 'object') {\n      const val = setting.value as any;\n      if (val.highWaterMark && val.timestamp) {\n        return { highWaterMark: val.highWaterMark, timestamp: val.timestamp };\n      }\n    }\n    // Fallback: latest snapshot drawdown\n    const latest = await this.prisma.riskManagementSnapshot.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, ...(scope === 'TRADER' ? { traderId: scopeId } : scope === 'STRATEGY' ? { strategyId: scopeId } : scope === 'FOLLOWER' ? { followerId: scopeId } : { accountId: scopeId }) },\n      orderBy: { capturedAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    if (latest?.drawdownAbs) {\n      // Not HWM, but we can approximate? Actually drawdown contains HWM? We stored drawdownAbs/percent but not HWM. So we need to search snapshot with HWM in exposureJson?\n      // For now return null if not in TenantSetting.\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async persistHighWaterMark(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    scope: string;\n    scopeId: string;\n    highWaterMark: string;\n    timestamp: string;\n    policyVersion: string;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const { tenantId, scope, scopeId, highWaterMark, timestamp, policyVersion } = params;\n    const key = `risk_hwm:${scope}:${scopeId}`;\n    await this.prisma.tenantSetting.upsert({\n      where: { tenantId_key: { tenantId, key } },\n      create: {\n        tenantId,\n        key,\n        value: { highWaterMark, timestamp, policyVersion, scope, scopeId } as any,\n        category: 'risk',\n        description: `High-water mark for ${scope} ${scopeId}`,\n      },\n      update: {\n        value: { highWaterMark, timestamp, policyVersion, scope, scopeId } as any,\n        updatedAt: new Date(),\n      },\n    });\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/risk-management/risk.controller.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":41,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Controller, Get, Post, Body, Param, Query, Req, ForbiddenException, BadRequestException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { Permission } from '@wlct/shared-types';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { RequireAnyPermission, RequirePermissions } from '../../common/decorators/permissions.decorator';\nimport { RiskDecisionService } from './risk-decision.service';\nimport { InstitutionalRiskPolicyService } from './risk-policy.service';\nimport { PortfolioExposureService } from './portfolio-exposure.service';\nimport { PositionRiskService } from './position-risk.service';\nimport { MarginRiskService } from './margin-risk.service';\nimport { LeverageRiskService } from './leverage-risk.service';\nimport { LeveragePolicyService } from '../risk/leverage-policy.service';\nimport { LiquidationRiskService } from './liquidation-risk.service';\nimport { ConcentrationRiskService } from './concentration-risk.service';\nimport { DrawdownRiskService } from './drawdown-risk.service';\nimport { DailyLossLimitService } from './daily-loss-limit.service';\nimport { CorrelationRiskService } from './correlation-risk.service';\nimport { VarRiskService } from './var-risk.service';\nimport { StressTestService } from './stress-test.service';\nimport { RiskManagementSnapshotRepository } from './risk-snapshot.repository';\nimport { CircuitBreakerService } from './circuit-breaker.service';\nimport { KillSwitchOrchestratorService, KillSwitchRequestScope } from './kill-switch-orchestrator.service';\nimport { RiskReconciliationService } from './risk-reconciliation.service';\nimport { CustomerExposureService } from './customer-exposure.service';\nimport type { CustomerRiskAnalysisView } from './customer-risk-analysis.types';\nimport { RiskCheckDto } from './dto/risk-check.dto';\nimport { UpsertRiskPolicyDto, RiskPolicyScopeDto } from './dto/risk-policy.dto';\nimport { RiskPolicyScope, CircuitBreakerScope } from './risk-management.types';\nimport { authTenantId, authUserIdOrNull, principal } from '../../common/guards/request-principal';\n\n/**\n * Institutional risk controller with RBAC:\n * - dashboard/pre-trade check/account/trader/strategy/follower risk/policy/breaker status/actions/kill-switch/reconciliation\n * - tenant risk admins own tenant, trader/follower own scope, platform risk admins PLATFORM_MANAGE, no cross-tenant\n * - No secrets in responses\n */\n\n/**\n * Risk-management console (unified pre-trade check, exposure, margin, VaR,\n * policies, circuit breakers, kill switches, reconciliation).\n *\n * The controller carried no permission metadata, so any tenant user, a\n * follower included, could rewrite the tenant's risk policy or trigger and\n * clear circuit breakers and kill switches. Permissions now mirror the\n * decorated risk controller (/risk): reads risk:read, policy changes\n * risk:config:update (class default), trigger/request/acknowledge\n * risk:kill_switch_update, clear risk:protection_clear. The pre-trade check\n * needs execution:submit or risk:config:update.\n */\n@RequirePermissions(Permission.RISK_CONFIG_UPDATE)\n@Controller('risk-management')\nexport class RiskManagementController {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly decisionService: RiskDecisionService,\n    private readonly policyService: InstitutionalRiskPolicyService,\n    private readonly exposureService: PortfolioExposureService,\n    private readonly positionService: PositionRiskService,\n    private readonly marginService: MarginRiskService,\n    private readonly leverageService: LeverageRiskService,\n    private readonly leveragePolicyService: LeveragePolicyService,\n    private readonly liquidationService: LiquidationRiskService,\n    private readonly concentrationService: ConcentrationRiskService,\n    private readonly drawdownService: DrawdownRiskService,\n    private readonly dailyLossService: DailyLossLimitService,\n    private readonly correlationService: CorrelationRiskService,\n    private readonly varService: VarRiskService,\n    private readonly stressService: StressTestService,\n    private readonly snapshotRepo: RiskManagementSnapshotRepository,\n    private readonly breakerService: CircuitBreakerService,\n    private readonly killSwitchService: KillSwitchOrchestratorService,\n    private readonly reconciliationService: RiskReconciliationService,\n    // Customer-facing exposure: owner-scoped and non-sandbox-correct, unlike the institutional\n    // PortfolioExposureService above, which answers for an operator-selected account. Both are\n    // real routes; neither replaces the other.\n    private readonly customerExposureService: CustomerExposureService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private getTenantId(req: any): string {\n    // Token tenant only; a header can never select the tenant.\n    return authTenantId(req);\n  }\n\n  private getUserId(req: any): string {\n    return authUserIdOrNull(req) ?? 'system';\n  }\n\n  private checkTenantAccess(req: any, targetTenantId: string): void {\n    const userTenantId = req.user?.tenantId;\n    const isPlatform = req.user?.isPlatformUser || req.user?.roles?.includes('PLATFORM_ADMIN') || req.user?.permissions?.includes('PLATFORM_MANAGE');\n    if (!isPlatform && userTenantId && userTenantId !== targetTenantId) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cross-tenant access denied');\n    }\n  }\n\n  // ---------- Dashboard ----------\n\n  @Get('dashboard')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.RISK_READ)\n  async getDashboard(@Req() req: any, @Query('accountId') accountId?: string, @Query('traderId') traderId?: string, @Query('strategyId') strategyId?: string, @Query('followerId') followerId?: string) {\n    const tenantId = this.getTenantId(req);\n    const exposure = await this.exposureService.calculateExposure({ tenantId, accountId, traderId, strategyId, followerId });\n    const policy = await this.policyService.resolveEffectivePolicy({ tenantId, traderId: traderId ?? null, strategyId: strategyId ?? null, followerId: followerId ?? null });\n\n    let margin = null;\n    let leverage = null;\n    let drawdown = null;\n    let dailyLoss = null;\n    if (accountId) {\n      const margins = await this.marginService.evaluateMargin({ tenantId, accountId });\n      margin = margins[0] ?? null;\n      const levs = await this.leverageService.evaluateLeverage({ tenantId, accountId });\n      leverage = levs[0] ?? null;\n    }\n    const drawdowns = await this.drawdownService.evaluateDrawdown({ tenantId, accountId, traderId, strategyId, followerId });\n    drawdown = drawdowns[0] ?? The state\n * filter must apply to both, `total` must count every matching row of both, and\n * pages must be cut from one list ordered by createdAt descending, so paging\n * through the list returns every key exactly once.\n */\n\nconst TENANT = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';\nconst OTHER = '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';\nconst DAY = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;\nconst at = (daysAgo: number) => new Date(Date.now() - daysAgo * DAY);\n\ndescribe('ApiKeyRepository', () => {\n  let prisma: any;\n  let repo: ApiKeyRepository;\n\n  beforeEach(() => {\n    prisma = new InMemoryPrisma({ enterpriseApiKey: [['tenantId', 'idempotencyKey']] });\n    repo = new ApiKeyRepository(prisma);\n\n    prisma.seed('enterpriseApiKey', { id: 'e-active', tenantId: TENANT, userId: 'u1', state: ApiKeyState.ACTIVE, createdAt: at(2), idempotencyKey: 'k-1' });\n    prisma.seed('enterpriseApiKey', { id: 'e-revoked', tenantId: TENANT, userId: 'u2', state: ApiKeyState.REVOKED, createdAt: at(4) });\n    prisma.seed('enterpriseApiKey', { id: 'e-rotated', tenantId: TENANT, userId: 'u1', state: ApiKeyState.ROTATED, createdAt: at(7) });\n    prisma.seed('enterpriseApiKey', { id: 'e-other', tenantId: OTHER, userId: 'u9', state: ApiKeyState.ACTIVE, createdAt: at(1) });\n\n    prisma.seed('tenantApiKey', { id: 't-active-future', tenantId: TENANT, keyId: 'tk1', createdById: 'u3', revokedAt: null, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + DAY), createdAt: at(1) });\n    prisma.seed('tenantApiKey', { id: 't-active', tenantId: TENANT, keyId: 'tk2', createdById: null, revokedAt: null, expiresAt: null, createdAt: at(3) });\n    prisma.seed('tenantApiKey', { id: 't-revoked', tenantId: TENANT, keyId: 'tk3', createdById: null, revokedAt: at(1), expiresAt: null, createdAt: at(5) });\n    prisma.seed('tenantApiKey', { id: 't-expired', tenantId: TENANT, keyId: 'tk4', createdById: null, revokedAt: null, expiresAt: at(1), createdAt: at(6) });\n    prisma.seed('tenantApiKey', { id: 't-other', tenantId: OTHER, keyId: 'tk9', createdById: null, revokedAt: null, expiresAt: null, createdAt: at(1) });\n  });\n\n  describe('listByTenant', () => {\n    it('pages through the merged list in createdAt order, every key exactly once, with the full total', async () => {\n      const page1 = await repo.listByTenant(TENANT, { page: 1, limit: 3 });\n      const page2 = await repo.listByTenant(TENANT, { page: 2, limit: 3 });\n      const page3 = await repo.listByTenant(TENANT, { page: 3, limit: 3 });\n\n      expect(page1.data.map((k) => k.id)).toEqual(['t-active-future', 'e-active', 't-active']);\n      expect(page2.data.map((k) => k.id)).toEqual(['e-revoked', 't-revoked', 't-expired']);\n      expect(page3.data.map((k) => k.id)).toEqual(['e-rotated']);\n      expect([page1.total, page2.total, page3.total]).toEqual([7, 7, 7]);\n    });\n\n    it('derives the state of TenantApiKey rows in the list shape', async () => {\n      const { data } = await repo.listByTenant(TENANT, { limit: 50 });\n      const byId = new Map(data.map((k) => [k.id, k]));\n      expect(byId.get('t-active-future')).toMatchObject({ state: ApiKeyState.ACTIVE, userId: 'u3', fingerprint: 'tk1' });\n      expect(byId.get('t-active')).toMatchObject({ state: ApiKeyState.ACTIVE, userId: 'unknown' });\n      expect(byId.get('t-revoked')).toMatchObject({ state: ApiKeyState.REVOKED });\n      expect(byId.get('t-expired')).toMatchObject({ state: ApiKeyState.EXPIRED });\n    });\n\n    it.each([\n      [ApiKeyState.ACTIVE, ['t-active-future', 'e-active', 't-active']],\n      [ApiKeyState.REVOKED, ['e-revoked', 't-revoked']],\n      [ApiKeyState.EXPIRED, ['t-expired']],\n      [ApiKeyState.ROTATED, ['e-rotated']],\n    ])('applies the %s filter to both stores and counts only matching rows', async (state, expected) => {\n      const result = await repo.listByTenant(TENANT, { state, limit: 50 });\n      expect(result.data.map((k) => k.id)).toEqual(expected);\n      expect(result.data.every((k) => k.state === state)).toBe(true);\n      expect(result.total).toBe(expected.length);\n    });\n\n    it('lists only the enterprise keys of a user when a userId filter is given', async () => {\n      const result = await repo.listByTenant(TENANT, { userId: 'u1', limit: 50 });\n      expect(result.data.map((k) => k.id)).toEqual(['e-active', 'e-rotated']);\n      expect(result.total).toBe(2);\n    });\n\n    it(\"never includes another tenant's keys\", async () => {\n      const result = await repo.listByTenant(TENANT, { limit: 50 });\n      expect(result.data.some((k) => k.tenantId !== TENANT)).toBe(false);\n    });\n\n    it('falls back to the enterprise keys alone when TenantApiKey cannot be read', async () => {\n      const broken: any = new Proxy(prisma, {\n        get: (target, prop) => (prop === 'tenantApiKey' ? { findMany: async () => { throw new Error('unavailable'); }, count: async () => 0 } : target[prop]),\n      });\n      const result = await new ApiKeyRepository(broken).listByTenant(TENANT, { page: 1, limit: 2 });\n      expect(result.data.map((k) => k.id)).toEqual(['e-active', 'e-revoked']);\n      expect(result.total).toBe(3);\n    });\n  });\n\n  describe('tenant-scoped writes', () => {\n    it(\"revoke and updateLastUsed do not touch another tenant's key\", async () => {\n      await expect(repo.revoke('e-active', OTHER)).resolves.toBeNull();\n      await expect(repo.revoke('t-active', OTHER)).resolves.toBeNull();\n      await repo.updateLastUsed('e-active', OTHER);\n      expect(prisma.rows('enterpriseApiKey').find((k: any) => k.id === 'e-active')).toMatchObject({ state: ApiKeyState.ACTIVE });\n      expect(prisma.rows('enterpriseApiKey').find((k: any) => k.id === 'e-active').lastUsedAt).toBeUndefined();\n      expect(prisma.rows('tenantApiKey').find((k: any) => k.id === 't-active').revokedAt).toBeNull();\n\n      await expect(repo.revoke('e-active', TENANT)).resolves.toMatchObject({ state: ApiKeyState.REVOKED });\n    });\n\n    it(\"rotate marks only the caller tenant's key as rotated\", async () => {\n      jest.spyOn(repo, 'create').mockResolvedValue({ id: 'new' } as any);\n      await repo.rotate('e-active', { tenantId: OTHER });\n      expect(prisma.rows('enterpriseApiKey').find((k: any) => k.id === 'e-active')).toMatchObject({ state: ApiKeyState.ACTIVE });\n      await repo.rotate('e-active', { tenantId: TENANT });\n      expect(prisma.rows('enterpriseApiKey').find((k: any) => k.id === 'e-active')).toMatchObject({ state: ApiKeyState.ROTATED });\n    });\n  });\n});\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/api-key.repository.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected
