'@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { ApiKeyState } from './security.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\nimport { isRecordNotFound } from '../../common/errors/prisma-not-found';\n\n/**\n * Persistence abstraction for API keys, fingerprints, scopes, expiration, last-used metadata, revocation, and tenant isolation.\n * Prevent duplicate fingerprint, tenant isolation required.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ApiKeyRepository {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ApiKeyRepository.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async create(input: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    name: string;\n    keyId: string;\n    secretHash: string;\n    fingerprint: string;\n    scopes: string[];\n    ipAllowlist?: string[];\n    expiresAt?: Date;\n    createdById?: string;\n    idempotencyKey?: string;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    // Prevent duplicate fingerprint\n    try {\n      const existingFingerprint = await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.findFirst({\n        where: { fingerprint: input.fingerprint },\n      });\n      if (existingFingerprint) {\n        throw new Error(`Duplicate fingerprint ${input.fingerprint} - prevented`);\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.message.includes('Duplicate fingerprint')) throw e;\n    }\n\n    // Idempotency check\n    if (input.idempotencyKey) {\n      try {\n        const existing = await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.findFirst({\n          where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey },\n        });\n        if (existing) {\n          this.logger.log(`Idempotent API key return key=${input.idempotencyKey}`);\n          return existing;\n        }\n      } catch {}\n    }\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date();\n\n    const data = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      userId: input.userId,\n      name: input.name,\n      keyId: input.keyId,\n      secretHash: input.secretHash,\n      fingerprint: input.fingerprint,\n      scopes: input.scopes,\n      state: ApiKeyState.ACTIVE,\n      ipAllowlist: input.ipAllowlist || [],\n      expiresAt: input.expiresAt || null,\n      createdById: input.createdById || null,\n      idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey || null,\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.create({ data });\n      if (created) {\n        this.logger.log(`API key created id=${created.id} tenant=${input.tenantId} keyId=${input.keyId}`);\n        return created;\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.code === 'P2002') {\n        // Check if it's idempotency or fingerprint duplicate\n        if (input.idempotencyKey) {\n          const existing = await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: input.tenantId, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey } });\n          if (existing) return existing;\n        }\n        throw new Error(`Duplicate API key constraint: ${e.message}`);\n      }\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to create enterprise API key, fallback to TenantApiKey: ${e.message}`);\n\n      // Fallback to TenantApiKey for backward compatibility\n      try {\n        const tenantKey = await (this.prisma as any).tenantApiKey?.create({\n          data: {\n            id,\n            tenantId: input.tenantId,\n            name: input.name,\n            keyId: input.keyId,\n            secretHash: input.secretHash,\n            scopes: input.scopes,\n            ipAllowlist: input.ipAllowlist || [],\n            expiresAt: input.expiresAt || null,\n            createdById: input.createdById || null,\n            createdAt: now,\n            updatedAt: now,\n          },\n        });\n        if (tenantKey) return { ...tenantKey, fingerprint: input.fingerprint, userId: input.userId, state: ApiKeyState.ACTIVE };\n      } catch (e2: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Fallback TenantApiKey creation also failed: ${e2.message}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { ...data, lastUsedAt: null, revokedAt: null, rotatedAt: null };\n  }\n\n  async findByFingerprint(fingerprint: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.findFirst({ where: { fingerprint } });\n    if (result) return result;\n\n    // Fallback to TenantApiKey by keyId? Fingerprint not in TenantApiKey, try keyId lookup\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  async findByKeyId(keyId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.findFirst({ where: { keyId } });\n    if (result) return result;\n\n    const tenantResult = await (this.prisma as any).tenantApiKey?.findFirst({ where: { keyId } });\n    return tenantResult || null;\n  }\n\n  async findById(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId } });\n    if (result) return result;\n\n    const tenantResult = await (this.prisma as any).tenantApiKey?.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId } });\n    return tenantResult || null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Keys of a tenant from both stores: EnterpriseApiKey (per-user keys with a stored state) and,\n   * when no userId filter is given, TenantApiKey (tenant-wide keys whose state is derived from\n   * revokedAt/expiresAt). The state filter applies to both stores, `total` counts every matching\n   * row of both stores, and the requested page is cut from the merged list ordered by createdAt\n   * descending (each store contributes at most offset + limit rows to that merge).\n   */\n  async listByTenant(tenantId: string, filters?: { userId?: string; state?: ApiKeyState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;\n    const now = new Date();\n\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (filters?.userId) where.userId = filters.userId;\n    if (filters?.state) where.state = filters.state;\n\n    // TenantApiKey rows belong to no user, so they only join an unfiltered tenant list, and a\n    // state they can never be in (ROTATED) excludes them entirely.\n    const tenantWhere = filters?.userId ? null : this.tenantApiKeyWhere(tenantId, filters?.state, now);\n\n    if (!tenantWhere) {\n      const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n        (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: offset, take: limit }) || [],\n        (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.count({ where }) || 0,\n      ]);\n      return { data, total };\n    }\n\n    const window = offset + limit;\n    const [enterpriseRows, enterpriseTotal] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: window }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n\n    let tenantRows: any[];\n    let tenantTotal: number;\n    try {\n      [tenantRows, tenantTotal] = await Promise.all([\n        (this.prisma as any).tenantApiKey?.findMany({ where: tenantWhere, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: window }) || [],\n        (this.prisma as any).tenantApiKey?.count({ where: tenantWhere }) || 0,\n      ]);\n    } catch {\n      // TenantApiKey unavailable: the list is the enterprise keys alone.\n      return { data: enterpriseRows.slice(offset, offset + limit), total: enterpriseTotal };\n    }\n\n    const merged = [...enterpriseRows, ...tenantRows.map((k: any) => this.toTenantKeyView(k, now))].sort(\n      (a: any, b: any) => this.createdAtMs(b) - this.createdAtMs(a),\n    );\n    return { data: merged.slice(offset, offset + limit), total: enterpriseTotal + tenantTotal };\n  }\n\n  /** TenantApiKey filter for a list state; null when no TenantApiKey can be in that state. */\n  private tenantApiKeyWhere(tenantId: string, state: ApiKeyState | undefined, now: Date): Record<string, any> | null {\n    switch (state) {\n      case undefined:\n        return { tenantId };\n      case ApiKeyState.ACTIVE:\n        return { tenantId, revokedAt: null, OR: [{ expiresAt: null }, { expiresAt: { gte: now } }] };\n      case ApiKeyState.EXPIRED:\n        return { tenantId, revokedAt: null, expiresAt: { lt: now } };\n      case ApiKeyState.REVOKED:\n        return { tenantId, revokedAt: { not: null } };\n      default:\n        return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** A TenantApiKey row in the EnterpriseApiKey list shape (state derived as tenantApiKeyWhere filters it). */\n  private toTenantKeyView(k: any, now: Date): any {\n    const state = k.revokedAt\n      ? ApiKeyState.REVOKED\n      : k.expiresAt && new Date(k.expiresAt) < now\n        ? ApiKeyState.EXPIRED\n        : ApiKeyState.ACTIVE;\n    return { ...k, userId: k.createdById || 'unknown', state, fingerprint: k.keyId };\n  }\n\n  private createdAtMs(row: any): number {\n    const ms = row?.createdAt ? new Date(row.createdAt).getTime() : NaN;\n    return Number.isNaN(ms) ? 0 : ms;\n  }\n\n  async listByUser(tenantId: string, userId: string, filters?: { state?: ApiKeyState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    return this.listByTenant(tenantId, { ...filters, userId });\n  }\n\n  async updateLastUsed(id: string, tenantId: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.update({\n        where: { id, tenantId },\n        data: { lastUsedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n    } catch {\n      try {\n        await (this.prisma as any).tenantApiKey?.update({\n          where: { id, tenantId },\n          data: { lastUsedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() },\n        });\n      } catch {}\n    }\n  }\n\n  async revoke(id: string, tenantId: string, reason?: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    try {\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.update({\n        where: { id, tenantId },\n        data: { state: ApiKeyState.REVOKED, revokedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n      if (updated) return updated;\n    } catch {}\n\n    try {\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).tenantApiKey?.update({\n        where: { id, tenantId },\n        data: { revokedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n      return updated || null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(error)) return null;\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async rotate(oldId: string, newRecord: any): Promise<any> {\n    // Mark old as ROTATED\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.update({\n        where: { id: oldId, tenantId: newRecord.tenantId },\n        data: { state: ApiKeyState.ROTATED, rotatedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n\n    // Create new\n    return this.create(newRecord);\n  }\n\n  async findExpired(beforeDate?: Date): Promise<any[]> {\n    const before = beforeDate || new Date();\n    return await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.findMany({\n      where: { expiresAt: { lt: before }, state: ApiKeyState.ACTIVE },\n    }) || [];\n  }\n\n  async expireKeys(): Promise<number> {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const result = await (this.prisma as any).enterpriseApiKey?.updateMany({\n      where: { expiresAt: { lt: now }, state: ApiKeyState.ACTIVE },\n      data: { state: ApiKeyState.EXPIRED, updatedAt: now },\n    });\n    return result?.count || 0;\n API_KEY_HMAC_SECRET (or the older\n * API_KEY_SECRET) wins. In production a missing value must never fall back to\n * the public development literal - anyone could recompute fingerprints - so a\n * domain-separated key is derived from DEVELOPER_SECRET_HMAC_KEY, which the\n * API already requires at boot; if that is absent too, startup fails.\n */\nexport function resolveApiKeyHmacSecret(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): string {\n  const explicit = env.API_KEY_HMAC_SECRET || env.API_KEY_SECRET;\n  if (explicit) return explicit;\n  if (env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') return DEV_FALLBACK_HMAC_SECRET;\n  const base = env.DEVELOPER_SECRET_HMAC_KEY;\n  if (!base || base.length < 16) {\n    throw new Error('API_KEY_HMAC_SECRET is required in production (or DEVELOPER_SECRET_HMAC_KEY of at least 16 characters).');\n  }\n  return createHmac('sha256', base).update('wlct:security-api-key-fingerprint:v1').digest('hex');\n}\n\n/**\n * Secure API key management: creation, hashing/fingerprinting, scoped permissions, expiration, rotation, revocation, tenant/user ownership using existing RBAC permissions.\n * Secret shown only at creation, persist hash/fingerprint not raw secret, cryptographically secure random generation.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ApiKeyService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ApiKeyService.name);\n  private readonly secretKey: string;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly repository: ApiKeyRepository,\n    private readonly policyService: SecurityPolicyService,\n    private readonly eventService: SecurityEventService,\n    private readonly auditService: SecurityAuditService,\n  ) {\n    this.secretKey = resolveApiKeyHmacSecret();\n  }\n\n  async createApiKey(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    name: string;\n    scopes: string[];\n    ipAllowlist?: string[];\n    expiresAt?: Date;\n    createdById: string;\n    callerPermissions: string[];\n    idempotencyKey?: string;\n    ipHash?: string;\n    requestId?: string;\n  }): Promise<{ record: any; secret: string }> {\n    // Validate scopes cannot exceed caller permissions\n    const forbiddenScopes = params.scopes.filter((scope) => !this.isScopeAllowed(scope, params.callerPermissions));\n    if (forbiddenScopes.length > 0) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException(`Scopes must be permission keys you hold yourself: ${forbiddenScopes.join(', ')}`);\n    }\n\n    // Prevent PLATFORM_MANAGE unless caller has it\n    if (params.scopes.includes(Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE) && !hasPermission(params.callerPermissions, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE)) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cannot assign platform:manage without having it');\n    }\n\n    // Validate tenant ownership\n    if (!params.tenantId) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('tenantId required');\n    }\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId });\n\n    // Determine expiration per policy if not provided\n    let expiresAt = params.expiresAt;\n    if (!expiresAt) {\n      const expiryDays = policy.apiKeyExpirationDays || 90;\n      expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + expiryDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n    } else {\n      // Check if expiration exceeds policy max\n      const maxExpiry = new Date(Date.now() + (policy.apiKeyExpirationDays || 90) * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n      if (expiresAt > maxExpiry) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`Expiration exceeds policy maximum of ${policy.apiKeyExpirationDays} days`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Generate cryptographically secure random secret\n    const keyId = `ak_${randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`;\n    const secretPart = randomBytes(32).toString('base64url');\n    const fullSecret = `${keyId}.${secretPart}`;\n\n    // Hash and fingerprint - never store raw secret\n    const secretHash = this.hashSecret(fullSecret);\n    const fingerprint = this.createFingerprint(fullSecret);\n\n    const record = await this.repository.create({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: params.userId,\n      name: params.name,\n      keyId,\n      secretHash,\n      fingerprint,\n      scopes: params.scopes,\n      ipAllowlist: params.ipAllowlist || [],\n      expiresAt,\n      createdById: params.createdById,\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n    });\n\n    await this.eventService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: params.userId,\n      type: SecurityEventType.API_KEY_CREATED,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n      description: `API key created name=${params.name} keyId=${keyId}`,\n      safeMetadata: { keyId, name: params.name, scopes: params.scopes, expiresAt: expiresAt?.toISOString() },\n      ipHash: params.ipHash,\n      requestId: params.requestId,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: params.userId,\n      actorId: params.createdById,\n      event: 'API_KEY_CREATED',\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      targetType: 'ApiKey',\n      targetId: record.id,\n      safeMetadata: { keyId, name: params.name, scopes: params.scopes },\n      ipHash: params.ipHash,\n      requestId: params.requestId,\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`API key created tenant=${params.tenantId} user=${params.userId} keyId=${keyId} - secret shown only once`);\n\n    // Return secret ONLY at creation - never again\n    return {\n      record: {\n        id: record.id,\n        tenantId: record.tenantId,\n        userId: record.userId,\n        name: record.name,\n        keyId: record.keyId,\n        fingerprint: record.fingerprint,\n        scopes: record.scopes,\n        state: record.state,\n        expiresAt: record.expiresAt ? new Date(record.expiresAt).toISOString() : undefined,\n        createdAt: new Date(record.createdAt).toISOString(),\n      },\n      secret: fullSecret,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async listApiKeys(tenantId: string, caller: { userId: string; tenantId: string; permissions: string[] }, filters?: { userId?: string; state?: ApiKeyState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    // Tenant isolation\n    if (caller.tenantId !== tenantId && !caller.permissions.includes('PLATFORM_MANAGE')) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cross-tenant access denied');\n    }\n\n    // Ordinary users can only list own keys unless admin\n    const isPrivileged = caller.permissions.includes('ADMIN') || caller.permissions.includes('OWNER') || caller.permissions.includes('API_KEY_MANAGE') || caller.permissions.includes('PLATFORM_MANAGE');\n\n    let effectiveUserId = filters?.userId;\n    if (!isPrivileged) {\n      effectiveUserId = caller.userId;\n    }\n\n    const result = await this.repository.listByTenant(tenantId, {\n      userId: effectiveUserId,\n      state: filters?.state as any,\n      page: filters?.page,\n      limit: filters?.limit,\n    });\n\n    // Never return secretHash\n    const sanitized = result.data.map((k: any) => ({\n      id: k.id,\n      tenantId: k.tenantId,\n      userId: k.userId,\n      name: k.name,\n      keyId: k.keyId,\n      fingerprint: k.fingerprint,\n      scopes: k.scopes,\n      state: k.state,\n      ipAllowlist: k.ipAllowlist,\n      expiresAt: k.expiresAt ? new Date(k.expiresAt).toISOString() : null,\n      lastUsedAt: k.lastUsedAt ? new Date(k.lastUsedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      revokedAt: k.revokedAt ? new Date(k.revokedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      rotatedAt: k.rotatedAt ? new Date(k.rotatedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      createdAt: k.createdAt ? new Date(k.createdAt).toISOString() : null,\n      updatedAt: k.updatedAt ? new Date(k.updatedAt).toISOString() : null,\n    }));\n\n    return { data: sanitized, total: result.total };\n  }\n\n  async validateApiKey(fullSecret: string, ip?: string): Promise<{ valid: boolean; record?: any; reason?: string }> {\n    // Extract keyId and secret part\n    const parts = fullSecret.split('.');\n    if (parts.length !== 2) {\n      return { valid: false, reason: 'INVALID_FORMAT' };\n    }\n\n    const keyId = parts[0];\n    const fingerprint = this.createFingerprint(fullSecret);\n\n    const record = await this.repository.findByKeyId(keyId);\n    if (!record) {\n      // Try fingerprint lookup\n      const byFingerprint = await this.repository.findByFingerprint(fingerprint);\n      if (!byFingerprint) {\n        return { valid: false, reason: 'KEY_NOT_FOUND' };\n      }\n      return this.validateRecord(byFingerprint, fullSecret, ip, fingerprint);\n    }\n\n    return this.validateRecord(record, fullSecret, ip, fingerprint);\n  }\n\n  private async validateRecord(record: any, fullSecret: string, ip?: string, fingerprint?: string): Promise<{ valid: boolean; record?: any; reason?: string }> {\n    // Check state\n    if (record.state === 'REVOKED' || record.revokedAt) {\n      return { valid: false, reason: 'REVOKED' };\n    }\n    if (record.state === 'EXPIRED') {\n      return { valid: false, reason: 'EXPIRED' };\n    }\n    if (record.expiresAt && new Date(record.expiresAt) < new Date()) {\n      return { valid: false, reason: 'EXPIRED' };\n    }\n    if (record.state === 'ROTATED') {\n      return { valid: false, reason: 'ROTATED' };\n    }\n\n    // Validate hash\n    const secretHash = this.hashSecret(fullSecret);\n    if (record.secretHash !== secretHash) {\n      // Also try to validate fingerprint match if secretHash is from old TenantApiKey (HMAC vs hash)\n      if (fingerprint && record.fingerprint !== fingerprint && record.keyId) {\n        // For TenantApiKey, fingerprint is keyId, check HMAC\n        const hmacHash = createHmac('sha256', this.secretKey).update(fullSecret).digest('hex').substring(0, 128);\n        if (record.secretHash !== hmacHash && record.secretHash !== secretHash) {\n          return { valid: false, reason: 'INVALID_SECRET' };\n        }\n      } else if (record.secretHash !== secretHash) {\n        return { valid: false, reason: 'INVALID_SECRET' };\n      }\n    }\n\n    // IP allowlist check\n    if (record.ipAllowlist && record.ipAllowlist.length > 0 && ip) {\n      if (!record.ipAllowlist.includes(ip)) {\n        return { valid: false, reason: 'IP_NOT_ALLOWED' };\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Update last used\n    try {\n      await this.repository.updateLastUsed(record.id, record.tenantId);\n    } catch {}\n\n    return { valid: true, record };\n  }\n\n  async rotateApiKey(params: {\n    id: string;\n    tenantId: string;\n    caller: { userId: string; tenantId: string; permissions: string[] };\n    createdById: string;\n    ipHash?: string;\n    requestId?: string;\n    idempotencyKey?: string;\n  }): Promise<{ record: any; secret: string }> {\n    const existing = await this.repository.findById(params.id, params.tenantId);\n    if (!existing) {\n      throw new NotFoundException(`API key ${params.id} not found`);\n    }\n\n    // Check ownership\n    const isOwner = existing.userId === params.caller.userId;\n    const isPrivileged = params.caller.permissions.includes('ADMIN') || params.caller.permissions.includes('OWNER') || params.caller.permissions.includes('API_KEY_MANAGE') || params.caller.permissions.includes('PLATFORM_MANAGE');\n\n    if (!isOwner && !isPrivileged) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cannot rotate API key owned by another user');\n    }\n\n    if (existing.tenantId !== params.tenantId && !params.caller.permissions.includes('PLATFORM_MANAGE')) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cross-tenant access denied');\n    }\n\n    // Check if already revoked/expired\n    if (existing.state === 'REVOKED' || existing.revokedAt) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Cannot rotate revoked key');\n    }\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId });\n    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + (policy.apiKeyExpirationDays || 90) * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n\n    const keyId = `ak_${randomBytes(8).toString('hex')}`;\n    const secretPart = randomBytes(32).toString('base64url');\n    const fullSecret = `${keyId}.${secretPart}`;\n    const secretHash = this.hashSecret(fullSecret);\n    const fingerprint = this.createFingerprint(fullSecret);\n\n    const newRecordData = {\n      tenantId: existing.tenantId,\n      userId: existing.userId,\n      name: existing.name,\n      keyId,\n      secretHash,\n      fingerprint,\n      scopes: existing.scopes,\n      ipAllowlist: existing.ipAllowlist || [],\n      expiresAt,\n      createdById: params.createdById,\n      idempotencyKey: params.idempotencyKey,\n      rotatedFromId: existing.id,\n    };\n\n    const newRecord = await this.repository.rotate(existing.id, newRecordData);\n\n    await this.eventService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: existing.userId,\n      type: SecurityEventType.API_KEY_ROTATED,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n      description: `API key rotated oldKeyId=${existing.keyId} newKeyId=${keyId}`,\n      safeMetadata: { oldKeyId: existing.keyId, newKeyId: keyId, name: existing.name },\n      ipHash: params.ipHash,\n      requestId: params.requestId,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: existing.userId,\n      actorId: params.createdById,\n      event: 'API_KEY_ROTATED',\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      targetType: 'ApiKey',\n      targetId: newRecord.id,\n      safeMetadata: { oldKeyId: existing.keyId, newKeyId: keyId },\n      ipHash: params.ipHash,\n      requestId: params.requestId,\n    });\n\n    this.logger.log(`API key rotated tenant=${params.tenantId} oldKeyId=${existing.keyId} newKeyId=${keyId} - new secret shown only once`);\n\n    return {\n      record: {\n        id: newRecord.id,\n        tenantId: newRecord.tenantId,\n        userId: newRecord.userId,\n        name: newRecord.name,\n        keyId: newRecord.keyId,\n        fingerprint: newRecord.fingerprint,\n        scopes: newRecord.scopes,\n        state: newRecord.state,\n        expiresAt: newRecord.expiresAt ? new Date(newRecord.expiresAt).toISOString() : undefined,\n        createdAt: new Date(newRecord.createdAt).toISOString(),\n      },\n      secret: fullSecret,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async revokeApiKey(params: { id: string; tenantId: string; caller: { userId: string; tenantId: string; permissions: string[] }; reason?: string; ipHash?: string; requestId?: string }): Promise<any> {\n    const existing = await this.repository.findById(params.id, params.tenantId);\n    if (!existing) {\n      throw new NotFoundException(`API key ${params.id} not found`);\n    }\n\n    const isOwner = existing.userId === params.caller.userId;\n    const isPrivileged = params.caller.permissions.includes('ADMIN') || params.caller.permissions.includes('OWNER') || params.caller.permissions.includes('API_KEY_MANAGE') || params.caller.permissions.includes('PLATFORM_MANAGE');\n\n    if (!isOwner && !isPrivileged) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cannot revoke API key owned by another user');\n    }\n\n    if (existing.tenantId !== params.tenantId && !params.caller.permissions.includes('PLATFORM_MANAGE')) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cross-tenant access denied');\n    }\n\n    const revoked = await this.repository.revoke(params.id, params.tenantId, params.reason);\n\n    await this.eventService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: existing.userId,\n      type: SecurityEventType.API_KEY_REVOKED,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n      description: `API key revoked keyId=${existing.keyId} reason=${params.reason || 'manual'}`,\n      safeMetadata: { keyId: existing.keyId, name: existing.name, reason: params.reason },\n      ipHash: params.ipHash,\n      requestId: params.requestId,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: existing.userId,\n      actorId: params.caller.userId,\n      event: 'API_KEY_REVOKED',\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      targetType: 'ApiKey',\n      targetId: existing.id,\n      safeMetadata: { keyId: existing.keyId, reason: params.reason },\n      ipHash: params.ipHash,\n      requestId: params.requestId,\n    });\n\n    return { id: revoked?.id || existing.id, state: 'REVOKED', revokedAt: new Date().toISOString() };\n  }\n\n  private hashSecret(secret: string): string {\n    return createHmac('sha256', this.secretKey).update(secret).digest('hex');\n  }\n\n  private createFingerprint(secret: string): string {\n    return createHash('sha256').update(secret).digest('hex').substring(0, 64);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * A scope is a real permission key (Permission in @wlct/shared-types) that\n   * the caller itself holds, using the same wildcard rules as the permission\n   * guard (hasPermission): an API key can never carry more than its creator.\n   * Unknown strings are rejected so a key cannot hold scopes nothing checks.\n   */\n  private isScopeAllowed(scope: string, callerPermissions: string[]): boolean {\n    if (!KNOWN_PERMISSIONS.has(scope)) return false;\n    return hasPermission(callerPermissions, scope);\n '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { SecurityPolicyService } from './security-policy.service';\nimport { SecurityEventService } from './security-event.service';\nimport { SecurityAuditService } from './security-audit.service';\nimport { DeviceState, SecurityEventType, SecurityRisk, SecurityDecision } from './security.types';\nimport { createHash, randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Device registration/trust lifecycle, device fingerprint reference, trust expiry, revocation, and step-up authentication requirements.\n * Use minimized device references/hashes, never override revoked session/blocked account/mandatory MFA/compliance restrictions.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class DeviceTrustService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(DeviceTrustService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: SecurityPolicyService,\n    private readonly eventService: SecurityEventService,\n    private readonly auditService: SecurityAuditService,\n  ) {}\n\n  private hashDevice(deviceId: string, userAgent?: string, ip?: string): string {\n    const data = `${deviceId}|${userAgent || ''}|${ip || ''}`;\n    return createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex').substring(0, 64);\n  }\n\n  private hashUserAgent(userAgent?: string): string {\n    if (!userAgent) return '';\n    return createHash('sha256').update(userAgent).digest('hex').substring(0, 32);\n  }\n\n  async registerDevice(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    deviceId: string;\n    userAgent?: string;\n    ipHash?: string;\n    requestId?: string;\n  }): Promise<any> {\n    const deviceHash = this.hashDevice(params.deviceId, params.userAgent, params.ipHash);\n    const userAgentHash = this.hashUserAgent(params.userAgent);\n\n    try {\n      const existing = await (this.prisma as any).deviceTrust?.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, userId: params.userId, deviceHash },\n      });\n\n      if (existing) {\n        // Update last seen\n        const updated = await (this.prisma as any).deviceTrust?.update({\n          where: { id: existing.id },\n          data: { lastSeenAt: new Date(), ipHash: params.ipHash, userAgentHash, updatedAt: new Date() },\n        });\n        return this.sanitizeDeviceRecord(updated || existing);\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId });\n    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + policy.deviceTrustDurationDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n\n    const id = randomUUID();\n    const now = new Date();\n\n    const data = {\n      id,\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: params.userId,\n      deviceId: params.deviceId,\n      deviceHash,\n      state: DeviceState.PENDING_TRUST,\n      lastSeenAt: now,\n      ipHash: params.ipHash || null,\n      userAgentHash,\n      metadata: {},\n      createdAt: now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const created = await (this.prisma as any).deviceTrust?.create({ data });\n      if (created) {\n        await this.eventService.record({\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          userId: params.userId,\n          type: SecurityEventType.DEVICE_REGISTERED,\n          severity: SecurityRisk.LOW,\n          description: `Device registered deviceId=${params.deviceId}`,\n          safeMetadata: { deviceId: params.deviceId, deviceHash: deviceHash.substring(0, 16), state: DeviceState.PENDING_TRUST },\n          ipHash: params.ipHash,\n          requestId: params.requestId,\n        });\n\n        return this.sanitizeDeviceRecord(created);\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.code === 'P2002') {\n        const existing = await (this.prisma as any).deviceTrust?.findFirst({ where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, userId: params.userId, deviceHash } });\n        if (existing) return this.sanitizeDeviceRecord(existing);\n      }\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to create device trust: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n\n    return this.sanitizeDeviceRecord({ ...data, expiresAt, trustedAt: null, revokedAt: null });\n  }\n\n  async trustDevice(params: { tenantId: string; userId: string; deviceId: string; deviceHash?: string; actorId: string; ipHash?: string; requestId?: string }): Promise<any> {\n    const deviceHash = params.deviceHash || this.hashDevice(params.deviceId);\n\n    try {\n      const device = await (this.prisma as any).deviceTrust?.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, userId: params.userId, ...(params.deviceHash ? { deviceHash } : { deviceId: params.deviceId }) },\n      });\n\n      if (!device) {\n        throw new Error(`Device not found deviceId=${params.deviceId}`);\n      }\n\n      // Check if session revoked or account blocked - device trust must never override\n      const user = await (this.prisma as any).user?.findUnique({ where: { id: params.userId }, select: { status: true } });\n      if (user?.status === 'SUSPENDED' || user?.status === 'LOCKED' || user?.status === 'DEACTIVATED') {\n        throw new Error(`Cannot trust device for blocked account status=${user.status} - device trust must never override blocked account`);\n      }\n\n      const policy = await this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId });\n      const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + policy.deviceTrustDurationDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).deviceTrust?.update({\n        where: { id: device.id },\n        data: { state: DeviceState.TRUSTED, trustedAt: new Date(), expiresAt, updatedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n\n      await this.eventService.record({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        userId: params.userId,\n        type: SecurityEventType.DEVICE_TRUSTED,\n        severity: SecurityRisk.LOW,\n        description: `Device trusted deviceId=${params.deviceId}`,\n        safeMetadata: { deviceId: params.deviceId, deviceHash: deviceHash.substring(0, 16) },\n        ipHash: params.ipHash,\n        requestId: params.requestId,\n      });\n\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        userId: params.userId,\n        actorId: params.actorId,\n        event: 'DEVICE_TRUSTED',\n        result: 'SUCCESS',\n        targetType: 'Device',\n        targetId: device.id,\n        safeMetadata: { deviceId: params.deviceId },\n        ipHash: params.ipHash,\n        requestId: params.requestId,\n      });\n\n      return this.sanitizeDeviceRecord(updated || { ...device, state: DeviceState.TRUSTED, trustedAt: new Date(), expiresAt });\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`trustDevice failed: ${e.message}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async revokeDevice(params: { tenantId: string; userId: string; deviceId: string; deviceHash?: string; actorId: string; reason?: string; ipHash?: string; requestId?: string }): Promise<any> {\n    try {\n      const device = await (this.prisma as any).deviceTrust?.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, userId: params.userId, ...(params.deviceHash ? { deviceHash: params.deviceHash } : { deviceId: params.deviceId }) },\n      });\n\n      if (!device) {\n        throw new Error(`Device not found deviceId=${params.deviceId}`);\n      }\n\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).deviceTrust?.update({\n        where: { id: device.id },\n        data: { state: DeviceState.REVOKED, revokedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() },\n      });\n\n      await this.eventService.record({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        userId: params.userId,\n        type: SecurityEventType.DEVICE_REVOKED,\n        severity: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n        description: `Device revoked deviceId=${params.deviceId} reason=${params.reason || 'manual'}`,\n        safeMetadata: { deviceId: params.deviceId, reason: params.reason },\n        ipHash: params.ipHash,\n        requestId: params.requestId,\n      });\n\n      await this.auditService.record({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        userId: params.userId,\n        actorId: params.actorId,\n        event: 'DEVICE_REVOKED',\n        result: 'SUCCESS',\n        targetType: 'Device',\n        targetId: device.id,\n        safeMetadata: { deviceId: params.deviceId, reason: params.reason },\n        ipHash: params.ipHash,\n        requestId: params.requestId,\n      });\n\n      return this.sanitizeDeviceRecord(updated || { ...device, state: DeviceState.REVOKED, revokedAt: new Date() });\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`revokeDevice failed: ${e.message}`);\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async listDevices(tenantId: string, userId: string, filters?: { state?: DeviceState; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n    const where: any = { tenantId, userId };\n    if (filters?.state) where.state = filters.state;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).deviceTrust?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { lastSeenAt: 'desc' }, skip: offset, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).deviceTrust?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n\n    return { data: data.map((d: any) => this.sanitizeDeviceRecord(d)), total };\n  }\n\n  async evaluateDeviceTrust(params: { tenantId: string; userId: string; deviceId: string; userAgent?: string; ipHash?: string }): Promise<{ trusted: boolean; state: DeviceState; decision: SecurityDecision; requiresStepUp: boolean }> {\n    const deviceHash = this.hashDevice(params.deviceId, params.userAgent, params.ipHash);\n\n    try {\n      const device = await (this.prisma as any).deviceTrust?.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, userId: params.userId, deviceHash },\n      });\n\n      if (!device) {\n        return { trusted: false, state: DeviceState.UNKNOWN, decision: SecurityDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED, requiresStepUp: true };\n      }\n\n      if (device.state === DeviceState.REVOKED || device.revokedAt) {\n        return { trusted: false, state: DeviceState.REVOKED, decision: SecurityDecision.DENY, requiresStepUp: true };\n      }\n\n      if (device.state === DeviceState.TRUSTED) {\n        // Check expiry\n        if (device.expiresAt && new Date(device.expiresAt) < new Date()) {\n          return { trusted: false, state: DeviceState.PENDING_TRUST, decision: SecurityDecision.STEP_UP_REQUIRED, requiresStepUp: true };\n        }\n        // Device trust must never override mandatory MFA - so if MFA required, still require step-up\n        // This check is done in MfaPolicyService, but we return trusted true here\n        return { trusted: true, state: DeviceState.TRUSTED, decision: SecurityDecision.ALLOW, requiresStepUp: false };\n      }\n\n      if (device.state === DeviceState.PENDING_TRUST) {\n        return { trusted: false, state: DeviceState.PENDING_TRUST, decision: SecurityDecision.STEP_UP_REQUIRED, requiresStepUp: true };\n      }\n\n      return { trusted: false, state: DeviceState.UNKNOWN, decision: SecurityDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED, requiresStepUp: true };\n    } catch {\n      return { trusted: false, state: DeviceState.UNKNOWN, decision: SecurityDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED, requiresStepUp: true };\n    }\n  }\n\n  private sanitizeDeviceRecord(record: any): any {\n    return {\n      id: record.id,\n      tenantId: record.tenantId,\n      userId: record.userId,\n      deviceId: record.deviceId,\n      deviceHash: record.deviceHash ? `${record.deviceHash.substring(0, 16)}...` : undefined,\n      state: record.state,\n      trustedAt: record.trustedAt ? new Date(record.trustedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      expiresAt: record.expiresAt ? new Date(record.expiresAt).toISOString() : null,\n      lastSeenAt: record.lastSeenAt ? new Date(record.lastSeenAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n      revokedAt: record.revokedAt ? new Date(record.revokedAt).toISOString() : null,\n      createdAt: record.createdAt ? new Date(record.createdAt).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/dto/api-key.dto.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/dto/list-security-events.dto.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/dto/resolve-security-event.dto.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/dto/security-policy.dto.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/dto/sso-config.dto.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/enterprise-sso.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected Specify a different type.","line":274,"column":49,"nodeType":"TSAnyKeyword","messageId":"unexpectedAny","endLine":274,"endColumn":52,"suggestions":[{"messageId":"suggestUnknown","fix":{"range":[11468,11471],"text":"unknown"},"desc":"Use `unknown` instead, this will force you to explicitly, and safely assert the type is correct."},{"messageId":"suggestNever","fix":{"range":[11468,11471],"text":"never"},"desc":"Use `never` instead, this is useful when instantiating generic type parameters that you don't need to know the type of."}]}],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":5,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"source":"import { Injectable, BadRequestException, ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { X509Certificate, createPrivateKey, type KeyObject } from 'crypto';\nimport type { SealedPayload } from '@wlct/utils';\nimport type { Prisma, SsoConfiguration } from '@prisma/client';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { CryptoService } from '../../infrastructure/crypto/crypto.service';\nimport { SsoProviderFactory } from './sso-provider.factory';\nimport { SecurityPolicyService } from './security-policy.service';\nimport { SecurityEventService } from './security-event.service';\nimport { SecurityAuditService } from './security-audit.service';\nimport { SamlProviderService, samlSpDecryptionKeyAad, samlSpSigningKeyAad } from './saml-provider.service';\nimport { ssoClientSecretAad } from './oidc-provider.service';\nimport { SsoProvider, SecurityEventType, SecurityRisk } from './security.types';\nimport { SSO_ASYMMETRIC_ALGORITHMS, SsoAuthError, isAllowedSsoUrl } from './sso-flow.types';\n\nexport interface SsoConfigurationInput {\n  tenantId: string;\n  providerType: SsoProvider;\n  issuer?: string;\n  audience?: string;\n  clientId?: string;\n  /** Write-only; envelope-encrypted before storage and never returned. */\n  clientSecret?: string;\n  metadataUrl?: string;\n  entityId?: string;\n  acsUrl?: string;\n  ssoUrl?: string;\n  certificate?: string;\n  allowedDomains?: string[];\n  enforced?: boolean;\n  jitEnabled?: boolean;\n  defaultRole?: string;\n  discoveryUrl?: string;\n  jwksUrl?: string;\n  scopes?: string[];\n  redirectUri?: string;\n  tokenEndpointAuthMethod?: string;\n  pkceRequired?: boolean;\n  clockSkewSec?: number;\n  maxAuthAgeSec?: number;\n  allowedAlgorithms?: string[];\n  wantResponseSigned?: boolean;\n  /** SAML opt-in: require encrypted assertions. */\n  wantAssertionsEncrypted?: boolean;\n  /** SAML: SP RSA private key (PEM). Write-only; envelope-encrypted before storage, never returned. */\n  spDecryptionPrivateKey?: string;\n  /** SAML: certificate of that key (PEM), handed to the IdP. */\n  spEncryptionCertificate?: string;\n  /** SAML Single Logout: IdP SingleLogoutService URL (HTTP-Redirect binding). */\n  sloUrl?: string;\n  /** SAML Single Logout: our SingleLogoutService URL (…/v1/auth/sso/saml/slo), registered at the IdP. */\n  logoutCallbackUrl?: string;\n  /** SAML Single Logout: SP RSA signing key (PEM). Write-only; envelope-encrypted, never returned. */\n  spSigningPrivateKey?: string;\n  /** SAML Single Logout: certificate of that key (PEM), handed to the IdP. */\n  spSigningCertificate?: string;\n  isActive?: boolean;\n  actorId: string;\n  /**\n   * True when the actor is platform staff. Platform staff are the break-glass\n   * path and may enforce without having signed in through the tenant's IdP;\n   * tenant administrators may not (see assertEnforcementWillNotLockOut).\n   */\n  actorIsPlatform?: boolean;\n  ipHash?: string;\n  requestId?: string;\n}\n\n/** What the API reports about a configuration. Secrets and certificates are never echoed. */\nexport interface SsoConfigurationView {\n  id: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  providerType: string;\n  state: string;\n  issuer: string | null;\n  audience: string | null;\n  clientId: string | null;\n  entityId: string | null;\n  acsUrl: string | null;\n  ssoUrl: string | null;\n  redirectUri: string | null;\n  discoveryUrl: string | null;\n  jwksUrl: string | null;\n  scopes: string[];\n  tokenEndpointAuthMethod: string;\n  pkceRequired: boolean;\n  clockSkewSec: number;\n  maxAuthAgeSec: number | null;\n  allowedAlgorithms: string[];\n  wantResponseSigned: boolean;\n  wantAssertionsEncrypted: boolean;\n  /** True when an SP decryption key is stored (the key itself is never returned). */\n  hasSpDecryptionKey: boolean;\n  /** Public SP encryption certificate, so the administrator can give it to the IdP. */\n  spEncryptionCertificate: string | null;\n  /** SAML Single Logout: the IdP SLO URL. */\n  sloUrl: string | null;\n  /** SAML Single Logout: our SLO URL. */\n  logoutCallbackUrl: string | null;\n  /** True when an SP signing key is stored (the key itself is never returned). */\n  hasSpSigningKey: boolean;\n  /** Public SP signing certificate, so the administrator can give it to the IdP. */\n  spSigningCertificate: string | null;\n  hasClientSecret: boolean;\n  hasCertificate: boolean;\n  enforced: boolean;\n  jitEnabled: boolean;\n  isActive: boolean;\n  allowedDomains: string[];\n}\n\nconst TOKEN_AUTH_METHODS = ['client_secret_basic', 'client_secret_post', 'none'];\nconst DOMAIN_PATTERN = /^(?=.{1,253}$)([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\\.)+[a-z]{2,63}$/;\n\n/**\n * Tenant SSO configuration and enforcement.\n *\n * The login flow itself (transactions, code redemption, assertion\n * verification, identity mapping, session issuance) lives in\n * modules/auth/sso; this service manages the configuration those flows\n * read. Configuration changes are validated before they are stored:\n *  - every endpoint / redirect URL must pass isAllowedSsoUrl (https);\n *  - SAML certificates must parse as X.509 and at least one must be valid now;\n *  - the OIDC client secret is envelope-encrypted with AAD bound to the\n *    tenant and provider, and is never returned (only hasClientSecret);\n *  - updates are partial: fields that are not supplied are left unchanged;\n *  - a tenant administrator can only leave a configuration ENFORCED after\n *    signing in through that IdP (round 7: SSO is configured by the tenant\n *    administrator, not only by platform staff, so the service itself must\n *    stop a tenant locking its own administrators out).\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class EnterpriseSsoService {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly ssoFactory: SsoProviderFactory,\n    private readonly policyService: SecurityPolicyService,\n    private readonly eventService: SecurityEventService,\n    private readonly auditService: SecurityAuditService,\n    private readonly crypto: CryptoService,\n    private readonly samlProvider: SamlProviderService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async configureSso(params: SsoConfigurationInput): Promise<SsoConfigurationView> {\n    const existing = await this.prisma.ssoConfiguration.findUnique({\n      where: { tenantId_providerType: { tenantId: params.tenantId, providerType: params.providerType } },\n    });\n\n    const changes = this.buildChanges(params);\n    const merged = { ...(existing ?? {}), ...changes } as Partial<SsoConfiguration>;\n    this.validateSpEncryption(params, existing, merged);\n    this.validateSingleLogout(params, existing, merged);\n    this.validateMerged(params.providerType, merged, Boolean(existing?.clientSecretCiphertext) || changes.clientSecretCiphertext !== undefined);\n    await this.assertEnforcementWillNotLockOut(params, existing, merged);\n\n    let record: SsoConfiguration;\n    if (existing) {\n      record = await this.prisma.ssoConfiguration.update({\n        where: { id: existing.id },\n        data: changes as Prisma.SsoConfigurationUpdateInput,\n      });\n    } else {\n      record = await this.prisma.ssoConfiguration.create({\n        data: {\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          providerType: params.providerType,\n          state: params.enforced ? 'ENFORCED' : 'ENABLED',\n          isActive: true,\n          createdById: params.actorId,\n          ...changes,\n        } as Prisma.SsoConfigurationUncheckedCreateInput,\n      });\n    }\n\n    await this.eventService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: params.actorId,\n      type: SecurityEventType.SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGED,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n      description: `SSO configuration ${existing ? 'updated' : 'created'} for provider ${params.providerType}`,\n      safeMetadata: {\n        providerType: params.providerType,\n        enforced: record.enforced,\n        jitEnabled: record.jitEnabled,\n        clientSecretChanged: params.clientSecret !== undefined,\n        certificateChanged: params.certificate !== undefined,\n        spSigningKeyChanged: params.spSigningPrivateKey !== undefined,\n      },\n      ipHash: params.ipHash,\n      requestId: params.requestId,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      actorId: params.actorId,\n      event: 'SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGED',\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      targetType: 'SsoConfiguration',\n      targetId: record.id,\n      safeMetadata: { providerType: params.providerType, enforced: record.enforced, fields: Object.keys(changes).filter((k) => k !== 'clientSecretCiphertext') },\n      ipHash: params.ipHash,\n      requestId: params.requestId,\n    });\n\n    return this.toView(record);\n  }\n\n  async disableSso(params: { tenantId: string; providerType: SsoProvider; actorId: string; ipHash?: string; requestId?: string }): Promise<any> {\n    const existing = await this.prisma.ssoConfiguration.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, providerType: params.providerType },\n    });\n\n    if (!existing) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`SSO configuration not found for provider ${params.providerType}`);\n    }\n\n    // Check platform policy - cannot disable if platform enforces SSO\n    const platformPolicy = await this.policyService.getPlatformPolicy();\n    if (platformPolicy.ssoEnforced) {\n      throw new ForbiddenException('Cannot disable SSO when platform enforces it');\n    }\n\n    const updated = await this.prisma.ssoConfiguration.update({\n      where: { id: existing.id },\n      data: { state: 'DISABLED', isActive: false },\n    });\n\n    // Emergency disable: unfinished logins for this provider die immediately.\n    await this.prisma.ssoAuthTransaction.updateMany({\n      where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, configurationId: existing.id, status: { in: ['PENDING', 'VERIFIED'] } },\n      data: { status: 'REJECTED', failureReason: 'PROVIDER_DISABLED', consumedAt: new Date() },\n    });\n\n    await this.eventService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      userId: params.actorId,\n      type: SecurityEventType.SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGED,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.HIGH,\n      description: `SSO disabled for provider ${params.providerType}`,\n      safeMetadata: { providerType: params.providerType },\n      ipHash: params.ipHash,\n      requestId: params.requestId,\n    });\n\n    await this.auditService.record({\n      tenantId: params.tenantId,\n      actorId: params.actorId,\n      event: 'SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGED',\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      targetType: 'SsoConfiguration',\n      targetId: existing.id,\n      safeMetadata: { providerType: params.providerType, action: 'DISABLED' },\n      ipHash: params.ipHash,\n      requestId: params.requestId,\n    });\n\n    return { id: updated.id, state: updated.state, isActive: updated.isActive };\n  }\n\n  async getSsoStatus(tenantId: string): Promise<{ enabled: boolean; enforced: boolean; providers: any[] }> {\n    const providers = await this.ssoFactory.listTenantProviders(tenantId);\n    const enabled = providers.some((p: any) => p.isActive && (p.state === 'ENABLED' || p.state === 'ENFORCED'));\n    const enforced = providers.some((p: any) => p.enforced && p.state === 'ENFORCED');\n    return { enabled, enforced, providers };\n  }\n\n  async enforceSsoCheck(tenantId: string, userEmail?: string): Promise<{ ssoRequired: boolean; providerType?: SsoProvider }> {\n    const isEnforced = await this.ssoFactory.isSsoEnforced(tenantId);\n    if (!isEnforced) {\n      return { ssoRequired: false };\n    }\n\n    const providers = await this.ssoFactory.listTenantProviders(tenantId);\n    const enforcedProvider = providers.find((p: any) => p.enforced && p.state === 'ENFORCED' && p.isActive);\n\n    if (!enforcedProvider) {\n      return { ssoRequired: false };\n    }\n\n    // Check domain restriction if email provided\n    if (userEmail && enforcedProvider.allowedDomains && enforcedProvider.allowedDomains.length > 0) {\n      const domain = userEmail.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n      if (!enforcedProvider.allowedDomains.map((d: string) => d.toLowerCase()).includes(domain)) {\n        return { ssoRequired: false };\n      }\n    }\n\n    return { ssoRequired: true, providerType: enforcedProvider.providerType as SsoProvider };\n  }\n\n  toView(record: SsoConfiguration): SsoConfigurationView {\n    return {\n      id: record.id,\n      tenantId: record.tenantId,\n      providerType: record.providerType,\n      state: record.state,\n      issuer: record.issuer,\n      audience: record.audience,\n      clientId: record.clientId,\n      entityId: record.entityId,\n      acsUrl: record.acsUrl,\n      ssoUrl: record.ssoUrl,\n      redirectUri: record.redirectUri,\n      discoveryUrl: record.discoveryUrl,\n      jwksUrl: record.jwksUrl,\n      scopes: record.scopes,\n      tokenEndpointAuthMethod: record.tokenEndpointAuthMethod,\n      pkceRequired: record.pkceRequired,\n      clockSkewSec: record.clockSkewSec,\n      maxAuthAgeSec: record.maxAuthAgeSec,\n      allowedAlgorithms: record.allowedAlgorithms,\n      wantResponseSigned: record.wantResponseSigned,\n      wantAssertionsEncrypted: record.wantAssertionsEncrypted,\n      hasSpDecryptionKey: record.spDecryptionKeyCiphertext !== null && record.spDecryptionKeyCiphertext !== undefined,\n      spEncryptionCertificate: record.spEncryptionCertificate,\n      sloUrl: record.sloUrl ?? null,\n      logoutCallbackUrl: record.logoutCallbackUrl ?? null,\n      hasSpSigningKey: record.spSigningKeyCiphertext !== null && record.spSigningKeyCiphertext !== undefined,\n      spSigningCertificate: record.spSigningCertificate ?? null,\n      hasClientSecret: record.clientSecretCiphertext !== null && record.clientSecretCiphertext !== undefined,\n      hasCertificate: Boolean(record.certificate),\n      enforced: record.enforced,\n      jitEnabled: record.jitEnabled,\n      isActive: record.isActive,\n      allowedDomains: record.allowedDomains,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Enforcement closes password login for the configuration's domains (see\n   * AuthService.assertPasswordLoginAllowed). A tenant administrator who\n   * enforces a configuration that does not work for them - wrong certificate,\n   * wrong issuer, a typo in the client id - would lock the tenant's\n   * administrators out until platform staff intervene. So when the result of\n   * this change is an ENFORCED, active configuration and the actor is not\n   * platform staff, the actor must already hold an SSO identity linked to THIS\n   * configuration under the issuer the configuration will have after the\n   * change. In practice: create or update without enforcement, sign in with\n   * SSO once, then enforce. Turning enforcement off is never blocked - that is\n   * the tenant's own way back.\n   */\n  private async assertEnforcementWillNotLockOut(\n    params: SsoConfigurationInput,\n    existing: SsoConfiguration | null,\n    merged: Partial<SsoConfiguration>,\n  ): Promise<void> {\n    if (params.actorIsPlatform === true) return;\n    const resultingState = merged.state ?? (existing ? existing.state : 'ENABLED');\n    const enforcing = merged.enforced === true && merged.isActive !== false && resultingState === 'ENFORCED';\n    if (!enforcing) return;\n\n    if (!existing) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(\n        'Single sign-on cannot be enforced in the same step that creates it. Save the configuration without enforcement, sign in through the identity provider once, then enforce it.',\n      );\n    }\n\n    const link = await this.prisma.ssoIdentity.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, configurationId: existing.id, userId: params.actorId },\n      select: { issuer: true },\n    });\n    if (!link || link.issuer !== merged.issuer) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(\n        'You have not signed in through this identity provider with its current settings. Sign in with single sign-on first, so enforcing it cannot lock administrators out.',\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * SAML encrypted-assertion opt-in. When the resulting configuration has\n   * wantAssertionsEncrypted, it must hold an SP decryption key AND an SP\n   * encryption certificate, the certificate must be currently valid, and it\n   * must be the certificate of that key (otherwise the IdP would encrypt to a\n   * key we do not have and every login would fail). The key is RSA >= 2048\n   * bits (XML Encryption key transport). The pair is re-checked whenever\n   * either half changes, unsealing the stored key when only the certificate\n   * is new.\n   */\n  private validateSpEncryption(\n    params: SsoConfigurationInput,\n    existing: SsoConfiguration | null,\n    merged: Partial<SsoConfiguration>,\n  ): void {\n    if (params.providerType !== SsoProvider.SAML) {\n      if (params.wantAssertionsEncrypted === true || params.spEncryptionCertificate) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('Encrypted assertions apply to SAML configurations only');\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n    const touched =\n      params.wantAssertionsEncrypted !== undefined ||\n      params.spDecryptionPrivateKey !== undefined ||\n      params.spEncryptionCertificate !== undefined;\n    if (!touched || merged.wantAssertionsEncrypted !== true) return;\n\n    if (!merged.spEncryptionCertificate) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('spEncryptionCertificate is required when wantAssertionsEncrypted is set');\n    }\n    if (!merged.spDecryptionKeyCiphertext) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('spDecryptionPrivateKey is required when wantAssertionsEncrypted is set');\n    }\n\n    let keyPem: string;\n    if (params.spDecryptionPrivateKey !== undefined) {\n      keyPem = params.spDecryptionPrivateKey.trim();\n    } else {\n      try {\n        keyPem = this.crypto.decrypt(\n          existing?.spDecryptionKeyCiphertext as unknown as SealedPayload,\n          samlSpDecryptionKeyAad(params.tenantId),\n        );\n      } catch {\n        throw new BadRequestException('The stored SP decryption key cannot be read; upload spDecryptionPrivateKey again');\n      }\n    }\n    const key = this.parseSpPrivateKey(keyPem);\n\n    let certificate: X509Certificate;\n    try {\n      certificate = new X509Certificate(merged.spEncryptionCertificate);\n    } catch {\n      throw new BadRequestException('spEncryptionCertificate is not a valid X.509 certificate');\n    }\n    const now = new Date();\n    if (!(new Date(certificate.validFrom) <= now && now <= new Date(certificate.validTo))) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('spEncryptionCertificate is not currently valid');\n    }\n    if (!certificate.checkPrivateKey(key)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('spEncryptionCertificate does not belong to spDecryptionPrivateKey');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * SAML Single Logout (round 8). When the resulting configuration has an IdP\n   * SLO URL, it must also have our SLO URL and an SP signing key + signing\n   * certificate; the certificate must be currently valid and belong to the\n   * key (otherwise the IdP could not verify our LogoutRequests and every\n   * logout would fail at the IdP). The key is RSA >= 2048 bits. Checked\n   * whenever one of the Single Logout fields changes, unsealing the stored\n   * key when only the certificate is new. Clearing sloUrl turns SLO off.\n   */\n  private validateSingleLogout(\n    params: SsoConfigurationInput,\n    existing: SsoConfiguration | null,\n    merged: Partial<SsoConfiguration>,\n  ): void {\n    const touched =\n      params.sloUrl !== undefined ||\n      params.logoutCallbackUrl !== undefined ||\n      params.spSigningPrivateKey !== undefined ||\n      params.spSigningCertificate !== undefined;\n    if (!touched) return;\n    if (params.providerType !== SsoProvider.SAML) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('Single Logout settings apply to SAML configurations only');\n    }\n    if (!merged.sloUrl) return;\n\n    if (!merged.logoutCallbackUrl) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('logoutCallbackUrl is required when sloUrl is set');\n    }\n    if (!merged.spSigningCertificate) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('spSigningCertificate is required when sloUrl is set');\n    }\n    if (!merged.spSigningKeyCiphertext) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('spSigningPrivateKey is required when sloUrl is set');\n    }\n\n    let keyPem: string;\n    if (params.spSigningPrivateKey !== undefined) {\n      keyPem = params.spSigningPrivateKey.trim();\n    } else {\n      try {\n        keyPem = this.crypto.decrypt(\n          existing?.spSigningKeyCiphertext as unknown as SealedPayload,\n          samlSpSigningKeyAad(params.tenantId),\n        );\n      } catch {\n        throw new BadRequestException('The stored SP signing key cannot be read; upload spSigningPrivateKey again');\n      }\n    }\n    const key = this.parseSpPrivateKey(keyPem, 'spSigningPrivateKey');\n\n    let certificate: X509Certificate;\n    try {\n      certificate = new X509Certificate(merged.spSigningCertificate);\n    } catch {\n      throw new BadRequestException('spSigningCertificate is not a valid X.509 certificate');\n    }\n    const now = new Date();\n    if (!(new Date(certificate.validFrom) <= now && now <= new Date(certificate.validTo))) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('spSigningCertificate is not currently valid');\n    }\n    if (!certificate.checkPrivateKey(key)) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('spSigningCertificate does not belong to spSigningPrivateKey');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** An RSA private key of at least 2048 bits, or a 400 naming the field. */\n  private parseSpPrivateKey(pem: string, field: string = 'spDecryptionPrivateKey'): KeyObject {\n    let key: KeyObject;\n    try {\n      key = createPrivateKey(pem.trim());\n    } catch {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`${field} is not a valid PEM private key`);\n    }\n    const bits = key.asymmetricKeyDetails?.modulusLength ?? 0;\n    if (key.asymmetricKeyType !== 'rsa' || bits < 2048) {\n      throw new BadRequestException(`${field} must be an RSA key of at least 2048 bits`);\n    }\n    return key;\n  }\n\n  /** Only the supplied fields; an empty string clears an optional text field. */\n  private buildChanges(params: SsoConfigurationInput): Record<string, unknown> {\n    const changes: Record<string, unknown> = {};\n    const text = (key: keyof SsoConfigurationInput, column: string = key as string) => {\n      const value = params[key];\n      if (value === undefined) return;\n      changes[column] = typeof value === 'string' && value.trim().length > 0 ? value.trim() : null;\n    };\n    text('issuer');\n    text('audience');\n    text('clientId');\n    text('metadataUrl');\n    text('entityId');\n    text('acsUrl');\n    text('ssoUrl');\n    text('defaultRole');\n    text('discoveryUrl');\n    text('jwksUrl');\n    text('redirectUri');\n    text('sloUrl');\n    text('logoutCallbackUrl');\n    if (params.certificate !== undefined) {\n      changes.certificate = params.certificate.trim().length > 0 ? params.certificate.trim() : null;\n    }\n    if (params.allowedDomains !== undefined) {\n      const domains = params.allowedDomains.map((d) => d.trim().toLowerCase()).filter((d) => d.length > 0);\n      for (const domain of domains) {\n        if (!DOMAIN_PATTERN.test(domain)) {\n          throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid allowed domain: ${domain.slice(0, 64)}`);\n        }\n      }\n      changes.allowedDomains = [...new Set(domains)];\n    }\n    if (params.scopes !== undefined) changes.scopes = [...new Set(params.scopes.map((s) => s.trim()).filter((s) => s.length > 0))];\n    if (params.enforced !== undefined) {\n      changes.enforced = params.enforced;\n      changes.state = params.enforced ? 'ENFORCED' : 'ENABLED';\n    }\n    if (params.isActive !== undefined) {\n      changes.isActive = params.isActive;\n      if (!params.isActive) changes.state = 'DISABLED';\n      else if (params.enforced === undefined) changes.state = 'ENABLED';\n    }\n    if (params.jitEnabled !== undefined) changes.jitEnabled = params.jitEnabled;\n    if (params.tokenEndpointAuthMethod !== undefined) changes.tokenEndpointAuthMethod = params.tokenEndpointAuthMethod;\n    if (params.pkceRequired !== undefined) changes.pkceRequired = params.pkceRequired;\n    if (params.clockSkewSec !== undefined) changes.clockSkewSec = params.clockSkewSec;\n    if (params.maxAuthAgeSec !== undefined) changes.maxAuthAgeSec = params.maxAuthAgeSec;\n    if (params.allowedAlgorithms !== undefined) changes.allowedAlgorithms = [...new Set(params.allowedAlgorithms)];\n    if (params.wantResponseSigned !== undefined) changes.wantResponseSigned = params.wantResponseSigned;\n    if (params.wantAssertionsEncrypted !== undefined) changes.wantAssertionsEncrypted = params.wantAssertionsEncrypted;\n    if (params.spEncryptionCertificate !== undefined) {\n      changes.spEncryptionCertificate = params.spEncryptionCertificate.trim().length > 0 ? params.spEncryptionCertificate.trim() : null;\n    }\n    if (params.spDecryptionPrivateKey !== undefined) {\n      if (params.providerType !== SsoProvider.SAML) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('spDecryptionPrivateKey applies to SAML configurations only');\n      }\n      // Parsed before it is sealed, so a malformed key is refused instead of stored.\n      this.parseSpPrivateKey(params.spDecryptionPrivateKey);\n      changes.spDecryptionKeyCiphertext = this.crypto.encrypt(\n        params.spDecryptionPrivateKey.trim(),\n        samlSpDecryptionKeyAad(params.tenantId),\n      ) as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue;\n    }\n    if (params.spSigningCertificate !== undefined) {\n      changes.spSigningCertificate = params.spSigningCertificate.trim().length > 0 ? params.spSigningCertificate.trim() : null;\n    }\n    if (params.spSigningPrivateKey !== undefined) {\n      if (params.providerType !== SsoProvider.SAML) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('spSigningPrivateKey applies to SAML configurations only');\n      }\n      // Parsed before it is sealed, so a malformed key is refused instead of stored.\n      this.parseSpPrivateKey(params.spSigningPrivateKey, 'spSigningPrivateKey');\n      changes.spSigningKeyCiphertext = this.crypto.encrypt(\n        params.spSigningPrivateKey.trim(),\n        samlSpSigningKeyAad(params.tenantId),\n      ) as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue;\n    }\n    if (params.clientSecret !== undefined) {\n      changes.clientSecretCiphertext = this.crypto.encrypt(params.clientSecret, ssoClientSecretAad(params.tenantId)) as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue;\n    }\n    return changes;\n  }\n\n  private validateMerged(providerType: SsoProvider, merged: Partial<SsoConfiguration>, hasSecret: boolean): void {\n    const url = (value: string | null | undefined, label: string, required: boolean) => {\n      if (!value) {\n        if (required) throw new BadRequestException(`${label} is required`);\n        return;\n      }\n      if (!isAllowedSsoUrl(value)) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(`${label} must be an https URL`);\n      }\n    };\n\n    if (!merged.issuer) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('issuer is required');\n    }\n\n    if (providerType === SsoProvider.OIDC) {\n      url(merged.issuer, 'issuer', true);\n      if (!merged.clientId) throw new BadRequestException('clientId is required');\n      url(merged.redirectUri, 'redirectUri', true);\n      url(merged.discoveryUrl, 'discoveryUrl', false);\n      url(merged.jwksUrl, 'jwksUrl', false);\n      url(merged.ssoUrl, 'ssoUrl', false);\n      const method = merged.tokenEndpointAuthMethod ?? 'client_secret_basic';\n      if (!TOKEN_AUTH_METHODS.includes(method)) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('Unsupported tokenEndpointAuthMethod');\n      }\n      if (method !== 'none' && !hasSecret) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('clientSecret is required for a confidential client');\n      }\n      if (method === 'none' && merged.pkceRequired === false) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('A public client (tokenEndpointAuthMethod \"none\") must use PKCE');\n      }\n      for (const alg of merged.allowedAlgorithms ?? []) {\n        if (!SSO_ASYMMETRIC_ALGORITHMS.includes(alg)) {\n          throw new BadRequestException(`Algorithm ${alg} is not an accepted asymmetric algorithm`);\n        }\n      }\n      const scopes = merged.scopes ?? [];\n      if (scopes.length > 0 && !scopes.includes('openid')) {\n        throw new BadRequestException('scopes must include openid');\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // SAML\n    url(merged.ssoUrl, 'ssoUrl', true);\n    url(merged.acsUrl, 'acsUrl', false);\n    url(merged.redirectUri, 'redirectUri', false);\n    url(merged.sloUrl, 'sloUrl', false);\n    url(merged.logoutCallbackUrl, 'logoutCallbackUrl', false);\n    if (!merged.certificate) {\n      throw new BadRequestException('certificate is required');\n    }\n    try {\n      this.samlProvider.signingCertificates(merged.certificate);\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof SsoAuthError) {\n        throw new BadRequestException(error.message);\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/enterprise-sso.tenant-admin.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. tenantId: TENANT,\n    providerType: 'OIDC',\n    state: 'ENABLED',\n    issuer: ISSUER,\n    audience: null,\n    clientId: 'client-1',\n    metadataUrl: null,\n    entityId: null,\n    acsUrl: ciphertext: 'x' },\n    tokenEndpointAuthMethod: 'client_secret_basic',\n    redirectUri: 'https://acme.app.test/api/auth/sso/callback',\n    pkceRequired: true,\n    clockSkewSec: 60,\n issuer: ISSUER,\n        clientId: 'client-1',\n        clientSecret: 'secret',\n        redirectUri: 'https://acme.app.test/api/auth/sso/callback',\n        enforced: true,\n      }),\n    ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);\n    expect(h.prisma.ssoConfiguration.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('a tenant admin can create without enforcement', async () => {\n    const h 'https://acme.app.test/api/auth/sso/callback',\n    });\n    expect(view.enforced).toBe(false);\n    expect(h.prisma.ssoConfiguration.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n  });\n\n  it('a tenant admin who has not signed in through the IdP cannot enforce it', async () => {\n    const h = build({ link: null });\n    await expect(h.service.configureSso({ ...base, enforced: true })).rejects.toThrow(/signed in through this identity provider/);\n    expect(h.prisma.ssoConfiguration.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('a tenant admin with a linked identity can enforce it', async () => {\n    const h = build({ link: { issuer: ISSUER } });\n    const view = await h.service.configureSso({ ...base, enforced: true });\n    expect(view).toMatchObject({ enforced: true, state: 'ENFORCED' });\n    expect(h.prisma.ssoIdentity.findFirst).toHaveBeenCalledWith({\n      where: { tenantId: TENANT, configurationId: CONFIG_ID, userId: ADMIN },\n      select: { issuer: true },\n    });\n  });\n\n  it('changing the issuer of an enforced configuration needs a link under the NEW issuer', async () => {\n    const h = build({ existing: existingOidc({ enforced: true, state: expect(h.prisma.ssoConfiguration.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    // A harmless change under the same issuer is accepted.\n    await expect(h.service.configureSso({ ...base, jitEnabled: true '%s requires SSO_MANAGE + SECURITY_POLICY_WRITE and no longer PLATFORM_MANAGE',\n    (method) => {\n      expect(metadata(method)).toEqual({\n        permissions: [Permission.SSO_MANAGE, expect.arrayContaining([Permission.SSO_MANAGE, Permission.SECURITY_POLICY_WRITE, Permission.SSO_READ]),\n    );\n  });\n\n  it('the controller passes actorIsPlatform from the authenticated principal,
