'./device-trust.service';\nimport { SecurityDecision, SecurityRisk } from './security.types';\n\n/**\n * Resolves MFA/security-factor requirements from existing auth policy, tenant policy, privileged-role requirements, and high-risk security signals.\n * This service decides WHEN MFA is required, does not implement another MFA engine.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class MfaPolicyService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(MfaPolicyService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: SecurityPolicyService,\n    private readonly deviceTrustService: DeviceTrustService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async isMfaRequired(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    roles?: string[];\n    operation?: string;\n    deviceId?: string;\n    ipHash?: string;\n    userAgent?: string;\n    riskLevel?: SecurityRisk;\n    isNewDevice?: boolean;\n    isPrivileged?: boolean;\n  }): Promise<{ required: boolean; decision: SecurityDecision; reasons: string[]; policyVersion: string }> {\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId });\n    const reasons: string[] = [];\n\n    // Platform mandatory MFA\n    if (policy.mfaRequired) {\n      reasons.push('PLATFORM_MFA_REQUIRED');\n    }\n\n    // Privileged roles require MFA\n    const privilegedRoles = ['ADMIN', 'OWNER', 'PLATFORM_ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'COMPLIANCE_REVIEWER', 'SECURITY_ADMIN'];\n    const hasPrivilegedRole = params.roles?.some((r) => privilegedRoles.includes(r)) || params.isPrivileged;\n\n    if (hasPrivilegedRole && policy.mfaForPrivilegedRoles) {\n      reasons.push('PRIVILEGED_ROLE_MFA_REQUIRED');\n    }\n\n    // Sensitive operations require MFA\n    const sensitiveOps = ['API_KEY_CREATE', 'API_KEY_ROTATE', 'SSO_CONFIG_CHANGE', 'SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGE', 'USER_ROLE_ASSIGN', 'PAYOUT_CREATE', 'WITHDRAW', 'PRIVILEGED_ACTION'];\n    if (params.operation && sensitiveOps.includes(params.operation) && policy.mfaForSensitiveOperations) {\n      reasons.push(`SENSITIVE_OPERATION_MFA_REQUIRED:${params.operation}`);\n    }\n\n    // High risk signals require MFA\n    if (params.riskLevel === SecurityRisk.HIGH || params.riskLevel === SecurityRisk.CRITICAL) {\n      reasons.push(`HIGH_RISK_MFA_REQUIRED:${params.riskLevel}`);\n    }\n\n    // New device requires MFA\n    if (params.isNewDevice) {\n      reasons.push('NEW_DEVICE_MFA_REQUIRED');\n    } else if (params.deviceId) {\n      // Check device trust - untrusted device requires step-up\n      const deviceTrust = await this.deviceTrustService.evaluateDeviceTrust({\n        tenantId: params.tenantId,\n        userId: params.userId,\n        deviceId: params.deviceId,\n        userAgent: params.userAgent,\n        ipHash: params.ipHash,\n      });\n\n      if (!deviceTrust.trusted) {\n        reasons.push(`UNTRUSTED_DEVICE_MFA_REQUIRED:${deviceTrust.state}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Check user's existing MFA status - if user has 2FA enabled, we still evaluate if required, but we don't weaken\n    try {\n      const user = await (this.prisma as any).user?.findUnique({ where: { id: params.userId }, select: { twoFactorEnabled: true } });\n      if (user?.twoFactorEnabled && reasons.length === 0) {\n        // User has MFA enabled but policy doesn't require - don't require step-up unless risk\n        // But if platform requires MFA, we already added reason\n      }\n    } catch {}\n\n    const required = reasons.length > 0;\n    const decision = required ? SecurityDecision.STEP_UP_REQUIRED : SecurityDecision.ALLOW;\n\n    this.logger.log(`MFA evaluation tenant=${params.tenantId} user=${params.userId} required=${required} reasons=${reasons.join(',')} operation=${params.operation || 'login'}`);\n\n    return { required, decision, reasons, policyVersion: policy.policyVersion };\n  }\n\n  async requiresReauthForPrivileged(params: { tenantId: string; userId: string; operation: string; lastAuthAt?: Date }): Promise<{ required: boolean; reason?: string }> {\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId });\n\n    if (!policy.privilegedReauthRequired) {\n      return { required: false };\n    }\n\n    const privilegedOps = ['SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGE', 'SSO_CONFIG_CHANGE', 'API_KEY_CREATE', 'ROLE_ASSIGN', 'TENANT_DELETE', 'PAYOUT_CREATE'];\n    if (!privilegedOps.includes(params.operation)) {\n      return { required: false };\n    }\n\n    // Check last auth time - if more than 15 minutes ago, require re-auth\n    const reauthWindowSec = 15 * 60;\n    if (params.lastAuthAt) {\n      const elapsedSec = (Date.now() - params.lastAuthAt.getTime()) / 1000;\n      if (elapsedSec > reauthWindowSec) {\n        return { required: true, reason: `PRIVILEGED_REAUTH_REQUIRED: elapsed ${elapsedSec}s > ${reauthWindowSec}s` };\n      }\n      return { required: false };\n    }\n\n    return { required: true, reason: 'PRIVILEGED_REAUTH_REQUIRED: no recent auth' };\n  }\n\n  async evaluateStepUp(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    currentFactors: string[];\n    requiredFactors: string[];\n    riskLevel?: SecurityRisk;\n  }): Promise<{ stepUpRequired: boolean; missingFactors: string[]; decision: SecurityDecision }> {\n    const missing = params.requiredFactors.filter((f) => !params.currentFactors.includes(f));\n\n    if (missing.length > 0) {\n      return { stepUpRequired: true, missingFactors: missing, decision: SecurityDecision.STEP_UP_REQUIRED };\n    }\n\n    if (params.riskLevel === SecurityRisk.CRITICAL) {\n      // Even if factors satisfied, critical risk requires review\n      return { stepUpRequired: true, missingFactors: [], decision: SecurityDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED };\n    }\n\n    return { stepUpRequired: false, missingFactors: [], decision: SecurityDecision.ALLOW };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/oidc-provider.service.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/oidc-provider.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. './sso-flow.types';\n\n/** The subset of an SsoConfiguration row the OIDC provider reads. */\nexport interface OidcConfigRecord {\n  id: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  providerType: string;\n  state: number | null;\n  maxAuthAgeSec?: number | null;\n  allowedAlgorithms?: string[] | null;\n}\n\n/** Trusted endpoints for one issuer, from its discovery document. */\nexport interface OidcEndpoints {\n  issuer: string;\n  authorizationEndpoint: string;\n  tokenEndpoint: string;\n  jwksUri: string;\n  endSessionEndpoint?: string;\n  codeChallengeMethods?: string[];\n}\n\nexport type constructor(\n    message: string,\n    public readonly status?: number,\n    public readonly body?: unknown,\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = 'OidcTransportError';\n  }\n}\n\nconst sha256Hex = (value: string): string => createHash('sha256').update(value, 'utf8').digest('hex');\n\n/**\n * OpenID Connect relying party: authorization-code flow with PKCE.\n *\n * Everything that decides trust comes from server-side configuration (the\n * SsoConfiguration row): issuer, client id, client secret, redirect URI and\n * the discovery URL. Nothing a browser sends can change which IdP is asked,\n * where the code is redeemed or which keys verify the ID token. ID tokens are\n * verified with the `jose` library; no signature code is hand-written here.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class OidcProviderService implements ISsoProvider {\n  readonly providerType = SsoProvider.OIDC;\n  readonly providerName = 'OIDC';\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(OidcProviderService.name);\n\n  private static readonly DISCOVERY_TTL_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;\n  private static readonly JWKS_TTL_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;\n  /** Minimum gap between forced JWKS refetches (unknown kid) per URL. */\n  private static readonly JWKS_REFETCH_COOLDOWN_MS = 30 * 1000;\n  private static readonly HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;\n\n  private readonly discoveryCache = new Map<string, { endpoints: OidcEndpoints; fetchedAt: number }>();\n  private readonly jwksCache = new Map<string, { jwks: JSONWebKeySet; fetchedAt: number }>();\n  private readonly lastForcedRefetch = new Map<string, number>();\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly crypto: CryptoService,\n  ) {}\n\n  isAvailable(): boolean {\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  async getMetadata(tenantId: string): Promise<SsoProviderMetadata> {\n    const config = await this.loadConfig(tenantId);\n    if (!config) {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED, 'OIDC is not configured for this tenant');\n    }\n    const endpoints = await this.resolveEndpoints(config);\n    return {\n      issuer: endpoints.issuer,\n      authorizationEndpoint: endpoints.authorizationEndpoint,\n      tokenEndpoint: endpoints.tokenEndpoint,\n      jwksUri: endpoints.jwksUri,\n      endSessionEndpoint: endpoints.endSessionEndpoint,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * OpenID Connect RP-Initiated Logout 1.0 URL. With `expectedConfigurationId`\n   * the URL is only built when that configuration is still the tenant's\n   * active OIDC configuration (a session issued by a replaced or disabled IdP\n   * configuration is not sent to whatever IdP is configured now).\n   */\n  async getLogoutUrl(tenantId: string, redirectUri?: string, expectedConfigurationId?: string): Promise<string> {\n    const config = await this.loadConfig(tenantId);\n    if (!config || config.state === 'DISABLED') {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED, 'OIDC is not configured for this tenant');\n    }\n    if (expectedConfigurationId !== undefined && config.id !== expectedConfigurationId) {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED, 'The configuration that issued this session is no longer active');\n    }\n    const endpoints = await this.resolveEndpoints(config);\n    if (!endpoints.endSessionEndpoint) {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.CONFIG_INVALID, 'The IdP does not publish an end_session_endpoint');\n    }\n    const url = new URL(endpoints.endSessionEndpoint);\n    if (config.clientId) url.searchParams.set('client_id', config.clientId);\n    if (redirectUri && redirectUri.startsWith('/') && !redirectUri.startsWith('//') && config.redirectUri) {\n      url.searchParams.set('post_logout_redirect_uri', new URL(redirectUri, config.redirectUri).toString());\n    }\n    return url.toString();\n  }\n\n  /** Effective client authentication method of a configuration. */\n  clientAuthMethod(config: OidcConfigRecord): OidcClientAuthMethod {\n    const method = (config.tokenEndpointAuthMethod || 'client_secret_basic') as OidcClientAuthMethod;\n    return CLIENT_AUTH_METHODS.includes(method) ? method : 'client_secret_basic';\n  }\n\n  /** PKCE is used unless the configuration explicitly turns it off for a confidential client. */\n  usesPkce(config: OidcConfigRecord): boolean {\n    return config.pkceRequired !== false || this.clientAuthMethod(config) === 'none';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Refuses a configuration that cannot run a secure authorization-code flow.\n   * Called before every start and every callback.\n   */\n  assertConfigUsable(config: OidcConfigRecord): void {\n    if (config.providerType !== 'OIDC') {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.PROVIDER_MISMATCH, 'Configuration is not an OIDC provider');\n    }\n    if (!config.isActive || config.state === 'DISABLED') {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.PROVIDER_DISABLED, 'OIDC provider is disabled');\n    }\n    if (!config.issuer || !isAllowedSsoUrl(config.issuer)) {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.CONFIG_INVALID, 'OIDC issuer must be an https URL');\n    }\n    if (!config.clientId) {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.CONFIG_INVALID, 'OIDC client id is not configured');\n    }\n    if (!config.redirectUri || !isAllowedSsoUrl(config.redirectUri)) {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.CONFIG_INVALID, 'OIDC redirect URI must be a registered https URL');\n    }\n    const rawMethod = config.tokenEndpointAuthMethod || 'client_secret_basic';\n    if (!CLIENT_AUTH_METHODS.includes(rawMethod as OidcClientAuthMethod)) {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.CONFIG_INVALID, 'Unsupported token endpoint auth method');\n    }\n    if (rawMethod !== 'none' && !config.clientSecretCiphertext) {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.CONFIG_INVALID, 'OIDC client secret is not configured');\n    }\n    for (const url of [config.discoveryUrl, config.jwksUrl, config.ssoUrl]) {\n      if (url && !isAllowedSsoUrl(url)) {\n        throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.CONFIG_INVALID, 'OIDC endpoint overrides must be https URLs');\n      }\n    }\n    const scopes = this.scopes(config);\n    if (!scopes.includes('openid')) {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.CONFIG_INVALID, 'OIDC scopes must include openid');\n    }\n    this.algorithms(config);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Endpoints from the issuer's discovery document (or the configured\n   * discoveryUrl). The document's `issuer` must equal the configured issuer\n   * exactly, and every endpoint must be https. Cached for an hour.\n   */\n  async resolveEndpoints(config: OidcConfigRecord): Promise<OidcEndpoints> {\n    const issuer = String(config.issuer);\n    const discoveryUrl = config.discoveryUrl || `${issuer.replace(/\\/+$/, '')}/.well-known/openid-configuration`;\n    const cacheKey = `${issuer}|${discoveryUrl}`;\n    const cached = this.discoveryCache.get(cacheKey);\n    let endpoints: OidcEndpoints;\n    if (cached && Date.now() - cached.fetchedAt < OidcProviderService.DISCOVERY_TTL_MS) {\n      endpoints = cached.endpoints;\n    } else {\n      let doc: any;\n      try {\n        doc = await this.fetchJson(discoveryUrl);\n      } catch (error) {\n        throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, `OIDC discovery failed: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      }\n     throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.ISSUER_MISMATCH, 'OIDC discovery issuer does not match the configured issuer');\n      }\n      for (const field of ['authorization_endpoint', 'token_endpoint', 'jwks_uri']) {\n        if (typeof doc[field] !== 'string' || !isAllowedSsoUrl(doc[field])) {\n          throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.CONFIG_INVALID, `OIDC discovery ${field} is missing or not https`);\n        }\n      }\n      if (doc.end_session_endpoint !== undefined && (typeof doc.end_session_endpoint !== 'string' || !isAllowedSsoUrl(doc.end_session_endpoint))) {\n        throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.CONFIG_INVALID, 'OIDC discovery end_session_endpoint is not https');\n      }\n      endpoints = {\n        issuer: doc.issuer,\n        authorizationEndpoint: doc.authorization_endpoint,\n        tokenEndpoint: doc.token_endpoint,\n        jwksUri: doc.jwks_uri,\n        endSessionEndpoint: doc.end_session_endpoint,\n        codeChallengeMethods: Array.isArray(doc.code_challenge_methods_supported)\n          ? doc.code_challenge_methods_supported.filter((m: unknown) => typeof m === 'string')\n          : undefined,\n      };\n      this.discoveryCache.set(cacheKey, { endpoints, fetchedAt: Date.now() });\n    }\n    // Administrator overrides (validated as https in assertConfigUsable).\n    return {\n      ...endpoints,\n      authorizationEndpoint: config.ssoUrl || endpoints.authorizationEndpoint,\n      jwksUri: config.jwksUrl || endpoints.jwksUri,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /** The IdP authorization URL for one transaction. Access and refresh\n   * tokens in the response are discarded unread.\n   */\n  async redeemCode(\n    config: OidcConfigRecord,\n    endpoints: OidcEndpoints,\n    input: { code: string; redirectUri: string; codeVerifier?: string | null },\n  ): Promise<string> {\n    if (!input.code) {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.CODE_MISSING, 'Authorization code missing');\n    }\n    if (input.redirectUri !== config.redirectUri) {\n      // The configuration changed between start and callback; '')}`.toLowerCase();\n        if (description.includes('code_verifier') || description.includes('pkce') || description.includes('code challenge')) {\n          throw new response !== 'object') {\n      throw new SsoAuthError(SsoReasonCode.TOKEN_EXCHANGE_FAILED, 'Token endpoint returned no JSON object');\n    }\n    if (response.token_type !== undefined && Destination / replay checks run on the decrypted, signed XML.\n * Every key is generated at test time (jest globalSetup or below); none is\n * committed.\n */\n\nconst KEYS = loadSamlTestKeys();\nconst TENANT = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';\nconst IDP_ISSUER = 'https://idp.acme.test/saml';\nconst SP_ENTITY = 'https://acme.app.test/saml/sp';\nconst ACS = */\nconst fakeCrypto = {\n  encrypt: (plaintext: string, aad?: string) => ({ sealed: plaintext, aad }),\n  decrypt: (payload: { sealed: string; aad?: string }, aad?: string) => {\n    if (payload.aad !== aad) throw new Error('AAD mismatch');\n    return payload.sealed;\n  },\n};\n\nfunction config(overrides: Partial<SamlConfigRecord> = {}): SamlConfigRecord {\n  return {\n    id: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222',\n    tenantId: TENANT,\n    providerType: 'SAML',\n    state: 'ENABLED',\n    isActive: true,\n    issuer: IDP_ISSUER,\n    entityId: SP_ENTITY,\n    audience: null,\n    ssoUrl: 'https://idp.acme.test/sso',\n    acsUrl: ACS,\n    certificate: KEYS.idpCert,\n    clockSkewSec: 60,\n    wantResponseSigned: false,\n    wantAssertionsEncrypted: true,\n    spDecryptionKeyCiphertext: fakeCrypto.encrypt(KEYS.spEncKey, samlSpDecryptionKeyAad(TENANT)),\n    spEncryptionCertificate: KEYS.spEncCert,\n    ...overrides,\n  };\n}\n\nconst iso = (d: Date) => d.toISOString();\n\nfunction assertionXml(assertionId: string): string {\n  const now = Date.now();\n  return (\n    `<saml:Assertion xmlns:saml=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion\" ID=\"${assertionId}\" Version=\"2.0\" IssueInstant=\"${iso(new Date(now))}\">` +\n    `<saml:Issuer>${IDP_ISSUER}</saml:Issuer>` +\n    `<saml:Subject>` +\n    `<saml:NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified\">subject-alice</saml:NameID>` +\n    `<saml:SubjectConfirmation Method=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:cm:bearer\">` +\n    `<saml:SubjectConfirmationData InResponseTo=\"${REQUEST_ID}\" NotOnOrAfter=\"${iso(new Date(now + 300_000))}\" Recipient=\"${ACS}\"/>` +\n    `</saml:SubjectConfirmation>` +\n    `</saml:Subject>` +\n `<saml:AudienceRestriction><saml:Audience>${SP_ENTITY}</saml:Audience></saml:AudienceRestriction>` +\n    `</saml:Conditions>` +\n    `<saml:AuthnStatement AuthnInstant=\"${iso(new Date(now))}\" SessionIndex=\"_session1\">` +\n    `<saml:AuthnContext><saml:AuthnContextClassRef>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:ac:classes:PasswordProtectedTransport</saml:AuthnContextClassRef></saml:AuthnContext>` +\n    `</saml:AuthnStatement>` +\n    `<saml:AttributeStatement>` +\n    `<saml:Attribute Name=\"email\"><saml:AttributeValue>alice@acme.test</saml:AttributeValue></saml:Attribute>` +\n    `</saml:AttributeStatement>` +\n    `</saml:Assertion>`\n  );\n}\n\nfunction sign(xml: string, key: string, cert: string): string {\n  const sig = new SignedXml({ privateKey: key, publicCert: cert ssoAssertionReplay: {\n      create: jest.fn(async ({ data }: { data: { tenantId: string; issuer: string; assertionId: string } }) => {\n        const key = expect(result.identity).toMatchObject({ issuer: IDP_ISSUER, subject: 'subject-alice', email: 'alice@acme.test' });\n  });\n\n  it('with the opt-in, a plaintext (signed) assertion is refused', async () '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { sanitizeSecurityMetadata } from './security.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Immutable security audit trail with safe metadata, actor/tenant references, result, policy reference, and sanitized context.\n * Never stores passwords, raw API keys, refresh tokens, SAML assertions, OIDC tokens, private keys, provider secrets, recovery secrets.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class SecurityAuditService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(SecurityAuditService.name);\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}\n\n  async record(params: {\n    tenantId: string;\n    userId?: string;\n    actorId?: string;\n    actorType?: string;\n    event: string;\n    result?: string;\n    policyVersion?: string;\n    targetType?: string;\n    targetId?: string;\n    safeMetadata?: Record<string, any>;\n    ipHash?: string;\n    requestId?: string;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const safeMeta = params.safeMetadata ? sanitizeSecurityMetadata(params.safeMetadata) : {};\n\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).securityAuditLog?.create({\n        data: {\n          id: randomUUID(),\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          userId: params.userId || null,\n          actorId: params.actorId || null,\n          actorType: params.actorType || 'USER',\n          event: params.event as any,\n          result: params.result || 'SUCCESS',\n          policyVersion: params.policyVersion || null,\n          targetType: params.targetType || null,\n          targetId: params.targetId || null,\n          safeMetadata: safeMeta,\n          ipHash: params.ipHash || null,\n          requestId: params.requestId || null,\n          createdAt: new Date(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      this.logger.log(`Security audit recorded event=${params.event} tenant=${params.tenantId} actor=${params.actorId || 'system'} target=${params.targetType || 'none'}:${params.targetId || 'none'}`);\n\n      // Also record to legacy auditLog for backward compatibility\n      try {\n        await (this.prisma as any).auditLog?.create({\n          data: {\n            id: randomUUID(),\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            actorType: (params.actorType as any) || 'USER',\n            actorId: params.actorId || null,\n            action: params.event,\n            outcome: (params.result as any) || 'SUCCESS',\n            resourceType: params.targetType || 'Security',\n            resourceId: params.targetId || params.userId || 'unknown',\n            description: `Security ${params.event}`,\n            metadata: safeMeta,\n            ipHash: params.ipHash || null,\n            requestId: params.requestId || null,\n            createdAt: new Date(),\n          },\n        });\n      } catch {}\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to record security audit ${params.event}: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async recordLogin(tenantId: string, userId: string, success: boolean, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string, deviceId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      actorId: userId,\n      event: success ? 'LOGIN_SUCCESS' : 'LOGIN_FAILURE',\n      result: success ? 'SUCCESS' : 'FAILURE',\n      targetType: 'User',\n      targetId: userId,\n      safeMetadata: { userId, deviceId, success },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordMfa(tenantId: string, userId: string, factor: string, success: boolean, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      actorId: userId,\n      event: success ? 'MFA_SUCCESS' : 'MFA_FAILURE',\n      result: success ? 'SUCCESS' : 'FAILURE',\n      targetType: 'User',\n      targetId: userId,\n      safeMetadata: { factor, success },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordSso(tenantId: string, userId: string | undefined, providerType: string, success: boolean, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      actorId: userId,\n      event: success ? 'SSO_LOGIN_SUCCESS' : 'SSO_LOGIN_FAILURE',\n      result: success ? 'SUCCESS' : 'FAILURE',\n      targetType: 'SsoConfiguration',\n      targetId: providerType,\n      safeMetadata: { providerType, success },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordApiKey(tenantId: string, userId: string, keyId: string, action: 'CREATED' | 'ROTATED' | 'REVOKED', actorId: string, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      actorId,\n      event: `API_KEY_${action}`,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      targetType: 'ApiKey',\n      targetId: keyId,\n      safeMetadata: { keyId, action },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordSession(tenantId: string, userId: string, sessionId: string, action: 'CREATED' | 'REVOKED' | 'SUSPICIOUS', actorId?: string, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      actorId: actorId || userId,\n      event: `SESSION_${action}`,\n      result: action === 'SUSPICIOUS' ? 'FAILURE' : 'SUCCESS',\n      targetType: 'Session',\n      targetId: sessionId,\n      safeMetadata: { sessionId, action },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordDevice(tenantId: string, userId: string, deviceId: string, action: 'REGISTERED' | 'TRUSTED' | 'REVOKED', actorId: string, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      actorId,\n      event: `DEVICE_${action}`,\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      targetType: 'Device',\n      targetId: deviceId,\n      safeMetadata: { deviceId, action },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordPolicyChange(tenantId: string, policyVersion: string, actorId: string, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      actorId,\n      event: 'SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGED',\n      result: 'SUCCESS',\n      targetType: 'SecurityPolicy',\n      targetId: policyVersion,\n      policyVersion,\n      safeMetadata: { policyVersion },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async listAuditLogs(tenantId: string, filters?: { userId?: string; event?: string; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (filters?.userId) where.userId = filters.userId;\n    if (filters?.event) where.event = filters.event;\n    if (filters?.fromDate || filters?.toDate) {\n      where.createdAt = {};\n      if (filters.fromDate) where.createdAt.gte = filters.fromDate;\n      if (filters.toDate) where.createdAt.lte = filters.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).securityAuditLog?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: offset, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).securityAuditLog?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/security-event-outbox.spec.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected any. validateDeveloperEventPayload } from '../developer-platform/event-schemas/developer-event-schemas';\n\nconst TENANT_ID = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';\n\nfunction buildService(options: { failAppend?: boolean } = {}) {\n  let persisted: any = null;\n  const tx = {\n    securityEvent: {\n      create: jest.fn(async ({ data }: { data: Record<string, unknown> }) => {\n        persisted = { ...data };\n        return persisted;\n      }),\n    },\n  };\n  const prisma: any = {\n    withTenantRls: jest.fn(async (_tenantId: string, work: (transaction: unknown) => Promise<unknown>) => {\n      const before = persisted;\n      try {\n        return await work(tx);\n      } catch (error) {\n        persisted = before;\n        throw error;\n      }\n    }),\n    securityAuditLog: { create: jest.fn(async () => ({})) },\n  };\n  const outbox = {\n    append: jest.fn(async (_transaction: unknown, _input: Record<string, unknown>) => {\n      if (options.failAppend) throw new Error('outbox unavailable');\n      return undefined;\n    }),\n  };\n  const service = new SecurityEventService(prisma as never, outbox as never);\n  return { service, prisma, tx, outbox, persisted: () => persisted };\n}\n\ndescribe('SecurityEventService outbox transaction', () => {\n  it('records a tenant security event and its redacted public event atomically', async () => {\n    const { service, prisma, tx, outbox, persisted } = buildService();\n    await service.record({\n      tenantId: TENANT_ID,\n      userId: 'user-1',\n      type: SecurityEventType.MFA_FAILURE,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.HIGH,\n      description: 'MFA verification failed.',\n      safeMetadata: { factor: 'TOTP', token: 'must-not-leave-the-security-table' },\n      requestId: 'request-1',\n    });\n\n    const securityEventId = persisted().id;\n    expect(prisma.withTenantRls).toHaveBeenCalledWith(TENANT_ID, expect.any(Function));\n    expect(tx.securityEvent.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    expect(outbox.append).toHaveBeenCalledWith(tx, expect.objectContaining({\n      tenantId: TENANT_ID,\n      aggregateType: 'security_event',\n      aggregateId: securityEventId,\n      eventType: 'security.event',\n      idempotencyKey: `security-event:${securityEventId}:recorded`,\n      correlationId: 'request-1',\n      payload: {\n        securityEventId,\n        category: SecurityEventType.MFA_FAILURE,\n        severity: 'WARNING',\n      },\n    }));\n    const event = outbox.append.mock.calls[0]?.[1];\n    expect(validateDeveloperEventPayload('security.event', event?.payload)).toEqual({ valid: true, errors: [] });\n    expect(JSON.stringify(event)).not.toContain('must-not-leave-the-security-table');\n  });\n\n  it('propagates an outbox failure so the transaction rolls back instead of silently losing delivery', async () => {\n    const { service, tx, persisted } = buildService({ failAppend: true });\n    await expect(service.record({\n      tenantId: TENANT_ID,\n      type: SecurityEventType.LOGIN_SUCCESS,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.LOW,\n      description: 'Login success.',\n    })).rejects.toThrow('outbox unavailable');\n\n    expect(tx.securityEvent.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\n    expect(persisted()).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it('rejects an invalid non-null tenant instead of downgrading it to a platform event', async () => {\n    const { service, prisma, outbox } = buildService();\n\n    await expect(service.record({\n      tenantId: 'not-a-tenant-uuid',\n      type: SecurityEventType.LOGIN_FAILURE,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.HIGH,\n      description: 'Invalid tenant event.',\n    })).rejects.toThrow('tenantId must be a UUID or null');\n\n    expect(prisma.withTenantRls).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(outbox.append).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n\n  it('rejects unknown severities instead of projecting them as informational', async () => {\n    const { service, prisma, outbox } = buildService();\n\n    await expect(service.record({\n      tenantId: TENANT_ID,\n      type: SecurityEventType.LOGIN_FAILURE,\n      severity: 'UNRECOGNIZED' as SecurityRisk,\n      description: 'Invalid severity event.',\n    })).rejects.toThrow('severity is invalid');\n\n    expect(prisma.withTenantRls).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n    expect(outbox.append).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n  });\n});\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/security-event.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected refusing to persist the event');\n}\n\n/**\n * Canonical security event recording for login, logout, MFA, SSO, API key, session, device, policy, and privileged administrative events.\n * Preserves existing SecurityEventsService logic, adds enterprise event types.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class SecurityEventService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(SecurityEventService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    @Optional() private readonly outbox?: OutboxService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async record(input: {\n    tenantId: string | null;\n    userId?: string | null;\n    type: SecurityEventType | string;\n    severity: SecurityRisk | string;\n    description: string;\n    safeMetadata?: Record<string, any> | null;\n    metadata?: Record<string, any> | null;\n    ipHash?: string | null;\n    userAgent?: string | null;\n    requestId?: string | null;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const rawMeta = (input as any).safeMetadata || (input as any).metadata || {};\n    const safeMeta = rawMeta ? sanitizeSecurityMetadata(rawMeta) : {};\n\n    const tenantScoped = input.tenantId !== null;\n    if (tenantScoped && !TENANT_UUID_PATTERN.test(input.tenantId as string)) {\n      throw new Error('Security event tenantId must be a UUID or null; refusing to persist the event');\n    }\n    const severity = requireSecurityRisk(input.severity);\n    const eventData = {\n      id: randomUUID(),\n      tenantId: input.tenantId,\n      userId: input.userId || null,\n      type: input.type as any,\n      severity,\n      description: input.description.substring(0, 500),\n      metadata: safeMeta,\n      ipHash: input.ipHash || null,\n      userAgent: input.userAgent ? input.userAgent.substring(0, 512) : null,\n      requestId: input.requestId || null,\n      createdAt: new Date(),\n    };\n\n    try {\n      if (tenantScoped) {\n        if (!this.outbox) {\n          throw new Error('Transactional outbox is unavailable; refusing tenant security event without its security.event event');\n        }\n        const publicSeverity = severity === SecurityRisk.CRITICAL\n          ? 'CRITICAL'\n          : severity === SecurityRisk.HIGH || severity === SecurityRisk.MEDIUM\n            ? 'WARNING'\n            : 'INFO';\n        await this.prisma.withTenantRls(input.tenantId!, async (tx) => {\n          await (tx as any).securityEvent.create({ data: eventData });\n          await this.outbox!.append(tx, {\n            tenantId: input.tenantId!,\n            aggregateType: 'security_event',\n            aggregateId: eventData.id,\n            eventType: 'security.event',\n            idempotencyKey: `security-event:${eventData.id}:recorded`,\n            correlationId: input.requestId && input.requestId.length <= 64 ? input.requestId : null,\n            occurredAt: eventData.createdAt,\n            payload: {\n              securityEventId: eventData.id,\n              category: String(input.type).slice(0, 96),\n              severity: publicSeverity,\n            },\n          });\n        });\n      } else {\n        // Platform-level events have no tenant webhook audience, but remain persisted locally.\n        try {\n          await (this.prisma as any).securityEvent?.create({ data: eventData });\n        } catch (error) {\n          this.logger.warn(`Failed to persist platform security event: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // The enterprise audit mirror remains best-effort; the tenant SecurityEvent row and outbox\n      // record above are the atomic developer-webhook source of truth.\n      try {\n        await (this.prisma as any).securityAuditLog?.create({\n          data: {\n            id: randomUUID(),\n            tenantId: input.tenantId || 'platform',\n            userId: input.userId || null,\n            actorId: input.userId || null,\n            actorType: 'USER',\n            event: this.mapToEnterpriseCategory(input.type as any),\n            result: severity === SecurityRisk.CRITICAL || input.type.includes('FAILURE') ? 'FAILURE' : 'SUCCESS',\n            safeMetadata: safeMeta,\n            ipHash: input.ipHash || null,\n            requestId: input.requestId || null,\n            createdAt: new Date(),\n          },\n        });\n      } catch {}\n\n      const logPayload = {\n        event: 'security.event',\n        type: input.type,\n        severity,\n        tenantId: input.tenantId,\n        userId: input.userId,\n        requestId: input.requestId,\n      };\n      if (severity === SecurityRisk.CRITICAL) {\n        this.logger.error(logPayload, input.description);\n      } else if (severity === SecurityRisk.HIGH) {\n        this.logger.warn(logPayload, input.description);\n      } else {\n        this.logger.log(`${input.type} tenant=${input.tenantId} user=${input.userId} ${input.description}`);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      this.logger.error(`Failed to record security event ${input.type}: ${(error as Error).message}`);\n      if (tenantScoped) throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  async recordLoginSuccess(tenantId: string, userId: string, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string, deviceId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      type: SecurityEventType.LOGIN_SUCCESS,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.LOW,\n      description: `Login success user=${userId} device=${deviceId || 'unknown'}`,\n      safeMetadata: { userId, deviceId },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordLoginFailure(tenantId: string, email: string, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string, reason?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      type: SecurityEventType.LOGIN_FAILURE,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n      description: `Login failure emailHash=${this.hashEmail(email)} reason=${reason || 'unknown'}`,\n      safeMetadata: { emailDomain: email.split('@')[1], reason },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordLogout(tenantId: string, userId: string, sessionId?: string, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      type: SecurityEventType.LOGOUT,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.LOW,\n      description: `Logout user=${userId} session=${sessionId || 'unknown'}`,\n      safeMetadata: { userId, sessionId },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordMfaSuccess(tenantId: string, userId: string, factor: string, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      type: SecurityEventType.MFA_SUCCESS,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.LOW,\n      description: `MFA success user=${userId} factor=${factor}`,\n      safeMetadata: { userId, factor },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async recordMfaFailure(tenantId: string, userId: string, factor: string, ipHash?: string, requestId?: string, reason?: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.record({\n      tenantId,\n      userId,\n      type: SecurityEventType.MFA_FAILURE,\n      severity: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n      description: `MFA failure user=${userId} factor=${factor} reason=${reason || 'unknown'}`,\n      safeMetadata: { userId, factor, reason },\n      ipHash,\n      requestId,\n    });\n  }\n\n  async listEvents(tenantId: string, filters?: { userId?: string; type?: string; severity?: string; fromDate?: Date; toDate?: Date; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number; page: number; limit: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (filters?.userId) where.userId = filters.userId;\n    if (filters?.type) where.type = filters.type;\n    if (filters?.severity) where.severity = filters.severity;\n    if (filters?.fromDate || filters?.toDate) {\n      where.createdAt = {};\n      if (filters.fromDate) where.createdAt.gte = filters.fromDate;\n      if (filters.toDate) where.createdAt.lte = filters.toDate;\n    }\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).securityEvent?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: offset, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).securityEvent?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n\n    return { data, total, page, limit };\n  }\n\n  // Backward compatibility aliases for old SecurityEventsService\n  async list(filter: any): Promise<any> {\n    const tenantId = filter?.tenantId || 'platform';\n    const result = await this.listEvents(tenantId, {\n      userId: filter?.userId,\n      type: filter?.type,\n      severity: filter?.severity,\n      page: filter?.page,\n      limit: filter?.limit,\n    });\n    return { items: result.data, pagination: { page: result.page, limit: result.limit, totalItems: result.total } };\n  }\n\n  async resolve(tenantId: string, eventId: string, resolvedById: string, resolution: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await (this.prisma as any).securityEvent?.updateMany({\n        where: { id: eventId, tenantId },\n        data: { resolved: true, resolvedAt: new Date(), resolvedById, resolution: resolution.substring(0, 500) },\n      });\n    } catch {}\n  }\n\n  private mapToEnterpriseCategory(type: string): any {\n    const mapping: Record<string, string> = {\n      [SecurityEventType.LOGIN_SUCCESS]: 'LOGIN_SUCCESS',\n      [SecurityEventType.LOGIN_FAILURE]: 'LOGIN_FAILURE',\n      [SecurityEventType.LOGOUT]: 'LOGOUT',\n      [SecurityEventType.MFA_REQUIRED]: 'MFA_REQUIRED',\n      [SecurityEventType.MFA_SUCCESS]: 'MFA_SUCCESS',\n      [SecurityEventType.MFA_FAILURE]: 'MFA_FAILURE',\n      [SecurityEventType.SSO_LOGIN_STARTED]: 'SSO_LOGIN_STARTED',\n      [SecurityEventType.SSO_LOGIN_SUCCESS]: 'SSO_LOGIN_SUCCESS',\n      [SecurityEventType.SSO_LOGIN_FAILURE]: 'SSO_LOGIN_FAILURE',\n      [SecurityEventType.API_KEY_CREATED]: 'API_KEY_CREATED',\n      [SecurityEventType.API_KEY_ROTATED]: 'API_KEY_ROTATED',\n      [SecurityEventType.API_KEY_REVOKED]: 'API_KEY_REVOKED',\n      [SecurityEventType.SESSION_CREATED]: 'SESSION_CREATED',\n      [SecurityEventType.SESSION_REVOKED]: 'SESSION_REVOKED',\n      [SecurityEventType.SESSION_SUSPICIOUS]: 'SESSION_SUSPICIOUS',\n      [SecurityEventType.DEVICE_REGISTERED]: 'DEVICE_REGISTERED',\n      [SecurityEventType.DEVICE_TRUSTED]: 'DEVICE_TRUSTED',\n      [SecurityEventType.DEVICE_REVOKED]: 'DEVICE_REVOKED',\n      [SecurityEventType.SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGED]: 'SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGED',\n      [SecurityEventType.PRIVILEGED_ACTION]: 'PRIVILEGED_ACTION',\n      [SecurityEventType.SECURITY_ALERT]: 'SECURITY_ALERT',\n    };\n    return mapping[type] || 'SECURITY_ALERT';\n  }\n\n  private hashEmail(email: string): string {\n    return createHash('sha256').update(email.toLowerCase()).digest('hex').substring(0, 8);\n  }\n}\n","usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/security-events.service.outbox.spec.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/security-events.service.ts","messages":[],"suppressedMessages":[],"errorCount":0,"fatalErrorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fixableErrorCount":0,"fixableWarningCount":0,"usedDeprecatedRules":[]},{"filePath":"/home/user/White-Label01-Crypto-Copy-Trading-App/whitelabel-copytrade/apps/api/src/modules/security/security-policy.service.ts","messages":[{"ruleId":"@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any","severity":1,"message":"Unexpected '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { SecurityPolicy } from './security.types';\nimport { randomUUID } from 'crypto';\n\n/**\n * Resolves tenant/platform security policy: MFA requirements, session duration, idle timeout, password/security requirements, device trust, API-key rules, and SSO enforcement.\n * Policy precedence explicit, tenant cannot weaken mandatory platform-wide security.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class SecurityPolicyService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(SecurityPolicyService.name);\n  private readonly platformPolicy: SecurityPolicy;\n\n  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {\n    this.platformPolicy = {\n      id: 'platform_default',\n      tenantId: null,\n      policyVersion: process.env.SECURITY_POLICY_VERSION || 'v1.0.0',\n      mfaRequired: process.env.SECURITY_MFA_REQUIRED === 'true',\n      mfaForPrivilegedRoles: process.env.SECURITY_MFA_PRIVILEGED !== 'false',\n      mfaForSensitiveOperations: process.env.SECURITY_MFA_SENSITIVE !== 'false',\n      sessionAbsoluteTimeoutSec: parseInt(process.env.SECURITY_SESSION_ABSOLUTE_TIMEOUT || '86400', 10),\n      sessionIdleTimeoutSec: parseInt(process.env.SECURITY_SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT || '1800', 10),\n      maxConcurrentSessions: parseInt(process.env.SECURITY_MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS || '5', 10),\n      deviceTrustDurationDays: parseInt(process.env.SECURITY_DEVICE_TRUST_DAYS || '30', 10),\n      apiKeyExpirationDays: parseInt(process.env.SECURITY_API_KEY_EXPIRY_DAYS || '90', 10),\n      apiKeyRotationDays: parseInt(process.env.SECURITY_API_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS || '30', 10),\n      ssoEnforced: process.env.SECURITY_SSO_ENFORCED === 'true',\n      allowedSsoDomains: (process.env.SECURITY_ALLOWED_SSO_DOMAINS || '').split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),\n      jitProvisioning: process.env.SECURITY_JIT_ENABLED === 'true',\n      privilegedReauthRequired: process.env.SECURITY_PRIVILEGED_REAUTH !== 'false',\n      securityNotifications: process.env.SECURITY_NOTIFICATIONS !== 'false',\n      passwordMinLength: parseInt(process.env.SECURITY_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH || '12', 10),\n      isActive: true,\n      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async getEffectivePolicy(params: { tenantId?: string; userId?: string }): Promise<SecurityPolicy> {\n    try {\n      if (params.tenantId) {\n        const tenantPolicy = await (this.prisma as any).securityPolicy?.findFirst({\n          where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, isActive: true },\n          orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        });\n        if (tenantPolicy) {\n          return this.mergeWithPlatform(this.mapToPolicy(tenantPolicy));\n        }\n      }\n\n      const platformPolicy = await (this.prisma as any).securityPolicy?.findFirst({\n        where: { tenantId: null, isActive: true },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n      if (platformPolicy) {\n        return this.mapToPolicy(platformPolicy);\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to fetch security policy from DB: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n    return this.platformPolicy;\n  }\n\n  async getPlatformPolicy(): Promise<SecurityPolicy> {\n    return this.getEffectivePolicy({});\n  }\n\n  async getTenantPolicy(tenantId: string): Promise<SecurityPolicy> {\n    return this.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId });\n  }\n\n  async listPolicies(): Promise<SecurityPolicy[]> {\n    try {\n      const records = await (this.prisma as any).securityPolicy?.findMany({ orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } }) || [];\n      return records.map((r: any) => this.mapToPolicy(r));\n    } catch {\n      return [this.platformPolicy];\n    }\n  }\n\n  async createOrUpdatePolicy(input: {\n    tenantId?: string | null;\n    policyVersion: string;\n    mfaRequired?: boolean;\n    mfaForPrivilegedRoles?: boolean;\n    mfaForSensitiveOperations?: boolean;\n    sessionAbsoluteTimeoutSec?: number;\n    sessionIdleTimeoutSec?: number;\n    maxConcurrentSessions?: number;\n    deviceTrustDurationDays?: number;\n    apiKeyExpirationDays?: number;\n    apiKeyRotationDays?: number;\n    ssoEnforced?: boolean;\n    allowedSsoDomains?: string[];\n    jitProvisioning?: boolean;\n    privilegedReauthRequired?: boolean;\n    securityNotifications?: boolean;\n    passwordMinLength?: number;\n    actorId: string;\n  }): Promise<SecurityPolicy> {\n    const tenantId = input.tenantId || null;\n\n    // Enforce platform mandatory requirements cannot be weakened by tenant\n    if (tenantId) {\n      const platform = policyVersion: string }[];\n    total: number;\n  }> {\n    const from = params.fromDate || new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);\n    const to = params.toDate || new Date();\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId });\n\n    const signals: any[] = [];\n\n    // Fetch security events for analysis\n    let events: any[] = [];\n    try {\n      events = await (this.prisma as any).securityEvent?.findMany({\n        where: { tenantId: params.tenantId, ...(params.userId ? { userId: params.userId } : {}), createdAt: { gte: from, lte: to } },\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        take: 500,\n      }) || [];\n    } catch {\n      events = [];\n    }\n\n    // Rule: repeated failed login\n    const failedLogins = events.filter((e: any) => e.type === 'LOGIN_FAILURE' || e.type === SecurityEventType.LOGIN_FAILURE);\n    if (failedLogins.length >= 5) {\n      signals.push({\n        ruleId: 'REPEATED_FAILED_LOGIN',\n        riskLevel: failedLogins.length >= 10 ? SecurityRisk.HIGH : SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n        decision: failedLogins.length >= 10 ? SecurityDecision.DENY : SecurityDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED,\n        summary: `${failedLogins.length} failed login attempts in last 24h`,\n        recommendedAction: failedLogins.length >= 10 ? 'BLOCK_IP_AND_REQUIRE_MFA' : 'REQUIRE_MFA_AND_NOTIFY',\n        sourceEventIds: failedLogins.slice(0, 10).map((e: any) => e.id),\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Rule: repeated MFA failure\n    const mfaFailures = events.filter((e: any) => e.type === SecurityEventType.MFA_FAILURE);\n    if (mfaFailures.length >= 3) {\n      signals.push({\n        ruleId: 'REPEATED_MFA_FAILURE',\n        riskLevel: mfaFailures.length >= 5 ? SecurityRisk.HIGH : SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n        decision: SecurityDecision.SUSPICIOUS,\n        summary: `${mfaFailures.length} MFA failures in last 24h`,\n        recommendedAction: 'REQUIRE_RECOVERY_AND_NOTIFY',\n        sourceEventIds: mfaFailures.slice(0, 10).map((e: any) => e.id),\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Rule: API-key abuse - unusual spike\n    const apiKeyCreations = events.filter((e: any) => e.type === SecurityEventType.API_KEY_CREATED);\n    if (apiKeyCreations.length >= 5) {\n      signals.push({\n        ruleId: 'API_KEY_ABUSE',\n        riskLevel: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n        decision: SecurityDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED,\n        summary: `${apiKeyCreations.length} API keys created in last 24h`,\n        recommendedAction: 'REVIEW_API_KEY_SCOPES',\n        sourceEventIds: apiKeyCreations.slice(0, 10).map((e: any) => e.id),\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Rule: revoked key reuse attempt\n    const revokedReuse = events.filter((e: any) => e.type === 'API_KEY_REVOKED_REUSE' || (e.description && e.description.includes('REVOKED')));\n    if (revokedReuse.length > 0) {\n      signals.push({\n        ruleId: 'REVOKED_KEY_REUSE',\n        riskLevel: SecurityRisk.HIGH,\n        decision: SecurityDecision.DENY,\n        summary: `Attempt to use revoked API key detected`,\n        recommendedAction: 'BLOCK_AND_ALERT',\n        sourceEventIds: revokedReuse.slice(0, 5).map((e: any) => e.id),\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Rule: expired key use\n    const expiredUse = events.filter((e: any) => e.type === 'API_KEY_EXPIRED_USE');\n    if (expiredUse.length > 0) {\n      signals.push({\n        ruleId: 'EXPIRED_KEY_USE',\n        riskLevel: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n        decision: SecurityDecision.DENY,\n        summary: `Attempt to use expired API key`,\n        recommendedAction: 'ROTATE_KEY_AND_NOTIFY',\n        sourceEventIds: expiredUse.slice(0, 5).map((e: any) => e.id),\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Rule: impossible session state - session created and revoked quickly\n    const sessionCreated = events.filter((e: any) => e.type === SecurityEventType.SESSION_CREATED);\n    const sessionRevoked = events.filter((e: any) => e.type === SecurityEventType.SESSION_REVOKED);\n    if (sessionCreated.length >= 10 && sessionRevoked.length >= 10) {\n      signals.push({\n        ruleId: 'IMPOSSIBLE_SESSION_STATE',\n        riskLevel: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n        decision: SecurityDecision.SUSPICIOUS,\n        summary: `High session churn: ${sessionCreated.length} created, ${sessionRevoked.length} revoked in 24h`,\n        recommendedAction: 'REVIEW_SESSION_ACTIVITY',\n        sourceEventIds: [...sessionCreated.slice(0, 5), ...sessionRevoked.slice(0, 5)].map((e: any) => e.id),\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Rule: repeated SSO failures\n    const ssoFailures = events.filter((e: any) => e.type === SecurityEventType.SSO_LOGIN_FAILURE);\n    if (ssoFailures.length >= 3) {\n      signals.push({\n        ruleId: 'REPEATED_SSO_FAILURES',\n        riskLevel: ssoFailures.length >= 5 ? SecurityRisk.HIGH : SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n        decision: SecurityDecision.REVIEW_REQUIRED,\n        summary: `${ssoFailures.length} SSO login failures in 24h`,\n        recommendedAction: 'CHECK_SSO_CONFIG_AND_IDP',\n        sourceEventIds: ssoFailures.slice(0, 10).map((e: any) => e.id),\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Rule: excessive session creation\n    if (sessionCreated.length >= 20) {\n      signals.push({\n        ruleId: 'EXCESSIVE_SESSION_CREATION',\n        riskLevel: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n        decision: SecurityDecision.SUSPICIOUS,\n        summary: `Excessive session creation: ${sessionCreated.length} sessions in 24h`,\n        recommendedAction: 'ENFORCE_CONCURRENT_LIMIT_AND_REVIEW',\n        sourceEventIds: sessionCreated.slice(0, 10).map((e: any) => e.id),\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Rule: new device + high risk (preserve existing SuspiciousLoginDetector logic)\n    const newDeviceLogins = events.filter((e: any) => e.type === 'NEW_DEVICE_LOGIN' || e.type === SecurityEventType.DEVICE_REGISTERED);\n    if (newDeviceLogins.length >= 3) {\n      signals.push({\n        ruleId: 'NEW_DEVICE_BURST',\n        riskLevel: SecurityRisk.MEDIUM,\n        decision: SecurityDecision.STEP_UP_REQUIRED,\n        summary: `${newDeviceLogins.length} new device logins in 24h`,\n        recommendedAction: 'REQUIRE_MFA_FOR_NEW_DEVICES',\n        sourceEventIds: newDeviceLogins.slice(0, 10).map((e: any) => e.id),\n        policyVersion: policy.policyVersion,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Persist signals\n    for (const signal of signals) {\n      try {\n        await (this.prisma as any).securityThreatSignal?.create({\n          data: {\n            id: randomUUID(),\n            tenantId: params.tenantId,\n            userId: params.userId || null,\n            ruleId: signal.ruleId,\n            riskLevel: signal.riskLevel,\n            decision: signal.decision,\n            sourceEventIds: signal.sourceEventIds,\n            safeSummary: signal.summary.substring(0, 1000),\n            policyVersion: signal.policyVersion,\n            createdAt: new Date(),\n          },\n        });\n\n        await this.eventService.record({\n          tenantId: params.tenantId,\n          userId: params.userId || null,\n          type: SecurityEventType.SECURITY_ALERT,\n          severity: signal.riskLevel,\n          description: `Threat detected rule=${signal.ruleId} ${signal.summary}`,\n          safeMetadata: { ruleId: signal.ruleId, riskLevel: signal.riskLevel, decision: signal.decision, recommendedAction: signal.recommendedAction },\n        });\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        this.logger.warn(`Failed to persist threat signal ${signal.ruleId}: ${e.message}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    this.logger.log(`Threat detection completed tenant=${params.tenantId} signals=${signals.length} eventsScanned=${events.length}`);\n\n    return { signals, total: signals.length };\n  }\n\n  async listThreats(tenantId: string, filters?: { userId?: string; riskLevel?: SecurityRisk; ruleId?: string; resolved?: boolean; page?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<{ data: any[]; total: number }> {\n    const page = filters?.page || 1;\n    const limit = filters?.limit || 20;\n    const offset = (page - 1) * limit;\n\n    const where: any = { tenantId };\n    if (filters?.userId) where.userId = filters.userId;\n    if (filters?.riskLevel) where.riskLevel = filters.riskLevel;\n    if (filters?.ruleId) where.ruleId = filters.ruleId;\n    if (filters?.resolved !== undefined) where.resolved = filters.resolved;\n\n    const [data, total] = await Promise.all([\n      (this.prisma as any).securityThreatSignal?.findMany({ where, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, skip: offset, take: limit }) || [],\n      (this.prisma as any).securityThreatSignal?.count({ where }) || 0,\n    ]);\n\n    return { data, total };\n  }\n\n  async resolveThreat(signalId: string, tenantId: string, resolverId: string, resolution: string): Promise<any | null> {\n    try {\n      const updated = await (this.prisma as any).securityThreatSignal?.update({\n        where: { id: signalId },\n        data: { resolved: true, resolvedAt: new Date(), resolvedById: resolverId },\n      });\n\n      await this.eventService.record({\n        tenantId,\n        userId: resolverId,\n        type: SecurityEventType.SECURITY_ALERT,\n        severity: SecurityRisk.LOW,\n        description: `Threat signal resolved signalId=${signalId} resolution=${resolution}`,\n        safeMetadata: { signalId, resolution: resolution.substring(0, 500) },\n      });\n\n      return updated || null;\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (isRecordNotFound(e)) return null;\n      throw e;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Backward compatibility: old SuspiciousLoginDetector API used by auth.service.ts\n  async assess(signals: { tenantId: string; userId: string; emailIndex: string; ipHash: string; deviceId: string; userAgent: string | null; requestId: string; geoLabel: string | null }): Promise<{ isNewDevice: boolean; isNewIp: boolean; recentFailureCount: number; distinctIpCount: number; riskScore: number; requiresNotification: boolean }> {\n    return this.assessLoginRisk(signals);\n  }\n\n  async recordFailure(tenantId: string, ipHash: string, requestId: string): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      if (this.cache) {\n        const key = `security:failed-ip:${tenantId}:${ipHash}`;\n        const count = await this.cache.increment(key, 900);\n        if (count === 25) {\n          await this.eventService.record({\n            tenantId,\n            type: SecurityEventType.SECURITY_ALERT,\n            severity: SecurityRisk.HIGH,\n            description: 'A single client produced 25 failed sign-in attempts within 15 minutes.',\n            safeMetadata: { windowSeconds: 900, attempts: count, ipHash, requestId },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`recordFailure failed: ${e.message}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Preserve existing suspicious login detection logic\n  async assessLoginRisk(signals: { tenantId: string; userId: string; emailIndex: string; ipHash: string; deviceId: string; userAgent: string | null; requestId: string; geoLabel: string | null }): Promise<{ isNewDevice: boolean; isNewIp: boolean; recentFailureCount: number; distinctIpCount: number; riskScore: number; requiresNotification: boolean }> {\n    const since = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 3_600_000);\n\n    try {\n      const [knownDevice, knownIp, recentFailureCount, distinctIps] = await Promise.all([\n        (this.prisma as any).userSession?.findFirst({ where: { userId: signals.userId, deviceId: signals.deviceId }, select: { id: true } }) || null,\n        (this.prisma as any).loginAttempt?.findFirst({ where: { userId: signals.userId, ipHash: signals.ipHash, successful: true }, select: { id: true } }) || null,\n        (this.prisma as any).loginAttempt?.count({ where: { tenantId: signals.tenantId, emailIndex: signals.emailIndex, successful: false, createdAt: { gte: since } } }) || 0,\n        (this.prisma as any).loginAttempt?.findMany({ where: { userId: signals.userId, createdAt: { gte: since } }, select: { ipHash: true }, distinct: ['ipHash'] }) || [],\n      ]);\n\n      const isNewDevice = knownDevice === null;\n      const isNewIp = knownIp === null;\n      const distinctIpCount = distinctIps.length;\n\n      let riskScore = 0;\n      if (isNewDevice) riskScore += 35;\n      if (isNewIp) riskScore += 25;\n      if (recentFailureCount >= 3) riskScore += Math.min(30, recentFailureCount * 5);\n      if (distinctIpCount >= 5) riskScore += 20;\n\n      return {\n        isNewDevice,\n        isNewIp,\n        recentFailureCount,\n        distinctIpCount,\n        riskScore: Math.min(100, riskScore),\n        requiresNotification: isNewDevice || riskScore >= 60,\n      };\n    } catch {\n      return { isNewDevice: true, isNewIp: true, recentFailureCount: 0, distinctIpCount: 1, riskScore: 35, requiresNotification: true };\n    }\n Delete,\n  Body,\n  Param,\n  Query,\n  UseGuards,\n  Req,\n  ForbiddenException,\n  BadRequestException,\n} from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { AuthGuard } from '@nestjs/passport';\nimport { RequirePermissions } from '../../common/decorators/permissions.decorator';\nimport { Permission } from '@wlct/shared-types';\nimport { CurrentUser } from '../../common/decorators/current-user.decorator';\nimport { CurrentTenant, TenantId } from '../../common/decorators/current-tenant.decorator';\nimport { SecurityPolicyService } from './security-policy.service';\nimport { EnterpriseSsoService } from './enterprise-sso.service';\nimport { SsoProviderFactory } from './sso-provider.factory';\nimport { ApiKeyService } from './api-key.service';\nimport { SessionSecurityService } from './session-security.service';\nimport { DeviceTrustService } from './device-trust.service';\nimport { MfaPolicyService } from './mfa-policy.service';\nimport { SecurityEventService } from './security-event.service';\nimport { SecurityAuditService } from './security-audit.service';\nimport { SecurityThreatDetectionService } from './security-threat-detection.service';\nimport { CreateSamlConfigDto, CreateOidcConfigDto, UpdateSsoConfigDto } from './dto/sso-config.dto';\nimport { CryptoService } from '../../infrastructure/crypto/crypto.service';\nimport { CreateApiKeyDto, ListApiKeyDto, RotateApiKeyDto, RevokeApiKeyDto } from './dto/api-key.dto';\nimport { CreateSecurityPolicyDto, UpdateSecurityPolicyDto, SessionQueryDto, DeviceQueryDto, SecurityEventQueryDto, ThreatQueryDto } from './dto/security-policy.dto';\nimport { SsoProvider } from './security.types';\nimport { isPlatformPrincipal } from '../../common/guards/request-principal';\n\n/**\n * RBAC-protected security API for SSO, API keys, sessions, devices, security events, and policy management.\n * Tenant security admins → own tenant, privileged platform admins → PLATFORM_MANAGE, ordinary users → only own sessions/API keys/devices.\n */\n\n@Controller('security')\n@UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))\nexport class SecurityController {\n  constructor(\n    private readonly policyService: SecurityPolicyService,\n    private readonly ssoService: EnterpriseSsoService,\n    private readonly ssoFactory: SsoProviderFactory,\n    private readonly apiKeyService: ApiKeyService,\n    private readonly sessionService: SessionSecurityService,\n    private readonly deviceService: DeviceTrustService,\n    private readonly mfaPolicyService: MfaPolicyService,\n    private readonly eventService: SecurityEventService,\n    private readonly auditService: SecurityAuditService,\n    private readonly threatService: SecurityThreatDetectionService,\n    private readonly crypto: CryptoService,\n  ) {}\n\n  /** Keyed, non-reversible client IP for audit records (never the raw address). */\n  private ipHashOf(req: { ip?: string }): string | undefined {\n    return req.ip ? this.crypto.hashIp(req.ip) : undefined;\n  }\n\n  // ===== Security Policy =====\n\n  @Get('policy')\n  @RequirePermissions(Permission.SECURITY_POLICY_READ, Permission.PLATFORM_MANAGE, Permission.SECURITY_EVENT_READ)\n  async getPolicy(@CurrentTenant() tenant: any, @Query('tenantId') tenantIdQuery?: {\n  PASSWORD = 'PASSWORD',\n  TOTP = 'TOTP',\n  WEBAUTHN = 'WEBAUTHN',\n  SAML = 'SAML',\n  OIDC = 'OIDC',\n  RECOVERY = 'RECOVERY',\n}\n\nexport enum SessionState {\n  ACTIVE = 'ACTIVE',\n  EXPIRED = 'EXPIRED',\n  REVOKED = 'REVOKED',\n  SUSPICIOUS = 'SUSPICIOUS',\n}\n\nexport enum ApiKeyState {\n  ACTIVE = 'ACTIVE',\n  EXPIRED = 'EXPIRED',\n  REVOKED = 'REVOKED',\n  ROTATED = 'ROTATED',\n}\n\nexport enum DeviceState {\n  UNKNOWN = 'UNKNOWN',\n  PENDING_TRUST = 'PENDING_TRUST',\n  TRUSTED = 'TRUSTED',\n  REVOKED = 'REVOKED',\n}\n\nexport enum SsoProvider {\n  SAML = 'SAML',\n  OIDC = 'OIDC',\n}\n\nexport enum SecurityRisk {\n  LOW = 'LOW',\n  MEDIUM = 'MEDIUM',\n  HIGH = 'HIGH',\n  CRITICAL = 'CRITICAL',\n}\n\nexport enum SecurityDecision {\n  ALLOW = 'ALLOW',\n  STEP_UP_REQUIRED = 'STEP_UP_REQUIRED',\n  DENY = 'DENY',\n  SUSPICIOUS = 'SUSPICIOUS',\n  REVIEW_REQUIRED = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED',\n}\n\nexport enum SecurityEventType {\n  LOGIN_SUCCESS = 'LOGIN_SUCCESS',\n  LOGIN_FAILURE = 'LOGIN_FAILURE',\n  LOGOUT = 'LOGOUT',\n  MFA_REQUIRED = 'MFA_REQUIRED',\n  MFA_SUCCESS = 'MFA_SUCCESS',\n  MFA_FAILURE = 'MFA_FAILURE',\n  SSO_LOGIN_STARTED = 'SSO_LOGIN_STARTED',\n  SSO_LOGIN_SUCCESS = 'SSO_LOGIN_SUCCESS',\n  SSO_LOGIN_FAILURE = 'SSO_LOGIN_FAILURE',\n  API_KEY_CREATED = 'API_KEY_CREATED',\n  API_KEY_ROTATED = 'API_KEY_ROTATED',\n  API_KEY_REVOKED = 'API_KEY_REVOKED',\n  SESSION_CREATED = 'SESSION_CREATED',\n  SESSION_REVOKED = 'SESSION_REVOKED',\n  SESSION_SUSPICIOUS = 'SESSION_SUSPICIOUS',\n  DEVICE_REGISTERED = 'DEVICE_REGISTERED',\n  DEVICE_TRUSTED = 'DEVICE_TRUSTED',\n  DEVICE_REVOKED = 'DEVICE_REVOKED',\n  SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGED = 'SECURITY_POLICY_CHANGED',\n  PRIVILEGED_ACTION = 'PRIVILEGED_ACTION',\n  SECURITY_ALERT = 'SECURITY_ALERT',\n  // Preserve existing types\n  SUSPICIOUS_LOGIN = 'SUSPICIOUS_LOGIN',\n  NEW_DEVICE_LOGIN = 'NEW_DEVICE_LOGIN',\n  IMPOSSIBLE_TRAVEL = 'IMPOSSIBLE_TRAVEL',\n  BRUTE_FORCE_SUSPECTED = 'BRUTE_FORCE_SUSPECTED',\n  CREDENTIAL_STUFFING_SUSPECTED = 'CREDENTIAL_STUFFING_SUSPECTED',\n  TOKEN_REUSE = 'TOKEN_REUSE',\n  RATE_LIMIT_ABUSE = 'RATE_LIMIT_ABUSE',\n  PERMISSION_ESCALATION_ATTEMPT = 'PERMISSION_ESCALATION_ATTEMPT',\n  TENANT_ISOLATION_VIOLATION = 'TENANT_ISOLATION_VIOLATION',\n  ENCRYPTION_FAILURE = 'ENCRYPTION_FAILURE',\n}\n\nexport interface NormalizedSsoIdentity {\n  provider: SsoProvider;\n  issuer: string;\n  subject: string;\n  email: string;\n  emailVerified?: boolean;\n  displayName?: string;\n  firstName?: string;\n  lastName?: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  tenantSlug?: string;\n  providerReference: string;\n  groups?: string[];\n  roles?: string[];\n  amr?: AuthFactor[];\n  safeMetadata: Record<string, any>;\n}\n\nexport interface SsoProviderConfig {\n  id: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  providerType: SsoProvider;\n  state: 'DISABLED' | 'ENABLED' | 'ENFORCED';\n  issuer?: string;\n  audience?: string;\n  clientId?: string;\n  metadataUrl?: string;\n  entityId?: string;\n  acsUrl?: string;\n  ssoUrl?: string;\n  discoveryUrl?: string;\n  jwksUrl?: string;\n  allowedDomains: string[];\n  enforced: boolean;\n  jitEnabled: boolean;\n  defaultRole?: string;\n  scopes: string[];\n  isActive: boolean;\n  createdById?: string;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n}\n\nexport interface ApiKeyRecord {\n  id: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  userId: string;\n  name: string;\n  keyId: string;\n  fingerprint: string;\n  scopes: string[];\n  state: ApiKeyState;\n  ipAllowlist: string[];\n  expiresAt?: string;\n  lastUsedAt?: string;\n  revokedAt?: string;\n  rotatedAt?: string;\n  rotatedFromId?: string;\n  createdById?: string;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n}\n\nexport interface SessionSecurityRecord {\n  id: string;\n  userId: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  deviceId: string;\n  state: SessionState;\n  ipHash: string;\n  userAgentHash?: string;\n  geoLabel?: string;\n  createdAt: string;\n  lastSeenAt: string;\n  expiresAt: string;\n  idleExpiresAt?: string;\n  absoluteExpiresAt?: string;\n  revokedAt?: string;\n  suspicious: boolean;\n  trusted: boolean;\n  safeMetadata: Record<string, any>;\n}\n\nexport interface DeviceTrustRecord {\n  id: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  userId: string;\n  deviceId: string;\n  deviceHash: string;\n  state: DeviceState;\n  trustedAt?: string;\n  expiresAt?: string;\n  lastSeenAt: string;\n  revokedAt?: string;\n  ipHash?: string;\n  userAgentHash?: string;\n  safeMetadata: Record<string, any>;\n}\n\nexport interface SecurityPolicy {\n  id: string;\n  tenantId: string | null;\n  policyVersion: string;\n  mfaRequired: boolean;\n  mfaForPrivilegedRoles: boolean;\n  mfaForSensitiveOperations: boolean;\n  sessionAbsoluteTimeoutSec: number;\n  sessionIdleTimeoutSec: number;\n  maxConcurrentSessions: number;\n  deviceTrustDurationDays: number;\n  apiKeyExpirationDays: number;\n  apiKeyRotationDays: number;\n  ssoEnforced: boolean;\n  allowedSsoDomains: string[];\n  jitProvisioning: boolean;\n  privilegedReauthRequired: boolean;\n  securityNotifications: boolean;\n  passwordMinLength: number;\n  isActive: boolean;\n  createdAt: string;\n  updatedAt: string;\n}\n\nexport interface SecurityEvent {\n  id?: string;\n  tenantId: string | null;\n  userId?: string | null;\n  type: SecurityEventType;\n  severity: SecurityRisk;\n  description: string;\n  safeMetadata?: Record<string, any>;\n  ipHash?: string;\n  userAgent?: string;\n  requestId?: string;\n  createdAt?: string;\n}\n\nexport interface ThreatSignal {\n  id: string;\n  tenantId: string;\n  userId?: string;\n  ruleId: string;\n  riskLevel: SecurityRisk;\n  decision: SecurityDecision;\n  sourceEventIds: string[];\n  safeSummary: string;\n  policyVersion?: string;\n  recommendedAction: string;\n  createdAt: string;\n}\n\nexport const SENSITIVE_SECURITY_FIELDS = [\n  'password',\n  'secret',\n  'token',\n  'assertion',\n  'samlResponse',\n  'idToken',\n  'accessToken',\n  'refreshToken',\n  'privateKey',\n  'apiKey',\n  'recoveryCode',\n  'clientSecret',\n  'certificatePrivate',\n];\n\nexport function sanitizeSecurityMetadata(metadata: Record<string, any>): Record<string, any> {\n  const sanitized: Record<string, any> = {};\n  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(metadata)) {\n    const lower = k.toLowerCase();\n    if (SENSITIVE_SECURITY_FIELDS.some((f) => lower.includes(f.toLowerCase()))) {\n      sanitized[k] = '[REDACTED]';\n    } else if (typeof v === 'object' && v !== null) {\n      sanitized[k] = sanitizeSecurityMetadata(v as any);\n    } else {\n      sanitized[k] = v;\n    }\n  }\n  return sanitized;\n}\n\nexport function hashValue(value: string): string {\n  // Deterministic hash for safe reference, not cryptographic - HMAC used in persistence\n  return createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex').substring(0, '@nestjs/common';\nimport { PrismaService } from '../../infrastructure/prisma/prisma.service';\nimport { SecurityPolicyService } from './security-policy.service';\nimport { SecurityEventService } from './security-event.service';\nimport { SecurityAuditService } from './security-audit.service';\nimport { SessionState, SecurityEventType, SecurityRisk } from './security.types';\nimport { CacheService } from '../../infrastructure/redis/cache.service';\n\n/**\n * Session lifecycle security: issuance metadata, rotation, revocation, idle timeout, absolute timeout, suspicious-session detection, and global logout support.\n * Integrates with existing session/token implementation, does not create second auth system.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class SessionSecurityService {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(SessionSecurityService.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly policyService: SecurityPolicyService,\n    private readonly eventService: SecurityEventService,\n    private readonly auditService: SecurityAuditService,\n    private readonly cache: CacheService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async registerSession(params: {\n    sessionId: string;\n    userId: string;\n    tenantId: string;\n    deviceId: string;\n    ipHash: string;\n    userAgent?: string;\n    geoLabel?: string;\n    requestId?: string;\n  }): Promise<void> {\n    const policy = await this.policyService.getEffectivePolicy({ tenantId: params.tenantId });\n\n    // Enforce concurrent session limits\n    await this.enforceConcurrentLimit(params.userId, params.tenantId, policy.maxConcurrentSessions);\n\n    const now = new Date();\n    const absoluteExpiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + policy.sessionAbsoluteTimeoutSec * 1000);\n    const './oidc-provider.service';\n\n/**\n * Selects tenant's configured SSO provider based on tenant/provider configuration without bypassing authentication.\n * SAML/OIDC support, explicit configuration, disabled rejected, outage becomes auth failure, no fallback to insecure when enforced.\n */\n\nclass DisabledSsoProvider implements ISsoProvider {\n  readonly providerType: SsoProvider;\n  readonly providerName = 'DISABLED';\n\n  constructor(providerType: SsoProvider = SsoProvider.SAML) {\n    this.providerType = providerType;\n  }\n\n  isAvailable(): boolean {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  async getMetadata(tenantId: string): Promise<SsoProviderMetadata> {\n    throw new SsoAuthError(\n      SsoReasonCode.PROVIDER_DISABLED,\n      `SSO provider ${this.providerType} disabled for tenant ${tenantId} - explicit authentication failure, no fallback to insecure login`,\n    );\n  }\n}\n\n@Injectable()\nexport class SsoProviderFactory {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(SsoProviderFactory.name);\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,\n    private readonly samlProvider: SamlProviderService,\n    private readonly oidcProvider: OidcProviderService,\n  ) {}\n\n  async getProvider(tenantId: string, providerType?: SsoProvider): Promise<ISsoProvider> {\n    try {\n      const where: any = { tenantId, isActive: true };\n      if (providerType) where.providerType = providerType;\n\n      const config = await (this.prisma as any).ssoConfiguration?.findFirst({\n        where,\n        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n      });\n\n      if (!config) {\n        if (providerType) {\n          this.logger.warn(`SSO config not found tenant=${tenantId} provider=${providerType} - explicit failure, no insecure fallback`);\n          return new DisabledSsoProvider(providerType);\n        }\n        // Try any enabled\n        const anyConfig = await (this.prisma as any).ssoConfiguration?.findFirst({\n          where: { tenantId, isActive: true, state: { in: ['ENABLED', 'ENFORCED'] } },\n          orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n        });\n        if (!anyConfig) {\n          this.logger.warn(`No SSO config for tenant=${tenantId} - disabled`);\n          return new DisabledSsoProvider();\n        }\n        return this.resolveProviderFromConfig(anyConfig);\n      }\n\n      if (config.state === 'DISABLED' || !config.isActive) {\n        this.logger.warn(`SSO provider disabled tenant=${tenantId} provider=${config.providerType} state=${config.state}`);\n        return new DisabledSsoProvider(config.providerType as SsoProvider);\n      }\n\n      return this.resolveProviderFromConfig(config);\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      this.logger.warn(`Failed to get SSO provider tenant=${tenantId}: ${e.message} - explicit failure`);\n      return new DisabledSsoProvider(providerType);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async getProviderByType(providerType: SsoProvider): Promise<ISsoProvider> {\n    switch (providerType) {\n      case SsoProvider.SAML:\n        return this.samlProvider;\n      case SsoProvider.OIDC:\n        return this.oidcProvider;\n      default:\n        this.logger.warn(`Unknown SSO provider type ${providerType} - rejected`);\n        return new DisabledSsoProvider(providerType);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async isSsoEnabled(tenantId: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    const provider = await this.getProvider(tenantId);\n    return provider.isAvailable();\n  }\n\n  async isSsoEnforced(tenantId: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    const config = await (this.prisma as any).ssoConfiguration?.findFirst({\n      where: { tenantId, isActive: true },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n    return config?.enforced === true && config?.state === 'ENFORCED';\n  }\n\n  private resolveProviderFromConfig(config: any): ISsoProvider {\n    switch (config.providerType) {\n      case 'SAML':\n      case SsoProvider.SAML:\n        return this.samlProvider;\n      case 'OIDC':\n      case SsoProvider.OIDC:\n        return this.oidcProvider;\n      default:\n        this.logger.warn(`Unknown provider type in config ${config.providerType}`);\n        return new DisabledSsoProvider(config.providerType as SsoProvider);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async listTenantProviders(tenantId: string): Promise<any[]> {\n    const configs = await (this.prisma as any).ssoConfiguration?.findMany({\n      where: { tenantId },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    }) || [];\n    return configs.map((c: any) => ({\n      id: c.id,\n      tenantId: c.tenantId,\n      providerType: c.providerType,\n      state: c.state,\n      issuer: c.issuer,\n      audience: c.audience,\n      enforced: c.enforced,\n      jitEnabled: Contains nothing\n   * sensitive by design.\n   */\n  async getPublicConfig(tenantId: string): Promise<TenantPublicConfigDto> {\n    return this.cache.remember(\n      CACHE_KEY.tenantPublicConfig(tenantId),\n      CACHE_TTL.TENANT_PUBLIC_CONFIG_SECONDS,\n      async () => {\n        const tenant = await this.prisma.tenant.findFirst({\n          where: { id: tenantId, deletedAt: null },\n          include: { branding: true },\n        });\n\n        if (!tenant) {\n          throw new NotFoundException('Tenant', tenantId);\n        }\n\n        const flags = await this.featureFlags.getAllForTenant(tenantId);\n\n        return {\n          tenantId: tenant.id,\n          slug: tenant.slug,\n          name: tenant.name,\n          status: tenant.status as TenantStatus,\n          branding: {\n            appName: tenant.branding?.appName ?? tenant.name,\n            logoUrl: tenant.branding?.logoUrl ?? null,\n            logoDarkUrl: tenant.branding?.logoDarkUrl ?? null,\n            faviconUrl: tenant.branding?.faviconUrl ?? null,\n            primaryColor: tenant.branding?.primaryColor ?? {},\n          },\n          defaultLocale: tenant.defaultLocale as SupportedLocale,\n          supportedLocales: tenant.supportedLocales as SupportedLocale[],\n          defaultCurrency: tenant.defaultCurrency as SupportedCurrency,\n          supportedCurrencies: tenant.supportedCurrencies as SupportedCurrency[],\n          features: flags,\n          registrationEnabled: flags.public_registration ?? true,\n          twoFactorRequired: flags.two_factor_mandatory ?? false,\n        };\n      },\n    );\n  }\n\n  async create(\n    dto: CreateTenantDto,\n    context: { actorId: string; ipHash: string; requestId: string },\n  ): Promise<TenantDto> {\n    const existing = await this.prisma.tenant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: dto.slug },\n      select: { id: true },\n    });\n\n    if (existing) {\n      throw new ConflictException('This slug is already taken by another organisation.', {\n        slug: dto.slug,\n      });\n    }\n\n    const ownerPasswordHash = dto.owner ? context.requestId : null,\n        payload: { customerId: created.id },\n      });\n\n      return created;\n    });\n\n    await this.featureFlags.applyDefaultsForTenant(tenant.id);\n\n    this.logger.info(\n      { event: 'tenant.created', tenantId: tenant.id, slug: tenant.slug },\n      'Tenant provisioned',\n    );\n\n    await this.audit.recordImmediate({\n      tenantId: tenant.id,\n      actorType: AuditActorType.USER,\n      actorId: context.actorId,\n      action: AuditAction.TENANT_CREATED,\n      outcome: AuditOutcome.SUCCESS,\n      resourceType: 'Tenant',\n      resourceId: tenant.id,\n      description: `Created tenant ${dto.slug}`,\n      metadata: { slug: dto.slug, withOwner: Boolean(dto.owner) },\n      ipHash: context.ipHash,\n      requestId: context.requestId,\n    });\n\n    return this.findById(tenant.id);\n  }\n\n  async update(\n    tenantId: string,\n    dto: UpdateTenantDto,\n    context: { actorId: string; ipHash: string; requestId: string },\n  ): Promise<TenantDto> {\n    const before = await this.prisma.tenant.findFirst({\n      where: { id: tenantId, deletedAt: null },\n      include: TENANT_INCLUDE,\n    });\n\n    if (!before) {\n      throw new NotFoundException('Tenant', tenantId);\n    }\n\n    if (!this.outbox) {\n      throw new Error('Transactional outbox is unavailable; refusing tenant update without its customer.updated event');\n    }\n    const updated = await this.prisma.withTenantRls(tenantId, async (tx) => {\n      const tenantUpdate = await tx.tenant.update({\n        where: { id: tenantId },\n        data: {\n          ...(dto.name !== undefined ? { contactPhone: dto.contactPhone } : {}),\n          ...(dto.countryCode !== undefined ? { countryCode: dto.countryCode } : {}),\n          ...(dto.defaultLocale !== undefined ? { defaultLocale: dto.defaultLocale } : {}),\n          ...(dto.supportedLocales !== undefined ? { supportedLocales: dto.supportedLocales } : {}),\n          ...(dto.defaultCurrency !== undefined ? { defaultCurrency: dto.defaultCurrency } : {}),\n          ...(dto.supportedCurrencies !== undefined\n            ? Updates include tenant/account/current-state/current-remaining predicates.
